CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.ADD_NUMBERS (
    inparam1                       IN    NUMBER,
    inparam2                       IN    NUMBER,
    outparam1                      OUT   NUMBER,
    outparam2                      OUT   NUMBER,
    outparam3                      OUT   VARCHAR2  /* OUT 매개변수 추가 */
) IS
BEGIN
    -- IN 파라미터 값을 더해서 OUT 파라미터에 할당
    outparam1   := inparam1 + inparam2;
    outparam2   := inparam1 - inparam2;

    -- 현재 시간을 문자열 형식으로 반환 (YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS 형식)
    outparam3   := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS');
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.API_02_03 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- API 자료수신 요청생성(국내 일별종가)
--
    w_tr_co_cd                     VARCHAR (10) := '00003';
    w_company                      VARCHAR (20) := 'KB_REAL';

    w_ymd                          DATE;
BEGIN
    if  p_ymd > '00000000'  then
            w_ymd := TO_DATE (p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');
    else    w_ymd := TRUNC (now ( ),'dd');
    end if;
    w_ymd := F_OPEN_YMD (w_ymd, '-');

    -- 일별종가 수신 요청 (02-03)
    INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
         ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
         , URL            /* _2- */
         , HEADERS        /* _3- */
         , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
         , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
         , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
         , REQUEST        /* _7- */
         , API_KEY        /* _8- */
         , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
         , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
         , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
         , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
         , KEY1           /* _13- */
         , NUM1           /* _14- */
         , PG_NM          /* _15- */
         )
    SELECT t2.COMPANY                                                   /* _1- */
         , t2.URL                                                       /* _2- */
         , t2.HEADERS                                                   /* _3- */
         , REPLACE(t2.QUERYPARAMS, '@iscd', t1.KOSCOM_CD)               /* _4- */
         , t2.TABLENAME                                                 /* _5- */
         , t2.SUBTABLE                                                  /* _6- */
         , '0'                                                          /* _7- */
         , TO_CHAR(now( ), 'yyyymmdd') || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))  /* _8- */
         , t2.KEY_VALUE                                                 /* _9- */
         , t2.SUB_KEY_VALUE                                             /* _10- */
         , '2402'                                                       /* _11- */
         , w_ymd                                                        /* _12- */
         , t1.KOSCOM_CD                                                 /* _13- */
         , 3                                                            /* _14- */
         , 'PR_API_02_03'                                               /* _15- */
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT KOSCOM_CD
              FROM SJM0JJ g1  /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE DANC_GB             IN ('A','C','D','G')
               AND NVL(ABOL_DT, w_ymd) >= w_ymd
            ) t1
           CROSS JOIN (SELECT COMPANY        /* _1- */
                            , URL            /* _2- */
                            , HEADERS        /* _3- */
                            , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
                            , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
                            , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
                            , KEY_VALUE      /* _7- */
                            , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _8- */
                         FROM API_PARAMS g1
                        WHERE TR_CO_CD = w_tr_co_cd
                          AND GR_CD    = '02'
                          AND SCD      = '03'
                          AND COMPANY  = w_company
                       ) t2;

    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.API_10_03 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- API 자료수신 요청생성(선물)
--
    w_tr_co_cd                     VARCHAR (10) := '00003';
    w_company                      VARCHAR (20) := 'KB_REAL';

    w_ymd                          DATE;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    if  p_ymd > '00000000'  then
            w_ymd := TO_DATE (p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');
    else    w_ymd := TRUNC (now ( ),'dd');
    end if;
    if  p_corp_gr = '2502'  then
            w_ymd := F_OPEN_YMD (w_ymd, '-1');
    else    w_ymd := F_OPEN_YMD (w_ymd, '-' );
    end if;

    w_msg := TO_CHAR (w_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '일 상품선물';

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.COMPANY                                                               /* _1- */
             , t1.URL                                                                   /* _2- */
             , t1.HEADERS                                                               /* _3- */
             , t1.QUERYPARAMS                                                           /* _4- */
             , t1.TABLENAME                                                             /* _5- */
             , t1.SUBTABLE                                                              /* _6- */
             , t1.KEY_VALUE                                                             /* _7- */
             , t1.SUB_KEY_VALUE                                                         /* _8- */
             , TO_CHAR(now ( ),'yyyymmdd') || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))  AS api_key  /* _9- */
             , cd.COM_TYPE                                                              /* _10- */
             , cd.SHRN_ISCD                                                             /* _11- */
             , cd.STND_ISCD                                                             /* _12- */
          FROM API_PARAMS  t1
             , FO_COM_CODE cd  /* 상품 선물/옵션 종목 */
         WHERE t1.TR_CO_CD  = w_tr_co_cd
           AND t1.GR_CD     = '10'
           AND t1.SCD       = '03'
           AND t1.COMPANY   = w_company
           AND cd.STND_ISCD IN (SELECT SJ_CD
                                  FROM SSM0KM ta  /* 파생 보유현황 */
                                 WHERE ta.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                                   AND ta.YMD     = w_ymd)
    ) loop
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@code', 'CF');
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@iscd', xx.shrn_iscd);
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@date1', TO_CHAR(w_ymd, 'yyyymmdd'));
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@date2', TO_CHAR(w_ymd, 'yyyymmdd'));
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@div', 'D');
        INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
             ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
             , URL            /* _2- */
             , HEADERS        /* _3- */
             , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
             , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
             , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
             , REQUEST        /* _7- */
             , API_KEY        /* _8- */
             , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
             , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
             , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
             , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
             , KEY1           /* _13- */
             , NUM1           /* _14- */
             , PG_NM          /* _15- */
             )
        VALUES ( xx.company        /* _1- */
               , xx.url            /* _2- */
               , xx.headers        /* _3- */
               , xx.queryparams    /* _4- */
               , xx.tablename      /* _5- */
               , xx.subtable       /* _6- */
               , '0'               /* _7- */
               , xx.api_key        /* _8- */
               , xx.key_value      /* _9- */
               , xx.sub_key_value  /* _10- */
               , p_corp_gr         /* _11- */
               , w_ymd             /* _12- */
               , xx.STND_ISCD      /* _13- */
               , 2                 /* _14- */
               , 'PR_API_10_03'    /* _15- */
               );
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg := w_msg;
END;
/

--
    w_tr_co_cd                     VARCHAR (10) := '00003';

    w_num1                         NUMBER;

BEGIN
    for api IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t1.JM_CD
             , t1.EXCD

         WHERE t1.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.JASAN_GB = '1'

        if  api.uspm_ymd >= TRUNC (now ( ),'dd') then
                w_new  := w_new + 1;

        else    w_num1 := 2;
        end if;
        w_cnt := w_cnt + 1;
        for xx IN (
            SELECT COMPANY                                                                  /* _1- */
                 , URL                                                                      /* _2- */

              FROM API_PARAMS t1

                   , xx.key_value      /* _9- */
                   , xx.sub_key_value  /* _10- */
                   , p_corp_gr         /* _11- */

                   , api.jm_cd         /* _13- */

                   , 'PR_API_13_02'    /* _15- */

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.API_13_02_200 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- API 해외주식 과거자료(200영업일) 요청
--
    w_ymd                          DATE;
    w_tr_co_cd                     VARCHAR (10) := '00003';
    w_company                      VARCHAR (20) := 'KB_REAL';

    w_cnt                          NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
    w_ymd := TO_DATE (p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');
    for api IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t1.JM_CD
             , t1.EXCD
             , t1.BLBG_TCKR  AS SYMB
          FROM SYM0YA t1
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.JASAN_GB = '1'
           AND t1.EXCD IS NOT NULL
           AND t1.USPM_YMD BETWEEN w_ymd AND F_OPEN_YMD(w_ymd,'+2')
    ) loop
        w_cnt := w_cnt + 1;
        for xx IN (
            SELECT COMPANY                                            /* _1- */
                 , URL                                                /* _2- */
                 , HEADERS                                            /* _3- */
                 , QUERYPARAMS                                        /* _4- */
                 , TABLENAME                                          /* _5- */
                 , SUBTABLE                                           /* _6- */
                 , KEY_VALUE                                          /* _7- */
                 , SUB_KEY_VALUE                                      /* _8- */
                 , p_ymd || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))  AS api_key  /* _9- */
              FROM API_PARAMS T1
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND T1.TR_CO_CD = w_tr_co_cd
               AND T1.GR_CD    = '13'
               AND T1.SCD      = '02'
               AND COMPANY     = w_company
        ) loop
            xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@excd', api.excd);
            xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@symb', api.symb);
            xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@gubn', '0');
            xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@bymd', p_ymd);

            INSERT INTO API_Q
                 ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
                 , URL            /* _2- */
                 , HEADERS        /* _3- */
                 , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
                 , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
                 , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
                 , REQUEST        /* _7- */
                 , API_KEY        /* _8- */

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.API_13_03 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- API 자료수신 요청생성(환율)
--
    w_tr_co_cd                     VARCHAR (10) := '00003';
    w_company                      VARCHAR (20) := 'KB_REAL';

    w_ymd                          DATE;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    if  p_ymd > '00000000'  then
            w_ymd := TO_DATE (p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');
    else    w_ymd := TRUNC (now ( ),'dd');
    end if;
    w_ymd := F_OPEN_YMD (w_ymd, '-');

    w_msg := TO_CHAR (w_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '일 FX@GBP, FX@HKD, FX@KRW, FX@SGD, FX@VND 환율';

    -- 환율
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.COMPANY                                                               /* _1- */
             , t1.URL                                                                   /* _2- */
             , t1.HEADERS                                                               /* _3- */
             , t1.QUERYPARAMS                                                           /* _4- */
             , t1.TABLENAME                                                             /* _5- */
             , t1.SUBTABLE                                                              /* _6- */
             , t1.KEY_VALUE                                                             /* _7- */
             , t1.SUB_KEY_VALUE                                                         /* _8- */
             , TO_CHAR(now ( ),'yyyymmdd') || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))  AS api_key  /* _9- */
             , cd.FRID                                                                  /* _10- */
             , cd.FRGN                                                                  /* _11- */
          FROM API_PARAMS   t1
             , API_FRGNCODE cd
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.TR_CO_CD = w_tr_co_cd
           AND t1.GR_CD    = '13'
           AND t1.SCD      = '03'
           AND t1.COMPANY  = w_company
           AND cd.FRID     = 'X'
           AND cd.FRGN     IN ('FX@GBP','FX@HKD','FX@KRW','FX@SGD','FX@VND')
    ) loop
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@mrkt', xx.frid);
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@iscd', xx.frgn);
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@date1', TO_CHAR(w_ymd, 'yyyymmdd'));
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@date2', TO_CHAR(w_ymd, 'yyyymmdd'));
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@div', 'D');
        INSERT INTO API_Q
             ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
             , URL            /* _2- */
             , HEADERS        /* _3- */
             , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
             , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
             , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
             , REQUEST        /* _7- */
             , API_KEY        /* _8- */
             , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
             , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
             , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
             , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
             , KEY1           /* _13- */
             , KEY2           /* _14- */
             , PG_NM          /* _15- */
             )
        VALUES ( xx.company         /* _1- */
               , xx.url             /* _2- */
               , xx.headers         /* _3- */
               , xx.queryparams     /* _4- */
               , xx.tablename       /* _5- */
               , xx.subtable        /* _6- */
               , '0'                /* _7- */
               , xx.api_key         /* _8- */
               , xx.key_value       /* _9- */
               , xx.sub_key_value   /* _10- */
               , p_corp_gr          /* _11- */
               , w_ymd              /* _12- */
               , xx.frid            /* _13- */
               , SUBSTR(xx.frgn,4)  /* _14- */
               , 'PR_API_13_03'     /* _15- */
               );
    end loop;

    w_msg := w_msg || ',지수(SPX-S&P500, NDX-NASDAQ100)';

    -- 지수
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.COMPANY                                                               /* _1- */
             , t1.URL                                                                   /* _2- */
             , t1.HEADERS                                                               /* _3- */
             , t1.QUERYPARAMS                                                           /* _4- */
             , t1.TABLENAME                                                             /* _5- */
             , t1.SUBTABLE                                                              /* _6- */
             , t1.KEY_VALUE                                                             /* _7- */
             , t1.SUB_KEY_VALUE                                                         /* _8- */
             , TO_CHAR(now ( ),'yyyymmdd') || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))  AS api_key  /* _9- */
             , cd.FRID                                                                  /* _10- */
             , cd.FRGN                                                                  /* _11- */
          FROM API_PARAMS   t1
             , API_FRGNCODE cd
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.TR_CO_CD = w_tr_co_cd
           AND t1.GR_CD    = '13'
           AND t1.SCD      = '03'
           AND t1.COMPANY  = w_company
           AND cd.FRID     = 'P'
           AND cd.FRGN     IN ('SPX','NDX')
    ) loop
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@mrkt', 'N');
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@iscd', xx.frgn);
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@date1', TO_CHAR(w_ymd, 'yyyymmdd'));
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@date2', TO_CHAR(w_ymd, 'yyyymmdd'));
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@div', 'D');
        INSERT INTO API_Q
             ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
             , URL            /* _2- */
             , HEADERS        /* _3- */
             , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
             , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
             , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
             , REQUEST        /* _7- */
             , API_KEY        /* _8- */
             , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
             , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
             , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
             , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
             , KEY1           /* _13- */
             , KEY2           /* _14- */
             , PG_NM          /* _15- */
             )
        VALUES ( xx.company         /* _1- */
               , xx.url             /* _2- */
               , xx.headers         /* _3- */
               , xx.queryparams     /* _4- */
               , xx.tablename       /* _5- */
               , xx.subtable        /* _6- */
               , '0'                /* _7- */
               , xx.api_key         /* _8- */
               , xx.key_value       /* _9- */
               , xx.sub_key_value   /* _10- */

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.API_17_14 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR,
    p_cre_dt                       IN    DATE DEFAULT now ( )
 ) AS
-- API 자료수신 요청생성(파생시가)
--
    w_tr_co_cd                     VARCHAR(10) := '00003';
    w_company                      VARCHAR(20) := 'KB_REAL';

    w_ymd                          DATE;
    w_us_ymd                       DATE;

    w_inc_ticksz                   NUMBER;
    w_ii                           NUMBER;
    w_stkprc_1                     NUMBER;
    w_stkprc_2                     NUMBER;

    w_srscd_call                   VARCHAR2(20);
    w_srscd_put                    VARCHAR2(20);

    w_api_key                      VARCHAR(64);
BEGIN
    if  p_ymd > '00000000'  then
            w_ymd := TO_DATE (p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');
    else    w_ymd := TRUNC (now ( ),'dd');
    end if;

    -- 지수요청시 당일은 존재하지 않으므로 전일자로 요청(미국시장 기준, premarket open자료 당일처리)
    if  w_ymd = TRUNC (now ( ),'dd')     then
        if TO_CHAR (now ( ), 'hh24mi') > '2230' then
                w_us_ymd := F_OPEN_US (w_ymd, '-');
        else    w_us_ymd := F_OPEN_US (w_ymd, '-1');  /* 지수요청시 당일은 존재하지 않으므로 전일자로 요청(미국시장과 일자차이) */
        end if;
    else
        w_us_ymd := F_OPEN_US (w_ymd, '-');
    end if;

    /* 해외옵션종목현재가 - 시차로 인해 AAMS 배분작업을 전영업일에 하므로 전영업일 종가에 update (2520 API 시세자료 요청화면 일자로 TRIGGER에서 처리) */
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t1.COMPANY  /* _1- */
             , t1.URL               /* _2- */
             , t1.HEADERS           /* _3- */
             , t1.QUERYPARAMS       /* _4- */
             , t1.TABLENAME         /* _5- */
             , t1.SUBTABLE          /* _6- */
             , t1.KEY_VALUE         /* _7- */
             , t1.SUB_KEY_VALUE     /* _8- */
             , t2.SRS_CD            /* _9- */
             , t2.STKPRC            /* _10- */
             , t2.BLBG_TCKR         /* _11- */
             , t2.ISIN_CD           /* _12- */
          FROM API_PARAMS t1
             , SRS_CD     t2
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.GR_CD    = '17'
           AND t1.SCD      = '14'
           AND t1.TR_CO_CD = w_tr_co_cd
           AND t1.COMPANY  = w_company
           AND (t2.EXPR_DATE IS NOT NULL OR t2.CRE_DT = p_cre_dt)
         ORDER BY t2.SRS_CD ASC
    ) loop
        w_api_key := TO_CHAR  (now ( ), 'yyyymmdd') || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ));
        INSERT INTO API_Q
             ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
             , URL            /* _2- */
             , HEADERS        /* _3- */
             , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
             , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
             , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
             , REQUEST        /* _7- */
             , API_KEY        /* _8- */
             , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
             , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
             , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
             , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
             , KEY1           /* _13- */
             , KEY2           /* _14- */
             , KEY3           /* _15- */
             , NUM1           /* _16- */
             , PG_NM          /* _17- */
             )
        VALUES ( xx.company                           /* _1- */
               , xx.url                               /* _2- */
               , xx.headers                           /* _3- */
               , '{ SRS_CD: "' || xx.srs_cd || '" }'  /* _4- */
               , xx.tablename                         /* _5- */
               , xx.subtable                          /* _6- */
               , '0'                                  /* _7- */
               , w_api_key                            /* _8- */
               , xx.key_value                         /* _9- */
               , xx.sub_key_value                     /* _10- */
               , p_corp_gr                            /* _11- */
               , w_us_ymd                             /* _12- */
               , xx.srs_cd                            /* _13- */
               , xx.blbg_tckr                         /* _14- */
               , xx.isin_cd                           /* _15- */
               , xx.stkprc                            /* _16- */
               , 'PR_API_17_14'                       /* _17- */
               );
    end loop;
    commit;
    p_msg := TO_CHAR (w_us_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '일 해외파생시가';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.API_17_16 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- API 자료수신 요청생성(파생종가)
--
    w_tr_co_cd                     VARCHAR (10) := '00003';
    w_company                      VARCHAR (20) := 'KB_REAL';

    w_ymd                          DATE;
BEGIN
    if  p_ymd > '00000000'  then
            w_ymd := TO_DATE (p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');
    else    w_ymd := TRUNC (now ( ),'dd');
    end if;

    -- 해외주식당일 종가
    for api IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT tt.jm_cd
             , tt.excd
          FROM (SELECT t1.JM_CD
                     , t1.EXCD
                  FROM SYM0YA t1  /* 해외 자산종목 */
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND t1.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.JASAN_GB = 'A'
                UNION ALL
                SELECT t1.RIGHT_JM_CD
                     , t1.EXCD
                  FROM SYM0YA t1  /* 해외 자산종목 */
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND t1.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.JASAN_GB = 'A'
                ) tt
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND jm_cd IS NOT NULL
           AND excd IS NOT NULL
    ) loop
        for xx IN (
            SELECT COMPANY                                                                  /* _1- */
                 , URL                                                                      /* _2- */
                 , HEADERS                                                                  /* _3- */
                 , QUERYPARAMS                                                              /* _4- */
                 , TABLENAME                                                                /* _5- */
                 , SUBTABLE                                                                 /* _6- */
                 , KEY_VALUE                                                                /* _7- */
                 , SUB_KEY_VALUE                                                            /* _8- */
                 , TO_CHAR(now ( ),'yyyymmdd') || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))  AS api_key  /* _9- */
              FROM API_PARAMS t1
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.TR_CO_CD = w_tr_co_cd
               AND t1.GR_CD    = '17'
               AND t1.SCD      = '16'
               AND t1.COMPANY  = w_company
        ) loop
            xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@srscd', api.jm_cd);
            xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@excd', api.excd);
            xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@date1', TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(w_ymd, -1), 'yyyymmdd'));
            xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@date2', TO_CHAR(w_ymd, 'yyyymmdd'));

            INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
                 ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
                 , URL            /* _2- */
                 , HEADERS        /* _3- */
                 , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
                 , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
                 , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
                 , REQUEST        /* _7- */
                 , API_KEY        /* _8- */
                 , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
                 , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
                 , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
                 , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
                 , KEY1           /* _13- */
                 , KEY2           /* _14- */
                 , PG_NM          /* _15- */
                 )
            VALUES ( xx.company                                                                     /* _1- */
                   , xx.url                                                                         /* _2- */
                   , xx.headers                                                                     /* _3- */
                   , xx.queryparams                                                                 /* _4- */
                   , xx.tablename                                                                   /* _5- */
                   , xx.subtable                                                                    /* _6- */
                   , '0'                                                                            /* _7- */
                   , xx.api_key                                                                     /* _8- */
                   , xx.key_value                                                                   /* _9- */
                   , xx.sub_key_value                                                               /* _10- */
                   , p_corp_gr                                                                      /* _11- */
                   , sysdate                                                                        /* _12- */
                   , api.jm_cd                                                                      /* _13- */
                   , TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(w_ymd,-1),'yyyymmdd') || '-' || TO_CHAR(w_ymd, 'yyyymmdd')  /* _14- */
                   , 'PR_API_17_16'                                                                 /* _15- */
                   );
        end loop;
    end loop;
    commit;
    p_msg := TO_CHAR (w_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '일 해외파생종가';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.API_17_20 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 옵션 CALL,PUT 종목 생성
--
    w_ymd                          DATE;

    w_srscd_call                   VARCHAR (20);
    w_srscd_put                    VARCHAR (20);
    w_call_nm                      VARCHAR(200);
    w_put_nm                       VARCHAR(200);

    w_cnt                          NUMBER;
    w_inc_ticksz                   NUMBER;
    w_stkprc                       NUMBER;
BEGIN
    if NVL (p_ymd,'00000000') > '00000000'      then
            w_ymd := TO_DATE (p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');
    else    w_ymd := TRUNC (now ( ),'dd');
    end if;

    DELETE FROM SRS_CD
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND NVL(EXPR_DATE, TO_CHAR (w_ymd,'yyyymmdd')) <= TO_CHAR(w_ymd,'yyyymmdd');

    UPDATE SRS_CD
       SET GIJUN_STKPRC_YN = 'N';

    for xx IN (
        WITH fri_dt AS (
             SELECT TO_DATE (t1.YMD,'yyyymmdd')  AS mangi
               FROM FW_CALENDAR t1  /* 달력 (연간정보) */
              WHERE 1 = 1
                AND t1.YMD        BETWEEN TO_CHAR (w_ymd,'yyyymmdd') AND TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY (ADD_MONTHS (w_ymd,1)),'yyyymmdd')
                AND t1.WEEKDAY_EN = 'FRI'
             )
        -- Main SQL --
        --------------
        SELECT DISTINCT pm.JM_CD             AS uspm_jm_cd    /* _1- */
             , TO_CHAR (dt.mangi,'yy')       AS yy            /* _2- */
             , TO_CHAR (dt.mangi,'mm')       AS mm            /* _3- */
             , CASE WHEN TO_CHAR (dt.mangi,'w')='3' THEN ''
                                                    ELSE TO_CHAR (dt.mangi,'w')
               END                           AS week          /* _4- */
             , NVL(ya.SRS_CD, ya.BLBG_TCKR)  AS jm_cd         /* _5- */
             , TRUNC(pm.JONGA)               AS strike_price  /* _6- */
             , CASE TO_CHAR (dt.mangi,'w') WHEN '1' THEN NVL(ya.OPT_1UNIT,0)
                                           WHEN '2' THEN NVL(ya.OPT_2UNIT,0)
                                           WHEN '4' THEN NVL(ya.OPT_4UNIT,0)
                                           WHEN '5' THEN NVL(ya.OPT_5UNIT,0)
                                                    ELSE NVL(ya.OPT_UNIT,0)
               END                           AS inc_ticksz    /* _7- */
          FROM USPM      pm  /* US Portfolio Model 일변 기준정보 */
             , USPM_PORT po  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
             , SYM0YA    ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             , FRI_DT    dt
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND pm.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr    /* 운용(자문)사 */
           AND pm.YMD      = (SELECT MAX(YMD)
                                FROM USPM ta  /* US Portfolio Model 일변 기준정보 */
                               WHERE 1 = 1
                                 AND ta.CORP_GR = P_CORP_GR  /* 운용(자문)사 */
                                 AND ta.YMD     <= w_ymd     /* 기준일자 */
                              )          /* 기준일자 */
           AND po.CORP_GR  = pm.CORP_GR   /* 운용(자문)사 */
           AND po.FUND_CD  = pm.FUND_CD   /* 펀드코드 */
           AND po.TYMD     = pm.YMD       /* 기준일자 */
           AND po.PORT_NUM = pm.PORT_NUM  /* 포트폴리오 Number */
           AND ya.CORP_GR  = pm.CORP_GR   /* 운용(자문)사 */
           AND ya.JM_CD    = pm.JM_CD     /* 종목코드 */
    ) loop
        SELECT xx.week || xx.jm_cd || SRS_MM || xx.yy || ' C'
             , xx.week || xx.jm_cd || SRS_MM || xx.yy || ' P'
             , CASE WHEN xx.week IS NULL THEN xx.jm_cd || SRS_MM || xx.yy || ' C'
                                         ELSE xx.jm_cd || SRS_MM || xx.yy || '(' || xx.week || 'W)' || ' C' END
             , CASE WHEN xx.week IS NULL THEN xx.jm_cd || SRS_MM || xx.yy || ' P'
                                         ELSE xx.jm_cd || SRS_MM || xx.yy || '(' || xx.week || 'W)' || ' P' END
          INTO w_srscd_call
             , w_srscd_put
             , w_call_nm
             , w_put_nm
          FROM SZX0YM t1  /* 년월 코드 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.YMD_GB = 'M'    /* 년월일구분[HX] */
           AND t1.YMD_ID = xx.mm  /* 년월일 ID */
        ;


        if  xx.strike_price > 9.99    then  xx.strike_price := TRUNC (xx.strike_price, -1);
        end if;

        -- CALL 종목생성 필요시 (PUT 복사해서 생성) ; SJ_GB = '2'

        MERGE INTO SRS_CD tt 
           USING DUAL ON ( SRS_CD = w_srscd_put || F_N0(xx.strike_price,0,1)
                       AND STKPRC = xx.strike_price )
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( w_srscd_put || F_N0(xx.strike_price, 0, 1)      /* _1- */
                    , xx.strike_price                                 /* _2- */
                    , xx.jm_cd                                        /* _3- */
                    , xx.uspm_jm_cd                                   /* _4- */
                    , NULL                                            /* _5- */
                    , NULL                                            /* _6- */
                    , NULL                                            /* _7- */
                    , SYSDATE                                         /* _8- */
                    , 'Y'                                             /* _9- */
                    , xx.yy || xx.mm || NVL(xx.week,'0')              /* _10- */
                    , w_put_nm || F_N0(xx.strike_price, 0, 1) || '-'
                               || xx.yy || xx.mm || NVL(xx.week,'0')  /* _11- */
                    , '3'                                             /* _12- */
                    , NULL                                            /* _13- */
                    , NULL                                            /* _14- */
                    )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET GIJUN_STKPRC_YN = 'Y'
                  , JM_NM           = w_put_nm || F_N0(xx.strike_price, 0, 1) || '-' || xx.yy || xx.mm || NVL(xx.week,'0');

        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(price_diff,0)
              INTO w_inc_ticksz
              FROM (SELECT stkprc
                         , LEAD(stkprc) OVER (ORDER BY stkprc) - stkprc  AS price_diff
                         , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (ORDER BY stkprc)          AS rn
                      FROM SRS_CD p1
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND exch_cd IS NOT NULL
                       AND stkprc  >= xx.strike_price
                       AND srs_cd  LIKE w_srscd_put || '%'
                    ) tt
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND rn = 1;

            if  xx.inc_ticksz = 0 AND w_inc_ticksz > 0  then
                UPDATE SYM0YA   /* 해외 자산종목 */
                   SET OPT_UNIT  = CASE WHEN xx.week NOT IN ('1','2','4','5') THEN w_inc_ticksz
                                                                              ELSE OPT_UNIT END
                     , OPT_1UNIT = CASE xx.week WHEN '1' THEN w_inc_ticksz
                                                         ELSE OPT_1UNIT END
                     , OPT_2UNIT = CASE xx.week WHEN '2' THEN w_inc_ticksz
                                                         ELSE OPT_2UNIT END
                     , OPT_4UNIT = CASE xx.week WHEN '4' THEN w_inc_ticksz
                                                         ELSE OPT_4UNIT END
                     , OPT_5UNIT = CASE xx.week WHEN '5' THEN w_inc_ticksz
                                                         ELSE OPT_5UNIT END
                 WHERE 1 = 1 
                   AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr      /* 운용(자문)사 */
                   AND jm_cd   = xx.uspm_jm_cd  /* 종목코드 */
                ;
            end if;

            w_cnt := 50;
            if  xx.inc_ticksz = 0 AND (w_inc_ticksz = 0 OR w_inc_ticksz > 999)  then
                if  xx.strike_price < 10        then    w_inc_ticksz := 0.1;
                elsif xx.strike_price > 99.99   then    w_inc_ticksz := 2.5;
                else                                    w_inc_ticksz := 0.5;
                end if;
                w_cnt := 200;
            elsif w_inc_ticksz >= xx.inc_ticksz then
                w_inc_ticksz := xx.inc_ticksz;
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            if  xx.strike_price < 10        then    w_inc_ticksz := 0.1;
            elsif xx.strike_price > 99.99   then    w_inc_ticksz := 2.5;
            else                                    w_inc_ticksz := 0.5;
            end if;
            w_cnt := 200;
        END;

        w_stkprc := xx.strike_price;
        for w_ii IN 1..w_cnt loop
            w_stkprc := w_stkprc + w_inc_ticksz;

            -- CALL 종목생성 필요시 (PUT 복사해서 생성) ; SJ_GB = '2'

            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO SRS_CD
                VALUES ( w_srscd_put || F_N0(w_stkprc, 0, 1)             /* _1- */
                       , w_stkprc                                        /* _2- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                                        /* _3- */
                       , xx.uspm_jm_cd                                   /* _4- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _5- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _6- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _7- */
                       , SYSDATE                                         /* _8- */
                       , 'N'                                             /* _9- */
                       , xx.yy || xx.mm || NVL(xx.week,'0')              /* _10- */
                       , w_put_nm || F_N0(w_stkprc, 0, 1) || '-'
                                  || xx.yy || xx.mm || NVL(xx.week,'0')  /* _11- */
                       , '3'                                             /* _12- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _13- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _14- */
                       );
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                NULL;
            END;
        end loop;

        w_stkprc := xx.strike_price;
        for w_ii IN 1..w_cnt loop
            w_stkprc := w_stkprc - w_inc_ticksz;
            if  w_stkprc < 1    then    EXIT;
            end if;

            -- CALL 종목생성 필요시 (PUT 복사해서 생성) ; SJ_GB = '2'

            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO SRS_CD
                VALUES ( w_srscd_put || F_N0(w_stkprc, 0, 1)             /* _1- */
                       , w_stkprc                                        /* _2- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                                        /* _3- */
                       , xx.uspm_jm_cd                                   /* _4- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _5- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _6- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _7- */
                       , SYSDATE                                         /* _8- */
                       , 'N'                                             /* _9- */
                       , xx.yy || xx.mm || NVL(xx.week,'0')              /* _10- */
                       , w_put_nm || F_N0(w_stkprc, 0, 1) || '-'
                                  || xx.yy || xx.mm || NVL(xx.week,'0')  /* _11- */
                       , '3'                                             /* _12- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _13- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _14- */
                       );
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                NULL;
            END;
        end loop;
    end loop;

    -- API 옵션 종목정보 요청생성
    INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
         ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
         , URL            /* _2- */
         , HEADERS        /* _3- */
         , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
         , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
         , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
         , REQUEST        /* _7- */
         , API_KEY        /* _8- */
         , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
         , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
         , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
         , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
         , KEY1           /* _13- */
         , KEY2           /* _14- */
         , PG_NM          /* _15- */
         )
    SELECT COMPANY                                                      /* _1- */
         , URL                                                          /* _2- */
         , HEADERS                                                      /* _3- */
         , '{ QRY_CNT: "1", SRS_CD_01: "' || cd.SRS_CD || '" }'         /* _4- */
         , TABLENAME                                                    /* _5- */
         , SUBTABLE                                                     /* _6- */
         , '0'                                                          /* _7- */
         , TO_CHAR(now ( ),'yyyymmdd') || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))  /* _8- */
         , KEY_VALUE                                                    /* _9- */
         , SUB_KEY_VALUE                                                /* _10- */
         , p_corp_gr                                                    /* _11- */
         , sysdate                                                      /* _12- */
         , cd.SRS_CD                                                    /* _13- */
         , 'SRS_CD'                                                     /* _14- */
         , 'PR_API_17_20'                                               /* _15- */
      FROM API_PARAMS t1
         , SRS_CD     cd
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.TR_CO_CD = '00003'
       AND t1.GR_CD    = '17'
       AND t1.SCD      = '20'
       AND t1.COMPANY  = 'KB_REAL'
       AND cd.EXCH_CD IS NULL
     ORDER BY cd.SRS_CD ASC;

    commit;
    p_msg := 'CALL, PUT 해외파생 종목정보(17-20) 요청';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.API_KSE (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- API 자료수신 요청생성(국내 주식정보)
--
    w_tr_co_cd                     VARCHAR (10) := '00003';
    w_company                      VARCHAR (20) := 'KB_REAL';

    w_ymd                          DATE;
    w_balh_co                      NUMBER;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    if  p_ymd > '00000000'  then
            w_ymd := TO_DATE (p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');
    else    w_ymd := TRUNC (now ( ),'dd');
    end if;
    w_ymd := F_OPEN_YMD (w_ymd, '-');

    -- 주식당일 현재가(종가) : 요청시간에 따라
    if  w_ymd = TRUNC (now ( ),'dd') then
        w_msg := TO_CHAR (w_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '일 주가지수';
        -- 국내 종합주가지수요청
        --API_INDEX_DAILY_PRICE_SUB
        for xx IN (
            SELECT COMPANY                                             /* _1- */
                 , URL                                                 /* _2- */
                 , HEADERS                                             /* _3- */
                 , QUERYPARAMS                                         /* _4- */
                 , TABLENAME                                           /* _5- */
                 , SUBTABLE                                            /* _6- */
                 , KEY_VALUE                                           /* _7- */
                 , SUB_KEY_VALUE                                       /* _8- */
                 , TO_CHAR(now ( ),'yyyymmdd')
                          || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))  AS api_key  /* _9- */
              FROM API_PARAMS t1
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.TR_CO_CD = w_tr_co_cd
               AND t1.GR_CD    = '04'
               AND t1.SCD      = '06'
               AND t1.COMPANY  = w_company
        ) loop
            xx.queryparams := '{ FID_PERIOD_DIV_CODE: "D", FID_COND_MRKT_DIV_CODE: "U", FID_INPUT_ISCD: "0001", FID_INPUT_DATE_1: "' || TO_CHAR (w_ymd,'yyyymmdd') || '" }';
            INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
                 ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
                 , URL            /* _2- */
                 , HEADERS        /* _3- */
                 , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
                 , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
                 , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
                 , REQUEST        /* _7- */
                 , API_KEY        /* _8- */
                 , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
                 , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
                 , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
                 , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
                 , KEY1           /* _13- */
                 , PG_NM          /* _14- */
                 )
            VALUES ( xx.company        /* _1- */
                   , xx.url            /* _2- */
                   , xx.headers        /* _3- */
                   , xx.queryparams    /* _4- */
                   , xx.tablename      /* _5- */
                   , xx.subtable       /* _6- */
                   , '0'               /* _7- */
                   , xx.api_key        /* _8- */
                   , xx.key_value      /* _9- */
                   , xx.sub_key_value  /* _10- */
                   , 'JISU'            /* _11- */
                   , w_ymd             /* _12- */
                   , 'kospi_jisu'      /* _13- */
                   , 'PR_API_KSE'      /* _14- */
                   );
        end loop;

        w_msg := w_msg || ',현재가';

        --API_INQUIRE_PRICE
        for api IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT t1.KOSCOM_CD
              FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.DANC_GB             IN ('A','C','D','G')
               AND NVL(t1.ABOL_DT, w_ymd) >= w_ymd
             ORDER BY 1 ASC
        ) loop
            INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
                 ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
                 , URL            /* _2- */
                 , HEADERS        /* _3- */
                 , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
                 , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
                 , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
                 , REQUEST        /* _7- */
                 , API_KEY        /* _8- */
                 , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
                 , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
                 , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
                 , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
                 , KEY1           /* _13- */
                 , PG_NM          /* _14- */
                 )
            SELECT COMPANY                                       /* _1- */
                 , URL                                           /* _2- */
                 , HEADERS                                       /* _3- */
                 , REPLACE (QUERYPARAMS,'@iscd', api.koscom_cd)  /* _4- */
                 , TABLENAME                                     /* _5- */
                 , SUBTABLE                                      /* _6- */
                 , '0'                                           /* _7- */
                 , TO_CHAR(now ( ),'yyyymmdd')
                          || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))        /* _8- */
                 , KEY_VALUE                                     /* _9- */
                 , SUB_KEY_VALUE                                 /* _10- */
                 , p_corp_gr                                     /* _11- */
                 , w_ymd                                         /* _12- */
                 , api.koscom_cd                                 /* _13- */
                 , 'PR_API_KSE'                                  /* _14- */
              FROM API_PARAMS t1
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.TR_CO_CD = w_tr_co_cd
               AND t1.GR_CD    = '02'
               AND t1.SCD      = '01'
               AND COMPANY     = w_company;
        end loop;
        -- 신주인수권은 상장시 폐지이므로
        for api IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT t1.KOSCOM_CD
              FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.DANC_GB                 = 'X'
               AND NVL(t1.SANGJ_YMD, now ( )) > TRUNC(now ( ),'dd')
             ORDER BY 1 ASC
        ) loop
            INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
                 ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
                 , URL            /* _2- */
                 , HEADERS        /* _3- */
                 , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
                 , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
                 , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
                 , REQUEST        /* _7- */
                 , API_KEY        /* _8- */
                 , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
                 , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
                 , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
                 , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
                 , KEY1           /* _13- */
                 , PG_NM          /* _14- */
                 )
            SELECT COMPANY                                       /* _1- */
                 , URL                                           /* _2- */
                 , HEADERS                                       /* _3- */
                 , REPLACE (QUERYPARAMS,'@iscd', api.koscom_cd)  /* _4- */
                 , TABLENAME                                     /* _5- */
                 , SUBTABLE                                      /* _6- */
                 , '0'                                           /* _7- */
                 , TO_CHAR(now ( ),'yyyymmdd')
                          || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))        /* _8- */
                 , KEY_VALUE                                     /* _9- */
                 , SUB_KEY_VALUE                                 /* _10- */
                 , p_corp_gr                                     /* _11- */
                 , w_ymd                                         /* _12- */
                 , api.koscom_cd                                 /* _13- */
                 , 'PR_API_KSE'                                  /* _14- */
              FROM API_PARAMS t1
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.TR_CO_CD = w_tr_co_cd
               AND t1.GR_CD    = '02'
               AND t1.SCD      = '01'
               AND COMPANY     = w_company;
        end loop;
    end if;

    -- 주식종목정보(월요일만 받음)
    -- API_STOCK_INFO
    if TO_CHAR (w_ymd, 'w') = '2'      then
        w_msg := w_msg || '(월요일-주식종목정보)';
        for api IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT t1.KOSCOM_CD
              FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.DANC_GB IN ('A','C','D','G')
             ORDER BY 1 ASC
        ) loop
            INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
                 ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
                 , URL            /* _2- */
                 , HEADERS        /* _3- */
                 , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
                 , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
                 , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
                 , REQUEST        /* _7- */
                 , API_KEY        /* _8- */
                 , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
                 , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
                 , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
                 , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
                 , KEY1           /* _13- */
                 , PG_NM          /* _14- */
                 )
            SELECT COMPANY                                       /* _1- */
                 , URL                                           /* _2- */
                 , HEADERS                                       /* _3- */
                 , REPLACE (QUERYPARAMS,'@pdno', api.koscom_cd)  /* _4- */
                 , TABLENAME                                     /* _5- */
                 , SUBTABLE                                      /* _6- */
                 , '0'                                           /* _7- */
                 , TO_CHAR(now ( ),'yyyymmdd')
                          || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))        /* _8- */
                 , KEY_VALUE                                     /* _9- */
                 , SUB_KEY_VALUE                                 /* _10- */
                 , p_corp_gr                                     /* _11- */
                 , w_ymd                                         /* _12- */
                 , api.koscom_cd                                 /* _13- */
                 , 'PR_API_KSE'                                  /* _14- */
              FROM API_PARAMS t1
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.TR_CO_CD = w_tr_co_cd
               AND t1.GR_CD    = '05'
               AND t1.SCD      = '02'
               AND COMPANY     = w_company;
        end loop;
    end if;

    -- 신규발행기관 정보
    SELECT TO_NUMBER (MAX(balh_co))
      INTO w_balh_co
      FROM SJX0JB t1  /* 발행기관 */
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND NVL(DEL_YN,'N') = 'N'
       AND LENGTH(balh_co) = 5
     ORDER BY balh_co ASC;

    p_msg := w_msg || '...' || TO_CHAR (w_balh_co) || '-' || TO_CHAR (w_balh_co + 6) || '_신규발행기관 정보';

    --API_KSE_INFO
    for xx IN (
        SELECT COMPANY        /* _1- */
             , URL            /* _2- */
             , HEADERS        /* _3- */
             , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
             , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
             , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
             , KEY_VALUE      /* _7- */
             , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _8- */
          FROM API_PARAMS t1
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND T1.TR_CO_CD = w_tr_co_cd
           AND T1.GR_CD    = '05'
           AND T1.SCD      = '01'
           AND COMPANY     = w_company
    ) loop
        for i IN 1 .. 5 loop
            w_balh_co := w_balh_co + 1;
            INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
                 ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
                 , URL            /* _2- */
                 , HEADERS        /* _3- */
                 , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
                 , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
                 , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
                 , REQUEST        /* _7- */
                 , API_KEY        /* _8- */
                 , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
                 , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
                 , PG_NM          /* _11- */
                 )
            VALUES ( xx.company                                            /* _1- */
                   , xx.url                                                /* _2- */
                   , xx.headers                                            /* _3- */
                   , '{PRDT_TYPE_CD: "300", PDNO: "' || TO_CHAR(w_balh_co)
                                                     || '0"}'              /* _4- */
                   , xx.tablename                                          /* _5- */
                   , xx.subtable                                           /* _6- */
                   , '0'                                                   /* _7- */
                   , TO_CHAR(now ( ),'yyyymmdd') || '-'
                                                 || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))  /* _8- */
                   , xx.key_value                                          /* _9- */
                   , xx.sub_key_value                                      /* _10- */
                   , 'PR_API_KSE'                                          /* _11- */
                   );
        end loop;
    end loop;
    commit;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.API_OLD_DATA_CLEAN IS
    v_sql                          VARCHAR2(2000);
    v_total_deleted                NUMBER := 0;
    v_table_deleted                NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
    -- 1. KFP 유저 소유이면서, 테이블명에 'API'가 포함되고, 'API_KEY' 컬럼이 있는 테이블 목록 조회
    for rec IN (
        SELECT t20.table_name
          FROM ALL_TABLES t20
                JOIN ALL_TAB_COLUMNS t3
                  ON t3.owner      = t20.owner
                 AND t3.table_name = t20.table_name
         WHERE t20.owner       = 'KFP'
           AND t20.table_name  LIKE '%API%'
           AND t3.column_name = 'API_KEY'
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            -- 2. 해당 테이블의 API_KEY에서 추출한 '가장 최신 날짜'를 기준으로 7일 이전 데이터를 삭제하는 동적 SQL 구성
            v_sql   := 'DELETE FROM KFP.' || rec.table_name || ' t1 '
                                          || 'WHERE TO_DATE(SUBSTR(API_KEY, 1, 8), ''YYYYMMDD'') < ('
                                          || '    SELECT MAX(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(API_KEY, 1, 8), ''YYYYMMDD'')) - 7 '
                                          || '    FROM KFP.' || rec.table_name
                                          || ')';

            -- 3. 쿼리 실행 및 삭제 건수 누적
            EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v_sql;
            v_table_deleted := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            v_total_deleted := v_total_deleted + v_table_deleted;

            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(rec.table_name || ' : ' || v_table_deleted || '건 삭제 완료');

        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            -- 특정 테이블에서 에러 발생 시 로그만 남기고 다음 테이블로 진행
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Error on ' || rec.table_name || ' : ' || SQLERRM);
        END;
    end loop;

    -- 4. 정상 종료 시 커밋
    COMMIT;
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('=========================================');
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('총 삭제 건수 : ' || v_total_deleted || '건');

EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    ROLLBACK;
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('프로시저 전체 실행 중 오류 발생 : ' || SQLERRM);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.NEW_13_02 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- API 해외주식 일괄 과거자료 200영업일 요청
--
    w_tr_co_cd                     VARCHAR (10) := '00003';
    w_company                      VARCHAR (20) := 'KB_REAL';

    w_num1                         NUMBER;
    w_cnt                          NUMBER := 0;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    API_17_20 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_msg );

    for api IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t1.JM_CD
             , t1.EXCD
             , t1.BLBG_TCKR                      AS SYMB
             , NVL (t1.USPM_YMD, now ( ) - 100)  AS uspm_ymd
          FROM SYM0YA t1  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.JASAN_GB = '1'
           AND t1.EXCD IS NOT NULL
         ORDER BY 4 ASC, 3 ASC
    ) loop
        w_num1 := 100;

        w_cnt := w_cnt + 1;
        for xx IN (
            SELECT COMPANY                                                                  /* _1- */
                 , URL                                                                      /* _2- */
                 , HEADERS                                                                  /* _3- */
                 , QUERYPARAMS                                                              /* _4- */
                 , TABLENAME                                                                /* _5- */
                 , SUBTABLE                                                                 /* _6- */
                 , KEY_VALUE                                                                /* _7- */

                xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@bymd', TO_CHAR (F_OPEN_US(now ( ), '-195'), 'yyyymmdd'));

                     ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
                     , URL            /* _2- */
                     , HEADERS        /* _3- */
                     , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
                     , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
                     , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
                     , REQUEST        /* _7- */
                     , API_KEY        /* _8- */
                     , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
                     , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
                     , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
                     , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
                     , KEY1           /* _13- */
                     , NUM1           /* _14- */
                     )
                VALUES ( xx.company        /* _1- */
                       , xx.url            /* _2- */
                       , xx.headers        /* _3- */
                       , xx.queryparams    /* _4- */
                       , xx.tablename      /* _5- */
                       , xx.subtable       /* _6- */
                       , '0'               /* _7- */
                       , xx.api_key        /* _8- */
                       , xx.key_value      /* _9- */
                       , xx.sub_key_value  /* _10- */
                       , p_corp_gr         /* _11- */
                       , now( )            /* _12- */
                       , api.jm_cd         /* _13- */
                       , 100               /* _14- */
                       );
            end loop;

            -- 해외주식정보
            for xx IN (
                SELECT COMPANY                                                                  /* _1- */
                     , URL                                                                      /* _2- */
                     , HEADERS                                                                  /* _3- */
                     , QUERYPARAMS                                                              /* _4- */
                     , TABLENAME                                                                /* _5- */
                     , SUBTABLE                                                                 /* _6- */
                     , KEY_VALUE                                                                /* _7- */
                     , SUB_KEY_VALUE                                                            /* _8- */
                     , TO_CHAR(now ( ),'yyyymmdd') || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))  AS api_key  /* _9- */
                  FROM API_PARAMS t1
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND T1.TR_CO_CD = '00003'
                   AND T1.GR_CD    = '13'
                   AND T1.SCD      = '09'
                   AND COMPANY     = 'KB_REAL'
            ) loop
                xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@prdt', '512');
                xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@pdno', api.symb);

                INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
                     ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
                     , URL            /* _2- */
                     , HEADERS        /* _3- */
                     , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
                     , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
                     , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
                     , REQUEST        /* _7- */
                     , API_KEY        /* _8- */
                     , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
                     , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
                     , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
                     , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
                     , KEY1           /* _13- */
                     )
                VALUES ( xx.company           /* _1- */
                       , xx.url               /* _2- */
                       , xx.headers           /* _3- */
                       , xx.queryparams       /* _4- */
                       , xx.tablename         /* _5- */
                       , xx.subtable          /* _6- */
                       , '0'                  /* _7- */
                       , xx.api_key || '512'  /* _8- */
                       , xx.key_value         /* _9- */
                       , xx.sub_key_value     /* _10- */
                       , p_corp_gr            /* _11- */
                       , now( )               /* _12- */
                       , api.jm_cd            /* _13- */
                       );

                xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '"512"', '"513"');
                INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
                     ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
                     , URL            /* _2- */
                     , HEADERS        /* _3- */
                     , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
                     , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
                     , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
                     , REQUEST        /* _7- */
                     , API_KEY        /* _8- */
                     , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
                     , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
                     , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
                     , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
                     , KEY1           /* _13- */
                     )
                VALUES ( xx.company           /* _1- */
                       , xx.url               /* _2- */
                       , xx.headers           /* _3- */
                       , xx.queryparams       /* _4- */
                       , xx.tablename         /* _5- */
                       , xx.subtable          /* _6- */
                       , '0'                  /* _7- */
                       , xx.api_key || '513'  /* _8- */
                       , xx.key_value         /* _9- */
                       , xx.sub_key_value     /* _10- */
                       , p_corp_gr            /* _11- */
                       , now( )               /* _12- */
                       , api.jm_cd            /* _13- */
                       );

                xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '"513"', '"529"');
                INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
                     ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
                     , URL            /* _2- */
                     , HEADERS        /* _3- */
                     , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
                     , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
                     , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
                     , REQUEST        /* _7- */
                     , API_KEY        /* _8- */
                     , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
                     , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
                     , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
                     , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
                     , KEY1           /* _13- */
                     )
                VALUES ( xx.company           /* _1- */
                       , xx.url               /* _2- */
                       , xx.headers           /* _3- */
                       , xx.queryparams       /* _4- */
                       , xx.tablename         /* _5- */
                       , xx.subtable          /* _6- */
                       , '0'                  /* _7- */
                       , xx.api_key || '529'  /* _8- */
                       , xx.key_value         /* _9- */
                       , xx.sub_key_value     /* _10- */
                       , p_corp_gr            /* _11- */
                       , now( )               /* _12- */
                       , api.jm_cd            /* _13- */
                       );
            end loop;
        end if;
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg := w_msg || ' - 일괄 : ' || F_N# (w_cnt) || '건 요청';
END;
