CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SP_SHM0HM_FUND_ALLOC (
    P_YMD                          IN    DATE,      /* 기준일자 */
    P_CORP_GR                      IN    VARCHAR2,  /* 법인그룹 */
    P_JM_CD                        IN    VARCHAR2,  /* 종목코드 */
    P_SRC_FUND                     IN    VARCHAR2,  /* 원본 펀드 (예: '1') */
    P_IP_USER                      IN    VARCHAR2   /* 등록자 사번 */
 ) IS
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO KFP.SHM0HM
         ( CORP_GR             /* _1- */
         , YMD                 /* _2- */
         , FUND_CD             /* _3- */
         , JM_CD               /* _4- */
         , BFIL_AEKM           /* _5- */
         , MEIB_AEKM           /* _6- */
         , MEDO_AEKM           /* _7- */
         , BFIL_CHUI_AEK       /* _8- */
         , MEIB_AEK            /* _9- */
         , MEDO_AEK            /* _10- */
         , BFIL_ANBUN_AEK      /* _11- */
         , ANBUN_AEK           /* _12- */
         , SANGHW_AEK          /* _13- */
         , BFIL_MISU_IJA       /* _14- */
         , MISU_IJA            /* _15- */
         , BFIL_SUNG_COST      /* _16- */
         , SUNG_COST           /* _17- */
         , BFIL_SUNG_TAX       /* _18- */
         , SUNG_TAX            /* _19- */
         , BFIL_SUNN_TAX       /* _20- */
         , SUNN_TAX            /* _21- */
         , BFIL_YESU_TAX       /* _22- */
         , YESU_TAX            /* _23- */
         , BFIL_PYUNGA_AEK     /* _24- */
         , PYUNGA_AEK          /* _25- */
         , DAY_IJA             /* _26- */
         , DAY_ANBUN_AEK       /* _27- */
         , LST_MEIB_YMD        /* _28- */
         , BFIL_SIGA_AEK       /* _29- */
         , SIGA_AEK            /* _30- */
         , BFIL_YUHYO_RT       /* _31- */
         , YUHYO_RT            /* _32- */
         , BFIL_JILG           /* _33- */
         , UP_JILG             /* _34- */
         , DW_JILG             /* _35- */
         , SUSU_GA             /* _36- */
         , BFIL_SUSU_GA        /* _37- */
         , DAY_SUSU_GA         /* _38- */
         , SUSU_09900          /* _39- */
         , BFIL_SUSU_09900     /* _40- */
         , DAY_SUSU_09900      /* _41- */
         , BFIL_SUNSU_IJA      /* _42- */
         , UP_SUNSU_IJA        /* _43- */
         , DW_SUNSU_IJA        /* _44- */
         , GUGAN_IJA           /* _45- */
         , GYUL_UP_SONIK       /* _46- */
         , CONS_BFIL_CHUI_AEK  /* _47- */
         , CONS_MEDO_AEK       /* _48- */
         , IP_USER             /* _49- */
         )
    WITH TARGET_RATIO AS (
         /* 1. 타겟 펀드('1a', '1b', '1c')의 안분 비율 산출 */
         SELECT CORP_GR                                                                                                 /* _1- */
              , YMD                                                                                                     /* _2- */
              , JM_CD                                                                                                   /* _3- */
              , FUND_CD                                                                              AS TARGET_FUND_CD  /* _4- */
              , RATIO_TO_REPORT(NVL(BFIL_AEKM, 0) + NVL(MEIB_AEKM, 0) - NVL(MEDO_AEKM, 0)) OVER ( )  AS ANBUN_RATE      /* _5- */
           FROM KFP.SHM0HM p1
          WHERE YMD     = P_YMD
            AND CORP_GR = P_CORP_GR
            AND JM_CD   = P_JM_CD
            AND FUND_CD IN (P_SRC_FUND || 'a', P_SRC_FUND || 'b', P_SRC_FUND || 'c')
         ) , 
     SOURCE_DATA AS (
         /* 2. 원본 펀드('1')의 데이터 추출 */
         SELECT *
           FROM KFP.SHM0HM p2
          WHERE YMD     = P_YMD
            AND CORP_GR = P_CORP_GR
            AND JM_CD   = P_JM_CD
            AND FUND_CD = P_SRC_FUND
         ) , 
     STEP_TRUNC AS (
         /* 3. 원본 금액 유지 및 1차 안분 (단수 버림) */
         SELECT p18.TARGET_FUND_CD                                                                              /* _1- */
              , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (ORDER BY p18.ANBUN_RATE DESC, p18.TARGET_FUND_CD)  AS RN                    /* _2- */
              -- [문자/날짜 컬럼]
              , p19.CORP_GR                                                                                     /* _3- */
              , p19.YMD                                                                                         /* _4- */
              , p19.JM_CD                                                                                       /* _5- */
              , p19.LST_MEIB_YMD                                                                                /* _6- */
              -- [소수점 4자리 세금 항목]
              , p19.BFIL_SUNG_TAX                                                                               /* _7- */
              , TRUNC(p19.BFIL_SUNG_TAX * p18.ANBUN_RATE, 4)                           AS T_BFIL_SUNG_TAX       /* _8- */
              , p19.SUNG_TAX                                                                                    /* _9- */
              , TRUNC(p19.SUNG_TAX * p18.ANBUN_RATE, 4)                                AS T_SUNG_TAX            /* _10- */
              , p19.BFIL_SUNN_TAX                                                                               /* _11- */
              , TRUNC(p19.BFIL_SUNN_TAX * p18.ANBUN_RATE, 4)                           AS T_BFIL_SUNN_TAX       /* _12- */
              , p19.SUNN_TAX                                                                                    /* _13- */
              , TRUNC(p19.SUNN_TAX * p18.ANBUN_RATE, 4)                                AS T_SUNN_TAX            /* _14- */
              , p19.BFIL_YESU_TAX                                                                               /* _15- */
              , TRUNC(p19.BFIL_YESU_TAX * p18.ANBUN_RATE, 4)                           AS T_BFIL_YESU_TAX       /* _16- */
              , p19.YESU_TAX                                                                                    /* _17- */
              , TRUNC(p19.YESU_TAX * p18.ANBUN_RATE, 4)                                AS T_YESU_TAX            /* _18- */
              -- [일반 정수 항목]
              , p19.BFIL_AEKM                                                                                   /* _19- */
              , TRUNC(p19.BFIL_AEKM * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                  AS T_BFIL_AEKM           /* _20- */
              , p19.MEIB_AEKM                                                                                   /* _21- */
              , TRUNC(p19.MEIB_AEKM * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                  AS T_MEIB_AEKM           /* _22- */
              , p19.MEDO_AEKM                                                                                   /* _23- */
              , TRUNC(p19.MEDO_AEKM * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                  AS T_MEDO_AEKM           /* _24- */
              , p19.BFIL_CHUI_AEK                                                                               /* _25- */
              , TRUNC(p19.BFIL_CHUI_AEK * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                              AS T_BFIL_CHUI_AEK       /* _26- */
              , p19.MEIB_AEK                                                                                    /* _27- */
              , TRUNC(p19.MEIB_AEK * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                   AS T_MEIB_AEK            /* _28- */
              , p19.MEDO_AEK                                                                                    /* _29- */
              , TRUNC(p19.MEDO_AEK * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                   AS T_MEDO_AEK            /* _30- */
              , p19.BFIL_ANBUN_AEK                                                                              /* _31- */
              , TRUNC(p19.BFIL_ANBUN_AEK * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                             AS T_BFIL_ANBUN_AEK      /* _32- */
              , p19.ANBUN_AEK                                                                                   /* _33- */
              , TRUNC(p19.ANBUN_AEK * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                  AS T_ANBUN_AEK           /* _34- */
              , p19.SANGHW_AEK                                                                                  /* _35- */
              , TRUNC(p19.SANGHW_AEK * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                 AS T_SANGHW_AEK          /* _36- */
              , p19.BFIL_MISU_IJA                                                                               /* _37- */
              , TRUNC(p19.BFIL_MISU_IJA * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                              AS T_BFIL_MISU_IJA       /* _38- */
              , p19.MISU_IJA                                                                                    /* _39- */
              , TRUNC(p19.MISU_IJA * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                   AS T_MISU_IJA            /* _40- */
              , p19.BFIL_SUNG_COST                                                                              /* _41- */
              , TRUNC(p19.BFIL_SUNG_COST * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                             AS T_BFIL_SUNG_COST      /* _42- */
              , p19.SUNG_COST                                                                                   /* _43- */
              , TRUNC(p19.SUNG_COST * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                  AS T_SUNG_COST           /* _44- */
              , p19.BFIL_PYUNGA_AEK                                                                             /* _45- */
              , TRUNC(p19.BFIL_PYUNGA_AEK * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                            AS T_BFIL_PYUNGA_AEK     /* _46- */
              , p19.PYUNGA_AEK                                                                                  /* _47- */
              , TRUNC(p19.PYUNGA_AEK * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                 AS T_PYUNGA_AEK          /* _48- */
              , p19.DAY_IJA                                                                                     /* _49- */
              , TRUNC(p19.DAY_IJA * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                    AS T_DAY_IJA             /* _50- */
              , p19.DAY_ANBUN_AEK                                                                               /* _51- */
              , TRUNC(p19.DAY_ANBUN_AEK * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                              AS T_DAY_ANBUN_AEK       /* _52- */
              , p19.BFIL_SIGA_AEK                                                                               /* _53- */
              , TRUNC(p19.BFIL_SIGA_AEK * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                              AS T_BFIL_SIGA_AEK       /* _54- */
              , p19.SIGA_AEK                                                                                    /* _55- */
              , TRUNC(p19.SIGA_AEK * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                   AS T_SIGA_AEK            /* _56- */
              , p19.BFIL_YUHYO_RT                                                                               /* _57- */
              , TRUNC(p19.BFIL_YUHYO_RT * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                              AS T_BFIL_YUHYO_RT       /* _58- */
              , p19.YUHYO_RT                                                                                    /* _59- */
              , TRUNC(p19.YUHYO_RT * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                   AS T_YUHYO_RT            /* _60- */
              , p19.BFIL_JILG                                                                                   /* _61- */
              , TRUNC(p19.BFIL_JILG * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                  AS T_BFIL_JILG           /* _62- */
              , p19.UP_JILG                                                                                     /* _63- */
              , TRUNC(p19.UP_JILG * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                    AS T_UP_JILG             /* _64- */
              , p19.DW_JILG                                                                                     /* _65- */
              , TRUNC(p19.DW_JILG * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                    AS T_DW_JILG             /* _66- */
              , p19.SUSU_GA                                                                                     /* _67- */
              , TRUNC(p19.SUSU_GA * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                    AS T_SUSU_GA             /* _68- */
              , p19.BFIL_SUSU_GA                                                                                /* _69- */
              , TRUNC(p19.BFIL_SUSU_GA * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                               AS T_BFIL_SUSU_GA        /* _70- */
              , p19.DAY_SUSU_GA                                                                                 /* _71- */
              , TRUNC(p19.DAY_SUSU_GA * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                AS T_DAY_SUSU_GA         /* _72- */
              , p19.SUSU_09900                                                                                  /* _73- */
              , TRUNC(p19.SUSU_09900 * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                 AS T_SUSU_09900          /* _74- */
              , p19.BFIL_SUSU_09900                                                                             /* _75- */
              , TRUNC(p19.BFIL_SUSU_09900 * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                            AS T_BFIL_SUSU_09900     /* _76- */
              , p19.DAY_SUSU_09900                                                                              /* _77- */
              , TRUNC(p19.DAY_SUSU_09900 * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                             AS T_DAY_SUSU_09900      /* _78- */
              , p19.BFIL_SUNSU_IJA                                                                              /* _79- */
              , TRUNC(p19.BFIL_SUNSU_IJA * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                             AS T_BFIL_SUNSU_IJA      /* _80- */
              , p19.UP_SUNSU_IJA                                                                                /* _81- */
              , TRUNC(p19.UP_SUNSU_IJA * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                               AS T_UP_SUNSU_IJA        /* _82- */
              , p19.DW_SUNSU_IJA                                                                                /* _83- */
              , TRUNC(p19.DW_SUNSU_IJA * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                               AS T_DW_SUNSU_IJA        /* _84- */
              , p19.GUGAN_IJA                                                                                   /* _85- */
              , TRUNC(p19.GUGAN_IJA * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                                  AS T_GUGAN_IJA           /* _86- */
              , p19.GYUL_UP_SONIK                                                                               /* _87- */
              , TRUNC(p19.GYUL_UP_SONIK * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                              AS T_GYUL_UP_SONIK       /* _88- */
              , p19.CONS_BFIL_CHUI_AEK                                                                          /* _89- */
              , TRUNC(p19.CONS_BFIL_CHUI_AEK * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                         AS T_CONS_BFIL_CHUI_AEK  /* _90- */
              , p19.CONS_MEDO_AEK                                                                               /* _91- */
              , TRUNC(p19.CONS_MEDO_AEK * p18.ANBUN_RATE)                              AS T_CONS_MEDO_AEK       /* _92- */
           FROM SOURCE_DATA p19
                CROSS JOIN TARGET_RATIO p18
         )
    --- Main SQL ---
    ----------------
    -- 4. 최종 SELECT (RN=1인 타겟 펀드에 단수 차이 일괄 가산)
    SELECT CORP_GR                                                                                                          /* _1- */
         , YMD                                                                                                              /* _2- */
         , TARGET_FUND_CD                                                                                                   /* _3- */
         , JM_CD                                                                                                            /* _4- */
         , T_BFIL_AEKM       + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN BFIL_AEKM - SUM(T_BFIL_AEKM)            OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _5- */
         , T_MEIB_AEKM       + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN MEIB_AEKM - SUM(T_MEIB_AEKM)            OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _6- */
         , T_MEDO_AEKM       + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN MEDO_AEKM - SUM(T_MEDO_AEKM)            OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _7- */
         , T_BFIL_CHUI_AEK   + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN BFIL_CHUI_AEK - SUM(T_BFIL_CHUI_AEK)    OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _8- */
         , T_MEIB_AEK        + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN MEIB_AEK - SUM(T_MEIB_AEK)              OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _9- */
         , T_MEDO_AEK        + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN MEDO_AEK - SUM(T_MEDO_AEK)              OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _10- */
         , T_BFIL_ANBUN_AEK  + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN BFIL_ANBUN_AEK - SUM(T_BFIL_ANBUN_AEK)  OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _11- */
         , T_ANBUN_AEK       + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN ANBUN_AEK - SUM(T_ANBUN_AEK)            OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _12- */
         , T_SANGHW_AEK      + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN SANGHW_AEK - SUM(T_SANGHW_AEK)          OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _13- */
         , T_BFIL_MISU_IJA   + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN BFIL_MISU_IJA - SUM(T_BFIL_MISU_IJA)    OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _14- */
         , T_MISU_IJA        + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN MISU_IJA - SUM(T_MISU_IJA)              OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _15- */
         , T_BFIL_SUNG_COST  + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN BFIL_SUNG_COST - SUM(T_BFIL_SUNG_COST)  OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _16- */
         , T_SUNG_COST       + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN SUNG_COST - SUM(T_SUNG_COST)            OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _17- */
         , T_BFIL_SUNG_TAX   + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN BFIL_SUNG_TAX - SUM(T_BFIL_SUNG_TAX)    OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _18- */
         , T_SUNG_TAX        + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN SUNG_TAX - SUM(T_SUNG_TAX)              OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _19- */
         , T_BFIL_SUNN_TAX   + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN BFIL_SUNN_TAX - SUM(T_BFIL_SUNN_TAX)    OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _20- */
         , T_SUNN_TAX        + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN SUNN_TAX - SUM(T_SUNN_TAX)              OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _21- */
         , T_BFIL_YESU_TAX   + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN BFIL_YESU_TAX - SUM(T_BFIL_YESU_TAX)    OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _22- */
         , T_YESU_TAX        + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN YESU_TAX - SUM(T_YESU_TAX)              OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _23- */
         , T_BFIL_PYUNGA_AEK + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN BFIL_PYUNGA_AEK- SUM(T_BFIL_PYUNGA_AEK) OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _24- */
         , T_PYUNGA_AEK      + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN PYUNGA_AEK - SUM(T_PYUNGA_AEK)          OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _25- */
         , T_DAY_IJA         + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN DAY_IJA - SUM(T_DAY_IJA)                OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _26- */
         , T_DAY_ANBUN_AEK   + CASE WHEN RN = 1THEN DAY_ANBUN_AEK - SUM(T_DAY_ANBUN_AEK)    OVER ( )ELSE 0 END              /* _27- */
         , LST_MEIB_YMD                                                                                                     /* _28- */
         , T_BFIL_SIGA_AEK      + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN BFIL_SIGA_AEK - SUM(T_BFIL_SIGA_AEK)           OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _29- */
         , T_SIGA_AEK           + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN SIGA_AEK - SUM(T_SIGA_AEK)                     OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _30- */
         , T_BFIL_YUHYO_RT      + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN BFIL_YUHYO_RT - SUM(T_BFIL_YUHYO_RT)           OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _31- */
         , T_YUHYO_RT           + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN YUHYO_RT - SUM(T_YUHYO_RT)                     OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _32- */
         , T_BFIL_JILG          + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN BFIL_JILG - SUM(T_BFIL_JILG)                   OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _33- */
         , T_UP_JILG            + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN UP_JILG - SUM(T_UP_JILG)                       OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _34- */
         , T_DW_JILG            + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN DW_JILG - SUM(T_DW_JILG)                       OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _35- */
         , T_SUSU_GA            + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN SUSU_GA - SUM(T_SUSU_GA)                       OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _36- */
         , T_BFIL_SUSU_GA       + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN BFIL_SUSU_GA - SUM(T_BFIL_SUSU_GA)             OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _37- */
         , T_DAY_SUSU_GA        + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN DAY_SUSU_GA - SUM(T_DAY_SUSU_GA)               OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _38- */
         , T_SUSU_09900         + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN SUSU_09900 - SUM(T_SUSU_09900)                 OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _39- */
         , T_BFIL_SUSU_09900    + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN BFIL_SUSU_09900- SUM(T_BFIL_SUSU_09900)        OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _40- */
         , T_DAY_SUSU_09900     + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN DAY_SUSU_09900 - SUM(T_DAY_SUSU_09900)         OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _41- */
         , T_BFIL_SUNSU_IJA     + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN BFIL_SUNSU_IJA - SUM(T_BFIL_SUNSU_IJA)         OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _42- */
         , T_UP_SUNSU_IJA       + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN UP_SUNSU_IJA - SUM(T_UP_SUNSU_IJA)             OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _43- */
         , T_DW_SUNSU_IJA       + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN DW_SUNSU_IJA - SUM(T_DW_SUNSU_IJA)             OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _44- */
         , T_GUGAN_IJA          + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN GUGAN_IJA - SUM(T_GUGAN_IJA)                   OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _45- */
         , T_GYUL_UP_SONIK      + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN GYUL_UP_SONIK - SUM(T_GYUL_UP_SONIK)           OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _46- */
         , T_CONS_BFIL_CHUI_AEK + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN CONS_BFIL_CHUI_AEK - SUM(T_CONS_BFIL_CHUI_AEK) OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _47- */
         , T_CONS_MEDO_AEK      + CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN CONS_MEDO_AEK - SUM(T_CONS_MEDO_AEK)           OVER ( ) ELSE 0 END  /* _48- */
         , P_IP_USER                                                                                                        /* _49- */
      FROM STEP_TRUNC p3;

    COMMIT;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    ROLLBACK;
    RAISE;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_10151_FCUR_IN (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_currency                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_aek                          IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 기준통화 외화예금 입금(default 결제종목/해외보관처, 당일환율로 계산)
--
    w_gyulje_jm_cd                 syt0ys.gyulje_jm_cd%type;
    w_trustee                      syx2mm.trustee%type;

    w_won_aek                      NUMBER;

    w_currency                     VARCHAR (3);
    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    p_msg := 'Y';
    if  p_aek = 0   then    RETURN;
    end if;

    BEGIN
        SELECT jm_cd
             , currency
          INTO w_gyulje_jm_cd
             , w_currency
          FROM SYM0YA t1
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.currency   = p_fund_currency
           AND t1.sanghw_ymd >= p_ymd
           AND t1.gyulje_jm  = 'Y'
           AND t1.jasan_gb   = '5';
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := '기준통화(' || p_fund_currency || ')별 결제종목을 확인(1개만 존재해야 함).(2900 화면)';
        RETURN;
    END;

    BEGIN
        SELECT trustee
          INTO w_trustee
          FROM SYX2MM t1
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_currency = 'Y'
           AND t1.currency      = p_fund_currency
           AND t1.used          = '1';
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := '기준통화(' || p_fund_currency || ')별 해외보관처 확인(1개만 존재해야 함).(9210 화면)';
        RETURN;
    END;

    w_won_aek := F_COVWON (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_fund_currency, p_aek);

    UPDATE SYM0YZ
       SET tr_up_jusu       = NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) + p_aek
         , tr_up_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) + p_aek
         , won_up_chui_aek  = NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) + w_won_aek
         , fcur_up_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0) + F_COVCUR(p_corp_gr, p_ymd, currency, p_aek, p_fund_currency)
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
       AND jm_cd   = w_gyulje_jm_cd
       AND ymd     = p_ymd
       AND trustee = w_trustee
       AND bs_type = 0;
    if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
        INSERT INTO SYM0YZ
             ( corp_gr           /* _1- */
             , ymd               /* _2- */
             , fund_cd           /* _3- */
             , trustee           /* _4- */
             , jm_cd             /* _5- */
             , bs_type           /* _6- */
             , currency          /* _7- */
             , tr_up_jusu        /* _8- */
             , tr_up_chui_aek    /* _9- */
             , won_up_chui_aek   /* _10- */
             , fcur_up_chui_aek  /* _11- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                       /* _1- */
               , p_ymd                                                           /* _2- */
               , p_fund_cd                                                       /* _3- */
               , w_trustee                                                       /* _4- */
               , w_gyulje_jm_cd                                                  /* _5- */
               , 0                                                               /* _6- */
               , p_fund_currency                                                 /* _7- */
               , p_aek                                                           /* _8- */
               , p_aek                                                           /* _9- */
               , w_won_aek                                                       /* _10- */
               , F_COVCUR(p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_currency, p_aek, p_fund_currency)  /* _11- */
               );
    end if;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := SUBSTR  (sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_10151_FCUR_OUT (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_currency                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_aek                          IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 기준통화 외화예금 출금(default 결제종목/해외보관처, 당일환율로 계산)
--
    w_gyulje_jm_cd                 syt0ys.gyulje_jm_cd%type;
    w_trustee                      syx2mm.trustee%type;

    yz_chui_aek                    NUMBER;
    yz_won_aek                     NUMBER;
    w_won_chui_aek                 NUMBER;
BEGIN
    p_msg := 'Y';
    if  p_aek = 0   then    RETURN;
    end if;

    BEGIN
        SELECT jm_cd
          INTO w_gyulje_jm_cd
          FROM SYM0YA t1
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.currency   = p_fund_currency
           AND t1.sanghw_ymd >= p_ymd
           AND t1.gyulje_jm  = 'Y'
           AND t1.jasan_gb   = '5';
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := '기준통화(' || p_fund_currency || ')별 결제종목을 확인(1개만 존재해야 함).(2900 화면)';
        RETURN;
    END;

    BEGIN
        SELECT trustee
          INTO w_trustee
          FROM SYX2MM t1
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.currency      = p_fund_currency
           AND t1.fund_currency = 'Y'
           AND t1.used          = '1';
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := '기준통화(' || p_fund_currency || ')별 해외보관처 확인(1개만 존재해야 함).(9210 화면,해외보관처)';
        RETURN;
    END;

    BEGIN
        SELECT NVL(tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0)
             , NVL(won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0)
          INTO yz_chui_aek
             , yz_won_aek
          FROM SYM0YZ t1
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd    = w_gyulje_jm_cd
           AND t1.currency = p_fund_currency
           AND t1.trustee  = w_trustee
           AND t1.bs_type  = 0;
    EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
        p_msg := p_fund_cd || '-' || w_gyulje_jm_cd || '-결제 외화예금 자산마스타가 없습니다.';
        RETURN;
    END;

    if  yz_chui_aek < p_aek then
        p_msg := F_NTRIM (yz_chui_aek - p_aek) || ' - 외화예금 잔고가 부족합니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;
    if  yz_chui_aek = p_aek then
            w_won_chui_aek := yz_won_aek;
    else    w_won_chui_aek := TRUNC(yz_won_aek / yz_chui_aek * p_aek);
    end if;

    UPDATE SYM0YZ
       SET tr_dw_jusu       = NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0) + p_aek
         , tr_dw_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0) + p_aek
         , won_dw_chui_aek  = NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0) + w_won_chui_aek
         , fcur_dw_chui_aek = F_TRUNC(NVL(fcur_dw_chui_aek, 0) + F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, currency, p_aek, p_fund_currency), p_fund_currency)
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd      = p_ymd
       AND fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
       AND jm_cd    = w_gyulje_jm_cd
       AND bs_type  = 0
       AND currency = p_fund_currency
       AND trustee  = w_trustee;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := SUBSTR  (sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_10151_IN (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_currency                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_trustee                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_bs_type                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_aek                          IN    NUMBER,
    p_won_aek                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_fcur_aek                     IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 외화예금 입금 처리(원화액이 null인 경우 당일환율로 계산)
--
    w_gyulje_jm_cd                 syt0ys.gyulje_jm_cd%type;
    w_currency                     VARCHAR(3);
    w_won_aek                      NUMBER;
BEGIN
    p_msg := 'Y';
    if  p_aek = 0   then    RETURN;
    end if;

    if  p_jm_cd IS NULL then
        BEGIN
            SELECT jm_cd
              INTO w_gyulje_jm_cd
              FROM SYM0YA t1
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.currency   = p_currency
               AND t1.sanghw_ymd >= p_ymd
               AND t1.gyulje_jm  = 'Y'
               AND t1.jasan_gb   = '5';
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := '통화(' || p_currency || ')별 결제종목을 확인(1개만 존재해야 함).(4100 화면)';
            RETURN;
        END;
    else
        w_gyulje_jm_cd := p_jm_cd;

        SELECT currency
          INTO w_currency
          FROM SYM0YA t1
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd   = w_gyulje_jm_cd;
        if  w_currency != p_currency    then
            p_msg := w_gyulje_jm_cd || ' - 결제종목 통화(' || w_currency || ')와 거래통화(' || p_currency || ')가 다릅니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end if;

    if NVL (p_won_aek,0) = 0    then
            w_won_aek := F_COVWON (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_currency, p_aek);
    else    w_won_aek := p_won_aek;
    end if;

    UPDATE SYM0YZ
       SET tr_up_jusu       = NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) + p_aek
         , tr_up_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) + p_aek
         , won_up_chui_aek  = NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) + w_won_aek
         , fcur_up_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0) + p_fcur_aek
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
       AND jm_cd   = w_gyulje_jm_cd
       AND ymd     = p_ymd
       AND trustee = p_trustee
       AND bs_type = p_bs_type;
    if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
        INSERT INTO SYM0YZ
             ( CORP_GR           /* _1- */
             , YMD               /* _2- */
             , FUND_CD           /* _3- */
             , TRUSTEE           /* _4- */
             , JM_CD             /* _5- */
             , BS_TYPE           /* _6- */
             , CURRENCY          /* _7- */
             , TR_UP_JUSU        /* _8- */
             , TR_UP_CHUI_AEK    /* _9- */
             , WON_UP_CHUI_AEK   /* _10- */
             , FCUR_UP_CHUI_AEK  /* _11- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
               , p_ymd           /* _2- */
               , p_fund_cd       /* _3- */
               , p_trustee       /* _4- */
               , w_gyulje_jm_cd  /* _5- */
               , p_bs_type       /* _6- */
               , p_currency      /* _7- */
               , p_aek           /* _8- */
               , p_aek           /* _9- */
               , w_won_aek       /* _10- */
               , p_fcur_aek      /* _11- */
               );
    end if;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := SUBSTR  (sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_10151_OUT (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_currency                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_trustee                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_bs_type                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_aek                          IN    NUMBER,
    p_won_chui_aek                 OUT   NUMBER,
    p_fcur_chui_aek                OUT   NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 외화예금 출금 처리(원화액이 null인 경우 당일환율로 계산)
--
    w_gyulje_jm_cd                 syt0ys.gyulje_jm_cd%type;
    w_currency                     VARCHAR(3);
    w_fund_currency                szm0ia.fund_currency%type;

    yz_chui_aek                    NUMBER;
    yz_won_aek                     NUMBER;
    yz_fcur_aek                    NUMBER;
BEGIN
    p_won_chui_aek  := 0;
    p_fcur_chui_aek := 0;

    p_msg := 'Y';
    if  p_aek = 0   then    RETURN;
    end if;

    if  p_jm_cd IS NULL then
        BEGIN
            SELECT jm_cd
              INTO w_gyulje_jm_cd
              FROM SYM0YA t1
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.currency   = p_currency
               AND t1.sanghw_ymd >= p_ymd
               AND t1.gyulje_jm  = 'Y'
               AND t1.jasan_gb   = '5';
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := '통화(' || p_currency || ')별 결제종목을 확인(1개만 존재해야 함).(2900 화면)';
            RETURN;
        END;
    else
        w_gyulje_jm_cd := p_jm_cd;

        SELECT currency
          INTO w_currency
          FROM SYM0YA t1
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd   = w_gyulje_jm_cd;
        if  w_currency != p_currency    then
            p_msg := w_gyulje_jm_cd || ' - 결제종목 통화(' || w_currency || ')와 거래통화(' || p_currency || ')가 다릅니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end if;

    BEGIN
        SELECT NVL(tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0)
             , NVL(won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0)
             , NVL(fcur_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(fcur_dw_chui_aek,0)
             , ia.fund_currency
          INTO yz_chui_aek
             , yz_won_aek
             , yz_fcur_aek
             , w_fund_currency
          FROM SYM0YZ t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd    = w_gyulje_jm_cd
           AND t1.bs_type  = p_bs_type
           AND t1.currency = p_currency
           AND t1.trustee  = p_trustee
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd;
    EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
        p_msg := p_fund_cd || '-' || w_gyulje_jm_cd || '-결제 외화예금 자산마스타가 없습니다.';
        RETURN;
    END;

    if  yz_chui_aek < p_aek THEN
        p_msg   := p_fund_cd || '-' || w_gyulje_jm_cd || ' - ' || p_aek || ' -YZ : ' || yz_chui_aek
                             || ' - 외화예금 잔고가 부족(' || F_NTRIM (yz_chui_aek - p_aek);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    if  yz_chui_aek = p_aek OR yz_chui_aek = 0  then
        p_won_chui_aek  := yz_won_aek;
        p_fcur_chui_aek := yz_fcur_aek;
    else
        p_won_chui_aek  := TRUNC  (yz_won_aek   / yz_chui_aek * p_aek);
        p_fcur_chui_aek := F_TRUNC (yz_fcur_aek / yz_chui_aek * p_aek, w_fund_currency);
    end if;

    UPDATE SYM0YZ
       SET tr_dw_jusu       = NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0) + p_aek
         , tr_dw_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0) + p_aek
         , won_dw_chui_aek  = NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0) + p_won_chui_aek
         , fcur_dw_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_dw_chui_aek,0) + p_fcur_chui_aek
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd      = p_ymd
       AND fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
       AND jm_cd    = w_gyulje_jm_cd
       AND bs_type  = p_bs_type
       AND currency = p_currency
       AND trustee  = p_trustee;

EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := SUBSTR  (sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_AC_POPUP (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_rt_key                       IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_gb                           IN    VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 펀드별 분개장 출력
--
    w_work_gb                      VARCHAR (5);
    w_procf                        NUMBER;
    w_proct                        NUMBER;

    w_key                          VARCHAR (99) default '---';
    w_num                          NUMBER;
    dr_num                         NUMBER;
    cr_num                         NUMBER;
BEGIN
    commit;
    w_work_gb := '[A]';
    if  p_gb = 'A'  then
        w_procf := 11;
        w_proct := 16;

    elsif p_gb = 'B'    then
        w_procf := 17;
        w_proct := 17;

    elsif p_gb = 'C'    then
        w_procf := 20;
        w_proct := 20;

    elsif p_gb = 'D'    then
        w_procf := 39;
        w_proct := 39;

    elsif p_gb = 'E'    then
        w_procf := 41;
        w_proct := 49;

    elsif p_gb = 'F'    then
        w_procf := 51;
        w_proct := 59;

    elsif p_gb = 'G'    then
        w_procf := 61;
        w_proct := 99;

    elsif p_gb = 'H'    then
        w_work_gb := '[B]';
        w_procf   := 0;
        w_proct   := 99;
    else
        w_work_gb := '[AB]';
        w_procf   := 0;
        w_proct   := 99;
        if  p_gb = '9'  then
            w_procf := 9;
            w_proct := 9;
        end if;
    end if;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT tt.fund_currency  /* _1- */
             , tt.work_gb        /* _2- */
             , tt.fund_nm        /* _3- */
             , tt.tr_cd          /* _4- */
             , tt.tr_nm          /* _5- */
             , tt.jeokyo_cd      /* _6- */
             , tt.jeokyo_nm      /* _7- */
             , tt.jm_cd          /* _8- */
             , tt.jj_nm          /* _9- */
             , tt.seq_no         /* _10- */
             , tt.chasu          /* _11- */
             , tt.row_no         /* _12- */
             , tt.gwamok         /* _13- */
             , tt.gwamok_nm      /* _14- */
             , tt.chadae_gb      /* _15- */
             , tt.aek            /* _16- */
             , tt.proc_step      /* _17- */
             , tt.bigo           /* _18- */
          FROM (SELECT t1.fund_currency                                   /* _1- */
                     , t1.work_gb                                         /* _2- */
                     , CASE WHEN t1.work_gb='A' THEN ia.fund_nm
                                                ELSE ia.fund_nm || '(결산)'
                       END                                  AS fund_nm    /* _3- */
                     , t1.tr_cd                                           /* _4- */
                     , F_TR_NM (tr_cd)                      AS tr_nm      /* _5- */
                     , t1.jeokyo_cd                                       /* _6- */
                     , F_JEOKYO_NM (jeokyo_cd)              AS jeokyo_nm  /* _7- */
                     , NVL(t1.jm_cd,'null')                 AS jm_cd      /* _8- */
                     , CASE WHEN lower (t1.jm_cd)=lower (F_JM_NM (t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd))
                            THEN ''
                            ELSE F_JM_NM (t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd)
                       END                                  AS jj_nm      /* _9- */
                     , t1.seq_no                                          /* _10- */
                     , NVL(t1.chasu,0)                      AS chasu      /* _11- */
                     , t1.row_no                                          /* _12- */
                     , t1.gwamok                                          /* _13- */
                     , F_GWAMOK_NM (t1.corp_gr, t1.gwamok)  AS gwamok_nm  /* _14- */
                     , t1.chadae_gb                                       /* _15- */
                     , t1.aek                                             /* _16- */
                     , t1.proc_step                                       /* _17- */
                     , t1.bigo                                            /* _18- */
                  FROM SKT0BU t1  /* 분개장 */
                     , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd   = p_fund_cd
                   AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
                   AND (REGEXP_LIKE (t1.work_gb, w_work_gb) OR (p_gb='H' AND REGEXP_LIKE (t1.tr_cd,'^Q[359]')))
                   AND t1.proc_step BETWEEN w_procf AND w_proct
                   AND ia.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd   = t1.fund_cd
                ) tt
         ORDER BY 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 4 ASC, 8 ASC, 10 ASC, 11 ASC, 12 ASC
    ) loop
        if  w_key != xx.fund_currency || xx.work_gb || xx.tr_cd || xx.jeokyo_cd || xx.jm_cd || xx.seq_no || xx.chasu    then
            w_key  := xx.fund_currency || xx.work_gb || xx.tr_cd || xx.jeokyo_cd || xx.jm_cd || xx.seq_no || xx.chasu;
            w_num  := 0;
            dr_num := 0;
            cr_num := 0;
        end if;

        if  xx.chadae_gb = 'D'  then
            if  xx.gwamok = '10101' AND cr_num < dr_num then    cr_num := dr_num;
            end if;
            dr_num := dr_num + 1;
            w_num  := dr_num;
        else
            if  xx.gwamok = '10101' AND dr_num < cr_num then    dr_num := cr_num;
            end if;
            cr_num := cr_num + 1;
            if  xx.gwamok_nm LIKE '미지급%' then    cr_num := GREATEST (cr_num, dr_num);
            end if;
            w_num := cr_num;
        end if;

        MERGE INTO GZZXSRT tt 
           USING DUAL ON ( rt_key = p_rt_key
                       AND c_02   = xx.fund_nm
                       AND c_03   = xx.tr_cd
                       AND c_05   = xx.jeokyo_cd
                       AND c_07   = xx.jm_cd
                       AND n_01   = w_num
                       AND n_02   = xx.seq_no
                       AND n_03   = xx.chasu )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET c_09 = CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='D' THEN xx.gwamok    ELSE c_09 END
                  , c_10 = CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='D' THEN xx.gwamok_nm ELSE c_10 END
                  , c_11 = CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='C' THEN xx.gwamok    ELSE c_11 END
                  , c_12 = CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='C' THEN xx.gwamok_nm ELSE c_12 END
                  , n_04 = CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='D' THEN xx.row_no    ELSE n_04 END
                  , n_05 = CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='D' THEN xx.aek       ELSE n_05 END
                  , n_06 = CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='C' THEN xx.row_no    ELSE n_06 END
                  , n_07 = CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='C' THEN xx.aek       ELSE n_07 END
                  , n_20 = xx.proc_step
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT ( rt_key  /* _1- */
                    , c_01    /* _2- */
                    , c_15    /* _3- */
                    , c_02    /* _4- */
                    , c_03    /* _5- */
                    , c_04    /* _6- */
                    , c_05    /* _7- */
                    , c_06    /* _8- */
                    , c_07    /* _9- */
                    , c_08    /* _10- */
                    , c_09    /* _11- */
                    , c_10    /* _12- */
                    , c_11    /* _13- */
                    , c_12    /* _14- */
                    , c_13    /* _15- */
                    , c_21    /* _16- */
                    , n_01    /* _17- */
                    , n_02    /* _18- */
                    , n_03    /* _19- */
                    , n_04    /* _20- */
                    , n_05    /* _21- */
                    , n_06    /* _22- */
                    , n_07    /* _23- */
                    , n_20    /* _24- */
                    )
             VALUES ( p_rt_key                                          /* _1- */
                    , p_fund_cd                                         /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_currency                                  /* _3- */
                    , xx.fund_nm                                        /* _4- */
                    , xx.tr_cd                                          /* _5- */
                    , xx.tr_nm                                          /* _6- */
                    , xx.jeokyo_cd                                      /* _7- */
                    , xx.jeokyo_nm                                      /* _8- */
                    , xx.jm_cd                                          /* _9- */
                    , xx.jj_nm                                          /* _10- */
                    , CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='D' THEN xx.gwamok END     /* _11- */
                    , CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='D' THEN xx.gwamok_nm END  /* _12- */
                    , CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='C' THEN xx.gwamok END     /* _13- */
                    , CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='C' THEN xx.gwamok_nm END  /* _14- */
                    , xx.work_gb                                        /* _15- */
                    , xx.bigo                                           /* _16- */
                    , w_num                                             /* _17- */
                    , xx.seq_no                                         /* _18- */
                    , xx.chasu                                          /* _19- */
                    , CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='D' THEN xx.row_no END     /* _20- */
                    , CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='D' THEN xx.aek END        /* _21- */
                    , CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='C' THEN xx.row_no END     /* _22- */
                    , CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='C' THEN xx.aek END        /* _23- */
                    , xx.proc_step                                      /* _24- */
                    );
    end loop;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_BSS (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_gu                           IN    VARCHAR,
    p_where                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_naye                         IN    VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- Batch Step별 Status관리 Table 생성    ...
--
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO BSS tt  /* Batch Step Status 관리 */
    VALUES ( p_corp_gr, systimestamp, seq_bss.nextval, SUBSTRB(p_gu,1,4), SUBSTRB(p_where,1,800), SUBSTRB(p_naye,1,3000) );
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_CLCAFD (
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_ija_jigub_gb                 IN    VARCHAR,  /* 이자지급방법 */
    p_yy_ija_hoisu                 IN    NUMBER,   /* 년이자지급회수 */
    p_balh                         IN    DATE,
    p_sanghw                       IN    DATE,
    p_af_ymd                       OUT   DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 후이자일 계산 procedure
--
    w_af_ymd                       DATE;
BEGIN
    p_msg   := 'Y';

    if  p_ija_jigub_gb is null  then
        p_msg   := '후이자일계산-이자지급방법이 없습니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;
    if NVL (p_yy_ija_hoisu,0) = 0   then
        p_msg := '후이자일계산-이자지급회차가 없습니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;
    if  p_sanghw is null    then
        p_msg := '후이자일계산-상환일이 없습니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 할인채,통화채
    if  p_ija_jigub_gb IN ('0','1','2','3','A','B','C') then
        p_af_ymd := p_sanghw;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    w_af_ymd := ADD_MONTHS(p_ymd, 12 / p_yy_ija_hoisu);
    if  w_af_ymd is null    then
        p_msg := '후이자일을 계산하지 못했습니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 후이자일을 발행일 기준으로 생성
    BEGIN
        if  TO_CHAR (p_balh, 'dd') < TO_CHAR (w_af_ymd, 'dd')   then
            w_af_ymd := TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(w_af_ymd, 'yyyymm') || TO_CHAR(p_balh, 'dd'), 'yyyymmdd');
        end if;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        w_af_ymd := ADD_MONTHS(p_ymd, 12 / p_yy_ija_hoisu);
    END;
    if  w_af_ymd > p_sanghw then    w_af_ymd := p_sanghw;
    end if;

    p_af_ymd := w_af_ymd;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_CLCDGT (
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_digit                        OUT   VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 종목 check digit 계산
--
    sbuf                           VARCHAR (1);
    w_digit                        VARCHAR (30) := '';
    w_chasu                        NUMBER (1)   := 1;
    w_work                         VARCHAR (2);
    w_total                        NUMBER (2) := 0;
    w_idxlimit                     NUMBER (2) := 11;
BEGIN
    FOR i IN reverse 1..w_idxlimit LOOP
        sbuf    := SUBSTR(p_jm_cd,i,1);
        if  ascii (sbuf) between 48 AND 57      then    w_digit := sbuf || w_digit;                    -- 숫자
        elsif ascii (sbuf) between 65 AND 90    then    w_digit := TO_CHAR(ascii(sbuf)-55,'fm00')||w_digit; -- 영문자
        else
            p_msg   := '종목코드에 이상한 문자가 있습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    w_idxlimit := LENGTH(w_digit);

    FOR i IN reverse 1..w_idxlimit LOOP
        sbuf := SUBSTR(w_digit,i,1);
        if  w_chasu = 1 then
            w_work  := TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(sbuf) * 2, 'fm00');
            w_total := w_total + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(w_work,1,1)) + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(w_work,2,1));
            w_chasu := 0;
        else
            w_total := w_total + TO_NUMBER(sbuf);
            w_chasu := 1;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    if  MOD (w_total, 10) = 0   then
        p_digit := '0';
    else
        w_total := w_total - TRUNC(w_total, -1);
        p_digit := TO_CHAR(10 - w_total, 'fm0');
    end if;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_CLCIJAC (
    p_ija_jigub_gb                 IN    VARCHAR,  /* 이자지급방법 */
    p_bond_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 채권종류 */
    p_iyul                         IN    NUMBER,   /* 표면이율 / 할인(증)이율 */
    p_yy_ija_hoisu                 IN    NUMBER,   /* 이자지급횟수 */
    p_now_gugan_no                 IN    NUMBER,   /* 현 구간횟수 */
    p_jun_bok_ija                  IN    NUMBER,   /* 전구간복리합이자합 */
    p_balh_ymd                     IN    DATE,     /* 발행일 */
    p_sanghw_ymd                   IN    DATE,     /* 상환일 */
    p_ija                          OUT   NUMBER
 ) AS
-- 채권 단위이자
--
BEGIN
    p_ija := 0;
    if  p_ija_jigub_gb IN ('7','8','G','H','9') then    -- 이표채,연단리만기
        p_ija := p_iyul / p_yy_ija_hoisu;

--    elsif p_bond_cd = '101'    then    -- 통화채
--        p_ija     := p_iyul / 365 * (p_sanghw_ymd - p_balh_ymd);

    elsif p_ija_jigub_gb IN ('5','6','D','E','F')   then    -- 복리채 ( 소수 5자리이하 절사 )
        p_ija := (POWER (1 + (p_iyul / p_yy_ija_hoisu), p_now_gugan_no) - 1) - p_jun_bok_ija;

    elsif p_ija_jigub_gb = '4'  then    -- 서울도시철도채 5복2단 ( 소수 5자리이하 절사 )
        if  p_now_gugan_no <= 5 then
                p_ija := (POWER (1 + (p_iyul / p_yy_ija_hoisu), p_now_gugan_no) - 1) - p_jun_bok_ija;
        else    p_ija := p_iyul / p_yy_ija_hoisu;
        end if;
    else
        if  p_yy_ija_hoisu = 1  then
                p_ija := p_iyul / 365 * (p_sanghw_ymd - p_balh_ymd);
        else    p_ija := p_iyul;
        end if;
    end if;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_CLCIJAS (
    p_medo_ymd                     IN    DATE,
    p_balh_ymd                     IN    DATE,
    p_sanghw_ymd                   IN    DATE,
    p_ija_jigub_gb                 IN    VARCHAR,
    p_bond_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_aekm                         IN    NUMBER,
    p_balh_ga                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_pyom_iyul                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_yy_ija_hoisu                 IN    NUMBER,
    p_sc_gugan_ija                 OUT   NUMBER,
    p_sc_day_ija                   OUT   NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 선매출채 이자계산
--
    w_sc_ilsu                      NUMBER;
    w_ilsu                         NUMBER;

    w_ilban_ija                    NUMBER;
    w_tot_ija                      NUMBER;

    w_danga                        NUMBER;

    w_sc_gugan_ija                 NUMBER;
    w_sc_day_ija                   NUMBER;
BEGIN
    p_msg := 'Y';

    w_sc_ilsu := p_balh_ymd - p_medo_ymd;
    if  w_sc_ilsu = 0   then
        p_sc_gugan_ija := 0;
        p_sc_day_ija   := 0;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -----------------------------------------
    -- 이자지급방법에 따른 선매출 이자계산 --
    -----------------------------------------
--    if  (p_ija_jigub_gb IN ('7','8','9','G','H','0')) OR (p_bond_cd = '101')  then    -- 이표채,통화채
    if (p_ija_jigub_gb IN ('7', '8', '9', 'G', 'H', '0'))   then    -- 이표채
        w_sc_gugan_ija := p_aekm * p_pyom_iyul * w_sc_ilsu / 365;
        w_sc_day_ija   := w_sc_gugan_ija / w_sc_ilsu;

    elsif p_ija_jigub_gb IN ('1','2','3','A','B','C')   then    -- 할인채
        w_ilsu         := p_sanghw_ymd - p_balh_ymd;
        w_ilban_ija    := p_aekm * (p_pyom_iyul / 365 * w_ilsu);
        w_tot_ija      := p_aekm * (p_pyom_iyul / 365 * (w_sc_ilsu + w_ilsu));
        w_sc_gugan_ija := w_tot_ija    - w_ilban_ija;
        w_sc_day_ija   := w_sc_gugan_ija / w_sc_ilsu;

    elsif p_ija_jigub_gb IN ('4','5','6','D','E','F')   then    -- 복리채
        -----------------------------------
        -- 발행일이 1996.1.1보다 작고 장기채,중기채,산금채
        -- 혹은 토지채는 액면방식
        -----------------------------------
        if (p_balh_ymd < '1996.1.1' AND p_bond_cd IN ('102', '104', '105')) OR (p_bond_cd = '505')  then
            w_sc_gugan_ija := p_pyom_iyul * p_aekm * w_sc_ilsu / 365;
            w_sc_day_ija   := w_sc_gugan_ija / w_sc_ilsu;
        else
            w_danga := p_aekm / (POWER (1 + (p_pyom_iyul / p_yy_ija_hoisu), (p_yy_ija_hoisu * w_sc_ilsu / 365)));

            w_sc_gugan_ija := p_aekm - w_danga;
            w_sc_day_ija   := w_sc_gugan_ija / w_sc_ilsu;
        end if;
    end if;
    p_sc_gugan_ija := w_sc_gugan_ija;
    p_sc_day_ija   := w_sc_day_ija;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := 'clcijas:' || SUBSTR (sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_CLCIJAY (
    p_ija_jigub_gb                 IN    VARCHAR,  /* 이자지급방법 */
    p_ija_dcf                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* Day Count Fraction */
    p_pyom_iyul                    IN    NUMBER,   /* 표면이율 */
    p_yy_ija_hoisu                 IN    NUMBER,   /* 이자지급횟수 */
    p_now_gugan_no                 IN    NUMBER,   /* 현 구간횟수 */
    p_jun_bok_ija                  IN    NUMBER,   /* 전구간복리합이자합 */
    p_balh_ymd                     IN    DATE,     /* 발행일 */
    p_sanghw_ymd                   IN    DATE,     /* 상환일 */
    p_ija                          OUT   NUMBER
 ) AS
-- 해외채권 이자를 계산하기 위한 procedure
--
BEGIN
    p_ija := 0;
    if  p_ija_jigub_gb IN ('7') then    -- 이표채
        p_ija := p_pyom_iyul / p_yy_ija_hoisu;

    elsif p_ija_jigub_gb = '4'  then    -- 복리채
        p_ija := POWER (1 + (p_pyom_iyul / p_yy_ija_hoisu), p_now_gugan_no) - p_jun_bok_ija;
    else
        if  p_ija_dcf = '1'     then    p_ija := p_pyom_iyul;
        elsif p_ija_dcf = '2'   then    p_ija := p_pyom_iyul / 365 * (ADD_MONTHS (p_balh_ymd,12) - p_balh_ymd);
        else                            p_ija := p_pyom_iyul / 360 * (ADD_MONTHS (p_balh_ymd,12) - p_balh_ymd);
        end if;
    end if;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_COM_ANBUN (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_buy_date                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_aekm                         IN    NUMBER,
    p_chui_aek                     IN    NUMBER,
    p_pr_misu_ija                  IN    NUMBER,
    p_com_anbun_aek                OUT   NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
--  채권 상환손익액 계산
--
    w_gugan_no                     NUMBER;
    w_bf_ija_ymd                   DATE;
    w_af_ija_ymd                   DATE;

    sc_gugan_ija                   NUMBER;
    sc_sung_cost                   NUMBER;
    sc_misu_ija                    NUMBER;

    ig_gugan_ija                   NUMBER;
    ig_gugan_ilsu                  NUMBER;
    ig_pr_gugan_ija                NUMBER;
    ig_pr_gugan_ilsu               NUMBER;
    ig_pass_ilsu                   NUMBER;
    ig_pass_ija                    NUMBER;
    ig_pass_pr_ija                 NUMBER;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    p_msg := p_jm_cd || ' - 종목정보확인';
    for xx IN (
        SELECT balh_ymd       /* _1- */
             , medo_ymd       /* _2- */
             , sanghw_ymd     /* _3- */
             , sunme_ija_ymd  /* _4- */
             , ija_jigub_gb   /* _5- */
             , bond_cd        /* _6- */
             , bond_attr      /* _7- */
             , balh_ga        /* _8- */
             , bf_ija_ymd     /* _9- */
             , af_ija_ymd     /* _10- */
          FROM SCM0CJ t1  /* 채권종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.sunme_ija_ymd = xx.sanghw_ymd AND xx.medo_ymd < xx.balh_ymd  then
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL(bfil_sung_cost,0)
                     , NVL(bfil_misu_ija,0)
                     , NVL(gugan_ija,0)
                  INTO sc_sung_cost
                     , sc_misu_ija
                     , sc_gugan_ija
                  FROM SCM0SC t1  /* 채권 선매출이자현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd    = p_jm_cd
                   AND t1.buy_date = p_buy_date;
            EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
                p_msg := p_jm_cd || '- 선매출마스타 정보가 없습니다.';
                RETURN;
            END;
        else
            sc_sung_cost := 0;
            sc_misu_ija  := 0;
            sc_gugan_ija := 0;
        end if;

        if  xx.ija_jigub_gb IN ('7','8','9','G','H')    then
            -- 금융이표채는 발행단위(10,000원), 기타 이표채는 액면으로 계산
            if  NOT (xx.bond_attr = '3' AND (SUBSTR (xx.bond_cd,1,1) = '1' OR xx.bond_cd = '900'))  then
                xx.balh_ga := NVL (p_aekm,0);
            end if;

            SELECT gugan_ija
              INTO ig_gugan_ija
              FROM SCJ0IG t1  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.jm_cd      = p_jm_cd
               AND t1.ija_gb     = 'B'
               AND t1.af_ija_ymd = xx.af_ija_ymd;

            if  xx.bond_attr = '6'  then
                    ig_gugan_ija := TRUNC(xx.balh_ga * ig_gugan_ija) * TRUNC (p_aekm / xx.balh_ga,14);
            else    ig_gugan_ija := ceilnum(xx.balh_ga * ig_gugan_ija) * TRUNC (p_aekm / xx.balh_ga,14);
            end if;

            ig_pr_gugan_ija := 0;
        else
            SR_NOW_GUGAN_IJA (p_corp_gr, xx.sanghw_ymd - 1, p_jm_cd, p_aekm,
                              ig_gugan_ilsu, ig_gugan_ija, ig_pr_gugan_ilsu, ig_pr_gugan_ija, ig_pass_ilsu, ig_pass_ija, ig_pass_pr_ija,
                              w_gugan_no, w_bf_ija_ymd, w_af_ija_ymd, w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 수령액 계산(안분 미반영 처리키위해) 위해 20200305 yjs
        if  xx.ija_jigub_gb IN ('7','8','G','H','9')            then
            p_com_anbun_aek := p_aekm - (p_chui_aek + p_pr_misu_ija + sc_misu_ija + sc_sung_cost);

        elsif xx.ija_jigub_gb IN ('1','2','3','A','B','C','0')  then
            p_com_anbun_aek := p_aekm - ig_gugan_ija - p_chui_aek;

        elsif (xx.ija_jigub_gb IN ('4', '5', '6', 'D', 'E', 'F')) OR 
            (xx.bond_attr = '6' AND xx.bond_cd IN ('5','7','N','P','S','T') )    then
            p_com_anbun_aek := p_aekm - (p_chui_aek + sc_misu_ija + sc_sung_cost);
        else
            p_com_anbun_aek := p_aekm - p_chui_aek;
        end if;
        p_msg := 'Y';
        EXIT;
    end loop;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_DAY_RUN (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 자문관리 일 초기작업
--
    w_us_ymd                       DATE;
    w_hyun_ymd                     DATE;
    w_junyong_ymd                  DATE;
    w_ymd                          DATE;
    w_bymd                         DATE;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    if  p_corp_gr IN ('2502')   then
        -- 해외배분은 전일처리
        SELECT hyun_ymd
             , F_OPEN_US (TRUNC (now( ),'dd'),'-1')
             , F_OPEN_US (TRUNC (now( ),'dd'),'-2')
          INTO w_hyun_ymd
             , w_ymd
             , w_bymd
          FROM SZX0AA t1  /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr;
    else
        SELECT hyun_ymd
             , F_OPEN_YMD (TRUNC (now( ),'dd'),'-')
             , F_OPEN_YMD (TRUNC (now( ),'dd'),'-1')
          INTO w_hyun_ymd
             , w_ymd
             , w_bymd
          FROM SZX0AA t1  /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr;
    end if;

    if  w_hyun_ymd <> w_bymd  then
        p_msg := '작업일 (' || TO_CHAR (w_hyun_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '일)을 확인하십시오.';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_PROC0010 (p_corp_gr, w_hyun_ymd, w_msg);
    if  w_msg <> 'Y'    then
        p_msg := 'PROC0010 : ' || w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;
    commit;

    SELECT t1.HYUN_YMD
         , t1.JUNYONG_YMD + 1
      INTO w_hyun_ymd
         , w_junyong_ymd
      FROM SZX0AA t1  /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
     WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr;

    if  p_corp_gr IN ('2502')   then    -- USPM 기준정보 재처리
        DELETE FROM SZT0IA_V    /* 펀드별 모델산정 기준정보 */
         WHERE CORP_GR      = p_corp_gr
           AND TR_YMD       > w_junyong_ymd
           AND NVL(DEL,'N') <> 'Y'
           AND FUND_CD      IN (SELECT FUND_CD
                                  FROM SZT0IA_V ta  /* 펀드별 모델산정 기준정보 */
                                 WHERE ta.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                                   AND ta.TR_YMD  = F_OPEN_US(w_hyun_ymd,'-1'));

        DELETE FROM USPM    /* US Portfolio Model 일변 기준정보 */
         WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
           AND YMD     > w_junyong_ymd
           AND FUND_CD IN (SELECT FUND_CD
                             FROM SZT0IA_V ta  /* 펀드별 모델산정 기준정보 */
                            WHERE ta.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                              AND ta.TR_YMD  = F_OPEN_US(w_hyun_ymd,'-1'));

        DELETE FROM USPM_PORT   /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
         WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
           AND TYMD    > w_junyong_ymd
           AND FUND_CD IN (SELECT FUND_CD
                             FROM SZT0IA_V ta  /* 펀드별 모델산정 기준정보 */
                            WHERE ta.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                              AND ta.TR_YMD  = F_OPEN_US(w_hyun_ymd,'-1'));

        -- 해외 자료는 휴일분 처리를 당일 한번더 처리
        w_us_ymd := F_OPEN_YMD (w_hyun_ymd, '-1');
        if (w_us_ymd + 1) = w_hyun_ymd   then
            p_msg    := '작업일 변경 이월처리(' || TO_CHAR (w_hyun_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '일) 완료 !!!';
            w_us_ymd := w_hyun_ymd;
        else
            p_msg := '작업일 변경 이월처리(' || TO_CHAR (w_us_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '-' || TO_CHAR (w_hyun_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || ') 완료 !!!';
        end if;

        for xx IN (
            SELECT dt.YMD
                 , ps.PGM_ID
                 , ps.PGM_NM
              FROM SZX0PS ps  /* 프로그램별 처리단계 */
                 , SZX9DT dt  /* 작업일자 Between조건용 일자 */
             WHERE ps.PROC_SEQ BETWEEN 10 AND 99
               AND dt.YMD      BETWEEN w_us_ymd AND w_hyun_ymd
             ORDER BY dt.YMD, ps.PROC_SEQ
        ) loop
            UPDATE SZX0AA tt    /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
               SET HYUN_YMD = xx.ymd
             WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr;

            SR_EXEC (p_corp_gr, TO_CHAR (xx.ymd,'yyyy.mm.dd'), xx.pgm_id, 'DAY_RUN', w_msg);
            if  w_msg <> 'Y'    then
                p_msg := xx.pgm_id || '(' || TO_CHAR (xx.ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || ') : ' || w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end loop;
    else
        for xx IN (
            SELECT PGM_ID
                 , PGM_NM
              FROM SZX0PS ps  /* 프로그램별 처리단계 */
             WHERE proc_seq BETWEEN 10 AND 99
             ORDER BY PROC_SEQ
        ) loop
            SR_EXEC (p_corp_gr, TO_CHAR (w_hyun_ymd,'yyyy.mm.dd'), xx.pgm_id, 'DAY_RUN', w_msg);
            if  w_msg <> 'Y'    then
                p_msg := xx.pgm_id || ' : ' || w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end loop;
        p_msg := '작업일 변경 이월처리(' || TO_CHAR (w_hyun_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '일) 완료 !!!';
    end if;
    commit;

END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.sr_ddl (
    p_para                         IN    VARCHAR
) AS
-- DDL 명령어를 실행
--
    c1                           integer;
    ii                           integer;
BEGIN
    c1  := dbms_sql.open_cursor;
    dbms_sql.parse(c1, p_para, dbms_sql.native);
    ii  := dbms_sql.execute(c1);
    dbms_sql.close_cursor(c1);
--    sr_bss ('%', 'DDL', 'status='||ii, p_para||' - 실행' );
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_EXEC (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    VARCHAR,
    p_pgm_id                       IN    VARCHAR,
    p_user_id                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
    w_ymd                          DATE;
    sql_command                    VARCHAR(400);
    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    w_ymd := TO_DATE (p_ymd,'yyyy.mm.dd');
    if  p_pgm_id = 'SR_PROC0700'    then
        sql_command := 'begin ' || p_pgm_id || ' (:1, :2, :3, :p_msg); end;';
        EXECUTE immediate sql_command USING p_corp_gr, w_ymd, p_user_id, OUT w_msg;
    else
        sql_command := 'begin ' || p_pgm_id || ' (:1, :2, :p_msg); end;';
        EXECUTE immediate sql_command USING p_corp_gr, w_ymd, OUT w_msg;
    end if;
    p_msg := w_msg;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_FINCATCH1 (
    p_ymd                          IN    VARCHAR,
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 체결내역 LOAD
--
    v_fhandle                      UTL_FILE.FILE_TYPE;

    w_count                        NUMBER := 0;
    w_error                        NUMBER := 0;

    w_text                         VARCHAR(800);
    w_filename                     VARCHAR(50);

    w_200                          VARCHAR_varray_200;
BEGIN
    w_filename := '0' || p_corp_gr || '_FI10001_' || p_ymd || '.txt';
    v_fhandle  := UTL_FILE.fopen('FINCATCH', w_filename, 'r', 800);
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM FINCATCH_1 tt   /* 핀케치 체결정보 */
         WHERE 1 = 1 
           AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND op_dt   = p_ymd;

        LOOP
            UTL_FILE.get_line ( v_fhandle, w_text, 800 );

            w_200   := F_VARRAY (w_text,'|');
            w_count := w_count + 1;

            INSERT INTO FINCATCH_1 tt   /* 핀케치 체결정보 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr  /* _1- */
                   , w_200(2)   /* _2- */
                   , w_200(3)   /* _3- */
                   , w_200(4)   /* _4- */
                   , w_200(5)   /* _5- */
                   , w_200(6)   /* _6- */
                   , w_200(7)   /* _7- */
                   , w_200(8)   /* _8- */
                   , w_200(9)   /* _9- */
                   , w_200(10)  /* _10- */
                   , w_200(11)  /* _11- */
                   , w_200(12)  /* _12- */
                   , w_200(13)  /* _13- */
                   , w_200(14)  /* _14- */
                   , w_200(15)  /* _15- */
                   , w_200(16)  /* _16- */

                   , w_200(19)  /* _19- */

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_GETGC (
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_tr_dr_gb                     OUT   VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 거래코드의 거래증감구분을 가져온다.
--
BEGIN
    BEGIN
        SELECT tr_dr_gb
          INTO p_tr_dr_gb
          FROM SZX0GC t1  /* 거래코드 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd = p_tr_cd;
    EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
        p_msg := p_tr_cd || '- 거래코드를 등록하십시요.';
        RETURN;
    END;
    if  p_tr_dr_gb IS NULL  then
            p_msg := p_tr_cd || '- 거래증감구분을 등록하십시요.';
    else    p_msg := 'Y';
    end if;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_GETHL (
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 휴일 Check
--
BEGIN
    SELECT 'Y'
      INTO p_msg
      FROM SZX0HL t1  /* 공휴일 */
     WHERE t1.nation_cd = 'KR'
       AND t1.holi_ymd  = p_ymd;
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
    p_msg := 'N';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_GETJJ2 (
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_balh_co                      OUT   VARCHAR,
    p_woos_ilban_gb                OUT   VARCHAR,
    p_chg_gb                       OUT   VARCHAR,
    p_new_old_gb                   OUT   VARCHAR,
    p_danc_gb                      OUT   VARCHAR,
    p_koscom                       OUT   VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 주식종목의 성격 가져오기
--
BEGIN
    BEGIN
        SELECT balh_co        /* _1- */
             , woos_ilban_gb  /* _2- */
             , chg_gb         /* _3- */
             , new_old_gb     /* _4- */
             , danc_gb        /* _5- */
             , koscom_cd      /* _6- */
          INTO p_balh_co        /* _1- */
             , p_woos_ilban_gb  /* _2- */
             , p_chg_gb         /* _3- */
             , p_new_old_gb     /* _4- */
             , p_danc_gb        /* _5- */
             , p_koscom         /* _6- */
          FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
         WHERE t1.jm_cd = p_jm_cd;
    EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
        p_msg := p_jm_cd || '- 주식종목을 등록하십시요.';
        RETURN;
    END;
    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_GETJJ4 (
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_sosok_gb                     OUT   VARCHAR,
    p_danc_gb                      OUT   VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 발행기관 상장여부 가져오기
--
BEGIN
    SELECT t2.sosok_gb
         , t1.danc_gb
      INTO p_sosok_gb
         , p_danc_gb
      FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
         , SJX0JB t2  /* 발행기관 */
     WHERE t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd
       AND t2.balh_co = t1.balh_co;

    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
    p_msg := p_jm_cd || '- 주식종목(발행기관)을 등록하십시요.';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_GETSM5 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_tasa_jm_cd                   IN    VARCHAR,
    p_tr_jwa                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_tr_gjwa                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_danga                        OUT   NUMBER,
    p_gdanga                       OUT   NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 타사수익증권마스타의 매도가 구하기(차등분배는 과표좌수처리)
--
BEGIN
    p_msg := 'Y';

    SELECT ROUND((NVL(t1.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_aek,0)) / (NVL(t1.bfil_jwa,0) + NVL(t1.up_jwa,0)) * p_tr_jwa)
         , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.gbfil_jwa,0) + NVL(t1.gup_jwa,0)=0
                THEN 0
                ELSE ROUND((NVL(t1.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_aek,0)) / (NVL(t1.gbfil_jwa,0) + NVL(t1.gup_jwa,0)) * p_tr_gjwa)
           END
      INTO p_danga
         , p_gdanga
      FROM SJM5SM t1  /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd    = p_fund_cd
       AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
       AND t1.tasa_jm_cd = p_tasa_jm_cd;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := p_fund_cd || '-' || p_tasa_jm_cd || '- SJM5SM에 자료가 없습니다.';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_GETSU (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_susu_tr_co_cd                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_tr_aek                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_susu_sang_ga                 OUT   NUMBER,
    p_susu_rt                      OUT   NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 주식매매 수수료율
--
BEGIN
    SELECT susu_sang_ga
         , susu_rt
      INTO p_susu_sang_ga
         , p_susu_rt
      FROM SZX0SU t1  /* 주식매매 수수료율 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_co_cd = p_susu_tr_co_cd
       AND p_tr_aek    BETWEEN t1.from_chgyl_ga AND t1.TO_CHGYL_GA;

    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
    p_msg := p_susu_tr_co_cd || '-' || p_tr_aek || '- 해당 주식 매매수수료율을 등록하십시요.';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_GETSUSU (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_daeyeo_gb                    IN    VARCHAR,
    p_aekm                         IN    NUMBER,
    p_ilsu                         IN    NUMBER,
    p_susu_ga                      OUT   NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 중개수수료 가져오기(현금)
--
    w_susu_ga                      NUMBER   default 0;
BEGIN
    if  p_daeyeo_gb = '0'   then
        w_susu_ga := 0;
        p_msg     := 'Y';
    else
        for r1 IN (
            SELECT from_ilsu
                 , TO_ILSU
                 , susu_rt
              FROM SHX0SU t1  /* 중개수수료 구간 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.daeyeo_gb = p_daeyeo_gb
               AND ((TO_ILSU <= p_ilsu OR from_ilsu <= p_ilsu) AND TO_ILSU >= p_ilsu)
             ORDER BY from_ilsu, TO_ILSU
        ) loop
            if  r1.to_ilsu <= p_ilsu    then
                    w_susu_ga := w_susu_ga + TRUNC (p_aekm * (r1.to_ilsu - r1.from_ilsu + 1) * r1.susu_rt);
            else    w_susu_ga := w_susu_ga + TRUNC (p_aekm * (p_ilsu - r1.from_ilsu + 1) * r1.susu_rt);
            end if;
        end loop;
        if  w_susu_ga = 0   then
                p_msg := '중개수수료를 산출할 수 없습니다.';
        else    p_msg := 'Y';
        end if;
    end if;
    p_susu_ga := w_susu_ga;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_INSAG (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,     /* 처리일자 */
    p_work_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 작업구분('A'=결산외,'B'=결산) */
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 펀드코드 */
    p_fund_currency                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_gwamok                       IN    VARCHAR,  /* 계정과목 */
    p_aek                          IN    NUMBER    /* 금액 */
 ) AS
-- 난외계정 총계정원장 생성
--
BEGIN
    MERGE INTO SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
       USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd       = p_fund_cd
                   AND t1.fund_currency = p_fund_currency
                   AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
                   AND t1.work_gb       = p_work_gb
                   AND t1.gwamok        = p_gwamok )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
         UPDATE
            SET dr_aek = NVL(p_aek,0) - NVL(junj,0)
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
         INSERT
         VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
                , p_ymd            /* _2- */
                , p_work_gb        /* _3- */
                , p_fund_cd        /* _4- */
                , p_gwamok         /* _5- */
                , 'D'              /* _6- */
                , 0                /* _7- */
                , p_aek            /* _8- */
                , 0                /* _9- */
                , p_fund_currency  /* _10- */
                );

EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR (-20301, TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '-' || p_work_gb
                                                                  || '-' || p_fund_cd || '-' || p_gwamok || '-' || F_NTRIM(p_aek)
                                                                  || '-총계정원장 생성에러(' || SUBSTR( sqlerrm, 1, 9 ) || ')');
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_INSAG1 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,     /* 처리일자 */
    p_work_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 작업구분('A'=결산외,'B'=결산) */
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 펀드코드 */
    p_fund_currency                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_gwamok                       IN    VARCHAR,  /* 계정과목 */
    p_aek                          IN    NUMBER    /* 금액 */
 ) AS
-- 난외계정 총계정원장 생성(평가손익)
-- dr_aek = NVL(junj,0) * -1 처리 후 작업하는 경우
-- sr_skkp010_121   : gwamok  Between  'A0201' And 'A02ZZ'
--                    gwamok  Between  'A0301' And 'A0399'
--                    ==> skgp170에서 결산 후 평가손익 0처리
-- sr_skkp010_150   : gwamok  IN ('D0101','D0204','D0205','D0206')
-- sr_skkp010_mc_af : gwamok  LIKE 'B03%' AND gwamok != 'B0313'
--
BEGIN
    MERGE INTO SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
       USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd       = p_fund_cd
                   AND t1.fund_currency = p_fund_currency
                   AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
                   AND t1.work_gb       = p_work_gb
                   AND t1.gwamok        = p_gwamok )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
         UPDATE
            SET dr_aek = NVL(p_aek,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0)
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
         INSERT
         VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
                , p_ymd            /* _2- */
                , p_work_gb        /* _3- */
                , p_fund_cd        /* _4- */
                , p_gwamok         /* _5- */
                , 'D'              /* _6- */
                , 0                /* _7- */
                , p_aek            /* _8- */
                , 0                /* _9- */
                , p_fund_currency  /* _10- */
                );

EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR (-20301, TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '-' || p_work_gb || '-'
                                                                  || p_fund_cd || '-' || p_gwamok || '-' || F_NTRIM(p_aek)
                                                                  || '-총계정원장1 생성에러(' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,9) || ')');
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_INSBU (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_tr_ymd                       IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_work_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_upmu_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,

    p_chasu                        IN    NUMBER,
    p_row_no                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_dc_gb                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_gwamok                       IN    VARCHAR,
