    p_jeokyo_cd                    IN    VARCHAR,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_bigo                         IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 분개장 내역 생성
--
BEGIN
    p_msg := 'Y';
    IF NVL (p_aek,0) = 0    THEN    RETURN;
    end if;

    INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
    VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
           , p_tr_ymd         /* _2- */
           , p_work_gb        /* _3- */
           , p_fund_cd        /* _4- */
           , p_upmu_gb        /* _5- */
           , p_tr_cd          /* _6- */
           , p_jm_cd          /* _7- */
           , p_seq_no         /* _8- */
           , NVL(p_chasu,1)   /* _9- */
           , p_row_no         /* _10- */
           , p_dc_gb          /* _11- */
           , p_gwamok         /* _12- */
           , p_aek            /* _13- */
           , p_jeokyo_cd      /* _14- */
           , p_proc_step      /* _15- */
           , p_bigo           /* _16- */
           , p_fund_currency  /* _17- */
           );
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg   := TO_CHAR (p_tr_ymd,'yyyy.mm.dd') || '-' || p_tr_cd || '-' || p_work_gb || '-' || p_fund_cd
                                               || '-' || p_jm_cd || '-' || p_seq_no || ',' || p_chasu || ',' || p_row_no
                                              || '-분개처리가 안됐습니다.(' || SUBSTR (sqlerrm,1,9) || ')';
END;
/

    p_upmu_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,

    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 분개장 내역 생성

BEGIN
    p_msg := 'Y';
    if NVL (p_aek,0) = 0    then    RETURN;
    end if;

    INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */

           , p_tr_ymd         /* _2- */

                                               || '-' || p_seq_no || ',' || p_chasu || ',' || p_row_no
                                               || '-분개처리가 안됐습니다.(' || SUBSTR (sqlerrm,1,9) || ')';
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_INSKS (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_tr_ymd                       IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_sj_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_trustee                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_currency                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_chasu                        IN    NUMBER,
    p_tr_seq_no                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_org_gyey_aek                 IN    NUMBER,
    p_susu                         IN    NUMBER,
    p_tr_sonik_gb                  IN    VARCHAR,
    p_sudo_aek                     IN    NUMBER,
    p_sudo_ymd                     IN    DATE,
    p_tr_co_cd                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_gyulje_aek                   IN    NUMBER,
    p_hangsa_ga                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_dansu_aek                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 선물 수도결제내역 insert
--
BEGIN
    MERGE INTO SST0KS tt  /* 파생상품 수도결제 */
       USING DUAL ON ( corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
                   AND tr_ymd    = p_tr_ymd
                   AND tr_cd     = p_tr_cd
                   AND fund_cd   = p_fund_cd
                   AND sj_cd     = p_sj_cd
                   AND chasu     = p_chasu
                   AND tr_seq_no = p_tr_seq_no
                   AND trustee   = p_trustee
                   AND currency  = p_currency )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
         UPDATE
            SET org_gyey_aek = p_org_gyey_aek
              , susu         = p_susu
              , tr_sonik_gb  = p_tr_sonik_gb
              , sudo_aek     = p_sudo_aek
              , sudo_ymd     = p_sudo_ymd
              , tr_co_cd     = p_tr_co_cd
              , gyulje_aek   = p_gyulje_aek
              , hangsa_ga    = p_hangsa_ga
              , dansu_aek    = p_dansu_aek
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
         INSERT ( corp_gr       /* _1- */
                , tr_ymd        /* _2- */
                , fund_cd       /* _3- */
                , tr_cd         /* _4- */
                , sj_cd         /* _5- */
                , chasu         /* _6- */
                , tr_seq_no     /* _7- */
                , org_gyey_aek  /* _8- */
                , susu          /* _9- */
                , tr_sonik_gb   /* _10- */
                , sudo_aek      /* _11- */
                , sudo_ymd      /* _12- */
                , tr_co_cd      /* _13- */
                , gyulje_aek    /* _14- */
                , hangsa_ga     /* _15- */
                , dansu_aek     /* _16- */
                , trustee       /* _17- */
                , currency      /* _18- */
                )
         VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
                , p_tr_ymd        /* _2- */
                , p_fund_cd       /* _3- */
                , p_tr_cd         /* _4- */
                , p_sj_cd         /* _5- */
                , p_chasu         /* _6- */
                , p_tr_seq_no     /* _7- */
                , p_org_gyey_aek  /* _8- */
                , p_susu          /* _9- */
                , p_tr_sonik_gb   /* _10- */
                , p_sudo_aek      /* _11- */
                , p_sudo_ymd      /* _12- */
                , p_tr_co_cd      /* _13- */
                , p_gyulje_aek    /* _14- */
                , p_hangsa_ga     /* _15- */
                , p_dansu_aek     /* _16- */
                , p_trustee       /* _17- */
                , p_currency      /* _18- */
                );

    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := 'insks:' || SUBSTR  (sqlerrm,1,160);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA020F (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_corp_gr2                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    VARCHAR,
    p_balh_co                      IN    VARCHAR,
    R_SET                          OUT   RESULT_SET.REF_CURSOR
 ) AS
-- 주식 당일점검표
--
    w_ymd                          DATE;
    w_trade_ymd                    DATE;
    w_koscom_cd                    sjm0jm.koscom_cd%type;
    w_jm_cd                        sjm0jm.jm_cd%type;

    w_close                        NUMBER;
    w_preclose                     NUMBER;
    w_gclose                       NUMBER;
    w_gpreclose                    NUMBER;
    w_day_sonik                    NUMBER;
    w_day_gsonik                   NUMBER;
    w_aekm                         NUMBER;
    w_danga                        NUMBER;

    w_old_jm_cd                    VARCHAR(12);

    w_tr_cd                        VARCHAR(3);
    w_hab_co                       VARCHAR(5);
    w_pi_hab_co                    VARCHAR(5);
    w_tr_nm                        VARCHAR(80);
    w_churi                        VARCHAR(80);
    w_bigo                         VARCHAR(400);
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM GZZX1RT;

    w_ymd       := TO_DATE (p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');
    w_trade_ymd := F_TRADE_YMD (w_ymd, '-');
    w_koscom_cd := '!@#$';
    w_jm_cd     := '!@#$';

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.corp_gr                                                                  /* _1- */
             , aa.company_name                                                             /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                  /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_nm                                                                  /* _4- */
             , t1.balh_co                                                                  /* _5- */
             , t1.danc_gb                                                                  /* _6- */
             , t1.koscom_cd                                                                /* _7- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                    /* _8- */
             , jj.jj_nm                                                                    /* _9- */
             , t1.type_trench                                                              /* _10- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                                  /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0)                                   AS jusu          /* _12- */
             , NVL(t1.gongs_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_jusu,0)          AS gongs_jusu    /* _13- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0)                                    AS aek           /* _14- */
             , NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)  AS gongs_aek     /* _15- */
             , t1.sonik                                                                    /* _16- */
             , t1.misu_baed_aek                                                            /* _17- */
             , t1.mijunab_aek                                                              /* _18- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_jilg_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.lock_jusu,0)
                                        + NVL(t1.mesu_hald_jusu,0)        AS lock_jusu     /* _19- */
             , NVL(t1.gbfil_aek,0)                                        AS gaek          /* _20- */
             , t1.gsonik                                                                   /* _21- */
             , jb.gyul_mm                                                                  /* _22- */
             , CASE WHEN w_ymd < jb.venture_end THEN jb.venture_end
                                                ELSE NULL END             AS venture_end   /* _23- */
             , CASE WHEN w_ymd < jb.venture_end THEN jb.venture_end - w_ymd
                                                ELSE NULL END             AS jan           /* _24- */
          FROM SZX0AA aa  /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
             , SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJM0JJ jj  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE aa.corp_gr LIKE p_corp_gr2
           AND t1.corp_gr = aa.corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = w_ymd
           AND t1.balh_co = p_balh_co
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND jj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND jb.balh_co = t1.balh_co
         ORDER BY t1.koscom_cd, t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        if  w_koscom_cd != xx.koscom_cd then
            BEGIN
                SELECT CLOSE
                     , preclose
                     , aekm
                  INTO w_close
                     , w_preclose
                     , w_aekm
                  FROM SJT1TG t1  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
                 WHERE t1.ymd       = w_trade_ymd
                   AND t1.koscom_cd = xx.koscom_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                w_close    := 0;
                w_preclose := 0;
                w_aekm     := 0;
            END;
            w_koscom_cd := xx.koscom_cd;
        end if;

        if  w_jm_cd != xx.jm_cd then
            BEGIN
                SELECT dang_ggijun_ga
                     , jun_ggijun_ga
                  INTO w_gclose
                     , w_gpreclose
                  FROM SJT0SC t1  /* ETF/상장집합투자증권/타사집합투자증권 종가정보 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd     = w_trade_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                w_gclose    := NULL;
                w_gpreclose := NULL;
            END;
            w_jm_cd := xx.jm_cd;
        end if;

        -- 상장공시
        BEGIN
            SELECT old_jm_cd
              INTO w_old_jm_cd
              FROM SJT0SK t1  /* 상장 공시 */
             WHERE t1.tr_ymd        = w_ymd
               AND t1.tr_cd         IN ('G51','G54')
               AND t1.new_jm_cd     = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.new_koscom_cd = xx.koscom_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_old_jm_cd := xx.jm_cd;
        END;

        if  xx.jusu + xx.gongs_jusu = 0 then
                w_danga := 0;
        else    w_danga := TRUNC((xx.aek + xx.gongs_aek) / (xx.jusu + xx.gongs_jusu));
        end if;

        BEGIN
            if  w_old_jm_cd != xx.jm_cd then
                SELECT NVL(xx.sonik,0) - sonik
                     , NVL(xx.gsonik,0) - gsonik
                  INTO w_day_sonik
                     , w_day_gsonik
                  FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd         = w_ymd - 1
                   AND t1.jm_cd       = w_old_jm_cd
                   AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
                   AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
            else
                SELECT NVL(xx.sonik,0) - sonik
                     , NVL(xx.gsonik,0) - gsonik
                  INTO w_day_sonik
                     , w_day_gsonik
                  FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd         = w_ymd - 1
                   AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
                   AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_day_sonik  := xx.sonik;
            w_day_gsonik := xx.gsonik;
        END;

        -- 발행기관별 권리처리 현황
        w_bigo := '';

        -- 예상배당 등
        SELECT MAX(F_TR_NM(tr_cd)) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST    ORDER BY CASE WHEN corp_gr = p_corp_gr THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)
          INTO w_tr_nm
          FROM SJT0BK t1  /* 발행기관별 배당권리 내역 */
         WHERE tr_ymd  = w_ymd
           AND balh_co = p_balh_co
           AND corp_gr IN (p_corp_gr, '%');

        if  w_tr_nm IS NOT NULL then
            w_churi := '(미처리)';

            SELECT ''
              INTO w_churi
              FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = xx.corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     = w_ymd
               AND t1.balh_co = p_balh_co
               AND ROWNUM = 1;
        end if;
        if  w_tr_nm IS NOT NULL then
            if  w_bigo IS NULL  then
                    w_bigo := w_tr_nm || w_churi;
            else    w_bigo := w_bigo || ', ' || w_tr_nm || w_churi;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 증자
        BEGIN
            SELECT jeungj_mth
                 , F_TR_NM (tr_cd)
              INTO w_tr_cd
                 , w_tr_nm
              FROM SJT0JK t1  /* 증자공시 */
             WHERE t1.tr_ymd  = w_ymd
               AND t1.balh_co = p_balh_co;

            w_churi := '(미처리)';

            SELECT ''
              INTO w_churi
              FROM SJT0J1 t1  /* 증자대장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr    = xx.corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd        = w_ymd
               AND t1.balh_co    = p_balh_co
               AND t1.jeungj_mth = w_tr_cd
               AND ROWNUM = 1;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_tr_nm := NULL;
        END;
        if  w_tr_nm IS NOT NULL then
            if  w_bigo IS NULL  then
                    w_bigo := w_tr_nm || w_churi;
            else    w_bigo := w_bigo || ', ' || w_tr_nm || w_churi;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 상장
        BEGIN
            SELECT F_TR_NM (tr_cd)
              INTO w_tr_nm
              FROM SJT0SK t1  /* 상장 공시 */
             WHERE t1.tr_ymd  = w_ymd
               AND t1.balh_co = p_balh_co;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_tr_nm := NULL;
        END;
        if  w_tr_nm IS NOT NULL then
            if  w_bigo IS NULL  then
                    w_bigo := w_tr_nm;
            else    w_bigo := w_bigo || ', ' || w_tr_nm;
            end if;
        end if;
        BEGIN
            SELECT F_TR_NM (tr_cd)
              INTO w_tr_nm
              FROM SJT0JL t1  /* 신주인수권 상장정보 */
             WHERE t1.tr_ymd  = w_ymd
               AND t1.balh_co = p_balh_co
               AND t1.tr_cd   = 'G55';
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_tr_nm := NULL;
        END;
        if  w_tr_nm IS NOT NULL then
            if  w_bigo IS NULL  then
                    w_bigo := w_tr_nm;
            else    w_bigo := w_bigo || ', ' || w_tr_nm;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 합병 등
        BEGIN
            SELECT tr_cd
                 , hab_co
                 , pi_hab_co
                 , F_TR_NM (tr_cd)
              INTO w_tr_cd
                 , w_hab_co
                 , w_pi_hab_co
                 , w_tr_nm
              FROM SJT0HK t1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 공시자료 */
             WHERE t1.tr_ymd = w_ymd
               AND (t1.pi_hab_co = p_balh_co OR t1.hab_co = p_balh_co);

            w_churi := '(미처리)';

            SELECT ''
              INTO w_churi
              FROM SJT0H1 t1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr   = xx.corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd   = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd    = w_ymd
               AND t1.tr_cd     = w_tr_cd
               AND t1.hab_co    = w_hab_co
               AND t1.pi_hab_co = w_pi_hab_co
               AND ROWNUM = 1;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_tr_nm := NULL;
        END;
        if  w_tr_nm IS NOT NULL then
            if  w_bigo IS NULL  then
                    w_bigo := w_tr_nm || w_churi;
            else    w_bigo := w_bigo || ', ' || w_tr_nm || w_churi;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- PRINT TABLE 생성
        INSERT INTO GZZX1RT tt  
             ( rt_key  /* _1- */
             , c_01    /* _2- */
             , c_02    /* _3- */
             , c_03    /* _4- */
             , c_04    /* _5- */
             , c_05    /* _6- */
             , c_06    /* _7- */
             , c_07    /* _8- */
             , c_08    /* _9- */
             , c_09    /* _10- */
             , c_10    /* _11- */
             , c_11    /* _12- */
             , c_40    /* _13- */
             , n_01    /* _14- */
             , n_02    /* _15- */
             , n_03    /* _16- */
             , n_04    /* _17- */
             , n_05    /* _18- */
             , n_06    /* _19- */
             , n_07    /* _20- */
             , n_08    /* _21- */
             , n_09    /* _22- */
             , n_10    /* _23- */
             , n_11    /* _24- */
             , n_12    /* _25- */
             , n_13    /* _26- */
             , n_14    /* _27- */
             , n_15    /* _28- */
             , n_16    /* _29- */
             , n_17    /* _30- */
             , n_18    /* _31- */
             , n_19    /* _32- */
             , d_01    /* _33- */
             , n_20    /* _34- */
             , n_21    /* _35- */
             )
        VALUES ( 'JA020F'                                               /* _1- */
               , xx.corp_gr                                             /* _2- */
               , xx.company_name                                        /* _3- */
               , xx.fund_cd                                             /* _4- */
               , xx.fund_nm                                             /* _5- */
               , xx.koscom_cd                                           /* _6- */
               , xx.jm_cd                                               /* _7- */
               , xx.jj_nm                                               /* _8- */
               , xx.balh_co                                             /* _9- */
               , CASE WHEN xx.danc_gb IN ('A','C','D','G')
                      THEN '0' || xx.danc_gb
                      ELSE '9' || xx.danc_gb
                 END                                                    /* _10- */
               , xx.gyul_mm                                             /* _11- */
               , CASE xx.bs_type WHEN -1
                                 THEN '차입주식'
                                 ELSE NULL
                 END                                                    /* _12- */
               , w_bigo                                                 /* _13- */
               , xx.jusu + xx.gongs_jusu                                /* _14- */
               , xx.aek + xx.gongs_aek                                  /* _15- */
               , xx.gongs_jusu                                          /* _16- */
               , xx.gongs_aek                                           /* _17- */
               , NVL(xx.aek,0) + NVL(xx.gongs_aek,0) + NVL(xx.sonik,0)  /* _18- */
               , xx.sonik                                               /* _19- */
               , w_day_sonik                                            /* _20- */
               , w_preclose                                             /* _21- */
               , w_close                                                /* _22- */
               , NVL(xx.misu_baed_aek,0) + NVL(xx.mijunab_aek,0)        /* _23- */
               , w_aekm                                                 /* _24- */
               , w_danga                                                /* _25- */
               , xx.lock_jusu                                           /* _26- */
               , w_gpreclose                                            /* _27- */
               , w_gclose                                               /* _28- */
               , xx.gaek                                                /* _29- */
               , xx.gsonik                                              /* _30- */
               , xx.gaek + xx.gsonik                                    /* _31- */
               , w_day_gsonik                                           /* _32- */
               , xx.venture_end                                         /* _33- */
               , xx.jan                                                 /* _34- */
               , CASE WHEN w_bigo LIKE '%(미처리)%' THEN 255
                      WHEN w_bigo IS NOT NULL       THEN 13762560
                                                    ELSE 2960685 END    /* _35- */
               );
    end loop;

    OPEN R_SET FOR 
        SELECT c_01  AS corp_gr      /* _1- */
             , c_02  AS corp_nm      /* _2- */
             , c_03  AS fund_cd      /* _3- */
             , c_04  AS fund_nm      /* _4- */
             , c_05  AS koscom_cd    /* _5- */
             , c_06  AS jm_cd        /* _6- */
             , c_07  AS jj_nm        /* _7- */
             , c_08  AS balh_co      /* _8- */
             , c_09  AS jm_sort      /* _9- */
             , c_10  AS gyul_mm      /* _10- */
             , c_11  AS jm_type      /* _11- */
             , c_40  AS bigo         /* _12- */
             , n_01  AS jusu         /* _13- */
             , n_02  AS aek          /* _14- */
             , n_03  AS gongs_jusu   /* _15- */
             , n_04  AS gongs_aek    /* _16- */
             , n_05  AS pyunga_aek   /* _17- */
             , n_06  AS sonik        /* _18- */
             , n_07  AS day_sonik    /* _19- */
             , n_08  AS bjonga       /* _20- */
             , n_09  AS JOINGA       /* _21- */
             , n_10  AS mi_aek       /* _22- */
             , n_11  AS aekm         /* _23- */
             , n_12  AS danga        /* _24- */
             , n_13  AS lock_jusu    /* _25- */
             , n_14  AS gbjonga      /* _26- */
             , n_15  AS gjonga       /* _27- */
             , n_16  AS gaek         /* _28- */
             , n_17  AS gsonik       /* _29- */
             , n_18  AS gpyunga_aek  /* _30- */
             , n_19  AS day_gsonik   /* _31- */
             , d_01  AS venture_end  /* _32- */
             , n_20  AS jan          /* _33- */
             , n_21  AS font_color   /* _34- */
          FROM GZZX1RT t1
         WHERE t1.rt_key = 'JA020F'; 
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA021C (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_koscom_cd                    IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_brok_ymd                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 종목별 확정내역 가져오기
--
    w_brok_ymd                     DATE;
    w_balh_co                      sjm0jj.balh_co%type;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    -- 주식종목사항 가져오기
    BEGIN
        SELECT balh_co
          INTO w_balh_co
          FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
         WHERE jm_cd = p_jm_cd;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := p_jm_cd || '- 주식종목을 등록하십시요.';
        RETURN;
    END;

    if  p_tr_cd = 'F53' then    -- 전환사채단주대금수령
        INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             ( CORP_GR    /* _1- */
             , TR_YMD     /* _2- */
             , TR_CD      /* _3- */
             , FUND_CD    /* _4- */
             , JM_CD      /* _5- */
             , KOSCOM_CD  /* _6- */
             , HWAKJ_AEK  /* _7- */
             , DANGA      /* _8- */
             , SURY_AEK   /* _9- */
             , BROK_YMD   /* _10- */
             , UPD_USER   /* _11- */
             )
        SELECT t1.corp_gr        /* _1- */
             , p_ymd             /* _2- */
             , p_tr_cd           /* _3- */
             , gg.fund_cd        /* _4- */
             , p_jm_cd           /* _5- */
             , p_koscom_cd       /* _6- */
             , gg.chg_danju_aek  /* _7- */
             , 0                 /* _8- */
             , gg.chg_danju_aek  /* _9- */
             , gg.tr_ymd         /* _10- */
             , 'JA021C'          /* _11- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJT0GG gg  /* 전환 청구 (교환,신주인수권포함) */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   LIKE p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND gg.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND gg.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND gg.tr_cd                     = 'F51'
           AND gg.new_jm_cd                 = p_jm_cd
           AND NVL(gg.sury_ymd, p_ymd)      = p_ymd;

    elsif p_tr_cd = 'F57'   then    -- 교환사채단주대금수령
        INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             ( CORP_GR    /* _1- */
             , TR_YMD     /* _2- */
             , TR_CD      /* _3- */
             , FUND_CD    /* _4- */
             , JM_CD      /* _5- */
             , KOSCOM_CD  /* _6- */
             , HWAKJ_AEK  /* _7- */
             , DANGA      /* _8- */
             , SURY_AEK   /* _9- */
             , BROK_YMD   /* _10- */
             , UPD_USER   /* _11- */
             )
        SELECT t1.corp_gr        /* _1- */
             , p_ymd             /* _2- */
             , p_tr_cd           /* _3- */
             , gg.fund_cd        /* _4- */
             , p_jm_cd           /* _5- */
             , p_koscom_cd       /* _6- */
             , gg.chg_danju_aek  /* _7- */
             , 0                 /* _8- */
             , gg.chg_danju_aek  /* _9- */
             , gg.tr_ymd         /* _10- */
             , 'JA021C'          /* _11- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJT0GG gg  /* 전환 청구 (교환,신주인수권포함) */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   LIKE p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND gg.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND gg.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND gg.tr_cd                     = 'F55'
           AND gg.new_jm_cd                 = p_jm_cd
           AND NVL(gg.sury_ymd, p_ymd)      = p_ymd;

    elsif p_tr_cd = 'F16'   then    -- 주식매수청구대금수령
        INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
             , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
             , TR_CD        /* _3- */
             , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
             , JM_CD        /* _5- */
             , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
             , HWAKJ_AEK    /* _7- */
             , DANGA        /* _8- */
             , SURY_AEK     /* _9- */
             , TAX          /* _10- */
             , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _11- */
             , BS_TYPE      /* _12- */
             , BROK_YMD     /* _13- */
             , UPD_USER     /* _14- */
             )
        SELECT t1.corp_gr      /* _1- */
             , p_ymd           /* _2- */
             , p_tr_cd         /* _3- */
             , cy.fund_cd      /* _4- */
             , p_jm_cd         /* _5- */
             , p_koscom_cd     /* _6- */
             , cy.cheng_aek    /* _7- */
             , cy.danga        /* _8- */
             , cy.cheng_aek    /* _9- */
             , cy.tax          /* _10- */
             , cy.type_trench  /* _11- */
             , cy.bs_type      /* _12- */
             , cy.tr_ymd       /* _13- */
             , 'JA021C'        /* _14- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJT0CY cy  /* 주식청약내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   LIKE p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND cy.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND cy.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND cy.jm_cd                     = p_jm_cd
           AND cy.tr_cd                     = 'F65'
           AND NVL(cy.sury_ymd, p_ymd)      = p_ymd;

    elsif p_tr_cd = 'F42'   then    -- 공개매수확정
        INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
             , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
             , TR_CD        /* _3- */
             , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
             , JM_CD        /* _5- */
             , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
             , HWAKJ_AEK    /* _7- */
             , DANGA        /* _8- */
             , SURY_AEK     /* _9- */
             , TAX          /* _10- */
             , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _11- */
             , BS_TYPE      /* _12- */
             , BROK_YMD     /* _13- */
             , UPD_USER     /* _14- */
             )
        SELECT t1.corp_gr      /* _1- */
             , p_ymd           /* _2- */
             , p_tr_cd         /* _3- */
             , cy.fund_cd      /* _4- */
             , p_jm_cd         /* _5- */
             , p_koscom_cd     /* _6- */
             , cy.cheng_jusu   /* _7- */
             , cy.danga        /* _8- */
             , cy.cheng_jusu   /* _9- */
             , cy.tax          /* _10- */
             , cy.type_trench  /* _11- */
             , cy.bs_type      /* _12- */
             , cy.tr_ymd       /* _13- */
             , 'JA021C'        /* _14- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJT0CY cy  /* 주식청약내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   LIKE p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND cy.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND cy.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND cy.jm_cd                     = p_jm_cd
           AND cy.tr_cd                     = 'F41'
           AND NVL(cy.sury_ymd, p_ymd)      = p_ymd;

    elsif p_tr_cd = 'F43'   then    -- 공개매수 대금수령
        INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
             , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
             , TR_CD        /* _3- */
             , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
             , JM_CD        /* _5- */
             , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
             , HWAKJ_AEK    /* _7- */
             , DANGA        /* _8- */
             , SURY_AEK     /* _9- */
             , TAX          /* _10- */
             , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _11- */
             , BS_TYPE      /* _12- */
             , BROK_YMD     /* _13- */
             , UPD_USER     /* _14- */
             )
        SELECT t1.corp_gr                                /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                                     /* _2- */
             , p_tr_cd                                   /* _3- */
             , fs.fund_cd                                /* _4- */
             , p_jm_cd                                   /* _5- */
             , p_koscom_cd                               /* _6- */
             , (fs.sury_aek * fs.danga) - NVL(tax,0)     /* _7- */
             , fs.danga                                  /* _8- */
             , (fs.sury_aek * fs.danga) - NVL(fs.tax,0)  /* _9- */
             , fs.tax                                    /* _10- */
             , fs.type_trench                            /* _11- */
             , fs.bs_type                                /* _12- */
             , fs.brok_ymd                               /* _13- */
             , 'JA021C'                                  /* _14- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJT0FS fs  /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   LIKE p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND fs.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND fs.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND fs.jm_cd                     = p_jm_cd
           AND fs.tr_cd                     = 'F42';

    elsif p_tr_cd IN ('F17','F19')  then    -- 유무상주식 수령
        if SUBSTR (p_jm_cd,1,3) != 'Kxx'   then
            BEGIN
                SELECT created_ymd
                  INTO w_brok_ymd
                  FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
                 WHERE t1.jm_cd = p_jm_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := p_jm_cd || '- 유무상 수령 주식종목(신주생성일)을 등록하십시요.';
                RETURN;
            END;

            INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
                 ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
                 , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
                 , TR_CD        /* _3- */
                 , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
                 , JM_CD        /* _5- */
                 , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
                 , HWAKJ_AEK    /* _7- */
                 , DANGA        /* _8- */
                 , SURY_AEK     /* _9- */
                 , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _10- */
                 , BS_TYPE      /* _11- */
                 , BROK_YMD     /* _12- */
                 , UPD_USER     /* _13- */
                 )
            SELECT t1.corp_gr         /* _1- */
                 , p_ymd              /* _2- */
                 , p_tr_cd            /* _3- */
                 , j1.fund_cd         /* _4- */
                 , p_jm_cd            /* _5- */
                 , p_koscom_cd        /* _6- */
                 , SUM(j1.baej_jusu)  /* _7- */
                 , MAX(j1.balh_ga)    /* _8- */
                 , SUM(j1.baej_jusu)  /* _9- */
                 , j1.type_trench     /* _10- */
                 , j1.bs_type         /* _11- */
                 , w_brok_ymd         /* _12- */
                 , 'JA021C'           /* _13- */
              FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 , SJT0J1 j1  /* 증자대장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr                   LIKE p_corp_gr
               AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
               AND j1.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
               AND j1.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
               AND j1.ymd                       = w_brok_ymd
               AND j1.new_jm_cd                 = p_jm_cd
               AND NVL(j1.sury_ymd, p_ymd)      = p_ymd
             GROUP BY t1.CORP_GR, j1.FUND_CD, j1.TYPE_TRENCH, j1.BS_TYPE;
        else
            INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
                 ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
                 , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
                 , TR_CD        /* _3- */
                 , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
                 , JM_CD        /* _5- */
                 , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
                 , HWAKJ_AEK    /* _7- */
                 , DANGA        /* _8- */
                 , SURY_AEK     /* _9- */
                 , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _10- */
                 , BS_TYPE      /* _11- */
                 , BROK_YMD     /* _12- */
                 , UPD_USER     /* _13- */
                 )
            SELECT t1.corp_gr         /* _1- */
                 , p_ymd              /* _2- */
                 , p_tr_cd            /* _3- */
                 , jm.fund_cd         /* _4- */
                 , p_jm_cd            /* _5- */
                 , koscom_cd          /* _6- */
                 , jm.bfil_boyu_jusu  /* _7- */
                 , jl.hwakj_balh_ga   /* _8- */
                 , jm.bfil_boyu_jusu  /* _9- */
                 , jm.type_trench     /* _10- */
                 , jm.bs_type         /* _11- */
                 , jl.krak_ymd        /* _12- */
                 , 'JA021C'           /* _13- */
              FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 , SJM0JM jm  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                 , SJT0JL jl  /* 신주인수권 상장정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr                   LIKE p_corp_gr
               AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
               AND jm.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
               AND jm.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
               AND jm.ymd                       = p_ymd
               AND jm.jm_cd                     = p_jm_cd
               AND jl.tr_ymd                    < jm.ymd
               AND jl.jm_cd                     = jm.jm_cd
               AND jl.cheng_ymd                 = p_ymd;
        end if;

    elsif p_tr_cd = 'F20'   then    -- 무상 단주대금 수령
        SELECT MAX(krak_ymd)  /* 최종 증자 권리락일 가져오기 */
          INTO w_brok_ymd
          FROM SJT0JK t1  /* 증자공시 */
         WHERE t1.balh_co = w_balh_co
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'G35';

        INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
             , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
             , TR_CD        /* _3- */
             , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
             , JM_CD        /* _5- */
             , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
             , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _7- */
             , BS_TYPE      /* _8- */
             , BROK_YMD     /* _9- */
             , UPD_USER     /* _10- */
             )
        SELECT DISTINCT t1.corp_gr  /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                /* _2- */
             , p_tr_cd              /* _3- */
             , j1.fund_cd           /* _4- */
             , p_jm_cd              /* _5- */
             , p_koscom_cd          /* _6- */
             , j1.type_trench       /* _7- */
             , j1.bs_type           /* _8- */
             , w_brok_ymd           /* _9- */
             , 'JA021C'             /* _10- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJT0J1 j1  /* 증자대장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   LIKE p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND j1.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND j1.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND j1.ymd                       = w_brok_ymd
           AND j1.balh_co                   = w_balh_co;

    elsif p_tr_cd = 'F38'   then    -- 분할 단주대금 수령
        INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
             , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
             , TR_CD        /* _3- */
             , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
             , JM_CD        /* _5- */
             , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
             , HWAKJ_AEK    /* _7- */
             , DANGA        /* _8- */
             , SURY_AEK     /* _9- */
             , TAX          /* _10- */
             , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _11- */
             , BS_TYPE      /* _12- */
             , BROK_YMD     /* _13- */
             , UPD_USER     /* _14- */
             )
        SELECT t1.corp_gr          /* _1- */
             , p_ymd               /* _2- */
             , p_tr_cd             /* _3- */
             , h1.fund_cd          /* _4- */
             , p_jm_cd             /* _5- */
             , p_koscom_cd         /* _6- */
             , TRUNC((h1.boyu_jusu * h1.HAB_PER / 100 - h1.HAB_JUSU)
                      * tg.close)  /* _7- */
             , tg.close            /* _8- */
             , TRUNC((h1.boyu_jusu * h1.HAB_PER / 100 - h1.HAB_JUSU)
                      * tg.close)  /* _9- */
             , 0                   /* _10- */
             , h1.type_trench      /* _11- */
             , h1.bs_type          /* _12- */
             , h1.tr_ymd           /* _13- */
             , 'JA021C'            /* _14- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJT0H1 h1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
             , SJT0SK sk  /* 상장 공시 */
             , SJT1TG tg  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   LIKE p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND h1.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND h1.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND h1.tr_cd                     = 'G60'
           AND h1.new_jm_cd                 = p_jm_cd
           AND NVL(h1.aek_sury_ymd, p_ymd)  = p_ymd
           AND sk.tr_cd                     = 'G54'
           AND sk.old_jm_cd                 = h1.new_jm_cd
           AND tg.ymd                       = sk.tr_ymd
           AND tg.koscom_cd                 = sk.old_koscom_cd;

    elsif p_tr_cd = 'F12'   then    -- 배당주식 수령
        BEGIN
            SELECT created_ymd
              INTO w_brok_ymd
              FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE t1.jm_cd = p_jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := p_jm_cd || '- 배당주식 주식종목(신주생성일)을 등록하십시요.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
             , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
             , TR_CD        /* _3- */
             , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
             , JM_CD        /* _5- */
             , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
             , HWAKJ_AEK    /* _7- */
             , DANGA        /* _8- */
             , SURY_AEK     /* _9- */
             , CHUI_AEK     /* _10- */
             , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _11- */
             , BS_TYPE      /* _12- */
             , BROK_YMD     /* _13- */
             , UPD_USER     /* _14- */
             )
        SELECT t1.corp_gr                /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                     /* _2- */
             , p_tr_cd                   /* _3- */
             , bm.fund_cd                /* _4- */
             , p_jm_cd                   /* _5- */
             , p_koscom_cd               /* _6- */
             , SUM(CASE WHEN bm.juchong_ymd IS NULL
                        THEN CASE WHEN bm.hwakj_ymd IS NULL THEN bm.yesa_jusu
                                                            ELSE bm.hwakj_jusu END
                        ELSE bm.juchong_jusu
                   END)                  /* _7- */
             , MAX(bm.danga)             /* _8- */
             , SUM(CASE WHEN bm.juchong_ymd IS NULL
                        THEN CASE WHEN bm.hwakj_ymd IS NULL THEN bm.yesa_jusu
                                                            ELSE bm.hwakj_jusu END
                        ELSE bm.juchong_jusu
                   END)                  /* _9- */
             , SUM(CASE WHEN bm.juchong_ymd IS NULL
                        THEN CASE WHEN bm.hwakj_ymd IS NULL THEN bm.yesa_jusu
                                                            ELSE bm.hwakj_jusu END
                        ELSE bm.juchong_jusu
                   END) * MAX(bm.danga)  /* _10- */
             , bm.type_trench            /* _11- */
             , bm.bs_type                /* _12- */
             , w_brok_ymd                /* _13- */
             , 'JA021C'                  /* _14- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJT0BM bm  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND bm.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND bm.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(bm.del_yn,'2')           = '2'
           AND bm.new_jm_cd                 = p_jm_cd
           AND NVL(bm.sury_ymd, p_ymd)      = p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.CORP_GR, bm.FUND_CD, bm.TYPE_TRENCH, bm.BS_TYPE;

    elsif p_tr_cd = 'F13'   then    -- 배당단수주대금 수령
        for xx IN (
            SELECT MAX(tr_ymd)  AS ymd
              FROM (SELECT tr_ymd
                         , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY balh_co, tr_cd, brok_ymd
                                                   ORDER BY CASE WHEN corp_gr = p_corp_gr THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)  AS rnum
                      FROM SJT0BK p1  /* 발행기관별 배당권리 내역 */
                     WHERE tr_ymd  <= p_ymd
                       AND balh_co = w_balh_co
                       AND tr_cd   IN ('G10','G15')
                       AND corp_gr IN (p_corp_gr, '%')
                     )
             WHERE rnum = 1
        ) loop
            INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
                 ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
                 , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
                 , TR_CD        /* _3- */
                 , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
                 , JM_CD        /* _5- */
                 , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
                 , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _7- */
                 , BS_TYPE      /* _8- */
                 , BROK_YMD     /* _9- */
                 , UPD_USER     /* _10- */
                 )
            SELECT DISTINCT t1.corp_gr  /* _1- */
                 , p_ymd                /* _2- */
                 , p_tr_cd              /* _3- */
                 , bm.fund_cd           /* _4- */
                 , p_jm_cd              /* _5- */
                 , p_koscom_cd          /* _6- */
                 , bm.type_trench       /* _7- */
                 , bm.bs_type           /* _8- */
                 , xx.ymd               /* _9- */
                 , 'JA021C'             /* _10- */
              FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 , SJT0BM bm  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
               AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
               AND bm.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
               AND bm.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
               AND bm.ymd                       = xx.ymd
               AND NVL(bm.del_yn,'2')           = '2'
               AND bm.new_jm_cd                 = p_jm_cd
               AND (bm.sury_ymd IS NULL OR bm.sury_ymd BETWEEN (p_ymd - 20) AND p_ymd);
        end loop;

    elsif p_tr_cd = 'F47'   then    -- 공모주 추가납입/환불
        -- 확정청약 후 실권이 발행하는 경우가 있어 20200320 yjs '2' 추가
        for xx IN (
            SELECT corp_gr
                 , MAX(t1.tr_ymd)  AS ymd
              FROM SJT0CY t1  /* 주식청약내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr    LIKE p_corp_gr
               AND t1.tr_ymd     BETWEEN p_ymd - 60 AND p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd      = p_jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd      = 'F46'
               AND t1.cheng_type IN ('1','2')
             GROUP BY corp_gr
        ) loop
            INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
                 ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
                 , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
                 , TR_CD        /* _3- */
                 , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
                 , JM_CD        /* _5- */
                 , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
                 , HWAKJ_AEK    /* _7- */
                 , DANGA        /* _8- */
                 , CHUI_AEK     /* _9- */
                 , SURY_AEK     /* _10- */
                 , SUSU         /* _11- */
                 , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _12- */
                 , BS_TYPE      /* _13- */
                 , BROK_YMD     /* _14- */
                 , UPD_USER     /* _15- */
                 )
            SELECT t1.corp_gr                                 /* _1- */
                 , p_ymd                                      /* _2- */
                 , p_tr_cd                                    /* _3- */
                 , cy.fund_cd                                 /* _4- */
                 , p_jm_cd                                    /* _5- */
                 , p_koscom_cd                                /* _6- */
                 , cy.cheng_jusu                              /* _7- */
                 , cy.danga                                   /* _8- */
                 , cy.danga * cy.cheng_jusu + NVL(cy.susu,0)  /* _9- */
                 , cy.cheng_jusu                              /* _10- */
                 , cy.susu                                    /* _11- */
                 , cy.type_trench                             /* _12- */
                 , cy.bs_type                                 /* _13- */
                 , xx.ymd                                     /* _14- */
                 , 'JA021C'                                   /* _15- */
              FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 , SJT0CY cy  /* 주식청약내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = xx.corp_gr
               AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
               AND cy.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
               AND cy.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
               AND cy.tr_ymd                    = xx.ymd
               AND cy.jm_cd                     = p_jm_cd
               AND cy.tr_cd                     = 'F46'
               AND cy.cheng_type                IN ('1','2');
        end loop;

    elsif p_tr_cd = 'F49'   then    -- 미지급공모청약금 납입
        -- 확정전 평가 경우가 있어 20200915 yjs '3' 추가
        for xx IN (
            SELECT corp_gr
                 , MAX(t1.tr_ymd)  AS ymd
              FROM SJT0CY t1  /* 주식청약내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr    LIKE p_corp_gr
               AND t1.tr_ymd     BETWEEN p_ymd - 60 AND p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd      = p_jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd      = 'F46'
               AND t1.cheng_type = '3'
             GROUP BY corp_gr
        ) loop
            INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
                 ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
                 , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
                 , TR_CD        /* _3- */
                 , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
                 , JM_CD        /* _5- */
                 , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
                 , HWAKJ_AEK    /* _7- */
                 , DANGA        /* _8- */
                 , CHUI_AEK     /* _9- */
                 , SURY_AEK     /* _10- */
                 , SUSU         /* _11- */
                 , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _12- */
                 , BS_TYPE      /* _13- */
                 , BROK_YMD     /* _14- */
                 , UPD_USER     /* _15- */
                 )
            SELECT t1.corp_gr                                 /* _1- */
                 , p_ymd                                      /* _2- */
                 , p_tr_cd                                    /* _3- */
                 , cy.fund_cd                                 /* _4- */
                 , p_jm_cd                                    /* _5- */
                 , p_koscom_cd                                /* _6- */
                 , cy.cheng_jusu                              /* _7- */
                 , cy.danga                                   /* _8- */
                 , cy.danga * cy.cheng_jusu + NVL(cy.susu,0)  /* _9- */
                 , cy.cheng_jusu                              /* _10- */
                 , cy.susu                                    /* _11- */
                 , cy.type_trench                             /* _12- */
                 , cy.bs_type                                 /* _13- */
                 , xx.ymd                                     /* _14- */
                 , 'JA021C'                                   /* _15- */
              FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 , SJT0CY cy  /* 주식청약내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = xx.corp_gr
               AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
               AND cy.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
               AND cy.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
               AND cy.tr_ymd                    = xx.ymd
               AND cy.jm_cd                     = p_jm_cd
               AND cy.tr_cd                     = 'F46'
               AND cy.cheng_type                = '3';
        end loop;

    elsif p_tr_cd = 'F11'   then    -- 배당금 수령
        if  p_brok_ymd IS NULL  then
            SELECT MAX(brok_ymd)
              INTO w_brok_ymd
              FROM (SELECT brok_ymd
                         , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY balh_co, tr_cd, brok_ymd
                                                   ORDER BY CASE WHEN corp_gr = p_corp_gr THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)  AS rnum
                      FROM SJT0BK p1  /* 발행기관별 배당권리 내역 */
                     WHERE tr_ymd  BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(p_ymd, -6) AND p_ymd
                       AND balh_co = w_balh_co
                       AND tr_cd   = 'G10'
                       AND corp_gr IN (p_corp_gr, '%')
                     )
             WHERE rnum = 1;
        else
            w_brok_ymd := TO_DATE (p_brok_ymd,'yyyy.mm.dd');
        end if;

        INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
             , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
             , TR_CD        /* _3- */
             , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
             , JM_CD        /* _5- */
             , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
             , HWAKJ_AEK    /* _7- */
             , DANGA        /* _8- */
             , SURY_AEK     /* _9- */
             , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _10- */
             , BS_TYPE      /* _11- */
             , BROK_YMD     /* _12- */
             , UPD_USER     /* _13- */
             )
        SELECT t1.corp_gr       /* _1- */
             , p_ymd            /* _2- */
             , p_tr_cd          /* _3- */
             , bm.fund_cd       /* _4- */
             , p_jm_cd          /* _5- */
             , p_koscom_cd      /* _6- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN bm.juchong_ymd IS NULL
                            THEN CASE WHEN bm.hwakj_ymd IS NULL THEN bm.yesa_aek - NVL(bm.yesa_tax,0)
                                                                ELSE bm.hwakj_aek - NVL(bm.hwakj_tax,0) END
                            ELSE bm.juchong_aek
                       END),0)  /* _7- */
             , 0                /* _8- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN bm.juchong_ymd IS NULL
                            THEN CASE WHEN bm.hwakj_ymd IS NULL THEN bm.yesa_aek - NVL(bm.yesa_tax,0)
                                                                ELSE bm.hwakj_aek - NVL(bm.hwakj_tax,0) END
                            ELSE bm.juchong_aek
                       END),0)  /* _9- */
             , bm.type_trench   /* _10- */
             , bm.bs_type       /* _11- */
             , w_brok_ymd       /* _12- */
             , 'JA021C'         /* _13- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJT0BM bm  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND bm.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND bm.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND bm.ymd                       = w_brok_ymd
           AND NVL(bm.del_yn,'2')           = '2'
           AND bm.new_jm_cd                 = p_jm_cd
           AND NVL(bm.sury_ymd, p_ymd)      = p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.CORP_GR, bm.FUND_CD, bm.TYPE_TRENCH, bm.BS_TYPE;

    elsif p_tr_cd = 'F14'   then    -- 중간배당금 수령
        for xx IN (
            SELECT MAX(tr_ymd)  AS ymd
              FROM (SELECT tr_ymd
                         , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY balh_co, tr_cd, brok_ymd
                                                   ORDER BY CASE WHEN corp_gr = p_corp_gr THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)  AS rnum
                      FROM SJT0BK p1  /* 발행기관별 배당권리 내역 */
                     WHERE tr_ymd  <= p_ymd
                       AND balh_co = w_balh_co
                       AND tr_cd   = 'G15'
                       AND corp_gr IN (p_corp_gr, '%')
                     )
             WHERE rnum = 1
        ) loop
            INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
                 ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
                 , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
                 , TR_CD        /* _3- */
                 , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
                 , JM_CD        /* _5- */
                 , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
                 , HWAKJ_AEK    /* _7- */
                 , DANGA        /* _8- */
                 , SURY_AEK     /* _9- */
                 , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _10- */
                 , BS_TYPE      /* _11- */
                 , BROK_YMD     /* _12- */
                 , UPD_USER     /* _13- */
                 )
            SELECT t1.corp_gr      /* _1- */
                 , p_ymd           /* _2- */
                 , p_tr_cd         /* _3- */
                 , bm.fund_cd      /* _4- */
                 , p_jm_cd         /* _5- */
                 , p_koscom_cd     /* _6- */
                 , SUM(CASE WHEN bm.hwakj_ymd IS NULL THEN bm.yesa_aek - NVL(bm.yesa_tax,0)
                                                      ELSE bm.hwakj_aek - NVL(bm.hwakj_tax,0)
                       END)        /* _7- */
                 , 0               /* _8- */
                 , SUM(CASE WHEN bm.hwakj_ymd IS NULL THEN bm.yesa_aek - NVL(bm.yesa_tax,0)
                                                      ELSE bm.hwakj_aek - NVL(bm.hwakj_tax,0)
                       END)        /* _9- */
                 , bm.type_trench  /* _10- */
                 , bm.bs_type      /* _11- */
                 , xx.ymd          /* _12- */
                 , 'JA021C'        /* _13- */
              FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 , SJT0BM bm  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
               AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
               AND bm.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
               AND bm.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
               AND bm.ymd                       IN (xx.ymd, xx.ymd - 1)
               AND NVL(bm.del_yn,'2')           = '2'
               AND bm.new_jm_cd                 = p_jm_cd
               AND NVL(bm.sury_ymd, p_ymd)      = p_ymd
             GROUP BY t1.corp_gr, bm.fund_cd, bm.type_trench, bm.bs_type;
        end loop;

    elsif p_tr_cd IN ('F33','F39')  then    -- 감자/합병 단주대금
        for xx IN (
            SELECT corp_gr
                 , MAX(tr_ymd)  AS ymd
              FROM SJT0H1 t1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr   LIKE p_corp_gr
               AND t1.tr_cd     IN ('G40','G43','G45','G60')
               AND t1.new_jm_cd = p_jm_cd
             GROUP BY corp_gr
        ) loop
            INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
                 ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
                 , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
                 , TR_CD        /* _3- */
                 , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
                 , JM_CD        /* _5- */
                 , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
                 , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _7- */
                 , BS_TYPE      /* _8- */
                 , BROK_YMD     /* _9- */
                 , UPD_USER     /* _10- */
                 )
            SELECT DISTINCT t1.corp_gr  /* _1- */
                 , p_ymd                /* _2- */
                 , p_tr_cd              /* _3- */
                 , h1.fund_cd           /* _4- */
                 , p_jm_cd              /* _5- */
                 , p_koscom_cd          /* _6- */
                 , h1.type_trench       /* _7- */
                 , h1.bs_type           /* _8- */
                 , xx.ymd               /* _9- */
                 , 'JA021C'             /* _10- */
              FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 , SJT0H1 h1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = xx.corp_gr
               AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
               AND h1.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
               AND h1.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
               AND h1.tr_ymd                    = xx.ymd
               AND h1.tr_cd                     IN ('G40','G43','G45','G60')
               AND h1.new_jm_cd                 = p_jm_cd
               AND h1.hab_jusu                  > 0;
        end loop;

    elsif p_tr_cd IN ('F31','F34','F36','F3A')  then    -- 합병/감자/회사분할/부분분할합병
        INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
             , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
             , TR_CD        /* _3- */
             , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
             , JM_CD        /* _5- */
             , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
             , HWAKJ_AEK    /* _7- */
             , DANGA        /* _8- */
             , SURY_AEK     /* _9- */
             , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _10- */
             , BS_TYPE      /* _11- */
             , BROK_YMD     /* _12- */
             , UPD_USER     /* _13- */
             )
        SELECT t1.corp_gr        /* _1- */
             , p_ymd             /* _2- */
             , p_tr_cd           /* _3- */
             , h1.fund_cd        /* _4- */
             , p_jm_cd           /* _5- */
             , p_koscom_cd       /* _6- */
             , SUM(h1.hab_jusu)  /* _7- */
             , 0                 /* _8- */
             , SUM(h1.hab_jusu)  /* _9- */
             , h1.type_trench    /* _10- */
             , h1.bs_type        /* _11- */
             , h1.tr_ymd         /* _12- */
             , 'JA021C'          /* _13- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJT0H1 h1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   LIKE p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND h1.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND h1.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND h1.tr_ymd                    >= ADD_MONTHS(p_ymd,-3)
           AND h1.tr_cd                     = (CASE p_tr_cd WHEN 'F31' THEN 'G40'
                                                            WHEN 'F34' THEN 'G45'
                                                            WHEN 'F3A' THEN 'G43'
                                                            WHEN 'F36' THEN 'G60' END)
           AND h1.new_jm_cd                 = p_jm_cd
           AND NVL(h1.aek_sury_ymd, p_ymd)  = p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.corp_gr, h1.fund_cd, h1.type_trench, h1.bs_type, h1.tr_ymd;

    elsif p_tr_cd = 'F3B'   then    -- 부분분할주수
        INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
             , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
             , TR_CD        /* _3- */
             , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
             , JM_CD        /* _5- */
             , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
             , HWAKJ_AEK    /* _7- */
             , DANGA        /* _8- */
             , SURY_AEK     /* _9- */
             , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _10- */
             , BS_TYPE      /* _11- */
             , BROK_YMD     /* _12- */
             , UPD_USER     /* _13- */
             )
        SELECT t1.corp_gr        /* _1- */
             , p_ymd             /* _2- */
             , p_tr_cd           /* _3- */
             , h1.fund_cd        /* _4- */
             , p_jm_cd           /* _5- */
             , p_koscom_cd       /* _6- */
             , SUM(h1.gam_jusu)  /* _7- */
             , 0                 /* _8- */
             , SUM(h1.gam_jusu)  /* _9- */
             , h1.type_trench    /* _10- */
             , h1.bs_type        /* _11- */
             , h1.tr_ymd         /* _12- */
             , 'JA021C'          /* _13- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJT0H1 h1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   LIKE p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND h1.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND h1.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND h1.tr_ymd                    >= ADD_MONTHS(p_ymd,-3)
           AND h1.tr_cd                     = 'G43'
           AND h1.old_jm_cd                 = p_jm_cd
         GROUP BY t1.corp_gr, h1.fund_cd, h1.type_trench, h1.bs_type, h1.tr_ymd;

    elsif p_tr_cd IN ('F32','F35','F37')    then    -- 합병교부금/감자대금/유상소각 수령
        INSERT INTO SJT0FS tt   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
             , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
             , TR_CD        /* _3- */
             , FUND_CD      /* _4- */
             , JM_CD        /* _5- */
             , KOSCOM_CD    /* _6- */
             , HWAKJ_AEK    /* _7- */
             , DANGA        /* _8- */
             , SURY_AEK     /* _9- */
             , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _10- */
             , BS_TYPE      /* _11- */
             , UPD_USER     /* _12- */
             )
        SELECT p_corp_gr              /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                  /* _2- */
             , p_tr_cd                /* _3- */
             , h1.FUND_CD             /* _4- */
             , p_jm_cd                /* _5- */
             , p_koscom_cd            /* _6- */
             , SUM(h1.HAB_GYOUB_AEK)  /* _7- */
             , 0                      /* _8- */
             , SUM(h1.HAB_GYOUB_AEK)  /* _9- */
             , h1.TYPE_TRENCH         /* _10- */
             , h1.BS_TYPE             /* _11- */
             , 'JA021C'               /* _12- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJT0H1 h1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR                   LIKE p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.HAEJI_YMD, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND h1.CORP_GR                   = t1.CORP_GR
           AND h1.FUND_CD                   = t1.FUND_CD
           AND h1.TR_CD                     = (CASE p_tr_cd WHEN 'F32' THEN 'G40'
                                                            WHEN 'F35' THEN 'G45'
                                                            WHEN 'F37' THEN 'G47' END)
           AND h1.NEW_JM_CD                 = p_jm_cd
           AND NVL(h1.AEK_SURY_YMD, p_ymd)  = p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.CORP_GR, h1.FUND_CD, h1.TYPE_TRENCH, h1.BS_TYPE;
    else
        p_msg := p_tr_cd || '-반영되지 않은 거래유형입니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;
    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := p_tr_cd || '-중복생성';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA021H (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    VARCHAR,
    R_SET                          OUT   RESULT_SET.REF_CURSOR
 ) AS
-- 상장종목 보유내역
--
BEGIN
    OPEN R_SET FOR 
        SELECT /*+ FULL (SZX0AA) INDEX (SJM0JM SJM0JM_IDX) */ t1.corp_gr           /* _1- */
             , aa.company_name                                                     /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                          /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_nm                                                          /* _4- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                          /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.dw_jusu,0)
                                        + NVL(t1.gongs_up_jusu,0)         AS jusu  /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                       + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0)      AS aek   /* _7- */
             , t1.gongs_dw_jusu                                                    /* _8- */
             , t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek                                                /* _9- */
          FROM SZX0AA aa  /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
             , SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE aa.corp_gr LIKE p_corp_gr
           AND t1.corp_gr = aa.corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd
           AND NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.gongs_up_jusu,0) > 0
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, TO_DATE(p_ymd,'yyyymmdd') + 1) > TO_DATE(p_ymd,'yyyymmdd')
         ORDER BY 8, t1.corp_gr, t1.fund_cd, t1.bs_type; 
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA030E (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fr_jm_cd                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_to_jm_cd                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    VARCHAR,
    R_SET                          OUT   RESULT_SET.REF_CURSOR
 ) AS
-- 종목정보내역
--
    w_ymd                          DATE;

    w_now_gugan_no                 NUMBER;
    ig_gugan_misu_ija              NUMBER;
    ig_gugan_pr_ija                NUMBER;

    cs_sunn_tax                    NUMBER;
    cs_pr_sunn_tax                 NUMBER;
    cs_sc_sunn_tax                 NUMBER;

    sc_sung_cost                   NUMBER;
    sc_misu_ija                    NUMBER;
    sc_day_ija                     NUMBER;
    sc_gugan_ija                   NUMBER;
    sc_sung_tax                    NUMBER;

    w_kis_grade                    VARCHAR (4);
    w_kis_suik_rt                  NUMBER := 0;
    w_kis_danga                    NUMBER := 0;
    w_kap_grade                    VARCHAR (4);
    w_kap_suik_rt                  NUMBER := 0;
    w_kap_danga                    NUMBER := 0;
    w_nice_grade                   VARCHAR (4);
    w_nice_suik_rt                 NUMBER := 0;
    w_nice_danga                   NUMBER := 0;
    w_jy_suik_rt                   NUMBER := 0;
    w_jy_danga                     NUMBER := 0;

    p_rt_key                       VARCHAR (50);
BEGIN
    commit;
    p_rt_key := p_corp_gr || TO_CHAR  (seq_bss.nextval);
    w_ymd    := TO_DATE (p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.jm_cd                                                        /* _1-종목코드 */
             , t2.buy_date                                                     /* _2- */
             , t1.cj_fnm                                                       /* _3-종목전칭 */
             , t1.cj_nm                                                        /* _4-종목명칭(약칭) */
             , t1.cj_enm                                                       /* _5-종목영문명칭(약칭) */
             , t1.sanghw_ymd                                                   /* _6-상환일 */
             , t1.medo_ymd                                                     /* _7-매출일자 */
             , t1.sangj_gb                                                     /* _8-상장여부 */
             , t1.sunhu_gb                                                     /* _9-선후취구분 */
             , t1.halin_gb                                                     /* _10-할인구분 */
             , t1.ija_yy_su                                                    /* _11-이자지급연수 */
             , t1.yy_ija_hoisu                                                 /* _12-이자지급연횟수 */
             , t1.tot_ija_hoicha                                               /* _13-총이자지급회차 */
             , t1.bunhal_gb                                                    /* _14-특이사항(특이채구분) */
             , t1.ydong_gb                                                     /* _15-연동구분 */
             , t1.bojng_co                                                     /* _16-보증기관 */
             , t1.balh_aek                                                     /* _17-발행액 */
             , t1.bond_cd                                                      /* _18-채권종류코드 */
             , t1.budo_ymd                                                     /* _19-부도구분 */
             , t1.sunme_ija_ymd                                                /* _20-선매출이자수령일 */
             , t1.bf_ija_ymd                                                   /* _21-전이자수령일 */
             , t1.af_ija_ymd                                                   /* _22-후이자수령일 */
             , t1.now_gugan_no                                                 /* _23-현이자구간 번호 */
             , t1.bond_attr                                                    /* _24-채권속성 */
             , t1.ija_jigub_gb                                                 /* _25-이자지급방법 구분 */
             , t1.balh_ga                                                      /* _26-발행단위(가) */
             , t1.balh_co                                                      /* _27-발행기관 */
             , t5.chg_jm_cd                                                    /* _28- */
             , t5.chg_ga                                                       /* _29-적용단가 */
             , TO_DATE(t5.chg_start_il,'yyyymmdd')           AS chg_start      /* _30- */
             , TO_DATE(t5.chg_end_il,'yyyymmdd')             AS chg_end        /* _31- */
             , t1.jm_cre_dt                                                    /* _32-종목등록일 */
             , NVL(t1.as_cj_cd, t1.jm_cd)                    AS as_cj_cd       /* _33-구종목코드(AS) */
             , t2.ymd                                                          /* _34-처리일자 */
             , t2.fund_cd                                                      /* _35-펀드코드 */
             , t3.fund_nm                                                      /* _36-펀드명 */
             , t1.pyom_iyul                                                    /* _37-표면이율 */
             , t1.halin_iyul                                                   /* _38-할인율 */
             , t1.halj_iyul                                                    /* _39-할증율 */
             , NVL(t2.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t2.meib_aekm,0)
                                   - NVL(t2.medo_aekm,0)     AS aekm           /* _40-액면 */
             , NVL(t2.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t2.meib_aek,0)
                                       - NVL(t2.medo_aek,0)  AS chui_aek       /* _41-취득가 */
             , t2.sung_cost                                                    /* _42-선급비용 */
             , t2.pr_sung_cost                                                 /* _43-할인   선급비용 */
             , t2.misu_ija                                                     /* _44-미수이자 */
             , t2.pr_misu_ija                                                  /* _45-할인   미수이자 */
             , t2.sung_tax                                                     /* _46-선급원천세 */
             , t2.pr_sung_tax                                                  /* _47-할인 선급원천세 */
             , t2.anbun_aek                                                    /* _48-누적손익안분액 */
             , t2.day_ija                                                      /* _49-하루미수이자 */
             , t2.pr_day_ija                                                   /* _50-하루미수이자 */
             , t2.sc_day_ija                                                   /* _51-하루미수이자 */
             , t2.day_anbun_aek                                                /* _52-하루손익안분액 */
             , t1.balh_ymd                                                     /* _53-발행일 */
             , CASE WHEN t1.as_cj_cd IS NULL THEN 'N'
                                             ELSE 'Y'
               END                                           AS fund_siga_gb   /* _54-시가평가구분 */
             , t5.husunwi_gb                                                   /* _55-후순위채권 구분 */
             , t3.mg_cd                                                        /* _56- */
             , '(' || REPLACE(t4.tr_co_nm,'은행','') || ')'  AS sutak_nm       /* _57- */
             , NVL(t2.msd_meib_aekm,0)                       AS msd_meib_aekm  /* _58- */
             , NVL(t2.msd_meib_aek,0)                        AS msd_meib_aek   /* _59- */
             , NVL(t2.msd_medo_aekm,0)                       AS msd_medo_aekm  /* _60- */
             , NVL(t2.msd_medo_aek,0)                        AS msd_medo_aek   /* _61- */
          FROM SCM0CM t2            /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SCM0CJ t1            /* 채권종목 */
        LEFT   OUTER
                JOIN SCM0CJ_KAP t5  /* 한국자산평가 (채권발행정보) */
                  ON t5.as_cj_cd = NVL(t1.as_cj_cd, t1.jm_cd)
             , SZM0IA t3            /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZX2MM t4            /* 매매처 */
         WHERE t2.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t2.ymd      = w_ymd
           AND t2.jm_cd    BETWEEN p_fr_jm_cd AND p_to_jm_cd
           AND t1.corp_gr  = t2.corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd    = t2.jm_cd
           AND t3.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t3.fund_cd  = t2.fund_cd
           AND t4.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t4.tr_co_cd = t3.mg_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT bf_ija_ymd
                 , af_ija_ymd
                 , gugan_no
              INTO xx.bf_ija_ymd
                 , xx.af_ija_ymd
                 , w_now_gugan_no
              FROM SCJ0IG t1  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.ija_gb  = 'B'
               AND w_ymd      BETWEEN bf_ija_ymd AND (af_ija_ymd - 1);
        EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
            -- 선매출 이자구간
            xx.bf_ija_ymd  := xx.medo_ymd;
            xx.af_ija_ymd  := xx.balh_ymd;
            w_now_gugan_no := 0;
        END;

        SELECT NVL(MAX(gugan_ija * xx.aekm),0)
          INTO ig_gugan_misu_ija
          FROM SCJ0IG t1  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
           AND t1.ija_gb   = 'B'
           AND t1.gugan_no = w_now_gugan_no;

        SELECT NVL(MAX(gugan_ija * xx.aekm),0)
          INTO ig_gugan_pr_ija
          FROM SCJ0IG t1  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
           AND t1.ija_gb   IN ('I','J')
           AND t1.gugan_no = 1;

        -- 세금 납부/환급 제외로 삭제처리 20190528 yjs
        cs_sunn_tax    := 0;
        cs_pr_sunn_tax := 0;
        cs_sc_sunn_tax := 0;

        BEGIN
            -- 선매출 선급비용/미수이자/하루이자/구간이자/선급원천세
            SELECT NVL(t1.sung_cost,0)  /* _1- */
                 , NVL(t1.misu_ija,0)   /* _2- */
                 , NVL(t1.day_ija,0)    /* _3- */
                 , NVL(t1.gugan_ija,0)  /* _4- */
                 , NVL(t1.sung_tax,0)   /* _5- */
              INTO sc_sung_cost  /* _1- */
                 , sc_misu_ija   /* _2- */
                 , sc_day_ija    /* _3- */
                 , sc_gugan_ija  /* _4- */
                 , sc_sung_tax   /* _5- */
              FROM SCM0SC t1  /* 채권 선매출이자현황 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = w_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.buy_date = xx.buy_date;
        EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
            sc_sung_cost := 0;
            sc_misu_ija  := 0;
            sc_day_ija   := 0;
            sc_gugan_ija := 0;
            sc_sung_tax  := 0;
        END;

        -- 시가평가자료
        BEGIN
            SELECT kis_pg_nm     /* _1- */
                 , kis_suik_rt   /* _2- */
                 , kis_danga     /* _3- */
                 , kap_pg_nm     /* _4- */
                 , kap_suik_rt   /* _5- */
                 , kap_danga     /* _6- */
                 , nice_pg_nm    /* _7- */
                 , nice_suik_rt  /* _8- */
                 , nice_danga    /* _9- */
                 , jy_suik_rt    /* _10- */
                 , danga         /* _11- */
              INTO w_kis_grade     /* _1- */
                 , w_kis_suik_rt   /* _2- */
                 , w_kis_danga     /* _3- */
                 , w_kap_grade     /* _4- */
                 , w_kap_suik_rt   /* _5- */
                 , w_kap_danga     /* _6- */
                 , w_nice_grade    /* _7- */
                 , w_nice_suik_rt  /* _8- */
                 , w_nice_danga    /* _9- */
                 , w_jy_suik_rt    /* _10- */
                 , w_jy_danga      /* _11- */
              FROM SCM1SM t1  /* 채권 시가평가 자료 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd      = w_ymd
               AND t1.as_cj_cd = xx.as_cj_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_kis_grade    := '';
            w_kis_suik_rt  := 0;
            w_kis_danga    := 0;
            w_kap_grade    := '';
            w_kap_suik_rt  := 0;
            w_kap_danga    := 0;
            w_nice_grade   := '';
            w_nice_suik_rt := 0;
            w_nice_danga   := 0;
        END;

        -- PRINT TABLE 생성
        INSERT INTO GZZX1RT tt  
             ( rt_key  /* _1- */
             , c_01    /* _2-종목코드 */
             , c_02    /* _3-종목전칭 */
