             , c_03    /* _4-종목명칭(약칭) */
             , c_04    /* _5-종목영문명칭(약칭) */
             , d_01    /* _6-상환일 */
             , d_02    /* _7-매출일자 */
             , c_05    /* _8-상장여부 */
             , c_06    /* _9-선후취구분 */
             , c_07    /* _10-할인구분 */
             , c_29    /* _11-이자지급연수 */
             , c_30    /* _12-이자지급연횟수 */
             , c_31    /* _13-총이자지급회차 */
             , c_08    /* _14-특이사항(특이채구분) */
             , c_09    /* _15-연동구분 */
             , c_11    /* _16-보증기관 */
             , n_06    /* _17-발행액 */
             , c_12    /* _18-채권종류코드 */
             , d_14    /* _19-부도일자 */
             , d_03    /* _20-선매출이자수령일 */
             , d_04    /* _21-전이자수령일 */
             , d_05    /* _22-후이자수령일 */
             , c_32    /* _23-현이자구간 번호 */
             , c_15    /* _24-채권속성 */
             , c_16    /* _25-이자지급방법 구분 */
             , n_08    /* _26-발행단위(가) */
             , c_17    /* _27-발행기관 */
             , c_19    /* _28-주식구분(0:보통1:우선 */
             , n_09    /* _29-적용단가 */
             , d_07    /* _30-수령일 */
             , d_10    /* _31-결산일 */
             , d_11    /* _32-종목등록일 */
             , c_21    /* _33-구종목코드(AS) */
             , d_12    /* _34-처리일자 */
             , c_22    /* _35-펀드코드 */
             , c_35    /* _36-펀드명 */
             , n_10    /* _37-표면이율 */
             , n_11    /* _38-할인율 */
             , n_12    /* _39-할증율 */
             , n_13    /* _40-액면 */
             , n_14    /* _41-취득가 */
             , n_15    /* _42-선급비용 */
             , n_16    /* _43-할인   선급비용 */
             , n_18    /* _44-선매출 선급비용 */
             , n_19    /* _45-미수이자 */
             , n_20    /* _46-할인   미수이자 */
             , n_22    /* _47-선매출 미수이자 */
             , n_23    /* _48-하루 이자 */
             , n_24    /* _49-하루할인이자 */
             , n_26    /* _50-선매출 하루이자 */
             , n_27    /* _51-구간 이자 */
             , n_28    /* _52-구간할인이자 */
             , n_30    /* _53-선매출구간이자 */
             , n_31    /* _54-선급원천세 */
             , n_32    /* _55-할인 선급원천세 */
             , n_34    /* _56-선매출선급원천세 */
             , n_05    /* _57-선납원천세 */
             , n_04    /* _58-할인 선납원천세 */
             , n_03    /* _59-하루손익안분 */
             , n_02    /* _60-구간손익안분 */
             , n_01    /* _61-누적 손익안분 */
             , d_13    /* _62-발행일 */
             , c_24    /* _63- */
             , c_25    /* _64- */
             , c_27    /* _65- */
             , c_36    /* _66- */
             , c_37    /* _67- */
             , c_38    /* _68- */
             , n_07    /* _69- */
             , n_17    /* _70- */
             , c_39    /* _71- */
             , n_21    /* _72- */
             , n_25    /* _73- */
             , c_10    /* _74- */
             , n_33    /* _75- */
             , n_36    /* _76- */
             , n_29    /* _77- */
             , n_35    /* _78- */
             , c_40    /* _79- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_rt_key                                                        /* _1- */
               , xx.jm_cd                                                        /* _2-종목코드 */
               , xx.cj_fnm                                                       /* _3-종목전칭 */
               , xx.cj_nm                                                        /* _4-종목명칭(약칭) */
               , xx.cj_enm                                                       /* _5-종목영문명칭(약칭) */
               , xx.sanghw_ymd                                                   /* _6-상환일 */
               , xx.medo_ymd                                                     /* _7-매출일자 */
               , xx.sangj_gb                                                     /* _8-상장여부 */
               , xx.sunhu_gb                                                     /* _9-선후취구분 */
               , xx.halin_gb                                                     /* _10-할인구분 */
               , xx.ija_yy_su                                                    /* _11-이자지급연수 */
               , xx.yy_ija_hoisu                                                 /* _12-이자지급연횟수 */
               , xx.tot_ija_hoicha                                               /* _13-총이자지급회차 */
               , xx.bunhal_gb                                                    /* _14-특이사항(특이채구분) */
               , xx.ydong_gb                                                     /* _15-연동구분 */
               , xx.bojng_co                                                     /* _16-보증기관 */
               , xx.balh_aek                                                     /* _17-발행액 */
               , xx.bond_cd                                                      /* _18-채권종류코드 */
               , xx.budo_ymd                                                     /* _19-부도구분 */
               , xx.sunme_ija_ymd                                                /* _20-선매출이자수령일 */
               , xx.bf_ija_ymd                                                   /* _21-전이자수령일 */
               , xx.af_ija_ymd                                                   /* _22-후이자수령일 */
               , xx.now_gugan_no                                                 /* _23-현이자구간 번호 */
               , xx.bond_attr                                                    /* _24-채권속성 */
               , xx.ija_jigub_gb                                                 /* _25-이자지급방법 구분 */
               , xx.balh_ga                                                      /* _26-발행단위(가) */
               , xx.balh_co                                                      /* _27-발행기관 */
               , xx.chg_jm_cd                                                    /* _28- */
               , xx.chg_ga                                                       /* _29-적용단가 */
               , xx.chg_start                                                    /* _30- */
               , xx.chg_end                                                      /* _31- */
               , xx.jm_cre_dt                                                    /* _32-종목등록일 */
               , xx.as_cj_cd                                                     /* _33-구종목코드(AS) */
               , xx.ymd                                                          /* _34-처리일자 */
               , xx.fund_cd                                                      /* _35-펀드코드 */
               , xx.fund_nm                                                      /* _36-펀드명 */
               , xx.pyom_iyul                                                    /* _37-표면이율 */
               , xx.halin_iyul                                                   /* _38-할인율 */
               , xx.halj_iyul                                                    /* _39-할증율 */
               , xx.aekm + xx.msd_meib_aekm - xx.msd_medo_aekm                   /* _40-액면 */
               , xx.chui_aek + xx.anbun_aek + xx.msd_meib_aek - xx.msd_medo_aek  /* _41-취득가 */
               , xx.sung_cost                                                    /* _42-선급비용 */
               , xx.pr_sung_cost + sc_sung_cost                                  /* _43-할인   선급비용 */
               , sc_sung_cost                                                    /* _44-선매출 선급비용 */
               , xx.misu_ija                                                     /* _45-미수이자 */
               , xx.pr_misu_ija + sc_misu_ija                                    /* _46-할증   미수이자 */
               , sc_misu_ija                                                     /* _47-선매출 미수이자 */
               , xx.day_ija                                                      /* _48-하루 이자 */
               , xx.pr_day_ija                                                   /* _49-P 하루이자 */
               , sc_day_ija                                                      /* _50-선매출 하루이자 */
               , ig_gugan_misu_ija                                               /* _51-구간 이자 */
               , ig_gugan_pr_ija + sc_gugan_ija                                  /* _52-구간할증이자 */
               , sc_gugan_ija                                                    /* _53-선매출구간이자 */
               , TRUNC(xx.sung_tax)                                              /* _54-선급원천세 */
               , TRUNC(xx.pr_sung_tax) + TRUNC(sc_sung_tax)                      /* _55-할증 선급원천세 */
               , TRUNC(sc_sung_tax)                                              /* _56-선매출선급원천세 */
               , TRUNC(cs_sunn_tax)                                              /* _57-선납원천세 */
               , TRUNC(cs_pr_sunn_tax) + TRUNC(cs_sc_sunn_tax)                   /* _58-할증 선납원천세 */
               , xx.day_anbun_aek                                                /* _59-하루손익안분 */
               , 0                                                               /* _60-구간손익안분 */
               , xx.anbun_aek                                                    /* _61-누적 손익안분 */
               , xx.balh_ymd                                                     /* _62-발행일 */
               , F_TR_CO_NM(p_rt_key, xx.bojng_co)                               /* _63- */
               , F_BOND_NM(xx.bond_attr, xx.bond_cd)                             /* _64- */
               , F_BALH_NM(p_rt_key, xx.balh_co)                                 /* _65- */
               , xx.fund_siga_gb                                                 /* _66- */
               , xx.husunwi_gb                                                   /* _67- */
               , w_kis_grade                                                     /* _68- */
               , w_kis_suik_rt                                                   /* _69- */
               , w_kis_danga                                                     /* _70- */
               , w_kap_grade                                                     /* _71- */
               , w_kap_suik_rt                                                   /* _72- */
               , w_kap_danga                                                     /* _73- */
               , w_nice_grade                                                    /* _74- */
               , w_nice_suik_rt                                                  /* _75- */
               , w_nice_danga                                                    /* _76- */
               , w_jy_suik_rt                                                    /* _77- */
               , w_jy_danga                                                      /* _78- */
               , xx.sutak_nm                                                     /* _79- */
               );
    end loop;

    OPEN R_SET FOR 
        SELECT c_01  AS jm_cd            /* _1- */
             , c_02  AS cj_fnm           /* _2- */
             , c_03  AS cj_nm            /* _3- */
             , c_04  AS cj_enm           /* _4- */
             , d_01  AS sanghw_ymd       /* _5- */
             , d_02  AS medo_ymd         /* _6- */
             , c_05  AS sangj_gb         /* _7- */
             , c_06  AS sunhu_gb         /* _8- */
             , c_07  AS halin_gb         /* _9- */
             , c_29  AS ija_yy_su        /* _10- */
             , c_30  AS yy_ija_hoisu     /* _11- */
             , c_31  AS tot_ija_hoicha   /* _12- */
             , c_08  AS bunhal_gb        /* _13- */
             , c_09  AS ydong_gb         /* _14- */
             , c_11  AS bojng_co         /* _15- */
             , n_06  AS balh_aek         /* _16- */
             , c_12  AS bond_cd          /* _17- */
             , d_14  AS budo_ymd         /* _18- */
             , d_03  AS sunme_ija_ymd    /* _19- */
             , d_04  AS bf_ija_ymd       /* _20- */
             , d_05  AS af_ija_ymd       /* _21- */
             , c_32  AS now_gugan_no     /* _22- */
             , c_15  AS bond_attr        /* _23- */
             , c_16  AS ija_jigub_gb     /* _24- */
             , n_08  AS balh_ga          /* _25- */
             , c_17  AS balh_co          /* _26- */
             , c_19  AS chg_jm_cd        /* _27- */
             , n_09  AS chg_ga           /* _28- */
             , d_07  AS chg_start        /* _29- */
             , d_10  AS chg_end          /* _30- */
             , d_11  AS jm_cre_dt        /* _31- */
             , c_21  AS as_cj_cd         /* _32- */
             , d_12  AS ymd              /* _33- */
             , c_22  AS fund_cd          /* _34- */
             , c_35  AS fund_nm          /* _35- */
             , n_10  AS pyom_iyul        /* _36- */
             , n_11  AS halin_iyul       /* _37- */
             , n_12  AS halj_iyul        /* _38- */
             , n_13  AS aekm             /* _39- */
             , n_14  AS chui_aek         /* _40- */
             , n_15  AS sung_cost        /* _41- */
             , n_16  AS pr_sung_cost     /* _42- */
             , n_18  AS sc_sung_cost     /* _43- */
             , n_19  AS misu_ija         /* _44- */
             , n_20  AS pr_misu_ija      /* _45- */
             , n_22  AS sc_misu_ija      /* _46- */
             , n_23  AS day_misu_ija     /* _47- */
             , n_24  AS day_pr_ija       /* _48- */
             , n_26  AS sc_day_ija       /* _49- */
             , n_27  AS gugan_misu_ija   /* _50- */
             , n_28  AS gugan_pr_ija     /* _51- */
             , n_30  AS sc_gugan_ija     /* _52- */
             , n_31  AS sung_tax         /* _53- */
             , n_32  AS pr_sung_tax      /* _54- */
             , n_34  AS sc_sung_tax      /* _55- */
             , n_05  AS sunn_tax         /* _56- */
             , n_04  AS pr_sunn_tax      /* _57- */
             , n_03  AS day_anbun_aek    /* _58- */
             , n_02  AS gugan_anbun_aek  /* _59- */
             , n_01  AS anbun_aek        /* _60- */
             , d_13  AS balh_ymd         /* _61- */
             , c_24  AS code_nm2         /* _62- */
             , c_25  AS code_nm3         /* _63- */
             , c_27  AS code_nm5         /* _64- */
             , c_36  AS siga_gb          /* _65- */
             , c_37  AS husunwi_gb       /* _66- */
             , c_38  AS kis_grace        /* _67- */
             , n_07  AS kis_suk_rt       /* _68- */
             , n_17  AS kis_danga        /* _69- */
             , c_39  AS kap_grace        /* _70- */
             , n_21  AS kap_suk_rt       /* _71- */
             , n_25  AS kap_danga        /* _72- */
             , c_10  AS nice_grace       /* _73- */
             , n_33  AS nice_suk_rt      /* _74- */
             , n_36  AS nice_danga       /* _75- */
             , n_29  AS jy_suik_rt       /* _76- */
             , n_35  AS jy_danga         /* _77- */
             , c_40  AS sutak_nm         /* _78- */
          FROM GZZX1RT t1
         WHERE rt_key = p_rt_key
         ORDER BY jm_cd, fund_cd; 
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA030J (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    R_SET                          OUT   RESULT_SET.REF_CURSOR
 ) AS
-- 현금자산 이자내역
--
    w_gugan_ija                    NUMBER;
    w_ija_hoicha                   NUMBER;
BEGIN
    BEGIN
        SELECT gugan_no
             , gugan_ija
          INTO w_ija_hoicha
             , w_gugan_ija
          FROM SHJ0IG t1  /* 현금 종목별 이자구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd
           AND p_ymd      BETWEEN t1.bf_ija_ymd AND (t1.af_ija_ymd - 1);
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        w_ija_hoicha := 0;
        w_gugan_ija  := 0;
    END;

    OPEN R_SET FOR 
        SELECT t1.day_ija                                                                              /* _1- */
             , t1.misu_ija                                                                             /* _2- */
             , TRUNC(w_gugan_ija * (NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)))  /* _3- */
             , t1.sung_cost                                                                            /* _4- */
             , t1.sung_tax                                                                             /* _5- */
             , t1.sunn_tax                                                                             /* _6- */
             , t1.yesu_tax                                                                             /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)                         /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aek,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aek,0)                       /* _9- */
             , t1.anbun_aek                                                                            /* _10- */
             , t1.pyunga_aek                                                                           /* _11- */
             , t1.siga_aek                                                                             /* _12- */
             , t1.sanghw_aek                                                                           /* _13- */
             , t2.pyom_iyul                                                                            /* _14- */
             , t2.balh_ymd                                                                             /* _15- */
             , t2.sanghw_ymd                                                                           /* _16- */
             , t2.af_ija_ymd                                                                           /* _17- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_sunsu_ija,0) + NVL(t1.up_sunsu_ija,0) - NVL(t1.dw_sunsu_ija,0)              /* _18- */
             , NVL(t1.dw_sunsu_ija,0)                                                                  /* _19- */
          FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
             , SHM0HJ t2  /* 현금 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = TO_DATE(p_ymd,'yyyymmdd')
           AND t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd
           AND t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd; 
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA030K (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fymd                         IN    VARCHAR,
    p_tymd                         IN    VARCHAR,
    R_SET                          OUT   RESULT_SET.REF_CURSOR
 ) AS
-- 원리금 상환 명세표
--
    p_rt_key                       VARCHAR(50);
BEGIN
    commit;
    p_rt_key := p_corp_gr || TO_CHAR  (seq_bss.nextval);

    INSERT INTO GZZX1RT tt  
         ( rt_key  /* _1- */
         , d_01    /* _2- */
         , c_01    /* _3-종목코드 */
         , c_02    /* _4-종목명 */
         , c_03    /* _5-펀드코드 */
         , c_04    /* _6-펀드명 */
         , c_05    /* _7-종목구분 */
         , n_01    /* _8-액면 */
         , n_02    /* _9-원금 */
         , n_03    /* _10-수입이자 */
         , n_04    /* _11-선급비용 */
         , n_05    /* _12-세금 */
         , n_06    /* _13- */
         , n_13    /* _14- */
         , n_14    /* _15- */
         )
    SELECT p_rt_key                                                  /* _1- */
         , t1.sanghw_ymd                                             /* _2- */
         , t1.jm_cd                                                  /* _3- */
         , t3.cj_nm                                                  /* _4- */
         , t1.fund_cd                                                /* _5- */
         , t2.fund_nm                                                /* _6- */
         , '채권'                                                    /* _7- */
         , t1.aekm / 10000                                           /* _8- */
         , t1.won_gm                                                 /* _9- */
         , NVL(t1.misu_ija,0) + NVL(t1.sc_misu_ija,0)                /* _10- */
         , NVL(t1.sung_cost,0) + NVL(t1.sc_sung_cost,0)              /* _11- */
         , NVL(t1.sunn_tax,0) + NVL(t1.sc_sunn_tax,0)
                              + NVL(yesu_tax,0)
                              + NVL(sc_yesu_tax,0)                   /* _12- */
         , t1.won_ri_gm - (NVL(t1.sunn_tax,0) + NVL(t1.sc_sunn_tax,0)
                                              + NVL(yesu_tax,0)
                                              + NVL(sc_yesu_tax,0))  /* _13- */
         , t1.SUNSU_IJA                                              /* _14- */
         , t1.SUIB_IJA                                               /* _15- */
      FROM UCS0BH t1  /* 채권 상환내역 */
         , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         , SCM0CJ t3  /* 채권종목 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.sanghw_ymd BETWEEN TO_DATE(p_fymd,'yyyymmdd') AND TO_DATE(p_tymd,'yyyymmdd')
       AND t1.currency IS NULL
       AND t2.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
       AND t2.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
       AND t3.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
       AND t3.jm_cd      = t1.jm_cd;

    INSERT INTO GZZX1RT tt  
         ( rt_key  /* _1- */
         , d_01    /* _2- */
         , c_01    /* _3-종목코드 */
         , c_02    /* _4-종목명 */
         , c_03    /* _5-펀드코드 */
         , c_04    /* _6-펀드명 */
         , c_05    /* _7-종목구분 */
         , n_01    /* _8-액면 */
         , n_02    /* _9-원금 */
         , n_03    /* _10-수입이자 */
         , n_04    /* _11-선급비용 */
         , n_05    /* _12-세금 */
         , n_06    /* _13- */
         )
    SELECT p_rt_key                                                          /* _1- */
         , t1.sanghw_ymd                                                     /* _2- */
         , t1.hj_cd                                                          /* _3- */
         , F_JM_NM (p_corp_gr, t1.hj_cd)                                     /* _4- */
         , t1.fund_cd                                                        /* _5- */
         , t2.fund_nm                                                        /* _6- */
         , '현금'                                                            /* _7- */
         , t1.aekm / 10000                                                   /* _8- */
         , t1.sanghw_aek                                                     /* _9- */
         , t1.misu_ija                                                       /* _10- */
         , t1.sung_cost                                                      /* _11- */
         , NVL(t1.sunn_tax,0) + NVL(t1.yesu_tax,0)                           /* _12- */
         , NVL(t1.sanghw_aek,0) + NVL(t1.misu_ija,0) + NVL(t1.sung_cost,0)
                                - (NVL(t1.sunn_tax,0) + NVL(t1.yesu_tax,0))  /* _13- */
      FROM UHM0HP t1  /* 현금 상환내역 */
         , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.sanghw_ymd BETWEEN TO_DATE(p_fymd,'yyyymmdd') AND TO_DATE(p_tymd,'yyyymmdd')
       AND t2.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
       AND t2.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd;

    OPEN R_SET FOR 
        SELECT d_01  AS sanghw_ymd     /* _1- */
             , c_01  AS jm_cd          /* _2-종목코드 */
             , c_02  AS jm_nm          /* _3-종목명 */
             , c_03  AS fund_cd        /* _4-펀드코드 */
             , c_04  AS fund_nm        /* _5-펀드명 */
             , c_05  AS jm_gu          /* _6-종목구분 */
             , n_01  AS aekm           /* _7-액면 */
             , n_02  AS won_gm         /* _8-원금 */
             , n_03  AS misu_ija       /* _9-수입이자 */
             , n_05  AS sunn_tax       /* _10-세금 */
             , n_06  AS won_ri_gm      /* _11-수령액 */
             , n_04  AS sung_cost      /* _12-선급비용 */
             , c_11  AS currency       /* _13- */
             , n_11  AS cur_misu_ija   /* _14- */
             , n_12  AS cur_sung_cost  /* _15- */
             , n_13  AS hol_sunsu_ija  /* _16- */
             , n_14  AS hol_suib_ija   /* _17- */
          FROM GZZX1RT t1
         WHERE rt_key = p_rt_key
         ORDER BY d_01, c_05, c_01, c_03; 
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA031A (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 선물/옵션 전매/환매 거래내역 성성
--
    w_tr_cd                        VARCHAR (3);
    w_tr_gb                        VARCHAR (1);
    w_sm_tr_gb                     VARCHAR (1);

    w_gyey_su                      NUMBER;

    ss_susu_base_aek               NUMBER;
    ss_susu_rt                     NUMBER;

    all_susu                       NUMBER;
    jan_susu                       NUMBER;
    com_susu                       NUMBER;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_JA031A', p_ymd || ' : 선물/옵션 전매/환매 거래내역 성성' );

    -- 선물/옵션 거래내역 삭제
    DELETE FROM SST0KT tt   /* 파생 거래내역 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd
       AND ip_user = 'JA0313A';

    -- 만기처리내역 삭제
    DELETE FROM SST0KT t1   /* 파생 거래내역 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
       AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('S13','S23','S73','S83','S93','SA3','S74','S84','S94','SA4');

    -- 선물/옵션 매수/매도내역으로 환매/전매 확인 생성
    for xx IN (
        SELECT fund_cd        /* _1- */
             , tr_cd          /* _2- */
             , sj_cd          /* _3- */
             , chasu          /* _4- */
             , tr_seq_no      /* _5- */
             , gyey_su        /* _6- */
             , gyey_jisu      /* _7- */
             , gyey_aek       /* _8- */
             , tr_co_cd       /* _9- */
             , susu_tr_co_cd  /* _10- */
          FROM SST1KT t1  /* 파생거래 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
         ORDER BY tr_co_cd, fund_cd, sj_cd, tr_cd DESC
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'S10'    then    -- 매수선물
            w_tr_gb := '2';
            w_tr_cd := 'S21';  /* 환매약정 */

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'S20'  then    -- 매도선물
            w_tr_gb := '1';
            w_tr_cd := 'S11';  /* 전매약정 */

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'S70'  then    -- 콜매수
            w_tr_gb := '4';
            w_tr_cd := 'S81';  /* 콜환매 */

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'S80'  then    -- 콜매도
            w_tr_gb := '3';
            w_tr_cd := 'S71';  /* 콜전매 */

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'S90'  then    -- 풋매수
            w_tr_gb := '6';
            w_tr_cd := 'SA1';  /* 풋환매 */

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'SA0'  then    -- 풋매도
            w_tr_gb := '5';
            w_tr_cd := 'S91';  /* 풋전매 */
        else
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '_' || xx.tr_cd || '-선물거래 코드를 확인하십시오.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(up_gyey_su,0) - NVL(dw_gyey_su,0)
              INTO w_gyey_su
              FROM SSM0KM t1  /* 파생 보유현황 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.sj_cd    = xx.sj_cd
               AND t1.tr_co_cd = xx.tr_co_cd
               AND t1.sm_tr_gb = w_tr_gb
               AND t1.chasu    = xx.chasu;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_gyey_su := 0;
        END;
        if  w_gyey_su = 0   then
            INSERT INTO SST0KT tt   /* 파생 거래내역 */
                 ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd         /* _2- */
                 , fund_cd        /* _3- */
                 , tr_cd          /* _4- */
                 , sj_cd          /* _5- */
                 , chasu          /* _6- */
                 , tr_seq_no      /* _7- */
                 , gyey_su        /* _8- */
                 , gyey_jisu      /* _9- */
                 , gyey_aek       /* _10- */
                 , tr_co_cd       /* _11- */
                 , susu_tr_co_cd  /* _12- */
                 , ip_user        /* _13- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _3- */
                   , xx.tr_cd          /* _4- */
                   , xx.sj_cd          /* _5- */
                   , xx.chasu          /* _6- */
                   , xx.tr_seq_no      /* _7- */
                   , xx.gyey_su        /* _8- */
                   , xx.gyey_jisu      /* _9- */
                   , xx.gyey_aek       /* _10- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd       /* _11- */
                   , xx.susu_tr_co_cd  /* _12- */
                   , 'JA0313A'         /* _13- */
                   );

        elsif w_gyey_su >= xx.gyey_su   then
            INSERT INTO SST0KT tt   /* 파생 거래내역 */
                 ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd         /* _2- */
                 , fund_cd        /* _3- */
                 , tr_cd          /* _4- */
                 , sj_cd          /* _5- */
                 , chasu          /* _6- */
                 , tr_seq_no      /* _7- */
                 , gyey_su        /* _8- */
                 , gyey_jisu      /* _9- */
                 , gyey_aek       /* _10- */
                 , tr_co_cd       /* _11- */
                 , susu_tr_co_cd  /* _12- */
                 , ip_user        /* _13- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _3- */
                   , w_tr_cd           /* _4- */
                   , xx.sj_cd          /* _5- */
                   , xx.chasu          /* _6- */
                   , xx.tr_seq_no      /* _7- */
                   , xx.gyey_su        /* _8- */
                   , xx.gyey_jisu      /* _9- */
                   , xx.gyey_aek       /* _10- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd       /* _11- */
                   , xx.susu_tr_co_cd  /* _12- */
                   , 'JA0313A'         /* _13- */
                   );
        else
            INSERT INTO SST0KT tt   /* 파생 거래내역 */
                 ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd         /* _2- */
                 , fund_cd        /* _3- */
                 , tr_cd          /* _4- */
                 , sj_cd          /* _5- */
                 , chasu          /* _6- */
                 , tr_seq_no      /* _7- */
                 , gyey_su        /* _8- */
                 , gyey_jisu      /* _9- */
                 , gyey_aek       /* _10- */
                 , tr_co_cd       /* _11- */
                 , susu_tr_co_cd  /* _12- */
                 , ip_user        /* _13- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                               /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                                   /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                              /* _3- */
                   , xx.tr_cd                                /* _4- */
                   , xx.sj_cd                                /* _5- */
                   , xx.chasu                                /* _6- */
                   , xx.tr_seq_no                            /* _7- */
                   , xx.gyey_su - w_gyey_su                  /* _8- */
                   , xx.gyey_jisu                            /* _9- */
                   , xx.gyey_aek / xx.gyey_su
                                 * (xx.gyey_su - w_gyey_su)  /* _10- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd                             /* _11- */
                   , xx.susu_tr_co_cd                        /* _12- */
                   , 'JA0313A'                               /* _13- */
                   );

            INSERT INTO SST0KT tt   /* 파생 거래내역 */
                 ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd         /* _2- */
                 , fund_cd        /* _3- */
                 , tr_cd          /* _4- */
                 , sj_cd          /* _5- */
                 , chasu          /* _6- */
                 , tr_seq_no      /* _7- */
                 , gyey_su        /* _8- */
                 , gyey_jisu      /* _9- */
                 , gyey_aek       /* _10- */
                 , tr_co_cd       /* _11- */
                 , susu_tr_co_cd  /* _12- */
                 , ip_user        /* _13- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                               /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                                                   /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                                              /* _3- */
                   , w_tr_cd                                                 /* _4- */
                   , xx.sj_cd                                                /* _5- */
                   , xx.chasu                                                /* _6- */
                   , xx.tr_seq_no                                            /* _7- */
                   , w_gyey_su                                               /* _8- */
                   , xx.gyey_jisu                                            /* _9- */
                   , xx.gyey_aek - (xx.gyey_aek / xx.gyey_su
                                                * (xx.gyey_su - w_gyey_su))  /* _10- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd                                             /* _11- */
                   , xx.susu_tr_co_cd                                        /* _12- */
                   , 'JA0313A'                                               /* _13- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'A', 'JA031A', p_ymd || ' : 선물/옵션매매 수수료 계산' );

    -- 파생거래내역 펀드/매매처/수수료매매처/종목별 약정합계
    -- 최종결제는 별도 계산
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                  /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                 /* _2- */
             , t1.susu_tr_co_cd                            /* _3- */
             , t1.sj_cd                                    /* _4- */
             , CASE t1.tr_cd WHEN 'S10' THEN 'S2'
                             WHEN 'S20' THEN 'S1'
                             WHEN 'S70' THEN 'S8'
                             WHEN 'S80' THEN 'S7'
                             WHEN 'S90' THEN 'SA'
                             WHEN 'SA0' THEN 'S9'
                                        ELSE SUBSTR(t1.tr_cd,1,2)
               END                             AS tr_cd    /* _5- */
             , SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(t1.gyey_aek,0)=0
                        THEN NVL(t1.gyey_su,0) * NVL(t1.gyey_jisu,0)
                        ELSE t1.gyey_aek END)  AS tr_aek   /* _6- */
             , SUM(t1.gyey_su)                 AS gyey_su  /* _7- */
             , SUM(t1.susu)                    AS susu     /* _8- */
             , kj.jasan                                    /* _9- */
             , kj.unit_aek                                 /* _10- */
          FROM SST0KT t1  /* 파생 거래내역 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SSX0KJ kj  /* 파생종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd       = p_ymd
           AND REGEXP_LIKE (t1.tr_cd,'^[S][12789A]')
           AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE (t1.tr_cd,'[34]$')
           AND ia.corp_gr      = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd      = t1.fund_cd
           AND kj.corp_gr      = t1.corp_gr
           AND kj.sj_cd        = t1.sj_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, t1.tr_co_cd, t1.susu_tr_co_cd, t1.sj_cd
                , CASE t1.tr_cd WHEN 'S10' THEN 'S2'
                                WHEN 'S20' THEN 'S1'
                                WHEN 'S70' THEN 'S8'
                                WHEN 'S80' THEN 'S7'
                                WHEN 'S90' THEN 'SA'
                                WHEN 'SA0' THEN 'S9'
                                           ELSE SUBSTR(t1.tr_cd,1,2) END
                , kj.jasan  , kj.unit_aek
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT susu_base_aek
                 , susu_rt
              INTO ss_susu_base_aek
                 , ss_susu_rt
              FROM SSM0SS t1  /* 파생매매 수수료율 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr                 = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.tr_co_cd                = xx.susu_tr_co_cd
               AND (xx.tr_aek * xx.unit_aek)  BETWEEN t1.from_gugan_aek AND t1.to_gugan_aek;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            ss_susu_base_aek := 0;
            ss_susu_rt       := 0;
        END;

        /* 거래처별 수수료 계산 */
        if NVL (ss_susu_rt,0) = 0   then
                all_susu := ROUND (ss_susu_base_aek * xx.gyey_su);
        else    all_susu := TRUNC((xx.tr_aek * ss_susu_rt * xx.unit_aek), -1) + ss_susu_base_aek;
        end if;

        -- 펀드별 안분처리
        jan_susu := all_susu;
        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.gyey_su                                            /* _1- */
                 , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.gyey_aek,0)=0 THEN NVL(t1.gyey_su,0) * NVL(t1.gyey_jisu,0)
                                                  ELSE t1.gyey_aek
                   END                                       AS tr_aek   /* _2- */
                 , t1.rowid                                  AS row_id   /* _3- */
                 , COUNT(*) OVER ( )                         AS row_cnt  /* _4- */
                 , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (ORDER BY t1.gyey_su)  AS row_num  /* _5- */
              FROM SST0KT t1  /* 파생 거래내역 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd        = p_ymd
               AND t1.sj_cd         = xx.sj_cd
               AND t1.tr_co_cd      = xx.tr_co_cd
               AND t1.susu_tr_co_cd = xx.susu_tr_co_cd
               AND REGEXP_LIKE (t1.tr_cd,'^[S][12789A]')
               AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE (t1.tr_cd,'[34]$')
               AND ia.corp_gr       = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd
               AND (CASE t1.tr_cd WHEN 'S10' THEN 'S2'
                                  WHEN 'S20' THEN 'S1'
                                  WHEN 'S70' THEN 'S8'
                                  WHEN 'S80' THEN 'S7'
                                  WHEN 'S90' THEN 'SA'
                                  WHEN 'SA0' THEN 'S9'
                                             ELSE SUBSTR(t1.tr_cd,1,2)
                    END) = xx.tr_cd
             ORDER BY t1.gyey_su
        ) loop
            if  x1.row_cnt = x1.row_num then
                    com_susu := jan_susu;
            else    com_susu := TRUNC (all_susu * (x1.tr_aek / xx.tr_aek));
            end if;

            UPDATE SST0KT tt    /* 파생 거래내역 */
               SET susu = com_susu
             WHERE ROWID = x1.row_id;

            jan_susu := jan_susu - com_susu;
        end loop;
    end loop;

    -- 최종결제 펀드/매매처/수수료매매처/종목별 약정합계
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                               /* _2- */
             , t1.susu_tr_co_cd                                          /* _3- */
             , t1.sj_cd                                                  /* _4- */
             , CASE t1.tr_cd WHEN 'S10' THEN 'S2'
                             WHEN 'S20' THEN 'S1'
                             WHEN 'S70' THEN 'S8'
                             WHEN 'S80' THEN 'S7'
                             WHEN 'S90' THEN 'SA'
                             WHEN 'SA0' THEN 'S9'
                                        ELSE SUBSTR(t1.tr_cd,1,2)
               END                                           AS tr_cd    /* _5- */
             , SUM(NVL(t1.gyey_su,0) * NVL(t1.gyey_jisu,0))  AS tr_aek   /* _6- */
             , SUM(t1.gyey_su)                               AS gyey_su  /* _7- */
             , SUM(t1.susu)                                  AS susu     /* _8- */
             , kj.jasan                                                  /* _9- */
             , kj.unit_aek                                               /* _10- */
          FROM SST0KT t1  /* 파생 거래내역 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SSX0KJ kj  /* 파생종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
           AND REGEXP_LIKE (t1.tr_cd,'^[S][12789A]')
           AND REGEXP_LIKE (t1.tr_cd,'[34]$')
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
           AND kj.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND kj.sj_cd    = t1.sj_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, t1.tr_co_cd, t1.susu_tr_co_cd, t1.sj_cd
                , CASE t1.tr_cd WHEN 'S10' THEN 'S2'
                                WHEN 'S20' THEN 'S1'
                                WHEN 'S70' THEN 'S8'
                                WHEN 'S80' THEN 'S7'
                                WHEN 'S90' THEN 'SA'
                                WHEN 'SA0' THEN 'S9'
                                           ELSE SUBSTR(t1.tr_cd,1,2) END
                , kj.jasan  , kj.unit_aek
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT susu_base_aek
                 , susu_rt
              INTO ss_susu_base_aek
                 , ss_susu_rt
              FROM SSM0SS t1  /* 파생매매 수수료율 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr                 = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.tr_co_cd                = xx.susu_tr_co_cd
               AND (xx.tr_aek * xx.unit_aek)  BETWEEN t1.from_gugan_aek AND t1.to_gugan_aek;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            ss_susu_base_aek := 0;
            ss_susu_rt       := 0;
        END;

        /* 거래처별 수수료 계산 */
        if NVL (ss_susu_rt,0) = 0   then
                all_susu := ROUND (ss_susu_base_aek * xx.gyey_su);
        else    all_susu := ROUND((xx.tr_aek * ss_susu_rt * xx.unit_aek),0) + ss_susu_base_aek;
        end if;

        -- 펀드별 안분처리
        jan_susu := all_susu;
        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.gyey_su                                           /* _1- */
                 , NVL(t1.gyey_su * t1.gyey_jisu,0)          AS tr_aek  /* _2- */
                 , t1.rowid                                  AS row_id  /* _3- */
                 , COUNT(*) OVER ( )                         AS row_cnt /* _4- */
                 , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (ORDER BY t1.gyey_su)  AS row_num /* _5- */
              FROM SST0KT t1  /* 파생 거래내역 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd        = p_ymd
               AND t1.sj_cd         = xx.sj_cd
               AND t1.tr_co_cd      = xx.tr_co_cd
               AND t1.susu_tr_co_cd = xx.susu_tr_co_cd
               AND ia.corp_gr       = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd
               AND (CASE t1.tr_cd WHEN 'S10' THEN 'S2'
                                  WHEN 'S20' THEN 'S1'
                                  WHEN 'S70' THEN 'S8'
                                  WHEN 'S80' THEN 'S7'
                                  WHEN 'S90' THEN 'SA'
                                  WHEN 'SA0' THEN 'S9'
                                             ELSE SUBSTR(t1.tr_cd,1,2)
                    END) = xx.tr_cd
             ORDER BY t1.gyey_su
        ) loop
            if  x1.row_cnt = x1.row_num then
                    com_susu := jan_susu;
            else    com_susu := ROUND (all_susu * (x1.tr_aek / xx.tr_aek));
            end if;

            UPDATE SST0KT tt    /* 파생 거래내역 */
               SET susu = com_susu
             WHERE ROWID = x1.row_id;

            jan_susu := jan_susu - com_susu;
        end loop;
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := 'JA0313A:' || SUBSTR  (sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA031J (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ym                           IN    VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 금감원 보고서
--
    w_ymd_fr                       DATE;    /* 당월초 */
    w_ymd_to                       DATE;    /* 당월말 */
    w_pre_ymd                      DATE;    /* 전월말 */
    w_year_fr                      DATE;    /* 당기초 */
    w_year_to                      DATE;    /* 당기말 */
    w_pre_year_fr                  DATE;    /* 전기초 */
    w_pre_year_to                  DATE;    /* 전기말 */

    w_pre_cs_cnt                   NUMBER := 0;
    w_pre_acct_cnt                 NUMBER := 0;
    w_pre_wonbon_aek               NUMBER := 0;
    w_pre_nav                      NUMBER := 0;
    w_cs_cnt                       NUMBER := 0;
    w_acct_cnt                     NUMBER := 0;
    w_wonbon_aek                   NUMBER := 0;
    w_nav                          NUMBER := 0;
    w_seolj_cs_cnt                 NUMBER := 0;
    w_seolj_acct_cnt               NUMBER := 0;
    w_seolj_wonbon_aek             NUMBER := 0;
    w_seolj_nav                    NUMBER := 0;
    w_haeji_cs_cnt                 NUMBER := 0;
    w_haeji_acct_cnt               NUMBER := 0;
    w_haeji_wonbon_aek             NUMBER := 0;
    w_haeji_nav                    NUMBER := 0;
    w_jae_wonbon_aek               NUMBER := 0;

    w_susu                         NUMBER := 0;
    w_pre_susu                     NUMBER := 0;

    w_t_aek1                       NUMBER := 0;

BEGIN
    DELETE FROM GA
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ym      = p_ym;

    w_ymd_fr  := TO_DATE (p_ym || '01', 'yyyymmdd');
    w_ymd_to  := LAST_DAY  (w_ymd_fr);
    w_pre_ymd := LAST_DAY  (ADD_MONTHS(w_ymd_to,-1));

    w_year_fr     := w_ymd_fr;
    w_year_to     := w_ymd_to;
    w_pre_year_fr := ADD_MONTHS  (w_year_fr, -12);
    w_pre_year_to := LAST_DAY  (ADD_MONTHS(w_year_to,-12));

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- [GA179] 나.투자자문계약현황
    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 전월말 고객수/계약건수/계약금액
    SELECT COUNT(*)
         , SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(t1.fst_seolj_ymd,'yyyymm')=TO_CHAR(w_pre_ymd,'yyyymm')
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0 END)
         , SUM(hy.TOTAL_ASSET)
      INTO w_pre_cs_cnt
         , w_pre_acct_cnt
         , w_pre_nav
      FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         , SZX0SE se  /* 시리즈구분 */
         , UZM0HY hy  /* 계좌별 수요예측 집계자료 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr                       = p_corp_gr
       AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, w_pre_ymd + 1) > w_pre_ymd
       AND se.corp_gr                       = t1.corp_gr
       AND se.ga                            IN ('11','12')
       AND se.series_gb                     = t1.series_gb
       AND hy.corp_gr                       = t1.corp_gr
       AND hy.fund_cd                       = t1.fund_cd
       AND hy.ymd                           = w_pre_ymd;

    -- 당월말 고객수/계약건수/계약금액
    SELECT COUNT(*)
         , SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(t1.fst_seolj_ymd,'yyyymm')=TO_CHAR(w_pre_ymd,'yyyymm')
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0 END)
         , SUM(hy.TOTAL_ASSET)
      INTO w_cs_cnt
         , w_acct_cnt
         , w_nav
      FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         , SZX0SE se  /* 시리즈구분 */
         , UZM0HY hy  /* 계좌별 수요예측 집계자료 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr                      = p_corp_gr
       AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, w_ymd_to + 1) > w_ymd_to
       AND se.corp_gr                      = t1.corp_gr
       AND se.ga                           IN ('11','12')
       AND se.series_gb                    = t1.series_gb
       AND hy.corp_gr                      = t1.corp_gr
       AND hy.fund_cd                      = t1.fund_cd
       AND hy.ymd                          = w_ymd_to;

    INSERT INTO GA
         ( corp_gr  /* _1- */
         , ym       /* _2- */
         , fund_cd  /* _3- */
         , c_01     /* _4- */
         , c_02     /* _5- */
         , c_03     /* _6-구분 */
         , n_01     /* _7-전월말 */
         , n_02     /* _8-당월말 */
         , n_03     /* _9-증가 */
         , n_04     /* _10- */
         )
    VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
           , p_ym             /* _2- */
           , '%'              /* _3- */
           , 'GA179'          /* _4- */
           , 1                /* _5- */
           , '고객수'         /* _6-구분 */
           , w_pre_cs_cnt     /* _7-전월말 */
           , w_cs_cnt         /* _8-당월말 */
           , CASE WHEN w_cs_cnt > w_pre_cs_cnt
                  THEN w_cs_cnt - w_pre_cs_cnt
                  ELSE 0 END  /* _9-증가 */
           , CASE WHEN w_cs_cnt < w_pre_cs_cnt
                  THEN w_pre_cs_cnt - w_cs_cnt
                  ELSE 0 END  /* _10-감소 */
           );

    INSERT INTO GA
         ( corp_gr  /* _1- */
         , ym       /* _2- */
         , fund_cd  /* _3- */
         , c_01     /* _4- */
         , c_02     /* _5- */
         , c_03     /* _6-구분 */
         , n_01     /* _7-전월말 */
         , n_02     /* _8-당월말 */
         , n_03     /* _9-증가 */
         , n_04     /* _10- */
         )
    VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
           , p_ym             /* _2- */
           , '%'              /* _3- */
           , 'GA179'          /* _4- */
           , 2                /* _5- */
           , '자문계약건수'   /* _6-구분 */
           , w_pre_acct_cnt   /* _7-전월말 */
           , w_acct_cnt       /* _8-당월말 */
           , CASE WHEN w_acct_cnt > w_pre_acct_cnt
                  THEN w_acct_cnt - w_pre_acct_cnt
                  ELSE 0 END  /* _9-증가 */
           , CASE WHEN w_acct_cnt < w_pre_acct_cnt
                  THEN w_pre_acct_cnt - w_acct_cnt
                  ELSE 0 END  /* _10-감소 */
           );

    if  w_pre_nav < w_nav   then
        w_seolj_nav := w_nav - w_pre_nav;
        w_haeji_nav := 0;
    else
        w_seolj_nav := 0;
        w_haeji_nav := w_pre_nav - w_nav;
    end if;

    INSERT INTO GA
         ( corp_gr  /* _1- */
         , ym       /* _2- */
         , fund_cd  /* _3- */
         , c_01     /* _4- */
         , c_02     /* _5- */
         , c_03     /* _6-구분 */
         , n_01     /* _7-전월말 */
         , n_02     /* _8-당월말 */
         , n_03     /* _9-증가 */
         , n_04     /* _10- */
         )
    VALUES ( p_corp_gr           /* _1- */
           , p_ym                /* _2- */
           , '%'                 /* _3- */
           , 'GA179'             /* _4- */
           , 3                   /* _5- */
           , '자문계약자산총액'  /* _6-구분 */
           , w_pre_nav           /* _7-전월말 */
           , w_nav               /* _8-당월말 */
           , w_seolj_nav         /* _9-증가 */
           , w_haeji_nav         /* _10-감소 */
           );

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- [GA180] 다.자문수수료수입현황
    -----------------------------------------------------
--    SELECT NVL(SUM(pre_susu), 0)
--      INTO w_susu
--      FROM SAM2LD t1
--     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
--       AND t1.ymd     = w_year_to;
--
--    SELECT NVL(SUM(pre_susu), 0)
--      INTO w_pre_susu

--       AND t1.ymd     = w_pre_year_to;
--
--    INSERT INTO GA
--        ( corp_gr  /* _1- */
--  , ym
--  , fund_cd
--        , c_01    /* _2- */
--        , n_01    /* _3-전기말 */
--        , n_02    /* _4-당기말 */
--        , n_03    /* _5- */
--        )
--    VALUES ( p_corp_gr             /* _1-증감 */
--  , p_ym
--  , '%'
--           , 'GA180'              /* _2- */
--           , w_pre_susu           /* _3-전기말 */
--           , w_susu               /* _4-당기말 */
--           , w_susu - w_pre_susu  /* _5-증감 */
--           );

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- [GA181] 라.투자자문재산현황
    -----------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO GA
         ( corp_gr  /* _1- */
         , ym       /* _2- */
         , fund_cd  /* _3- */
         , C_01     /* _4- */
         , C_02     /* _5-계약자산구분 */
         , C_03     /* _6-투자자구분 */
         , n_01     /* _7-(1)금융투자업자_건수 */
         , n_02     /* _8-(1)금융투자업자_금액 */
         , n_03     /* _9-(2)투자일임재산_건수 */
         , n_04     /* _10-(2)투자일임재산_금액 */
         , n_05     /* _11-(3)집합투자재산_건수 */
         , n_06     /* _12-(3)집합투자재산_금액 */
         , n_07     /* _13-(4)은행_건수 */
         , n_08     /* _14-(4)은행_금액 */
         , n_09     /* _15-(5)보험회사(고유)_건수 */
         , n_10     /* _16-(5)보험회사(고유)_금액 */
         , n_11     /* _17-(6)연기금_건수 */
         , n_12     /* _18-(6)연기금_금액 */
         , n_13     /* _19-(7)공제회_건수 */
         , n_14     /* _20-(7)공제회_금액 */
         , n_15     /* _21-(8)종금_건수 */
         , n_16     /* _22-(8)종금_금액 */
         , n_17     /* _23-(9)개인_건수 */
         , n_18     /* _24-(9)개인_금액 */
         , n_19     /* _25-(A)기타_건수 */
         , n_20     /* _26- */
         )
    SELECT p_corp_gr                /* _1- */
         , p_ym                     /* _2- */
         , '%'                      /* _3- */
         , 'GA181'                  /* _4- */
         , '국내계약자산'  AS GB1   /* _5-계약자산구분 */
         , GB2             AS GB2   /* _6-투자자구분 */
         , SUM(CNT1)       AS CNT1  /* _7-(1)금융투자업자_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT1)       AS AMT1  /* _8-(1)금융투자업자_금액 */
         , SUM(CNT2)       AS CNT2  /* _9-(2)투자일임재산_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT2)       AS AMT2  /* _10-(2)투자일임재산_금액 */
         , SUM(CNT3)       AS CNT3  /* _11-(3)집합투자재산_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT3)       AS AMT3  /* _12-(3)집합투자재산_금액 */
         , SUM(CNT4)       AS CNT4  /* _13-(4)은행_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT4)       AS AMT4  /* _14-(4)은행_금액 */
         , SUM(CNT5)       AS CNT5  /* _15-(5)보험회사(고유)_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT5)       AS AMT5  /* _16-(5)보험회사(고유)_금액 */
         , SUM(CNT6)       AS CNT6  /* _17-(6)연기금_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT6)       AS AMT6  /* _18-(6)연기금_금액 */
         , SUM(CNT7)       AS CNT7  /* _19-(7)공제회_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT7)       AS AMT7  /* _20-(7)공제회_금액 */
         , SUM(CNT8)       AS CNT8  /* _21-(8)종금_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT8)       AS AMT8  /* _22-(8)종금_금액 */
         , SUM(CNT9)       AS CNT9  /* _23-(9)개인_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT9)       AS AMT9  /* _24-(9)개인_금액 */
         , SUM(CNTA)       AS CNTA  /* _25-(A)기타_건수 */
         , SUM(AMTA)       AS AMTA  /* _26-(A)기타_금액 */
      FROM (SELECT FD_CS_GB                                    AS GB2  /* _1-투자자구분 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='1' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT1 /* _2-(1)금융투자업자_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='1' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT1 /* _3-(1)금융투자업자_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='2' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT2 /* _4-(2)투자일임재산_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='2' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT2 /* _5-(2)투자일임재산_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='3' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT3 /* _6-(3)집합투자재산_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='3' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT3 /* _7-(3)집합투자재산_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='4' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT4 /* _8-(4)은행_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='4' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT4 /* _9-(4)은행_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='5' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT5 /* _10-(5)보험회사(고유)_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='5' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT5 /* _11-(5)보험회사(고유)_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='6' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT6 /* _12-(6)연기금_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='6' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT6 /* _13-(6)연기금_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='7' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT7 /* _14-(7)공제회_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='7' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT7 /* _15-(7)공제회_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='8' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT8 /* _16-(8)종금_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='8' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT8 /* _17-(8)종금_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='9' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT9 /* _18-(9)개인_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='9' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT9 /* _19-(9)개인_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='A' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNTA /* _20-(A)기타_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='A' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMTA /* _21-(A)기타_금액 */
              FROM (SELECT '1일반투자자'       AS FD_GB     /* 투자자구분 */
                         , '3'                 AS FD_CS_GB  /* 고객구분 */
                         , COUNT(t1.MG_CD)     AS CNT
                         , SUM(hy.INVEST_AMT)  AS AMT
                      FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                         , SZX0SE se  /* 시리즈구분 */
                         , UZM0HY hy  /* 계좌별 수요예측 집계자료 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr                      = p_corp_gr
                       AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, w_ymd_to + 1) > w_ymd_to
                       AND se.corp_gr                      = t1.corp_gr
                       AND se.ga                           = '11'
                       AND se.series_gb                    = t1.series_gb
                       AND hy.corp_gr                      = t1.corp_gr
                       AND hy.fund_cd                      = t1.fund_cd
                       AND hy.ymd                          = w_ymd_to
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT '2전문투자자'
                         , '9'
                         , COUNT(t1.MG_CD)     AS CNT
                         , SUM(hy.INVEST_AMT)  AS AMT
                      FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                         , SZX0SE se  /* 시리즈구분 */
                         , UZM0HY hy  /* 계좌별 수요예측 집계자료 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr                      = p_corp_gr
                       AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, w_ymd_to + 1) > w_ymd_to
                       AND se.corp_gr                      = t1.corp_gr
                       AND se.ga                           = '12'
                       AND se.series_gb                    = t1.series_gb
                       AND hy.corp_gr                      = t1.corp_gr
                       AND hy.fund_cd                      = t1.fund_cd
                       AND hy.ymd                          = w_ymd_to
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT '3계'
                         , '3'
                         , COUNT(t1.MG_CD)     AS CNT
                         , SUM(hy.INVEST_AMT)  AS AMT
                      FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                         , SZX0SE se  /* 시리즈구분 */
                         , UZM0HY hy  /* 계좌별 수요예측 집계자료 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr                      = p_corp_gr
                       AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, w_ymd_to + 1) > w_ymd_to
                       AND se.corp_gr                      = t1.corp_gr
                       AND se.ga                           IN ('11','12')
                       AND se.series_gb                    = t1.series_gb
                       AND hy.corp_gr                      = t1.corp_gr
                       AND hy.fund_cd                      = t1.fund_cd
                       AND hy.ymd                          = w_ymd_to
                     ) g1
             ) tt
     GROUP BY GB2
    UNION ALL

                    THEN 1

         , SUM(AMT1)       AS AMT1  /* _8-(1)금융투자업자_금액 */
         , SUM(CNT2)       AS CNT2  /* _9-(2)은행_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT2)       AS AMT2  /* _10-(2)은행_금액 */
         , SUM(CNT3)       AS CNT3  /* _11-(3)보험회사(고유계정)_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT3)       AS AMT3  /* _12-(3)보험회사(고유계정)_금액 */
         , SUM(CNT4)       AS CNT4  /* _13-(4)보험회사(특별계정)_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT4)       AS AMT4  /* _14-(4)보험회사(특별계정)_금액 */
         , SUM(CNT5)       AS CNT5  /* _15-(5)연기금_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT5)       AS AMT5  /* _16-(5)연기금_금액 */
         , SUM(CNT6)       AS CNT6  /* _17-(6)공제회_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT6)       AS AMT6  /* _18-(6)공제회_금액 */
         , SUM(CNT7)       AS CNT7  /* _19-(7)종금_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT7)       AS AMT7  /* _20-(7)종금_금액 */
         , SUM(CNT8)       AS CNT8  /* _21-(8)개인_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT8)       AS AMT8  /* _22-(8)개인_금액 */
         , SUM(CNT9)       AS CNT9  /* _23-(9)기타_건수 */
         , SUM(AMT9)       AS AMT9  /* _24-(9)기타_금액 */
      FROM (SELECT FD_GB                                       AS GB2  /* _1-투자자구분 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='1' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT1 /* _2-(1)금융투자업자_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='1' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT1 /* _3-(1)금융투자업자_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='2' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT2 /* _4-(2)은행_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='2' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT2 /* _5-(2)은행_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='3' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT3 /* _6-(3)보험회사(고유계정)_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='3' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT3 /* _7-(3)보험회사(고유계정)_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='4' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT4 /* _8-(4)보험회사(특별계정)_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='4' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT4 /* _9-(4)보험회사(특별계정)_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='5' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT5 /* _10-(5)연기금_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='5' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT5 /* _11-(5)연기금_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='6' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT6 /* _12-(6)공제회_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='6' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT6 /* _13-(6)공제회_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='7' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT7 /* _14-(7)종금_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='7' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT7 /* _15-(7)종금_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='8' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT8 /* _16-(8)개인_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='8' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT8 /* _17-(8)개인_금액 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='9' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END  AS CNT9 /* _18-(9)기타_건수 */
                 , CASE WHEN FD_CS_GB='9' THEN AMT ELSE 0 END  AS AMT9 /* _19-(9)기타_금액 */
              FROM (SELECT '1일반투자자'       AS FD_GB     /* 투자자구분 */
                         , '8'                 AS FD_CS_GB  /* 고객구분 */
                         , COUNT(t1.MG_CD)     AS CNT
                         , SUM(hy.INVEST_AMT)  AS AMT
                      FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                         , SZX0SE se  /* 시리즈구분 */
                         , UZM0HY hy  /* 계좌별 수요예측 집계자료 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr                      = p_corp_gr
                       AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, w_ymd_to + 1) > w_ymd_to
                       AND se.corp_gr                      = t1.corp_gr
                       AND se.ga                           = '21'
                       AND se.series_gb                    = t1.series_gb
                       AND hy.corp_gr                      = t1.corp_gr
                       AND hy.fund_cd                      = t1.fund_cd
                       AND hy.ymd                          = w_ymd_to
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT '2전문투자자'
                         , '8'
                         , COUNT(t1.MG_CD)     AS CNT
                         , SUM(hy.INVEST_AMT)  AS AMT
                      FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                         , SZX0SE se  /* 시리즈구분 */
                         , UZM0HY hy  /* 계좌별 수요예측 집계자료 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr                      = p_corp_gr
                       AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, w_ymd_to + 1) > w_ymd_to
                       AND se.corp_gr                      = t1.corp_gr
                       AND se.ga                           = '22'
                       AND se.series_gb                    = t1.series_gb
                       AND hy.corp_gr                      = t1.corp_gr
                       AND hy.fund_cd                      = t1.fund_cd
                       AND hy.ymd                          = w_ymd_to
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT '3계'
                         , '8'
                         , COUNT(t1.MG_CD)     AS CNT
                         , SUM(hy.INVEST_AMT)  AS AMT
                      FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                         , SZX0SE se  /* 시리즈구분 */
                         , UZM0HY hy  /* 계좌별 수요예측 집계자료 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr                      = p_corp_gr
                       AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, w_ymd_to + 1) > w_ymd_to
                       AND se.corp_gr                      = t1.corp_gr
                       AND se.ga                           IN ('21','22')
                       AND se.series_gb                    = t1.series_gb
                       AND hy.corp_gr                      = t1.corp_gr
                       AND hy.fund_cd                      = t1.fund_cd
                       AND hy.ymd                          = w_ymd_to
                     ) g1
             ) tt
     GROUP BY GB2
    UNION ALL

         , p_ym            /* _2- */

           , '30201'           /* _5- */
           , '파생상품'        /* _6- */
           , '장외파생상품'    /* _7- */
           , '이자율관련거래'  /* _8- */
           , 0                 /* _9- */
           , 0                 /* _10- */
           , 47                /* _11- */
           );

    INSERT INTO GA
         ( corp_gr  /* _1- */
         , ym       /* _2- */
         , fund_cd  /* _3- */
         , c_01     /* _4- */
         , c_02     /* _5- */
         , c_03     /* _6- */
         , c_04     /* _7- */
         , c_05     /* _8- */
         , n_01     /* _9- */
         , n_02     /* _10- */
         , n_03     /* _11- */
         )
    VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
           , p_ym            /* _2- */
           , '%'             /* _3- */
           , 'GA191'         /* _4- */
           , '30202'         /* _5- */
           , '파생상품'      /* _6- */
           , '장외파생상품'  /* _7- */
           , '통화관련거래'  /* _8- */
           , 0               /* _9- */
           , 0               /* _10- */
           , 48              /* _11- */
           );

    INSERT INTO GA
         ( corp_gr  /* _1- */
         , ym       /* _2- */
         , fund_cd  /* _3- */
         , c_01     /* _4- */
         , c_02     /* _5- */
         , c_03     /* _6- */
         , c_04     /* _7- */
         , c_05     /* _8- */
         , n_01     /* _9- */
         , n_02     /* _10- */
         , n_03     /* _11- */
         )
    VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
           , p_ym            /* _2- */
           , '%'             /* _3- */
           , 'GA191'         /* _4- */
           , '30203'         /* _5- */
           , '파생상품'      /* _6- */
           , '장외파생상품'  /* _7- */
           , '주식관련거래'  /* _8- */
           , 0               /* _9- */
           , 0               /* _10- */
           , 49              /* _11- */
           );

    INSERT INTO GA
         ( corp_gr  /* _1- */
         , ym       /* _2- */
         , fund_cd  /* _3- */
         , c_01     /* _4- */
         , c_02     /* _5- */
         , c_03     /* _6- */
         , c_04     /* _7- */
         , c_05     /* _8- */
         , n_01     /* _9- */
         , n_02     /* _10- */
         , n_03     /* _11- */
         )
    VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
           , p_ym            /* _2- */
           , '%'             /* _3- */
           , 'GA191'         /* _4- */
           , '30204'         /* _5- */
           , '파생상품'      /* _6- */
           , '장외파생상품'  /* _7- */
           , '기타'          /* _8- */
           , 0               /* _9- */
           , 0               /* _10- */
           , 50              /* _11- */
           );

    -- 기타로 차이분 보정처리 처리함.
    INSERT INTO GA
         ( corp_gr  /* _1- */
         , ym       /* _2- */
         , fund_cd  /* _3- */
         , c_01     /* _4- */
         , c_02     /* _5- */
         , c_03     /* _6- */
         , n_01     /* _7- */
         , n_02     /* _8- */
         , n_03     /* _9- */
         )
    SELECT p_corp_gr                                       /* _1- */
         , p_ym                                            /* _2- */
         , t1.fund_cd                                      /* _3- */
         , 'GA191'                                         /* _4- */
         , '40101'                                         /* _5- */
         , '기타'                                          /* _6- */
         , (SELECT NVL(SUM(nav),0)
              FROM (SELECT hy.TOTAL_ASSET  AS nav
                      FROM UZM0HY hy  /* 계좌별 수요예측 집계자료 */
                     WHERE hy.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND hy.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                       AND hy.ymd     = w_ymd_to
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT NVL(BFIL_AEK,0) + NVL(UP_AEK,0) - NVL(DW_AEK,0)
                                           + NVL(SONIK,0)  /* 수익증권 순자산 제외금액 합산처리(금투협에 보고시 합산하므로) */
                      FROM SJM5SM sm  /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
                         , SJM0SC sc  /* 타사집합투자증권 정보 */
                     WHERE sm.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
                       AND sm.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd
                       AND sm.ymd           = w_ymd_to
                       AND sc.corp_gr       = sm.CORP_GR
                       AND sc.NAV_TARGET_YN = 'N'
                       AND sc.TASA_JM_CD    = sm.TASA_JM_CD
                     ) tt)
            - NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.n_01,0) + NVL(t1.n_02,0)),0)  /* _7- */
         , 0                                               /* _8- */
         , 53                                              /* _9- */
      FROM GA t1
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ym      = p_ym
       AND t1.c_01    = 'GA191'
     GROUP BY t1.fund_cd;

    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA032A (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_tymd                         IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 변동성 생성
--
    w_fymd                         DATE;

    w_days                         NUMBER;
    w_price                        NUMBER;

    uspm_corp_gr                   VARCHAR (10);
    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    w_fymd := F_OPEN_US (ADD_MONTHS (p_tymd, -12), '-1');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.FUND_CD
             , t1.PORT_NUM
             , t1.MANGI
          FROM USPM_PORT t1  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.TYMD    = p_tymd
         ORDER BY t1.PORT_NUM
    ) loop
        UPDATE USPM_PORT    /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
           SET FYMD = w_fymd
             , DT   = CASE WHEN p_tymd >= MANGI THEN NULL
                                                ELSE F_DAYS(p_tymd, MANGI) END
         WHERE CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
           AND TYMD     = p_tymd
           AND FUND_CD  = xx.fund_cd
           AND PORT_NUM = xx.port_num;

        for po IN (
            SELECT t1.JM_CD                         /* _1- */
                 , t1.PORT_NUM                      /* _2- */
                 , po.INST_DAYS  AS ss              /* _3-분할일수 */
                 , po.TT                            /* _4- */
                 , po.DT                            /* _5-잔존일수 */
                 , po.PUT_Z                         /* _6-변동성조절 */
                 , po.CALL_Z                        /* _7-변동성조절 */
                 , NULL          AS tt_volatility   /* _8- */
                 , NULL          AS put_price       /* _9- */
                 , NULL          AS call_price      /* _10- */
                 , 0             AS d30_volatility  /* _11- */
                 , NULL          AS g30_volatility  /* _12- */
                 , 0             AS tvol            /* _13- */
                 , 0             AS tomv            /* _14- */
                 , 0             AS short_price     /* _15- */
                 , 0             AS gijun_price     /* _16- */
                 , 0             AS ssum            /* _17- */
                 , 0             AS psum            /* _18- */
                 , 0             AS dsum            /* _19- */
                 , 0             AS am              /* _20-avrage of markte */
                 , 0             AS pm              /* _21-price of market */
                 , 0             AS var             /* _22- */
                 , 0             AS ssum5           /* _23- */
                 , 0             AS psum5           /* _24- */
                 , 0             AS dsum5           /* _25- */
                 , 0             AS am5             /* _26- */
                 , 0             AS pm5             /* _27- */
                 , 0             AS var5            /* _28- */
                 , 0             AS ssum10          /* _29- */
                 , 0             AS psum10          /* _30- */
                 , 0             AS dsum10          /* _31- */
                 , 0             AS am10            /* _32- */
                 , 0             AS pm10            /* _33- */
                 , 0             AS var10           /* _34- */
                 , 0             AS ssum15          /* _35- */
                 , 0             AS psum15          /* _36- */
                 , 0             AS dsum15          /* _37- */
                 , 0             AS am15            /* _38- */
                 , 0             AS pm15            /* _39- */
                 , 0             AS var15           /* _40- */
                 , 0             AS ssum20          /* _41- */
                 , 0             AS psum20          /* _42- */
                 , 0             AS dsum20          /* _43- */
                 , 0             AS am20            /* _44- */
                 , 0             AS pm20            /* _45- */
                 , 0             AS var20           /* _46- */
                 , 0             AS ssum60          /* _47- */
                 , 0             AS psum60          /* _48- */
                 , 0             AS dsum60          /* _49- */
                 , 0             AS am60            /* _50- */
                 , 0             AS pm60            /* _51- */
                 , 0             AS var60           /* _52- */
                 , 0             AS ssum120         /* _53- */
                 , 0             AS psum120         /* _54- */
                 , 0             AS dsum120         /* _55- */
                 , 0             AS am120           /* _56- */
                 , 0             AS pm120           /* _57- */
                 , 0             AS var120          /* _58- */
              FROM USPM      t1  /* US Portfolio Model 일변 기준정보 */
                 , USPM_PORT po  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
             WHERE t1.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.FUND_CD  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.YMD      = p_tymd
               AND t1.PORT_NUM = xx.port_num
               AND po.CORP_GR  = t1.CORP_GR
               AND po.FUND_CD  = t1.FUND_CD
               AND po.TYMD     = t1.YMD
               AND po.PORT_NUM = t1.PORT_NUM
             ORDER BY t1.PORT_NUM
                    , t1.COL
        ) loop
            w_days  := 0;
            w_price := 0;
            if  po.tt BETWEEN '1' AND '9'   then
                for xx IN (
                    SELECT t1.YMD                                                                                            /* _1- */
                         , t1.TVOL                                                                                           /* _2- */
                         , t1.TOMV                                                                                           /* _3- */
                         , NVL(t1.JONGA,0)                                                                      AS jonga     /* _4- */
                         , LAG(NVL(t1.JONGA,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.JM_CD
                                                          ORDER BY t1.YMD)                                      AS bf_jonga  /* _5- */
                         , CASE WHEN LAG(NVL(t1.JONGA,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.JM_CD
                                                                    ORDER BY t1.YMD)=0
                                THEN 0
                                ELSE NVL(t1.JONGA,0) / LAG(NVL(t1.JONGA,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.JM_CD
                                                                                      ORDER BY t1.YMD) - 1 END  AS rt        /* _6- */
                      FROM SYT0LP t1  /* 해외수신 종목 시세 */
                     WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.YMD     BETWEEN w_fymd AND p_tymd
                       AND t1.YMD     NOT IN (SELECT HOLI_YMD
                                                FROM SZX0HL ta  /* 공휴일 */
                                               WHERE ta.NATION_CD = 'US'
                                                 AND ta.HOLI_YMD  >= w_fymd)
                       AND t1.JM_CD   = po.jm_cd
                     ORDER BY t1.YMD DESC
                ) loop
                    if  xx.rt IS NULL   then    CONTINUE;
                    end if;

                    w_days := w_days + 1;
                    if  xx.ymd = p_tymd then
                        w_price := xx.jonga;
                        po.tomv := xx.tomv;   /* 시가총액 */
                    end if;
                    if  w_days <= po.dt then    po.tvol := po.tvol + xx.tvol;
                    end if;

                    po.psum := po.psum + xx.jonga;
                    po.ssum := po.ssum + xx.rt;
                    po.dsum := po.dsum + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                    if  w_days <= 5     then
                        po.psum5 := po.psum5 + xx.jonga;
                        po.ssum5 := po.ssum5 + xx.rt;
                        po.dsum5 := po.dsum5 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                    end if;
                    if  w_days <= 10    then
                        po.psum10 := po.psum10 + xx.jonga;
                        po.ssum10 := po.ssum10 + xx.rt;
                        po.dsum10 := po.dsum10 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                    end if;
                    if  w_days <= 15    then
                        po.psum15 := po.psum15 + xx.jonga;
                        po.ssum15 := po.ssum15 + xx.rt;
                        po.dsum15 := po.dsum15 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                    end if;
                    if  w_days <= 20    then
                        po.psum20 := po.psum20 + xx.jonga;
                        po.ssum20 := po.ssum20 + xx.rt;
                        po.dsum20 := po.dsum20 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                    end if;
                    if  w_days <= 60    then
                        po.psum60 := po.psum60 + xx.jonga;
                        po.ssum60 := po.ssum60 + xx.rt;
                        po.dsum60 := po.dsum60 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                    end if;
                    if  w_days <= 120   then
                        po.psum120 := po.psum120 + xx.jonga;
                        po.ssum120 := po.ssum120 + xx.rt;
                        po.dsum120 := po.dsum120 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                    end if;
                end loop;
            else
                for xx IN (
                    SELECT t1.YMD                                                        /* _1- */
                         , t1.VOLUME                                                     /* _2- */
                         , t1.VALUE                                                      /* _3- */
                         , NVL(t1.close,0)                                  AS CLOSE     /* _4- */
                         , LAG(NVL(t1.close,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.KOSCOM_CD
                                                          ORDER BY t1.YMD)  AS bf_close  /* _5- */
                         , CASE WHEN LAG(NVL(t1.close,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.KOSCOM_CD
                                                                    ORDER BY t1.YMD)=0
                                THEN 0
                                ELSE NVL(t1.close,0) / LAG(NVL(t1.close,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.KOSCOM_CD
                                                                                      ORDER BY t1.YMD) - 1
                           END                                              AS rt        /* _6- */
                      FROM SJT1TG t1  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
                     WHERE t1.YMD       BETWEEN w_fymd AND p_tymd
                       AND t1.YMD       NOT IN (SELECT HOLI_YMD
                                                  FROM SZX0HL ta  /* 공휴일 */
                                                 WHERE ta.NATION_CD = 'KR'
                                                   AND ta.HOLI_YMD  >= w_fymd)
                       AND t1.KOSCOM_CD = po.jm_cd
                     ORDER BY t1.YMD DESC
                ) loop
                    if  xx.rt IS NULL   then    CONTINUE;
                    end if;

                    w_days := w_days + 1;
                    if  xx.ymd = p_tymd then
