                        w_price := xx.close;
                        po.tomv := xx.value;  /* 시가총액 */
                    end if;
                    if  w_days <= po.dt then    po.tvol := po.tvol + xx.volume;
                    end if;

                    po.psum := po.psum + xx.close;
                    po.ssum := po.ssum + xx.rt;
                    po.dsum := po.dsum + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                    if  w_days <= 5     then
                        po.psum5 := po.psum5 + xx.close;
                        po.ssum5 := po.ssum5 + xx.rt;
                        po.dsum5 := po.dsum5 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                    end if;
                    if  w_days <= 10    then
                        po.psum10 := po.psum10 + xx.close;
                        po.ssum10 := po.ssum10 + xx.rt;
                        po.dsum10 := po.dsum10 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                    end if;
                    if  w_days <= 15    then
                        po.psum15 := po.psum15 + xx.close;
                        po.ssum15 := po.ssum15 + xx.rt;
                        po.dsum15 := po.dsum15 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                    end if;
                    if  w_days <= 20    then
                        po.psum20 := po.psum20 + xx.close;
                        po.ssum20 := po.ssum20 + xx.rt;
                        po.dsum20 := po.dsum20 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                    end if;
                    if  w_days <= 60    then
                        po.psum60 := po.psum60 + xx.close;
                        po.ssum60 := po.ssum60 + xx.rt;
                        po.dsum60 := po.dsum60 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                    end if;
                    if  w_days <= 120   then
                        po.psum120 := po.psum120 + xx.close;
                        po.ssum120 := po.ssum120 + xx.rt;
                        po.dsum120 := po.dsum120 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                    end if;
                end loop;
            end if;

            if  w_days > 1  then
                -- 1주간 일변동성구하기(6)
                po.pm5  := TRUNC  (po.psum5 / 5, 8);
                po.am5  := TRUNC  (po.ssum5 / 5, 8);
                po.var5 := TRUNC  ((po.dsum5 / 5 - po.am5 * po.am5) * 5 / 4,8);

                -- 2주간 일변동성구하기(5)
                po.pm10  := TRUNC  (po.psum10 / 10, 8);
                po.am10  := TRUNC  (po.ssum10 / 10, 8);
                po.var10 := TRUNC  ((po.dsum10 / 10 - po.am10 * po.am10) * 10 / 9,8);

                -- 3주간 일변동성구하기(-)
                po.pm15  := TRUNC  (po.psum15 / 15, 8);
                po.am15  := TRUNC  (po.ssum15 / 15, 8);
                po.var15 := TRUNC  ((po.dsum15 / 15 - po.am15 * po.am15) * 15 / 14,8);

                -- 1개월 일변동성구하기(1)
                po.pm20  := TRUNC  (po.psum20 / 20, 8);
                po.am20  := TRUNC  (po.ssum20 / 20, 8);
                po.var20 := TRUNC  ((po.dsum20 / 20 - po.am20 * po.am20) * 20 / 19,8);

                -- 3개월 일변동성구하기(2)
                po.pm60  := TRUNC  (po.psum60 / 60, 8);
                po.am60  := TRUNC  (po.ssum60 / 60, 8);
                po.var60 := TRUNC  ((po.dsum60 / 60 - po.am60 * po.am60) * 60 / 59,8);

                -- 6개월 일변동성구하기(3)
                po.pm120  := TRUNC  (po.psum120 / 120, 8);
                po.am120  := TRUNC  (po.ssum120 / 120, 8);
                po.var120 := TRUNC  ((po.dsum120 / 120 - po.am120 * po.am120) * 120 / 119,8);

                -- 1년간 일변동성구하기(4)
                po.pm  := TRUNC  (po.psum / w_days, 8);
                po.am  := TRUNC  (po.ssum / w_days, 8);
                po.var := TRUNC  ((po.dsum / w_days - po.am * po.am) * w_days / (w_days - 1),8);

                if  po.tt = '1'     then    po.tt_volatility := sqrt (po.var5 * po.dt);                                                                                                                   -- 1주 변동성
                elsif po.tt = '2'   then    po.tt_volatility := ((sqrt (po.var5 * po.dt) * 0.6)  + (sqrt (po.var10 * po.dt) * 0.4));                                                                      -- 2주 변동성
                elsif po.tt = '3'   then    po.tt_volatility := ((sqrt (po.var5 * po.dt) * 0.5)  + (sqrt (po.var10 * po.dt) * 0.3) + (sqrt (po.var15 * po.dt) * 0.2));                                    -- 3주 변동성
                elsif po.tt = '4'   then    po.tt_volatility := ((sqrt (po.var5 * po.dt) * 0.4)  + (sqrt (po.var10 * po.dt) * 0.3) + (sqrt (po.var15 * po.dt) * 0.2) + (sqrt (po.var20 * po.dt) * 0.1));  -- 4주 변동성
                else                        po.tt_volatility := ((sqrt (po.var20 * po.dt) * 0.4) + (sqrt (po.var60 * po.dt) * 0.3) + (sqrt (po.var120 * po.dt) * 0.2) + (sqrt (po.var * po.dt) * 0.1));
                end if;
                po.tt_volatility := TRUNC  (po.tt_volatility,12);
                po.put_price     := ROUND  (w_price * (1 - po.put_z * po.tt_volatility),0);   /* PUT 행사가격 */
                po.call_price    := ROUND  (w_price * (1 - po.call_z * po.tt_volatility),0);  /* CALL행사가격 */

                po.short_price := ROUND  ((po.pm10 * 0.6) + (po.pm20 * 0.4),0);                                     /* 단기평균가격 */
                po.gijun_price := ROUND  ((po.pm20 * 0.4) + (po.pm60 * 0.3) + (po.pm120 * 0.2) + (po.pm * 0.1),0);  /* 기준평균가격 */

                po.d30_volatility := TRUNC  ((sqrt (po.var10 * 30) * 0.6)  + (sqrt (po.var20 * 30) * 0.4),8);                                                                /* 단기변동성, (30일기준)추이 계산용 */
                po.g30_volatility := TRUNC  (((sqrt (po.var20 * 30) * 0.4) + (sqrt (po.var60 * 30) * 0.3) + (sqrt (po.var120 * 30) * 0.2) + (sqrt (po.var * 30) * 0.1)),8);  /* 기준변동성 */

                UPDATE USPM /* US Portfolio Model 일변 기준정보 */
                   SET JONGA                 = w_price
                     , DAYS                  = w_days
                     , AVG_VOLUME            = TRUNC(po.tvol / po.dt,0)
                     , MARKET_CAPITALIZATION = po.tomv
                     , D30_VOLATILITY        = po.d30_volatility
                     , G30_VOLATILITY        = po.g30_volatility
                     , TT_VOLATILITY         = po.tt_volatility
                     , PUT_PRICE             = po.put_price
                     , CALL_PRICE            = po.call_price
                     , SHORT_PRICE           = po.short_price
                     , GIJUN_PRICE           = po.gijun_price
                     , AM                    = po.am
                     , PM                    = po.pm
                     , VAR                   = po.var
                     , AM5                   = po.am5
                     , PM5                   = po.pm5
                     , VAR5                  = po.var5
                     , AM10                  = po.am10
                     , PM10                  = po.pm10
                     , VAR10                 = po.var10
                     , AM15                  = po.am15
                     , PM15                  = po.pm15
                     , VAR15                 = po.var15
                     , AM20                  = po.am20
                     , PM20                  = po.pm20
                     , VAR20                 = po.var20
                     , AM60                  = po.am60
                     , PM60                  = po.pm60
                     , VAR60                 = po.var60
                     , AM120                 = po.am120
                     , PM120                 = po.pm120
                     , VAR120                = po.var120
                     , COM_DT                = sysdate
                 WHERE CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
                   AND YMD      = p_tymd
                   AND FUND_CD  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND JM_CD    = po.jm_cd
                   AND PORT_NUM = po.port_num;
            end if;
        end loop;
    end loop;

    DELETE FROM USPM_DD /* US Portfolio Model 종목 일별 기준변동성 현황 */
     WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
       AND YMD     = p_tymd;

    for po IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t1.JM_CD                     /* _1- */
             , t1.OVRS_EXCG_CD                       /* _2- */
             , 0                  AS d30_volatility  /* _3- */
             , NULL               AS g30_volatility  /* _4- */
             , 0                  AS short_price     /* _5- */
             , 0                  AS gijun_price     /* _6- */
             , 0                  AS ssum            /* _7- */
             , 0                  AS psum            /* _8- */
             , 0                  AS dsum            /* _9- */
             , 0                  AS am              /* _10-avrage of markte */
             , 0                  AS pm              /* _11-price of market */
             , 0                  AS var             /* _12- */
             , 0                  AS ssum10          /* _13- */
             , 0                  AS psum10          /* _14- */
             , 0                  AS dsum10          /* _15- */
             , 0                  AS am10            /* _16- */
             , 0                  AS pm10            /* _17- */
             , 0                  AS var10           /* _18- */
             , 0                  AS ssum20          /* _19- */
             , 0                  AS psum20          /* _20- */
             , 0                  AS dsum20          /* _21- */
             , 0                  AS am20            /* _22- */
             , 0                  AS pm20            /* _23- */
             , 0                  AS var20           /* _24- */
             , 0                  AS ssum60          /* _25- */
             , 0                  AS psum60          /* _26- */
             , 0                  AS dsum60          /* _27- */
             , 0                  AS am60            /* _28- */
             , 0                  AS pm60            /* _29- */
             , 0                  AS var60           /* _30- */
             , 0                  AS ssum120         /* _31- */
             , 0                  AS psum120         /* _32- */
             , 0                  AS dsum120         /* _33- */
             , 0                  AS am120           /* _34- */
             , 0                  AS pm120           /* _35- */
             , 0                  AS var120          /* _36- */
             , 0                  AS ma50            /* _37- */
             , 0                  AS ma200           /* _38- */
          FROM SYM0YA t1  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.JASAN_GB = '1'
    ) loop
        w_days  := 0;
        w_price := 0;
        for xx IN (
            SELECT t1.YMD
                 , NVL(t1.JONGA,0)                                                                      AS jonga
                 , LAG(NVL(t1.JONGA,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.JM_CD
                                                  ORDER BY t1.YMD)                                      AS bf_jonga
                 , CASE WHEN LAG(NVL(t1.JONGA,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.JM_CD
                                                            ORDER BY t1.YMD)=0
                        THEN 0
                        ELSE NVL(t1.JONGA,0) / LAG(NVL(t1.JONGA,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.JM_CD
                                                                              ORDER BY t1.YMD) - 1 END  AS rt
              FROM SYT0LP t1  /* 해외수신 종목 시세 */
             WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.YMD     BETWEEN w_fymd AND p_tymd
               AND t1.YMD     NOT IN (SELECT HOLI_YMD
                                        FROM SZX0HL ta  /* 공휴일 */
                                       WHERE ta.NATION_CD = 'US'
                                         AND ta.HOLI_YMD  >= w_fymd)
               AND t1.JM_CD   = po.jm_cd
             ORDER BY t1.YMD DESC
        ) loop
            if  xx.rt IS NULL   then    CONTINUE;
            end if;

            w_days := w_days + 1;
            if  xx.ymd = p_tymd  then   w_price := xx.jonga;
            end if;

            po.psum := po.psum + xx.jonga;
            po.ssum := po.ssum + xx.rt;
            po.dsum := po.dsum + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
            if  w_days <= 10    then
                po.psum10 := po.psum10 + xx.jonga;
                po.ssum10 := po.ssum10 + xx.rt;
                po.dsum10 := po.dsum10 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
            end if;
            if  w_days <= 20    then
                po.psum20 := po.psum20 + xx.jonga;
                po.ssum20 := po.ssum20 + xx.rt;
                po.dsum20 := po.dsum20 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
            end if;
            if  w_days <= 60    then
                po.psum60 := po.psum60 + xx.jonga;
                po.ssum60 := po.ssum60 + xx.rt;
                po.dsum60 := po.dsum60 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
            end if;
            if  w_days <= 120   then
                po.psum120 := po.psum120 + xx.jonga;
                po.ssum120 := po.ssum120 + xx.rt;
                po.dsum120 := po.dsum120 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
            end if;
            if  w_days <= 50    then    po.ma50 := po.ma50 + xx.jonga;
            end if;
            if  w_days <= 200   then    po.ma200 := po.ma200 + xx.jonga;
            end if;
        end loop;

        if  w_days > 1  then
            -- 2주간 일변동성구하기(5)
            po.pm10  := TRUNC  (po.psum10 / 10, 8);
            po.am10  := TRUNC  (po.ssum10 / 10, 8);
            po.var10 := TRUNC  ((po.dsum10 / 10 - po.am10 * po.am10) * 10 / 9,8);

            -- 1개월 일변동성구하기(1)
            po.pm20  := TRUNC  (po.psum20 / 20, 8);
            po.am20  := TRUNC  (po.ssum20 / 20, 8);
            po.var20 := TRUNC  ((po.dsum20 / 20 - po.am20 * po.am20) * 20 / 19,8);

            -- 3개월 일변동성구하기(2)
            po.pm60  := TRUNC  (po.psum60 / 60, 8);
            po.am60  := TRUNC  (po.ssum60 / 60, 8);
            po.var60 := TRUNC  ((po.dsum60 / 60 - po.am60 * po.am60) * 60 / 59,8);

            -- 6개월 일변동성구하기(3)
            po.pm120  := TRUNC  (po.psum120 / 120, 8);
            po.am120  := TRUNC  (po.ssum120 / 120, 8);
            po.var120 := TRUNC  ((po.dsum120 / 120 - po.am120 * po.am120) * 120 / 119,8);

            -- 1년간 일변동성구하기(4)
            po.pm  := TRUNC  (po.psum / w_days, 8);
            po.am  := TRUNC  (po.ssum / w_days, 8);
            po.var := TRUNC  ((po.dsum / w_days - po.am * po.am) * w_days / (w_days - 1),8);

            po.short_price := ROUND  ((po.pm10 * 0.6) + (po.pm20 * 0.4),0);                                     /* 단기평균가격 */
            po.gijun_price := ROUND  ((po.pm20 * 0.4) + (po.pm60 * 0.3) + (po.pm120 * 0.2) + (po.pm * 0.1),0);  /* 기준평균가격 */

            po.d30_volatility := TRUNC  ((sqrt (po.var10 * 30) * 0.6)  + (sqrt (po.var20 * 30) * 0.4),8);                                                                /* 단기변동성, (30일기준)추이 계산용 */
            po.g30_volatility := TRUNC  (((sqrt (po.var20 * 30) * 0.4) + (sqrt (po.var60 * 30) * 0.3) + (sqrt (po.var120 * 30) * 0.2) + (sqrt (po.var * 30) * 0.1)),8);  /* 기준변동성 */

            if  w_days >= 200 then
                po.ma50  := po.ma50  / 50;
                po.ma200 := po.ma200 / 200;
            else
                if  w_days >= 50    then    po.ma50 := po.ma50 / 50;
                else                        po.ma50 := po.ma50 / w_days;
                end if;
                po.ma200 := po.ma200 / w_days;
            end if;

            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO USPM_DD /* US Portfolio Model 종목 일별 기준변동성 현황 */
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr          /* _1- */
                       , p_tymd             /* _2- */
                       , po.jm_cd           /* _3- */
                       , w_price            /* _4- */
                       , po.d30_volatility  /* _5- */
                       , po.g30_volatility  /* _6- */
                       , po.short_price     /* _7- */
                       , po.gijun_price     /* _8- */
                       , sysdate            /* _9- */
                       , po.ovrs_excg_cd    /* _10- */
                       , po.ma50            /* _11- */
                       , po.ma200           /* _12- */
                       );
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                NULL;   /* 일별 기준자료이므로 삭제 후 재생성 */
            END;
        end if;
    end loop;

    BEGIN
        SELECT CORP_GR
          INTO uspm_corp_gr
          FROM USPM t1  /* US Portfolio Model 일변 기준정보 */
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.YMD     = p_tymd
           AND ROWNUM = 1;

        for po IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT t1.KOSCOM_CD  AS JM_CD           /* _1- */
                 , 0                      AS d30_volatility  /* _2- */
                 , NULL                   AS g30_volatility  /* _3- */
                 , 0                      AS short_price     /* _4- */
                 , 0                      AS gijun_price     /* _5- */
                 , 0                      AS ssum            /* _6- */
                 , 0                      AS psum            /* _7- */
                 , 0                      AS dsum            /* _8- */
                 , 0                      AS am              /* _9-avrage of markte */
                 , 0                      AS pm              /* _10-price of market */
                 , 0                      AS var             /* _11- */
                 , 0                      AS ssum10          /* _12- */
                 , 0                      AS psum10          /* _13- */
                 , 0                      AS dsum10          /* _14- */
                 , 0                      AS am10            /* _15- */
                 , 0                      AS pm10            /* _16- */
                 , 0                      AS var10           /* _17- */
                 , 0                      AS ssum20          /* _18- */
                 , 0                      AS psum20          /* _19- */
                 , 0                      AS dsum20          /* _20- */
                 , 0                      AS am20            /* _21- */
                 , 0                      AS pm20            /* _22- */
                 , 0                      AS var20           /* _23- */
                 , 0                      AS ssum60          /* _24- */
                 , 0                      AS psum60          /* _25- */
                 , 0                      AS dsum60          /* _26- */
                 , 0                      AS am60            /* _27- */
                 , 0                      AS pm60            /* _28- */
                 , 0                      AS var60           /* _29- */
                 , 0                      AS ssum120         /* _30- */
                 , 0                      AS psum120         /* _31- */
                 , 0                      AS dsum120         /* _32- */
                 , 0                      AS am120           /* _33- */
                 , 0                      AS pm120           /* _34- */
                 , 0                      AS var120          /* _35- */
                 , 0                      AS ma50            /* _36- */
                 , 0                      AS ma200           /* _37- */
              FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE t1.USPM    = '1'
               AND t1.DANC_GB IN ('A','C')
        ) loop
            w_days  := 0;
            w_price := 0;
            for xx IN (
                SELECT t1.YMD
                     , NVL(t1.CLOSE,0)                                                                      AS jonga
                     , LAG(NVL(t1.CLOSE,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.KOSCOM_CD
                                                      ORDER BY t1.YMD)                                      AS bf_jonga
                     , CASE WHEN LAG(NVL(t1.CLOSE,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.KOSCOM_CD
                                                                ORDER BY t1.YMD)=0
                            THEN 0
                            ELSE NVL(t1.CLOSE,0) / LAG(NVL(t1.CLOSE,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.KOSCOM_CD
                                                                                  ORDER BY t1.YMD) - 1 END  AS rt
                  FROM SJT1TG t1  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
                 WHERE t1.YMD          BETWEEN w_fymd AND p_tymd
                   AND t1.YMD          NOT IN (SELECT HOLI_YMD
                                                 FROM SZX0HL ta  /* 공휴일 */
                                                WHERE ta.NATION_CD = 'KR'
                                                  AND ta.HOLI_YMD  >= w_fymd)
                   AND NVL(t1.CLOSE,0) != 0
                   AND t1.KOSCOM_CD    = po.jm_cd
                 ORDER BY t1.YMD DESC
            ) loop
                if  xx.rt IS NULL   then    CONTINUE;
                end if;

                w_days := w_days + 1;
                if  xx.ymd = p_tymd  then   w_price := xx.jonga;
                end if;

                po.psum := po.psum + xx.jonga;
                po.ssum := po.ssum + xx.rt;
                po.dsum := po.dsum + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                if  w_days <= 10    then
                    po.psum10 := po.psum10 + xx.jonga;
                    po.ssum10 := po.ssum10 + xx.rt;
                    po.dsum10 := po.dsum10 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                end if;
                if  w_days <= 20    then
                    po.psum20 := po.psum20 + xx.jonga;
                    po.ssum20 := po.ssum20 + xx.rt;
                    po.dsum20 := po.dsum20 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                end if;
                if  w_days <= 60    then
                    po.psum60 := po.psum60 + xx.jonga;
                    po.ssum60 := po.ssum60 + xx.rt;
                    po.dsum60 := po.dsum60 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                end if;
                if  w_days <= 120   then
                    po.psum120 := po.psum120 + xx.jonga;
                    po.ssum120 := po.ssum120 + xx.rt;
                    po.dsum120 := po.dsum120 + (xx.rt * xx.rt);
                end if;
                if  w_days <= 50    then    po.ma50 := po.ma50 + xx.jonga;
                end if;
                if  w_days <= 200   then    po.ma200 := po.ma200 + xx.jonga;
                end if;
            end loop;

            if  w_days > 1  then
                -- 2주간 일변동성구하기(5)
                po.pm10  := TRUNC  (po.psum10 / 10, 8);
                po.am10  := TRUNC  (po.ssum10 / 10, 8);
                po.var10 := TRUNC  ((po.dsum10 / 10 - po.am10 * po.am10) * 10 / 9,8);

                -- 1개월 일변동성구하기(1)
                po.pm20  := TRUNC  (po.psum20 / 20, 8);
                po.am20  := TRUNC  (po.ssum20 / 20, 8);
                po.var20 := TRUNC  ((po.dsum20 / 20 - po.am20 * po.am20) * 20 / 19,8);

                -- 3개월 일변동성구하기(2)
                po.pm60  := TRUNC  (po.psum60 / 60, 8);
                po.am60  := TRUNC  (po.ssum60 / 60, 8);
                po.var60 := TRUNC  ((po.dsum60 / 60 - po.am60 * po.am60) * 60 / 59,8);

                -- 6개월 일변동성구하기(3)
                po.pm120  := TRUNC  (po.psum120 / 120, 8);
                po.am120  := TRUNC  (po.ssum120 / 120, 8);
                po.var120 := TRUNC  ((po.dsum120 / 120 - po.am120 * po.am120) * 120 / 119,8);

                -- 1년간 일변동성구하기(4)
                po.pm  := TRUNC  (po.psum / w_days, 8);
                po.am  := TRUNC  (po.ssum / w_days, 8);
                po.var := TRUNC  ((po.dsum / w_days - po.am * po.am) * w_days / (w_days - 1),8);

                po.short_price := ROUND  ((po.pm10 * 0.6) + (po.pm20 * 0.4),0);                                     /* 단기평균가격 */
                po.gijun_price := ROUND  ((po.pm20 * 0.4) + (po.pm60 * 0.3) + (po.pm120 * 0.2) + (po.pm * 0.1),0);  /* 기준평균가격 */

                po.d30_volatility := TRUNC  ((sqrt (po.var10 * 30) * 0.6)  + (sqrt (po.var20 * 30) * 0.4),8);                                                                /* 단기변동성, (30일기준)추이 계산용 */
                po.g30_volatility := TRUNC  (((sqrt (po.var20 * 30) * 0.4) + (sqrt (po.var60 * 30) * 0.3) + (sqrt (po.var120 * 30) * 0.2) + (sqrt (po.var * 30) * 0.1)),8);  /* 기준변동성 */

                if  w_days >= 200 then
                    po.ma50  := po.ma50  / 50;
                    po.ma200 := po.ma200 / 200;
                else
                    if  w_days >= 50    then    po.ma50 := po.ma50 / 50;
                    else                        po.ma50 := po.ma50 / w_days;
                    end if;
                    po.ma200 := po.ma200 / w_days;
                end if;

                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO USPM_DD /* US Portfolio Model 종목 일별 기준변동성 현황 */
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr          /* _1- */
                           , p_tymd             /* _2- */
                           , po.jm_cd           /* _3- */
                           , w_price            /* _4- */
                           , po.d30_volatility  /* _5- */
                           , po.g30_volatility  /* _6- */
                           , po.short_price     /* _7- */
                           , po.gijun_price     /* _8- */
                           , sysdate            /* _9- */
                           , 'KRX'              /* _10- */
                           , po.ma50            /* _11- */
                           , po.ma200           /* _12- */
                           );
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    NULL;   /* 일별 기준자료이므로 삭제 후 재생성 */
                END;
            end if;
        end loop;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        NULL;
        -- USPM 자료 미생성 회사
    END;

    commit;
    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA032A_DD (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 종목별 변동성 일별 기준자료 생성
--
    w_fymd                         DATE;
    w_tymd                         DATE;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    w_tymd := F_OPEN_US (p_ymd, '+');
    w_fymd := F_OPEN_US (ADD_MONTHS (w_tymd, -12), '-1');

    INSERT INTO SZT0IA_V    /* 펀드별 모델산정 기준정보 */
    SELECT t1.CORP_GR         /* _1- */
         , t1.FUND_CD         /* _2- */
         , w_tymd             /* _3- */
         , t1.WONBON_AEK      /* _4- */
         , t1.JM_PER          /* _5- */
         , t1.USD_WONBON_AEK  /* _6- */
         , 0                  /* _7- */
         , NULL               /* _8- */
         , NULL               /* _9- */
         , NULL               /* _10- */
         , NULL               /* _11- */
         , NULL               /* _12- */
         , NULL               /* _13- */
         , NULL               /* _14- */
      FROM SZT0IA_V t1  /* 펀드별 모델산정 기준정보 */
         , SZM0IA   ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
     WHERE t1.CORP_GR               = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.FUND_CD               NOT IN (SELECT FUND_CD
                                              FROM SZT0IA_V ta  /* 펀드별 모델산정 기준정보 */
                                             WHERE ta.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                                               AND ta.TR_YMD  = w_tymd)
       AND t1.TR_YMD                = F_OPEN_US(p_ymd,'-1')
       AND NVL(t1.DEL,'N')          <> 'Y'
       AND ia.CORP_GR               = t1.CORP_GR
       AND ia.FUND_CD               = t1.FUND_CD
       AND NVL(ia.HAEJI_YMD, p_ymd) >= p_ymd;

    INSERT INTO USPM    /* US Portfolio Model 일변 기준정보 */
         ( CORP_GR            /* _1- */
         , YMD                /* _2- */
         , FUND_CD            /* _3- */
         , PORT_NUM           /* _4- */
         , JM_CD              /* _5- */
         , COL                /* _6- */
         , USD_TUJA           /* _7- */
         , PRICE_PER          /* _8- */
         , OVRS_EXCG_CD       /* _9- */
         , TARGET_RETURN_PER  /* _10- */
         )
    SELECT t1.CORP_GR            /* _1- */
         , w_tymd                /* _2- */
         , t1.FUND_CD            /* _3- */
         , t1.PORT_NUM           /* _4- */
         , t1.JM_CD              /* _5- */
         , t1.COL                /* _6- */
         , t1.USD_TUJA           /* _7- */
         , t1.PRICE_PER          /* _8- */
         , t1.OVRS_EXCG_CD       /* _9- */
         , t1.TARGET_RETURN_PER  /* _10- */
      FROM USPM      t1    /* US Portfolio Model 일변 기준정보 */
         , USPM_PORT port  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
         , SZM0IA    ia    /* 자문 계좌정보 */
     WHERE t1.CORP_GR               = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.FUND_CD               NOT IN (SELECT FUND_CD
                                              FROM USPM ta  /* US Portfolio Model 일변 기준정보 */
                                             WHERE ta.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                                               AND ta.YMD     = w_tymd)
       AND t1.YMD                   = F_OPEN_US(p_ymd,'-1')
       AND port.CORP_GR             = t1.CORP_GR
       AND port.FUND_CD             = t1.FUND_CD
       AND port.MANGI               >= p_ymd
       AND port.TYMD                = t1.YMD
       AND port.PORT_NUM            = t1.PORT_NUM
       AND ia.CORP_GR               = t1.CORP_GR
       AND ia.FUND_CD               = t1.FUND_CD
       AND NVL(ia.HAEJI_YMD, p_ymd) >= p_ymd;

    INSERT INTO USPM_PORT   /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
    SELECT t1.CORP_GR                                        /* _1- */
         , w_fymd                                            /* _2- */
         , w_tymd                                            /* _3- */
         , t1.FUND_CD                                        /* _4- */
         , t1.PORT_NUM                                       /* _5- */
         , t1.TT                                             /* _6- */
         , CASE WHEN t1.INST_DAYS > 1 THEN t1.INST_DAYS - 1
                                      ELSE t1.INST_DAYS END  /* _7- */
         , F_DAYS(w_tymd, t1.MANGI)                          /* _8- */
         , t1.JM_PER                                         /* _9- */
         , t1.USD_TUJA                                       /* _10- */
         , t1.MANGI                                          /* _11- */
         , NULL                                              /* _12- */
         , NULL                                              /* _13- */
         , PRICE_PER                                         /* _14- */
         , PUT_Z                                             /* _15- */
         , CALL_Z                                            /* _16- */
      FROM USPM_PORT t1  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
         , SZM0IA    ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
     WHERE t1.CORP_GR               = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.FUND_CD               NOT IN (SELECT FUND_CD
                                              FROM USPM_PORT ta  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
                                             WHERE ta.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                                               AND ta.TYMD    = w_tymd)
       AND t1.TYMD                  = F_OPEN_US(p_ymd,'-1')
       AND t1.MANGI                 >= p_ymd
       AND ia.CORP_GR               = t1.CORP_GR
       AND ia.FUND_CD               = t1.FUND_CD
       AND NVL(ia.HAEJI_YMD, p_ymd) >= p_ymd;

    -- 이월 후 PORT번호 변경
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.TYMD
             , t1.FUND_CD
             , t1.PORT_NUM
             , 'AA'  AS target_num
          FROM USPM_PORT t1  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR          = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.TYMD             = F_OPEN_US(p_ymd,'-1')
           AND t1.MANGI            < p_ymd
           AND LENGTH(t1.PORT_NUM) = 1
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT t1.PORT_NUM
              INTO xx.target_num
              FROM USPM_PORT t1  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
             WHERE t1.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.FUND_CD  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.MANGI    = (SELECT MIN (MANGI)
                                    FROM USPM_PORT ta  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
                                   WHERE ta.CORP_GR  = t1.CORP_GR
                                     AND ta.FUND_CD  = xx.fund_cd
                                     AND ta.TYMD     = p_ymd
                                     AND ta.PORT_NUM LIKE xx.port_num || '%')
               AND t1.TYMD     = xx.tymd
               AND t1.PORT_NUM LIKE xx.port_num || '%';
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            -- 이미 포트 변경된 경우
            CONTINUE;
        END;

        UPDATE USPM t1  /* US Portfolio Model 일변 기준정보 */
           SET (USD_TUJA, PRICE_PER, TARGET_RETURN_PER)
               = (SELECT USD_TUJA
                       , PRICE_PER
                       , TARGET_RETURN_PER
                    FROM USPM ta  /* US Portfolio Model 일변 기준정보 */
                   WHERE ta.CORP_GR  = t1.CORP_GR
                     AND ta.FUND_CD  = t1.FUND_CD
                     AND ta.YMD      = F_OPEN_US(p_ymd,'-1')
                     AND ta.JM_CD    = t1.JM_CD
                     AND ta.PORT_NUM = xx.port_num)
             , PORT_NUM = xx.port_num
         WHERE CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
           AND YMD      = p_ymd
           AND FUND_CD  = xx.fund_cd
           AND PORT_NUM = xx.target_num;

        UPDATE USPM_PORT    /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
           SET PORT_NUM = xx.port_num
         WHERE CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
           AND TYMD     = p_ymd
           AND FUND_CD  = xx.fund_cd
           AND PORT_NUM = xx.target_num;
    end loop;

    SR_JA032A ( p_corp_gr, w_tymd, w_msg );
    if  w_msg <> 'Y'    then
        p_msg := w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    commit;
    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA032D (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- API 자료수신 요청생성(지수,주식종가)
--
    w_tr_co_cd                     VARCHAR (10) := '00003';
    w_company                      VARCHAR (20) := 'KB_REAL';

    w_ymd                          DATE;
    w_us_ymd                       DATE;
    w_cre_dt                       DATE;

    w_srscd_call                   VARCHAR (20);
    w_srscd_put                    VARCHAR (20);
    w_call_nm                      VARCHAR(200);
    w_put_nm                       VARCHAR(200);

    w_inc_ticksz                   NUMBER;
    w_stkprc                       NUMBER;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
    w_1714                         VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    if  p_ymd > '00000000'  then
            w_ymd := TO_DATE (p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');
    else    w_ymd := TRUNC (now ( ),'dd');
    end if;

    -- 지수요청시 당일은 존재하지 않으므로 전일자로 요청(미국시장 기준, premarket open자료 당일처리)
    if  w_ymd = TRUNC (now ( ),'dd')     then
        if TO_CHAR (now ( ), 'hh24mi') > '2230' then
                w_us_ymd := F_OPEN_US (w_ymd, '-');
        else    w_us_ymd := F_OPEN_US (w_ymd, '-1');  /* 지수요청시 당일은 존재하지 않으므로 전일자로 요청(미국시장과 일자차이) */
        end if;
    else
        w_us_ymd := F_OPEN_US (w_ymd, '-');
    end if;
    w_msg := TO_CHAR (w_us_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '일 ';

    -- S&P500 지수요청
    for xx IN (
        SELECT COMPANY                                                                  /* _1- */
             , URL                                                                      /* _2- */
             , HEADERS                                                                  /* _3- */
             , QUERYPARAMS                                                              /* _4- */
             , TABLENAME                                                                /* _5- */
             , SUBTABLE                                                                 /* _6- */
             , KEY_VALUE                                                                /* _7- */
             , SUB_KEY_VALUE                                                            /* _8- */
             , TO_CHAR(now ( ),'yyyymmdd') || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))  AS api_key  /* _9- */
          FROM API_PARAMS t1
         WHERE t1.TR_CO_CD = w_tr_co_cd
           AND t1.GR_CD    = '13'
           AND t1.SCD      = '03'
           AND t1.COMPANY  = w_company
    ) loop
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@mrkt', 'N');
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@date1', TO_CHAR(w_us_ymd, 'yyyymmdd'));
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@date2', TO_CHAR(w_us_ymd, 'yyyymmdd'));
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@iscd', 'SPX');
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@div', 'D');
        INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
             ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
             , URL            /* _2- */
             , HEADERS        /* _3- */
             , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
             , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
             , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
             , REQUEST        /* _7- */
             , API_KEY        /* _8- */
             , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
             , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
             , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
             , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
             , KEY1           /* _13- */
             )
        VALUES ( xx.company        /* _1- */
               , xx.url            /* _2- */
               , xx.headers        /* _3- */
               , xx.queryparams    /* _4- */
               , xx.tablename      /* _5- */
               , xx.subtable       /* _6- */
               , '0'               /* _7- */
               , xx.api_key        /* _8- */
               , xx.key_value      /* _9- */
               , xx.sub_key_value  /* _10- */
               , p_corp_gr         /* _11- */
               , w_us_ymd          /* _12- */
               , 'SPX'             /* _13- */
               );
    end loop;
    w_msg := w_msg || '(S&P500지수';
    -- NASDAQ100 지수요청
    for xx IN (
        SELECT COMPANY                                                                  /* _1- */
             , URL                                                                      /* _2- */
             , HEADERS                                                                  /* _3- */
             , QUERYPARAMS                                                              /* _4- */
             , TABLENAME                                                                /* _5- */
             , SUBTABLE                                                                 /* _6- */
             , KEY_VALUE                                                                /* _7- */
             , SUB_KEY_VALUE                                                            /* _8- */
             , TO_CHAR(now ( ),'yyyymmdd') || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))  AS api_key  /* _9- */
          FROM API_PARAMS t1
         WHERE t1.TR_CO_CD = w_tr_co_cd
           AND t1.GR_CD    = '13'
           AND t1.SCD      = '03'
           AND t1.COMPANY  = w_company
    ) loop
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@mrkt', 'N');
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@date1', TO_CHAR(w_us_ymd, 'yyyymmdd'));
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@date2', TO_CHAR(w_us_ymd, 'yyyymmdd'));
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@iscd', 'NDX');
        xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@div', 'D');
        INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
             ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
             , URL            /* _2- */
             , HEADERS        /* _3- */
             , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
             , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
             , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
             , REQUEST        /* _7- */
             , API_KEY        /* _8- */
             , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
             , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
             , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
             , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
             , KEY1           /* _13- */
             )
        VALUES ( xx.company        /* _1- */
               , xx.url            /* _2- */
               , xx.headers        /* _3- */
               , xx.queryparams    /* _4- */
               , xx.tablename      /* _5- */
               , xx.subtable       /* _6- */
               , '0'               /* _7- */
               , xx.api_key        /* _8- */
               , xx.key_value      /* _9- */
               , xx.sub_key_value  /* _10- */
               , p_corp_gr         /* _11- */
               , w_us_ymd          /* _12- */
               , 'NDX'             /* _13- */
               );
    end loop;
    w_msg := w_msg || ',NASDAQ100지수';

    -- 해외주식당일 종가
    if  F_OPEN_US (w_ymd, '-1') = w_us_ymd      then
        for api IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT t1.JM_CD
                 , t1.EXCD
                 , t1.BLBG_TCKR  AS SYMB
              FROM SYM0YA t1  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             WHERE t1.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.JASAN_GB = '1'
               AND t1.EXCD IS NOT NULL
        ) loop
            for xx IN (
                SELECT COMPANY                                                                  /* _1- */
                     , URL                                                                      /* _2- */
                     , HEADERS                                                                  /* _3- */
                     , QUERYPARAMS                                                              /* _4- */
                     , TABLENAME                                                                /* _5- */
                     , SUBTABLE                                                                 /* _6- */
                     , KEY_VALUE                                                                /* _7- */
                     , SUB_KEY_VALUE                                                            /* _8- */
                     , TO_CHAR(now ( ),'yyyymmdd') || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))  AS api_key  /* _9- */
                  FROM API_PARAMS t1
                 WHERE t1.TR_CO_CD = w_tr_co_cd
                   AND t1.GR_CD    = '13'
                   AND t1.SCD      = '06'
                   AND t1.COMPANY  = w_company
            ) loop
                xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@excd', api.excd);
                xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@symb', api.symb);

                INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
                     ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
                     , URL            /* _2- */
                     , HEADERS        /* _3- */
                     , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
                     , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
                     , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
                     , REQUEST        /* _7- */
                     , API_KEY        /* _8- */
                     , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
                     , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
                     , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
                     , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
                     , KEY1           /* _13- */
                     )
                VALUES ( xx.company        /* _1- */
                       , xx.url            /* _2- */
                       , xx.headers        /* _3- */
                       , xx.queryparams    /* _4- */
                       , xx.tablename      /* _5- */
                       , xx.subtable       /* _6- */
                       , '0'               /* _7- */
                       , xx.api_key        /* _8- */
                       , xx.key_value      /* _9- */
                       , xx.sub_key_value  /* _10- */
                       , p_corp_gr         /* _11- */
                       , w_us_ymd          /* _12- */
                       , api.jm_cd         /* _13- */
                       );
            end loop;
        end loop;
        w_msg := w_msg || ',해외주식당일시가';

        -- 당일종가에 일자가 없으므로 과거일자는 13-02 최근 100일자료 수신(NUM1=trigger 처리건수)
        for api IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT t1.JM_CD
                 , t1.EXCD
                 , t1.BLBG_TCKR  AS SYMB
              FROM SYM0YA t1  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             WHERE t1.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.JASAN_GB = '1'
               AND t1.EXCD IS NOT NULL
        ) loop
            for xx IN (
                SELECT COMPANY                                                                  /* _1- */
                     , URL                                                                      /* _2- */
                     , HEADERS                                                                  /* _3- */
                     , QUERYPARAMS                                                              /* _4- */
                     , TABLENAME                                                                /* _5- */
                     , SUBTABLE                                                                 /* _6- */
                     , KEY_VALUE                                                                /* _7- */
                     , SUB_KEY_VALUE                                                            /* _8- */
                     , TO_CHAR(now ( ),'yyyymmdd') || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))  AS api_key  /* _9- */
                  FROM API_PARAMS t1
                 WHERE t1.TR_CO_CD = w_tr_co_cd
                   AND t1.GR_CD    = '13'
                   AND t1.SCD      = '02'
                   AND t1.COMPANY  = w_company
            ) loop
                xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@excd', api.excd);
                xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@symb', api.symb);
                xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@gubn', '0');
                xx.queryparams := REPLACE (xx.queryparams, '@bymd', TO_CHAR (w_ymd, 'yyyymmdd'));

                INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
                     ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
                     , URL            /* _2- */
                     , HEADERS        /* _3- */
                     , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
                     , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
                     , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
                     , REQUEST        /* _7- */
                     , API_KEY        /* _8- */
                     , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
                     , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
                     , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
                     , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
                     , KEY1           /* _13- */
                     , NUM1           /* _14- */
                     )
                VALUES ( xx.company        /* _1- */
                       , xx.url            /* _2- */
                       , xx.headers        /* _3- */
                       , xx.queryparams    /* _4- */
                       , xx.tablename      /* _5- */
                       , xx.subtable       /* _6- */
                       , '0'               /* _7- */
                       , xx.api_key        /* _8- */
                       , xx.key_value      /* _9- */
                       , xx.sub_key_value  /* _10- */
                       , p_corp_gr         /* _11- */
                       , now( )            /* _12- */
                       , api.jm_cd         /* _13- */
                       , 2                 /* _14- */
                       );
            end loop;
        end loop;
        w_msg := w_msg || ',해외주식종가';
    end if;

    w_cre_dt := now ( );
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT pm.JM_CD             AS uspm_jm_cd    /* _1- */
             , TO_CHAR (po.mangi,'yy')       AS yy            /* _2- */
             , TO_CHAR (po.mangi,'mm')       AS mm            /* _3- */
             , CASE WHEN TO_CHAR (po.mangi,'w')='3' THEN ''
                                                    ELSE TO_CHAR (po.mangi,'w')
               END                           AS week          /* _4- */
             , NVL(ya.SRS_CD, ya.BLBG_TCKR)  AS jm_cd         /* _5- */
             , TRUNC(pm.JONGA)               AS strike_price  /* _6- */
          FROM USPM      pm  /* US Portfolio Model 일변 기준정보 */
             , USPM_PORT po  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
             , SYM0YA    ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE pm.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
           AND pm.YMD      = w_ymd
           AND po.CORP_GR  = pm.CORP_GR
           AND po.FUND_CD  = pm.FUND_CD
           AND po.mangi    NOT IN (SELECT TO_DATE (EXPR_DATE,'yyyymmdd')
                                     FROM SRS_CD ta
                                    WHERE ta.EXPR_DATE IS NOT NULL)
           AND po.TYMD     = pm.YMD
           AND po.PORT_NUM = pm.PORT_NUM
           AND ya.CORP_GR  = pm.CORP_GR
           AND ya.JM_CD    = pm.JM_CD
    ) loop
        SELECT xx.week || xx.jm_cd || SRS_MM || xx.yy || ' C'
             , xx.week || xx.jm_cd || SRS_MM || xx.yy || ' P'
             , CASE WHEN xx.week IS NULL THEN xx.jm_cd || SRS_MM || xx.yy || ' C'
                                         ELSE xx.jm_cd || SRS_MM || xx.yy || '(' || xx.week || 'W)' || ' C' END
             , CASE WHEN xx.week IS NULL THEN xx.jm_cd || SRS_MM || xx.yy || ' P'
                                         ELSE xx.jm_cd || SRS_MM || xx.yy || '(' || xx.week || 'W)' || ' P' END
          INTO w_srscd_call
             , w_srscd_put
             , w_call_nm
             , w_put_nm
          FROM SZX0YM t1  /* 년월 코드 */
         WHERE t1.YMD_GB = 'M'
           AND t1.YMD_ID = xx.mm;

        xx.strike_price := TRUNC (xx.strike_price, -1);

        -- CALL 종목생성 필요시 (PUT 복사해서 생성) ; SJ_GB = '2'

        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SRS_CD
            VALUES ( w_srscd_put || F_N0(xx.strike_price, 0, 1)      /* _1- */
                   , xx.strike_price                                 /* _2- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                                        /* _3- */
                   , xx.uspm_jm_cd                                   /* _4- */
                   , NULL                                            /* _5- */
                   , NULL                                            /* _6- */
                   , NULL                                            /* _7- */
                   , w_cre_dt                                        /* _8- */
                   , 'Y'                                             /* _9- */
                   , xx.yy || xx.mm || NVL(xx.week,0)                /* _10- */
                   , w_put_nm || F_N0(xx.strike_price, 0, 1) || '-'
                              || xx.yy || xx.mm || NVL(xx.week,'0')  /* _11- */
                   , '3'                                             /* _12- */
                   , NULL                                            /* _13- */
                   , NULL                                            /* _14- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;

        if  xx.strike_price < 10        then    w_inc_ticksz := 0.1;
        elsif xx.strike_price > 99.99   then    w_inc_ticksz := 2.5;
        else                                    w_inc_ticksz := 0.5;
        end if;

        UPDATE SYM0YA   /* 해외 자산종목 */
           SET OPT_UNIT  = CASE WHEN xx.week NOT IN ('1','2','4','5') THEN w_inc_ticksz
                                                                      ELSE OPT_UNIT END
             , OPT_1UNIT = CASE xx.week WHEN '1' THEN w_inc_ticksz
                                                 ELSE OPT_1UNIT END
             , OPT_2UNIT = CASE xx.week WHEN '2' THEN w_inc_ticksz
                                                 ELSE OPT_2UNIT END
             , OPT_4UNIT = CASE xx.week WHEN '4' THEN w_inc_ticksz
                                                 ELSE OPT_4UNIT END
             , OPT_5UNIT = CASE xx.week WHEN '5' THEN w_inc_ticksz
                                                 ELSE OPT_5UNIT END
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND jm_cd   = xx.uspm_jm_cd;

        w_stkprc := xx.strike_price;
        for w_ii IN 1..200 loop
            w_stkprc := w_stkprc + w_inc_ticksz;

            -- CALL 종목생성 필요시 (PUT 복사해서 생성) ; SJ_GB = '2'


            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO SRS_CD
                VALUES ( w_srscd_put || F_N0(w_stkprc, 0, 1)             /* _1- */
                       , w_stkprc                                        /* _2- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                                        /* _3- */
                       , xx.uspm_jm_cd                                   /* _4- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _5- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _6- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _7- */
                       , w_cre_dt                                        /* _8- */
                       , 'N'                                             /* _9- */
                       , xx.yy || xx.mm || NVL(xx.week,0)                /* _10- */
                       , w_put_nm || F_N0(w_stkprc, 0, 1) || '-'
                                  || xx.yy || xx.mm || NVL(xx.week,'0')  /* _11- */
                       , '3'                                             /* _12- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _13- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _14- */
                       );
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                NULL;
            END;
        end loop;

        w_stkprc := xx.strike_price;
        for w_ii IN 1..200 loop
            w_stkprc := w_stkprc - w_inc_ticksz;
            if  w_stkprc < 1    then    EXIT;
            end if;

            -- CALL 종목생성 필요시 (PUT 복사해서 생성) ; SJ_GB = '2'


            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO SRS_CD
                VALUES ( w_srscd_put || F_N0(w_stkprc, 0, 1)             /* _1- */
                       , w_stkprc                                        /* _2- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                                        /* _3- */
                       , xx.uspm_jm_cd                                   /* _4- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _5- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _6- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _7- */
                       , w_cre_dt                                        /* _8- */
                       , 'N'                                             /* _9- */
                       , xx.yy || xx.mm || NVL(xx.week,0)                /* _10- */
                       , w_put_nm || F_N0(w_stkprc, 0, 1) || '-'
                                  || xx.yy || xx.mm || NVL(xx.week,'0')  /* _11- */
                       , '3'                                             /* _12- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _13- */
                       , NULL                                            /* _14- */
                       );
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                NULL;
            END;
        end loop;
    end loop;

    -- API 옵션 종목정보 요청생성
    INSERT INTO API_Q   /* API 요청 및 처리결과 */
         ( COMPANY        /* _1- */
         , URL            /* _2- */
         , HEADERS        /* _3- */
         , QUERYPARAMS    /* _4- */
         , TABLENAME      /* _5- */
         , SUBTABLE       /* _6- */
         , REQUEST        /* _7- */
         , API_KEY        /* _8- */
         , KEY_VALUE      /* _9- */
         , SUB_KEY_VALUE  /* _10- */
         , CORP_GR        /* _11- */
         , TR_YMD         /* _12- */
         , KEY1           /* _13- */
         , KEY2           /* _14- */
         )
    SELECT COMPANY                                                      /* _1- */
         , URL                                                          /* _2- */
         , HEADERS                                                      /* _3- */
         , '{ QRY_CNT: "1", SRS_CD_01: "' || cd.SRS_CD || '" }'         /* _4- */
         , TABLENAME                                                    /* _5- */
         , SUBTABLE                                                     /* _6- */
         , '0'                                                          /* _7- */
         , TO_CHAR(now ( ),'yyyymmdd') || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID( ))  /* _8- */
         , KEY_VALUE                                                    /* _9- */
         , SUB_KEY_VALUE                                                /* _10- */
         , p_corp_gr                                                    /* _11- */
         , sysdate                                                      /* _12- */
         , cd.SRS_CD                                                    /* _13- */
         , 'SRS_CD'                                                     /* _14- */
      FROM API_PARAMS t1
         , SRS_CD     cd
     WHERE t1.TR_CO_CD = '00003'
       AND t1.GR_CD    = '17'
       AND t1.SCD      = '20'
       AND t1.COMPANY  = 'KB_REAL'
       AND cd.cre_dt   = w_cre_dt
     ORDER BY cd.SRS_CD;

    API_17_14 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_1714, w_cre_dt );
    commit;

    p_msg := w_msg || ') - ' || w_1714;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA036E (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_rt_key                       IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_currency                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd_gu                     IN    VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 자산 보유현황
--
    w_jasan_nm                     VARCHAR (50);
    w_ymd                          DATE;
BEGIN
    commit;

    w_ymd := F_OPEN_US (p_ymd, '-1');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT jm_cd                                             /* _1- */
             , F_JM_NM (p_corp_gr, jm_cd)           AS hj_nm     /* _2- */
             , NVL(siga_aek,0)                      AS siga_aek  /* _3- */
             , NVL(misu_ija,0)                      AS misu_ija  /* _4- */
             , NVL(siga_aek,0) - NVL(pyunga_aek,0)  AS jun       /* _5- */
          FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = w_ymd
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
             ( rt_key  /* _1- */
             , c_01    /* _2- */
             , c_02    /* _3- */
             , c_03    /* _4- */
             , c_04    /* _5- */
             , c_05    /* _6- */
             , n_10    /* _7- */
             , n_20    /* _8- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_rt_key                /* _1- */
               , '10'                    /* _2- */
               , '현금'                  /* _3- */
               , xx.jm_cd                /* _4- */
               , xx.hj_nm                /* _5- */
               , '원'                    /* _6- */
               , CASE WHEN SUBSTR (xx.jm_cd,8,2)='90'
                      THEN - xx.siga_aek
                      ELSE - xx.jun END  /* _7- */
               , CASE WHEN SUBSTR (xx.jm_cd,8,2)='90'
                      THEN - xx.siga_aek + xx.misu_ija
                      ELSE - xx.jun END  /* _8- */
               );
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.jm_cd                                                    /* _1- */
             , F_JM_NM (p_corp_gr, t1.jm_cd)                  AS hj_nm     /* _2- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0)
                                   - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)      AS aekm      /* _3- */
             , NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)      AS day_aekm  /* _4- */
             , CASE WHEN hj.cash_cd='90'
                    THEN 0
                    ELSE NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0)
               END + NVL(t1.meib_aek,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aek,0)  AS aek       /* _5- */
             , t1.pyunga_aek                                               /* _6- */
             , t1.siga_aek                                                 /* _7- */
             , t1.bfil_sung_cost                                           /* _8- */
             , t1.sung_cost                                                /* _9- */
             , t1.misu_ija                                                 /* _10- */
             , t1.day_ija                                                  /* _11- */
          FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
             , SHM0HJ hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND hj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
             ( rt_key  /* _1- */
             , c_01    /* _2- */
             , c_02    /* _3- */
             , c_03    /* _4- */
             , c_04    /* _5- */
             , c_05    /* _6- */
             , n_01    /* _7- */
             , n_02    /* _8- */
             , n_06    /* _9- */
             , n_07    /* _10- */
             , n_08    /* _11- */
             , n_10    /* _12- */
             , n_14    /* _13- */
             , n_15    /* _14- */
             , n_16    /* _15- */
             , n_20    /* _16- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_rt_key                                   /* _1- */
               , '10'                                       /* _2- */
               , '현금'                                     /* _3- */
               , xx.jm_cd                                   /* _4- */
               , xx.hj_nm                                   /* _5- */
               , '원'                                       /* _6- */
               , xx.aekm                                    /* _7- */
               , xx.day_aekm                                /* _8- */
               , xx.aek                                     /* _9- */
               , xx.pyunga_aek                              /* _10- */
               , NVL(xx.siga_aek,0) - NVL(xx.pyunga_aek,0)  /* _11- */
               , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(xx.jm_cd,8,2)='90'
                      THEN NVL(xx.siga_aek,0)
                      ELSE NVL(xx.siga_aek,0) - NVL(xx.pyunga_aek,0)
                 END                                        /* _12- */
               , xx.sung_cost                               /* _13- */
               , xx.misu_ija                                /* _14- */
               , xx.day_ija                                 /* _15- */
               , NVL(xx.siga_aek,0) - NVL(xx.misu_ija,0)    /* _16- */
               );
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT gwamok
             , F_GWAMOK_NM (corp_gr, gwamok)              AS gwamok_nm
             , F_DANGJ (chadae_gb, junj, dr_aek, cr_aek)  AS dangj
             , CASE WHEN fund_currency='KRW'
                    THEN '원'
                    ELSE fund_currency
               END                                        AS fcur
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd       = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok        IN ('12001','12002')
           AND t1.fund_currency = p_fund_currency
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
             ( rt_key  /* _1- */
             , c_01    /* _2- */
             , c_02    /* _3- */
             , c_03    /* _4- */
             , c_04    /* _5- */
             , c_05    /* _6- */
             , n_06    /* _7- */
             , n_07    /* _8- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_rt_key          /* _1- */
               , '10'              /* _2- */
               , '현금'            /* _3- */
               , '_' || xx.gwamok  /* _4- */
               , xx.gwamok_nm      /* _5- */
               , xx.fcur           /* _6- */
               , xx.dangj          /* _7- */
               , xx.dangj          /* _8- */
               );
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT gwamok
             , F_GWAMOK_NM (corp_gr, gwamok)              AS gwamok_nm
             , F_DANGJ (chadae_gb, junj, dr_aek, cr_aek)  AS dangj
             , CASE WHEN fund_currency='KRW'
                    THEN '원'
                    ELSE fund_currency
               END                                        AS fcur
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd       = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok        IN ('20201','20202')
           AND t1.fund_currency = p_fund_currency
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
             ( rt_key  /* _1- */
             , c_01    /* _2- */
             , c_02    /* _3- */
             , c_03    /* _4- */
             , c_04    /* _5- */
             , c_05    /* _6- */
             , n_06    /* _7- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_rt_key          /* _1- */
               , '10'              /* _2- */
               , '현금'            /* _3- */
               , '_' || xx.gwamok  /* _4- */
               , xx.gwamok_nm      /* _5- */
               , xx.fcur           /* _6- */
               , - xx.dangj        /* _7- */
               );
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT CASE WHEN p_jm_cd_gu='1'
                    THEN cj.jm_cd
                    ELSE cj.as_cj_cd
               END                                        AS jm_cd
             , F_JM_NM (p_corp_gr, t1.jm_cd)              AS cj_nm
             , NVL(t1.siga_aek,0) - NVL(t1.pyunga_aek,0)  AS jun
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = w_ymd
           AND cj.corp_gr = F_LINK_CORP_GR(t1.corp_gr)
           AND cj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
             ( rt_key  /* _1- */
             , c_01    /* _2- */
             , c_02    /* _3- */
             , c_03    /* _4- */
             , c_04    /* _5- */
             , c_05    /* _6- */
             , n_10    /* _7- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_rt_key  /* _1- */
               , '40'      /* _2- */
               , '채권'    /* _3- */
               , xx.jm_cd  /* _4- */
               , xx.cj_nm  /* _5- */
               , '원'      /* _6- */
               , - xx.jun  /* _7- */
               );
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT CASE WHEN p_jm_cd_gu='1'
                    THEN cj.jm_cd
                    ELSE cj.as_cj_cd
               END                                                             AS jm_cd           /* _1- */
             , F_JM_NM (p_corp_gr, t1.jm_cd)                                   AS cj_nm           /* _2- */
             , t1.pyunga_aek                                                                      /* _3- */
             , t1.siga_aek                                                                        /* _4- */
             , NVL(bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(meib_aekm,0) - NVL(medo_aekm,0)
                                + NVL(msd_meib_aekm,0) - NVL(msd_medo_aekm,0)  AS aekm            /* _5- */
             , NVL(meib_aekm,0) - NVL(medo_aekm,0)                             AS day_aekm        /* _6- */
             , NVL(bfil_sung_cost,0) + NVL(bfil_pr_sung_cost,0)                AS bfil_sung_cost  /* _7- */
             , NVL(sung_cost,0) + NVL(pr_sung_cost,0)                          AS sung_cost       /* _8- */
             , NVL(misu_ija,0) + NVL(pr_misu_ija,0)                            AS misu_ija        /* _9- */
             , t1.day_ija                                                                         /* _10- */
             , NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(meib_aek,0) - NVL(medo_aek,0)
                                    + NVL(anbun_aek,0) + NVL(msd_meib_aek,0)   AS aek             /* _11- */
             , NVL(meib_aek,0) - NVL(medo_aek,0)
                               + NVL(msd_meib_aek,0) - NVL(msd_medo_aek,0)     AS day_aek         /* _12- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND cj.corp_gr = F_LINK_CORP_GR(t1.corp_gr)
           AND cj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
             ( rt_key  /* _1- */
             , c_01    /* _2- */
             , c_02    /* _3- */
             , c_03    /* _4- */
             , c_04    /* _5- */
             , c_05    /* _6- */
             , n_01    /* _7- */
             , n_02    /* _8- */
             , n_06    /* _9- */
             , n_20    /* _10- */
             , n_07    /* _11- */
             , n_08    /* _12- */
             , n_10    /* _13- */
             , n_14    /* _14- */
             , n_15    /* _15- */
             , n_16    /* _16- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_rt_key                                   /* _1- */
               , '40'                                       /* _2- */
               , '채권'                                     /* _3- */
               , xx.jm_cd                                   /* _4- */
               , xx.cj_nm                                   /* _5- */
               , '원'                                       /* _6- */
               , xx.aekm                                    /* _7- */
               , xx.day_aekm                                /* _8- */
               , xx.aek                                     /* _9- */
               , xx.day_aek                                 /* _10- */
               , xx.pyunga_aek                              /* _11- */
               , NVL(xx.siga_aek,0) - NVL(xx.pyunga_aek,0)  /* _12- */
               , NVL(xx.siga_aek,0) - NVL(xx.pyunga_aek,0)  /* _13- */
               , xx.sung_cost                               /* _14- */
               , xx.misu_ija                                /* _15- */
               , xx.day_ija                                 /* _16- */
               );
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT CASE WHEN p_jm_cd_gu='1'
                    THEN t1.jm_cd
                    ELSE NVL(ya.isin_cd, t1.jm_cd)
               END            AS jm_cd   /* _1- */
             , ya.jm_nm                  /* _2- */
             , ya.currency               /* _3- */
             , ya.lsy_ymd                /* _4- */
             , ya.jasan_gb               /* _5- */
             , ya.jasan_attr             /* _6- */
             , ya.sj_gb                  /* _7- */
             , t1.TRUSTEE                /* _8- */
             , t1.sm_tr_gb               /* _9- */
             , CASE WHEN p_fund_currency='KRW'
                    THEN t1.won_pyunga_sonik
                    ELSE t1.fcur_pyunga_sonik
               END            AS p       /* _10- */
             , CASE WHEN p_fund_currency='KRW'
                    THEN t1.won_hwan_cha
                    ELSE t1.fcur_hwan_cha
               END            AS h       /* _11- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr          = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd          = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd              = w_ymd
           AND t1.WON_PYUNGA_SONIK <> 0
           AND t1.WON_HWAN_CHA     <> 0
           AND ya.corp_gr          = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd            = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.jasan_gb = '1' AND xx.sj_gb != '9'   then
            INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
                 ( rt_key  /* _1- */
                 , c_01    /* _2- */
                 , c_02    /* _3- */
                 , c_03    /* _4- */
                 , c_04    /* _5- */
                 , c_05    /* _6- */
                 , n_10    /* _7- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_rt_key                          /* _1- */
                   , '30'                              /* _2- */
                   , '외화주식'                        /* _3- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                          /* _4- */
                   , xx.trustee || xx.jm_nm            /* _5- */
                   , xx.currency                       /* _6- */
                   , (NVL(xx.p,0) + NVL(xx.h,0)) * -1  /* _7- */
                   );

        elsif xx.jasan_gb = '1' AND xx.sj_gb = '9'  then
            INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
                 ( rt_key  /* _1- */
                 , c_01    /* _2- */
                 , c_02    /* _3- */
                 , c_03    /* _4- */
                 , c_04    /* _5- */
                 , c_05    /* _6- */
                 , n_10    /* _7- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_rt_key                          /* _1- */
                   , '35'                              /* _2- */
                   , '외화특별자산'                    /* _3- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                          /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_nm                          /* _5- */
                   , xx.currency                       /* _6- */
                   , (NVL(xx.p,0) + NVL(xx.h,0)) * -1  /* _7- */
                   );

        elsif xx.jasan_gb = 'A' then    -- 장내선물옵션
            if  xx.sj_gb = '1' AND xx.sm_tr_gb = '1'    then
                INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
                     ( rt_key  /* _1- */
                     , c_01    /* _2- */
                     , c_02    /* _3- */
                     , c_03    /* _4- */
                     , c_04    /* _5- */
                     , c_05    /* _6- */
                     , n_10    /* _7- */
                     , d_02    /* _8- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_rt_key                          /* _1- */
                       , '51'                              /* _2- */
                       , '외화매입선물'                    /* _3- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                          /* _4- */
                       , xx.trustee || xx.jm_nm            /* _5- */
                       , xx.currency                       /* _6- */
                       , (NVL(xx.p,0) + NVL(xx.h,0)) * -1  /* _7- */
                       , xx.lsy_ymd                        /* _8- */
                       );
            elsif xx.sj_gb = '1' AND xx.sm_tr_gb = '2'  then
                INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
                     ( rt_key  /* _1- */
                     , c_01    /* _2- */
                     , c_02    /* _3- */
                     , c_03    /* _4- */
                     , c_04    /* _5- */
                     , c_05    /* _6- */
                     , n_10    /* _7- */
                     , d_02    /* _8- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_rt_key                          /* _1- */
                       , '5A'                              /* _2- */
                       , '외화매도선물'                    /* _3- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                          /* _4- */
                       , xx.trustee || xx.jm_nm            /* _5- */
                       , xx.currency                       /* _6- */
                       , (NVL(xx.p,0) + NVL(xx.h,0)) * -1  /* _7- */
                       , xx.lsy_ymd                        /* _8- */
                       );
            elsif xx.sj_gb = '2' AND xx.sm_tr_gb = '3'  then
                INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
                     ( rt_key  /* _1- */
                     , c_01    /* _2- */
                     , c_02    /* _3- */
                     , c_03    /* _4- */
                     , c_04    /* _5- */
                     , c_05    /* _6- */
                     , n_10    /* _7- */
                     , d_02    /* _8- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_rt_key                          /* _1- */
                       , '51'                              /* _2- */
                       , '외화콜옵션매수'                  /* _3- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                          /* _4- */
                       , xx.trustee || xx.jm_nm            /* _5- */
                       , xx.currency                       /* _6- */
                       , (NVL(xx.p,0) + NVL(xx.h,0)) * -1  /* _7- */
                       , xx.lsy_ymd                        /* _8- */
                       );
            elsif xx.sj_gb = '2' AND xx.sm_tr_gb = '4'  then
                INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
                     ( rt_key  /* _1- */
                     , c_01    /* _2- */
                     , c_02    /* _3- */
                     , c_03    /* _4- */
                     , c_04    /* _5- */
                     , c_05    /* _6- */
                     , n_10    /* _7- */
                     , d_02    /* _8- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_rt_key                          /* _1- */
                       , '5A'                              /* _2- */
                       , '외화콜옵션매도'                  /* _3- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                          /* _4- */
                       , xx.trustee || xx.jm_nm            /* _5- */
                       , xx.currency                       /* _6- */
                       , (NVL(xx.p,0) + NVL(xx.h,0)) * -1  /* _7- */
                       , xx.lsy_ymd                        /* _8- */
                       );
            elsif xx.sj_gb = '3' AND xx.sm_tr_gb = '5'  then
                INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
                     ( rt_key  /* _1- */
                     , c_01    /* _2- */
                     , c_02    /* _3- */
                     , c_03    /* _4- */
                     , c_04    /* _5- */
                     , c_05    /* _6- */
                     , n_10    /* _7- */
                     , d_02    /* _8- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_rt_key                          /* _1- */
                       , '51'                              /* _2- */
                       , '외화풋옵션매수'                  /* _3- */
                       , xx.trustee || xx.jm_cd            /* _4- */
                       , xx.jm_nm                          /* _5- */
                       , xx.currency                       /* _6- */
                       , (NVL(xx.p,0) + NVL(xx.h,0)) * -1  /* _7- */
                       , xx.lsy_ymd                        /* _8- */
                       );
            elsif xx.sj_gb = '3' AND xx.sm_tr_gb = '6'  then
                INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
                     ( rt_key  /* _1- */
                     , c_01    /* _2- */
                     , c_02    /* _3- */
                     , c_03    /* _4- */
                     , c_04    /* _5- */
                     , c_05    /* _6- */
                     , n_10    /* _7- */
                     , d_02    /* _8- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_rt_key                          /* _1- */
                       , '5A'                              /* _2- */
                       , '외화풋옵션매도'                  /* _3- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                          /* _4- */
                       , xx.trustee || xx.jm_nm            /* _5- */
                       , xx.currency                       /* _6- */
                       , (NVL(xx.p,0) + NVL(xx.h,0)) * -1  /* _7- */
                       , xx.lsy_ymd                        /* _8- */
                       );
            end if;
        elsif xx.jasan_gb = '2' then
            INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
                 ( rt_key  /* _1- */
                 , c_01    /* _2- */
                 , c_02    /* _3- */
                 , c_03    /* _4- */
                 , c_04    /* _5- */
                 , c_05    /* _6- */
                 , n_10    /* _7- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_rt_key                          /* _1- */
                   , '40'                              /* _2- */
                   , CASE WHEN xx.jasan_attr IN ('140')
                          THEN '외화대여금'
                          ELSE '외화채권'
                     END                               /* _3- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                          /* _4- */
