                   , xx.jm_nm                          /* _5- */
                   , xx.currency                       /* _6- */
                   , (NVL(xx.p,0) + NVL(xx.h,0)) * -1  /* _7- */
                   );
        elsif xx.jasan_gb = '5' then
            INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
                 ( rt_key  /* _1- */
                 , c_01    /* _2- */
                 , c_02    /* _3- */
                 , c_03    /* _4- */
                 , c_04    /* _5- */
                 , c_05    /* _6- */
                 , n_10    /* _7- */
                 , d_01    /* _8- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_rt_key      /* _1- */
                   , '20'          /* _2- */
                   , '외화예치금'  /* _3- */
                   , xx.jm_cd      /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_nm      /* _5- */
                   , xx.currency   /* _6- */
                   , - xx.h        /* _7- */
                   , p_ymd         /* _8- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT CASE WHEN p_jm_cd_gu='1'
                    THEN t1.jm_cd

             , NVL(t1.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_aek,0)
                                  - NVL(t1.dw_aek,0)  AS aek      /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.up_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_aek,0)    AS day_aek  /* _6- */
             , t1.sonik                                           /* _7- */
          FROM SJM5SM t1  /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
             , SJM0SC sc  /* 타사집합투자증권 정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd    = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND sc.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND sc.tasa_jm_cd = t1.tasa_jm_cd
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
             ( rt_key  /* _1- */
             , c_01    /* _2- */
             , c_02    /* _3- */
             , c_03    /* _4- */
             , c_04    /* _5- */
             , c_05    /* _6- */
             , n_01    /* _7- */
             , n_02    /* _8- */
             , n_06    /* _9- */
             , n_20    /* _10- */
             , n_07    /* _11- */
             , n_08    /* _12- */
             , n_10    /* _13- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_rt_key                         /* _1- */
               , '60'                             /* _2- */
               , '수익증권'                       /* _3- */
               , xx.tasa_jm_cd                    /* _4- */
               , xx.fund_nm                       /* _5- */
               , '원'                             /* _6- */
               , xx.jwa                           /* _7- */
               , xx.day_jwa                       /* _8- */
               , xx.aek                           /* _9- */
               , xx.day_aek                       /* _10- */
               , NVL(xx.aek,0) + NVL(xx.sonik,0)  /* _11- */
               , xx.sonik                         /* _12- */
               , xx.sonik                         /* _13- */
               );
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.jm_cd
             , jm.jm_nm
             , t1.sonik
          FROM OTS0OM t1  /* OTS 보유현황 */
             , OTS0JM jm  /* OTS 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = w_ymd
           AND jm.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND jm.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
             ( rt_key  /* _1- */
             , c_01    /* _2- */
             , c_02    /* _3- */
             , c_03    /* _4- */
             , c_04    /* _5- */
             , c_05    /* _6- */
             , n_10    /* _7- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_rt_key    /* _1- */
               , '70'        /* _2- */
               , 'OTS'       /* _3- */
               , xx.jm_cd    /* _4- */
               , xx.jm_nm    /* _5- */
               , '원'        /* _6- */
               , - xx.sonik  /* _7- */
               );
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.jm_cd                                           /* _1- */
             , jm.jm_nm                                           /* _2- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_qty,0) + NVL(t1.up_qty,0)
                                  - NVL(t1.dw_qty,0)  AS qty      /* _3- */
             , NVL(t1.up_qty,0) - NVL(t1.dw_qty,0)    AS day_qty  /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_aek,0)
                                  - NVL(t1.dw_aek,0)  AS aek      /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.up_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_aek,0)    AS day_aek  /* _6- */
             , t1.sonik                                           /* _7- */
          FROM OTS0OM t1  /* OTS 보유현황 */
             , OTS0JM jm  /* OTS 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND jm.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND jm.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
             ( rt_key  /* _1- */
             , c_01    /* _2- */
             , c_02    /* _3- */
             , c_03    /* _4- */
             , c_04    /* _5- */
             , c_05    /* _6- */
             , n_01    /* _7- */
             , n_02    /* _8- */
             , n_06    /* _9- */
             , n_20    /* _10- */
             , n_07    /* _11- */
             , n_08    /* _12- */
             , n_10    /* _13- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_rt_key                         /* _1- */
               , '70'                             /* _2- */
               , 'OTS'                            /* _3- */
               , xx.jm_cd                         /* _4- */
               , xx.jm_nm                         /* _5- */
               , '원'                             /* _6- */
               , xx.qty                           /* _7- */
               , xx.day_qty                       /* _8- */
               , xx.aek                           /* _9- */
               , xx.day_aek                       /* _10- */
               , NVL(xx.aek,0) + NVL(xx.sonik,0)  /* _11- */
               , xx.sonik                         /* _12- */
               , xx.sonik                         /* _13- */
               );
    end loop;

    -- 대체투자
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.jm_cd
             , jm.jm_nm
             , NVL(t1.pyunga_sonik,0) + NVL(t1.gyul_sonik,0)  AS sonik
          FROM SGM0HK t1  /* 대체투자보유내역 */
             , SGM0JM jm  /* 대체투자종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = w_ymd
           AND jm.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND jm.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
             ( rt_key  /* _1- */
             , c_01    /* _2- */
             , c_02    /* _3- */
             , c_03    /* _4- */
             , c_04    /* _5- */
             , c_05    /* _6- */
             , n_10    /* _7- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_rt_key    /* _1- */
               , '80'        /* _2- */
               , '특별자산'  /* _3- */
               , xx.jm_cd    /* _4- */
               , xx.jm_nm    /* _5- */
               , '원'        /* _6- */
               , - xx.sonik  /* _7- */
               );
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.jm_cd                                                      /* _1- */
             , jm.jm_nm                                                      /* _2- */
             , NVL(t1.bf_qty,0) + NVL(t1.up_qty,0)
                                - NVL(t1.dw_qty,0)            AS qty         /* _3- */
             , NVL(t1.up_qty,0) - NVL(t1.dw_qty,0)            AS day_qty     /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.bf_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0)
                                     - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)  AS aek         /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)  AS day_aek     /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.pyunga_sonik,0) + NVL(t1.gyul_sonik,0)  AS sonik       /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.pyunga_aek,0)                           AS pyunga_aek  /* _8- */
          FROM SGM0HK t1  /* 대체투자보유내역 */
             , SGM0JM jm  /* 대체투자종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND jm.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND jm.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
             ( rt_key  /* _1- */
             , c_01    /* _2- */
             , c_02    /* _3- */
             , c_03    /* _4- */
             , c_04    /* _5- */
             , c_05    /* _6- */
             , n_01    /* _7- */
             , n_02    /* _8- */
             , n_06    /* _9- */
             , n_20    /* _10- */
             , n_07    /* _11- */
             , n_08    /* _12- */
             , n_10    /* _13- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_rt_key       /* _1- */
               , '80'           /* _2- */
               , '특별자산'     /* _3- */
               , xx.jm_cd       /* _4- */
               , xx.jm_nm       /* _5- */
               , '원'           /* _6- */
               , xx.qty         /* _7- */
               , xx.day_qty     /* _8- */
               , xx.aek         /* _9- */
               , xx.day_aek     /* _10- */
               , xx.pyunga_aek  /* _11- */
               , xx.sonik       /* _12- */
               , xx.sonik       /* _13- */
               );
    end loop;

    UPDATE GZZX0RT
       SET d_01 = p_ymd
     WHERE rt_key = p_rt_key
       AND d_01   < p_ymd;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA050 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_auto_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 마스타 검증 처리
--
    w_mod                          NUMBER := 0;
    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -- fund별 check 자료를 삭제하고 원장의 말잔액을 일괄 insert한다.
    DELETE FROM SZX1CK tt   /* fund별 검증 자료 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr;

    DELETE FROM SZX2CK tt   /* 펀드별 Check 자료 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr;

    DELETE FROM SZX3CK tt   /* 펀드별 Check 자료 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND proc    IN ('skkp010','JA050');

    DELETE FROM WFRMERR tt  /* 에러메세지(저장작업 정지됨) */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr;

    if  p_auto_gb IN ('1','2')  then
        DELETE FROM SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
         WHERE corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND tr_ymd    = p_ymd
           AND tr_cd     = 'Z98'
           AND work_gb   = 'A'
           AND proc_step = 9
           AND bigo      = '자가진단 계정변경(JA050)';
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            UPDATE SZX0AA tt    /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
               SET last_ymd = p_ymd -1
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr;
        end if;
    end if;

    if  p_corp_gr = '2200'  then
        -- 테스트 회사 자가진단 PASS
        UPDATE SZX0AA tt    /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
           SET check_ymd = p_ymd
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr;
        commit;

        p_msg := 'Y';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    if  p_corp_gr = '2201'  then
        -- 투핸즈 PASS
        commit;
        p_msg := 'Y';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    commit;

    SR_JA05000 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd );  /* 마스타 검증처리 */

    SR_JA05001 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_msg );  /* 주식마스타 검증처리 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then    -- 주식종가 에러시 재작업 처리
        p_msg := 'JA050 - ' || w_msg;
        commit;
        RETURN;
    end if;
    SR_JA05002 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd );  /* 채권마스타 검증처리 */
    SR_JA05003 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd );  /* 현금마스타 검증처리 */
    SR_JA05004 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd );  /* 주식 수도결제 검증처리 */
    SR_JA05005 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd );  /* 채권 수도결제 검증처리 */
    SR_JA05008 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd );  /* 미지급주식납입금 검증처리 */
    SR_JA05009 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd );  /* 공모/청약/위탁증거금 검증처리 */
    SR_JA05010 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd );  /* 펀드마스타 검증처리 */
    SR_JA05012 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd );  /* 미수배당금 검증처리 */
    SR_JA05017 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd );  /* 수익증권마스타 검증처리(해외제외) */
    SR_JA05018 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd );  /* 선물 마스타 검증 처리 */
    SR_JA05019 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd );  /* 선물 수도 결제 check */

    -- 검증용 테이블 작성
    INSERT INTO SZX2CK tt   /* 펀드별 Check 자료 */
    SELECT p_corp_gr                  /* _1- */
         , t1.fund_cd                 /* _2- */
         , t1.gwamok                  /* _3- */
         , NVL(SUM(t1.master_aek),0)  /* _4- */
         , NVL(SUM(t1.ag_aek),0)      /* _5- */
         , ia.fund_currency           /* _6- */
      FROM SZX1CK t1  /* fund별 검증 자료 */
         , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
       AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
       AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
       AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
     GROUP BY t1.fund_cd
            , ia.fund_currency
            , t1.gwamok;

    commit;

    -- 자가진단시 소속변경으로 계정변경 발생시 자동 분개생성
    if  p_auto_gb = '1' then
        for xx IN (
            SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                                                          /* _1- */
                 , t2.fund_currency                                                                                    /* _2- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10301' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10301 /* _3- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10302' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10302 /* _4- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10303' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10303 /* _5- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10304' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10304 /* _6- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10351' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10351 /* _7- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10401' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10401 /* _8- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10402' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10402 /* _9- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10403' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10403 /* _10- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10404' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10404 /* _11- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10408' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10408 /* _12- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10451' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10451 /* _13- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10452' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10452 /* _14- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10501' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10501 /* _15- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10502' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10502 /* _16- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10503' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10503 /* _17- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10504' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10504 /* _18- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10505' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10505 /* _19- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10523' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10523 /* _20- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10524' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10524 /* _21- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10525' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10525 /* _22- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10506' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10506 /* _23- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10526' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10526 /* _24- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='12001' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g12001 /* _25- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='12101' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g12101 /* _26- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='12102' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g12102 /* _27- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='12103' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g12103 /* _28- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='12201' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g12201 /* _29- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='12202' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g12202 /* _30- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='12203' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g12203 /* _31- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='12301' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g12301 /* _32- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='12302' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g12302 /* _33- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='10103' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g10103 /* _34- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='20201' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g20201 /* _35- */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.GWAMOK='40101' THEN NVL(t1.master_aek,0) - NVL(t1.ag_aek,0) END),0)  AS g40101 /* _36- */
              FROM SZX1CK t1  /* fund별 검증 자료 */
                 , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
               AND t2.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr
               AND t2.fund_cd   = t1.fund_cd
               AND t2.haeji_ymd IS NULL
             GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, t2.fund_currency
        ) loop
            if  p_corp_gr = '2202' AND p_ymd = TO_DATE ('20220711','yyyymmdd')  then
                SR_INSBU1 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 9, 4, 50, 'C', '60101', xx.g10401 + xx.g10402, 'Z98', 9, '자가진단 계정변경(JA050)', w_msg );
            end if;

            SR_INSBU1 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 9, 3, 1, 'D', '10301', xx.g10301, 'Z98', 9, '자가진단 계정변경(JA050)', w_msg );
            SR_INSBU1 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 9, 3, 2, 'D', '10302', xx.g10302, 'Z98', 9, '자가진단 계정변경(JA050)', w_msg );
            SR_INSBU1 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 9, 3, 3, 'D', '10303', xx.g10303, 'Z98', 9, '자가진단 계정변경(JA050)', w_msg );
            SR_INSBU1 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 9, 3, 4, 'D', '10304', xx.g10304, 'Z98', 9, '자가진단 계정변경(JA050)', w_msg );

            end if;
            if  xx.g12302 != 0  then
                SR_INSBU1 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 9, 20, 1, 'D', '12302', xx.g12302  , 'Z98', 9, '자가진단 계정변경(JA050)', w_msg );

            -- 재계약금액 수정액 분개

            SR_INSBU1 ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 9, 99, 2, 'D', '54902', xx.g40101, 'Z98', 9, '자가진단 재계약금액 수정(JA050)', w_msg );

            commit;

            if  xx.g10301 != 0 OR xx.g10302 != 0 OR xx.g10303 != 0 OR xx.g10304 != 0 OR xx.g10351 != 0 OR 
                xx.g10401 != 0 OR xx.g10402 != 0 OR xx.g10403 != 0 OR xx.g10404 != 0 OR xx.g10408 != 0 OR xx.g10451 != 0 OR xx.g10452 != 0 OR 
                xx.g10501 != 0 OR xx.g10502 != 0 OR xx.g10503 != 0 OR xx.g10504 != 0 OR xx.g10505 != 0 OR xx.g10523 != 0 OR 
                xx.g10524 != 0 OR xx.g10525 != 0 OR xx.g10506 != 0 OR xx.g10526 != 0 OR xx.g12101 != 0 OR xx.g12102 != 0 OR xx.g12103 != 0 OR 
                xx.g12201 != 0 OR xx.g12202 != 0 OR xx.g12203 != 0 OR xx.g12301 != 0 OR xx.g10103 != 0 OR 
                xx.g12302 != 0 OR xx.g12001 != 0 OR xx.g20201 != 0 OR xx.g40101 != 0    then
                w_mod := 1;
            end if;
        end loop;
        if  w_mod = 1   then
            UPDATE SZX0AA tt    /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
               SET last_ymd = p_ymd -1
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr;

--    if  p_ip_user != '003'  then

--        -- 후에 자가진단 수정분개 프로그램 수정이 필요하므로

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA05000 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
) AS
-- szx0ck에 등록된 계정별 잔액을 szx1ck에 일괄생성
--
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO SZX1CK ff  
        ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
        , chk_no         /* _2- */
        , chk_gb         /* _3- */
        , fund_cd        /* _4- */
        , fund_currency  /* _5- */
        , gwamok         /* _6- */
        , ag_aek         /* _7- */
        , ip_user        /* _8- */
        , ip_ymd         /* _9- */
        )
      SELECT p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
           , '00'              /* _2- */
           , '00'              /* _3- */
           , t1.fund_cd        /* _4- */
           , t1.fund_currency  /* _5- */
           , t1.gwamok         /* _6- */
           , CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='64903'
                  THEN F_DANGJ (t1.chadae_gb,0, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek)
                  ELSE F_DANGJ (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek)
             END               /* _7- */
           , '00'              /* _8- */
           , sysdate           /* _9- */
        FROM SKM0AG t1
           , SZM0IA ia
       WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
         AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
         AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
         AND t1.gwamok        IN (SELECT gwamok
                                    FROM SZX0CK ta
                                   WHERE ta.gwamok IS NOT NULL)
         AND ia.corp_gr       = t1.corp_gr
         AND ia.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd
         AND ia.fund_currency = t1.fund_currency;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA05001 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 주식마스타 검증 처리
--
    w_sosok_gb                   sjx0jb.sosok_gb%type;
    w_balh_nm                    sjx0jb.balh_nm%type;
    w_ggijun_ga                  sjt0sc.dang_ggijun_ga%type;
    w_chk_gb                     VARCHAR(2);
    w_acct_no                    VARCHAR(40);
BEGIN
    ---------------------------------------------
    -- 상장종목  (01) => 상장주식 계정
    -- 비상장종목(03) => 비상장주식 계정
    -- 등록주식  (04) => 등록주식 계정
    -- ETF종목   (05) => ETF종목 계정
    -- 등록주식  (06) => 코넥스주식 계정
    -- 주식ETN   (07) => 주식ETN 계정
    ---------------------------------------------
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.jm_cd                                                                   /* _1- */
             , t1.danc_gb                                                                 /* _2- */
             , t1.balh_co                                                                 /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                 /* _4- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                           /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(dw_chui_aek,0)
                                            + NVL(gongs_up_chui_aek,0)
                                            - NVL(gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)),0)  AS master_aek /* _6- */
          FROM SJM0JM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.bs_type != -1
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(up_jusu,0) - NVL(dw_jusu,0) 
                                     + NVL(gongs_up_jusu,0) - NVL(gongs_dw_jusu,0)  != 0
         GROUP BY t1.jm_cd        
                , t1.danc_gb      
                , t1.balh_co      
                , t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
         ORDER BY t1.jm_cd  
                , t1.balh_co
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT CASE sosok_gb WHEN '1' THEN CASE WHEN xx.danc_gb='B' THEN '03'
                                                                        ELSE '01' END
                                 WHEN 'C' THEN CASE WHEN xx.danc_gb='B' THEN '03'
                                                                        ELSE '04' END
                                 WHEN 'D' THEN CASE WHEN xx.danc_gb='B' THEN '03'
                                                                        ELSE '06' END
                                 WHEN '2' THEN '02'  /* 상장수익증권 */
                                 WHEN '3' THEN '12'  /* 주식형ETF */
                                 WHEN '4' THEN '11'  /* ETF */
                                 WHEN '8' THEN '04'  /* 코스닥주식 */
                                 WHEN 'B' THEN '03'  /* 비상장 */
                                 WHEN 'G' THEN '12'  /* ETN도 주식형ETF/ETN 으로 분류 20200721 bjh */
                                          ELSE '**' END
                 , sosok_gb
                 , balh_nm
              INTO w_chk_gb
                 , w_sosok_gb
                 , w_balh_nm
              FROM SJX0JB t1
             WHERE t1.balh_co = xx.balh_co;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            NULL;
        END;

        if  w_sosok_gb = '**'   then
            p_msg   := xx.balh_co || ' - 소속구분을 확인하십시오';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if  SUBSTR (xx.jm_cd,1,3) != 'KRB'          then
            if  w_sosok_gb IN ('2','3') then    -- 상장수익증권/ETF 점검
                if  xx.danc_gb NOT IN ('A','C','D') then
                    INSERT INTO SZX3CK tt  
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr, '01-02 =>' || xx.balh_co || ' ' || w_balh_nm || ' 단축식별(' || xx.danc_gb
                                                   || ')과 발행기관 소속구분(' || w_sosok_gb || ')을 점검하십시오.', 250, 'szzd080' );
                end if;
            else
                if (xx.danc_gb='A' AND w_chk_gb != '01') OR (xx.danc_gb='B' AND w_chk_gb != '03') 
                     OR (xx.danc_gb = 'C' AND w_chk_gb != '04') OR (xx.danc_gb='D' AND w_chk_gb != '06') 
                     OR (xx.danc_gb='G' AND w_chk_gb != '07')   then
                    INSERT INTO SZX3CK tt  
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr, '01-02 =>' || xx.balh_co || ' ' || w_balh_nm || ' 단축식별(' || xx.danc_gb
                                                   || ')과 발행기관 소속구분(' || w_sosok_gb || ')을 점검하십시오.', 250, 'szzd080' );
                end if;
            end if;
        end if;
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '01', w_chk_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.master_aek, '01', sysdate);
    END LOOP;

    -------------------------
    -- 주식편입비율 체크
    -------------------------
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT fund_cd
             , CASE WHEN NVL(stock_rt1,0)=0 THEN NVL(stock_rt,0)
                                            ELSE NVL(stock_rt1,0) END  AS stock_rt
          FROM SKT0GI t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND CASE WHEN NVL(stock_rt1,0)=0 THEN NVL(stock_rt,0)
                                            ELSE NVL(stock_rt1,0) END > 1
    ) loop
        if  xx.stock_rt > 1 then
            INSERT INTO SZX3CK tt  
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr, '01-03 =>' || xx.fund_cd || '펀드 주식편입비율이 100%를 초과하므로 확인하십시오.', 250, 'szzd080' );
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    -- 집합투자증권/ETF 과표기준가 등록 점검
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT jm_cd
             , koscom_cd
             , F_JM_NM (p_corp_gr, jm_cd)  AS jm_nm
          FROM SJM0JM t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.balh_co IN (SELECT balh_co
                                FROM SJX0JB ta
                               WHERE ta.sosok_gb IN ('2','3','4','G'))
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT dang_ggijun_ga
              INTO w_ggijun_ga
              FROM SJT0SC t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd                     = xx.jm_cd
               AND TRUNC(NVL(ip_ymd, sysdate))  >= F_OPEN_YMD(p_ymd,'-');
        EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT close
                  INTO w_ggijun_ga
                  FROM SJT1TG t1
                 WHERE ymd       = p_ymd
                   AND koscom_cd = xx.koscom_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                w_ggijun_ga := 0;
            END;
        END;

        if NVL (w_ggijun_ga,0) = 0  then
            INSERT INTO SZX3CK tt  
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr, '01-04 =>' || xx.jm_cd || '-' || xx.jm_nm
                                           || ' 2622 상장/타사집합투자증권 종가등록을 확인하십시오.', 250, 'szzd080' );
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    -- 차입주식
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)),0) * -1  AS aek
          FROM SJM0JM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.bs_type = -1
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '01', '50', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.aek, '01', sysdate);
    END LOOP;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA05002 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
) AS
-- 채권마스타 검증 처리
--
    w_open_ymd                   DATE;
    w_ija                        NUMBER;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    w_open_ymd  := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '-');

    ----------------------------------------------------
    -- 이월취득가 + 매입취득가 - 매도취득가 +누적손익안분 => 취득가
    ----------------------------------------------------
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                         /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                   /* _2- */
             , NVL(t2.slip_attr, t2.bond_attr)                      AS slip_attr  /* _3- */
             , t2.sangj_gb                                                        /* _4- */
             , t2.bond_cd                                                         /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(meib_aek,0) - NVL(medo_aek,0)
                                            + NVL(anbun_aek,0)),0)  AS master_aek /* _6- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SCM0CJ t2
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND (NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(meib_aek,0) - NVL(medo_aek,0) + NVL(anbun_aek,0))  != 0
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd                     
                , ia.fund_currency               
                , NVL(t2.slip_attr, t2.bond_attr)
                , t2.sangj_gb                    
                , t2.bond_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.slip_attr = '1'  then    -- 국채
            if  xx.sangj_gb = 'A'   then
                    SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.master_aek, '02', sysdate);
            else    SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '02', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.master_aek, '02', sysdate);
            end if;
        elsif xx.slip_attr = '2'    then    -- 지방채
            if  xx.sangj_gb = 'A'   then
                    SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '03', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.master_aek, '02', sysdate);
            else    SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '04', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.master_aek, '02', sysdate);
            end if;
        elsif xx.slip_attr = '3'    then    -- 특수채
            if  xx.sangj_gb = 'A'   then
                    SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '05', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.master_aek, '02', sysdate);
            else    SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '06', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.master_aek, '02', sysdate);
            end if;
        elsif xx.slip_attr = '4'    then    -- 금융채
            if  xx.sangj_gb = 'A'   then
                    SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '07', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.master_aek, '02', sysdate);
            else    SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '08', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.master_aek, '02', sysdate);
            end if;
        elsif xx.slip_attr = '5'    then    -- 주식사채
            if  xx.sangj_gb = 'A'   then
                    SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '11', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.master_aek, '02', sysdate);
            else    SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '12', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.master_aek, '02', sysdate);
            end if;
        elsif xx.slip_attr = '6'    then    -- 일반사채
            if  xx.sangj_gb = 'A'       then
                SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '09', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.master_aek, '02', sysdate);
            else    SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '10', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.master_aek, '02', sysdate);
            end if;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    ----------------------------------------------------
    -- 정상 이자관련 채권마스타 내역
    ----------------------------------------------------
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                                                     /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                               /* _2- */
             , cj.jm_cd                                                                                       /* _3- */
             , cj.sangj_gb                                                                                    /* _4- */
             , cj.sunhu_gb                                                                                    /* _5- */
             , NVL(cj.pyom_iyul,0)                                                          AS pyom_iyul      /* _6- */
             , cj.budo_ymd                                                                                    /* _7- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)),0)  AS aekm           /* _8- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.misu_ija),0) + NVL(SUM(t1.pr_misu_ija),0)                         AS misu_ija       /* _9- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.sung_cost),0) + NVL(SUM(t1.pr_sung_cost),0)                       AS sung_cost      /* _10- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.yesu_tax),0) + NVL(SUM(t1.pr_yesu_tax),0)                         AS yesu_tax       /* _11- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.cbmg_misu_ija),0)                                                 AS cbmg_misu_ija  /* _12- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.cbmg_sung_cost),0)                                                AS cbmg_sung_cost /* _13- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SCM0CJ cj
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND cj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd         
                , ia.fund_currency   
                , cj.jm_cd           
                , cj.sangj_gb        
                , cj.sunhu_gb        
                , NVL(cj.pyom_iyul,0)
                , cj.budo_ymd        
         ORDER BY cj.jm_cd  
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.sangj_gb = 'A'   then
            SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '13', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.misu_ija, '02', sysdate);
            SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '15', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sung_cost, '02', sysdate);
        else
            if  xx.sunhu_gb = '1'   then
                SELECT NVL(TRUNC (SUM(ig.gugan_ija * xx.aekm)),0)
                  INTO w_ija
                  FROM SCJ0IG ig
                 WHERE ig.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND ig.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND ig.ija_gb  = 'B'
                   AND p_ymd      Between ig.bf_ija_ymd AND (ig.af_ija_ymd - 1);

                    SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '17', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, w_ija - xx.misu_ija, '02', sysdate);
            else    SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '14', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.misu_ija, '02', sysdate);
            end if;
            SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '16', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sung_cost, '02', sysdate);
        end if;

        if  xx.aekm > 0     then
            SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '22', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.cbmg_misu_ija, '02', sysdate);
        end if;
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '23', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.cbmg_sung_cost, '02', sysdate);
        -- 미수이자 0인경우 체크 hsj
        if  xx.pyom_iyul != 0 AND xx.aekm > 0 AND xx.misu_ija <= 0  then
            if  xx.budo_ymd IS NULL then
                INSERT INTO SZX3CK ff  
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr, xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.jm_cd || ' - 채권미수이자가 ' || xx.misu_ija
                                               || ' 이므로 확인하십시오.', 255, 'szzd080' );
            else
                INSERT INTO SZX3CK ff  
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr, xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.jm_cd || '(' || TO_CHAR(xx.budo_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || ') - 채권미수이자가 ' || xx.misu_ija
                                               || ' 이므로 확인하십시오.', 130, 'szzd080' );
            end if;
        end if;
--        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '18', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.yesu_tax, '02', sysdate);
    END LOOP;

    ----------------------------------------------------
    -- 선수이자
    -- 총 선수이자 금액(자가진단 확인)
    ----------------------------------------------------
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(t1.sunsu_ija - cm.suib_ija),0)  AS sunsu_ija
          FROM SCT0FS t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SCM0CM cm
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'B24'
           AND p_ymd      Between t1.tr_ymd AND (t1.af_ymd - 1)
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND cm.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND cm.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND cm.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND cm.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '17', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sunsu_ija, '02', sysdate);
    END LOOP;

    ----------------------------------------------------
    --  선매출 이자관련 선매출 채권마스타 내역
    ----------------------------------------------------
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                             /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                       /* _2- */
             , t2.sangj_gb                            /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.misu_ija),0)   AS misu_ija  /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.sung_cost),0)  AS sung_cost /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.yesu_tax),0)   AS yesu_tax  /* _6- */
          FROM SCM0SC t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SCM0CJ t2
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
                , t2.sangj_gb
    ) loop
        if  xx.sangj_gb = 'A'   then
            SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '13', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.misu_ija, '02', sysdate);
            SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '15', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sung_cost, '02', sysdate);
        else
            SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '14', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.misu_ija, '02', sysdate);
            SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '16', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sung_cost, '02', sysdate);
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    ----------------------------------------------------
    --  FRN채권 이자락 확인
    ----------------------------------------------------
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT jm_cd
             , cj_nm
             , af_ija_ymd
             , bf_ija_ymd
             , sanghw_ymd
          FROM SCM0CJ t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ydong_gb = '1'
    ) loop
        w_msg   := 'P';
        if  xx.sanghw_ymd between p_ymd AND (p_ymd + 3) then
            NULL;
        elsif (xx.af_ija_ymd=p_ymd) OR (xx.bf_ija_ymd=p_ymd)    then
            BEGIN
                SELECT 'P'
                  INTO w_msg
                  FROM SCT0IJ t1
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.chg_ymd = p_ymd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                w_msg   := xx.jm_cd || ' ' || xx.cj_nm || ' - 당일 이자수령, FRN(채권) 이율변경이 등록되지 않았습니다.';
            END;
        elsif xx.af_ija_ymd between p_ymd AND (p_ymd + 3)   then
            w_msg   := xx.jm_cd || ' ' || xx.cj_nm || ' - FRN(변동금리채권) 이자수령일이 ' || TO_CHAR(xx.af_ija_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '일입니다.';
        elsif xx.bf_ija_ymd between p_ymd AND (p_ymd + 3)   then
            w_msg   := xx.jm_cd || ' ' || xx.cj_nm || ' - FRN(변동금리채권) 이자수령일이 ' || TO_CHAR(xx.bf_ija_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '일입니다. 확인하십시오.';
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'P'    then
            INSERT INTO SZX3CK ff  
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr, w_msg, 16711680, 'szzd080' );
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    ----------------------------------------------------
    --  유보원금
    ----------------------------------------------------
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='12049' THEN '39'
                                           ELSE '38' END  AS chk_gb
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(jan_aek,0)),0)                 AS wongm
          FROM SCT1CG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.sanghw_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
                , CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='12049' THEN '39'
                                              ELSE '38' END
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', xx.chk_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.wongm, '02', sysdate);
    END LOOP;

    -------------------------------------------------------------
    --  전환권행사(F51)시 단주대금 미수령분(20200731 psNa)
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(ija_sudo_aek,0)),0)  AS aek
          FROM SCT0CG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd                     NOT IN (SELECT tt.jm_cd
                                                      FROM SCT1CG tt
                                                     WHERE tt.corp_gr         = t1.corp_gr
                                                       AND tt.fund_cd         = t1.fund_cd
                                                       AND tt.jm_cd           = t1.jm_cd
                                                       AND NVL(tt.sanghw_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  > p_ymd
                                                       AND NVL(tt.jan_aek,0)  > 0)
           AND NVL(t1.ija_sudo_ymd, p_ymd)  > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        if  p_corp_gr = '1901' AND xx.fund_cd = '190080' AND xx.aek = 7344262   then
            -- 벨레포크 20.3.14일 상환시 이자일부 미수입금처리 한 내역임
            xx.aek  := 0;
        end if;
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '39', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.aek, '02', sysdate);
    END LOOP;

    -------------------------
    -- 채권편입비율 체크
    -------------------------
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT fund_cd
             , fund_currency
             , bond_rt
          FROM SKT0GI t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.bond_rt > 1
    ) loop
        if  xx.bond_rt > 1  then
            INSERT INTO SZX3CK ff  
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr, xx.fund_cd || '펀드 채권편입비율이 100%를 초과하므로 확인하십시오.', 250, 'szzd080' );
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    -------------------------
    -- 손익안분액 점검
    -------------------------
    FOR rd IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t1.jm_cd
             , F_JM_NM (p_corp_gr, t1.jm_cd)  AS jm_nm
          FROM SCM0CM t1
             , SCM0CM t2
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)  > 0
           AND abs((t1.day_anbun_aek / (NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)))
                                     - (t2.day_anbun_aek / (NVL(t2.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t2.meib_aekm,0) + NVL(t2.medo_aekm,0))))  > 0.5
           AND t2.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.ymd      = p_ymd - 1
           AND t2.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
           AND t2.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
           AND NVL(t2.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t2.meib_aekm,0) + NVL(t2.medo_aekm,0)  > 0
           AND t2.buy_date = t1.buy_date
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO SZX3CK ff  
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr, rd.jm_cd || ',' || rd.jm_nm
                                     || ' - 손익안분액 전일대비 증감을 확인하십시오.', 250, 'szzd080' );
    END LOOP;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA05003 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
) AS
-- 현금마스타 검증 처리
--
    w_balh_ymd                   DATE;
BEGIN
    -- 현금마스타
    for xx IN (
        select t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , CASE hj.cash_cd WHEN '10' THEN '06'
                               WHEN '20' THEN '07'
                               WHEN '50' THEN '04'
                               WHEN '70' THEN '03'
                               WHEN '71' THEN '03'
                               WHEN '72' THEN '03'
                               WHEN '80' THEN '02'
                               WHEN 'AA' THEN '15'
                               WHEN 'DC' THEN '05'
                               WHEN 'ZS' THEN '20'
                               WHEN 'ZF' THEN '40'
                                         ELSE hj.cash_cd END               AS chk_gb
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(bfil_chui_aek, 0) + NVL(meib_aek, 0) - NVL(medo_aek, 0)
                                             + NVL(anbun_aek, 0)), 0)      AS master_aek
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_misu_ija, 0) + NVL(t1.day_ija, 0)), 0)  AS ija
          from SHM0HM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SHM0HJ hj
         where t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           and t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           and ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           and hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and hj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           and hj.cash_cd != '90'
           and (NVL(bfil_chui_aek, 0) + NVL(meib_aek, 0) - NVL(medo_aek, 0) + NVL(anbun_aek, 0))  > 0
         group BY t1.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
                , CASE hj.cash_cd WHEN '10' THEN '06'
                                  WHEN '20' THEN '07'
                                  WHEN '50' THEN '04'
                                  WHEN '70' THEN '03'
                                  WHEN '71' THEN '03'
                                  WHEN '72' THEN '03'
                                  WHEN '80' THEN '02'
                                  WHEN 'AA' THEN '15'
                                  WHEN 'DC' THEN '05'
                                  WHEN 'ZS' THEN '20'
                                  WHEN 'ZF' THEN '40'
                                            ELSE hj.cash_cd END
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', xx.chk_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.master_aek, '03', sysdate);
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        select t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , t1.jm_cd
             , hj.balh_ymd
             , t1.meib_aek
          from SHM0HM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SHM0HJ hj
         where t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           and t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           and ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           and hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and hj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           and hj.cash_cd = '90'
           and p_ymd      Between hj.balh_ymd And (hj.sanghw_ymd - 1)
    ) loop
        SELECT MAX(balh_ymd)
          INTO w_balh_ymd
          FROM SHM0HJ hj
         WHERE hj.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND hj.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;

        -- 현재예금 이자구간이 아닌경우는 이자만
        if  xx.balh_ymd = w_balh_ymd    then    SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.meib_aek, '03', sysdate);
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 미수이자/선납세
    for xx IN (
        select t1.fund_cd                                                                 /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                           /* _2- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.misu_ija), 0)                                     AS misu_ija   /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.sung_cost), 0)                                    AS sung_cost  /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.susu_ga, 0) - NVL(t1.bfil_susu_ga, 0)
                                          - NVL(t1.day_susu_ga, 0)
                                          + NVL(t1.susu_09900, 0)
                                          - NVL(t1.bfil_susu_09900, 0)
                                          - NVL(t1.day_susu_09900, 0)), 0)  AS mi_susu    /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.sunn_tax), 0)                                     AS sunn_tax   /* _6- */
             , NVL(SUM(trunc(t1.yesu_tax, -1)), 0)                          AS yesu_tax   /* _7- */
          from SHM0HM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SHM0HJ hj
         where t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           and t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           and ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           and hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and hj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           and hj.cash_cd NOT IN ('AA','DC','ZS','ZF')
         group BY t1.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', '17', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.mi_susu, '03', sysdate);      -- 311라인에 03-17과 합산하여 계산함
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', '13', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sung_cost + xx.mi_susu, '03', sysdate);
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', '12', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.misu_ija, '03', sysdate);
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '02', '18', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.yesu_tax, '03', sysdate);
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        select fund_cd
             , fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(aek_sun_ija,0)), 0)  AS aek_sun_ija
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(aek_hu_ija,0)), 0)   AS aek_hu_ija
         from (select t1.fund_cd
                    , ia.fund_currency
                    , trunc(NVL(bfil_sunsu_ija, 0) + NVL(up_sunsu_ija, 0) - NVL(dw_sunsu_ija, 0))  AS aek_sun_ija
                    , NVL(misu_ija,0)                                                              AS aek_hu_ija
                 from SHM0HM t1
                    , SZM0IA ia
                    , SHM0HJ hj
                where t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                  and t1.ymd     = p_ymd
                  and ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
                  and ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                  and hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
                  and hj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
                  and hj.cash_cd = 'DC'
               )  t1
         group BY fund_cd
                , fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', '10', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.aek_sun_ija, '03', sysdate);
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', '09', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.aek_hu_ija, '03', sysdate);
    end loop;

    -- 대출채권선급비용
    for xx IN (
        select t1.fund_cd
             , t1.jm_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , ig.bf_ija_ymd
             , ig.other_cost
          from SHM0HM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SHJ0IG ig
         where t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           and t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           and ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           and ig.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and ig.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           and p_ymd      Between ig.bf_ija_ymd And (ig.af_ija_ymd - 1)
           and other_cost > 0
    ) loop
        SELECT xx.other_cost - NVL(SUM(aek), 0)
          INTO xx.other_cost
          FROM SKT0BU t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  Between xx.bf_ija_ymd And p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'P11'
           AND t1.work_gb = 'A'
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.gwamok  = '12262'
           AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb = '1'
           AND t1.seq_no  = 4;

        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', '11', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.other_cost, '03', sysdate);
    end loop;
    -- 지분(사업)증권미수이자
    for xx IN (
        select t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(misu_ija), 0)  AS ija
          from SHM0HM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SHM0HJ hj
         where t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           and t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           and ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           and hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and hj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           and hj.cash_cd = 'AA'
         group BY t1.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', '16', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.ija, '03', sysdate);
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        select t1.fund_cd                                         /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                   /* _2- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.misu_ija), 0)             AS misu_ija   /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.sung_cost), 0)            AS sung_cost  /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.sunn_tax), 0)             AS sunn_tax   /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(trunc(t1.yesu_tax, -1)), 0)  AS yesu_tax   /* _6- */
          from SHM0HM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SHM0HJ hj
         where t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           and t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           and ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           and hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and hj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           and hj.cash_cd IN ('ZS')
         group BY t1.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', '21', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.misu_ija, '03', sysdate);
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', '22', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sung_cost, '03', sysdate);
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', '23', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.yesu_tax, '03', sysdate);
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        select t1.fund_cd                                         /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                   /* _2- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.misu_ija), 0)             AS misu_ija   /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.sung_cost), 0)            AS sung_cost  /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.sunn_tax), 0)             AS sunn_tax   /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(trunc(t1.yesu_tax, -1)), 0)  AS yesu_tax   /* _6- */
          from SHM0HM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SHM0HJ hj
         where t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           and t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           and ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           and hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and hj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           and hj.cash_cd IN ('ZF')
         group BY t1.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', '41', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.misu_ija, '03', sysdate);
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', '42', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sung_cost, '03', sysdate);
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', '23', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.yesu_tax, '03', sysdate);
    end loop;

    -- 현금이자 미수령(유예)금액 (#2206화면 / 12032 계정)
    for xx IN (
        select t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , SUM(NVL(t1.JAN_AEK,0))  AS aek
          from SHT1HG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         where t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           and t1.tr_ymd                <= p_ymd
           and t1.gwamok                NOT IN ('14905','14906','14909','12161')  /* 부가세/대출채권미수입금 제외 */
           and SUBSTR(t1.gwamok, 1, 1)  = '1'                                     /* 미수입금만 */
           and ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           and ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
         group BY t1.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', '24', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.aek, '03', sysdate);
    end loop;

    -- 대출채권이자 미수령(유예)금액 (#????화면 / 12027 계정)
    for xx IN (
        select t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , SUM(NVL(t1.JAN_AEK,0))  AS aek
          from SHT1HG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         where t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           and t1.tr_ymd  <= p_ymd
           and t1.gwamok  IN ('12161')  /* 부가세/대출채권미수입금 제외 */
           and ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         group BY t1.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '03', '32', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.aek, '03', sysdate);
    end loop;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA05004 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
) AS
-- 주식 수도결제마스타 검증 처리
--
BEGIN
    -- 주식 미수입금
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(gyulje_aek),0)  AS gyulje_aek
          FROM SKT0SD t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd    LIKE 'K2%'
           AND t1.tr_cd    != 'K2A'
           AND t1.tr_ymd   <= p_ymd
           AND t1.sudo_ymd > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '04', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_aek, '04', sysdate);
    END LOOP;

    -- 주식 미지급금
    FOR r2 IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(gyulje_aek),0)  AS miji_aek
          FROM SKT0SD t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd    != 'J2A'
           AND (t1.tr_cd LIKE 'J2%' OR t1.tr_cd='F21')
           AND t1.tr_ymd   <= p_ymd
           AND t1.sudo_ymd > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '04', '02', r2.fund_cd, r2.fund_currency, r2.miji_aek, '04', sysdate);
    END LOOP;

    -- ETF 미수입금
    FOR r3 IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(gyulje_aek),0)  AS gyulje_aek
          FROM SKT0SD t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd    = 'K2A'
           AND t1.tr_ymd   <= p_ymd
           AND t1.sudo_ymd > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SELECT r3.gyulje_aek + NVL(MAX(t1.etf_cash_hwakj - t1.etf_cash_aek),0)
          INTO r3.gyulje_aek
          FROM SJT0JG t1
             , SZM0IA t2
             , SJM0JJ jj
             , SJX0JB jb
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd                = r3.fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_cd                  = 'J2E'
           AND t1.sudo_ymd               = p_ymd
           AND t1.etf_hwakj_ymd          = F_TRADE_YMD(p_ymd,'-1')
           AND t2.corp_gr                = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd                = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
           AND jj.jm_cd                  = t1.etf_jm_cd
           AND jb.balh_co                = jj.balh_co;

        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '04', '03', r3.fund_cd, r3.fund_currency, r3.gyulje_aek, '04', sysdate);
    END LOOP;

    -- ETF 미지급금
    FOR r4 IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(gyulje_aek),0)  AS gyulje_aek
          FROM SKT0SD t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd    = 'J2A'
           AND t1.tr_ymd   <= p_ymd
           AND t1.sudo_ymd > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SELECT r4.gyulje_aek + NVL(MAX(t1.etf_cash_hwakj - t1.etf_cash_aek),0)
          INTO r4.gyulje_aek
          FROM SJT0JG t1
             , SZM0IA t2
             , SJM0JJ jj
             , SJX0JB jb
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd                = r4.fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_cd                  = 'K2E'
           AND t1.sudo_ymd               = p_ymd
           AND t1.etf_hwakj_ymd          = F_OPEN_YMD(p_ymd,'-1')
           AND t2.corp_gr                = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd                = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
           AND jj.jm_cd                  = t1.etf_jm_cd
           AND jb.balh_co                = jj.balh_co;

        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '04', '04', r4.fund_cd, r4.fund_currency, r4.gyulje_aek, '04', sysdate);
    END LOOP;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA05005 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
) AS
-- 채권수도결제마스타 검증 처리
--
BEGIN
    -- 채권 미수입금
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(tr_aek,0) - NVL(susu,0)),0)  AS gyulje_aek
          FROM SCT0CG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd    = 'K11'
           AND t1.tr_ymd   <= p_ymd
           AND t1.sudo_ymd > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '05', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_aek, '05', sysdate);
    END LOOP;

    -- 채권 미지급금
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(tr_aek,0) + NVL(susu,0)),0)  AS gyulje_aek
          FROM SCT0CG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd    = 'J14'
           AND t1.tr_ymd   <= p_ymd
           AND t1.sudo_ymd > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '05', '02', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_aek, '05', sysdate);
    END LOOP;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA05008 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
) AS
-- 미지급 주식납입금마스타 검증 처리
--
BEGIN
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN sury_ymd IS NULL
                            THEN chui_aek
                            ELSE NVL(sury_jusu,0) * NVL(balh_ga,0) END),0)  AS chui_aek
          FROM SJT0J1 t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd        <= p_ymd
           AND t1.jeungj_mth = '1'
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
           AND (cheng_ymd > p_ymd OR cheng_ymd IS NULL)  /* (신주인수권 상장폐지후 유상주 청약기간 동안 미지급주식납입금이 안잡히는 문제) */
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '08', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.chui_aek, '08', sysdate);
    END LOOP;

    -------------------------
    -- 유상증자 청약일 확인
    -------------------------
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t2.balh_co              /* _1- */
             , t3.balh_nm                       /* _2- */
             , t1.cheng_ymd                     /* _3- */
             , CASE WHEN t1.tr_cd IN ('G31','G32')
                    THEN '유상증자'
                    ELSE '무상증자' END  AS nm  /* _4- */
          FROM SJT0JK t1
             , SJT0J1 t2
             , SJX0JB t3
         WHERE t1.tr_ymd    > (p_ymd - 90)
           AND t1.cheng_ymd >= p_ymd
           AND t2.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND t2.ymd       = t1.krak_ymd
           AND t2.balh_co   = t1.balh_co
           AND t3.balh_co   = t1.balh_co
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO SZX3CK ff  
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr, xx.balh_co || '-' || xx.balh_nm || ',' || xx.nm
                                       || ' 청약일(' || xx.cheng_ymd || ')', 8421376, 'szzd080' );
    END LOOP;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA05009 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
) AS
-- 공모청약마스타/위탁증거금마스타 검증처리
--
BEGIN
    -- 공모청약
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(t1.cheng_aek, 0) + NVL(t1.susu, 0)  AS cheng_aek
          FROM SJT0CY t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr              = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd || t1.jm_cd  NOT IN (SELECT ta.fund_cd || ta.jm_cd
                                                 FROM SJT0FS ta
                                                WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                                  AND ta.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                                                  AND ta.tr_cd   = 'F47'
                                                  AND ta.tr_ymd  >= t1.tr_ymd)
           AND t1.tr_cd                = 'F46'
           AND t1.tr_ymd               Between p_ymd - 60 And p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.sury_ymd,p_ymd)  = p_ymd
           AND t1.cheng_type           = '1'
           AND ia.corp_gr              = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd              = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '09', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.cheng_aek, '09', sysdate);
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT fund_cd
             , fund_currency
             , jm_cd
             , SUM(aek_f47)  AS aek_f47
             , SUM(aek_f49)  AS aek_f49
          FROM (SELECT t1.fund_cd
                     , ia.fund_currency
                     , t1.jm_cd
                     , t1.chui_aek  AS aek_f47
                     , 0            AS aek_f49
                  FROM SJT0FS t1
                     , SZM0IA ia
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'F47'
                   AND t1.tr_ymd                Between p_ymd - 60 And p_ymd
                   AND t1.CY_TYPE               = '3'
                   AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
                   AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
                UNION ALL
                SELECT t1.fund_cd
                     , ia.fund_currency
                     , t1.jm_cd
                     , 0
                     , t1.chui_aek
                  FROM SJT0FS t1
                     , SZM0IA ia
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'F49'
                   AND t1.tr_ymd                Between p_ymd - 60 And p_ymd
                   AND t1.CY_TYPE               = '3'
                   AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
                   AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
                ) t1 
        HAVING SUM(aek_f47)- SUM(aek_f49) > 0
         GROUP BY fund_cd, fund_currency, jm_cd
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '09', '04', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.aek_f47, '09', sysdate);
    end loop;

    -- 공개매수청구권행사  (장외거래세 반영-세후)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , trunc(t1.cheng_aek * (1 - gr.sebu_num))  AS cheng_aek
          FROM SJT0CY t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SJM0JJ jj
             , SZX0GR gr
         WHERE t1.corp_gr             = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd || t1.jm_cd NOT IN (SELECT ta.fund_cd || ta.jm_cd
                                                FROM SJT0FS ta
                                               WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                                 AND ta.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                                                 AND ta.tr_cd   = 'F16'
                                                 AND ta.tr_ymd  >= t1.tr_ymd)
           AND t1.tr_cd               = 'F65'
           AND t1.tr_ymd              Between  (p_ymd - 90)  And p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr             = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd             = t1.fund_cd
           AND jj.jm_cd               = t1.jm_cd
           AND gr.gr_cd               = '95'
           AND gr.sebu_cd             = '02'
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '09', '03', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.cheng_aek, '09', sysdate);
    end loop;

    -- 공개매수확정(장외거래세 반영-세후)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , trunc(cy.cheng_aek * (1 - gr.sebu_num))  AS cheng_aek
          FROM SJT0FS t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SJT0CY cy
             , SZX0GR gr
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'F42'
           AND t1.tr_ymd  Between  (p_ymd - 90)  And p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND cy.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND cy.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND cy.tr_cd   = 'F41'
           AND NVL(cy.sury_ymd,p_ymd + 1)  > p_ymd
           AND cy.tr_ymd  > t1.tr_ymd - 60
           AND cy.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND gr.gr_cd   = '95'
           AND gr.sebu_cd = '02'
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '09', '03', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.cheng_aek, '09', sysdate);
    end loop;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA05010 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
) AS
-- 설정/해지 마스타 검증처리
--
    w_03_jwa                     NUMBER;

    w_fund_currency              VARCHAR(3);
BEGIN
    -- 계약잔액
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.FUND_CD
             , ia.FUND_CURRENCY
             , t1.WONBON_AEK
          FROM SZT0IO t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = (SELECT MAX(TR_YMD)
                               FROM SZT0IO ta
                              WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                AND ta.tr_ymd  <= p_ymd
                                AND ta.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd)
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '10', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.WONBON_AEK, '10', sysdate);
    END LOOP;
    commit;
END;
