CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA05012 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
 ) AS
-- 미수배당금 검증 처리
--
    w_misu_baed_aek                NUMBER;
    w_jusu                         NUMBER;
BEGIN
    -- 마스타 미수배당금과 점검
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(t1.misu_baed_aek),0)  AS aek
             , CASE WHEN t2.sosok_gb='C' THEN '04'
                                         ELSE '01'
               END                           AS chk_gb
          FROM SJM0JM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SJX0JB t2
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND t2.balh_co = t1.balh_co
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
                , CASE WHEN t2.sosok_gb='C' THEN '04'
                                            ELSE '01' END
        HAVING NVL (SUM(t1.misu_baed_aek),0) > 0
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '12', xx.chk_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.aek, '12', sysdate );
    end loop;

    -- 펀드별 배정내역과 마스타금액 점검
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , t1.balh_co
             , t2.balh_nm
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(t1.juchong_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
                            THEN CASE WHEN NVL(t1.hwakj_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
                                      THEN t1.yesa_aek - NVL(t1.yesa_tax,0)
                                      ELSE t1.hwakj_aek - NVL(t1.hwakj_tax,0) END
                            ELSE t1.juchong_aek END),0)  AS aek
          FROM SJT0BM t1
             , SJX0JB t2
             , SZM0IA t3
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr                  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                      <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.del_yn,'2')          = '2'
           AND NVL(t1.sury_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND t1.new_jm_cd                = t1.old_jm_cd
           AND t2.balh_co                  = t1.balh_co
           AND  (t3.haeji_ymd IS NULL OR t3.haeji_ymd > p_ymd)
           AND t3.corp_gr                  = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.fund_cd                  = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.balh_co
                , t2.balh_nm
    ) loop
        SELECT NVL(SUM(misu_baed_aek),0)
          INTO w_misu_baed_aek
          FROM SJM0JM t1
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND ymd        = p_ymd
           AND balh_co    = xx.balh_co
           AND fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd;

        if  xx.aek != w_misu_baed_aek   then
            INSERT INTO SZX3CK ff  
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                                    /* _1- */
                   , '12-01 =>' || xx.balh_co || '_' || xx.balh_nm || '-' || xx.fund_cd
                                || ' 주식원장배당금(' || F_NTRIM(w_misu_baed_aek) || ')과'
                                || ' 배당내역배당금(' || F_NTRIM(xx.aek) || ')이 서로 다릅니다.'  /* _2- */
                   , 255                                                                          /* _3- */
                   , 'szzd080'                                                                    /* _4- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 미수배당주 Check
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , t1.new_jm_cd
             , t2.jj_nm
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(t1.juchong_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
                            THEN CASE WHEN NVL(t1.hwakj_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
                                      THEN t1.yesa_jusu
                                      ELSE t1.hwakj_jusu END
                            ELSE t1.juchong_jusu END),0)  AS jusu
          FROM SJT0BM t1
               LEFT OUTER JOIN SJM0JJ t2
                            ON t2.jm_cd = t1.new_jm_cd
             , SZM0IA t3
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.del_yn,'2')           = '2'
           AND NVL(t1.sury_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  > p_ymd
           AND t1.new_jm_cd                 != t1.old_jm_cd
           AND NVL(t3.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND t3.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.new_jm_cd
                , t2.jj_nm
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(up_jusu,0) - NVL(dw_jusu,0)
                                         + NVL(gongs_up_jusu,0) - NVL(gongs_dw_jusu,0)
              INTO w_jusu
              FROM SJM0JM t1
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND ymd        = p_ymd
               AND fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd      = xx.new_jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                w_jusu := 0;
        END;
        if  xx.jusu != w_jusu   then
            INSERT INTO SZX3CK ff  
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                            /* _1- */
                   , '12-02 =>' || xx.new_jm_cd || ' ' || xx.jj_nm || '-' || xx.fund_cd
                                || ' 주식원장수량 : ' || F_NTRIM(w_jusu) || '주 배당내역수량 : ' || F_NTRIM(xx.jusu)
                                || '주로 서로 다릅니다.'  /* _2- */
                   , 255                                  /* _3- */
                   , 'szzd080'                            /* _4- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 배당일자 Check
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t1.ymd
             , t1.old_jm_cd
             , t2.jj_nm
          FROM SJT0BM t1
               LEFT OUTER JOIN SJM0JJ t2
                            ON t2.jm_cd = t1.old_jm_cd
             , SZM0IA t3
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND ADD_MONTHS(t1.ymd,4)         < p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.del_yn,'2')           = '2'
           AND NVL(t1.sury_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  > p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.hwakj_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.hwakj_aek,0) + NVL(t1.juchong_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.juchong_aek,0) != 0
           AND NVL(t3.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND t3.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO SZX3CK ff  
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                                                 /* _1- */
               , '12-03 =>' || xx.old_jm_cd || ' ' || xx.jj_nm || ' _ 예상배당일이 '
                            || TO_CHAR(xx.ymd, 'yyyy"년" mm"월" dd"일"') || '로 4개월이 경과 되었습니다.'  /* _2- */
               , 255                                                                                       /* _3- */
               , 'szzd080'                                                                                 /* _4- */
               );
    end loop;

    -- 확정일자 Check
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t1.ymd
             , t1.old_jm_cd
             , t2.jj_nm
             , t1.hwakj_ymd
          FROM SJT0BM t1
               LEFT OUTER JOIN SJM0JJ t2
                            ON t2.jm_cd = t1.old_jm_cd
             , SZM0IA t3
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.del_yn,'2')           = '2'
           AND NVL(t1.sury_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  > p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.hwakj_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.hwakj_aek,0) + NVL(t1.juchong_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.juchong_aek,0) != 0
           AND NVL(t3.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND t3.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND ADD_MONTHS(NVL(t1.juchong_ymd, t1.hwakj_ymd),2) < p_ymd
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO SZX3CK ff  
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                                                     /* _1- */
               , '12-04 =>' || xx.old_jm_cd || ' ' || xx.jj_nm || '(' || TO_CHAR(xx.ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || ') _ 배당금 확정일이 '
                            || TO_CHAR(xx.hwakj_ymd, 'yyyy"년"mm"월"dd"일"') || '로 2개월이 경과 되었습니다.'  /* _2- */
               , 32760                                                                                         /* _3- */
               , 'szzd080'                                                                                     /* _4- */
               );
    end loop;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA05017 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
 ) AS
-- 수익증권마스타 검증 처리 (해외제외)
--
BEGIN
    -- 내부 수익증권
    for xx IN (
        SELECT sm.fund_cd
             , t1.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type_gb IN ('0','1','2')
                            THEN NVL(sm.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(sm.up_aek,0) - NVL(sm.dw_aek,0) - NVL(sm.gyul_aek,0)
                       END), 0)  AS sm_1_aek
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type_gb IN ('3','4','5','7','9')
                            THEN NVL(sm.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(sm.up_aek,0) - NVL(sm.dw_aek,0) - NVL(sm.gyul_aek,0)
                                                                       + CASE WHEN t1.af_gyul_ymd=sm.ymd OR t1.bf_gyul_ymd=sm.ymd
                                                                              THEN NVL(sm.sonik,0)
                                                                              ELSE 0 END
                       END), 0)  AS sm_2_aek
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJM0SM sm  /* (모자 / Multi Class) 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND sm.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND sm.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND sm.mo_fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY sm.fund_cd
                , t1.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '17', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sm_1_aek, '17' || '-01', sysdate);
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '17', '02', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sm_2_aek, '17' || '-02', sysdate);
    end loop;

    -- 타사수익증권
    for xx IN (
        SELECT sm.fund_cd                                                                                        /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                  /* _2- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type_gb IN ('0','1','2')
                            THEN NVL(sm.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(sm.up_aek,0) - NVL(sm.dw_aek,0) END), 0)  AS sm_1_aek  /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type_gb IN ('3','4','5','9')
                            THEN NVL(sm.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(sm.up_aek,0) - NVL(sm.dw_aek,0) END), 0)  AS sm_2_aek  /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type_gb='7'
                            THEN NVL(sm.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(sm.up_aek,0) - NVL(sm.dw_aek,0) END), 0)  AS sm_7_aek  /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type_gb='8'
                            THEN NVL(sm.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(sm.up_aek,0) - NVL(sm.dw_aek,0) END), 0)  AS sm_8_aek  /* _6- */
          FROM SJM0SC t1  /* 타사집합투자증권 정보 */
             , SJM5SM sm  /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND sm.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND sm.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND sm.tasa_jm_cd = t1.tasa_jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = sm.fund_cd
         GROUP BY sm.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        -- 주식형으로
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '17', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sm_1_aek, '17' || '-03', sysdate);
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '17', '02', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sm_2_aek, '17' || '-04', sysdate);
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '17', '07', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sm_7_aek, '17' || '-03', sysdate);
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '17', '08', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sm_8_aek, '17' || '-04', sysdate);
    end loop;

    -- 타사수익증권
    -- 익일 기준가적용 수익증권
    for xx IN (
        SELECT sg.fund_cd                                         /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                   /* _2- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type_gb IN ('0','1','2')
                            THEN sg.tr_aek END), 0)  AS sm_1_aek  /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type_gb IN ('3','4','5','9')
                            THEN sg.tr_aek END), 0)  AS sm_2_aek  /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type_gb='7'
                            THEN sg.tr_aek END), 0)  AS sm_7_aek  /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type_gb='8'
                            THEN sg.tr_aek END), 0)  AS sm_8_aek  /* _6- */
          FROM SJM0SC t1  /* 타사집합투자증권 정보 */
             , SJT5SG sg  /* 타사집합투자증권 매매내역 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND sg.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
           AND sg.tr_ymd      <= p_ymd
           AND sg.gijunga_ymd > p_ymd
           AND sg.tasa_jm_cd  = t1.tasa_jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd     = sg.fund_cd
         GROUP BY sg.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '17', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sm_1_aek, '17' || '-05', sysdate);
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '17', '02', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sm_2_aek, '17' || '-06', sysdate);
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '17', '07', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sm_7_aek, '17' || '-05', sysdate);
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '17', '08', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sm_8_aek, '17' || '-06', sysdate);
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT tt.fund_cd
             , tt.tr_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(tt.aek), 0)  AS aek
          FROM (SELECT ta.fund_cd
                     , SUBSTR (ta.tr_cd, 1)  AS tr_cd
                     , ta.tr_aek             AS aek
                  FROM SJT0SG ta  /* 집합투자증권 매매내역 */
                 WHERE ta.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND ta.tr_ymd   <= p_ymd
                   AND ta.sudo_ymd > p_ymd
                UNION ALL
                SELECT ta.fund_cd
                     , SUBSTR (ta.tr_cd, 1, 1)
                     , ta.tr_aek
                  FROM SJT5SG ta  /* 타사집합투자증권 매매내역 */
                 WHERE ta.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND ta.tr_ymd   <= p_ymd
                   AND ta.sudo_ymd > p_ymd
                 ) tt
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE ia.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = tt.fund_cd
         GROUP BY tt.fund_cd
                , tt.tr_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_cd LIKE 'K%'  then
                SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '17', '03', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.aek, '17' || '-07', sysdate);
        ELSE    SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '17', '04', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.aek, '17' || '-08', sysdate);
        end if;
    end loop;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA05018 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
) AS
-- 선물 마스타 검증 처리
--
    w_jan                        NUMBER;
BEGIN
    --
    -- 매입콜(3)/풋(5)옵션 계정  => 11201/11202
    --
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , t1.sm_tr_gb
             , F_ROUND (SUM(NVL(t1.pass_chui_ga,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_ga,0)
                                                   - NVL(t1.dw_chui_ga,0)), ia.fund_currency)  AS master_aek
          FROM SSM0KM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.sm_tr_gb IN ('3','5')
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(up_gyey_su,0) - NVL(dw_gyey_su,0)  != 0
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
                , t1.sm_tr_gb
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '18', '0' || xx.sm_tr_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.master_aek, 'JA05018', sysdate);
    END LOOP;

    --
    -- 매도콜(4)/풋(6)옵션 계정  => 21501/21502
    --
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , t1.sm_tr_gb
             , F_ROUND (SUM(NVL(t1.pass_chui_ga,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_ga,0)
                                                   - NVL(t1.dw_chui_ga,0)), ia.fund_currency)  AS master_aek
          FROM SSM0KM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.sm_tr_gb IN ('4','6')
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(up_gyey_su,0) - NVL(dw_gyey_su,0)  != 0
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
                , t1.sm_tr_gb
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '18', '0' || xx.sm_tr_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.master_aek, 'JA05018', sysdate);
    END LOOP;

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT koscom_cd  AS sj_cd
          FROM SJT1TG t1
         WHERE t1.ymd   = p_ymd
           AND t1.close != t1.preclose
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO SZX3CK ff  
          SELECT p_corp_gr
               , xx.sj_cd || ',' || fund_cd
                          || '-선물평가 손익이 0입니다. 선물평가를 다시하십시오.'
               , 25
               , 'szzd080'
            FROM SSM0KM t1
           WHERE t1.corp_gr           = p_corp_gr
             AND t1.ymd               = p_ymd
             AND t1.sj_cd             = xx.sj_cd
             AND NVL(pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(up_gyey_su,0) - NVL(dw_gyey_su,0)  > 0
             AND NVL(pyunga_sonik,0)  = 0;
    END LOOP;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA05019 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
) AS
-- 선물 수도 결제 check
--
BEGIN
    -------------------------------
    --  선물 미수입금 10903      --
    -------------------------------
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(sudo_aek),0)  AS misu_aek
          FROM (SELECT ta.fund_cd
                     , ta.sj_cd
                     , F_ROUND (SUM(ta.sudo_aek), ia.fund_currency)  AS sudo_aek
                  FROM SST0KS ta
                     , SZM0IA ia
                 WHERE ta.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND ta.tr_ymd      <= p_ymd
                   AND ta.sudo_ymd    > p_ymd
                   AND ta.tr_sonik_gb = '1'
                   AND REGEXP_LIKE (ta.tr_cd,'^[S][12]|S65')
                   AND ia.corp_gr     = ta.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd     = ta.fund_cd
                 GROUP BY ta.fund_cd , ta.tr_cd        , ta.sj_cd
                        , ta.currency, ia.fund_currency) t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE ia.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '19', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                   xx.misu_aek, 'JA05019', sysdate);
    END LOOP;

    -------------------------------
    --  선물 미지급금 20203      --
    -------------------------------
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(sudo_aek),0)  AS miji_aek
          FROM (SELECT ta.fund_cd
                     , ta.sj_cd
                     , F_ROUND (SUM(ta.sudo_aek), ia.fund_currency)  AS sudo_aek
                  FROM SST0KS ta
                     , SZM0IA ia
                 WHERE ta.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND ta.tr_ymd      <= p_ymd
                   AND ta.sudo_ymd    > p_ymd
                   AND ta.tr_sonik_gb = '2'
                   AND REGEXP_LIKE (ta.tr_cd,'^[S][12]|S65')
                   AND ia.corp_gr     = ta.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd     = ta.fund_cd
                 GROUP BY ta.fund_cd , ta.tr_cd        , ta.sj_cd
                        , ta.currency, ia.fund_currency) t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE ia.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '19', '02', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                   xx.miji_aek, 'JA05019', sysdate);
    END LOOP;

    -------------------------------
    --  옵션 미수입금 10908      --
    -------------------------------
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(sudo_aek),0)  AS misu_aek
          FROM (SELECT ta.fund_cd
                     , ta.sj_cd
                     , F_ROUND (SUM(ta.sudo_aek), ia.fund_currency)  AS sudo_aek
                  FROM SST0KS ta
                     , SZM0IA ia
                 WHERE ta.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND ta.tr_ymd      <= p_ymd
                   AND ta.sudo_ymd    > p_ymd
                   AND ta.tr_sonik_gb = '1'
                   AND REGEXP_LIKE (ta.tr_cd,'^[S][789A]')
                   AND ia.corp_gr     = ta.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd     = ta.fund_cd
                 GROUP BY ta.fund_cd , ta.tr_cd        , ta.sj_cd
                        , ta.currency, ia.fund_currency) t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE ia.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '19', '03', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                   xx.misu_aek, 'JA05019', sysdate);
    END LOOP;

    -------------------------------
    --  옵션 미지급금 20207      --
    -------------------------------
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(t1.sudo_aek),0)  AS miji_aek
          FROM (SELECT ta.fund_cd
                     , ta.sj_cd
                     , F_ROUND (SUM(ta.sudo_aek), ia.fund_currency)  AS sudo_aek
                  FROM SST0KS ta
                     , SZM0IA ia
                 WHERE ta.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND ta.tr_ymd      <= p_ymd
                   AND ta.sudo_ymd    > p_ymd
                   AND ta.tr_sonik_gb = '2'
                   AND REGEXP_LIKE (ta.tr_cd,'^[S][789A]')
                   AND ia.corp_gr     = ta.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd     = ta.fund_cd
                 GROUP BY ta.fund_cd , ta.tr_cd        , ta.sj_cd
                        , ta.currency, ia.fund_currency) t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE ia.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZX1CK (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, '19', '04', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                   xx.miji_aek, 'JA05019', sysdate);
    END LOOP;
    commit;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA05099 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
) AS
-- 상위계정 점검
--
    w_cnt                        NUMBER := 0;

    p_rt_key                     VARCHAR(50);
BEGIN
    commit;
    p_rt_key    := p_corp_gr || TO_CHAR(seq_bss.nextval);

    INSERT INTO GZZX1RT ff  
        ( rt_key  /* _1- */
        , c_01    /* _2- */
        , c_02    /* _3- */
        , c_03    /* _4- */
        , n_01    /* _5- */
        , n_02    /* _6- */
        , n_03    /* _7- */
        , n_04    /* _8- */
        )
      SELECT p_rt_key            /* _1- */
           , t1.hab_gwamok       /* _2- */
           , t2.fund_cd          /* _3- */
           , t2.fund_currency    /* _4- */
           , NVL(SUM(junj),0)    /* _5- */
           , NVL(SUM(dr_aek),0)  /* _6- */
           , NVL(SUM(cr_aek),0)  /* _7- */
           , t1.yonsan           /* _8- */
        FROM SZX0CC t1
           , SKM0AG t2
           , SZM0IA ia
       WHERE t1.gwamok        < '90000'
         AND t2.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
         AND t2.ymd           = p_ymd
         AND t2.work_gb       = 'A'
         AND t2.gwamok        = t1.gwamok
         AND ia.corp_gr       = t2.corp_gr
         AND ia.fund_cd       = t2.fund_cd
         AND ia.fund_currency = t2.fund_currency
       GROUP BY t1.hab_gwamok   
              , t2.fund_cd      
              , t2.fund_currency
              , t1.yonsan;

    INSERT INTO GZZX1RT ff  
        ( rt_key  /* _1- */
        , c_01    /* _2- */
        , c_02    /* _3- */
        , c_03    /* _4- */
        , n_11    /* _5- */
        , n_12    /* _6- */
        , n_13    /* _7- */
        )
      SELECT p_rt_key            /* _1- */
           , t1.gwamok           /* _2- */
           , t1.fund_cd          /* _3- */
           , t1.fund_currency    /* _4- */
           , NVL(SUM(junj),0)    /* _5- */
           , NVL(SUM(dr_aek),0)  /* _6- */
           , NVL(SUM(cr_aek),0)  /* _7- */
        FROM SKM0AG t1
           , SZM0IA ia
           , SZX0GM t2
       WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
         AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
         AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
         AND ia.corp_gr       = t1.corp_gr
         AND ia.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd
         AND ia.fund_currency = t1.fund_currency
         AND t2.gwamok_gb     != '9'
         AND t2.inp_gb        != '1'
         AND t2.gwamok        = t1.gwamok
       GROUP BY t1.gwamok       
              , t1.fund_cd      
              , t1.fund_currency;

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT c_01                     AS gwamok         /* _1- */
             , c_02                     AS fund_cd        /* _2- */
             , c_03                     AS fund_currency  /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(n_01 * n_04),0)  AS junj           /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(n_02 * n_04),0)  AS dr_aek         /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(n_03 * n_04),0)  AS cr_aek         /* _6- */
             , NVL(SUM(n_11),0)         AS hab_junj       /* _7- */
             , NVL(SUM(n_12),0)         AS hab_dr_aek     /* _8- */
             , NVL(SUM(n_13),0)         AS hab_cr_aek     /* _9- */
          FROM GZZX1RT t1
             , SZM0IA  t2
         WHERE t1.rt_key        = p_rt_key
           AND t2.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd       = t1.c_02
           AND t2.haeji_ymd IS NULL
           AND t2.fund_currency = t1.c_03
         GROUP BY c_01, c_02, c_03
         ORDER BY c_02, c_01
    ) loop
        if  xx.junj != xx.hab_junj OR xx.dr_aek != xx.hab_dr_aek OR xx.cr_aek != xx.hab_cr_aek  then
            if  w_cnt = 0   then
                w_cnt   := 1;
                INSERT INTO WFRMERR ff  
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr, '     *** 분개계정 상위계정 합계를 확인 하십시오(반드시확인) ***' );
                INSERT INTO WFRMERR ff  
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr, ' ' );
            end if;
            INSERT INTO WFRMERR ff  
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr, xx.fund_cd || '(' || xx.fund_currency || '),'
                                           || xx.gwamok || ' junj:' || F_NTRIM(xx.junj, 20, 2) || ' hab:' || F_NTRIM(xx.hab_junj, 20, 2)
                                           || ' dr_aek:' || F_NTRIM(xx.dr_aek, 20, 2) || ' hab:' || F_NTRIM(xx.hab_dr_aek, 20, 2)
                                           || ' cr_aek:' || F_NTRIM(xx.cr_aek, 20, 2) || ' hab:' || F_NTRIM(xx.hab_cr_aek, 20, 2)  );
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    p_rt_key    := p_corp_gr || TO_CHAR(seq_bss.nextval);

    INSERT INTO GZZX1RT ff  
        ( rt_key  /* _1- */
        , c_01    /* _2- */
        , c_02    /* _3- */
        , c_03    /* _4- */
        , n_01    /* _5- */
        )
      SELECT p_rt_key
           , t1.gwamok
           , t2.fund_cd
           , t2.fund_currency
           , NVL(SUM(CASE t2.chadae_gb WHEN 'D' THEN NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0) - NVL(cr_aek,0)
                                       WHEN 'C' THEN NVL(junj,0) - NVL(dr_aek,0) + NVL(cr_aek,0)
                     END * t1.yonsan),0)
        FROM SZX0CC t1
           , SKM0AG t2
           , SZM0IA ia
       WHERE t1.gwamok        IN (SELECT gwamok
                                    FROM SZX0GM ta
                                   WHERE ta.gwamok_gb = '9')
         AND t2.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
         AND t2.ymd           = p_ymd
         AND t2.work_gb       = 'A'
         AND t2.gwamok        = t1.hab_gwamok
         AND ia.corp_gr       = t2.corp_gr
         AND ia.fund_cd       = t2.fund_cd
         AND ia.fund_currency = t2.fund_currency
       GROUP BY t1.gwamok       
              , t2.fund_currency
              , t2.fund_cd;

    INSERT INTO GZZX1RT ff  
        ( rt_key  /* _1- */
        , c_01    /* _2- */
        , c_02    /* _3- */
        , c_03    /* _4- */
        , n_11    /* _5- */
        )
      SELECT p_rt_key
           , t1.gwamok
           , t1.fund_cd
           , t1.fund_currency
           , NVL(SUM(NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0) - NVL(cr_aek,0)),0)
        FROM SKM0AG t1
           , SZM0IA ia
       WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
         AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
         AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
         AND t1.gwamok        IN (SELECT c_01
                                    FROM GZZX1RT ta
                                   WHERE rt_key = p_rt_key)
         AND t1.gwamok        NOT IN ('B0101','B0411','B0412','B0421','B0422','D0206')
         AND ia.corp_gr       = t1.corp_gr
         AND ia.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd
         AND ia.fund_currency = t1.fund_currency
       GROUP BY t1.gwamok       
              , t1.fund_cd      
              , t1.fund_currency;

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT c_01                                   AS gwamok         /* _1- */
             , c_02                                   AS fund_cd        /* _2- */
             , c_03                                   AS fund_currency  /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(n_01),0)                       AS aek            /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(n_11),0)                       AS hab_aek        /* _5- */
             , LEAD(c_02) OVER (ORDER BY c_02, c_01)  AS lead_fund      /* _6- */
          FROM GZZX1RT t1
             , SZM0IA  t2
         WHERE t1.rt_key        = p_rt_key
           AND t2.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd       = t1.c_02
           AND t2.haeji_ymd IS NULL
           AND t2.fund_currency = t1.c_03
         GROUP BY c_01, c_02, c_03
         HAVING SUM (n_11) != 0
         ORDER BY c_02, c_01
    ) loop
        if  xx.aek != xx.hab_aek    then
            if  w_cnt = 0   then
                w_cnt   := 1;
                INSERT INTO WFRMERR ff  
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr, '     *** 상위계정 합계를 확인 하십시오 ***' );
                INSERT INTO WFRMERR ff  
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr, ' ' );
            end if;
            INSERT INTO WFRMERR ff  
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr, xx.fund_cd || '(' || xx.fund_currency || '),' || xx.gwamok
                                           || ' aek:' || F_NTRIM(xx.aek, 20, 2)
                                           || ' hab:' || F_NTRIM(xx.hab_aek, 20, 2)  );
        end if;
    END LOOP;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA050C (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_rt_key                       IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_gb                           IN    VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 펀드별 분개장 출력
--
    w_work_gb                      VARCHAR(5);
    w_procf                        NUMBER;
    w_proct                        NUMBER;

    w_key                          VARCHAR(99)  default '---';
    w_num                          NUMBER;
    dr_num                         NUMBER;
    cr_num                         NUMBER;
BEGIN
    commit;
    w_work_gb := '[A]';
    if  p_gb = 'A'  then
        w_procf := 11;
        w_proct := 16;
    elsif p_gb = 'B'    then
        w_procf := 17;
        w_proct := 17;
    elsif p_gb = 'C'    then
        w_procf := 20;
        w_proct := 20;
    elsif p_gb = 'D'    then
        w_procf := 39;
        w_proct := 39;
    elsif p_gb = 'E'    then
        w_procf := 41;
        w_proct := 49;
    elsif p_gb = 'F'    then
        w_procf := 51;
        w_proct := 59;
    elsif p_gb = 'G'    then
        w_procf := 61;
        w_proct := 99;
    elsif p_gb = 'H'    then
        w_work_gb := '[B]';
        w_procf   := 0;
        w_proct   := 99;
    else
        w_work_gb := '[AB]';
        w_procf   := 0;
        w_proct   := 99;
        if  p_gb = '9'  then
            w_procf := 9;
            w_proct := 9;
        end if;
    end if;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT tt.fund_currency  /* _1- */
             , tt.work_gb        /* _2- */
             , tt.fund_nm        /* _3- */
             , tt.tr_cd          /* _4- */
             , tt.tr_nm          /* _5- */
             , tt.jeokyo_cd      /* _6- */
             , tt.jeokyo_nm      /* _7- */
             , tt.jm_cd          /* _8- */
             , tt.jj_nm          /* _9- */
             , tt.seq_no         /* _10- */
             , tt.chasu          /* _11- */
             , tt.row_no         /* _12- */
             , tt.gwamok         /* _13- */
             , tt.gwamok_nm      /* _14- */
             , tt.chadae_gb      /* _15- */
             , tt.aek            /* _16- */
             , tt.proc_step      /* _17- */
             , tt.bigo           /* _18- */
          FROM (SELECT t1.fund_currency                                   /* _1- */
                     , t1.work_gb                                         /* _2- */
                     , CASE WHEN t1.work_gb='A' THEN ia.fund_nm
                                                ELSE ia.fund_nm || '(결산)'
                       END                                  AS fund_nm    /* _3- */
                     , t1.tr_cd                                           /* _4- */
                     , F_TR_NM (tr_cd)                      AS tr_nm      /* _5- */
                     , t1.jeokyo_cd                                       /* _6- */
                     , F_JEOKYO_NM (jeokyo_cd)              AS jeokyo_nm  /* _7- */
                     , NVL(t1.jm_cd,'null')                 AS jm_cd      /* _8- */
                     , CASE WHEN lower (t1.jm_cd)=lower (F_JM_NM (t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd))
                            THEN ''
                            ELSE F_JM_NM (t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd)
                       END                                  AS jj_nm      /* _9- */
                     , t1.seq_no                                          /* _10- */
                     , NVL(t1.chasu,0)                      AS chasu      /* _11- */
                     , t1.row_no                                          /* _12- */
                     , t1.gwamok                                          /* _13- */
                     , F_GWAMOK_NM (t1.corp_gr, t1.gwamok)  AS gwamok_nm  /* _14- */
                     , t1.chadae_gb                                       /* _15- */
                     , t1.aek                                             /* _16- */
                     , t1.proc_step                                       /* _17- */
                     , t1.bigo                                            /* _18- */
                  FROM SKT0BU t1
                     , SZM0IA ia
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
                   AND t1.fund_cd   = p_fund_cd
                   AND  (REGEXP_LIKE (t1.work_gb, w_work_gb) OR (p_gb = 'H' AND REGEXP_LIKE (t1.tr_cd,'^Q[359]')))
                   AND t1.proc_step BETWEEN w_procf AND w_proct
                   AND ia.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd   = t1.fund_cd
                ) tt
         ORDER BY 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 4 ASC, 8 ASC, 10 ASC, 11 ASC, 12 ASC
    ) loop
        if  w_key != xx.fund_currency || xx.work_gb || xx.tr_cd || xx.jeokyo_cd || xx.jm_cd || xx.seq_no || xx.chasu    then
            w_key  := xx.fund_currency || xx.work_gb || xx.tr_cd || xx.jeokyo_cd || xx.jm_cd || xx.seq_no || xx.chasu;
            w_num  := 0;
            dr_num := 0;
            cr_num := 0;
        end if;

        if  xx.chadae_gb = 'D'  then
            if  xx.gwamok = '10101' AND cr_num < dr_num then    cr_num := dr_num;
            end if;
            dr_num := dr_num + 1;
            w_num  := dr_num;
        else
            if  xx.gwamok = '10101' AND dr_num < cr_num then    dr_num := cr_num;
            end if;
            cr_num := cr_num + 1;
            if  xx.gwamok_nm LIKE '미지급%' then    cr_num := GREATEST (cr_num, dr_num);
            end if;
            w_num := cr_num;
        end if;

        UPDATE GZZXSRT ff  
           SET c_09 = CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='D' THEN xx.gwamok    ELSE c_09 END
             , c_10 = CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='D' THEN xx.gwamok_nm ELSE c_10 END
             , c_11 = CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='C' THEN xx.gwamok    ELSE c_11 END
             , c_12 = CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='C' THEN xx.gwamok_nm ELSE c_12 END
             , n_04 = CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='D' THEN xx.row_no    ELSE n_04 END
             , n_05 = CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='D' THEN xx.aek       ELSE n_05 END
             , n_06 = CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='C' THEN xx.row_no    ELSE n_06 END
             , n_07 = CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='C' THEN xx.aek       ELSE n_07 END
             , n_20 = xx.proc_step
         WHERE 1 = 1 
           AND rt_key = p_rt_key
           AND c_02   = xx.fund_nm
           AND c_03   = xx.tr_cd
           AND c_05   = xx.jeokyo_cd
           AND c_07   = xx.jm_cd
           AND n_01   = w_num
           AND n_02   = xx.seq_no
           AND n_03   = xx.chasu;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO GZZXSRT ff  
                 ( rt_key  /* _1- */
                 , c_01    /* _2- */
                 , c_15    /* _3- */
                 , c_02    /* _4- */
                 , c_03    /* _5- */
                 , c_04    /* _6- */
                 , c_05    /* _7- */
                 , c_06    /* _8- */
                 , c_07    /* _9- */
                 , c_08    /* _10- */
                 , c_09    /* _11- */
                 , c_10    /* _12- */
                 , c_11    /* _13- */
                 , c_12    /* _14- */
                 , c_13    /* _15- */
                 , c_21    /* _16- */
                 , n_01    /* _17- */
                 , n_02    /* _18- */
                 , n_03    /* _19- */
                 , n_04    /* _20- */
                 , n_05    /* _21- */
                 , n_06    /* _22- */
                 , n_07    /* _23- */
                 , n_20    /* _24- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_rt_key                                          /* _1- */
                   , p_fund_cd                                         /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_currency                                  /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_nm                                        /* _4- */
                   , xx.tr_cd                                          /* _5- */
                   , xx.tr_nm                                          /* _6- */
                   , xx.jeokyo_cd                                      /* _7- */
                   , xx.jeokyo_nm                                      /* _8- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                                          /* _9- */
                   , xx.jj_nm                                          /* _10- */
                   , CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='D' THEN xx.gwamok END     /* _11- */
                   , CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='D' THEN xx.gwamok_nm END  /* _12- */
                   , CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='C' THEN xx.gwamok END     /* _13- */
                   , CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='C' THEN xx.gwamok_nm END  /* _14- */
                   , xx.work_gb                                        /* _15- */
                   , xx.bigo                                           /* _16- */
                   , w_num                                             /* _17- */
                   , xx.seq_no                                         /* _18- */
                   , xx.chasu                                          /* _19- */
                   , CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='D' THEN xx.row_no END     /* _20- */
                   , CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='D' THEN xx.aek END        /* _21- */
                   , CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='C' THEN xx.row_no END     /* _22- */
                   , CASE WHEN xx.chadae_gb='C' THEN xx.aek END        /* _23- */
                   , xx.proc_step                                      /* _24- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA050D (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_rt_key                       IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_mg_cd                        IN    VARCHAR
) AS
-- 기준가 재계산시 변경내역 출력용
--
    w_user_nm                    VARCHAR(50);
BEGIN
    for xx IN (
        select rowidtochar(t2.rowid)                                       AS row_id
             , t1.jwa
             , t1.aek
             , LEAD(t1.jwa) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                      ORDER BY t1.fund_cd, t1.ymd, t1.dt)  AS af_jwa
             , LEAD(t1.aek) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                      ORDER BY t1.fund_cd, t1.ymd, t1.dt)  AS af_aek
          from GIJUN_GA_COM t1
             , SZM0IA       t2
         where t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           and t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           and t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and t2.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           and t2.mg_cd   LIKE p_mg_cd
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.ymd
                , t1.dt
    ) loop
        if  xx.jwa != xx.af_jwa OR xx.aek != xx.af_aek  then
            INSERT INTO ROWID_IN ff
            VALUES ( p_rt_key
                   , xx.row_id
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        select t1.ymd                                                                     /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                 /* _2- */
             , t2.fund_nm                                                                 /* _3- */
             , t1.dt                                                                      /* _4- */
             , t1.jwa                                                                     /* _5- */
             , t1.aek                                                                     /* _6- */
             , LEAD(t1.dt) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                     ORDER BY t1.fund_cd, t1.ymd, t1.dt)      AS af_dt    /* _7- */
             , LEAD(t1.jwa) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                      ORDER BY t1.fund_cd, t1.ymd, t1.dt)     AS af_jwa   /* _8- */
             , LEAD(t1.aek) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                      ORDER BY t1.fund_cd, t1.ymd, t1.dt)     AS af_aek   /* _9- */
             , LEAD(t1.userid) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd, t1.ymd, t1.dt)  AS user_id  /* _10- */
          from GIJUN_GA_COM t1
             , SZM0IA       t2
         where t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           and t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           and t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and t2.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           and t2.rowid   IN (select row_id
                                from ROWID_IN t1
                               where rt_key = p_rt_key)
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.ymd
                , t1.dt
    ) loop
        if  xx.af_jwa IS NOT NULL   then
            BEGIN
                SELECT '(' || user_nm || ')'
                  INTO w_user_nm
                  FROM FW_USER_MST t1
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.user_id = xx.user_id;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                w_user_nm   := '';
            END;

            INSERT INTO GZZX0RT ff
                ( rt_key  /* _1- */
                , c_01    /* _2- */
                , c_02    /* _3- */
                , c_03    /* _4- */
                , d_01    /* _5- */
                , d_02    /* _6- */
                , n_01    /* _7- */
                , n_02    /* _8- */
                , n_03    /* _9- */
                , n_04    /* _10- */
                )
            VALUES ( p_rt_key    /* _1- */
                   , xx.fund_cd  /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_nm  /* _3- */
                   , w_user_nm   /* _4- */
                   , xx.dt       /* _5- */
                   , xx.af_dt    /* _6- */
                   , xx.aek      /* _7- */
                   , xx.af_aek   /* _8- */
                   , xx.jwa      /* _9- */
                   , xx.af_jwa   /* _10- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA060B (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_tymd                         IN    DATE,
    p_re_gu                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_sbnm                         IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 분기(해지)보고서 생성
-- ...재설정일(자산운용은 최초설정일) 기준으로 누적일 계산
--
    w_customer_gr                  VARCHAR(20);
    w_mail_cc                      VARCHAR(400);

    w_fst_seolj_ymd                DATE;
    w_bungi_start                  DATE;

    w_day_tsusu                    NUMBER;
    w_io_aek                       NUMBER;
    w_pyung_jan                    NUMBER;
    w_avg_jasan                    NUMBER;
    w_col_val                      NUMBER;
    w_gongmo_aek                   NUMBER;
    w_bungi_gongmo_aek             NUMBER;

    f                              sics_fund%rowtype;
    F_OLD                          sics_fund%rowtype;
BEGIN
    SELECT CUSTOMER_GR
      INTO w_customer_gr
      FROM SZX0AA t1
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr;

    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO w_io_aek
      FROM SKT0GI t1
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
       AND t1.ymd     <= p_tymd;
    if  w_io_aek = 1    then
        p_msg := '신규설정 PASS';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    BEGIN
        SELECT MAIL_CC
          INTO w_mail_cc
          FROM SICS_FUND t1
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = (SELECT MAX(YMD)
                               FROM SICS_FUND ta
                              WHERE 1 = 1
                                AND ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                AND ta.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
                                AND ta.ymd     BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS (p_tymd,-6) AND p_tymd - 1);
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        w_mail_cc := '';
    END;

    BEGIN
        SELECT *
          INTO f
          FROM SICS_FUND t1
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = p_tymd;

        f.re_create_dt   := sysdate;
        f.re_create_user := p_sbnm;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        f.ymd         := p_tymd;
        f.create_dt   := sysdate;
        f.create_user := p_sbnm;
        f.risk_level  := '00';
        f.rep_gb      := 'B';
        f.mail_cc     := w_mail_cc;
    END;

    F_OLD := f;  /* 변경분 점검을 위해 20211023 */

    f.jasan_gijun_ymd := p_tymd;

    SELECT t1.CORP_GR                             /* _1- */
         , t1.FUND_CD                             /* _2- */
         , ia.FST_SEOLJ_YMD                       /* _3- */
         , ia.RE_SEOLJ_YMD                        /* _4- */
         , NVL(t1.HAEJI_YMD - 1, t1.AF_GYUL_YMD)  /* _5- */
         , TO_ENCRYPTS (ia.EMAIL1)                /* _6- */
         , ia.SINTAK_GIGAN                        /* _7- */
         , ia.BOSU_GIGAN                          /* _8- */
         , ia.PRE_BASIC                           /* _9- */
         , ia.BASIC_PER                           /* _10- */
         , ia.BM_PER                              /* _11- */
         , ia.SUCCESS_PER                         /* _12- */
         , ia.TARGET_JASAN                        /* _13- */
      INTO f.corp_gr        /* _1- */
         , f.fund_cd        /* _2- */
         , w_fst_seolj_ymd  /* _3- */
         , f.re_seolj_ymd   /* _4- */
         , f.af_gyul_ymd    /* _5- */
         , f.enc_e_mail     /* _6- */
         , f.SINTAK_GIGAN   /* _7- */
         , f.BOSU_GIGAN     /* _8- */
         , f.PRE_BASIC      /* _9- */
         , f.BASIC_PER      /* _10- */
         , f.BM_PER         /* _11- */
         , f.SUCCESS_PER    /* _12- */
         , f.TARGET_JASAN   /* _13- */
      FROM SZM0GI t1
         , SZM0IA ia
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
       AND f.ymd      BETWEEN (t1.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND t1.af_gyul_ymd
       AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
       AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd;

    if  f.re_seolj_ymd >= p_tymd then
        SELECT MAX (tr_ymd)
          INTO f.re_seolj_ymd
          FROM SZT0IO t1
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND corp_gr        = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd        = p_fund_cd
           AND tr_ymd         < f.re_seolj_ymd
           AND NVL(in_aek,0)  = 0
           AND NVL(out_aek,0) = 0;
    end if;

    f.b_3m := ADD_MONTHS  (p_tymd, -3);
    f.b_6m := ADD_MONTHS  (p_tymd, -6);
    f.b_9m := ADD_MONTHS  (p_tymd, -9);
    f.b_1y := ADD_MONTHS  (p_tymd, -12);

    -- 기준일 평잔수익률
    BEGIN
        if  p_corp_gr = '2402'  then
            SELECT tt.A0402
                 , ss.nav
                 , ss.re_pj
                 , ss.RE_SEOLJ_SUIK_PER / 100
              INTO f.wonbon_aek
                 , f.sun_jasan_aek
                 , w_pyung_jan
                 , f.suik_rt
              FROM SKT0GI t1
                 , TABLE(F_FUND_SUIK_PER1 (t1.corp_gr,t1.fund_cd,TO_CHAR(t1.ymd,'yyyymmdd'))) ss
                 , (SELECT NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0)  AS A0402
                      FROM SKM0AG t1
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND ymd     = p_tymd
                       AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
                       AND work_gb = 'A'
                       AND gwamok  = 'A0402'
                     ) tt
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     = p_tymd
               AND t1.work_gb = 'A';
        else
            SELECT tt.A0402
                 , t1.sun_jasan_aek
                 , t1.tuja_pj_aek
                 , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.tuja_pj_aek,0)=0 THEN 0
                                                     ELSE (t1.sun_jasan_aek - tt.A0402) / t1.tuja_pj_aek END
              INTO f.wonbon_aek
                 , f.sun_jasan_aek
                 , w_pyung_jan
                 , f.suik_rt
              FROM SKT0GI t1
                 , (SELECT NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0)  AS A0402
                      FROM SKM0AG t1
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND ymd     = p_tymd
                       AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
                       AND work_gb = 'A'
                       AND gwamok  = 'A0402'
                     ) tt
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     = p_tymd
               AND t1.work_gb = 'A';
        end if;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := p_fund_cd || ' - 평잔수익률 계산에러';
        RETURN;
    END;

--    if  f.re_create_dt IS NOT NULL AND p_re_gu != 'force'   then
--        if  f.wonbon_aek = F_OLD.WONBON_AEK AND f.sun_jasan_aek = F_OLD.SUN_JASAN_AEK AND trunc (f.suik_rt, 6) != trunc (F_OLD.SUIK_RT, 6)  then
--            p_msg   := '변경된 자료가 없습니다.(no update)';
--            RETURN;
--        end if;
--    end if;

    SELECT col_val
      INTO w_col_val
      FROM SKT0BM t1
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = 'JISU'
       AND t1.ymd     = F_TRADE_YMD(p_tymd,'-')
       AND t1.col_id  = 'kospi_jisu';

    SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ymd=F_TRADE_YMD (f.b_3m,'-') AND NVL(col_val,0) <> 0 THEN w_col_val / col_val - 1 END),0)
         , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ymd=F_TRADE_YMD (f.b_6m,'-') AND NVL(col_val,0) <> 0 THEN w_col_val / col_val - 1 END),0)
         , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ymd=F_TRADE_YMD (f.b_9m,'-') AND NVL(col_val,0) <> 0 THEN w_col_val / col_val - 1 END),0)
         , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ymd=F_TRADE_YMD (f.b_1y,'-') AND NVL(col_val,0) <> 0 THEN w_col_val / col_val - 1 END),0)
      INTO f.bm_3rt
         , f.bm_6rt
         , f.bm_9rt
         , f.bm_12rt
      FROM SKT0BM t1
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = 'JISU'
       AND t1.col_id  = 'kospi_jisu'
       AND t1.ymd     IN (F_TRADE_YMD(f.b_3m, '-'), F_TRADE_YMD(f.b_6m, '-'), F_TRADE_YMD(f.b_9m, '-'), F_TRADE_YMD(f.b_1y, '-'));

    if  f.re_seolj_ymd > f.b_3m then
        f.b_6m    := NULL;
        f.b_9m    := NULL;
        f.b_1y    := NULL;
        f.bm_6rt  := NULL;
        f.bm_9rt  := NULL;
        f.bm_12rt := NULL;
    else
        if  f.re_seolj_ymd > f.b_6m then
            f.b_9m    := NULL;
            f.b_1y    := NULL;
            f.bm_9rt  := NULL;
            f.bm_12rt := NULL;
        else
            if  f.re_seolj_ymd > f.b_9m then
                f.b_1y    := NULL;
                f.bm_12rt := NULL;
            end if;
        end if;
    end if;

    f.suik_3rt  := NULL;
    f.suik_6rt  := NULL;
    f.suik_9rt  := NULL;
    f.suik_12rt := NULL;

    if  f.b_3m < f.re_seolj_ymd then
        BEGIN
            SELECT CASE WHEN NVL(col_val,0)=0
                        THEN 0
                        ELSE w_col_val / col_val - 1 END
              INTO f.bm_3rt
              FROM SKT0BM t1
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.corp_gr = 'JISU'
               AND t1.col_id  = 'kospi_jisu'
               AND t1.ymd     = F_TRADE_YMD(f.re_seolj_ymd,'-1');
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := f.re_seolj_ymd || '- 지수가 없습니다.(3m)';
            RETURN;
        END;
        f.suik_3rt := f.suik_rt;
    else
        SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(in_aek,0) - NVL(out_aek,0)),0)
          INTO w_io_aek
          FROM SZT0IO t1
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND tr_ymd  BETWEEN f.b_3m + 1 AND p_tymd;

        BEGIN
            if  p_corp_gr = '2402'  then
                -- 리코 순자산은 UZM0HY 이용
                SELECT ((f.sun_jasan_aek - w_io_aek) / (nav + NVL(ex_siga_aek,0))) - 1
                  INTO f.suik_3rt
                  FROM UZM0HY t1
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
                   AND ymd     = f.b_3m;
            else
                SELECT CASE WHEN NVL(sun_jasan_aek,0)=0
                            THEN 0
                            ELSE ((f.sun_jasan_aek - w_io_aek) / sun_jasan_aek) - 1 END
                  INTO f.suik_3rt
                  FROM SKT0GI t1
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
                   AND work_gb = 'A'
                   AND ymd     = f.b_3m;
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            f.suik_3rt := 0;
        END;
    end if;
    if  f.b_6m IS NOT NULL  then
        if  f.b_6m < f.re_seolj_ymd then
            BEGIN
                SELECT CASE WHEN NVL(col_val,0)=0
                            THEN 0
                            ELSE w_col_val / col_val - 1 END
                  INTO f.bm_6rt
                  FROM SKT0BM t1
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND t1.corp_gr = 'JISU'
                   AND t1.col_id  = 'kospi_jisu'
                   AND t1.ymd     = F_TRADE_YMD(f.re_seolj_ymd,'-1');
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := f.re_seolj_ymd || '- 지수가 없습니다.(6m)';
                RETURN;
            END;
            f.suik_6rt := f.suik_rt;
        else
            SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(in_aek,0) - NVL(out_aek,0)),0)
              INTO w_io_aek
              FROM SZT0IO t1
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
               AND tr_ymd  BETWEEN f.b_6m + 1 AND p_tymd;

            BEGIN
                if  p_corp_gr = '2402'  then
                    -- 리코 순자산은 UZM0HY 이용
                    SELECT ((f.sun_jasan_aek - w_io_aek) / (nav + NVL(ex_siga_aek,0))) - 1
                      INTO f.suik_6rt
                      FROM UZM0HY t1
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
                       AND ymd     = f.b_6m;
                else
                    SELECT CASE WHEN NVL(sun_jasan_aek,0)=0
                                THEN 0
                                ELSE ((f.sun_jasan_aek - w_io_aek) / sun_jasan_aek) - 1 END
                      INTO f.suik_6rt
                      FROM SKT0GI t1
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
                       AND work_gb = 'A'
                       AND ymd     = f.b_6m;
                end if;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                f.suik_6rt := 0;
            END;
        end if;
        if  f.b_9m IS NOT NULL  then
            if  f.b_9m < f.re_seolj_ymd then
                BEGIN
                    SELECT CASE WHEN NVL(col_val,0)=0
                                THEN 0
                                ELSE w_col_val / col_val - 1 END
                      INTO f.bm_9rt
                      FROM SKT0BM t1
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND t1.corp_gr = 'JISU'
                       AND t1.col_id  = 'kospi_jisu'
                       AND t1.ymd     = F_TRADE_YMD(f.re_seolj_ymd,'-1');
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    p_msg := f.re_seolj_ymd || '- 지수가 없습니다.(9m)';
                    RETURN;
                END;
                f.suik_9rt := f.suik_rt;
            else
                SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(in_aek,0) - NVL(out_aek,0)),0)
                  INTO w_io_aek
                  FROM SZT0IO t1
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
                   AND tr_ymd  BETWEEN f.b_9m + 1 AND p_tymd;

                BEGIN
                    if  p_corp_gr = '2402'  then
                        -- 리코 순자산은 UZM0HY 이용
                        SELECT ((f.sun_jasan_aek - w_io_aek) / (nav + NVL(ex_siga_aek,0))) - 1
                          INTO f.suik_9rt
                          FROM UZM0HY t1
                         WHERE 1 = 1
                           AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                           AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
                           AND ymd     = f.b_9m;
                    else
                        SELECT ((f.sun_jasan_aek - w_io_aek) / sun_jasan_aek) - 1
                          INTO f.suik_9rt
                          FROM SKT0GI t1
                         WHERE 1 = 1
                           AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                           AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
                           AND work_gb = 'A'
                           AND ymd     = f.b_9m;
                    end if;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    f.suik_9rt := 0;
                END;
            end if;
            if  f.b_1y IS NOT NULL  then
                BEGIN
                    SELECT CASE WHEN NVL(col_val,0)=0
                                THEN 0
                                ELSE w_col_val / col_val - 1 END
                      INTO f.bm_12rt
                      FROM SKT0BM t1
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND t1.corp_gr = 'JISU'
                       AND t1.col_id  = 'kospi_jisu'
                       AND t1.ymd     = F_TRADE_YMD(f.re_seolj_ymd,'-1');
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    p_msg := f.re_seolj_ymd || '- 지수가 없습니다.(12m)';
                    RETURN;
                END;
                f.suik_12rt := f.suik_rt;
            end if;
        end if;
    end if;

    if  w_customer_gr = '자산운용'  then
        -- 리코요청 분기시작일을 최초설정일을 기준으로 변경 20250704
        if  f.b_3m < w_fst_seolj_ymd then
                w_bungi_start := w_fst_seolj_ymd;
        else    w_bungi_start := f.b_3m + 1;
        end if;
    else
        if  f.b_3m < f.re_seolj_ymd then
                w_bungi_start := f.re_seolj_ymd;
        else    w_bungi_start := f.b_3m + 1;
        end if;
    end if;

    -- 일임수수료
    if  p_corp_gr = '2402'  then
        -- 리코자산운용 당분기 입력금액 사용

        SELECT NVL(SUM(bungi_tsusu),0)
          INTO f.tsusu
          FROM SICS_FUND t1
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     BETWEEN f.re_seolj_ymd AND p_tymd;
    else
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0)
                 , NVL(dr_aek,0)
              INTO f.tsusu
                 , w_day_tsusu
              FROM SKM0AG t1
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND ymd     = p_tymd
               AND work_gb = 'A'
               AND gwamok  = '90120'
               AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            f.tsusu     := 0;
            w_day_tsusu := 0;
        END;
    end if;

    -- 성과수수료(입력금액 사용)
    if  p_corp_gr = '2402'  then
        -- 리코자산운용 당분기 입력금액 사용

        SELECT NVL(SUM(bungi_sbosu),0)
          INTO f.sbosu
          FROM SICS_FUND t1
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     BETWEEN f.re_seolj_ymd AND p_tymd;
    else
        f.bungi_sbosu := 0;
        if LAST_DAY (p_tymd) != p_tymd then
            -- 중도해지
            SELECT NVL(inchul_tsusu,0)
                 , NVL(inchul_sbosu,0)
              INTO f.tsusu
                 , f.sbosu
              FROM SKT0GS t1
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
               AND t1.gyul_ymd = p_tymd;
        else
            if  f.b_3m <= f.re_seolj_ymd    then
                    f.bungi_tsusu := f.tsusu;
            else    f.bungi_tsusu := w_day_tsusu * (p_tymd - f.b_3m);
            end if;

            SELECT NVL(SUM(bungi_sbosu),0)
              INTO f.sbosu
              FROM SICS_FUND t1
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     BETWEEN f.re_seolj_ymd AND p_tymd - 1;
        end if;
    end if;

    -- 주식 분기 매수
    SELECT NVL(SUM(tr_aek),0)
         , NVL(SUM(susu),0)
         , NVL(SUM(tax),0)
      INTO f.bungi_stock_maesu
         , f.bungi_stock_susu
         , f.bungi_stock_tax
      FROM SJT0JG t1
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
       AND t1.tr_cd   LIKE 'J2%'
       AND t1.tr_ymd  BETWEEN w_bungi_start AND p_tymd;

    -- 주식 분기 매도
    SELECT NVL(SUM(tr_aek),0)
         , NVL(SUM(susu),0) + f.bungi_stock_susu
         , NVL(SUM(tax),0) + f.bungi_stock_tax
      INTO f.bungi_stock_maedo
         , f.bungi_stock_susu
         , f.bungi_stock_tax
      FROM SJT0JG t1
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
       AND t1.tr_cd   LIKE 'K2%'
       AND t1.tr_ymd  BETWEEN w_bungi_start AND p_tymd;

    f.bungi_stock_fee := f.bungi_stock_susu + f.bungi_stock_tax;

    -- 채권 분기 매수
    SELECT NVL(SUM(tr_aek),0)
         , NVL(SUM(susu),0)
         , 0
      INTO f.bungi_bond_maesu
         , f.bungi_bond_susu
         , f.bungi_bond_tax
      FROM SCT0CG t1
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
       AND t1.tr_cd   LIKE 'J%'
       AND t1.tr_ymd  BETWEEN w_bungi_start AND p_tymd;

    -- 채권 분기 매도
    SELECT NVL(SUM(tr_aek),0)
         , NVL(SUM(susu),0) + f.bungi_bond_susu
      INTO f.bungi_bond_maedo
         , f.bungi_bond_susu
      FROM SCT0CG t1
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
       AND t1.tr_cd   LIKE 'K%'
       AND t1.tr_ymd  BETWEEN w_bungi_start AND p_tymd;

    f.bungi_bond_fee := f.bungi_bond_susu + f.bungi_bond_tax;

    SELECT NVL(SUM(tr_aek),0)
      INTO f.stock_mm_aek
      FROM SJT0JG t1
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
       AND  (t1.tr_cd LIKE 'J2%' OR t1.tr_cd LIKE 'K2%')
       AND t1.tr_ymd  BETWEEN f.re_seolj_ymd AND p_tymd;

    SELECT NVL(SUM(bungi_bond_susu),0) + NVL(SUM(bungi_stock_susu),0)
                                       + f.bungi_bond_susu + f.bungi_stock_susu
      INTO f.susu
      FROM SICS_FUND t1
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
       AND t1.ymd     BETWEEN f.re_seolj_ymd AND p_tymd - 1;

    SELECT NVL(SUM(bungi_bond_tax),0) + NVL(SUM(bungi_stock_tax),0)
                                      + f.bungi_bond_tax + f.bungi_stock_tax
      INTO f.tax
      FROM SICS_FUND t1
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
       AND t1.ymd     BETWEEN f.re_seolj_ymd AND p_tymd - 1;

    f.fee := f.susu + f.tax + f.tsusu + f.sbosu;

    --2026.07.21 리코 요청으로 인한 공모 납입액도 보고서의 회전율 포함을 위해 별도 컬럼에 배치.
    --일 평잔
    SELECT AVG(sun_jasan_aek)
      INTO w_avg_jasan
      FROM SKT0GI t1
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
       AND t1.ymd     BETWEEN w_bungi_start AND p_tymd
       AND t1.work_gb = 'A';


        f.avg_jasan := w_avg_jasan;

    --2026.07.21 리코 요청으로 인한 공모 납입액도 보고서의 회전율 포함을 위해 별도 컬럼에 배치.
    --분기 공모 납입액.
    SELECT NVL(SUM(t1.SURY_AEK * danga),0)  AS sum_gm
      INTO w_bungi_gongmo_aek
      FROM SJT0FS t1
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd  BETWEEN w_bungi_start AND p_tymd
       AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
       AND t1.tr_cd   = 'F47';

    --누적 공모 납입액.
    SELECT NVL(SUM(t1.SURY_AEK * danga),0)  AS sum_gm
      INTO w_gongmo_aek
      FROM SJT0FS t1
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
       AND t1.tr_cd   = 'F47'
       AND t1.tr_ymd  BETWEEN f.re_seolj_ymd AND p_tymd;

    f.bungi_gongmo_napip := w_bungi_gongmo_aek;
    f.gongmo_napip       := w_gongmo_aek;

    -- 매매회전율
    if  w_avg_jasan = 0 then
        f.bungi_stock_turnover_rt := 0;
        f.stock_turnover_rt       := 0;
    else
        f.bungi_stock_turnover_rt := (NVL(f.bungi_stock_maesu,0) + NVL(f.bungi_stock_maedo,0)) / (w_avg_jasan * 2);
        f.stock_turnover_rt       := f.stock_mm_aek                                            / (w_avg_jasan * 2);
    end if;

    -- 공모주 매도손익
    -- 재공모할 수도 있기때문에 생성일 기준 MAX YMD로 가져오기로 수정 필요.
    SELECT NVL(SUM(t1.gyul_aek),0) - NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.meib_chui_aek,0) + NVL(fc.CY_SUSU,0)),0)
      INTO f.bungi_f47_suik
      FROM SJT0JG t1
         , SJG1JC jc
         , SJG1FC fc
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
       AND t1.tr_cd    LIKE 'K%'
       AND t1.tr_ymd   BETWEEN w_bungi_start AND p_tymd
       AND jc.sj_ymd   <= p_tymd
       AND jc.sj_jm_cd = t1.jm_cd
       AND fc.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
       AND fc.JC_JOIN  = jc.JC_JOIN;

    SELECT NVL(SUM(t1.gyul_aek),0) - NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.meib_chui_aek,0) + NVL(fc.CY_SUSU,0)),0)
      INTO f.f47_suik
      FROM SJT0JG t1
         , SJG1JC jc
         , SJG1FC fc
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
       AND t1.tr_cd    LIKE 'K%'
       AND t1.tr_ymd   BETWEEN f.re_seolj_ymd AND p_tymd
       AND jc.sj_ymd   <= p_tymd
       AND jc.sj_jm_cd = t1.jm_cd
       AND fc.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
       AND fc.JC_JOIN  = jc.JC_JOIN;

    f.send_type := '1';

    if  f.re_create_dt IS NOT NULL  then
        if  f.wonbon_aek != F_OLD.WONBON_AEK    then
            f.re_create_bigo := '변경원본 : ' || F_NTRIM (f.wonbon_aek - F_OLD.WONBON_AEK);
        end if;
        if  f.sun_jasan_aek != F_OLD.SUN_JASAN_AEK  then
            if  f.re_create_bigo IS NOT NULL    then    f.re_create_bigo := f.re_create_bigo || ' / ';
            end if;
            f.re_create_bigo := f.re_create_bigo || '변경순자산 : ' || F_NTRIM (f.sun_jasan_aek - F_OLD.SUN_JASAN_AEK);
        end if;
        if  f.suik_rt != F_OLD.SUIK_RT  then
            if  f.re_create_bigo IS NOT NULL    then    f.re_create_bigo := f.re_create_bigo || ' / ';
            end if;
            f.re_create_bigo := f.re_create_bigo || '변경수익률 : ' || F_NTRIM (F_OLD.SUIK_RT, 0, 6) || '-->' || F_NTRIM (f.suik_rt, 0, 6);
        end if;
        p_msg := NVL (f.re_create_bigo,'변경된 자료가 없습니다.') || '(update)';

        UPDATE SICS_FUND t1  
           SET ROW = f
         WHERE 1 = 1 
           AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = p_tymd;
    else
        INSERT INTO SICS_FUND tt  
         VALUES f;

        p_msg := 'Y';
    end if;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JA999A (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_rt_key                       IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_mg_cd                        IN    VARCHAR
) AS
-- 기준가 재계산시 변경내역 출력용
--
    w_user_nm                    VARCHAR(50);
BEGIN
    FOR r1 IN (
        SELECT rowidtochar(t2.rowid)                                                         AS row_id
             , t1.jwa
             , t1.aek
             , LEAD(t1.jwa) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd ORDER BY t1.fund_cd,t1.ymd,t1.dt)  AS af_jwa
             , LEAD(t1.aek) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd ORDER BY t1.fund_cd,t1.ymd,t1.dt)  AS af_aek
          FROM GIJUN_GA_COM t1
             , SZM0IA       t2
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t2.mg_cd   LIKE p_mg_cd
           AND t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.ymd
                , t1.dt
    ) loop
        if  r1.jwa != r1.af_jwa OR r1.aek != r1.af_aek  then
            INSERT INTO ROWID_IN
            VALUES ( p_rt_key
                   , r1.row_id
                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    FOR r1 IN (
        SELECT t1.ymd                                                                                       /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                   /* _2- */
             , t2.fund_nm                                                                                   /* _3- */
             , t1.dt                                                                                        /* _4- */
             , t1.jwa                                                                                       /* _5- */
             , t1.aek                                                                                       /* _6- */
             , LEAD(t1.dt) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd ORDER BY t1.fund_cd,t1.ymd,t1.dt)      AS af_dt    /* _7- */
             , LEAD(t1.jwa) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd ORDER BY t1.fund_cd,t1.ymd,t1.dt)     AS af_jwa   /* _8- */
             , LEAD(t1.aek) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd ORDER BY t1.fund_cd,t1.ymd,t1.dt)     AS af_aek   /* _9- */
             , LEAD(t1.userid) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd ORDER BY t1.fund_cd,t1.ymd,t1.dt)  AS user_id  /* _10- */
          FROM GIJUN_GA_COM t1
             , SZM0IA       t2
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t2.rowid   IN (SELECT row_id
                                FROM ROWID_IN t1
                               WHERE rt_key = p_rt_key)
           AND t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.ymd
                , t1.dt
    ) loop
        if  r1.af_jwa IS NOT NULL   then
            BEGIN
                SELECT '(' || user_nm || ')'
                  INTO w_user_nm
                  FROM FW_USER_MST t1
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.user_id = r1.user_id;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                w_user_nm   := '';
            END;

            INSERT INTO GZZX0RT
                ( rt_key  /* _1- */
                , c_01    /* _2- */
                , c_02    /* _3- */
                , c_03    /* _4- */
                , d_01    /* _5- */
                , d_02    /* _6- */
                , n_01    /* _7- */
                , n_02    /* _8- */
                , n_03    /* _9- */
                , n_04    /* _10- */
                )
            VALUES ( p_rt_key    /* _1- */
                   , r1.fund_cd  /* _2- */
                   , r1.fund_nm  /* _3- */
                   , w_user_nm   /* _4- */
                   , r1.dt       /* _5- */
                   , r1.af_dt    /* _6- */
                   , r1.aek      /* _7- */
                   , r1.af_aek   /* _8- */
                   , r1.jwa      /* _9- */
                   , r1.af_jwa   /* _10- */
                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_JASAN_TONG (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fr_ymd                       IN    DATE,
    p_to_ymd                       IN    DATE,
    p_pgm_id                       IN    VARCHAR,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 통계표(jasan_tong) 생성
--
    w_link_corp_gr                 VARCHAR (8);
    w                              jasan_tong%rowtype;
    w_misu_ija_sy                  NUMBER;
    w_jibun_aa                     NUMBER;
    w_sun_tot                      NUMBER;  /* 해외선물 합계 */
    w_tot_sy                       NUMBER;  /* 해외자산 만의 합계 */

    w_j8_bisang                    NUMBER;
    w_j8_kosdaq                    NUMBER;
    w_j8_sang                      NUMBER;
    w_j8_chui_aek                  NUMBER;
BEGIN
    w_link_corp_gr := F_LINK_CORP_GR (p_corp_gr);

    DELETE FROM JASAN_TONG  /* 자산통계 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     BETWEEN p_fr_ymd AND p_to_ymd;

    DELETE FROM JASAN_TONG_SY   /* 자산통계 해외 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     BETWEEN p_fr_ymd AND p_to_ymd;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.ymd                           /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_cd                       /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                 /* _3- */
             , ia.series_gb                     /* _4- */
             , t1.jasan_tot_aek                 /* _5- */
             , t1.sun_jasan_aek                 /* _6- */
             , t1.real_jasan_aek                /* _7- */
             , t1.cash_aek                      /* _8- */
             , t1.ots_aek                       /* _9- */
             , t1.seolj_jwa                     /* _10- */
             , t1.wonbon_aek      AS seolj_aek  /* _11- */
             , CASE WHEN ia.fund_currency != 'KRW'
                    THEN F_CURRENCY_RT (p_corp_gr, t1.ymd, ia.fund_currency)
               END                AS trans_rt   /* _12- */
          FROM UZM0UH t1  /* 정보계 신탁재산 운용현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                        BETWEEN p_fr_ymd AND p_to_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, t1.ymd + 1) > t1.ymd
           AND t1.fund_currency              = 'KRW'
           AND ia.corp_gr                    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                    = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd              <= t1.ymd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd              <= t1.ymd
    ) loop
        -- OTS종목 일단 TRS만 처리 다른 OTS 발생시 분리 필요
        SELECT SUM(NVL(BFIL_AEK,0) + NVL(UP_AEK,0) - NVL(DW_AEK,0) + NVL(SONIK,0))
          INTO w.ots
          FROM OTS0OM t1  /* OTS 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = xx.ymd;

        -- 주식
        SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN jb.sosok_gb='B'
                            THEN NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                         + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                         + NVL(t1.sonik,0)
                       END),0)                                                                                  /* _1- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN jb.sosok_gb='C'
                            THEN NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                         + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0) +
                                 NVL(t1.sonik,0)
                       END),0)                                                                                  /* _2- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN jb.sosok_gb='3'
                            THEN NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                         + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                         + NVL(t1.sonik,0)
                       END),0)                                                                                  /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN INSTR('BC3', jb.sosok_gb)=0
                            THEN NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                         + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                         + NVL(t1.sonik,0)
                       END),0)                                                                                  /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                               + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)),0)  /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.woos_ilban_gb='0'
                            THEN 0
                            ELSE NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                         + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                         + NVL(t1.sonik,0)
                       END),0)                                                                                  /* _6- */
          INTO w.ju_bisang    /* _1- */
             , w.ju_kosdaq    /* _2- */
             , w.suik_etf     /* _3- */
             , w.ju_sang      /* _4- */
             , w.ju_chui_aek  /* _5- */
             , w.ju_woos      /* _6- */
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
           AND NVL(t1.BFIL_BOYU_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.UP_JUSU,0) - NVL(t1.DW_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.gongs_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_jusu,0) > 0
           AND jb.balh_co  = t1.balh_co
           AND jb.sosok_gb != '8';

        w_j8_bisang   := 0;
        w_j8_kosdaq   := 0;
        w_j8_sang     := 0;
        w_j8_chui_aek := 0;

        -- KDR KR8
        SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN jj.danc_gb='B'
