                            THEN NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                         + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                         + NVL(t1.sonik,0)
                       END),0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN jj.danc_gb IN ('C','D','G')
                            THEN NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                         + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                         + NVL(t1.sonik,0)
                       END),0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN INSTR('BCDG', jj.danc_gb)=0
                            THEN NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                         + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                         + NVL(t1.sonik,0)
                       END),0)
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                               + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)),0)
          INTO w_j8_bisang
             , w_j8_kosdaq
             , w_j8_sang
             , w_j8_chui_aek
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             , SJM0JJ jj  /* 주식종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = xx.ymd
           AND jj.balh_co IN (SELECT balh_co
                                FROM SJX0JB ta  /* 발행기관 */
                               WHERE sosok_gb = '8')
           AND jj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd;

        w.ju_bisang   := NVL(w.ju_bisang  , 0) + NVL(w_j8_bisang,0);
        w.ju_kosdaq   := NVL(w.ju_kosdaq  , 0) + NVL(w_j8_kosdaq,0);
        w.ju_sang     := NVL(w.ju_sang    , 0) + NVL(w_j8_sang,0);
        w.ju_chui_aek := NVL(w.ju_chui_aek, 0) + NVL(w_j8_chui_aek,0);

        -- 현금(shm0hm)에서 보유하고 있는 CASH_gb = 'AA' 지분증권있는 있는 경우
        -- 현금합계에서 제외하고 주식의 합계에 포함
        SELECT NVL(SUM(t1.siga_aek),0)
          INTO w_jibun_aa
          FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
             , SHM0HJ hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = xx.ymd
           AND hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND hj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND hj.cash_cd = 'AA'
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd;

        -- 해외주식
        SELECT NVL(SUM(won_pyunga_aek),0)
          INTO w.ju_over
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
           AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb = '1';

        w.ju_tot := NVL(w.ju_sang,0) + NVL(w.ju_kosdaq,0) + NVL(w.ju_bisang,0) + w_jibun_aa;

        -- 선물, 옵션
        -- sm_tr_gb : '1'(선물매입), '2'(선물매도), '3'(콜매입), '4'(콜매도), '5'(풋매입), '6'(풋매도)
        SELECT ROUND (SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='1' THEN (NVL(t1.pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(t1.up_gyey_su,0) - NVL(t1.dw_gyey_su,0)) * NVL(tg.close,0) * NVL(kj.unit_aek,0) END),0)  /* _1- */
             , ROUND (SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='2' THEN (NVL(t1.pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(t1.up_gyey_su,0) - NVL(t1.dw_gyey_su,0)) * NVL(tg.close,0) * NVL(kj.unit_aek,0) END),0)  /* _2- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='3' THEN NVL(t1.pass_chui_ga,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_ga,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_ga,0) END),0)                                              /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='3' THEN NVL(t1.pass_chui_ga,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_ga,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_ga,0) + NVL(t1.pyunga_sonik,0) END),0)                     /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='4' THEN NVL(t1.pass_chui_ga,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_ga,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_ga,0) END),0)                                              /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='4' THEN NVL(t1.pass_chui_ga,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_ga,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_ga,0) + NVL(t1.pyunga_sonik,0) END),0)                     /* _6- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='5' THEN NVL(t1.pass_chui_ga,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_ga,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_ga,0) END),0)                                              /* _7- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='5' THEN NVL(t1.pass_chui_ga,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_ga,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_ga,0) + NVL(t1.pyunga_sonik,0) END),0)                     /* _8- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='6' THEN NVL(t1.pass_chui_ga,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_ga,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_ga,0) END),0)                                              /* _9- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='6' THEN NVL(t1.pass_chui_ga,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_ga,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_ga,0) + NVL(t1.pyunga_sonik,0) END),0)                     /* _10- */
          INTO w.sun_meib           /* _1- */
             , w.sun_medo           /* _2- */
             , w.c_opt_meib_chui    /* _3- */
             , w.c_opt_meib_pyunga  /* _4- */
             , w.c_opt_medo_chui    /* _5- */
             , w.c_opt_medo_pyunga  /* _6- */
             , w.p_opt_meib_chui    /* _7- */
             , w.p_opt_meib_pyunga  /* _8- */
             , w.p_opt_medo_chui    /* _9- */
             , w.p_opt_medo_pyunga  /* _10- */
          FROM SSM0KM t1  /* 파생 보유현황 */
             , SJT1TG tg  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
             , SSX0KJ kj  /* 파생종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd   = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd       = xx.ymd
           AND tg.ymd       = F_TRADE_YMD(xx.ymd,'-')
           AND tg.koscom_cd = t1.sj_cd
           AND kj.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr
           AND kj.sj_cd     = t1.sj_cd;

        -- 국고채금리 선물
        -- sm_tr_gb : '1'(선물매입), '2'(선물매도)
        SELECT ROUND (SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='1'
                               THEN (NVL(t1.pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(t1.up_gyey_su,0) - NVL(t1.dw_gyey_su,0)) * NVL(tg.close,0) * NVL(kj.unit_aek,0)
                          END),0)
             , ROUND (SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='2'
                               THEN (NVL(t1.pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(t1.up_gyey_su,0) - NVL(t1.dw_gyey_su,0)) * NVL(tg.close,0) * NVL(kj.unit_aek,0)
                          END),0)
          INTO w.sun_meib_bond
             , w.sun_medo_bond
          FROM SSM0KM t1  /* 파생 보유현황 */
             , SJT1TG tg  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
             , SSX0KJ kj  /* 파생종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd   = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd       = xx.ymd
           AND tg.ymd       = F_TRADE_YMD(xx.ymd,'-')
           AND tg.koscom_cd = t1.sj_cd
           AND kj.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr
           AND kj.sj_cd     = t1.sj_cd
           AND kj.jasan     IN ('XX');

        --        SELECT NVL(SUM(nvl(pass_cash_aek,0) + nvl(day_up_aek,0) - nvl(day_dw_aek,0)),0)
        --             , NVL(SUM(nvl(pass_daey_aek,0) + nvl(up_daey_aek,0) - nvl(dw_daey_aek,0)),0)
        --          INTO w.sun_cash
        --             , w.sun_daey
        --        FROM   SSM0WG t1
        --        WHERE  t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
        --          AND  t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
        --          AND  t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
        --          AND  t1.CURRENCY = 'KRW';

        -- 채권
        w.bond_tot         := 0;
        w.bond_10          := 0;
        w.bond_20          := 0;
        w.bond_30          := 0;
        w.bond_31          := 0;
        w.bond_321         := 0;
        w.bond_322         := 0;
        w.bond_323         := 0;
        w.bond_331         := 0;
        w.bond_332         := 0;
        w.bond_333         := 0;
        w.bond_334         := 0;
        w.bond_39          := 0;
        w.bond_60          := 0;
        w.bond_gongmo      := 0;
        w.bond_samo        := 0;
        w.bond_bojng       := 0;
        w.bond_mubojng     := 0;
        w.bond_stock       := 0;
        w.bond_hoisa_ilban := 0;
        w.bond_husun       := 0;
        w.bond_abs         := 0;

        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.jm_cd                           /* _1- */
                 , cj.bond_attr                       /* _2- */
                 , cj.bond_cd                         /* _3- */
                 , ka.husunwi_gb                      /* _4- */
                 , cj.bojng_co                        /* _5- */
                 , cj.mojib_gb                        /* _6- */
                 , cj.balh_co                         /* _7- */
                 , CASE WHEN NVL(ka.ydong_gb,'00') != '00'
                        THEN 'Y'
                        ELSE 'N'
                   END                 AS abs_gb      /* _8- */
                 , NVL(t1.siga_aek,0)  AS pyunga_aek  /* _9- */
              FROM SCM0CM     t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
                 , SCM0CJ     cj  /* 채권종목 */
                 , SZM0IA     ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 , SCM0CJ_KAP ka  /* 한국자산평가 (채권발행정보) */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd         = xx.ymd
               AND cj.corp_gr     = w_link_corp_gr
               AND cj.jm_cd       = t1.jm_cd
               AND ia.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd     = t1.fund_cd
               AND ka.as_cj_cd(+) = NVL(cj.as_cj_cd, cj.jm_cd)
        ) loop
            w.bond_tot := w.bond_tot + x1.pyunga_aek;
            if  x1.bond_attr = '1'      then    w.bond_10 := w.bond_10 + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.bond_attr = '2'    then    w.bond_20 := w.bond_20 + x1.pyunga_aek;
            else
                BEGIN
                    SELECT CASE WHEN comp_bu='321' THEN x1.pyunga_aek ELSE 0 END + w.bond_321  /* _1- */
                         , CASE WHEN comp_bu='322' THEN x1.pyunga_aek ELSE 0 END + w.bond_322  /* _2- */
                         , CASE WHEN comp_bu='323' THEN x1.pyunga_aek ELSE 0 END + w.bond_323  /* _3- */
                         , CASE WHEN comp_bu='331' THEN x1.pyunga_aek ELSE 0 END + w.bond_331  /* _4- */
                         , CASE WHEN comp_bu='332' THEN x1.pyunga_aek ELSE 0 END + w.bond_332  /* _5- */
                         , CASE WHEN comp_bu='333' THEN x1.pyunga_aek ELSE 0 END + w.bond_333  /* _6- */
                         , CASE WHEN comp_bu='334' THEN x1.pyunga_aek ELSE 0 END + w.bond_334  /* _7- */
                         , CASE WHEN comp_bu='390' THEN x1.pyunga_aek ELSE 0 END + w.bond_39   /* _8- */
                      INTO w.bond_321  /* _1- */
                         , w.bond_322  /* _2- */
                         , w.bond_323  /* _3- */
                         , w.bond_331  /* _4- */
                         , w.bond_332  /* _5- */
                         , w.bond_333  /* _6- */
                         , w.bond_334  /* _7- */
                         , w.bond_39   /* _8- */
                      FROM SJX0JB t1  /* 발행기관 */
                     WHERE balh_co = x1.balh_co
                       AND comp_bu IS NOT NULL;

                    if  x1.bond_attr = '3'  then    w.bond_30 := w.bond_30 + x1.pyunga_aek;
                    else
                        w.bond_60 := w.bond_60 + x1.pyunga_aek;

                        -- 교환사채/신주인수권부사채/전환사채
                        if  x1.bond_cd IN ('7','S','T','6','Q','R','5','N','P') then
                                w.bond_stock       := w.bond_stock + x1.pyunga_aek;
                        else    w.bond_hoisa_ilban := w.bond_hoisa_ilban + x1.pyunga_aek;
                        end if;

                        if NVL (x1.husunwi_gb,'1') != '1'   then    w.bond_husun := w.bond_husun + x1.pyunga_aek;
                        end if;

                        if  x1.mojib_gb = '2'   then
                            w.bond_samo := w.bond_samo + x1.pyunga_aek;
                            if  x1.abs_gb = 'Y' then    w.bond_abs := w.bond_abs + x1.pyunga_aek;
                            else
                                if  x1.bojng_co IS NOT NULL then
                                        w.bond_bojng   := w.bond_bojng + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                else    w.bond_mubojng := w.bond_mubojng + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                end if;
                            end if;
                        else
                            w.bond_gongmo := w.bond_gongmo + x1.pyunga_aek;
                            if  x1.abs_gb = 'Y' then    w.bond_abs := w.bond_abs + x1.pyunga_aek;
                            else
                                if  x1.bojng_co IS NOT NULL then
                                        w.bond_bojng   := w.bond_bojng + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                else    w.bond_mubojng := w.bond_mubojng + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                end if;
                            end if;
                        end if;
                    end if;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    if  x1.bond_attr = '3'      then    w.bond_30 := w.bond_30 + x1.pyunga_aek;
                        if  x1.bond_cd = '101'  then    w.bond_31 := w.bond_31 + x1.pyunga_aek;
                        end if;
                    else
                        w.bond_60 := w.bond_60 + x1.pyunga_aek;

                        -- 교환사채/신주인수권부사채/전환사채
                        if  x1.bond_cd IN ('7','S','T','6','Q','R','5','N','P') then
                                w.bond_stock       := w.bond_stock + x1.pyunga_aek;
                        else    w.bond_hoisa_ilban := w.bond_hoisa_ilban + x1.pyunga_aek;
                        end if;

                        if NVL (x1.husunwi_gb,'1') != '1'   then    w.bond_husun := w.bond_husun + x1.pyunga_aek;
                        end if;

                        if  x1.mojib_gb = '2'   then
                            w.bond_samo := w.bond_samo + x1.pyunga_aek;
                            if  x1.abs_gb = 'Y' then    w.bond_abs := w.bond_abs + x1.pyunga_aek;
                            else
                                if  x1.bojng_co IS NOT NULL then
                                        w.bond_bojng   := w.bond_bojng + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                else    w.bond_mubojng := w.bond_mubojng + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                end if;
                            end if;
                        else
                            w.bond_gongmo := w.bond_gongmo + x1.pyunga_aek;
                            if  x1.abs_gb = 'Y' then    w.bond_abs := w.bond_abs + x1.pyunga_aek;
                            else
                                if  x1.bojng_co IS NOT NULL then
                                        w.bond_bojng   := w.bond_bojng + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                else    w.bond_mubojng := w.bond_mubojng + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                end if;
                            end if;
                        end if;
                    end if;
                END;
            end if;
        end loop;

        -- 현금
        w.cash_tot   := 0;
        w.cash_10    := 0;
        w.cash_20    := 0;
        w.cash_31    := 0;
        w.cash_32    := 0;
        w.cash_50    := 0;
        w.cash_60    := 0;
        w.cash_70    := 0;
        w.cash_80    := 0;
        w.cash_90    := 0;
        w.cash_cheng := 0;
        w.cash_etc   := 0;
        w.bond_s     := 0;  /* 전단채 추가 20210304 yjs */

        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.jm_cd                                                     /* _1- */
                 , hj.cash_cd                                                   /* _2- */
                 , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aek,0)
                                           - NVL(t1.medo_aek,0)  AS chui_aek    /* _3- */
                 , NVL(t1.siga_aek,0)                            AS pyunga_aek  /* _4- */
                 , NVL(t1.anbun_aek,0)                           AS anbun_aek   /* _5- */
              FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
                 , SHM0HJ hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     = xx.ymd
               AND hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
               AND hj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
               AND hj.cash_cd NOT IN ('90','AA')
               AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
        ) loop
            w.cash_tot := w.cash_tot + x1.pyunga_aek;

            if  x1.cash_cd = '10'           then    w.cash_10  := w.cash_10 + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.cash_cd = '20'         then    w.cash_20  := w.cash_20 + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.cash_cd = '31'         then    w.cash_31  := w.cash_31 + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.cash_cd = '32'         then    w.cash_32  := w.cash_32 + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.cash_cd = '50'         then    w.cash_50  := w.cash_50 + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.cash_cd = '60'         then    w.cash_60  := w.cash_60 + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.cash_cd IN ('71','72') then    w.cash_70  := w.cash_70 + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.cash_cd IN ('ZS')      then    w.bond_s   := w.bond_s + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.cash_cd = '80'         then    w.cash_80  := w.cash_80 + x1.pyunga_aek;
            else                                    w.cash_etc := w.cash_etc + x1.pyunga_aek;
            end if;
        end loop;

        -- 세이프가드수수료 미지급금 처리
        --        SELECT NVL(sum(sang_ds_aek),0) + w.ju_misu_ji
        --          INTO w.ju_misu_ji
        --        FROM   SKM0ET t1
        --        WHERE  t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
        --          AND  t1.ymd     = xx.ymd
        --          AND  t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
        --          AND  t1.sang_gb = 'A';

        -- 대출채권미수령액 기타현금액 처리
        --        SELECT NVL(sum(sang_ds_aek),0) + w.cash_etc
        --          INTO w.cash_etc
        --        FROM   SKM0ET t1
        --        WHERE  t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
        --          AND  t1.ymd     = xx.ymd
        --          AND  t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
        --          AND  t1.sang_gb = 'B';

        -- 예금잔액
        for x1 IN (
            SELECT F_DANGJ (chadae_gb, junj, dr_aek, cr_aek)  AS dangj
              FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd           = xx.ymd
               AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
               AND t1.gwamok        = '10101'
               AND t1.FUND_CURRENCY = 'KRW'
        ) loop
            w.cash_tot := w.cash_tot + x1.dangj;
            w.cash_90  := w.cash_90 + x1.dangj;
        end loop;

        -- 외화기준가펀드 외화예금잔액
        for x1 IN (
            SELECT F_DANGJ (chadae_gb, junj, dr_aek, cr_aek)  AS dangj
              FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd           = xx.ymd
               AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
               AND t1.gwamok        = '10151'
               AND t1.FUND_CURRENCY = 'KRW'
               AND ia.corp_gr       = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd
        ) loop
            w.cash_tot := w.cash_tot + x1.dangj;
            w.cash_90  := w.cash_90 + x1.dangj;
        end loop;

        -- 수익증권
        SELECT NVL(SUM(chui_aek),0)
             , NVL(SUM(sonik),0)
          INTO w.suik_aek
             , w.suik_suik
          FROM (SELECT NVL(bfil_aek,0) + NVL(up_aek,0) - NVL(dw_aek,0)
                                       - NVL(gyul_aek,0)  AS chui_aek
                     , sonik
                  FROM SJM0SM t1  /* (모자 / Multi Class) 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd     = xx.ymd
                UNION ALL
                SELECT NVL(bfil_aek,0) + NVL(up_aek,0) - NVL(dw_aek,0)
                     , sonik
                  FROM SJM5SM t1  /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd     = xx.ymd
                 ) tt;

        -- 수익증권
        -- 현재는 모두 투자신탁 또는 클래스이므로 구분없이 합계처리
        SELECT NVL(SUM(fund),0)
          INTO w.fund
          FROM (SELECT NVL(bfil_aek,0) + NVL(up_aek,0) - NVL(dw_aek,0)
                                       - NVL(gyul_aek,0) + NVL(sonik,0)  AS fund
                  FROM SJM0SM t1  /* (모자 / Multi Class) 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd     = xx.ymd
                UNION ALL
                SELECT NVL(bfil_aek,0) + NVL(up_aek,0) - NVL(dw_aek,0) + NVL(sonik,0)
                  FROM SJM5SM t1  /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd     = xx.ymd
                 ) tt;

        -- 공모청약금,주식미수입금/미지급금,미수배당금
        w.ju_misu_ip := 0;
        w.ju_misu_ji := 0;
        w.misu_baed  := 0;
        for x1 IN (
            SELECT gwamok
                 , F_DANGJ (chadae_gb, junj, dr_aek, cr_aek)  AS dangj
              FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd           = xx.ymd
               AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
               AND t1.gwamok        IN ('10103','12001','12002','12300','20201','20202')
               AND t1.fund_currency = 'KRW'
        ) loop
            if  x1.gwamok = '10103' then    -- 공모청약금
                w.cash_tot   := w.cash_tot + x1.dangj;
                w.cash_cheng := w.cash_cheng + x1.dangj;

            elsif x1.gwamok IN ('12001','12002')    then    -- 주식/채권 미수입금
                w.ju_misu_ip := w.ju_misu_ip + x1.dangj;

            elsif x1.gwamok = '12300'   then    -- 미수배당금
                w.misu_baed := w.misu_baed + x1.dangj;
            else                                            /* 주식/채권 미지급금 */
                w.ju_misu_ji := w.ju_misu_ji + x1.dangj;
            end if;
        end loop;

        -- 통계표 Insert
        INSERT INTO JASAN_TONG  /* 자산통계 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr                            /* _1-p_corp_gr */
               , xx.ymd                               /* _2-xx.ymd */
               , xx.fund_cd                           /* _3-xx.fund_cd */
               , xx.sun_jasan_aek                     /* _4-xx.sun_jasan_aek */
               , xx.jasan_tot_aek                     /* _5-xx.jasan_tot_aek */
               , xx.real_jasan_aek                    /* _6-xx.real_jasan_aek */
               , NVL(w.JU_CHUI_AEK,0)                 /* _7-, */
               , NVL(w.JU_TOT,0)                      /* _8-, */
               , NVL(w.JU_SANG,0)                     /* _9-, */
               , NVL(w.JU_KOSDAQ,0)                   /* _10-, */
               , NVL(w.JU_BISANG,0)                   /* _11-, */
               , NVL(w.JU_WOOS,0)                     /* _12-, */
               , NVL(w.JU_OVER,0)                     /* _13-, */
               , NVL(w.SUN_CASH,0)                    /* _14-, */
               , NVL(w.SUN_DAEY,0)                    /* _15-, */
               , NVL(w.SUN_MEIB,0)                    /* _16-, */
               , NVL(w.SUN_MEDO,0)                    /* _17-, */
               , NVL(w.SUN_MEIB_BOND,0)               /* _18-, */
               , NVL(w.SUN_MEDO_BOND,0)               /* _19-, */
               , NVL(w.SUN_MEIB_OVER,0)               /* _20-, */
               , NVL(w.SUN_MEDO_OVER,0)               /* _21-, */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_CHUI,0)             /* _22-, */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA,0)           /* _23-, */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_CHUI,0)             /* _24-, */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA,0)           /* _25-, */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_CHUI_B,0)           /* _26-, */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA_B,0)         /* _27-, */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_CHUI_B,0)           /* _28-, */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA_B,0)         /* _29-, */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_CHUI_OVER,0)        /* _30-, */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA_OVER,0)      /* _31-, */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_CHUI_OVER,0)        /* _32-, */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA_OVER,0)      /* _33-, */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_CHUI,0)             /* _34-, */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA,0)           /* _35-, */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_CHUI,0)             /* _36-, */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA,0)           /* _37-, */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_CHUI_B,0)           /* _38-, */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA_B,0)         /* _39-, */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_CHUI_B,0)           /* _40-, */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA_B,0)         /* _41-, */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_CHUI_OVER,0)        /* _42-, */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA_OVER,0)      /* _43-, */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_CHUI_OVER,0)        /* _44-, */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA_OVER,0)      /* _45-, */
               , NVL(w.SWAP_MEIB_CHUI,0)              /* _46-, */
               , NVL(w.SWAP_MEIB_PYUNGA,0)            /* _47-, */
               , NVL(w.SWAP_MEDO_CHUI,0)              /* _48-, */
               , NVL(w.SWAP_MEDO_PYUNGA,0)            /* _49-, */
               , NVL(w.FE_MEIB_CHUI,0)                /* _50-, */
               , NVL(w.FE_MEIB_PYUNGA,0)              /* _51-, */
               , NVL(w.FE_MEDO_CHUI,0)                /* _52-, */
               , NVL(w.FE_MEDO_PYUNGA,0)              /* _53-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_TOT,0) + NVL(w.bond_s,0)  /* _54-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_10,0)                     /* _55-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_20,0)                     /* _56-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_30,0)                     /* _57-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_31,0)                     /* _58-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_321,0)                    /* _59-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_322,0)                    /* _60-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_323,0)                    /* _61-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_331,0)                    /* _62-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_332,0)                    /* _63-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_333,0)                    /* _64-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_334,0)                    /* _65-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_39,0)                     /* _66-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_STOCK,0)                  /* _67-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_HOISA_ILBAN,0)            /* _68-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_HUSUN,0)                  /* _69-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_60,0)                     /* _70-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_GONGMO,0)                 /* _71-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_SAMO,0)                   /* _72-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_BOJNG,0)                  /* _73-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_MUBOJNG,0)                /* _74-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_ABS,0)                    /* _75-, */
               , NVL(w.BOND_OVER,0)                   /* _76-, */
               , NVL(w.CASH_TOT,0)                    /* _77-, */
               , NVL(w.CASH_10,0)                     /* _78-, */
               , NVL(w.CASH_20,0)                     /* _79-, */
               , NVL(w.CASH_31,0)                     /* _80-, */
               , NVL(w.CASH_32,0)                     /* _81-, */
               , NVL(w.CASH_50,0)                     /* _82-, */
               , NVL(w.CASH_60,0)                     /* _83-, */
               , NVL(w.CASH_70,0)                     /* _84-, */
               , NVL(w.CASH_80,0)                     /* _85-, */
               , NVL(w.CASH_90,0)                     /* _86-, */
               , NVL(w.CASH_ETC,0)                    /* _87-, */
               , NVL(w.CASH_OVER,0)                   /* _88-, */
               , NVL(w.SUIK_AEK,0)                    /* _89-, */
               , NVL(w.SUIK_SUIK,0)                   /* _90-, */
               , NVL(w.SUIK_ETF,0)                    /* _91-, */
               , NVL(w.JU_MISU_IP,0)                  /* _92-, */
               , NVL(w.JU_MISU_JI,0)                  /* _93-, */
               , NVL(w.MISU_BAED,0)                   /* _94-, */
               , NVL(w.CASH_CHENG,0)                  /* _95-, */
               , NVL(w.OTS,0)                         /* _96-, */
               , NVL(w.FUND,0)                        /* _97-, */
               , NVL(w.INVEST_CORP,0)                 /* _98-, */
               , NVL(w.ETF,0)                         /* _99-, */
               , NVL(w.FUND_OVER,0)                   /* _100-, */
               , NVL(w.UNPAID_BOSU,0)                 /* _101-, */
               , NVL(w.UNPAID_CLOSE,0)                /* _102-, */
               , NVL(w.REPAID_IIK,0)                  /* _103-, */
               , xx.seolj_jwa                         /* _104-xx.seolj_jwa */
               , xx.seolj_aek                         /* _105-xx.seolj_aek */
               , w.bond_s                             /* _106-w.bond_s */
               );
    end loop;

    --  해외부분 자산통계 (JASAN_TONG_SY) 생성
    w := NULL;  /* 전체변수 */

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.ymd                          /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_cd                      /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                /* _3- */
             , ia.series_gb                    /* _4- */
             , t1.jasan_tot_aek                /* _5- */
             , t1.sun_jasan_aek                /* _6- */
             , t1.seolj_jwa                    /* _7- */
             , t1.wonbon_aek     AS seolj_aek  /* _8- */
          FROM UZM0UH t1  /* 정보계 신탁재산 운용현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                        BETWEEN p_fr_ymd AND p_to_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, t1.ymd + 1) > t1.ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr                    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                    = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fund_currency              != 'KRW'
           AND ia.fund_currency              = t1.fund_currency
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd              <= t1.ymd
    ) loop
        -- 해외자산총액의 합계 REAL_JASAN_AEK에 처리함
        w_tot_sy := 0;

        -- 주식
        SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_ATTR='320'
                            THEN NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                       END),0)                                                 /* _1-장외 */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_ATTR='310'
                            THEN NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                       END),0)                                                 /* _2-코스닥 */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_ATTR IN ('330','340','390')
                            THEN NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                       END),0)                                                 /* _3-기타 */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_ATTR='300'
                            THEN NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                       END),0)                                                 /* _4-상장 */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.fcur_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.fcur_up_chui_aek,0)
                                                    - NVL(t1.fcur_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                    + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK,0)),0)  /* _5-취득가 */
             , 0                                                               /* _6-우선주 */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0)),0)                           /* _7-해외주식합계 */
          INTO w.ju_bisang    /* _1- */
             , w.ju_kosdaq    /* _2- */
             , w.suik_etf     /* _3- */
             , w.ju_sang      /* _4- */
             , w.ju_chui_aek  /* _5- */
             , w.ju_woos      /* _6- */
             , w.ju_over      /* _7- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
           AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb = '1'
           AND ya.sj_gb    != '2';

        w.ju_tot := NVL(w.ju_over, 0);                    /* 해외주식합계 */
        w_tot_sy := NVL(w_tot_sy , 0) + NVL(w.ju_tot,0);  /* 해외자산합계 */

        -- 해외 선물/옵션
        w.sun_meib := 0;
        w.sun_medo := 0;

        w.sun_meib_bond := 0;
        w.sun_medo_bond := 0;

        w.c_opt_meib_chui   := 0;
        w.c_opt_meib_pyunga := 0;
        w.c_opt_medo_chui   := 0;
        w.c_opt_medo_pyunga := 0;
        w.p_opt_meib_chui   := 0;
        w.p_opt_meib_pyunga := 0;
        w.p_opt_medo_chui   := 0;
        w.p_opt_medo_pyunga := 0;

        w_sun_tot := 0;

        -- 해외 선물/옵션
        -- sm_tr_gb : '1'(선물매입), '2'(선물매도), '3'(콜매입), '4'(콜매도), '5'(풋매입), '6'(풋매도)
        -- 해외 국고채금리선물
        -- sm_tr_gb : '1'(선물매입), '2'(선물매도)
        SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='1' AND ya.jasan_attr != 'A11' THEN NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                       END),0)                        /* _1-매입선물취득액 */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='2' AND ya.jasan_attr != 'A11' THEN NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                       END),0)                        /* _2-매도선물취득액 */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='1' AND ya.jasan_attr='A11' THEN NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                       END),0)                        /* _3-매입 금리선물취득액 */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='2' AND ya.jasan_attr='A11' THEN NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                       END),0)                        /* _4-매도 금리선물취득액 */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='3' THEN NVL(NVL(t1.FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.FCUR_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.FCUR_DW_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_FCUR_AEK,0),0)
                       END),0)                        /* _5-콜매수취득액 */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='3' THEN NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                       END),0)                        /* _6-콜매수평가액 */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='4' THEN NVL(NVL(t1.FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.FCUR_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.FCUR_DW_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_FCUR_AEK,0),0)
                       END),0)                        /* _7-콜매도취득액 */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='4' THEN NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                       END),0)                        /* _8-콜매도평가액 */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='5' THEN NVL(NVL(t1.FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.FCUR_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.FCUR_DW_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_FCUR_AEK,0),0)
                       END),0)                        /* _9-풋매수취득액 */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='5' THEN NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                       END),0)                        /* _10-풋매수평가액 */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='6' THEN NVL(NVL(t1.FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.FCUR_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.FCUR_DW_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_FCUR_AEK,0),0)
                       END),0)                        /* _11-풋매도취득액 */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='6' THEN NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                       END),0)                        /* _12-풋매도평가액 */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0)),0)  /* _13-해외장내선물합계 */
          INTO w.sun_meib           /* _1- */
             , w.sun_medo           /* _2- */
             , w.sun_meib_bond      /* _3- */
             , w.sun_medo_bond      /* _4- */
             , w.c_opt_meib_chui    /* _5- */
             , w.c_opt_meib_pyunga  /* _6- */
             , w.c_opt_medo_chui    /* _7- */
             , w.c_opt_medo_pyunga  /* _8- */
             , w.p_opt_meib_chui    /* _9- */
             , w.p_opt_meib_pyunga  /* _10- */
             , w.p_opt_medo_chui    /* _11- */
             , w.p_opt_medo_pyunga  /* _12- */
             , w_sun_tot            /* _13- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
           AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb = 'A';

        -- 해외 위탁증거금
        --        SELECT NVL(sum(nvl(pass_cash_aek,0) + nvl(day_up_aek,0) - nvl(day_dw_aek,0)),0)
        --             , NVL(sum(nvl(pass_daey_aek,0) + nvl(up_daey_aek,0) - nvl(dw_daey_aek,0)),0)
        --          INTO w.sun_cash
        --             , w.sun_daey
        --        FROM   SSM0WG t1
        --        WHERE  t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
        --          AND  t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
        --          AND  t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
        --          AND  t1.CURRENCY != 'KRW';

        w_tot_sy := NVL(w_tot_sy,0) + NVL(w.sun_cash,0);  /* 해외선물옵션자산합계에는 가수제외하고 증거금만 합산함 */

        -- 채권
        w.bond_tot         := 0;
        w.bond_10          := 0;
        w.bond_20          := 0;
        w.bond_30          := 0;
        w.bond_31          := 0;
        w.bond_321         := 0;
        w.bond_322         := 0;
        w.bond_323         := 0;
        w.bond_331         := 0;
        w.bond_332         := 0;
        w.bond_333         := 0;
        w.bond_334         := 0;
        w.bond_39          := 0;
        w.bond_60          := 0;
        w.bond_gongmo      := 0;
        w.bond_samo        := 0;
        w.bond_bojng       := 0;
        w.bond_mubojng     := 0;
        w.bond_stock       := 0;
        w.bond_hoisa_ilban := 0;
        w.bond_husun       := 0;
        w.bond_abs         := 0;

        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.jm_cd
                 , ya.JASAN_ATTR
                 , NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0)  AS pyunga_aek
              FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                 , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
               AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ya.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
               AND ya.jasan_gb = '2'
        ) loop
            w.bond_tot := w.bond_tot + x1.pyunga_aek;

            w_tot_sy := NVL(w_tot_sy,0) + NVL(x1.pyunga_aek,0);  /* 해외자산합계 */

            if  x1.JASAN_ATTR = '200'       then    w.bond_10  := w.bond_10 + x1.pyunga_aek;   -- 국채
            elsif x1.JASAN_ATTR = '210'     then    w.bond_20  := w.bond_20 + x1.pyunga_aek;   -- 지방채
            elsif x1.JASAN_ATTR = '240'     then    w.bond_30  := w.bond_30 + x1.pyunga_aek;   -- 특수채
                                                    w.bond_323 := w.bond_323 + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.JASAN_ATTR = '230'     then    w.bond_30  := w.bond_30 + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                                    w.bond_31  := w.bond_31 + x1.pyunga_aek;   /* 통안채 */
            elsif x1.JASAN_ATTR = '250'     then    w.bond_30  := w.bond_30 + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                                    w.bond_331 := w.bond_331 + x1.pyunga_aek;

            elsif x1.JASAN_ATTR = '261'     then    w.bond_60      := w.bond_60 + x1.pyunga_aek;       -- 회사채
                                                    w.bond_bojng   := w.bond_bojng + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.JASAN_ATTR = '262'     then    w.bond_60      := w.bond_60 + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                                    w.bond_mubojng := w.bond_mubojng + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.JASAN_ATTR = '263'     then    w.bond_60      := w.bond_60 + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                                    w.bond_abs     := w.bond_abs + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.JASAN_ATTR = '269'     then    w.bond_60      := w.bond_60 + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                                    w.bond_samo    := w.bond_samo + x1.pyunga_aek;
            else                                    w.bond_60      := w.bond_60 + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                                    w.bond_samo    := w.bond_samo + x1.pyunga_aek;     /* 기타채권 : 사모회사채에 합산 */
            end if;
        end loop;

        -- 현금
        w.cash_tot   := 0;
        w.cash_10    := 0;
        w.cash_20    := 0;
        w.cash_31    := 0;
        w.cash_32    := 0;
        w.cash_50    := 0;
        w.cash_60    := 0;
        w.cash_70    := 0;
        w.cash_80    := 0;
        w.cash_90    := 0;

            SELECT t1.jm_cd

                 , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd

            w_tot_sy := NVL(w_tot_sy,0) + NVL(x1.pyunga_aek,0);  /* 해외자산합계 */

            if  x1.JASAN_ATTR = '190'   then
                    w.cash_etc := w.cash_etc + x1.pyunga_aek;  /* 기타현금성자선 */
            else    w.cash_90  := w.cash_90 + x1.pyunga_aek;   /* 외화예금 */
            end if;
        end loop;


        -- 수익증권
        w.suik_suik := 0;  /* 수익증권 이익 */
        w.FUND      := 0;  /* 수익증권합 */
        w.SUIK_AEK  := 0;  /* 수익증권 */
        w.SUIK_ETF  := 0;  /* 기타수익증권 */

        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.jm_cd
                 , NVL(ya.JASAN_ATTR,'400')   AS jasan_attr
                 , NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0)  AS pyunga_aek
              FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                 , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
               AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ya.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
               AND ya.jasan_gb = '1'
               AND ya.sj_gb    = '2'
        ) loop
                w.FUND     := 0;
                w.SUIK_AEK := 0;  /* 수익증권 */
                w.SUIK_ETF := 0;  /* 기타수익증권 */

                w_tot_sy := NVL(w_tot_sy,0) + NVL(x1.pyunga_aek,0);  /* 해외자산합계 */

                if  x1.JASAN_ATTR = '400'   then
                        w.suik_aek := w.suik_aek + NVL(x1.pyunga_aek, 0);  /* 수익증권 */
                ELSE    w.suik_etf := w.suik_etf + NVL(x1.pyunga_aek, 0);  /* 수익증권기타 */
                end if;
        end loop;

        -- 공모청약금,주식미수입금/미지급금,미수배당금
        w.ju_misu_ip := 0;
        w.ju_misu_ji := 0;
        w.misu_baed  := 0;

        for x1 IN (
            SELECT gwamok
                 , F_DANGJ (chadae_gb, junj, dr_aek, cr_aek)  AS dangj
              FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd           = xx.ymd
               AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
               AND t1.gwamok        IN ('10154','10155','12051','12052','10253','12054','12351','20251','20252','20253','20254')
               AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency
        ) loop
            w_tot_sy := NVL(w_tot_sy,0) + NVL(x1.dangj,0);  /* 해외자산합계 */

            if  x1.gwamok IN ('10154','10155')  then    -- 외화 공모청약금/증거금
                w.cash_tot   := w.cash_tot + x1.dangj;
                w.cash_cheng := w.cash_cheng + x1.dangj;

            elsif x1.gwamok IN ('12051','12052','10253','12054')    then    -- 외화 주식/채권/현금/수익증권
                w.ju_misu_ip := w.ju_misu_ip + x1.dangj;

            elsif x1.gwamok = '12351'   then    -- 외화 미수배당금
                    w.misu_baed  := w.misu_baed + x1.dangj;
            else    w.ju_misu_ji := w.ju_misu_ji + x1.dangj;  /* '20251','20252','20253','20254' 주식/채권/현금/수익증권 미지급금 */
            end if;
        end loop;

        -- 해외채권이자 미수입금
        w_misu_ija_sy := 0;

        SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(fcur_pyunga_aek,0)),0)
          INTO w_misu_ija_sy
          FROM SYT0YS t1  /* 해외 수도결제 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd                     = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd                         = xx.ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                       = 'E22'
           AND NVL(t1.GYULJE_YMD, xx.ymd + 1) > xx.ymd;

        w.ju_misu_ip := w.ju_misu_ip + w_misu_ija_sy;

        w_tot_sy := NVL(w_tot_sy,0) + NVL(w_misu_ija_sy,0);  /* 해외자산합계 */

        -- 통계표 Insert
        INSERT INTO JASAN_TONG_SY   /* 자산통계 해외 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr                        /* _1-p_corp_gr */
               , xx.ymd                           /* _2-xx.ymd */
               , xx.fund_cd                       /* _3-xx.fund_cd */
               , xx.fund_currency                 /* _4-xx.fund_currency */
               , xx.sun_jasan_aek                 /* _5-xx.sun_jasan_aek */
               , xx.jasan_tot_aek                 /* _6-xx.jasan_tot_aek */
               , NVL(w_tot_sy,0)                  /* _7- */
               , NVL(w.JU_CHUI_AEK,0)             /* _8- */
               , NVL(w.JU_TOT,0)                  /* _9- */
               , NVL(w.JU_SANG,0)                 /* _10- */
               , NVL(w.JU_KOSDAQ,0)               /* _11- */
               , NVL(w.JU_BISANG,0)               /* _12- */
               , NVL(w.JU_WOOS,0)                 /* _13- */
               , NVL(w.JU_OVER,0)                 /* _14- */
               , NVL(w.SUN_CASH,0)                /* _15- */
               , NVL(w.SUN_DAEY,0)                /* _16- */
               , NVL(w.SUN_MEIB,0)                /* _17- */
               , NVL(w.SUN_MEDO,0)                /* _18- */
               , NVL(w.SUN_MEIB_BOND,0)           /* _19- */
               , NVL(w.SUN_MEDO_BOND,0)           /* _20- */

               , NVL(w.SUN_MEDO_OVER,0)           /* _22- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_CHUI,0)         /* _23- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA,0)       /* _24- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_CHUI,0)         /* _25- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA,0)       /* _26- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_CHUI_B,0)       /* _27- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA_B,0)     /* _28- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_CHUI_B,0)       /* _29- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA_B,0)     /* _30- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_CHUI_OVER,0)    /* _31- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA_OVER,0)  /* _32- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_CHUI_OVER,0)    /* _33- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA_OVER,0)  /* _34- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_CHUI,0)         /* _35- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA,0)       /* _36- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_CHUI,0)         /* _37- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA,0)       /* _38- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_CHUI_B,0)       /* _39- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA_B,0)     /* _40- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_CHUI_B,0)       /* _41- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA_B,0)     /* _42- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_CHUI_OVER,0)    /* _43- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA_OVER,0)  /* _44- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_CHUI_OVER,0)    /* _45- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA_OVER,0)  /* _46- */
               , NVL(w.SWAP_MEIB_CHUI,0)          /* _47- */
               , NVL(w.SWAP_MEIB_PYUNGA,0)        /* _48- */
               , NVL(w.SWAP_MEDO_CHUI,0)          /* _49- */
               , NVL(w.SWAP_MEDO_PYUNGA,0)        /* _50- */
               , NVL(w.FE_MEIB_CHUI,0)            /* _51- */
               , NVL(w.FE_MEIB_PYUNGA,0)          /* _52- */
               , NVL(w.FE_MEDO_CHUI,0)            /* _53- */
               , NVL(w.FE_MEDO_PYUNGA,0)          /* _54- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_TOT,0)                /* _55- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_10,0)                 /* _56- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_20,0)                 /* _57- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_30,0)                 /* _58- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_31,0)                 /* _59- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_321,0)                /* _60- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_322,0)                /* _61- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_323,0)                /* _62- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_331,0)                /* _63- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_332,0)                /* _64- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_333,0)                /* _65- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_334,0)                /* _66- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_39,0)                 /* _67- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_STOCK,0)              /* _68- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_HOISA_ILBAN,0)        /* _69- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_HUSUN,0)              /* _70- */

               , NVL(w.BOND_GONGMO,0)             /* _72- */

               , NVL(w.BOND_BOJNG,0)              /* _74- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_MUBOJNG,0)            /* _75- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_ABS,0)                /* _76- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_OVER,0)               /* _77- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_TOT,0)                /* _78- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_10,0)                 /* _79- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_20,0)                 /* _80- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_31,0)                 /* _81- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_32,0)                 /* _82- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_50,0)                 /* _83- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_60,0)                 /* _84- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_70,0)                 /* _85- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_80,0)                 /* _86- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_90,0)                 /* _87- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_ETC,0)                /* _88- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_OVER,0)               /* _89- */
               , NVL(w.SUIK_AEK,0)                /* _90- */
               , NVL(w.SUIK_SUIK,0)               /* _91- */
               , NVL(w.SUIK_ETF,0)                /* _92- */
               , NVL(w.JU_MISU_IP,0)              /* _93- */
               , NVL(w.JU_MISU_JI,0)              /* _94- */
               , NVL(w.MISU_BAED,0)               /* _95- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_CHENG,0)              /* _96- */
               , NVL(w.OTS,0)                     /* _97- */
               , NVL(w.FUND,0)                    /* _98- */
               , NVL(w.INVEST_CORP,0)             /* _99- */
               , NVL(w.ETF,0)                     /* _100- */
               , NVL(w.FUND_OVER,0)               /* _101- */
               , NVL(w.UNPAID_BOSU,0)             /* _102- */
               , NVL(w.UNPAID_CLOSE,0)            /* _103- */
               , NVL(w.REPAID_IIK,0)              /* _104- */
               , xx.seolj_jwa                     /* _105- */
               , xx.seolj_aek                     /* _106- */
               );
    end loop;

    -- 전체변수
    w := NULL;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.ymd                          /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_cd                      /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                /* _3- */
             , ia.series_gb                    /* _4- */
             , t1.jasan_tot_aek                /* _5- */
             , t1.sun_jasan_aek                /* _6- */
             , t1.seolj_jwa                    /* _7- */
             , t1.wonbon_aek     AS seolj_aek  /* _8- */
          FROM UZM0UH t1  /* 정보계 신탁재산 운용현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd                    IN (SELECT fund_cd
                                                   FROM SYM0YZ ta  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                                                  WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                                    AND ta.ymd     BETWEEN p_fr_ymd AND p_to_ymd
                                                    AND NVL(tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0) + NVL(msd_meib_aekm,0) != 0)
           AND t1.ymd                        BETWEEN p_fr_ymd AND p_to_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, t1.ymd + 1) > t1.ymd
           AND t1.fund_currency              = 'KRW'
           AND ia.corp_gr                    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                    = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd              <= t1.ymd
    ) loop
        -- 해외자산총액의 합계 REAL_JASAN_AEK에 처리함
        w_tot_sy := 0;

        -- 주식
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_ATTR='320'
                                THEN NVL(t1.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.won_pyunga_sonik,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.won_hwan_cha,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)
                           END),0)                                                    /* _1-장외 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_ATTR='310'
                                THEN NVL(t1.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.won_pyunga_sonik,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.won_hwan_cha,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)
                           END),0)                                                    /* _2-코스닥 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_ATTR IN ('330','340','390')
                                THEN NVL(t1.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.won_pyunga_sonik,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.won_hwan_cha,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)
                           END),0)                                                    /* _3-기타 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_ATTR='300'
                                THEN NVL(t1.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.won_pyunga_sonik,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.won_hwan_cha,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)
                           END),0)                                                    /* _4-상장 */
                 , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_chui_aek,0)
                                                       - NVL(t1.won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                       + NVL(t1.RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)),0)  /* _5-취득가 */
                 , 0                                                                  /* _6-우선주 */
                 , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                       + NVL(t1.RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)
                                                       + NVL(t1.won_pyunga_sonik,0)
                                                       + NVL(t1.won_hwan_cha,0)),0)   /* _7-해외주식합계 */
              INTO w.ju_bisang    /* _1- */
                 , w.ju_kosdaq    /* _2- */
                 , w.suik_etf     /* _3- */
                 , w.ju_sang      /* _4- */
                 , w.ju_chui_aek  /* _5- */
                 , w.ju_woos      /* _6- */
                 , w.ju_over      /* _7- */
              FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                 , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
               AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ya.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
               AND ya.jasan_gb = '1'
               AND ya.sj_gb    != '2';
        else
            SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_ATTR='320'
                                THEN F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))
                           END),0)                                                                         /* _1-장외 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_ATTR='310'
                                THEN F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.fund_currency, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))
                           END),0)                                                                         /* _2-코스닥 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_ATTR IN ('330','340','390')
                                THEN F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.fund_currency, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))
                           END),0)                                                                         /* _3-기타 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_ATTR='300'
                                THEN F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.fund_currency, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))
                           END),0)                                                                         /* _4-상장 */
                 , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_chui_aek,0)
                                                       - NVL(t1.won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                       + NVL(t1.RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)),0)                       /* _5-취득가 */
                 , 0                                                                                       /* _6-우선주 */
                 , NVL(SUM(F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.fund_currency, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))),0)  /* _7-해외주식합계 */
              INTO w.ju_bisang    /* _1- */
                 , w.ju_kosdaq    /* _2- */
                 , w.suik_etf     /* _3- */
                 , w.ju_sang      /* _4- */
                 , w.ju_chui_aek  /* _5- */
                 , w.ju_woos      /* _6- */
                 , w.ju_over      /* _7- */
              FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                 , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
               AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ya.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
               AND ya.jasan_gb = '1'
               AND ya.sj_gb    != '2';
        end if;

        w.ju_tot := NVL(w.ju_over, 0);                    /* 해외주식합계 */
        w_tot_sy := NVL(w_tot_sy , 0) + NVL(w.ju_tot,0);  /* 해외자산합계 */

        -- 해외 선물/옵션
        w.sun_meib := 0;
        w.sun_medo := 0;

        w.sun_meib_bond := 0;
        w.sun_medo_bond := 0;

        w.c_opt_meib_chui   := 0;
        w.c_opt_meib_pyunga := 0;
        w.c_opt_medo_chui   := 0;
        w.c_opt_medo_pyunga := 0;
        w.p_opt_meib_chui   := 0;
        w.p_opt_meib_pyunga := 0;
        w.p_opt_medo_chui   := 0;
        w.p_opt_medo_pyunga := 0;

        w_sun_tot := 0;

        -- 해외 선물/옵션
        -- sm_tr_gb : '1'(선물매입), '2'(선물매도), '3'(콜매입), '4'(콜매도), '5'(풋매입), '6'(풋매도)
        -- 해외 국고채금리선물
        -- sm_tr_gb : '1'(선물매입), '2'(선물매도)
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='1' AND ya.jasan_attr != 'A11'
                                THEN NVL(t1.WON_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                           END),0)                       /* _1-매입선물취득액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='2' AND ya.jasan_attr != 'A11'
                                THEN NVL(t1.WON_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                           END),0)                       /* _2-매도선물취득액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='1' AND ya.jasan_attr='A11'
                                THEN NVL(t1.WON_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                           END),0)                       /* _3-매입 금리선물취득액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='2' AND ya.jasan_attr='A11'
                                THEN NVL(t1.WON_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                           END),0)                       /* _4-매도 금리선물취득액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='3'
                                THEN NVL(t1.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_chui_aek,0)
                                                                 - NVL(t1.won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)
                           END),0)                       /* _5-콜매수취득액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='3'
                                THEN NVL(t1.WON_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                           END),0)                       /* _6-콜매수평가액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='4'
                                THEN NVL(t1.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_chui_aek,0)
                                                                 - NVL(t1.won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)
                           END),0)                       /* _7-콜매도취득액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='4'
                                THEN NVL(t1.WON_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                           END),0)                       /* _8-콜매도평가액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='5'
                                THEN NVL(t1.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_chui_aek,0)
                                                                 - NVL(t1.won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)
                           END),0)                       /* _9-풋매수취득액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='5'
                                THEN NVL(t1.WON_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                           END),0)                       /* _10-풋매수평가액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='6'
                                THEN NVL(t1.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_chui_aek,0)
                                                                 - NVL(t1.won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)
                           END),0)                       /* _11-풋매도취득액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='6' THEN NVL(t1.WON_PYUNGA_AEK,0)
                           END),0)                       /* _12-풋매도평가액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.WON_PYUNGA_AEK,0)),0)  /* _13-해외장내선물합계 */
              INTO w.sun_meib           /* _1- */
                 , w.sun_medo           /* _2- */
                 , w.sun_meib_bond      /* _3- */
                 , w.sun_medo_bond      /* _4- */
                 , w.c_opt_meib_chui    /* _5- */
                 , w.c_opt_meib_pyunga  /* _6- */
                 , w.c_opt_medo_chui    /* _7- */
                 , w.c_opt_medo_pyunga  /* _8- */
                 , w.p_opt_meib_chui    /* _9- */
                 , w.p_opt_meib_pyunga  /* _10- */
                 , w.p_opt_medo_chui    /* _11- */
                 , w.p_opt_medo_pyunga  /* _12- */
                 , w_sun_tot            /* _13- */
              FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                 , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
               AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ya.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
               AND ya.jasan_gb = 'A';

            -- 해외 위탁증거금
            --            SELECT SUM(nvl(FCUR_PASS_CASH_AEK,0) + nvl(FCUR_DAY_UP_AEK,0) - nvl(FCUR_DAY_DW_AEK,0))
            --                 , SUM(nvl(FCUR_PASS_DAEY_AEK,0) + nvl(FCUR_UP_DAEY_AEK,0) - nvl(FCUR_DW_DAEY_AEK,0))
            --              INTO w.sun_cash
            --                 , w.sun_daey
            --            FROM   SSM0WG t1
            --            WHERE  t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
            --              AND  t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
            --              AND  t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
            --              AND  t1.CURRENCY != 'KRW';
        else
            SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='1' AND ya.jasan_attr != 'A11'
                                THEN F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))
                           END),0)                                                                         /* _1-매입선물취득액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='2' AND ya.jasan_attr != 'A11'
                                THEN F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))
                           END),0)                                                                         /* _2-매도선물취득액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='1' AND ya.jasan_attr='A11'
                                THEN F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))
                           END),0)                                                                         /* _3-매입 금리선물취득액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='2' AND ya.jasan_attr='A11'
                                THEN F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))
                           END),0)                                                                         /* _4-매도 금리선물취득액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='3'
                                THEN F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(NVL(t1.FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.FCUR_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.FCUR_DW_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_FCUR_AEK,0),0))
                           END),0)                                                                         /* _5-콜매수취득액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='3'
                                THEN F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))
                           END),0)                                                                         /* _6-콜매수평가액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='4'
                                THEN F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(NVL(t1.FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.FCUR_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.FCUR_DW_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_FCUR_AEK,0),0))
                           END),0)                                                                         /* _7-콜매도취득액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='4'
                                THEN F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))
                           END),0)                                                                         /* _8-콜매도평가액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='5'
                                THEN F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(NVL(t1.FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.FCUR_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.FCUR_DW_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_FCUR_AEK,0),0))
                           END),0)                                                                         /* _9-풋매수취득액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='5'
                                THEN F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))
                           END),0)                                                                         /* _10-풋매수평가액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='6'
                                THEN F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(NVL(t1.FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.FCUR_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.FCUR_DW_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_FCUR_AEK,0),0))
                           END),0)                                                                         /* _11-풋매도취득액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb='6'
                                THEN F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))
                           END),0)                                                                         /* _12-풋매도평가액 */
                 , NVL(SUM(F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, xx.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))),0)  /* _13-해외장내선물합계 */
              INTO w.sun_meib           /* _1- */
                 , w.sun_medo           /* _2- */
                 , w.sun_meib_bond      /* _3- */
                 , w.sun_medo_bond      /* _4- */
                 , w.c_opt_meib_chui    /* _5- */
                 , w.c_opt_meib_pyunga  /* _6- */
                 , w.c_opt_medo_chui    /* _7- */
                 , w.c_opt_medo_pyunga  /* _8- */
                 , w.p_opt_meib_chui    /* _9- */
                 , w.p_opt_meib_pyunga  /* _10- */
                 , w.p_opt_medo_chui    /* _11- */
                 , w.p_opt_medo_pyunga  /* _12- */
                 , w_sun_tot            /* _13- */
              FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                 , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
               AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ya.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
               AND ya.jasan_gb = 'A';

            -- 해외 위탁증거금
            --            SELECT NVL(sum(F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr,t1.ymd,xx.FUND_CURRENCY,nvl(pass_cash_aek,0) + nvl(day_up_aek,0) - nvl(day_dw_aek,0))),0)
            --                 , NVL(sum(F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr,t1.ymd,xx.FUND_CURRENCY,nvl(pass_daey_aek,0) + nvl(up_daey_aek,0) - nvl(dw_daey_aek,0))),0)
            --              INTO w.sun_cash
            --                 , w.sun_daey
            --            FROM   SSM0WG t1
            --            WHERE  t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
            --              AND  t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
            --              AND  t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
            --              AND  t1.CURRENCY != 'KRW';
        end if;

        w_tot_sy := NVL(w_tot_sy,0) + NVL(w.sun_cash,0);  /* 해외선물옵션자산합계에는 가수제외하고 증거금만 합산함 */

        -- 채권
        w.bond_tot         := 0;
        w.bond_10          := 0;
        w.bond_20          := 0;
        w.bond_30          := 0;
        w.bond_31          := 0;
        w.bond_321         := 0;
        w.bond_322         := 0;
        w.bond_323         := 0;
        w.bond_331         := 0;
        w.bond_332         := 0;
        w.bond_333         := 0;
        w.bond_334         := 0;
        w.bond_39          := 0;
        w.bond_60          := 0;
        w.bond_gongmo      := 0;
        w.bond_samo        := 0;
        w.bond_bojng       := 0;
        w.bond_mubojng     := 0;
        w.bond_stock       := 0;
        w.bond_hoisa_ilban := 0;
        w.bond_husun       := 0;
        w.bond_abs         := 0;

        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.jm_cd
                 , ya.JASAN_ATTR
                 , CASE WHEN ia.fund_currency='KRW'
                        THEN NVL(t1.won_pyunga_aek,0)
                        ELSE F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, ia.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))
                   END  AS pyunga_aek
              FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                 , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
               AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ya.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
               AND ya.jasan_gb = '2'
               AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
        ) loop
            w.bond_tot := w.bond_tot + x1.pyunga_aek;

            w_tot_sy := NVL(w_tot_sy,0) + NVL(x1.pyunga_aek,0);  /* 해외자산합계 */

            if  x1.JASAN_ATTR = '200'       then    w.bond_10  := w.bond_10 + x1.pyunga_aek;   -- 국채
            elsif x1.JASAN_ATTR = '210'     then    w.bond_20  := w.bond_20 + x1.pyunga_aek;   -- 지방채
            elsif x1.JASAN_ATTR = '240'     then    w.bond_30  := w.bond_30 + x1.pyunga_aek;   -- 특수채
                                                    w.bond_323 := w.bond_323 + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.JASAN_ATTR = '230'     then    w.bond_30  := w.bond_30 + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                                    w.bond_31  := w.bond_31 + x1.pyunga_aek;   /* 통안채 */
            elsif x1.JASAN_ATTR = '250'     then    w.bond_30  := w.bond_30 + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                                    w.bond_331 := w.bond_331 + x1.pyunga_aek;

            elsif x1.JASAN_ATTR = '261'     then    w.bond_60      := w.bond_60 + x1.pyunga_aek;       -- 회사채
                                                    w.bond_bojng   := w.bond_bojng + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.JASAN_ATTR = '262'     then    w.bond_60      := w.bond_60 + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                                    w.bond_mubojng := w.bond_mubojng + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.JASAN_ATTR = '263'     then    w.bond_60      := w.bond_60 + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                                    w.bond_abs     := w.bond_abs + x1.pyunga_aek;
            elsif x1.JASAN_ATTR = '269'     then    w.bond_60      := w.bond_60 + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                                    w.bond_samo    := w.bond_samo + x1.pyunga_aek;
            else                                    w.bond_60      := w.bond_60 + x1.pyunga_aek;
                                                    w.bond_samo    := w.bond_samo + x1.pyunga_aek;     /* 기타채권 : 사모회사채에 합산 */
            end if;
        end loop;

        -- 현금
        w.cash_tot   := 0;
        w.cash_10    := 0;
        w.cash_20    := 0;
        w.cash_31    := 0;
        w.cash_32    := 0;
        w.cash_50    := 0;
        w.cash_60    := 0;
        w.cash_70    := 0;
        w.cash_80    := 0;
        w.cash_90    := 0;
        w.cash_cheng := 0;
        w.cash_etc   := 0;

        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.jm_cd
                 , NVL(ya.JASAN_ATTR,'100')  AS jasan_attr
                 , CASE WHEN ia.fund_currency='KRW'
                        THEN NVL(t1.won_pyunga_aek,0)
                        ELSE F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, ia.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))
                   END                       AS pyunga_aek
              FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                 , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
               AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ya.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
               AND ya.jasan_gb = '5'
               AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
        ) loop
            w.cash_tot := w.cash_tot + x1.pyunga_aek;

            w_tot_sy := NVL(w_tot_sy,0) + NVL(x1.pyunga_aek,0);  /* 해외자산합계 */

            if  x1.JASAN_ATTR = '190'       then
                    w.cash_etc := w.cash_etc + x1.pyunga_aek;  /* 기타현금성자선 */
            else    w.cash_90  := w.cash_90 + x1.pyunga_aek;   /* 외화예금 */
            end if;
        end loop;

        -- 수익증권 : PDJ 2020.05.29 주식에서 분리하여 수익증권(집합투자증권) 별도처리함
        w.suik_suik := 0;  /* 수익증권 이익 */
        w.FUND      := 0;  /* 수익증권합 */
        w.SUIK_AEK  := 0;  /* 수익증권 */
        w.SUIK_ETF  := 0;  /* 기타수익증권 */

        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.jm_cd
                 , NVL(ya.JASAN_ATTR,'400')  AS jasan_attr
                 , CASE WHEN ia.fund_currency='KRW'
                        THEN NVL(t1.won_pyunga_aek,0)
                        ELSE F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, ia.FUND_CURRENCY, NVL(t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK,0))
                   END                       AS pyunga_aek
              FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                 , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = xx.ymd
               AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ya.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
               AND ya.jasan_gb = '1'
               AND ya.sj_gb    = '2'
               AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
        ) loop
                w.FUND     := 0;
                w.SUIK_AEK := 0;  /* 수익증권 */
                w.SUIK_ETF := 0;  /* 기타수익증권 */

                w_tot_sy := NVL(w_tot_sy,0) + NVL(x1.pyunga_aek,0);  /* 해외자산합계 */

                if  x1.JASAN_ATTR = '400'   then
                        w.suik_aek := w.suik_aek + NVL(x1.pyunga_aek, 0);  /* 수익증권 */
                ELSE    w.suik_etf := w.suik_etf + NVL(x1.pyunga_aek, 0);  /* 수익증권기타 */
                end if;
        end loop;

        -- 공모청약금,주식미수입금/미지급금,미수배당금
        w.ju_misu_ip := 0;
        w.ju_misu_ji := 0;
        w.misu_baed  := 0;

        for x1 IN (
            SELECT gwamok
                 , F_DANGJ (chadae_gb, junj, dr_aek, cr_aek)  AS dangj
              FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd           = xx.ymd
               AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
               AND t1.gwamok        IN ('10154','10155','12051','12052','10253','12054','12351','20251','20252','20253','20254')
               AND t1.fund_currency = 'KRW'
        ) loop
            w_tot_sy := NVL(w_tot_sy,0) + NVL(x1.dangj,0);  /* 해외자산합계 */

            if  x1.gwamok IN ('10154','10155')  then    -- 외화 공모청약금/증거금
                w.cash_tot   := w.cash_tot + x1.dangj;
                w.cash_cheng := w.cash_cheng + x1.dangj;

            elsif x1.gwamok IN ('12051','12052','10253','12054')    then    -- 외화 주식/채권/현금/수익증권
                w.ju_misu_ip := w.ju_misu_ip + x1.dangj;

            elsif x1.gwamok = '12351'   then    -- 외화 미수배당금
                w.misu_baed := w.misu_baed + x1.dangj;
            else                                /* '20251','20252','20253','20254' 주식/채권/현금/수익증권 미지급금 */
                w.ju_misu_ji := w.ju_misu_ji + x1.dangj;
            end if;
        end loop;

        -- 해외채권이자 미수입금
        w_misu_ija_sy := 0;

        SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(won_pyunga_aek,0)),0)
          INTO w_misu_ija_sy
          FROM SYT0YS t1  /* 해외 수도결제 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd                     = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd                         = xx.ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                       = 'E22'
           AND NVL(t1.GYULJE_YMD, xx.ymd + 1) > xx.ymd;

        w.ju_misu_ip := w.ju_misu_ip + w_misu_ija_sy;

        w_tot_sy := NVL(w_tot_sy,0) + NVL(w_misu_ija_sy,0);  /* 해외자산합계 */

        -- 통계표 Insert
        INSERT INTO JASAN_TONG_SY   /* 자산통계 해외 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr                        /* _1-p_corp_gr */
               , xx.ymd                           /* _2-xx.ymd */
               , xx.fund_cd                       /* _3-xx.fund_cd */
               , 'TOT'                            /* _4-'TOT' */
               , xx.sun_jasan_aek                 /* _5-xx.sun_jasan_aek */
               , xx.jasan_tot_aek                 /* _6-xx.jasan_tot_aek */
               , NVL(w_tot_sy,0)                  /* _7- */
               , NVL(w.JU_CHUI_AEK,0)             /* _8- */
               , NVL(w.JU_TOT,0)                  /* _9- */
               , NVL(w.JU_SANG,0)                 /* _10- */
               , NVL(w.JU_KOSDAQ,0)               /* _11- */
               , NVL(w.JU_BISANG,0)               /* _12- */
               , NVL(w.JU_WOOS,0)                 /* _13- */
               , NVL(w.JU_OVER,0)                 /* _14- */
