               , NVL(w.SUN_CASH,0)                /* _15- */
               , NVL(w.SUN_DAEY,0)                /* _16- */
               , NVL(w.SUN_MEIB,0)                /* _17- */
               , NVL(w.SUN_MEDO,0)                /* _18- */
               , NVL(w.SUN_MEIB_BOND,0)           /* _19- */
               , NVL(w.SUN_MEDO_BOND,0)           /* _20- */
               , NVL(w.SUN_MEIB_OVER,0)           /* _21- */
               , NVL(w.SUN_MEDO_OVER,0)           /* _22- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_CHUI,0)         /* _23- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA,0)       /* _24- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_CHUI,0)         /* _25- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA,0)       /* _26- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_CHUI_B,0)       /* _27- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA_B,0)     /* _28- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_CHUI_B,0)       /* _29- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA_B,0)     /* _30- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_CHUI_OVER,0)    /* _31- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA_OVER,0)  /* _32- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_CHUI_OVER,0)    /* _33- */
               , NVL(w.C_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA_OVER,0)  /* _34- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_CHUI,0)         /* _35- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA,0)       /* _36- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_CHUI,0)         /* _37- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA,0)       /* _38- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_CHUI_B,0)       /* _39- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA_B,0)     /* _40- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_CHUI_B,0)       /* _41- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA_B,0)     /* _42- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_CHUI_OVER,0)    /* _43- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEIB_PYUNGA_OVER,0)  /* _44- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_CHUI_OVER,0)    /* _45- */
               , NVL(w.P_OPT_MEDO_PYUNGA_OVER,0)  /* _46- */
               , NVL(w.SWAP_MEIB_CHUI,0)          /* _47- */
               , NVL(w.SWAP_MEIB_PYUNGA,0)        /* _48- */
               , NVL(w.SWAP_MEDO_CHUI,0)          /* _49- */
               , NVL(w.SWAP_MEDO_PYUNGA,0)        /* _50- */
               , NVL(w.FE_MEIB_CHUI,0)            /* _51- */
               , NVL(w.FE_MEIB_PYUNGA,0)          /* _52- */
               , NVL(w.FE_MEDO_CHUI,0)            /* _53- */
               , NVL(w.FE_MEDO_PYUNGA,0)          /* _54- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_TOT,0)                /* _55- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_10,0)                 /* _56- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_20,0)                 /* _57- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_30,0)                 /* _58- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_31,0)                 /* _59- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_321,0)                /* _60- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_322,0)                /* _61- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_323,0)                /* _62- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_331,0)                /* _63- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_332,0)                /* _64- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_333,0)                /* _65- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_334,0)                /* _66- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_39,0)                 /* _67- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_STOCK,0)              /* _68- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_HOISA_ILBAN,0)        /* _69- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_HUSUN,0)              /* _70- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_60,0)                 /* _71- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_GONGMO,0)             /* _72- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_SAMO,0)               /* _73- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_BOJNG,0)              /* _74- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_MUBOJNG,0)            /* _75- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_ABS,0)                /* _76- */
               , NVL(w.BOND_OVER,0)               /* _77- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_TOT,0)                /* _78- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_10,0)                 /* _79- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_20,0)                 /* _80- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_31,0)                 /* _81- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_32,0)                 /* _82- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_50,0)                 /* _83- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_60,0)                 /* _84- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_70,0)                 /* _85- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_80,0)                 /* _86- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_90,0)                 /* _87- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_ETC,0)                /* _88- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_OVER,0)               /* _89- */
               , NVL(w.SUIK_AEK,0)                /* _90- */
               , NVL(w.SUIK_SUIK,0)               /* _91- */
               , NVL(w.SUIK_ETF,0)                /* _92- */
               , NVL(w.JU_MISU_IP,0)              /* _93- */
               , NVL(w.JU_MISU_JI,0)              /* _94- */
               , NVL(w.MISU_BAED,0)               /* _95- */
               , NVL(w.CASH_CHENG,0)              /* _96- */
               , NVL(w.OTS,0)                     /* _97- */
               , NVL(w.FUND,0)                    /* _98- */
               , NVL(w.INVEST_CORP,0)             /* _99- */
               , NVL(w.ETF,0)                     /* _100- */
               , NVL(w.FUND_OVER,0)               /* _101- */
               , NVL(w.UNPAID_BOSU,0)             /* _102- */
               , NVL(w.UNPAID_CLOSE,0)            /* _103- */
               , NVL(w.REPAID_IIK,0)              /* _104- */
               , xx.seolj_jwa                     /* _105- */
               , CASE WHEN xx.fund_currency='KRW'
                      THEN xx.seolj_aek
                      ELSE F_COVWON (p_corp_gr, xx.ymd, xx.FUND_CURRENCY, xx.seolj_aek)
                 END                              /* _106- */
               );
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_NOW_GUGAN_IJA (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ija_ymd                      IN    DATE,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_aekm                         IN    NUMBER,
    p_gugan_ilsu                   OUT   NUMBER,
    p_gugan_ija                    OUT   NUMBER,
    p_pr_ilsu                      OUT   NUMBER,
    p_pr_ija                       OUT   NUMBER,
    p_pass_ilsu                    OUT   NUMBER,  /* 경과일수 */
    p_pass_ija                     OUT   NUMBER,  /* 경과이자 */
    p_pass_pr_ija                  OUT   NUMBER,  /* 경과할인(증)이자 */
    p_gugan_no                     OUT   NUMBER,
    p_bf_ija_ymd                   OUT   DATE,
    p_af_ija_ymd                   OUT   DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 채권 액면 현재 구간이자계산
--
    w_balh_ga                      NUMBER;
    w_qty                          NUMBER;

    bj_geochi_ija_gb               scm0bj.geochi_ija_gb%type;
    bj_geochi_gigan                scm0bj.geochi_gigan%type;
    bj_geochi_iyul                 scm0bj.geochi_iyul%type;
    bj_sanghw_ija_gb               scm0bj.sanghw_ija_gb%type;
    bj_sanghw_iyul                 scm0bj.sanghw_iyul%type;
BEGIN
    p_msg := 'Y';

    p_gugan_ija   := 0;
    p_pr_ija      := 0;
    p_pass_ilsu   := 0;
    p_pass_ija    := 0;
    p_pass_pr_ija := 0;

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.balh_ymd
             , t1.sanghw_ymd - t1.balh_ymd                                      AS pr_ilsu
             , NVL(t1.pyom_iyul,0)                                              AS pyom_iyul
             , NVL(t1.halin_iyul,0) + NVL(t1.halj_iyul,0)                       AS pr_iyul
             , t1.bunhal_gb
             , t1.ija_jigub_gb
             , t1.ija_yy_su
             , t1.yy_ija_hoisu
             , t1.balh_ga
             , t1.bond_attr
             , t1.bond_cd
             , ig.gugan_no
             , ig.bf_ija_ymd
             , ig.af_ija_ymd
             , ig.gugan_ilsu
             , CASE WHEN ig.chg_ija_ymd IS NULL OR ig.chg_ija_ymd <= p_ija_ymd
                    THEN ig.gugan_ija
                    ELSE ig.bf_gugan_ija
               END                                                              AS gugan_ija
             , CASE WHEN chg_ija_ymd IS NULL OR chg_ija_ymd > p_ija_ymd
                    THEN NULL
                    ELSE chg_ija_ymd
               END                                                              AS chg_ija_ymd
             , F_DAYS (ig.bf_ija_ymd, ig.chg_ija_ymd)                           AS chg_bf_ilsu
             , TRUNC((ig.bf_gugan_ija * p_aekm) / ig.gugan_ilsu
                                      * F_DAYS(ig.bf_ija_ymd, ig.chg_ija_ymd))  AS chg_gugan_ija_aek
          FROM SCM0CJ t1  /* 채권종목 */
             , SCJ0IG ig  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd
           AND ig.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ig.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND ig.ija_gb  = 'B'
           AND p_ija_ymd  BETWEEN ig.bf_ija_ymd AND (ig.af_ija_ymd - 1)
    ) loop
        p_gugan_ilsu := xx.gugan_ilsu;
        IF  xx.bunhal_gb = '1'  THEN    -- 분할채권
            SELECT geochi_ija_gb
                 , NVL(geochi_gigan,0)
                 , NVL(geochi_iyul,0)
                 , sanghw_ija_gb
                 , NVL(sanghw_iyul,0)
              INTO bj_geochi_ija_gb
                 , bj_geochi_gigan
                 , bj_geochi_iyul
                 , bj_sanghw_ija_gb
                 , bj_sanghw_iyul
              FROM SCM0BJ t1  /* 분할채 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd;
            IF  xx.gugan_no <= TRUNC (bj_geochi_gigan / 12) THEN
                    xx.ija_jigub_gb := bj_geochi_ija_gb;
            else    xx.ija_jigub_gb := bj_sanghw_ija_gb;  /* 상환기간일경우 상환이자지급 및 이율 적용 */
            end if;
            IF  xx.gugan_no = TRUNC (bj_geochi_gigan / 12)  THEN
                    xx.pyom_iyul := bj_geochi_iyul;
            else    xx.pyom_iyul := bj_sanghw_iyul;
            end if;
        end if;

        if  xx.balh_ga = 9      then    w_balh_ga := NVL(p_aekm,0);
        elsif xx.balh_ga = 0    then    w_balh_ga := 1;
        ELSE
            --------------------------------------------
            -- 이표채는 발행단위대신 액면으로 계산
            -- 단,금융이표채는 발행단위(10,000원)
            --------------------------------------------
            IF  xx.ija_jigub_gb IN ('7','8','G','H','9')    THEN
                IF  xx.bond_attr = '3' AND (SUBSTR (xx.bond_cd, 1, 1) = '1' OR xx.bond_cd = '900')  THEN
                        w_balh_ga := xx.balh_ga;
                else    w_balh_ga := NVL (p_aekm,0);
                end if;
            else        w_balh_ga := xx.balh_ga;
            end if;
        end if;
        w_qty := NVL (TRUNC (p_aekm / w_balh_ga, 14), 0);

        IF  xx.ija_jigub_gb IN ('4','5','6','D','E','F')    THEN    -- 복리채
            IF (p_jm_cd LIKE 'KR2001%' AND SUBSTR(p_jm_cd, 9, 1) ='4')  THEN    -- 서울도시철도 5복2단
                IF  xx.gugan_no <= 5    THEN
                    p_gugan_ija := TRUNC((w_balh_ga * power(1 + xx.pyom_iyul / xx.yy_ija_hoisu, xx.gugan_no))) * w_qty - p_aekm;
                ELSE
                    p_gugan_ija := TRUNC((w_balh_ga * power(1 + xx.pyom_iyul / xx.yy_ija_hoisu,5)) * w_qty
                                         + (w_balh_ga * (1 + ((xx.pyom_iyul / xx.yy_ija_hoisu) * (xx.gugan_no -5)))) * w_qty) - 2 * p_aekm;
                end if;
            ELSE
                p_gugan_ija := TRUNC((w_balh_ga * power(1 + xx.pyom_iyul / xx.yy_ija_hoisu, xx.gugan_no))) * w_qty - p_aekm;
            end if;
        ELSIF xx.chg_ija_ymd IS NULL    THEN
                p_gugan_ija := TRUNC(p_aekm * xx.gugan_ija);
        else    p_gugan_ija := TRUNC((p_aekm * xx.gugan_ija) / xx.gugan_ilsu * (xx.gugan_ilsu - xx.chg_bf_ilsu)) + xx.chg_gugan_ija_aek;
        end if;

        -- 경과이자 계산
        IF  xx.ija_jigub_gb IN ('4','5','6','D','E','F')    THEN    -- 복리채
            p_pass_ilsu := p_ija_ymd - xx.balh_ymd + 1;
            IF (p_jm_cd LIKE 'KR2001%' AND SUBSTR(p_jm_cd, 9, 1) ='4')  THEN    -- 서울도시철도 5복2단
                IF  xx.gugan_no <= 5    THEN
                    p_pass_ija := TRUNC(p_aekm * power(1 + xx.pyom_iyul / xx.yy_ija_hoisu, (xx.gugan_no - 1) + ((p_ija_ymd - xx.bf_ija_ymd + 1) / xx.gugan_ilsu)) - p_aekm);
                ELSE
                    p_pass_ija  := TRUNC(p_aekm * power(1 + xx.pyom_iyul / xx.yy_ija_hoisu,5)
                                         + (p_aekm * (1 + ((xx.pyom_iyul / xx.yy_ija_hoisu)
                                                           * ((xx.gugan_no - 6) + ((p_ija_ymd - xx.bf_ija_ymd + 1) / xx.gugan_ilsu)))))) - 2 * p_aekm;
                end if;
            ELSE
                p_pass_ija  := TRUNC(p_aekm * power(1 + xx.pyom_iyul / xx.yy_ija_hoisu, (xx.gugan_no - 1)
                                                    + ((p_ija_ymd - xx.bf_ija_ymd + 1) / xx.gugan_ilsu)) - p_aekm);
            end if;
        ELSE
            IF  xx.bf_ija_ymd <= p_ija_ymd  THEN    -- 발행일에 익일매수(J14)하는 경우
                p_pass_ilsu := p_ija_ymd - xx.bf_ija_ymd + 1;
                p_pass_ija  := TRUNC(p_gugan_ija / p_gugan_ilsu * p_pass_ilsu);
            end if;
        end if;

        IF  xx.pr_iyul != 0 THEN
            p_pr_ilsu := xx.pr_ilsu;
            p_pr_ija  := TRUNC(w_balh_ga * xx.pr_iyul) * w_qty;
            if  xx.balh_ymd < p_ija_ymd then    p_pass_pr_ija := TRUNC(p_pr_ija / p_pr_ilsu * (p_ija_ymd - xx.balh_ymd) );
            end if;
        ELSE
            p_pr_ilsu     := 0;
            p_pr_ija      := 0;
            p_pass_pr_ija := 0;
        end if;
        p_gugan_no   := xx.gugan_no;
        p_bf_ija_ymd := xx.bf_ija_ymd;
        p_af_ija_ymd := xx.af_ija_ymd;
    end loop;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg   := 'now_gugan_ija:(' || p_jm_cd || ',' || TO_CHAR(p_ija_ymd,'yyyy.mm.dd') || ')'
                                 || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0010 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 작업일자 변경
--
    dt_hyun_ymd                  DATE;
    dt_ikyong_ymd                DATE;
    dt_thikyong_ymd              DATE;
    w_customer_gr                SZX0AA.CUSTOMER_GR%type;

    cur                          integer;
    result                       integer;
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0010', p_ymd || ' : 작업일자 변경');

    if  p_corp_gr = '2502'  then
        dt_hyun_ymd     := F_OPEN_US (p_ymd, '+1');         -- 변경영업일
        dt_ikyong_ymd   := F_OPEN_US (dt_hyun_ymd, '+1');   -- 익영업일
        dt_thikyong_ymd := F_OPEN_US (dt_ikyong_ymd, '+1'); -- 3영업일
    else
        dt_hyun_ymd     := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '+1');            -- 변경영업일
        dt_ikyong_ymd   := F_OPEN_YMD (dt_hyun_ymd, '+1');      -- 익영업일
        dt_thikyong_ymd := F_OPEN_YMD (dt_ikyong_ymd, '+1');    -- 3영업일
    end if;

    -- 작업일자 update
    UPDATE SZX0AA tt  
       SET junyong_ymd  = p_ymd
         , hyun_ymd     = dt_hyun_ymd
         , ikyong_ymd   = dt_ikyong_ymd
         , thikyong_ymd = dt_thikyong_ymd
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr;

    SELECT customer_gr
      INTO w_customer_gr
      FROM SZX0AA t1
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr;

    if  w_customer_gr = '자산운용'  then
        -- 자산운용은 기준가방식으로 처리하므로 평잔재계산 제외
        NULL;
    else
        -- 결산펀드 평잔재계산
        FOR xx IN (
            SELECT fund_cd
              FROM SZM0IA t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.af_gyul_ymd Between dt_hyun_ymd AND dt_ikyong_ymd - 1
        ) loop
            SR_PYUNGJAN (p_corp_gr, xx.fund_cd, dt_hyun_ymd);
        END LOOP;
    end if;
    commit;

    BEGIN
        cur := dbms_sql.open_cursor;

        dbms_sql.parse(cur, 'truncate table ZZXART', dbms_sql.v7);
        result  := dbms_sql.execute (cur);
        SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B099', 'zzxart', 'truncate ok = ' || result);

        dbms_sql.close_cursor(cur);
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS then
        NULL;
    END;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0110 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 이월처리 초기화
--
    w_hyun_ymd                     DATE;
    w_junyong_ymd                  DATE;
    w_gijunga_ymd                  DATE;
    w_open_ymd                     DATE;
    w_jun_ymd                      DATE;

    w_seq                          NUMBER;
    w_jan                          NUMBER;

    w_holi_gb                      VARCHAR(1);

    w_weekday                      varchar_varray_50;
    w_weekday_en                   varchar_varray_50;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0110', p_ymd || ' : 이월처리 초기화');

    -- trigger 갯수 및 status 확인
    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO w_seq
      FROM USER_OBJECTS t1
     WHERE object_type = 'TRIGGER'
       AND status      = 'VALID';

    -- disable trigger 확인
    BEGIN
        SELECT 1
          INTO w_seq
          FROM USER_TRIGGERS ta
         WHERE ta.status = 'DISABLED'
           AND ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
        NULL;
    END;

    if  w_seq <> 19 then
        p_msg := 'Trigger 생성을 전산실에 요청하십시요.';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SELECT junyong_ymd
         , gijunga_ymd
         , hyun_ymd
      INTO w_junyong_ymd
         , w_gijunga_ymd
         , w_hyun_ymd
      FROM SZX0AA t1  /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr;

    -- 작업일자 구간조건용 일자생성
    if  F_STOCK (p_ymd) = '1'   then    w_holi_gb := '2';
    end if;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT p_ymd + ROWNUM - 1  AS ymd
          FROM DUAL
        CONNECT BY LEVEL  <= (F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd,'+1') - p_ymd + 1)
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SZX9DT tt   /* 작업일자 Between조건용 일자 */
                 ( ymd      /* _1- */
                 , holi_gb  /* _2- */
                 )
            VALUES ( xx.ymd                                       /* _1- */
                   , CASE WHEN F_STOCK (xx.ymd)='1' THEN '2' END  /* _2- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;
    end loop;

    SELECT MIN(tr_ymd)
      INTO w_open_ymd
      FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
     WHERE corp_gr          = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd           BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(p_ymd,-3) AND p_ymd - 1
       AND (NVL(in_aek,0) + NVL(out_aek,0)) > 0
       AND NVL(gigan_amt,0) = 0;

    if  w_open_ymd IS NOT NULL  then
        p_msg := TO_CHAR (w_open_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '일 입(출)금 평잔재계산 처리가 되지 않았습니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 계약잔액 수정분 반영(화면에서 수정 불가처리) 20250301 yjs
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT tt.fund_cd
          FROM (SELECT fund_cd
                  FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.re_seolj_ymd = p_ymd
                UNION ALL
                SELECT fund_cd
                  FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
                 WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd
                 ) tt
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT wonbon_aek
              INTO w_jan
              FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND tr_ymd  = (SELECT MAX(tr_ymd)
                                FROM SZT0IO ta  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
                               WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                 AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                                 AND tr_ymd  <= p_ymd);

            UPDATE SZM0IA tt    /* 자문 계좌정보 */
               SET re_seolj_aek = w_jan
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;
    end loop;

    -- szx3ck clear
    DELETE FROM SZX3CK tt   /* 펀드별 Check 자료 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr;

    -- 자문용 종가 이월
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT koscom_cd
          FROM (SELECT koscom_cd
                  FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
                UNION ALL
                SELECT koscom_cd
                  FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd - 1
                 ) t1
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SJT0TG tt   /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
                 ( corp_gr     /* _1- */
                 , ymd         /* _2- */
                 , koscom_cd   /* _3- */
                 , CLOSE       /* _4- */
                 , preclose    /* _5- */
                 , change      /* _6- */
                 , aekm        /* _7- */
                 , sangj_jusu  /* _8- */
                 )
            SELECT p_corp_gr               /* _1- */
                 , F_OPEN_YMD(p_ymd,'-')   /* _2- */
                 , xx.koscom_cd            /* _3- */
                 , NVL(MAX(CLOSE),0)       /* _4- */
                 , NVL(MAX(CLOSE),0)       /* _5- */
                 , 0                       /* _6- */
                 , NVL(MAX(aekm),0)        /* _7- */
                 , NVL(MAX(sangj_jusu),0)  /* _8- */
              FROM SJT0TG t1  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd       = F_OPEN_YMD(p_ymd,'-1')
               AND t1.koscom_cd = xx.koscom_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;
    end loop;

    w_open_ymd := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '+');
    w_jun_ymd  := p_ymd - 1;                /* 전 작업일자 계산 */

    -- 최초설정일 조정에 따른 정리추가 20241024
    DELETE FROM SKT0BU_9
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd
       AND fund_cd IN (SELECT fund_cd
                         FROM SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                        WHERE ia.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
                          AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd > p_ymd);

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU  /* 분개장 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd
       AND fund_cd IN (SELECT fund_cd
                         FROM SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                        WHERE ia.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
                          AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd > p_ymd);

    DELETE FROM SKM0AG  /* 총계정원장 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd
       AND fund_cd IN (SELECT fund_cd
                         FROM SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                        WHERE ia.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
                          AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd > p_ymd);

    -- 총계정원장 이월처리
    INSERT INTO SKT0BU_9 tt  
    SELECT *
      FROM SKT0BU t1  /* 분개장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND t1.proc_step = 9;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B021', 'skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd, '분개장 삭제');

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B022', 'skm0ag.ymd=' || p_ymd, '총계정원장 삭제');

    -- 분개장 Trigger 때문에 먼저 삭제 후 처리

    DELETE FROM SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B023', 'skm0ag.ymd=' || p_ymd, '총계정원장 이월');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT fund_cd
             , F_WORK_GB (corp_gr, fund_cd, w_jun_ymd)  AS work_gb
             , bf_gyul_ymd
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
             ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
             , ymd            /* _2- */
             , work_gb        /* _3- */
             , fund_cd        /* _4- */
             , fund_currency  /* _5- */
             , gwamok         /* _6- */
             , chadae_gb      /* _7- */
             , junj           /* _8- */
             , dr_aek         /* _9- */
             , cr_aek         /* _10- */
             )
        SELECT p_corp_gr      /* _1- */
             , p_ymd          /* _2- */
             , 'A'            /* _3- */
             , fund_cd        /* _4- */
             , fund_currency  /* _5- */
             , gwamok         /* _6- */
             , chadae_gb      /* _7- */
             , CASE chadae_gb WHEN 'D' THEN NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0) - NVL(cr_aek,0)
                              WHEN 'C' THEN NVL(junj,0) - NVL(dr_aek,0) + NVL(cr_aek,0)
                                       ELSE 0
               END            /* _8- */
             , 0              /* _9- */
             , 0              /* _10- */
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = w_jun_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb = xx.work_gb
           AND (NVL(t1.junj,0) != 0 OR NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) != 0 OR NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) != 0);
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B024', 'skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0bu.proc_step=9', '수작업분 분개 환원');

    -- 수작업분 분개처리(commit 주의) 환원
    INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
    SELECT *
      FROM SKT0BU_9 t1
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B070', '', '펀드결산일 재처리');

    -- 결산구간 기준 _ 주식합계용 제외 20230712
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                              /* _2- */
             , NVL(t1.gyul_gi,0)                                           AS gyul_gi  /* _3- */
             , t1.af_gyul_ymd                                                          /* _4- */
             , t1.re_seolj_ymd                                                         /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.BF_GYUL_YMD, t1.re_seolj_ymd)                        AS bf       /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.haeji_ymd - 1, NVL(gi.AF_GYUL_YMD, t1.AF_GYUL_YMD))  AS af       /* _7-결산구간을 변경할 경우 SZM0GI 정보이용케 20250513 */
             , NULL                                                        AS gi_bf    /* _8- */
             , NULL                                                        AS gi_af    /* _9- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.mg_cd                     != '99999'
           AND t1.fst_seolj_ymd             <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND gi.corp_gr(+)                = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd(+)                = t1.fund_cd
           AND gi.gyul_gi(+)                = t1.gyul_gi
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT gyul_gi
                 , bf_gyul_ymd
                 , af_gyul_ymd
              INTO xx.gyul_gi
                 , xx.gi_bf
                 , xx.gi_af
              FROM SZM0GI t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND p_ymd      BETWEEN (t1.BF_GYUL_YMD + 1) AND t1.AF_GYUL_YMD
               AND ROWNUM = 1;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            if  p_ymd < xx.re_seolj_ymd then
                CONTINUE;
                -- 운용시작 전 설정 제외
            else
                if  xx.af_gyul_ymd IS NULL  then
                        xx.gyul_gi := 1;
                else    xx.gyul_gi := xx.gyul_gi + 1;
                end if;
                xx.gi_bf := NVL(xx.af, xx.re_seolj_ymd - 1);
                xx.gi_af := ADD_MONTHS(xx.gi_bf, 12);

                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO SZM0GI tt   /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr                   /* _1- */
                           , xx.fund_cd                  /* _2- */
                           , xx.gyul_gi                  /* _3- */
                           , xx.gi_bf                    /* _4- */
                           , xx.gi_af                    /* _5- */
                           , F_DAYS(xx.gi_bf, xx.gi_af)  /* _6- */
                           , NULL                        /* _7- */
                           , NULL                        /* _8- */
                           , NULL                        /* _9- */
                           , NULL                        /* _10- */
                           , NULL                        /* _11- */
                           , '0'                         /* _12- */
                           , NULL                        /* _13- */
                           , NULL                        /* _14- */
                           );
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    p_msg := xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.gi_bf || ' ' || xx.gi_af;
--                    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'EXE', 'SR_PROC0110', xx.fund_cd || ' ' || to_char(xx.gi_bf,'yyyy.mm.dd') || ' ' || to_char(xx.gi_af,'yyyy.mm.dd'));
--                    commit;
                    RETURN;
                END;
            end if;
        END;
        if (xx.bf != xx.gi_bf OR xx.af != xx.gi_af) AND p_ymd BETWEEN xx.gi_bf AND xx.gi_af then
            UPDATE SZM0IA t1    /* 자문 계좌정보 */
               SET gyul_gi     = xx.gyul_gi
                 , BF_GYUL_YMD = xx.gi_bf
                 , AF_GYUL_YMD = xx.gi_af
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 전부해지 펀드결산일 재처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                               AS fd_rowid  /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                          /* _2- */
             , t1.haeji_ymd                                        /* _3- */
             , gi.rowid                               AS gi_rowid  /* _4- */
             , gi.gyul_gi                                          /* _5- */
             , gi.BF_GYUL_YMD                         AS bf        /* _6- */
             , NVL(gi.haeji_ymd - 1, gi.AF_GYUL_YMD)  AS af        /* _7- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                 = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.haeji_ymd               > p_ymd
           AND gi.corp_gr                 = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                 = t1.fund_cd
           AND gi.AF_GYUL_YMD + 1         >= t1.haeji_ymd
           AND NVL(gi.haeji_ymd, sysdate) != t1.haeji_ymd
           AND p_ymd                      BETWEEN (gi.BF_GYUL_YMD + 1) AND gi.AF_GYUL_YMD
    ) loop
        UPDATE SZM0GI tt    /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
           SET haeji_ymd = xx.haeji_ymd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.gi_rowid;

        UPDATE SZM0IA t1    /* 자문 계좌정보 */
           SET BF_GYUL_YMD = xx.bf
             , AF_GYUL_YMD = xx.af
         WHERE ROWID = xx.fd_rowid;
    end loop;

    -- Benchmark 계산용 비율 전일자료 이월처리
    --
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B100_1', p_ymd, 'Benchmark 계산용 비율 전일자료 이월처리');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT *
          FROM SKT0BM t1  /* 벤치마크수익률/성과보수 산출기준 각종비율 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd - 1
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SKT0BM tt   /* 벤치마크수익률/성과보수 산출기준 각종비율 */
            SELECT p_corp_gr
                 , p_ymd
                 , col_id
                 , col_val
              FROM SKT0BM t1  /* 벤치마크수익률/성과보수 산출기준 각종비율 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd - 1;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            if  F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '-') != p_ymd        then
                -- 휴일이후 작업처리가 된경우는 update 제외
                SELECT NVL(COUNT(*),0)
                  INTO w_seq
                  FROM SKT0BM t1  /* 벤치마크수익률/성과보수 산출기준 각종비율 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd     = w_open_ymd;
                if  w_seq = 0   then
                    UPDATE SKT0BM tt    /* 벤치마크수익률/성과보수 산출기준 각종비율 */
                       SET col_val = xx.col_val
                     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND ymd     = p_ymd
                       AND col_id  = xx.col_id;
                end if;
            end if;
        END;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B100_2', p_ymd, '차트용 일별자료 생성');

    -- 차트용 일별자료 생성
    w_weekday    := varchar_varray_50 ('일' , '월' , '화' , '수' , '목' , '금' , '토' );
    w_weekday_en := varchar_varray_50 ('SUN', 'MON', 'TUE', 'WED', 'THU', 'FRI', 'SAT');
    w_seq        := TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'D');
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT fund_currency
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT fund_currency
              INTO xx.fund_currency
              FROM FW_DAY_CHTDATA t1  /* 회사 일별 챠트자료 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
               AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            INSERT INTO FW_DAY_CHTDATA tt   /* 회사 일별 챠트자료 */
            SELECT corp_gr                      /* _1- */
                 , p_ymd                        /* _2- */
                 , xx.fund_currency             /* _3- */
                 , w_seq                        /* _4- */
                 , TO_CHAR(p_ymd + 1,'IYYYIW')  /* _5- */
                 , w_weekday(w_seq)             /* _6- */
                 , w_weekday_en(w_seq)          /* _7- */
                 , NULL                         /* _8- */
                 , NULL                         /* _9- */
                 , NULL                         /* _10- */
                 , NULL                         /* _11- */
                 , NULL                         /* _12- */
                 , NULL                         /* _13- */
                 , NULL                         /* _14- */
                 , NULL                         /* _15- */
                 , NULL                         /* _16- */
                 , NULL                         /* _17- */
                 , NULL                         /* _18- */
              FROM SZX0AA t1  /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr;
        END;
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0120 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 마스타 이월작업
--
    w_holi                         VARCHAR (1); /* 휴일처리flag */
    w_ymd                          DATE;

    w_cnt                          NUMBER;
    w_ggijun_ga                    NUMBER;
    w_krw                          NUMBER;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0120', p_ymd || ' : 주식,집합투자증권 마스타 이월작업' );

    if  F_STOCK (p_ymd) = '1'   then
            w_holi := 'Y';
    else    w_holi := 'N';
    end if;

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND t1.proc_step = 12;

    -- 주식마스타 이월처리
    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjm0jm.ymd=' || p_ymd, '주식마스타(sjm0jm) delete' );

    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'B020', '', '주식마스타(sjm0jm)' );

    DELETE FROM SJM0JM tt   /* 주식 보유현황 */
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    INSERT INTO SJM0JM tt   /* 주식 보유현황 */
         ( corp_gr              /* _1- */
         , ymd                  /* _2- */
         , fund_cd              /* _3- */
         , jm_cd                /* _4- */
         , bfil_boyu_jusu       /* _5- */
         , bfil_jilg_jusu       /* _6- */
         , bfil_chui_aek        /* _7- */
         , gbfil_aek            /* _8- */
         , mesu_hald_jusu       /* _9- */
         , balh_co              /* _10- */
         , woos_ilban_gb        /* _11- */
         , chg_gb               /* _12- */
         , new_old_gb           /* _13- */
         , danc_gb              /* _14- */
         , koscom_cd            /* _15- */
         , sonik                /* _16- */
         , gsonik               /* _17- */
         , misu_baed_aek        /* _18- */
         , mijunab_aek          /* _19- */
         , lock_jusu            /* _20- */
         , type_trench          /* _21- */
         , bs_type              /* _22- */
         , cons_bfil_chui_aek   /* _23- */
         , cons_bfil_gchui_aek  /* _24- */
         , venture_type         /* _25- */
         , coll_jusu            /* _26- */
         , coll_pass            /* _27- */
         , coll_start           /* _28- */
         , coll_end             /* _29- */
         )
    SELECT p_corp_gr                                                          /* _1- */
         , p_ymd                                                              /* _2- */
         , t1.fund_cd                                                         /* _3- */
         , t1.jm_cd                                                           /* _4- */
         , NVL(bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(up_jusu,0) - NVL(dw_jusu,0)
                                 + NVL(gongs_up_jusu,0)
                                 - NVL(gongs_dw_jusu,0)                       /* _5- */
         , NVL(bfil_jilg_jusu,0) + NVL(jilg_up_jusu,0) - NVL(jilg_dw_jusu,0)  /* _6- */
         , NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(dw_chui_aek,0)
                                + NVL(gongs_up_chui_aek,0)
                                - NVL(gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)                    /* _7- */
         , NVL(t1.gbfil_aek,0) + NVL(t1.gup_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gdw_aek,0)
                               + NVL(gyul_up_gsonik,0)                        /* _8- */
         , t1.mesu_hald_jusu                                                  /* _9- */
         , t1.balh_co                                                         /* _10- */
         , t1.woos_ilban_gb                                                   /* _11- */
         , t1.chg_gb                                                          /* _12- */
         , t1.new_old_gb                                                      /* _13- */
         , t1.danc_gb                                                         /* _14- */
         , jj.koscom_cd                                                       /* _15- */
         , CASE WHEN w_holi='Y' THEN t1.sonik ELSE 0 END                      /* _16- */
         , CASE WHEN w_holi='Y' THEN t1.gsonik ELSE 0 END                     /* _17- */
         , t1.misu_baed_aek                                                   /* _18- */
         , t1.mijunab_aek                                                     /* _19- */
         , NULL                                                               /* _20- */
         , t1.type_trench                                                     /* _21- */
         , t1.bs_type                                                         /* _22- */
         , NVL(cons_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(up_chui_aek,0) + NVL(gongs_up_chui_aek,0)
                                     - NVL(cons_dw_chui_aek,0)                /* _23- */
         , NVL(cons_bfil_gchui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.gup_aek,0)
                                      - NVL(t1.cons_dw_gchui_aek,0)           /* _24- */
         , NULL                                                               /* _25- */
         , NVL(coll_jusu,0)                                                   /* _26- */
         , NVL(coll_pass,0) + NVL(coll_up,0) - NVL(coll_dw,0)                 /* _27- */
         , CASE WHEN NVL (coll_jusu,0)=0 THEN NULL ELSE coll_start END        /* _28- */
         , CASE WHEN NVL (coll_jusu,0)=0 THEN NULL ELSE coll_end END          /* _29- */
      FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
         , SJM0JJ jj  /* 주식종목 */
         , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd - 1
       AND  ((NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.dw_jusu,0)
                                       + NVL(t1.gongs_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_jusu,0) != 0)
             OR (NVL(t1.misu_baed_aek,0) > 0) OR (NVL(t1.mijunab_aek,0) > 0))
       AND jj.jm_cd                 = t1.jm_cd
       AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
       AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
       AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd;

    -- 취득액 변경자료 정리
    DELETE FROM SJM0JM_CHUI ff  /* 주식 보유현황 */
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd
       AND ip_user IS NULL;

    DELETE FROM SJM0JM_CHUI ff  /* 주식 보유현황 */
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = ADD_MONTHS(p_ymd,-1)
       AND ip_user IS NULL;

    MERGE INTO SJM0JM_CHUI t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
       USING ( SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                /* _1- */
                    , t1.jm_cd                                                  /* _2- */
                    , t1.type_trench                                            /* _3- */
                    , t1.bs_type                                                /* _4- */
                    , NVL(bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(up_jusu,0) - NVL(dw_jusu,0)
                                            + NVL(gongs_up_jusu,0)
                                            - NVL(gongs_dw_jusu,0)     AS jusu  /* _5- */
                    , NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(dw_chui_aek,0)
                                           + NVL(gongs_up_chui_aek,0)
                                           - NVL(gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)  AS aek   /* _6- */
                 FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                    , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                WHERE 1 = 1
                  AND t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
                  AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd - 1
                  AND  ((NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.dw_jusu,0)
                                                  + NVL(t1.gongs_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_jusu,0) != 0)
                        OR (NVL(t1.misu_baed_aek,0) > 0) OR (NVL(t1.mijunab_aek,0) > 0))
                  AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
                  AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
                  AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd ) mm 
          ON ( t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd     = mm.fund_cd
           AND t1.jm_cd       = mm.jm_cd
           AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
           AND t1.type_trench = mm.type_trench
           AND t1.bs_type     = mm.bs_type )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
         UPDATE
            SET bfil_boyu_jusu = mm.jusu
              , bfil_chui_aek  = mm.aek
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
         INSERT
         VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
                , p_ymd           /* _2- */
                , mm.fund_cd      /* _3- */
                , mm.jm_cd        /* _4- */
                , mm.type_trench  /* _5- */
                , mm.bs_type      /* _6- */
                , mm.jusu         /* _7- */
                , mm.aek          /* _8- */
                , NULL            /* _9- */
                , NULL            /* _10- */
                );

    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO w_cnt
      FROM SJM0JM_COLL t1  /* 주식 보유현황(신용/대출 LOAD 보관용) */
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;
    if  w_cnt > 0   then
        for xx IN (
            SELECT tt.fund_cd                               /* _1- */
                 , tt.jm_cd                                 /* _2- */
                 , NVL(SUM(tt.coll_jusu),0)  AS coll_jusu   /* _3- */
                 , NVL(SUM(tt.bf_pass),0)    AS bf_pass     /* _4- */
                 , NVL(SUM(tt.af_pass),0)    AS af_pass     /* _5- */
                 , MAX(tt.coll_start)        AS coll_start  /* _6- */
                 , MAX(tt.coll_end)          AS coll_end    /* _7- */
              FROM (SELECT FUND_CD                 /* _1- */
                         , JM_CD                   /* _2- */
                         , COLL_JUSU               /* _3- */
                         , 0           AS BF_PASS  /* _4- */
                         , COLLATERAL  AS AF_PASS  /* _5- */
                         , COLL_START              /* _6- */
                         , COLL_END                /* _7- */
                      FROM SJM0JM_COLL t1  /* 주식 보유현황(신용/대출 LOAD 보관용) */
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.YMD     = p_ymd
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT FUND_CD                            /* _1- */
                         , JM_CD                              /* _2- */
                         , 0                                  /* _3- */
                         , NVL(COLL_PASS,0) + NVL(COLL_UP,0)
                                            - NVL(COLL_DW,0)  /* _4- */
                         , 0                                  /* _5- */
                         , NULL                               /* _6- */
                         , NULL                               /* _7- */
                      FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND t1.CORP_GR   = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.YMD       = p_ymd - 1
                       AND t1.COLL_JUSU != 0
                    ) tt
             GROUP BY tt.fund_cd, tt.jm_cd
        ) loop
            UPDATE SJM0JM t1    /* 주식 보유현황 */
               SET COLL_JUSU  = xx.coll_jusu
                 , COLL_PASS  = xx.bf_pass
                 , COLL_UP    = CASE WHEN xx.af_pass > xx.bf_pass THEN xx.af_pass - xx.bf_pass
                                                                  ELSE 0 END
                 , COLL_DW    = CASE WHEN xx.af_pass < xx.bf_pass THEN xx.bf_pass - xx.af_pass
                                                                  ELSE 0 END
                 , COLL_START = xx.coll_start
                 , COLL_END   = xx.coll_end
             WHERE 1 = 1 
               AND t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.YMD     = p_ymd
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;
        end loop;
    end if;

    -- 타사집합투자증권마스타 이월처리
    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'B030', 'sjm5sm.ymd=' || p_ymd, '타사집합투자증권마스타(sjm5sm) delete,재생성' );

    DELETE FROM SJM5SM t1   /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                             /* _1- */
             , t1.tasa_jm_cd                                                          /* _2- */
             , NVL(bfil_jwa,0) + NVL(up_jwa,0) - NVL(dw_jwa,0)      AS jwa            /* _3- */
             , NVL(bfil_aek,0) + NVL(up_aek,0) - NVL(dw_aek,0)
                               + NVL(gyul_up_sonik,0)               AS aek            /* _4- */
             , NVL(sonik,0)                                         AS sonik          /* _5- */
             , NVL(gyul_up_sonik,0)                                 AS gyul_up_sonik  /* _6- */
             , NVL(gbfil_jwa,0) + NVL(gup_jwa,0)
                                - NVL(gdw_jwa,0)                    AS gjwa           /* _7- */
             , NVL(bi_gbfil_jwa,0) + NVL(bi_gup_jwa,0)
                                   - NVL(bi_gdw_jwa,0)              AS bi_gjwa        /* _8- */
             , pre_susu                                                               /* _9- */
             , NVL(cons_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(up_aek,0)
                                         - NVL(cons_dw_chui_aek,0)  AS cons_aek       /* _10- */
             , sc.trans_unit                                                          /* _11- */
          FROM SJM5SM t1  /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
             , SJM0SC sc  /* 타사집합투자증권 정보 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd - 1
           AND (NVL(t1.bfil_jwa,0) + NVL(t1.up_jwa,0) - NVL(t1.dw_jwa,0)) > 0
           AND sc.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND sc.tasa_jm_cd            = t1.tasa_jm_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.gyul_up_sonik != 0   then
            -- 과표,비거주자과표를 좌수로 관리하므로 20200430 yjs
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL(t1.dang_ggijun_ga,0)
                  INTO w_ggijun_ga
                  FROM SJT0SC t1  /* ETF/상장집합투자증권/타사집합투자증권 종가정보 */
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd - 1
                   AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.tasa_jm_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := xx.tasa_jm_cd || '-취득액 변경을 위한 타사수익증권 종가를 확인하십시오';
                RETURN;
            END;
            if  w_ggijun_ga = 0     then
                p_msg := xx.tasa_jm_cd || '-결산 후 과표가를 확인하십시오';
                RETURN;
            end if;
            xx.gjwa := TRUNC (xx.aek / w_ggijun_ga * xx.trans_unit,0);
        end if;

        INSERT INTO SJM5SM tt   /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
             ( corp_gr             /* _1- */
             , ymd                 /* _2- */
             , fund_cd             /* _3- */
             , tasa_jm_cd          /* _4- */
             , bfil_jwa            /* _5- */
             , bfil_aek            /* _6- */
             , gbfil_jwa           /* _7- */
             , bi_gbfil_jwa        /* _8- */
             , pre_susu            /* _9- */
             , cons_bfil_chui_aek  /* _10- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr      /* _1- */
               , p_ymd          /* _2- */
               , xx.fund_cd     /* _3- */
               , xx.tasa_jm_cd  /* _4- */
               , xx.jwa         /* _5- */
               , xx.aek         /* _6- */
               , xx.gjwa        /* _7- */
               , xx.bi_gjwa     /* _8- */
               , xx.pre_susu    /* _9- */
               , xx.cons_aek    /* _10- */
               );

        MERGE INTO SJT0SC tt  /* ETF/상장집합투자증권/타사집합투자증권 종가정보 */
           USING DUAL ON ( corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND ymd     = p_ymd
                       AND jm_cd   = xx.tasa_jm_cd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET BF_SIGA_AEK = xx.aek + xx.sonik
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT ( corp_gr      /* _1- */
                    , ymd          /* _2- */
                    , jm_cd        /* _3- */
                    , bf_siga_aek  /* _4- */
                    )
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr          /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd              /* _2- */
                    , xx.tasa_jm_cd      /* _3- */
                    , xx.aek + xx.sonik  /* _4- */
                    );
    end loop;

    -- 전일시가액 이월
    MERGE INTO SJT0SC tt  /* ETF/상장집합투자증권/타사집합투자증권 종가정보 */
       USING ( SELECT corp_gr
                    , jm_cd
                    , load_siga_aek
                 FROM SJT0SC t1  /* ETF/상장집합투자증권/타사집합투자증권 종가정보 */
                WHERE 1 = 1
                  AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                  AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd - 1 ) mm 
          ON ( tt.corp_gr          = mm.corp_gr
           AND tt.ymd              = p_ymd
           AND tt.jm_cd            = mm.jm_cd
           AND NVL(tt.bigo,'이월') <> 'W_SJT0SC' )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
         UPDATE
            SET LOAD_SIGA_AEK = mm.load_siga_aek;

    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'B050', '', '신주인수권 매매 재처리(발행가변경시)' );

    UPDATE SJT5J1 tt    /* 신주인수권 매매 내역 */
       SET balh_ga         = chg_bf_balh_ga

       AND corp_gr         = p_corp_gr
       AND gosi_jekyng_ymd IS NOT NULL
       AND gosi_jekyng_ymd >= p_ymd;

           AND ymd                 = p_ymd; -- 휴일도 입력분 반영
    end if;

      INTO w_cnt

                , p_ymd        /* _2- */
                , mm.fund_cd   /* _3- */
                , mm.jm_cd     /* _4- */
                , mm.buy_date  /* _5- */
                , mm.aekm      /* _6- */
                , mm.aek       /* _7- */
                , NULL         /* _8- */
                , NULL         /* _9- */
                );

    -- 선매출마스타 이월
    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'scm0sc.ymd=' || p_ymd, '선매출 마스타(scm0sc) delete,재생성' );

    DELETE FROM SCM0SC t1   /* 채권 선매출이자현황 */
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    INSERT INTO SCM0SC tt   /* 채권 선매출이자현황 */
    SELECT p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
         , p_ymd             /* _2- */
         , t1.fund_cd        /* _3- */
         , t1.jm_cd          /* _4- */
         , t1.buy_date       /* _5- */
         , NVL(misu_ija,0)   /* _6- */
         , NVL(misu_ija,0)   /* _7- */
         , NVL(sung_cost,0)  /* _8- */
         , NVL(sung_cost,0)  /* _9- */
         , NVL(sung_tax,0)   /* _10- */
         , NVL(sung_tax,0)   /* _11- */
         , NVL(yesu_tax,0)   /* _12- */
         , NVL(yesu_tax,0)   /* _13- */
         , NVL(day_ija,0)    /* _14- */
         , NVL(gugan_ija,0)  /* _15- */
      FROM SCM0SC t1  /* 채권 선매출이자현황 */
         , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd - 1
       AND NVL(t1.misu_ija,0) + NVL(t1.sung_cost,0) > 0
       AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
       AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
       AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd;

    -- 원금상환 삭제
    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'B030', 'ucs0bh.sanghw_ymd=' || p_ymd, '원금상환(ucs0bh) delete' );

    DELETE FROM UCS0BH t1   /* 채권 상환내역 */
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.sanghw_ymd = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'ssm0km.ymd=' || p_ymd, '선물마스타(ssm0km) delete,재생성' );

    DELETE FROM SSM0KM tt   /* 파생 보유현황 */
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    INSERT INTO SSM0KM tt   /* 파생 보유현황 */
         ( corp_gr             /* _1- */
         , ymd                 /* _2- */
         , fund_cd             /* _3- */
         , sj_cd               /* _4- */
         , chasu               /* _5- */
         , sm_tr_gb            /* _6- */
         , tr_co_cd            /* _7- */
         , org_tr_ymd          /* _8- */
         , pass_gyey_su        /* _9- */
         , up_gyey_su          /* _10- */
         , dw_gyey_su          /* _11- */
         , pass_chui_ga        /* _12- */
         , up_chui_ga          /* _13- */
         , dw_chui_ga          /* _14- */
         , pyunga_sonik        /* _15- */
         , pyunga_tr_cha       /* _16- */
         , cons_bfil_chui_aek  /* _17- */
         , jungsan_aek         /* _18- */
         , siga_aek            /* _19- */
         )
    SELECT p_corp_gr                                                    /* _1- */
         , p_ymd                                                        /* _2- */
         , t1.fund_cd                                                   /* _3- */
         , t1.sj_cd                                                     /* _4- */
         , t1.chasu                                                     /* _5- */
         , t1.sm_tr_gb                                                  /* _6- */
         , t1.tr_co_cd                                                  /* _7- */
         , t1.org_tr_ymd                                                /* _8- */
         , NVL(pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(up_gyey_su,0) - NVL(dw_gyey_su,0)  /* _9- */
         , 0                                                            /* _10- */
         , 0                                                            /* _11- */
         , NVL(t1.pass_chui_ga,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_ga,0)
                                  - NVL(t1.dw_chui_ga,0)
                                  + CASE WHEN t1.sm_tr_gb IN ('3','5')
                                         THEN - NVL(t1.gyul_up_sonik,0)
                                         ELSE NVL(t1.gyul_up_sonik,0)
                                    END                                 /* _12- */
         , 0                                                            /* _13- */
         , 0                                                            /* _14- */
         , CASE WHEN w_holi='Y' THEN pyunga_sonik
                                ELSE 0 END                              /* _15- */
         , 0                                                            /* _16- */
         , NVL(t1.cons_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_ga,0)
                                        - NVL(t1.cons_dw_chui_aek,0)    /* _17- */
         , jungsan_aek                                                  /* _18- */
         , siga_aek                                                     /* _19- */
      FROM SSM0KM t1  /* 파생 보유현황 */
         , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd - 1
       AND NVL(t1.pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(t1.up_gyey_su,0) - NVL(t1.dw_gyey_su,0) != 0
       AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
       AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
       AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd;

    -- 선물거래 -> Master 갱신
    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'B060', '', '선물거래 -> Master 갱신' );

    -- 선물 거래 Table
    for xx IN (
        SELECT tr_ymd                          /* _1- */
             , fund_cd                         /* _2- */
             , tr_cd                           /* _3- */
             , sj_cd                           /* _4- */
             , chasu                           /* _5- */
             , tr_seq_no                       /* _6- */
             , NVL(gyey_su,0)    AS gyey_su    /* _7- */
             , NVL(gyey_jisu,0)  AS gyey_jisu  /* _8- */
             , tr_co_cd                        /* _9- */
             , ip_user                         /* _10- */
          FROM SST0KT t1  /* 파생 거래내역 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   NOT LIKE 'L%'
         ORDER BY tr_cd ASC
    ) loop
        SR_UPDKM9 (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.fund_cd,
                   xx.tr_cd, xx.sj_cd, xx.chasu, xx.gyey_su, xx.tr_co_cd, 'i', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'SR_UPDKM9 : ' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 미지급이익분배금 자동 재투자 처리
    -- SR_PROC0400 : 재계약시 조정처리로 이동 20230403 yjs

    -- 채권단가 자동생성 20240905
    for xx IN (
        SELECT NVL(cj.as_cj_cd, cj.jm_cd)           AS as_cj_cd
             , cj.jm_cd
             , MAX (t1.siga_aek / t1.aekm * 10000)  AS danga
          FROM SCM0CM_SIGA t1  /* 채권 시가 LOAD 자료 */
             , SCM0CJ      cj  /* 채권종목 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr                 = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                     = p_ymd
           AND t1.siga_aek                > 0
           AND t1.aekm                    > 0
           AND cj.corp_gr                 = t1.corp_gr
           AND NVL(cj.as_cj_cd, cj.jm_cd) = t1.jm_cd
         GROUP BY cj.as_cj_cd, cj.jm_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SCM1SM tt  /* 채권 시가평가 자료 */
                   ( corp_gr  , ymd  , jm_cd   , as_cj_cd   , danga             )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.jm_cd, xx.as_cj_cd, ROUND(xx.danga,2) );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            UPDATE SCM1SM tt    /* 채권 시가평가 자료 */
               SET danga = ROUND(xx.danga,2)
             WHERE 1 = 1 
               AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND ymd     = p_ymd
               AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;
        END;
    end loop;

    -- OTS 이월처리

    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'B070', 'ots0om.ymd=' || p_ymd, 'OTS 보유현황 delete, 재생성' );

    DELETE FROM OTS0OM t1   /* OTS 보유현황 */
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    INSERT INTO OTS0OM  /* OTS 보유현황 */
         ( corp_gr             /* _1- */
         , ymd                 /* _2- */
         , fund_cd             /* _3- */
         , jm_cd               /* _4- */
         , bfil_qty            /* _5- */
         , bfil_aek            /* _6- */
         , bfil_sonik          /* _7- */
         , sonik               /* _8- */
         , cons_bfil_chui_aek  /* _9- */
         )
    SELECT p_corp_gr                                            /* _1- */
         , p_ymd                                                /* _2- */
         , t1.fund_cd                                           /* _3- */
         , t1.jm_cd                                             /* _4- */
         , NVL(bfil_qty,0) + NVL(up_qty,0) - NVL(dw_qty,0)      /* _5- */
         , NVL(bfil_aek,0) + NVL(up_aek,0) - NVL(dw_aek,0)
                           + NVL(gyul_up_sonik,0)               /* _6- */
         , NVL(sonik,0)                                         /* _7- */
         , NVL(sonik,0)                                         /* _8- */
         , NVL(cons_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(up_aek,0)
                                     - NVL(cons_dw_chui_aek,0)  /* _9- */
      FROM OTS0OM t1  /* OTS 보유현황 */
         , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd - 1
       AND  (NVL(t1.bfil_qty,0) + NVL(t1.up_qty,0) - NVL(t1.dw_qty,0) != 0 OR
             NVL(t1.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_aek,0) != 0)
       AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
       AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
       AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd;

    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'B080', 'ots0jg.ymd=' || p_ymd, 'OTS 종가정보 delete, 재생성' );

    -- OTS 종가정보 이월처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t1.jm_cd
             , t2.jonga
             , mj_ija
             , mg_aek
          FROM OTS0OM t1  /* OTS 보유현황 */
             , OTS0JG t2  /* OTS 종가정보 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t2.ymd     = p_ymd - 1
           AND t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO OTS0JG  /* OTS 종가정보 */
                 ( corp_gr      /* _1- */
                 , ymd          /* _2- */
                 , jm_cd        /* _3- */
                 , bfil_jonga   /* _4- */
                 , jonga        /* _5- */
                 , bfil_mj_ija  /* _6- */
                 , mj_ija       /* _7- */
                 , bfil_mg_aek  /* _8- */
                 , mg_aek       /* _9- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr  /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd      /* _2- */
                   , xx.jm_cd   /* _3- */
                   , xx.jonga   /* _4- */
                   , xx.jonga   /* _5- */
                   , xx.mj_ija  /* _6- */
                   , xx.mj_ija  /* _7- */
                   , xx.mg_aek  /* _8- */
                   , xx.mg_aek  /* _9- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            if  w_holi = 'Y'    then
                UPDATE OTS0JG   /* OTS 종가정보 */
                   SET bfil_jonga  = xx.jonga
                     , jonga       = xx.jonga
                     , bfil_mj_ija = xx.mj_ija
                     , mj_ija      = xx.mj_ija
                     , bfil_mg_aek = xx.mg_aek
                     , mg_aek      = xx.mg_aek
                     , chgtime     = p_ymd
                 WHERE 1 = 1 
                   AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND ymd     = p_ymd;
            else
                UPDATE OTS0JG   /* OTS 종가정보 */
                   SET bfil_jonga  = xx.jonga
                     , bfil_mj_ija = xx.mj_ija
                     , bfil_mg_aek = xx.mg_aek
                 WHERE 1 = 1 
                   AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND ymd     = p_ymd;
            end if;
        END;
    end loop;

    -- 해외자산 이월처리

    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'B110', 'syt0mc.ymd=' || p_ymd, '해외 채권/채무(syt0mc) delete, 재생성' );

    -- 해외 채권/채무 익일 이월처리
    DELETE FROM SYT0MC  /* 해외 채권/채무 발생 및 감소 MASTER */
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd;

    INSERT INTO SYT0MC  /* 해외 채권/채무 발생 및 감소 MASTER */
    SELECT p_corp_gr                                  /* _1- */
         , p_ymd                                      /* _2- */
         , t1.tr_cd                                   /* _3- */
         , t1.fund_cd                                 /* _4- */
         , t1.trustee                                 /* _5- */
         , t1.currency                                /* _6- */
         , NVL(bfil_aek,0) + NVL(up_aek,0)
                           - NVL(dw_aek,0)            /* _7- */
         , 0                                          /* _8- */
         , 0                                          /* _9- */
         , NVL(won_bfil_aek,0) + NVL(won_up_aek,0)
                               - NVL(won_dw_aek,0)    /* _10- */
         , 0                                          /* _11- */
         , 0                                          /* _12- */
         , NVL(won_hwan_cha,0)                        /* _13- */
         , NVL(won_hwan_cha,0)                        /* _14- */
         , NULL                                       /* _15- */
         , NVL(fcur_bfil_aek,0) + NVL(fcur_up_aek,0)
                                - NVL(fcur_dw_aek,0)  /* _16- */
         , 0                                          /* _17- */
         , 0                                          /* _18- */
         , NVL(fcur_hwan_cha,0)                       /* _19- */
         , NVL(fcur_hwan_cha,0)                       /* _20- */
      FROM SYT0MC t1  /* 해외 채권/채무 발생 및 감소 MASTER */
         , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd - 1
       AND  (NVL(t1.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_aek,0) != 0
             OR NVL(t1.won_bfil_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_aek,0) - NVL(t1.won_dw_aek,0) != 0
             OR NVL(t1.fcur_bfil_aek,0) + NVL(t1.fcur_up_aek,0) - NVL(t1.fcur_dw_aek,0) != 0)
       AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
       AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
       AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd;

    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'syt0ys.ymd=' || p_ymd, '수도결제(syt0ys) delete, 재생성' );

    -- 작업일보다 재처리일시가 작은경우 수도결제 삭제자료 backup
    --- 과거자료 잘못 돌리거나 재처리시 필요
    SELECT hyun_ymd
      INTO w_ymd
      FROM SZX0AA t1  /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr;

    if  w_ymd > p_ymd   then
        INSERT INTO SYT0YS_BACKUP   /* 해외 수도결제(작업일과 다른 기준가작업시 임의 백업) */
        SELECT sysdate
             , t1.*
          FROM SYT0YS t1  /* 해외 수도결제 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     >= p_ymd;
    end if;

    INSERT INTO SYT0YS_BUNHAL   /* 해외 수도결제 분할처리 */
    SELECT *
      FROM SYT0YS t1  /* 해외 수도결제 */
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
       AND t1.bunhal_aek != 0;

    -- 수도결제 재처리
    DELETE FROM SYT0YS  /* 해외 수도결제 */
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd       = p_ymd
       AND gyulje_gb = 'N';

    -- 재처리시 당일생성되는 수도결제 확인된 자료 삭제되므로 다시 입력해야 함. 20190620 yjs
    DELETE FROM SYT0YS  /* 해외 수도결제 */
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd  >= p_ymd
       AND ymd     > p_ymd;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.*
             , ia.fund_currency
          FROM SYT0YS t1  /* 해외 수도결제 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd - 1
           AND t1.gyulje_gb             = 'N'
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.bunhal_aek > 0   then
            xx.gyulje_aek      := xx.gyulje_aek      - xx.bunhal_aek;
            xx.won_gyulje_aek  := xx.won_gyulje_aek  - xx.bunhal_won_gyulje_aek;
            xx.fcur_gyulje_aek := xx.fcur_gyulje_aek - xx.bunhal_fcur_gyulje_aek;
        end if;
        BEGIN
            -- 당일 분할상환 입력액 처리
            SELECT bunhal_aek
              INTO xx.bunhal_aek
              FROM SYT0YS_BUNHAL t1  /* 해외 수도결제 분할처리 */
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd   = xx.tr_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.currency = xx.currency
               AND t1.tr_seq   = xx.tr_seq
               AND t1.tr_cd    = xx.tr_cd
               AND t1.trustee  = xx.trustee
               AND t1.tr_co_cd = xx.tr_co_cd
               AND t1.bs_type  = xx.bs_type;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            xx.bunhal_aek := 0;
        END;
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SYT0YS  /* 해외 수도결제 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr           /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd               /* _2- */
                   , xx.tr_ymd           /* _3- */
                   , xx.tr_cd            /* _4- */
                   , xx.fund_cd          /* _5- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd         /* _6- */
                   , xx.trustee          /* _7- */
                   , xx.jm_cd            /* _8- */
                   , xx.currency         /* _9- */
                   , xx.tr_seq           /* _10- */
                   , xx.gyulje_ymd       /* _11- */
                   , xx.tr_chui_aek      /* _12- */
                   , xx.won_tr_chui_aek  /* _13- */
                   , xx.gyulje_aek       /* _14- */
                   , xx.won_gyulje_aek   /* _15- */
                   , xx.gyulje_gb        /* _16- */
                   , xx.gyulje_jm_cd     /* _17- */
                   , xx.won_pyunga_aek   /* _18- */
                   , xx.won_hwan_cha     /* _19- */
                   , xx.count_cost       /* _20- */
                   , xx.tax_aek          /* _21- */
                   , NULL                /* _22- */
                   , xx.pyunga_join      /* _23- */
                   , xx.bs_type          /* _24- */
                   , xx.fcur_gyulje_aek  /* _25- */
                   , xx.fcur_pyunga_aek  /* _26- */
                   , xx.fcur_hwan_cha    /* _27- */
                   , xx.bunhal_aek       /* _28- */
                   , NULL                /* _29- */
                   , NULL                /* _30- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
            -- 당일 결제확인된 종목 중복에러 pass
        END;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'B121', 'syt0ys_tax.ymd=' || p_ymd, '세금납부(syt0ys_tax) delete, 재생성' );

    -- GROSS-UP 세금관리 재처리
    DELETE FROM SYT0TAX /* 해외 세금 납부확정 자료(GROSS-UP 환급관리) */
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'B122', 'syt0yg_pyunga.ymd=' || p_ymd, '배당/주식권리 일별 평가자료(syt0yg_pyunga) delete, 재생성' );

    -- 해외 배당/주식권리 일별 평가자료 이월처리
    DELETE FROM SYT0YG_PYUNGA   /* 해외 배당/주식권리 일별 평가 */
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd       = p_ymd
       AND churi_ymd IS NULL;

    INSERT INTO SYT0YG_PYUNGA   /* 해외 배당/주식권리 일별 평가 */
    SELECT p_corp_gr            /* _1- */
         , p_ymd                /* _2- */
         , t1.pyunga_join       /* _3- */
         , t1.jusu              /* _4- */
         , t1.gyulje_aek        /* _5- */
         , t1.won_gyulje_aek    /* _6- */
         , t1.pyunga_aek        /* _7- */
         , t1.won_pyunga_aek    /* _8- */
         , t1.won_pyunga_sonik  /* _9- */
         , t1.won_hwan_cha      /* _10- */
         , t1.napbu_ymd         /* _11- */
         , NULL                 /* _12- */
         , NULL                 /* _13- */
         , NULL                 /* _14- */
         , NULL                 /* _15- */
         , NULL                 /* _16- */
         , NULL                 /* _17- */
         , NULL                 /* _18- */
         , NULL                 /* _19- */
         , NULL                 /* _20- */
         , fcur_gyulje_aek      /* _21- */
         , fcur_pyunga_aek      /* _22- */
         , fcur_pyunga_sonik    /* _23- */
         , fcur_hwan_cha        /* _24- */
         , fcur_aek             /* _25- */
      FROM SYT0YG_PYUNGA t1  /* 해외 배당/주식권리 일별 평가 */
         , SYT0YG        yg  /* 해외 배당/주식권리 현황 */
         , SZM0IA        ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd - 1
       AND t1.churi_ymd IS NULL
       AND t1.pyunga_join               NOT IN (SELECT pyunga_join
                                                  FROM SYT0YG_PYUNGA ta  /* 해외 배당/주식권리 일별 평가 */
                                                 WHERE 1 = 1
                                                   AND ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                                   AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd)
       AND NVL(yg.end_ymd, p_ymd + 1)   > p_ymd
       AND NVL(yg.churi_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
       AND yg.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
       AND yg.pyunga_join               = t1.pyunga_join
       AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd)     >= p_ymd
       AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
       AND ia.fund_cd                   = yg.fund_cd;

    -- 자산마스타 익일 이월처리
    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'B130', 'sym0yz.ymd=' || p_ymd, '자산마스타(sym0yz) delete, 재생성' );

    DELETE FROM SYM0YZ  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                                     /* _1- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                     /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                       /* _3- */
             , t1.currency                                                                    /* _4- */
             , NVL(tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(tr_up_jusu,0)
                                   - NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0)
                                   + NVL(RIGHT_JUSU,0)                 AS jusu                /* _5- */
             , NVL(bfil_jilg_jusu,0) + NVL(jilg_up_jusu,0)
                                     - NVL(jilg_dw_jusu,0)             AS jilg_jusu           /* _6- */
             , NVL(tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0)
                                       - NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                       + NVL (RIGHT_AEK,0)
                                       + NVL(tr_gyul_up_sonik,0)       AS chui_aek            /* _7- */
             , NVL(won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0)
                                        - NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                        + NVL(RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)
                                        + NVL(won_gyul_up_sonik,0)     AS won_chui_aek        /* _8- */
             , NVL(sung_cost,0)                                        AS sung_cost           /* _9- */
             , NVL(won_sung_cost,0)                                    AS won_sung_cost       /* _10- */
             , NVL(misu_ija,0)                                         AS misu_ija            /* _11- */
             , NVL(won_misu_ija,0)                                     AS won_misu_ija        /* _12- */
             , NVL(sung_tax,0)                                         AS sung_tax            /* _13- */
             , NVL(won_sung_tax,0)                                     AS won_sung_tax        /* _14- */
             , NVL(misu_ija_tax,0)                                     AS misu_ija_tax        /* _15- */
             , NVL(won_misu_ija_tax,0)                                 AS won_misu_ija_tax    /* _16- */
             , NVL(msd_meib_aekm,0)                                    AS msd_meib_aekm       /* _17- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                                     /* _18- */
             , t1.sm_tr_gb                                                                    /* _19- */
             , NVL(fcur_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0)
                                         - NVL(fcur_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                         + NVL(RIGHT_FCUR_AEK,0)
                                         + NVL(fcur_gyul_up_sonik,0)   AS fcur_chui_aek       /* _20- */
             , NVL(fcur_sung_cost,0)                                   AS fcur_sung_cost      /* _21- */
             , NVL(fcur_misu_ija,0)                                    AS fcur_misu_ija       /* _22- */
             , NVL(cons_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0)
                                         - NVL(cons_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                         + NVL(RIGHT_AEK,0)            AS cons_chui_aek       /* _23- */
             , NVL(cons_won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0)
                                             - NVL(cons_won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                             + NVL(RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)    AS cons_won_chui_aek   /* _24- */
             , NVL(cons_fcur_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0)
                                              - NVL(cons_fcur_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                              + NVL(RIGHT_FCUR_AEK,0)  AS cons_fcur_chui_aek  /* _25- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd - 1
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        if (xx.jusu + xx.msd_meib_aekm) != 0    then
            INSERT INTO SYM0YZ  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr              /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                  /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd             /* _3- */
                   , xx.trustee             /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_cd               /* _5- */
                   , xx.currency            /* _6- */
                   , xx.jusu                /* _7- */
                   , 0                      /* _8- */
                   , 0                      /* _9- */
                   , xx.chui_aek            /* _10- */
                   , 0                      /* _11- */
                   , 0                      /* _12- */
                   , 0                      /* _13- */
                   , xx.won_chui_aek        /* _14- */
                   , 0                      /* _15- */
                   , 0                      /* _16- */
                   , 0                      /* _17- */
                   , 0                      /* _18- */
                   , 0                      /* _19- */
                   , xx.sung_cost           /* _20- */
                   , xx.sung_cost           /* _21- */
                   , xx.sung_tax            /* _22- */
                   , xx.sung_tax            /* _23- */
                   , xx.misu_ija            /* _24- */
                   , xx.misu_ija            /* _25- */
                   , xx.misu_ija_tax        /* _26- */
                   , xx.misu_ija_tax        /* _27- */
                   , xx.won_sung_cost       /* _28- */
                   , xx.won_sung_cost       /* _29- */
                   , xx.won_sung_tax        /* _30- */
                   , xx.won_sung_tax        /* _31- */
                   , xx.won_misu_ija        /* _32- */
                   , xx.won_misu_ija        /* _33- */
                   , xx.won_misu_ija_tax    /* _34- */
                   , xx.won_misu_ija_tax    /* _35- */
                   , 0                      /* _36- */
                   , 0                      /* _37- */
                   , 0                      /* _38- */
                   , 0                      /* _39- */
