                   , 0                      /* _40- */
                   , 0                      /* _41- */
                   , xx.bs_type             /* _42- */
                   , NULL                   /* _43- */
                   , NULL                   /* _44- */
                   , xx.sm_tr_gb            /* _45- */
                   , xx.jilg_jusu           /* _46- */
                   , 0                      /* _47- */
                   , 0                      /* _48- */
                   , xx.fcur_chui_aek       /* _49- */
                   , 0                      /* _50- */
                   , 0                      /* _51- */
                   , 0                      /* _52- */
                   , 0                      /* _53- */
                   , 0                      /* _54- */
                   , xx.fcur_sung_cost      /* _55- */
                   , xx.fcur_sung_cost      /* _56- */
                   , xx.fcur_misu_ija       /* _57- */
                   , xx.fcur_misu_ija       /* _58- */
                   , 0                      /* _59- */
                   , 0                      /* _60- */
                   , 0                      /* _61- */
                   , 0                      /* _62- */
                   , 0                      /* _63- */
                   , NULL                   /* _64- */
                   , NULL                   /* _65- */
                   , NULL                   /* _66- */
                   , xx.cons_chui_aek       /* _67- */
                   , 0                      /* _68- */
                   , xx.cons_won_chui_aek   /* _69- */
                   , 0                      /* _70- */
                   , xx.cons_fcur_chui_aek  /* _71- */
                   , 0                      /* _72- */
                   , NULL                   /* _73- */
                   , NULL                   /* _74- */
                   , NULL                   /* _75- */
                   , NULL                   /* _76- */
                   , NULL                   /* _77- */
                   , NULL                   /* _78- */
                   , NULL                   /* _79- */
                   , NULL                   /* _80- */
                   , NULL                   /* _81- */
                   , NULL                   /* _82- */
                   , NULL                   /* _83- */
                   , NULL                   /* _84- */
                   , NULL                   /* _85- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 해외채권 마스타 미수도결제 매입/매도액 재처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                                                                                                     /* _1- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                                                                     /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                                                                       /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                                                               /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE t1.tr_cd WHEN 'J14' THEN t1.tr_jusu        END),0)                                                              AS meib_jusu      /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE t1.tr_cd WHEN 'J14' THEN t1.gyulje_aek     END),0)                                                              AS meib_aek       /* _6- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE t1.tr_cd WHEN 'J14' THEN t1.won_gyulje_aek END),0)                                                              AS won_meib_aek   /* _7- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE t1.tr_cd WHEN 'J14' THEN F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek, ia.fund_currency) END),0)  AS fcur_meib_aek  /* _8- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE t1.tr_cd WHEN 'K11' THEN t1.tr_jusu        END),0)                                                              AS medo_jusu      /* _9- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE t1.tr_cd WHEN 'K11' THEN t1.gyulje_aek     END),0)                                                              AS medo_aek       /* _10- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE t1.tr_cd WHEN 'K11' THEN t1.won_gyulje_aek END),0)                                                              AS won_medo_aek   /* _11- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE t1.tr_cd WHEN 'K11' THEN F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek, ia.fund_currency)
                       END),0)                                                                                                              AS fcur_medo_aek  /* _12- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1  /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd     BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS (p_ymd,-1) AND (p_ymd - 1)
           AND t1.tr_cd      IN ('J14','K11')
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb   = '2'
           AND ya.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd      = t1.jm_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, t1.trustee, t1.jm_cd, ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
           SET msd_meib_aekm     = xx.meib_jusu
             , msd_meib_aek      = xx.meib_aek
             , won_msd_meib_aek  = xx.won_meib_aek
             , msd_medo_aekm     = xx.medo_jusu
             , msd_medo_aek      = xx.medo_aek
             , won_msd_medo_aek  = xx.won_medo_aek
             , fcur_msd_meib_aek = xx.fcur_meib_aek
             , fcur_msd_medo_aek = xx.fcur_medo_aek
         WHERE 1 = 1 
           AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND trustee = xx.trustee
           AND ymd     = p_ymd;
    end loop;

    -- 일별 변동성 기준자료 이월생성 처리 (당일신규생성분 처리로 union 으로 변경)
    SR_JA032A_DD ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_msg );
    if  w_msg <> 'Y'    then
        p_msg := 'SR_JA032A_DD : ' || w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;
--    dbms_output.put_line ('SR_JA032A_DD : (' || to_char (p_ymd,'yyyy.mm.dd') || ') ' || w_msg);

    -- 이월 후 PORT번호 변경
    SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'PORT', 'uspm_port.ymd=' || TO_CHAR (F_OPEN_US(p_ymd,'-1'),'yyyy.mm.dd'), 'MANGI < ' || TO_CHAR (p_ymd,'yyyy.mm.dd') );
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.TYMD
             , t1.FUND_CD
             , t1.PORT_NUM
             , 'AA'  AS target_num
          FROM USPM_PORT t1  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.CORP_GR          = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.TYMD             = F_OPEN_US(p_ymd,'-1')
           AND t1.MANGI            < p_ymd
           AND LENGTH(t1.PORT_NUM) = 1
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT t1.PORT_NUM
              INTO xx.target_num
              FROM USPM_PORT t1  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.MANGI    = (SELECT MIN (MANGI)
                                    FROM USPM_PORT ta  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
                                   WHERE 1 = 1
                                     AND ta.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
                                     AND ta.TYMD     = p_ymd
                                     AND ta.FUND_CD  = xx.fund_cd
                                     AND ta.PORT_NUM = xx.port_num)
               AND t1.FUND_CD  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.TYMD     = xx.tymd
               AND t1.PORT_NUM LIKE xx.port_num || '%';
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            CONTINUE;
        END;

        SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'PORT', 'uspm_port.ymd=' || p_ymd, 'PORT : ' || xx.target_num || ' --> ' || xx.port_num );

        for yz IN (
            SELECT t1.JM_CD                                /* _1- */
                 , '(' || xx.port_num || ')'   AS trustee  /* _2- */
                 , t1.CURRENCY                             /* _3- */
                 , t1.BS_TYPE                              /* _4- */
                 , t1.SM_TR_GB                             /* _5- */
                 , t1.TR_BFIL_JUSU                         /* _6- */
                 , t1.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK                     /* _7- */
                 , t1.WON_BFIL_CHUI_AEK                    /* _8- */
                 , t1.FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK                   /* _9- */
                 , t1.CONS_BFIL_CHUI_AEK                   /* _10- */
                 , t1.CONS_WON_BFIL_CHUI_AEK               /* _11- */
                 , t1.CONS_FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK              /* _12- */
              FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.YMD     = p_ymd
               AND t1.TRUSTEE = '(' || xx.target_num || ')'
               AND t1.FUND_CD = xx.fund_cd
        ) loop
            SR_BSS ( p_corp_gr, 'PORT', 'sym0yz change', xx.fund_cd || '(' || xx.target_num || ')' || yz.jm_cd );
            BEGIN
                UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                   SET TRUSTEE = yz.trustee
                 WHERE 1 = 1 
                   AND CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
                   AND YMD      = p_ymd
                   AND FUND_CD  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND TRUSTEE  = '(' || xx.target_num || ')'
                   AND JM_CD    = yz.jm_cd
                   AND CURRENCY = yz.currency
                   AND BS_TYPE  = yz.bs_type
                   AND SM_TR_GB = yz.SM_TR_GB;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                   SET TR_BFIL_JUSU            = NVL(TR_BFIL_JUSU,0) + NVL(yz.TR_BFIL_JUSU,0)
                     , TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK        = NVL(TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(yz.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0)
                     , WON_BFIL_CHUI_AEK       = NVL(WON_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(yz.WON_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0)
                     , FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK      = NVL(FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(yz.FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0)
                     , CONS_BFIL_CHUI_AEK      = NVL(CONS_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(yz.CONS_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0)
                     , CONS_WON_BFIL_CHUI_AEK  = NVL(CONS_WON_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(yz.CONS_WON_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0)
                     , CONS_FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK = NVL(CONS_FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(yz.CONS_FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0)
                 WHERE 1 = 1 
                   AND CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
                   AND YMD      = p_ymd
                   AND FUND_CD  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND TRUSTEE  = yz.trustee
                   AND JM_CD    = yz.JM_CD
                   AND CURRENCY = yz.currency
                   AND BS_TYPE  = yz.bs_type
                   AND SM_TR_GB = yz.SM_TR_GB;

                DELETE FROM SYM0YZ  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                 WHERE 1 = 1 
                   AND CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
                   AND YMD      = p_ymd
                   AND FUND_CD  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND TRUSTEE  = '(' || xx.target_num || ')'
                   AND JM_CD    = yz.jm_cd
                   AND CURRENCY = yz.currency
                   AND BS_TYPE  = yz.bs_type
                   AND SM_TR_GB = yz.SM_TR_GB;
            END;
        end loop;
    end loop;

    -- 국가별 휴일관리가 되고있지 않으므로 환율과 주식종가 이월처리
    --
    -- 환율 이월처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT *
          FROM SYX0HY t1  /* (개별 환율이 없을경우)적용 환율 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.gijun_ymd = F_OPEN_US(p_ymd,'-1')
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SYX0HY  /* (개별 환율이 없을경우)적용 환율 */
            VALUES ( p_ymd        /* _1- */
                   , xx.currency  /* _2- */
                   , xx.GIJUN_RT  /* _3- */
                   , xx.TRANS_RT  /* _4- */
                   , NULL         /* _5- */
                   , NULL         /* _6- */
                   , NULL         /* _7- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;
    end loop;
    -- 자문사별 환율입력자료 이월
    for xx IN (
        SELECT CURRENCY
             , GIJUN_RT
          FROM SYX1HY t1  /* (개별 환율이 없을경우)적용 환율 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.currency  != 'KRW'
           AND t1.gijun_ymd = F_OPEN_US(p_ymd,'-1')
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT currency
              INTO xx.currency
              FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.currency = xx.currency
               AND ROWNUM = 1;

            MERGE INTO SYX1HY tt  /* 운용(자문)사 개별 환율 */
               USING DUAL ON ( CORP_GR   = p_corp_gr
                           AND GIJUN_YMD = p_ymd
                           AND CURRENCY  = xx.currency )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                 UPDATE
                    SET GIJUN_RT = xx.gijun_rt
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                 INSERT
                 VALUES ( p_corp_gr    /* _1- */
                        , p_ymd        /* _2- */
                        , xx.currency  /* _3- */
                        , xx.gijun_rt  /* _4- */
                        , NULL         /* _5- */
                        , NULL         /* _6- */
                        );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;
    end loop;

    -- 환율 원화대비 환산
    BEGIN
        SELECT USD_GIJUN
          INTO w_krw
          FROM SYX1HY t1  /* 운용(자문)사 개별 환율 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.CORP_GR   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.CURRENCY  = 'KRW'
           AND t1.GIJUN_YMD = p_ymd;

        UPDATE SYX1HY   /* 운용(자문)사 개별 환율 */
           SET GIJUN_RT = F_TRUNC(w_krw / USD_GIJUN * CASE WHEN CURRENCY IN ('JPY','VND')
                                                           THEN 100
                                                           ELSE 1 END, currency)
         WHERE 1 = 1 
           AND CORP_GR   = p_corp_gr
           AND GIJUN_YMD = p_ymd
           AND CURRENCY  <> 'KRW'
           AND USD_GIJUN > 0;

        UPDATE SYX1HY   /* 운용(자문)사 개별 환율 */
           SET GIJUN_RT = w_krw
         WHERE 1 = 1 
           AND CORP_GR   = p_corp_gr
           AND GIJUN_YMD = p_ymd
           AND CURRENCY  = 'USD';
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        NULL;
    END;
    -- 자문사별 환율입력자료 이월
    for xx IN (
        SELECT CURRENCY
             , GIJUN_RT
          FROM SYX1HY t1  /* 운용(자문)사 개별 환율 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.currency  != 'KRW'
           AND t1.gijun_ymd = F_OPEN_US(p_ymd,'-1')
    ) loop
        MERGE INTO SYX1HY tt  /* 운용(자문)사 개별 환율 */
           USING DUAL ON ( CORP_GR   = p_corp_gr
                       AND GIJUN_YMD = p_ymd
                       AND CURRENCY  = xx.currency )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET GIJUN_RT = CASE WHEN GIJUN_RT=0 THEN xx.gijun_rt
                                                    ELSE GIJUN_RT END
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr    /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd        /* _2- */
                    , xx.currency  /* _3- */
                    , xx.gijun_rt  /* _4- */
                    , NULL         /* _5- */
                    , NULL         /* _6- */
                    );
    end loop;

    -- 해외종가 이월처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT *
          FROM SYT0LP t1  /* 해외수신 종목 시세 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = F_OPEN_US(p_ymd,'-1')
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SYT0LP  /* 해외수신 종목 시세 */
                 ( CORP_GR                   /* _1- */
                 , YMD                       /* _2- */
                 , JM_CD                     /* _3- */
                 , JONGA                     /* _4- */
                 , DANGA                     /* _5- */
                 , PX_CLOSE_DT               /* _6- */
                 , PX_LAST                   /* _7- */
                 , PX_DT_1D                  /* _8- */
                 , PX_CLOSE_1D               /* _9- */
                 , PX_YEST_CLOSE_EXCH_UNADJ  /* _10- */
                 , BLBG_TCKR                 /* _11- */
                 , ISIN_CD                   /* _12- */
                 , CURRENCY                  /* _13- */
                 , HANGSA_GA                 /* _14- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                    /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                        /* _2- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                     /* _3- */
                   , xx.jonga                     /* _4- */
                   , xx.danga                     /* _5- */
                   , xx.px_close_dt               /* _6- */
                   , xx.px_last                   /* _7- */
                   , xx.px_dt_1d                  /* _8- */
                   , xx.px_close_1d               /* _9- */
                   , xx.px_yest_close_exch_unadj  /* _10- */
                   , xx.blbg_tckr                 /* _11- */
                   , xx.isin_cd                   /* _12- */
                   , xx.currency                  /* _13- */
                   , xx.hangsa_ga                 /* _14- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            -- 휴일 자료 LOAD된경우는 update 제외
            SELECT COUNT(*)
              INTO w_cnt
              FROM SYT0LP t1  /* 해외수신 종목 시세 */
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd       = p_ymd
               AND t1.load_time IS NULL
               AND t1.jm_cd     = xx.jm_cd;
            if  w_cnt != 0  then
                UPDATE SYT0LP   /* 해외수신 종목 시세 */
                   SET jonga = xx.jonga
                     , danga = xx.danga
                 WHERE 1 = 1 
                   AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND ymd     = p_ymd;
            end if;
        END;
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0210 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 현금 수도결제(상환,이자수령)
--
    w_holi                         VARCHAR(1);

    w_junyong_ymd                  DATE;
    w_ikyong_ymd                   DATE;
    w_sury_ymd                     DATE;

    w_medo_ija                     NUMBER;
    w_misu_ija                     NUMBER;
    w_sunsu_ija                    NUMBER;
    w_sury_ija                     NUMBER;
    w_suib_ija                     NUMBER;  /* 수입이자 */
    w_dr_aek                       NUMBER;
    w_cr_aek                       NUMBER;

    w_tr_cd                        VARCHAR(3);
    w_jasan_gb                     szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;
    w_bigo                         VARCHAR(200);

    w_tr_B34                       VARCHAR(1);  /* 선수령(후취) 확인 */

    w_aek                          number_varray_50;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200)
    ;                             
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0210', p_ymd || ' : 현금 수도결제 초기화');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B000', 'skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0bu.proc_step=21', '현금수도결제 분개장(skt0bu) delete');

    -- 현금관련 분개장 삭제
    DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND t1.proc_step = 21;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'uhm0hp.sanghw_ymd=' || p_ymd, '정보계 현금자산 상환실적(uhm0hp) delete');

    -- 정보계마스타 생성
    DELETE FROM UHM0HP  /* 현금 상환내역 */
     WHERE corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
       AND sanghw_ymd = p_ymd;

    DELETE FROM UZM0SH  /* 채권/현금 이자수령 및 만기상환내역 (수령액 차이분 입력용) */
     WHERE corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
       AND sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
       AND jm_gr      = 'H'
       AND mod_user IS NULL;

    -- 현금이자구간 재처리
    -- 선취
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid           /* _1- */
             , t1.jm_cd           /* _2- */
             , t1.sunhu_gb        /* _3- */
             , t1.now_ija_hoicha  /* _4- */
             , t1.bf_ija_ymd      /* _5- */
             , t1.af_ija_ymd      /* _6- */
          FROM SHM0HJ t1  /* 현금 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.cash_cd    != '90'
           AND t1.balh_ymd   <= p_ymd
           AND t1.sanghw_ymd > p_ymd
           AND t1.sunhu_gb   = '1'
           AND p_ymd         NOT BETWEEN (t1.bf_ija_ymd + 1) AND t1.af_ija_ymd
    ) loop
        -- 당일 이자수령 처리가 가능하게
        BEGIN
            SELECT gugan_no
                 , bf_ija_ymd
                 , af_ija_ymd
              INTO xx.now_ija_hoicha
                 , xx.bf_ija_ymd
                 , xx.af_ija_ymd
              FROM SHJ0IG t1  /* 현금 종목별 이자구간 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND p_ymd      BETWEEN (t1.bf_ija_ymd + 1) AND t1.af_ija_ymd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            SR_SHJ0IG (p_corp_gr, xx.jm_cd, 'no');
            BEGIN
                SELECT gugan_no
                     , bf_ija_ymd
                     , af_ija_ymd
                  INTO xx.now_ija_hoicha
                     , xx.bf_ija_ymd
                     , xx.af_ija_ymd
                  FROM SHJ0IG t1  /* 현금 종목별 이자구간 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND p_ymd      BETWEEN t1.bf_ija_ymd AND (t1.af_ija_ymd - 1);
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := xx.jm_cd || ' - 선취이자구간을 확인하십시오';
                RETURN;
            END;
        END;

        UPDATE SHM0HJ tt    /* 현금 종목정보 */
           SET now_ija_hoicha = xx.now_ija_hoicha
             , bf_ija_ymd     = xx.bf_ija_ymd
             , af_ija_ymd     = xx.af_ija_ymd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;
    -- 후취
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid           /* _1- */
             , t1.jm_cd           /* _2- */
             , t1.sunhu_gb        /* _3- */
             , t1.now_ija_hoicha  /* _4- */
             , t1.bf_ija_ymd      /* _5- */
             , t1.af_ija_ymd      /* _6- */
          FROM SHM0HJ t1  /* 현금 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.cash_cd    != '90'
           AND t1.balh_ymd   <= p_ymd
           AND t1.sanghw_ymd > p_ymd
           AND t1.sunhu_gb   != '1'
           AND p_ymd         NOT BETWEEN t1.bf_ija_ymd AND (t1.af_ija_ymd - 1)
    ) loop
        -- 당일 이자수령 처리가 가능하게
        BEGIN
            SELECT gugan_no
                 , bf_ija_ymd
                 , af_ija_ymd
              INTO xx.now_ija_hoicha
                 , xx.bf_ija_ymd
                 , xx.af_ija_ymd
              FROM SHJ0IG t1  /* 현금 종목별 이자구간 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND p_ymd      BETWEEN t1.bf_ija_ymd AND (t1.af_ija_ymd - 1);
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            SR_SHJ0IG (p_corp_gr, xx.jm_cd, 'no');
            BEGIN
                SELECT gugan_no
                     , bf_ija_ymd
                     , af_ija_ymd
                  INTO xx.now_ija_hoicha
                     , xx.bf_ija_ymd
                     , xx.af_ija_ymd
                  FROM SHJ0IG t1  /* 현금 종목별 이자구간 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND p_ymd      BETWEEN t1.bf_ija_ymd AND (t1.af_ija_ymd - 1);
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := xx.jm_cd || ' - 후취이자구간을 확인하십시오';
                RETURN;
            END;
        END;

        UPDATE SHM0HJ tt    /* 현금 종목정보 */
           SET now_ija_hoicha = xx.now_ija_hoicha
             , bf_ija_ymd     = xx.bf_ija_ymd
             , af_ija_ymd     = xx.af_ija_ymd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0210', p_ymd || ' : 현금 이자수령(지급) 처리');

    SR_GETHL (p_ymd, w_holi);  /* 공휴일 Check */
    if  w_holi = 'Y'    then    -- 공휴일인 경우 익영업일 이자수령
        p_msg := 'Y';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 개별법 자료 재처리
    DELETE FROM SHM1K tt    /* 현금 매도(이자수령) */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    w_junyong_ymd := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '-1');  /* 전영업일 */
    w_ikyong_ymd  := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '+1');  /* 익영업일 */

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                      AS hj_rowid        /* _1- */
             , ia.type_gb                                                       /* _2- */
             , hm.rowid                                      AS hm_rowid        /* _3- */
             , hm.fund_cd                                                       /* _4- */
             , hm.jm_cd                                                         /* _5- */
             , NVL(hm.bfil_aekm,0)                           AS bfil_aekm       /* _6- */
             , NVL(hm.bfil_chui_aek,0)                       AS bfil_chui_aek   /* _7- */
             , NVL(hm.sanghw_aek,0)                          AS sanghw_aek      /* _8- */
             , NVL(hm.bfil_anbun_aek,0)                      AS bfil_anbun_aek  /* _9- */
             , NVL(hm.bfil_misu_ija,0)                       AS bfil_misu_ija   /* _10- */
             , NVL(hm.bfil_sung_cost,0)                      AS bfil_sung_cost  /* _11- */
             , t1.pyom_iyul                                                     /* _12- */
             , t1.cash_cd                                                       /* _13- */
             , t1.meib_ymd                                                      /* _14- */
             , NVL(t1.now_ija_hoicha,1)                      AS now_ija_hoicha  /* _15- */
             , t1.sunhu_gb                                                      /* _16- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                                      /* _17- */
             , t1.offer_co_cd                                                   /* _18- */
             , t1.jach_cd                                                       /* _19- */
             , t1.tax_offer_gb                                                  /* _20- */
             , t1.TOT_IJA_GUGAN                                                 /* _21- */
             , ig.gugan_no                                                      /* _22- */
             , ig.bf_ija_ymd                                                    /* _23- */
             , ig.af_ija_ymd                                                    /* _24- */
             , ig.gugan_ija                                                     /* _25- */
             , TRUNC(ig.gugan_ija * NVL(hm.bfil_aekm,0))     AS gugan_ija_aek   /* _26- */
             , CASE WHEN t1.sunhu_gb='1'
                    THEN TRUNC(ig.gugan_ija * NVL(hm.bfil_aekm,0))
                    ELSE 0
               END                                           AS sunsu_ija       /* _27- */
             , TRUNC(ig.other_cost)                          AS other_cost      /* _28- */
             , ig.gugan_ilsu                                                    /* _29- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY hm.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY hm.fund_cd)  AS seq             /* _30- */
          FROM SHM0HJ t1  /* 현금 종목정보 */
             , SHJ0IG ig  /* 현금 종목별 이자구간 */
             , SHM0HM hm  /* 현금 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.cash_cd != '90'
           AND (t1.sunhu_gb='1' AND ig.bf_ija_ymd BETWEEN (w_junyong_ymd + 1) AND p_ymd OR
                t1.sunhu_gb != '1' AND ig.af_ija_ymd BETWEEN (w_junyong_ymd + 1) AND p_ymd)
           AND ig.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ig.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND hm.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND hm.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND hm.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr = hm.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = hm.fund_cd
         ORDER BY hm.fund_cd
                , hm.jm_cd
    ) loop
        -- 휴일이자수령 종목 선수령 제외
        BEGIN
            SELECT sury_ija
              INTO w_medo_ija
              FROM SHT0FS t1  /* 펀드/종목별 이자수령 유예내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd     = F_OPEN_YMD(p_ymd - 1,'-')
               AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd      = 'B29'
               AND t1.af_ija_ymd < p_ymd
               AND t1.sury_ymd   = p_ymd;

            CONTINUE;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;

        -- 선수령 확인
        w_tr_B34 := 'N';
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(sury_ija,0)
                 , 'Y'
              INTO w_sury_ija
                 , w_tr_B34
              FROM SHT0FS t1  /* 펀드/종목별 이자수령 유예내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd      = 'B34'
               AND t1.sury_ymd   < p_ymd
               AND t1.bf_ija_ymd = xx.bf_ija_ymd
               AND t1.af_ija_ymd = xx.af_ija_ymd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;

        -- 당일 매도분 반영 20200811 yjs
        SELECT NVL(SUM(aekm),0) * xx.gugan_ija
          INTO w_medo_ija
          FROM SHT0HG t1  /* 현금거래내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('E37','E41','K30');

        if  w_medo_ija != 0 then
            if  xx.sunhu_gb = '1'   then
                    xx.sunsu_ija := xx.sunsu_ija - w_medo_ija;
            else    xx.gugan_ija := xx.gugan_ija - w_medo_ija;
            end if;
        end if;

        SELECT bfil_misu_ija
             , bfil_sung_cost
          INTO xx.bfil_misu_ija
             , xx.bfil_sung_cost
          FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = (CASE WHEN xx.sunhu_gb='1' THEN xx.bf_ija_ymd ELSE xx.af_ija_ymd END)
           AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;

        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- 정기예금 : 전일수령처리
        --            전일수령 미수이자는 선수이자로 분개
        --            공휴일에 선수이자분 상계
        -- 기타     : 익일수령처리
        ----------------------------------------
        -- 수입이자, 선수이자 계산
        ----------------------------------------
        w_sunsu_ija := 0;
        if  xx.cash_cd IN ('DC','AA')   then    -- 매출채권/지분증권
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL(suib_ija,0)
                     , sury_ymd
                  INTO w_suib_ija
                     , w_sury_ymd
                  FROM SHT0FS t1  /* 펀드/종목별 이자수령 유예내역 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.tr_cd   = 'B29';
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                w_suib_ija := 0;
                w_sury_ymd := p_ymd;
            END;

            if  w_tr_B34 = 'Y'  then
                w_suib_ija := w_sury_ija - (xx.bfil_misu_ija + xx.bfil_sung_cost + xx.sunsu_ija);
            end if;

        elsif xx.cash_cd = '50' then    -- 정기예금
            if  xx.TOT_IJA_GUGAN = 1    then
                    w_suib_ija := xx.sanghw_aek - (xx.bfil_chui_aek + xx.bfil_sung_cost + xx.bfil_misu_ija);
            ELSE    w_suib_ija := xx.gugan_ija_aek - (xx.bfil_sung_cost + xx.bfil_misu_ija                   );
            end if;

        elsif xx.sunhu_gb = '1' then    -- 선취
            w_suib_ija := xx.bfil_aekm - (xx.bfil_chui_aek + xx.bfil_sung_cost + xx.bfil_misu_ija + xx.bfil_anbun_aek);

        elsif xx.sunhu_gb = '2' then    -- 후취
            w_suib_ija := xx.sanghw_aek - (xx.bfil_chui_aek + xx.bfil_sung_cost + xx.bfil_misu_ija + xx.bfil_anbun_aek);

        elsif xx.sunhu_gb = '3' then    -- 할인(매매액)
                w_suib_ija := xx.sanghw_aek - xx.bfil_chui_aek - (xx.bfil_misu_ija + xx.bfil_sung_cost);
        else    w_suib_ija := 0;
        end if;

        -- 현금 마스타 update
        UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
           SET misu_ija  = misu_ija - xx.bfil_misu_ija
             , sung_cost = 0
             , sung_tax  = 0
             , yesu_tax  = 0
         WHERE ROWID = xx.hm_rowid;

        -- 개별법 상환생성
        INSERT INTO SHM1K tt    /* 현금 매도(이자수령) */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                       /* _1- */
               , xx.fund_cd                                      /* _2- */
               , xx.jm_cd                                        /* _3- */
               , TO_CHAR(xx.meib_ymd, 'yyyymmdd')                /* _4- */
               , p_ymd                                           /* _5- */
               , 0                                               /* _6- */
               , 0                                               /* _7- */
               , 0                                               /* _8- */
               , xx.gugan_no                                     /* _9- */
               , xx.bf_ija_ymd                                   /* _10- */
               , xx.af_ija_ymd                                   /* _11- */
               , xx.gugan_ija_aek                                /* _12- */
               , xx.gugan_ija_aek                                /* _13- */
               , TRUNC(xx.gugan_ija_aek * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _14- */
               );

        -- 분개장 생성
        w_dr_aek := 0;
        w_cr_aek := 0;
        if  w_suib_ija > 0      then    w_cr_aek := w_suib_ija;
        elsif w_suib_ija < 0    then    w_dr_aek := w_suib_ija * -1;
        end if;

        w_tr_cd    := 'E21';
        w_jasan_gb := xx.cash_cd;
        if  xx.cash_cd IN ('ZS','ZF')   then
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.bfil_misu_ija + xx.bfil_sung_cost + w_suib_ija + w_sunsu_ija,
                                         xx.bfil_misu_ija,
                                         0, xx.bfil_sung_cost,
                                         w_dr_aek, w_cr_aek);               /* 수입이자 */
            if  xx.cash_cd = 'ZS'   then
                    w_jasan_gb := 'Z';
            else    w_jasan_gb := 'ZF';
            end if;
            w_bigo := 'PROC0210_Z';

        elsif xx.cash_cd = 'AA' then
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.bfil_misu_ija + xx.bfil_sung_cost + w_suib_ija,
                                         xx.bfil_misu_ija, xx.bfil_sung_cost, w_dr_aek, w_cr_aek);
            w_bigo := 'PROC0210_AA';

        elsif xx.cash_cd = 'DC' then
            if  xx.sunhu_gb = '1'   then
                if  w_tr_B34 = 'Y'  then
                    w_aek      := number_varray_50 (xx.sunsu_ija + w_suib_ija, 0, xx.sunsu_ija, w_dr_aek, w_cr_aek);
                    w_jasan_gb := 'D1';
                    w_bigo     := 'PROC0210 선취(선수)';
                elsif NVL (xx.other_cost,0) = 0 then
                    w_aek  := number_varray_50 (xx.sunsu_ija, 0, xx.sunsu_ija);
                    w_bigo := 'PROC0210 선취-선급비용';
                else
                    w_aek  := number_varray_50 (xx.sunsu_ija, 0, xx.sunsu_ija, 0, 0, NVL(xx.other_cost,0), NVL(xx.other_cost,0));
                    w_bigo := 'PROC0210 선취';
                end if;
            else
                w_aek := number_varray_50 (xx.bfil_misu_ija + xx.bfil_sung_cost + w_suib_ija, xx.bfil_misu_ija, 0, w_dr_aek, w_cr_aek);
                if  w_tr_B34 = 'Y'  then    -- 선수령
                    w_jasan_gb := 'D1';
                    w_bigo     := 'PROC0210_후취(선수)_' || w_jasan_gb || '(' || TO_CHAR (w_sury_ymd, 'mm.dd') || ')';
                else
                    w_bigo := 'PROC0210_후취(' || TO_CHAR (w_sury_ymd, 'mm.dd') || ')';
                    if  w_sury_ymd != p_ymd then    -- 현금이자미수령(미수입금)
                        w_tr_cd := 'E2M';
                    end if;
                end if;
            end if;

        elsif xx.cash_cd = '71' then    -- REPO매도 이자지급
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.bfil_misu_ija + xx.bfil_sung_cost + w_suib_ija, xx.bfil_misu_ija, xx.bfil_sung_cost, w_dr_aek, w_cr_aek);
            w_tr_cd := 'E74';
            w_bigo  := 'PROC0210_71';
        else
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.bfil_misu_ija + xx.bfil_sung_cost + w_suib_ija + w_sunsu_ija,
                                         xx.bfil_misu_ija,
                                         0,
                                         xx.bfil_sung_cost,
                                         w_dr_aek, w_cr_aek,
                                         0,
                                         w_sunsu_ija);      /* 선수이자 */
            if  xx.tax_offer_gb = '2'   then
                if  w_tr_B34 = 'Y'  then
                        w_jasan_gb := '20';  /* 선수령(후취)시 */
                else    w_jasan_gb := '01';
                end if;
            else
                if  w_tr_B34 = 'Y'  then
                        w_jasan_gb := '21';  /* 선수령(후취)시 */
                else    w_jasan_gb := '00';
                end if;
            end if;
            w_bigo := 'PROC0210_ETC' || xx.cash_cd || '/' || w_jasan_gb;
        end if;

        SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, w_aek, 21, w_bigo, w_msg);

        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(이자수령)';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 원금 상환 실적 insert
        MERGE INTO UHM0HP t1  /* 현금 상환내역 */
           USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
                       AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.hj_cd      = xx.jm_cd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET YESU_TAX  = TRUNC(xx.bfil_sung_cost * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                  , SUNN_TAX  = TRUNC((xx.bfil_misu_ija + w_suib_ija + w_sunsu_ija) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                  , MISU_IJA  = xx.bfil_misu_ija + w_suib_ija + w_sunsu_ija
                  , SUNG_COST = xx.bfil_sung_cost
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                        /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd                                            /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                                       /* _3- */
                    , xx.jm_cd                                         /* _4- */
                    , xx.cash_cd                                       /* _5- */
                    , xx.tr_co_cd                                      /* _6- */
                    , xx.offer_co_cd                                   /* _7- */
                    , xx.jach_cd                                       /* _8- */
                    , xx.meib_ymd                                      /* _9- */
                    , 0                                                /* _10- */
                    , 0                                                /* _11- */
                    , TRUNC(xx.bfil_sung_cost * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _12- */
                    , TRUNC((xx.bfil_misu_ija + w_suib_ija + w_sunsu_ija)
                            * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))                    /* _13- */
                    , xx.bfil_misu_ija + w_suib_ija + w_sunsu_ija      /* _14- */
                    , xx.bfil_sung_cost                                /* _15- */
                    , xx.pyom_iyul                                     /* _16- */
                    , xx.sunsu_ija                                     /* _17- */
                    );

        MERGE INTO UZM0SH t1  /* 채권/현금 이자수령 및 만기상환내역 (수령액 차이분 입력용) */
           USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
                       AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.jm_gr      = 'H'
                       AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET AEKM     = xx.bfil_aekm
                  , CHUI_AEK = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN xx.bfil_chui_aek
                                    ELSE CHUI_AEK END
                  , MISU_IJA = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN w_aek (1)
                                    ELSE MISU_IJA END
                  , IJA_TAX  = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN TRUNC(w_aek (1) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                                    ELSE IJA_TAX END
                  , SURY_AEK = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN xx.sanghw_aek - TRUNC(w_aek (1) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                                    ELSE SURY_AEK END
                  , mod_dt   = p_ymd
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd                                                    /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                                               /* _3- */
                    , 'H'                                                      /* _4- */
                    , xx.jm_cd                                                 /* _5- */
                    , TO_CHAR(xx.meib_ymd,'yyyymmdd')                          /* _6- */
                    , NULL                                                     /* _7- */
                    , 'KRW'                                                    /* _8- */
                    , xx.sunhu_gb                                              /* _9- */
                    , xx.bfil_aekm                                             /* _10- */
                    , xx.bfil_chui_aek                                         /* _11- */
                    , w_aek(1)                                                 /* _12- */
                    , TRUNC(w_aek (1) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))                  /* _13- */
                    , xx.sanghw_aek - TRUNC(w_aek (1) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _14- */
                    , NULL                                                     /* _15- */
                    , p_ymd                                                    /* _16- */
                    );

        -- 이자구간 변경처리
        -- 다음구간이 있는 경우 만 변경
        BEGIN
            SELECT gugan_no
                 , bf_ija_ymd
                 , af_ija_ymd
              INTO xx.now_ija_hoicha
                 , xx.bf_ija_ymd
                 , xx.af_ija_ymd
              FROM SHJ0IG t1  /* 현금 종목별 이자구간 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND p_ymd      BETWEEN t1.bf_ija_ymd AND (t1.af_ija_ymd - 1);
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;

        BEGIN
            UPDATE SHM0HJ tt    /* 현금 종목정보 */
               SET now_ija_hoicha = xx.now_ija_hoicha
                 , bf_ija_ymd     = xx.bf_ija_ymd
                 , af_ija_ymd     = xx.af_ija_ymd
             WHERE ROWID = xx.hj_rowid;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;
    end loop;

    -- 휴일이자수령 종목 선수령
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                   /* _1- */
             , ia.type_gb                                                   /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                     /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                                  /* _4- */
             , t1.aekm                                                      /* _5- */
             , t1.misu_ija                                                  /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.sung_cost,0)                            AS sung_cost  /* _7- */
             , t1.sury_ija                                                  /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.suib_ija,0)                             AS suib_ija   /* _9- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                        ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq        /* _10- */
             , hj.pyom_iyul                                                 /* _11- */
             , hj.cash_cd                                                   /* _12- */
             , hj.meib_ymd                                                  /* _13- */
             , hj.sunhu_gb                                                  /* _14- */
          FROM SHT0FS t1  /* 펀드/종목별 이자수령 유예내역 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SHM0HJ hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'B29'
           AND t1.sury_ymd   = p_ymd
           AND t1.af_ija_ymd > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
           AND hj.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND hj.jm_cd      = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        -- 현금 마스타 update
        UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
           SET misu_ija  = misu_ija - xx.misu_ija
             , sung_cost = 0
             , sung_tax  = 0
             , yesu_tax  = 0
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND ymd     = p_ymd;

        w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.sury_ija, xx.misu_ija,
                                     0, xx.sung_cost,
                                     0, xx.suib_ija);
        if  xx.cash_cd = 'DC'   then
                SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E21', 'A', '1', 'D0', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                            xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, w_aek, 21, 'PROC0210_선수령(B29) D0', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E21', 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                            xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, w_aek, 21, 'PROC0210_선수령(B29)' || xx.cash_cd, w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(이자선수령)';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 원금 상환 실적 insert
        MERGE INTO UHM0HP t1  /* 현금 상환내역 */
           USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
                       AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.hj_cd      = xx.jm_cd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET AEKM      = xx.aekm
                  , YESU_TAX  = TRUNC(xx.sung_cost * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                  , SUNN_TAX  = TRUNC(xx.sury_ija * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                  , MISU_IJA  = xx.sury_ija
                  , SUNG_COST = xx.sung_cost
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                   /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd                                       /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                                  /* _3- */
                    , xx.jm_cd                                    /* _4- */
                    , xx.cash_cd                                  /* _5- */
                    , xx.tr_co_cd                                 /* _6- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _7- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _8- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _9- */
                    , xx.aekm                                     /* _10- */
                    , 0                                           /* _11- */
                    , TRUNC(xx.sung_cost * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _12- */
                    , TRUNC(xx.sury_ija * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))   /* _13- */
                    , xx.sury_ija                                 /* _14- */
                    , xx.sung_cost                                /* _15- */
                    , xx.pyom_iyul                                /* _16- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _17- */
                    );

        MERGE INTO UZM0SH t1  /* 채권/현금 이자수령 및 만기상환내역 (수령액 차이분 입력용) */
           USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
                       AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.jm_gr      = 'H'
                       AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET AEKM     = xx.aekm
                  , MISU_IJA = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN w_aek (1)
                                    ELSE MISU_IJA END
                  , IJA_TAX  = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN TRUNC(w_aek (1) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                                    ELSE IJA_TAX END
                  , SURY_AEK = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN w_aek (1) - TRUNC(w_aek (1) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                                    ELSE SURY_AEK END
                  , mod_dt   = p_ymd
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                           /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd                                               /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                                          /* _3- */
                    , 'H'                                                 /* _4- */
                    , xx.jm_cd                                            /* _5- */
                    , TO_CHAR(xx.meib_ymd,'yyyymmdd')                     /* _6- */
                    , NULL                                                /* _7- */
                    , 'KRW'                                               /* _8- */
                    , xx.sunhu_gb                                         /* _9- */
                    , xx.aekm                                             /* _10- */
                    , 0                                                   /* _11- */
                    , w_aek(1)                                            /* _12- */
                    , TRUNC(w_aek (1) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))             /* _13- */
                    , w_aek(1) - TRUNC(w_aek (1) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _14- */
                    , NULL                                                /* _15- */
                    , p_ymd                                               /* _16- */
                    );
    end loop;

    -- 후취 선수령 처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                             /* _1- */
             , ia.type_gb                                             /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                               /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                            /* _4- */
             , t1.aekm                                                /* _5- */
             , t1.sury_ija                                            /* _6- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                        ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq  /* _7- */
             , hj.pyom_iyul                                           /* _8- */
             , hj.cash_cd                                             /* _9- */
             , hj.meib_ymd                                            /* _10- */
             , hj.sunhu_gb                                            /* _11- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                               /* _12- */
          FROM SHT0FS t1  /* 펀드/종목별 이자수령 유예내역 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SHM0HJ hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'B34'
           AND t1.sury_ymd   = p_ymd
           AND t1.af_ija_ymd > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
           AND hj.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND hj.jm_cd      = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        w_aek := number_varray_50 (xx.sury_ija, xx.sury_ija);

        -- 대출채권인
        if  xx.cash_cd = 'DC'   then
                SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', 'D0', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                            xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, w_aek, 21, 'PROC0210_선수령(B34) D0', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                            xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, w_aek, 21, 'PROC0210_선수령(B34)' || xx.cash_cd, w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(이자선수령)';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 원금 상환 실적 insert
        MERGE INTO UHM0HP t1  /* 현금 상환내역 */
           USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
                       AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.hj_cd      = xx.jm_cd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET AEKM     = xx.aekm
                  , SUNN_TAX = TRUNC(xx.sury_ija * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                  , MISU_IJA = xx.sury_ija
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                  /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd                                      /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                                 /* _3- */
                    , xx.jm_cd                                   /* _4- */
                    , xx.cash_cd                                 /* _5- */
                    , xx.tr_co_cd                                /* _6- */
                    , NULL                                       /* _7- */
                    , NULL                                       /* _8- */
                    , NULL                                       /* _9- */
                    , xx.aekm                                    /* _10- */
                    , 0                                          /* _11- */
                    , 0                                          /* _12- */
                    , TRUNC(xx.sury_ija * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _13- */
                    , xx.sury_ija                                /* _14- */
                    , 0                                          /* _15- */
                    , xx.pyom_iyul                               /* _16- */
                    , NULL                                       /* _17- */
                    );

        MERGE INTO UZM0SH t1  /* 채권/현금 이자수령 및 만기상환내역 (수령액 차이분 입력용) */
           USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
                       AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.jm_gr      = 'H'
                       AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET AEKM     = xx.aekm
                  , MISU_IJA = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN w_aek (1)
                                    ELSE MISU_IJA END
                  , IJA_TAX  = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN TRUNC(w_aek (1) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                                    ELSE IJA_TAX END
                  , SURY_AEK = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN w_aek (1) - TRUNC(w_aek (1) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                                    ELSE SURY_AEK END
                  , mod_dt   = p_ymd
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                           /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd                                               /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                                          /* _3- */
                    , 'H'                                                 /* _4- */
                    , xx.jm_cd                                            /* _5- */
                    , TO_CHAR(xx.meib_ymd,'yyyymmdd')                     /* _6- */
                    , NULL                                                /* _7- */
                    , 'KRW'                                               /* _8- */
                    , xx.sunhu_gb                                         /* _9- */
                    , xx.aekm                                             /* _10- */
                    , 0                                                   /* _11- */
                    , w_aek(1)                                            /* _12- */
                    , TRUNC(w_aek (1) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))             /* _13- */
                    , w_aek(1) - TRUNC(w_aek (1) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _14- */
                    , NULL                                                /* _15- */
                    , p_ymd                                               /* _16- */
                    );
    end loop;

    -- 현금원장에서 해당종목의 미수이자 추출
    -- 수입이자 보정에서 예금이자 차액 처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                              /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                            /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                              /* _3- */
             , t1.misu_ija                                           /* _4- */
             , t1.misu_ija                                   AS ija  /* _5- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq  /* _6- */
          FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SHM0HJ t3  /* 현금 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.ymd                   = p_ymd
           AND t2.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
           AND t3.corp_gr               = t2.corp_gr
           AND t3.jm_cd                 = t1.jm_cd
           AND t3.cash_cd               = '90'
           AND t3.sanghw_ymd            = p_ymd
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT sury_ija
              INTO xx.ija
              FROM SHT0FS t1  /* 펀드/종목별 이자수령 유예내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd    = 'B29'
               AND t1.sury_ymd = p_ymd;

            SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E21', 'A', '1', '10', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                        xx.jm_cd, 2, 2, xx.ija, xx.misu_ija, 21, 'PROC0210', w_msg);
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E21', 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                        xx.jm_cd, 2, 2, xx.misu_ija, xx.misu_ija, 21, 'PROC0210', w_msg);
        END;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(수탁사예금이자수령)';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 예금이자수령 마스타 당일분 삭제처리(재처리시 전일자를 읽으므로)
        DELETE FROM SHM0HM tt   /* 현금 보유현황 */
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0210', p_ymd || ' : 현금자산 원금상환 처리');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                              /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                            /* _2- */
             , ia.type_gb                                            /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                              /* _4- */
             , t1.bfil_aekm                                          /* _5- */
             , t1.bfil_chui_aek                                      /* _6- */
             , t1.anbun_aek                                          /* _7- */
             , t1.misu_ija                                           /* _8- */
             , t1.siga_aek                                           /* _9- */
             , hj.cash_cd                                            /* _10- */
             , hj.meib_ymd                                           /* _11- */
             , hj.sanghw_ymd                                         /* _12- */
             , hj.pyom_iyul                                          /* _13- */
             , hj.tr_co_cd                                           /* _14- */
             , hj.offer_co_cd                                        /* _15- */
             , hj.jach_cd                                            /* _16- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq  /* _17- */
          FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SHM0HJ hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
           AND hj.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND hj.jm_cd      = t1.jm_cd
           AND hj.cash_cd    != '90'
           AND hj.sanghw_ymd <= p_ymd
    ) loop
        -----------------------
        -- 원금상환 분개처리 --
        -----------------------
        if ((xx.cash_cd='50') AND (xx.sanghw_ymd < p_ymd)) OR xx.cash_cd = '70' then
            w_dr_aek   := xx.bfil_chui_aek + xx.misu_ija;
            w_cr_aek   := xx.bfil_chui_aek;
            w_misu_ija := xx.misu_ija;
        else
            w_dr_aek   := xx.bfil_chui_aek + xx.anbun_aek;
            w_cr_aek   := xx.bfil_chui_aek + xx.anbun_aek;
            w_misu_ija := 0;
        end if;
        if  xx.cash_cd IN ('ZS')    then
            SR_SZSL021 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E31', 'A', '1', 'Z', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                        xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, w_dr_aek, w_cr_aek, 21, 'proc0210', w_msg);
        elsif xx.cash_cd IN ('ZF')  then
            SR_SZSL021 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E31', 'A', '1', 'ZF', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                        xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, w_dr_aek, w_cr_aek, 21, 'proc0210', w_msg);
        else
            SR_SZSL021 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E31', 'A', '1', xx.cash_cd, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                        xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, w_dr_aek, w_cr_aek, 21, 'proc0210 ' || xx.jm_cd || p_ymd, w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
        ----------------------
        -- 현금 마스타 삭제 --
        ----------------------
        DELETE FROM SHM0HM tt   /* 현금 보유현황 */
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        -- 원금 상환 실적 insert
        MERGE INTO UHM0HP t1  /* 현금 상환내역 */
           USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
                       AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.hj_cd      = xx.jm_cd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET AEKM       = xx.bfil_aekm
                  , SANGHW_AEK = w_dr_aek
                  , SUNN_TAX   = TRUNC(w_misu_ija * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                  , MISU_IJA   = w_misu_ija
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                 /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd                                     /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                                /* _3- */
                    , xx.jm_cd                                  /* _4- */
                    , xx.cash_cd                                /* _5- */
                    , xx.tr_co_cd                               /* _6- */
                    , xx.offer_co_cd                            /* _7- */
                    , xx.jach_cd                                /* _8- */
                    , xx.meib_ymd                               /* _9- */
                    , xx.bfil_aekm                              /* _10- */
                    , w_dr_aek                                  /* _11- */
                    , 0                                         /* _12- */
                    , TRUNC(w_misu_ija * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _13- */
                    , w_misu_ija                                /* _14- */
                    , 0                                         /* _15- */
                    , xx.pyom_iyul                              /* _16- */
                    , 0                                         /* _17- */
                    );


        -- 개별법 상환생성
        MERGE INTO SHM1K t1  /* 현금 매도(이자수령) */
           USING ( SELECT jm_cd                                     /* _1- */
                        , gugan_no                                  /* _2- */
                        , bf_ija_ymd                                /* _3- */
                        , af_ija_ymd                                /* _4- */
                        , TRUNC (gugan_ija * xx.bfil_aekm)  AS ija  /* _5- */
                     FROM SHJ0IG ta  /* 현금 종목별 이자구간 */
                    WHERE ta.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                      AND ta.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
                      AND ta.af_ija_ymd = p_ymd ) mm
              ON ( t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = mm.jm_cd
               AND t1.buy_date = TO_CHAR(xx.meib_ymd,'yyyymmdd')
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET aekm = xx.bfil_aekm
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                  /* _1- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                                 /* _2- */
                    , mm.jm_cd                                   /* _3- */
                    , TO_CHAR(xx.meib_ymd,'yyyymmdd')            /* _4- */
                    , p_ymd                                      /* _5- */
                    , xx.bfil_aekm                               /* _6- */
                    , 0                                          /* _7- */
                    , 0                                          /* _8- */
                    , mm.gugan_no                                /* _9- */
                    , mm.bf_ija_ymd                              /* _10- */
                    , mm.af_ija_ymd                              /* _11- */
                    , mm.ija                                     /* _12- */
                    , w_misu_ija                                 /* _13- */
                    , TRUNC(w_misu_ija * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))  /* _14- */
                    );
    end loop;

    -- 당일 상환자료가 아닌경우 삭제처리
    DELETE FROM UZM0SH  /* 채권/현금 이자수령 및 만기상환내역 (수령액 차이분 입력용) */
     WHERE corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
       AND sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
       AND jm_gr      = 'H'
       AND mod_dt     <> p_ymd;

    p_msg := 'Y';

    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0220 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 채권 수도결제(상환,이자수령)
--
    w_holi                         VARCHAR(1);
    w_budo                         VARCHAR(10);
    w_jasan_gb                     szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;

    w_junyong_ymd                  DATE;
    w_sury_ymd                     DATE;
    w_ikyong_ymd                   DATE;
    w_ymd                          DATE;

    w_ija                          NUMBER;
    w_cbmg_ija                     NUMBER;
    com_anbun_aek                  NUMBER;

    sc_guganija                    NUMBER;
    sc_sungcost                    NUMBER;
    sc_misuija                     NUMBER;

    ig_gugan_ija                   NUMBER;
    ig_gugan_ilsu                  NUMBER;
    ig_pr_ija                      NUMBER;  /* 할인/할증이자 */
    ig_pr_ilsu                     NUMBER;
    ig_pr_gugan_ija                NUMBER;
    ig_pr_gugan_ilsu               NUMBER;
    ig_pass_ilsu                   NUMBER;
    ig_pass_ija                    NUMBER;
    ig_pass_pr_ija                 NUMBER;

    cm_misu_ija                    NUMBER;
    cm_sung_cost                   NUMBER;
    sc_suibija                     NUMBER;  /* 수입이자 - 선매출부분 */
    w_suib_ija                     NUMBER;  /* 수입이자 - 총액 + 휴일이자 */
    cr_aek                         NUMBER;  /* 수입이자 - 감소액 */
    dr_aek                         NUMBER;  /* 수입이자 - 증가액 */

    w_tr_aek                       NUMBER;
    w_tr_chui_aek                  NUMBER;
    w_anbun_aek                    NUMBER;
    w_misu_ija                     NUMBER;
    w_sung_cost                    NUMBER;
    w_pr_sung_cost                 NUMBER;
    w_cbmg_misu_ija                NUMBER;
    w_cbmg_sung_cost               NUMBER;
    w_yesu_tax                     NUMBER;
    w_sung_tax                     NUMBER;
    w_dr_hab                       NUMBER;
    w_cr_hab                       NUMBER;

    w_aek                          number_varray_50;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0220', p_ymd || ' : 채권 수도결제 초기화');

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND t1.proc_step = 22;

    -- 채권 이자구간 조정
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid         /* _1- */
             , t1.jm_cd         /* _2- */
             , t1.cj_nm         /* _3- */
             , t1.now_gugan_no  /* _4- */
             , t1.bf_ija_ymd    /* _5- */
             , t1.af_ija_ymd    /* _6- */
          FROM SCM0CJ t1  /* 채권종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.balh_ymd               <= p_ymd
           AND t1.sanghw_ymd             > p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.bf_ija_ymd, p_ymd) >= F_OPEN_YMD(p_ymd,'-')
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT bf_ija_ymd
                 , af_ija_ymd
                 , gugan_no
              INTO xx.bf_ija_ymd
                 , xx.af_ija_ymd
                 , xx.now_gugan_no
              FROM SCJ0IG t1  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr             = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.jm_cd               = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.ija_gb              = 'B'
               AND F_OPEN_YMD(p_ymd,'-')  BETWEEN (t1.bf_ija_ymd + 1) AND t1.af_ija_ymd;

            UPDATE SCM0CJ tt    /* 채권종목 */
               SET now_gugan_no = xx.now_gugan_no
                 , bf_ija_ymd   = xx.bf_ija_ymd
                 , af_ija_ymd   = xx.af_ija_ymd
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

            INSERT INTO SZX3CK tt   /* 펀드별 Check 자료 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                          /* _1- */
                   , xx.jm_cd || ' ' || xx.cj_nm || ' - 이자구간 수정'  /* _2- */
                   , 1612500                                            /* _3- */
                   , 'sz15000'                                          /* _4- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B030', 'scm0cm.ymd=' || p_ymd, '이자수령 종목마스타 전/후이자일 재조정 처리');

    SR_RESET_IJA_YMD (p_corp_gr, p_ymd);

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0220', p_ymd || ' : 채권 원리금 상환처리(분할채 분할원금 상환)');

    SR_GETHL (p_ymd, w_holi);  /* 공휴일 CHECK */
    if  w_holi = 'Y'    then
        p_msg := 'Y';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    w_junyong_ymd := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '-1');  /* 전영업일 */
    w_ikyong_ymd  := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '+1');  /* 익영업일 */

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid       /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd     /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd       /* _3- */
             , t1.anbun_aek   /* _4- */
             , t2.slip_attr   /* _5- */
             , t2.sangj_gb    /* _6- */
             , ig.sanghw_aek  /* _7- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SCM0CJ t2  /* 채권종목 */
             , SCM0IG ig  /* 분할채 상환내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd          = p_ymd
           AND t2.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd        = t1.jm_cd
           AND t2.bunhal_gb    = '1'
           AND ig.corp_gr      = t1.corp_gr
           AND ig.fund_cd      = t1.fund_cd
           AND ig.jm_cd        = t1.jm_cd
           AND ig.repay_ymd    = p_ymd
           AND ig.sanghw_aek   > 0
           AND ig.lst_meib_ymd = t1.lst_meib_ymd
    ) loop
        -------------------------------------
        -- 채권마스타 거래후분으로 수정
        -------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
           SET medo_aekm = xx.sanghw_aek
             , meib_aek  = xx.anbun_aek
             , medo_aek  = xx.sanghw_aek
             , anbun_aek = 0
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        -- 분개생성(E32:원금상환)
        SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E32', 'A', '1', xx.slip_attr || xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd,
                    1, 1, xx.sanghw_aek, xx.sanghw_aek, 22, 'sccp021', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0220', p_ymd || ' : 채권 원리금 상환처리');

    -- 개별법 자료 재처리
    DELETE FROM SCM1K tt    /* 채권 매도(이자수령) */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                          /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                        /* _2- */
             , ia.type_gb                                                        /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                          /* _4- */
             , t1.buy_date                                                       /* _5- */
             , cj.sangj_gb                                                       /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0)                            AS aekm            /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0)                        AS chui_aek        /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_anbun_aek,0)                       AS anbun_aek       /* _9- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_pr_misu_ija,0)                     AS pr_misu_ija     /* _10- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_pr_sung_cost,0)                    AS pr_sung_cost    /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_misu_ija,0)                        AS misu_ija        /* _12- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_sung_cost,0)                       AS sung_cost       /* _13- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_suib_ija,0)                        AS suib_ija        /* _14- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_cbmg_sung_cost,0)                  AS cbmg_sung_cost  /* _15- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_cbmg_misu_ija,0)                   AS cbmg_misu_ija   /* _16- */
             , cj.bond_cd                                                        /* _17- */
             , cj.bond_attr                                                      /* _18- */
             , cj.balh_ga                                                        /* _19- */
             , cj.ija_jigub_gb                                                   /* _20- */
             , cj.slip_attr                                                      /* _21- */
             , cj.balh_co                                                        /* _22- */
             , cj.balh_ymd                                                       /* _23- */
             , cj.sanghw_ymd                                                     /* _24- */
             , cj.pyom_iyul                                                      /* _25- */
             , cj.now_gugan_no                                                   /* _26- */
             , cj.bf_ija_ymd                                                     /* _27- */
             , cj.af_ija_ymd                                                     /* _28- */
             , cj.sunme_ija_ymd                                                  /* _29- */
             , cj.medo_ymd                                                       /* _30- */
             , cj.mangi_iyul                                                     /* _31- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                        ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq             /* _32- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND cj.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND NVL(cj.budo_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  > p_ymd
           AND (cj.sanghw_ymd <= p_ymd OR ((cj.sanghw_ymd BETWEEN p_ymd AND w_ikyong_ymd - 1) AND NVL(cj.holi_ija_su,'A') ='B'))
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
    ) loop
        BEGIN   /* 발행기관 부도시 상환유예 */
            SELECT 'pass'
              INTO w_budo
              FROM SJX0JB t1  /* 발행기관 */
             WHERE t1.balh_co                  = xx.balh_co
               AND NVL(t1.budo_ymd, p_ymd + 1) <= p_ymd;

            CONTINUE;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;

        BEGIN   /* 상환거래 발생시 pass 처리 20200727 yjs */
            SELECT '1'
              INTO w_budo
              FROM SCT0CG t1  /* 채권거래내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd    LIKE 'E%'
               AND t1.buy_date = xx.buy_date;

            CONTINUE;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;

        if (xx.bf_ija_ymd IS NULL OR xx.af_ija_ymd IS NULL
             OR (xx.sunme_ija_ymd IS NULL AND xx.medo_ymd < xx.balh_ymd)
             OR xx.sanghw_ymd IS NULL) AND (xx.pyom_iyul != 0)    then
            p_msg   := p_ymd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-'
                             || '원금상환관련 채권종목정보를 확인하십시요 .';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 선매출 금액 구함
        if  xx.sunme_ija_ymd = xx.sanghw_ymd AND xx.medo_ymd < xx.balh_ymd  then
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL(bfil_sung_cost,0)
                     , NVL(bfil_misu_ija,0)
                     , NVL(gugan_ija,0)
                  INTO sc_sungcost
                     , sc_misuija
                     , sc_guganija
                  FROM SCM0SC t1  /* 채권 선매출이자현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.buy_date = xx.buy_date;
            EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
                p_msg := xx.jm_cd || '- 선매출마스타 정보가 없습니다.';
                RETURN;
            END;
        else
            sc_sungcost := 0;
            sc_misuija  := 0;
            sc_guganija := 0;
        end if;

        if  xx.ija_jigub_gb IN ('7','8','9','G','H')    then
            -- 금융이표채는 발행단위(10,000원), 기타 이표채는 액면으로 계산
            if  NOT (xx.bond_attr='3' AND (SUBSTR (xx.bond_cd,1,1) ='1' OR xx.bond_cd='900')) OR xx.balh_ga = '9'    then
                xx.balh_ga := NVL (xx.aekm,0);
            end if;

            BEGIN
                SELECT gugan_ija
                  INTO ig_gugan_ija
                  FROM SCJ0IG t1  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.ija_gb     = 'B'
                   AND t1.af_ija_ymd = xx.af_ija_ymd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := xx.jm_cd || ' ' || TO_CHAR (xx.af_ija_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || ' - 이자구간이 없습니다.';
                RETURN;
            END;

            if  xx.bond_cd = '101' AND xx.ija_jigub_gb = '1'    then    ---통안채 이표는 제외
