                    ig_gugan_ija := ceilnum(xx.balh_ga * ig_gugan_ija) * TRUNC (xx.aekm / xx.balh_ga,14);
            ELSE    ig_gugan_ija := TRUNC(xx.balh_ga * ig_gugan_ija) * TRUNC (xx.aekm / xx.balh_ga,14);
            end if;

            ig_pr_gugan_ija := 0;
        else
            SR_NOW_GUGAN_IJA (p_corp_gr, xx.sanghw_ymd - 1, xx.jm_cd, xx.aekm,
                              ig_gugan_ilsu, ig_gugan_ija, ig_pr_gugan_ilsu, ig_pr_gugan_ija, ig_pass_ilsu, ig_pass_ija, ig_pass_pr_ija,
                              xx.now_gugan_no, xx.bf_ija_ymd, xx.af_ija_ymd, w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;

        ----------------------------------------
        -- 상환액 계산
        ----------------------------------------
        -- 이표채(789) / 할인채,통화채(1230) / 복리채,전환,교환(456)
        -- 최종 상환손익액 계산
        SR_COM_ANBUN (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.buy_date,
                      xx.aekm, xx.chui_aek, (xx.pr_misu_ija + xx.pr_sung_cost), com_anbun_aek, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'sr_com_anbun : ' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        ----------------------------------------
        -- 분개생성(E32:원금상환)
        ----------------------------------------
        SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E32', 'A', '1', xx.slip_attr || xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, xx.seq,
                    xx.chui_aek + com_anbun_aek, xx.chui_aek + xx.anbun_aek, 22, 'sccp020', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(ija,0) - (xx.misu_ija + xx.pr_misu_ija + sc_misuija
                              + xx.sung_cost + xx.pr_sung_cost + sc_sungcost)
                 , cbmg_ija
              INTO w_ija
                 , w_cbmg_ija
              FROM SCT0FS t1  /* 펀드/종목별 원금(이자) 유예 MASTER */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr              = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd              = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd               = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd                = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd                = 'B22'
               AND NVL(t1.sury_ymd, p_ymd) = p_ymd
               AND t1.buy_date             = xx.buy_date;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_ija   := (ig_gugan_ija + ig_pr_gugan_ija + sc_guganija)
                        - (xx.misu_ija + xx.pr_misu_ija + sc_misuija + xx.sung_cost + xx.pr_sung_cost + sc_sungcost);
            w_cbmg_ija := 0;
        END;

        w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.pr_sung_cost + xx.sung_cost + xx.pr_misu_ija + xx.misu_ija + xx.suib_ija + sc_sungcost + sc_misuija + w_ija,
                                     xx.pr_misu_ija + xx.misu_ija + xx.suib_ija + sc_misuija,
                                     0,
                                     xx.pr_sung_cost + xx.sung_cost + sc_sungcost,
                                     CASE WHEN w_ija < 0 THEN - w_ija ELSE 0 END,
                                     CASE WHEN w_ija > 0 THEN w_ija ELSE 0 END);
        SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E22', 'A', '1', xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, xx.seq, w_aek, 22, 'sccp020', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if NVL (xx.mangi_iyul,0) != 0   then    --- 만기에 한번반영
            if  w_cbmg_ija != 0 then
                    w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.cbmg_misu_ija, xx.cbmg_sung_cost,
                                                 w_cbmg_ija, w_cbmg_ija - (xx.cbmg_misu_ija + xx.cbmg_sung_cost));
            else    w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.cbmg_misu_ija, xx.cbmg_sung_cost,
                                                 xx.cbmg_misu_ija + xx.cbmg_sung_cost);
            end if;
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B2D', 'A', '1', xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 9, xx.seq, w_aek, 22, 'sccp020', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg || '(채권상환(sccp020))';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 원리금상환 생성
        BEGIN
            if  xx.pyom_iyul != 0   then
                MERGE INTO UCS0BH t1  /* 채권 상환내역 */
                   USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                               AND t1.sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
                               AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
                               AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
                               AND t1.buy_date   = xx.buy_date )
                WHEN MATCHED THEN
                     UPDATE
                        SET AEKM         = xx.aekm
                          , YESU_TAX     = TRUNC(xx.sung_cost * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))
                          , SUNN_TAX     = TRUNC((xx.misu_ija + (ig_gugan_ija - xx.misu_ija - xx.sung_cost)) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                          , WON_GM       = xx.chui_aek + NVL(com_anbun_aek,0)
                          , MISU_IJA     = xx.misu_ija + (ig_gugan_ija - xx.misu_ija - xx.sung_cost)
                          , SUNG_COST    = xx.sung_cost
                          , WON_RI_GM    = xx.chui_aek + NVL(com_anbun_aek,0) + xx.misu_ija + xx.pr_misu_ija + xx.sung_cost + xx.pr_sung_cost
                                                       + sc_misuija + sc_sungcost + w_ija + xx.suib_ija
                          , SC_YESU_TAX  = TRUNC((xx.pr_sung_cost + sc_sungcost) * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))
                          , SC_SUNN_TAX  = TRUNC((ig_pr_gugan_ija + sc_guganija - xx.pr_sung_cost - sc_sungcost) * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))
                          , SC_MISU_IJA  = ig_pr_gugan_ija + sc_guganija - xx.pr_sung_cost - sc_sungcost
                          , SC_SUNG_COST = xx.pr_sung_cost + sc_sungcost
                          , SUIB_IJA     = xx.suib_ija
                          , CBMG_IJA     = xx.cbmg_misu_ija + xx.cbmg_sung_cost
                WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                     INSERT
                     VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                  /* _1- */
                            , p_ymd                                                      /* _2- */
                            , xx.fund_cd                                                 /* _3- */
                            , xx.jm_cd                                                   /* _4- */
                            , xx.buy_date                                                /* _5- */
                            , xx.bond_cd                                                 /* _6- */
                            , xx.aekm                                                    /* _7- */
                            , TRUNC(xx.sung_cost * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))                /* _8- */
                            , TRUNC((xx.misu_ija + (ig_gugan_ija - xx.misu_ija - xx.sung_cost))
                                    * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))                              /* _9- */
                            , xx.chui_aek + NVL(com_anbun_aek,0)                         /* _10- */
                            , xx.misu_ija + (ig_gugan_ija - xx.misu_ija - xx.sung_cost)  /* _11- */
                            , xx.sung_cost                                               /* _12- */
                            , xx.chui_aek + NVL(com_anbun_aek,0) + xx.misu_ija + xx.pr_misu_ija + xx.sung_cost
                                          + xx.pr_sung_cost + sc_misuija + sc_sungcost
                                          + w_ija + xx.suib_ija                          /* _13- */
                            , TRUNC((xx.pr_sung_cost + sc_sungcost)
                                    * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))                             /* _14- */
                            , TRUNC((ig_pr_gugan_ija + sc_guganija - xx.pr_sung_cost - sc_sungcost)
                                    * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))                             /* _15- */
                            , ig_pr_gugan_ija + sc_guganija
                                              - xx.pr_sung_cost - sc_sungcost            /* _16- */
                            , xx.pr_sung_cost + sc_sungcost                              /* _17- */
                            , NULL                                                       /* _18- */
                            , NULL                                                       /* _19- */
                            , NULL                                                       /* _20- */
                            , NULL                                                       /* _21- */
                            , NULL                                                       /* _22- */
                            , xx.suib_ija                                                /* _23- */
                            , xx.cbmg_misu_ija + xx.cbmg_sung_cost                       /* _24- */
                            );
            else
                MERGE INTO UCS0BH t1  /* 채권 상환내역 */
                   USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                               AND t1.sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
                               AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
                               AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
                               AND t1.buy_date   = xx.buy_date )
                WHEN MATCHED THEN
                     UPDATE
                        SET AEKM         = xx.aekm
                          , YESU_TAX     = TRUNC(xx.sung_cost * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))
                          , SUNN_TAX     = TRUNC((xx.misu_ija + (ig_gugan_ija - xx.misu_ija - xx.sung_cost)) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                          , WON_GM       = xx.aekm
                          , MISU_IJA     = xx.misu_ija + (ig_gugan_ija - xx.misu_ija - xx.sung_cost)
                          , SUNG_COST    = xx.sung_cost
                          , WON_RI_GM    = xx.aekm + xx.misu_ija + xx.pr_misu_ija + xx.sung_cost + xx.pr_sung_cost
                                                   + sc_misuija + sc_sungcost + w_ija + xx.suib_ija
                          , SC_YESU_TAX  = TRUNC((xx.pr_sung_cost + sc_sungcost) * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))
                          , SC_SUNN_TAX  = TRUNC((ig_pr_gugan_ija + sc_guganija - xx.pr_sung_cost - sc_sungcost) * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))
                          , SC_MISU_IJA  = ig_pr_gugan_ija + sc_guganija - xx.pr_sung_cost - sc_sungcost
                          , SC_SUNG_COST = xx.pr_sung_cost + sc_sungcost
                          , SUIB_IJA     = xx.suib_ija
                          , CBMG_IJA     = xx.cbmg_misu_ija + xx.cbmg_sung_cost
                WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                     INSERT
                     VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                  /* _1- */
                            , p_ymd                                                      /* _2- */
                            , xx.fund_cd                                                 /* _3- */
                            , xx.jm_cd                                                   /* _4- */
                            , xx.buy_date                                                /* _5- */
                            , xx.bond_cd                                                 /* _6- */
                            , xx.aekm                                                    /* _7- */
                            , TRUNC(xx.sung_cost * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))                /* _8- */
                            , TRUNC((xx.misu_ija + (ig_gugan_ija - xx.misu_ija - xx.sung_cost))
                                    * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))                              /* _9- */
                            , xx.aekm                                                    /* _10- */
                            , xx.misu_ija + (ig_gugan_ija - xx.misu_ija - xx.sung_cost)  /* _11- */
                            , xx.sung_cost                                               /* _12- */
                            , xx.aekm + xx.misu_ija + xx.pr_misu_ija + xx.sung_cost + xx.pr_sung_cost
                                      + sc_misuija + sc_sungcost
                                      + w_ija + xx.suib_ija                              /* _13- */
                            , TRUNC((xx.pr_sung_cost + sc_sungcost)
                                    * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))                             /* _14- */
                            , TRUNC((ig_pr_gugan_ija + sc_guganija - xx.pr_sung_cost - sc_sungcost)
                                    * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))                             /* _15- */
                            , ig_pr_gugan_ija + sc_guganija
                                              - xx.pr_sung_cost - sc_sungcost            /* _16- */
                            , xx.pr_sung_cost + sc_sungcost                              /* _17- */
                            , NULL                                                       /* _18- */
                            , NULL                                                       /* _19- */
                            , NULL                                                       /* _20- */
                            , NULL                                                       /* _21- */
                            , NULL                                                       /* _22- */
                            , xx.suib_ija                                                /* _23- */
                            , xx.cbmg_misu_ija + xx.cbmg_sung_cost                       /* _24- */
                            );
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.jm_cd || '-채권원리금 상환내역의 생성오류입니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        MERGE INTO UZM0SH t1  /* 채권/현금 이자수령 및 만기상환내역 (수령액 차이분 입력용) */
           USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
                       AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.jm_gr      = 'C'
                       AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
                       AND t1.buy_date   = xx.buy_date )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET AEKM     = xx.aekm
                  , MISU_IJA = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN ig_gugan_ija + w_cbmg_ija
                                    ELSE MISU_IJA END
                  , IJA_TAX  = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN TRUNC((ig_gugan_ija + w_cbmg_ija) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                                    ELSE IJA_TAX END
                  , SURY_AEK = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN xx.aekm + ig_gugan_ija + w_cbmg_ija - TRUNC((ig_gugan_ija + w_cbmg_ija) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                                    ELSE SURY_AEK END
                  , mod_dt   = p_ymd
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                                                        /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd                                                                                            /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                                                                                       /* _3- */
                    , 'C'                                                                                              /* _4- */
                    , xx.jm_cd                                                                                         /* _5- */
                    , xx.buy_date                                                                                      /* _6- */
                    , NULL                                                                                             /* _7- */
                    , 'KRW'                                                                                            /* _8- */
                    , '2'                                                                                              /* _9- */
                    , xx.aekm                                                                                          /* _10- */
                    , 0                                                                                                /* _11- */
                    , ig_gugan_ija + w_cbmg_ija                                                                        /* _12- */
                    , TRUNC((ig_gugan_ija + w_cbmg_ija) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))                                        /* _13- */
                    , xx.aekm + ig_gugan_ija + w_cbmg_ija - TRUNC((ig_gugan_ija + w_cbmg_ija) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _14- */
                    , NULL                                                                                             /* _15- */
                    , p_ymd                                                                                            /* _16- */
                    );

        -- 개별법 상환생성
        MERGE INTO SCM1K t1  /* 채권 매도(이자수령) */
           USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
                       AND t1.buy_date = xx.buy_date
                       AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET aekm = xx.aekm
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                   /* _1- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                                  /* _2- */
                    , xx.jm_cd                                    /* _3- */
                    , xx.buy_date                                 /* _4- */
                    , p_ymd                                       /* _5- */
                    , xx.aekm                                     /* _6- */
                    , 0                                           /* _7- */
                    , 0                                           /* _8- */
                    , xx.now_gugan_no                             /* _9- */
                    , xx.bf_ija_ymd                               /* _10- */
                    , xx.af_ija_ymd                               /* _11- */
                    , ig_gugan_ija                                /* _12- */
                    , ig_pr_gugan_ija + sc_guganija - xx.pr_sung_cost
                                      - sc_sungcost               /* _13- */
                    , TRUNC(ig_gugan_ija * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _14- */
                    );

        -- 채권 선매출 마스타 삭제
        DELETE FROM SCM0SC tt   /* 채권 선매출이자현황 */
         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
           AND buy_date = xx.buy_date
           AND ymd      >= p_ymd;

        -- 채권 마스타 삭제
        DELETE FROM SCM0CM tt   /* 채권 보유현황 */
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0220', p_ymd || ' : 채권 이자수령 처리');

    -- 이표채면서 국채/금융채인 경우 선매출 구간이자 취득액 처리
    -- 선매출이자수령일 종목정보 수정 20200310 yjs
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                       AS cm_rowid   /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                   /* _2- */
             , ia.type_gb                                                   /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                             /* _4- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                     /* _5- */
             , t1.buy_date                                                  /* _6- */
             , t1.bfil_aekm                                                 /* _7- */
             , t1.bfil_chui_aek                                             /* _8- */
             , t1.yuhyo_rt                                                  /* _9- */
             , cj.slip_attr || cj.sangj_gb                    AS jasan_gb   /* _10- */
             , cj.sanghw_ymd                                                /* _11- */
             , sc.rowid                                       AS sc_rowid   /* _12- */
             , NVL(sc.misu_ija,0)                             AS misu_ija   /* _13- */
             , NVL(sc.sung_cost,0)                            AS sung_cost  /* _14- */
             , cj.rowid                                       AS cj_rowid   /* _15- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                        ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq        /* _16- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SCM0SC sc  /* 채권 선매출이자현황 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
             , SCJ0IG ig  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND sc.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND sc.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND sc.ymd                       = t1.ymd
           AND sc.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND sc.buy_date                  = t1.buy_date
           AND cj.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND cj.slip_attr                 IN ('1','4')
           AND cj.ija_jigub_gb              IN ('7','8','G','H')
           AND ig.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND ig.jm_cd                     = cj.jm_cd
           AND ig.ija_gb                    = 'B'
           AND ig.af_ija_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND ig.gugan_no                  = 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
         ORDER BY t1.jm_cd
                , sc.fund_cd
    ) loop
        -- 선매출이자 수령일 정보수정
        UPDATE SCM0CJ tt    /* 채권종목 */
           SET sunme_ija_ymd = p_ymd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.cj_rowid;

        -- 채권마스타 취득액 update
        UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
           SET meib_aek = NVL(meib_aek,0) + (xx.misu_ija + xx.sung_cost)
         WHERE ROWID = xx.cm_rowid;

        -- 선매출채권마스타  update
        UPDATE SCM0SC tt    /* 채권 선매출이자현황 */
           SET misu_ija  = 0
             , sung_cost = 0
             , sung_tax  = 0
             , yesu_tax  = 0
             , day_ija   = 0
         WHERE ROWID = xx.sc_rowid;

        INSERT INTO SCM1K tt    /* 채권 매도(이자수령) */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                  /* _1- */
               , xx.fund_cd                                 /* _2- */
               , xx.jm_cd                                   /* _3- */
               , xx.buy_date                                /* _4- */
               , p_ymd                                      /* _5- */
               , 0                                          /* _6- */
               , 0                                          /* _7- */
               , 0                                          /* _8- */
               , NULL                                       /* _9- */
               , NULL                                       /* _10- */
               , NULL                                       /* _11- */
               , NULL                                       /* _12- */
               , xx.misu_ija                                /* _13- */
               , TRUNC(xx.misu_ija * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _14- */
               );

        w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.misu_ija + xx.sung_cost,
                                     xx.misu_ija,
                                     0,
                                     xx.sung_cost);
        SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E27', 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                    1, xx.seq, w_aek, 22, 'PROC0220 선매출(휴일도작업)', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC0220 -> ' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    w_junyong_ymd := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '-1');  /* 전영업일 */
    w_ikyong_ymd  := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '+1');  /* 익영업일 */

    -- B24 채권이자선수령
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                          /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                        /* _2- */
             , ia.type_gb                                                        /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                          /* _4- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                          /* _5- */
             , t1.aekm                                                           /* _6- */
             , t1.ija                                                            /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.cbmg_ija,0)                             AS cbmg_ija        /* _8- */
             , cj.sangj_gb                                                       /* _9- */
             , cj.bond_cd                                                        /* _10- */

             , ig.bf_ija_ymd                                                     /* _17- */
             , ig.af_ija_ymd                                                     /* _18- */
             , ROUND (t1.aekm * 10000 * ig.gugan_ija)         AS gugan_ija       /* _19- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                        ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq             /* _20- */
          FROM SCT0FS t1  /* 펀드/종목별 원금(이자) 유예 MASTER */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SCM0CM cm  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
             , SCJ0IG ig  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd    = 'B24'
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
           AND cm.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND cm.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
           AND cm.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND cm.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
           AND cm.buy_date = t1.buy_date
           AND cj.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
           AND ig.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ig.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
           AND ig.ija_gb   = 'B'
           AND p_ymd       BETWEEN ig.bf_ija_ymd AND (ig.af_ija_ymd - 1)
    ) loop
        dr_aek := 0;
        cr_aek := 0;
        if  xx.gugan_ija > xx.ija   then
                cr_aek := xx.gugan_ija - xx.ija;
        else    dr_aek := xx.ija - xx.gugan_ija;
        end if;
        w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.ija,
                                     xx.misu_ija,
                                     xx.sung_cost,
                                     dr_aek,
                                     cr_aek,
                                     xx.gugan_ija - (xx.misu_ija + xx.sung_cost));
        SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B24', 'A', '1', '1' || xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd,
                    1, xx.seq, w_aek, 22, 'PROC0220 ' || xx.jm_cd, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC0220 -> ' || xx.sangj_gb || ' - ' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        WHEN MATCHED THEN

        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN

                    , p_ymd                                       /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                                  /* _3- */
                    , xx.jm_cd                                    /* _4- */

                    , xx.bond_cd                                  /* _6- */

                    , TRUNC(xx.misu_ija * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))   /* _9- */
                    , 0                                           /* _10- */
                    , xx.misu_ija                                 /* _11- */
                    , xx.sung_cost                                /* _12- */
                    , xx.gugan_ija                                /* _13- */
                    , 0                                           /* _14- */
                    , 0                                           /* _15- */
                    , 0                                           /* _16- */
                    , 0                                           /* _17- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _18- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _19- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _20- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _21- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _22- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _23- */
                    , xx.cbmg_ija                                 /* _24- */

           USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr

                    , NULL                                           /* _7- */
                    , 'KRW'                                          /* _8- */
                    , '2'                                            /* _9- */
                    , 0                                              /* _10- */
                    , 0                                              /* _11- */

                    , TRUNC(xx.ija * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))           /* _13- */
                    , xx.ija - TRUNC(xx.ija * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _14- */
                    , NULL                                           /* _15- */

                    , xx.buy_date                                  /* _5- */
                    , xx.bond_cd                                   /* _6- */
                    , 0                                            /* _7- */
                    , TRUNC(xx.gugan_ija * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))  /* _8- */
                    , 0                                            /* _9- */
                    , 0                                            /* _10- */
                    , 0                                            /* _11- */
                    , xx.gugan_ija                                 /* _12- */
                    , xx.gugan_ija                                 /* _13- */

                    , NULL                                         /* _18- */
                    , NULL                                         /* _19- */

                    , NULL                                         /* _24- */

           USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
                       AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd

                       AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd

                                    THEN xx.gugan_ija
                                    ELSE MISU_IJA END

                                    ELSE IJA_TAX END
                  , SURY_AEK = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN xx.gugan_ija - TRUNC(xx.gugan_ija * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                                    ELSE SURY_AEK END

                    , xx.jm_cd                                                   /* _5- */

                     , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0)    AS bfil_aekm     /* _11- */

                     , ig.gugan_ija                            /* _15- */
                     , ig.gugan_ilsu                           /* _16- */
                     , ig.bf_ija_ymd                           /* _17- */
                     , ig.af_ija_ymd                           /* _18- */
                     , cj.sanghw_ymd                           /* _19- */
                     , cj.sunme_ija_ymd                        /* _20- */

                 WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd

                     , cj.jm_cd               /* _5- */

                     , cj.ija_jigub_gb        /* _22- */
                     , cj.slip_attr           /* _23- */
                     , rowidtochar(t1.rowid)  /* _24- */
                     , cj.bunhal_gb           /* _25- */
                     , t1.lst_meib_ymd        /* _26- */
                     , cj.holi_ija_su         /* _27- */
                  FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
                     , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
                     , SCJ0IG ig  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
                     , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
                   AND cj.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
                   AND cj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
                   AND cj.sanghw_ymd                BETWEEN (w_junyong_ymd + 1) AND p_ymd
                   AND cj.ija_jigub_gb              IN ('4','5','6','D','E','F')
                   AND NVL(cj.budo_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  > p_ymd
                   AND cj.sunhu_gb                  = '2'
                   AND ig.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
                   AND ig.jm_cd                     = cj.jm_cd
                   AND ig.af_ija_ymd                BETWEEN (w_junyong_ymd + 1) AND p_ymd
                   AND ig.gugan_no                  > 0
                   AND ig.ija_gb                    = 'B'
                   AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
                   AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
                UNION ALL
                SELECT t1.fund_cd             /* _1- */
                     , ia.type_gb             /* _2- */
                     , cj.bond_attr           /* _3- */
                     , cj.balh_ga             /* _4- */
                     , cj.jm_cd               /* _5- */
                     , t1.buy_date            /* _6- */
                     , 0                      /* _7- */
                     , cj.sangj_gb            /* _8- */
                     , NVL(t1.misu_ija,0)     /* _9- */
                     , NVL(t1.sung_cost,0)    /* _10- */
                     , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0)    /* _11- */
                     , cj.medo_ymd            /* _12- */
                     , cj.balh_ymd            /* _13- */
                     , 'B'                    /* _14- */
                     , 0                      /* _15- */
                     , 0                      /* _16- */
                     , cj.bf_ija_ymd          /* _17- */
                     , cj.af_ija_ymd          /* _18- */
                     , cj.sanghw_ymd          /* _19- */
                     , cj.sunme_ija_ymd       /* _20- */
                     , cj.bond_cd             /* _21- */
                     , cj.ija_jigub_gb        /* _22- */
                     , cj.slip_attr           /* _23- */
                     , rowidtochar(t1.rowid)  /* _24- */
                     , cj.bunhal_gb           /* _25- */
                     , t1.lst_meib_ymd        /* _26- */
                     , cj.holi_ija_su         /* _27- */
                  FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
                     , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
                     , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
                   AND cj.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
                   AND cj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
                   AND cj.sanghw_ymd                > p_ymd
                   AND cj.sunme_ija_ymd             BETWEEN (w_junyong_ymd + 1) AND p_ymd
                   AND cj.slip_attr                 NOT IN ('1','4')
                   AND cj.ija_jigub_gb              NOT IN ('7','8','G','H')
                   AND NVL(cj.budo_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  > p_ymd
                   AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
                   AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
                 ORDER BY 4, 1
                 ) tt
    ) loop
        if  xx.bfil_aekm = 0    then
            -- 매입분 미수령시 이자계산 제외 20200216 yjs
            CONTINUE;
        end if;
        if  xx.holi_ija_su = 'S' AND xx.sanghw_ymd > xx.af_ija_ymd  then
            -- 휴일이자수령구분이 상환일인 경우 상환일 수령처리
            -- 메테우스 서울도시철도채 처리 20191231 yjs
            CONTINUE;
        end if;
        if (xx.sunme_ija_ymd IS NULL AND xx.medo_ymd < xx.balh_ymd) OR (xx.now_gugan_no IS NULL) OR (xx.sangj_gb IS NULL)   then
            p_msg   := p_ymd || '-' || xx.jm_cd
                             || '-이자수령관련 채권종목정보를 확인하십시요(PROC0220).';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 당일 일부상환시 전부이자수령은 이자수령 제외
        BEGIN
            SELECT '1'
              INTO w_msg
              FROM SCT0CG t1  /* 채권거래내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd    = 'E38'
               AND t1.buy_date = xx.buy_date;
            if  w_msg = '1' then
                -- 일부상환시 계산된 이자금액 전부를 수령처리 하므로 pass 20200309 yjs
                CONTINUE;
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;

        -- 당일 연체상환시 이자수령일이 당일이 아닌경우 이자수령 제외
        BEGIN
            SELECT '1'
              INTO w_msg
              FROM SCT0CG t1  /* 채권거래내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd      = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd       = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd        = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd        = 'E43'
               AND t1.ija_sudo_ymd > p_ymd
               AND t1.buy_date     = xx.buy_date;
            if  w_msg = '1' then
                -- 일부상환시 계산된 이자금액 전부를 수령처리 하므로 pass 20200309 yjs
                CONTINUE;
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;

        -- 구간이자 계산
        if  xx.ija_gb IN ('I','J')  then    -- 할인/할증이자
            ig_gugan_ilsu := xx.af_ija_ymd - xx.bf_ija_ymd;
            ig_gugan_ija  := TRUNC (xx.gugan_ija * xx.bfil_aekm);
        else
            if  xx.ija_jigub_gb IN ('7','8','9','G','H')    then
                ig_gugan_ilsu := xx.gugan_ilsu;
                if  xx.balh_ga IN (100000, 1000000)     then    ---액면과 만원을 제외하고 십만원, 백만원은 따로 계산(발행가 데이터를 정확히 넣는다고 가정)
                    ig_gugan_ija := ceilnum(xx.balh_ga * xx.gugan_ija) * TRUNC (xx.bfil_aekm / xx.balh_ga);
                else
                    xx.balh_ga   := NVL  (xx.bfil_aekm, 0);
                    ig_gugan_ija := ceilnum(xx.balh_ga * xx.gugan_ija) * TRUNC (xx.bfil_aekm / xx.balh_ga);
                end if;
            else
                SR_NOW_GUGAN_IJA (p_corp_gr, xx.af_ija_ymd - 1, xx.jm_cd, xx.bfil_aekm,
                                  ig_gugan_ilsu, ig_gugan_ija, ig_pr_ilsu, ig_pr_ija, ig_pass_ilsu, ig_pass_ija, ig_pass_pr_ija,
                                  xx.now_gugan_no, xx.bf_ija_ymd, xx.af_ija_ymd, w_msg);
                if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                    p_msg := 'PROC0220 -> ' || w_msg;
                    RETURN;
                end if;
            end if;
            if  xx.bunhal_gb = '1'  then
                -- 분할채는 개별 이자관리
                BEGIN
                    SELECT gugan_ija_aek
                      INTO ig_gugan_ija
                      FROM SCM0IG t1  /* 분할채 상환내역 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.fund_cd      = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.jm_cd        = xx.jm_cd
                       AND t1.lst_meib_ymd = xx.lst_meib_ymd
                       AND t1.ija_gugan_no = xx.now_gugan_no;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    -- 분할채 개별 이자금액이 없는 경우 이자구간 이자로 처리 20200930 yjs
                    NULL;
                END;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 선매출 이자수령액 가져오기
        if  xx.sunme_ija_ymd BETWEEN (w_junyong_ymd + 1) AND p_ymd  then
            BEGIN   /* 선매출 이자정보 */
                SELECT NVL(misu_ija,0)
                     , NVL(sung_cost,0)
                     , NVL(gugan_ija,0) - NVL(misu_ija,0) - NVL(sung_cost,0)
                  INTO sc_misuija
                     , sc_sungcost
                     , sc_suibija
                  FROM SCM0SC t1  /* 채권 선매출이자현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.buy_date = xx.buy_date;

                UPDATE SCM0SC tt    /* 채권 선매출이자현황 */
                   SET misu_ija  = 0
                     , sung_cost = 0
                     , sung_tax  = 0
                     , yesu_tax  = 0
                     , day_ija   = 0
                 WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
                   AND buy_date = xx.buy_date
                   AND ymd      = p_ymd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg   := p_ymd || ' 선매출 이자정보가 없습니다(PROC0220).' || ' 펀드: ' || xx.fund_cd
                                 || ' 종목: ' || xx.jm_cd || ' BUYDATE: ' || xx.buy_date;
                RETURN;
            END;
        else
            sc_misuija  := 0;
            sc_suibija  := 0;
            sc_sungcost := 0;
        end if;

        -- 수입이자 계산
        if  p_ymd = xx.af_ija_ymd   then    -- 휴일이자수령일인 경우
            cm_misu_ija  := xx.b_misu_ija;
            cm_sung_cost := xx.b_sung_cost;
        else
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL(t1.bfil_misu_ija,0)
                     , NVL(t1.bfil_sung_cost,0)
                  INTO cm_misu_ija
                     , cm_sung_cost
                  FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd      = xx.af_ija_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.buy_date = xx.buy_date;
            EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
                p_msg   := xx.af_ija_ymd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd
                                         || '- 채권마스타 휴일정보를 찾을 수 없습니다(PROC0220).';
                RETURN;
            END;
        end if;
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(ija,0) - (NVL(cm_misu_ija,0) + NVL(cm_sung_cost,0)) + sc_suibija
                 , NVL(sury_ymd, p_ymd)
              INTO w_suib_ija
                 , w_sury_ymd
              FROM SCT0FS t1  /* 펀드/종목별 원금(이자) 유예 MASTER */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd    = 'B22'
               AND t1.buy_date = xx.buy_date;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_suib_ija  := NVL  (ig_gugan_ija,0) - NVL  (cm_misu_ija,0)
                            - NVL  (cm_sung_cost,0) + sc_suibija;
            w_sury_ymd := p_ymd;
        END;

        -- 채권마스타  update
        UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
           SET misu_ija  = NVL(misu_ija,0) - cm_misu_ija
             , sung_cost = NVL(sung_cost,0) - cm_sung_cost
         WHERE ROWID = xx.row_id;

        -- 조기상환 이자수령 제외 20200326 yjs
        -- 미수이자액은 0 처리
        BEGIN
            SELECT '1'
              INTO w_msg
              FROM SCT0FS t1  /* 펀드/종목별 원금(이자) 유예 MASTER */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd   BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS (p_ymd,-1) AND p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd    = 'B24'
               AND t1.af_ymd   BETWEEN F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd,'-1') AND p_ymd
               AND t1.buy_date = xx.buy_date;
            if  w_msg = '1' then
                CONTINUE;
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;

        INSERT INTO SCM1K tt    /* 채권 매도(이자수령) */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                              /* _1- */
               , xx.fund_cd                                                             /* _2- */
               , xx.jm_cd                                                               /* _3- */
               , xx.buy_date                                                            /* _4- */
               , p_ymd                                                                  /* _5- */
               , 0                                                                      /* _6- */
               , 0                                                                      /* _7- */
               , 0                                                                      /* _8- */
               , NULL                                                                   /* _9- */
               , NULL                                                                   /* _10- */
               , NULL                                                                   /* _11- */
               , NULL                                                                   /* _12- */
               , cm_misu_ija + w_suib_ija + sc_misuija                                  /* _13- */
               , TRUNC((cm_misu_ija + w_suib_ija + sc_misuija) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _14- */
               );

        dr_aek := 0;
        cr_aek := 0;
        if  w_suib_ija < 0  then
                dr_aek := - w_suib_ija;
        else    cr_aek := w_suib_ija;
        end if;

        w_aek   := number_varray_50 (cm_misu_ija + w_suib_ija + cm_sung_cost + sc_misuija + sc_sungcost,
                                     cm_misu_ija + sc_misuija,
                                     0,
                                     cm_sung_cost + sc_sungcost,
                                     dr_aek, cr_aek);           /* 수입이자 */
        if  w_sury_ymd != p_ymd then
                SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E2B', 'A', '1', xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 2, xx.seq, w_aek, 22, 'PROC0220 미수' || xx.jm_cd , w_msg);
        ELSE    SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E22', 'A', '1', xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 2, xx.seq, w_aek, 22, 'PROC0220 수령 ' || xx.jm_cd, w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC0220 -> ' || xx.sangj_gb || ' - ' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 원리금상환 생성
        MERGE INTO UCS0BH t1  /* 채권 상환내역 */
           USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
                       AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
                       AND t1.buy_date   = xx.buy_date )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET YESU_TAX     = TRUNC(cm_sung_cost * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                  , SUNN_TAX     = TRUNC((cm_misu_ija + w_suib_ija) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                  , MISU_IJA     = cm_misu_ija + w_suib_ija
                  , SUNG_COST    = cm_sung_cost
                  , WON_RI_GM    = cm_misu_ija + cm_sung_cost + sc_misuija + sc_sungcost + w_suib_ija
                  , SC_MISU_IJA  = sc_misuija + sc_suibija
                  , SC_SUNG_COST = sc_sungcost
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                   /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd                                       /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                                  /* _3- */
                    , xx.jm_cd                                    /* _4- */
                    , xx.buy_date                                 /* _5- */
                    , xx.bond_cd                                  /* _6- */
                    , 0                                           /* _7- */
                    , TRUNC(cm_sung_cost * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _8- */
                    , TRUNC((cm_misu_ija + w_suib_ija)
                            * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))               /* _9- */
                    , 0                                           /* _10- */
                    , cm_misu_ija + w_suib_ija                    /* _11- */
                    , cm_sung_cost                                /* _12- */
                    , cm_misu_ija + cm_sung_cost + sc_misuija + sc_sungcost
                                  + w_suib_ija                    /* _13- */
                    , 0                                           /* _14- */
                    , 0                                           /* _15- */
                    , sc_misuija + sc_suibija                     /* _16- */
                    , sc_sungcost                                 /* _17- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _18- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _19- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _20- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _21- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _22- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _23- */
                    , NULL                                        /* _24- */
                    );

        MERGE INTO UZM0SH t1  /* 채권/현금 이자수령 및 만기상환내역 (수령액 차이분 입력용) */
           USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
                       AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.jm_gr      = 'C'
                       AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
                       AND t1.buy_date   = xx.buy_date )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET MISU_IJA = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN w_aek(1)
                                    ELSE MISU_IJA END
                  , IJA_TAX  = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN TRUNC(w_aek(1) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                                    ELSE IJA_TAX END
                  , SURY_AEK = CASE WHEN mod_user IS NULL
                                    THEN w_aek(1) - TRUNC(w_aek(1) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                                    ELSE SURY_AEK END
                  , mod_dt   = p_ymd
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                          /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd                                              /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                                         /* _3- */
                    , 'C'                                                /* _4- */
                    , xx.jm_cd                                           /* _5- */
                    , xx.buy_date                                        /* _6- */
                    , NULL                                               /* _7- */
                    , 'KRW'                                              /* _8- */
                    , '2'                                                /* _9- */
                    , 0                                                  /* _10- */
                    , 0                                                  /* _11- */
                    , w_aek(1)                                           /* _12- */
                    , TRUNC(w_aek(1) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))             /* _13- */
                    , w_aek(1) - TRUNC(w_aek(1) * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _14- */
                    , NULL                                               /* _15- */
                    , p_ymd                                              /* _16- */
                    );
    end loop;

    -- E43 채권원금상환 유보시 이자만 수령처리
    -- 원금/이자 미수입금 처리 후 수령시 예금 처리 20200316 yjs
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                          /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                        /* _2- */
             , ia.type_gb                                                        /* _3- */
             , cj.bond_attr                                                      /* _4- */
             , cj.jm_cd                                                          /* _5- */
             , t1.buy_date                                                       /* _6- */
             , cj.sangj_gb                                                       /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0)                            AS aekm            /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0)                        AS chui_aek        /* _9- */
             , NVL(t1.misu_ija,0)                             AS misu_ija        /* _10- */
             , NVL(t1.sung_cost,0)                            AS sung_cost       /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.cbmg_misu_ija,0)                        AS cbmg_misu_ija   /* _12- */
             , NVL(t1.cbmg_sung_cost,0)                       AS cbmg_sung_cost  /* _13- */
             , cg.ija_sudo_ymd                                                   /* _14- */
             , cj.bond_cd                                                        /* _15- */
             , cj.slip_attr                                                      /* _16- */
             , cj.af_ija_ymd                                                     /* _17- */
             , rowidtochar(t1.rowid)                          AS row_id          /* _18- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                        ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq             /* _19- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SCT0CG cg  /* 채권거래내역 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND cg.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND cg.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND cg.tr_ymd                    = t1.ymd
           AND cg.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND cg.tr_cd                     = 'E43'
           AND cj.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
    ) loop
        -- 상환완료분 삭제처리
        DELETE FROM SCM0CM tt   /* 채권 보유현황 */
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        if  xx.ija_sudo_ymd = p_ymd then
            w_aek := number_varray_50 (xx.chui_aek, xx.chui_aek, 0, 0);
        else
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.chui_aek + xx.misu_ija + xx.sung_cost + xx.cbmg_sung_cost + xx.cbmg_misu_ija,
                                         xx.chui_aek,
                                         xx.sung_cost,
                                         xx.misu_ija,
                                         0,
                                         0,
                                         xx.cbmg_sung_cost,
                                         xx.cbmg_misu_ija);
        end if;
        SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E43', 'A', '1', xx.slip_attr || xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd,
                    2, xx.seq, w_aek, 22, 'PROC0220 원금상환유예' || xx.jm_cd, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC0220 -> ' || xx.slip_attr || xx.sangj_gb || ' - ' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        INSERT INTO SCM1K tt    /* 채권 매도(이자수령) */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                  /* _1- */
               , xx.fund_cd                                 /* _2- */
               , xx.jm_cd                                   /* _3- */
               , xx.buy_date                                /* _4- */
               , p_ymd                                      /* _5- */
               , 0                                          /* _6- */
               , 0                                          /* _7- */
               , 0                                          /* _8- */
               , NULL                                       /* _9- */
               , NULL                                       /* _10- */
               , NULL                                       /* _11- */
               , NULL                                       /* _12- */
               , xx.misu_ija                                /* _13- */
               , TRUNC(xx.misu_ija * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _14- */
               );
        -- 원리금상환 생성
        if  xx.ija_sudo_ymd > p_ymd then
            MERGE INTO UCS0BH t1  /* 채권 상환내역 */
               USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                           AND t1.sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
                           AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
                           AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
                           AND t1.buy_date   = xx.buy_date )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                 UPDATE
                    SET AEKM      = xx.aekm
                      , YESU_TAX  = TRUNC(xx.sung_cost * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                      , SUNN_TAX  = TRUNC(xx.misu_ija * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                      , WON_GM    = xx.chui_aek
                      , MISU_IJA  = xx.misu_ija
                      , SUNG_COST = xx.sung_cost
                      , WON_RI_GM = xx.chui_aek + xx.misu_ija + xx.sung_cost
                      , CBMG_IJA  = xx.cbmg_misu_ija + xx.cbmg_sung_cost
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                 INSERT
                 VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                   /* _1- */
                        , p_ymd                                       /* _2- */
                        , xx.fund_cd                                  /* _3- */
                        , xx.jm_cd                                    /* _4- */
                        , xx.buy_date                                 /* _5- */
                        , xx.bond_cd                                  /* _6- */
                        , xx.aekm                                     /* _7- */
                        , TRUNC(xx.sung_cost * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _8- */
                        , TRUNC(xx.misu_ija * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))   /* _9- */
                        , xx.chui_aek                                 /* _10- */
                        , xx.misu_ija                                 /* _11- */
                        , xx.sung_cost                                /* _12- */
                        , xx.chui_aek + xx.misu_ija + xx.sung_cost    /* _13- */
                        , 0                                           /* _14- */
                        , 0                                           /* _15- */
                        , NULL                                        /* _16- */
                        , NULL                                        /* _17- */
                        , NULL                                        /* _18- */
                        , NULL                                        /* _19- */
                        , NULL                                        /* _20- */
                        , NULL                                        /* _21- */
                        , NULL                                        /* _22- */
                        , NULL                                        /* _23- */
                        , xx.cbmg_misu_ija + xx.cbmg_sung_cost        /* _24- */
                        );
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0220', p_ymd || ' : 채권 수도결제 처리');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sct0cg.sudo_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sct0cg.tr_cd = J14', '채권 익일매입 결제처리');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd                                                    /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                  /* _2- */
             , t2.fund_currency                                            /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                    /* _4- */
             , t1.buy_date                                                 /* _5- */
             , t1.aekm                                                     /* _6- */
             , t1.tr_aek                                                   /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.chui_aek,0)                             AS chui_aek  /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.susu,0)                                 AS susu      /* _9- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_aek,0) + NVL(t1.susu,0)              AS gyul_aek  /* _10- */
             , t1.mk_suik_rt                                               /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.danga_gb,'0')                           AS danga_gb  /* _12-세전(후)단가 구분 */
             , t1.pass_sc_ija                                              /* _13- */
             , t1.pass_ija                                                 /* _14- */
             , t1.pass_pr_ija                                              /* _15- */
             , t1.sc_yesu_tax                                              /* _16- */
             , t1.yesu_tax                                                 /* _17- */
             , t1.pr_yesu_tax                                              /* _18- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                        ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq       /* _19- */
          FROM SCT0CG t1  /* 채권거래내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                    < p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                     = 'J14'
           AND t1.sudo_ymd                  = p_ymd
           AND t2.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
         ORDER BY t1.jm_cd
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        SR_PROC0220J (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.buy_date, xx.aekm, xx.tr_aek, xx.chui_aek,
                      xx.buy_date, xx.pass_sc_ija, xx.pass_ija, xx.pass_pr_ija, xx.sc_yesu_tax, xx.yesu_tax, xx.pr_yesu_tax, w_jasan_gb, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || 'sudo (schp011)';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.gyul_aek, xx.gyul_aek,
                                     xx.chui_aek, xx.tr_aek + xx.susu,
                                     xx.pass_sc_ija + xx.pass_ija + xx.pass_pr_ija, xx.susu);
        SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, w_aek, 22, 'sccp040_j', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(익일매입 수도결제)';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'sct0cg.sudo_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sct0cg.tr_cd = K11', '채권 익일매도 결제처리');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                    /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                    /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                  /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                    /* _4- */
             , t1.buy_date                                                 /* _5- */
             , t1.aekm                                                     /* _6- */
             , NVL(NVL(t1.tr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.susu,0), 0)      AS gyul_aek  /* _7- */
             , t1.jangbu_sonik                                             /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_aek                                                   /* _9- */
             , t1.tr_ymd - 1                                  AS ija_ymd   /* _10- */
             , NVL(t1.susu,0)                                 AS susu      /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.danga_gb,'0')                           AS danga_gb  /* _12- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                        ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq       /* _13- */
          FROM SCT0CG t1  /* 채권거래내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                    < p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                     = 'K11'
           AND t1.sudo_ymd                  = p_ymd
           AND t2.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
         ORDER BY t1.jm_cd
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        SR_PROC0220K (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.ija_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.buy_date, xx.aekm,
                      w_tr_aek, w_anbun_aek, w_misu_ija, w_sung_cost, w_pr_sung_cost, w_cbmg_misu_ija, w_cbmg_sung_cost, w_yesu_tax, w_sung_tax, w_jasan_gb, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || 'sudo (schp012)';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 분개 처리
        w_dr_hab := xx.tr_aek;
        w_cr_hab := w_tr_chui_aek + w_anbun_aek + w_misu_ija + w_sung_cost + w_pr_sung_cost;

        -- 세후단가 거래, 20010701, yjs
        if  xx.danga_gb = '1'   then    w_dr_hab := w_dr_hab + NVL (w_yesu_tax,0) + NVL (w_sung_tax,0);
        end if;

        if  w_dr_hab - w_cr_hab > 0 then
            w_cr_hab := w_dr_hab - w_cr_hab;
            w_dr_hab := 0;
        else
            w_dr_hab := w_cr_hab - w_dr_hab;
            w_cr_hab := 0;
        end if;

        w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.gyul_aek, xx.gyul_aek,
                                     NVL(xx.tr_aek, 0) - NVL(xx.susu, 0) - xx.jangbu_sonik, w_tr_chui_aek + w_anbun_aek,
                                     0, w_sung_cost + w_pr_sung_cost,
                                     0, w_misu_ija,
                                     w_dr_hab, w_cr_hab, xx.susu);
        SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, w_aek, 22, 'PROC0220_k', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(익일매도 수도결제)';
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if (w_cbmg_misu_ija + w_cbmg_sung_cost) != 0    then
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (w_cbmg_misu_ija,
                                         w_cbmg_sung_cost,
                                         w_cbmg_misu_ija + w_cbmg_sung_cost);
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B2C', 'A', '1', '9', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 9, xx.seq, w_aek, 22, 'PROC0220', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg || '(채권매도(schp010))';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 채권 거래내역에 취득가,원천세 Update
        if  xx.danga_gb = '1'   then    -- 세후단가 거래시 세금은 매도자에게 이전, 20010701, yjs
            UPDATE SCT0CG tt    /* 채권거래내역 */
               SET chui_aek       = w_tr_chui_aek + w_anbun_aek
                 , mijigub_tax    = 0
                 , mm_sonik       = w_cr_hab - w_dr_hab + xx.jangbu_sonik
                 , cbmg_misu_ija  = w_cbmg_misu_ija
                 , cbmg_sung_cost = w_cbmg_sung_cost
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        else
            UPDATE SCT0CG tt    /* 채권거래내역 */
               SET chui_aek       = w_tr_chui_aek + w_anbun_aek
                 , mijigub_tax    = w_sung_tax + w_yesu_tax
                 , mm_sonik       = w_cr_hab - w_dr_hab + xx.jangbu_sonik
                 , cbmg_misu_ija  = w_cbmg_misu_ija
                 , cbmg_sung_cost = w_cbmg_sung_cost
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0220', p_ymd || ' : 전환청구 이자수령 처리');

    w_ymd := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '-1') + 1;
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                          /* _1- */
             , t1.old_jm_cd            AS jm_cd    /* _2- */
             , t3.sangj_gb                         /* _3- */
             , SUM(NVL(t1.chg_aek,0))  AS chg_aek  /* _4- */
             , SUM(NVL(t1.ija,0))      AS ija      /* _5- */
          FROM SJT0GG t1  /* 전환 청구 (교환,신주인수권포함) */
             , SCM0CJ t3  /* 채권종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.gyul_ymd BETWEEN w_ymd AND p_ymd
           AND t1.sury_ymd = p_ymd
           AND t3.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.jm_cd    = t1.old_jm_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.old_jm_cd
                , t3.sangj_gb
                , t3.balh_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E23', 'A', '1', xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.ija, 22, 'sccp030', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0220', p_ymd || ' : 채권 수도결제 마무리');

    -------------------------
    -- 채권 결산분개 보정처리(자문제외)
    -------------------------
--    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B020','','skgp150_re 실행 - 채권 평가손익 결산분개 보정분개 처리');
--    SR_SKGP150_RE (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_pgm_id, p_proc_step, w_msg);
--    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
--        p_msg   := 'SR_SKGP150_RE-'||w_msg;
--        RETURN;
--    end if;

    -----------------------------------------------
    -- 채권 마스타 미수도결제 매입/매도액 재처리 --
    -----------------------------------------------
    UPDATE SCM0CM t1    /* 채권 보유현황 */
       SET (t1.msd_meib_aekm, t1.msd_meib_aek, t1.msd_medo_aekm, t1.msd_medo_aek) 
              = (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE ta.tr_cd WHEN 'J14' THEN ta.aekm END), 0)
                      , NVL(SUM(CASE ta.tr_cd WHEN 'J14' THEN ta.chui_aek END), 0)
                      , NVL(SUM(CASE ta.tr_cd WHEN 'K11' THEN ta.aekm END), 0)
                      , NVL(SUM(CASE ta.tr_cd WHEN 'K11' THEN ta.chui_aek END), 0)
                   FROM SCT0CG ta  /* 채권거래내역 */
                  WHERE ta.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                    AND ta.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
                    AND ta.tr_ymd   < p_ymd
                    AND ta.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
                    AND ta.tr_cd    IN ('J14','K11')
                    AND ta.sudo_ymd > p_ymd
                    AND ta.buy_date = t1.buy_date)
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    -- 당일 상환자료가 아닌경우 삭제처리
    DELETE FROM UZM0SH  /* 채권/현금 이자수령 및 만기상환내역 (수령액 차이분 입력용) */
     WHERE corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
       AND sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
       AND jm_gr      = 'C'
       AND mod_dt     != p_ymd;

    p_msg := 'Y';

    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0220J (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_currency                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_buy_date                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_aekm                         IN    NUMBER,
    p_tr_aek                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_chui_aek                     IN    NUMBER,
    p_meib_ymd                     IN    DATE,
    p_pass_sc_ija                  IN    NUMBER,
    p_pass_ija                     IN    NUMBER,
    p_pass_pr_ija                  IN    NUMBER,
    p_sc_yesu_tax                  IN    NUMBER,
    p_yesu_tax                     IN    NUMBER,
    p_pr_yesu_tax                  IN    NUMBER,
    p_jasan_gb                     OUT   VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 채권매입 master 처리
--
    w_sunme_yn                   VARCHAR(1) default 'N'; -- 선매출 여부

    w_sc_gugan_ija               NUMBER := 0;

    cm_aekm                      NUMBER;
    cm_anbun_aek                 NUMBER;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    p_msg   := p_jm_cd || ' - 매입 종목정보를 찾을 수 없습니다.' || p_fund_cd;

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.balh_ymd       /* _1- */
             , t1.medo_ymd       /* _2- */
             , t1.sanghw_ymd     /* _3- */
             , t1.ija_jigub_gb   /* _4- */
             , t1.pyom_iyul      /* _5- */
             , t1.sunme_ija_ymd  /* _6- */
             , t1.bond_cd        /* _7- */
             , slip_attr         /* _8- */
             , t1.yy_ija_hoisu   /* _9- */
             , t1.balh_ga        /* _10- */
             , t1.sangj_gb       /* _11- */
          FROM SCM0CJ t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd
    ) loop
        -- 채권마스타 확인
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(meib_aekm,0)
                 , NVL(anbun_aek,0)
              INTO cm_aekm
                 , cm_anbun_aek
              FROM SCM0CM t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = p_jm_cd
               AND t1.buy_date = p_buy_date;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            cm_aekm         := 0;
            cm_anbun_aek    := 0;
        END;

        -- 선매출 여부를 확인
        if  xx.medo_ymd < xx.balh_ymd       then    w_sunme_yn  := 'Y';
            if  xx.sunme_ija_ymd <= p_ymd   then    w_sunme_yn  := 'N';
            end if;
        end if;
        if  w_sunme_yn = 'Y'    then
            -- 선매출 이자 계산
            BEGIN
                SELECT F_TRUNC (gugan_ija * (cm_aekm + p_aekm), p_fund_currency)
                  INTO w_sc_gugan_ija
                  FROM SCJ0IG ig
                 WHERE ig.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND ig.jm_cd    = p_jm_cd
                   AND ig.ija_gb   = 'B'
                   AND ig.gugan_no = 0;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                w_sc_gugan_ija  := 0;
            END;

            -- 자문 경과이자는 취득액 처리
            w_sc_gugan_ija  := 0;

            MERGE INTO SCM0SC t1 
               USING DUAL  ON ( t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                            AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
                            AND t1.fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
                            AND t1.jm_cd    = p_jm_cd
                            AND t1.buy_date = p_buy_date )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                 UPDATE
                    SET sung_cost = NVL(sung_cost,0) + p_pass_sc_ija
                      , yesu_tax  = NVL(yesu_tax,0) + p_sc_yesu_tax
                      , gugan_ija = w_sc_gugan_ija
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                 INSERT ( corp_gr    /* _1- */
                        , ymd        /* _2- */
                        , fund_cd    /* _3- */
                        , jm_cd      /* _4- */
                        , buy_date   /* _5- */
                        , sung_cost  /* _6- */
                        , yesu_tax   /* _7- */
                        , gugan_ija  /* _8- */
                        )
                 VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
                        , p_ymd           /* _2- */
                        , p_fund_cd       /* _3- */
                        , p_jm_cd         /* _4- */
                        , p_buy_date      /* _5- */
                        , p_pass_sc_ija   /* _6- */
                        , p_sc_yesu_tax   /* _7- */
                        , w_sc_gugan_ija  /* _8- */
                        );
        end if;

        MERGE INTO SCM0CM t1 
           USING DUAL  ON ( t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                        AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
                        AND t1.fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
                        AND t1.jm_cd    = p_jm_cd
                        AND t1.buy_date = p_buy_date )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET meib_aekm    = NVL(meib_aekm,0) + p_aekm
                  , meib_aek     = NVL(meib_aek,0) + p_chui_aek + cm_anbun_aek
                  , anbun_aek    = 0
                  , sung_cost    = NVL(sung_cost,0) + p_pass_ija
                  , pr_sung_cost = NVL(pr_sung_cost,0) + p_pass_pr_ija
                  , yesu_tax     = NVL(yesu_tax,0) + p_yesu_tax
                  , pr_yesu_tax  = NVL(pr_yesu_tax,0) + p_pr_yesu_tax
                  , lst_meib_ymd = p_ymd
                  , jilg_up_aekm = 0
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT ( corp_gr       /* _1- */
                    , ymd           /* _2- */
                    , fund_cd       /* _3- */
                    , jm_cd         /* _4- */
                    , buy_date      /* _5- */
                    , meib_aekm     /* _6- */
                    , meib_aek      /* _7- */
                    , sung_cost     /* _8- */
                    , pr_sung_cost  /* _9- */
                    , yesu_tax      /* _10- */
                    , pr_yesu_tax   /* _11- */
                    , lst_meib_ymd  /* _12- */
                    )
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr      /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd          /* _2- */
                    , p_fund_cd      /* _3- */
                    , p_jm_cd        /* _4- */
                    , p_buy_date     /* _5- */
                    , p_aekm         /* _6- */
                    , p_chui_aek     /* _7- */
                    , p_pass_ija     /* _8- */
                    , p_pass_pr_ija  /* _9- */
                    , p_yesu_tax     /* _10- */
                    , p_pr_yesu_tax  /* _11- */
                    , p_meib_ymd     /* _12- */
                    );

        p_jasan_gb  := xx.slip_attr || xx.sangj_gb;
        p_msg       := 'Y';
    END LOOP;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0220K (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_ija_ymd                      IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_buy_date                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_aekm                         IN    NUMBER,
    p_tr_chui_aek                  OUT   NUMBER,
    p_anbun_aek                    OUT   NUMBER,
    p_misu_ija                     OUT   NUMBER,
    p_sung_cost                    OUT   NUMBER,
    p_pr_sung                      OUT   NUMBER,
    p_cbmg_misu_ija                OUT   NUMBER,
    p_cbmg_sung_cost               OUT   NUMBER,
    p_yesu_tax                     OUT   NUMBER,
    p_sung_tax                     OUT   NUMBER,
    p_jasan_gb                     OUT   VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 채권매도 master 처리
--
    w_sunme_yn                   VARCHAR(1) := 'N'; -- 선매출 여부
    sc_misu_ija                  NUMBER := 0;
    sc_sung_cost                 NUMBER := 0;
    sc_sung_tax                  NUMBER := 0;
    sc_yesu_tax                  NUMBER := 0;

    w_sc_gugan_ija               NUMBER := 0;
    w_sc_day_ija                 NUMBER := 0;

    -- 매도후금액
    w1_aekm                      NUMBER;
    w1_chui_aek                  NUMBER;

    -- 매도분금액
    w_biyul                      NUMBER;

    w_sc_sung_cost               NUMBER := 0;
    w_sc_misu_ija                NUMBER := 0;
    w_sc_sung_tax                NUMBER := 0;
    w_sc_yesu_tax                NUMBER := 0;

    w_anbun_aek                  NUMBER;
    w_chui_aek                   NUMBER;
    w_sung_cost                  NUMBER;
    w_pr_sung_cost               NUMBER;
    w_misu_ija                   NUMBER;
    w_pr_misu_ija                NUMBER;
    w_cbmg_misu_ija              NUMBER;
    w_cbmg_sung_cost             NUMBER;

    w_sung_tax                   NUMBER;
    w_pr_sung_tax                NUMBER;
    w_yesu_tax                   NUMBER;
    w_pr_yesu_tax                NUMBER;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    p_msg   := p_corp_gr || ' ' || p_fund_cd || ',' || p_jm_cd || ' ' || p_buy_date
                         || ' - 매도 종목정보를 찾을 수 없습니다.';

    for xx IN (
        select cj.balh_ymd                                                          /* _1- */
             , cj.medo_ymd                                                          /* _2- */
             , cj.sanghw_ymd                                                        /* _3- */
