             , cj.ija_jigub_gb                                                      /* _4- */
             , cj.pyom_iyul                                                         /* _5- */
             , cj.halin_iyul                                                        /* _6- */
             , cj.halj_iyul                                                         /* _7- */
             , cj.bf_ija_ymd                                                        /* _8- */
             , cj.af_ija_ymd                                                        /* _9- */
             , cj.bond_attr                                                         /* _10- */
             , cj.slip_attr                                                         /* _11- */
             , cj.bond_cd                                                           /* _12- */
             , cj.yy_ija_hoisu                                                      /* _13- */
             , NVL(cj.now_gugan_no,0)                            AS now_gugan_no    /* _14- */
             , cj.sunme_ija_ymd                                                     /* _15- */
             , NVL(cj.balh_ga,0)                                 AS balh_ga         /* _16- */
             , cj.sangj_gb                                                          /* _17- */
             , cj.budo_ymd                                                          /* _18- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)
                                   + NVL(t1.msd_meib_aekm,0)     AS aekm            /* _19- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aek,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aek,0)
                                       + NVL(t1.msd_meib_aek,0)  AS chui_aek        /* _20- */
             , NVL(t1.anbun_aek,0)                               AS anbun_aek       /* _21- */
             , NVL(t1.misu_ija,0)                                AS misu_ija        /* _22- */
             , NVL(t1.pr_misu_ija,0)                             AS pr_misu_ija     /* _23- */
             , NVL(t1.sung_cost,0)                               AS sung_cost       /* _24- */
             , NVL(t1.pr_sung_cost,0)                            AS pr_sung_cost    /* _25- */
             , NVL(t1.sung_tax,0)                                AS sung_tax        /* _26- */
             , NVL(t1.pr_sung_tax,0)                             AS pr_sung_tax     /* _27- */
             , NVL(t1.yesu_tax,0)                                AS yesu_tax        /* _28- */
             , NVL(t1.pr_yesu_tax,0)                             AS pr_yesu_tax     /* _29- */
             , NVL(t1.cbmg_misu_ija,0)                           AS cbmg_misu_ija   /* _30- */
             , NVL(t1.cbmg_sung_cost,0)                          AS cbmg_sung_cost  /* _31- */
             , t1.lst_meib_ymd                                                      /* _32- */
             , t1.rowid                                                             /* _33- */
          from SCM0CM t1
             , SCM0CJ cj
         where t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           and t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           and t1.fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
           and t1.buy_date = p_buy_date
           and cj.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           and cj.jm_cd    = p_jm_cd
           and cj.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        -- 부도채권은 채권종목정보 이용
        if  xx.budo_ymd IS NULL then
            -- 선매출 여부를 확인하고 채권선매출 마스타 정보
            if (xx.medo_ymd < xx.balh_ymd) And (p_ija_ymd < xx.sunme_ija_ymd)   then
                -- 선매출 이자구간
                xx.bf_ija_ymd   := xx.medo_ymd;
                xx.af_ija_ymd   := xx.balh_ymd;
                BEGIN
                    SELECT NVL(misu_ija,0)
                         , NVL(sung_cost,0)
                         , NVL(sung_tax,0)
                         , NVL(yesu_tax,0)
                      INTO sc_misu_ija
                         , sc_sung_cost
                         , sc_sung_tax
                         , sc_yesu_tax
                      FROM SCM0SC t1
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
                       AND t1.fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
                       AND t1.jm_cd    = p_jm_cd
                       AND t1.buy_date = p_buy_date;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    p_msg   := p_fund_cd || '-' || p_jm_cd || '-채권 선매출마스타를 확인하십시오.';
                    RETURN;
                END;
                w_sunme_yn  := 'Y';
            else
                BEGIN
                    SELECT bf_ija_ymd
                         , af_ija_ymd
                      INTO xx.bf_ija_ymd
                         , xx.af_ija_ymd
                      FROM SCJ0IG t1
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd
                       AND t1.ija_gb  = 'B'
                       AND p_ija_ymd  Between t1.bf_ija_ymd And (t1.af_ija_ymd - 1);
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    p_msg   := p_fund_cd || '-' || p_jm_cd || '-채권 이자구간(scj0ig)을 확인하십시오.';
                    RETURN;
                END;
            end if;
        end if;
        -------------------------------
        -- 매도후 보유분에 대한 계산 --
        -------------------------------
        -- 매도후 액면 = 매도전 액면 - 매도액면
        w1_aekm := NVL(xx.aekm,0) - NVL(p_aekm,0);

        if NVL (w1_aekm,0) < 0  then
            p_msg   := p_fund_cd || '-' || p_jm_cd || '-(' || F_NTRIM (w1_aekm) || ')-매도후 액면확인';
            RETURN;
        else
            w1_chui_aek := trunc(xx.chui_aek * w1_aekm / xx.aekm);
            w_biyul     := 1 - (w1_aekm / xx.aekm); -- 매도분에 대한 계산비율

            w_sc_sung_cost      := trunc(sc_sung_cost * w_biyul);
            w_sc_misu_ija       := trunc(sc_misu_ija * w_biyul);
            w_sung_cost         := trunc(xx.sung_cost * w_biyul);
            w_pr_sung_cost      := trunc(xx.pr_sung_cost * w_biyul);
            w_misu_ija          := trunc(xx.misu_ija * w_biyul);
            w_pr_misu_ija       := trunc(xx.pr_misu_ija * w_biyul);
            w_cbmg_misu_ija     := trunc(xx.cbmg_misu_ija * w_biyul);
            w_cbmg_sung_cost    := trunc(xx.cbmg_sung_cost * w_biyul);

            w_chui_aek      := xx.chui_aek - w1_chui_aek;
            w_anbun_aek     := trunc(xx.anbun_aek * w_biyul);

            w_sc_sung_tax   := trunc(sc_sung_tax * w_biyul,4);
            w_sc_yesu_tax   := trunc(sc_yesu_tax * w_biyul, -1);
            w_sung_tax      := trunc(xx.sung_tax * w_biyul,4);
            w_pr_sung_tax   := trunc(xx.pr_sung_tax * w_biyul,4);
            w_yesu_tax      := trunc(xx.yesu_tax * w_biyul,4);
            w_pr_yesu_tax   := trunc(xx.pr_yesu_tax * w_biyul,4);
        end if;

        if  w_sunme_yn = 'Y'    then    -- 채권선매출마스타 거래후분으로 수정
            BEGIN
                SELECT trunc(gugan_ija * p_aekm)
                     , trunc(gugan_ija * p_aekm / gugan_ilsu)
                  INTO w_sc_gugan_ija
                     , w_sc_day_ija
                  FROM SCJ0IG ig
                 WHERE ig.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND ig.jm_cd    = p_jm_cd
                   AND ig.ija_gb   = 'B'
                   AND ig.gugan_no = 0;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                w_sc_gugan_ija  := 0;
                w_sc_day_ija    := 0;
            END;

            UPDATE SCM0SC tt
               SET misu_ija   = NVL(misu_ija,0) - w_sc_misu_ija
                 , sung_cost  = NVL(sung_cost,0) - w_sc_sung_cost
                 , sung_tax   = NVL(sung_tax,0) - w_sc_sung_tax
                 , yesu_tax   = NVL(yesu_tax,0) - w_sc_yesu_tax
                 , day_ija    = w_sc_day_ija
                 , gugan_ija  = w_sc_gugan_ija
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = p_jm_cd
               AND buy_date = p_buy_date
               AND ymd      = p_ymd;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
                p_msg   := p_fund_cd || '-' || p_jm_cd || '-채권선매출 마스타를 갱신하지 못했습니다.';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 채권마스타 거래후분으로 수정
        UPDATE SCM0CM tt
           SET medo_aekm       = NVL(medo_aekm,0) + p_aekm
             , medo_aek        = NVL(medo_aek,0) + w_chui_aek
             , anbun_aek       = NVL(anbun_aek,0) - w_anbun_aek
             , misu_ija        = NVL(misu_ija,0) - w_misu_ija
             , pr_misu_ija     = NVL(pr_misu_ija,0) - w_pr_misu_ija
             , sung_cost       = NVL(sung_cost,0) - w_sung_cost
             , pr_sung_cost    = NVL(pr_sung_cost,0) - w_pr_sung_cost
             , sung_tax        = NVL(sung_tax,0) - w_sung_tax
             , pr_sung_tax     = NVL(pr_sung_tax,0) - w_pr_sung_tax
             , yesu_tax        = NVL(yesu_tax,0) - w_yesu_tax
             , pr_yesu_tax     = NVL(pr_yesu_tax,0) - w_pr_yesu_tax
             , cbmg_misu_ija   = NVL(cbmg_misu_ija,0) - w_cbmg_misu_ija
             , cbmg_sung_cost  = NVL(cbmg_sung_cost,0) - w_cbmg_sung_cost
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        -- 분개용 자료 return
        p_tr_chui_aek       := w_chui_aek;
        p_anbun_aek         := w_anbun_aek;
        p_misu_ija          := w_misu_ija + w_pr_misu_ija + w_sc_misu_ija;
        p_sung_cost         := w_sung_cost + w_sc_sung_cost;
        p_pr_sung           := w_pr_sung_cost;
        p_cbmg_misu_ija     := w_cbmg_misu_ija;
        p_cbmg_sung_cost    := w_cbmg_sung_cost;
        p_yesu_tax          := trunc(w_yesu_tax, -1) + trunc(w_pr_yesu_tax, -1) + trunc(w_sc_yesu_tax, -1);
        p_sung_tax          := trunc(w_sung_tax, -1) + trunc(w_pr_sung_tax, -1) + trunc(w_sc_sung_tax, -1);
        p_jasan_gb          := xx.slip_attr || xx.sangj_gb;
        p_sung_tax          := 0;

        p_msg   := 'Y';

        if  w1_aekm = 0 then    SR_UPDMST1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_fund_cd, p_jm_cd, p_buy_date);  -- 채권 마스타, 이자구간 0으로 갱신
        end if;
    end loop;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0230 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 주식 수도결제
--
    -- 모펀드 설정/해지내역 계산용
    w_40101                        NUMBER;  /* 원본액 */
    w_40201                        NUMBER;  /* 이월잉여금-과표 */
    w_40211                        NUMBER;  /* 이월잉여금-비과표 */
    w_D0101                        NUMBER;  /* 순자산총액 */
    w_D0204                        NUMBER;  /* 과표 */
    w_D0205                        NUMBER;  /* 비과표 */

    w_cha_aek                      NUMBER;
    w_wonbon_chg                   NUMBER;
    w_suik_gwa_chg                 NUMBER;
    w_suik_bgwa_chg                NUMBER;
    w_ing_gwa_chg                  NUMBER;
    w_ing_bgwa_chg                 NUMBER;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0230', p_ymd || ' : 주식 수도결제');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B000', 'skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0bu.proc_step=23', '주식수도결제 분개장(skt0bu) delete');

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND t1.proc_step = 23;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjm0sm.ymd=' || p_ymd, '수익증권 마스타(sjm0sm) 당일 증감액 clear');

    -- 수익증권마스타Table의 당일증감취득액 clear
    UPDATE SJM0SM t1    /* (모자 / Multi Class) 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
       SET up_jwa       = 0
         , dw_jwa       = 0
         , up_aek       = 0
         , dw_aek       = 0
         , gup_aek      = 0
         , gdw_aek      = 0
         , gyul_aek     = NULL
         , ggyul_aek    = NULL
         , gyul_sonik   = NULL
         , bi_gup_aek   = 0
         , bi_gdw_aek   = 0
         , bi_gsonik    = NULL
         , bi_ggyul_aek = NULL
         , g40200       = NULL
         , g40201       = NULL
         , b0411        = NULL
         , b0412        = NULL
         , b0421        = NULL
         , b0422        = NULL
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0230', p_ymd || ' : 주식/수익증권 수도결제 회계처리');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'tr_cd like J2%,K2% * sudo_ymd=' || p_ymd, '주식 수도결제(skt0sd) 회계처리');

    -- 주식매매 당일 수도결제분
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                   /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                      AS bf_tr_cd    /* _2- */
             , t1.etf_jm_cd                                                 /* _3- */
             , CASE WHEN t2.tr_dr_gb='1' THEN 'E90'
                                         ELSE 'E10' END      AS tr_cd       /* _4- */
             , CASE WHEN t1.tr_cd IN ('J2A','K2A') THEN '05'
                    WHEN t1.tr_cd IN ('J27','K27') THEN 'A0'
                                                   ELSE '03'
               END                                           AS jasan_gb    /* _5- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                   /* _6- */
             , t1.type_trench                                               /* _7- */
             , SUM(t1.gyulje_aek)                            AS gyulje_aek  /* _8- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq         /* _9- */
          FROM SKT0SD t1  /* 주식,채권 수도결제 */
             , SZX0GC t2  /* 거래코드 */
             , SZM0IA t3  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.sudo_ymd              = p_ymd
           AND REGEXP_LIKE (t1.tr_cd, '^[JK][2]|F21')
           AND t2.tr_cd                 = t1.tr_cd
           AND t3.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t3.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd                                                                                                                                                                         , t1.tr_cd                                                                                                                                                                           , t1.etf_jm_cd
                , CASE WHEN t2.tr_dr_gb='1' THEN 'E90'
                                            ELSE 'E10' END
                , CASE WHEN t1.tr_cd IN ('J2A','K2A') THEN '05'
                       WHEN t1.tr_cd IN ('J27','K27') THEN 'A0'
                                                      ELSE '03' END
                , t1.bs_type                                                                                                                                                                         , t1.type_trench
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                    xx.etf_jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.gyulje_aek, 23, 'PROC0230(' || xx.bf_tr_cd || ')', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'sudo_ymd=' || p_ymd, '수익증권 수도결제(sjt0sg) 회계처리');

    -- 수익증권매매 모펀드 설정/해지 내역처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.mo_fund_cd
             , t1.tr_jwa
             , t1.tr_aek
             , t1.rowid
          FROM SJT0SG t1  /* 집합투자증권 매매내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd      < p_ymd
           AND t1.gijunga_ymd = p_ymd
    ) loop
        -- 원본,순자산,과표/비과표 손익
        SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='40101' THEN t1.junj END), 0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='D0101' THEN t1.junj END), 0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='D0204' THEN t1.junj END), 0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='D0205' THEN t1.junj END), 0)
          INTO w_40101
             , w_D0101
             , w_D0204
             , w_D0205
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.mo_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok  IN ('40101','D0101','D0204','D0205');

        -- 이월이익잉여금
        SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t2.tax_gb='1' THEN t1.junj END), 0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t2.tax_gb='2' THEN t1.junj END), 0)
          INTO w_40201
             , w_40211
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             , SZX0GM t2  /* 계정과목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.mo_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok  BETWEEN '40201' AND '40299'
           AND t2.gwamok  = t1.gwamok;

        if (w_D0204 + w_D0205 + w_40201 + w_40211) != (w_D0101 - w_40101)   then
            p_msg   := xx.mo_fund_cd || ' - 수익증권 설정해지 순자산 계정의 합이 틀립니다.('
                                     || F_NTRIM ((w_D0204 + w_D0205 + w_40201 + w_40211) - (w_D0101 - w_40101)) || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 추가설정좌수별 금액계산
        w_suik_gwa_chg  := ROUND  (w_D0204 * (xx.tr_jwa / w_40101));
        w_suik_bgwa_chg := ROUND  (w_D0205 * (xx.tr_jwa / w_40101));
        w_ing_gwa_chg   := ROUND  (w_40201 * (xx.tr_jwa / w_40101));
        w_ing_bgwa_chg  := ROUND  (w_40211 * (xx.tr_jwa / w_40101));
        w_wonbon_chg    := ROUND  (w_40101 * (xx.tr_jwa / w_40101));

        -- 금액 보정처리
        if (w_D0204 + w_D0205) != 0 then
            w_cha_aek := xx.tr_aek - (w_suik_gwa_chg + w_suik_bgwa_chg + w_ing_gwa_chg + w_ing_bgwa_chg + w_wonbon_chg);
            if  w_cha_aek != 0  then
                w_suik_gwa_chg  := w_suik_gwa_chg + TRUNC  (w_cha_aek / (w_D0204 + w_D0205) * w_D0204);
                w_suik_bgwa_chg := w_suik_bgwa_chg + TRUNC  (w_cha_aek / (w_D0204 + w_D0205) * w_D0205);
            end if;
        end if;
        w_cha_aek := xx.tr_aek - (w_suik_gwa_chg + w_suik_bgwa_chg + w_ing_gwa_chg + w_ing_bgwa_chg + w_wonbon_chg);
        if  w_cha_aek != 0  then
            if  w_suik_bgwa_chg != 0    then
                    w_suik_bgwa_chg := w_suik_bgwa_chg + w_cha_aek;
            else    w_suik_gwa_chg  := w_suik_gwa_chg + w_cha_aek;
            end if;
        end if;

        UPDATE SJT0SG tt    /* 집합투자증권 매매내역 */
           SET gtr_aek       = NVL(w_wonbon_chg, 0) + NVL(w_suik_gwa_chg, 0) + NVL(w_ing_gwa_chg, 0)
             , wonbon_chg    = w_wonbon_chg
             , suik_gwa_chg  = w_suik_gwa_chg
             , suik_bgwa_chg = w_suik_bgwa_chg
             , ing_gwa_chg   = w_ing_gwa_chg
             , ing_bgwa_chg  = w_ing_bgwa_chg
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;

    -- 수익증권 당일 매도분 수도결제
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                    /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                   /* _2- */
             , t1.mo_fund_cd                /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_cd                     /* _4- */
             , t1.tr_jwa                    /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_aek                    /* _6- */
             , t1.gtr_aek                   /* _7- */
             , t1.bi_gtr_aek                /* _8- */
             , t1.seq_no                    /* _9- */
             , CASE WHEN t2.type_gb='3' THEN '03'
                                        ELSE '01'
               END            AS jasan_gb   /* _10- */
             , t1.sudo_ymd                  /* _11- */
          FROM SJT0SG t1  /* 집합투자증권 매매내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd   < p_ymd
           AND t1.sudo_ymd = p_ymd
           AND t2.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd  = t1.mo_fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_cd LIKE 'J%'  then
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                        xx.mo_fund_cd, TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'dd'), xx.seq_no, xx.tr_aek, 23, 'PROC0230(' || xx.tr_cd || ')', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;

            -- 수익증권 마스타
            UPDATE SJM0SM tt    /* (모자 / Multi Class) 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
               SET up_jwa     = up_jwa + xx.tr_jwa
                 , up_aek     = up_aek + xx.tr_aek
                 , gup_aek    = gup_aek + NVL(xx.gtr_aek, 0)
                 , bi_gup_aek = bi_gup_aek + NVL(xx.bi_gtr_aek, 0)
             WHERE corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
               AND ymd        = p_ymd
               AND mo_fund_cd = xx.mo_fund_cd;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
                INSERT INTO SJM0SM tt   /* (모자 / Multi Class) 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr      /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd          /* _2- */
                       , xx.fund_cd     /* _3- */
                       , xx.mo_fund_cd  /* _4- */
                       , 0              /* _5- */
                       , xx.tr_jwa      /* _6- */
                       , 0              /* _7- */
                       , 0              /* _8- */
                       , xx.tr_aek      /* _9- */
                       , 0              /* _10- */
                       , 0              /* _11- */
                       , 0              /* _12- */
                       , xx.gtr_aek     /* _13- */
                       , 0              /* _14- */
                       , 0              /* _15- */
                       , NULL           /* _16- */
                       , NULL           /* _17- */
                       , NULL           /* _18- */
                       , 0              /* _19- */
                       , xx.bi_gtr_aek  /* _20- */
                       , 0              /* _21- */
                       , NULL           /* _22- */
                       , NULL           /* _23- */
                       , NULL           /* _24- */
                       , NULL           /* _25- */
                       , NULL           /* _26- */
                       , NULL           /* _27- */
                       , NULL           /* _28- */
                       , NULL           /* _29- */
                       , NULL           /* _30- */
                       );
            end if;
        else
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E13', 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                        '', TO_CHAR(xx.tr_ymd, 'dd'), xx.seq_no, xx.tr_aek, 23, 'PROC0230(' || xx.tr_cd || ')', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 타사수익증권 매도 익일수도결제
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd      /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd     /* _2- */
             , t1.tasa_jm_cd  /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_cd       /* _4- */
             , t1.tr_aek      /* _5- */
             , t1.seq_no      /* _6- */
          FROM SJT5SG t1  /* 타사집합투자증권 매매내역 */
             , SJM0SC t2  /* 타사집합투자증권 정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd     < p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd      LIKE 'K%'
           AND t1.sudo_ymd   = p_ymd
           AND t2.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.tasa_jm_cd = t1.tasa_jm_cd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E13', 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                    xx.tasa_jm_cd, TO_CHAR(xx.tr_ymd, 'dd'), xx.seq_no, xx.tr_aek, 23, '#2512 PROC0230(' || xx.tr_cd || ')', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', '', '평가손익 결산분개 보정분개 처리');

    SR_PROC0760_RE (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 23, w_msg);
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := 'PROC0230-' || w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0240 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 선물 수도결제
--
    w_sudo_tr_cd                   szx0ga.tr_cd%type;   /* 수도결제거래코드 */
    w_jasan_gb                     szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0240', p_ymd || ' : 선물 수도결제 거래 회계처리');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B000', 'skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0bu.proc_step=24', '선물/OTS 수도결제 거래 회계처리');

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND t1.proc_step = 24;

    -- 수도결제 거래내역 분개
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                 /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                           /* _2- */
             , kj.sj_gb                                                   /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_sonik_gb                                             /* _4- */
             , t1.currency                                                /* _5- */
             , F_ROUND (SUM(t1.sudo_aek), ia.fund_currency)  AS sudo_aek  /* _6- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq       /* _7- */
          FROM SST0KS t1  /* 파생상품 수도결제 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SSX0KJ kj  /* 파생종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.sudo_ymd = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
           AND kj.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND kj.sj_cd    = t1.sj_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
                , kj.sj_gb
                , t1.tr_sonik_gb
                , t1.currency
    ) loop
        if  xx.sj_gb = '1'  then
                w_jasan_gb := '00';  /* 선물 */
        else    w_jasan_gb := '01';
        end if;
        -- 미수금
        if  xx.tr_sonik_gb = '1'    then
                w_sudo_tr_cd := 'S52';  /* 선물수도결제입금 */
        else    w_sudo_tr_cd := 'S51';  /* 선물수도결제출금 */
        end if;

        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_sudo_tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                    '', xx.seq, 1, xx.sudo_aek, 24, 'PROC0240', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 수도결제 거래내역 분개
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                               /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                         /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                 /* _3- */
             , t2.jm_gb                                                 /* _4- */
             , t2.NAV_TARGET_YN                                         /* _5- */
             , MAX(t1.seq_no)                                AS seq_no  /* _6- */
             , F_TRUNC (SUM(t1.tr_aek), ia.fund_currency)    AS tr_aek  /* _7- */
             , F_TRUNC (SUM(t1.mm_sonik), ia.fund_currency)  AS sonik   /* _8- */
          FROM OTS0OG t1  /* OTS 매매내역 */
             , OTS0JM t2  /* OTS 종목정보 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd   BETWEEN (p_ymd - 10) AND p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd    IN ('J93','E33','E39')
           AND t1.sudo_ymd = p_ymd
           AND t1.sudo_ymd != t1.tr_ymd
           AND t2.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
                , t1.tr_cd
                , t2.jm_gb
                , t2.NAV_TARGET_YN
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'J93'    then
            if (xx.jm_gb = '7' AND xx.NAV_TARGET_YN = 'N') OR xx.jm_gb = 'F'    then    ---TRS 처리를 위해(매수 매도 금액 결제 없이 정산액만 결제), 20210820 fxfoward도 포함
                    NULL;
            else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E92', 'A', '1', '0', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', xx.seq_no, 1, xx.tr_aek, 24, 'PROC0240', w_msg);
            end if;
        else
            if  xx.jm_gb = 'F'  then
                    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E93', 'A', '1', sign(xx.sonik), xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', xx.seq_no, 1, abs(xx.sonik), 24, 'PROC0240', w_msg);
            ELSE    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E93', 'A', '1', '1'           , xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', xx.seq_no, 1, xx.tr_aek    , 24, 'PROC0240', w_msg);
            end if;
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0310 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 공시처리
--
    w_jm_cd1                       sjm0jj.jm_cd%type;
    w_jm_cd2                       sjm0jj.jm_cd%type;

    w_bf_balh_ga                   NUMBER;
    w_cha                          NUMBER;
    w_aekm                         NUMBER;
    w_hab_per                      NUMBER;
    w_hab_jusu                     NUMBER;
    w_hab_chui_aek                 NUMBER;
    w_hab_gyoub_aek                NUMBER;

    w_kweonri_ymd                  DATE;

    w_balh_co                      sjm0jm.balh_co%type;
    w_woos_ilban_gb                sjm0jm.woos_ilban_gb%type;
    w_chg_gb                       sjm0jm.chg_gb%type;
    w_new_old_gb                   sjm0jm.new_old_gb%type;
    w_danc_gb                      sjm0jm.danc_gb%type;
    w_koscom_cd                    sjm0jm.koscom_cd%type;

    w_new_jm_cd                    sjm0jj.jm_cd%type;
    w_new_jm_nm                    sjm0jj.jj_fnm%type;
    w_digit                        VARCHAR (1);

    w_jasan_gb                     szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;

    w_jusu                         NUMBER;
    w_aek1                         NUMBER;
    w_sonik                        NUMBER;
    w_hab_rt                       NUMBER;
    w_hab_aek                      NUMBER;
    w_hab_sonik                    NUMBER;
    w_rt                           NUMBER;
    w_up_jusu                      NUMBER;
    w_dw_jusu                      NUMBER;

    w_aek                          number_varray_50;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'PROC0310', p_ymd || ' : 공시처리 초기화');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B100', 'skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0bu.proc_step=31', '공시관련 분개내용(skt0bu) delete');

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND proc_step = 31;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B025', 'sjx0jb.bf_aekm_ymd=' || p_ymd, '당일 액면분할/합병 환원처리');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT ROWID
             , balh_co
             , ymd
             , bf_data
          FROM SJX0JB_HISTORY t1  /* 발행기관 변경 History */
         WHERE t1.ymd        > p_ymd
           AND t1.chg_column = 'aekm'
           AND t1.upd_user   = 'PROC0310'
    ) loop
        UPDATE SJX0JB tt    /* 발행기관 */
           SET aekm = xx.bf_data
         WHERE balh_co = xx.balh_co;

        DELETE FROM SJX0JB_HISTORY tt   /* 발행기관 변경 History */
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B040', 'sjm0jm.ymd=' || p_ymd, '주식마스타(sjm0jm) gongs_up_jusu=0,gongs_up_chui_aek=0,gongs_dw_jusu=0,gongs_dw_chui_aek=0 처리');

    -- 주식마스터 초기화
    UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
       SET gongs_up_jusu     = 0
         , gongs_up_chui_aek = 0
         , gongs_dw_jusu     = 0
         , gongs_dw_chui_aek = 0
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    ---------------------
    -- 공시대장 초기화 --
    ---------------------
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B080', 'sjt0bm.ymd=' || p_ymd, '배당락 주수(sjt0bm) delete');

    -- 배당락
    DELETE FROM SJT0BM tt   /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    -- 전부해지후 전일 재처리시
    DELETE FROM SJT0BM tt   /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
     WHERE corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd       > ADD_MONTHS(p_ymd,-6)
       AND haeji_ymd >= p_ymd;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B090', 'sjt0bm.hwakj_ymd=' || p_ymd, '확정주수(sjt0bm) clear');

    -- 확정배당
    UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
       SET hwakj_jusu = 0
         , hwakj_aek  = 0
         , hwakj_tax  = 0
         , hwakj_ymd  = NULL
     WHERE corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND hwakj_ymd = p_ymd;

    UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
       SET juchong_jusu = 0
         , juchong_aek  = 0
         , juchong_tax  = 0
         , juchong_ymd  = NULL
     WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
       AND juchong_ymd = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B100', 'sjt0j1.ymd=' || p_ymd, '권리락(sjt0j1) delete');

    -- 권리락
    -- 3311 유무상권리내역 조회 화면에서 수정된 배정주수
    DELETE FROM SJT0J1_IN tt  
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr;

    INSERT INTO SJT0J1_IN tt  
    SELECT *
      FROM SJT0J1 t1  /* 증자대장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
       AND t1.upd_user IS NOT NULL;

    DELETE FROM SJT0J1 tt   /* 증자대장 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    -- 전부해지후 전일 재처리시
    DELETE FROM SJT0J1 tt   /* 증자대장 */
     WHERE corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd       > ADD_MONTHS(p_ymd,-6)
       AND haeji_ymd > p_ymd;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B110', 'sjt0j1.gosi_jekyung_ymd=' || p_ymd, '비율변경전 내용으로 변경(sjt0j1)');

    -- 비율변경 (변경전을 최종으로)
    UPDATE SJT0J1 tt    /* 증자대장 */
       SET baej_jusu       = chg_bf_jusu
         , baej_rt         = chg_bf_rt
         , balh_ga         = chg_bf_balh_ga
         , chui_aek        = chg_chui_aek
         , gosi_jekyng_ymd = chg_bf_ymd
     WHERE corp_gr         = p_corp_gr
       AND gosi_jekyng_ymd = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B115', 'sjt5j1.gosi_jekyung_ymd=' || p_ymd, '비율변경전 내용으로 변경(sjt5j1)');

    -- 신주인수권 발행가 변경 (변경전을 최종으로) [yjs]
    UPDATE SJT5J1 tt    /* 신주인수권 매매 내역 */
       SET balh_ga         = chg_bf_balh_ga
         , gosi_jekyng_ymd = chg_bf_ymd
     WHERE corp_gr         = p_corp_gr
       AND gosi_jekyng_ymd = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B120', 'sjt0h1.ymd=' || p_ymd, '합병,감자(sjt0h1) delete');

    -- 합병,감자
    DELETE FROM SJT0H1 tt   /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B130', 'sjt0bm.del_ymd=' || p_ymd, '상장공시에 의한 배당대장 재처리');

    -- 배당대장 Select
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.*
             , t1.rowid
          FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.del_ymd = p_ymd
    ) loop
        UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
           SET del_yn        = NULL
             , del_ymd       = NULL
             , old_jm_cd_553 = NULL
             , new_jm_cd_553 = NULL
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
           SET boyu_jusu     = NVL(boyu_jusu,0) - xx.boyu_jusu
             , boyu_chui_aek = NVL(boyu_chui_aek,0) - xx.boyu_chui_aek
             , brok_jusu     = NVL(brok_jusu,0) - xx.brok_jusu
             , yesa_jusu     = NVL(yesa_jusu,0) - xx.yesa_jusu
             , yesa_aek      = NVL(yesa_aek,0) - xx.yesa_aek
             , yesa_tax      = NVL(yesa_tax,0) - xx.yesa_tax
             , hwakj_jusu    = NVL(hwakj_jusu,0) - xx.hwakj_jusu
             , hwakj_aek     = NVL(hwakj_aek,0) - xx.hwakj_aek
             , juchong_jusu  = NVL(juchong_jusu,0) - xx.juchong_jusu
             , juchong_aek   = NVL(juchong_aek,0) - xx.juchong_aek
             , juchong_tax   = NVL(juchong_tax,0) - xx.juchong_tax
         WHERE corp_gr             = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd             = xx.fund_cd
           AND old_jm_cd           = xx.old_jm_cd_553
           AND ymd                 = xx.ymd
           AND balh_co             = SUBSTR(xx.new_jm_cd_553,4,5)
           AND new_jm_cd           = xx.new_jm_cd_553
           AND NVL(haeji_fund,'x') = NVL(xx.haeji_fund,'x');
    end loop;

    -- 증자공시 Select
    for xx IN (
        SELECT tr_cd            /* _1-거래코드 */
             , balh_co          /* _2-발행기관 */
             , jeungj_mth       /* _3-증자방법 */
             , baej_mth         /* _4-배정방법 */
             , balh_ga          /* _5-발행가 */
             , woos_balh_ga     /* _6-발행가(우선주) */
             , jekyng_rt        /* _7-적용비율 */
             , woos_jekyng_rt   /* _8-적용비율(우선주) */
             , baed_gisan_ymd   /* _9- */
             , cheng_ymd        /* _10-청약일 */
             , krak_ymd         /* _11-권리락일 */
             , baej_gijun_ymd   /* _12-배정기준일 */
             , jukm_nabib_ymd   /* _13-주금납입일 */
             , sinj_jaew        /* _14-신주재원 */
             , ilban_balh_jusu  /* _15-보통주발행주수 */
             , woos_balh_jusu   /* _16-우선주발행주수 */
          FROM SJT0JK t1  /* 증자공시 */
         WHERE t1.tr_ymd = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd  IN ('G31','G35')
         ORDER BY tr_cd
    ) loop
        -- 신주종목코드 생성
        SR_PROC031A (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.balh_co, xx.jeungj_mth, xx.baej_mth, xx.balh_ga,
                     xx.baed_gisan_ymd, xx.jukm_nabib_ymd, xx.ilban_balh_jusu, xx.woos_balh_jusu, w_jm_cd1, w_jm_cd2, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC031A-' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 증자대장 생성
        SR_PROC031B (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.krak_ymd, xx.balh_co, xx.jeungj_mth, xx.baej_mth, xx.balh_ga,
                     xx.woos_balh_ga, xx.jekyng_rt, xx.woos_jekyng_rt, w_jm_cd1, w_jm_cd2, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC031B-' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 3311 유무상권리내역 조회 화면에서 수정된 배정주수 반영
        for ri IN (
            SELECT *
              FROM SJT0J1_IN t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
               AND balh_co    = xx.balh_co
        ) loop
            UPDATE SJT0J1 tt    /* 증자대장 */
               SET BAEJ_JUSU    = ri.baej_jusu
                 , CHUI_AEK     = ri.chui_aek
                 , CHG_BF_JUSU  = ri.baej_jusu
                 , CHG_CHUI_AEK = ri.chui_aek
                 , UPD_USER     = ri.upd_user
             WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd     = ri.fund_cd
               AND old_jm_cd   = ri.old_jm_cd
               AND ymd         = p_ymd
               AND balh_co     = ri.balh_co
               AND jeungj_mth  = ri.jeungj_mth
               AND new_jm_cd   = ri.new_jm_cd
               AND bs_type     = ri.bs_type
               AND type_trench = ri.type_trench;
        end loop;

        -- 주식마스터 생성 - 신주종목
        SR_PROC031C (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.krak_ymd, xx.balh_co, xx.jeungj_mth, xx.baej_mth, xx.balh_ga, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC031C-' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 주식마스터 구주 취득가 조정 - (무상만)
        if  xx.jeungj_mth = '2'     then
            SR_PROC031D (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.krak_ymd, xx.balh_co, xx.jeungj_mth, w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := 'PROC031D-' || w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 증자공시 Select
    for xx IN (
        SELECT tr_cd           /* _1-거래코드 */
             , balh_co         /* _2-발행기관 */
             , jeungj_mth      /* _3-증자방법 */
             , baej_mth        /* _4-배정방법 */
             , jekyng_rt       /* _5-적용비율 */
             , woos_jekyng_rt  /* _6-적용비율(우선주) */
             , balh_ga         /* _7-발행가 */
             , woos_balh_ga    /* _8-발행가(우선주) */
             , cheng_ymd       /* _9-청약일 */
             , krak_ymd        /* _10-권리락일 */
             , baej_gijun_ymd  /* _11-배정기준일 */
             , jukm_nabib_ymd  /* _12-주금납입일 */
             , sinj_jaew       /* _13-신주재원 */
          FROM SJT0JK t1  /* 증자공시 */
         WHERE t1.tr_ymd = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd  IN ('G32','G36')
    ) loop
        -- 증자대장 변경 - 배정주수.취득액계산
        SR_PROC031E (p_corp_gr, xx.krak_ymd, xx.balh_co, xx.jeungj_mth, xx.baej_mth,
                     xx.jekyng_rt, xx.woos_jekyng_rt, xx.balh_ga, xx.woos_balh_ga, p_ymd);
        -- 주식마스터 생성 - 신주종목
        SR_PROC031F (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.krak_ymd, xx.balh_co, xx.jeungj_mth, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC031F-' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 신주인수권 발행가 변경
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'G32'    then
            UPDATE SJT5J1 tt    /* 신주인수권 매매 내역 */
               SET CHG_BF_BALH_GA  = balh_ga
                 , CHG_BF_YMD      = gosi_jekyng_ymd
                 , BALH_GA         = xx.balh_ga
                 , GOSI_JEKYNG_YMD = p_ymd
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND krak_ymd = xx.krak_ymd
               AND balh_co  = xx.balh_co;

            w_bf_balh_ga := 0;
            for x2 IN (
                SELECT balh_ga  /* 발행가 */
                  FROM SJT0JK t1  /* 증자공시 */
                 WHERE t1.tr_ymd    BETWEEN xx.krak_ymd AND p_ymd - 1
                   AND t1.balh_co   = xx.balh_co
                   AND t1.tr_cd     IN ('G31','G32')
                   AND t1.cheng_ymd = xx.cheng_ymd
                   AND t1.krak_ymd  = xx.krak_ymd
                 ORDER BY t1.tr_ymd
            ) loop
                -- 발행가변경 최종분 찾기
                w_bf_balh_ga := x2.balh_ga;
            end loop;
            if  w_bf_balh_ga != 0   then
                -- 신주인수권 시장매입분 처리를 위해 sjm0jm 으로 변경 20210608 yjs
                w_cha := xx.balh_ga - w_bf_balh_ga;
                if  abs (w_cha) > 0         then    -- 20220302 bjh 발행가변경이 아닌 유증비율 변경의 경우 취득액증감분이 0으로 바뀌는 문제로 수정
                    for x2 IN (
                        SELECT t1.rowid
                             , NVL(bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(up_jusu,0) - NVL(dw_jusu,0)
                                                     + NVL(gongs_up_jusu,0) - NVL(gongs_dw_jusu,0)  AS jusu
                          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
                           AND t1.balh_co = xx.balh_co
                           AND t1.jm_cd   LIKE 'KRT%'
                           AND bs_type    IN (0, -1)
                    ) loop
                        -- 권리락에 의해 보유한자료와 매입한 자료가 혼재되어 있을 수 있어(sjhp533에서 변경) 20210808 yjs
                        -- NVL(gongs_up_chui_aek,0) + 컬럼 삭제처리
                        UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
                           SET GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK = CASE WHEN sign(w_cha)=1 THEN x2.jusu * w_cha ELSE 0 END
                             , GONGS_DW_CHUI_AEK = CASE WHEN sign(w_cha)= -1 THEN x2.jusu * - w_cha ELSE 0 END
                         WHERE ROWID = x2.rowid;
                    end loop;
                end if;
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 예상배당, 중간배당 처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT CORP_GR         /* _1- */
             , TR_CD           /* _2- */
             , BALH_CO         /* _3- */
             , BAED_MTH        /* _4- */
             , BAEJ_MTH        /* _5- */
             , CASH_ILBAN_RT   /* _6- */
             , CASH_WOOS_RT    /* _7- */
             , ILBAN_AEK       /* _8- */
             , WOOS_AEK        /* _9- */
             , STOCK_ILBAN_RT  /* _10- */
             , STOCK_WOOS_RT   /* _11- */
             , BROK_YMD        /* _12- */
             , JUCHONG_YMD     /* _13- */
          FROM (SELECT t1.*
                     , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY BALH_CO, TR_CD, BROK_YMD
                                               ORDER BY CASE WHEN CORP_GR = p_corp_gr THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)  AS rnum
                  FROM SJT0BK t1  /* 발행기관별 배당권리 내역 */
                 WHERE TR_CD   IN ('G10','G15')
                   AND CORP_GR IN (p_corp_gr, '%')
                   AND ((TR_CD = 'G15' AND TR_YMD = p_ymd) OR
                       (TR_CD = 'G10' AND BROK_YMD = p_ymd))
                 )
         WHERE rnum = 1
    ) loop
        SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_cd, xx.balh_co, xx.baed_mth);

        -- 신주종목코드 생성
        SR_PROC031G (p_corp_gr, xx.brok_ymd, xx.balh_co, xx.baej_mth, xx.juchong_ymd, w_jm_cd1, w_jm_cd2, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC031G-' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 배당대장 생성
        SR_PROC031H (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.balh_co, xx.baed_mth, xx.baej_mth,
                     NVL(xx.cash_ilban_rt, 0), NVL(xx.cash_woos_rt, 0), xx.ilban_aek, xx.woos_aek,
                     NVL(xx.stock_ilban_rt, 0), NVL(xx.stock_woos_rt, 0), xx.brok_ymd, w_jm_cd1, w_jm_cd2, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC031H-' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 주식마스터 생성 ( 배당신주 )
        if  xx.baed_mth IN ('2','3')    then    SR_PROC031J (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.balh_co);
        end if;
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT TR_CD           /* _1- */
             , BALH_CO         /* _2- */
             , BAED_MTH        /* _3- */
             , BAEJ_MTH        /* _4- */
             , CASH_ILBAN_RT   /* _5- */
             , CASH_WOOS_RT    /* _6- */
             , ILBAN_AEK       /* _7- */
             , WOOS_AEK        /* _8- */
             , STOCK_ILBAN_RT  /* _9- */
             , STOCK_WOOS_RT   /* _10- */
             , BROK_YMD        /* _11- */
             , JUCHONG_YMD     /* _12- */
          FROM (SELECT t1.*
                     , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY BALH_CO, TR_CD, BROK_YMD
                                               ORDER BY CASE WHEN CORP_GR = p_corp_gr THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)  AS rnum
                  FROM SJT0BK t1  /* 발행기관별 배당권리 내역 */
                 WHERE TR_YMD  = p_ymd
                   AND TR_CD   IN ('G20','G23','G25')
                   AND CORP_GR IN (p_corp_gr, '%')
                 )
         WHERE rnum = 1
    ) loop
        -- 신주종목코드 생성
        SR_PROC031G (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.balh_co, xx.baej_mth, xx.juchong_ymd, w_jm_cd1, w_jm_cd2, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC031G-' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
        BEGIN
            SELECT aekm
              INTO w_aekm
              FROM SJX0JB t1  /* 발행기관 */
             WHERE t1.balh_co = xx.balh_co;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_aekm := 0;
        END;

        -- 배당대장수정 ( 확정배당주수,배당액 계산 )
        SR_PROC031K (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.brok_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.balh_co, w_aekm, xx.baed_mth, xx.baej_mth,
                     NVL(xx.cash_ilban_rt, 0), NVL(xx.cash_woos_rt, 0), NVL(xx.ilban_aek, 0), NVL(xx.woos_aek, 0), NVL(xx.stock_ilban_rt, 0), NVL(xx.stock_woos_rt, 0),
                     w_jm_cd1, w_jm_cd2, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC031K-' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 주식마스터 생성 ( 신주종목 )
        SR_PROC031M (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.brok_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.balh_co);
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT TR_CD            /* _1-거래코드 */
             , HAB_CO           /* _2-합병/감자회사 */
             , PI_HAB_CO        /* _3-피합병/감자회사 */
             , HAB_ILBAN_RT     /* _4-합병/감자비율(보통주) */
             , HAB_WOOS_RT      /* _5-(우선주) */
             , HAB_ILBAN_AEK    /* _6-합병/감자교부금(보통주) */
             , HAB_WOOS_AEK     /* _7-(우선주) */
             , GAM_ILBAN_RT     /* _8-부분합병비율(보통주) */
             , GAM_WOOS_RT      /* _9-(우선주) */
             , PI_HAB_ILBAN_RT  /* _10- */
             , PI_HAB_WOOS_RT   /* _11- */
          FROM SJT0HK t1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 공시자료 */
         WHERE t1.tr_ymd = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd  IN ('G40','G43','G45','G93')
         ORDER BY tr_cd DESC
    ) loop
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 신주종목코드 생성
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        SR_PROC031N (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.hab_co, w_jm_cd1, w_jm_cd2, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC031N-' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 대장 생성
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        SR_PROC031P (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.hab_co, xx.pi_hab_co,
                     xx.hab_ilban_rt, xx.hab_woos_rt, xx.hab_ilban_aek, xx.hab_woos_aek, xx.gam_ilban_rt, xx.gam_woos_rt, xx.pi_hab_ilban_rt, xx.pi_hab_woos_rt,
                     w_jm_cd1, w_jm_cd2, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC031P-' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- 신주 주식마스터 생성
        --------------------------------------------------------
        for r2 IN (
            SELECT t1.fund_cd                             /* _1- */
                 , t1.new_jm_cd                           /* _2- */
                 , t1.type_trench                         /* _3- */
                 , t1.bs_type                             /* _4- */
                 , SUM(t1.hab_jusu)      AS hab_jusu      /* _5- */
                 , SUM(t1.hab_chui_aek)  AS hab_chui_aek  /* _6- */
              FROM SJT0H1 t1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
               AND t1.tr_cd                 = xx.tr_cd
               AND t1.hab_co                = xx.hab_co
               AND t1.pi_hab_co             = xx.pi_hab_co
               AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
               AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
             GROUP BY t1.fund_cd
                    , t1.new_jm_cd
                    , t1.type_trench
                    , t1.bs_type
        ) loop
            -- 당일 주식수령에 의한 주수 변경분 반영 20090701 yjs
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL(sury_aek,0)
                  INTO r2.hab_jusu
                  FROM SJT0FS t1  /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd     = r2.fund_cd
                   AND t1.tr_ymd      = p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd       = r2.new_jm_cd
                   AND t1.tr_cd       = (CASE xx.tr_cd WHEN 'G40' THEN 'F31'
                                                       WHEN 'G43' THEN 'F3A'
                                                       WHEN 'G45' THEN 'F34' END)
                   AND t1.type_trench = r2.type_trench
                   AND t1.bs_type     = r2.bs_type;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                NULL;
            END;

            MERGE INTO SJM0JM tt  /* 주식 보유현황 */
               USING ( SELECT balh_co        /* _1- */
                            , woos_ilban_gb  /* _2- */
                            , chg_gb         /* _3- */
                            , new_old_gb     /* _4- */
                            , danc_gb        /* _5- */
                            , koscom_cd      /* _6- */
                         FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
                        WHERE t1.jm_cd = r2.new_jm_cd ) ut
                  ON ( corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND fund_cd = r2.fund_cd
                   AND jm_cd   = r2.new_jm_cd
                   AND ymd     = p_ymd )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                 UPDATE
                    SET gongs_up_jusu     = NVL(gongs_up_jusu,0) + r2.hab_jusu
                      , gongs_up_chui_aek = NVL(gongs_up_chui_aek,0) + r2.hab_chui_aek
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                 INSERT ( CORP_GR            /* _1- */
                        , YMD                /* _2- */
                        , FUND_CD            /* _3- */
                        , JM_CD              /* _4- */
                        , GONGS_UP_JUSU      /* _5- */
                        , GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK  /* _6-당일증가 주수/취득액 */
                        , BALH_CO            /* _7- */
                        , WOOS_ILBAN_GB      /* _8- */
                        , CHG_GB             /* _9- */
                        , NEW_OLD_GB         /* _10- */
                        , DANC_GB            /* _11- */
                        , KOSCOM_CD          /* _12- */
                        , TYPE_TRENCH        /* _13- */
                        , BS_TYPE            /* _14- */
                        )
                 VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                        , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                        , r2.fund_cd        /* _3- */
                        , r2.new_jm_cd      /* _4- */
                        , r2.hab_jusu       /* _5- */
                        , r2.hab_chui_aek   /* _6- */
                        , ut.balh_co        /* _7- */
                        , ut.woos_ilban_gb  /* _8- */
                        , ut.chg_gb         /* _9- */
                        , ut.new_old_gb     /* _10- */
                        , ut.danc_gb        /* _11- */
                        , ut.koscom_cd      /* _12- */
                        , r2.type_trench    /* _13- */
                        , r2.bs_type        /* _14- */
                        );
        end loop;
    end loop;

    -- 유상소각 Select
    for xx IN (
        SELECT TR_CD          /* _1- */
             , HAB_CO         /* _2- */
             , HAB_ILBAN_RT   /* _3- */
             , HAB_WOOS_RT    /* _4- */
             , HAB_ILBAN_AEK  /* _5- */
             , HAB_WOOS_AEK   /* _6- */
          FROM SJT0HK t1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 공시자료 */
         WHERE t1.tr_ymd = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd  = 'G47'
    ) loop
        for r2 IN (
            SELECT t1.rowid                         /* _1- */
                 , t1.fund_cd                       /* _2- */
                 , t1.jm_cd                         /* _3- */
                 , t1.type_trench                   /* _4- */
                 , t1.bs_type                       /* _5- */
                 , t1.woos_ilban_gb                 /* _6- */
                 , t1.bfil_boyu_jusu  AS boyu_jusu  /* _7- */
                 , t1.bfil_chui_aek   AS chui_aek   /* _8- */
              FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd
               AND t1.balh_co               = xx.hab_co
               AND t1.bfil_boyu_jusu        > 0
               AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
               AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
        ) loop
            -- 유상소각주수/금액
            if  r2.woos_ilban_gb = '0'      then
                w_hab_per       := xx.hab_ilban_rt * 100;
                w_hab_jusu      := ROUND (r2.boyu_jusu * xx.hab_ilban_rt);
                w_hab_chui_aek  := ROUND (r2.chui_aek * xx.hab_ilban_rt);
                w_hab_gyoub_aek := w_hab_jusu * xx.hab_ilban_aek;
            else
                w_hab_per       := xx.hab_woos_rt * 100;
                w_hab_jusu      := ROUND (r2.boyu_jusu * xx.hab_woos_rt);
                w_hab_chui_aek  := ROUND (r2.chui_aek * xx.hab_woos_rt);
                w_hab_gyoub_aek := w_hab_jusu * xx.hab_woos_aek;
            end if;

            -- 유상소각대장 생성
            INSERT INTO SJT0H1 tt   /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
                 ( CORP_GR        /* _1- */
                 , TR_YMD         /* _2-합병기일 */
                 , TR_CD          /* _3-거래코드 */
                 , HAB_CO         /* _4-합병회사 */
                 , PI_HAB_CO      /* _5-피합병회사 */
                 , FUND_CD        /* _6-펀드코드 */
                 , OLD_JM_CD      /* _7-피합병종목코드 */
                 , NEW_JM_CD      /* _8-합병종목코드 */
                 , BOYU_JUSU      /* _9-보유주수 */
                 , CHUI_AEK       /* _10-취득액 */
                 , HAB_PER        /* _11- */
                 , HAB_JUSU       /* _12-합병주수 */
                 , HAB_CHUI_AEK   /* _13-합병금액 */
                 , HAB_GYOUB_AEK  /* _14-합병교부금 */
                 , TYPE_TRENCH    /* _15- */
                 , BS_TYPE        /* _16- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd            /* _2-합병기일 */
                   , xx.tr_cd         /* _3-거래코드 */
                   , xx.hab_co        /* _4-합병회사 */
                   , xx.hab_co        /* _5-피합병회사 */
                   , r2.fund_cd       /* _6-펀드코드 */
                   , r2.jm_cd         /* _7-피합병종목코드 */
                   , r2.jm_cd         /* _8-합병종목코드 */
                   , r2.boyu_jusu     /* _9-보유주수 */
                   , r2.chui_aek      /* _10-취득액 */
                   , w_hab_per        /* _11- */
                   , w_hab_jusu       /* _12-합병주수 */
                   , w_hab_chui_aek   /* _13-합병취득액 */
                   , w_hab_gyoub_aek  /* _14-합병교부금 */
                   , r2.type_trench   /* _15- */
                   , r2.bs_type       /* _16- */
                   );
            -- 주식원장 수정
            UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
               SET gongs_dw_jusu     = NVL(gongs_dw_jusu,0) + w_hab_jusu
                 , gongs_dw_chui_aek = NVL(gongs_dw_chui_aek,0) + w_hab_chui_aek
             WHERE ROWID = r2.rowid;
        end loop;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjt0sk.ymd=' || p_ymd, '상장공시처리');

    -- 배당주식 수령처리 없이 상장처리시 자동으로 수령처리분 재처리
    UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
       SET sury_ymd    = NULL
         , sury_ju_aek = NULL
         , sury_set    = NULL
     WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND sury_ymd = p_ymd
       AND sury_set = 'A';

    -- 상장공시 Select
    for xx IN (
        SELECT TR_CD        /* _1- */
             , BALH_CO      /* _2- */
             , OLD_JM_CD    /* _3- */
             , OLD_DANC_GB  /* _4- */
             , NEW_JM_CD    /* _5- */
             , NEW_DANC_GB  /* _6- */
             , JONGA        /* _7- */
          FROM SJT0SK t1  /* 상장 공시 */
         WHERE t1.tr_ymd = p_ymd
        UNION ALL  /* -- 신주인수권상장(G55) */
        SELECT t1.TR_CD     /* _1- */
             , t1.BALH_CO   /* _2- */
             , jj.JM_CD     /* _3- */
             , jj.DANC_GB   /* _4- */
             , t1.SJ_JM_CD  /* _5- */
             , sj.DANC_GB   /* _6- */
             , NULL         /* _7- */
          FROM SJT0JL t1  /* 신주인수권 상장정보 */
             , SJM0JJ jj  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJM0JJ sj  /* 주식종목 */
         WHERE t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'G55'
           AND jj.balh_co = t1.balh_co
           AND jj.danc_gb = 'T'
           AND sj.jm_cd   = t1.sj_jm_cd
    ) loop
        SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B011', xx.tr_cd, xx.balh_co || ' ' || xx.old_jm_cd || ' ' || xx.new_jm_cd);
        if (xx.old_jm_cd=xx.new_jm_cd) AND (xx.tr_cd IN ('G00', 'G53'))     then    -- 코드변경없이 소속만 변경시
            UPDATE SJM0JJ tt    /* 주식종목 */
               SET DANC_GB   = xx.new_danc_gb
                 , SANGJ_YMD = p_ymd
             WHERE jm_cd = xx.new_jm_cd;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
                p_msg := xx.new_jm_cd || '- 찾을 수 없습니다';
                RETURN;
            end if;

            UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
               SET DANC_GB = xx.new_danc_gb
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND jm_cd   = xx.new_jm_cd
               AND ymd     = p_ymd;
        else
            -- 구종목코드 Find
            BEGIN
                SELECT kweonri_ymd
                  INTO w_kweonri_ymd
                  FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
                 WHERE t1.jm_cd = xx.old_jm_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := xx.old_jm_cd || '-구종목을 찾을 수 없습니다';
                RETURN;
            END;

            -- 신종목코드 update
            UPDATE SJM0JJ tt    /* 주식종목 */
               SET KWEONRI_YMD = w_kweonri_ymd
                 , SANGJ_YMD   = p_ymd
             WHERE jm_cd = xx.new_jm_cd;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
                p_msg := xx.new_jm_cd || '-신종목을 찾을 수 없습니다';
                RETURN;
            end if;

            -- to종목 마스터 생성및 from종목 마스터 삭제
            if  xx.tr_cd != 'G54'   then    xx.jonga := 0;
            end if;

            SR_PROC031Q (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.balh_co, xx.old_jm_cd, xx.new_jm_cd, xx.jonga, w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := 'PROC031Q-' || w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;

            -- 배당대장 병합
            SR_PROC031R (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.old_jm_cd, xx.new_jm_cd);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := 'PROC031R-' || w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 신주인수권 상장폐지 처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.balh_co
             , NVL(t1.hwakj_balh_ga, t1.balh_ga)  AS balh_ga
             , t1.jm_cd                           AS af_jm_cd
             , t1.sj_jm_cd                        AS bf_jm_cd
          FROM SJT0JL t1  /* 신주인수권 상장정보 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd     = 'G55'
           AND t1.close_ymd = p_ymd
           AND jb.balh_co   = t1.balh_co
    ) loop
        SR_PROC031Q (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.balh_co, xx.bf_jm_cd, xx.af_jm_cd, xx.balh_ga, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC031Q-' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 회사분할/이전(교환) 공시

    -- 신규종목 생성
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid          /* _1- */
             , t1.PI_HAB_CO      /* _2- */
             , t1.HAB_CO         /* _3- */
             , t3.BALH_NM        /* _4- */
             , t2.JM_CD          /* _5- */
             , t2.KOSCOM_CD      /* _6- */
             , t2.WOOS_ILBAN_GB  /* _7- */
             , t2.CHG_GB         /* _8- */
             , t2.NEW_OLD_GB     /* _9- */
             , t2.BALH_GA        /* _10- */
             , t2.UPJ_CD         /* _11- */
          FROM SJT0HK t1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 공시자료 */
             , SJM0JJ t2  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJX0JB t3  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'G60'
           AND t2.balh_co = t1.pi_hab_co
           AND t3.balh_co = t1.hab_co
    ) loop
        -- 코드조합
        w_new_jm_cd := 'KRB' || xx.hab_co || SUBSTR  (xx.jm_cd   , 9      , 3    );
        SR_CLCDGT (w_new_jm_cd, w_digit, w_msg);
        w_new_jm_cd := w_new_jm_cd || w_digit;

        if  xx.woos_ilban_gb = '0'  then    w_new_jm_nm := xx.balh_nm || '(분할)';
        else
            SELECT xx.balh_nm || '(' || sebu_cd_nm || ')(분할)'
              INTO w_new_jm_nm
              FROM SZX0GR t1  /* 그룹코드 */
             WHERE t1.gr_cd   = '33'
               AND t1.sebu_cd = xx.woos_ilban_gb;
        end if;

        MERGE INTO SJM0JJ tt  /* 주식종목 */
           USING DUAL ON ( jm_cd = w_new_jm_cd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET kweonri_ymd = p_ymd
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT ( JM_CD          /* _1- */
                    , KOSCOM_CD      /* _2- */
                    , JJ_FNM         /* _3- */
                    , JJ_NM          /* _4- */
                    , BALH_CO        /* _5- */
                    , WOOS_ILBAN_GB  /* _6- */
                    , CHG_GB         /* _7- */
                    , NEW_OLD_GB     /* _8- */
                    , DANC_GB        /* _9- */
                    , BALH_GA        /* _10- */
                    , KWEONRI_YMD    /* _11- */
                    , UPJ_CD         /* _12- */
                    , CREATED_YMD    /* _13- */
                    )
             VALUES ( w_new_jm_cd                            /* _1- */
                    , xx.hab_co || SUBSTR(xx.koscom_cd,6,1)  /* _2- */
                    , w_new_jm_nm                            /* _3- */
                    , w_new_jm_nm                            /* _4- */
                    , xx.hab_co                              /* _5- */
                    , xx.woos_ilban_gb                       /* _6- */
                    , xx.chg_gb                              /* _7- */
                    , xx.new_old_gb                          /* _8- */
                    , 'B'                                    /* _9- */
                    , xx.balh_ga                             /* _10- */
                    , p_ymd                                  /* _11- */
                    , xx.upj_cd                              /* _12- */
                    , p_ymd                                  /* _13- */
                    );
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t1.tr_cd                                               /* _1- */
             , t1.pi_hab_co                                                    /* _2- */
             , t2.jm_cd                                                        /* _3- */
             , t2.woos_ilban_gb                                                /* _4- */
             , t2.new_old_gb                                                   /* _5- */
             , t3.fund_cd                                                      /* _6- */
             , t2.danc_gb                                                      /* _7- */
             , NVL(t3.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(t3.up_jusu,0) - NVL(t3.dw_jusu,0)
                                        + NVL(t3.gongs_up_jusu,0)
                                        - NVL(t3.gongs_dw_jusu,0)     AS jusu  /* _8- */
             , NVL(t3.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t3.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t3.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                       + NVL(t3.gongs_up_chui_aek,0)
                                       - NVL(t3.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)  AS aek   /* _9- */
             , t3.sonik                                                        /* _10- */
             , t3.type_trench                                                  /* _11- */
             , t3.bs_type                                                      /* _12- */
          FROM SJT0HK t1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 공시자료 */
             , SJM0JJ t2  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJM0JM t3  /* 주식 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'G60'
           AND t2.balh_co = t1.pi_hab_co
           AND t3.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t3.ymd     = t1.tr_ymd - 1
           AND t3.jm_cd   = t2.jm_cd
    ) loop
        w_hab_rt := 0;

        w_hab_aek   := 0;
        w_hab_sonik := 0;
        for ra IN (
            SELECT t1.HAB_CO                          /* _1- */
                 , t2.JM_CD                           /* _2- */
                 , t2.CHG_GB                          /* _3- */
                 , t2.DANC_GB                         /* _4- */
                 , t2.KOSCOM_CD                       /* _5- */
                 , t1.HAB_ILBAN_RT        AS com_rt   /* _6- */
                 , NVL(t1.HAB_WOOS_RT,1)  AS jusu_rt  /* _7- */
              FROM SJT0HK t1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 공시자료 */
                 , SJM0JJ t2  /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE t1.tr_ymd        = p_ymd
               AND t1.tr_cd         = xx.tr_cd
               AND t1.pi_hab_co     = xx.pi_hab_co
               AND t2.balh_co       = t1.hab_co
               AND t2.danc_gb       = 'B'
               AND t2.woos_ilban_gb = xx.woos_ilban_gb
               AND t2.new_old_gb    = xx.new_old_gb
             ORDER BY t1.hab_ilban_rt
        ) loop
            w_jusu   := TRUNC  (xx.jusu * (ra.com_rt * ra.jusu_rt));
            w_hab_rt := w_hab_rt + ra.com_rt;
            if  w_hab_rt = 1    then
                w_aek1  := xx.aek - w_hab_aek;
                w_sonik := xx.sonik - w_hab_sonik;
            else
                w_aek1  := ROUND  (xx.aek * ra.com_rt  );
                w_sonik := ROUND  (xx.sonik * ra.com_rt);
            end if;
            w_hab_aek   := w_hab_aek + w_aek1;
            w_hab_sonik := w_hab_sonik + w_sonik;

            if  ra.jusu_rt != 1 then
                INSERT INTO SJT0H1 tt   /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
                     ( CORP_GR       /* _1- */
                     , TR_YMD        /* _2- */
                     , TR_CD         /* _3- */
                     , HAB_CO        /* _4- */
                     , PI_HAB_CO     /* _5- */
                     , FUND_CD       /* _6- */
                     , OLD_JM_CD     /* _7- */
                     , NEW_JM_CD     /* _8- */
                     , BOYU_JUSU     /* _9- */
                     , CHUI_AEK      /* _10- */
                     , HAB_PER       /* _11- */
                     , HAB_JUSU      /* _12- */
                     , HAB_CHUI_AEK  /* _13- */
                     , GAM_PER       /* _14- */
                     , GAM_JUSU      /* _15- */
                     , TYPE_TRENCH   /* _16- */
                     , BS_TYPE       /* _17- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                            /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd                                /* _2- */
                       , xx.tr_cd                             /* _3- */
                       , ra.hab_co                            /* _4- */
                       , xx.pi_hab_co                         /* _5- */
                       , xx.fund_cd                           /* _6- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                             /* _7- */
                       , ra.jm_cd                             /* _8- */
                       , xx.jusu                              /* _9- */
                       , xx.aek                               /* _10- */
                       , ra.com_rt * 100                      /* _11- */
                       , w_jusu                               /* _12- */
                       , w_aek1 + w_sonik                     /* _13- */
                       , ra.jusu_rt * 100                     /* _14- */
                       , TRUNC(xx.jusu * ra.com_rt) - w_jusu  /* _15- */
                       , xx.type_trench                       /* _16- */
                       , xx.bs_type                           /* _17- */
                       );
            else
                INSERT INTO SJT0H1 tt   /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
                     ( CORP_GR       /* _1- */
                     , TR_YMD        /* _2-분할일 */
                     , TR_CD         /* _3-거래코드 */
                     , HAB_CO        /* _4-분할회사 */
                     , PI_HAB_CO     /* _5-피분할회사 */
                     , FUND_CD       /* _6-펀드코드 */
                     , OLD_JM_CD     /* _7-피분할종목코드 */
                     , NEW_JM_CD     /* _8-분할종목코드 */
                     , BOYU_JUSU     /* _9-보유주수 */
                     , CHUI_AEK      /* _10-취득액 */
                     , HAB_PER       /* _11- */
                     , HAB_JUSU      /* _12-분할주수 */
                     , HAB_CHUI_AEK  /* _13-분할금액 */
                     , TYPE_TRENCH   /* _14- */
                     , BS_TYPE       /* _15- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                       , xx.tr_cd          /* _3- */
                       , ra.hab_co         /* _4- */
                       , xx.pi_hab_co      /* _5- */
                       , xx.fund_cd        /* _6- */
                       , xx.jm_cd          /* _7- */
                       , ra.jm_cd          /* _8- */
                       , xx.jusu           /* _9- */
                       , xx.aek            /* _10- */
                       , ra.com_rt * 100   /* _11- */
                       , w_jusu            /* _12- */
                       , w_aek1 + w_sonik  /* _13- */
                       , xx.type_trench    /* _14- */
                       , xx.bs_type        /* _15- */
                       );
            end if;

            MERGE INTO SJM0JM tt  /* 주식 보유현황 */
               USING DUAL ON ( corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                           AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
                           AND jm_cd       = ra.jm_cd
                           AND ymd         = p_ymd
                           AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
                           AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                 UPDATE
                    SET BALH_CO           = ra.hab_co
                      , GONGS_UP_JUSU     = NVL(gongs_up_jusu,0) + w_jusu
                      , GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK = NVL(gongs_up_chui_aek,0) + w_aek1 + w_sonik
                      , CHG_GB            = ra.chg_gb
                      , DANC_GB           = ra.danc_gb
                      , KOSCOM_CD         = ra.koscom_cd
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                 INSERT ( CORP_GR            /* _1- */
                        , YMD                /* _2- */
                        , FUND_CD            /* _3- */
                        , JM_CD              /* _4- */
                        , GONGS_UP_JUSU      /* _5- */
                        , GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK  /* _6- */
                        , BALH_CO            /* _7- */
                        , WOOS_ILBAN_GB      /* _8- */
                        , CHG_GB             /* _9- */
                        , NEW_OLD_GB         /* _10- */
                        , DANC_GB            /* _11- */
                        , KOSCOM_CD          /* _12- */
                        , TYPE_TRENCH        /* _13- */
                        , BS_TYPE            /* _14- */
                        )
                 VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                        , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                        , xx.fund_cd        /* _3- */
                        , ra.jm_cd          /* _4- */
                        , w_jusu            /* _5- */
                        , w_aek1 + w_sonik  /* _6- */
                        , ra.hab_co         /* _7- */
                        , xx.woos_ilban_gb  /* _8- */
                        , ra.chg_gb         /* _9- */
                        , xx.new_old_gb     /* _10- */
                        , ra.danc_gb        /* _11- */
                        , ra.koscom_cd      /* _12- */
                        , xx.type_trench    /* _13- */
                        , xx.bs_type        /* _14- */
                        );
        end loop;
    end loop;

    -- 회사분할공시 분개
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t1.tr_cd          /* _1- */
             , t2.jm_cd                   /* _2- */
             , t3.fund_cd                 /* _3- */
             , t2.danc_gb                 /* _4- */
             , t3.bfil_chui_aek   AS aek  /* _5- */
          FROM SJT0HK t1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 공시자료 */
             , SJM0JJ t2  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJM0JM t3  /* 주식 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'G60'
           AND t2.balh_co = t1.pi_hab_co
           AND t3.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t3.ymd     = t1.tr_ymd - 1
           AND t3.jm_cd   = t2.jm_cd
    ) loop
        -- 분개처리
        if  xx.danc_gb = 'B'    then    w_jasan_gb := '01';  -- 비상장
        elsif xx.danc_gb = 'C'  then    w_jasan_gb := '02';  -- 등록
        else                            w_jasan_gb := '00';  /* 상장 */
        end if;

        SELECT NVL(SUM(hab_chui_aek),0)
          INTO w_aek1
          FROM SJT0H1 t1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd   = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd     = xx.tr_cd
           AND t1.hab_jusu  > 0
           AND t1.old_jm_cd = xx.jm_cd;

        /* 분개처리 */
        SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, w_aek1, xx.aek, 31, 'sjhp540', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then    -- 분개처리error
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 공시수량 update
    UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
       SET gongs_dw_jusu     = bfil_boyu_jusu
         , gongs_dw_chui_aek = bfil_chui_aek
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND jm_cd   IN (SELECT tb.jm_cd
                         FROM SJT0HK ta  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 공시자료 */
                            , SJM0JJ tb  /* 주식종목 */
                        WHERE ta.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
                          AND ta.tr_cd   = 'G60'
                          AND tb.balh_co = ta.pi_hab_co)
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    -- 액면분할

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.TR_CD
             , t1.HAB_CO
             , t1.HAB_ILBAN_RT
             , t2.AEKM
          FROM SJT0HK t1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 공시자료 */
             , SJX0JB t2  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'G92'
           AND t2.balh_co = t1.hab_co
    ) loop
        -- 발행기관변경 History
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SJX0JB_HISTORY tt   /* 발행기관 변경 History */
            VALUES ( xx.hab_co                  /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                      /* _2- */
                   , 'aekm'                     /* _3- */
                   , xx.aekm                    /* _4- */
                   , xx.aekm * xx.hab_ilban_rt  /* _5- */
                   , 'sjhp570'                  /* _6- */
                   , NULL                       /* _7- */
                   );

            -- 복수회사 처리로 한번만 update 실행케 수정
            UPDATE SJX0JB tt    /* 발행기관 */
               SET AEKM = xx.aekm * xx.hab_ilban_rt
             WHERE BALH_CO = xx.hab_co;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;

        w_rt := (1 / xx.hab_ilban_rt) - 1;

        -- 주식마스타 수정
        for ra IN (
            SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                /* _1- */
                 , t1.jm_cd                                                  /* _2- */
                 , t1.type_trench                                            /* _3- */
                 , t1.bs_type                                                /* _4- */
                 , NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.gongs_up_jusu,0)
                                            - NVL(gongs_dw_jusu,0)  AS jusu  /* _5- */
                 , t1.danc_gb                                                /* _6- */
                 , t1.balh_co                                                /* _7- */
              FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                 , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd
               AND t1.balh_co               = xx.hab_co
               AND NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.gongs_up_jusu,0) - NVL(gongs_dw_jusu,0) > 0
               AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
               AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
               AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
             ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                    , t1.jm_cd
        ) loop
            if  w_rt > 0    then
                w_up_jusu := ra.jusu * w_rt;
                w_dw_jusu := 0;
            else
                w_dw_jusu := ra.jusu * - w_rt;
                w_up_jusu := 0;
            end if;

            UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
               SET GONGS_UP_JUSU = NVL(gongs_up_jusu,0) + w_up_jusu
                 , GONGS_DW_JUSU = NVL(gongs_dw_jusu,0) + w_dw_jusu
             WHERE CORP_GR     = p_corp_gr
               AND FUND_CD     = ra.fund_cd
               AND JM_CD       = ra.jm_cd
               AND YMD         = p_ymd
               AND TYPE_TRENCH = ra.type_trench
               AND BS_TYPE     = ra.bs_type;

            INSERT INTO SJT0H1 tt   /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
                 ( CORP_GR      /* _1- */
                 , TR_YMD       /* _2- */
                 , TR_CD        /* _3- */
                 , HAB_CO       /* _4- */
                 , PI_HAB_CO    /* _5- */
                 , FUND_CD      /* _6- */
                 , OLD_JM_CD    /* _7- */
                 , NEW_JM_CD    /* _8- */
                 , BOYU_JUSU    /* _9- */
                 , HAB_PER      /* _10- */
                 , HAB_JUSU     /* _11- */
                 , TYPE_TRENCH  /* _12- */
                 , BS_TYPE      /* _13- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr              /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                  /* _2- */
                   , 'G92'                  /* _3- */
                   , xx.hab_co              /* _4- */
                   , xx.hab_co              /* _5- */
