                   , ra.fund_cd             /* _6- */
                   , ra.jm_cd               /* _7- */
                   , ra.jm_cd               /* _8- */
                   , ra.jusu                /* _9- */
                   , w_rt * 100             /* _10- */
                   , w_up_jusu - w_dw_jusu  /* _11- */
                   , ra.type_trench         /* _12- */
                   , ra.bs_type             /* _13- */
                   );
        end loop;
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';

    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC031A (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_krak_ymd                     IN    DATE,     /* 권리락일 */
    p_balh_co                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 발행기관 */
    p_jeungj_mth                   IN    VARCHAR,  /* 증자방법 */
    p_baej_mth                     IN    VARCHAR,  /* 배정방법 */
    p_balh_ga                      IN    NUMBER,   /* 발행가 */
    p_baed_gisan_ymd               IN    DATE,
    p_jukm_nabib_ymd               IN    DATE,     /* 주금납입일 */
    p_balh_jusu1                   IN    NUMBER,   /* 보통주발행주수 */
    p_balh_jusu2                   IN    NUMBER,   /* 우선주발행주수 */
    p_jm_cd1                       OUT   VARCHAR,  /* 신주종목코드 */
    p_jm_cd2                       OUT   VARCHAR,  /* 신주종목코드 */
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 권리락 회계처리 - 신주종목생성
--
    w_jm_cd                        sjm0jj.jm_cd%type;
    w_koscom_cd                    sjm0jj.koscom_cd%type;
    w_balh_nm                      sjm0jj.jj_nm%type;
    w_jj_nm                        sjm0jj.jj_nm%type;
    w_nm                           sjm0jj.jj_nm%type;
    w_jj_enm                       sjm0jj.jj_enm%type;
    w_woos_ilban_gb                sjm0jj.woos_ilban_gb%type;
    w_danc_gb                      sjm0jj.danc_gb%type;
    w_upj_cd                       sjm0jj.upj_cd%type;
    w_sangj_jusu                   sjm0jj.sangj_jusu%type;
    w_capsize                      sjm0jj.capsize%type;
    w_kospigubun                   sjm0jj.kospigubun%type;
    w_digit                        VARCHAR(1);
    w_kweonri_ymd                  DATE;
    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -- 발행기관명
    BEGIN
        SELECT balh_nm
          INTO w_balh_nm
          FROM SJX0JB t1  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE t1.balh_co = p_balh_co;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := p_balh_co || '-해당 발행기관이 없습니다.';
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- 권리발생일
    if  p_jeungj_mth = '1'  then    -- 유상증자
        w_danc_gb     := 'T';
        w_nm          := '(유상/';
        w_kweonri_ymd := p_jukm_nabib_ymd;
    else                            /* 무상증자 */
        w_danc_gb := 'U';
        w_nm      := '(무상/';
    end if;

    -- 신주종목코드 생성(보통주)
    if  SUBSTR (p_baej_mth, 2, 1) IN ('1','3')      then
        w_jj_nm      := w_balh_nm || w_nm || '보)';  /* 종목명 */
        w_sangj_jusu := p_balh_jusu1;                /* 발행주수 */

        -- Koscom 코드 , 업종
        BEGIN
            SELECT koscom_cd   /* _1- */
                 , jj_enm      /* _2- */
                 , upj_cd      /* _3- */
                 , capsize     /* _4- */
                 , kospigubun  /* _5- */
              INTO w_koscom_cd   /* _1- */
                 , w_jj_enm      /* _2- */
                 , w_upj_cd      /* _3- */
                 , w_capsize     /* _4- */
                 , w_kospigubun  /* _5- */
              FROM SJM0JJ t1     /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE t1.jm_cd = (SELECT jm_cd
                                 FROM SJM0JJ ta  /* 주식종목 */
                                WHERE ta.balh_co       = p_balh_co
                                  AND ta.woos_ilban_gb = '0'
                                  AND ROWNUM = 1);
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := p_balh_co || '-신주종목코드(보)을 생성할 수 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        -- 유무상신주 코드 조합
        w_jm_cd := 'KR' || w_danc_gb || p_balh_co || '000';
        SR_CLCDGT (w_jm_cd, w_digit, w_msg);
        w_jm_cd  := w_jm_cd || w_digit;
        p_jm_cd1 := w_jm_cd;

        MERGE INTO SJM0JJ tt  /* 주식종목 */
           USING DUAL  ON ( jm_cd = w_jm_cd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET jj_nm           = w_jj_nm
                  , jj_fnm          = w_jj_nm
                  , jj_enm          = w_jj_enm
                  , kweonri_ymd     = w_kweonri_ymd
                  , created_ymd     = p_krak_ymd
                  , baed_gisan_ymd  = p_baed_gisan_ymd
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT ( jm_cd           /* _1- */
                    , koscom_cd       /* _2- */
                    , jj_fnm          /* _3- */
                    , jj_nm           /* _4- */
                    , jj_enm          /* _5- */
                    , balh_co         /* _6- */
                    , woos_ilban_gb   /* _7- */
                    , chg_gb          /* _8- */
                    , new_old_gb      /* _9- */
                    , danc_gb         /* _10- */
                    , balh_ga         /* _11- */
                    , kweonri_ymd     /* _12- */
                    , upj_cd          /* _13- */
                    , sangj_jusu      /* _14- */
                    , del_yn          /* _15- */
                    , created_ymd     /* _16- */
                    , capsize         /* _17- */
                    , kospigubun      /* _18- */
                    , baed_gisan_ymd  /* _19- */
                    )
             VALUES ( w_jm_cd           /* _1- */
                    , w_koscom_cd       /* _2- */
                    , w_jj_nm           /* _3- */
                    , w_jj_nm           /* _4- */
                    , w_jj_enm          /* _5- */
                    , p_balh_co         /* _6- */
                    , '0'               /* _7- */
                    , '0'               /* _8- */
                    , '0'               /* _9- */
                    , w_danc_gb         /* _10- */
                    , p_balh_ga         /* _11- */
                    , w_kweonri_ymd     /* _12- */
                    , w_upj_cd          /* _13- */
                    , w_sangj_jusu      /* _14- */
                    , NULL              /* _15- */
                    , p_krak_ymd        /* _16- */
                    , w_capsize         /* _17- */
                    , w_kospigubun      /* _18- */
                    , p_baed_gisan_ymd  /* _19- */
                    );
    end if;

    -- 신주종목코드 생성(우선주)
    if  SUBSTR (p_baej_mth, 2, 1) IN ('2','3')      then
        w_jj_nm      := w_balh_nm || w_nm || '우)';  /* 종목명 */
        w_sangj_jusu := p_balh_jusu2;                /* 발행주수 */

        -- Koscom 코드 , 업종
        BEGIN
            SELECT koscom_cd   /* _1- */
                 , jj_enm      /* _2- */
                 , upj_cd      /* _3- */
                 , capsize     /* _4- */
                 , kospigubun  /* _5- */
              INTO w_koscom_cd   /* _1- */
                 , w_jj_enm      /* _2- */
                 , w_upj_cd      /* _3- */
                 , w_capsize     /* _4- */
                 , w_kospigubun  /* _5- */
              FROM SJM0JJ t1     /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE t1.jm_cd = (SELECT jm_cd
                                 FROM SJM0JJ ta  /* 주식종목 */
                                WHERE ta.balh_co       = p_balh_co
                                  AND ta.woos_ilban_gb > '0'
                                  AND ROWNUM = 1);
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := p_balh_co || '-신주종목코드(우)을 생성할 수 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        -- 유무상신주 코드 조합
        w_jm_cd := 'KR' || w_danc_gb || p_balh_co || '100';
        SR_CLCDGT (w_jm_cd, w_digit, w_msg);
        w_jm_cd  := w_jm_cd || w_digit;
        p_jm_cd2 := w_jm_cd;

        MERGE INTO SJM0JJ tt  /* 주식종목 */
           USING DUAL  ON ( jm_cd = w_jm_cd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET jj_nm           = w_jj_nm
                  , jj_fnm          = w_jj_nm
                  , jj_enm          = w_jj_enm
                  , kweonri_ymd     = w_kweonri_ymd
                  , created_ymd     = p_krak_ymd
                  , baed_gisan_ymd  = p_baed_gisan_ymd
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT ( jm_cd           /* _1- */
                    , koscom_cd       /* _2- */
                    , jj_fnm          /* _3- */
                    , jj_nm           /* _4- */
                    , jj_enm          /* _5- */
                    , balh_co         /* _6- */
                    , woos_ilban_gb   /* _7- */
                    , chg_gb          /* _8- */
                    , new_old_gb      /* _9- */
                    , danc_gb         /* _10- */
                    , balh_ga         /* _11- */
                    , kweonri_ymd     /* _12- */
                    , upj_cd          /* _13- */
                    , sangj_jusu      /* _14- */
                    , del_yn          /* _15- */
                    , created_ymd     /* _16- */
                    , capsize         /* _17- */
                    , kospigubun      /* _18- */
                    , baed_gisan_ymd  /* _19- */
                    )
             VALUES ( w_jm_cd           /* _1- */
                    , w_koscom_cd       /* _2- */
                    , w_jj_nm           /* _3- */
                    , w_jj_nm           /* _4- */
                    , w_jj_enm          /* _5- */
                    , p_balh_co         /* _6- */
                    , '1'               /* _7- */
                    , '0'               /* _8- */
                    , '0'               /* _9- */
                    , w_danc_gb         /* _10- */
                    , p_balh_ga         /* _11- */
                    , w_kweonri_ymd     /* _12- */
                    , w_upj_cd          /* _13- */
                    , w_sangj_jusu      /* _14- */
                    , NULL              /* _15- */
                    , p_krak_ymd        /* _16- */
                    , w_capsize         /* _17- */
                    , w_kospigubun      /* _18- */
                    , p_baed_gisan_ymd  /* _19- */
                    );
    end if;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC031B (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,     /* 생성일 */
    p_krak_ymd                     IN    DATE,     /* 권리락일 */
    p_balh_co                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 발행기관 */
    p_jeungj_mth                   IN    VARCHAR,  /* 증자방법 */
    p_baej_mth                     IN    VARCHAR,  /* 배정방법 */
    p_balh_ga                      IN    NUMBER,   /* 발행가 */
    p_woos_balh_ga                 IN    NUMBER,   /* 발행가(우선주) */
    p_jekyng_rt                    IN    NUMBER,   /* 적용비율 */
    p_woos_jekyng_rt               IN    NUMBER,   /* 적용비율(우선주) */
    p_jm_cd1                       IN    VARCHAR,  /* 신주종목코드 */
    p_jm_cd2                       IN    VARCHAR,  /* 신주종목코드 */
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 권리락 - 증자대장 생성
--
    w_jm_cd                        sjm0jj.jm_cd%type;
    w_fr_woos_ilban_gb             sjm0jm.woos_ilban_gb%type;
    w_to_woos_ilban_gb             sjm0jm.woos_ilban_gb%type;

    w_baej_jusu                    NUMBER;
    w_chui_aek                     NUMBER;
    w_balh_ga                      NUMBER;
    w_jekyng_rt                    NUMBER;

    w_fund_cd                      szm0ia.fund_cd%type;

    w_juchong_ymd                  DATE;
BEGIN
    if  SUBSTR (p_baej_mth,1,1) = '1'     then  -- 보통주
        w_fr_woos_ilban_gb := '0';
        w_to_woos_ilban_gb := '0';

    elsif SUBSTR (p_baej_mth,1,1) = '2'   then  -- 우선주
        w_fr_woos_ilban_gb := '1';
        w_to_woos_ilban_gb := 'Z';
    else                                        /* 혼합 */
        w_fr_woos_ilban_gb := '0';
        w_to_woos_ilban_gb := 'Z';
    end if;

    -- 주식 MASTER Select
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                              /* _1- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                /* _2- */
             , t1.woos_ilban_gb                        /* _3- */
             , t1.type_trench                          /* _4- */
             , t1.bs_type                              /* _5- */
             , jj.kweonri_ymd                          /* _6- */
             , jj.balh_co                              /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0)  AS boyu_jusu  /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0)   AS chui_aek   /* _9- */
             , j1.baej_jusu                            /* _10- */
             , j1.upd_user                             /* _11- */
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SJT0J1_IN j1
                       ON j1.corp_gr   = t1.CORP_GR
                      AND j1.fund_cd   = t1.FUND_CD
                      AND j1.old_jm_cd = t1.jm_cd
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJM0JJ jj  /* 주식종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                   = p_krak_ymd
           AND t1.balh_co               = p_balh_co
           AND t1.woos_ilban_gb         BETWEEN w_fr_woos_ilban_gb AND w_to_woos_ilban_gb
           AND NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
           AND jj.jm_cd                 = t1.jm_cd
           AND jj.danc_gb               != 'Y'
    ) loop
        if  xx.boyu_jusu < 0    then
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || ' (' || xx.jm_cd || ') 차입주식입니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;
        -- 배당주식의 경우 주총 전이면 보유수량에서 제외 20050207, yjs
        if  xx.jm_cd LIKE 'KRY%'    then
            BEGIN
                SELECT juchong_ymd
                  INTO w_juchong_ymd
                  FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd         = xx.kweonri_ymd
                   AND t1.balh_co     = xx.balh_co
                   AND t1.new_jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
                   AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type;

                if NVL (w_juchong_ymd, p_krak_ymd + 1) >= p_krak_ymd then
                    CONTINUE;
                end if;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                NULL;
            END;
        end if;

        if (p_baej_mth='33') AND (xx.woos_ilban_gb != '0')  then    -- 우선주 유형별 분류요 yjs 19991203
            w_balh_ga   := p_woos_balh_ga;
            w_jekyng_rt := p_woos_jekyng_rt;
        else
            w_balh_ga   := p_balh_ga;
            w_jekyng_rt := p_jekyng_rt;
        end if;
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 배정주수 = 권리락시 보유주수 * 배정비율
        --
        -- 취득액       유상; 배정주수 * 발행가
        --              무상; 신주수 / (구주수 + 신주수) * 구주취득가
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        w_baej_jusu := TRUNC (xx.boyu_jusu * w_jekyng_rt);
        BEGIN
            if  p_jeungj_mth = '1'  then
                    w_chui_aek := w_baej_jusu * w_balh_ga;
            else    w_chui_aek := ROUND (w_baej_jusu / (xx.boyu_jusu + w_baej_jusu) * xx.chui_aek);
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_chui_aek := 0;
        END;

        if  xx.woos_ilban_gb = '0'  then
                w_jm_cd := p_jm_cd1;
        else    w_jm_cd := p_jm_cd2;
        end if;

        if  SUBSTR (p_baej_mth,2,1) = '1'     then  w_jm_cd := p_jm_cd1;  -- 보통주
        elsif SUBSTR (p_baej_mth,2,1) = '2'   then  w_jm_cd := p_jm_cd2;  -- 우선주
        end if;

        -- 증자대장 생성
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SJT0J1 tt   /* 증자대장 */
                 ( corp_gr          /* _1- */
                 , ymd              /* _2-생성일 */
                 , balh_co          /* _3-발행기관 */
                 , jeungj_mth       /* _4-증자방법 */
                 , fund_cd          /* _5-펀드코드 */
                 , old_jm_cd        /* _6-구주종목코드 */
                 , new_jm_cd        /* _7-신주종목코드 */
                 , krak_jusu        /* _8-권리락주수 */
                 , krak_chui_aek    /* _9-권리락취득액 */
                 , baej_jusu        /* _10-배정주수  (최종) */
                 , baej_rt          /* _11-배정비율  (최종) */
                 , balh_ga          /* _12-발행가    (최종) */
                 , chui_aek         /* _13-취득액    (최종) */
                 , gosi_jekyng_ymd  /* _14-공시적용일(최종) */
                 , chg_bf_jusu      /* _15-배정주수  (변경전) */
                 , chg_bf_rt        /* _16-배정비율  (변경전) */
                 , chg_bf_balh_ga   /* _17-발행가    (변경전) */
                 , chg_chui_aek     /* _18-취득액    (변경전) */
                 , chg_bf_ymd       /* _19-공시적용일(변경전) */
                 , type_trench      /* _20- */
                 , bs_type          /* _21- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
                   , p_krak_ymd      /* _2-권리락일 */
                   , p_balh_co       /* _3-발행기관 */
                   , p_jeungj_mth    /* _4-증자방법 */
                   , xx.fund_cd      /* _5-펀드코드 */
                   , xx.jm_cd        /* _6-구주종목코드 */
                   , w_jm_cd         /* _7-신주종목코드 */
                   , xx.boyu_jusu    /* _8-권리락주수 */
                   , xx.chui_aek     /* _9-권리락취득액 */
                   , w_baej_jusu     /* _10-배정주수  (최종) */
                   , w_jekyng_rt     /* _11-배정비율  (최종) */
                   , w_balh_ga       /* _12-발행가    (최종) */
                   , w_chui_aek      /* _13-취득액    (최종) */
                   , p_ymd           /* _14-공시적용일(최종) */
                   , w_baej_jusu     /* _15-배정주수  (변경전) */
                   , w_jekyng_rt     /* _16-배정비율  (변경전) */
                   , w_balh_ga       /* _17-발행가    (변경전) */
                   , w_chui_aek      /* _18-취득액    (변경전) */
                   , p_ymd           /* _19-공시적용일(변경전) */
                   , xx.type_trench  /* _20- */
                   , xx.bs_type      /* _21- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := p_balh_co || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-증자대장을 생성할수 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC031C (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,     /* 생성일 */
    p_krak_ymd                     IN    DATE,     /* 권리락일 */
    p_balh_co                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 발행기관 */
    p_jeungj_mth                   IN    VARCHAR,  /* 증자방법 */
    p_baej_mth                     IN    VARCHAR,  /* 배정방법 */
    p_balh_ga                      IN    NUMBER,   /* 발행가 */
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 권리락 회계처리 -- 주식마스터 생성 ( 신주 )
--
BEGIN
    -- 증자대장 Select
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                       /* _1- */
             , t1.new_jm_cd                     /* _2- */
             , t1.type_trench                   /* _3- */
             , t1.bs_type                       /* _4- */
             , SUM(t1.baej_jusu)  AS baej_jusu  /* _5- */
             , SUM(t1.chui_aek)   AS chui_aek   /* _6- */
          FROM SJT0J1 t1  /* 증자대장 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                   = p_krak_ymd
           AND t1.balh_co               = p_balh_co
           AND t1.jeungj_mth            = p_jeungj_mth
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, t1.new_jm_cd, t1.type_trench, t1.bs_type
    ) loop
        MERGE INTO SJM0JM tt  /* 주식 보유현황 */
           USING ( SELECT balh_co        /* _1- */
                        , woos_ilban_gb  /* _2- */
                        , chg_gb         /* _3- */
                        , new_old_gb     /* _4- */
                        , danc_gb        /* _5- */
                        , koscom_cd      /* _6- */
                     FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
                    WHERE jm_cd = xx.new_jm_cd ) ut 
              ON ( corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd       = xx.new_jm_cd
               AND ymd         = p_ymd
               AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET gongs_up_jusu     = NVL(gongs_up_jusu,0) + xx.baej_jusu
                  , gongs_up_chui_aek = NVL(gongs_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.chui_aek
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT ( corp_gr            /* _1- */
                    , ymd                /* _2- */
                    , fund_cd            /* _3- */
                    , jm_cd              /* _4- */
                    , gongs_up_jusu      /* _5- */
                    , gongs_up_chui_aek  /* _6- */
                    , balh_co            /* _7- */
                    , woos_ilban_gb      /* _8- */
                    , chg_gb             /* _9- */
                    , new_old_gb         /* _10- */
                    , danc_gb            /* _11- */
                    , koscom_cd          /* _12- */
                    , type_trench        /* _13- */
                    , bs_type            /* _14- */
                    )
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd        /* _3- */
                    , xx.new_jm_cd      /* _4- */
                    , xx.baej_jusu      /* _5- */
                    , xx.chui_aek       /* _6- */
                    , ut.balh_co        /* _7- */
                    , ut.woos_ilban_gb  /* _8- */
                    , ut.chg_gb         /* _9- */
                    , ut.new_old_gb     /* _10- */
                    , ut.danc_gb        /* _11- */
                    , ut.koscom_cd      /* _12- */
                    , xx.type_trench    /* _13- */
                    , xx.bs_type        /* _14- */
                    );
    end loop;
    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC031D (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,     /* 공시적용일 */
    p_krak_ymd                     IN    DATE,     /* 권리락일 */
    p_balh_co                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 발행기관 */
    p_jeungj_mth                   IN    VARCHAR,  /* 증자방법 */
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 권리락일 회계처리 - 구주 취득가 감소
--
    w_com_jusu                     NUMBER;
    w_jan_jusu                     NUMBER;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    -- 증자대장 Select
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                      /* _1- */
             , t1.old_jm_cd                    /* _2- */
             , t1.type_trench                  /* _3- */
             , t1.bs_type                      /* _4- */
             , SUM(t1.baej_jusu)  AS jusu      /* _5- */
             , SUM(t1.chui_aek)   AS chui_aek  /* _6- */
          FROM SJT0J1 t1  /* 증자대장 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd
           AND t1.balh_co               = p_balh_co
           AND t1.jeungj_mth            = p_jeungj_mth
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, t1.old_jm_cd, t1.type_trench, t1.bs_type
    ) loop
        -- 주식마스터 갱신 ( 당일취득액감소 + )
        UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
           SET gongs_dw_chui_aek = xx.chui_aek
         WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd       = xx.old_jm_cd
           AND ymd         = p_ymd
           AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
           AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.old_jm_cd || ' - 구주 취득액 변경을 할 수 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC031E (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_krak_ymd                     IN    DATE,     /* 권리락일 */
    p_balh_co                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 발행기관 */
    p_jeungj_mth                   IN    VARCHAR,  /* 증자방법 */
    p_baej_mth                     IN    VARCHAR,  /* 배정방법 */
    p_jekyng_rt                    IN    NUMBER,   /* 적용비율 */
    p_woos_jekyng_rt               IN    NUMBER,   /* 적용비율(우선주) */
    p_balh_ga                      IN    NUMBER,   /* 발행가 */
    p_woos_balh_ga                 IN    NUMBER,   /* 발행가(우선주) */
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE      /* 공시적용일 */
 ) AS
-- 비율/발행가변경변경 회계처리 -- 증자대장1변경
--
    w_baej_jusu                    NUMBER;
    w_balh_ga                      NUMBER;
    w_chui_aek                     NUMBER;
    w_jekyng_rt                    NUMBER;
BEGIN
    -- 증자대장 Select
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd        /* _1- */
             , t1.old_jm_cd      /* _2- */
             , t1.new_jm_cd      /* _3- */
             , t1.krak_jusu      /* _4- */
             , t1.krak_chui_aek  /* _5- */
             , t1.chui_aek       /* _6- */
             , t2.woos_ilban_gb  /* _7- */
             , t3.type_gb        /* _8- */
             , t1.rowid          /* _9- */
          FROM SJT0J1 t1  /* 증자대장 */
             , SJM0JJ t2  /* 주식종목 */
             , SZM0IA t3  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                      = p_krak_ymd
           AND t1.balh_co                  = p_balh_co
           AND NVL(t1.sury_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND t1.jeungj_mth               = p_jeungj_mth
           AND t2.jm_cd                    = t1.old_jm_cd
           AND t3.corp_gr                  = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.fund_cd                  = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t3.haeji_ymd, p_ymd)    >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        if (p_baej_mth='33') AND (xx.woos_ilban_gb != '0')  then    -- 우선주 종류별 처리로 변경요 yjs 19991203
            w_balh_ga   := p_woos_balh_ga;
            w_jekyng_rt := p_woos_jekyng_rt;
        else
            w_balh_ga   := p_balh_ga;
            w_jekyng_rt := p_jekyng_rt;
        end if;
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 배정주수 = 권리락시 보유주수 * 배정비율
        --
        -- 취득액       유상; 배정주수 * 발행가
        --              무상; 신주수 / ( 구주수+신주수) * 구주취득가
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        w_baej_jusu := TRUNC (xx.krak_jusu * w_jekyng_rt);
        if  p_jeungj_mth = '1'  then
                w_chui_aek := w_baej_jusu * w_balh_ga;
        else    w_chui_aek := xx.chui_aek;
        end if;
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        --      발행가변경
        --      신주종목
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        if  p_jeungj_mth = '1'  then
            UPDATE SJM0JJ tt    /* 주식종목 */
               SET balh_ga = w_balh_ga
             WHERE jm_cd = xx.new_jm_cd;
        end if;
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 증자대장 Update
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE SJT0J1 tt    /* 증자대장 */
           SET chg_bf_jusu     = baej_jusu
             , chg_bf_rt       = baej_rt
             , chg_bf_balh_ga  = balh_ga
             , chg_chui_aek    = chui_aek
             , chg_bf_ymd      = gosi_jekyng_ymd
             , baej_jusu       = w_baej_jusu
             , baej_rt         = w_jekyng_rt
             , balh_ga         = w_balh_ga
             , chui_aek        = w_chui_aek
             , gosi_jekyng_ymd = p_ymd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC031F (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,     /* 공시적용일 */
    p_krak_ymd                     IN    DATE,     /* 권리락일 */
    p_balh_co                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 발행기관 */
    p_jeungj_mth                   IN    VARCHAR,  /* 증자방법 */
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 비율/발행가변경 회계처리 -- 주식마스터 생성 ( 신주 )
--
    w_up_jusu                      NUMBER;
    w_up_chui_aek                  NUMBER;
    w_dw_jusu                      NUMBER;
    w_dw_chui_aek                  NUMBER;

    jm_balh_co                     sjm0jm.balh_co%type;
    jm_woos_ilban_gb               sjm0jm.woos_ilban_gb%type;
    jm_chg_gb                      sjm0jm.chg_gb%type;
    jm_new_old_gb                  sjm0jm.new_old_gb%type;
    jm_danc_gb                     sjm0jm.danc_gb%type;
    jm_koscom_cd                   sjm0jm.koscom_cd%type;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    -- 증자대장 Select
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                            /* _1- */
             , t1.new_jm_cd                                                          /* _2- */
             , t1.type_trench                                                        /* _3- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                            /* _4- */
             , t2.type_gb                                                            /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.baej_jusu), 0) - NVL(SUM(t1.chg_bf_jusu), 0)  AS jusu_gap  /* _6- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.chui_aek), 0) - NVL(SUM(t1.chg_chui_aek), 0)  AS aek_gap   /* _7- */
          FROM SJT0J1 t1  /* 증자대장 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                      = p_krak_ymd
           AND t1.balh_co                  = p_balh_co
           AND NVL(t1.sury_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND t1.jeungj_mth               = p_jeungj_mth
           AND t2.corp_gr                  = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd                  = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd)    >= p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, t1.new_jm_cd, t2.type_gb, t1.type_trench, t1.bs_type
    ) loop
        if (xx.jusu_gap=0) AND (xx.aek_gap=0)   then
            NULL;
        else
            if  xx.jusu_gap > 0 then
                w_up_jusu := xx.jusu_gap;
                w_dw_jusu := 0;
            else
                w_up_jusu := 0;
                w_dw_jusu := xx.jusu_gap * -1;
            end if;

            if  xx.aek_gap > 0  then
                w_up_chui_aek := xx.aek_gap;
                w_dw_chui_aek := 0;
            else
                w_up_chui_aek := 0;
                w_dw_chui_aek := xx.aek_gap * -1;
            end if;

            UPDATE SJM0JM ff    /* 주식 보유현황 */
               SET gongs_up_jusu     = NVL(gongs_up_jusu,0) + w_up_jusu
                 , gongs_up_chui_aek = NVL(gongs_up_chui_aek,0) + w_up_chui_aek
                 , gongs_dw_jusu     = NVL(gongs_dw_jusu,0) + w_dw_jusu
                 , gongs_dw_chui_aek = NVL(gongs_dw_chui_aek,0) + w_dw_chui_aek
             WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd       = xx.new_jm_cd
               AND ymd         = p_ymd
               AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
                -- 주식종목사항 가져오기
                SR_GETJJ2 (xx.new_jm_cd, jm_balh_co, jm_woos_ilban_gb, jm_chg_gb, jm_new_old_gb, jm_danc_gb, jm_koscom_cd, w_msg);
                if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                    p_msg := xx.new_jm_cd || '-' || w_msg;
                    RETURN;
                end if;
                INSERT INTO SJM0JM ff   /* 주식 보유현황 */
                     ( corp_gr            /* _1- */
                     , ymd                /* _2- */
                     , fund_cd            /* _3- */
                     , jm_cd              /* _4- */
                     , balh_co            /* _5- */
                     , woos_ilban_gb      /* _6- */
                     , chg_gb             /* _7- */
                     , new_old_gb         /* _8- */
                     , danc_gb            /* _9- */
                     , koscom_cd          /* _10- */
                     , gongs_up_jusu      /* _11- */
                     , gongs_up_chui_aek  /* _12- */
                     , gongs_dw_jusu      /* _13- */
                     , gongs_dw_chui_aek  /* _14- */
                     , type_trench        /* _15- */
                     , bs_type            /* _16- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                       , xx.fund_cd        /* _3- */
                       , xx.new_jm_cd      /* _4- */
                       , jm_balh_co        /* _5- */
                       , jm_woos_ilban_gb  /* _6- */
                       , jm_chg_gb         /* _7- */
                       , jm_new_old_gb     /* _8- */
                       , jm_danc_gb        /* _9- */
                       , jm_koscom_cd      /* _10- */
                       , w_up_jusu         /* _11- */
                       , w_up_chui_aek     /* _12- */
                       , w_dw_jusu         /* _13- */
                       , w_dw_chui_aek     /* _14- */
                       , xx.type_trench    /* _15- */
                       , xx.bs_type        /* _16- */
                       );
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC031G (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,     /* 공시적용일 */
    p_balh_co                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 발행기관 */
    p_baej_mth                     IN    VARCHAR,  /* 배정방법 */
    p_juchong_ymd                  IN    DATE,     /* 주총일 */
    p_jm_cd1                       OUT   VARCHAR,  /* 신주종목코드 */
    p_jm_cd2                       OUT   VARCHAR,  /* 신주종목코드 */
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 배당신주종목코드 생성
--
    w_jm_cd                        sjm0jj.jm_cd%type;
    w_koscom_cd                    sjm0jj.koscom_cd%type;
    w_balh_nm                      sjx0jb.balh_nm%type;
    w_jj_nm                        sjm0jj.jj_nm%type;
    w_jj_enm                       sjm0jj.jj_enm%type;
    w_upj_cd                       sjm0jj.upj_cd%type;
    w_capsize                      sjm0jj.capsize%type;
    w_kospigubun                   sjm0jj.kospigubun%type;
    w_digit                        VARCHAR(1);
    w_check                        NUMBER;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -- 발행기관명
    BEGIN
        SELECT SUBSTRB(balh_nm, 1, 30)
          INTO w_balh_nm
          FROM SJX0JB t1  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE t1.balh_co = p_balh_co;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := p_balh_co || '-해당 발행기관이 없습니다.';
        RETURN;
    END;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', '', 'PROC031G 실행 - 신규종목코드(보통주) : ' || w_jj_nm);

    -- 신주종목코드(보통주) 생성
    if  SUBSTR (p_baej_mth, 1, 1) IN ('1','3')      then
        w_jj_nm := rtrim (w_balh_nm) || '(배당/보)';  /* 종목명 */
        BEGIN       /* Koscom 코드, 업종 */
            SELECT koscom_cd   /* _1- */
                 , jj_enm      /* _2- */
                 , upj_cd      /* _3- */
                 , capsize     /* _4- */
                 , kospigubun  /* _5- */
              INTO w_koscom_cd   /* _1- */
                 , w_jj_enm      /* _2- */
                 , w_upj_cd      /* _3- */
                 , w_capsize     /* _4- */
                 , w_kospigubun  /* _5- */
              FROM SJM0JJ t1     /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE t1.jm_cd = (SELECT MIN(jm_cd)
                                 FROM SJM0JJ ta  /* 주식종목 */
                                WHERE ta.balh_co       = p_balh_co
                                  AND ta.woos_ilban_gb = '0');
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            SELECT COUNT(*)
              INTO w_check
              FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.balh_co = p_balh_co
               AND t1.danc_gb <> 'B';
            if  w_check > 0 then
                    p_msg := p_balh_co || '-신주종목코드(보)을 생성할 수 없습니다.';
            else    p_msg := 'Y';
            end if;
            RETURN;
        END;

        -- 배당신주 코드 조합
        w_jm_cd := 'KRY' || p_balh_co || '000';
        SR_CLCDGT (w_jm_cd, w_digit, w_msg);
        w_jm_cd  := w_jm_cd || w_digit;
        p_jm_cd1 := w_jm_cd;

        MERGE INTO SJM0JJ tt  /* 주식종목 */
           USING DUAL ON ( jm_cd = w_jm_cd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET jj_fnm       = w_jj_nm
                  , jj_nm        = w_jj_nm
                  , jj_enm       = w_jj_enm
                  , kweonri_ymd  = p_juchong_ymd
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT ( jm_cd          /* _1- */
                    , koscom_cd      /* _2- */
                    , jj_fnm         /* _3- */
                    , jj_nm          /* _4- */
                    , jj_enm         /* _5- */
                    , balh_co        /* _6- */
                    , woos_ilban_gb  /* _7- */
                    , chg_gb         /* _8- */
                    , new_old_gb     /* _9- */
                    , danc_gb        /* _10- */
                    , balh_ga        /* _11- */
                    , kweonri_ymd    /* _12- */
                    , upj_cd         /* _13- */
                    , created_ymd    /* _14- */
                    , capsize        /* _15- */
                    , kospigubun     /* _16- */
                    )
             VALUES ( w_jm_cd        /* _1- */
                    , w_koscom_cd    /* _2- */
                    , w_jj_nm        /* _3- */
                    , w_jj_nm        /* _4- */
                    , w_jj_enm       /* _5- */
                    , p_balh_co      /* _6- */
                    , '0'            /* _7- */
                    , '0'            /* _8- */
                    , '0'            /* _9- */
                    , 'Y'            /* _10- */
                    , 0              /* _11- */
                    , p_juchong_ymd  /* _12- */
                    , w_upj_cd       /* _13- */
                    , p_ymd          /* _14- */
                    , w_capsize      /* _15- */
                    , w_kospigubun   /* _16- */
                    );
    end if;

    -- 신주종목코드(우선주) 생성
    if  SUBSTR (p_baej_mth, 1, 1) IN ('2','3')      then
        w_jj_nm := rtrim(w_balh_nm) || '(배당/우)';  /* 종목명 */
        BEGIN       /* Koscom코드, 업종 */
            SELECT koscom_cd   /* _1- */
                 , jj_enm      /* _2- */
                 , upj_cd      /* _3- */
                 , capsize     /* _4- */
                 , kospigubun  /* _5- */
              INTO w_koscom_cd   /* _1- */
                 , w_jj_enm      /* _2- */
                 , w_upj_cd      /* _3- */
                 , w_capsize     /* _4- */
                 , w_kospigubun  /* _5- */
              FROM SJM0JJ t1     /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE t1.jm_cd = (SELECT MIN(jm_cd)
                                 FROM SJM0JJ ta  /* 주식종목 */
                                WHERE ta.balh_co       = p_balh_co
                                  AND ta.woos_ilban_gb > '0');
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := p_balh_co || '-신주종목코드(우)을 생성할 수 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        -- 배당신주 코드 조합
        w_jm_cd := 'KRY' || p_balh_co || '100';
        SR_CLCDGT (w_jm_cd, w_digit, w_msg);
        w_jm_cd  := w_jm_cd || w_digit;
        p_jm_cd2 := w_jm_cd;

        MERGE INTO SJM0JJ tt  /* 주식종목 */
           USING DUAL ON ( jm_cd = w_jm_cd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET jj_fnm       = w_jj_nm
                  , jj_nm        = w_jj_nm
                  , jj_enm       = w_jj_enm
                  , kweonri_ymd  = p_juchong_ymd
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT ( jm_cd          /* _1-종목코드 */
                    , koscom_cd      /* _2-KOSCOM 코드 */
                    , jj_fnm         /* _3-종목전칭 */
                    , jj_nm          /* _4-종목약칭 */
                    , jj_enm         /* _5-영문약칭 */
                    , balh_co        /* _6-발행기관 */
                    , woos_ilban_gb  /* _7-주권종류 */
                    , chg_gb         /* _8-전환종류 */
                    , new_old_gb     /* _9-신구주구분 */
                    , danc_gb        /* _10-단축식별 */
                    , balh_ga        /* _11-발행가 */
                    , kweonri_ymd    /* _12-권리발생일 */
                    , upj_cd         /* _13-업종코드 */
                    , created_ymd    /* _14- */
                    , capsize        /* _15- */
                    , kospigubun     /* _16-신주생성일 */
                    )
             VALUES ( w_jm_cd        /* _1- */
                    , w_koscom_cd    /* _2- */
                    , w_jj_nm        /* _3- */
                    , w_jj_nm        /* _4- */
                    , w_jj_enm       /* _5- */
                    , p_balh_co      /* _6- */
                    , '1'            /* _7- */
                    , '0'            /* _8- */
                    , '0'            /* _9- */
                    , 'Y'            /* _10- */
                    , 0              /* _11- */
                    , p_juchong_ymd  /* _12- */
                    , w_upj_cd       /* _13- */
                    , p_ymd          /* _14- */
                    , w_capsize      /* _15- */
                    , w_kospigubun   /* _16- */
                    );
    end if;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    commit;
    p_msg := 'PROC031G:' || p_balh_co || ':' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC031H (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_balh_co                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 발행기관 */
    p_baed_mth                     IN    VARCHAR,  /* 배당방법 */
    p_baej_mth                     IN    VARCHAR,  /* 배정방법 */
    p_cash_ilban_rt                IN    NUMBER,   /* 보통주배당율(현금) */
    p_cash_woos_rt                 IN    NUMBER,   /* 우선주배당율(현금) */
    p_ilban_aek                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_woos_aek                     IN    NUMBER,
    p_stock_ilban_rt               IN    NUMBER,   /* 보통주배당율(주식) */
    p_stock_woos_rt                IN    NUMBER,   /* 우선주배당율(주식) */
    p_brok_ymd                     IN    DATE,     /* 배당락일 */
    p_jm_cd1                       IN    VARCHAR,  /* 신주종목코드 */
    p_jm_cd2                       IN    VARCHAR,  /* 신주종목코드 */
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 예상배당(중간배당) 회계처리 - 배당대장 생성
--
    w_aekm                         NUMBER;
    w_stock_rt                     NUMBER;
    w_cash_rt                      NUMBER;
    w_baed_aek                     NUMBER;

    w_jm_cd                        sjm0jj.jm_cd%type;

    w_yesa_jusu                    NUMBER;
    w_yesa_aek                     NUMBER;
BEGIN
    -- 발행기관에서 다음결산일,전결산일 Find
    BEGIN
        SELECT aekm
          INTO w_aekm
          FROM SJX0JB t1  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE balh_co = p_balh_co;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := p_balh_co || '-발행기관이 없습니다.';
        RETURN;
    END;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, p_tr_cd, p_balh_co, p_brok_ymd || ',' || p_baed_mth || ',' || p_baej_mth || ',' || p_ilban_aek);

    -- 주식 MASTER Select
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                              /* _1- */
             , ia.type_gb                                                              /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                /* _3- */
             , t1.woos_ilban_gb                                                        /* _4- */
             , t1.type_trench                                                          /* _5- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                              /* _6- */
             , SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='U'
                                                   THEN NVL(t1.gongs_up_jusu,0)
                                                   ELSE 0
                                              END)                   AS boyu_jusu      /* _7- */
             , SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='U'
                                                  THEN NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0)
                                                  ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN t1.new_old_gb='0'
                                                                    THEN 0
                                                                    ELSE NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                               END)  AS boyu_chui_aek  /* _8- */
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_brok_ymd
           AND t1.balh_co = p_balh_co
           AND t1.jm_cd   IN (SELECT jm_cd
                                FROM SJM0JJ ta  /* 주식종목 */
                               WHERE ta.balh_co                         = p_balh_co
                                 AND ta.jm_cd                           NOT LIKE 'KRY%'
                                 AND NVL(ta.baed_gisan_ymd, p_brok_ymd) <= p_brok_ymd)
           AND NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + (CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='U'
                                                THEN NVL(t1.gongs_up_jusu,0)
                                                ELSE 0 END) != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd    , ia.type_gb, t1.jm_cd, t1.woos_ilban_gb
                , t1.type_trench, t1.bs_type
    ) loop
        -- 적용비율
        BEGIN
            -- 종목별 별도적용시 20070126
            SELECT cash_rt
                 , stock_rt
                 , baed_aek
              INTO w_cash_rt
                 , w_stock_rt
                 , w_baed_aek
              FROM SJT0BJ t1  /* 종목별 배당권리 내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = '%'
               AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd   = p_tr_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            if  xx.woos_ilban_gb = '0'  then
                w_cash_rt  := p_cash_ilban_rt;
                w_stock_rt := p_stock_ilban_rt;
                w_baed_aek := p_ilban_aek;
            else
                w_cash_rt  := p_cash_woos_rt;
                w_stock_rt := p_stock_woos_rt;
                w_baed_aek := p_woos_aek;
            end if;
        END;

        -- 현금배당
        if  p_baed_mth IN ('1','3')     then
            w_yesa_jusu := 0;
            w_yesa_aek  := xx.boyu_jusu * w_baed_aek;  -- 현금배당은 주당배당금으로 계산

            -- 배당대장생성
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO SJT0BM ff    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                     ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                     , ymd            /* _2-배당락일 */
                     , balh_co        /* _3-발행기관 */
                     , fund_cd        /* _4-펀드코드 */
                     , old_jm_cd      /* _5-종목코드(구) */
                     , new_jm_cd      /* _6-종목코드(신) */
                     , boyu_jusu      /* _7-보유주수 */
                     , boyu_chui_aek  /* _8-보유취득액 */
                     , baed_bu_ilsu   /* _9-배당부일수 */
                     , brok_jusu      /* _10-배당락주수 */
                     , yesa_jusu      /* _11-예상주수 */
                     , yesa_aek       /* _12-예상액 */
                     , yesa_tax       /* _13- */
                     , hwakj_ymd      /* _14-확정일 */
                     , hwakj_jusu     /* _15-확정주수 */
                     , hwakj_aek      /* _16-확정액 */
                     , hwakj_tax      /* _17-확정액 */
                     , del_yn         /* _18-삭제여부 */
                     , type_trench    /* _19- */
                     , bs_type        /* _20- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                 /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd                                     /* _2- */
                       , p_balh_co                                 /* _3- */
                       , xx.fund_cd                                /* _4- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                                  /* _5- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                                  /* _6- */
                       , xx.boyu_jusu                              /* _7- */
                       , xx.boyu_chui_aek                          /* _8- */
                       , 365                                       /* _9- */
                       , xx.boyu_jusu                              /* _10- */
                       , w_yesa_jusu                               /* _11- */
                       , w_yesa_aek                                /* _12- */
                       , TRUNC(w_yesa_aek * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _13- */
                       , NULL                                      /* _14- */
                       , 0                                         /* _15- */
                       , 0                                         /* _16- */
                       , 0                                         /* _17- */
                       , '2'                                       /* _18- */
                       , xx.type_trench                            /* _19- */
                       , xx.bs_type                                /* _20- */
                       );
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := p_balh_co || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-현금배당대장을 생성할 수 없습니다.';
                RETURN;
            END;
        end if;

        -- 주식배당
        if  p_baed_mth IN ('2','3')     then
            -- 예상주수,예상액
            w_yesa_jusu := TRUNC(xx.boyu_jusu * w_stock_rt);
            w_yesa_aek  := w_yesa_jusu * w_aekm;

            if  xx.woos_ilban_gb = '0'  then
                    w_jm_cd := p_jm_cd1;
            else    w_jm_cd := p_jm_cd2;
            end if;

            if  SUBSTR (p_baej_mth,2,1) = '1'       then    w_jm_cd := p_jm_cd1;  -- 보통주
            elsif SUBSTR (p_baej_mth,2,1) = '2'     then    w_jm_cd := p_jm_cd2;  -- 우선주
            end if;

            -- 배당대장생성
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO SJT0BM ff    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                     ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                     , ymd            /* _2-배당락일 */
                     , balh_co        /* _3-발행기관 */
                     , fund_cd        /* _4-펀드코드 */
                     , old_jm_cd      /* _5-종목코드(구) */
                     , new_jm_cd      /* _6-종목코드(신) */
                     , boyu_jusu      /* _7-보유주수 */
                     , boyu_chui_aek  /* _8-보유취득액 */
                     , baed_bu_ilsu   /* _9-배당부일수 */
                     , brok_jusu      /* _10-배당락주수 */
                     , yesa_jusu      /* _11-예상주수 */
                     , yesa_aek       /* _12-예상액 */
                     , yesa_tax       /* _13- */
                     , hwakj_ymd      /* _14-확정일 */
                     , hwakj_jusu     /* _15-확정주수 */
                     , hwakj_aek      /* _16-확정액 */
                     , hwakj_tax      /* _17-확정액 */
                     , danga          /* _18-단가 */
                     , del_yn         /* _19-삭제여부 */
                     , type_trench    /* _20- */
                     , bs_type        /* _21- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                 /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd                                     /* _2- */
                       , p_balh_co                                 /* _3- */
                       , xx.fund_cd                                /* _4- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                                  /* _5- */
                       , w_jm_cd                                   /* _6- */
                       , xx.boyu_jusu                              /* _7- */
                       , xx.boyu_chui_aek                          /* _8- */
                       , 365                                       /* _9- */
                       , xx.boyu_jusu                              /* _10- */
                       , w_yesa_jusu                               /* _11- */
                       , w_yesa_aek                                /* _12- */
                       , TRUNC(w_yesa_aek * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _13- */
                       , NULL                                      /* _14- */
                       , 0                                         /* _15- */
                       , 0                                         /* _16- */
                       , 0                                         /* _17- */
                       , w_aekm                                    /* _18- */
                       , '2'                                       /* _19- */
                       , xx.type_trench                            /* _20- */
                       , xx.bs_type                                /* _21- */
                       );
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := p_balh_co || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-주식배당대장을 생성할 수 없습니다.';
                RETURN;
            END;
        end if;
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := 'PROC031H:' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC031J (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,    /* 배당락일 */
    p_balh_co                      IN    VARCHAR  /* 발행기관 */
 ) AS
-- 예상배당 -- 주식마스터 생성
--
BEGIN
    -- 배당대장(1) Select
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                               /* _1- */
             , t1.new_jm_cd                             /* _2- */
             , t1.type_trench                           /* _3- */
             , t1.bs_type                               /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.yesa_jusu), 0)  AS yesa_jusu  /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.yesa_aek), 0)   AS yesa_aek   /* _6- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.yesa_tax), 0)   AS yesa_tax   /* _7- */
          FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd
           AND t1.balh_co               = p_balh_co
           AND t1.old_jm_cd             != new_jm_cd
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.new_jm_cd
                , t1.type_trench
                , t1.bs_type
    ) loop
        MERGE INTO SJM0JM tt  /* 주식 보유현황 */
           USING ( SELECT balh_co        /* _1- */
                        , woos_ilban_gb  /* _2- */
                        , chg_gb         /* _3- */
                        , new_old_gb     /* _4- */
                        , danc_gb        /* _5- */
                        , koscom_cd      /* _6- */
                     FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
                    WHERE jm_cd = xx.new_jm_cd ) ut
              ON ( corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd       = xx.new_jm_cd
               AND ymd         = p_ymd
               AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET gongs_up_jusu      = NVL(gongs_up_jusu,0) + xx.yesa_jusu
                  , gongs_up_chui_aek  = NVL(gongs_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.yesa_aek - xx.yesa_tax
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT ( corp_gr            /* _1- */
                    , ymd                /* _2- */
                    , fund_cd            /* _3- */
                    , jm_cd              /* _4- */
                    , gongs_up_jusu      /* _5- */
                    , gongs_up_chui_aek  /* _6- */
                    , balh_co            /* _7- */
                    , woos_ilban_gb      /* _8- */
                    , chg_gb             /* _9- */
                    , new_old_gb         /* _10- */
                    , danc_gb            /* _11- */
                    , koscom_cd          /* _12- */
                    , type_trench        /* _13- */
                    , bs_type            /* _14- */
                    )
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                  /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd                      /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                 /* _3- */
                    , xx.new_jm_cd               /* _4- */
                    , xx.yesa_jusu               /* _5- */
                    , xx.yesa_aek - xx.yesa_tax  /* _6- */
                    , ut.balh_co                 /* _7- */
                    , ut.woos_ilban_gb           /* _8- */
                    , ut.chg_gb                  /* _9- */
                    , ut.new_old_gb              /* _10- */
                    , ut.danc_gb                 /* _11- */
                    , ut.koscom_cd               /* _12- */
                    , xx.type_trench             /* _13- */
                    , xx.bs_type                 /* _14- */
                    );
    end loop;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC031K (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,     /* 배당확정일 */
    p_brok_ymd                     IN    DATE,     /* 배당락일 */
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,  /* 거래코드 */
    p_balh_co                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 발행기관 */
    p_aekm                         IN    NUMBER,   /* 액면 */
    p_baed_mth                     IN    VARCHAR,  /* 배당방법 */
    p_baej_mth                     IN    VARCHAR,  /* 배정방법 */
    p_cash_ilban_rt                IN    NUMBER,   /* 보통주배당율(현금) */
    p_cash_woos_rt                 IN    NUMBER,   /* 우선주배당율(현금) */
    p_ilban_aek                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_woos_aek                     IN    NUMBER,
    p_stock_ilban_rt               IN    NUMBER,   /* 보통주배당율(주식) */
    p_stock_woos_rt                IN    NUMBER,   /* 우선주배당율(주식) */
    p_jm_cd1                       IN    VARCHAR,  /* 신주종목코드 */
    p_jm_cd2                       IN    VARCHAR,  /* 신주종목코드 */
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 확정배당 대장변경
--
    w_woos_ilban_gb                sjm0jj.woos_ilban_gb%type;

    w_stock_rt                     NUMBER;
    w_cash_rt                      NUMBER;
    w_baed_aek                     NUMBER;

    w_rowcount                     NUMBER   default 0;

    w_jm_cd                        VARCHAR(12);

    w_aek                          NUMBER;
    w_jusu                         NUMBER;
BEGIN
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd      /* _1- */
             , ia.type_gb      /* _2- */
             , t1.old_jm_cd    /* _3- */
             , t1.new_jm_cd    /* _4- */
             , t1.hwakj_ymd    /* _5- */
             , t1.juchong_ymd  /* _6- */
             , t1.rowid        /* _7- */
          FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                   = p_brok_ymd
           AND t1.balh_co               = p_balh_co
           AND NVL(t1.del_yn,'2')       != '1'
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        if (p_tr_cd='G20') AND (NVL(xx.hwakj_ymd, p_ymd) != p_ymd)       then    -- 이사회배당
            p_msg := xx.old_jm_cd || '-이미 이사회확정 처리된 종목입니다';
            RETURN;

        elsif (p_tr_cd='G25') AND (NVL(xx.juchong_ymd, p_ymd) != p_ymd)      then    -- 주총배당
            p_msg := xx.old_jm_cd || '-이미 주총확정 처리된 종목입니다';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 보통주,우선주 여부
        BEGIN
            SELECT woos_ilban_gb
              INTO w_woos_ilban_gb
              FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE t1.jm_cd = xx.old_jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_woos_ilban_gb := '0';
        END;

        -- 적용비율
        BEGIN
            -- 종목별 별도적용시 20070126
            SELECT cash_rt
                 , stock_rt
                 , baed_aek
              INTO w_cash_rt
                 , w_stock_rt
                 , w_baed_aek
              FROM SJT0BJ t1  /* 종목별 배당권리 내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = '%'
               AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.old_jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd   = p_tr_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            if  w_woos_ilban_gb = '0'       then    -- 보통주
                w_cash_rt  := p_cash_ilban_rt;
                w_stock_rt := p_stock_ilban_rt;
                w_baed_aek := p_ilban_aek;
            else    /* 우선주 */
                w_cash_rt  := p_cash_woos_rt;
                w_stock_rt := p_stock_woos_rt;
                w_baed_aek := p_woos_aek;
            end if;
        END;

        if  p_tr_cd IN ('G20','G23')    then    -- 이사회배당
            if  xx.old_jm_cd = xx.new_jm_cd then    -- 현금배당
                if (w_cash_rt=0 AND w_baed_aek=0)   then    -- 배당취소시
                    UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                       SET sury_ju_aek = 0
                         , sury_ymd    = p_ymd
                         , hwakj_aek   = 0
                         , hwakj_tax   = 0
                         , hwakj_ymd   = p_ymd
                     WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
                else
                    UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                       SET hwakj_jusu = 0
                         , hwakj_aek  = brok_jusu * w_baed_aek
                         , hwakj_tax  = TRUNC(brok_jusu * w_baed_aek * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                         , hwakj_ymd  = p_ymd
                         , sury_ymd   = NULL
                     WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
                end if;
            else
                if  w_stock_rt = 0  then    -- 배당취소시
                    UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                       SET sury_ju_aek = 0
                         , sury_ymd    = p_ymd
                         , hwakj_jusu  = 0
                         , hwakj_aek   = 0
                         , hwakj_ymd   = p_ymd
                     WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
                else
                    UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                       SET hwakj_jusu = TRUNC(brok_jusu * w_stock_rt)
                         , hwakj_aek  = TRUNC(brok_jusu * w_stock_rt) * p_aekm
                         , hwakj_tax  = TRUNC(brok_jusu * w_stock_rt * p_aekm * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                         , hwakj_ymd  = p_ymd
                         , sury_ymd   = NULL
                     WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
                end if;
                w_rowcount := w_rowcount + 1;
            end if;

        elsif p_tr_cd = 'G25'   then    -- 주총배당
            if  xx.old_jm_cd = xx.new_jm_cd then    -- 현금배당
                if (w_cash_rt=0 AND w_baed_aek=0)   then    -- 배당취소시
                    UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                       SET sury_ju_aek = 0
                         , sury_ymd    = p_ymd
                         , juchong_aek = 0
                         , juchong_tax = 0
                         , juchong_ymd = p_ymd
                     WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
                else
                    UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                       SET juchong_jusu = 0
                         , juchong_aek  = brok_jusu * w_baed_aek
                         , juchong_tax  = TRUNC(brok_jusu * w_baed_aek * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                         , juchong_ymd  = p_ymd
                         , sury_ymd     = NULL
                     WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
                end if;
            else
                if  w_stock_rt = 0  then    -- 배당취소시
                    UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                       SET sury_ju_aek  = 0
                         , sury_ymd     = p_ymd
                         , juchong_jusu = 0
                         , juchong_aek  = 0
                         , juchong_ymd  = p_ymd
                     WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
                else
                    UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                       SET juchong_jusu = TRUNC(brok_jusu * w_stock_rt)
                         , juchong_aek  = TRUNC(brok_jusu * w_stock_rt) * p_aekm
                         , juchong_tax  = TRUNC(brok_jusu * w_stock_rt * p_aekm * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                         , juchong_ymd  = p_ymd
                         , sury_ymd     = NULL
                     WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
                end if;
                w_rowcount := w_rowcount + 1;
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    if (w_rowcount=0) AND (NVL(p_stock_ilban_rt,0) + NVL(p_stock_woos_rt,0)) > 0    then
        for xx IN (
            SELECT t1.ymd            /* _1- */
                 , t1.balh_co        /* _2- */
                 , t1.fund_cd        /* _3- */
                 , t1.old_jm_cd      /* _4- */
                 , t1.boyu_jusu      /* _5- */
                 , t1.boyu_chui_aek  /* _6- */
                 , t1.baed_bu_ilsu   /* _7- */
                 , t1.brok_jusu      /* _8- */
                 , t1.del_yn         /* _9- */
                 , t1.type_trench    /* _10- */
                 , t1.bs_type        /* _11- */
                 , fd.type_gb        /* _12- */
              FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                 , SZM0IA fd  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd                   = p_brok_ymd
               AND t1.balh_co               = p_balh_co
               AND NVL(t1.del_yn,'2')       != '1'
               AND t1.new_jm_cd             = t1.old_jm_cd
               AND fd.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
               AND fd.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
               AND NVL(fd.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
        ) loop
            -- 보통주,우선주 여부
            BEGIN
                SELECT woos_ilban_gb
                  INTO w_woos_ilban_gb
                  FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
                 WHERE t1.jm_cd = xx.old_jm_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                w_woos_ilban_gb := '0';
            END;

            -- 종목코드
            if  w_woos_ilban_gb = '0'   then
                    w_jm_cd := p_jm_cd1;  /* 보통주 */
            else    w_jm_cd := p_jm_cd2;  /* 우선주 */
            end if;

            -- 적용비율
            BEGIN
                -- 종목별 별도적용시 20070126
                SELECT stock_rt
                  INTO w_stock_rt
                  FROM SJT0BJ t1  /* 종목별 배당권리 내역 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.old_jm_cd
                   AND t1.tr_cd   = p_tr_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                if  w_woos_ilban_gb = '0'   then
                        w_stock_rt := p_stock_ilban_rt;  /* 보통주 */
                else    w_stock_rt := p_stock_woos_rt;   /* 우선주 */
                end if;
            END;

            if  p_tr_cd IN ('G20','G23')        then    -- 이사회배당
                w_jusu := TRUNC (xx.brok_jusu * w_stock_rt);
                w_aek  := w_jusu * p_aekm;
                INSERT INTO SJT0BM tt   /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                     ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                     , ymd            /* _2- */
                     , balh_co        /* _3- */
                     , fund_cd        /* _4- */
                     , old_jm_cd      /* _5- */
                     , new_jm_cd      /* _6- */
                     , boyu_jusu      /* _7- */
                     , boyu_chui_aek  /* _8- */
                     , baed_bu_ilsu   /* _9- */
                     , brok_jusu      /* _10- */
                     , hwakj_ymd      /* _11- */
                     , hwakj_jusu     /* _12- */
                     , hwakj_aek      /* _13- */
                     , hwakj_tax      /* _14- */
                     , del_yn         /* _15- */
                     , type_trench    /* _16- */
                     , bs_type        /* _17- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                            /* _1- */
                       , xx.ymd                               /* _2- */
                       , xx.balh_co                           /* _3- */
                       , xx.fund_cd                           /* _4- */
                       , xx.old_jm_cd                         /* _5- */
                       , w_jm_cd                              /* _6- */
                       , xx.boyu_jusu                         /* _7- */
                       , xx.boyu_chui_aek                     /* _8- */
                       , xx.baed_bu_ilsu                      /* _9- */
                       , xx.brok_jusu                         /* _10- */
                       , p_ymd                                /* _11- */
                       , w_jusu                               /* _12- */
                       , w_aek                                /* _13- */
                       , TRUNC(w_aek * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))  /* _14- */
                       , '2'                                  /* _15- */
                       , xx.type_trench                       /* _16- */
                       , xx.bs_type                           /* _17- */
                       );

            elsif p_tr_cd = 'G25'       then    -- 주총배당
                w_jusu := TRUNC (xx.brok_jusu * w_stock_rt);
                w_aek  := w_jusu * p_aekm;
                MERGE INTO SJT0BM tt  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                   USING DUAL ON ( corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
                               AND old_jm_cd   = xx.old_jm_cd
                               AND ymd         = xx.ymd
                               AND balh_co     = xx.balh_co
                               AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
                               AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type
                               AND haeji_fund IS NULL )
                WHEN MATCHED THEN
                     UPDATE
                        SET juchong_jusu = w_jusu
                          , juchong_aek  = w_aek
                          , juchong_tax  = TRUNC(w_aek * F_TAX_RT(xx.type_gb))
                          , juchong_ymd  = p_ymd
                WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                     INSERT ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                            , ymd            /* _2- */
                            , balh_co        /* _3- */
                            , fund_cd        /* _4- */
                            , old_jm_cd      /* _5- */
                            , new_jm_cd      /* _6- */
                            , boyu_jusu      /* _7- */
                            , boyu_chui_aek  /* _8- */
                            , baed_bu_ilsu   /* _9- */
                            , brok_jusu      /* _10- */
                            , del_yn         /* _11- */
                            , juchong_ymd    /* _12- */
                            , juchong_jusu   /* _13- */
                            , juchong_aek    /* _14- */
                            , juchong_tax    /* _15- */
                            , type_trench    /* _16- */
                            , bs_type        /* _17- */
                            )
                     VALUES ( p_corp_gr                             /* _1- */
                            , xx.ymd                                /* _2- */
                            , xx.balh_co                            /* _3- */
                            , xx.fund_cd                            /* _4- */
                            , xx.old_jm_cd                          /* _5- */
                            , w_jm_cd                               /* _6- */
                            , xx.boyu_jusu                          /* _7- */
                            , xx.boyu_chui_aek                      /* _8- */
                            , xx.baed_bu_ilsu                       /* _9- */
                            , xx.brok_jusu                          /* _10- */
                            , '2'                                   /* _11- */
                            , p_ymd                                 /* _12- */
                            , w_jusu                                /* _13- */
                            , w_aek                                 /* _14- */
                            , TRUNC(w_aek * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))  /* _15- */
                            , xx.type_trench                        /* _16- */
                            , xx.bs_type                            /* _17- */
                            );
            end if;
        end loop;
    end if;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := 'PROC031K:' || SUBSTR (sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC031M (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,     /* 공시적용일 */
    p_brok_ymd                     IN    DATE,     /* 배당락일 */
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,  /* 거래코드 */
    p_balh_co                      IN    VARCHAR   /* 발행기관 */
 ) AS
-- 확정배당 회계처리 -- 주식마스터 생성
--
    w_jusu                         NUMBER;
    w_aek                          NUMBER;
    w_tax                          NUMBER;
    w_up_jusu                      NUMBER;
    w_up_aek                       NUMBER;
    w_up_tax                       NUMBER;
    w_dw_jusu                      NUMBER;
    w_dw_aek                       NUMBER;
    w_dw_tax                       NUMBER;
BEGIN
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                              /* _1- */
             , t1.new_jm_cd                                            /* _2- */
             , NVL(t1.hwakj_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.yesa_jusu,0)  AS h_jusu   /* _3- */
             , NVL(t1.hwakj_aek,0) - NVL(t1.yesa_aek,0)    AS h_aek    /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.hwakj_tax,0) - NVL(t1.yesa_tax,0)    AS h_tax    /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.juchong_jusu,0) - CASE WHEN t1.hwakj_ymd IS NULL THEN NVL(t1.yesa_jusu,0)
                                                                       ELSE NVL(t1.hwakj_jusu,0)
                                        END                AS j_jusu   /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.juchong_aek,0) - CASE WHEN t1.hwakj_ymd IS NULL THEN NVL(t1.yesa_aek,0)
                                                                      ELSE NVL(t1.hwakj_aek,0)
                                       END                 AS j_aek    /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.juchong_tax,0) - CASE WHEN t1.hwakj_ymd IS NULL THEN NVL(t1.yesa_tax,0)
                                                                      ELSE NVL(t1.hwakj_tax,0)
                                       END                 AS j_tax    /* _8- */
             , t1.type_trench                                          /* _9- */
             , t1.bs_type                                              /* _10- */
          FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                   = p_brok_ymd
           AND t1.balh_co               = p_balh_co
           AND NVL(t1.del_yn,'2')       = '2'
           AND t1.old_jm_cd             != new_jm_cd
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        -- 배당구분
        if  p_tr_cd = 'G20' then
            w_jusu := xx.h_jusu;
            w_aek  := xx.h_aek;
            w_tax  := xx.h_tax;

        elsif p_tr_cd = 'G25'   then
            w_jusu := xx.j_jusu;
            w_aek  := xx.j_aek;
            w_tax  := xx.j_tax;
        end if;

        -- 증감계산
        if  w_jusu > 0      then
            w_up_jusu := w_jusu;
            w_up_aek  := w_aek;
            w_up_tax  := w_tax;
            w_dw_jusu := 0;
            w_dw_aek  := 0;
            w_dw_tax  := 0;
        else
            w_up_jusu := 0;
            w_up_aek  := 0;
            w_up_tax  := 0;
            w_dw_jusu := w_jusu * -1;
            w_dw_aek  := w_aek * -1;
            w_dw_tax  := w_tax * -1;
        end if;

        -- 주식마스터 변경
        MERGE INTO SJM0JM tt  /* 주식 보유현황 */
           USING ( SELECT balh_co        /* _1- */
                        , woos_ilban_gb  /* _2- */
                        , chg_gb         /* _3- */
                        , new_old_gb     /* _4- */
                        , danc_gb        /* _5- */
                        , koscom_cd      /* _6- */
                     FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
                    WHERE jm_cd = xx.new_jm_cd ) ut 
              ON ( corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd       = xx.new_jm_cd
               AND ymd         = p_ymd
               AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET gongs_up_jusu     = NVL(gongs_up_jusu,0) + w_up_jusu
                  , gongs_up_chui_aek = NVL(gongs_up_chui_aek,0) + w_up_aek - w_up_tax
                  , gongs_dw_jusu     = NVL(gongs_dw_jusu,0) + w_dw_jusu
                  , gongs_dw_chui_aek = NVL(gongs_dw_chui_aek,0) + w_dw_aek - w_dw_tax
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT ( corp_gr            /* _1- */
                    , ymd                /* _2- */
                    , fund_cd            /* _3- */
                    , jm_cd              /* _4- */
                    , gongs_up_jusu      /* _5- */
                    , gongs_up_chui_aek  /* _6- */
                    , gongs_dw_jusu      /* _7- */
                    , gongs_dw_chui_aek  /* _8- */
                    , balh_co            /* _9- */
                    , woos_ilban_gb      /* _10- */
                    , chg_gb             /* _11- */
                    , new_old_gb         /* _12- */
                    , danc_gb            /* _13- */
                    , koscom_cd          /* _14- */
                    , type_trench        /* _15- */
                    , bs_type            /* _16- */
                    )
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr            /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd                /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd           /* _3- */
                    , xx.new_jm_cd         /* _4- */
                    , w_up_jusu            /* _5- */
                    , w_up_aek - w_up_tax  /* _6- */
                    , w_dw_jusu            /* _7- */
                    , w_dw_aek - w_dw_tax  /* _8- */
                    , ut.balh_co           /* _9- */
                    , ut.woos_ilban_gb     /* _10- */
                    , ut.chg_gb            /* _11- */
                    , ut.new_old_gb        /* _12- */
                    , ut.danc_gb           /* _13- */
                    , ut.koscom_cd         /* _14- */
                    , xx.type_trench       /* _15- */
                    , xx.bs_type           /* _16- */
                    );
    end loop;
    commit;
END;
/
