CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC031N (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_hab_ymd                      IN    DATE,     /* 공시일 */
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,  /* 거래코드 */
    p_hab_co                       IN    VARCHAR,  /* 합병(감자)회사 */
    p_jm_cd1                       OUT   VARCHAR,  /* 신주종목코드(보통주) */
    p_jm_cd2                       OUT   VARCHAR,  /* 신주종목코드(우선주) */
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 합병/감자/이전(교환)공시 - 신주종목코드 생성
--
    w_jm_cd                        sjm0jj.jm_cd%type;
    w_koscom_cd                    sjm0jj.koscom_cd%type;
    w_balh_nm                      sjm0jj.jj_nm%type;
    w_jj_nm                        sjm0jj.jj_nm%type;
    w_nm                           sjm0jj.jj_nm%type;
    w_jj_enm                       sjm0jj.jj_enm%type;
    w_danc_gb                      sjm0jj.danc_gb%type;
    w_upj_cd                       sjm0jj.upj_cd%type;
    w_digit                        VARCHAR(1);

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -- 발행기관명
    BEGIN
        SELECT balh_nm
             , sosok_gb
          INTO w_balh_nm
             , w_danc_gb
          FROM SJX0JB t1  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE balh_co = p_hab_co;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := p_hab_co || '-해당 발행기관이 없습니다.';
        RETURN;
    END;

    if  p_tr_cd = 'G40' then
        w_nm := '(합병/';
        if  w_danc_gb != 'B'    then    w_danc_gb := 'Z';
        end if;

    elsif p_tr_cd = 'G43'   then
        w_nm := '(부분분할/';
        if  w_danc_gb != 'B'    then    w_danc_gb := 'Z';
        end if;

    elsif p_tr_cd = 'G45'   then
        w_nm      := '(감자/';
        w_danc_gb := 'S';

    elsif p_tr_cd = 'G93'   then
        w_nm      := '(이전_교환/';
        w_danc_gb := 'V';
    end if;

    -- 신주종목코드 생성 (보통주)
    w_jj_nm := w_balh_nm || w_nm || '보)';

    -- Koscom 코드 , 업종
    BEGIN
        SELECT koscom_cd
             , jj_enm
             , upj_cd
          INTO w_koscom_cd
             , w_jj_enm
             , w_upj_cd
          FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
         WHERE jm_cd = (SELECT MIN(jm_cd)
                          FROM SJM0JJ ta  /* 주식종목 */
                         WHERE ta.balh_co       = p_hab_co
                           AND ta.woos_ilban_gb = '0');
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := p_hab_co || '-신주종목코드(보)을 생성할 수 없습니다.';
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- 코드 조합
    w_jm_cd := 'KR' || w_danc_gb || p_hab_co || '000';
    SR_CLCDGT (w_jm_cd, w_digit, w_msg);
    w_jm_cd  := w_jm_cd || w_digit;
    p_jm_cd1 := w_jm_cd;

    MERGE INTO SJM0JJ tt  /* 주식종목 */
       USING DUAL ON ( jm_cd = w_jm_cd )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
         UPDATE
            SET jj_fnm       = w_jj_nm
              , jj_nm        = w_jj_nm
              , jj_enm       = w_jj_enm
              , kweonri_ymd  = p_hab_ymd
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
         INSERT ( jm_cd          /* _1-종목코드 */
                , koscom_cd      /* _2-KOSCOM 코드 */
                , jj_fnm         /* _3-종목전칭 */
                , jj_nm          /* _4-종목약칭 */
                , jj_enm         /* _5-영문약칭 */
                , balh_co        /* _6-발행기관 */
                , woos_ilban_gb  /* _7-주권종류(보통/우선)  0,1-9 */
                , chg_gb         /* _8-전환종류(비전환/전환)0,1-9 */
                , new_old_gb     /* _9-신구주구분(구주/신주)0,1-9 */
                , danc_gb        /* _10-단축식별 (A-시장) */
                , balh_ga        /* _11-발행가 */
                , kweonri_ymd    /* _12-권리발생일 */
                , upj_cd         /* _13-업종코드 */
                , del_yn         /* _14-삭제여부 */
                , created_ymd    /* _15-신주생성일 */
                )
         VALUES ( w_jm_cd      /* _1-종목코드 */
                , w_koscom_cd  /* _2-KOSCOM 코드 */
                , w_jj_nm      /* _3-종목전칭 */
                , w_jj_nm      /* _4-종목약칭 */
                , w_jj_enm     /* _5-영문약칭 */
                , p_hab_co     /* _6-발행기관 */
                , '0'          /* _7-주권종류(보통/우선)  0,1-9 */
                , '0'          /* _8-전환종류(비전환/전환)0,1-9 */
                , '0'          /* _9-신구주구분(구주/신주)0,1-9 */
                , w_danc_gb    /* _10-단축식별 (A-시장) */
                , 0            /* _11-발행가 */
                , p_hab_ymd    /* _12-권리발생일 */
                , w_upj_cd     /* _13-업종코드 */
                , NULL         /* _14-삭제여부 */
                , p_hab_ymd    /* _15-신주생성일 */
                );

    -- 신주종목코드 생성 (우선주)
    w_jj_nm := w_balh_nm || w_nm || '우)';

    -- Koscom 코드 , 업종
    BEGIN
        SELECT koscom_cd
             , jj_enm
             , upj_cd
          INTO w_koscom_cd
             , w_jj_enm
             , w_upj_cd
          FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
         WHERE jm_cd = (SELECT MIN(jm_cd)
                          FROM SJM0JJ ta  /* 주식종목 */
                         WHERE ta.balh_co       = p_hab_co
                           AND ta.woos_ilban_gb > '0');
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := 'Y';
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- 코드 조합
    w_jm_cd := 'KR' || w_danc_gb || p_hab_co || '100';
    SR_CLCDGT (w_jm_cd, w_digit, w_msg);
    w_jm_cd  := w_jm_cd || w_digit;
    p_jm_cd2 := w_jm_cd;

    MERGE INTO SJM0JJ tt  /* 주식종목 */
       USING DUAL ON ( jm_cd = w_jm_cd )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
         UPDATE
            SET jj_fnm       = w_jj_nm
              , jj_nm        = w_jj_nm
              , jj_enm       = w_jj_enm
              , kweonri_ymd  = p_hab_ymd
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
         INSERT ( jm_cd          /* _1-종목코드 */
                , koscom_cd      /* _2-KOSCOM 코드 */
                , jj_fnm         /* _3-종목전칭 */
                , jj_nm          /* _4-종목약칭 */
                , jj_enm         /* _5-영문약칭 */
                , balh_co        /* _6-발행기관 */
                , woos_ilban_gb  /* _7-주권종류 */
                , chg_gb         /* _8-전환종류 */
                , new_old_gb     /* _9-신구주구분 */
                , danc_gb        /* _10-단축식별 */
                , balh_ga        /* _11-발행가 */
                , kweonri_ymd    /* _12-권리발생일 */
                , upj_cd         /* _13-업종코드 */
                , del_yn         /* _14-삭제여부 */
                , created_ymd    /* _15-신주생성일 */
                )
         VALUES ( w_jm_cd      /* _1-종목코드 */
                , w_koscom_cd  /* _2-KOSCOM 코드 */
                , w_jj_nm      /* _3-종목전칭 */
                , w_jj_nm      /* _4-종목약칭 */
                , w_jj_enm     /* _5-영문약칭 */
                , p_hab_co     /* _6-발행기관 */
                , '1'          /* _7-주권종류 */
                , '0'          /* _8-전환종류 */
                , '0'          /* _9-신구주구분 */
                , w_danc_gb    /* _10-단축식별 */
                , 0            /* _11-발행가 */
                , p_hab_ymd    /* _12-권리발생일 */
                , w_upj_cd     /* _13-업종코드 */
                , NULL         /* _14-삭제여부 */
                , p_hab_ymd    /* _15-신주생성일 */
                );
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC031P (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_hab_co                       IN    VARCHAR,
    p_pi_hab_co                    IN    VARCHAR,
    p_hab_ilban_rt                 IN    NUMBER,
    p_hab_woos_rt                  IN    NUMBER,
    p_hab_ilban_aek                IN    NUMBER,
    p_hab_woos_aek                 IN    NUMBER,
    p_gam_ilban_rt                 IN    NUMBER,
    p_gam_woos_rt                  IN    NUMBER,
    p_pi_hab_ilban_rt              IN    NUMBER,
    p_pi_hab_woos_rt               IN    NUMBER,
    p_jm_cd1                       IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd2                       IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 합병/감자/유상소각 대장 생성
--
    w_rt                         NUMBER;
    w_jusu                       NUMBER; -- 부분분할대상 주수
    w_aek                        NUMBER; -- 부분분할대상 취득액

    w_hab_jusu                   NUMBER;
    w_hab_gyoub_aek              NUMBER;

    w_sonik                      NUMBER;

    w_hab_per                    NUMBER;
    w_gam_per                    NUMBER;

    w_jm_cd                      sjm0jj.jm_cd%type;
BEGIN
    -- 주식 MASTER
    for xx IN (
        select t1.fund_cd                  /* _1- */
             , t1.jm_cd                    /* _2- */
             , t1.koscom_cd                /* _3- */
             , t1.type_trench              /* _4- */
             , t1.bs_type                  /* _5- */
             , t1.woos_ilban_gb            /* _6- */
             , t1.bfil_boyu_jusu  AS jusu  /* _7- */
             , t1.bfil_chui_aek   AS aek   /* _8- */
          from SJM0JM t1
             , SZM0IA fd
         where t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           and t1.ymd                   = p_ymd
           and t1.bfil_boyu_jusu        > 0
           and t1.balh_co               = p_pi_hab_co
           and fd.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           and fd.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           and NVL(fd.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        if  p_tr_cd = 'G43' then    -- 부분 분할합병
            SELECT sonik  /* 전일 평가손익 */
              INTO w_sonik
              FROM SJM0JM t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd - 1
               AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type;

            if  xx.woos_ilban_gb = '0'      then
                w_hab_per   := p_hab_ilban_rt * 100;
                w_gam_per   := p_gam_ilban_rt * 100;
                w_jusu      := xx.jusu - trunc(xx.jusu * (1 - p_gam_ilban_rt));
                w_aek       := trunc (xx.aek * p_gam_ilban_rt);
                w_sonik     := ROUND (w_sonik * p_gam_ilban_rt);
                w_hab_jusu  := trunc (w_jusu * p_hab_ilban_rt);
                w_jm_cd     := p_jm_cd1;
            else
                w_hab_per   := p_hab_woos_rt * 100;
                w_gam_per   := p_gam_woos_rt * 100;
                w_jusu      := xx.jusu - trunc(xx.jusu * (1 - p_gam_woos_rt));
                w_aek       := trunc (xx.aek * p_gam_woos_rt);
                w_sonik     := ROUND (w_sonik * p_gam_woos_rt);
                w_hab_jusu  := trunc (w_jusu * p_hab_woos_rt);
                w_jm_cd     := p_jm_cd2;
            end if;

            INSERT INTO SJT0H1 ff
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd            /* _2-합병기일 */
                   , p_tr_cd          /* _3-거래코드 */
                   , p_hab_co         /* _4-합병회사 */
                   , p_pi_hab_co      /* _5-피합병회사 */
                   , xx.fund_cd       /* _6-펀드코드 */
                   , xx.jm_cd         /* _7-피합병종목코드 */
                   , w_jm_cd          /* _8-합병종목코드 */
                   , xx.jusu          /* _9-보유주수 */
                   , w_aek            /* _10-취득액 */
                   , w_hab_per        /* _11- */
                   , w_hab_jusu       /* _12-합병주수 */
                   , w_aek + w_sonik  /* _13-합병취득액 */
                   , w_hab_gyoub_aek  /* _14-합병교부금 */
                   , w_gam_per        /* _15- */
                   , w_jusu           /* _16-부분분할주수 */
                   , NULL             /* _17- */
                   , NULL             /* _18- */
                   , NULL             /* _19- */
                   , NULL             /* _20- */
                   , NULL             /* _21- */
                   , xx.type_trench   /* _22- */
                   , xx.bs_type       /* _23- */
                   );

            -- 당일 주식수령에 의한 부분분할주수 변경분 반영 20090701 yjs
            SELECT NVL(SUM(sury_aek), 0)
              INTO w_jusu
              FROM SJT0FS t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.tr_ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.tr_cd       = 'F3B'
               AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type;

            UPDATE SJM0JM  ff
               SET gongs_dw_jusu      = w_jusu
                 , gongs_dw_chui_aek  = w_aek
             WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
               AND ymd         = p_ymd
               AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type;

        elsif p_tr_cd = 'G93'   then
            w_jm_cd := p_jm_cd1;

            if  xx.woos_ilban_gb = '0'      then
                w_hab_per       := p_hab_ilban_rt * 100;
                w_hab_jusu      := trunc (xx.jusu * p_hab_ilban_rt);
                w_hab_gyoub_aek := trunc (xx.aek * p_hab_ilban_rt);
            else
                w_hab_per       := p_hab_woos_rt * 100;
                w_hab_jusu      := trunc (xx.jusu * p_hab_woos_rt);
                w_hab_gyoub_aek := trunc (xx.aek * p_hab_woos_rt);
            end if;

            INSERT INTO SJT0H1 ff
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd            /* _2-합병기일 */
                   , p_tr_cd          /* _3-거래코드 */
                   , p_hab_co         /* _4-합병회사 */
                   , p_pi_hab_co      /* _5-피합병회사 */
                   , xx.fund_cd       /* _6-펀드코드 */
                   , xx.jm_cd         /* _7-피합병종목코드 */
                   , w_jm_cd          /* _8-합병종목코드 */
                   , xx.jusu          /* _9-보유주수 */
                   , xx.aek           /* _10-취득액 */
                   , w_hab_per        /* _11- */
                   , w_hab_jusu       /* _12-합병주수 */
                   , w_hab_gyoub_aek  /* _13-합병취득액 */
                   , NULL             /* _14- */
                   , NULL             /* _15- */
                   , NULL             /* _16- */
                   , NULL             /* _17- */
                   , NULL             /* _18- */
                   , NULL             /* _19- */
                   , NULL             /* _20- */
                   , NULL             /* _21- */
                   , xx.type_trench   /* _22- */
                   , xx.bs_type       /* _23- */
                   );

            w_jm_cd := p_jm_cd2;
            if  xx.woos_ilban_gb = '0'  then
                w_hab_per       := p_pi_hab_ilban_rt * 100;
                w_hab_jusu      := trunc (xx.jusu * p_pi_hab_ilban_rt);
                w_hab_gyoub_aek := trunc (xx.aek * p_pi_hab_ilban_rt);
            else
                w_hab_per       := p_pi_hab_woos_rt * 100;
                w_hab_jusu      := trunc (xx.jusu * p_pi_hab_woos_rt);
                w_hab_gyoub_aek := trunc (xx.aek * p_pi_hab_woos_rt);
            end if;

            INSERT INTO SJT0H1 ff
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd            /* _2-합병기일 */
                   , p_tr_cd          /* _3-거래코드 */
                   , p_hab_co         /* _4-합병회사 */
                   , p_pi_hab_co      /* _5-피합병회사 */
                   , xx.fund_cd       /* _6-펀드코드 */
                   , xx.jm_cd         /* _7-피합병종목코드 */
                   , w_jm_cd          /* _8-합병종목코드 */
                   , xx.jusu          /* _9-보유주수 */
                   , xx.aek           /* _10-취득액 */
                   , w_hab_per        /* _11- */
                   , w_hab_jusu       /* _12-합병주수 */
                   , w_hab_gyoub_aek  /* _13-합병취득액 */
                   , NULL             /* _14- */
                   , NULL             /* _15- */
                   , NULL             /* _16- */
                   , NULL             /* _17- */
                   , NULL             /* _18- */
                   , NULL             /* _19- */
                   , NULL             /* _20- */
                   , NULL             /* _21- */
                   , xx.type_trench   /* _22- */
                   , xx.bs_type       /* _23- */
                   );

            UPDATE SJM0JM  ff
               SET del_yn             = '1'
                 , gongs_dw_jusu      = xx.jusu
                 , gongs_dw_chui_aek  = xx.aek
             WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
               AND ymd         = p_ymd
               AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
        else
            if  xx.woos_ilban_gb = '0'  then
                w_hab_per       := p_hab_ilban_rt * 100;
                w_hab_jusu      := trunc (xx.jusu * p_hab_ilban_rt);
                w_hab_gyoub_aek := p_hab_ilban_aek;
                w_jm_cd         := p_jm_cd1;
            else
                w_hab_per       := p_hab_woos_rt * 100;
                w_hab_jusu      := trunc (xx.jusu * p_hab_woos_rt);
                w_hab_gyoub_aek := p_hab_woos_aek;
                w_jm_cd         := p_jm_cd2;
            end if;

            INSERT INTO SJT0H1 ff
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd            /* _2-합병기일 */
                   , p_tr_cd          /* _3-거래코드 */
                   , p_hab_co         /* _4-합병회사 */
                   , p_pi_hab_co      /* _5-피합병회사 */
                   , xx.fund_cd       /* _6-펀드코드 */
                   , xx.jm_cd         /* _7-피합병종목코드 */
                   , w_jm_cd          /* _8-합병종목코드 */
                   , xx.jusu          /* _9-보유주수 */
                   , xx.aek           /* _10-취득액 */
                   , w_hab_per        /* _11- */
                   , w_hab_jusu       /* _12-합병주수 */
                   , xx.aek           /* _13-합병취득액 */
                   , w_hab_gyoub_aek  /* _14-합병교부금 */
                   , NULL             /* _15- */
                   , NULL             /* _16- */
                   , NULL             /* _17- */
                   , NULL             /* _18- */
                   , NULL             /* _19- */
                   , NULL             /* _20- */
                   , NULL             /* _21- */
                   , xx.type_trench   /* _22- */
                   , xx.bs_type       /* _23- */
                   );

            UPDATE SJM0JM  ff
               SET del_yn             = '1'
                 , gongs_dw_jusu      = xx.jusu
                 , gongs_dw_chui_aek  = xx.aek
             WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
               AND ymd         = p_ymd
               AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
        end if;
    end loop;

    if (p_hab_co != p_pi_hab_co) And (p_tr_cd != 'G43') then    -- 합병시 주식종목 삭제
        UPDATE SJM0JJ  ff
           SET del_yn = '1'
         WHERE balh_co = p_pi_hab_co;
    end if;

    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC031Q (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,     /* 상장일 */
    p_balh_co                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_old_jm_cd                    IN    VARCHAR,  /* from종목 */
    p_new_jm_cd                    IN    VARCHAR,  /* to  종목 */
    p_jonga                        IN    NUMBER,   /* 분할상장시 취득가액 변경처리(변경상장일 종가로) */
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
    -- 상장공시
    -- 주식마스터 생성
    --
    w_balh_co                      sjm0jm.balh_co%type;
    w_woos_ilban_gb                sjm0jm.woos_ilban_gb%type;
    w_chg_gb                       sjm0jm.chg_gb%type;
    w_new_old_gb                   sjm0jm.new_old_gb%type;
    w_danc_gb                      sjm0jm.danc_gb%type;
    w_koscom_cd                    sjm0jm.koscom_cd%type;

    w_aek                          NUMBER;

    w_brok_ymd                     DATE; -- 배당기산일

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    if  p_old_jm_cd LIKE 'KRY%' then    -- 배당주식 수령처리 없이 상장시 수령일자 처리
        SELECT MAX(brok_ymd)
          INTO w_brok_ymd
          FROM SJT0BK t1  /* 발행기관별 배당권리 내역 */
         WHERE balh_co = p_balh_co
           AND corp_gr IN (p_corp_gr, '%');
    end if;

    -- 주식마스터 Select (from종목)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                      /* _1- */
             , t1.type_trench                                                  /* _2- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                      /* _3- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.gongs_up_jusu,0)     AS jusu  /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0)  AS aek   /* _5- */
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd                 = p_old_jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        -- 당일 주수보정분 반영(무상주 보정은 금액반영 안함)
        SELECT xx.jusu + NVL(SUM(NVL(sury_aek,0) - NVL(hwakj_aek,0)),0)
             , xx.aek + NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN t1.tr_cd='F19' THEN 0
                                                         ELSE danga
                                END),0) * (NVL(SUM(NVL(sury_aek,0) - NVL(hwakj_aek,0)),0))
          INTO xx.jusu
             , xx.aek
          FROM SJT0FS t1  /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd       = p_old_jm_cd
           AND t1.tr_cd       IN ('F12','F17','F19','F31','F34','F36','F42','F47')
           AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
           AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type;

        -- 상장 종목코드 Find
        BEGIN
            SELECT balh_co        /* _1- */
                 , woos_ilban_gb  /* _2- */
                 , chg_gb         /* _3- */
                 , new_old_gb     /* _4- */
                 , danc_gb        /* _5- */
                 , koscom_cd      /* _6- */
              INTO w_balh_co        /* _1- */
                 , w_woos_ilban_gb  /* _2- */
                 , w_chg_gb         /* _3- */
                 , w_new_old_gb     /* _4- */
                 , w_danc_gb        /* _5- */
                 , w_koscom_cd      /* _6- */
              FROM SJM0JJ t1        /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE jm_cd = p_new_jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := p_new_jm_cd || '-상장종목을 찾을 수 없습니다';
            RETURN;
        END;

        if NVL (p_jonga,0) = 0      then
                w_aek := xx.aek;
        else    w_aek := xx.jusu * p_jonga;
        end if;

        if  w_danc_gb = 'X'     then    w_aek := 0;               -- 신주인수권 취득가 0
        elsif w_danc_gb = 'T'   then    w_aek := w_aek + xx.aek;  -- 신주인수권 장내취득시 취득가액 포함
        end if;

        -- 상장 주식마스터 생성
        MERGE INTO SJM0JM tt  /* 주식 보유현황 */
           USING DUAL  ON ( corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                        AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
                        AND jm_cd       = p_new_jm_cd
                        AND ymd         = p_ymd
                        AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
                        AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET gongs_up_jusu     = NVL(gongs_up_jusu,0) + xx.jusu
                  , gongs_up_chui_aek = NVL(gongs_up_chui_aek,0) + w_aek
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT ( corp_gr            /* _1- */
                    , ymd                /* _2- */
                    , fund_cd            /* _3- */
                    , jm_cd              /* _4- */
                    , gongs_up_jusu      /* _5- */
                    , gongs_up_chui_aek  /* _6- */
                    , balh_co            /* _7- */
                    , woos_ilban_gb      /* _8- */
                    , chg_gb             /* _9- */
                    , new_old_gb         /* _10- */
                    , danc_gb            /* _11- */
                    , koscom_cd          /* _12- */
                    , lock_jusu          /* _13- */
                    , type_trench        /* _14- */
                    , bs_type            /* _15- */
                    )
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd            /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd       /* _3- */
                    , p_new_jm_cd      /* _4- */
                    , xx.jusu          /* _5- */
                    , w_aek            /* _6- */
                    , w_balh_co        /* _7- */
                    , w_woos_ilban_gb  /* _8- */
                    , w_chg_gb         /* _9- */
                    , w_new_old_gb     /* _10- */
                    , w_danc_gb        /* _11- */
                    , w_koscom_cd      /* _12- */
                    , NULL             /* _13- */
                    , xx.type_trench   /* _14- */
                    , xx.bs_type       /* _15- */
                    );

        -- 주식 취득액 변경 테이블 종목정보 수정
        BEGIN
            UPDATE SJM0JM_CHUI /* 주식 보유현황 */
               SET JM_CD = p_new_jm_cd
             WHERE CORP_GR     = p_corp_gr
               AND FUND_CD     = xx.fund_cd
               AND JM_CD       = p_old_jm_cd
               AND YMD         = p_ymd
               AND TYPE_TRENCH = xx.type_trench
               AND BS_TYPE     = xx.bs_type;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;

        -- 미상장 주식종목/주식마스터 삭제
        BEGIN
            UPDATE SJM0JM tt   /* 주식 보유현황 */
               SET del_yn            = '1'
                 , gongs_dw_jusu     = xx.jusu
                 , gongs_dw_chui_aek = xx.aek
             WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd       = p_old_jm_cd
               AND ymd         = p_ymd
               AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := p_old_jm_cd || '-미상장종목 sjhp552 명세(sjm0jm = others) UPDATE 오류';
            RETURN;
        END;

        if  w_brok_ymd IS NOT NULL  then    -- 배당주식 수령처리 없이 상장 처리
            UPDATE SJT0BM tt   /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
               SET sury_ymd    = p_ymd
                 , sury_ju_aek = xx.jusu
                 , sury_set    = 'A'
             WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND new_jm_cd   = p_old_jm_cd
               AND ymd         = w_brok_ymd
               AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type
               AND balh_co     = p_balh_co
               AND sury_ymd IS NULL;
        end if;
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC031R (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_old_jm_cd                    IN    VARCHAR,
    p_new_jm_cd                    IN    VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 배당대장 조정
--
    w_old_jm_cd                    sjm0jj.jm_cd%type;
    w_new_jm_cd                    sjm0jj.jm_cd%type;
BEGIN
    -- 배당대장 Select
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.*
             , t1.rowid
          FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.old_jm_cd             = p_old_jm_cd
           AND t1.sury_ymd IS NULL
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        w_old_jm_cd := p_new_jm_cd;
        if  xx.old_jm_cd != xx.new_jm_cd    then
                w_new_jm_cd := xx.new_jm_cd;
        else    w_new_jm_cd := w_old_jm_cd;
        end if;
        --------------------------------------------------------
        --      배당대장 Update
        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- 변경전 종목 삭제처리
        UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
           SET del_yn        = '1'
             , del_ymd       = p_ymd
             , old_jm_cd_553 = w_old_jm_cd
             , new_jm_cd_553 = w_new_jm_cd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        MERGE INTO SJT0BM tt  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
           USING DUAL ON ( corp_gr             = p_corp_gr
                       AND fund_cd             = xx.fund_cd
                       AND old_jm_cd           = w_old_jm_cd
                       AND ymd                 = xx.ymd
                       AND balh_co             = SUBSTR(w_new_jm_cd,4,5)
                       AND new_jm_cd           = w_new_jm_cd
                       AND type_trench         = xx.type_trench
                       AND bs_type             = xx.bs_type
                       AND NVL(haeji_fund,'x') = NVL(xx.haeji_fund,'x') )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET boyu_jusu     = NVL(boyu_jusu,0) + xx.boyu_jusu
                  , boyu_chui_aek = NVL(boyu_chui_aek,0) + xx.boyu_chui_aek
                  , brok_jusu     = NVL(brok_jusu,0) + xx.brok_jusu
                  , yesa_jusu     = NVL(yesa_jusu,0) + xx.yesa_jusu
                  , yesa_aek      = NVL(yesa_aek,0) + xx.yesa_aek
                  , hwakj_jusu    = NVL(hwakj_jusu,0) + xx.hwakj_jusu
                  , hwakj_aek     = NVL(hwakj_aek,0) + xx.hwakj_aek
                  , juchong_jusu  = NVL(juchong_jusu,0) + xx.juchong_jusu
                  , juchong_aek   = NVL(juchong_aek,0) + xx.juchong_aek
                  , yesa_tax      = NVL(yesa_tax,0) + xx.yesa_tax
                  , hwakj_tax     = NVL(hwakj_tax,0) + xx.hwakj_tax
                  , juchong_tax   = NVL(juchong_tax,0) + xx.juchong_tax
                  , sury_ju_tax   = NVL(sury_ju_tax,0) + xx.sury_ju_tax
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                /* _1- */
                    , xx.ymd                   /* _2- */
                    , SUBSTR(w_new_jm_cd,4,5)  /* _3- */
                    , xx.fund_cd               /* _4- */
                    , w_old_jm_cd              /* _5- */
                    , w_new_jm_cd              /* _6- */
                    , xx.boyu_jusu             /* _7- */
                    , xx.boyu_chui_aek         /* _8- */
                    , xx.baed_bu_ilsu          /* _9- */
                    , xx.brok_jusu             /* _10- */
                    , xx.yesa_jusu             /* _11- */
                    , xx.danga                 /* _12- */
                    , xx.yesa_aek              /* _13- */
                    , xx.hwakj_ymd             /* _14- */
                    , xx.hwakj_jusu            /* _15- */
                    , xx.hwakj_aek             /* _16- */
                    , xx.juchong_ymd           /* _17- */
                    , xx.juchong_jusu          /* _18- */
                    , xx.juchong_aek           /* _19- */
                    , NULL                     /* _20- */
                    , NULL                     /* _21- */
                    , '2'                      /* _22- */
                    , NULL                     /* _23- */
                    , xx.haeji_fund            /* _24- */
                    , xx.haeji_ymd             /* _25- */
                    , NULL                     /* _26- */
                    , NULL                     /* _27- */
                    , NULL                     /* _28- */
                    , xx.type_trench           /* _29- */
                    , xx.bs_type               /* _30- */
                    , xx.yesa_tax              /* _31- */
                    , xx.hwakj_tax             /* _32- */
                    , xx.juchong_tax           /* _33- */
                    , xx.sury_ju_tax           /* _34- */
                    );
    end loop;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0320 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 공시분개
--
    w_fst_seolj_ymd                DATE;
    w_af_gyul_ymd                  DATE;
    w_haeji_able_ymd               DATE;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0320', p_ymd || ' : 공시처리 분개 Main');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B000', 'skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0bu.proc_step=32', '공시관련 분개내용(skt0bu) delete');

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND proc_step = 32;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', '', '예상배당,중간배당');

    SR_PROC032A (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'G10', 32, w_msg);  /* 예상배당 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := 'SR_PROC032A-' || w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B030', '', '확정배당');

    SR_PROC032B (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'G20', 32, w_msg);  /* 확정배당 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := 'SR_PROC032B-' || w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B035', '', '주총배당');

    SR_PROC032C (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'G25', 32, w_msg);  /* 주총배당 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := 'SR_PROC032C-' || w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B040', '', '유상권리락');

    SR_PROC032D (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'G31', 32, w_msg);  /* 유상권리락 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := 'SR_PROC032D-' || w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B050', '', '유무상 비율변경');

    SR_PROC032E (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'G32', 32, w_msg);  /* 유무상 비율변경 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := 'SR_PROC032E-' || w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B060', '', 'sjhp587 실행 - 상장');

    SR_PROC032F (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 32, w_msg);  /* 상장 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := 'SR_PROC032F-' || w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B070', '', 'sjhp588 실행 - 합병, 감자');

    SR_PROC032G (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 32, w_msg);  /* 합병/감자 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := 'SR_PROC032G-' || w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    p_msg := 'Y';
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC032A (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,     /* 배당락일 */
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,  /* 거래코드 */
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 예상/중간배당 분개처리
--
    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                            /* _1- */
             , CASE t3.sosok_gb WHEN 'B' THEN '04'
                                WHEN 'C' THEN '06'
                                         ELSE '02' END  AS jasan_gb  /* _2- */
             , t1.type_trench                                        /* _3- */
             , t1.bs_type                                            /* _4- */
             , SUM(t1.yesa_aek - NVL(t1.yesa_tax,0))    AS aek       /* _5- */
          FROM SJT0BM t1
             , SZM0IA t2
             , SJX0JB t3
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                        = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.yesa_aek,0)            != 0
           AND NVL(t1.del_ymd,p_ymd + 1)  != p_ymd
           AND t1.new_jm_cd                  = t1.old_jm_cd
           AND t2.corp_gr                    = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd                    = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)       >= p_ymd
           AND t3.balh_co                    = t1.balh_co
           and not (t3.balh_co='00636' and t1.ymd='2026.3.30')
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd    
                , CASE t3.sosok_gb WHEN 'B' THEN '04'
                                   WHEN 'C' THEN '06' ELSE '02' END
                , t1.type_trench
                , t1.bs_type
    ) loop
        if  xx.bs_type = -1 then
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', '-', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.bs_type, xx.jasan_gb, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032A', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.bs_type, xx.jasan_gb, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032A', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                            /* _1- */
             , t1.new_jm_cd                                          /* _2- */
             , CASE t3.sosok_gb WHEN 'B' THEN '03'
                                WHEN 'C' THEN '05'
                                         ELSE '01' END  AS jasan_gb  /* _3- */
             , t1.type_trench                                        /* _4- */
             , t1.bs_type                                            /* _5- */
             , SUM(t1.yesa_aek)                         AS aek       /* _6- */
          FROM SJT0BM t1
             , SZM0IA t2
             , SJX0JB t3
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                        = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.yesa_aek,0)            != 0
           AND NVL(t1.del_ymd,'2999-12-31')  != p_ymd
           AND t1.new_jm_cd                  != t1.old_jm_cd
           AND t2.corp_gr                    = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd                    = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)       >= p_ymd
           AND t3.balh_co                    = t1.balh_co
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd    
                , t1.new_jm_cd  
                , CASE t3.sosok_gb WHEN 'B' THEN '03'
                                   WHEN 'C' THEN '05' ELSE '01' END
                , t1.type_trench
                , t1.bs_type
    ) loop
        if  xx.bs_type = -1 then
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', '-', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.new_jm_cd, xx.jasan_gb, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032A', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.new_jm_cd, xx.jasan_gb, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032A', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC032B (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 확정배당 분개처리
--
    w_jasan_gb                   szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;
    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                /* _1- */
             , CASE WHEN t1.new_jm_cd=t1.old_jm_cd THEN 1
                                                   ELSE 2 END  AS seq    /* _2- */
             , t1.new_jm_cd                                              /* _3- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                /* _4- */
             , jb.sosok_gb                                     AS sosok  /* _5- */
             , ia.mg_cd                                                  /* _6- */
             , SUM(NVL(t1.hwakj_aek,0) - NVL(t1.yesa_aek,0)
                                       - (NVL(t1.hwakj_tax,0)
                                       - NVL(t1.yesa_tax,0)))  AS aek    /* _7-배당금차이 */
          FROM SJT0BM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SJX0JB jb
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.del_yn,'2')       = '2'
           AND t1.hwakj_ymd             = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
           AND jb.balh_co               = t1.balh_co
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd  
                , CASE WHEN t1.new_jm_cd=t1.old_jm_cd THEN 1
                                                      ELSE 2 END
                , t1.new_jm_cd, t1.bs_type, jb.sosok_gb, ia.mg_cd
         HAVING SUM(NVL(t1.hwakj_aek,0) - NVL(t1.yesa_aek,0)) != 0
    ) loop
        if NVL (xx.aek,0) >= 0  then
            if  xx.seq = 1  then    -- 현금배당
                if  xx.sosok = 'B'      then    w_jasan_gb  := '04';    -- 비상장
                elsif xx.sosok = 'C'    then    w_jasan_gb  := '06';    -- 등록
                else                            w_jasan_gb  := '02';    -- 상장
                end if;
            else            -- 주식배당
                if  xx.sosok = 'B'      then    w_jasan_gb  := '03';    -- 비상장
                elsif xx.sosok = 'C'    then    w_jasan_gb  := '05';    -- 등록
                else                            w_jasan_gb  := '01';    -- 상장
                end if;
            end if;
        else
            if  xx.seq = 1  then    -- 현금배당
                if  xx.sosok = 'B'      then    w_jasan_gb  := '14';    -- 비상장
                elsif xx.sosok = 'C'    then    w_jasan_gb  := '16';    -- 등록
                else                            w_jasan_gb  := '12';    -- 상장
                end if;
            else            -- 주식배당
                if  xx.sosok = 'B'      then    w_jasan_gb  := '13';    -- 비상장
                elsif xx.sosok = 'C'    then    w_jasan_gb  := '15';    -- 등록
                else                            w_jasan_gb  := '11';    -- 상장
                end if;
            end if;
            xx.aek  := xx.aek * -1;
        end if;

        if  xx.bs_type = -1 then
                SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', '-', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.new_jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032B', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.new_jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032B', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC032C (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 주총배당 분개처리
--
    w_jasan_gb                   szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                  /* _1- */
             , CASE WHEN t1.new_jm_cd=t1.old_jm_cd THEN 1
                                                   ELSE 2
               END                               AS seq    /* _2- */
             , t1.new_jm_cd                                /* _3- */
             , t1.bs_type                                  /* _4- */
             , jb.sosok_gb                       AS sosok  /* _5- */
             , ia.mg_cd                                    /* _6- */
             , SUM(NVL(t1.juchong_aek,0) - NVL(t1.juchong_tax,0)
                                         - CASE WHEN t1.hwakj_ymd IS NULL
                                                THEN NVL(t1.yesa_aek,0) - NVL(t1.yesa_tax,0)
                                                ELSE NVL(t1.hwakj_aek,0) - NVL(t1.hwakj_tax,0)
                                           END)  AS aek    /* _7-배당금차이 */
          FROM SJT0BM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SJX0JB jb
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND NVL(t1.del_yn,'2')       = '2'
           AND t1.juchong_ymd           = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
           AND jb.balh_co               = t1.balh_co
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd  
                , CASE WHEN t1.new_jm_cd=t1.old_jm_cd
                       THEN 1
                       ELSE 2 END
                , t1.new_jm_cd, t1.bs_type, jb.sosok_gb, ia.mg_cd
         HAVING SUM(NVL(t1.juchong_aek,0) - CASE WHEN t1.hwakj_ymd IS NULL
                            THEN NVL(t1.yesa_aek,0)
                            ELSE NVL(t1.hwakj_aek,0)
                       END) != 0
    ) loop
        if NVL (xx.aek,0) >= 0  then
            if  xx.seq = 1  then    -- 현금배당
                if  xx.sosok = 'B'      then    w_jasan_gb  := '04';    -- 비상장
                elsif xx.sosok = 'C'    then    w_jasan_gb  := '06';    -- 등록
                else                            w_jasan_gb  := '02';    -- 상장
                end if;
            else            -- 주식배당
                if  xx.sosok = 'B'      then    w_jasan_gb  := '03';    -- 비상장
                elsif xx.sosok = 'C'    then    w_jasan_gb  := '05';    -- 등록
                else                            w_jasan_gb  := '01';    -- 상장
                end if;
            end if;
        else
            if  xx.seq = 1  then    -- 현금배당
                if  xx.sosok = 'B'      then    w_jasan_gb  := '14';    -- 비상장
                elsif xx.sosok = 'C'    then    w_jasan_gb  := '16';    -- 등록
                else                            w_jasan_gb  := '12';    -- 상장
                end if;
            else            -- 주식배당
                if  xx.sosok = 'B'      then    w_jasan_gb  := '13';    -- 비상장
                elsif xx.sosok = 'C'    then    w_jasan_gb  := '15';    -- 등록
                else                            w_jasan_gb  := '11';    -- 상장
                end if;
            end if;
            xx.aek  := xx.aek * -1;
        end if;
        if  xx.bs_type = -1 then
                SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', '-', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.new_jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032C', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.new_jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032C', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC032D (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,     /* 권리락일 */
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,  /* 거래구분 */
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 유상권리락 분개처리
--
    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT j1.fund_cd                                            /* _1- */
             , j1.old_jm_cd                                          /* _2- */
             , CASE jb.sosok_gb WHEN 'B' THEN '01'
                                WHEN 'C' THEN '02'
                                         ELSE '00' END  AS jasan_gb  /* _3- */
             , SUM(j1.chui_aek)                         AS aek       /* _4- */
          FROM SJT0JK t1
             , SJT0J1 j1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SJX0JB jb
         WHERE t1.tr_cd                 = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.jeungj_mth            = '1'
           AND j1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND j1.ymd                   = t1.krak_ymd
           AND j1.balh_co               = t1.balh_co
           AND ia.corp_gr               = j1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = j1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
           AND jb.balh_co               = j1.balh_co
         GROUP BY j1.fund_cd  
                , j1.old_jm_cd
                , CASE jb.sosok_gb WHEN 'B' THEN '01'
                                   WHEN 'C' THEN '02' ELSE '00' END
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.old_jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032D', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC032E (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,     /* 권리락일 */
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,  /* 거래구분 */
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 유상배정 비율 및 발행가변경 분개처리(신주인수권 포함)
--
    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -- 신주인수권 매입분 발행가 변경처리키 위해 sjt0j1 -> sjm0jm 으로 변경 20210608 yjs
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , t1.jm_cd
             , jb.sosok_gb
             , SUM(NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0))  AS aek
          FROM SJM0JM t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SJX0JB jb
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd                 LIKE 'KRT%'
           AND t1.balh_co               IN (SELECT balh_co
                                              FROM SJT0JK ta
                                             WHERE ta.tr_cd  = 'G32'
                                               AND ta.tr_ymd = p_ymd)
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
           AND jb.balh_co               = t1.balh_co
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd 
                , t1.jm_cd   
                , jb.sosok_gb
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.sosok_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032E', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    -- 신주인수권 대장 select
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , t1.jm_cd
             , jb.sosok_gb
             , SUM((NVL(t1.balh_ga,0) - NVL(t1.chg_bf_balh_ga,0)) * t1.tr_jusu)  AS chui_aek
          FROM SJT5J1 t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SJX0JB jb
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.gosi_jekyng_ymd       = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
           AND jb.balh_co               = t1.balh_co
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd 
                , t1.jm_cd   
                , jb.sosok_gb
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.sosok_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.chui_aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032E', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC032F (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,  /* 배당락일 */
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 상장공시 분개처리
--
    w_jasan_gb                   szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;
    w_old_danc_gb                sjm0jm.danc_gb%type;
    w_new_danc_gb                sjm0jm.danc_gb%type;
    w_cy_type                    sjt0fs.cy_type%type;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -- 공모주는 추가납입/환불시 자기 소속으로 분개하므로 상장시 분개 제외 20180807 yjs
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.balh_co                                                          /* _1- */
             , t1.old_jm_cd                                                        /* _2- */
             , t1.old_danc_gb || t1.new_danc_gb                       AS jasan_gb  /* _3- */
             , jm.fund_cd                                                          /* _4- */
             , NVL(jm.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(jm.gongs_up_chui_aek,0)  AS aek       /* _5- */
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ia.fund_cd
                                      ORDER BY ia.fund_cd)            AS seq       /* _6- */
          FROM SJT0SK t1
             , SJM0JM jm
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.tr_cd                 = 'G00'
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND jm.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND jm.ymd                   = t1.tr_ymd
           AND jm.jm_cd                 = t1.old_jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = jm.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = jm.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
         ORDER BY fund_cd  
                , old_jm_cd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'G00', 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                    xx.old_jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032F -' || xx.jasan_gb || xx.old_jm_cd, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    -- 공모주는 추가납입/환불시 자기 소속으로 분개하므로 상장시 분개 제외 20180807 yjs
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT tr_cd                                            /* _1- */
             , balh_co                                          /* _2- */
             , old_jm_cd                                        /* _3- */
             , new_jm_cd                                        /* _4- */
             , fund_cd                                          /* _5- */
             , jonga                                            /* _6- */
             , aek                                              /* _7- */
             , bfil_aek                                         /* _8- */
             , jonga_aek                                        /* _9- */
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fund_cd
                                      ORDER BY fund_cd)  AS seq /* _10- */
             , old_danc_gb                                      /* _11-소속기관은 sjt0sk 입력 소속을 사용 */
             , new_danc_gb                                      /* _12- */
          FROM (SELECT t1.tr_cd                                                                       /* _1- */
                     , t1.balh_co                                                                     /* _2- */
                     , t1.old_jm_cd                                                                   /* _3- */
                     , t1.new_jm_cd                                                                   /* _4- */
                     , jm.fund_cd                                                                     /* _5- */
                     , t1.jonga                                                                       /* _6- */
                     , NVL(jm.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(jm.gongs_up_chui_aek,0)            AS aek        /* _7-당일 공시처리 반영 */
                     , NVL(jm.bfil_chui_aek,0)                                          AS bfil_aek   /* _8-전일금액 */
                     , (NVL(jm.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(jm.gongs_up_jusu,0)) * t1.jonga  AS jonga_aek  /* _9- */
                     , t1.old_danc_gb                                                                 /* _10- */
                     , t1.new_danc_gb                                                                 /* _11- */
                  FROM SJT0SK t1
                     , SJM0JM jm
                     , SZM0IA ia
                 WHERE t1.tr_cd                  != 'G00'
                   AND t1.tr_ymd                 = p_ymd
                   AND SUBSTR(t1.old_jm_cd,1,3)  != 'KRU'
                   AND jm.corp_gr                = p_corp_gr
                   AND jm.ymd                    = t1.tr_ymd
                   AND jm.jm_cd                  = t1.old_jm_cd
                   AND ia.corp_gr                = jm.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd                = jm.fund_cd
                   AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)   >= p_ymd
                UNION ALL
                SELECT t1.tr_cd                                               /* _1- */
                     , t1.balh_co                                             /* _2- */
                     , jj.jm_cd                                               /* _3- */
                     , t1.jm_cd                                               /* _4- */
                     , jm.fund_cd                                             /* _5- */
                     , 0                                                      /* _6- */
                     , NVL(jm.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(jm.gongs_up_chui_aek,0)  /* _7- */
                     , 0                                                      /* _8- */
                     , 0                                                      /* _9- */
                     , NULL                                                   /* _10- */
                     , NULL                                                   /* _11- */
                  FROM SJT0JL t1
                     , SJM0JM jm
                     , SZM0IA ia
                     , SJM0JJ jj
                 WHERE t1.tr_cd                 = 'G55'
                   AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
                   AND jm.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
                   AND jm.ymd                   = t1.tr_ymd
                   AND ia.corp_gr               = jm.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd               = jm.fund_cd
                   AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
                   AND jj.danc_gb               = 'T'
                   AND jj.jm_cd                 = jm.jm_cd
                   AND jj.balh_co               = t1.balh_co
                ) tt 
         ORDER BY tr_cd    
                , fund_cd  
                , old_jm_cd
                , new_jm_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
        SELECT cy_type
          INTO w_cy_type
          FROM SJT0FS t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'F47'
           AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.old_jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            w_cy_type   := '0';
        END;

        if  xx.tr_cd = 'G55'    then
        BEGIN
            SELECT t1.danc_gb
              INTO w_old_danc_gb
              FROM SJM0JJ t1
             WHERE t1.jm_cd = xx.old_jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                p_msg   := xx.old_jm_cd || ' - 구종목이 없습니다.';
                RETURN;
        END;

            BEGIN
                SELECT t1.danc_gb
                  INTO w_new_danc_gb
                  FROM SJM0JJ t1
                 WHERE t1.jm_cd = xx.new_jm_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                p_msg   := xx.new_jm_cd || ' - 신종목이 없습니다.';
                RETURN;
            END;
        else
            w_old_danc_gb   := xx.old_danc_gb;
            w_new_danc_gb   := xx.new_danc_gb;
        end if;

        if  w_cy_type = 'A'     then    ----실권주 청약일 경우, 발행기관 소속을 따름
                w_jasan_gb  := w_new_danc_gb || w_new_danc_gb;
        else    w_jasan_gb  := w_new_danc_gb || w_old_danc_gb;
        end if;

        if  xx.tr_cd = 'G54'    then
            SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.new_jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.jonga_aek, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032F', w_msg);

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'G52'      then    -- 추가상장시 20090522,yjs
            if  w_jasan_gb IN ('AA','BB','CC','DD') then
                    NULL;   -- 동일계정분개는 생략
            else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.new_jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032F', w_msg);
            end if;

        -- 신주인수권 코드변경시
        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'G55' AND SUBSTR (xx.new_jm_cd,1,3) = 'KRA'        then
            SELECT sosok_gb
              INTO w_jasan_gb
              FROM SJX0JB t1
             WHERE t1.balh_co = xx.balh_co;

            -- 증자대장 청약일
            UPDATE SJT0J1 ff  
               SET cheng_ymd = p_ymd -1
             WHERE corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
               AND new_jm_cd = xx.old_jm_cd
               AND ymd       >= p_ymd - 90
               AND balh_co   = xx.balh_co;

            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.new_jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032F', w_msg);

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'G55' AND SUBSTR (xx.new_jm_cd,1,3) = 'KRT'        then
            SELECT sosok_gb
              INTO w_jasan_gb
              FROM SJX0JB t1
             WHERE t1.balh_co = xx.balh_co;

            -- 증자대장 청약일
            UPDATE SJT0J1 ff  
               SET cheng_ymd = p_ymd -1
             WHERE corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
               AND new_jm_cd = xx.old_jm_cd
               AND ymd       >= p_ymd - 90
               AND balh_co   = xx.balh_co;

            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.new_jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032F', w_msg);
        else
            if  w_jasan_gb IN ('AA','BB','CC','DD','AW','CW')   then    ---전환신주는 미리 본 소속으로 들어가있으므로 AW, CW 포함
                    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                                xx.new_jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032F -' || w_jasan_gb || xx.old_jm_cd, w_msg);
            elsif w_jasan_gb IN ('CD','CA','AC','AD','DA','DC') AND xx.bfil_aek = 0 then    -- 종목코드 변경없이 소속시장 변경시 전일자 보유가 없으면 pass
                    CONTINUE;
            else
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                            xx.new_jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032F -' || w_jasan_gb, w_msg);
            end if;

            if  xx.tr_cd = 'G51'    then    ----공모주 상장일에 소속구분 변경
                UPDATE SJX0JB t1  
                   SET sosok_gb = CASE WHEN w_new_danc_gb='A' THEN '1' ELSE w_new_danc_gb END
                 WHERE balh_co = xx.balh_co;

                UPDATE SJM0JJ t2  /* >코스닥등 */
                   SET danc_gb = xx.new_danc_gb
                 WHERE jm_cd   = xx.new_jm_cd
                   AND balh_co = xx.balh_co;

                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO SJX0JB_HISTORY ff  
                    VALUES ( xx.balh_co       /* _1- */
                           , p_ymd            /* _2- */
                           , 'sosok_gb'       /* _3- */
                           , w_old_danc_gb    /* _4- */
                           , w_new_danc_gb    /* _5- */
                           , 'PROC032F(G51)'  /* _6- */
                           , 'N'              /* _7- */
                           );
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    CONTINUE;
                END;
            end if;
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    -- 신주인수권 상장폐지에 따른 미지급주식납입금 처리
    -- 미지급주식납입금은 발생가로 계산(장내 신주인수권 매수시 매수가는 취득액에 포함)
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.jm_cd                                                  /* _1- */
             , jm.fund_cd                                                /* _2- */
             , 'R' || jb.sosok_gb                           AS jasan_gb  /* _3- */
             , NVL(jm.gongs_up_jusu,0) * NVL(t1.balh_ga,0)  AS aek       /* _4- */
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY jm.fund_cd
                                      ORDER BY jm.fund_cd)  AS seq       /* _5- */
             , t1.cheng_ymd                                              /* _6- */
          FROM SJT0JL t1
             , SJM0JM jm
             , SJX0JB jb
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.tr_cd                 = 'G55'
           AND t1.close_ymd             = p_ymd
           AND jm.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND jm.ymd                   = p_ymd
           AND jm.jm_cd                 = t1.jm_cd
           AND jm.balh_co               = t1.balh_co
           AND jb.balh_co               = jm.balh_co
           AND ia.corp_gr               = jm.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = jm.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'G55', 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032F_2', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
        -- 증자대장 청약일 변경 (마스터에 반영)
        UPDATE SJT0J1 ff  
           SET cheng_ymd = xx.cheng_ymd
         WHERE corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND new_jm_cd = xx.jm_cd
           AND ymd       >= p_ymd - 90;
    END LOOP;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    p_msg   := 'PROC032F:' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC032G (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,  /* 배당락일 */
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 합병/감자/유상소각 분개처리
--
    w_jasan_gb                   szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;
    w_old_sosok_gb               sjx0jb.sosok_gb%type;
    w_new_sosok_gb               sjx0jb.sosok_gb%type;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd          /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd        /* _2- */
             , t1.old_jm_cd      /* _3-피합병회사종목 */
             , t1.new_jm_cd      /* _4-합병회사종목 */
             , t1.hab_co         /* _5-합병회사 */
             , t1.chui_aek       /* _6-취득액 */
             , t1.hab_gyoub_aek  /* _7-합병교부금 */
          FROM SJT0H1 t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd                 IN ('G40','G45')
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_cd    
                , t1.fund_cd  
                , t1.old_jm_cd
                , t1.new_jm_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT t2.sosok_gb
              INTO w_old_sosok_gb
              FROM SJM0JJ t1
                 , SJX0JB t2
             WHERE t1.jm_cd   = xx.old_jm_cd
               AND t2.balh_co = t1.balh_co;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            p_msg   := xx.old_jm_cd || '-피합병/감자회사종목이 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;
        BEGIN
            SELECT t2.sosok_gb
              INTO w_new_sosok_gb
              FROM SJM0JJ t1
                 , SJX0JB t2
             WHERE t1.jm_cd   = xx.new_jm_cd
               AND t2.balh_co = t1.balh_co;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            p_msg   := xx.new_jm_cd || '-합병/감자회사가 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        if  xx.tr_cd = 'G40'    then
                w_jasan_gb  := w_new_sosok_gb || w_old_sosok_gb;    -- 합병
        else    w_jasan_gb  := w_old_sosok_gb;  -- 감자
        end if;

        SR_SZSL022 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                    xx.new_jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.chui_aek, xx.hab_gyoub_aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032G', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    -- 부분분할합병 분개처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd         /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd       /* _2- */
             , t1.old_jm_cd     /* _3- */
             , t1.new_jm_cd     /* _4- */
             , t1.chui_aek      /* _5- */
             , t1.hab_chui_aek  /* _6- */
          FROM SJT0H1 t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'G43'
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_cd    
                , t1.fund_cd  
                , t1.old_jm_cd
                , t1.new_jm_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT t2.sosok_gb
              INTO w_old_sosok_gb
              FROM SJM0JJ t1
                 , SJX0JB t2
             WHERE t1.jm_cd   = xx.old_jm_cd
               AND t2.balh_co = t1.balh_co;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            p_msg   := xx.old_jm_cd || '-부분분할회사종목이 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;
        BEGIN
            SELECT t2.sosok_gb
              INTO w_new_sosok_gb
              FROM SJM0JJ t1
                 , SJX0JB t2
             WHERE t1.jm_cd   = xx.new_jm_cd
               AND t2.balh_co = t1.balh_co;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            p_msg   := xx.new_jm_cd || '-부분분할회사종목이 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_new_sosok_gb || w_old_sosok_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                    xx.new_jm_cd, 2, 1, xx.hab_chui_aek, xx.chui_aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032G', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd          /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd        /* _2- */
             , t1.old_jm_cd      /* _3- */
             , t1.hab_chui_aek   /* _4- */
             , t1.hab_gyoub_aek  /* _5- */
          FROM SJT0H1 t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'G47'
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd,p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_cd    
                , t1.fund_cd  
                , t1.old_jm_cd
                , t1.new_jm_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT t2.sosok_gb
              INTO w_old_sosok_gb
              FROM SJM0JJ t1
                 , SJX0JB t2
             WHERE t1.jm_cd   = xx.old_jm_cd
               AND t2.balh_co = t1.balh_co;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            p_msg   := xx.old_jm_cd || '-유상소각회사종목이 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;
        -- 자산구분
        if  w_old_sosok_gb = 'B'    then    w_jasan_gb  := '01';
        elsif w_old_sosok_gb = 'C'  then    w_jasan_gb  := '02';
        elsif w_old_sosok_gb = 'D'  then    w_jasan_gb  := '03';
        else                                w_jasan_gb  := '00';
        end if;

        SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                    xx.old_jm_cd, 3, 1, xx.hab_gyoub_aek, xx.hab_chui_aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC032G', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0400 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 자문 신규(재)계약
--
    w_wonbon_aek                   NUMBER;
    w_re_aek                       NUMBER;

    w_gigan_jan                    NUMBER;
    w_cnt                          NUMBER;

    w_aek                          number_varray_50;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0400', p_ymd || ' : 자문계약 처리');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B000', 'skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0bu.proc_step=40', '계약분개자료 삭제');

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU ff   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND proc_step = 40;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0400', p_ymd || ' : (재)계약처리');

    -- 결산내역에 따른 입출내역 생성
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , t1.re_wonbon_aek  AS aek
          FROM SKT0GS t1  /* 결산실적 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.gyul_ymd = p_ymd - 1
    ) loop
        if  p_ymd > ADD_MONTHS (now ( ), -1) then
            SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B001', 'szt0io.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd, xx.fund_cd || ' - 결산 원본 (재)계약금액 재생성용 삭제처리');
            DELETE FROM SZT0IO  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
             WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
               AND FUND_CD = xx.fund_cd
               AND TR_YMD  = p_ymd
               AND MOD_DT IS NULL;
        else
            SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B001', TO_CHAR (p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || ' > ' || TO_CHAR (ADD_MONTHS (now ( ), -1), 'yyyy.mm.dd'), '* 1개월전 작업시 삭제처리 PASS');
        end if;

        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SZT0IO  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr   /* _1- */
                   , xx.fund_cd  /* _2- */
                   , p_ymd       /* _3- */
                   , xx.aek      /* _4- */
                   , 0           /* _5- */
                   , 0           /* _6- */
                   , 100         /* _7- */
                   , 0           /* _8- */
                   , NULL        /* _9- */
                   , NULL        /* _10- */
                   , NULL        /* _11- */
                   , NULL        /* _12- */
                   , NULL        /* _13- */
                   );

            UPDATE SZM0IA   /* 자문 계좌정보 */
               SET RE_SEOLJ_AEK = xx.aek
             WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
               AND FUND_CD = xx.fund_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            -- 화면에서 수정했을경우 PASS
            NULL;
        END;
    end loop;

    -- 신규설정좌수 존재 펀드 해당 자료가져오기
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                        /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                       /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                 /* _3- */
             , t1.wonbon_aek                   AS aek           /* _4- */
             , NVL(in_aek,0) - NVL(out_aek,0)  AS today_io_aek  /* _5- */
             , 0                               AS g10101        /* _6- */
             , 0                               AS g20301        /* _7- */
             , 0                               AS g40101        /* _8- */
             , 0                               AS g40201        /* _9- */
             , 0                               AS g40202        /* _10- */
             , 0                               AS g40211        /* _11- */
          FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd       = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr      = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd      = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.re_seolj_ymd = p_ymd
    ) loop
        SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='10101' THEN junj END),0)                                    /* _1- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='20301' THEN junj - NVL (dr_aek,0) + NVL (cr_aek,0) END),0)  /* _2- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='40201' THEN junj - NVL (dr_aek,0) + NVL (cr_aek,0) END),0)  /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='40202' THEN junj - NVL (dr_aek,0) + NVL (cr_aek,0) END),0)  /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='40211' THEN junj - NVL (dr_aek,0) + NVL (cr_aek,0) END),0)  /* _5- */
          INTO xx.g10101  /* _1- */
             , xx.g20301  /* _2- */
             , xx.g40201  /* _3- */
             , xx.g40202  /* _4- */
             , xx.g40211  /* _5- */
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok  IN ('10101','20301','40201','40202','40211');

        if  xx.g10101 = 0   then
            -- 신규설정
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A11', 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 1, 1, xx.aek, 40, 'PROC0400', w_msg);
        else
            -- 재계약
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO SZT0IO ff   /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr   /* _1- */
                       , xx.fund_cd  /* _2- */
                       , p_ymd       /* _3- */
                       , xx.aek      /* _4- */
                       , 0           /* _5- */
                       , 0           /* _6- */
                       , 100         /* _7- */
                       , 0           /* _8- */
                       , NULL        /* _9- */
                       , NULL        /* _10- */
                       , 0           /* _11- */
                       , NULL        /* _12- */
                       , NULL        /* _13- */
                       );

                UPDATE SZM0IA   /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                   SET RE_SEOLJ_AEK = xx.aek
                 WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                   AND FUND_CD = xx.fund_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                -- 화면에서 수정했을경우 반영
                NULL;
            END;

            UPDATE SKT0GS ff    /* 결산실적 */
               SET re_wonbon_aek = sun_jasan_aek - xx.today_io_aek
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND gyul_ymd = p_ymd - 1;

            if  xx.g20301 > 0   then    -- 미지급이익분배금(이익)
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Q99', 'A', '1', '10', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 1, 1, xx.g20301, 12, 'PROC0400', w_msg);

            elsif xx.g40201 != 0 OR xx.g40202 != 0 OR xx.g40211 != 0    then    -- 원본처리
                w_aek := number_varray_50 (xx.g40201, xx.g40202, xx.g40211, (xx.g40201 + xx.g40202 + xx.g40211));
                SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Q99', 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, NULL, 1, 1, w_aek, 12, 'PROC0400', w_msg);
            end if;

            SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='40101' THEN junj - NVL (dr_aek,0) + NVL (cr_aek,0) END),0)
              INTO xx.g40101
              FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
               AND t1.work_gb = 'A'
               AND t1.gwamok  = '40101';

            SR_INSBU (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A99', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', '', 1, 1, 1, 'C', '10101', xx.g40101 - xx.aek, 'A99', 40, 'PROC0400 재계약금액 수정', w_msg);
            SR_INSBU (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A99', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', '', 1, 1, 2, 'D', '40101', xx.g40101 - xx.aek, 'A99', 40, 'PROC0400 재계약금액 수정', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.FUND_CD                                                                                     /* _1- */
             , t1.IN_AEK                                                                                      /* _2- */
             , t1.OUT_AEK                                                                                     /* _3- */
             , NVL(t1.IN_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.OUT_AEK,0)                                            AS aek         /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.IO_JO,0)                                                                 AS io_jo       /* _5- */
             , ia.fUND_CURRENCY                                                                               /* _6- */
             , gi.BF_GYUL_YMD + 1                                                              AS re_seolj    /* _7- */
             , TRUNC((gi.AF_GYUL_YMD - t1.TR_YMD + 1) / (gi.AF_GYUL_YMD - gi.BF_GYUL_YMD),12)  AS gigan_rt    /* _8- */
             , gi.AF_GYUL_YMD - t1.TR_YMD + 1                                                  AS gigan_ilsu  /* _9- */
             , t1.TR_YMD - gi.BF_GYUL_YMD - 1                                                  AS ilsu        /* _10- */
             , aa.customer_gr                                                                                 /* _11- */
          FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
