             , SZX0AA aa  /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.TR_YMD  = p_ymd
           AND (t1.in_aek > 0 OR t1.out_aek > 0)
           AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR
           AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD
           AND gi.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR
           AND gi.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD
           AND p_ymd      BETWEEN (gi.BF_GYUL_YMD + 1) AND gi.AF_GYUL_YMD
           AND aa.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR
    ) loop
        -- 재계약금액
        BEGIN
            SELECT WONBON_AEK
              INTO w_wonbon_aek
              FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd  = xx.re_seolj;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_wonbon_aek := 0;
        END;
        if  xx.re_seolj = p_ymd then
            -- 결산일 재계약금 처리
            BEGIN
                SELECT t1.re_wonbon_aek
                  INTO w_re_aek
                  FROM SKT0GS t1  /* 결산실적 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.gyul_ymd = p_ymd - 1;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                w_re_aek := 0;
            END;

            SELECT w_re_aek + NVL(t1.in_aek,0) - NVL(t1.out_aek,0)
                 , w_re_aek + NVL(t1.in_aek,0) - NVL(t1.out_aek,0)
              INTO w_wonbon_aek
                 , w_gigan_jan
              FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd;
        else
            SELECT w_wonbon_aek + NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.in_aek,0) - NVL(t1.out_aek,0)),0)
                 , w_wonbon_aek + NVL(SUM(gigan_amt),0)
              INTO w_wonbon_aek
                 , w_gigan_jan
              FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd  BETWEEN (xx.re_seolj + 1) AND p_ymd - 1;
        end if;

        if  xx.customer_gr = '자산운용' then
            -- 원본조정액 입력분 그대로 반영(차후를 위해 기간가중금액 산정)
            UPDATE SZT0IO t1    /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
               SET gigan_per  = xx.gigan_rt * 100
                 , gigan_amt  = TRUNC(xx.aek * xx.gigan_rt)
                 , gigan_ilsu = xx.gigan_ilsu
                 , pass_ilsu  = xx.ilsu
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd;
        else
            UPDATE SZT0IO t1    /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
               SET wonbon_aek = w_wonbon_aek + xx.aek
                 , gigan_per  = xx.gigan_rt * 100
                 , gigan_amt  = TRUNC(xx.aek * xx.gigan_rt)
                 , gigan_ilsu = xx.gigan_ilsu
                 , pass_ilsu  = xx.ilsu
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd;

            UPDATE SZM0IA   /* 자문 계좌정보 */
               SET RE_SEOLJ_AEK = w_wonbon_aek + xx.aek
             WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
               AND FUND_CD = xx.fund_cd;
        end if;

        if  xx.in_aek > 0   then
            if  xx.customer_gr = '자산운용' then
                -- 당일 순자산기준으로 조정금 입력분 반영
                SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A12', 'A', '1', '20', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'dd'), xx.ilsu,
                            xx.in_aek, xx.in_aek + xx.io_jo, 40, 'PROC0400', w_msg);
            else
                SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A12', 'A', '1', '20', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'dd'), xx.ilsu,
                            xx.in_aek, TRUNC(xx.in_aek * xx.gigan_rt), 40, 'PROC0400', w_msg);
            end if;
        end if;
        if  xx.out_aek > 0  then
            if  xx.customer_gr = '자산운용'     then
                -- 당일 순자산기준으로 조정금 입력분 반영
                SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A31', 'A', '1', '20', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'dd'), xx.ilsu,
                            xx.out_aek - xx.io_jo, xx.out_aek, 40, 'PROC0400', w_msg);
            else
                SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A31', 'A', '1', '20', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'dd'), xx.ilsu,
                            TRUNC(xx.out_aek * xx.gigan_rt), xx.out_aek, 40, 'PROC0400', w_msg);
            end if;
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC0400 : ' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';

    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0510 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 현금 회계처리
--
    w_mm_sonik                     NUMBER;
    w_seq                          NUMBER;

    w_yong_ymd                     DATE;

    ig_gugan_ija                   shj0ig.gugan_ija%type;
    ig_bf_ija_ymd                  DATE;
    ig_af_ija_ymd                  DATE;
    ig_gugan_ilsu                  shj0ig.gugan_ilsu%type;

    w_ija                          shj0ig.gugan_ija%type := 0;
    w_dang_ija                     shj0ig.gugan_ija%type := 0;
    w_dang_tax                     shm0hm.sung_tax%type  := 0;

    w_fund_cd                      szm0ia.fund_cd%type;
    w_fund_currency                szm0ia.fund_currency%type;
    w_cash_cd                      shm0hj.cash_cd%type;
    w_sunhu_gb                     shm0hj.sunhu_gb%type;

    w_first_yn                     VARCHAR(1) := 'Y';
    w_ilsu                         NUMBER;

    tot_dang_ija                   skt0bu.aek%type;
    tot_anbun_aek                  skt0bu.aek%type;

    -- 유효이자율 계산용
    w_yuhyo_anbun                  NUMBER;

    w_aek                          number_varray_50;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -- 현금회계처리 분개내역 삭제
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B000', 'skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0bu.proc_step=51', '현금회계처리 분개내역(skt0bu) delete');

    -- 현금종목 등록시 펀드생성분 거래생성
    DELETE FROM SHT0HG tt   /* 현금거래내역 */
     WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd   = p_ymd
       AND tr_cd    = 'J31'
       AND cre_user = 'PROC0510';

    -- 현금이자구간 없는 종목 재생성
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                          /* _1- */
             , t1.jm_cd                          /* _2- */
             , NVL(t1.now_ija_hoicha,0)  AS now  /* _3- */
             , t1.bf_ija_ymd                     /* _4- */
             , t1.af_ija_ymd                     /* _5- */
          FROM SHM0HJ t1  /* 현금 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.cash_cd != '90'
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT CASE WHEN gugan_no=xx.now THEN 99 ELSE gugan_no END
                 , bf_ija_ymd
                 , af_ija_ymd
              INTO xx.now
                 , xx.bf_ija_ymd
                 , xx.af_ija_ymd
              FROM SHJ0IG t1  /* 현금 종목별 이자구간 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND p_ymd      BETWEEN t1.bf_ija_ymd AND (t1.af_ija_ymd - 1);

            if  xx.now != 99    then
                UPDATE SHM0HJ tt    /* 현금 종목정보 */
                   SET now_ija_hoicha = xx.now
                     , bf_ija_ymd     = xx.bf_ija_ymd
                     , af_ija_ymd     = xx.af_ija_ymd
                 WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            SR_SHJ0IG (p_corp_gr, xx.jm_cd, 'no');
        END;
    end loop;

    if  p_corp_gr = '2402' AND p_ymd = TO_DATE ('20240515','yyyymmdd')  then
        -- 초기생성
        DELETE FROM SHM1J tt    /* 현금 매수 */
         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND buy_date <= TO_CHAR(p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');

        DELETE FROM SHM1K tt    /* 현금 매도(이자수령) */
         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND buy_date <= TO_CHAR(p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');
    else
        DELETE FROM SHM1J tt    /* 현금 매수 */
         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND buy_date = TO_CHAR(p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');
    end if;


    if  p_corp_gr = '2402' AND p_ymd = TO_DATE ('20240515','yyyymmdd')   then   -- 발행어음 매수처리
        -- 신규회사 거래내역 등록분 매수처리
        for xx IN (
            SELECT t1.fund_cd     /* _1- */
                 , t1.jm_cd       /* _2- */
                 , t1.aekm        /* _3- */
                 , t1.tr_aek      /* _4- */
                 , ia.mg_cd       /* _5- */
                 , t1.pyom_iyul   /* _6- */
                 , t1.sung_cost   /* _7- */
                 , t1.meib_ymd    /* _8- */
                 , t1.sanghw_aek  /* _9- */
                 , t1.pg_cd       /* _10- */
              FROM SHM0HJ t1  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd IS NOT NULL
               AND t1.meib_ymd      <= p_ymd
               AND ia.corp_gr       = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd
               AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd <= p_ymd
        ) loop
            MERGE INTO SHM1J tt  /* 현금 매수 */
               USING ( SELECT gugan_no
                            , gugan_ija
                            , bf_ija_ymd
                            , af_ija_ymd
                         FROM SHJ0IG f1  /* 현금 종목별 이자구간 */
                        WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                          AND jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
                          AND xx.meib_ymd BETWEEN bf_ija_ymd
                                              AND (af_ija_ymd - 1) ) ig
                  ON ( corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
                   AND buy_date = TO_CHAR(xx.meib_ymd,'yyyymmdd') )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                 UPDATE
                    SET aekm      = aekm + xx.aekm
                      , aek       = aek + xx.tr_aek
                      , chui_aek  = chui_aek + xx.tr_aek
                      , gugan_ija = TRUNC(ig.gugan_ija * xx.aekm)
                      , pass_ija  = xx.sung_cost  /* 경과이자 계산만 하고 선급비용 대신 취득액으로 처리 */
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                 INSERT
                 VALUES ( p_corp_gr                        /* _1- */
                        , xx.fund_cd                       /* _2- */
                        , xx.jm_cd                         /* _3- */
                        , TO_CHAR(xx.meib_ymd,'yyyymmdd')  /* _4- */
                        , xx.aekm                          /* _5- */
                        , xx.tr_aek                        /* _6- */
                        , xx.tr_aek                        /* _7- */
                        , ig.gugan_no                      /* _8- */
                        , ig.bf_ija_ymd                    /* _9- */
                        , ig.af_ija_ymd                    /* _10- */
                        , TRUNC(ig.gugan_ija * xx.aekm)    /* _11- */
                        , xx.sung_cost                     /* _12-경과이자 계산만 하고 선급비용 대신 취득액으로 처리 */
                        );

            INSERT INTO SHT0HG tt   /* 현금거래내역 */
                 ( corp_gr       /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd        /* _2- */
                 , tr_cd         /* _3- */
                 , fund_cd       /* _4- */
                 , jm_cd         /* _5- */
                 , seq_no        /* _6- */
                 , aekm          /* _7- */
                 , tr_aek        /* _8- */
                 , tr_co_cd      /* _9- */
                 , mk_suik_rt    /* _10- */
                 , sung_cost     /* _11- */
                 , sanghw_aek    /* _12- */
                 , mijigub_tax   /* _13- */
                 , susu_ga       /* _14- */
                 , tax_offer_gb  /* _15- */
                 , jajun_gb      /* _16- */
                 , susu_09900    /* _17- */
                 , sunsu_ija     /* _18- */
                 , cre_user      /* _19- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr      /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd          /* _2- */
                   , 'J31'          /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd     /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_cd       /* _5- */
                   , 1              /* _6- */
                   , xx.aekm        /* _7- */
                   , xx.tr_aek      /* _8- */
                   , xx.mg_cd       /* _9- */
                   , xx.pyom_iyul   /* _10- */
                   , 0              /* _11-자문 경과이자는 취득액 처리 */
                   , xx.sanghw_aek  /* _12- */
                   , 0              /* _13-개인 세금처리 */
                   , 0              /* _14- */
                   , '1'            /* _15- */
                   , '2'            /* _16- */
                   , 0              /* _17- */
                   , 0              /* _18- */
                   , 'PROC0510'     /* _19- */
                   );

            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO SHM1PG tt  /* 현금 평가등급 자료 */
                VALUES (p_corp_gr, xx.meib_ymd, xx.jm_cd, xx.pg_cd);
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                NULL;
            END;
        end loop;
    else
        for xx IN (
            SELECT t1.fund_cd     /* _1- */
                 , t1.jm_cd       /* _2- */
                 , t1.aekm        /* _3- */
                 , t1.tr_aek      /* _4- */
                 , ia.mg_cd       /* _5- */
                 , t1.pyom_iyul   /* _6- */
                 , t1.sung_cost   /* _7- */
                 , t1.sanghw_aek  /* _8- */
                 , t1.pg_cd       /* _9- */
              FROM SHM0HJ t1  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd IS NOT NULL
               AND t1.meib_ymd = p_ymd
               AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
        ) loop
            MERGE INTO SHM1J tt  /* 현금 매수 */
               USING ( SELECT gugan_no
                            , gugan_ija
                            , bf_ija_ymd
                            , af_ija_ymd
                         FROM SHJ0IG f1  /* 현금 종목별 이자구간 */
                        WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                          AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                          AND p_ymd   BETWEEN bf_ija_ymd
                                          AND (af_ija_ymd - 1) ) ig
                  ON ( corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
                   AND buy_date = TO_CHAR(p_ymd,'yyyymmdd') )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                 UPDATE
                    SET aekm      = aekm + xx.aekm
                      , aek       = aek + xx.tr_aek
                      , chui_aek  = chui_aek + xx.tr_aek
                      , gugan_ija = TRUNC(ig.gugan_ija * xx.aekm)
                      , pass_ija  = xx.sung_cost  /* 경과이자 계산만 하고 선급비용 대신 취득액으로 처리 */
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                 INSERT
                 VALUES ( p_corp_gr                      /* _1- */
                        , xx.fund_cd                     /* _2- */
                        , xx.jm_cd                       /* _3- */
                        , TO_CHAR(p_ymd,'yyyymmdd')      /* _4- */
                        , xx.aekm                        /* _5- */
                        , xx.tr_aek                      /* _6- */
                        , xx.tr_aek                      /* _7- */
                        , ig.gugan_no                    /* _8- */
                        , ig.bf_ija_ymd                  /* _9- */
                        , ig.af_ija_ymd                  /* _10- */
                        , TRUNC(ig.gugan_ija * xx.aekm)  /* _11- */
                        , xx.sung_cost                   /* _12-경과이자 계산만 하고 선급비용 대신 취득액으로 처리 */
                        );

            INSERT INTO SHT0HG tt   /* 현금거래내역 */
                 ( corp_gr       /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd        /* _2- */
                 , tr_cd         /* _3- */
                 , fund_cd       /* _4- */
                 , jm_cd         /* _5- */
                 , seq_no        /* _6- */
                 , aekm          /* _7- */
                 , tr_aek        /* _8- */
                 , tr_co_cd      /* _9- */
                 , mk_suik_rt    /* _10- */
                 , sung_cost     /* _11- */
                 , sanghw_aek    /* _12- */
                 , mijigub_tax   /* _13- */
                 , susu_ga       /* _14- */
                 , tax_offer_gb  /* _15- */
                 , jajun_gb      /* _16- */
                 , susu_09900    /* _17- */
                 , sunsu_ija     /* _18- */
                 , cre_user      /* _19- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr      /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd          /* _2- */
                   , 'J31'          /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd     /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_cd       /* _5- */
                   , 1              /* _6- */
                   , xx.aekm        /* _7- */
                   , xx.tr_aek      /* _8- */
                   , xx.mg_cd       /* _9- */
                   , xx.pyom_iyul   /* _10- */
                   , 0              /* _11-자문 경과이자는 취득액 처리 */
                   , xx.sanghw_aek  /* _12- */
                   , 0              /* _13-개인 세금처리 */
                   , 0              /* _14- */
                   , '1'            /* _15- */
                   , '2'            /* _16- */
                   , 0              /* _17- */
                   , 0              /* _18- */
                   , 'PROC0510'     /* _19- */
                   );
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO SHM1PG tt  /* 현금 평가등급 자료 */
                VALUES (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.jm_cd, xx.pg_cd);
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                NULL;
            END;
        end loop;
    end if;

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND t1.proc_step = 51;

    -- 현금 매매 회계처리

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0510', p_ymd || 'sht0hg.tr_cd = J31 J32 J43 L13');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sht0hg.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sht0hg.tr_cd in (J31,J32,L13)', '현금 매입처리');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                               /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                               /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                             /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                               /* _4- */
             , t1.seq_no                                                              /* _5- */
             , t1.aekm                                                                /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.mk_suik_rt, NVL(hj.meib_suik_rt, hj.pyom_iyul))  AS meib_rt     /* _7- */
             , t1.tr_aek                                                              /* _8- */
             , t1.sanghw_aek                                                          /* _9- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                                            /* _10- */
             , NVL(t1.susu_ga,0)                                       AS susu_ga     /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.susu_09900,0)                                    AS susu_09900  /* _12- */
             , NVL(t1.sung_cost,0)                                     AS sung_cost   /* _13- */
          FROM SHT0HG t1  /* 현금거래내역 */
             , SHM0HJ hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('J31','J32','L13')
           AND hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND hj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        SR_PROC0511 (p_corp_gr, xx.rowid, p_ymd, 51, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd,
                     xx.seq_no, xx.aekm, xx.meib_rt, xx.tr_aek, xx.sanghw_aek, xx.tr_co_cd, xx.sung_cost, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if (xx.susu_ga + xx.susu_09900) > 0 then
            UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
               SET susu_ga    = NVL(susu_ga,0) + xx.susu_ga
                 , susu_09900 = NVL(susu_09900,0) + xx.susu_09900
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND ymd     = p_ymd;

            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                        xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1, xx.susu_ga + xx.susu_09900, 51, 'shhp010', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'sht0hg.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sht0hg.tr_cd in (K30,E37,E41,E51,L23)', '현금 매도처리');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT tr_cd                                        /* _1- */
             , fund_cd                                      /* _2- */
             , jm_cd                                        /* _3- */
             , seq_no                                       /* _4- */
             , aekm                                         /* _5- */
             , tr_aek - NVL(mijigub_tax,0)  AS tr_aek       /* _6- */
             , tr_co_cd                                     /* _7- */
             , NVL(susu_ga,0)               AS susu_ga      /* _8- */
             , NVL(MIJIGUB_TAX,0)           AS MIJIGUB_TAX  /* _9- */
             , ROWID                                        /* _10- */
          FROM SHT0HG t1  /* 현금거래내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('K30','E37','E41','E51','L23')
    ) loop
        SR_PROC0512 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 51, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no,
                     xx.aekm, xx.tr_aek, xx.tr_co_cd, xx.susu_ga, xx.MIJIGUB_TAX, w_mm_sonik, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        UPDATE SHT0HG tt    /* 현금거래내역 */
           SET mm_sonik = w_mm_sonik
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0510', p_ymd || ' : 현금 미수이자 처리(회계처리후 실행)');

    DELETE FROM SZX3CK tt   /* 펀드별 Check 자료 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND proc    = 'PROC0510';

    w_yong_ymd := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '-');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                      /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                    /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                              /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                      /* _4- */
             , hj.now_ija_hoicha                                                             /* _5- */
             , hj.cash_cd                                                                    /* _6- */
             , hj.ksd_jm_cd                                                                  /* _7- */
             , hj.sunhu_tax_gb                                                               /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0)
                                   - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)                 AS aekm             /* _9-보유액면 */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aek,0)
                                       - NVL(t1.medo_aek,0)              AS aek              /* _10-취득액 */
             , NVL(t1.misu_ija,0)                                        AS misu_ija         /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_sunsu_ija,0)                                  AS bfil_sunsu_ija   /* _12- */
             , dw_sunsu_ija                                              AS dw_sunsu_ija     /* _13- */
             , 0                                                         AS up_sunsu_ija     /* _14- */
             , NVL(t1.anbun_aek,0)                                       AS anbun_aek        /* _15- */
             , NVL(t1.sung_cost,0)                                       AS sung_cost        /* _16- */
             , hj.pyom_iyul                                                                  /* _17- */
             , hj.balh_ymd                                                                   /* _18- */
             , hj.bf_ija_ymd                                                                 /* _19- */
             , hj.af_ija_ymd                                                                 /* _20- */
             , hj.sanghw_ymd                                                                 /* _21- */
             , hj.sanghw_ymd - t1.ymd                                    AS susu_anbun_ilsu  /* _22- */
             , hj.sunhu_gb                                                                   /* _23- */
             , t1.yuhyo_rt                                                                   /* _24- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd, hj.cash_cd)  AS seq              /* _25- */
          FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
             , SHM0HJ hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND (NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)) > 0
           AND hj.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND hj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND hj.cash_cd                   != '90'
           AND hj.sanghw_ymd                > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd ASC
                , hj.cash_cd ASC
                , hj.sunhu_gb ASC
                , t1.jm_cd ASC
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT sury_ija
              INTO w_dang_ija
              FROM SHT0FS t1  /* 펀드/종목별 이자수령 유예내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd     = F_OPEN_YMD(p_ymd,'-')
               AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd      = 'B29'
               AND t1.af_ija_ymd > p_ymd
               AND t1.sury_ymd   = t1.tr_ymd;

            -- 선수령 이자계산 제외
            CONTINUE;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;

        w_dang_tax    := 0;
        w_yuhyo_anbun := 0;
        if (xx.cash_cd='50') AND (xx.af_ija_ymd > w_yong_ymd) AND (xx.af_ija_ymd <= p_ymd)  then    -- 정기예금 이자계산
            w_dang_ija := ROUND (xx.aekm * xx.pyom_iyul * (p_ymd - xx.af_ija_ymd) / 365) - ROUND (xx.aekm * xx.pyom_iyul * (p_ymd - xx.af_ija_ymd) / 365);

        elsif xx.cash_cd = '70' then    -- RP예금 이자계산
            if  xx.balh_ymd = p_ymd then
                -- RP 당일이자 미지급
                w_dang_ija := 0;
            else
                w_dang_ija := ROUND (xx.aekm * xx.pyom_iyul / 365);
            end if;
        else
            -- 이자구간 정보를 Select
            BEGIN
                SELECT ROUND(gugan_ija * xx.aekm)
                     , bf_ija_ymd
                     , af_ija_ymd
                     , gugan_ilsu
                  INTO ig_gugan_ija
                     , ig_bf_ija_ymd
                     , ig_af_ija_ymd
                     , ig_gugan_ilsu
                  FROM SHJ0IG t1  /* 현금 종목별 이자구간 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND p_ymd      BETWEEN t1.bf_ija_ymd AND (t1.af_ija_ymd - 1);
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '- 이자구간 정보를 확인하십시오.';
                RETURN;
            END;

            -- 선취이자 처리 20200306 yjs
            -- 선취이자수령은 shpp010 에서 처리하므로 up_sunsu_ija 컬럼만 처리
            if  xx.cash_cd = 'DC' AND xx.sunhu_gb = '1' AND ig_bf_ija_ymd = p_ymd   then
                BEGIN
                    SELECT ROUND(gugan_ija * xx.aekm)
                      INTO xx.up_sunsu_ija
                      FROM SHJ0IG t1  /* 현금 종목별 이자구간 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                       AND p_ymd      BETWEEN t1.bf_ija_ymd AND (t1.af_ija_ymd - 1);
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '- 선취 이자구간 정보를 확인하십시오.';
                    RETURN;
                END;
            end if;

            -- 지분증권/대출(금전)채권 등 표면이자가 없는 자산 제외
            if  xx.pyom_iyul != 0 AND ig_gugan_ija = 0  then
                p_msg   := xx.jm_cd || '- 구간이자(' || F_NTRIM (xx.aekm) || ',' || F_NTRIM (ig_gugan_ija)
                                    || ')를 계산 할 수 없습니다.';
                RETURN;
            end if;
            if  ig_gugan_ilsu = 0   then
                ig_gugan_ilsu := 1;
                SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, '****', '구간일수 zero', p_ymd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-' || xx.now_ija_hoicha);
            end if;
            -------------------
            -- 하루이자 계산 --
            -------------------
            if (xx.bfil_sunsu_ija + xx.up_sunsu_ija) > 0    then
                -- 선수이자 하루이자 계산 (일부상환으로 dw_sunsu_ija 추가 20200924 yjs)
                w_dang_ija := ROUND ((xx.bfil_sunsu_ija + xx.up_sunsu_ija - NVL(xx.dw_sunsu_ija,0)) / (ig_af_ija_ymd - p_ymd));

            elsif xx.sunhu_gb = '1' AND xx.cash_cd = 'DC' AND (xx.bfil_sunsu_ija + xx.up_sunsu_ija) = 0 AND ig_gugan_ija > 0    then    -- 선수이자 계상이 이미끝난경우는 당일이자는 0
                w_dang_ija := 0;

            elsif xx.cash_cd IN ('71','72') AND p_ymd = (ig_af_ija_ymd -1)      then
                -- REPO거래인 경우 구간종료일에 구간이자 차이분 발생하게 처리함 20191102 PDJ
                w_dang_ija := ig_gugan_ija - (xx.misu_ija + xx.sung_cost);

            elsif w_yong_ymd != p_ymd   then
                if  ig_gugan_ilsu = 0   then
                    p_msg   := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-' || ig_gugan_ilsu
                                          || '- PROC0510/ig_gugan_ilsu=0 Divide Zero err 1!';
                    RETURN;
                end if;

                -- 휴일인 경우는 하루이자는 구간일수로 나눈금액 사용
                w_dang_ija := ROUND (ig_gugan_ija / ig_gugan_ilsu);
            else
                -- 하루이자 계산
                w_ilsu     := p_ymd - ig_bf_ija_ymd;                            /* 경과일수 계산(자문은 당일이자계산으로 한편넣기 처리) */
                w_ija      := ROUND (ig_gugan_ija * (w_ilsu / ig_gugan_ilsu));  /* 경과이자 = (구간미수이자 / 구간일수) * 경과일수 */
                w_dang_ija := w_ija - (xx.misu_ija + xx.sung_cost);  /* 당일하루이자 = 경과이자 - (누적미수이자 + 선급비용) */

                if (w_dang_ija BETWEEN ROUND(ig_gugan_ija / ig_gugan_ilsu) - 100 AND ROUND(ig_gugan_ija / ig_gugan_ilsu) + 100)     then
                    NULL;
                else
                    INSERT INTO SZX3CK tt   /* 펀드별 Check 자료 */
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                                     /* _1- */
                           , LPAD(xx.fund_cd, 4, ' ') || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '    현금 당일이자 확인 dang_ija=' || w_dang_ija
                                                      || ' gugan=' || ROUND(ig_gugan_ija / ig_gugan_ilsu)  /* _2- */
                           , 1612541                                                                       /* _3- */
                           , 'PROC0510'                                                                    /* _4- */
                           );
                end if;
            end if;

            w_dang_tax    := 0;
            w_yuhyo_anbun := 0;
        end if;

        ----------------------------------------
        -- 현금마스타 당일미수이자(누적) update
        ----------------------------------------
        BEGIN
            if (xx.bfil_sunsu_ija + xx.up_sunsu_ija) > 0    then
                UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
                   SET up_sunsu_ija  = xx.up_sunsu_ija
                     , dw_sunsu_ija  = NVL(dw_sunsu_ija,0) + w_dang_ija
                     , sung_tax      = NVL(sung_tax,0) + w_dang_tax
                     , anbun_aek     = NVL(anbun_aek,0) + w_yuhyo_anbun
                     , day_anbun_aek = w_yuhyo_anbun
                     , gugan_ija     = ig_gugan_ija
                 WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
            else
                UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
                   SET misu_ija      = NVL(misu_ija,0) + w_dang_ija
                     , sung_tax      = NVL(sung_tax,0) + w_dang_tax
                     , anbun_aek     = NVL(anbun_aek,0) + w_yuhyo_anbun
                     , day_ija       = w_dang_ija
                     , day_anbun_aek = w_yuhyo_anbun
                     , gugan_ija     = ig_gugan_ija
                 WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '- PROC0510-UPDATE **미수이자처리시 SHM0HM명세을 확인하십시오.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        -- 자산종류별로 종목을 합산하여 분개처리
        if  w_first_yn = 'Y'    then
            w_first_yn      := 'N';
            w_fund_cd       := xx.fund_cd;
            w_fund_currency := xx.fund_currency;
            w_cash_cd       := xx.cash_cd;
            w_sunhu_gb      := xx.sunhu_gb;
            tot_dang_ija    := 0;
            tot_anbun_aek   := 0;
        end if;

        if (w_fund_cd != xx.fund_cd) OR (w_cash_cd != xx.cash_cd) OR (w_sunhu_gb != xx.sunhu_gb)    then
            if  w_cash_cd IN ('ZS')     then    -- 전단채 처리
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B21', 'A', '1', 'Z', w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency,
                            '', w_seq, 1, tot_dang_ija, 51, 'PROC0510-Z', w_msg);
                if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                    p_msg := w_msg || 'PROC0510-Z';
                    RETURN;
                end if;
            elsif w_cash_cd IN ('ZF')   then    -- 어음, 전단채에서 분리
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B21', 'A', '1', 'ZF', w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency,
                            '', w_seq, 1, tot_dang_ija, 51, 'PROC0510-ZF', w_msg);
                if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                    p_msg := w_msg || 'PROC0510-Z';
                    RETURN;
                end if;
            elsif w_cash_cd = 'AA'  then
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B21', 'A', '1', w_cash_cd, w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency,
                            '', w_seq, 1, tot_dang_ija, 51, 'PROC0510-AA', w_msg);
                if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                    p_msg := w_msg || 'PROC0510-AA';
                    RETURN;
                end if;
            elsif w_cash_cd = 'DC'  then
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B25', 'A', '1', w_sunhu_gb, w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency,
                            '', w_seq, 1, tot_dang_ija, 51, 'PROC0510-DC N ', w_msg);
                if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                    p_msg := w_msg || 'PROC0510-DC';
                    RETURN;
                end if;
                -- REPO매도 지급이자 계상 처리
            elsif w_cash_cd = '71'  then
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B21', 'A', '1', w_cash_cd, w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency,
                            '', w_seq, 1, tot_dang_ija, 51, 'PROC0510-71', w_msg);
                if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                    p_msg := w_msg || 'PROC0510-71';
                    RETURN;
                end if;
            else
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B21', 'A', '1', '00', w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency,
                            '', w_seq, 1, tot_dang_ija, 51, 'PROC0510', w_msg);
                if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                    p_msg := w_msg || 'PROC0510';
                    RETURN;
                end if;
                -- 안분손익 분개처리
                SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B11', 'A', '1', w_cash_cd, w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency,
                            '', w_seq, 1, tot_anbun_aek, 51, 'PROC0510', w_msg);
                if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                    p_msg := w_msg || 'PROC0510';
                    RETURN;
                end if;
            end if;

            tot_dang_ija    := 0;
            tot_anbun_aek   := 0;
            w_fund_cd       := xx.fund_cd;
            w_fund_currency := xx.fund_currency;
            w_cash_cd       := xx.cash_cd;
            w_sunhu_gb      := xx.sunhu_gb;
        end if;
        tot_dang_ija  := NVL  (tot_dang_ija,0) + w_dang_ija;
        tot_anbun_aek := NVL  (tot_anbun_aek,0) + w_yuhyo_anbun;
        w_seq         := xx.seq;
    end loop;
    if  w_first_yn = 'N'    then
        if  w_cash_cd IN ('ZS')     then    -- 전단채 처리
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B21', 'A', '1', 'Z', w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency,
                        '', w_seq, 1, tot_dang_ija, 51, 'PROC0510-Z', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg || 'PROC0510-Z';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        elsif w_cash_cd IN ('ZF')   then    -- 기업어음전단채 처리
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B21', 'A', '1', 'ZF', w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency,
                        '', w_seq, 1, tot_dang_ija, 51, 'PROC0510-ZF', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg || 'PROC0510-Z';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        elsif w_cash_cd = 'AA'  then
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B21', 'A', '1', w_cash_cd, w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency,
                        '', w_seq, 1, tot_dang_ija, 51, 'PROC0510-AA', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg || 'PROC0510-AA';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        elsif w_cash_cd = 'DC'  then
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B25', 'A', '1', w_sunhu_gb, w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency,
                        '', w_seq, 1, tot_dang_ija, 51, 'PROC0510-DC Y ', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg || 'PROC0510-DC';
                RETURN;
            end if;
            -- REPO매도 지급이자 계상 처리 및  ('ZS','ZF')'AA''DC'
        elsif w_cash_cd = '71'  then
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B21', 'A', '1', w_cash_cd, w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency,
                        '', w_seq, 1, tot_dang_ija, 51, 'PROC0510-71', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg || 'PROC0510-71';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        else
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B21', 'A', '1', '00', w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency,
                        '', w_cash_cd, 1, tot_dang_ija, 51, 'PROC0510 ' || w_cash_cd, w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg || 'PROC0510';
                RETURN;
            end if;
            -- 안분손익 분개처리
            SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B11', 'A', '1', w_cash_cd, w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency,
                        '', w_cash_cd, 1, tot_anbun_aek, 51, 'PROC0510 ' || w_cash_cd, w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg || 'PROC0510';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
    end if;

    -- 선수령 이자 당일이자 발생처리 20201103 yjs
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , t1.jm_cd
             , t1.suib_ija
          FROM SHT0FS t1  /* 펀드/종목별 이자수령 유예내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'B29'
           AND t1.af_ija_ymd > p_ymd
    ) loop
        UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
           SET day_ija = xx.suib_ija
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND ymd     = p_ymd;
    end loop;

    --------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 현금자산 평가금액 = 취득가 + 선급비용 + 미수이자 + 손익안분
    --------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 선취
    UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
       SET pyunga_aek = NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(meib_aek,0) - NVL(medo_aek,0) + NVL(anbun_aek,0)
                                             + (NVL(gugan_ija,0) - (NVL(bfil_sunsu_ija,0) + NVL(up_sunsu_ija,0) - NVL(dw_sunsu_ija,0)))
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND jm_cd   IN (SELECT jm_cd
                         FROM SHM0HJ ta  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                        WHERE ta.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                          AND ta.cash_cd  != '90'
                          AND ta.sunhu_gb = '1')
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;
    -- 후취
    UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
       SET pyunga_aek = NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(meib_aek,0) - NVL(medo_aek,0)
                                             + NVL(sung_cost,0) + NVL(misu_ija,0) + NVL(anbun_aek,0)
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND jm_cd   IN (SELECT jm_cd
                         FROM SHM0HJ ta  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                        WHERE ta.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                          AND ta.cash_cd  != '90'
                          AND ta.sunhu_gb != '1')
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0510', p_ymd || ' : 현금 회계처리 마무리');

    -- 자동생성된 유예 이외자료 분개처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                             /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                       /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                               /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                               /* _4- */
             , t1.gwamok                                              /* _5- */
             , t1.aek                                                 /* _6- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                        ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq  /* _7- */
          FROM SHT1HG t1  /* 현금 원금(이자) 상환유예내역 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd        = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd         != 'D31'
           AND NVL(t1.bigo,' ') NOT IN ('원금상환유예','이자상환유예')
           AND ia.corp_gr       = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.gwamok = '10101' then
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E44', 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        xx.jm_cd, 2, xx.seq, xx.aek, 51, 'sz43999 미수' || xx.jm_cd, w_msg);
        elsif xx.gwamok = '12161'   then
            -- 대출채권 이자구간 변경분 미수령분 처리 20210602 yjs
            -- sr_PROC0510 에서 당일이자 수령처리
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E44', 'A', '1', '02', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        xx.jm_cd, 2, xx.seq, xx.aek, 51, 'sz43999 미수' || xx.jm_cd, w_msg);
        else
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E44', 'A', '1', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        xx.jm_cd, 2, xx.seq, xx.aek, 51, 'sz43999 미수' || xx.jm_cd, w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'sz43999 -> ' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';

    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0511 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_rowid                        IN    ROWID,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_seq_no                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_aekm                         IN    NUMBER,
    p_tr_iyul                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_tr_aek                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_sanghw_aek                   IN    NUMBER,
    p_tr_co_cd                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_sung_cost                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 현금 매입 회계처리
--
    w_shm0hm                     ROWID;
    hm_aekm                      NUMBER;
    hm_anbun_aek                 NUMBER;

    w_chui_aek                   NUMBER;
    w_misu_ija                   NUMBER;
    w_sunsu_ija                  NUMBER;
    w_sunn_tax                   NUMBER;
    w_yesu_tax                   NUMBER;
    w_sung_cost                  NUMBER;
    w_sanghw_aek                 NUMBER;

    w_day_ija                    NUMBER;
    w_now_gugan_ija              NUMBER;
    w_now_bf_ija_ymd             DATE;
    w_now_af_ija_ymd             DATE;

    w_dr_aek                     NUMBER;
    w_cr_aek                     NUMBER;

    w_aek                        number_varray_50;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    p_msg   := p_jm_cd || '- 현금종목 정보가 없습니다.';

    for xx IN (
        select t1.rowid                             /* _1- */
             , t1.cash_cd                           /* _2- */
             , t1.offer_co_cd                       /* _3- */
             , t1.balh_ymd                          /* _4- */
             , t1.meib_ymd                          /* _5- */
             , t1.sanghw_ymd                        /* _6- */
             , t1.sunhu_tax_gb                      /* _7- */
             , t1.sunhu_gb                          /* _8- */
             , t1.pyom_iyul                         /* _9- */
             , t1.yy_ija_hoicha                     /* _10- */
             , t1.tot_ija_gugan                     /* _11- */
             , t1.now_ija_hoicha                    /* _12- */
             , t1.meib_mk_gb                        /* _13- */
             , t1.cd_jigub_gb                       /* _14- */
             , t1.tax_offer_gb                      /* _15- */
             , t1.broker_cd                         /* _16- */
             , t2.bf_ija_ymd                        /* _17- */
             , t2.af_ija_ymd                        /* _18- */
             , trunc(t2.other_cost)  AS other_cost  /* _19- */
          from SHM0HJ t1
             , SHJ0IG t2
         where t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           and t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd
           and t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and t2.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           and p_ymd      Between t2.bf_ija_ymd And (t2.af_ija_ymd - 1)
    ) loop
        if NVL (xx.tot_ija_gugan,0) = 0 then    xx.tot_ija_gugan    := 1;   -- 총이자구간
        end if;

        -- 이자구간/년이자지급회수/총이자지급구간 점검
        if NVL (xx.tot_ija_gugan,0) >= NVL (xx.yy_ija_hoicha,0) And (xx.cash_cd IN ('ZS','ZF') And xx.yy_ija_hoicha != 1)   then    -- 총이자구간/구간일수 점검
            p_msg   := p_jm_cd || '/' || NVL(xx.tot_ija_gugan,0) || '/' || NVL(xx.yy_ija_hoicha,0)
                               || '=>PROC0511 현금종목 연이자회수(전단채=1)등을 점검하세요.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        w_yesu_tax  := 0;

        -----------------
        -- 매입분 계산 --
        -----------------
        if  xx.cash_cd IN ('10','20','DC','ZS','ZF')    then
            if  xx.cash_cd IN ('ZS','ZF')   then
                w_misu_ija      := trunc (p_aekm * p_tr_iyul * (xx.sanghw_ymd - xx.balh_ymd) / 365);
                w_sanghw_aek    := p_aekm;
                w_sung_cost     := trunc (p_aekm * p_tr_iyul * (p_ymd - xx.balh_ymd) / 365);
                if  p_corp_gr = '2402'  then
                    -- 리코자산 선급비용 제외
                    w_misu_ija  := w_misu_ija + w_sung_cost;
                    w_sung_cost := 0;
                end if;
                w_chui_aek  := p_tr_aek - w_sung_cost;
            else
                BEGIN
                    SELECT ROUND(gugan_ija * p_aekm) 
                      INTO w_misu_ija
                      FROM SHJ0IG t1
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd
                       AND p_ymd      Between bf_ija_ymd And (af_ija_ymd - 1);
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    w_misu_ija  := trunc (p_aekm * xx.pyom_iyul * (xx.sanghw_ymd - xx.balh_ymd) / 365);
                END;
                w_chui_aek      := p_aekm - w_misu_ija;
                w_sanghw_aek    := p_aekm;
                if  p_corp_gr = '2402'  then
                    -- 리코자산 선급비용 제외
                    w_sung_cost := 0;
                else
                    w_sung_cost := trunc (p_aekm * xx.pyom_iyul * (p_ymd - xx.balh_ymd) / 365);
                end if;

            end if;
            if  p_tr_cd NOT IN ('J43','L13')    then
                if  xx.cash_cd NOT IN ('ZS','ZF')   then    w_sung_cost := p_sung_cost; -- 전단채 이외 매매시 선급비용 계산액 사용
                end if;
            else
                w_chui_aek  := p_tr_aek - w_sung_cost;  -- 이체시 선급비용 계산
            end if;

            if  xx.sunhu_gb = '1'   then    -- 선취
                w_chui_aek      := p_aekm;
                w_sanghw_aek    := p_aekm;
            elsif xx.sunhu_gb = '2' And xx.cash_cd NOT IN ('ZS','ZF')   then    -- 후취
                w_chui_aek      := p_aekm;
                w_sanghw_aek    := p_aekm + w_misu_ija;
            end if;
            w_sunn_tax  := 0;

        elsif xx.cash_cd = '70' then    -- RP예금
            w_misu_ija      := 0;
            w_chui_aek      := p_aekm;
            w_sanghw_aek    := p_aekm;

        elsif xx.cash_cd IN ('80','71','72')    then    -- 콜론/RP매입/RP매도
            w_misu_ija  := trunc (p_aekm * xx.pyom_iyul * (xx.sanghw_ymd - xx.balh_ymd) / 365);
            if  p_aekm != p_tr_aek  then
                    w_chui_aek  := p_tr_aek;
            else    w_chui_aek  := p_aekm;
            end if;
            -- 화면에서 입력시 수정한 금액이 1,000원미만으로 차이가 나지 않으면 입력금액 유지 20190213 yjs
            if  abs (p_sanghw_aek - (p_aekm + w_misu_ija)) > 999    then
                    w_sanghw_aek    := p_aekm + w_misu_ija;
            else    w_sanghw_aek    := p_sanghw_aek;
            end if;

        elsif xx.cash_cd = 'AA' then    -- 지분증권
            w_misu_ija  := trunc (p_aekm * xx.pyom_iyul / 12 * trunc (months_between(xx.sanghw_ymd,xx.balh_ymd)));
            if  months_between (xx.sanghw_ymd,xx.balh_ymd) != trunc (months_between(xx.sanghw_ymd,xx.balh_ymd))         then
                w_misu_ija  := w_misu_ija + (trunc (p_aekm * xx.pyom_iyul / 365 * (xx.sanghw_ymd - ADD_MONTHS(xx.balh_ymd, trunc (months_between(xx.sanghw_ymd, xx.balh_ymd))))));
            end if;
            w_chui_aek      := p_aekm;
            w_sanghw_aek    := p_aekm + w_misu_ija;

        else    -- 정기예금
            w_misu_ija      := trunc (p_aekm * xx.pyom_iyul / xx.yy_ija_hoicha);
            w_chui_aek      := p_aekm;
            w_sanghw_aek    := p_aekm + w_misu_ija;
        end if;

        -- 현금 마스타 Select
        -- 유효이자율평가액 = 전일평가액 + 당일매입액 + 당일매입분선급비용
        BEGIN
            SELECT ROWID
                 , NVL(bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(meib_aekm,0) 
                 , NVL(anbun_aek,0) 
              INTO w_shm0hm
                 , hm_aekm
                 , hm_anbun_aek
              FROM SHM0HM t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
               AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
               AND t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            w_shm0hm            := NULL;
            hm_aekm             := 0;
            hm_anbun_aek        := 0;
        END;

        if  xx.sunhu_gb = '1'   then    -- 선취수령이자
            w_sunsu_ija := w_misu_ija;
            w_misu_ija  := 0;
        else
            w_sunsu_ija := 0;
        end if;

        -- 매매분 분개 처리
        if  xx.cash_cd IN ('ZF','ZS')   then    -- 전단채
            UPDATE SHM0HJ ff  
               SET meib_suik_rt = p_tr_iyul
             WHERE ROWID        = xx.rowid
               AND meib_suik_rt IS NULL;

            w_dr_aek    := 0;
            w_cr_aek    := 0;
            if NVL (p_tr_aek,0) = 0 then
                w_aek   := number_varray_50 (w_chui_aek,w_chui_aek + w_sung_cost,w_sung_cost);
            else
                if (w_chui_aek + NVL(w_sung_cost,0)) > p_tr_aek     then    w_cr_aek    := (w_chui_aek + NVL(w_sung_cost,0)) - p_tr_aek;
                elsif (w_chui_aek + NVL(w_sung_cost,0)) < p_tr_aek  then    w_dr_aek    := p_tr_aek - (w_chui_aek + NVL(w_sung_cost,0));
                end if;
                w_aek   := number_varray_50 (w_chui_aek,p_tr_aek,w_sung_cost,w_dr_aek,w_cr_aek);
            end if;
            if  xx.cash_cd = 'ZS'       then
                SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', 'Z', p_fund_cd, 'KRW'
                            ,p_jm_cd, p_seq_no, 2, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC0511 ZS', w_msg);
            elsif xx.cash_cd = 'ZF' then
                SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', 'ZF', p_fund_cd, 'KRW'
                            ,p_jm_cd, p_seq_no, 2, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC0511 ZF', w_msg);
            end if;

        else
            if  xx.cash_cd = '71'   then
                    w_aek   := number_varray_50 (w_chui_aek,p_tr_aek,0,0);
            else    w_aek   := number_varray_50 (w_chui_aek,p_tr_aek,w_sung_cost,0,0,0,0);
            end if;
            if  xx.cash_cd = '20'   then    -- 매매시 임의 수정으로 인한 취득액과의 차이 손익처리
                if  w_aek (1) < w_aek (2)   then
                        w_aek(3)    := w_aek(2) - w_aek(1);
                else    w_aek(4)    := w_aek(1) - w_aek(2);
                end if;
            elsif xx.cash_cd = 'DC'     then    -- 대출채권
                w_aek(1)    := p_aekm;
                w_aek(3)    := w_sunsu_ija;
                if  p_aekm = p_tr_aek   then
                    w_aek(4)    := 0;
                    w_aek(5)    := w_sunsu_ija;
                else
                    w_aek(4)    := w_aek(1) - w_aek(2) - w_aek(3);
                end if;
            end if;
            if  xx.other_cost > 0   then
                w_aek(6)    := xx.other_cost;
                w_aek(7)    := xx.other_cost;
            end if;
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.cash_cd, p_fund_cd, 'KRW'
                        ,p_jm_cd, p_seq_no, 2, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC0511' || xx.cash_cd, w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 현금거래내역 갱신
        if  p_rowid IS NOT NULL then
            UPDATE SHT0HG ff  
               SET tr_aek       = CASE WHEN NVL(tr_aek,0)=0 THEN w_chui_aek + w_sung_cost
                                                            ELSE tr_aek  END
                 , sanghw_aek   = w_sanghw_aek
                 , sung_cost    = w_sung_cost
                 , sunsu_ija    = w_sunsu_ija
                 , mijigub_tax  = trunc (w_sunn_tax, -1)
             WHERE ROWID = p_rowid;
        end if;

        -- 전체분 구간이자 생성
        if  xx.cash_cd NOT IN ('70','90')       then    -- RP예금,예금은 일별 이자계산
            BEGIN
                SELECT trunc(gugan_ija * (p_aekm + hm_aekm)) 
                     , bf_ija_ymd
                     , af_ija_ymd
                     , ROUND(gugan_ija * (p_aekm + hm_aekm) / gugan_ilsu) 
                  INTO w_now_gugan_ija
                     , w_now_bf_ija_ymd
                     , w_now_af_ija_ymd
                     , w_day_ija
                  FROM SHJ0IG t1
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd
                   AND p_ymd      Between bf_ija_ymd And (af_ija_ymd - 1);
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                P_msg   := p_jm_cd || '- 이자구간 정보를 확인하십시오.';
                RETURN;
            END;
        elsif xx.cash_cd IN ('ZS','ZF') then
                w_day_ija   := ROUND((p_aekm + hm_aekm) * p_tr_iyul / 365);
        else    w_day_ija   := ROUND((p_aekm + hm_aekm) * xx.pyom_iyul / 365);
        end if;

        if  p_tr_cd = 'L13' then    -- 현금편입시 매매차이분 보정처리
            w_sung_cost := p_tr_aek - (w_chui_aek - NVL(w_yesu_tax,0));

        elsif xx.cash_cd NOT IN ('ZS','ZF') And NVL (p_sanghw_aek,0) != 0   then    -- 매매 입력금액 사용
            w_sung_cost     := p_sung_cost;
            w_sanghw_aek    := p_sanghw_aek;
        end if;

        -- 현금마스타
        if  w_shm0hm IS NOT NULL    then
            UPDATE SHM0HM ff  
               SET meib_aekm     = NVL(meib_aekm,0) + p_aekm
                 , meib_aek      = NVL(meib_aek,0) + w_chui_aek + hm_anbun_aek
                 , sanghw_aek    = NVL(sanghw_aek,0) + w_sanghw_aek
                 , anbun_aek     = 0
                 , sung_cost     = NVL(sung_cost,0) + w_sung_cost
                 , up_sunsu_ija  = NVL(up_sunsu_ija,0) + w_sunsu_ija
                 , sunn_tax      = NVL(sunn_tax,0) + trunc (w_sunn_tax, -1)
                 , yesu_tax      = NVL(yesu_tax,0) + trunc (w_yesu_tax, -1)
                 , lst_meib_ymd  = p_ymd
             WHERE ROWID = w_shm0hm;
        else
            BEGIN
                INSERT  INTO SHM0HM ff  
                    ( corp_gr       /* _1- */
                    , ymd           /* _2- */
                    , fund_cd       /* _3- */
                    , jm_cd         /* _4- */
                    , meib_aekm     /* _5- */
                    , meib_aek      /* _6- */
                    , sanghw_aek    /* _7- */
                    , sung_cost     /* _8- */
                    , up_sunsu_ija  /* _9- */
                    , sunn_tax      /* _10- */
                    , yesu_tax      /* _11- */
                    , lst_meib_ymd  /* _12- */
                    )
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr              /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd                  /* _2- */
                       , p_fund_cd              /* _3- */
                       , p_jm_cd                /* _4- */
                       , p_aekm                 /* _5- */
                       , w_chui_aek             /* _6- */
                       , w_sanghw_aek           /* _7- */
                       , w_sung_cost            /* _8- */
                       , w_sunsu_ija            /* _9- */
                       , trunc(w_sunn_tax, -1)  /* _10- */
                       , trunc(w_yesu_tax, -1)  /* _11- */
                       , p_ymd                  /* _12- */
                       );
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                p_msg   := p_ymd || '-' || p_fund_cd || '-' || p_jm_cd || '-현금마스타 생성 오류입니다.';
                RETURN;
            END;
        end if;
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    p_msg   := 'PROC0511:' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0512 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_seq_no                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_aekm                         IN    NUMBER,
    p_tr_aek                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_tr_co_cd                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_susu_ga                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_tax                          IN    NUMBER,
    p_mm_sonik                     OUT   NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 현금 매도 회계처리
--
    w_aekm                       NUMBER;
    w_aekm_bi                    NUMBER;
    w_chui_aek                   NUMBER;
    w_anbun_aek                  NUMBER;
    w_misu_ija                   NUMBER;
    w_skm0et_misu_ija            NUMBER;
    w_sunsu_ija                  NUMBER;
    w_sung_cost                  NUMBER;
    w_tax                        NUMBER;
    w_sanghw_aek                 NUMBER;
    w_platform_fee               NUMBER;

    w_dr_hab                     NUMBER;
    w_cr_hab                     NUMBER;
    w_dr_aek                     NUMBER;
    w_cr_aek                     NUMBER;

    w_aek                        number_varray_50;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    p_msg   := p_fund_cd || ' ' || p_jm_cd || '- 현금종목 정보가 없습니다.';

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.cash_cd                                                           /* _1- */
             , t1.sunhu_gb                                                          /* _2- */
             , t1.balh_ymd                                                          /* _3- */
             , t1.meib_ymd                                                          /* _4- */
             , t1.sanghw_ymd                                                        /* _5- */
             , hm.sanghw_aek                                                        /* _6- */
             , t1.broker_cd                                                         /* _7- */
             , CASE WHEN t1.cash_cd LIKE 'Z%' AND NVL(t1.pyom_iyul,0)=0
                    THEN t1.meib_suik_rt
                    ELSE t1.pyom_iyul
               END                                                AS ija_iyul       /* _8- */
             , ig.gugan_no                                                          /* _9- */
             , ig.bf_ija_ymd                                                        /* _10- */
             , ig.af_ija_ymd                                                        /* _11- */
             , ig.gugan_ija                                                         /* _12- */
             , t1.tax_offer_gb                                                      /* _13- */
             , NVL(hm.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(hm.meib_aekm,0)
                                   - NVL(hm.medo_aekm,0)          AS boyu_aekm      /* _14- */
             , NVL(hm.anbun_aek,0)                                AS anbun_aek      /* _15- */
             , NVL(hm.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(hm.meib_aek,0)
                                       - NVL(hm.medo_aek,0)       AS chui_aek       /* _16- */
             , NVL(hm.misu_ija,0)                                 AS misu_ija       /* _17- */
             , NVL(hm.bfil_sunsu_ija,0) + NVL(hm.up_sunsu_ija,0)
                                        - NVL(hm.dw_sunsu_ija,0)  AS sunsu_ija      /* _18- */
             , NVL(hm.sung_cost,0)                                AS sung_cost      /* _19- */
             , hm.lst_meib_ymd                                                      /* _20- */
             , NVL(hm.susu_ga,0) - NVL(hm.bfil_susu_ga,0)         AS susu_ga        /* _21- */
             , NVL(hm.susu_09900,0) - NVL(hm.bfil_susu_09900,0)   AS susu_09900     /* _22- */
             , hm.rowid                                                             /* _23- */
             , CASE WHEN ig.bf_ija_ymd=p_ymd
                    THEN 0
                    ELSE CASE WHEN p_aekm=NVL(hm.bfil_aekm,0)
                              THEN NVL(hm.bfil_sunsu_ija,0)
                              ELSE TRUNC ((p_aekm * ig.gugan_ija) / ig.gugan_ilsu * (ig.af_ija_ymd - p_ymd))
                         END
               END                                                AS jan_sunsu_ija  /* _24- */
          FROM SHM0HJ t1
             , SHM0HM hm
             , SHJ0IG ig
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd
           AND hm.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND hm.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND hm.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND hm.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND ig.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ig.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND p_ymd      Between ig.bf_ija_ymd AND (ig.af_ija_ymd - 1)
    ) loop
        w_aekm  := xx.boyu_aekm - p_aekm;
        if  w_aekm < 0      then
            p_msg   := p_tr_cd || '-' || p_fund_cd || '-' || p_jm_cd
                               || ' 거래전 액면(' || w_aekm || ') 확인.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 각항목의 비율 = 거래 액면 / 거래전 액면
        w_aekm_bi       := p_aekm / xx.boyu_aekm;
        w_chui_aek      := TRUNC(xx.chui_aek * w_aekm_bi + 0.01);
        w_anbun_aek     := TRUNC(xx.anbun_aek * w_aekm_bi + 0.01);
        w_sanghw_aek    := TRUNC(xx.sanghw_aek * w_aekm_bi + 0.01);
        w_misu_ija      := TRUNC(xx.misu_ija * w_aekm_bi + 0.01);
        w_sunsu_ija     := 0;
        w_sung_cost     := TRUNC(xx.sung_cost * w_aekm_bi + 0.01);
        w_tax           := TRUNC(p_tax * w_aekm_bi + 0.01);

        -- 수수료 선급비용 해당액 분개
        if (xx.susu_ga + xx.susu_09900) > 0     then
            UPDATE SHM0HM tt  
               SET day_susu_ga    = NVL(day_susu_ga,0) + TRUNC(xx.susu_ga * w_aekm_bi)
                 , day_susu_09900 = NVL(day_susu_09900,0) + TRUNC(xx.susu_09900 * w_aekm_bi)
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'P11', 'A', '1', 'H0', p_fund_cd, 'KRW',
                        p_jm_cd, 11, p_seq_no, TRUNC (xx.susu_ga * w_aekm_bi + 0.01), p_proc_step, 'PROC0512', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg   := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'P11', 'A', '1', 'H0', p_fund_cd, 'KRW',
                        p_jm_cd, 12, p_seq_no, TRUNC (xx.susu_09900 * w_aekm_bi + 0.01), p_proc_step, 'PROC0512', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg   := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;

        w_dr_hab    := p_tr_aek;
        w_cr_hab    := w_chui_aek + w_anbun_aek + w_misu_ija + w_sung_cost - w_tax;
        if  w_dr_hab > w_cr_hab     then
            w_dr_aek    := 0;
            w_cr_aek    := w_dr_hab - w_cr_hab;
        else
            w_dr_aek    := w_cr_hab - w_dr_hab;
            w_cr_aek    := 0;
        end if;

        if  xx.cash_cd IN ('ZF','ZS')   then    -- 전단채
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (p_tr_aek, w_chui_aek + w_anbun_aek,
                                         0, w_sung_cost,
                                         0, w_misu_ija,
                                         w_dr_aek, w_cr_aek,
                                         w_tax, 0);
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'K30', 'A', '1', 'Z', p_fund_cd, 'KRW',
                        p_jm_cd, p_seq_no, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC0512', w_msg);

        elsif xx.cash_cd = 'DC' then    -- 대출채권
            if  xx.sunhu_gb = '1'   then
                w_sunsu_ija := xx.jan_sunsu_ija;
                w_dr_aek    := (p_aekm - w_sunsu_ija) - p_tr_aek;
                w_cr_aek    := p_tr_aek - (p_aekm - w_sunsu_ija);
                w_aek       := number_varray_50 (p_tr_aek, p_aekm,
                                                 w_sunsu_ija,
                                                 CASE WHEN w_dr_aek > 0 THEN w_dr_aek END,
                                                 CASE WHEN w_cr_aek > 0 THEN w_cr_aek END);
                SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', 'D1', p_fund_cd, 'KRW',
                            p_jm_cd, p_seq_no, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC0512', w_msg);
            else
                w_dr_aek    := (p_aekm + w_misu_ija) - p_tr_aek;
                w_cr_aek    := p_tr_aek - (p_aekm + w_misu_ija);
                w_aek       := number_varray_50 (p_tr_aek, p_aekm,
                                                 w_misu_ija,
                                                 CASE WHEN w_dr_aek > 0 THEN w_dr_aek END,
                                                 CASE WHEN w_cr_aek > 0 THEN w_cr_aek END);
                SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', 'DC', p_fund_cd, 'KRW',
                            p_jm_cd, p_seq_no, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC0512', w_msg);
            end if;
        else
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (p_tr_aek, w_chui_aek + w_anbun_aek,
                                         0, w_misu_ija,
                                         0, w_sung_cost,
                                         w_dr_aek, w_cr_aek,
                                         w_tax, 0);
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.cash_cd, p_fund_cd, 'KRW',
                        p_jm_cd, p_seq_no, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'PROC0512', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg       := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        p_mm_sonik  := w_cr_aek - w_dr_aek;

        INSERT INTO SHM1K tt  
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr              /* _1- */
               , p_fund_cd              /* _2- */
               , p_jm_cd                /* _3- */
               , xx.meib_ymd            /* _4- */
               , p_ymd                  /* _5- */
               , p_aekm                 /* _6- */
               , p_tr_aek - w_tax       /* _7- */
               , w_chui_aek             /* _8- */
               , xx.gugan_no            /* _9- */
               , xx.bf_ija_ymd          /* _10- */
               , xx.af_ija_ymd          /* _11- */
               , xx.gugan_ija * p_aekm  /* _12- */
               , w_misu_ija             /* _13- */
               , w_tax                  /* _14- */
               );

        -- 현금 마스타 갱신
        if  w_aekm != 0     then
            UPDATE SHM0HM tt  
               SET medo_aekm    = NVL(medo_aekm,0) + p_aekm
                 , medo_aek     = NVL(medo_aek,0) + w_chui_aek
                 , anbun_aek    = NVL(anbun_aek,0) - w_anbun_aek
                 , misu_ija     = NVL(misu_ija,0) - w_misu_ija
                 , dw_sunsu_ija = NVL(dw_sunsu_ija,0) + w_sunsu_ija
                 , sung_cost    = NVL(sung_cost,0) - w_sung_cost
                 , sanghw_aek   = NVL(sanghw_aek,0) - w_sanghw_aek
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND ymd     = p_ymd
               AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
               AND jm_cd   = p_jm_cd;
        else
            UPDATE SHM0HM tt  
               SET medo_aekm     = NVL(medo_aekm,0) + p_aekm
                 , medo_aek      = NVL(medo_aek,0) + w_chui_aek
                 , dw_sunsu_ija  = NVL(dw_sunsu_ija,0) + w_sunsu_ija
                 , sanghw_aek    = 0
                 , anbun_aek     = 0
                 , misu_ija      = 0
                 , sung_cost     = 0
                 , day_ija       = 0
                 , day_anbun_aek = 0
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND ymd     = p_ymd
               AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
               AND jm_cd   = p_jm_cd;
        end if;
        p_msg   := 'Y';
    END LOOP;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0520 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 채권 회계처리
--
    w_sunme_yn                     VARCHAR (1)  default 'N';    /* 선매출 여부 */
    w_jy_yn                        char (1);

    w_sc_gugan_ija                 NUMBER := 0;
    w_sc_day_ija                   NUMBER := 0;

    ig_gugan_ilsu                  NUMBER;
    ig_gugan_ija                   NUMBER;
    ig_pr_gugan_ilsu               NUMBER;
    ig_pr_gugan_ija                NUMBER;
    ig_pass_ilsu                   NUMBER;

    w_chui_yesu_tax                NUMBER;
    w_chui_aek                     NUMBER;
    w_tr_aek                       NUMBER;
    w_tr_chui_aek                  NUMBER;
    w_anbun_aek                    NUMBER;
    w_misu_ija                     NUMBER;
    w_sunsu_ija                    NUMBER;
    w_sung_cost                    NUMBER;
    w_pr_sung_cost                 NUMBER;
    w_cbmg_misu_ija                NUMBER;
    w_cbmg_sung_cost               NUMBER;
    w_yesu_tax                     NUMBER;
    w_sung_tax                     NUMBER;

    w_jkm_aek                      NUMBER;
    w_aekm                         NUMBER;

    w_jasan_gb                     szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;

    w_dr_hab                       NUMBER;
    w_cr_hab                       NUMBER;

    w_biyul                        NUMBER;
    w_jangbu_sonik                 NUMBER;
    w_pr_misu_ija                  NUMBER;

    w_aek                          number_varray_50;

    w_medo_rt                      NUMBER;

    cm_aekm                        NUMBER;
    cm_chui_aek                    NUMBER;
    cm_anbun_aek                   NUMBER;
    cm_misu_ija                    NUMBER;
    cm_pr_misu_ija                 NUMBER;
    cm_sung_cost                   NUMBER;
    cm_pr_sung_cost                NUMBER;
    cm_cbmg_misu_ija               NUMBER;
    cm_cbmg_sung_cost              NUMBER;
    cm_lst_meib_ymd                DATE;

    w1_aekm                        NUMBER := 0;
    w1_chui_aek                    NUMBER := 0;
    w_tr_anbun_aek                 NUMBER := 0;

    w_cha_aek                      NUMBER := 0;
    w_dr_aek1                      NUMBER := 0;
    w_cr_aek2                      NUMBER := 0;
    w_dr_aek3                      NUMBER := 0;
    w_cr_aek5                      NUMBER := 0;
    w_cr_aek6                      NUMBER := 0;
    w_cr_aek7                      NUMBER := 0;
    w_cr_aek8                      NUMBER := 0;
    w_dr_aek9                      NUMBER := 0;
    w_cr_aek10                     NUMBER := 0;
    w_dr_aek11                     NUMBER := 0;

    jb_gyul_mm                     sjx0jb.gyul_mm%type;
    w_sosok_gb                     sjx0jb.sosok_gb%type;
    w_woos_ilban_gb                sjm0jj.woos_ilban_gb%type;

    w_chg_year                     VARCHAR (4);
    w_chg_mm                       VARCHAR (2);
    w_af_gyul_ymd                  DATE;
    w_bf_gyul_ymd                  DATE;
    w_ija                          NUMBER := 0;

    w_new_jm_nm                    VARCHAR (40);

    sg_avg_danga                   NUMBER;
    sg_gavg_danga                  NUMBER;

    sm_aek                         NUMBER;
    sc_misu_ija                    NUMBER;
    sc_sung_cost                   NUMBER;

    w_gijun_ga                     NUMBER;
    w_ggijun_ga                    NUMBER;
    w_gaek                         NUMBER;
    w_com                          NUMBER;
    w_susu                         NUMBER;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0520', p_ymd || ' : 채권 회계처리 초기화' );

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B000', 'skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0bu.proc_step=52', '채권회계처리 분개장(skt0bu) 삭제' );

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND t1.proc_step = 52;

    -- SCT0CI 생성 자문제외

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sct0cg.ymd=' || p_ymd, '채권 매입 선급비용 계산' );

    if  p_corp_gr = '2402' AND p_ymd = TO_DATE ('20240515','yyyymmdd')  then
        -- 초기생성
        DELETE FROM SCM1J tt    /* 채권 매수 */
         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND buy_date <= TO_CHAR(p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');

        DELETE FROM SCM1K tt    /* 채권 매도(이자수령) */
         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND buy_date <= TO_CHAR(p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');
    else
        DELETE FROM SCM1J tt    /* 채권 매수 */
         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND buy_date = TO_CHAR(p_ymd,'yyyymmdd');

        -- 매도 SCM1K 테이블은 sr_proc0220에서 삭제처리
    end if;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                           /* _1- */
             , t1.buy_date                                        /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                         /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                           /* _4- */
             , t1.tr_ymd                                          /* _5- */
             , t1.aekm                       AS aekm              /* _6- */
             , t1.tr_aek                     AS tr_aek            /* _7- */
             , t1.pass_ija                                        /* _8- */
             , t1.pass_sc_ija                                     /* _9- */
             , t1.pass_pr_ija                                     /* _10- */
             , t1.sc_yesu_tax                                     /* _11- */
             , t1.yesu_tax                                        /* _12- */
             , t1.pr_yesu_tax                                     /* _13- */
             , t1.pg_cd                                           /* _14- */
             , t1.bigo                                            /* _15- */
             , cj.balh_ymd                                        /* _16- */
             , cj.medo_ymd                                        /* _17- */
             , cj.sanghw_ymd                                      /* _18- */
             , cj.sunme_ija_ymd                                   /* _19- */
             , NVL(cj.sun_tax_napbu_gb,'N')  AS sun_tax_napbu_gb  /* _20- */
             , cj.now_gugan_no                                    /* _21- */
             , cj.bf_ija_ymd                                      /* _22- */
             , cj.af_ija_ymd                                      /* _23- */
             , cj.sunhu_gb                                        /* _24- */
          FROM SCT0CG t1  /* 채권거래내역 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd    LIKE 'J%'
           AND t1.sudo_ymd = p_ymd
           AND cj.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        -- 선매출 여부를 확인
        if  xx.medo_ymd < xx.balh_ymd           then    w_sunme_yn := 'Y';
            if  xx.sunme_ija_ymd <= xx.tr_ymd   then    w_sunme_yn := 'N';
            end if;
        end if;

        xx.pass_sc_ija := 0;
        xx.sc_yesu_tax := 0;
        if  w_sunme_yn = 'Y'    then
            -- 선매출 이자계산
            BEGIN
                SELECT TRUNC(gugan_ija * xx.aekm)
                     , TRUNC(gugan_ija * xx.aekm / gugan_ilsu)
                  INTO w_sc_gugan_ija
                     , w_sc_day_ija
                  FROM SCJ0IG ig  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
                 WHERE ig.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND ig.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
                   AND ig.ija_gb   = 'B'
                   AND ig.gugan_no = 0;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                w_sc_gugan_ija := 0;
                w_sc_day_ija   := 0;
            END;
            if  xx.tr_ymd < xx.balh_ymd     then
                    xx.pass_sc_ija := TRUNC (w_sc_day_ija * (xx.tr_ymd - xx.medo_ymd + 1));
            else    xx.pass_sc_ija := w_sc_gugan_ija;
            end if;
            xx.sc_yesu_tax := 0;  /* 선매출구간 세금 기납부 */
        end if;

        -- 경과이자 계산
        SR_NOW_GUGAN_IJA (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.jm_cd, xx.aekm,
                          ig_gugan_ilsu, ig_gugan_ija, ig_pr_gugan_ilsu, ig_pr_gugan_ija, ig_pass_ilsu, xx.pass_ija, xx.pass_pr_ija,
                          xx.now_gugan_no, xx.bf_ija_ymd, xx.af_ija_ymd, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'IJA1', xx.fund_cd, F_NTRIM (xx.aekm) || ' ' || F_NTRIM (ig_gugan_ilsu) || ' ' || F_NTRIM (ig_gugan_ija)
                                                                 || ' ' || F_NTRIM (ig_pr_gugan_ilsu) || ' ' || F_NTRIM (ig_pr_gugan_ija));
        SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'IJA2', xx.jm_cd, F_NTRIM (ig_pass_ilsu) || ' ' || F_NTRIM (xx.pass_ija) || ' ' || F_NTRIM (xx.pass_pr_ija) );

        xx.sc_yesu_tax  := 0;
        xx.yesu_tax     := 0;
        xx.pr_yesu_tax  := 0;
        w_chui_yesu_tax := 0;
        w_chui_yesu_tax := 0;

        MERGE INTO SCM1J tt  /* 채권 매수 */
           USING DUAL ON ( corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                       AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                       AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
                       AND buy_date = xx.buy_date )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET aekm      = aekm + xx.aekm
                  , aek       = aek + xx.tr_aek
                  , chui_aek  = chui_aek + xx.tr_aek                                        /* 자문은 경과이자를 취득액으로 처리 */
                  , gugan_ija = gugan_ija + ig_gugan_ija
                  , pass_ija  = pass_ija + (xx.pass_sc_ija + xx.pass_ija + xx.pass_pr_ija)  /* 경과이자 계산만 하고 선급비용 대신 취득액으로 처리 */
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                      /* _1- */
