                    , xx.fund_cd                                     /* _2- */
                    , xx.jm_cd                                       /* _3- */
                    , xx.buy_date                                    /* _4- */
                    , xx.aekm                                        /* _5- */
                    , xx.tr_aek                                      /* _6- */
                    , xx.tr_aek                                      /* _7-자문은 경과이자를 취득액으로 처리 하므로 매매액을 취득액으로 */
                    , xx.now_gugan_no                                /* _8- */
                    , xx.bf_ija_ymd                                  /* _9- */
                    , xx.af_ija_ymd                                  /* _10- */
                    , ig_gugan_ija                                   /* _11- */
                    , xx.pass_sc_ija + xx.pass_ija + xx.pass_pr_ija  /* _12-경과이자 계산만 하고 선급비용 대신 취득액으로 처리 */
                    , xx.pg_cd                                       /* _13- */
                    );

        --  경과이자 계산만 하고 선급비용 대신 취득액으로 처리
        xx.pass_sc_ija := 0;
        xx.pass_ija    := 0;
        xx.pass_pr_ija := 0;

        UPDATE SCT0CG tt    /* 채권거래내역 */
           SET chui_aek    = xx.tr_aek - (xx.pass_sc_ija + xx.pass_ija + xx.pass_pr_ija) + w_chui_yesu_tax
             , ija_aekm    = xx.aekm
             , pass_sc_ija = xx.pass_sc_ija
             , pass_ija    = xx.pass_ija
             , pass_pr_ija = xx.pass_pr_ija
             , sunsu_ija   = CASE WHEN xx.sunhu_gb='1' THEN ig_gugan_ija - xx.pass_ija
                                                       ELSE NULL END
             , sc_yesu_tax = xx.sc_yesu_tax
             , yesu_tax    = xx.yesu_tax
             , pr_yesu_tax = xx.pr_yesu_tax
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        BEGIN
            SELECT jy_yn
              INTO w_jy_yn
              FROM SCM1PG ta  /* 채권 평가등급 자료 */
             WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND ta.ymd     = (SELECT MAX(ymd)
                                   FROM SCM1PG tt  /* 채권 평가등급 자료 */
                                  WHERE tt.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                    AND tt.ymd     < p_ymd
                                    AND tt.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd)
               AND ta.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_jy_yn := 'N';
        END;

        BEGIN
            -- 신규는 우량으로 등록 202406
            INSERT INTO SCM1PG tt  /* 채권 평가등급 자료 */
            VALUES( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.jm_cd, xx.pg_cd, w_jy_yn );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            -- 종목별 신용등급은 동일하므로 동일일자 생성은 한번만.
            NULL;
        END;
    end loop;

    -- 자문은 개별법이므로 매도시 기존 매수분에 매도액면 처리 20240527
    -- 과거 매도분처리 (최초 한번작업)
    -- 이후는 잔액을 기준으로 취득액 등록하므로 사용하면 안됨.
    if  p_corp_gr = '2402' AND p_ymd = TO_DATE ('20240515','yyyymmdd') then
        for xx IN (
            SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                /* _1- */
                 , t1.fund_cd                               /* _2- */
                 , ia.type_gb                               /* _3- */
                 , t1.jm_cd                                 /* _4- */
                 , t1.buy_date                              /* _5- */
                 , t1.seq_no                                /* _6- */
                 , t1.tr_co_cd                              /* _7- */
                 , t1.aekm                                  /* _8- */
                 , cj.sanghw_ymd                            /* _9- */
                 , jj.chui_aek / jj.aekm  AS danga          /* _10- */
                 , jj.gugan_no                              /* _11- */
                 , jj.bf_ija_ymd                            /* _12- */
                 , jj.af_ija_ymd                            /* _13- */
                 , 0                      AS meib_aekm      /* _14- */
                 , 0                      AS meib_chui_aek  /* _15- */
                 , 0                      AS medo_aekm      /* _16- */
                 , 0                      AS medo_chui_aek  /* _17- */
                 , 0                      AS pass_ija       /* _18- */
                 , 0                      AS pass_pr_ija    /* _19- */
              FROM SCT0CG t1  /* 채권거래내역 */
                 , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
                 , SCM1J  jj  /* 채권 매수 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.tr_cd    = 'K13'
               AND t1.sudo_ymd <= p_ymd
               AND cj.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND cj.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
               AND jj.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND jj.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
               AND jj.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
               AND jj.buy_date = t1.buy_date
               AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
             ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                    , t1.jm_cd
                    , t1.tr_ymd
                    , t1.seq_no
        ) loop
            -- 매도분 경과이자 계산
            if  xx.tr_ymd = xx.sanghw_ymd   then
                SR_NOW_GUGAN_IJA (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd - 1, xx.jm_cd, xx.aekm,
                                  ig_gugan_ilsu, ig_gugan_ija, ig_pr_gugan_ilsu, ig_pr_gugan_ija, ig_pass_ilsu, xx.pass_ija, xx.pass_pr_ija,
                                  xx.gugan_no, xx.bf_ija_ymd, xx.af_ija_ymd, w_msg);
            else
                SR_NOW_GUGAN_IJA (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.jm_cd, xx.aekm,
                                  ig_gugan_ilsu, ig_gugan_ija, ig_pr_gugan_ilsu, ig_pr_gugan_ija, ig_pass_ilsu, xx.pass_ija, xx.pass_pr_ija,
                                  xx.gugan_no, xx.bf_ija_ymd, xx.af_ija_ymd, w_msg);
            end if;

            SELECT NVL(SUM(tj.aekm),0)
                 , NVL(SUM(tj.chui_aek),0)
                 , NVL(SUM(tk.aekm),0)
                 , NVL(SUM(tk.chui_aek),0)
              INTO xx.meib_aekm
                 , xx.meib_chui_aek
                 , xx.medo_aekm
                 , xx.medo_chui_aek
              FROM SCM1J tj  /* 채권 매수 */
                 , SCM1K tk  /* 채권 매도(이자수령) */
             WHERE tj.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND tj.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND tj.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
               AND tj.buy_date    = xx.buy_date
               AND tk.corp_gr(+)  = tj.corp_gr
               AND tk.fund_cd(+)  = tj.fund_cd
               AND tk.ymd(+)      < xx.tr_ymd
               AND tk.jm_cd(+)    = tj.jm_cd
               AND tk.buy_date(+) = tj.buy_date;
            if  xx.meib_aekm = (xx.medo_aekm + xx.aekm) then
                    xx.medo_chui_aek := xx.meib_chui_aek - xx.medo_chui_aek;
            else    xx.medo_chui_aek := ROUND( xx.danga * xx.aekm);
            end if;

            INSERT INTO SCM1K tt    /* 채권 매도(이자수령) */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                      /* _1- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                                                     /* _2- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                                                       /* _3- */
                   , xx.buy_date                                                    /* _4- */
                   , xx.tr_ymd                                                      /* _5- */
                   , xx.aekm                                                        /* _6- */
                   , xx.medo_chui_aek                                               /* _7- */
                   , xx.medo_chui_aek                                               /* _8- */
                   , xx.gugan_no                                                    /* _9- */
                   , xx.bf_ija_ymd                                                  /* _10- */
                   , xx.af_ija_ymd                                                  /* _11- */
                   , ig_gugan_ija                                                   /* _12- */
                   , xx.pass_ija + xx.pass_pr_ija                                   /* _13- */
                   , TRUNC((xx.pass_ija + xx.pass_pr_ija) * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))  /* _14- */
                   );

            -- 자문 초기자료를 위한 처리(매도시 액면만 입력해서)
            -- 매도분은 합산해서 1건만 입력 할 것.(초기자료)
            UPDATE SCT0CG tt    /* 채권거래내역 */
               SET tr_aek   = xx.medo_chui_aek
                 , chui_aek = xx.medo_chui_aek
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND tr_ymd   = xx.tr_ymd
               AND tr_cd    = 'K13'
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND buy_date = xx.buy_date
               AND seq_no   = xx.seq_no;
        end loop;
    else
        -- scm0cm 잔고이용으로 수정
        for xx IN (
            SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                /* _1- */
                 , t1.fund_cd                               /* _2- */
                 , ia.type_gb                               /* _3- */
                 , t1.jm_cd                                 /* _4- */
                 , t1.buy_date                              /* _5- */
                 , t1.seq_no                                /* _6- */
                 , t1.tr_co_cd                              /* _7- */
                 , t1.aekm                                  /* _8- */
                 , t1.tr_aek                                /* _9- */
                 , jj.chui_aek / jj.aekm  AS danga          /* _10- */
                 , jj.gugan_no                              /* _11- */
                 , jj.bf_ija_ymd                            /* _12- */
                 , jj.af_ija_ymd                            /* _13- */
                 , 0                      AS meib_aekm      /* _14- */
                 , 0                      AS meib_chui_aek  /* _15- */
                 , 0                      AS medo_aekm      /* _16- */
                 , 0                      AS medo_chui_aek  /* _17- */
                 , 0                      AS pass_ija       /* _18- */
                 , 0                      AS pass_pr_ija    /* _19- */
              FROM SCT0CG t1  /* 채권거래내역 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 , SCM1J  jj  /* 채권 매수 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
               AND t1.tr_cd    = 'K13'
               AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
               AND jj.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND jj.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
               AND jj.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
               AND jj.buy_date = t1.buy_date
             ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                    , t1.jm_cd
                    , t1.tr_ymd
                    , t1.seq_no
        ) loop
            -- 매도분 경과이자 계산
            SR_NOW_GUGAN_IJA (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.jm_cd, xx.aekm,
                              ig_gugan_ilsu, ig_gugan_ija, ig_pr_gugan_ilsu, ig_pr_gugan_ija, ig_pass_ilsu, xx.pass_ija, xx.pass_pr_ija,
                              xx.gugan_no, xx.bf_ija_ymd, xx.af_ija_ymd, w_msg);

            SELECT NVL(SUM(tj.aekm),0)
                 , NVL(SUM(tj.chui_aek),0)
                 , NVL(SUM(tk.aekm),0)
                 , NVL(SUM(tk.chui_aek),0)
              INTO xx.meib_aekm
                 , xx.meib_chui_aek
                 , xx.medo_aekm
                 , xx.medo_chui_aek
              FROM SCM1J tj  /* 채권 매수 */
                 , SCM1K tk  /* 채권 매도(이자수령) */
             WHERE tj.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND tj.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND tj.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
               AND tj.buy_date    = xx.buy_date
               AND tk.corp_gr(+)  = tj.corp_gr
               AND tk.fund_cd(+)  = tj.fund_cd
               AND tk.ymd(+)      < p_ymd
               AND tk.jm_cd(+)    = tj.jm_cd
               AND tk.buy_date(+) = tj.buy_date;
            if  xx.meib_aekm = (xx.medo_aekm + xx.aekm) then
                    xx.medo_chui_aek := xx.meib_chui_aek - xx.medo_chui_aek;
            else    xx.medo_chui_aek := ROUND( xx.danga * xx.aekm);
            end if;

            -- 이자수령이 있으므로 MERGE
            MERGE INTO SCM1K mt  /* 채권 매도(이자수령) */
               USING DUAL ON ( mt.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                           AND mt.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                           AND mt.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
                           AND mt.buy_date = xx.buy_date
                           AND mt.ymd      = xx.tr_ymd )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                 UPDATE
                    SET aekm      = NVL(aekm,0) + xx.aekm
                      , aek       = NVL(aek,0) + xx.tr_aek
                      , chui_aek  = NVL(chui_aek,0) + xx.medo_chui_aek
                      , gugan_ija = ig_gugan_ija
                      , suip_ija  = xx.pass_ija + xx.pass_pr_ija
                      , ija_tax   = TRUNC((xx.pass_ija + xx.pass_pr_ija) * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                 INSERT
                 VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                      /* _1- */
                        , xx.fund_cd                                                     /* _2- */
                        , xx.jm_cd                                                       /* _3- */
                        , xx.buy_date                                                    /* _4- */
                        , xx.tr_ymd                                                      /* _5- */
                        , xx.aekm                                                        /* _6- */
                        , xx.tr_aek                                                      /* _7- */
                        , xx.medo_chui_aek                                               /* _8- */
                        , xx.gugan_no                                                    /* _9- */
                        , xx.bf_ija_ymd                                                  /* _10- */
                        , xx.af_ija_ymd                                                  /* _11- */
                        , ig_gugan_ija                                                   /* _12- */
                        , xx.pass_ija + xx.pass_pr_ija                                   /* _13- */
                        , TRUNC((xx.pass_ija + xx.pass_pr_ija) * F_TAX_RT (xx.type_gb))  /* _14- */
                        );

            -- 자문 초기자료를 위한 처리(매도시 액면만 입력해서)
            -- 매도분은 합산해서 1건만 입력 할 것.(초기자료)
            -- 입력자료 매매금액은 유지 20240821
            UPDATE SCT0CG tt    /* 채권거래내역 */
               SET tr_aek   = CASE WHEN cre_user='SCM0CM_SIGA' THEN xx.medo_chui_aek
                                                               ELSE tr_aek END
                 , chui_aek = xx.medo_chui_aek
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND tr_ymd   = xx.tr_ymd
               AND tr_cd    = 'K13'
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND buy_date = xx.buy_date
               AND seq_no   = xx.seq_no;
        end loop;
    end if;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'sjm0sm.ymd=' || p_ymd, '수익증권 마스타(sjm0sm) 당일 증감액 clear' );

    -- 수익증권마스타Table의 당일증감취득액 clear
    UPDATE SJM0SM t1    /* (모자 / Multi Class) 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
       SET up_jwa     = 0
         , dw_jwa     = 0
         , up_aek     = 0
         , dw_aek     = 0
         , gup_aek    = 0
         , gdw_aek    = 0
         , bi_gup_aek = 0
         , bi_gdw_aek = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    -- 수익증권매매내역 재처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT tr_cd       /* _1- */
             , fund_cd     /* _2- */
             , mo_fund_cd  /* _3- */
             , tr_jwa      /* _4- */
             , tr_aek      /* _5- */
             , gtr_aek     /* _6- */
             , bi_gtr_aek  /* _7- */
          FROM SJT0SG t1  /* 집합투자증권 매매내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd      < p_ymd
           AND t1.gijunga_ymd = p_ymd
         ORDER BY tr_cd
                , tr_ymd
                , mo_fund_cd
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'J61'    then    -- 매입
            -- 수익증권 마스타
            UPDATE SJM0SM tt    /* (모자 / Multi Class) 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
               SET up_jwa     = NVL(up_jwa,0) + xx.tr_jwa
                 , up_aek     = NVL(up_aek,0) + xx.tr_aek
                 , gup_aek    = NVL(gup_aek,0) + NVL(xx.gtr_aek,0)
                 , bi_gup_aek = NVL(bi_gup_aek,0) + NVL(xx.bi_gtr_aek,0)
             WHERE corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
               AND ymd        = p_ymd
               AND mo_fund_cd = xx.mo_fund_cd;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
                INSERT INTO SJM0SM tt   /* (모자 / Multi Class) 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr      /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd          /* _2- */
                       , xx.fund_cd     /* _3- */
                       , xx.mo_fund_cd  /* _4- */
                       , 0              /* _5- */
                       , xx.tr_jwa      /* _6- */
                       , 0              /* _7- */
                       , 0              /* _8- */
                       , xx.tr_aek      /* _9- */
                       , 0              /* _10- */
                       , 0              /* _11- */
                       , 0              /* _12- */
                       , xx.gtr_aek     /* _13- */
                       , 0              /* _14- */
                       , 0              /* _15- */
                       , NULL           /* _16- */
                       , NULL           /* _17- */
                       , NULL           /* _18- */
                       , 0              /* _19- */
                       , xx.bi_gtr_aek  /* _20- */
                       , 0              /* _21- */
                       , NULL           /* _22- */
                       , NULL           /* _23- */
                       , NULL           /* _24- */
                       , NULL           /* _25- */
                       , NULL           /* _26- */
                       , NULL           /* _27- */
                       , NULL           /* _28- */
                       , NULL           /* _29- */
                       , NULL           /* _30- */
                       );
            end if;
        else
            p_msg := '수익증권의 매도시 기준가적용일은 거래일과 같아야 합니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B060', 'sjm5sm.ymd=' || p_ymd, '타사수익증권 마스타(sjm5sm) 당일 증감액 clear' );

    -- 타사수익증권마스타Table의 당일증감취득액 clear
    UPDATE SJM5SM t1    /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
       SET up_aek     = 0
         , dw_aek     = 0
         , gup_jwa    = 0
         , gdw_jwa    = 0
         , bi_gup_jwa = 0
         , bi_gdw_jwa = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0520', p_ymd || ' : 채권 회계 재처리' );

    ---------------------------
    -- 전환청구 Table 초기화 --
    ---------------------------
    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B100', 'sjt0gg.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd, '전환청구(sjt0gg) delete' );

    DELETE FROM SJT0GG t1   /* 전환 청구 (교환,신주인수권포함) */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd;

    ---------------------
    -- 이율정정 재처리 --
    ---------------------
    SR_PROC052A( p_corp_gr, p_ymd );

    -----------------------------------------------
    -- 채권 마스타 미수도결제 매입/매도액 재처리 --
    -----------------------------------------------
    UPDATE SCM0CM t1    /* 채권 보유현황 */
       SET (t1.msd_meib_aekm, t1.msd_meib_aek, t1.msd_medo_aekm, t1.msd_medo_aek)
          = (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE ta.tr_cd WHEN 'J14' THEN ta.aekm END),0)
                  , NVL(SUM(CASE ta.tr_cd WHEN 'J14' THEN ta.chui_aek END),0)
                  , NVL(SUM(CASE ta.tr_cd WHEN 'K11' THEN ta.aekm END),0)
                  , NVL(SUM(CASE ta.tr_cd WHEN 'K11' THEN ta.chui_aek END),0)
               FROM SCT0CG ta  /* 채권거래내역 */
              WHERE ta.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                AND ta.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
                AND ta.tr_ymd   < p_ymd
                AND ta.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
                AND ta.tr_cd    IN ('J14','K11')
                AND ta.sudo_ymd > p_ymd
                AND ta.buy_date = t1.buy_date)
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0520', p_ymd || ' : 채권매매 회계처리' );

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'sct0cg.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sct0cg.tr_cd in (J10,J12,J13,J15,J41)', '채권 매입 회계처리' );

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                    /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                    /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                  /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                            /* _4- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                    /* _5- */
             , t1.buy_date                                                 /* _6- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                                 /* _7- */
             , t1.aekm                                        AS aekm      /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_aek                                      AS tr_aek    /* _9- */
             , t1.chui_aek                                    AS chui_aek  /* _10- */
             , NVL(t1.susu,0)                                 AS susu      /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.upd_user,'mm')                          AS upd_user  /* _12- */
             , NVL(t1.last_meib_ymd, t1.sudo_ymd)             AS meib_ymd  /* _13- */
             , t1.pass_sc_ija                                              /* _14- */
             , t1.pass_ija                                                 /* _15- */
             , t1.pass_pr_ija                                              /* _16- */
             , t1.sc_yesu_tax                                              /* _17- */
             , t1.yesu_tax                                                 /* _18- */
             , t1.pr_yesu_tax                                              /* _19- */
             , t1.sunsu_ija                                                /* _20- */
             , NVL(t1.jkm_yn,'N')                             AS jkm_yn    /* _21- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                        ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq       /* _22- */
          FROM SCT0CG t1  /* 채권거래내역 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd                     NOT IN (SELECT jm_cd
                                                      FROM SCM0CJ ta  /* 채권종목 */
                                                     WHERE ta.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                                                       AND ta.sanghw_ymd <= p_ymd)
           AND t1.tr_cd                     IN ('J10','J12','J13','J15','L11')
           AND t1.sudo_ymd                  = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
         ORDER BY t1.jm_cd
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        SR_PROC0220J (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.buy_date, xx.aekm, xx.tr_aek, xx.chui_aek,
                      xx.meib_ymd, xx.pass_sc_ija, xx.pass_ija, xx.pass_pr_ija, xx.sc_yesu_tax, xx.yesu_tax, xx.pr_yesu_tax, w_jasan_gb, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(proc0520->SR_PROC052J->)';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 증거금 사용시
        if  xx.jkm_yn = 'Y' then
                w_jkm_aek := xx.tr_aek + xx.susu;
        else    w_jkm_aek := 0;
        end if;

        -- 분개 처리
        w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.chui_aek, xx.tr_aek + xx.susu - w_jkm_aek,
                                     xx.pass_sc_ija + xx.pass_ija + xx.pass_pr_ija, xx.susu,
                                     w_jkm_aek,
                                     xx.sunsu_ija, xx.sunsu_ija);
        SR_SZSL999( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, xx.seq, w_aek, 52, 'PROC0520', w_msg );
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(채권매입(PROC0520))';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 채권 익일매입 회계처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.sudo_ymd                                                 /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                    /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                  /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                    /* _4- */
             , t1.buy_date                                                 /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.aekm),0)                            AS tr_aekm   /* _6- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.tr_aek,0) + NVL(t1.susu,0)),0)  AS gyul_aek  /* _7- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.susu),0)                            AS susu      /* _8- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.chui_aek),0)                        AS chui_aek  /* _9- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                        ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq       /* _10- */
          FROM SCT0CG t1  /* 채권거래내역 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'J14'
           AND t1.sudo_ymd              > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.sudo_ymd
                , t1.tr_cd
                , t1.fund_cd
                , t1.jm_cd
                , t1.buy_date
    ) loop
        -- 분개 처리
        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                    xx.jm_cd, TO_CHAR (xx.sudo_ymd, 'dd') * 10, xx.seq, xx.gyul_aek, 52, 'PROC0520', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC0520 J14매입->' || xx.jm_cd || ' - ' || xx.buy_date || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 채권마스타 미수도액면 insert
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SCM0CM tt   /* 채권 보유현황 */
                 ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                 , ymd            /* _2- */
                 , fund_cd        /* _3- */
                 , jm_cd          /* _4- */
                 , buy_date       /* _5- */
                 , lst_meib_ymd   /* _6- */
                 , msd_meib_aekm  /* _7- */
                 , msd_meib_aek   /* _8- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr    /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd        /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd   /* _3- */
                   , xx.jm_cd     /* _4- */
                   , xx.buy_date  /* _5- */
                   , xx.sudo_ymd  /* _6- */
                   , xx.tr_aekm   /* _7- */
                   , xx.chui_aek  /* _8- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
               SET msd_meib_aekm = NVL(msd_meib_aekm,0) + xx.tr_aekm
                 , msd_meib_aek  = NVL(msd_meib_aek,0) + xx.chui_aek
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND buy_date = xx.buy_date
               AND ymd      = p_ymd;
        END;
    end loop;

    -- 채권 (증권,운용)매입수수료 분개
    -- 자문제외

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B030', 'sct0cg_excel.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd like K%', '채권 매도거래 생성' );

    -- 선입선출 처리를 위한 자료 생성
    -- 자문은 화면에서 처리로 제외

    -- 채권 매도이자 계산
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                       /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                     /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                       /* _3- */
             , t1.buy_date                    /* _4- */
             , t1.sudo_ymd                    /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_ymd - 1     AS ija_ymd   /* _6- */
             , t1.aekm                        /* _7- */
             , cj.balh_ymd                    /* _8- */
             , cj.medo_ymd                    /* _9- */
             , cj.sunme_ija_ymd               /* _10- */
             , cj.now_gugan_no                /* _11- */
             , cj.bf_ija_ymd                  /* _12- */
             , cj.af_ija_ymd                  /* _13- */
             , 'N'               AS sunme_yn  /* _14- */
             , pass_ija                       /* _15- */
             , pass_sc_ija                    /* _16- */
             , pass_pr_ija                    /* _17- */
             , sc_yesu_tax                    /* _18- */
             , yesu_tax                       /* _19- */
             , pr_yesu_tax                    /* _20- */
          FROM SCT0CG t1  /* 채권거래내역 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd    LIKE 'K%'
           AND t1.sudo_ymd = p_ymd
           AND cj.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        -- 선매출 여부를 확인
        if  xx.medo_ymd < xx.balh_ymd           then    xx.sunme_yn := 'Y';
            if  xx.sunme_ija_ymd <= xx.ija_ymd  then    xx.sunme_yn := 'N';
            end if;
        end if;

        if  xx.sunme_yn = 'Y'   then
            -- 선매출 이자계산
            BEGIN
                SELECT TRUNC(gugan_ija * xx.aekm)
                     , TRUNC(gugan_ija * xx.aekm / gugan_ilsu)
                  INTO w_sc_gugan_ija
                     , w_sc_day_ija
                  FROM SCJ0IG ig  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
                 WHERE ig.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND ig.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
                   AND ig.ija_gb   = 'B'
                   AND ig.gugan_no = 0;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                w_sc_gugan_ija := 0;
                w_sc_day_ija   := 0;
            END;
            if  xx.ija_ymd < xx.balh_ymd    then
                    xx.pass_sc_ija := TRUNC (w_sc_day_ija * (xx.ija_ymd - xx.medo_ymd + 1));
            else    xx.pass_sc_ija := w_sc_gugan_ija;
            end if;
        end if;

        if  xx.balh_ymd <= p_ymd AND xx.bf_ija_ymd <= p_ymd then
            -- 경과이자 계산
            SR_NOW_GUGAN_IJA (p_corp_gr, xx.ija_ymd, xx.jm_cd, xx.aekm,
                              ig_gugan_ilsu, ig_gugan_ija, ig_pr_gugan_ilsu, ig_pr_gugan_ija, ig_pass_ilsu, xx.pass_ija, xx.pass_pr_ija,
                              xx.now_gugan_no, xx.bf_ija_ymd, xx.af_ija_ymd, w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;

        UPDATE SCT0CG tt    /* 채권거래내역 */
           SET ija_aekm    = xx.aekm
             , pass_sc_ija = xx.pass_sc_ija
             , pass_ija    = xx.pass_ija
             , pass_pr_ija = xx.pass_pr_ija
             , sc_yesu_tax = xx.sc_yesu_tax
             , yesu_tax    = xx.yesu_tax
             , pr_yesu_tax = xx.pr_yesu_tax
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B040', 'sct0cg.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sct0cg.tr_cd in (K10,K12,K13,K41,E38,E42,E52,S42)', '채권 매도 회계처리' );
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                   /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                   /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                 /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                   /* _4- */
             , t1.buy_date                                                /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_ymd - 1                                  AS ija_ymd  /* _6- */
             , t1.aekm                                                    /* _7- */
             , t1.tr_aek                                                  /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.susu,0)                                 AS susu     /* _9- */
             , NVL(t1.ija_tax,0)                              AS tax      /* _10- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                        ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq      /* _11- */
          FROM SCT0CG t1  /* 채권거래내역 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd                     NOT IN (SELECT jm_cd
                                                      FROM SCM0CJ ta  /* 채권종목 */
                                                     WHERE ta.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                                                       AND ta.sanghw_ymd <= p_ymd)
           AND t1.tr_cd                     IN ('K10','K12','K13',
                                                'E38','E42','E52','S42','L21')
           AND t1.sudo_ymd                  = p_ymd
           AND t1.sudo_ymd                  = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) >= p_ymd
         ORDER BY t1.jm_cd
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        SR_PROC0220K (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.ija_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.buy_date, xx.aekm,
                      w_tr_aek, w_anbun_aek, w_misu_ija, w_sung_cost, w_pr_sung_cost, w_cbmg_misu_ija, w_cbmg_sung_cost,
                      w_yesu_tax, w_sung_tax, w_jasan_gb, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(proc0520_k)';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 분개 처리
        w_dr_hab := xx.tr_aek;
        w_cr_hab := w_tr_aek + w_anbun_aek + w_misu_ija + w_sung_cost + w_pr_sung_cost + w_cbmg_misu_ija + w_cbmg_sung_cost;
        if  w_dr_hab - w_cr_hab > 0 then
            w_cr_hab := w_dr_hab - w_cr_hab;
            w_dr_hab := 0;
        else
            w_dr_hab := w_cr_hab - w_dr_hab;
            w_cr_hab := 0;
        end if;

        w_aek   := number_varray_50 (NVL(xx.tr_aek, 0) - xx.susu - xx.tax, w_tr_aek + w_anbun_aek,
                                     0, w_sung_cost + w_pr_sung_cost,
                                     0, w_misu_ija,
                                     w_dr_hab, w_cr_hab,
                                     xx.susu, xx.tax,
                                     w_cbmg_misu_ija, w_cbmg_sung_cost);
        if  xx.tr_cd LIKE 'K%'  then
                SR_SZSL999( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'K10'   , 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 2, xx.seq, w_aek, 52, 'PROC0520K', w_msg );
        ELSE    SR_SZSL999( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 2, xx.seq, w_aek, 52, 'PROC0520K', w_msg );
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(채권매도분개)';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 채권 거래내역에 취득가,원천세 Update
        -- 자문은 세금납부하므로 (추후점검)
        UPDATE SCT0CG tt    /* 채권거래내역 */
           SET chui_aek       = w_tr_aek + w_anbun_aek
             , mijigub_tax    = w_sung_tax + w_yesu_tax
             , mm_sonik       = w_cr_hab - w_dr_hab
             , cbmg_misu_ija  = w_cbmg_misu_ija
             , cbmg_sung_cost = w_cbmg_sung_cost
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;

    -- 채권 익일매도 회계처리
    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B041', 'sct0cg.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sct0cg.tr_cd=K11', '채권 익일매도 회계처리' );

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                    /* _1- */
             , t1.sudo_ymd                                                 /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                    /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                  /* _4- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                    /* _5- */
             , t1.buy_date                                                 /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.aekm,0)                                 AS tr_aekm   /* _7- */
             , NVL(NVL(t1.tr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.susu,0),0)       AS gyul_aek  /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.susu,0)                                 AS susu      /* _9- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                        ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq       /* _10- */
             , cj.balh_ymd                                                 /* _11- */
             , cj.medo_ymd                                                 /* _12- */
             , cj.sunme_ija_ymd                                            /* _13- */
             , cj.sangj_gb                                                 /* _14- */
             , NVL(t1.sudo_ymd, t1.tr_ymd) - 1                AS ija_ymd   /* _15- */
             , 'N'                                            AS sunme_yn  /* _16- */
          FROM SCT0CG t1  /* 채권거래내역 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'K11'
           AND t1.sudo_ymd              > p_ymd
           AND cj.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd                 = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.sudo_ymd
                , t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        -- 수도일 현재 액면, 취득액
        SELECT NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)
                                   + NVL(t1.msd_meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.msd_medo_aekm,0)    /* _1- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aek,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aek,0)
                                       + NVL(t1.msd_meib_aek,0) - NVL(t1.msd_medo_aek,0)  /* _2- */
             , NVL(t1.anbun_aek,0)                                                        /* _3- */
             , NVL(t1.misu_ija,0)                                                         /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.pr_misu_ija,0)                                                      /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.sung_cost,0)                                                        /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.pr_sung_cost,0)                                                     /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.cbmg_sung_cost,0)                                                   /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.cbmg_misu_ija,0)                                                    /* _9- */
          INTO w_aekm            /* _1- */
             , w_chui_aek        /* _2- */
             , w_anbun_aek       /* _3- */
             , w_misu_ija        /* _4- */
             , w_pr_misu_ija     /* _5- */
             , w_sung_cost       /* _6- */
             , w_pr_sung_cost    /* _7- */
             , w_cbmg_sung_cost  /* _8- */
             , w_cbmg_misu_ija   /* _9- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
           AND t1.buy_date = xx.buy_date;

        -- 매도후 액면확인
        if  w_aekm < xx.tr_aekm then
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-(' || TO_CHAR (w_aekm - xx.tr_aekm) || ')-매도후 액면확인(PROC0520)';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        w_biyul       := xx.tr_aekm / w_aekm;           /* 매도분에 대한 계산비율 */
        w_tr_chui_aek := TRUNC (w_chui_aek * w_biyul);

        BEGIN
            SELECT TRUNC (day_ija * w_biyul * (xx.sudo_ymd - p_ymd))
                          + TRUNC (day_anbun_aek * w_biyul * (xx.sudo_ymd - p_ymd))
              INTO w_sunsu_ija
              FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             WHERE t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd - 1
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.buy_date = xx.buy_date;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_sunsu_ija := 0;
        END;

        -- 선매출 여부를 확인
        if  xx.medo_ymd < xx.balh_ymd           then    xx.sunme_yn := 'Y';
            if  xx.sunme_ija_ymd <= xx.ija_ymd  then    xx.sunme_yn := 'N';
            end if;
        end if;

        if  xx.sunme_yn = 'Y'   then
            BEGIN
                SELECT TRUNC(NVL(misu_ija,0) * w_biyul)
                     , TRUNC(NVL(sung_cost,0) * w_biyul)
                  INTO sc_misu_ija
                     , sc_sung_cost
                  FROM SCM0SC t1  /* 채권 선매출이자현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.buy_date = xx.buy_date;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-채권 선매출마스타를 확인하십시오.';
                RETURN;
            END;
        else
            sc_misu_ija  := 0;
            sc_sung_cost := 0;
        end if;

        w_anbun_aek      := TRUNC (w_anbun_aek      * w_biyul);
        w_sung_cost      := TRUNC (w_sung_cost      * w_biyul);
        w_pr_sung_cost   := TRUNC (w_pr_sung_cost   * w_biyul);
        w_misu_ija       := TRUNC (w_misu_ija       * w_biyul);
        w_pr_misu_ija    := TRUNC (w_pr_misu_ija    * w_biyul);
        w_cbmg_sung_cost := TRUNC (w_cbmg_sung_cost * w_biyul);
        w_cbmg_misu_ija  := TRUNC (w_cbmg_misu_ija  * w_biyul);

        w_jangbu_sonik  := xx.gyul_aek - (w_tr_chui_aek + w_anbun_aek + w_misu_ija + w_pr_misu_ija
                                                        + w_sung_cost + w_pr_sung_cost + w_sunsu_ija + sc_misu_ija + sc_sung_cost
                                                        + w_cbmg_misu_ija + w_cbmg_sung_cost);
        SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, TO_CHAR (xx.sudo_ymd, 'dd') * 10, xx.seq,
                    xx.gyul_aek, xx.gyul_aek - w_jangbu_sonik, 52, 'PROC0520', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'schp010 K11매도->' || xx.jm_cd || ' - ' || xx.buy_date || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        UPDATE SCT0CG tt    /* 채권거래내역 */
           SET chui_aek     = w_tr_chui_aek
             , jangbu_sonik = w_jangbu_sonik
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        BEGIN   /* 채권마스타 미수도 매도액면 update */
            UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
               SET msd_medo_aekm = NVL(msd_medo_aekm,0) + xx.tr_aekm
                 , msd_medo_aek  = NVL(msd_medo_aek,0) + w_tr_chui_aek
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND buy_date = xx.buy_date
               AND ymd      = p_ymd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || ',' || xx.jm_cd || ' - 채권 미수도 매도액 update 에러(PROC0520)';
            RETURN;
        END;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0520', p_ymd || '-전환/교환/신주인수권 처리' );

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd                       /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                     /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                       /* _3- */
             , t1.buy_date                    /* _4- */
             , t1.seq_no                      /* _5- */
             , t1.sudo_ymd                    /* _6- */
             , t1.ija_baed_gb                 /* _7- */
             , t1.koscom_cd                   /* _8- */
             , t1.danc_gb                     /* _9- */
             , t1.aekm                        /* _10- */
             , t1.jusic_jusu                  /* _11- */
             , t1.danga                       /* _12- */
             , t1.jusic_aek                   /* _13- */
             , t1.ija_sudo_aek                /* _14- */
             , t1.ija_sudo_ymd                /* _15- */
             , cj.bond_attr                   /* _16- */
             , cj.bond_cd                     /* _17- */
             , cj.ija_jigub_gb                /* _18- */
             , cj.balh_ymd                    /* _19- */
             , cj.medo_ymd                    /* _20- */
             , cj.sanghw_ymd                  /* _21- */
             , cj.balh_ga                     /* _22- */
             , t1.chg_jm_cd                   /* _23- */
             , '00000'            AS balh_co  /* _24- */
             , cj.sangj_gb                    /* _25- */
             , cj.pyom_iyul                   /* _26- */
             , cj.halin_iyul                  /* _27- */
             , cj.halj_iyul                   /* _28- */
             , cj.now_gugan_no                /* _29- */
             , cj.bf_ija_ymd                  /* _30- */
             , cj.af_ija_ymd                  /* _31- */
             , cj.sunme_ija_ymd               /* _32- */
             , cj.yy_ija_hoisu                /* _33- */
             , cj.tot_ija_hoicha              /* _34- */
             , cj.bunhal_gb                   /* _35- */
          FROM SCT0CG t1  /* 채권거래내역 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                    = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                     IN ('F51','F55','F60')
           AND cj.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(meib_aekm,0) - NVL(medo_aekm,0)    /* _1- */
                 , NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(meib_aek,0) - NVL(medo_aek,0)  /* _2- */
                 , NVL(anbun_aek,0)                                          /* _3- */
                 , NVL(misu_ija,0)                                           /* _4- */
                 , NVL(pr_misu_ija,0)                                        /* _5- */
                 , NVL(sung_cost,0)                                          /* _6- */
                 , NVL(pr_sung_cost,0)                                       /* _7- */
                 , NVL(bfil_cbmg_misu_ija,0)                                 /* _8- */
                 , NVL(bfil_cbmg_sung_cost,0)                                /* _9- */
                 , lst_meib_ymd                                              /* _10- */
              INTO cm_aekm            /* _1- */
                 , cm_chui_aek        /* _2- */
                 , cm_anbun_aek       /* _3- */
                 , cm_misu_ija        /* _4- */
                 , cm_pr_misu_ija     /* _5- */
                 , cm_sung_cost       /* _6- */
                 , cm_pr_sung_cost    /* _7- */
                 , cm_cbmg_misu_ija   /* _8- */
                 , cm_cbmg_sung_cost  /* _9- */
                 , cm_lst_meib_ymd    /* _10- */
              FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.buy_date = xx.buy_date;
        EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
            p_msg := xx.tr_cd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '- 채권마스타 정보를 찾을 수 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        if  cm_aekm = xx.aekm   THEN    -- 전부전환/교환 처리
            w_chui_aek       := cm_chui_aek;        /* 전환취득가 */
            w_sung_cost      := cm_sung_cost;
            w_pr_sung_cost   := cm_pr_sung_cost;
            w_misu_ija       := cm_misu_ija;
            w_pr_misu_ija    := cm_pr_misu_ija;
            w_tr_anbun_aek   := cm_anbun_aek;
            w_cbmg_misu_ija  := cm_cbmg_misu_ija;
            w_cbmg_sung_cost := cm_cbmg_sung_cost;

            w_dr_aek1 := xx.jusic_aek;
            w_cr_aek2 := cm_chui_aek  + cm_anbun_aek;
            w_cr_aek5 := cm_sung_cost + cm_pr_sung_cost;
            w_cr_aek6 := cm_misu_ija  + cm_pr_misu_ija;
            w_cr_aek7 := cm_cbmg_sung_cost;
            w_cr_aek8 := cm_cbmg_misu_ija;
            w_cha_aek   := (w_dr_aek1 + NVL(xx.ija_sudo_aek,0))
                            - (w_cr_aek2 + w_cr_aek5 + w_cr_aek6 + w_cr_aek7 + w_cr_aek8);
            ------------------
            -- 채권마스타 수정
            ------------------
            UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
               SET medo_aekm = NVL(medo_aekm,0) + xx.aekm
                 , medo_aek  = NVL(medo_aek,0) + w_chui_aek
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND buy_date = xx.buy_date
               AND ymd      = p_ymd;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    THEN
                p_msg := p_ymd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-채권마스타 갱신 오류발생.';
                RETURN;
            end if;

        elsif cm_aekm > xx.aekm THEN    -- 일부전환/교환 처리
            w1_aekm := cm_aekm - xx.aekm;              /* 잔존액면 */
            w_biyul := 1       - (w1_aekm / cm_aekm);  /* 전환비율 */

            w1_chui_aek      := TRUNC (cm_chui_aek       * (w1_aekm / cm_aekm));  /* 잔존취득가 */
            w_chui_aek       := cm_chui_aek - w1_chui_aek;                        /* 전환취득가 */
            w_sung_cost      := TRUNC (cm_sung_cost      * w_biyul);
            w_pr_sung_cost   := TRUNC (cm_pr_sung_cost   * w_biyul);
            w_misu_ija       := TRUNC (cm_misu_ija       * w_biyul);
            w_pr_misu_ija    := TRUNC (cm_pr_misu_ija    * w_biyul);
            w_tr_anbun_aek   := TRUNC (cm_anbun_aek      * w_biyul);
            w_cbmg_misu_ija  := TRUNC (cm_cbmg_misu_ija  * w_biyul);
            w_cbmg_sung_cost := TRUNC (cm_cbmg_sung_cost * w_biyul);
            ------------------
            -- 채권마스타 수정
            ------------------
            UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
               SET medo_aekm      = NVL(medo_aekm,0) + xx.aekm
                 , medo_aek       = NVL(medo_aek,0) + w_chui_aek
                 , anbun_aek      = NVL(anbun_aek,0) - w_tr_anbun_aek
                 , misu_ija       = NVL(misu_ija,0) - w_misu_ija
                 , pr_misu_ija    = NVL(pr_misu_ija,0) - w_pr_misu_ija
                 , sung_cost      = NVL(sung_cost,0) - w_sung_cost
                 , pr_sung_cost   = NVL(pr_sung_cost,0) - w_pr_sung_cost
                 , cbmg_sung_cost = NVL(cbmg_sung_cost,0) - w_cbmg_sung_cost
                 , cbmg_misu_ija  = NVL(cbmg_misu_ija,0) - w_cbmg_misu_ija
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND buy_date = xx.buy_date
               AND ymd      = p_ymd;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    THEN
                p_msg := p_ymd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-채권마스타 갱신 오류발생.';
                RETURN;
            end if;

            w_dr_aek1 := xx.jusic_aek;
            w_cr_aek2 := w_chui_aek  + w_tr_anbun_aek;
            w_cr_aek5 := w_sung_cost + w_pr_sung_cost;
            w_cr_aek6 := w_misu_ija  + w_pr_misu_ija;
            w_cr_aek7 := w_cbmg_sung_cost;
            w_cr_aek8 := w_cbmg_misu_ija;
            w_cha_aek   := (w_dr_aek1 + NVL(xx.ija_sudo_aek,0))
                            - (w_cr_aek2 + w_cr_aek5 + w_cr_aek6 + w_cr_aek7 + w_cr_aek8);
        end if;

        -- 단수주대금
        if  xx.ija_sudo_ymd = p_ymd then
            w_dr_aek3  := xx.ija_sudo_aek;
            w_dr_aek11 := 0;
        else
            w_dr_aek3  := 0;
            w_dr_aek11 := xx.ija_sudo_aek;
        end if;

        if  w_cha_aek > 0   then
            w_dr_aek9  := 0;
            w_cr_aek10 := w_cha_aek;
        else
            w_dr_aek9  := - w_cha_aek;
            w_cr_aek10 := 0;
        end if;

        if  xx.tr_cd != 'F51'   then
            if  xx.ija_baed_gb = '2'    then    -- 배당(이자 미수령), 세금삭제
                w_dr_aek9  := 0;
                w_cr_aek10 := 0;
            end if;
        end if;

        BEGIN
            SELECT woos_ilban_gb
                 , gyul_mm
                 , t1.balh_co
                 , t2.sosok_gb
              INTO w_woos_ilban_gb
                 , jb_gyul_mm
                 , xx.balh_co
                 , w_sosok_gb
              FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
                 , SJX0JB t2  /* 발행기관 */
             WHERE t1.jm_cd   = xx.chg_jm_cd
               AND t2.balh_co = t1.balh_co;
        EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
            p_msg := xx.chg_jm_cd || '- 주식종목을 찾을 수 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        --------------
        -- 분개처리
        --------------
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'F60'    then    -- 신주인수권
            w_dr_aek9  := 0;
            w_cr_aek10 := 0;
            SR_SZSL010( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1, w_dr_aek1, 52, 'PROC0520 1' || xx.sangj_gb, w_msg );
        else
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (w_dr_aek1, w_cr_aek2, w_dr_aek3, 0, w_cr_aek5,
                                         w_cr_aek6, w_cr_aek7, w_cr_aek8, w_dr_aek9, w_cr_aek10, w_dr_aek11);

            -- 비전환주식의 매도처리로 인한 전환신주로 처리 후 상장하게 추가
            if  xx.tr_cd = 'F51'    then
                if  w_sosok_gb = '1'    then    -- 시장주식
                        SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', 'A' || xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1,
                                    w_aek, 52, 'PROC0520 ' || 'A' || xx.sangj_gb, w_msg);
                else    SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_sosok_gb || xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1,
                                    w_aek, 52, 'PROC0520 ' || w_sosok_gb || xx.sangj_gb, w_msg);
                end if;
            else
                SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.danc_gb || xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1,
                            w_aek, 52, 'PROC0520 ' || xx.danc_gb || xx.sangj_gb, w_msg);
            end if;
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        ---------------------------
        -- 전부전환/교환 처리
        ---------------------------
        if  cm_aekm = xx.aekm   then    SR_UPDMST1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.buy_date);   -- 채권 마스타,이자구간 0으로 갱신
        end if;
        --------------------------------------
        -- 채권 거래내역에 취득가,선급비용,원천세 Update
        --------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCT0CG tt    /* 채권거래내역 */
           SET chui_aek       = w_chui_aek
             , cbmg_misu_ija  = w_cbmg_misu_ija
             , cbmg_sung_cost = w_cbmg_sung_cost
         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND tr_ymd   = p_ymd
           AND tr_cd    = xx.tr_cd
           AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
           AND buy_date = xx.buy_date
           AND seq_no   = xx.seq_no;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-채권거래내역미지급원천세를 갱신하지 못했습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;
        ------------------
        -- 결산일 정보 set
        ------------------
        w_chg_year := TO_CHAR (p_ymd, 'yyyy');
        w_chg_mm   := TO_CHAR (p_ymd, 'mm');
        if  w_chg_mm > jb_gyul_mm   then
                w_af_gyul_ymd := LAST_DAY (ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(w_chg_year || jb_gyul_mm, 'yyyymm'), 12));
        else    w_af_gyul_ymd := LAST_DAY (TO_DATE(w_chg_year || jb_gyul_mm, 'yyyymm'));
        end if;
        w_bf_gyul_ymd := ADD_MONTHS (w_af_gyul_ymd, -12);
        ------------------
        -- 이자계산 (전환권,교환권)
        ------------------
        if (xx.tr_cd IN ('F51', 'F55')) AND (xx.ija_baed_gb='1')    then    -- 1:이자
            if (w_bf_gyul_ymd < xx.balh_ymd) AND (p_ymd <= w_af_gyul_ymd)   then
                    w_ija := TRUNC (xx.aekm * xx.pyom_iyul * (w_af_gyul_ymd - xx.balh_ymd + 1) / 365);
            else    w_ija := TRUNC( xx.aekm * xx.pyom_iyul                                          );
            end if;
        end if;
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'F51'    then
            if  xx.chg_jm_cd = '0'  then
                    w_new_jm_nm := '전환(보)';  /* 0:보통,1:우선 */
            else    w_new_jm_nm := '전환(우)';
            end if;
        end if;
        ------------------
        -- 전환 청구 생성
        ------------------
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SJT0GG tt   /* 전환 청구 (교환,신주인수권포함) */
                 ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd         /* _2- */
                 , tr_cd          /* _3- */
                 , fund_cd        /* _4- */
                 , old_jm_cd      /* _5- */
                 , new_jm_cd      /* _6- */
                 , chg_danga      /* _7- */
                 , chg_aek        /* _8- */
                 , chg_jusu       /* _9- */
                 , chg_danju_aek  /* _10- */
                 , ija_baed_gb    /* _11- */
                 , woos_ilban_gb  /* _12- */
                 , gyul_ymd       /* _13- */
                 , sury_ymd       /* _14- */
                 , ija            /* _15- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr               /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                   /* _2- */
                   , xx.tr_cd                /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd              /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                /* _5- */
                   , xx.chg_jm_cd            /* _6- */
                   , xx.danga                /* _7- */
                   , NVL(xx.jusic_aek,0)     /* _8- */
                   , NVL(xx.jusic_jusu,0)    /* _9- */
                   , NVL(xx.ija_sudo_aek,0)  /* _10- */
                   , xx.ija_baed_gb          /* _11- */
                   , w_woos_ilban_gb         /* _12- */
                   , w_af_gyul_ymd           /* _13- */
                   , xx.sudo_ymd             /* _14- */
                   , NVL(w_ija,0)            /* _15- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.jm_cd || '-' || xx.chg_jm_cd || '- 전환청구 생성에서 에러가 발생.';
            RETURN;
        END;
        ------------------
        -- 주식마스타 생성
        ------------------
        if  xx.tr_cd IN ('F51','F55')   then
            UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
               SET gongs_up_jusu     = xx.jusic_jusu
                 , gongs_up_chui_aek = xx.jusic_aek
             WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd       = xx.chg_jm_cd
               AND ymd         = p_ymd
               AND bs_type     = '0'
               AND type_trench = '00:';
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
                INSERT INTO SJM0JM tt   /* 주식 보유현황 */
                     ( corp_gr            /* _1- */
                     , ymd                /* _2- */
                     , fund_cd            /* _3- */
                     , jm_cd              /* _4- */
                     , bs_type            /* _5- */
                     , type_trench        /* _6- */
                     , gongs_up_jusu      /* _7- */
                     , gongs_up_chui_aek  /* _8- */
                     , balh_co            /* _9- */
                     , woos_ilban_gb      /* _10- */
                     , danc_gb            /* _11- */
                     , koscom_cd          /* _12- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd            /* _2- */
                       , xx.fund_cd       /* _3- */
                       , xx.chg_jm_cd     /* _4- */
                       , '0'              /* _5- */
                       , '00:'            /* _6- */
                       , xx.jusic_jusu    /* _7- */
                       , xx.jusic_aek     /* _8- */
                       , xx.balh_co       /* _9- */
                       , w_woos_ilban_gb  /* _10- */
                       , xx.danc_gb       /* _11- */
                       , xx.koscom_cd     /* _12- */
                       );
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 전환권행사 주식 매도제한일 관리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT fund_cd
             , chg_jm_cd
             , NVL(SUM(jusic_jusu),0)  AS jusu
          FROM SCT0CG t1  /* 채권거래내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd    IN ('F51','F55','F60')
           AND t1.lock_end > p_ymd
         GROUP BY fund_cd
                , chg_jm_cd
    ) loop
        UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
           SET lock_jusu = NVL(lock_jusu,0) + xx.jusu
         WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd       = xx.chg_jm_cd
           AND ymd         = p_ymd
           AND type_trench = '00:'
           AND bs_type     = 0;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0520', p_ymd || ' : 타사수익증권매매 회계처리' );

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjt5sg.tr_cd=szx0gc.tr_cd * sjt5sg.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd, '타사수익증권매매 회계처리' );

    -- 당일이후 기준가 적용 매매내역 제외 20180910 yjs
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                       /* _1- */
             , NVL(t1.gijunga_ymd, t1.tr_ymd)  AS gijunga_ymd  /* _2- */
             , NVL(t1.sudo_ymd, t1.tr_ymd)     AS sudo_ymd     /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                        /* _4- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                     /* _5- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                      /* _6- */
             , t1.tasa_jm_cd                                   /* _7- */
             , t1.seq_no                                       /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_jwa                                       /* _9- */
             , t1.tr_aek                                       /* _10- */
             , t1.gtr_jwa                                      /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.bi_gtr_jwa,0)            AS bi_gtr_jwa   /* _12- */
             , t1.gijunga                                      /* _13- */
             , t1.ggijunga                                     /* _14- */
             , NVL(t1.susu,0)                  AS susu         /* _15- */
             , gc.tr_dr_gb                                     /* _16- */
             , t1.rowid                                        /* _17- */
          FROM SJT5SG t1  /* 타사집합투자증권 매매내역 */
             , SZX0GC gc  /* 거래코드 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 != 'H61'
           AND gc.tr_cd                 = t1.tr_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
         ORDER BY gc.tr_dr_gb
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT CASE WHEN xx.sudo_ymd=p_ymd
                        THEN CASE WHEN type_gb IN ('0','1','2') THEN '00'
                                  WHEN type_gb='7'              THEN '07'
                                  WHEN type_gb='8'              THEN '08'
                                                                ELSE '03' END
                        ELSE CASE WHEN type_gb IN ('0','1','2') THEN '10'
                                  WHEN type_gb='7'              THEN '17'
                                  WHEN type_gb='8'              THEN '18'
                                                                ELSE '13' END END
              INTO w_jasan_gb
              FROM SJM0SC t1  /* 타사집합투자증권 정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.tasa_jm_cd = xx.tasa_jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
            p_msg := xx.tasa_jm_cd || ' - 수익증권 종목확인';
            RETURN;
        END;

        if  xx.tr_dr_gb = '1'   then
            sm_aek := xx.tr_aek;  /* 매입원가 */
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                        xx.tasa_jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1, xx.tr_aek, 52, 'PROC0520a', w_msg);
        else
            SR_GETSM5( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.tasa_jm_cd, xx.tr_jwa, xx.gtr_jwa, sg_avg_danga, sg_gavg_danga, w_msg );
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;

            -- 매도단가 update
            UPDATE SJT5SG tt    /* 타사집합투자증권 매매내역 */
               SET avg_danga  = sg_avg_danga
                 , gavg_danga = sg_gavg_danga
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

            sm_aek := sg_avg_danga;  /* 매도원가 */

            w_gaek := TRUNC (xx.gtr_jwa * xx.ggijunga / 1000) - sg_gavg_danga;
            w_com  := xx.tr_aek                               - sm_aek - NVL (w_gaek,0) + xx.susu;
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.tr_aek, sm_aek,
                                         CASE WHEN w_com < 0 THEN - w_com END, CASE WHEN w_com > 0 THEN w_com END,
                                         CASE WHEN w_gaek < 0 THEN - w_gaek END, CASE WHEN w_gaek > 0 THEN w_gaek END,
                                         xx.susu);
            SR_SZSL999( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.tasa_jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1, w_aek, 52, 'PROC0520b', w_msg );
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 당일 기준가적용 자료만 처리
        -- 수수료는 20210112 yjs 선지급(성과)수수료 처리
        if  xx.gijunga_ymd <= xx.tr_ymd then
            UPDATE SJM5SM tt    /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
               SET up_jwa  = CASE WHEN xx.tr_dr_gb='1' THEN NVL(up_jwa,0) + xx.tr_jwa ELSE up_jwa END
                 , up_aek  = CASE WHEN xx.tr_dr_gb='1' THEN NVL(up_aek,0) + sm_aek ELSE up_aek END
                 , dw_jwa  = CASE WHEN xx.tr_dr_gb='2' THEN NVL(dw_jwa,0) + xx.tr_jwa ELSE dw_jwa END
                 , dw_aek  = CASE WHEN xx.tr_dr_gb='2' THEN NVL(dw_aek,0) + sm_aek ELSE dw_aek END
                 , gup_jwa = CASE WHEN xx.tr_dr_gb='1' THEN NVL(gup_jwa,0) + xx.gtr_jwa ELSE gup_jwa END
                 , gdw_jwa = CASE WHEN xx.tr_dr_gb='2' THEN NVL(gdw_jwa,0) + xx.gtr_jwa ELSE gdw_jwa END
             WHERE corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
               AND tasa_jm_cd = xx.tasa_jm_cd
               AND ymd        = xx.tr_ymd;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
                if  xx.tr_dr_gb = '1'   then
                    BEGIN
                        INSERT INTO SJM5SM tt   /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
                             ( corp_gr     /* _1- */
                             , ymd         /* _2- */
                             , fund_cd     /* _3- */
                             , tasa_jm_cd  /* _4- */
                             , up_jwa      /* _5- */
                             , up_aek      /* _6- */
                             , gup_jwa     /* _7- */
                             )
                        VALUES ( p_corp_gr      /* _1- */
                               , p_ymd          /* _2- */
                               , xx.fund_cd     /* _3- */
                               , xx.tasa_jm_cd  /* _4- */
                               , xx.tr_jwa      /* _5- */
                               , xx.tr_aek      /* _6- */
                               , xx.gtr_jwa     /* _7- */
                               );
                    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                        p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.tasa_jm_cd || '- 매도분 타사수익증권마스타 등록이 안됐습니다.(#2512)';
                        RETURN;
                    END;
                else
                    p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.tasa_jm_cd || '- 매도분 타사수익증권마스타 등록이 안됐습니다.(#2512)';
                    RETURN;
                end if;
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'sjt5sg.tr_cd=szx0gc.tr_cd * sjt5sg.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd, '타사수익증권매매 수도결제 처리(#2512)' );

    -- 당일이후 기준가 적용 매매처리
    -- 매수만
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                       /* _1- */
             , t1.seq_no                       /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                      /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_currency                /* _4- */
             , t1.tasa_jm_cd                   /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                     /* _6- */
             , t1.tr_aek                       /* _7- */
             , t1.rowid                        /* _8- */
             , jm.trans_unit                   /* _9- */
             , CASE WHEN jm.type_gb IN ('0','1','2') THEN '00'
                    WHEN jm.type_gb='7'              THEN '07'
                    WHEN jm.type_gb='8'              THEN '08'
                                                     ELSE '03'
               END               AS jasan_gb   /* _10- */
             , t1.tr_jwa                       /* _11- */
             , t1.gtr_jwa                      /* _12- */
             , t1.upd_jwa                      /* _13- */
          FROM SJT5SG t1  /* 타사집합투자증권 매매내역 */
             , SJM0SC jm  /* 타사집합투자증권 정보 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd      BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS (p_ymd,-1) AND p_ymd - 1
           AND t1.tr_cd       LIKE 'J%'
           AND t1.gijunga_ymd = p_ymd
           AND jm.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
           AND jm.tasa_jm_cd  = t1.tasa_jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd     = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(t1.dang_gijun_ga,0)
                 , NVL(t1.dang_ggijun_ga,0)
              INTO w_gijun_ga
                 , w_ggijun_ga
              FROM SJT0SC t1  /* ETF/상장집합투자증권/타사집합투자증권 종가정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.tasa_jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.tasa_jm_cd || '-익일매수 수도결제를 위한 타사수익증권 종가를 입력하십시오';
            RETURN;
        END;
        if  w_gijun_ga = 0 OR w_ggijun_ga = 0   then
            p_msg := xx.tasa_jm_cd || '-익일매수 수도결제를 위한 타사수익증권 종가를 입력하십시오';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 좌수를 임의로 변경시 반영키 위해 20190123 yjs
        BEGIN
            -- 20210222 H61 신규생성 - 선취수수료 및 좌수조정
            SELECT tr_aek
                 , susu
                 , tr_jwa
                 , gtr_jwa
              INTO xx.tr_aek
                 , w_susu
                 , xx.tr_jwa
                 , xx.gtr_jwa
              FROM SJT5SG t1  /* 타사집합투자증권 매매내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd     = p_ymd
               AND t1.tr_cd      = 'H61'
               AND t1.tr_co_cd   = xx.tr_co_cd
               AND t1.tasa_jm_cd = xx.tasa_jm_cd
               AND t1.org_tr_ymd = xx.tr_ymd
               AND t1.org_seq_no = xx.seq_no;

            if  xx.tr_jwa = 0   then
                xx.jasan_gb := '-' || SUBSTR (xx.jasan_gb,2);
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'J61', 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                            xx.tasa_jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1, xx.tr_aek, 52, 'PROC0520 매수취소', w_msg);
            else
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'H61', 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                            xx.tasa_jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1, w_susu, 52, 'PROC0520 susu', w_msg);
            end if;
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            if NVL (xx.upd_jwa,'com') = 'com'   then
                xx.tr_jwa  := ROUND (xx.tr_aek / w_gijun_ga * 1000, 0);
                xx.gtr_jwa := ROUND (xx.tr_aek / w_ggijun_ga * 1000, 0);
            else
                if NVL (xx.gtr_jwa,0) = 0   then
                    p_msg := xx.tasa_jm_cd || '-익일매수 과표좌수를 확인하십시오.';
                    RETURN;
                end if;
            end if;
        END;

        UPDATE SJT5SG tt    /* 타사집합투자증권 매매내역 */
           SET tr_jwa   = xx.tr_jwa
             , gtr_jwa  = xx.gtr_jwa
             , gijunga  = w_gijun_ga
             , ggijunga = w_ggijun_ga
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        -- 매수취소는 제외
        if  xx.tr_jwa != 0  then
            UPDATE SJM5SM tt    /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
               SET up_jwa  = NVL(up_jwa,0) + xx.tr_jwa
                 , up_aek  = NVL(up_aek,0) + xx.tr_aek
                 , gup_jwa = NVL(gup_jwa,0) + xx.gtr_jwa
             WHERE corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
               AND tasa_jm_cd = xx.tasa_jm_cd
               AND ymd        = p_ymd;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
                INSERT INTO SJM5SM tt   /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
                     ( corp_gr     /* _1- */
                     , ymd         /* _2- */
                     , fund_cd     /* _3- */
                     , tasa_jm_cd  /* _4- */
                     , up_aek      /* _5- */
                     , up_jwa      /* _6- */
                     , gup_jwa     /* _7- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr      /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd          /* _2- */
                       , xx.fund_cd     /* _3- */
                       , xx.tasa_jm_cd  /* _4- */
                       , xx.tr_aek      /* _5- */
                       , xx.tr_jwa      /* _6- */
                       , xx.gtr_jwa     /* _7- */
                       );
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';

    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC052A (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
) AS
-- 채권 이율정정시 이자구간의 값을 변경
--
    w_bigo                       sct0ij.bigo%type;
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC052A', p_ymd || ' : 채권 이율정정시 이자구간의 값을 변경');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'scm0cj.jm_cd=sct0ij.jm_cd * scm0cj.chg_ymd=' || p_ymd, '채권이율 정정내역(sct0ij)으로 이자구간(scj0ig) 값변경처리');

    for xx IN (
        select cj.balh_ymd                             /* _1- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                /* _2- */
             , t1.pyom_iyul                            /* _3- */
             , t1.halin_iyul                           /* _4- */
             , t1.halj_iyul                            /* _5- */
             , t1.bigo                                 /* _6- */
             , cj.pyom_iyul * 100   AS old_pyom_iyul   /* _7- */
             , cj.halin_iyul * 100  AS old_halin_iyul  /* _8- */
             , cj.halj_iyul * 100   AS old_halj_iyul   /* _9- */
             , cj.rowid             AS cj_rowid        /* _10- */
             , cj.sanghw_ymd                           /* _11- */
             , t1.rowid             AS ij_rowid        /* _12- */
          from SCT0IJ t1
             , SCM0CJ cj
         where t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           and t1.chg_ymd = p_ymd
           and cj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           and cj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        w_bigo  := NULL;
        if  xx.pyom_iyul * 100 != xx.old_pyom_iyul      then
            if  w_bigo IS NULL  then
                    w_bigo  := '표면이율:' || F_N0 (xx.old_pyom_iyul) || '->' || F_N0 (xx.pyom_iyul * 100);
            else    w_bigo  := w_bigo || ',표면이율:' || F_N0 (xx.old_pyom_iyul) || '->' || F_N0 (xx.pyom_iyul * 100);
            end if;
        end if;
        if  xx.halin_iyul * 100 != xx.old_halin_iyul    then
            if  w_bigo IS NULL  then
                    w_bigo  := '할인이율:' || F_N0 (xx.old_halin_iyul) || '->' || F_N0 (xx.halin_iyul * 100);
            else    w_bigo  := w_bigo || ',할인이율:' || F_N0 (xx.old_halin_iyul) || '->' || F_N0 (xx.halin_iyul * 100);
            end if;
        end if;
        if  xx.halj_iyul * 100 != xx.old_halj_iyul      then
            if  w_bigo IS NULL  then
                    w_bigo  := '할증이율:' || F_N0 (xx.old_halj_iyul) || '->' || F_N0 (xx.halj_iyul * 100);
            else    w_bigo  := w_bigo || ',할증이율:' || F_N0 (xx.old_halj_iyul) || '->' || F_N0 (xx.halj_iyul * 100);
            end if;
        end if;

        if  w_bigo IS NULL  then
                w_bigo  := xx.bigo;
        else    w_bigo  := w_bigo || chr(10) || xx.bigo;
        end if;

        UPDATE SCT0IJ  ff
           SET bigo = w_bigo
         WHERE ROWID = xx.ij_rowid;

        -- 종목정보 update
        UPDATE SCM0CJ  ff
           SET pyom_iyul   = xx.pyom_iyul
             , halin_iyul  = xx.halin_iyul
             , halj_iyul   = xx.halj_iyul
         WHERE ROWID = xx.cj_rowid;
    end loop;

    SR_SCJ0IG (p_corp_gr,p_ymd);
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0530 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 채권미수이자처리 ( 회계처리후 실행 )
--
    w_gugan_day_ija                NUMBER;
    w_kyng_ija                     NUMBER;
    w_misu_ija                     NUMBER;
    w_misu_day_ija                 NUMBER;
    w_pr_ija                       NUMBER;
    w_pr_day_ija                   NUMBER;

    w_yy                           NUMBER;
    w_dd                           NUMBER;
    w_gugan_ija                    NUMBER;

    w_sc_misu_ija                  NUMBER;
    w_sc_sung_cost                 NUMBER;
    w_sc_day_ija                   NUMBER;

    w_day_tax                      NUMBER;
    w_pr_tax                       NUMBER;

    w_bany_suik_rt                 NUMBER;  /* 반영수익률 */

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);

    -- 유효이자율 계산을 위한 항목
    w_day_anbun                    NUMBER;
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0530', p_ymd || ' : 채권 미수이자 처리(회계처리후 실행)');

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND t1.proc_step = 53;

    -- B24 채권이자선수령 경과분 처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                         /* _1- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                           /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                           /* _3- */
             , TRUNC (t1.sunsu_ija / (t1.af_ymd - t1.tr_ymd))  AS day_sunsu_ija   /* _4- */
             , t1.sunsu_ija - TRUNC (t1.sunsu_ija / (t1.af_ymd - t1.tr_ymd))
                            * (t1.af_ymd - t1.tr_ymd - 1)      AS last_sunsu_ija  /* _5- */
             , t1.af_ymd                                                          /* _6- */
             , cj.sangj_gb                                                        /* _7- */
             , cm.rowid                                                           /* _8- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                        ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)   AS seq             /* _9- */
          FROM SCT0FS t1  /* 펀드/종목별 원금(이자) 유예 MASTER */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
             , SCM0CM cm  /* 채권 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'B24'
           AND p_ymd      BETWEEN t1.tr_ymd AND (t1.af_ymd - 1)
           AND cj.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND cm.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND cm.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND cm.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND cm.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        if  p_ymd = (xx.af_ymd - 1)     then
            UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
               SET suib_ija     = NVL(suib_ija,0) + xx.last_sunsu_ija
                 , day_suib_ija = xx.last_sunsu_ija
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B24', 'A', '1', '2' || xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                        xx.jm_cd, 9, xx.seq, xx.last_sunsu_ija, 53, 'proc0530 선수이자안분 ' || xx.jm_cd, w_msg);
        else
            UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
