               SET suib_ija     = NVL(suib_ija,0) + xx.day_sunsu_ija
                 , day_suib_ija = xx.day_sunsu_ija
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B24', 'A', '1', '2' || xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                        xx.jm_cd, 9, xx.seq, xx.day_sunsu_ija, 53, 'proc0530 선수이자안분 ' || xx.jm_cd, w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'scpp040 -> ' || xx.sangj_gb || ' - ' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 당일 하루이자 계산(상환전 종목)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                 /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                               /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                         /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                 /* _4- */
             , t1.buy_date                                                                              /* _5- */
             , t1.yuhyo_rt                                                                              /* _6- */
             , NVL(cj.pyom_iyul, 0)                                                  AS pyom_iyul       /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm, 0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm, 0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm, 0)    AS aekm            /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek, 0) + NVL(t1.meib_aek, 0) - NVL(t1.medo_aek, 0)  AS chui_aek        /* _9- */
             , NVL(t1.msd_medo_aekm, 0)                                              AS msd_medo_aekm   /* _10- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_anbun_aek, 0)                                             AS bfil_anbun_aek  /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.anbun_aek, 0)                                                  AS anbun_aek       /* _12- */
             , NVL(t1.sung_cost, 0)                                                  AS sung_cost       /* _13- */
             , NVL(t1.pr_sung_cost, 0)                                               AS pr_sung_cost    /* _14- */
             , NVL(t1.misu_ija, 0)                                                   AS misu_ija        /* _15- */
             , NVL(t1.pr_misu_ija, 0)                                                AS pr_misu_ija     /* _16- */
             , NVL(t1.cbmg_misu_ija, 0)                                              AS cbmg_misu_ija   /* _17- */
             , NVL(t1.cbmg_sung_cost, 0)                                             AS cbmg_sung_cost  /* _18- */
             , NVL(t1.cbmg_day_ija, 0)                                               AS cbmg_day_ija    /* _19- */
             , cj.mangi_iyul - cj.pyom_iyul                                          AS com_iyul        /* _20- */
             , t1.lst_meib_ymd                                                                          /* _21- */
             , cj.bond_cd                                                                               /* _22- */
             , cj.bond_attr                                                                             /* _23- */
             , cj.balh_ymd                                                                              /* _24- */
             , cj.medo_ymd                                                                              /* _25- */
             , cj.sanghw_ymd                                                                            /* _26- */
             , cj.sunme_ija_ymd                                                                         /* _27- */
             , cj.ija_jigub_gb                                                                          /* _28- */
             , cj.yy_ija_hoisu                                                                          /* _29- */
             , cj.holi_ija_su                                                                           /* _30- */
             , cj.bunhal_gb                                                                             /* _31- */
             , cj.mangi_iyul                                                                            /* _32- */
             , cj.mangi_sanghw_per                                                                      /* _33- */
             , ig.gugan_no                                                                              /* _34- */
             , ig.bf_ija_ymd                                                                            /* _35- */
             , ig.af_ija_ymd                                                                            /* _36- */
             , ig.gugan_ija                                                                             /* _37- */
             , ig.gugan_ilsu                                                                            /* _38- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
             , SCJ0IG ig  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0) != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND cj.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND cj.sanghw_ymd                > p_ymd
           AND ig.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND ig.jm_cd                     = cj.jm_cd
           AND ig.ija_gb                    = 'B'
           AND p_ymd                        BETWEEN ig.bf_ija_ymd AND (ig.af_ija_ymd - 1)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM SCT0FS ta  /* 펀드/종목별 원금(이자) 유예 MASTER */
                            WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                              AND ta.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                              AND ta.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
                              AND ta.tr_cd   = 'B24'
                              AND p_ymd      BETWEEN ta.tr_ymd AND (ta.af_ymd - 1))
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
                , cj.sangj_gb
                , cj.slip_attr
    ) loop
        ---------------------------------------------
        -- 일반하루분이자 및 선급세 구함
        ---------------------------------------------
        if  xx.gugan_no = 0 then    -- 선매출 구간
            w_misu_ija     := 0;
            w_misu_day_ija := 0;
            w_day_tax      := 0;
        else
            -- 이자수령일이 휴일이면서 선수령인 경우
            if  xx.ija_jigub_gb IN ('7','8','G','H') AND NVL (xx.holi_ija_su, 'A') = 'B' AND 
                xx.af_ija_ymd BETWEEN p_ymd + 1 AND F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '+1') - 1 AND p_ymd < xx.af_ija_ymd   then
                w_misu_ija     := xx.misu_ija;
                w_misu_day_ija := 0;
                w_day_tax      := 0;
            else
                -- 일반적인 하루이자 계산
                -- 20200925 SR_SCPP043에 종목정보에 부도일자를 등록하는 경우 하루미수이자 계산하지 않게 반영
                SR_PROC053A (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.bunhal_gb, xx.bond_cd, xx.bond_attr, xx.ija_jigub_gb, xx.holi_ija_su,
                             xx.yy_ija_hoisu, xx.aekm, xx.pyom_iyul, xx.sung_cost, xx.misu_ija, xx.lst_meib_ymd,
                             w_misu_day_ija, w_day_tax, w_misu_ija, w_msg);
                if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                    p_msg := 'SR_PROC053A-' || w_msg;
                    RETURN;
                end if;
            end if;
        end if;
        ---------------------------------------------
        -- 할인/할증 하루분이자 및 선급세 구함
        ---------------------------------------------
        SR_PROC053B (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.jm_cd, xx.medo_ymd, xx.balh_ymd,
                     xx.aekm, xx.pr_sung_cost, xx.pr_misu_ija, w_pr_ija, w_pr_day_ija, w_pr_tax);
        ---------------------------------------------
        -- 선매출 처리
        ---------------------------------------------
        -----------------------------
        -- 선매출 마스타 금액 select
        -----------------------------
        if NVL (xx.sunme_ija_ymd, p_ymd) > p_ymd     then
            SR_PROC053C (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.medo_ymd, xx.balh_ymd,
                         xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.buy_date, w_sc_sung_cost, w_sc_misu_ija, w_sc_day_ija);
        else
            w_sc_sung_cost := 0;
            w_sc_misu_ija  := 0;
            w_sc_day_ija   := 0;
        end if;

        if  xx.ija_jigub_gb IN ('4','5','6','D','E','F','H')    then
            w_gugan_day_ija := w_misu_day_ija;
            w_kyng_ija      := w_misu_ija + xx.sung_cost;
        else
            w_gugan_day_ija := TRUNC  (NVL(xx.gugan_ija,0) * xx.aekm / xx.gugan_ilsu                          );
            w_kyng_ija      := TRUNC  (NVL(xx.gugan_ija,0) * xx.aekm / xx.gugan_ilsu * (p_ymd - xx.bf_ija_ymd));  /* 자문은 당일이자계산으로 한편넣기 */
--            w_kyng_ija      := trunc(NVL(xx.gugan_ija,0) * xx.aekm / xx.gugan_ilsu * (p_ymd - xx.bf_ija_ymd + 1));
        end if;

        -- 만기보장수익 미수이자계산
        -- 매도분 생성제외 20200328 yjs
        if (xx.aekm - xx.msd_medo_aekm) > 0 AND xx.mangi_iyul > 0   then
            w_yy := TRUNC (Months_Between(xx.sanghw_ymd, xx.balh_ymd) / 12);
            if  w_yy < 0    then    w_yy := 0;
            end if;
            w_dd := xx.sanghw_ymd - ADD_MONTHS  (xx.balh_ymd, w_yy * 12);

            if NVL (xx.mangi_sanghw_per,100) > 100  then
                    w_gugan_ija := TRUNC (xx.aekm * (xx.mangi_sanghw_per -100) / 100);
            else    w_gugan_ija := TRUNC (xx.aekm * (POWER(1 + xx.com_iyul,w_yy) * (1 + xx.com_iyul / 365 * w_dd))) - xx.aekm;
            end if;

            BEGIN
                -- 구간이자는 매수액면이므로 중간에 일부상환시 처리를 위한 현재 액면으로 계산 20210204 yjs
                SELECT TRUNC ((xx.aekm * xx.mangi_iyul) / gugan_ilsu * (p_ymd - bf_ija_ymd))
                                       - (xx.cbmg_misu_ija + xx.cbmg_sung_cost)
                  INTO xx.cbmg_day_ija
                  FROM SCJ0IG t1  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.ija_gb   = 'M'
                   AND t1.gugan_no = 1;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                xx.cbmg_day_ija := TRUNC (w_gugan_ija / (xx.sanghw_ymd - xx.balh_ymd) * (p_ymd - xx.balh_ymd))
                                    - (xx.cbmg_misu_ija + xx.cbmg_sung_cost);  /* 자문은 당일이자계산으로 한편넣기 */
--                xx.cbmg_day_ija := trunc (w_gugan_ija / (xx.sanghw_ymd - xx.balh_ymd) * (p_ymd - xx.balh_ymd + 1))
--                                                      - (xx.cbmg_misu_ija + xx.cbmg_sung_cost);
            END;
        else
            xx.cbmg_misu_ija := 0;
            xx.cbmg_day_ija  := 0;
        end if;

        if  p_corp_gr >= '2402' then
            -- 리코자산운용 이후 손익안분 계산제외 20240909
            w_day_anbun := xx.bfil_anbun_aek * -1;
        else
            if  p_ymd = xx.sanghw_ymd   then
                    w_day_anbun := (xx.aekm - xx.chui_aek) - xx.bfil_anbun_aek;
            ELSE    w_day_anbun := (xx.aekm - xx.chui_aek - xx.bfil_anbun_aek) / F_DAYS (p_ymd,xx.sanghw_ymd);
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 반영수익률 계산
        BEGIN
            w_bany_suik_rt  := (w_gugan_day_ija + w_pr_day_ija + w_sc_day_ija + w_day_anbun)
                                / (xx.chui_aek + xx.anbun_aek + w_day_anbun + w_kyng_ija + xx.pr_sung_cost
                                    + w_pr_ija + w_sc_sung_cost + w_sc_misu_ija + (xx.cbmg_misu_ija + xx.cbmg_day_ija)) * 365;

        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_bany_suik_rt := 0;
        END;

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- 채권마스타 update
        -------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
           SET anbun_aek     = NVL(anbun_aek,0) + w_day_anbun
             , misu_ija      = w_misu_ija
             , pr_misu_ija   = w_pr_ija
             , bany_suik_rt  = w_bany_suik_rt
             , sung_tax      = NVL(sung_tax,0) + w_day_tax
             , pr_sung_tax   = NVL(pr_sung_tax,0) + w_pr_tax
             , day_ija       = w_misu_day_ija
             , pr_day_ija    = w_pr_day_ija
             , sc_day_ija    = w_sc_day_ija
             , day_anbun_aek = w_day_anbun
             , cbmg_misu_ija = NVL(cbmg_misu_ija,0) + xx.cbmg_day_ija
             , cbmg_day_ija  = xx.cbmg_day_ija
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;

    -- 당일 만기보장 이자 계산, 상환손익 계산 (이자 선수령시)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                 /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                               /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                         /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                 /* _4- */
             , t1.buy_date                                                                              /* _5- */
             , t1.yuhyo_rt                                                                              /* _6- */
             , NVL(cj.pyom_iyul, 0)                                                  AS pyom_iyul       /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm, 0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm, 0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm, 0)    AS aekm            /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek, 0) + NVL(t1.meib_aek, 0) - NVL(t1.medo_aek, 0)  AS chui_aek        /* _9- */
             , NVL(t1.msd_medo_aekm, 0)                                              AS msd_medo_aekm   /* _10- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_anbun_aek, 0)                                             AS bfil_anbun_aek  /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.anbun_aek, 0)                                                  AS anbun_aek       /* _12- */
             , NVL(t1.sung_cost, 0)                                                  AS sung_cost       /* _13- */
             , NVL(t1.pr_sung_cost, 0)                                               AS pr_sung_cost    /* _14- */
             , NVL(t1.misu_ija, 0)                                                   AS misu_ija        /* _15- */
             , NVL(t1.pr_misu_ija, 0)                                                AS pr_misu_ija     /* _16- */
             , NVL(t1.cbmg_misu_ija, 0)                                              AS cbmg_misu_ija   /* _17- */
             , NVL(t1.cbmg_sung_cost, 0)                                             AS cbmg_sung_cost  /* _18- */
             , NVL(t1.cbmg_day_ija, 0)                                               AS cbmg_day_ija    /* _19- */
             , cj.mangi_iyul - cj.pyom_iyul                                          AS com_iyul        /* _20- */
             , t1.lst_meib_ymd                                                                          /* _21- */
             , cj.bond_cd                                                                               /* _22- */
             , cj.bond_attr                                                                             /* _23- */
             , cj.balh_ymd                                                                              /* _24- */
             , cj.medo_ymd                                                                              /* _25- */
             , cj.sanghw_ymd                                                                            /* _26- */
             , cj.sunme_ija_ymd                                                                         /* _27- */
             , cj.ija_jigub_gb                                                                          /* _28- */
             , cj.yy_ija_hoisu                                                                          /* _29- */
             , cj.bunhal_gb                                                                             /* _30- */
             , cj.mangi_iyul                                                                            /* _31- */
             , cj.mangi_sanghw_per                                                                      /* _32- */
             , ig.gugan_no                                                                              /* _33- */
             , ig.bf_ija_ymd                                                                            /* _34- */
             , ig.af_ija_ymd                                                                            /* _35- */
             , ig.gugan_ija                                                                             /* _36- */
             , ig.gugan_ilsu                                                                            /* _37- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
             , SCJ0IG ig  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0) != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND cj.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND cj.sanghw_ymd                > p_ymd
           AND ig.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND ig.jm_cd                     = cj.jm_cd
           AND ig.ija_gb                    = 'B'
           AND p_ymd                        BETWEEN ig.bf_ija_ymd AND (ig.af_ija_ymd - 1)
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM SCT0FS ta  /* 펀드/종목별 원금(이자) 유예 MASTER */
                        WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                          AND ta.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                          AND ta.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
                          AND ta.tr_cd   = 'B24'
                          AND p_ymd      BETWEEN ta.tr_ymd AND (ta.af_ymd - 1))
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
                , cj.sangj_gb
                , cj.slip_attr
    ) loop
        -- 만기보장수익 미수이자계산
        -- 매도분 생성제외 20200328 yjs
        if (xx.aekm - xx.msd_medo_aekm) > 0 AND xx.mangi_iyul > 0   then
            w_yy := TRUNC (Months_Between(xx.sanghw_ymd, xx.balh_ymd) / 12);
            if  w_yy < 0    then    w_yy := 0;
            end if;
            w_dd := xx.sanghw_ymd - ADD_MONTHS  (xx.balh_ymd, w_yy * 12);

            if NVL (xx.mangi_sanghw_per,100) > 100  then
                    w_gugan_ija := TRUNC (xx.aekm * xx.mangi_sanghw_per / 100 - xx.aekm);
            else    w_gugan_ija := TRUNC (xx.aekm * (POWER(1 + xx.com_iyul,w_yy) * (1 + xx.com_iyul / 365 * w_dd))) - xx.aekm;
            end if;

            BEGIN
                -- 구간이자는 매수액면이므로 중간에 일부상환시 처리를 위한 현재 액면으로 계산 20210204 yjs
                SELECT TRUNC ((xx.aekm * xx.mangi_iyul) / gugan_ilsu * (p_ymd - bf_ija_ymd)) - (xx.cbmg_misu_ija + xx.cbmg_sung_cost)
                  INTO xx.cbmg_day_ija
                  FROM SCJ0IG t1  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.ija_gb   = 'M'
                   AND t1.gugan_no = 1;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                xx.cbmg_day_ija := TRUNC (w_gugan_ija / (xx.sanghw_ymd - xx.balh_ymd) * (p_ymd - xx.balh_ymd))
                                    - (xx.cbmg_misu_ija + xx.cbmg_sung_cost);
            END;
        else
            xx.cbmg_misu_ija := 0;
            xx.cbmg_day_ija  := 0;
        end if;

        if  p_corp_gr >= '2402' then
            -- 리코자산운용 이후 손익안분 계산제외 20240909
            w_day_anbun := xx.bfil_anbun_aek * -1;
        else
            if  p_ymd = xx.sanghw_ymd   then
                    w_day_anbun := (xx.aekm - xx.chui_aek) - xx.bfil_anbun_aek;
            ELSE    w_day_anbun := (xx.aekm - xx.chui_aek - xx.bfil_anbun_aek) / F_DAYS (p_ymd,xx.sanghw_ymd);
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 반영수익률 계산
        BEGIN
            w_bany_suik_rt  := (w_gugan_day_ija + w_pr_day_ija + w_sc_day_ija + w_day_anbun)
                                / (xx.chui_aek + xx.anbun_aek + w_day_anbun + w_kyng_ija + xx.pr_sung_cost
                                   + w_pr_ija + w_sc_sung_cost + w_sc_misu_ija + (xx.cbmg_misu_ija + xx.cbmg_day_ija)) * 365;

        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_bany_suik_rt := 0;
        END;

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- 채권마스타 update
        -------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
           SET anbun_aek     = NVL(anbun_aek,0) + w_day_anbun
             , day_anbun_aek = w_day_anbun
             , cbmg_misu_ija = NVL(cbmg_misu_ija,0) + xx.cbmg_day_ija
             , cbmg_day_ija  = xx.cbmg_day_ija
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;

    -- 상환종목 휴일분 이자계산
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                                         /* _1- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                           /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                   /* _3- */
             , cj.sangj_gb                                                                        /* _4- */
             , t1.rowid                                                                           /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm, 0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm, 0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm, 0)   AS aekm       /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.misu_ija, 0)                                                  AS misu_ija   /* _7- */
             , 0                                                                    AS day_ija    /* _8- */
             , cj.sanghw_ija_gb1                                                                  /* _9- */
             , CASE WHEN cj.sanghw_ija_gb2='1' THEN cj.pyom_iyul
                                               ELSE cj.sanghw_ija_iyul END / 365    AS ija_iyul   /* _10- */
             , cj.sanghw_aekm_gb1                                                                 /* _11- */
             , CASE WHEN cj.sanghw_aekm_gb2='1' THEN cj.pyom_iyul
                                                ELSE cj.sanghw_aekm_iyul END / 365  AS aekm_iyul  /* _12- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)    AS seq        /* _13- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0) != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND cj.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND cj.sanghw_ymd                <= p_ymd
           AND cj.sanghw_ymd                BETWEEN F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd,'-') + 1 AND F_OPEN_YMD(p_ymd,'+') - 1
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
                , cj.sangj_gb
    ) loop
        if  xx.sanghw_ija_gb1 = '4'     then    xx.day_ija := xx.day_ija + TRUNC (xx.misu_ija * xx.ija_iyul);
        elsif xx.sanghw_aekm_gb1 = '4'  then    xx.day_ija := xx.day_ija + TRUNC (xx.aekm * xx.aekm_iyul);
        end if;

        UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
           SET suib_ija     = NVL(suib_ija,0) + xx.day_ija
             , day_suib_ija = xx.day_ija
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        -- 휴일분 미수이자 분개
        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B22', 'A', '1', xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                    xx.jm_cd, 9, xx.seq, xx.day_ija, 53, 'proc0530 휴일이자', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.sangj_gb || ' ' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 당일 수입이자 분개
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                                                           /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                     /* _2- */
             , cj.slip_attr                                                                                         /* _3- */
             , cj.sunhu_gb                                                                                          /* _4- */
             , cj.sangj_gb                                                                                          /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.day_ija), 0) + NVL(SUM(t1.pr_day_ija), 0) + NVL(SUM(t1.sc_day_ija), 0)  AS day_ija        /* _6- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.day_anbun_aek), 0)                                                      AS day_anbun_aek  /* _7- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.cbmg_day_ija), 0)                                                       AS cbmg_day_ija   /* _8- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                        ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)                                      AS seq            /* _9- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0) != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND cj.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND cj.sanghw_ymd                > p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
                , cj.slip_attr
                , cj.sangj_gb
                , cj.sunhu_gb
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , cj.sunhu_gb
                , cj.slip_attr
    ) loop
        if  xx.sunhu_gb = '1'   then
            -- 선수이자 분개
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B22', 'A', '1', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', xx.slip_attr,
                        xx.seq, xx.day_ija, 53, 'proc0530 선수이자', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.slip_attr || ' ' || w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
            -- 손익안분 분개
            SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B12', 'A', '1', xx.slip_attr || xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        '', xx.slip_attr, xx.seq, xx.day_anbun_aek, 53, 'proc0530 선수손익안분', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.slip_attr || ' ' || xx.sangj_gb || ' ' || w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        else
            -- 미수이자 분개
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B22', 'A', '1', xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        '', xx.slip_attr, xx.seq, xx.day_ija, 53, 'proc0530 미수이자', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.sangj_gb || ' ' || w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;

            -- 손익안분 분개
            SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B12', 'A', '1', xx.slip_attr || xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        '', xx.slip_attr, xx.seq, xx.day_anbun_aek, 53, 'proc0530 미수손익안분', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.slip_attr || ' ' || xx.sangj_gb || ' ' || w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
        if  xx.cbmg_day_ija != 0    then
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B2C', 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        '', 9, xx.seq, xx.cbmg_day_ija, 53, 'proc0530 만기보장 미수이자', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := xx.fund_cd || ' ' || w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';

    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC053A (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_bunhal_gb                    IN    VARCHAR,
    p_bond_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_bond_attr                    IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ija_jigub_gb                 IN    VARCHAR,
    p_holi_ija_su                  IN    VARCHAR,
    p_yy_ija_hoisu                 IN    NUMBER,
    p_aekm                         IN    NUMBER,
    p_pyom_iyul                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_sung_cost                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_bfil_misu_ija                IN    NUMBER,
    p_lst_meib_ymd                 IN    DATE,
    p_day_ija                      OUT   NUMBER,
    p_day_tax                      OUT   NUMBER,
    p_misu_ija                     OUT   NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 채권미수이자처리 (일반 하루분이자 및 선급세 구함)
--
    w_bf_ija_ymd                 DATE;
    w_gugan_no                   NUMBER;

    ig_gugan_ilsu                NUMBER;
    ig_gugan_ija_aek             NUMBER;
    ig_bf_gugan_ija              NUMBER;
    ig_com_ija_gb                scj0ig.com_ija_gb%type;

    w_chg_ija_ymd                DATE;
    w_budo_ymd                   DATE;
    w_chg_gugan_ija_aek          NUMBER;

    w_day_ija                    NUMBER;
    w_misu_ija                   NUMBER;
    w_dang_ilsu                  NUMBER;
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM SZX3CK tt
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND proc    = 'scpp043'
       AND err_msg LIKE p_fund_cd||'-'||p_jm_cd;

    p_day_ija   := 0;
    p_day_tax   := 0;
    p_misu_ija  := 0;
    p_msg       := 'Y';

    BEGIN
        SELECT budo_ymd
          INTO w_budo_ymd
          FROM SCM0CJ t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd;
    EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        p_msg   := p_jm_cd || ' - scpp043 종목정보가 없습니다.';
        RETURN;
    END;

    if NVL (w_budo_ymd,p_ymd + 1) <= p_ymd  then
        w_day_ija   := 0;
        w_misu_ija  := p_bfil_misu_ija;
    else
        BEGIN
            -- 이자구간의 구간이자/일수/손익안분 구함
            SELECT gugan_no                                                /* _1- */
                 , bf_ija_ymd                                              /* _2- */
                 , NVL(gugan_ilsu,0)                                       /* _3- */
                 , CASE WHEN chg_ija_ymd IS NULL OR chg_ija_ymd <= p_ymd
                        THEN trunc(NVL(gugan_ija,0) * p_aekm)
                        ELSE trunc(NVL(bf_gugan_ija,0) * p_aekm) END       /* _4- */
                 , com_ija_gb                                              /* _5- */
                 , CASE WHEN chg_ija_ymd IS NULL OR chg_ija_ymd > p_ymd
                        THEN NULL
                        ELSE chg_ija_ymd END                               /* _6- */
                 , CASE WHEN chg_ija_ymd IS NULL OR chg_ija_ymd > p_ymd
                        THEN NULL
                        ELSE trunc((bf_gugan_ija * p_aekm) / gugan_ilsu
                                    * F_DAYS(bf_ija_ymd,chg_ija_ymd)) END  /* _7- */
              INTO w_gugan_no           /* _1- */
                 , w_bf_ija_ymd         /* _2- */
                 , ig_gugan_ilsu        /* _3- */
                 , ig_gugan_ija_aek     /* _4- */
                 , ig_com_ija_gb        /* _5- */
                 , w_chg_ija_ymd        /* _6- */
                 , w_chg_gugan_ija_aek  /* _7- */
              FROM SCJ0IG t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd
               AND t1.ija_gb  = 'B'
               AND p_ymd      Between t1.bf_ija_ymd And (t1.af_ija_ymd - 1);
        EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            p_msg   := p_jm_cd || ' - 구간이자가 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        if  p_bunhal_gb = '1'   then
            -- 분할채인 경우 개별 이자관리
            BEGIN
                SELECT gugan_ija_aek
                  INTO ig_gugan_ija_aek
                  FROM SCM0IG t1
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd      = p_fund_cd
                   AND t1.jm_cd        = p_jm_cd
                   AND t1.lst_meib_ymd = p_lst_meib_ymd
                   AND t1.ija_gugan_no = w_gugan_no;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                -- 분할채 개별 이자금액이 없는 경우 이자구간 이자로 처리 20200930 yjs
                NULL;
            END;
        end if;

        if  w_chg_ija_ymd IS NULL   then
                w_dang_ilsu := p_ymd - w_bf_ija_ymd + 1;    -- 당일 경과일수
        else    w_dang_ilsu := p_ymd - w_chg_ija_ymd + 1;   -- 구간내 이자변경 후 경과일수
        end if;
        ig_bf_gugan_ija := 0;

        if  p_holi_ija_su = 'S' then    -- 구간 복리/단리 계산인 경우(상환일 수령)
            if  ig_com_ija_gb = '4' then    -- 복리구간
                w_misu_ija  := trunc(p_aekm * power(1 + p_pyom_iyul / p_yy_ija_hoisu,(w_gugan_no - 1)
                                      + (w_dang_ilsu / ig_gugan_ilsu)) - p_aekm) - p_sung_cost;
                w_day_ija   := w_misu_ija - p_bfil_misu_ija;
            else
                -- 5복2단 이전구간 이자 합산
                SELECT trunc(SUM(NVL(gugan_ija,0) * p_aekm))
                  INTO ig_bf_gugan_ija
                  FROM SCJ0IG t1
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.jm_cd    = p_jm_cd
                   AND t1.ija_gb   = 'B'
                   AND t1.gugan_no < w_gugan_no;

                w_misu_ija  := trunc(ig_gugan_ija_aek / ig_gugan_ilsu * w_dang_ilsu) + ig_bf_gugan_ija - p_sung_cost;
                w_day_ija   := w_misu_ija - p_bfil_misu_ija;
            end if;

        elsif p_ija_jigub_gb IN ('4','5','6','D','E','F')   then    -- 복리채 이자계산 방식변경
            w_misu_ija  := trunc(p_aekm * power(1 + p_pyom_iyul / p_yy_ija_hoisu,(w_gugan_no - 1)
                                  + (w_dang_ilsu / ig_gugan_ilsu)) - p_aekm) - p_sung_cost;
            w_day_ija   := w_misu_ija - p_bfil_misu_ija;

        else
            -- 미수이자 = 총이자 - 현선급비용
            -- 휴일은 구간일수로 나눈금액 사용
            if  F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd,'-') != p_ymd then
                w_day_ija   := trunc(ig_gugan_ija_aek / ig_gugan_ilsu);
                w_misu_ija  := w_day_ija + p_bfil_misu_ija;
            else
                if  w_chg_ija_ymd IS NULL   then
                        w_misu_ija  := trunc(ig_gugan_ija_aek / ig_gugan_ilsu * w_dang_ilsu) - p_sung_cost;
                else    w_misu_ija  := trunc(ig_gugan_ija_aek / ig_gugan_ilsu * w_dang_ilsu) - p_sung_cost + w_chg_gugan_ija_aek;
                end if;
                w_day_ija   := w_misu_ija - p_bfil_misu_ija;
            end if;
            if  abs (w_day_ija - (ig_gugan_ija_aek / ig_gugan_ilsu)) > 1000 then
                INSERT INTO SZX3CK tt
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr
                       , p_fund_cd || '-' || p_jm_cd || '-' || '(' || p_ymd
                                   || ') 채권당일이자 확인 day_ija=' || F_NTRIM(w_day_ija)
                                   || ' gugan=' || F_NTRIM(ig_gugan_ija_aek / ig_gugan_ilsu)
                       , 1612540
                       , 'proc053a'
                       );
            end if;
        end if;
    end if;
    p_misu_ija  := w_misu_ija;
    p_day_ija   := w_day_ija;
    p_day_tax   := 0;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC053B (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_medo_ymd                     IN    DATE,
    p_balh_ymd                     IN    DATE,
    p_aekm                         IN    NUMBER,
    p_pr_sung_cost                 IN    NUMBER,
    p_bfil_misu_ija                IN    NUMBER,
    p_pr_misu_ija                  OUT   NUMBER,
    p_pr_day_ija                   OUT   NUMBER,
    p_pr_day_tax                   OUT   NUMBER
) AS
-- 채권미수이자처리 (할인/할증 하루분이자 및 선급세 구함)
--
    ig_gugan_ilsu                NUMBER;
    ig_gugan_ija                 NUMBER;
    ig_bf_ija_ymd                DATE;

    w_pr_day_ija                 NUMBER;
    w_pr_misu_ija                NUMBER;
BEGIN
    BEGIN
        -- 이자구간의 구간이자/일수 구함
        SELECT NVL(gugan_ilsu,0)
             , NVL(gugan_ija,0) * p_aekm
             , bf_ija_ymd
          INTO ig_gugan_ilsu
             , ig_gugan_ija
             , ig_bf_ija_ymd
          FROM SCJ0IG t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd    = p_jm_cd
           AND t1.gugan_no = 1
           AND t1.ija_gb   IN ('I','J');
    EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        p_pr_misu_ija   := 0;
        p_pr_day_ija    := 0;
        p_pr_day_tax    := 0;
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- 미수이자 = 총이자 - 현선급비용
    if  p_balh_ymd <= p_ymd then
        w_pr_misu_ija   := ig_gugan_ija - p_pr_sung_cost;
        w_pr_day_ija    := 0;
    else
        w_pr_misu_ija   := trunc(ig_gugan_ija / ig_gugan_ilsu * (p_ymd - ig_bf_ija_ymd + 1)) - p_pr_sung_cost;
        w_pr_day_ija    := w_pr_misu_ija - p_bfil_misu_ija;
    end if;

    p_pr_misu_ija   := w_pr_misu_ija;
    p_pr_day_ija    := w_pr_day_ija;
    p_pr_day_tax    := 0;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC053C (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_medo_ymd                     IN    DATE,
    p_balh_ymd                     IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_buy_date                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_sung_cost                    OUT   NUMBER,
    p_sunme_ija                    OUT   NUMBER,
    p_day_sunme_ija                OUT   NUMBER
) AS
-- 채권 선매출미수이자 처리
--
    sc_rowid                     ROWID;
    sc_misu_ija                  NUMBER;
    sc_sung_cost                 NUMBER;
    sc_gugan_ija                 NUMBER;
    sj_sun_tax_napbu_gb          scm0cj.sun_tax_napbu_gb%type;

    w_day_sunme_ija              NUMBER;
    w_day_tax                    NUMBER;
    w_kyng_ija                   NUMBER;
BEGIN
    p_sung_cost     := 0;
    p_sunme_ija     := 0;
    p_day_sunme_ija := 0;

    BEGIN
        -- 이자구간의 구간이자/일수 구함
        SELECT rowidtochar(t1.rowid)
             , NVL(t1.misu_ija,0)
             , NVL(t1.sung_cost,0)
             , NVL(t1.gugan_ija,0)
             , t2.sun_tax_napbu_gb
          INTO sc_rowid
             , sc_misu_ija
             , sc_sung_cost
             , sc_gugan_ija
             , sj_sun_tax_napbu_gb
          FROM SCM0SC t1
             , SCM0CJ t2
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.jm_cd    = p_jm_cd
           AND t1.buy_date = p_buy_date
           AND t2.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd;
    EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        RETURN;
    END;

    if  p_balh_ymd <= p_ymd then
            w_kyng_ija  := sc_gugan_ija - sc_sung_cost;
    else    w_kyng_ija  := trunc(sc_gugan_ija / (p_balh_ymd - p_medo_ymd) * (p_ymd - p_medo_ymd + 1)) - sc_sung_cost;
    end if;
    w_day_sunme_ija := w_kyng_ija - sc_misu_ija;
    w_day_tax       := 0;

    UPDATE SCM0SC  ff
       SET misu_ija  = w_kyng_ija
         , day_ija   = w_day_sunme_ija
         , sung_tax  = NVL(sung_tax,0) + w_day_tax
     WHERE ROWID = sc_rowid;

    p_sung_cost     := sc_sung_cost;
    p_sunme_ija     := w_kyng_ija;
    p_day_sunme_ija := w_day_sunme_ija;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0540 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 주식 회계처리
--
    w_jusu                         NUMBER;
    w_lock                         NUMBER;
    w_close                        NUMBER;

    w_jasan_gb                     szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;
    w_sosok_gb                     sjx0jb.sosok_gb%type;
    w_danc_gb                      sjm0jj.danc_gb%type;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0540', p_ymd || ' : 주식회계처리' );

    -- 분개장 Table의 주식분개자료 삭제
    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B000', 'skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0bu.proc_step=54', '주식회계처리 분개장(skt0bu) delete' );

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND t1.proc_step = 54;

    SR_PROC0541( p_corp_gr, p_ymd );  /* 주식 주식회계처리 초기화 */

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd        /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd      /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd        /* _3- */
             , t1.hwakj_aek    /* _4- */
             , t1.sury_aek     /* _5- */
             , t1.type_trench  /* _6- */
             , t1.bs_type      /* _7- */
          FROM SJT0FS t1  /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 IN ('F17','F19','F12','F47','F31','F42','F34','F36')
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'F47'    then    -- 공모주수령
            w_jusu := NVL (xx.sury_aek, 0);

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'F42'  then    -- 공개매수확정
            SR_UPDJM4( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, - xx.hwakj_aek, xx.type_trench, xx.bs_type, w_msg );
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg || '(주식마스타 변경에러)';
                RETURN;
            end if;
            w_jusu := NVL (xx.sury_aek, 0);
        else
            w_jusu := NVL (xx.sury_aek, 0) - NVL (xx.hwakj_aek,0);
        end if;
        SR_UPDJM( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_cd, w_jusu, '', xx.type_trench, xx.bs_type, w_msg );
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(주식마스타 변경에러2)';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd        /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd      /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd        /* _3- */
             , t1.type_trench  /* _4- */
             , t1.bs_type      /* _5- */
             , t1.cheng_jusu   /* _6- */
             , t1.cheng_aek    /* _7- */
             , t1.hwakj_jusu   /* _8- */
             , t1.kra_jusu     /* _9- */
             , t1.lock_end     /* _10- */
          FROM SJT0CY t1  /* 주식청약내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 IN ('F18','F65','F41')
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'F41'    then    -- 공개매수
            SR_UPDJM4( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.cheng_jusu, xx.type_trench, xx.bs_type, w_msg );
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg || '(주식마스타 변경에러3)';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        else
            if  xx.tr_cd = 'F18' AND NVL (xx.hwakj_jusu,0) != 0     then    -- 유상청약
                w_jusu := NVL (xx.cheng_jusu, 0) - NVL (xx.hwakj_jusu,0);
            else
                if  xx.kra_jusu > 0 then
                        w_jusu := NVL (xx.kra_jusu, 0);
                else    w_jusu := NVL(xx.cheng_jusu, 0);
                end if;
                if  xx.lock_end IS NOT NULL then    w_lock := xx.cheng_jusu;
                end if;
            end if;
            SR_UPDJM( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_cd, w_jusu, w_lock, xx.type_trench, xx.bs_type, w_msg );
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg || '(주식마스타 변경에러4)';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B050', 'sjt0jg.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=J2E,K2E', 'ETF 설정/환매 당일종가 반영 처리' );

    -- ETF 설정/환매 당일종가 반영 처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid
             , t1.koscom_cd
             , t1.tr_jusu
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('J2E','K2E')
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT CLOSE
              INTO w_close
              FROM SJT1TG t1  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
             WHERE t1.ymd       = p_ymd
               AND t1.koscom_cd = xx.koscom_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.koscom_cd || ' - ETF 설정/환매 종가적용 에러발생';
            RETURN;
        END;
        UPDATE SJT0JG tt    /* 주식거래 내역 */
           SET tr_aek   = xx.tr_jusu * w_close
             , gyul_aek = xx.tr_jusu * w_close
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;
    -- ETF 설정/환매 당일종가 반영 후 J2A,K2A 결제액 수정
    for xx IN (
        SELECT fund_cd                             /* _1- */
             , tr_cd                               /* _2- */
             , seq_no                              /* _3- */
             , etf_jm_cd                           /* _4- */
             , etf_cash_aek                        /* _5- */
             , SUM(tr_jusu)           AS offer_no  /* _6- */
             , NVL(SUM(gyul_aek), 0)  AS etf_aek   /* _7- */
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('J2E','K2E')
         GROUP BY fund_cd
                , tr_cd
                , seq_no
                , etf_jm_cd
                , etf_cash_aek
    ) loop
        UPDATE SJT0JG tt    /* 주식거래 내역 */
           SET tr_aek   = xx.etf_aek + xx.etf_cash_aek
             , gyul_aek = xx.etf_aek + xx.etf_cash_aek
         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND tr_ymd   = p_ymd
           AND tr_cd    = (CASE WHEN xx.tr_cd='K2E' THEN 'J2A' ELSE 'K2A'  END)
           AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd    = xx.etf_jm_cd
           AND seq_no   = xx.seq_no
           AND offer_no = xx.offer_no
           AND upd_user = 'sjue02e';
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.tr_cd || ' ' || xx.etf_jm_cd || ' ' || xx.seq_no || ' - ETF 결제금액 조정에러 발생';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjt0fs.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sjt0fs.tr_cd=F17', '(sjt0fs) 유상주 수령 회계처리' );

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                                         /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                          /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                        /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                          /* _4- */
             , t1.type_trench                                                    /* _5- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                        /* _6- */
             , (NVL(sury_aek,0) - NVL(hwakj_aek,0)) * NVL(danga,0)  AS chui_aek  /* _7- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)         AS seq       /* _8- */
          FROM SJT0FS t1  /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'F17'
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
           AND NVL(sury_aek,0) - NVL(hwakj_aek,0) != 0
    ) loop
        SR_UPDJM2( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.bs_type, xx.type_trench, xx.chui_aek, 0, w_msg );  /* 취득가 처리 */
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := xx.tr_cd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '- 취득가 처리가 안됐습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;
        SR_GETJJ4( xx.jm_cd, w_sosok_gb, w_danc_gb, w_msg );  /* 발행기관 소속구분 가져오기 */
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  w_sosok_gb = 'B'    then    w_jasan_gb := '01';  -- 비상장
        elsif w_sosok_gb = 'C'  then    w_jasan_gb := '02';  -- 등록
        elsif w_sosok_gb = 'D'  then    w_jasan_gb := '03';  -- 코넥스
        else                            w_jasan_gb := '00';  /* 상장 */
        end if;
        SR_SZSL010( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.chui_aek, 54, 'PROC0540', w_msg );
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then    -- 분개처리err
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjt0fs.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sjt0fs.tr_cd=F12', '(sjt0fs) 배당주식 수령 회계처리' );

    -- 펀드별종목별수탁사수령내역의 배당주 수령내역
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                                         /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                          /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                        /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                          /* _4- */
             , t1.type_trench                                                    /* _5- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                        /* _6- */
             , (NVL(sury_aek,0) - NVL(hwakj_aek,0)) * NVL(danga,0)  AS chui_aek  /* _7- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)         AS seq       /* _8- */
          FROM SJT0FS t1  /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                    = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                     = 'F12'
           AND t2.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND NVL(sury_aek,0) - NVL(hwakj_aek,0) != 0
    ) loop
        SR_UPDJM2( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.bs_type, xx.type_trench, xx.chui_aek, 0, w_msg );  /* 취득가 처리 */
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := xx.tr_cd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '- 취득가 처리가 안됐습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        SR_GETJJ4( xx.jm_cd, w_sosok_gb, w_danc_gb, w_msg );  /* 발행기관 소속구분 가져오기 */
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  w_sosok_gb = 'B'    then    w_jasan_gb := '01';  -- 비상장
        elsif w_sosok_gb = 'C'  then    w_jasan_gb := '02';  -- 등록주식
        elsif w_sosok_gb = 'D'  then    w_jasan_gb := '03';  -- 코넥스
        else                            w_jasan_gb := '00';  /* 상장 */
        end if;
        SR_SZSL010( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.chui_aek, 54, 'PROC0540', w_msg );
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjt0fs.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sjt0fs.tr_cd=F47', '(sjt0fs) 공모신주 수령 회계처리' );

    -- 펀드별종목별수탁사 공모신주 수령내역
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                                    /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                     /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                   /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                     /* _4- */
             , t1.type_trench                                               /* _5- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                   /* _6- */
             , t1.sury_aek                                   AS jusu        /* _7- */
             , t1.chui_aek                                                  /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.susu,0)                                AS susu        /* _9- */
             , t1.cy_type                                                   /* _10- */
             , t1.upd_user                                                  /* _11- */
             , jb.sosok_gb                                   AS w_sosok_gb  /* _12- */
             , jj.danc_gb                                    AS sosok_gb    /* _13- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                      AS new_jm_cd   /* _14- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq         /* _15- */
          FROM SJT0FS t1  /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
             , SJM0JJ jj  /* 주식종목 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'F47'
           AND jj.balh_co               = jb.balh_co
           AND jj.jm_cd                 = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(sj_jm_cd, xx.new_jm_cd)
              INTO xx.new_jm_cd
              FROM SJG1JC t1  /* 종목별 공모 기본정보 및 배정/청약내역(공통) */
             WHERE t1.ymd                    <= p_ymd
               AND NVL(t1.sj_ymd, p_ymd + 1) >= p_ymd
               AND t1.cy_jm_cd               = xx.jm_cd
               AND ROWNUM = 1;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.jm_cd || ' - 종목별 공모정보(2309)가 등록되어 있지 않습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        /* 취득가 처리 */
        if  xx.cy_type IN ('2','3') THEN
                SR_UPDJM2( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.bs_type, xx.type_trench, xx.chui_aek - xx.susu, 0, w_msg );
        ELSE    SR_UPDJM2( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.bs_type, xx.type_trench, xx.chui_aek          , 0, w_msg );
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    THEN
            p_msg := xx.tr_cd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '- 취득가 처리가 안됐습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if  xx.sosok_gb = '8'   THEN    ---DR의 경우는 발행기관이 아닌 주식소속구분으로
            SELECT t1.danc_gb
              INTO xx.sosok_gb
              FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE jm_cd = xx.new_jm_cd;
        end if;

        if  xx.cy_type = '3'    THEN    -- 공모납입(확정납부:청약일평가)
            if  xx.jusu > 0 THEN
                if  xx.sosok_gb = 'B'   then    w_jasan_gb := '21';  -- 비상장
                elsif xx.sosok_gb = 'C' then    w_jasan_gb := '22';  -- 등록
                elsif xx.sosok_gb = 'D' then    w_jasan_gb := '23';  -- 코넥스
                else                            w_jasan_gb := '20';  /* 상장 */
                end if;
                -- 20240927 자문 청약취득액 수수료제외
                SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.chui_aek - xx.susu, xx.chui_aek, 54, 'PROC0540a' || w_jasan_gb, w_msg );
            ELSE
                -- 청약취소(증거금사용하지 않으므로 분개 없음)
                w_msg := 'Y';
            end if;
        elsif xx.cy_type = '2'  THEN    -- 공모납입(확정납부:납입일평가)
            if  xx.jusu > 0 THEN
                if  xx.sosok_gb = 'B'   then    w_jasan_gb := '11';  -- 비상장
                elsif xx.sosok_gb = 'C' then    w_jasan_gb := '12';  -- 등록
                elsif xx.sosok_gb = 'D' then    w_jasan_gb := '13';  -- 코넥스
                else                            w_jasan_gb := '10';  /* 상장 */
                end if;
                -- 20240927 자문 청약취득액 수수료제외
                SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.chui_aek - xx.susu, xx.chui_aek, 54, 'PROC0540b' || w_jasan_gb, w_msg );
            ELSE
                -- 청약취소(증거금사용하지 않으므로 분개 없음)
                w_msg := 'Y';
            end if;
        elsif xx.cy_type = 'A'  THEN
            if  xx.w_sosok_gb IN ('1','C','D')  THEN

                if  xx.w_sosok_gb = '1'     then    w_jasan_gb := '00';  -- 상장
                elsif xx.w_sosok_gb = 'C'   then    w_jasan_gb := '02';  -- 등록
                elsif xx.w_sosok_gb = 'D'   then    w_jasan_gb := '03';  -- 코넥스
                end if;
            ELSE
                if  xx.sosok_gb = 'B'   then    w_jasan_gb := '01';  -- 비상장
                ELSE
                    -- 청약 종목 및 발행기관 확인! (증거금사용하지 않으므로 분개 없음)
                    p_msg   := xx.tr_cd || '펀드:' || xx.fund_cd || '종목:' || xx.jm_cd
                                        || '발행소속:' || xx.w_sosok_gb || '종목소속:' || xx.sosok_gb || '- 청약처리시 종목을 확인하시가 바랍니다.';
                    RETURN;
                end if;
            end if;
            SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.chui_aek, xx.chui_aek, 54, 'PROC0540c' || w_jasan_gb, w_msg );
        else    /* 공모청약금 */
            if  xx.sosok_gb = 'B'   then    w_jasan_gb := '01';  -- 비상장
            elsif xx.sosok_gb = 'C' then    w_jasan_gb := '02';  -- 등록
            elsif xx.sosok_gb = 'D' then    w_jasan_gb := '03';  -- 코넥스
            else                            w_jasan_gb := '00';  /* 상장 */
            end if;
            SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.chui_aek, xx.chui_aek, 54, 'PROC0540d' || w_jasan_gb, w_msg );
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 청약일 평가를 위해 미지급공모청약금 처리분 납입처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                              /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                               /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                             /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                               /* _4- */
             , t1.type_trench                                         /* _5- */
             , t1.bs_type                                             /* _6- */
             , t1.sury_aek                                   AS jusu  /* _7- */
             , t1.chui_aek                                            /* _8- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq   /* _9- */
          FROM SJT0FS t1  /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'F49'
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '3', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.chui_aek, 54, 'PROC0540', w_msg );
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjt0cy.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sjt0cy.tr_cd=F18', '청약내역(sjt0cy) 유상청약 회계처리' );

    -- 청약내역의 유상청약 내역
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                                    /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                     /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                   /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                     /* _4- */
             , t1.type_trench                                               /* _5- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                   /* _6- */
             , t1.cheng_jusu                                                /* _7- */
             , t1.cheng_aek                                                 /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.hwakj_jusu,0)                          AS hwakj_jusu  /* _9- */
             , NVL(t1.hwakj_jusu,0) * NVL(t1.danga,0)        AS hwakj_aek   /* _10- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq         /* _11- */
          FROM SJT0CY t1  /* 주식청약내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'F18'
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_GETJJ4( xx.jm_cd, w_sosok_gb, w_danc_gb, w_msg );  /* 발행기관 소속구분 가져오기 */
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  xx.cheng_jusu > 0       then    -- 유상청약
            if  w_danc_gb = 'X'     then
                if  w_sosok_gb = 'C'    then    w_jasan_gb := '12';  -- 등록주식
                elsif w_sosok_gb = 'D'  then    w_jasan_gb := '13';  -- 코넥스
                else                            w_jasan_gb := '11';  /* 상장 */
                end if;
            else
                if  w_sosok_gb = 'B'    then    w_jasan_gb := '01';  -- 비상장
                elsif w_sosok_gb = 'C'  then    w_jasan_gb := '02';  -- 등록주식
                elsif w_sosok_gb = 'D'  then    w_jasan_gb := '03';  -- 코넥스
                else                            w_jasan_gb := '00';  /* 상장 */
                end if;
            end if;
        else    /* 실권 */
            if  w_sosok_gb = 'B'    then    w_jasan_gb := '52';  -- 비상장
            elsif w_sosok_gb = 'C'  then    w_jasan_gb := '53';  -- 등록주식
            elsif w_sosok_gb = 'D'  then    w_jasan_gb := '54';  -- 코넥스
            else                            w_jasan_gb := '51';  /* 상장 */
            end if;
        end if;

        /* 분개처리 */
        if  xx.cheng_jusu > 0   then    -- 유상청약
            SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.hwakj_aek, xx.cheng_aek, 54, 'PROC0540 ' || w_jasan_gb, w_msg );
            -- 신주인수권증서 취득가 반영
            if  w_danc_gb = 'X' AND xx.hwakj_jusu != 0  then
                UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
                   SET up_chui_aek = xx.cheng_aek
                 WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
                   AND jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
                   AND ymd         = xx.tr_ymd
                   AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
                   AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
            end if;
        else
            SR_SZSL010( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.hwakj_aek, 54, 'PROC0540 ' || w_jasan_gb, w_msg );

            if  xx.hwakj_jusu != 0  then    ---20220215 bjh 청약포기 반영
                UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
                   SET dw_chui_aek = (xx.hwakj_aek - xx.cheng_aek)
                 WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
                   AND jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
                   AND ymd         = xx.tr_ymd
                   AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
                   AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
            end if;

        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then    -- 분개처리error
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjt0cy.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sjt0cy.tr_cd=F46', '청약내역(sjt0cy) 공모신주 회계처리' );

    -- 청약내역의 공모신주 내역
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                           /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                            /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                          /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                            /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.cheng_aek,0) + NVL(t1.susu,0)  AS cheng_aek  /* _5- */
          FROM SJT0CY t1  /* 주식청약내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'F46'
           AND t1.cheng_type            = '1'
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                    xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.cheng_aek, 54, 'PROC0540', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then    -- 분개처리error
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjt0fs.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sjt0fs.tr_cd=F16,F53,F57', '(sjt0fs) 주식매수청구권행사대금,전환/교환사채 단주대금 수령 회계처리' );

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd     /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd      /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd    /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd      /* _4- */
             , t1.hwakj_aek  /* _5- */
             , t1.sury_aek   /* _6- */
          FROM SJT0FS t1  /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 IN ('F16','F53')
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT danc_gb
              INTO w_danc_gb
              FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE jm_cd = xx.jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.jm_cd || ' - 종목이 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;
        if  w_danc_gb = 'B'     then    w_jasan_gb := '01';  -- 비상장
        elsif w_danc_gb = 'C'   then    w_jasan_gb := '02';  -- 등록
        elsif w_danc_gb = 'D'   then    w_jasan_gb := '03';  -- 코넥스
        else                            w_jasan_gb := '00';  /* 상장 */
        end if;
        SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.sury_aek, xx.hwakj_aek, 54, 'PROC0540', w_msg );
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then    -- 분개처리error
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd
             , t1.tr_cd
             , t1.fund_cd
             , t1.sury_aek
          FROM SJT0FS t1  /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'F57'
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', '', 1, 1, xx.sury_aek, xx.sury_aek, 54, 'PROC0540', w_msg );
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then    -- 분개처리error
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjt0fs.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sjt0fs.tr_cd in (F11 F13 F14)', '(sjt0fs) 배당금,배당 단주대금,중간배당금 수령 회계처리' );

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd     /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd      /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd    /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd      /* _4- */
             , t1.koscom_cd  /* _5- */
             , t1.hwakj_aek  /* _6- */
             , t1.sury_aek   /* _7- */
          FROM SJT0FS t1  /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 IN ('F11','F13','F14')
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        if  xx.jm_cd = xx.koscom_cd then    -- 자문계좌 배당금 수령(해외)
            w_jasan_gb := '00';
        else
            SR_GETJJ4( xx.jm_cd, w_sosok_gb, w_danc_gb, w_msg );  /* 발행기관 소속구분 가져오기 추가 */
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
            if  w_sosok_gb = 'B'    then    w_jasan_gb := '01';  -- 비상장
            elsif w_sosok_gb = 'C'  then    w_jasan_gb := '02';  -- 등록주식
            else                            w_jasan_gb := '00';  /* 상장 */
            end if;
        end if;
        if  xx.tr_cd IN ('F11','F14')   then    -- 배당금/중간배당금 수령
                SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.sury_aek, xx.hwakj_aek, 54, 'PROC0540', w_msg );
        ELSE    SR_SZSL010( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.sury_aek, 54, 'PROC0540', w_msg               );  /* 배당단주대금 수령 */
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjt0fs.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sjt0fs.tr_cd in (F32,F33,F38,F39)', '(sjt0fs) 합병교부금,단주대금 수령 회계처리' );

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd     /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd      /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd    /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd      /* _4- */
             , t1.hwakj_aek  /* _5- */
             , t1.sury_aek   /* _6- */
          FROM SJT0FS t1  /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 IN ('F32','F33','F38','F39')
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'F32'    then    -- 합병교부금수령
                SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.sury_aek, xx.hwakj_aek, 54, 'sjhp200', w_msg );
        ELSE    SR_SZSL010( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.sury_aek, 54, 'sjhp200', w_msg               );
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjt0fs.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sjt0fs.tr_cd = F20', '(sjt0fs) 무상 단주대금 수령 회계처리' );

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd     /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd      /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd    /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd      /* _4- */
             , t1.hwakj_aek  /* _5- */
             , t1.sury_aek   /* _6- */
          FROM SJT0FS t1  /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'F20'
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.sury_aek, 54, 'PROC0540', w_msg );
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjt0fs.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sjt0fs.tr_cd=F35,F43', '(sjt0fs) 감자/공개매수대금 수령 회계처리' );

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd     /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd      /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd    /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd      /* _4- */
             , t1.hwakj_aek  /* _5- */
             , t1.sury_aek   /* _6- */
          FROM SJT0FS t1  /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 IN ('F35','F37','F43')
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.sury_aek, xx.hwakj_aek, 54, 'PROC0540', w_msg );
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';

    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0541 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
 ) AS
-- 주식 회계처리 초기화
--
BEGIN
    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0541', p_ymd || ' : 주식회계처리 초기화' );

    -- 주식마스타Table의 당일증감취득액 clear
    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'sjm0jm.ymd=' || p_ymd, '주식마스타(sjm0jm) 취득액 Clear' );

    UPDATE SJM0JM t1    /* 주식 보유현황 */
       SET t1.up_chui_aek = 0
         , t1.dw_chui_aek = 0
         , t1.gup_aek     = 0
         , t1.gdw_aek     = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    -- 수도결제  Table의 주식자료 삭제
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B040', 'skt0sd.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0sd.tr_cd like J2% K2% skt0sd.chasu<>99',
            '수도결제(skt0sd) delete - 이체에 의한 수도결제자료 제외(chasu<>99)');

    DELETE FROM SKT0SD t1   /* 주식,채권 수도결제 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
       AND (t1.tr_cd LIKE 'J2%' OR t1.tr_cd LIKE 'K2%' OR t1.tr_cd='F21')
       AND t1.sudo_ymd > p_ymd
       AND t1.chasu    != 99
       AND t1.bigo IS NULL;

    -- 공모청약 납입일 등록에 의한 공모납입 형태 재처리
    -- sr_sjhp180에서 자동 생성한 경우
    DELETE FROM SJT0FS t1   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
       AND t1.jm_cd    IN (SELECT jm_cd
                             FROM SJT0CY ta  /* 주식청약내역 */
                            WHERE ta.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                              AND ta.tr_cd      = 'F46'
                              AND ta.sury_ymd   = p_ymd
                              AND ta.cheng_type = '2')
       AND t1.tr_cd    = 'F47'
       AND t1.upd_user = 'sz45000';

    -- 2309 배정/청약분 처리

    DELETE FROM SJT0FS t1   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
       AND t1.upd_user = 'sjg1fc';

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.cy_danga             /* _1- */
             , t1.cy_type              /* _2- */
             , jc.cy_jm_cd   AS jm_cd  /* _3- */
             , jj.koscom_cd            /* _4- */
             , fc.rowid                /* _5- */
             , fc.fund_cd              /* _6- */
             , fc.sc_aek               /* _7- */
             , fc.cy_jusu              /* _8- */
             , fc.cy_aek               /* _9- */
             , fc.cy_susu              /* _10- */
          FROM SJG1JC_TR t1  /* 종목별 공모 기본정보 및 배정/청약내역(공통) */
             , SJG1JC    jc  /* 종목별 공모 기본정보 및 배정/청약내역(공통) */
             , SJG1FC    fc  /* 펀드별 배정/청약 내역 */
             , SJM0JJ    jj  /* 주식종목 */
             , SZM0IA    ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.bb_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.cy_type               = '1'
           AND JC.JC_JOIN               = T1.JC_JOIN
           AND fc.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND FC.JC_JOIN               = T1.JC_JOIN
           AND fc.bb_jusu               != 0
           AND fc.jg_tr_co_cd           = t1.jg_tr_co_cd
           AND jj.jm_cd                 = jc.cy_jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = fc.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = fc.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        UPDATE SJG1FC ff    /* 펀드별 배정/청약 내역 */
           SET f47_ymd = p_ymd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        BEGIN

                 )

                   , 'F47'                                 /* _3- */

                   , xx.jm_cd                              /* _5- */

                   , xx.cy_jusu                            /* _7- */
                   , xx.cy_danga                           /* _8- */
                   , xx.cy_jusu                            /* _9- */

                   , xx.cy_susu                            /* _11- */
                   , xx.cy_type                            /* _12- */
                   , '00:'                                 /* _13- */
                   , 0                                     /* _14- */
                   , 'sjg1fc'                              /* _15- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN

            UPDATE SJT0FS ff    /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
               SET hwakj_aek = hwakj_aek + xx.cy_jusu

                 , chui_aek  = chui_aek + NVL(xx.cy_aek, 0) + NVL(xx.cy_susu, 0)

             WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr

           AND ia.fund_cd               = fc.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SJT0FS ff   /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
                 ( corp_gr      /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd       /* _2- */
                 , tr_cd        /* _3- */
                 , fund_cd      /* _4- */
                 , jm_cd        /* _5- */
                 , koscom_cd    /* _6- */
                 , hwakj_aek    /* _7- */
                 , danga        /* _8- */
                 , sury_aek     /* _9- */
                 , chui_aek     /* _10- */
                 , susu         /* _11- */
                 , cy_type      /* _12- */
                 , type_trench  /* _13- */
                 , bs_type      /* _14- */
                 , upd_user     /* _15- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                             /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                                 /* _2- */
                   , 'F49'                                 /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                            /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                              /* _5- */
                   , xx.koscom_cd                          /* _6- */
                   , xx.cy_jusu                            /* _7- */
                   , xx.cy_danga                           /* _8- */
                   , xx.cy_jusu                            /* _9- */
                   , NVL(xx.cy_aek,0) + NVL(xx.cy_susu,0)  /* _10- */
                   , xx.cy_susu                            /* _11- */
                   , xx.cy_type                            /* _12- */
                   , '00:'                                 /* _13- */
                   , 0                                     /* _14- */
                   , 'sjg1fc'                              /* _15- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            -- 복수증권사인 경우
            UPDATE SJT0FS ff    /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
               SET hwakj_aek = hwakj_aek + xx.cy_jusu
                 , sury_aek  = sury_aek + xx.cy_jusu
                 , chui_aek  = chui_aek + NVL(xx.cy_aek, 0) + NVL(xx.cy_susu, 0)
                 , susu      = susu + NVL(xx.cy_susu,0)
             WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND tr_ymd      = p_ymd
               AND tr_cd       = 'F49'
