               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
               AND cy_type     = xx.cy_type
               AND type_trench = '00:'
               AND bs_type     = 0;
        END;
    end loop;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0550 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 주식매매 회계처리
--
    ga_jasan_gb                    szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;

    w_sjt1jg_cnt                   NUMBER;
    w_chui_aek                     NUMBER;
    w_gchui_aek                    NUMBER;
    w_jusu                         NUMBER;
    w_qty                          NUMBER;
    w_mijunab_aek                  NUMBER;

    w_brok_ymd                     DATE;

    jm_balh_co                     sjm0jm.balh_co%type;
    jm_woos_ilban_gb               sjm0jm.woos_ilban_gb%type;
    jm_chg_gb                      sjm0jm.chg_gb%type;
    jm_new_old_gb                  sjm0jm.new_old_gb%type;
    jm_danc_gb                     sjm0jm.danc_gb%type;
    jm_koscom_cd                   sjm0jm.koscom_cd%type;

    w_aek                          number_varray_50;
    w_proc_step                    NUMBER(2) := 55;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0550', p_ymd || ' : 주식매입내역 회계처리(신주인수권매수 포함)' );

    -- 분개장 Table의 주식분개자료 삭제
    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B000', 'skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0bu.proc_step=', '주식회계처리 분개장(skt0bu) delete' );

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND t1.proc_step = w_proc_step;

    -- 마스타 매매수량 clear 처리
--    UPDATE SJM0JM tt
--       SET up_jusu      = 0
--         , dw_jusu      = 0
--         , up_chui_aek  = 0
--         , dw_chui_aek  = 0
--     WHERE corp_gr           = p_corp_gr
--       AND ymd               = p_ymd
--       AND (fund_cd, jm_cd)  IN (select fund_cd
--                                      , jm_cd
--                                   from SJT0JG ta
--                                  where ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
--                                    and ta.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
--                                    and sjt1jg_dt IS NOT NULL);

    -- sjt1jg_dt 컬럼이용 삭제 20240825
    DELETE FROM SJT0JG tt   /* 주식거래 내역 */
     WHERE corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND sjt1jg_dt IS NOT NULL;

    -- 잔고 LOAD 자료로 생성된 매매내역 삭제처리(과거 재처리시 이후 분 삭제처리)
    DELETE FROM SJT1JG tt   /* 주식거래 내역(엑셀Load용) */
     WHERE corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND load_user = 'SJM0JM_SIGA';

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 주식매매내역 등록으로 제외처리                                     20240722 --
    -- 성과보수 ++로 이익이면서 잔고 LOAD 하지 않은 펀드 잔고 취득액 기준으로 정리 --
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if  p_ymd < TO_DATE ('20240911','yyyymmdd')    then
        for fd IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT tt.fund_cd
              FROM (SELECT fund_cd
                      FROM SJM0JM_SIGA t1  /* 주식 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT fund_cd
                      FROM SCM0CM_SIGA t1  /* 채권 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT fund_cd
                      FROM SHM0HM_SIGA t1  /* 현금 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
                    ) tt
        ) loop
            for xx IN (
                SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                  /* _1- */
                     , ia.TARGET_JASAN                                             /* _2- */
                     , ia.mg_cd                                                    /* _3- */
                     , ia.enc_acct_no                                              /* _4- */
                     , t1.jm_cd                                                    /* _5- */
                     , jj.koscom_cd                                                /* _6- */
                     , jj.danc_gb                                                  /* _7- */
                     , NVL(o1.jusu,0) - t1.bfil_boyu_jusu          AS tr_jusu      /* _8- */
                     , NVL(o1.chui_aek,0) - t1.bfil_chui_aek       AS tr_aek       /* _9- */
                     , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0)=0
                            THEN 0
                            ELSE (NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.sonik,0)) / NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0)
                       END                                         AS jun_jongga   /* _10- */
                     , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.jm_cd
                                               ORDER BY t1.jm_cd)  AS offer_no     /* _11- */
                  FROM SJM0JM t1                  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN SJM0JM_SIGA o1  /* 주식 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                               ON o1.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
                              AND o1.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                              AND o1.ymd     = t1.ymd
                              AND o1.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
                     , SZM0IA ia                  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                     , SJM0JJ jj                  /* 주식종목 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd = fd.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
                   AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                   AND jj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
                   AND jj.danc_gb IN ('A','C','D','G')
            ) loop
                if  xx.tr_jusu < 0  then
                    xx.tr_jusu := ABS (xx.tr_jusu);

                    -- 동일종목 LOAD 자료 있으면 PASS
                    SELECT NVL(COUNT (*), 0)
                      INTO w_sjt1jg_cnt
                      FROM SJT1JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역(엑셀Load용) */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
                       AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                       AND t1.tr_cd   = 'K';
                    if  w_sjt1jg_cnt > 0    then
                        CONTINUE;
                    end if;

                    -- 잔고조정은 당일결제처리
                    INSERT INTO SJT1JG tt   /* 주식거래 내역(엑셀Load용) */
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr                          /* _1- */
                           , p_ymd                              /* _2- */
                           , 'K'                                /* _3- */
                           , xx.fund_cd                         /* _4- */
                           , xx.mg_cd                           /* _5- */
                           , xx.jm_cd                           /* _6- */
                           , xx.offer_no                        /* _7- */
                           , xx.tr_jusu                         /* _8- */
                           , TRUNC(xx.jun_jongga * xx.tr_jusu)  /* _9- */
                           , xx.enc_acct_no                     /* _10- */
                           , xx.koscom_cd                       /* _11- */
                           , xx.danc_gb                         /* _12- */
                           , 0                                  /* _13- */
                           , 0                                  /* _14- */
                           , p_ymd                              /* _15- */
                           , sysdate                            /* _16- */
                           , 'SJM0JM_SIGA'                      /* _17- */
                           , NULL                               /* _18- */
                           );
                elsif xx.tr_jusu > 0    then
                    -- 동일종목 LOAD 자료 있으면 PASS
                    SELECT NVL(COUNT (*), 0)
                      INTO w_sjt1jg_cnt
                      FROM SJT1JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역(엑셀Load용) */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
                       AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                       AND t1.tr_cd   = 'J';
                    if  w_sjt1jg_cnt > 0    then
                        CONTINUE;
                    end if;

                    -- 매수거래 생성
                    -- 잔고조정은 당일결제처리
                    INSERT INTO SJT1JG tt   /* 주식거래 내역(엑셀Load용) */
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
                           , p_ymd           /* _2- */
                           , 'J'             /* _3- */
                           , xx.fund_cd      /* _4- */
                           , xx.mg_cd        /* _5- */
                           , xx.jm_cd        /* _6- */
                           , xx.offer_no     /* _7- */
                           , xx.tr_jusu      /* _8- */
                           , xx.tr_aek       /* _9- */
                           , xx.enc_acct_no  /* _10- */
                           , xx.koscom_cd    /* _11- */
                           , xx.danc_gb      /* _12- */
                           , 0               /* _13- */
                           , 0               /* _14- */
                           , p_ymd           /* _15- */
                           , sysdate         /* _16- */
                           , 'SJM0JM_SIGA'   /* _17- */
                           , NULL            /* _18- */
                           );
                end if;
            end loop;
            -- 매수거래생성
            -- 잔고조정은 당일결제처리
            for xx IN (
                SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                      /* _1- */
                     , ia.mg_cd                                                        /* _2- */
                     , ia.enc_acct_no                                                  /* _3- */
                     , t1.jm_cd                                                        /* _4- */
                     , jj.koscom_cd                                                    /* _5- */
                     , jj.danc_gb                                                      /* _6- */
                     , t1.jusu                                            AS tr_jusu   /* _7- */
                     , t1.chui_aek                                        AS tr_aek    /* _8- */
                     , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.jm_cd
                                               ORDER BY t1.jm_cd) + 1000  AS offer_no  /* _9- */
                  FROM SJM0JM_SIGA t1  /* 주식 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                     , SZM0IA      ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                     , SJM0JJ      jj  /* 주식종목 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd = fd.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd   NOT IN (SELECT jm_cd
                                            FROM SJM0JM ta  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                                           WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                             AND ta.fund_cd = fd.fund_cd
                                             AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd)
                   AND t1.jusu    > 0
                   AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                   AND jj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
            ) loop
                SELECT NVL(COUNT (*), 0)
                  INTO w_sjt1jg_cnt
                  FROM SJT1JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역(엑셀Load용) */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.tr_cd   = 'J';
                if  w_sjt1jg_cnt > 0    then
                    CONTINUE;
                end if;

                -- 매수거래 생성
                INSERT INTO SJT1JG tt   /* 주식거래 내역(엑셀Load용) */
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd           /* _2- */
                       , 'J'             /* _3- */
                       , xx.fund_cd      /* _4- */
                       , xx.mg_cd        /* _5- */
                       , xx.jm_cd        /* _6- */
                       , xx.offer_no     /* _7- */
                       , xx.tr_jusu      /* _8- */
                       , xx.tr_aek       /* _9- */
                       , xx.enc_acct_no  /* _10- */
                       , xx.koscom_cd    /* _11- */
                       , xx.danc_gb      /* _12- */
                       , 0               /* _13- */
                       , 0               /* _14- */
                       , p_ymd           /* _15- */
                       , sysdate         /* _16- */
                       , 'SJM0JM_SIGA'   /* _17- */
                       , NULL            /* _18- */
                       );
            end loop;
        end loop;
    end if;

    -- 자문 주식매매내역 처리
    SR_PROC0550_SJT1JG( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_msg );
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 운용종료펀드 삭제처리
    DELETE FROM SJT0JG tt   /* 주식거래 내역 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd
       AND fund_cd IN (SELECT fund_cd
                         FROM SZM0IA ta  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                        WHERE ta.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
                          AND ta.haeji_ymd < p_ymd);

    -- 주식 매수처리
    SR_PROC0551( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_proc_step, w_msg );
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjm0jm.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * dw_jusu>0', '주식(sjm0jm) 수량감소와 관련된 회계처리 - 20190902' );

    -- 주식매도 감소취득액 마스타정리(차입상환도 포함)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                           /* _1- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                             /* _2- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                           /* _3- */
             , t1.type_trench                                                       /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.up_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.gongs_up_jusu,0)
                                        - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_jusu,0)     AS jusu       /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0)
                                       - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)  AS chui_aek   /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.gbfil_aek,0) + NVL(t1.gup_aek,0)                AS gchui_aek  /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.dw_jusu,0)                                      AS dw_jusu    /* _8- */
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.dw_jusu,0)        != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        if NVL (xx.jusu,0) = 0              then
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-해당 주식수량이 0입니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        w_chui_aek  := xx.chui_aek  - TRUNC  (xx.chui_aek / xx.jusu * (xx.jusu - xx.dw_jusu));
        w_gchui_aek := xx.gchui_aek - TRUNC  (xx.gchui_aek / xx.jusu * (xx.jusu - xx.dw_jusu));

        -- 주식마스타 당일감소취득액 update
        UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
           SET dw_chui_aek = w_chui_aek
             , gdw_aek     = w_gchui_aek
         WHERE CORP_GR     = p_corp_gr
           AND YMD         = p_ymd
           AND FUND_CD     = xx.fund_cd
           AND JM_CD       = xx.jm_cd
           AND TYPE_TRENCH = xx.type_trench
           AND BS_TYPE     = xx.bs_type;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-해당 주식마스타내역이 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 전부해지 매도 점검
        SELECT xx.dw_jusu - NVL(SUM(tr_jusu), 0)
             , w_chui_aek - NVL(SUM(meib_chui_aek), 0)
             , w_gchui_aek - NVL(SUM(gmeib_chui_aek), 0)
          INTO xx.dw_jusu
             , xx.chui_aek
             , xx.gchui_aek
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
           AND t1.tr_cd       = 'L22'
           AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type
           AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench;

        if  xx.dw_jusu != 0 then    -- 주식매도처리
            SR_PROC0552( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_proc_step, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.bs_type, xx.type_trench, xx.dw_jusu, xx.chui_aek, xx.gchui_aek, w_msg );
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 주식펀드간이동 삭제 20190312 yjs sr_sjhp032
        if  xx.dw_jusu != 0 then    -- 주식매수청구권행사 처리
            SR_PROC0553( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_proc_step, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.bs_type, xx.type_trench, xx.dw_jusu, xx.chui_aek, w_msg );
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;

        if  xx.dw_jusu != 0 then    -- 공개매수확정 처리
            SR_PROC0554( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_proc_step, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.bs_type, xx.type_trench, xx.dw_jusu, xx.chui_aek, w_msg );
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
--        SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjm0jm.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * dw_jusu>0', '주식(sjm0jm) 수량감소와 관련된 회계처리 - 공개매수확정 처리');
    end loop;

    -- 주식매도 일괄분개처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                                     /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                      /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                    /* _3- */
             , CASE WHEN t1.tr_cd IN ('K2A','K2E')
                    THEN NVL(t1.etf_jm_cd, t1.jm_cd)
                    ELSE CASE WHEN t1.bs_type=0 THEN NULL
                                                ELSE t1.jm_cd END
               END                                           AS jm_cd        /* _4- */
             , t1.sudo_ymd                                                   /* _5- */
             , CASE WHEN jb.sosok_gb='2'             THEN '2'
                    WHEN jb.sosok_gb IN ('3','4')    THEN '3'
                    WHEN jj.danc_gb IN ('T','U','X') THEN CASE WHEN jb.sosok_gb='1' THEN 'A'
                                                                                    ELSE jb.sosok_gb END
                                                     ELSE jj.danc_gb
               END                                           AS danc_gb      /* _6- */
             , t1.option_gb                                                  /* _7- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.gyul_aek), 0)                      AS gyul_aek     /* _8- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.meib_chui_aek), 0)                 AS chui_aek     /* _9- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(t1.gmeib_chui_aek,0)=0
                            THEN 0
                            ELSE NVL(t1.ggyul_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gmeib_chui_aek,0)
                       END), 0)                              AS gsonik       /* _10- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.tax), 0)                           AS tax          /* _11- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq          /* _12- */
             , CASE WHEN p_ymd BETWEEN jb.venture_start AND jb.venture_end THEN 'Y'
                                                                           ELSE 'N'
               END                                           AS venture_yn   /* _13- */
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
             , SJM0JJ jj  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 LIKE 'K2%'
           AND jj.jm_cd                 = t1.jm_cd
           AND jb.balh_co               = jj.balh_co
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.tr_ymd   , t1.tr_cd, t1.fund_cd
                , CASE WHEN t1.tr_cd IN ('K2A','K2E')
                       THEN NVL(t1.etf_jm_cd, t1.jm_cd)
                       ELSE CASE WHEN t1.bs_type=0 THEN NULL
                                                   ELSE t1.jm_cd END END
                , t1.sudo_ymd
                , CASE WHEN jb.sosok_gb='2'             THEN '2'
                       WHEN jb.sosok_gb IN ('3','4')    THEN '3'
                       WHEN jj.danc_gb IN ('T','U','X') THEN CASE WHEN jb.sosok_gb='1' THEN 'A'
                                                                                       ELSE jb.sosok_gb END
                                                        ELSE jj.danc_gb END
                , t1.option_gb
                , CASE WHEN p_ymd BETWEEN jb.venture_start AND jb.venture_end
                       THEN 'Y'
                       ELSE 'N' END
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_ymd = xx.sudo_ymd then
            ga_jasan_gb := xx.danc_gb || '1';
        else    /* 개별주식옵션매도 */
            if  xx.tr_cd = 'K27'    then
                    ga_jasan_gb := xx.danc_gb || xx.option_gb;
            else    ga_jasan_gb := xx.danc_gb || '0';
            end if;
        end if;
        -- 비상장 벤쳐비과표 처리 20200420 yjs
        if SUBSTR (ga_jasan_gb,1,1) = 'B' AND xx.venture_yn = 'Y'  then ga_jasan_gb := 'Y' || SUBSTR (ga_jasan_gb,2);
        end if;

        if  xx.tr_cd = 'K23'    then    -- 장외거래 거래세 별도분개처리
            w_aek := number_varray_50 (xx.gyul_aek, xx.chui_aek, 0, 0, xx.tax);
            if (xx.gyul_aek + xx.tax) > xx.chui_aek     then
                w_aek (3) := 0;
                w_aek (4) := (xx.gyul_aek + xx.tax) - xx.chui_aek;
            else
                w_aek (3) := xx.chui_aek - (xx.gyul_aek + xx.tax);
                w_aek (4) := 0;
            end if;
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', ga_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd,
                        'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, w_aek, w_proc_step, 'PROC0550 1 (' || xx.tr_cd || ')' || ga_jasan_gb, w_msg);
        else
            if  xx.danc_gb = 'A'    then
                xx.gsonik := 0;
            end if;
            SR_SZSL020_GWA (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', ga_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1,
                            xx.gyul_aek, xx.chui_aek, xx.gsonik, w_proc_step, 'PROC0550 2 (' || xx.tr_cd || ')', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(' || xx.jm_cd || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 주식출고(차입상환) 처리
    SR_PROC0550_F22( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_proc_step, w_msg );
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := 'SJHP030_F22 차입상환->' || w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 주식 ETF 처리
    SR_PROC055ETF( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_proc_step, w_msg );
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := 'ETF 처리->' || w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0550', p_ymd || ' : 주식 관련대장에 수령내역 update' );

    ------------------------------
    -- 당일자 수령 반영분 clear --
    ------------------------------
    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjt0gg.sury_ymd=' || p_ymd, '전환청구(sjt0gg) 당일자 수령 반영분 Clear' );

    UPDATE SJT0GG t1    /* 전환 청구 (교환,신주인수권포함) */
       SET sury_ymd = NULL
         , sury_aek = 0
         , ija      = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.sury_ymd = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'sjt0cy.sury_ymd=' || p_ymd, '청약내용(sjt0cy) 당일자 수령 반영분 Clear' );

    UPDATE SJT0CY t1    /* 주식청약내역 */
       SET sury_ymd  = NULL
         , sury_jusu = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.sury_ymd = p_ymd
       AND tr_cd       NOT IN ('F46','F65');

    UPDATE SJT0CY t1    /* 주식청약내역 */
       SET sury_ymd  = NULL
         , sury_jusu = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.sury_ymd = p_ymd
       AND tr_cd       = 'F46'
       AND cheng_type  = '1';

    -- 신주인수권 주식 권리행사는 당일처리
    UPDATE SJT0CY t1    /* 주식청약내역 */
       SET sury_ymd  = NULL
         , sury_jusu = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.sury_ymd     = p_ymd
       AND tr_cd           = 'F65'
       AND NVL(kra_jusu,0) = 0;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B030', 'sjt0j1.sury_ymd=' || p_ymd, '펀드별 증자권리 상세내역(sjt0j1) 당일자 수령 반영분 Clear' );

    UPDATE SJT0J1 t1    /* 증자대장 */
       SET sury_ymd  = NULL
         , sury_jusu = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.sury_ymd = p_ymd;

    UPDATE SJT0J1 t1    /* 증자대장 */
       SET cheng_ymd  = NULL
         , cheng_jusu = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.cheng_ymd = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B040', 'sjt0bm.jusu_sury_ymd=' || p_ymd, '펀드별 배당권리 상세내역(sjt0bm) 당일자 수령 반영분 Clear' );

    UPDATE SJT0BM t1    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
       SET sury_ymd    = NULL
         , sury_ju_aek = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.sury_ymd = p_ymd
       AND t1.sury_set IS NULL;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B050', 'sjt0h1.jusu_sury_ymd=' || p_ymd, '펀드별 합병,감자 상세내역(sjt0h1) 당일자 수령 반영분 Clear' );

    UPDATE SJT0H1 t1    /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
       SET jusu_sury_ymd = NULL
         , sury_jusu     = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_cd         IN ('G40','G43','G45','G60','G93')
       AND t1.jusu_sury_ymd = p_ymd;

    UPDATE SJT0H1 t1    /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
       SET aek_sury_ymd = NULL
         , sury_aek     = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_cd        IN ('G40','G43','G45','G47')
       AND t1.aek_sury_ymd = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B060', 'sjm0jm.ymd=' || p_ymd, '주식마스타(sjm0jm) misu_baed_aek,mijunab_aek Clear' );

    UPDATE SJM0JM t1    /* 주식 보유현황 */
       SET misu_baed_aek = 0
         , mijunab_aek   = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B070', 'sjt0fs.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd, '펀드/종목별 수탁사 수령내역(sjt0fs) 반영처리' );

    -- 펀드별종목별수탁사수령내역의 수령내역
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                  /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                   /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                 /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                   /* _4- */
             , t1.sury_aek                                /* _5- */
             , t1.danga                                   /* _6- */
             , t1.chui_aek + NVL(t1.susu,0)  AS chui_aek  /* _7- */
             , t1.type_trench                             /* _8- */
             , t1.bs_type                                 /* _9- */
             , t1.brok_ymd                                /* _10- */
          FROM SJT0FS t1  /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'F53'    then    -- 전환사채단주대금수령
            UPDATE SJT0GG tt    /* 전환 청구 (교환,신주인수권포함) */
               SET sury_ymd = p_ymd
                 , sury_aek = xx.sury_aek
                 , ija      = xx.chui_aek
             WHERE corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
               AND tr_cd     = 'F51'
               AND fund_cd   = xx.fund_cd
               AND new_jm_cd = xx.jm_cd
               AND sury_ymd IS NULL;

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'F57'  then    -- 교환사채단주대금수령
            UPDATE SJT0GG tt    /* 전환 청구 (교환,신주인수권포함) */
               SET sury_ymd = p_ymd
                 , sury_aek = xx.sury_aek
                 , ija      = xx.chui_aek
             WHERE corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
               AND tr_cd     = 'F55'
               AND fund_cd   = xx.fund_cd
               AND new_jm_cd = xx.jm_cd
               AND sury_ymd IS NULL;

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'F16'  then    -- 주식매수청구대금수령
            UPDATE SJT0CY tt    /* 주식청약내역 */
               SET sury_ymd  = p_ymd
                 , sury_jusu = xx.sury_aek
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND tr_cd    = 'F65'
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND sury_ymd IS NULL;

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'F43'  then    -- 공개매수 대금수령
            UPDATE SJT0CY tt    /* 주식청약내역 */
               SET sury_ymd  = p_ymd
                 , sury_jusu = xx.sury_aek
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND tr_cd    = 'F41'
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND sury_ymd IS NULL;

        elsif xx.tr_cd IN ('F17','F19') then    -- 유무상주식 수령
            BEGIN
                SELECT created_ymd
                  INTO w_brok_ymd
                  FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
                 WHERE t1.jm_cd = xx.jm_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := xx.jm_cd || '- 유무상 수령 주식종목(신주생성일)을 등록하십시요.';
                RETURN;
            END;

            -- 총배정주수
            SELECT SUM(baej_jusu)
              INTO w_qty
              FROM SJT0J1 t1  /* 증자대장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd         = w_brok_ymd
               AND t1.new_jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type;

            -- 증자대장의 증자주식내역
            for x1 IN (
                SELECT YMD         /* _1- */
                     , BALH_CO     /* _2- */
                     , JEUNGJ_MTH  /* _3- */
                     , OLD_JM_CD   /* _4- */
                     , NEW_JM_CD   /* _5- */
                     , BAEJ_JUSU   /* _6- */
                  FROM SJT0J1 t1  /* 증자대장 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd         = w_brok_ymd
                   AND t1.sury_ymd IS NULL
                   AND t1.new_jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
                   AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type
            ) loop
                if  xx.sury_aek = 0 then
                    w_jusu := 0;

                    UPDATE SJT0J1 tt    /* 증자대장 */
                       SET sury_ymd  = p_ymd
                         , sury_jusu = 0
                         , cheng_ymd = p_ymd  /* 유상청약 포기시 청약일 */
                     WHERE CORP_GR     = p_corp_gr
                       AND YMD         = x1.ymd
                       AND BALH_CO     = x1.balh_co
                       AND JEUNGJ_MTH  = x1.jeungj_mth
                       AND FUND_CD     = xx.fund_cd
                       AND OLD_JM_CD   = x1.old_jm_cd
                       AND NEW_JM_CD   = x1.new_jm_cd
                       AND TYPE_TRENCH = xx.type_trench
                       AND BS_TYPE     = xx.bs_type;
                else
                    w_jusu := TRUNC  (xx.sury_aek * (x1.baej_jusu / w_qty));

                    UPDATE SJT0J1 tt    /* 증자대장 */
                       SET sury_ymd  = p_ymd
                         , sury_jusu = w_jusu
                     WHERE CORP_GR     = p_corp_gr
                       AND YMD         = x1.ymd
                       AND BALH_CO     = x1.balh_co
                       AND JEUNGJ_MTH  = x1.jeungj_mth
                       AND FUND_CD     = xx.fund_cd
                       AND OLD_JM_CD   = x1.old_jm_cd
                       AND NEW_JM_CD   = x1.new_jm_cd
                       AND TYPE_TRENCH = xx.type_trench
                       AND BS_TYPE     = xx.bs_type;
                end if;
                xx.sury_aek := xx.sury_aek - w_jusu;
                w_qty       := w_qty       - x1.baej_jusu;
            end loop;

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'F12'  then    -- 배당주식 수령
            SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.juchong_ymd IS NOT NULL THEN t1.juchong_jusu
                                WHEN t1.hwakj_ymd IS NOT NULL   THEN t1.hwakj_jusu
                                                                ELSE t1.yesa_jusu END), 0)
              INTO w_qty
              FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr         = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd         = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd             = xx.brok_ymd
               AND NVL(t1.del_yn,'2') = '2'
               AND t1.new_jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.type_trench     = xx.type_trench
               AND t1.bs_type         = xx.bs_type;

            -- 배당대장의 배당주식내역
            for x2 IN (
                SELECT old_jm_cd
                     , CASE WHEN t1.juchong_ymd IS NOT NULL THEN t1.juchong_jusu
                            WHEN t1.hwakj_ymd IS NOT NULL   THEN t1.hwakj_jusu
                                                            ELSE t1.yesa_jusu
                       END  AS baej_jusu
                  FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr         = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd         = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd             = xx.brok_ymd
                   AND NVL(t1.del_yn,'2') = '2'
                   AND t1.new_jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.type_trench     = xx.type_trench
                   AND t1.bs_type         = xx.bs_type
            ) loop
                if  w_qty = 0   then
                        w_jusu := x2.baej_jusu;
                else    w_jusu := TRUNC(xx.sury_aek * (x2.baej_jusu / w_qty));
                end if;
                xx.sury_aek := xx.sury_aek - w_jusu;
                w_qty       := w_qty       - x2.baej_jusu;

                UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                   SET sury_ymd    = p_ymd
                     , sury_ju_aek = w_jusu
                 WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
                   AND old_jm_cd   = x2.old_jm_cd
                   AND ymd         = xx.brok_ymd
                   AND new_jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
                   AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type
                   AND sury_ymd IS NULL;
            end loop;

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'F47'  then    -- 공모주 추가납입/환불
            if  xx.brok_ymd IS NULL then
                SELECT MAX(t1.tr_ymd)
                  INTO w_brok_ymd
                  FROM SJT0CY t1  /* 주식청약내역 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.tr_ymd      BETWEEN (p_ymd - 30) AND p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.tr_cd       = 'F46'
                   AND t1.cheng_type  = '1'
                   AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
                   AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
            else
                w_brok_ymd := xx.brok_ymd;
            end if;

            UPDATE SJT0CY tt    /* 주식청약내역 */
               SET sury_ymd  = p_ymd
                 , sury_jusu = xx.sury_aek
             WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND tr_ymd      = w_brok_ymd
               AND tr_cd       = 'F46'
               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
               AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type
               AND sury_ymd IS NULL
               AND cheng_type  = '1';

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'F49'  then    -- 미지급공모청약금 납입
            if  xx.brok_ymd IS NULL then
                SELECT MAX(t1.tr_ymd)
                  INTO w_brok_ymd
                  FROM SJT0CY t1  /* 주식청약내역 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.tr_ymd      BETWEEN (p_ymd - 30) AND p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.tr_cd       = 'F46'
                   AND t1.cheng_type  = '3'
                   AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
                   AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
            else
                w_brok_ymd := xx.brok_ymd;
            end if;

            UPDATE SJT0CY tt    /* 주식청약내역 */
               SET sury_ymd  = p_ymd
                 , sury_jusu = xx.sury_aek
             WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND tr_ymd      = w_brok_ymd
               AND tr_cd       = 'F46'
               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
               AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type
               AND sury_ymd IS NULL
               AND cheng_type  = '3';

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'F11'  then    -- 배당금 수령
            if  xx.brok_ymd IS NULL then
                SELECT MAX(brok_ymd)
                  INTO w_brok_ymd
                  FROM (SELECT brok_ymd
                             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY balh_co, tr_cd, brok_ymd
                                                       ORDER BY CASE WHEN corp_gr = p_corp_gr THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)  AS rnum
                          FROM SJT0BK p1  /* 발행기관별 배당권리 내역 */
                         WHERE balh_co = (SELECT balh_co
                                            FROM SJM0JJ g1  /* 주식종목 */
                                           WHERE jm_cd = xx.jm_cd)
                           AND tr_cd   = 'G10'
                           AND corp_gr IN (p_corp_gr, '%')
                        )
                 WHERE rnum = 1;
            else
                w_brok_ymd := xx.brok_ymd;
            end if;

            -- 배당대장의 배당주식내역
            SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.juchong_ymd IS NOT NULL THEN t1.juchong_aek
                                WHEN t1.hwakj_ymd IS NOT NULL   THEN t1.hwakj_aek
                                                                ELSE t1.yesa_aek END), 0)
              INTO w_qty
              FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd      = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd          = w_brok_ymd
               AND t1.sury_ymd IS NULL
               AND t1.new_jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.type_trench  = xx.type_trench
               AND t1.bs_type      = xx.bs_type
               AND NVL(del_yn,'2') = '2';

            for x2 IN (
                SELECT YMD                       /* _1- */
                     , BALH_CO                   /* _2- */
                     , OLD_JM_CD                 /* _3- */
                     , NEW_JM_CD                 /* _4- */
                     , CASE WHEN T1.JUCHONG_YMD IS NOT NULL THEN T1.JUCHONG_AEK
                            WHEN T1.HWAKJ_YMD IS NOT NULL   THEN T1.HWAKJ_AEK
                                                            ELSE T1.YESA_AEK
                       END        AS baej_jusu   /* _5- */
                  FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr         = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd         = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd             = w_brok_ymd
                   AND NVL(t1.del_yn,'2') = '2'
                   AND t1.sury_ymd IS NULL
                   AND t1.new_jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.type_trench     = xx.type_trench
                   AND t1.bs_type         = xx.bs_type
            ) loop
                BEGIN
                    w_jusu      := TRUNC  (xx.sury_aek * (x2.baej_jusu / w_qty));
                    xx.sury_aek := xx.sury_aek - w_jusu;
                    w_qty       := w_qty       - x2.baej_jusu;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    w_jusu := 0;
                END;
                UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                   SET sury_ymd    = p_ymd
                     , sury_ju_aek = w_jusu
                 WHERE CORP_GR     = p_corp_gr
                   AND YMD         = x2.ymd
                   AND BALH_CO     = x2.balh_co
                   AND FUND_CD     = xx.fund_cd
                   AND OLD_JM_CD   = x2.old_jm_cd
                   AND NEW_JM_CD   = x2.new_jm_cd
                   AND TYPE_TRENCH = xx.type_trench
                   AND BS_TYPE     = xx.bs_type;
            end loop;

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'F14'  then    -- 중간배당금 수령
            if  xx.brok_ymd IS NULL then
                SELECT MAX(brok_ymd)
                  INTO w_brok_ymd
                  FROM (SELECT brok_ymd
                             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY balh_co, tr_cd, brok_ymd
                                                       ORDER BY CASE WHEN corp_gr = p_corp_gr THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)  AS rnum
                          FROM SJT0BK p1  /* 발행기관별 배당권리 내역 */
                         WHERE balh_co = (SELECT balh_co
                                            FROM SJM0JJ g1  /* 주식종목 */
                                           WHERE jm_cd = xx.jm_cd)
                           AND tr_cd   = 'G15'
                           AND corp_gr IN (p_corp_gr, '%')
                        )
                 WHERE rnum = 1;
            else
                w_brok_ymd := xx.brok_ymd;
            end if;

            -- 배당대장의 배당주식내역
            SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(yesa_aek, hwakj_aek)), 0)
              INTO w_qty
              FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd      = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd          = w_brok_ymd
               AND t1.sury_ymd IS NULL
               AND t1.new_jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.type_trench  = xx.type_trench
               AND t1.bs_type      = xx.bs_type
               AND NVL(del_yn,'2') = '2';

            for x2 IN (
                SELECT YMD                                    /* _1- */
                     , BALH_CO                                /* _2- */
                     , OLD_JM_CD                              /* _3- */
                     , NEW_JM_CD                              /* _4- */
                     , NVL(YESA_AEK, HWAKJ_AEK)  AS yesa_aek  /* _5- */
                  FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd      = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd          = w_brok_ymd
                   AND t1.sury_ymd IS NULL
                   AND t1.new_jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.type_trench  = xx.type_trench
                   AND t1.bs_type      = xx.bs_type
                   AND NVL(del_yn,'2') = '2'
            ) loop
                BEGIN
                    w_jusu      := TRUNC  (xx.sury_aek * (x2.yesa_aek / w_qty));
                    xx.sury_aek := xx.sury_aek - w_jusu;
                    w_qty       := w_qty       - x2.yesa_aek;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    w_jusu := 0;
                END;
                UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                   SET sury_ymd    = p_ymd
                     , sury_ju_aek = w_jusu
                 WHERE CORP_GR     = p_corp_gr
                   AND YMD         = x2.ymd
                   AND BALH_CO     = x2.balh_co
                   AND FUND_CD     = xx.fund_cd
                   AND OLD_JM_CD   = x2.old_jm_cd
                   AND NEW_JM_CD   = x2.new_jm_cd
                   AND TYPE_TRENCH = xx.type_trench
                   AND BS_TYPE     = xx.bs_type;
            end loop;

        elsif xx.tr_cd IN ('F31','F34','F36','F3A')     then    -- 합병/감자/회사분할
            SELECT SUM(hab_jusu)
              INTO w_qty
              FROM SJT0H1 t1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd       = (CASE xx.tr_cd WHEN 'F31' THEN 'G40'
                                                   WHEN 'F3A' THEN 'G43'
                                                   WHEN 'F34' THEN 'G45'
                                                   WHEN 'F36' THEN 'G60'
                                                              ELSE 'G93' END)
               AND t1.new_jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type;

            -- 합병대장의 합병주식내역
            for x1 IN (
                SELECT old_jm_cd
                     , hab_jusu  AS baej_jusu
                  FROM SJT0H1 t1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.tr_ymd      = xx.brok_ymd
                   AND t1.tr_cd       = (CASE xx.tr_cd WHEN 'F31' THEN 'G40'
                                                       WHEN 'F3A' THEN 'G43'
                                                       WHEN 'F34' THEN 'G45'
                                                       WHEN 'F36' THEN 'G60'
                                                                  ELSE 'G93' END)
                   AND t1.new_jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
                   AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type
            ) loop
                if  w_qty = 0   then
                        w_jusu := x1.baej_jusu;
                else    w_jusu := TRUNC(xx.sury_aek * (x1.baej_jusu / w_qty));
                end if;

                xx.sury_aek := xx.sury_aek - w_jusu;
                w_qty       := w_qty       - x1.baej_jusu;

                UPDATE SJT0H1 tt    /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
                   SET jusu_sury_ymd = p_ymd
                     , sury_jusu     = w_jusu
                 WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
                   AND tr_ymd        = xx.brok_ymd
                   AND tr_cd         = (CASE xx.tr_cd WHEN 'F31' THEN 'G40'
                                                      WHEN 'F3A' THEN 'G43'
                                                      WHEN 'F34' THEN 'G45'
                                                      WHEN 'F36' THEN 'G60'
                                                                 ELSE 'G93' END)
                   AND fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
                   AND old_jm_cd     = x1.old_jm_cd
                   AND new_jm_cd     = xx.jm_cd
                   AND type_trench   = xx.type_trench
                   AND bs_type       = xx.bs_type
                   AND jusu_sury_ymd IS NULL;
            end loop;

        elsif xx.tr_cd IN ('F32','F35','F37')   then    -- 합병교부금/감자대금/유상소각
            SELECT SUM(hab_gyoub_aek)
              INTO w_qty
              FROM SJT0H1 t1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd       = (CASE xx.tr_cd WHEN 'F32' THEN 'G40'
                                                   WHEN 'F35' THEN 'G45'
                                                   WHEN 'F37' THEN 'G47' END)
               AND t1.new_jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type;

            -- 합병대장의 합병교부금내역
            for x2 IN (
                SELECT old_jm_cd
                     , hab_gyoub_aek  AS baej_jusu
                  FROM SJT0H1 t1  /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.tr_ymd      = xx.brok_ymd
                   AND t1.tr_cd       = (CASE xx.tr_cd WHEN 'F32' THEN 'G40'
                                                       WHEN 'F35' THEN 'G45'
                                                       WHEN 'F37' THEN 'G47' END)
                   AND t1.new_jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
                   AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type
            ) loop
                w_jusu      := TRUNC  (xx.sury_aek * (x2.baej_jusu / w_qty));
                xx.sury_aek := xx.sury_aek - w_jusu;
                w_qty       := w_qty       - x2.baej_jusu;

                UPDATE SJT0H1 tt    /* 합병/감자/유상소각/이전(교환) 대장 */
                   SET aek_sury_ymd = p_ymd
                     , sury_aek     = w_jusu
                 WHERE corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
                   AND tr_ymd       = xx.brok_ymd
                   AND tr_cd        = (CASE xx.tr_cd WHEN 'F32' THEN 'G40'
                                                     WHEN 'F35' THEN 'G45'
                                                     WHEN 'F37' THEN 'G47' END)
                   AND fund_cd      = xx.fund_cd
                   AND old_jm_cd    = x2.old_jm_cd
                   AND new_jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
                   AND type_trench  = xx.type_trench
                   AND bs_type      = xx.bs_type
                   AND aek_sury_ymd IS NULL;
            end loop;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B080', 'sjt0cy.ymd=' || p_ymd, '청약내역의(sjt0cy) 유상청약주 수령처리' );

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.FUND_CD      /* _1- */
             , t1.JM_CD        /* _2- */
             , t1.TYPE_TRENCH  /* _3- */
             , t1.BS_TYPE      /* _4- */
             , t1.CHENG_JUSU   /* _5- */
          FROM SJT0CY t1  /* 주식청약내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'F18'
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT created_ymd
              INTO w_brok_ymd
              FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE t1.jm_cd = xx.jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.jm_cd || '- 유상청약 주식종목(신주생성일)을 등록하십시요.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        -- 총배정주수 (무상등 구주 이외의 종목분 청약 처리키 위해)
        SELECT SUM(baej_jusu)
          INTO w_qty
          FROM SJT0J1 t1  /* 증자대장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd         = w_brok_ymd
           AND t1.new_jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
           AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type;

        if  xx.cheng_jusu = 0   then
            -- 유상청약 처리 후 재 운용지시에 의한 포기시 청약일 seting 20210602 yjs
            UPDATE SJT0J1 tt    /* 증자대장 */
               SET sury_ymd  = p_ymd
                 , sury_jusu = 0
             WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND new_jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND ymd         = w_brok_ymd
               AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
        end if;

        -- 증자대장의 증자주식내역
        for x2 IN (
            SELECT YMD         /* _1- */
                 , BALH_CO     /* _2- */
                 , JEUNGJ_MTH  /* _3- */
                 , OLD_JM_CD   /* _4- */
                 , NEW_JM_CD   /* _5- */
                 , BAEJ_JUSU   /* _6- */
              FROM SJT0J1 t1  /* 증자대장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd         = w_brok_ymd
               AND t1.cheng_ymd IS NULL
               AND t1.new_jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type
        ) loop
            w_jusu        := TRUNC  (xx.cheng_jusu * (x2.baej_jusu / w_qty));
            xx.cheng_jusu := xx.cheng_jusu - w_jusu;
            w_qty         := w_qty         - x2.baej_jusu;

            UPDATE SJT0J1 tt    /* 증자대장 */
               SET cheng_ymd  = p_ymd
                 , cheng_jusu = w_jusu
             WHERE CORP_GR     = p_corp_gr
               AND YMD         = x2.ymd
               AND BALH_CO     = x2.balh_co
               AND JEUNGJ_MTH  = x2.jeungj_mth
               AND FUND_CD     = xx.fund_cd
               AND OLD_JM_CD   = x2.old_jm_cd
               AND NEW_JM_CD   = x2.new_jm_cd
               AND TYPE_TRENCH = xx.type_trench
               AND BS_TYPE     = xx.bs_type;
        end loop;
    end loop;

    -- 청약주수가 0인 자료 청약일 Seting(전부해지분)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT jm_cd
          FROM SJT0CY t1  /* 주식청약내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'F18'
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT created_ymd
              INTO w_brok_ymd
              FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE t1.jm_cd = xx.jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.jm_cd || '- 주식종목(신주생성일)을 등록하십시요.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        UPDATE SJT0J1 tt    /* 증자대장 */
           SET cheng_ymd  = p_ymd
             , cheng_jusu = 0
         WHERE corp_gr           = p_corp_gr
           AND new_jm_cd         = xx.jm_cd
           AND ymd               = w_brok_ymd
           AND NVL(cheng_jusu,0) = 0
           AND cheng_ymd IS NULL;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B090', 'sjt0bm.ymd<=' || p_ymd || ' * old_jm_cd=new_jm_cd * del_yb=2' || ' * (aek_sury_ymd is null or aek_sury_ymd>'
                                              || p_ymd, '미수배당금(sjt0bm) 수령내역 반영처리');

    -- 미수배당금 내역
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                          /* _1- */
             , t1.new_jm_cd                        /* _2- */
             , t1.type_trench                      /* _3- */
             , t1.bs_type                          /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.juchong_ymd IS NOT NULL AND p_ymd >= t1.juchong_ymd  /* 1순위: 주총일이 존재하고 기준일(p_ymd)이 주총일 이후인 경우 */
                            THEN t1.juchong_aek - NVL(t1.juchong_tax, 0)
                            WHEN t1.hwakj_ymd IS NOT NULL AND p_ymd >= t1.hwakj_ymd      /* 2순위: 이사회일이 존재하고 기준일(p_ymd)이 이사회일 이후인 경우 */
                            THEN t1.hwakj_aek - NVL(t1.hwakj_tax, 0)
                            ELSE t1.yesa_aek - NVL(t1.yesa_tax, 0)                       /* 3순위: 그 외 모든 경우 (확정 전이거나 기준일 이전인 경우) -> 예상액 사용 */
                       END), 0)  AS misu_baed_aek  /* _5- */
          FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                      <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.del_yn,'2')          = '2'
           AND NVL(t1.sury_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND t1.old_jm_cd                = t1.new_jm_cd
           AND t2.corp_gr                  = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd                  = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd)    >= p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, t1.new_jm_cd, t1.type_trench, t1.bs_type
    ) loop
        if  p_corp_gr = '2202' AND p_ymd BETWEEN TO_DATE ('20250103','yyyymmdd') AND TO_DATE ('20250228','yyyymmdd')  then
            -- 티이엠씨 배당금 조정 20250315
            if  xx.fund_cd IN ('2401','2108','2111','2110','2114','2002','2115','2117','2118','2333','2003','2120','2123','2121',
                               '2122','2346','2125','2217','2347','2128','2006') AND xx.new_jm_cd = 'KR7425040003'    then
                SELECT xx.misu_baed_aek - ((NVL(YESA_AEK,0) - NVL(YESA_TAX,0)) - (NVL(HWAKJ_AEK,0) - NVL(HWAKJ_TAX,0)))
                  INTO xx.misu_baed_aek
                  FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                 WHERE CORP_GR   = p_corp_gr
                   AND OLD_JM_CD = 'KR7425040003'
                   AND OLD_JM_CD = NEW_JM_CD
                   AND HWAKJ_YMD = '2025.3.11'
                   AND FUND_CD   = xx.fund_cd;
            end if;
        end if;

        if  xx.misu_baed_aek != 0   then
            UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
               SET misu_baed_aek = xx.misu_baed_aek
             WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd       = xx.new_jm_cd
               AND ymd         = p_ymd
               AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
                -- 주식종목사항 가져오기
                SR_GETJJ2( xx.new_jm_cd, jm_balh_co, jm_woos_ilban_gb, jm_chg_gb, jm_new_old_gb, jm_danc_gb, jm_koscom_cd, w_msg );
                INSERT INTO SJM0JM tt   /* 주식 보유현황 */
                     ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                     , ymd            /* _2- */
                     , fund_cd        /* _3- */
                     , jm_cd          /* _4- */
                     , misu_baed_aek  /* _5- */
                     , balh_co        /* _6- */
                     , woos_ilban_gb  /* _7- */
                     , chg_gb         /* _8- */
                     , new_old_gb     /* _9- */
                     , danc_gb        /* _10- */
                     , koscom_cd      /* _11- */
                     , type_trench    /* _12- */
                     , bs_type        /* _13- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                       , xx.fund_cd        /* _3- */
                       , xx.new_jm_cd      /* _4- */
                       , xx.misu_baed_aek  /* _5- */
                       , jm_balh_co        /* _6- */
                       , jm_woos_ilban_gb  /* _7- */
                       , jm_chg_gb         /* _8- */
                       , jm_new_old_gb     /* _9- */
                       , jm_danc_gb        /* _10- */
                       , jm_koscom_cd      /* _11- */
                       , xx.type_trench    /* _12- */
                       , xx.bs_type        /* _13- */
                       );
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B100', 'sjt0j1.ymd<=' || p_ymd || ' * sjt0j1.jeungj_mth=1' || ' * (cheng_ymd is null or cheng_ymd>' || p_ymd,
            '미지급주식납입금(sjt0j1) 수령내역 반영처리 + 신주인수권(sjt5j1) 내역 반영처리');

    -- 미지급주식납입금 내역
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                        /* _1- */
             , t1.new_jm_cd                      /* _2- */
             , t1.type_trench                    /* _3- */
             , t1.bs_type                        /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE sign(NVL(t1.sury_ymd, p_ymd + 1) - p_ymd) WHEN 1 THEN CASE WHEN sign(t1.gosi_jekyng_ymd - p_ymd)=1
                                                                                       THEN t1.chg_chui_aek
                                                                                       ELSE t1.chui_aek END
                                                                             ELSE NVL(t1.balh_ga,0) * NVL(sury_jusu,0)
                       END), 0)  AS mijunab_aek  /* _5- */
          FROM SJT0J1 t1  /* 증자대장 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       <= p_ymd
           AND t1.jeungj_mth                = '1'
           AND NVL(t1.cheng_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND t2.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd)     >= p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, t1.new_jm_cd, t1.type_trench, t1.bs_type
    ) loop
        UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
           SET mijunab_aek = xx.mijunab_aek
         WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd       = xx.new_jm_cd
           AND ymd         = p_ymd
           AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
           AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            -- 주식종목사항 가져오기
            SR_GETJJ2( xx.new_jm_cd, jm_balh_co, jm_woos_ilban_gb, jm_chg_gb, jm_new_old_gb, jm_danc_gb, jm_koscom_cd, w_msg );
            INSERT INTO SJM0JM tt   /* 주식 보유현황 */
                 ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                 , ymd            /* _2- */
                 , fund_cd        /* _3- */
                 , jm_cd          /* _4- */
                 , mijunab_aek    /* _5- */
                 , balh_co        /* _6- */
                 , woos_ilban_gb  /* _7- */
                 , chg_gb         /* _8- */
                 , new_old_gb     /* _9- */
                 , danc_gb        /* _10- */
                 , koscom_cd      /* _11- */
                 , type_trench    /* _12- */
                 , bs_type        /* _13- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _3- */
                   , xx.new_jm_cd      /* _4- */
                   , xx.mijunab_aek    /* _5- */
                   , jm_balh_co        /* _6- */
                   , jm_woos_ilban_gb  /* _7- */
                   , jm_chg_gb         /* _8- */
                   , jm_new_old_gb     /* _9- */
                   , jm_danc_gb        /* _10- */
                   , jm_koscom_cd      /* _11- */
                   , xx.type_trench    /* _12- */
                   , xx.bs_type        /* _13- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 미지급주식납입금 내역(신주인수권 매수내역)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd                                                       /* _1- */
             , gc.tr_dr_gb                                                    /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                     /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                       /* _4- */
             , t1.type_trench                                                 /* _5- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                     /* _6- */
             , t1.tr_jusu                                                     /* _7- */
             , t1.gyul_aek                                                    /* _8- */
             , (t1.tr_jusu * NVL(t1.balh_ga,0)) + NVL(t1.gyul_aek,0)  AS aek  /* _9- */
          FROM SJT5J1 t1             /* 신주인수권 매매 내역 */
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SZX0GC gc  /* 거래코드 */
                       ON gc.tr_cd = t1.tr_cd
             , SZM0IA t2             /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 NOT LIKE 'L%'
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_dr_gb IS NULL then
            p_msg := xx.tr_cd || ' - 거래코드 거래증감 확인';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        /* 주식종목마스타 update */
        SR_UPDJM( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_cd, xx.tr_jusu, '', xx.type_trench, xx.bs_type, w_msg );
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(주식마스타 변경에러)';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
           SET up_chui_aek = CASE xx.tr_dr_gb WHEN '1' THEN NVL(up_chui_aek,0) + xx.aek
                                                       ELSE up_chui_aek END
             , dw_chui_aek = CASE xx.tr_dr_gb WHEN '2' THEN NVL(dw_chui_aek,0) + xx.aek
                                                       ELSE dw_chui_aek END
             , mijunab_aek = NVL(mijunab_aek,0) + CASE xx.tr_dr_gb WHEN '1' THEN xx.aek - xx.gyul_aek
                                                                            ELSE xx.gyul_aek - xx.aek END
         WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
           AND ymd         = p_ymd
           AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
           AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
    end loop;

    -- 미지급주식납입금 내역(신주인수권 매도내역)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                     /* _1- */
             , t1.jm_cd                       /* _2- */
             , t1.type_trench                 /* _3- */
             , t1.bs_type                     /* _4- */
             , jb.sosok_gb                    /* _5- */
             , SUM(t1.tr_jusu)   AS jusu      /* _6- */
             , SUM(t1.gyul_aek)  AS gyul_aek  /* _7- */
          FROM SJT5J1 t1  /* 신주인수권 매매 내역 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'K92'
           AND jb.balh_co = t1.balh_co
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.jm_cd
                , t1.type_trench
                , t1.bs_type
                , jb.sosok_gb
    ) loop
        SELECT NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.up_jusu,0)
                                        + NVL(t1.gongs_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_jusu,0)
             , NVL(t1.mijunab_aek,0)
          INTO w_jusu
             , w_mijunab_aek
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;

        SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'K92', 'A', '1', xx.sosok_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                    xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.gyul_aek, TRUNC (w_mijunab_aek / w_jusu * xx.jusu), w_proc_step, 'sjhp611', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(' || xx.jm_cd || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
           SET mijunab_aek = NVL(mijunab_aek,0) - TRUNC(w_mijunab_aek / w_jusu * xx.jusu)
         WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
           AND ymd         = p_ymd
           AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
           AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
    end loop;

    -- 신용/대출 잔액분개
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , NVL(SUM(t1.coll_up), 0)  AS coll_up
             , NVL(SUM(t1.coll_dw), 0)  AS coll_dw
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND (NVL(t1.coll_pass,0) != 0 OR NVL(t1.coll_up,0) != 0 OR NVL(t1.coll_dw,0) != 0)
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.coll_up > 0  then
            SR_INSBU (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'I31', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                      '', 1, 1, 1, 'D', '10101', xx.coll_up, 'I31', w_proc_step, 'SR_PROC0550 신용/대출설정', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
            SR_INSBU (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'I31', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                      '', 1, 1, 2, 'C', '20101', xx.coll_up, 'I31', w_proc_step, 'SR_PROC0550 신용/대출설정', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
        if  xx.coll_dw > 0  then
            SR_INSBU (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'I32', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                      '', 1, 1, 1, 'D', '20101', xx.coll_dw, 'I32', w_proc_step, 'SR_PROC0550 신용/대출해지', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
            SR_INSBU (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'I32', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                      '', 1, 1, 2, 'C', '10101', xx.coll_dw, 'I32', w_proc_step, 'SR_PROC0550 신용/대출해지', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 소속변경 분개생성
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , t1.jm_cd
             , h1.bf_data || h1.af_data                                            AS jasan_gb
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                               + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0)
                                               - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)), 0)  AS aek
          FROM SJM0JM         t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             , SJM0JJ         jj  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJX0JB         jb  /* 발행기관 */
             , SJX0JB_HISTORY h1  /* 발행기관 변경 History */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND jj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND jb.balh_co = jj.balh_co
           AND h1.ymd     BETWEEN p_ymd AND (p_ymd + 1)
           AND h1.balh_co = jb.balh_co
           AND h1.skt0bu  = 'Y'
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, t1.jm_cd
                , h1.bf_data || h1.af_data
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.aek, w_proc_step, 'PROC0550', w_msg );
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(' || xx.jm_cd || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0550_F21 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 주식입고(차입) 회계처리
--
    bk                             sjt0bk%rowtype;
    w_hwakj_ymd                    DATE;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0550_F21', p_ymd || ' : 주식입고(차입) 회계처리');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjt0jg.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sjt0jg.tr_cd=F21', '주식거래내역(sjt0jg) 주식입고(차입) 회계처리');

    -- 주식현물입고
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd         /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd          /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd        /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd          /* _4- */
             , t1.seq_no         /* _5- */
             , t1.offer_no       /* _6- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd       /* _7- */
             , t1.tr_jusu        /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_aek         /* _9- */
             , t1.type_trench    /* _10- */
             , t1.bs_type        /* _11- */
             , t1.sudo_ymd       /* _12- */
             , t1.etf_jm_cd      /* _13- */
             , t1.brok_ymd       /* _14- */
             , t1.brok_jusu      /* _15- */
             , t1.misu_baed_aek  /* _16- */
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'F21'
           AND t1.bs_type               = 0
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.tr_cd
                , t1.danc_gb
    ) loop
        SR_UPDJM (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_cd, xx.tr_jusu, 0, xx.type_trench, xx.bs_type, w_msg);
        IF  w_msg != 'Y'    THEN
            p_msg := w_msg || '- 주식수량 처리가 안됐습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        SR_UPDJM2 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.bs_type, xx.type_trench, xx.tr_aek, 0, w_msg);
        IF  w_msg != 'Y'    THEN
            p_msg   := xx.tr_cd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd
                                || '-' || xx.seq_no || '-' || xx.offer_no || '- 취득가 처리가 안됐습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;
        IF  xx.tr_ymd != xx.sudo_ymd    THEN
            SR_INSSD (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.type_trench, xx.bs_type, '%', xx.seq_no, 2,
                      xx.sudo_ymd, xx.tr_co_cd, xx.tr_aek, 0, xx.tr_jusu, xx.etf_jm_cd);
        end if;
        IF  xx.brok_ymd IS NOT NULL THEN
            SELECT *
              INTO bk
              FROM (SELECT *
                      FROM SJT0BK p1  /* 발행기관별 배당권리 내역 */
                     WHERE tr_ymd  = xx.brok_ymd
                       AND balh_co = (SELECT balh_co
                                        FROM SJM0JJ g1  /* 주식종목 */
                                       WHERE jm_cd = xx.jm_cd)
                       AND tr_cd   IN ('G10','G15')
                       AND corp_gr IN (p_corp_gr, '%')
                     ORDER BY CASE WHEN corp_gr = p_corp_gr THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
                            , tr_cd ASC
                     )
             WHERE ROWNUM = 1;

            IF  bk.tr_cd = 'G10'    THEN
                SELECT MAX(tr_ymd)
                  INTO w_hwakj_ymd
                  FROM (SELECT tr_ymd
                             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY balh_co, tr_cd, brok_ymd
                                                       ORDER BY CASE WHEN corp_gr = p_corp_gr THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)  AS rnum
                          FROM SJT0BK p1  /* 발행기관별 배당권리 내역 */
                         WHERE tr_ymd  BETWEEN xx.tr_ymd + 1 AND p_ymd
                           AND balh_co = bk.balh_co
                           AND tr_cd   = 'G20'
                           AND corp_gr IN (p_corp_gr, '%')
                         )
                 WHERE rnum = 1;
            ELSE
                SELECT MAX(tr_ymd)
                  INTO w_hwakj_ymd
                  FROM (SELECT tr_ymd
                             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY balh_co, tr_cd, brok_ymd
                                                       ORDER BY CASE WHEN corp_gr = p_corp_gr THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)  AS rnum
                          FROM SJT0BK p1  /* 발행기관별 배당권리 내역 */
                         WHERE tr_ymd  BETWEEN xx.tr_ymd + 1 AND p_ymd
                           AND balh_co = bk.balh_co
                           AND tr_cd   = 'G23'
                           AND corp_gr IN (p_corp_gr, '%')
                         )
                 WHERE rnum = 1;
            end if;

            DELETE FROM SJT0BM tt   /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
             WHERE corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
               AND old_jm_cd  = xx.jm_cd
               AND ymd        = xx.brok_ymd
               AND balh_co    = bk.balh_co
               AND new_jm_cd  = xx.jm_cd
               AND haeji_fund = xx.fund_cd
               AND haeji_ymd  = p_ymd;

            INSERT INTO SJT0BM tt   /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
                 ( corp_gr     /* _1- */
                 , ymd         /* _2- */
                 , balh_co     /* _3- */
                 , fund_cd     /* _4- */
                 , old_jm_cd   /* _5- */
                 , new_jm_cd   /* _6- */
                 , boyu_jusu   /* _7- */
                 , brok_jusu   /* _8- */
                 , yesa_aek    /* _9- */
                 , hwakj_ymd   /* _10- */
                 , hwakj_aek   /* _11- */
                 , haeji_fund  /* _12- */
                 , haeji_ymd   /* _13- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , xx.brok_ymd       /* _2- */
                   , bk.balh_co        /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_cd          /* _5- */
                   , xx.jm_cd          /* _6- */
                   , xx.brok_jusu      /* _7- */
                   , xx.brok_jusu      /* _8- */
                   , xx.misu_baed_aek  /* _9- */
                   , w_hwakj_ymd       /* _10- */
                   , CASE WHEN w_hwakj_ymd IS NOT NULL THEN xx.misu_baed_aek
                     END               /* _11- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _12- */
                   , p_ymd             /* _13- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 주식현물입고 분개
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd                                                     /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                   /* _2- */
             , CASE WHEN t4.sosok_gb='1'          THEN 'A'
                    WHEN t4.sosok_gb IN ('3','4') THEN '3'
                                                  ELSE t4.sosok_gb
               END                                           AS jasan_gb    /* _3- */
             , CASE WHEN t1.tr_ymd=t1.sudo_ymd THEN '0'
                                               ELSE '1'
               END                                           AS jasan_add   /* _4- */
             , SUM(t1.tr_aek)                                AS tr_aek      /* _5- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq         /* _6- */
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJM0JJ t3  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJX0JB t4  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'F21'
           AND t1.bs_type               = 0
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
           AND t3.jm_cd                 = t1.jm_cd
           AND t4.balh_co               = t3.balh_co
         GROUP BY t1.tr_cd
                , t1.fund_cd
                , CASE WHEN t4.sosok_gb='1'          THEN 'A'
                       WHEN t4.sosok_gb IN ('3','4') THEN '3'
                                                     ELSE t4.sosok_gb END
                , CASE WHEN t1.tr_ymd=t1.sudo_ymd THEN '0'
                                                  ELSE '1' END
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.tr_cd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb || xx.jasan_add, xx.fund_cd,
                    'KRW', '', xx.seq, 1, xx.tr_aek, p_proc_step, 'sjhp020_f21', w_msg);
        IF  w_msg != 'Y'    THEN
            p_msg := w_msg || '(' || xx.tr_cd || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 우선충당 미수배당금
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd                                                        /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                      /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                        /* _3- */
             , SUM(t1.misu_baed_aek)                         AS misu_baed_aek  /* _4- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq            /* _5- */
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJM0JJ t3  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJX0JB t4  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'F21'
           AND t1.bs_type               = 0
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
           AND t3.jm_cd                 = t1.jm_cd
           AND t4.balh_co               = t3.balh_co
         GROUP BY t1.tr_cd
                , t1.fund_cd
                , t1.jm_cd
        HAVING SUM(t1.misu_baed_aek) != 0
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.tr_cd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.misu_baed_aek, p_proc_step, 'sjhp020_f21', w_msg);
        IF  w_msg != 'Y'    THEN
            p_msg := w_msg || '(' || xx.jm_cd || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 주식차입
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                          /* _1- */
