             , t1.tr_cd                           /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                         /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                           /* _4- */
             , t1.seq_no                          /* _5- */
             , t1.offer_no                        /* _6- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                        /* _7- */
             , t1.tr_jusu                         /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_aek                          /* _9- */
             , NVL(t1.ggyul_aek,0)  AS ggyul_aek  /* _10- */
             , t1.danc_gb                         /* _11- */
             , CASE WHEN t4.sosok_gb='1'          THEN 'A'
                    WHEN t4.sosok_gb IN ('3','4') THEN '3'
                                                  ELSE t4.sosok_gb
               END                  AS jasan_gb   /* _12- */
             , t1.koscom_cd                       /* _13- */
             , t1.type_trench                     /* _14- */
             , t1.bs_type                         /* _15- */
             , t1.dx_jm_cd                        /* _16- */
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJM0JJ t3  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJX0JB t4  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'F21'
           AND t1.bs_type               != 0
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
           AND t3.jm_cd                 = t1.jm_cd
           AND t4.balh_co               = t3.balh_co
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.tr_cd
                , t1.danc_gb
    ) loop
        SR_UPDJM2 (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.bs_type, xx.type_trench,
                   xx.tr_aek * CASE WHEN sign (xx.bs_type)= -1 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END,
                   xx.ggyul_aek * CASE WHEN sign (xx.bs_type)= -1 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END,
                   w_msg);
        IF  w_msg != 'Y'    THEN
            p_msg   := xx.tr_cd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-'
                                || xx.seq_no || '-' || xx.offer_no || '- 취득가 처리가 안됐습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;
        IF  xx.bs_type = 1  THEN
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '-' || xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd,
                        xx.seq_no, xx.offer_no, xx.tr_aek, p_proc_step, 'sjhp020_f21', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then    -- 분개처리error
                p_msg := w_msg || '(' || xx.jm_cd || ')';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        else
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO SDM0DM tt   /* 대(여)/차(입) 보유현황 */
                     ( corp_gr      /* _1- */
                     , ymd          /* _2- */
                     , fund_cd      /* _3- */
                     , jm_cd        /* _4- */
                     , buy_date     /* _5- */
                     , up_jusu      /* _6- */
                     , danga        /* _7- */
                     , up_chui_aek  /* _8- */
                     , koscom_cd    /* _9- */
                     , danc_gb      /* _10- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr               /* _1- */
                       , xx.tr_ymd               /* _2- */
                       , xx.fund_cd              /* _3- */
                       , xx.dx_jm_cd             /* _4- */
                       , '%'                     /* _5- */
                       , xx.tr_jusu              /* _6- */
                       , xx.tr_aek / xx.tr_jusu  /* _7- */
                       , xx.tr_aek               /* _8- */
                       , xx.koscom_cd            /* _9- */
                       , xx.danc_gb              /* _10- */
                       );
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                UPDATE SDM0DM tt    /* 대(여)/차(입) 보유현황 */
                   SET up_jusu     = NVL(up_jusu,0) + xx.tr_jusu
                     , danga       = (NVL(up_jusu,0) + xx.tr_jusu) / (NVL(up_chui_aek,0) + xx.tr_aek)
                     , up_chui_aek = NVL(up_chui_aek,0) + xx.tr_aek
                 WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND jm_cd    = xx.dx_jm_cd
                   AND buy_date = '%'
                   AND ymd      = xx.tr_ymd;
            END;
        end if;
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0550_F22 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 주식출고(차입상환) 처리
--
    w_bm_ymd                       DATE;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0550_F22', p_ymd || ' : 주식출고(차입상환) 처리');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjm0jm.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=F22', '주식(sjm0jm) 출고(차입상환) 처리');

    -- 배당주 출고처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd        /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd      /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd        /* _3- */
             , t1.type_trench  /* _4- */
             , t1.bs_type      /* _5- */
             , t1.danc_gb      /* _6- */
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
             , SJM0JJ jj  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd                 LIKE 'KRY%'
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'F22'
           AND t1.dx_jm_cd IS NULL
           AND jj.jm_cd                 = t1.jm_cd
           AND jb.balh_co               = jj.balh_co
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        SELECT MAX(ymd)
          INTO w_bm_ymd
          FROM SJT0BM t1  /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                      <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.del_yn,'2')          = '2'
           AND NVL(t1.sury_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND t1.old_jm_cd                != t1.new_jm_cd
           AND t1.new_jm_cd                = xx.jm_cd
           AND t1.type_trench              = xx.type_trench
           AND t1.bs_type                  = xx.bs_type;

        UPDATE SJT0BM tt    /* 펀드별 배당권리 상세내역 */
           SET hwakj_ymd  = p_ymd
             , hwakj_jusu = 0
             , hwakj_aek  = 0
             , sury_ymd   = p_ymd
         WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
           AND old_jm_cd   != new_jm_cd
           AND ymd         = w_bm_ymd
           AND new_jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND type_trench = xx.type_trench
           AND bs_type     = xx.bs_type;
    end loop;

    -- 차입상환
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd                                                      /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                    /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                      /* _3- */
             , t1.seq_no                                                     /* _4- */
             , t1.offer_no                                                   /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_jusu                                                    /* _6- */
             , t1.tr_aek                                                     /* _7- */
             , t1.meib_chui_aek                                AS chui_aek   /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.ggyul_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gmeib_chui_aek,0)  AS gsonik     /* _9- */
             , t1.type_trench                                                /* _10- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                    /* _11- */
             , t1.dx_jm_cd                                                   /* _12- */
             , CASE WHEN t1.tr_ymd=t1.sudo_ymd THEN '1'
                                               ELSE '0'
               END                                             AS jasan_gb   /* _13- */
             , jb.sosok_gb                                                   /* _14- */
             , t1.danc_gb                                                    /* _15- */
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
             , SJM0JJ jj  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'F22'
           AND jj.jm_cd                 = t1.jm_cd
           AND jb.balh_co               = jj.balh_co
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_UPDJM (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_cd, xx.tr_jusu, 0, xx.type_trench, xx.bs_type, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '- 주식수량 처리가 안됐습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  xx.bs_type = -1     then
            SR_SZSL020_GWA (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '-' || xx.danc_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, xx.offer_no,
                            xx.tr_aek, xx.chui_aek, xx.gsonik, p_proc_step, 'sjhp030_f22 ' || xx.jm_cd, w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg || '(' || xx.jm_cd || ')';
                RETURN;
            end if;

            -- 차입주식 잔고 상환처리
            UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
               SET dw_jusu     = NVL(dw_jusu,0) + (xx.tr_jusu * -1)
                 , dw_chui_aek = NVL(dw_chui_aek,0) + (xx.tr_aek * -1)
             WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
               AND ymd         = p_ymd
               AND bs_type     = -1
               AND type_trench = xx.type_trench;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
                p_msg := xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.jm_cd || ' 차입종목(sjm0jm) 확인!';
                RETURN;
            end if;

            UPDATE SDM0DM tt    /* 대(여)/차(입) 보유현황 */
               SET dw_jusu     = NVL(dw_jusu,0) + xx.tr_jusu
                 , dw_chui_aek = NVL(dw_chui_aek,0) + xx.tr_aek
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.dx_jm_cd
               AND buy_date = '%'
               AND ymd      = p_ymd;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
                p_msg := xx.fund_cd + ' ' + xx.dx_jm_cd || ' 차입종목(sdm0dm) 확인!';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        else
            SR_SZSL020_GWA (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.danc_gb || xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, xx.offer_no,
                            xx.tr_aek, xx.chui_aek, xx.gsonik, p_proc_step, 'sjhp030_f22 ' || xx.jm_cd, w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg || '(' || xx.jm_cd || ')';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0550_SJT1JG (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
    w_tr_cd                        sjt0jg.tr_cd%type;
    w_sudo_ymd                     DATE;

    w_clear                        NUMBER;
    w_jusu                         NUMBER;
    w_susu                         NUMBER;
    su_susu_sang_ga                NUMBER;
    su_susu_rt                     NUMBER;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    -- 자문 주식체결 LOAD 자료 처리
    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO w_clear
      FROM SJT1JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역(엑셀Load용) */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
       AND REGEXP_LIKE (tr_cd,'^[JK]');

    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO w_clear
      FROM SJT1JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역(엑셀Load용) */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
       AND t1.tr_cd   = 'F';

    if  w_clear > 0 then
        -- 주식 입출잔고 재생성 원본처리로 수정 2023.7.14
--        DELETE sjm0jm t1
--        WHERE  t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
--          AND  t1.ymd     = p_ymd
--          AND  t1.fund_cd IN ( select fund_cd
--                                 from sjt1jg t1
--                                where t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
--                                  and t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
--                                  and t1.tr_cd   = 'F' );
--

        DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1   /* 분개장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'Z98'
           AND t1.BIGO    LIKE '%(PROC0550)';

        for xx IN (
            SELECT t1.fund_cd                    /* _1- */
                 , t1.jm_cd                      /* _2- */
                 , t1.tr_jusu                    /* _3- */
                 , t1.tr_aek                     /* _4- */
                 , jj.balh_co                    /* _5- */
                 , jj.woos_ilban_gb              /* _6- */
                 , jj.chg_gb                     /* _7- */
                 , jj.new_old_gb                 /* _8- */
                 , jj.danc_gb                    /* _9- */
                 , t1.koscom_cd                  /* _10- */
                 , CASE jb.sosok_gb WHEN '1' THEN CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='B' THEN '10408' ELSE '10401' END  /* 상장주식 */
                                    WHEN 'C' THEN CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='B' THEN '10408' ELSE '10402' END  /* 코스닥 */
                                    WHEN 'D' THEN CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='B' THEN '10408' ELSE '10403' END  /* 코넥스 */
                                    WHEN '2' THEN '10303'                                                 /* 상장수익증권 */
                                    WHEN '3' THEN '10404'                                                 /* 주식형ETF */
                                    WHEN '4' THEN '10304'                                                 /* ETF */
                                    WHEN '8' THEN '10402'                                                 /* 코스닥주식 */
                                    WHEN 'B' THEN '10408'                                                 /* 비상장 */
                                    WHEN 'G' THEN '10404'                                                 /* ETN도 주식형ETF/ETN 으로 분류 */
                                             ELSE '**'
                   END               AS gwamok   /* _11- */
                 , ROWNUM            AS num      /* _12- */
              FROM SJT1JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역(엑셀Load용) */
                 , SJM0JJ jj  /* 주식종목 */
                 , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
               AND t1.tr_cd   = 'F'
               AND jj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
               AND jb.balh_co = jj.balh_co
        ) loop
            MERGE INTO SJM0JM tt  /* 주식 보유현황 */
               USING DUAL ON ( corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                           AND ymd     = p_ymd
                           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                           AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                 UPDATE
                    SET bfil_boyu_jusu = NVL(bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + xx.tr_jusu
                      , bfil_chui_aek  = NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0) + xx.tr_aek
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                 INSERT ( corp_gr              /* _1- */
                        , ymd                  /* _2- */
                        , fund_cd              /* _3- */
                        , jm_cd                /* _4- */
                        , bfil_boyu_jusu       /* _5- */
                        , bfil_jilg_jusu       /* _6- */
                        , bfil_chui_aek        /* _7- */
                        , gbfil_aek            /* _8- */
                        , mesu_hald_jusu       /* _9- */
                        , balh_co              /* _10- */
                        , woos_ilban_gb        /* _11- */
                        , chg_gb               /* _12- */
                        , new_old_gb           /* _13- */
                        , danc_gb              /* _14- */
                        , koscom_cd            /* _15- */
                        , sonik                /* _16- */
                        , gsonik               /* _17- */
                        , misu_baed_aek        /* _18- */
                        , mijunab_aek          /* _19- */
                        , lock_jusu            /* _20- */
                        , type_trench          /* _21- */
                        , bs_type              /* _22- */
                        , cons_bfil_chui_aek   /* _23- */
                        , cons_bfil_gchui_aek  /* _24- */
                        )
                 VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                        , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                        , xx.fund_cd        /* _3- */
                        , xx.jm_cd          /* _4- */
                        , xx.tr_jusu        /* _5- */
                        , 0                 /* _6- */
                        , xx.tr_aek         /* _7- */
                        , 0                 /* _8- */
                        , 0                 /* _9- */
                        , xx.balh_co        /* _10- */
                        , xx.woos_ilban_gb  /* _11- */
                        , xx.chg_gb         /* _12- */
                        , xx.new_old_gb     /* _13- */
                        , xx.danc_gb        /* _14- */
                        , xx.koscom_cd      /* _15- */
                        , 0                 /* _16- */
                        , 0                 /* _17- */
                        , 0                 /* _18- */
                        , 0                 /* _19- */
                        , NULL              /* _20- */
                        , '00:'             /* _21- */
                        , 0                 /* _22- */
                        , xx.tr_aek         /* _23- */
                        , 0                 /* _24- */
                        );

            SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', '', 9, xx.num, 1, 'D',
                       xx.gwamok, xx.tr_aek, 'Z98', 9, '취득액 예금처리(PROC0550)', w_msg);
            SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', '', 9, xx.num, 2, 'C',
                       '10101', xx.tr_aek, 'Z98', 9, '취득액 예금처리(PROC0550)', w_msg);
        end loop;

--        for xx in (
--            SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                                                                  /* _1: */
--                 , ia.fund_currency                                                                                            /* _2: */
--                 , CASE jb.sosok_gb WHEN '1' THEN CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='B' THEN '10408' ELSE '10401' END        -- 상장주식
--                                    WHEN 'C' THEN CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='B' THEN '10408' ELSE '10402' END        -- 코스닥
--                                    WHEN 'D' THEN CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='B' THEN '10408' ELSE '10403' END        -- 코넥스
--                                    WHEN '2' THEN '10303'                                                       -- 상장수익증권
--                                    WHEN '3' THEN '10404'                                                       -- 주식형ETF
--                                    WHEN '4' THEN '10304'                                                       -- ETF
--                                    WHEN '8' THEN '10402'                                                       -- 코스닥주식
--                                    WHEN 'B' THEN '10408'                                                       -- 비상장
--                                    WHEN 'G' THEN '10404'                                                       -- ETN도 주식형ETF/ETN 으로 분류
--                                             ELSE '**'
--                   END                                                                                        AS gwamok        /* _3: */
--                 , CASE jb.sosok_gb WHEN '1' THEN CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='B' THEN '50141' ELSE '50101' END

--                 , CASE jb.sosok_gb WHEN '1' THEN CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='B' THEN '60141' ELSE '60101' END

--                   END                                                                                        AS ik_gwamok     /* _5: */
--                 , 0                                                                                          AS ag_aek        /* _6: */
--                 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)                                                    AS num           /* _7: */
--                 , NVL(SUM(nvl(bfil_chui_aek,0) + nvl(up_chui_aek,0) - nvl(dw_chui_aek,0)
--                                                + nvl(gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - nvl(gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)), 0)    AS master_aek    /* _8: */
--            FROM   sjm0jm t1
--                 , sjx0jb jb
--                 , szm0ia ia
--            WHERE  t1.corp_gr            = p_corp_gr
--              AND  t1.ymd                = p_ymd
--              AND  (t1.fund_cd,t1.jm_cd) IN ( select fund_cd
--                                                   , jm_cd
--                                                from sjt1jg ta
--                                               where ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
--                                                 and ta.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
--                                                 and ta.tr_cd   = 'F' )
--              AND  jb.balh_co            = t1.balh_co
--              AND  ia.corp_gr            = t1.corp_gr
--              AND  ia.fund_cd            = t1.fund_cd
--            GROUP BY t1.fund_cd
--                   , ia.fund_currency
--                   , CASE jb.sosok_gb WHEN '1' THEN CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='B' THEN '10408' ELSE '10401' END
--                                      WHEN 'C' THEN CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='B' THEN '10408' ELSE '10402' END

--                                      WHEN '2' THEN '10303'
--                                      WHEN '3' THEN '10404'
--                                      WHEN '4' THEN '10304'
--                                      WHEN '8' THEN '10402'
--                                      WHEN 'B' THEN '10408'
--                                      WHEN 'G' THEN '10404'
--                                               ELSE '**'
--                     END
--                   , CASE jb.sosok_gb WHEN '1' THEN CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='B' THEN '50141' ELSE '50101' END
--                                      WHEN 'C' THEN CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='B' THEN '50141' ELSE '50102' END
--                                      WHEN 'D' THEN CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='B' THEN '50141' ELSE '50103' END
--                                      WHEN '2' THEN '50109'

--                                      WHEN 'C' THEN CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='B' THEN '60141' ELSE '60102' END
--                                      WHEN 'D' THEN CASE WHEN t1.danc_gb='B' THEN '60141' ELSE '60103' END
--                                      WHEN '2' THEN '60109'
--                                      WHEN '3' THEN '60104'
--                                      WHEN '4' THEN '60104'
--                                      WHEN '8' THEN '60102'
--                                      WHEN 'B' THEN '60141'
--                                      WHEN 'G' THEN '60105'
--                                               ELSE '**'
--                     END
--            ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
--        ) loop
--            SELECT NVL(sum(junj),0)
--              INTO xx.ag_aek
--            FROM   skm0ag t1
--            WHERE  t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
--              AND  t1.ymd     = p_ymd
--              AND  t1.work_gb = 'A'
--              AND  t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
--              AND  t1.gwamok  = xx.gwamok;
--
--            if  xx.ag_aek = 0   then
--                SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 9, xx.num, 1, 'D', xx.gwamok, xx.master_aek, 'Z98', 9, '취득액 예금처리(PROC0550)', w_msg);
--                SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 9, xx.num, 2, 'C', '10101', xx.master_aek, 'Z98', 9, '취득액 예금처리(PROC0550)', w_msg);
--            else
--                SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 9, xx.num, 1, 'D', xx.gwamok, xx.master_aek, 'Z98', 9, '취득액 원본처리(PROC0550)', w_msg);
--                SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 9, xx.num, 2, 'C', '10101', xx.master_aek, 'Z98', 9, '취득액 원본처리(PROC0550)', w_msg);
--                if  xx.ag_aek > xx.master_aek   then
--                    SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 9, xx.num, 1, 'C', xx.gwamok, xx.ag_aek - xx.master_aek, 'Z98', 9, '취득액 매매손익처리(PROC0550)', w_msg);
--                    SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 9, xx.num, 2, 'D', xx.son_gwamok, xx.ag_aek - xx.master_aek, 'Z98', 9, '취득액 매매손익처리(PROC0550)', w_msg);
--                else
--                    SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 9, xx.num, 1, 'D', xx.gwamok, xx.master_aek - xx.ag_aek, 'Z98', 9, '취득액 매매손익처리(PROC0550)', w_msg);
--                    SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z98', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 9, xx.num, 2, 'C', xx.ik_gwamok, xx.master_aek - xx.ag_aek, 'Z98', 9, '취득액 매매손익처리(PROC0550)', w_msg);
--                end if;
--            end if;
--        end loop;
    end if;

    -- 체결내역으로 주식매매내역 생성
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                           /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                             /* _2- */
             , t1.sudo_ymd                          /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                          /* _4- */
             , t1.enc_acct_no                       /* _5- */
             , t1.koscom_cd                         /* _6- */
             , t1.jm_cd                             /* _7- */
             , t1.danc_gb                           /* _8- */
             , NVL(ia.susu_rt,0)    AS susu_rt      /* _9- */
             , CASE WHEN p_corp_gr='2402' THEN 'Y'
                                          ELSE NVL(ia.order_send,'N')
               END                  AS order_send   /* _10-리코자산 수수료계산 제외 */
             , SUM(t1.tr_jusu)      AS jusu         /* _11- */
             , SUM(t1.tr_aek)       AS aek          /* _12- */
             , CASE WHEN t1.tr_cd='K'
                    THEN CASE WHEN NVL(SUM(t1.tax),0)=0
                              THEN TRUNC (SUM(t1.tr_aek) * 0.003)
                              ELSE SUM(t1.tax) END
                    ELSE 0
               END                  AS tax          /* _13- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.susu),0)  AS susu         /* _14- */
          FROM SJT1JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역(엑셀Load용) */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 IN ('J','K')
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd    , t1.tr_cd    , t1.sudo_ymd, t1.tr_co_cd
                , t1.enc_acct_no, t1.koscom_cd, t1.jm_cd   , t1.danc_gb
                , NVL(ia.susu_rt,0)
                , CASE WHEN p_corp_gr='2402' THEN 'Y'
                                             ELSE NVL(ia.order_send,'N') END
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd, t1.tr_cd, t1.tr_co_cd, t1.koscom_cd
    ) loop
        w_tr_cd := xx.tr_cd || '20';

        if  xx.tr_cd = 'K'  then
            -- 잔고가 없는 매도내역 생성제외 20240827
            SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(BFIL_BOYU_JUSU,0) + NVL(UP_JUSU,0) + NVL(GONGS_UP_JUSU,0)),0)
              INTO w_jusu
              FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;

            SELECT w_jusu + NVL(SUM(tr_jusu),0)
              INTO w_jusu
              FROM SJT1JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역(엑셀Load용) */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd   = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd     = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd     = 'J'
               AND t1.load_user = 'JA020N';

            if  w_jusu = 0  then
                UPDATE SJT1JG ta    /* 주식거래 내역(엑셀Load용) */
                   SET status = '잔고가 없습니다.'
                 WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd
                   AND tr_cd   = xx.tr_cd
                   AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                   AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;

                CONTINUE;
            else
                UPDATE SJT1JG ta    /* 주식거래 내역(엑셀Load용) */
                   SET status = 'OK'
                 WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd
                   AND tr_cd   = xx.tr_cd
                   AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                   AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;
            end if;
        else
            UPDATE SJT1JG ta    /* 주식거래 내역(엑셀Load용) */
               SET status = 'OK'
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd
               AND tr_cd   = xx.tr_cd
               AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;
        end if;

        SR_UPDJM (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, w_tr_cd, xx.jusu, 0, '00:', 0, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '- 주식수량 처리가 안됐습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- FPT자료는 load 수수료, 세금 이용
        if  xx.susu > 0 OR xx.order_send = 'Y'  then
            w_susu := xx.susu;
        else
            if  xx.susu_rt IS NULL  then    w_susu := TRUNC(xx.aek * 0.0005    , -1);
            elsif xx.susu_rt != 0   then    w_susu := TRUNC(xx.aek * xx.susu_rt, -1);
            else
                BEGIN
                    SELECT susu_sang_ga
                         , susu_rt
                      INTO su_susu_sang_ga
                         , su_susu_rt
                      FROM SZX0SU t1  /* 주식매매 수수료율 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.tr_co_cd = xx.tr_co_cd
                       AND xx.aek      BETWEEN t1.from_chgyl_ga AND t1.to_chgyl_ga;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    su_susu_sang_ga := 0;
                    su_susu_rt      := 0;
                END;
                w_susu := TRUNC(xx.aek * xx.susu_rt, -1) + su_susu_sang_ga;
            end if;
        end if;

        if  xx.sudo_ymd IS NULL then
                w_sudo_ymd := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '+2');
        else    w_sudo_ymd := xx.sudo_ymd;
        end if;

        INSERT INTO SJT0JG tt   /* 주식거래 내역 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
               , p_ymd           /* _2- */
               , w_tr_cd         /* _3- */
               , xx.fund_cd      /* _4- */
               , xx.jm_cd        /* _5- */
               , 1               /* _6- */
               , 1               /* _7- */
               , xx.jusu         /* _8- */
               , xx.aek          /* _9- */
               , w_susu          /* _10- */
               , xx.tax          /* _11- */
               , CASE WHEN xx.tr_cd='J' THEN xx.aek + w_susu
                                        ELSE xx.aek - w_susu - xx.tax
                 END             /* _12- */
               , w_sudo_ymd      /* _13- */
               , xx.tr_co_cd     /* _14- */
               , 'JCOM'          /* _15- */
               , 0               /* _16- */
               , xx.danc_gb      /* _17- */
               , xx.koscom_cd    /* _18- */
               , NULL            /* _19- */
               , NULL            /* _20- */
               , NULL            /* _21- */
               , NULL            /* _22- */
               , NULL            /* _23- */
               , NULL            /* _24- */
               , NULL            /* _25- */
               , xx.enc_acct_no  /* _26- */
               , '00:'           /* _27- */
               , 0               /* _28- */
               , NULL            /* _29- */
               , NULL            /* _30- */
               , NULL            /* _31- */
               , NULL            /* _32- */
               , NULL            /* _33- */
               , NULL            /* _34- */
               , NULL            /* _35- */
               , NULL            /* _36- */
               , NULL            /* _37- */
               , NULL            /* _38- */
               , sysdate         /* _39- */
               );
    end loop;
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd      /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd        /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd     /* _3- */
             , t1.koscom_cd    /* _4- */
             , t1.jm_cd        /* _5- */
             , t1.danc_gb      /* _6- */
             , t1.tr_jusu      /* _7- */
             , t1.tr_aek       /* _8- */
             , t1.offer_no     /* _9- */
             , t1.enc_acct_no  /* _10- */
          FROM SJT1JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역(엑셀Load용) */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'O'
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.tr_cd
                , t1.tr_co_cd
                , t1.koscom_cd
    ) loop
        w_tr_cd := 'K21';

        SR_UPDJM (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, w_tr_cd, xx.tr_jusu, 0, '00:', 0, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '- 주식수량 처리가 안됐습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        INSERT INTO SJT0JG tt   /* 주식거래 내역 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
               , p_ymd           /* _2- */
               , w_tr_cd         /* _3- */
               , xx.fund_cd      /* _4- */
               , xx.jm_cd        /* _5- */
               , 1               /* _6- */
               , 1               /* _7- */
               , xx.tr_jusu      /* _8- */
               , xx.tr_aek       /* _9- */
               , 0               /* _10- */
               , 0               /* _11- */
               , xx.tr_aek       /* _12- */
               , p_ymd           /* _13- */
               , xx.tr_co_cd     /* _14- */
               , 'JCOM'          /* _15- */
               , 0               /* _16- */
               , xx.danc_gb      /* _17- */
               , xx.koscom_cd    /* _18- */
               , NULL            /* _19- */
               , NULL            /* _20- */
               , NULL            /* _21- */
               , NULL            /* _22- */
               , NULL            /* _23- */
               , NULL            /* _24- */
               , NULL            /* _25- */
               , xx.enc_acct_no  /* _26- */
               , '00:'           /* _27- */
               , 0               /* _28- */
               , NULL            /* _29- */
               , NULL            /* _30- */
               , NULL            /* _31- */
               , NULL            /* _32- */
               , NULL            /* _33- */
               , NULL            /* _34- */
               , NULL            /* _35- */
               , NULL            /* _36- */
               , NULL            /* _37- */
               , NULL            /* _38- */
               , sysdate         /* _39- */
               );
    end loop;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0551 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 주식매입내역 회계처리
--
    w_expense_yn                   char(1);
    m_expense_yn                   char(1);

    w_sosok_gb                     VARCHAR(1);
    w_fund_cd                      szm0ia.fund_cd%type;
    w_tr_cd                        sjt0jg.tr_cd%type;
    w_jm_cd                        sjt0jg.jm_cd%type;
    w_etf_jm_cd                    sjt0jg.jm_cd%type;
    w_ga_jasan_gb                  szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;
    w_seq_no                       sjt0jg.seq_no%type;
    ga_jasan_gb                    szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;

    w_gyul_aek                     NUMBER;
    w_susu                         NUMBER;
    w_gyul_aek1                    NUMBER;
    w_aek                          NUMBER;

    w_tr_dr_gb                     szx0gc.tr_dr_gb%type;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B050', 'sjt5j1.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd, '신주인수권 매수내역(sjt5j1)의 당일내역' );

    -- 주식매매수수료 비용처리구분(회사)
    SELECT EXPENSE_YN
      INTO w_expense_yn
      FROM SZX0AA t1  /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
     WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr;

    -- 신주인수권 당일매수 trigger분
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd       /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd        /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd      /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd        /* _4- */
             , t1.type_trench  /* _5- */
             , t1.bs_type      /* _6- */
             , t1.tr_jusu      /* _7- */
             , t1.balh_ga      /* _8- */
             , t1.gyul_aek     /* _9- */
          FROM SJT5J1 t1  /* 신주인수권 매매 내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('J92','K92')
    ) loop
        -- 주식종목마스타_update
        SR_UPDJM( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_cd, xx.tr_jusu, '', xx.type_trench, xx.bs_type, w_msg );
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    THEN
            p_msg := xx.tr_cd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || ':' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        ELSE
            -- 거래코드 거래증감구분 가져오기
            SR_GETGC( xx.tr_cd, w_tr_dr_gb, w_msg );
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    THEN
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;

            w_aek := NVL (xx.tr_jusu,0) * NVL (xx.balh_ga,0) + NVL (xx.gyul_aek,0);
            UPDATE SJM0JM t1    /* 주식 보유현황 */
               SET up_chui_aek = CASE WHEN w_tr_dr_gb='1'
                                      THEN NVL(up_chui_aek,0) + w_aek ELSE up_chui_aek END
                 , dw_chui_aek = CASE WHEN w_tr_dr_gb='2'
                                      THEN NVL(dw_chui_aek,0) + w_aek ELSE dw_chui_aek END
                 , mijunab_aek = NVL(mijunab_aek,0) + CASE WHEN w_tr_dr_gb='1'
                                                           THEN w_aek - xx.gyul_aek ELSE xx.gyul_aek - w_aek END
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     = xx.tr_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 주식 당일 대여거래 trigger 분
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd     /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd   /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd     /* _3- */
             , t2.djm_cd    /* _4- */
             , t1.tr_jusu   /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_danga  /* _6- */
          FROM SDT0DG t1  /* 대여 거래내역 */
             , SDX0DJ t2  /* 대차(담보) 종목정보 */
             , SZM0IA t3  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 IN ('I11','I21')
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd                 = t1.jm_cd
           AND t2.jasan_gb              = '3'
           AND t3.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t3.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'I11'    THEN    -- 대여
            UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
               SET jilg_up_jusu = NVL(jilg_up_jusu,0) + xx.tr_jusu
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd   = xx.djm_cd
               AND ymd     = p_ymd;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    THEN
                p_msg := xx.djm_cd || '-대여종목을 확인하십시오.';
                RETURN;
            end if;

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'I21'  THEN    -- 회수
            UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
               SET jilg_dw_jusu = NVL(jilg_dw_jusu,0) + xx.tr_jusu
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd   = xx.djm_cd
               AND ymd     = p_ymd;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    THEN
                p_msg := xx.djm_cd || '-대여회수종목을 확인하십시오.';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sjt0jg.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd
                                                || ' * sjt0jg.tr_cd like J2%', '주식거래내역(sjt0jg) 주식매입 회계처리(신주인수권매수 포함)');

    -- 주식거래내역의 주식매입내역
    w_fund_cd  := '!';
    w_gyul_aek := 0;
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT tt.tr_ymd                                                          /* _1- */
             , tt.tr_cd                                                           /* _2- */
             , tt.fund_cd                                                         /* _3- */
             , tt.jm_cd                                                           /* _4- */
             , tt.seq_no                                                          /* _5- */
             , tt.offer_no                                                        /* _6- */
             , tt.tr_jusu                                                         /* _7- */
             , tt.tr_aek                                                          /* _8- */
             , tt.gyul_aek                                                        /* _9- */
             , tt.susu                                                            /* _10- */
             , tt.tr_co_cd                                                        /* _11- */
             , tt.sudo_ymd                                                        /* _12- */
             , tt.danc_gb                                                         /* _13- */
             , tt.option_gb                                                       /* _14- */
             , tt.ggyul_aek                                                       /* _15- */
             , tt.susu_tr_co_cd                                                   /* _16- */
             , tt.type_trench                                                     /* _17- */
             , tt.bs_type                                                         /* _18- */
             , tt.etf_jm_cd                                                       /* _19- */
             , CASE WHEN w_expense_yn='Y' THEN 'Y'
                                          ELSE ia.EXPENSE_YN END  AS expense_yn   /* _20- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY tt.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY tt.fund_cd)       AS seq          /* _21- */
          FROM (SELECT t1.tr_ymd         /* _1- */
                     , t1.tr_cd          /* _2- */
                     , t1.fund_cd        /* _3- */
                     , t1.jm_cd          /* _4- */
                     , t1.seq_no         /* _5- */
                     , t1.offer_no       /* _6- */
                     , t1.tr_jusu        /* _7- */
                     , t1.tr_aek         /* _8- */
                     , t1.gyul_aek       /* _9- */
                     , t1.susu           /* _10- */
                     , t1.tr_co_cd       /* _11- */
                     , t1.sudo_ymd       /* _12- */
                     , t1.danc_gb        /* _13- */
                     , t1.option_gb      /* _14- */
                     , t1.susu_tr_co_cd  /* _15- */
                     , t1.ggyul_aek      /* _16- */
                     , t1.type_trench    /* _17- */
                     , t1.bs_type        /* _18- */
                     , t1.etf_jm_cd      /* _19- */
                  FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
                   AND t1.tr_cd   LIKE 'J2%'
                   AND t1.danc_gb NOT IN ('A','X')
                UNION ALL
                SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                                /* _1- */
                     , t1.tr_cd                                                 /* _2- */
                     , t1.fund_cd                                               /* _3- */
                     , t1.jm_cd                                                 /* _4- */
                     , t1.seq_no                                                /* _5- */
                     , t1.offer_no                                              /* _6- */
                     , t1.tr_jusu                                               /* _7- */
                     , t1.tr_aek                                                /* _8- */
                     , t1.gyul_aek                                              /* _9- */
                     , t1.susu                                                  /* _10- */
                     , t1.tr_co_cd                                              /* _11- */
                     , t1.sudo_ymd                                              /* _12- */
                     , CASE WHEN t3.sosok_gb='1'          THEN 'A'
                            WHEN t3.sosok_gb IN ('3','4') THEN '3'
                                                          ELSE t3.sosok_gb END  /* _13- */
                     , t1.option_gb                                             /* _14- */
                     , t1.susu_tr_co_cd                                         /* _15- */
                     , t1.ggyul_aek                                             /* _16- */
                     , t1.type_trench                                           /* _17- */
                     , t1.bs_type                                               /* _18- */
                     , t1.etf_jm_cd                                             /* _19- */
                  FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
                     , SJM0JJ t2  /* 주식종목 */
                     , SJX0JB t3  /* 발행기관 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
                   AND t1.tr_cd   LIKE 'J2%'
                   AND t1.danc_gb IN ('A','X')
                   AND t2.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
                   AND t3.balh_co = t2.balh_co
                ) tt
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE ia.CORP_GR               = p_corp_gr
           AND ia.FUND_CD               = tt.FUND_CD
           AND NVL(ia.HAEJI_YMD, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
         ORDER BY tt.fund_cd
                , tt.tr_cd
                , tt.sudo_ymd
                , tt.danc_gb
                , tt.etf_jm_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_aek != 0 AND NVL (xx.gyul_aek,0) = 0 AND xx.susu_tr_co_cd NOT IN ('J000','JCOM')  THEN
            p_msg := xx.tr_cd || '-' || xx.tr_co_cd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-수수료 계산이 안됐습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        /* 취득가 처리 */
        if  xx.expense_yn = 'Y'   THEN
                SR_UPDJM2( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.bs_type, xx.type_trench, xx.tr_aek  , xx.ggyul_aek, w_msg );
        ELSE    SR_UPDJM2( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.bs_type, xx.type_trench, xx.gyul_aek, xx.ggyul_aek, w_msg );
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    THEN
            p_msg   := xx.tr_cd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd
                                || '-' || xx.seq_no || '-' || xx.offer_no || '=' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        SELECT sosok_gb
          INTO w_sosok_gb
          FROM SJM0JJ jj  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE jj.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND jb.balh_co = jj.balh_co;

        if  w_sosok_gb IN ('2','3','G') then    xx.danc_gb := w_sosok_gb;
        end if;

        if  xx.tr_ymd = xx.sudo_ymd then    ga_jasan_gb := xx.danc_gb || '1';
        ELSE
            if  xx.tr_cd = 'J27'    THEN
                ga_jasan_gb := xx.danc_gb || xx.option_gb;
            ELSE
                ga_jasan_gb := xx.danc_gb || '0';
                SR_INSSD( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.type_trench, xx.bs_type, '%', xx.seq_no, 1, xx.sudo_ymd, xx.tr_co_cd, xx.gyul_aek, xx.susu, xx.tr_jusu, xx.etf_jm_cd );
            end if;
        end if;

        if  REGEXP_LIKE (xx.tr_cd,'J23|J2A|K23|K2A')    then    xx.etf_jm_cd := NVL (xx.etf_jm_cd, xx.jm_cd);
        end if;

        if  w_fund_cd = '!' THEN
            w_fund_cd     := xx.fund_cd;
            w_tr_cd       := xx.tr_cd;
            w_jm_cd       := xx.jm_cd;
            w_etf_jm_cd   := xx.etf_jm_cd;
            w_ga_jasan_gb := ga_jasan_gb;
            w_seq_no      := xx.seq;
            w_gyul_aek    := 0;
            w_susu        := 0;
        end if;

        if (w_fund_cd != xx.fund_cd) OR (w_tr_cd != xx.tr_cd) OR (w_ga_jasan_gb != ga_jasan_gb) OR (NVL(w_etf_jm_cd,'null') != NVL(xx.etf_jm_cd,'null')) THEN
            if  m_expense_yn = 'Y'  THEN
                    SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_ga_jasan_gb, w_fund_cd, 'KRW', w_etf_jm_cd, w_seq_no, 1, w_gyul_aek - w_susu, w_gyul_aek, p_proc_step, 'proc0551' || w_ga_jasan_gb, w_msg );
            ELSE    SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_ga_jasan_gb, w_fund_cd, 'KRW', w_etf_jm_cd, w_seq_no, 1, w_gyul_aek         , w_gyul_aek, p_proc_step, 'proc0551' || w_ga_jasan_gb, w_msg );
            end if;
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    THEN    -- 분개처리error
                p_msg := '(' || w_jm_cd || ')' || w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
            w_fund_cd     := xx.fund_cd;
            w_tr_cd       := xx.tr_cd;
            w_jm_cd       := xx.jm_cd;
            w_etf_jm_cd   := xx.etf_jm_cd;
            w_ga_jasan_gb := ga_jasan_gb;
            w_seq_no      := xx.seq;
            w_gyul_aek    := 0;
            w_susu        := 0;
        end if;
        w_gyul_aek   := w_gyul_aek + xx.gyul_aek;
        w_susu       := w_susu     + xx.susu;
        m_expense_yn := xx.expense_yn;
    end loop;
    if  w_gyul_aek != 0 THEN
        if  m_expense_yn = 'Y'  THEN
                SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_ga_jasan_gb, w_fund_cd, 'KRW', w_etf_jm_cd, w_seq_no, 1, w_gyul_aek - w_susu, w_gyul_aek, p_proc_step, 'proc0551', w_msg );
        ELSE    SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_ga_jasan_gb, w_fund_cd, 'KRW', w_etf_jm_cd, w_seq_no, 1, w_gyul_aek         , w_gyul_aek, p_proc_step, 'proc0551', w_msg );
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    THEN
            p_msg := '(' || w_jm_cd || ')' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end if;

    -- 신주인수권 매입내역
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd                                              /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                            /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                              /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_jusu                                            /* _4- */
             , t1.gyul_aek                                           /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                           /* _6- */
             , t1.balh_ga                                            /* _7- */
             , t1.tr_ymd                                             /* _8- */
             , t1.bs_type                                            /* _9- */
             , t1.type_trench                                        /* _10- */
             , t2.sosok_gb                                           /* _11- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq  /* _12- */
          FROM SJT5J1 t1  /* 신주인수권 매매 내역 */
             , SJX0JB t2  /* 발행기관 */
             , SZM0IA t3  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'J92'
           AND t2.balh_co               = t1.balh_co
           AND t3.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t3.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        if  xx.sosok_gb = 'C'   then    ga_jasan_gb := '02';
        elsif xx.sosok_gb = 'B' then    ga_jasan_gb := '01';
        else                            ga_jasan_gb := '00';
        end if;

        /* 취득가 처리 */
        SR_UPDJM2( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.bs_type, xx.type_trench, xx.gyul_aek, 0, w_msg );
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    THEN
            p_msg   := xx.tr_cd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd
                                || '- 취득가 처리가 안됐습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if NVL (xx.balh_ga,0) = 0           THEN
                SR_SZSL021( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', ga_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.gyul_aek                             , xx.gyul_aek, p_proc_step, 'proc0551'  , w_msg );
        ELSE    SR_SZSL021( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', ga_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, ( xx.balh_ga * xx.tr_jusu) + xx.gyul_aek, xx.gyul_aek, p_proc_step, 'sjhp020 3 ', w_msg );
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then    -- 분개처리error
            p_msg := '(' || xx.jm_cd || ')' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 개별주식옵션매입처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                       /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                        /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                      /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                        /* _4- */
             , t1.type_trench                  /* _5- */
             , t1.bs_type                      /* _6- */
             , t1.offer_no                     /* _7- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                     /* _8- */
             , t1.sudo_ymd                     /* _9- */
             , t1.danc_gb                      /* _10- */
             , t1.option_gb                    /* _11- */
             , MIN(seq_no)        AS seq_no    /* _12- */
             , SUM(tr_jusu)       AS tr_jusu   /* _13- */
             , SUM(gyul_aek)      AS gyul_aek  /* _14- */
             , SUM(NVL(susu, 0))  AS susu      /* _15- */
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                 = 'J27'
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.tr_ymd  , t1.tr_cd      , t1.fund_cd
                , t1.jm_cd   , t1.type_trench, t1.bs_type
                , t1.offer_no, t1.tr_co_cd   , t1.sudo_ymd, t1.danc_gb, t1.option_gb
    ) loop
        if NVL (xx.gyul_aek,0) = 0  then
            p_msg   := xx.tr_cd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-' || xx.seq_no || '-' || xx.offer_no || '- 결제금액을 확인바랍니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if  xx.tr_ymd != xx.sudo_ymd    then
            -- 개별주식옵션 콜,풋매입
            if (xx.tr_cd='J27' AND xx.option_gb='C')    then
                BEGIN
                    SELECT SUM(t2.aek)
                      INTO w_gyul_aek1
                      FROM SST0KS t1  /* 파생상품 수도결제 */
                         , SKT0BU t2  /* 분개장 */
                         , SSX0KJ t3  /* 파생종목 */
                         , SZX0GR t4  /* 그룹코드 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.fund_cd      = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.currency     = 'KRW'
                       AND t1.sudo_ymd     = xx.tr_ymd
                       AND t2.corp_gr      = t1.corp_gr
                       AND t2.fund_cd      = t1.fund_cd
                       AND t2.tr_ymd       = t1.tr_ymd
                       AND t2.jm_cd        = t1.sj_cd
                       AND t2.tr_cd        = t1.tr_cd
                       AND t2.tr_cd        = 'S74'
                       AND t2.gwamok       = '20201'
                       AND t3.corp_gr      = t1.corp_gr
                       AND t3.sj_cd        = t1.sj_cd
                       AND t3.lsy_ymd      = t1.tr_ymd
                       AND t4.gr_cd        = 'A6'
                       AND t4.sebu_cd      = t3.jasan
                       AND t4.sebu_cd_efnm = xx.jm_cd;
                EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                    p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-개별주식콜매입 거래내역확인';
                    RETURN;
                END;

            elsif (xx.tr_cd='J27' AND xx.option_gb='P') then
                BEGIN
                    SELECT SUM(t2.aek)
                      INTO w_gyul_aek1
                      FROM SST0KS t1  /* 파생상품 수도결제 */
                         , SKT0BU t2  /* 분개장 */
                         , SSX0KJ t3  /* 파생종목 */
                         , SZX0GR t4  /* 그룹코드 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.fund_cd      = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.currency     = 'KRW'
                       AND t1.sudo_ymd     = xx.tr_ymd
                       AND t2.corp_gr      = t1.corp_gr
                       AND t2.fund_cd      = t1.fund_cd
                       AND t2.tr_ymd       = t1.tr_ymd
                       AND t2.jm_cd        = t1.sj_cd
                       AND t2.tr_cd        = t1.tr_cd
                       AND t2.tr_cd        = 'SA4'
                       AND t2.gwamok       = '20201'
                       AND t3.corp_gr      = t1.corp_gr
                       AND t3.sj_cd        = t1.sj_cd
                       AND t3.lsy_ymd      = t1.tr_ymd
                       AND t4.gr_cd        = 'A6'
                       AND t4.sebu_cd      = t3.jasan
                       AND t4.sebu_cd_efnm = xx.jm_cd;
                EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                    p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-개별주식풋매입 거래내역확인';
                    RETURN;
                END;
            else
                w_gyul_aek1 := 0;
            end if;
            SR_INSSD( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.type_trench, xx.bs_type, '%', xx.seq_no, 2, xx.sudo_ymd, xx.tr_co_cd, w_gyul_aek1, xx.susu, xx.tr_jusu, NULL );
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 주식입고(차입) 처리
    SR_PROC0550_F21( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_proc_step, w_msg );
    p_msg := w_msg;

    -- 주식매수청구권 주식 행사처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd         /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd          /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd        /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd          /* _4- */
             , t1.cheng_jusu     /* _5- */
             , t1.danga          /* _6- */
             , t1.cheng_aek      /* _7- */
             , t1.sj_jm_cd       /* _8- */
             , t1.kra_jusu       /* _9- */
             , t1.kra_chui_aek   /* _10- */
             , t1.type_trench    /* _11- */
             , t1.bs_type        /* _12- */
             , jj.balh_co        /* _13- */
             , jj.woos_ilban_gb  /* _14- */
             , jj.chg_gb         /* _15- */
             , jj.new_old_gb     /* _16- */
             , jj.danc_gb        /* _17- */
             , jj.koscom_cd      /* _18- */
          FROM SJT0CY t1  /* 주식청약내역 */
             , SJM0JJ jj  /* 주식종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd    = 'F65'
           AND t1.kra_jusu > 0
           AND jj.jm_cd    = t1.sj_jm_cd
    ) loop
        MERGE INTO SJM0JM t13  /* 주식 보유현황 */
           USING DUAL ON ( t13.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                       AND t13.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t13.jm_cd       = xx.sj_jm_cd
                       AND t13.ymd         = p_ymd
                       AND t13.bs_type     = xx.bs_type
                       AND t13.type_trench = xx.type_trench )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET up_jusu     = NVL(up_jusu,0) + xx.cheng_jusu
                  , up_chui_aek = NVL(up_chui_aek,0) + xx.cheng_aek + xx.kra_chui_aek
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                       /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd                           /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                      /* _3- */
                    , xx.sj_jm_cd                     /* _4- */
                    , 0                               /* _5- */
                    , xx.cheng_jusu                   /* _6- */
                    , 0                               /* _7- */
                    , 0                               /* _8- */
                    , xx.cheng_aek + xx.kra_chui_aek  /* _9- */
                    , 0                               /* _10- */
                    , 0                               /* _11- */
                    , 0                               /* _12- */
                    , 0                               /* _13- */
                    , 0                               /* _14- */
                    , 0                               /* _15- */
                    , 0                               /* _16- */
                    , 0                               /* _17- */
                    , xx.koscom_cd                    /* _18- */
                    , xx.balh_co                      /* _19- */
                    , 0                               /* _20- */
                    , 0                               /* _21- */
                    , 0                               /* _22- */
                    , 0                               /* _23- */
                    , xx.woos_ilban_gb                /* _24- */
                    , xx.chg_gb                       /* _25- */
                    , xx.new_old_gb                   /* _26- */
                    , xx.danc_gb                      /* _27- */
                    , NULL                            /* _28- */
                    , 0                               /* _29- */
                    , 0                               /* _30- */
                    , 0                               /* _31- */
                    , 0                               /* _32- */
                    , 0                               /* _33- */
                    , xx.type_trench                  /* _34- */
                    , xx.bs_type                      /* _35- */
                    , NULL                            /* _36- */
                    , NULL                            /* _37- */
                    , NULL                            /* _38- */
                    , NULL                            /* _39- */
                    , NULL                            /* _40- */
                    , NULL                            /* _41- */
                    , NULL                            /* _42- */
                    , NULL                            /* _43- */
                    , NULL                            /* _44- */
                    , NULL                            /* _45- */
                    , NULL                            /* _46- */
                    , NULL                            /* _47- */
                    , NULL                            /* _48- */
                    );
    end loop;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0552 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_bs_type                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_type_trench                  IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jusu                         IN    OUT   NUMBER,
    p_chui_aek                     IN    OUT   NUMBER,
    p_gchui_aek                    IN    OUT   NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 주식매도내역 회계처리
--
    w_aek                          NUMBER;
    w_gaek                         NUMBER;

    ga_jasan_gb                    szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -- 주식거래내역의 주식매도내역
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                    /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                     /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                   /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                     /* _4- */
             , t1.type_trench                               /* _5- */
             , t1.bs_type                                   /* _6- */
             , t1.seq_no                                    /* _7- */
             , t1.offer_no                                  /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_jusu,0)               AS tr_jusu   /* _9- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_aek,0)                AS tr_aek    /* _10- */
             , NVL(t1.gyul_aek,0)              AS gyul_aek  /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.susu,0) + NVL(t1.tax,0)  AS susu      /* _12- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                  /* _13- */
             , t1.sudo_ymd                                  /* _14- */
             , t1.susu_tr_co_cd                             /* _15- */
             , t1.etf_jm_cd                                 /* _16- */
             , t1.rowid                                     /* _17- */
             , t2.danc_gb                                   /* _18- */
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
             , SJM0JJ t2  /* 주식종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd     = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd       = p_jm_cd
           AND t1.bs_type     = p_bs_type
           AND t1.type_trench = p_type_trench
           AND REGEXP_LIKE (t1.tr_cd,'^[K][2]|S42|F22')
           AND t2.jm_cd       = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_aek != 0 AND NVL (xx.gyul_aek,0) = 0 AND xx.tr_cd != 'F22' AND xx.susu_tr_co_cd NOT IN ('J000','JCOM')    then
            p_msg := xx.tr_cd || '-' || xx.tr_co_cd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-수수료 계산이 안됐습니다(proc0552).';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if  p_jusu = xx.tr_jusu then
            w_aek  := p_chui_aek;
            w_gaek := p_gchui_aek;
        else
            w_aek  := TRUNC  (p_chui_aek  * (NVL(xx.tr_jusu,0) / p_jusu));
            w_gaek := TRUNC  (p_gchui_aek * (NVL(xx.tr_jusu,0) / p_jusu));
        end if;
        p_chui_aek  := p_chui_aek  - w_aek;
        p_gchui_aek := p_gchui_aek - w_gaek;
        p_jusu      := p_jusu      - NVL  (xx.tr_jusu,0);

        -- 매도원가 update
        UPDATE SJT0JG tt    /* 주식거래 내역 */
           SET meib_chui_aek  = w_aek
             , gmeib_chui_aek = w_gaek
             , sudo_ymd       = xx.sudo_ymd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        if  xx.tr_cd = 'S42'        then    -- 대용증권처분
            if  xx.danc_gb = 'B'    then    ga_jasan_gb := '08';  -- 비상장
            elsif xx.danc_gb = 'C'  then    ga_jasan_gb := '09';  -- 등록
            elsif xx.danc_gb = 'D'  then    ga_jasan_gb := '10';  -- 코넥스
            elsif xx.danc_gb = 'G'  then    ga_jasan_gb := '11';  -- 주식ETN
            else                            ga_jasan_gb := '07';  /* 상장 */
            end if;

            SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', ga_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, xx.offer_no, xx.gyul_aek, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'proc0552', w_msg );
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then    -- 분개처리error
                p_msg := w_msg || '(' || xx.jm_cd || ')';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        elsif (xx.tr_ymd != xx.sudo_ymd) AND (xx.tr_cd != 'K27')    then
            SR_INSSD (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.type_trench, xx.bs_type, '%', xx.seq_no, 3, xx.sudo_ymd,
                      xx.tr_co_cd, xx.gyul_aek, xx.susu, xx.tr_jusu, xx.etf_jm_cd);
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 개별주식옵션 수도결제내역 생성
    for xx IN (
        SELECT tr_ymd                                        /* _1- */
             , tr_cd                                         /* _2- */
             , fund_cd                                       /* _3- */
             , jm_cd                                         /* _4- */
             , type_trench                                   /* _5- */
             , bs_type                                       /* _6- */
             , offer_no                                      /* _7- */
             , tr_co_cd                                      /* _8- */
             , sudo_ymd                                      /* _9- */
             , option_gb                                     /* _10- */
             , MIN(seq_no)                      AS seq_no    /* _11- */
             , SUM(gyul_aek)                    AS gyul_aek  /* _12- */
             , SUM(NVL(susu, 0) + NVL(tax, 0))  AS susu      /* _13- */
             , SUM(tr_jusu)                     AS tr_jusu   /* _14- */
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'K27'
         GROUP BY tr_ymd
                , tr_cd
                , fund_cd
                , jm_cd
                , type_trench
                , bs_type
                , offer_no
                , tr_co_cd
                , sudo_ymd
                , option_gb
    ) loop
        if NVL (xx.gyul_aek,0) = 0      then
            p_msg := xx.tr_cd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-' || xx.seq_no || '-' || xx.offer_no || '- 결제액을 확인바랍니다(sjhp031).';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if  xx.tr_ymd != xx.sudo_ymd    then
            -- 개별주식옵션 콜,풋매도
            if  xx.tr_cd = 'K27' AND xx.option_gb = 'C' then
                SELECT NVL(SUM(t2.aek), 0)
                  INTO w_aek
                  FROM SST0KS t1  /* 파생상품 수도결제 */
                     , SKT0BU t2  /* 분개장 */
                     , SSX0KJ t3  /* 파생종목 */
                     , SZX0GR t4  /* 그룹코드 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd      = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.currency     = 'KRW'
                   AND t1.sudo_ymd     = xx.tr_ymd
                   AND t2.corp_gr      = t1.corp_gr
                   AND t2.fund_cd      = t1.fund_cd
                   AND t2.tr_ymd       = t1.tr_ymd
                   AND t2.jm_cd        = t1.sj_cd
                   AND t2.tr_cd        = t1.tr_cd
                   AND t2.tr_cd        = 'S84'
                   AND t2.gwamok       = '12001'
                   AND t3.corp_gr      = t1.corp_gr
                   AND t3.sj_cd        = t1.sj_cd
                   AND t3.lsy_ymd      = t1.tr_ymd
                   AND t4.gr_cd        = 'A6'
                   AND t4.sebu_cd      = t3.jasan
                   AND t4.sebu_cd_efnm = xx.jm_cd;
                if  w_aek = 0   then
                    p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-개별주식콜매도 거래내역확인(sjhp031)';
                    RETURN;
                end if;

            elsif (xx.tr_cd='K27' AND xx.option_gb='P') then
                SELECT NVL(SUM(t2.aek), 0)
                  INTO w_aek
                  FROM SST0KS t1  /* 파생상품 수도결제 */
                     , SKT0BU t2  /* 분개장 */
                     , SSX0KJ t3  /* 파생종목 */
                     , SZX0GR t4  /* 그룹코드 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd      = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.currency     = 'KRW'
                   AND t1.sudo_ymd     = xx.tr_ymd
                   AND t2.corp_gr      = t1.corp_gr
                   AND t2.fund_cd      = t1.fund_cd
                   AND t2.tr_ymd       = t1.tr_ymd
                   AND t2.jm_cd        = t1.sj_cd
                   AND t2.tr_cd        = t1.tr_cd
                   AND t2.tr_cd        = 'S94'
                   AND t2.gwamok       = '12001'
                   AND t3.corp_gr      = t1.corp_gr
                   AND t3.sj_cd        = t1.sj_cd
                   AND t3.lsy_ymd      = t1.tr_ymd
                   AND t4.gr_cd        = 'A6'
                   AND t4.sebu_cd      = t3.jasan
                   AND t4.sebu_cd_efnm = xx.jm_cd;
                if  w_aek = 0   then
                    p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-개별주식풋매도 거래내역확인(sjhp031)';
                    RETURN;
                end if;
            else
                w_aek := 0;
            end if;

            SR_INSSD (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.type_trench, xx.bs_type, '%', xx.seq_no, 4, xx.sudo_ymd,
                      xx.tr_co_cd, w_aek, xx.susu, xx.tr_jusu, NULL);
        end if;
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0553 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_bs_type                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_type_trench                  IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jusu                         IN    OUT   NUMBER,
    p_chui_aek                     IN    OUT   NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 주식매수청구권행사 회계처리
--
    w_aek                          NUMBER;

    w_danc_gb                      sjx0jb.sosok_gb%type;
    w_jasan_gb                     szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    BEGIN
        SELECT danc_gb
          INTO w_danc_gb
          FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
         WHERE jm_cd = p_jm_cd;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := p_jm_cd || ' - 주식매수청구권행사 종목이 없습니다.';
        RETURN;
    END;
    if  w_danc_gb = 'B'     then    w_jasan_gb := '01';  -- 비상장
    elsif w_danc_gb = 'C'   then    w_jasan_gb := '02';  -- 등록
    elsif w_danc_gb = 'D'   then    w_jasan_gb := '03';  -- 코넥스
    elsif w_danc_gb = 'G'   then    w_jasan_gb := '04';  -- 주식ETN
    else                            w_jasan_gb := '00';  /* 상장 */
    end if;

    -- 청약내역의 주식매수청구권행사 내역
    for xx IN (
        SELECT tr_ymd        /* _1- */
             , tr_cd         /* _2- */
             , fund_cd       /* _3- */
             , jm_cd         /* _4- */
             , cheng_jusu    /* _5- */
             , danga         /* _6- */
             , cheng_aek     /* _7- */
             , kra_jusu      /* _8- */
             , kra_chui_aek  /* _9- */
             , ROWID         /* _10- */
          FROM SJT0CY t1  /* 주식청약내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd     = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd       = p_jm_cd
           AND t1.tr_cd       = 'F65'
           AND t1.bs_type     = p_bs_type
           AND t1.type_trench = p_type_trench
    ) loop
        if  xx.kra_jusu > 0 then
            p_chui_aek := p_chui_aek - xx.kra_chui_aek;
            p_jusu     := p_jusu     - xx.kra_jusu;

            -- 매도원가 update
            UPDATE SJT0CY ff    /* 주식청약내역 */
               SET avg_danga = xx.kra_chui_aek
                 , sury_ymd  = p_ymd
                 , sury_jusu = xx.kra_jusu
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

            SR_SZSL010( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '10', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.cheng_aek, p_proc_step, 'proc0553', w_msg );
        else
            w_aek      := p_chui_aek * (NVL(xx.cheng_jusu,0) / p_jusu);
            p_chui_aek := p_chui_aek - w_aek;
            p_jusu     := p_jusu     - NVL  (xx.cheng_jusu,0);

            -- 매도원가 update
            UPDATE SJT0CY ff    /* 주식청약내역 */
               SET avg_danga = w_aek
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

            SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.cheng_aek, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'proc0553', w_msg );
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then    -- 분개처리error
            p_msg := w_msg || '(' || xx.jm_cd || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0554 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_bs_type                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_type_trench                  IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jusu                         IN    OUT   NUMBER,
    p_chui_aek                     IN    OUT   NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 공개매수확정 회계처리
--
    w_aek                          NUMBER;

    w_jasan_gb                     szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;
    w_danc_gb                      sjx0jb.sosok_gb%type;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    BEGIN
        SELECT danc_gb
          INTO w_danc_gb
          FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
         WHERE jm_cd = p_jm_cd;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := p_jm_cd || ' - 공개매수확정 종목이 없습니다.';
        RETURN;
    END;
    if  w_danc_gb = 'B'     then    w_jasan_gb := '01';  -- 비상장
    elsif w_danc_gb = 'C'   then    w_jasan_gb := '02';  -- 등록
    elsif w_danc_gb = 'D'   then    w_jasan_gb := '03';  -- 코넥스
    elsif w_danc_gb = 'G'   then    w_jasan_gb := '04';  -- 주식ETN
    else                            w_jasan_gb := '00';  /* 상장 */
    end if;

    -- 펀드/종목별 수탁사 수령내역의 공개매수 확정 내역
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                              /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                               /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                             /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                               /* _4- */
             , t1.sury_aek                               AS jusu      /* _5- */
             , TRUNC(sury_aek * danga * (1 - sebu_num))  AS sury_aek  /* _6- */
             , t1.rowid                                               /* _7- */
          FROM SZX0GR t2  /* 그룹코드 */
             , SJT0FS t1  /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
         WHERE t2.gr_cd       = '95'
           AND t2.sebu_cd     = '02'
           AND t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd     = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd       = p_jm_cd
           AND t1.tr_cd       = 'F42'
           AND t1.bs_type     = p_bs_type
           AND t1.type_trench = p_type_trench
    ) loop
        w_aek      := TRUNC  (p_chui_aek * (NVL(xx.jusu,0) / p_jusu));
        p_chui_aek := p_chui_aek - w_aek;
        p_jusu     := p_jusu     - NVL  (xx.jusu,0);

        -- 매도원가 update
        UPDATE SJT0FS ff    /* 펀드별 종목별 수탁사 수령내역 */
           SET chui_aek = w_aek
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.sury_aek, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'proc0554', w_msg );
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then    -- 분개처리error
            p_msg := w_msg || '(' || xx.jm_cd || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/
