CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC055ETF (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 주식 ETF 처리
--
    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -- ETF 설정(환매)시 현금 해당액 분개
    -- 예탁원 LOAD 자료(합산)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd                                                     /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                   /* _2- */
             , NVL(t1.etf_jm_cd, t1.jm_cd)                   AS jm_cd       /* _3- */
             , jb.sosok_gb                                                  /* _4- */
             , MAX(t1.etf_cash_aek)                          AS cash_aek    /* _5- */
             , MAX(t1.etf_cash_hwakj)                        AS cash_hwakj  /* _6- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq         /* _7- */
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJM0JJ jj  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd                 IN ('J2A','K2A','J2E','K2E')
           AND t1.etf_hwakj_ymd         = p_ymd
           AND t1.upd_user IS NOT NULL
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
           AND jj.jm_cd                 = t1.etf_jm_cd
           AND jb.balh_co               = jj.balh_co
         GROUP BY t1.tr_cd
                , t1.fund_cd
                , NVL(t1.etf_jm_cd, t1.jm_cd)
                , jb.sosok_gb
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '1' || xx.sosok_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 2,
                    xx.cash_hwakj - xx.cash_aek, p_proc_step, 'proc055etf(' || xx.tr_cd || ')', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(' || xx.jm_cd || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;
    -- 입력 자료(개별)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd                                                     /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                   /* _2- */
             , NVL(t1.etf_jm_cd, t1.jm_cd)                   AS jm_cd       /* _3- */
             , jb.sosok_gb                                                  /* _4- */
             , t1.etf_cash_aek                               AS cash_aek    /* _5- */
             , t1.etf_cash_hwakj                             AS cash_hwakj  /* _6- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq         /* _7- */
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJM0JJ jj  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd                 IN ('J2A','K2A','J2E','K2E')
           AND t1.etf_hwakj_ymd         = p_ymd
           AND t1.upd_user IS NULL
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
           AND jj.jm_cd                 = t1.etf_jm_cd
           AND jb.balh_co               = jj.balh_co
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '1' || xx.sosok_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 3,
                    xx.cash_hwakj - xx.cash_aek, p_proc_step, 'proc055etf(' || xx.tr_cd || ')', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(' || xx.jm_cd || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- BA 조정금액 분개
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                                  /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                   /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                 /* _3- */
             , NVL(t1.etf_jm_cd, t1.jm_cd)                   AS jm_cd     /* _4- */
             , jb.sosok_gb                                                /* _5- */
             , MAX(t1.etf_cash_hwakj - t1.etf_cash_aek)      AS cash_aek  /* _6- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq       /* _7- */
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
             , SZM0IA t2  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJM0JJ jj  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd                 IN ('J2E','K2E')
           AND t1.sudo_ymd              = p_ymd
           AND t1.etf_hwakj_ymd         = F_OPEN_YMD(p_ymd,'-1')
           AND t2.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
           AND jj.jm_cd                 = t1.etf_jm_cd
           AND jb.balh_co               = jj.balh_co
         GROUP BY t1.tr_ymd, t1.tr_cd   , t1.fund_cd
                , NVL(t1.etf_jm_cd, t1.jm_cd), jb.sosok_gb
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '2' || xx.sosok_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 4,
                    xx.cash_aek, p_proc_step, 'proc055etf(' || xx.tr_cd || ')', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg || '(' || xx.jm_cd || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0560 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 선물/옵션 회계처리
--
    w_ikyong_ymd                   DATE;

    w_rowid                        ROWID;

    w_link_corp_gr                 VARCHAR (8);
    w_tr_cd                        VARCHAR (3);
    w_tr_gb                        VARCHAR (1);
    w_susu_tr_co_cd                VARCHAR (5);

    w_gyey_su                      NUMBER;
    w_tr_seq_no                    NUMBER;
    w_gyul_jisu                    NUMBER;
    w_day_jonga                    NUMBER;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0560', p_ymd || ' : 선물/SWAP/OTS 회계처리 초기화');

    -- 선물/SWAP/OTS 회계처리 분개내역 삭제
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B000', 'skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0bu.proc_step=56', '선물/SWAP/OTS 회계처리 분개내역(skt0bu) delete');

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND t1.proc_step = 56;

    BEGIN
        SELECT fund_cd || '-' || sj_cd || '-' || tr_co_cd || '- 반대매매 가능계약수를 초과했습니다.'
          INTO w_msg
          FROM SSM0KM t1  /* 파생 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND NVL(pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(up_gyey_su,0) - NVL(dw_gyey_su,0) < 0;

        p_msg := w_msg;
        RETURN;
    EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
        NULL;
    END;

    -- 선물마스타Table의 당일증감취득액 clear
    UPDATE SSM0KM t1    /* 파생 보유현황 */
       SET t1.up_chui_ga    = 0
         , t1.dw_chui_ga    = 0
         , t1.dang_mm_sonik = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    -- 수도결제 Table  delete
    DELETE FROM SST0KS t1   /* 파생상품 수도결제 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
       AND t1.tr_cd   != 'S65';

    -- 선물/옵션 전매/환매 거래내역 성성

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'SST0KT', p_ymd || ' : 선물/옵션 전매/환매 거래내역 성성');

    -- 선물/옵션 거래내역 삭제
    DELETE FROM SST0KT tt   /* 파생 거래내역 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd
       AND ip_user = 'PROC0560';

    -- 만기처리내역 삭제
    DELETE FROM SST0KT t1   /* 파생 거래내역 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
       AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('S13','S23','S73','S83','S93','SA3','S74','S84','S94','SA4');

    -- 선물/옵션 매수/매도내역으로 환매/전매 확인 생성
    for xx IN (
        SELECT fund_cd        /* _1- */
             , tr_cd          /* _2- */
             , sj_cd          /* _3- */
             , chasu          /* _4- */
             , tr_seq_no      /* _5- */
             , gyey_su        /* _6- */
             , gyey_jisu      /* _7- */
             , gyey_aek       /* _8- */
             , tr_co_cd       /* _9- */
             , susu_tr_co_cd  /* _10- */
          FROM SST1KT t1  /* 파생거래 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
         ORDER BY tr_co_cd
                , fund_cd
                , sj_cd
                , tr_cd DESC
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'S10'    then    -- 매수선물
            w_tr_gb := '2';
            w_tr_cd := 'S21';  /* 환매약정 */

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'S20'  then    -- 매도선물
            w_tr_gb := '1';
            w_tr_cd := 'S11';  /* 전매약정 */

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'S70'  then    -- 콜매수
            w_tr_gb := '4';
            w_tr_cd := 'S81';  /* 콜환매 */

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'S80'  then    -- 콜매도
            w_tr_gb := '3';
            w_tr_cd := 'S71';  /* 콜전매 */

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'S90'  then    -- 풋매수
            w_tr_gb := '6';
            w_tr_cd := 'SA1';  /* 풋환매 */

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'SA0'  then    -- 풋매도
            w_tr_gb := '5';
            w_tr_cd := 'S91';  /* 풋전매 */
        else
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '_' || xx.tr_cd || '-선물거래 코드를 확인하십시오.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(up_gyey_su,0) - NVL(dw_gyey_su,0)
              INTO w_gyey_su
              FROM SSM0KM t1  /* 파생 보유현황 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.sj_cd    = xx.sj_cd
               AND t1.tr_co_cd = xx.tr_co_cd
               AND t1.sm_tr_gb = w_tr_gb
               AND t1.chasu    = xx.chasu;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_gyey_su := 0;
        END;
        if  w_gyey_su = 0   then
            INSERT INTO SST0KT tt   /* 파생 거래내역 */
                 ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd         /* _2- */
                 , fund_cd        /* _3- */
                 , tr_cd          /* _4- */
                 , sj_cd          /* _5- */
                 , chasu          /* _6- */
                 , tr_seq_no      /* _7- */
                 , gyey_su        /* _8- */
                 , gyey_jisu      /* _9- */
                 , gyey_aek       /* _10- */
                 , tr_co_cd       /* _11- */
                 , susu_tr_co_cd  /* _12- */
                 , ip_user        /* _13- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _3- */
                   , xx.tr_cd          /* _4- */
                   , xx.sj_cd          /* _5- */
                   , xx.chasu          /* _6- */
                   , xx.tr_seq_no      /* _7- */
                   , xx.gyey_su        /* _8- */
                   , xx.gyey_jisu      /* _9- */
                   , xx.gyey_aek       /* _10- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd       /* _11- */
                   , xx.susu_tr_co_cd  /* _12- */
                   , 'PROC0560'        /* _13- */
                   );

        elsif w_gyey_su >= xx.gyey_su   then
            INSERT INTO SST0KT tt   /* 파생 거래내역 */
                 ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd         /* _2- */
                 , fund_cd        /* _3- */
                 , tr_cd          /* _4- */
                 , sj_cd          /* _5- */
                 , chasu          /* _6- */
                 , tr_seq_no      /* _7- */
                 , gyey_su        /* _8- */
                 , gyey_jisu      /* _9- */
                 , gyey_aek       /* _10- */
                 , tr_co_cd       /* _11- */
                 , susu_tr_co_cd  /* _12- */
                 , ip_user        /* _13- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _3- */
                   , w_tr_cd           /* _4- */
                   , xx.sj_cd          /* _5- */
                   , xx.chasu          /* _6- */
                   , xx.tr_seq_no      /* _7- */
                   , xx.gyey_su        /* _8- */
                   , xx.gyey_jisu      /* _9- */
                   , xx.gyey_aek       /* _10- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd       /* _11- */
                   , xx.susu_tr_co_cd  /* _12- */
                   , 'PROC0560'        /* _13- */
                   );
        else
            INSERT INTO SST0KT tt   /* 파생 거래내역 */
                 ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd         /* _2- */
                 , fund_cd        /* _3- */
                 , tr_cd          /* _4- */
                 , sj_cd          /* _5- */
                 , chasu          /* _6- */
                 , tr_seq_no      /* _7- */
                 , gyey_su        /* _8- */
                 , gyey_jisu      /* _9- */
                 , gyey_aek       /* _10- */
                 , tr_co_cd       /* _11- */
                 , susu_tr_co_cd  /* _12- */
                 , ip_user        /* _13- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                            /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                                                /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                                           /* _3- */
                   , xx.tr_cd                                             /* _4- */
                   , xx.sj_cd                                             /* _5- */
                   , xx.chasu                                             /* _6- */
                   , xx.tr_seq_no                                         /* _7- */
                   , xx.gyey_su - w_gyey_su                               /* _8- */
                   , xx.gyey_jisu                                         /* _9- */
                   , xx.gyey_aek / xx.gyey_su * (xx.gyey_su - w_gyey_su)  /* _10- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd                                          /* _11- */
                   , xx.susu_tr_co_cd                                     /* _12- */
                   , 'PROC0560'                                           /* _13- */
                   );

            INSERT INTO SST0KT tt   /* 파생 거래내역 */
                 ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd         /* _2- */
                 , fund_cd        /* _3- */
                 , tr_cd          /* _4- */
                 , sj_cd          /* _5- */
                 , chasu          /* _6- */
                 , tr_seq_no      /* _7- */
                 , gyey_su        /* _8- */
                 , gyey_jisu      /* _9- */
                 , gyey_aek       /* _10- */
                 , tr_co_cd       /* _11- */
                 , susu_tr_co_cd  /* _12- */
                 , ip_user        /* _13- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                            /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                                                                /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                                                           /* _3- */
                   , w_tr_cd                                                              /* _4- */
                   , xx.sj_cd                                                             /* _5- */
                   , xx.chasu                                                             /* _6- */
                   , xx.tr_seq_no                                                         /* _7- */
                   , w_gyey_su                                                            /* _8- */
                   , xx.gyey_jisu                                                         /* _9- */
                   , xx.gyey_aek - (xx.gyey_aek / xx.gyey_su * (xx.gyey_su - w_gyey_su))  /* _10- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd                                                          /* _11- */
                   , xx.susu_tr_co_cd                                                     /* _12- */
                   , 'PROC0560'                                                           /* _13- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B030', 'PROC0560_SYT1MG', '해외 파생거래 생성');

    SR_PROC0560_SYT1MG (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_msg);
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := 'PROC0560_SYT1MG' || w_msg;  /* 해외 선물옵션 거래 생성오류 */
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 선물 최종결제/옵션 권리행사 처리
    -- 선물최종결제(채권의 경우는 최종결제일 전일 지수로 처리함)
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'SSX0KJ', p_ymd || ' : 선물 최종결제/옵션 권리행사 처리');

    BEGIN
        SELECT 'gyul'
          INTO w_msg
          FROM SSX0KJ t1  /* 파생종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND ((jasan != 'XX' AND lsy_ymd=p_ymd) OR (jasan='XX' AND lsy_ymd - 1=p_ymd))
           AND ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
        p_msg := 'Y';
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- 이전작업자료 삭제(선물거래테이블)
    DELETE FROM SST0KT t1   /* 파생 거래내역 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
       AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('S13','S23','S73','S83','S93','SA3','S74','S84','S94','SA4');

    SELECT NVL(MAX(tr_seq_no),0)
      INTO w_tr_seq_no
      FROM SST0KT t1  /* 파생 거래내역 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd;

    -- 거래생성 처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.ymd           /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd       /* _2- */
             , t1.sj_cd         /* _3- */
             , t1.chasu         /* _4- */
             , t1.sm_tr_gb      /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd      /* _6- */
             , t1.pass_gyey_su  /* _7- */
             , t1.up_gyey_su    /* _8- */
             , t1.dw_gyey_su    /* _9- */
             , t3.hangsa_ga     /* _10- */
             , t3.sj_gb         /* _11- */
             , t3.jasan         /* _12- */
             , t3.koscom_cd     /* _13- */
          FROM SSX0KJ t3  /* 파생종목 */
             , SSM0KM t1  /* 파생 보유현황 */
         WHERE t3.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t3.lsy_ymd = p_ymd
           AND t3.jasan   != 'XX'
           AND t1.corp_gr = t3.corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.sj_cd   = t3.sj_cd
           AND NVL(t1.pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(t1.up_gyey_su,0) != 0
        UNION ALL
        SELECT t1.ymd           /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd       /* _2- */
             , t1.sj_cd         /* _3- */
             , t1.chasu         /* _4- */
             , t1.sm_tr_gb      /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd      /* _6- */
             , t1.pass_gyey_su  /* _7- */
             , t1.up_gyey_su    /* _8- */
             , t1.dw_gyey_su    /* _9- */
             , t3.hangsa_ga     /* _10- */
             , t3.sj_gb         /* _11- */
             , t3.jasan         /* _12- */
             , t3.koscom_cd     /* _13- */
          FROM SSX0KJ t3  /* 파생종목 */
             , SSM0KM t1  /* 파생 보유현황 */
         WHERE t3.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t3.jasan         = 'XX'
           AND (t3.lsy_ymd - 1) = p_ymd
           AND t1.corp_gr       = t3.corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.sj_cd         = t3.sj_cd
           AND NVL(t1.pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(t1.up_gyey_su,0) != 0
    ) loop
        -- 결제가격
        if  xx.koscom_cd IS NOT NULL    then    -- 개별 주식옵션
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL(t1.close,0)
                  INTO w_gyul_jisu
                  FROM SJT1TG t1  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
                 WHERE t1.ymd       = F_TRADE_YMD(p_ymd,'-')
                   AND t1.koscom_cd = xx.koscom_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
                w_gyul_jisu := 0;
            END;
            if  w_gyul_jisu = 0 then
                p_msg := xx.sj_cd || '-' || xx.koscom_cd || '- 개별주식옵션 결제가격을 확인(#1042 SJT1TG)하십시요.';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        else
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL(CLOSE,0)
                  INTO w_gyul_jisu
                  FROM SSX0KJ t1  /* 파생종목 */
                     , SJT1TG tg  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.sj_gb     = '0'
                   AND t1.jasan     = xx.jasan
                   AND tg.ymd       = F_TRADE_YMD(p_ymd,'-')
                   AND tg.koscom_cd = t1.sj_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
                w_gyul_jisu := 0;
            END;
            if  w_gyul_jisu = 0 then
                w_gyul_jisu := 1390;
--                p_msg   := '펀드: ' || xx.fund_cd || ' 종목: ' || xx.sj_cd || ' 자산 : ' || xx.jasan
--                                    || '-결제가격이 등록되어(#1042 SJT1TG) 있지 않습니다.';
--                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 수수료 적용코드
        w_susu_tr_co_cd := NULL;

        BEGIN
            SELECT CASE WHEN INSTR('12', xx.sm_tr_gb)=0
                        THEN sebu_cd_efnm
                        ELSE sebu_cd_enm END
              INTO w_susu_tr_co_cd
              FROM SZX1GR t1  /* 회사별 그룹코드 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.gr_cd   = 'PP'
               AND t1.sebu_cd = SUBSTR(xx.tr_co_cd,1,5);
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;
        if  w_susu_tr_co_cd IS NULL then
            p_msg := SUBSTR  (xx.tr_co_cd,1,5) || '- (szx1gr.PP 3024화면)최종결제 수수료율을 등록하십시오.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        /* 거래코드 생성 처리 */
        if  xx.sm_tr_gb = '1'   then    w_tr_cd := 'S13';  -- 매입선물 최종결제
        elsif xx.sm_tr_gb = '2' then    w_tr_cd := 'S23';  -- 매도선물 최종결제
        elsif xx.sm_tr_gb = '3' then
            if  xx.jasan IN ('01','09') then
                    w_tr_cd := 'S73';  /* 콜매입 권리행사 */
            else    w_tr_cd := 'S74';  /* 개별옵션콜 권리행사 */
            end if;
        elsif xx.sm_tr_gb = '4' then
            if  xx.jasan IN ('01','09') then
                    w_tr_cd := 'S83';  /* 콜매도 의무이행 */
            else    w_tr_cd := 'S84';  /* 개별옵션콜 의무이행 */
            end if;
        elsif xx.sm_tr_gb = '5' then
            if  xx.jasan IN ('01','09') then
                    w_tr_cd := 'S93';  /* 풋매입 권리행사 */
            else    w_tr_cd := 'S94';  /* 개별옵션풋 권리행사 */
            end if;
        elsif xx.sm_tr_gb = '6' then
            if  xx.jasan IN ('01','09') then
                    w_tr_cd := 'SA3';  /* 풋매도 의무이행 */
            else    w_tr_cd := 'SA4';  /* 개별옵션풋 의무이행 */
            end if;
        else
            p_msg := xx.sj_cd || '- 선물옵션 구분이 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 계약수, 거래순번 및  처리 flag 생성
        w_gyey_su   := xx.pass_gyey_su + xx.up_gyey_su - xx.dw_gyey_su;
        w_tr_seq_no := w_tr_seq_no + 1;

        if  xx.sm_tr_gb IN ('1','2')    then    w_day_jonga := w_gyul_jisu;
        else
            if  xx.sm_tr_gb IN ('3','4')    then
                    w_day_jonga := w_gyul_jisu - xx.hangsa_ga;
            else    w_day_jonga := xx.hangsa_ga - w_gyul_jisu;
            end if;
            if  w_day_jonga < 0 then    w_day_jonga := 0;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 선물거래 Table Insert
        SR_INSKT2 (p_corp_gr, xx.ymd, xx.fund_cd, w_tr_cd, xx.sj_cd, xx.chasu, w_tr_seq_no,
                   w_gyey_su, w_day_jonga, xx.tr_co_cd, w_susu_tr_co_cd, 'n', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;  /* 선물옵션 최종결제 거래 생성오류 */
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := 'PROC0560:' || SUBSTR  (sqlerrm, 1, 180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0560_SYT1MG (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 해외 선물/옵션 전매/환매 거래내역 성성
--
    w_tr_cd                        VARCHAR(3);
    w_tr_gb                        VARCHAR(1);
    w_sm_tr_gb                     VARCHAR(1);

    w_gyey_su                      NUMBER;

    w_bf_count                     NUMBER;
    w_buy_jusu                     NUMBER;
    w_sell_jusu                    NUMBER;
    w_tr_susu                      NUMBER;
    w_tr_jusu                      NUMBER;

    w_gyulje_jm_cd                 SYT0MG.GYULJE_JM_CD%TYPE;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'PROC0560_SYT1MG', p_ymd || '-56 : 해외 선물/옵션 전매/환매 거래내역 성성');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'SYT1MG', 'SYT1MG : ' || p_ymd || ' : 해외선물/옵션 이동평균 전매/환매 거래내역 성성');

    -- 해외파생 매매잔고 확인을 위한 작업
    INSERT INTO SYM0YZ_FIFO
    SELECT fund_cd              /* _1- */
         , jm_cd                /* _2- */
         , trustee              /* _3- */
         , currency             /* _4- */
         , sm_tr_gb             /* _5- */
         , NVL(tr_bfil_jusu,0)  /* _6- */
         , 0                    /* _7- */
         , 0                    /* _8- */
      FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd IN (SELECT fund_cd
                            FROM SYT1MG ta  /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
                           WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                             AND ta.tr_ymd  = p_ymd)
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    -- 해외 선물/옵션 거래내역 삭제
    DELETE FROM SYT0MG /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
     WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd   = p_ymd
       AND upd_user = 'SYT1MG';

    -- 해외 만기처리내역 삭제
    DELETE FROM SYT0MG t1   /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
       AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('S13','S23','S73','S83','S93','SA3','S74','S84','S94','SA4');

    -- 해외 선물/옵션 매수/매도내역으로 환매/전매 확인 생성
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.TR_CD                            /* _1- */
             , t1.FUND_CD                          /* _2- */
             , t1.TR_CO_CD                         /* _3- */
             , t1.TRUSTEE                          /* _4- */
             , t1.JM_CD                            /* _5- */
             , t1.CURRENCY                         /* _6- */
             , t1.TR_SEQ                           /* _7- */
             , t1.TR_JUSU                          /* _8- */
             , t1.TR_DANGA                         /* _9- */
             , t1.TR_COST                          /* _10- */
             , t1.TR_AEK * ya.UNIT_AEK  AS tr_aek  /* _11- */
             , t1.GYULJE_YMD                       /* _12- */
             , t1.GYULJE_JM_CD                     /* _13- */
             , t1.TRANS_RT                         /* _14- */
             , ia.fund_currency                    /* _15- */
          FROM SYT1MG t1  /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('S10','S20','S70','S80','S90','SA0')
           AND ya.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_co_cd, t1.fund_cd
                , t1.TRUSTEE , t1.jm_cd  , t1.tr_cd DESC
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT sebu_cd_enm
              INTO w_sm_tr_gb
              FROM SZX0GR t1  /* 그룹코드 */
             WHERE t1.gr_cd   = 'B4'
               AND t1.sebu_cd = xx.tr_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.tr_cd || '-그룹코드 등록(9202 szx0gr:B4)';
            RETURN;
        END;

        if  xx.tr_cd = 'S10'    then    -- 매수선물
            w_tr_gb := '2';
            w_tr_cd := 'S21';  -- 환매약정

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'S20'  then    -- 매도선물
            w_tr_gb := '1';
            w_tr_cd := 'S11';  -- 전매약정

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'S70'  then    -- 콜매수
            w_tr_gb := '4';
            w_tr_cd := 'S81';  -- 콜환매

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'S80'  then    -- 콜매도
            w_tr_gb := '3';
            w_tr_cd := 'S71';  -- 콜전매

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'S90'  then    -- 풋매수
            w_tr_gb := '6';
            w_tr_cd := 'SA1';  -- 풋환매

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'SA0'  then    -- 풋매도
            w_tr_gb := '5';
            w_tr_cd := 'S91';  -- 풋전매
        else
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '_' || xx.tr_cd || ' - 파생거래 코드를 확인하십시오.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0)
              INTO w_gyey_su
              FROM SYM0YZ_FIFO t1
             WHERE t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.currency = xx.currency
               AND t1.trustee  = xx.trustee
               AND t1.sm_tr_gb = w_tr_gb;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_gyey_su := 0;
        END;

        if  w_gyey_su = 0   then
            UPDATE SYM0YZ_FIFO
               SET tr_up_jusu = NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) + xx.tr_jusu
             WHERE fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND trustee  = xx.trustee
               AND currency = xx.currency
               AND sm_tr_gb = w_sm_tr_gb;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
                INSERT INTO SYM0YZ_FIFO
                VALUES ( xx.fund_cd   /* _1- */
                       , xx.jm_cd     /* _2- */
                       , xx.trustee   /* _3- */
                       , xx.currency  /* _4- */
                       , w_sm_tr_gb   /* _5- */
                       , 0            /* _6- */
                       , xx.tr_jusu   /* _7- */
                       , 0            /* _8- */
                       );
            end if;

            INSERT INTO SYT0MG /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
                 ( corp_gr       /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd        /* _2- */
                 , tr_cd         /* _3- */
                 , fund_cd       /* _4- */
                 , tr_co_cd      /* _5- */
                 , trustee       /* _6- */
                 , jm_cd         /* _7- */
                 , currency      /* _8- */
                 , tr_seq        /* _9- */
                 , tr_jusu       /* _10- */
                 , tr_danga      /* _11- */
                 , tr_cost       /* _12- */
                 , tr_aek        /* _13- */
                 , gyulje_ymd    /* _14- */
                 , gyulje_jm_cd  /* _15- */
                 , trans_rt      /* _16- */
                 , upd_user      /* _17- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd            /* _2- */
                   , xx.tr_cd         /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd       /* _4- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd      /* _5- */
                   , xx.trustee       /* _6- */
                   , xx.jm_cd         /* _7- */
                   , xx.currency      /* _8- */
                   , xx.tr_seq        /* _9- */
                   , xx.tr_jusu       /* _10- */
                   , xx.tr_danga      /* _11- */
                   , xx.tr_cost       /* _12- */
                   , xx.tr_aek        /* _13- */
                   , xx.gyulje_ymd    /* _14- */
                   , xx.gyulje_jm_cd  /* _15- */
                   , xx.trans_rt      /* _16- */
                   , 'SYT1MG'         /* _17- */
                   );

        elsif w_gyey_su >= xx.tr_jusu   then
            UPDATE SYM0YZ_FIFO
               SET tr_dw_jusu = NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0) + xx.tr_jusu
             WHERE fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND trustee  = xx.trustee
               AND currency = xx.currency
               AND sm_tr_gb = w_tr_gb;

            INSERT INTO SYT0MG /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
                 ( corp_gr       /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd        /* _2- */
                 , tr_cd         /* _3- */
                 , fund_cd       /* _4- */
                 , tr_co_cd      /* _5- */
                 , trustee       /* _6- */
                 , jm_cd         /* _7- */
                 , currency      /* _8- */
                 , tr_seq        /* _9- */
                 , tr_jusu       /* _10- */
                 , tr_danga      /* _11- */
                 , tr_cost       /* _12- */
                 , tr_aek        /* _13- */
                 , gyulje_ymd    /* _14- */
                 , gyulje_jm_cd  /* _15- */
                 , trans_rt      /* _16- */
                 , upd_user      /* _17- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd            /* _2- */
                   , w_tr_cd          /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd       /* _4- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd      /* _5- */
                   , xx.trustee       /* _6- */
                   , xx.jm_cd         /* _7- */
                   , xx.currency      /* _8- */
                   , xx.tr_seq        /* _9- */
                   , xx.tr_jusu       /* _10- */
                   , xx.tr_danga      /* _11- */
                   , xx.tr_cost       /* _12- */
                   , xx.tr_aek        /* _13- */
                   , xx.gyulje_ymd    /* _14- */
                   , xx.gyulje_jm_cd  /* _15- */
                   , xx.trans_rt      /* _16- */
                   , 'SYT1MG'         /* _17- */
                   );
        else
            UPDATE SYM0YZ_FIFO
               SET tr_up_jusu = NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) + (xx.tr_jusu - w_gyey_su)
             WHERE fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND trustee  = xx.trustee
               AND currency = xx.currency
               AND sm_tr_gb = w_sm_tr_gb;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
                INSERT INTO SYM0YZ_FIFO
                VALUES ( xx.fund_cd              /* _1- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                /* _2- */
                       , xx.trustee              /* _3- */
                       , xx.currency             /* _4- */
                       , w_sm_tr_gb              /* _5- */
                       , 0                       /* _6- */
                       , xx.tr_jusu - w_gyey_su  /* _7- */
                       , 0                       /* _8- */
                       );
            end if;

            UPDATE SYM0YZ_FIFO
               SET tr_dw_jusu = NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0) + w_gyey_su
             WHERE fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND trustee  = xx.trustee
               AND currency = xx.currency
               AND sm_tr_gb = w_tr_gb;

            INSERT INTO SYT0MG /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
                 ( corp_gr       /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd        /* _2- */
                 , tr_cd         /* _3- */
                 , fund_cd       /* _4- */
                 , tr_co_cd      /* _5- */
                 , trustee       /* _6- */
                 , jm_cd         /* _7- */
                 , currency      /* _8- */
                 , tr_seq        /* _9- */
                 , tr_jusu       /* _10- */
                 , tr_danga      /* _11- */
                 , tr_cost       /* _12- */
                 , tr_aek        /* _13- */
                 , gyulje_ymd    /* _14- */
                 , gyulje_jm_cd  /* _15- */
                 , trans_rt      /* _16- */
                 , upd_user      /* _17- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                           /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                                               /* _2- */
                   , xx.tr_cd                                            /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                                          /* _4- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd                                         /* _5- */
                   , xx.trustee                                          /* _6- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                                            /* _7- */
                   , xx.currency                                         /* _8- */
                   , xx.tr_seq                                           /* _9- */
                   , xx.tr_jusu - w_gyey_su                              /* _10- */
                   , xx.tr_danga                                         /* _11- */
                   , xx.tr_cost / xx.tr_jusu * (xx.tr_jusu - w_gyey_su)  /* _12- */
                   , xx.tr_aek / xx.tr_jusu * (xx.tr_jusu - w_gyey_su)   /* _13- */
                   , xx.gyulje_ymd                                       /* _14- */
                   , xx.gyulje_jm_cd                                     /* _15- */
                   , xx.trans_rt                                         /* _16- */
                   , 'SYT1MG'                                            /* _17- */
                   );

            INSERT INTO SYT0MG /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
                 ( corp_gr       /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd        /* _2- */
                 , tr_cd         /* _3- */
                 , fund_cd       /* _4- */
                 , tr_co_cd      /* _5- */
                 , trustee       /* _6- */
                 , jm_cd         /* _7- */
                 , currency      /* _8- */
                 , tr_seq        /* _9- */
                 , tr_jusu       /* _10- */
                 , tr_danga      /* _11- */
                 , tr_cost       /* _12- */
                 , tr_aek        /* _13- */
                 , gyulje_ymd    /* _14- */
                 , gyulje_jm_cd  /* _15- */
                 , trans_rt      /* _16- */
                 , upd_user      /* _17- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                          /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                                                              /* _2- */
                   , w_tr_cd                                                            /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                                                         /* _4- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd                                                        /* _5- */
                   , xx.trustee                                                         /* _6- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                                                           /* _7- */
                   , xx.currency                                                        /* _8- */
                   , xx.tr_seq                                                          /* _9- */
                   , w_gyey_su                                                          /* _10- */
                   , xx.tr_danga                                                        /* _11- */
                   , xx.tr_cost - (xx.tr_cost / xx.tr_jusu * (xx.tr_jusu - w_gyey_su))  /* _12- */
                   , xx.tr_aek - (xx.tr_aek / xx.tr_jusu * (xx.tr_jusu - w_gyey_su))    /* _13- */
                   , xx.gyulje_ymd                                                      /* _14- */
                   , xx.gyulje_jm_cd                                                    /* _15- */
                   , xx.trans_rt                                                        /* _16- */
                   , 'SYT1MG'                                                           /* _17- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;
    commit;

    -- 해외선물/옵션 개별법 전매/환매 거래내역 성성
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'SYT1MG_EACH', 'SYT1MG_EACH : ' || p_ymd || ' : 해외선물/옵션 개별법 전매/환매 거래내역 성성');

    -- 해외선물 개별 FIFO 처리
    UPDATE SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
       SET counter_trade_buy  = 0
         , counter_trade_sell = 0
         , counter_trade_aek  = 0
         , balance_jusu       = NVL(buy_jusu,0) + NVL(sell_jusu,0)
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd;

    -- 전일 개별잔고 이월처리
    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO w_bf_count
      FROM SYT1MG_EACH t1  /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd       < p_ymd
       AND t1.balance_jusu > 0;

    if  w_bf_count > 0  then
        -- 전일 재처리 또는 당일 처음 작업시 전일 개별잔고 이월처리
        DELETE FROM SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
         WHERE corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND tr_ymd    = p_ymd
           AND jango_rec = 'Y';

        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
            SELECT t1.corp_gr                                                                            /* _1- */
                 , p_ymd                                                                                 /* _2- */
                 , t1.fund_cd                                                                            /* _3- */
                 , t1.tr_co_cd                                                                           /* _4- */
                 , t1.trustee                                                                            /* _5- */
                 , t1.jm_cd                                                                              /* _6- */
                 , t1.currency                                                                           /* _7- */
                 , t1.tr_seq                                                                             /* _8- */
                 , t1.tr_dt                                                                              /* _9- */
                 , CASE WHEN t1.buy_jusu=0  THEN 0 ELSE t1.balance_jusu
                   END                                                                                   /* _10- */
                 , CASE WHEN t1.sell_jusu=0 THEN 0 ELSE t1.balance_jusu
                   END                                                                                   /* _11- */
                 , tr_danga                                                                              /* _12- */
                 , 0                                                                                     /* _13- */
                 , t1.tr_aek - F_TRUNC (t1.tr_aek / (t1.buy_jusu + t1.sell_jusu)
                                         * (t1.buy_jusu + t1.sell_jusu - t1.balance_jusu), t1.currency)  /* _14- */
                 , balance_jusu                                                                          /* _15- */
                 , 0                                                                                     /* _16- */
                 , 0                                                                                     /* _17- */
                 , 0                                                                                     /* _18- */
                 , 'Y'                                                                                   /* _19- */
                 , NULL                                                                                  /* _20- */
              FROM SYT1MG_EACH t1  /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.tr_ymd       < p_ymd
               AND t1.balance_jusu > 0;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := 'ssup030_EACH: 재처리 또는 당일최초작업시 전일개별잔고이월처리' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,180);
                RETURN;
        END;

        -- 이월된 자료정리
        UPDATE SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
           SET balance_jusu = 0
         WHERE corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
           AND tr_ymd       < p_ymd
           AND balance_jusu > 0;
    end if;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid      /* _1- */
             , t1.FUND_CD    /* _2- */
             , t1.JM_CD      /* _3- */
             , t1.TR_CO_CD   /* _4- */
             , t1.CURRENCY   /* _5- */
             , t1.TR_DT      /* _6- */
             , t1.SELL_JUSU  /* _7- */
             , t1.BUY_JUSU   /* _8- */
          FROM SYT1MG_EACH t1  /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr            = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd             = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.jango_rec,'N') = 'N'
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.jm_cd
                , t1.tr_dt
                , t1.tr_seq
    ) loop
        w_buy_jusu  := NVL(xx.buy_jusu , 0);
        w_sell_jusu := NVL(xx.sell_jusu, 0);
        for rc IN (
            SELECT t1.rowid               /* _1- */
                 , t1.TR_AEK              /* _2- */
                 , t1.CURRENCY            /* _3- */
                 , t1.BALANCE_JUSU        /* _4- */
                 , t1.BUY_JUSU            /* _5- */
                 , t1.SELL_JUSU           /* _6- */
                 , t1.COUNTER_TRADE_BUY   /* _7- */
                 , t1.COUNTER_TRADE_SELL  /* _8- */
              FROM SYT1MG_EACH t1  /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd      = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd       = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd        = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.currency     = xx.currency
               AND t1.tr_co_cd     = xx.tr_co_cd
               AND t1.balance_jusu > 0
               AND t1.tr_dt        < xx.tr_dt
             ORDER BY t1.tr_dt
                    , t1.tr_seq
        ) loop
            if  w_buy_jusu > 0 AND rc.sell_jusu > 0 then
                if  rc.balance_jusu < w_buy_jusu    then
                    UPDATE SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
                       SET counter_trade_sell = counter_trade_sell + rc.balance_jusu
                         , counter_trade_aek  = counter_trade_aek + (rc.tr_aek - F_TRUNC (rc.tr_aek / rc.sell_jusu * (rc.sell_jusu - rc.balance_jusu), rc.currency))
                         , balance_jusu       = balance_jusu - rc.balance_jusu
                     WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

                    if  rc.counter_trade_buy > 0    then
                        UPDATE SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
                           SET balance_jusu = 0
                         WHERE ROWID = rc.rowid;
                    else
                        UPDATE SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
                           SET counter_trade_buy = rc.sell_jusu
                             , balance_jusu      = 0
                         WHERE ROWID = rc.rowid;
                    end if;

                    w_buy_jusu := w_buy_jusu - rc.balance_jusu;
                else
                    UPDATE SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
                       SET counter_trade_sell = counter_trade_sell + w_buy_jusu
                         , counter_trade_aek  = counter_trade_aek + F_TRUNC(rc.tr_aek / rc.sell_jusu * w_buy_jusu, rc.currency)
                         , balance_jusu       = balance_jusu - w_buy_jusu
                     WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

                    if  rc.counter_trade_buy > 0    then
                        UPDATE SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
                           SET balance_jusu = balance_jusu - w_buy_jusu
                         WHERE ROWID = rc.rowid;
                    else
                        UPDATE SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
                           SET counter_trade_buy = counter_trade_buy + w_buy_jusu
                             , balance_jusu      = balance_jusu - w_buy_jusu
                         WHERE ROWID = rc.rowid;
                    end if;

                    EXIT;
                end if;
            elsif w_sell_jusu > 0 AND rc.buy_jusu > 0   then
                if  rc.balance_jusu < w_sell_jusu       then
                    UPDATE SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
                       SET counter_trade_buy = counter_trade_buy + rc.balance_jusu
                         , counter_trade_aek = counter_trade_aek + (rc.tr_aek - F_TRUNC (rc.tr_aek / rc.buy_jusu * (rc.buy_jusu - rc.balance_jusu), rc.currency))
                         , balance_jusu      = balance_jusu - rc.balance_jusu
                     WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

                    if  rc.counter_trade_sell > 0   then
                        UPDATE SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
                           SET balance_jusu = 0
                         WHERE ROWID = rc.rowid;
                    else
                        UPDATE SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
                           SET counter_trade_sell = rc.buy_jusu
                             , balance_jusu       = 0
                         WHERE ROWID = rc.rowid;
                    end if;

                    w_sell_jusu := w_sell_jusu - rc.balance_jusu;
                else
                    UPDATE SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
                       SET counter_trade_buy = counter_trade_buy + w_sell_jusu
                         , counter_trade_aek = counter_trade_aek + F_TRUNC(rc.tr_aek / rc.buy_jusu * w_sell_jusu, rc.currency)
                         , balance_jusu      = balance_jusu - w_sell_jusu
                     WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

                    if  rc.counter_trade_sell > 0   then
                        UPDATE SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
                           SET balance_jusu = balance_jusu - w_sell_jusu
                         WHERE ROWID = rc.rowid;
                    else
                        UPDATE SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
                           SET counter_trade_sell = counter_trade_sell + w_sell_jusu
                             , balance_jusu       = balance_jusu - w_sell_jusu
                         WHERE ROWID = rc.rowid;
                    end if;

                    EXIT;
                end if;
            end if;
        end loop;
    end loop;

    -- 해외 선물/옵션 매수/매도내역으로 환매/전매 확인 생성

    DELETE FROM SYT0MG /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
     WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd   = p_ymd
       AND upd_user = 'SYT1MG_EACH';

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                 /* _1- */
             , t1.FUND_CD                               /* _2- */
             , t1.JM_CD                                 /* _3- */
             , t1.TRUSTEE                               /* _4- */
             , t1.TR_SEQ                                /* _5- */
             , t1.TR_CD                                 /* _6- */
             , t1.TR_CO_CD                              /* _7- */
             , t1.TR_AEK                                /* _8- */
             , t1.TR_DANGA                              /* _9- */
             , t1.TR_COST                               /* _10- */
             , t1.CURRENCY                              /* _11- */
             , t1.COUNTER_TRADE_AEK                     /* _12- */
             , t1.COUNTER_TRADE_BUY                     /* _13- */
             , t1.COUNTER_TRADE_SELL                    /* _14- */
             , t1.BUY_JUSU                              /* _15- */
             , t1.SELL_JUSU                             /* _16- */
             , ia.fund_currency                         /* _17- */
             , t1.buy_jusu + t1.sell_jusu  AS tr_jusu   /* _18- */
             , 0                           AS trans_rt  /* _19- */
             , ya.sj_gb                                 /* _20- */
             , ya.unit_aek                              /* _21- */
          FROM SYT1MG_EACH t1  /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
             , SYM0YA      ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             , SZM0IA      ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr            = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd             = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.jango_rec,'N') = 'N'
           AND ya.corp_gr            = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd              = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb           = 'A'
           AND ia.corp_gr            = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd            = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.jm_cd
                , t1.tr_dt
                , t1.tr_seq
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(gijun_rt,0)
              INTO xx.trans_rt
              FROM SYX0HY t1  /* (개별 환율이 없을경우)적용 환율 */
             WHERE gijun_ymd = p_ymd - 1
               AND currency  = xx.currency;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            xx.trans_rt := 0;
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT jm_cd
              INTO w_gyulje_jm_cd
              FROM SYM0YA t1  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.currency  = xx.currency
               AND t1.gyulje_jm = 'Y'
               AND t1.jasan_gb  = '5'
               AND p_ymd        BETWEEN balh_ymd AND sanghw_ymd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_gyulje_jm_cd := NULL;
        END;

        if  xx.counter_trade_aek = 0    then
            if  xx.buy_jusu > 0 then
                if  xx.sj_gb = '1'      then    xx.tr_cd := 'S10';  -- 매수선물
                elsif xx.sj_gb = '2'    then    xx.tr_cd := 'S70';  -- 콜매수
                elsif xx.sj_gb = '3'    then    xx.tr_cd := 'S90';  -- 풋매수
                end if;
            else
                if  xx.sj_gb = '1'      then    xx.tr_cd := 'S20';  -- 매도선물
                elsif xx.sj_gb = '2'    then    xx.tr_cd := 'S80';  -- 콜매도
                elsif xx.sj_gb = '3'    then    xx.tr_cd := 'SA0';  -- 풋매도
                end if;
            end if;

            if  xx.tr_cd = '***'    then
                p_msg := xx.fund_cd || ' - 상품을 확인 하십시오.';
                RETURN;
            end if;

            INSERT INTO SYT0MG /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
                 ( corp_gr       /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd        /* _2- */
                 , tr_cd         /* _3- */
                 , fund_cd       /* _4- */
                 , tr_co_cd      /* _5- */
                 , trustee       /* _6- */
                 , jm_cd         /* _7- */
                 , currency      /* _8- */
                 , tr_seq        /* _9- */
                 , tr_jusu       /* _10- */
                 , tr_danga      /* _11- */
                 , tr_cost       /* _12- */
                 , tr_aek        /* _13- */
                 , gyulje_ymd    /* _14- */
                 , gyulje_jm_cd  /* _15- */
                 , trans_rt      /* _16- */
                 , upd_user      /* _17- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                    /* _2- */
                   , xx.tr_cd                 /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd               /* _4- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd              /* _5- */
                   , xx.trustee               /* _6- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                 /* _7- */
                   , xx.currency              /* _8- */
                   , xx.tr_seq                /* _9- */
                   , xx.tr_jusu               /* _10- */
                   , xx.tr_danga              /* _11- */
                   , xx.tr_cost               /* _12- */
                   , xx.tr_aek * xx.unit_aek  /* _13- */
                   , p_ymd                    /* _14- */
                   , w_gyulje_jm_cd           /* _15- */
                   , xx.trans_rt              /* _16- */
                   , 'SYT1MG_EACH'            /* _17- */
                   );
        else
            w_tr_susu := 0;
            if  xx.buy_jusu > 0 then
                if  xx.buy_jusu != xx.counter_trade_sell    then
                    if  xx.sj_gb = '1'      then    xx.tr_cd := 'S10';  -- 매수선물
                    elsif xx.sj_gb = '2'    then    xx.tr_cd := 'S70';  -- 콜매수
                    elsif xx.sj_gb = '3'    then    xx.tr_cd := 'S90';  -- 풋매수
                    end if;

                    w_tr_jusu := xx.tr_jusu - xx.counter_trade_sell;
                    w_tr_susu := TRUNC (xx.tr_cost / xx.tr_jusu * w_tr_jusu);
                    INSERT INTO SYT0MG /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
                         ( corp_gr       /* _1- */
                         , tr_ymd        /* _2- */
                         , tr_cd         /* _3- */
                         , fund_cd       /* _4- */
                         , tr_co_cd      /* _5- */
                         , trustee       /* _6- */
                         , jm_cd         /* _7- */
                         , currency      /* _8- */
                         , tr_seq        /* _9- */
                         , tr_jusu       /* _10- */
                         , tr_danga      /* _11- */
                         , tr_cost       /* _12- */
                         , tr_aek        /* _13- */
                         , gyulje_ymd    /* _14- */
                         , gyulje_jm_cd  /* _15- */
                         , trans_rt      /* _16- */
                         , upd_user      /* _17- */
                         )
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr                              /* _1- */
                           , p_ymd                                  /* _2- */
                           , xx.tr_cd                               /* _3- */
                           , xx.fund_cd                             /* _4- */
                           , xx.tr_co_cd                            /* _5- */
                           , xx.trustee                             /* _6- */
                           , xx.jm_cd                               /* _7- */
                           , xx.currency                            /* _8- */
                           , xx.tr_seq                              /* _9- */
                           , w_tr_jusu                              /* _10- */
                           , xx.tr_danga                            /* _11- */
                           , w_tr_susu                              /* _12- */
                           , w_tr_jusu * xx.tr_danga * xx.unit_aek  /* _13- */
                           , p_ymd                                  /* _14- */
                           , w_gyulje_jm_cd                         /* _15- */
                           , xx.trans_rt                            /* _16- */
                           , 'SYT1MG_EACH'                          /* _17- */
                           );
                end if;

                w_tr_jusu := xx.counter_trade_sell;
                if  xx.sj_gb = '1'      then    xx.tr_cd := 'S21';  -- 환매도
                elsif xx.sj_gb = '2'    then    xx.tr_cd := 'S81';  -- 콜환매도
                elsif xx.sj_gb = '3'    then    xx.tr_cd := 'SA1';  -- 풋환매도
                else                            xx.tr_cd := '***';
                end if;
            else
                if  xx.sell_jusu != xx.counter_trade_buy    then
                    if  xx.sj_gb = '1'      then    xx.tr_cd := 'S20';  -- 매도선물
                    elsif xx.sj_gb = '2'    then    xx.tr_cd := 'S80';  -- 콜매도
                    elsif xx.sj_gb = '3'    then    xx.tr_cd := 'SA0';  -- 풋매도
                    end if;

                    w_tr_jusu := xx.tr_jusu - xx.counter_trade_buy;
                    w_tr_susu := TRUNC (xx.tr_cost / xx.tr_jusu * w_tr_jusu);
                    INSERT INTO SYT0MG /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
                         ( corp_gr       /* _1- */
                         , tr_ymd        /* _2- */
                         , tr_cd         /* _3- */
                         , fund_cd       /* _4- */
                         , tr_co_cd      /* _5- */
                         , trustee       /* _6- */
                         , jm_cd         /* _7- */
                         , currency      /* _8- */
                         , tr_seq        /* _9- */
                         , tr_jusu       /* _10- */
                         , tr_danga      /* _11- */
                         , tr_cost       /* _12- */
                         , tr_aek        /* _13- */
                         , gyulje_ymd    /* _14- */
                         , gyulje_jm_cd  /* _15- */
                         , trans_rt      /* _16- */
                         , upd_user      /* _17- */
                         )
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr                              /* _1- */
                           , p_ymd                                  /* _2- */
                           , xx.tr_cd                               /* _3- */
                           , xx.fund_cd                             /* _4- */
                           , xx.tr_co_cd                            /* _5- */
                           , xx.trustee                             /* _6- */
                           , xx.jm_cd                               /* _7- */
                           , xx.currency                            /* _8- */
                           , xx.tr_seq                              /* _9- */
                           , w_tr_jusu                              /* _10- */
                           , xx.tr_danga                            /* _11- */
                           , w_tr_susu                              /* _12- */
                           , w_tr_jusu * xx.tr_danga * xx.unit_aek  /* _13- */
                           , p_ymd                                  /* _14- */
                           , w_gyulje_jm_cd                         /* _15- */
                           , xx.trans_rt                            /* _16- */
                           , 'SYT1MG_EACH'                          /* _17- */
                           );
                end if;

                w_tr_jusu := xx.counter_trade_buy;
                if  xx.sj_gb = '1'      then    xx.tr_cd := 'S11';  -- 전매수
                elsif xx.sj_gb = '2'    then    xx.tr_cd := 'S71';  -- 콜전매수
                elsif xx.sj_gb = '3'    then    xx.tr_cd := 'S91';  -- 풋전매수
                else                            xx.tr_cd := '***';
                end if;
            end if;

            if  xx.tr_cd IS NULL    then
                p_msg := xx.fund_cd || ' - 상품을 확인 하십시오.';
                RETURN;
            end if;

            INSERT INTO SYT0MG /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
                 ( corp_gr       /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd        /* _2- */
                 , tr_cd         /* _3- */
                 , fund_cd       /* _4- */
                 , tr_co_cd      /* _5- */
                 , trustee       /* _6- */
                 , jm_cd         /* _7- */
                 , currency      /* _8- */
                 , tr_seq        /* _9- */
                 , tr_jusu       /* _10- */
                 , tr_danga      /* _11- */
                 , tr_cost       /* _12- */
                 , tr_aek        /* _13- */
                 , gyulje_ymd    /* _14- */
                 , gyulje_jm_cd  /* _15- */
                 , chui_aek      /* _16- */
                 , trans_rt      /* _17- */
                 , upd_user      /* _18- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                              /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                                  /* _2- */
                   , xx.tr_cd                               /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                             /* _4- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd                            /* _5- */
                   , xx.trustee                             /* _6- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                               /* _7- */
                   , xx.currency                            /* _8- */
                   , xx.tr_seq                              /* _9- */
                   , w_tr_jusu                              /* _10- */
                   , xx.tr_danga                            /* _11- */
                   , xx.tr_cost - w_tr_susu                 /* _12- */
                   , w_tr_jusu * xx.tr_danga * xx.unit_aek  /* _13- */
                   , p_ymd                                  /* _14- */
                   , w_gyulje_jm_cd                         /* _15- */
                   , xx.counter_trade_aek                   /* _16- */
                   , xx.trans_rt                            /* _17- */
                   , 'SYT1MG_EACH'                          /* _18- */
                   );
        end if;

        UPDATE SYT1MG_EACH /* 해외선물 개별법 처리용 매매거래내역 */
           SET tr_cd = xx.tr_cd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := 'PROC0560_SYT1MG:' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0570 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 현금위탁증거금 거래 회계처리
-- 기타수입 입금/기타비용 출금처리
--
    km_gyul_ga                     NUMBER;

    w_sm_tr_gb                     ssm0km.sm_tr_gb%type;
    ks_tr_sonik_gb                 sst0ks.tr_sonik_gb%type;
    ks_sudo_aek                    sst0ks.sudo_aek%type;

    w_dansu_aek                    NUMBER;
    w_gyulje_aek                   NUMBER;
    w_hangsa_ga                    NUMBER;
    w_junil_ga                     NUMBER;
    w_chui_aek                     NUMBER;
    w_sudo                         NUMBER;
    w_tr_cha                       NUMBER;
    w_sonik                        NUMBER;

    kt_avg_danga                   NUMBER;
    km_dw_chui_ga                  NUMBER;

    km_up_chui_ga                  NUMBER;
    km_pass_gyey_su                NUMBER;
    km_up_gyey_su                  NUMBER;
    wg_up_miji_cha                 NUMBER;
    wg_up_misu_cha                 NUMBER;

    w_jan_gyey_su                  NUMBER;
    w_jan_chui_ga                  NUMBER;
    w_dw_jungsan_ga                NUMBER;
    w_jungsan_dd                   NUMBER;

    w_aek                          number_varray_50;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0570', p_ymd || ' : 현금위탁증거금 거래 회계처리');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd         /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd        /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency  /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_cd          /* _4- */
             , t1.tr_seq_no      /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd       /* _6- */
             , t1.trustee        /* _7- */
             , t1.currency       /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_aek         /* _9- */
             , t1.fcur_tr_aek    /* _10- */
             , t1.wc_jm_cd       /* _11- */
          FROM SST0WC t1  /* 증거금 현금거래 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr                                                 /* 운용(자문)사 */
           AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd                                                     /* 거래일(인수) */
           AND t1.currency = 'KRW'                                                     /* 통화 */
           AND t1.tr_cd    IN ('S30','S31','S32','S33','S34','S35','S36','S37','S38')  /* 거래코드 */
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr                                                /* 운용(자문)사 */
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd                                                /* 펀드코드 */
    ) loop
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW' AND xx.currency = 'KRW'    then
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                            NVL(xx.wc_jm_cd, xx.tr_co_cd), 1, xx.tr_seq_no, xx.tr_aek, 57, 'PROC0570', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '3', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                            NVL(xx.wc_jm_cd, xx.tr_co_cd), 1, xx.tr_seq_no, xx.fcur_tr_aek, 57, 'PROC0570', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 선물 신규약정 회계처리
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0570', p_ymd || ' : 선물 신규약정 회계처리');

    -- 선물 신규 약정 내역
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                          /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                         /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                           /* _3- */
             , t1.sj_cd                           /* _4- */
             , t1.chasu                           /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_seq_no                       /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.gyey_su,0)    AS gyey_su    /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.gyey_jisu,0)  AS gyey_jisu  /* _8- */
             , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.gyey_aek,0)=0
                    THEN NVL(gyey_su,0) * NVL(gyey_jisu,0) * unit_aek
                    ELSE t1.gyey_aek
               END                  AS gyul_aek   /* _9- */
             , NVL(t1.susu,0)       AS susu       /* _10- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                        /* _11- */
          FROM SST0KT t1  /* 파생 거래내역 */
             , SSX0KJ kj  /* 파생종목 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr                               /* 운용(자문)사 */
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd                                   /* 매매일 */
           AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('S10','S20','S70','S80','S90','SA0')  /* 거래코드 */
           AND kj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr                              /* 운용(자문)사 */
           AND kj.sj_cd   = t1.sj_cd                                /* 파생종목코드 */
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr                              /* 운용(자문)사 */
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd                              /* 펀드코드 */
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT sebu_cd_enm
              INTO w_sm_tr_gb
              FROM SZX0GR t1  /* 그룹코드 */
             WHERE t1.gr_cd   = 'B4'      /* 그룹코드 */
               AND t1.sebu_cd = xx.tr_cd  /* 세부코드( . ; 그룹코드명) */
            ;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.tr_cd || '-그룹코드 등록(9202 szx0gr:B4)';
            RETURN;
        END;

        -- 취득가 계산, 매입매도선물구분
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'S10'    then
            ks_tr_sonik_gb := '2';          -- 선물거래손(출금 대상액)
            km_gyul_ga     := xx.gyul_aek;

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'S20'  then
            ks_tr_sonik_gb := '2';          -- 선물거래손(출금 대상액)
            km_gyul_ga     := xx.gyul_aek;

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'S70'  then
            ks_tr_sonik_gb := '2';                    -- 선물거래손(출금 대상액)
            km_gyul_ga     := xx.gyul_aek + xx.susu;

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'S80'  then
            ks_tr_sonik_gb := '1';                    -- 선물거래익(입금 대상액)
            km_gyul_ga     := xx.gyul_aek - xx.susu;

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'S90'  then
            ks_tr_sonik_gb := '2';                    -- 선물거래손(출금 대상액)
            km_gyul_ga     := xx.gyul_aek + xx.susu;

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'SA0'  then
            ks_tr_sonik_gb := '1';                    -- 선물거래익(입금 대상액)
            km_gyul_ga     := xx.gyul_aek - xx.susu;
        else
            p_msg := '거래코드를 확인하십시요.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 취득가 선물 마스타 update
        SR_UPDKM2 (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.sj_cd, xx.chasu, w_sm_tr_gb, xx.tr_co_cd, xx.gyul_aek, 0, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 수도결제액 table insert
        if  xx.tr_cd IN ('S10','S20')   then
                ks_sudo_aek := xx.susu;
        else    ks_sudo_aek := ROUND (km_gyul_ga);
        end if;

        SR_INSKS (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.sj_cd,
                  'KRW', 'KRW', xx.chasu, xx.tr_seq_no, xx.gyul_aek, xx.susu, ks_tr_sonik_gb,
                  ks_sudo_aek, F_TRADE_YMD(p_ymd + 1, '+'), xx.tr_co_cd, 0, 0, 0, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 단위액(unit_aek) 소숫점으로 종목별 round 후 합산처리 20200619 yjs
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                  /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                    /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_currency                                            /* _3- */
             , CASE WHEN gr.sebu_cd_efnm IS NULL THEN kj.jasan || 'err'
                    WHEN gr.sebu_cd_efnm='채권'  THEN '11'
                                                 ELSE '01'
               END                                           AS jasan_gb   /* _4- */
             , t1.currency                                                 /* _5- */
             , SUM(t1.gyey_aek)                              AS gyey_aek   /* _6- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.susu),0)                           AS susu       /* _7- */
             , SUM(t1.sudo_aek)                              AS sudo_aek   /* _8- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq        /* _9- */
          FROM (SELECT ta.fund_cd                                                     /* _1- */
                     , ta.tr_cd                                                       /* _2- */
                     , ta.sj_cd                                                       /* _3- */
                     , ta.currency                                                    /* _4- */
                     , ia.fund_currency                                               /* _5- */
                     , F_ROUND (SUM(ta.org_gyey_aek), ia.fund_currency)  AS gyey_aek  /* _6- */
                     , F_ROUND (SUM(ta.susu), ia.fund_currency)          AS susu      /* _7- */
                     , F_ROUND (SUM(ta.sudo_aek), ia.fund_currency)      AS sudo_aek  /* _8- */
                  FROM SST0KS ta  /* 파생상품 수도결제 */
                     , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr                               /* 운용(자문)사 */
                   AND ta.tr_ymd  = p_ymd                                   /* 매매일자 */
                   AND ta.tr_cd   IN ('S10','S20','S70','S80','S90','SA0')  /* 거래코드 */
                   AND ia.corp_gr = ta.corp_gr                              /* 운용(자문)사 */
                   AND ia.fund_cd = ta.fund_cd                              /* 펀드코드 */
                 GROUP BY ta.fund_cd , ta.tr_cd        , ta.sj_cd
                        , ta.currency, ia.fund_currency
                 ) t1
             , SSX0KJ kj             /* 파생종목 */
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SZX0GR gr  /* 그룹코드 */
                       ON gr.gr_cd   = 'A6'
                      AND gr.sebu_cd = kj.jasan
         WHERE kj.corp_gr = p_corp_gr  /* 운용(자문)사 */
           AND kj.sj_cd   = t1.sj_cd   /* 파생종목코드 */
         GROUP BY t1.tr_cd   , t1.fund_cd, t1.fund_currency
                , CASE WHEN gr.sebu_cd_efnm IS NULL THEN kj.jasan || 'err'
                       WHEN gr.sebu_cd_efnm='채권'  THEN '11'
                                                    ELSE '01' END
                , t1.currency
    ) loop
        if  xx.jasan_gb LIKE '%err' then
            p_msg := xx.jasan_gb || '-자산구분을 확인하십시오.';
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  xx.tr_cd IN ('S10','S20')   then
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', '', xx.seq, 1, xx.sudo_aek, 57, 'PROC0570', w_msg);
        else
            if  xx.tr_cd IN ('S70','S90')   then
                    w_aek := number_varray_50 (xx.gyey_aek, xx.sudo_aek, xx.susu);
            ELSE    w_aek := number_varray_50 (xx.sudo_aek, xx.gyey_aek, xx.susu);
            end if;
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', xx.seq, 1, w_aek, 57, 'PROC0570', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 전매환매 내역 회계처리
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0570', p_ymd || ' :  전매환매 내역 회계처리');

    -- 선물/옵션 거래내역의 전매/환매,최종결제,권리행사/의무이행 내역
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                                  /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                 /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                           /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                   /* _4- */
             , t1.sj_cd                                                   /* _5- */
             , t1.chasu                                                   /* _6- */
             , t1.tr_seq_no                                               /* _7- */
             , t1.gyey_su                                                 /* _8- */
             , t1.gyey_jisu                                               /* _9- */
             , t1.susu                                                    /* _10- */
             , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.gyey_aek,0)=0 THEN t1.gyey_su * t1.gyey_jisu * unit_aek
                                              ELSE t1.gyey_aek
               END                                          AS gyey_aek   /* _11- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                                /* _12- */
             , kj.jasan                                                   /* _13- */
             , kj.unit_aek                                                /* _14- */
             , kj.koscom_cd                                               /* _15- */
             , MAX(tr_seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd,t1.sj_cd
                                               , t1.tr_cd)  AS max_seq    /* _16- */
             , t1.rowid                                                   /* _17- */
          FROM SST0KT t1  /* 파생 거래내역 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SSX0KJ kj  /* 파생종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr                                           /* 운용(자문)사 */
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd                                               /* 매매일 */
           AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('S11','S12','S13','S21','S22','S23',
                              'S71','S72','S73','S74','S81','S82','S83','S84',
                              'S91','S92','S93','S94','SA1','SA2','SA3','SA4')  /* 거래코드 */
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr                                          /* 운용(자문)사 */
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd                                          /* 펀드코드 */
           AND kj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr                                          /* 운용(자문)사 */
           AND kj.sj_cd   = t1.sj_cd                                            /* 파생종목코드 */
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd ASC, t1.sj_cd ASC, t1.chasu ASC, t1.tr_seq_no ASC, t1.tr_cd ASC
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT sebu_cd_enm
              INTO w_sm_tr_gb
              FROM SZX0GR t1  /* 그룹코드 */
             WHERE t1.gr_cd   = 'B4'      /* 그룹코드 */
               AND t1.sebu_cd = xx.tr_cd  /* 세부코드( . ; 그룹코드명) */
            ;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.tr_cd || '-그룹코드 등록(9202 szx0gr:B4)';
            RETURN;
        END;

        -- 반대매매단가 가져오기
        BEGIN
            SELECT (NVL(pass_chui_ga,0) + NVL(up_chui_ga,0)) / (NVL(pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(up_gyey_su,0))  /* _1- */
                 , NVL(pass_gyey_su,0)                                                                    /* _2- */
                 , NVL(up_gyey_su,0)                                                                      /* _3- */
                 , NVL(up_chui_ga,0)                                                                      /* _4- */
                 , NVL(pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(up_gyey_su,0) - NVL(dw_gyey_su,0)                            /* _5- */
                 , NVL(pass_chui_ga,0) + NVL(up_chui_ga,0) - NVL(dw_chui_ga,0)                            /* _6- */
                 , NVL(dang_mm_sonik,0)                                                                   /* _7- */
              INTO kt_avg_danga     /* _1- */
                 , km_pass_gyey_su  /* _2- */
                 , km_up_gyey_su    /* _3- */
                 , km_up_chui_ga    /* _4- */
                 , w_jan_gyey_su    /* _5- */
                 , w_jan_chui_ga    /* _6- */
                 , w_jungsan_dd     /* _7- */
              FROM SSM0KM t1        /* 파생 보유현황 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr    /* 운용(자문)사 */
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd   /* 펀드코드 */
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd        /* 보유일자 */
