               AND t1.sj_cd    = xx.sj_cd     /* 파생종목코드 */
               AND t1.tr_co_cd = xx.tr_co_cd  /* 매매처코드 */
               AND t1.sm_tr_gb = w_sm_tr_gb   /* 파생구분[43] */
               AND t1.chasu    = xx.chasu     /* 차수 */
               AND NVL(pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(up_gyey_su,0) != 0;
        EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.sj_cd || '- 반대매매단가를 구할수 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        -- 반대매매원가
        if  w_jan_gyey_su = 0 AND xx.tr_seq_no = xx.max_seq then
                km_dw_chui_ga := ROUND (w_jan_chui_ga);              -- 감소취득가
        else    km_dw_chui_ga := ROUND (xx.gyey_su * kt_avg_danga);
        end if;

        -- 매매차액
        if  w_sm_tr_gb IN ('1','2') then
            BEGIN
                SELECT PRECLOSE
                  INTO w_junil_ga
                  FROM SJT1TG t1  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
                 WHERE t1.ymd       = F_TRADE_YMD(p_ymd,'-')  /* 종가일자 */
                   AND t1.koscom_cd = xx.sj_cd                /* 주식(단축)/선물옵션(종목) 코드 */
                ;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                w_junil_ga := 0;
            END;
            IF  w_junil_ga = 0  THEN
                p_msg   := xx.sj_cd || '(' || TO_CHAR(F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '-1'), 'yyyy.mm.dd')
                                    || ')전영업일 종가를 찾을 수 없습니다.';
                RETURN;
            end if;

            -- 선물 당잔취득액
            w_chui_aek := km_pass_gyey_su * w_junil_ga * xx.unit_aek + km_up_chui_ga;
            IF  w_jan_gyey_su = 0 AND xx.tr_seq_no = xx.max_seq THEN
                    w_dw_jungsan_ga := ROUND (w_chui_aek - w_jungsan_dd);
            else    w_dw_jungsan_ga := ROUND (w_chui_aek * (xx.gyey_su / (km_pass_gyey_su + km_up_gyey_su)));
            end if;
            w_tr_cha := ROUND (xx.gyey_aek - w_dw_jungsan_ga);
        ELSE
            w_tr_cha        := ROUND (xx.gyey_aek - km_dw_chui_ga);
            w_dw_jungsan_ga := 0;
        end if;

        if  w_sm_tr_gb IN ('2','4','6') then    w_tr_cha := w_tr_cha * -1;
        end if;

        -- 반대매매단가,원계약지수,매매차액
        UPDATE SST0KT tt   /* 파생 거래내역 */
           SET avg_danga = kt_avg_danga
             , tr_cha    = w_tr_cha
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        -- 반대매매원가 선물 마스타 update
        SR_UPDKM2 (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.sj_cd, xx.chasu, w_sm_tr_gb, xx.tr_co_cd, km_dw_chui_ga, w_dw_jungsan_ga, w_msg);
        IF  w_msg != 'Y'    THEN
            p_msg   := xx.tr_cd || '-' || xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.sj_cd || '-' || xx.tr_seq_no
                                || '- 반대매매원가 처리가 안됐습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 수도결제액 및 미지급 미수 매매차액 계산
        w_hangsa_ga  := 0;
        w_gyulje_aek := 0;
        w_dansu_aek  := 0;

        -- 선물 반대매매
        IF  w_sm_tr_gb IN ('1','2') then
            w_sudo := w_tr_cha - xx.susu;  -- 수도결제액
            if  w_sudo > 0  then
                ks_tr_sonik_gb := '1';     -- 미수금
                ks_sudo_aek    := w_sudo;
            else
                ks_tr_sonik_gb := '2';          -- 미지급금
                ks_sudo_aek    := w_sudo * -1;
            end if;

            -- 매입옵션 반대매매
        elsif xx.tr_cd IN ('S71','S72','S73','S91','S92','S93') then
            ks_sudo_aek    := ROUND (NVL(xx.gyey_aek,0) - NVL(xx.susu,0));  -- 수도결제액
            ks_tr_sonik_gb := '1';                                          -- 미수금

            -- 매도옵션 반대매매
        elsif xx.tr_cd IN ('S81','S82','S83','SA1','SA2','SA3') then
            ks_sudo_aek    := ROUND (NVL(xx.gyey_aek,0) + NVL(xx.susu,0));  -- 수도결제액
            ks_tr_sonik_gb := '2';                                          -- 미지급금

            -- 개별주식옵션 반대매매 (최종결제시)
        elsif xx.tr_cd IN ('S74','S84','S94','SA4') then
            ks_tr_sonik_gb := '2';  -- 미지급금(옵션수수료)
            if  xx.gyey_aek != 0    then
                -- 미결제주식
                SELECT NVL(CLOSE,0)
                  INTO w_gyulje_aek
                  FROM SJT1TG t1  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
                 WHERE t1.ymd       = F_TRADE_YMD(xx.tr_ymd,'-')  /* 종가일자 */
                   AND t1.koscom_cd = xx.koscom_cd                /* 주식(단축)/선물옵션(종목) 코드 */
                ;

                if  w_gyulje_aek = 0    then
                    p_msg := xx.sj_cd || ' 개별주식옵션종목의 권리가격을 확인바랍니다.';
                    RETURN;
                end if;

                -- 주식미지급/미수금
                SELECT NVL(hangsa_ga,0)
                  INTO w_hangsa_ga
                  FROM SSX0KJ t1  /* 파생종목 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr  /* 운용(자문)사 */
                   AND t1.sj_cd   = xx.sj_cd   /* 파생종목코드 */
                   AND t1.lsy_ymd = xx.tr_ymd  /* 최종결제일 */
                   AND t1.jasan   = xx.jasan   /* 파생 기준자산[A6] */
                ;
                if  w_hangsa_ga = 0 then
                    p_msg := xx.sj_cd || ' 개별주식옵션종목의 행사가격을 확인바랍니다.';
                    RETURN;
                end if;
                -- 개별주식옵션 단수주금 산출
                ----------------------------------------------------
                -- 콜 : (결제가격 - 행사가격) * 행사수량 * 단주수량
                -- 풋 : (행사가격 - 결제가격) * 행사수량 * 단주수량
                ----------------------------------------------------
                if  xx.tr_cd IN ('S74','S84')   then
                    w_dansu_aek := (w_gyulje_aek - w_hangsa_ga) * xx.gyey_su * (xx.unit_aek - TRUNC(xx.unit_aek, -1));
                elsif xx.tr_cd IN ('S94','SA4') then
                    w_dansu_aek := (w_hangsa_ga - w_gyulje_aek) * xx.gyey_su * (xx.unit_aek - TRUNC(xx.unit_aek, -1));
                end if;
                -- 수도결제액
                if  xx.tr_cd IN ('S84','SA4')   then
                    ks_sudo_aek := ROUND (NVL(xx.susu,0) + w_dansu_aek);
                else
                    ks_sudo_aek := ROUND (NVL(xx.susu,0) - w_dansu_aek);
                    if  ks_sudo_aek < 0 then
                        ks_sudo_aek    := ks_sudo_aek * -1;
                        ks_tr_sonik_gb := '1';               -- 미수금(단수대금)
                    end if;
                end if;
                ks_sudo_aek  := ks_sudo_aek;
                w_gyulje_aek := w_gyulje_aek * xx.gyey_su * TRUNC(xx.unit_aek, -1);
                w_hangsa_ga  := w_hangsa_ga * xx.gyey_su * TRUNC(xx.unit_aek, -1);
            else
                w_dansu_aek  := 0;
                ks_sudo_aek  := 0;
                w_gyulje_aek := 0;
                w_hangsa_ga  := 0;
            end if;
        end if;

        wg_up_misu_cha := w_tr_cha;  -- 매매차액
        if  wg_up_misu_cha > 0  then
            wg_up_misu_cha := wg_up_misu_cha;
            wg_up_miji_cha := 0;
        else
            wg_up_miji_cha := wg_up_misu_cha * -1;
            wg_up_misu_cha := 0;
        end if;

        -- 수도결제액 선물 수도결제
        SR_INSKS (p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.sj_cd,
                  'KRW', 'KRW', xx.chasu, xx.tr_seq_no, km_dw_chui_ga, xx.susu, ks_tr_sonik_gb,
                  ks_sudo_aek, F_TRADE_YMD(p_ymd + 1, '+'), xx.tr_co_cd, w_gyulje_aek, w_hangsa_ga, w_dansu_aek, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 반대매매 분개처리
    for xx IN (
        WITH JASAN_TEMP AS (
                 SELECT t1.tr_cd                                                                                 /* _1- */
                      , t1.fund_cd                                                                               /* _2- */
                      , ia.fund_currency                                                                         /* _3- */
                      , t1.sj_cd                                                                                 /* _4- */
                      , t1.tr_sonik_gb                                                                           /* _5- */
                      , kj.jasan                                                                                 /* _6- */
                      , F_ROUND (SUM(t2.tr_cha), ia.fund_currency)                                AS tr_cha      /* _7- */
                      , F_ROUND (SUM(t1.sudo_aek), ia.fund_currency)                              AS sudo_aek    /* _8- */
                      , F_ROUND (SUM(t1.org_gyey_aek), ia.fund_currency)                          AS dw_chui_ga  /* _9- */
                      , F_ROUND (SUM(t1.susu), ia.fund_currency)                                  AS susu        /* _10- */
                      , F_ROUND (SUM(t1.gyulje_aek), ia.fund_currency)                            AS gyulje_aek  /* _11- */
                      , F_ROUND (SUM(t2.gyey_su * t2.gyey_jisu * kj.unit_aek), ia.fund_currency)  AS gyey_aek    /* _12- */
                   FROM SST0KS t1  /* 파생상품 수도결제 */
                      , SST0KT t2  /* 파생 거래내역 */
                      , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                      , SSX0KJ kj  /* 파생종목 */
                  WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr                                           /* 운용(자문)사 */
                    AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd                                               /* 매매일자 */
                    AND t1.tr_cd     IN ('S11','S12','S13','S21','S22','S23',
                                         'S71','S72','S73','S74','S81','S82','S83','S84',
                                         'S91','S92','S93','S94','SA1','SA2','SA3','SA4')  /* 거래코드 */
                    AND t2.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr                                          /* 운용(자문)사 */
                    AND t2.fund_cd   = t1.fund_cd                                          /* 펀드코드 */
                    AND t2.tr_ymd    = t1.tr_ymd                                           /* 매매일 */
                    AND t2.sj_cd     = t1.sj_cd                                            /* 파생종목코드 */
                    AND t2.tr_seq_no = t1.tr_seq_no                                        /* 거래순번 */
                    AND t2.tr_cd     = t1.tr_cd                                            /* 거래코드 */
                    AND t2.chasu     = t1.chasu                                            /* 차수 */
                    AND ia.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr                                          /* 운용(자문)사 */
                    AND ia.fund_cd   = t1.fund_cd                                          /* 펀드코드 */
                    AND kj.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr                                          /* 운용(자문)사 */
                    AND kj.sj_cd     = t1.sj_cd                                            /* 파생종목코드 */
                  GROUP BY t1.tr_cd
                         , t1.fund_cd
                         , ia.fund_currency
                         , t1.sj_cd
                         , t1.tr_sonik_gb
                         , kj.jasan
                 )
            -- Main SQL --
            --------------
            SELECT t1.tr_cd                                                     /* _1- */
                 , t1.fund_cd                                                   /* _2- */
                 , t1.fund_currency                                             /* _3- */
                 , CASE WHEN t1.tr_cd LIKE '%4' THEN t1.sj_cd
                                                ELSE NULL
                   END                                           AS sj_cd       /* _4- */
                 , CASE WHEN gr.sebu_cd_efnm IS NULL THEN t1.jasan || 'err'
                        WHEN gr.sebu_cd_efnm='채권'  THEN '11'
                                                     ELSE '01'
                   END                                           AS jasan_gb    /* _5- */
                 , t1.tr_sonik_gb                                               /* _6- */
                 , SUM(t1.tr_cha)                                AS tr_cha      /* _7- */
                 , SUM(t1.sudo_aek)                              AS sudo_aek    /* _8- */
                 , SUM(t1.dw_chui_ga)                            AS dw_chui_ga  /* _9- */
                 , SUM(t1.susu)                                  AS susu        /* _10- */
                 , SUM(t1.gyulje_aek)                            AS gyulje_aek  /* _11- */
                 , SUM(t1.gyey_aek)                              AS gyey_aek    /* _12- */
                 , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                           ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq         /* _13- */
              FROM JASAN_TEMP t1
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SZX0GR gr  /* 그룹코드 */
                           ON gr.gr_cd   = 'A6'
                          AND gr.sebu_cd = t1.jasan
             GROUP BY t1.tr_cd      , t1.fund_cd, t1.fund_currency
                    , CASE WHEN t1.tr_cd LIKE '%4' THEN t1.sj_cd
                                                   ELSE NULL END
                    , CASE WHEN gr.sebu_cd_efnm IS NULL THEN t1.jasan || 'err'
                           WHEN gr.sebu_cd_efnm='채권'  THEN '11'
                                                        ELSE '01' END
                    , t1.tr_sonik_gb
    ) loop
        if  xx.jasan_gb LIKE '%err' then
            p_msg := xx.jasan_gb || '-자산구분을 확인하십시오.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if  xx.tr_cd IN ('S11','S12','S13','S21','S22','S23')   then    -- 매입/매도선물 반대매매
            SR_SSSL040 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sj_cd, xx.jasan_gb, xx.seq, 2,
                        xx.tr_cha, xx.tr_cha - xx.susu, 57, 'PROC0570', w_msg);

        elsif xx.tr_cd IN ('S71','S72','S73','S91','S92','S93') then    -- 매입옵션 반대매매
            w_sonik := xx.gyey_aek - xx.dw_chui_ga;
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.sudo_aek,
                                         xx.dw_chui_ga,
                                         CASE WHEN w_sonik < 0 THEN - w_sonik ELSE 0 END,
                                         CASE WHEN w_sonik > 0 THEN w_sonik   ELSE 0 END,
                                         xx.susu);
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sj_cd, xx.seq, 2, w_aek, 57, 'PROC0570', w_msg);

        elsif xx.tr_cd IN ('S81','S82','S83','SA1','SA2','SA3') then    -- 매도옵션 반대매매
            w_sonik := xx.dw_chui_ga - xx.gyey_aek;
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.dw_chui_ga,
                                         xx.sudo_aek,
                                         CASE WHEN w_sonik < 0 THEN - w_sonik ELSE 0 END,
                                         CASE WHEN w_sonik > 0 THEN w_sonik   ELSE 0 END,
                                         xx.susu);
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sj_cd, xx.seq, 2, w_aek, 57, 'PROC0570', w_msg);

        elsif xx.tr_cd IN ('S74','S94') then    -- 개별주식옵션 최종결제시(매입)
            w_sonik := xx.gyey_aek - xx.dw_chui_ga;
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.gyulje_aek, xx.dw_chui_ga,
                                         w_dansu_aek, w_hangsa_ga,
                                         xx.susu, xx.susu,
                                         CASE WHEN w_sonik < 0 THEN - w_sonik ELSE 0 END,
                                         CASE WHEN w_sonik > 0 THEN w_sonik   ELSE 0 END);
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sj_cd, xx.seq, 2, w_aek, 57, 'PROC0570', w_msg);

        elsif xx.tr_cd IN ('S84','SA4') then    -- 개별주식옵션 최종결제시(매도)
            w_sonik := xx.dw_chui_ga - xx.gyey_aek;
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.gyulje_aek, xx.dw_chui_ga,
                                         0, w_hangsa_ga,
                                         xx.susu, xx.susu + w_dansu_aek,
                                         CASE WHEN w_sonik < 0 THEN - w_sonik ELSE 0 END,
                                         CASE WHEN w_sonik > 0 THEN w_sonik   ELSE 0 END);
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.sj_cd, xx.seq, 2, w_aek, 57, 'PROC0570', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'PROC0570 : ', p_ymd || ' - 기타수입 입금/기타비용 출금처리');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'skt0hs.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ',skt0hs.tr_cd=...', '입금');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                            /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                           /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                      /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                              /* _4- */
             , t1.hwanib_aek                                 AS aek  /* _5- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq  /* _6- */
          FROM SKT0HS t1  /* 환매수수료 환입 및 각종비용 출금내용 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr                   /* 운용(자문)사 */
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd                       /* 환입/출금일자 */
           AND t1.tr_cd                 IN ('E25','E2C','E2F','E2L')  /* 거래코드 */
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr                  /* 운용(자문)사 */
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd                  /* 펀드코드 */
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) > p_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.tr_co_cd, 1, xx.seq, xx.aek, 57, 'PROC0570', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'skt0hs.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ',skt0hs.tr_cd=...', '출금');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd                                              /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                            /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                           /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                      /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.hwanib_aek,0)                          AS aek  /* _5- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq  /* _6- */
          FROM SKT0HS t1  /* 환매수수료 환입 및 각종비용 출금내용 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr                               /* 운용(자문)사 */
           AND t1.tr_ymd                = p_ymd                                   /* 환입/출금일자 */
           AND t1.tr_cd                 IN ('H11','H80','H84','H87','H90','H92')  /* 거래코드 */
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr                              /* 운용(자문)사 */
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd                              /* 펀드코드 */
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) > p_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.tr_co_cd, 3, xx.seq, xx.aek, 57, 'PROC0570', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0580 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- OTS 매입, 매도, 상환 회계처리
-- 해외 회계처리
--
    w_cnt                          NUMBER;
    w_jasan_gb                     szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;

    w_meib_aek                     NUMBER;
    w_iik                          NUMBER;
    w_son                          NUMBER;

    w_siga_gb                      VARCHAR(1);
    w_fund_cd                      szm0ia.fund_cd%type;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);

    w_aek                          number_varray_50;
BEGIN
    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'A', 'PROC0580', p_ymd || '- 58 : OTS 매매 회계처리' );

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B010', p_ymd                                                    , 'OTS 매매 회계처리'                        );
    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B011', 'skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0bu.proc_step=' || 58, 'OTS,해외회계처리 분개내역(skt0bu) delete' );

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND t1.proc_step = 58;

    -- 만기상환 재처리
    DELETE FROM OTS0OG  /* OTS 매매내역 */
     WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd   = p_ymd
       AND tr_cd    = 'E33'
       AND upd_user = 'PROC0580';

    -- 만기상환 점검
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t1.fund_cd
             , t1.jm_cd
          FROM OTS0OM t1  /* OTS 보유현황 */
             , OTS0JM jm  /* OTS 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd       = p_ymd
           AND jm.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr
           AND jm.jm_cd     = t1.jm_cd
           AND jm.mangi_ymd <= p_ymd
           AND (NVL(bfil_qty,0) + NVL(up_qty,0) - NVL(dw_qty,0)) > 0
    ) loop
        SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0)
          INTO w_cnt
          FROM OTS0OG t1  /* OTS 매매내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'E33';
        if  w_cnt = 0   then
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-만기상환이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 재처리
    UPDATE OTS0OM t1    /* OTS 보유현황 */
       SET up_qty = 0
         , up_aek = 0
         , dw_qty = 0
         , dw_aek = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                                      /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                       /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                     /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                       /* _4- */
             , t1.seq_no                                                      /* _5- */
             , jm.jm_gb                                                       /* _6- */
             , jm.option_type                                                 /* _7- */
             , t1.sudo_ymd                                                    /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_qty,0)                              AS qty           /* _9- */
             , F_TRUNC (NVL(t1.tr_aek,0), ia.fund_currency)  AS aek           /* _10- */
             , NVL(t1.susu,0)                                AS susu          /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.JS_SONIK_AEK,0)                        AS js_sonik_aek  /* _12- */
             , t1.rowid                                                       /* _13- */
          FROM OTS0OG t1  /* OTS 매매내역 */
             , OTS0JM jm  /* OTS 종목정보 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   != 'U50'
           AND jm.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND jm.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY fund_cd
                , CASE WHEN tr_cd LIKE 'J%' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
                , tr_cd DESC
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_cd IN ('J90','J93')   then    -- 보유현황 생성
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO OTS0OM  /* OTS 보유현황 */
                     ( corp_gr  /* _1- */
                     , ymd      /* _2- */
                     , fund_cd  /* _3- */
                     , jm_cd    /* _4- */
                     , up_qty   /* _5- */
                     , up_aek   /* _6- */
                     )
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                       , xx.fund_cd        /* _3- */
                       , xx.jm_cd          /* _4- */
                       , xx.qty            /* _5- */
                       , xx.aek - xx.susu  /* _6- */
                       );
            EXCEPTION WHEN DUP_VAL_ON_INDEX THEN 
                UPDATE OTS0OM   /* OTS 보유현황 */
                   SET up_qty = NVL(up_qty,0) + xx.qty
                     , up_aek = NVL(up_aek,0) + xx.aek - xx.susu
                 WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                   AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND ymd     = p_ymd;
            END;
        else
            BEGIN
                SELECT CASE WHEN xx.qty=0
                            THEN NVL(bfil_aek,0) + NVL(up_aek,0)
                            ELSE ROUND(((NVL(bfil_aek,0) + NVL(up_aek,0)) / (NVL(bfil_qty,0) + NVL(up_qty,0))) * xx.qty,0) END
                  INTO w_meib_aek
                  FROM OTS0OM t1  /* OTS 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                w_meib_aek := 0;
            END;

            UPDATE OTS0OM   /* OTS 보유현황 */
               SET dw_qty = NVL(dw_qty,0) + xx.qty
                 , dw_aek = NVL(dw_aek,0) + w_meib_aek
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND ymd     = p_ymd;

            xx.aek := xx.aek + xx.susu;
            if  xx.jm_gb = 'F'  then
                if  xx.option_type = 'F1'   then
                        w_iik := xx.JS_SONIK_AEK;
                else    w_iik := xx.aek - w_meib_aek;
                end if;
            else        w_iik := xx.aek - w_meib_aek;
            end if;
            UPDATE OTS0OG   /* OTS 매매내역 */
               SET mm_sonik = w_iik
                 , meib_aek = w_meib_aek
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        end if;
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                                 /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                  /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                  /* _4- */
             , t1.seq_no                                                 /* _5- */
             , jm.jm_gb                                                  /* _6- */
             , jm.option_type                                            /* _7- */
             , F_TRUNC (t1.js_aek, ia.fund_currency)         AS new_aek  /* _8- */
             , t1.js_aek / 10000                             AS new_qty  /* _9- */
             , t1.sudo_ymd                                               /* _10- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_aek,0) / 10000                      AS qty      /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_qty,0)                              AS tr_qty   /* _12- */
             , F_TRUNC (NVL(t1.tr_aek,0), ia.fund_currency)  AS aek      /* _13- */
             , NVL(t1.susu,0)                                AS susu     /* _14- */
             , t1.rowid                                                  /* _15- */
          FROM OTS0OG t1  /* OTS 매매내역 */
             , OTS0JM jm  /* OTS 종목정보 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'U50'
           AND jm.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND jm.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.jm_gb = 'F'  then
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO OTS0OM  /* OTS 보유현황 */
                           ( corp_gr  , ymd  , fund_cd   , jm_cd   , dw_qty   , dw_aek )
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_qty, xx.aek );
                EXCEPTION WHEN DUP_VAL_ON_INDEX THEN 
                    UPDATE OTS0OM   /* OTS 보유현황 */
                       SET dw_qty = xx.tr_qty
                         , dw_aek = xx.aek
                     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                       AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                       AND ymd     = p_ymd;
                END;
        else
            if  xx.new_aek > xx.aek     then
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO OTS0OM  /* OTS 보유현황 */
                         ( corp_gr  /* _1- */
                         , ymd      /* _2- */
                         , fund_cd  /* _3- */
                         , jm_cd    /* _4- */
                         , up_qty   /* _5- */
                         , up_aek   /* _6- */
                         )
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr            /* _1- */
                           , p_ymd                /* _2- */
                           , xx.fund_cd           /* _3- */
                           , xx.jm_cd             /* _4- */
                           , xx.new_qty - xx.qty  /* _5- */
                           , xx.new_aek - xx.aek  /* _6- */
                           );
                EXCEPTION WHEN DUP_VAL_ON_INDEX THEN 
                    UPDATE OTS0OM   /* OTS 보유현황 */
                       SET up_qty = xx.new_qty - xx.qty
                         , up_aek = xx.new_aek - xx.aek
                     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                       AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                       AND ymd     = p_ymd;
                END;
            else
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO OTS0OM  /* OTS 보유현황 */
                         ( corp_gr  /* _1- */
                         , ymd      /* _2- */
                         , fund_cd  /* _3- */
                         , jm_cd    /* _4- */
                         , dw_qty   /* _5- */
                         , dw_aek   /* _6- */
                         )
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr            /* _1- */
                           , p_ymd                /* _2- */
                           , xx.fund_cd           /* _3- */
                           , xx.jm_cd             /* _4- */
                           , xx.qty - xx.new_qty  /* _5- */
                           , xx.aek - xx.new_aek  /* _6- */
                           );
                EXCEPTION WHEN DUP_VAL_ON_INDEX THEN 
                    UPDATE OTS0OM   /* OTS 보유현황 */
                       SET dw_qty = xx.qty - xx.new_qty
                         , dw_aek = xx.aek - xx.new_aek
                     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                       AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                       AND ymd     = p_ymd;
                END;
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 분개는 합산처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                                                  /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                   /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                 /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                           /* _4- */
             , jm.jm_gb                                                                   /* _5- */
             , jm.slip_attr                                                               /* _6- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                   /* _7- */
             , jm.option_type                                                             /* _8- */
             , t1.sudo_ymd                                                                /* _9- */
             , jm.NAV_TARGET_YN                                                           /* _10- */
             , F_TRUNC (NVL(SUM(t1.tr_aek), 0), ia.fund_currency)        AS aek           /* _11- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.susu), 0)                                      AS susu          /* _12- */
             , F_TRUNC (NVL(SUM(t1.mm_sonik), 0), ia.fund_currency)      AS sonik         /* _13- */
             , F_TRUNC (NVL(SUM(t1.meib_aek), 0), ia.fund_currency)      AS meib_aek      /* _14- */
             , F_TRUNC (NVL(SUM(t1.js_aek), 0), ia.fund_currency)        AS js_aek        /* _15- */
             , F_TRUNC (NVL(SUM(t1.js_sonik_aek), 0), ia.fund_currency)  AS js_sonik_aek  /* _16- */
             , ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                        ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)             AS seq_no        /* _17- */
          FROM OTS0OG t1  /* OTS 매매내역 */
             , OTS0JM jm  /* OTS 종목정보 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND jm.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND jm.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.tr_ymd
                , t1.tr_cd
                , t1.fund_cd
                , ia.fund_currency
                , jm.slip_attr
                , jm.jm_gb
                , t1.jm_cd
                , jm.option_type
                , t1.sudo_ymd
                , jm.NAV_TARGET_YN
    ) loop
        w_iik := 0;
        w_son := 0;
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'J90'    then
            SR_SZSL021( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1, xx.aek - xx.susu, xx.aek, 58, 'PROC0580', w_msg );

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'J93'  then
            if  xx.nav_target_yn = 'N'  then
                    SR_SZSL021( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jm_gb || xx.slip_attr, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1, 0               , 0     , 58, 'PROC0580 TRS삭제', w_msg );
            ELSE    SR_SZSL021( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jm_gb || xx.slip_attr, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1, xx.aek - xx.susu, xx.aek, 58, 'PROC0580'        , w_msg );
            end if;

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'U50'  then    -- 파생정산분개
            SR_SZSL011( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jm_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, xx.js_sonik_aek, 58, 'PROC0580', w_msg );
            if  xx.jm_gb = '7'  then
                SR_SZSL011( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'U51', 'A', '1', xx.jm_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, 1, 1, (xx.js_aek - xx.aek), 58, 'PROC0580', w_msg );  /* TRS 명목금액 조정 */
            end if;

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'K90'  then
            if  xx.sonik > 0    then
                    w_iik := xx.sonik;
            else    w_son := - xx.sonik;
            end if;
            w_aek := number_varray_50 (NVL(xx.aek, 0), xx.meib_aek, xx.susu, w_son, w_iik);
            SR_SZSL999( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1, w_aek, 58, 'PROC0580', w_msg );

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'K93'  then
            if  xx.jm_gb = 'G'  then
                if  xx.sonik > 0    then
                        w_iik := xx.sonik;
                else    w_son := - xx.sonik;
                end if;
                w_aek := number_varray_50 (NVL(xx.aek, 0), xx.meib_aek, w_son, w_iik);
                SR_SZSL999( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jm_gb || xx.slip_attr, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1, w_aek, 58, 'PROC0580_G', w_msg );
            else
                if  xx.nav_target_yn = 'N'  then    -- 20200902 파생상품 분개 삭제
                        SR_SZSL010( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jm_gb || xx.slip_attr, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1, 0     , 58, 'PROC0580_1', w_msg );
                ELSE    SR_SZSL010( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jm_gb || xx.slip_attr, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1, xx.aek, 58, 'PROC0580_1', w_msg );
                end if;
                SR_SZSL011( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.jm_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 2, xx.js_sonik_aek, 58, 'PROC0580_2 ' || xx.jm_gb, w_msg );
            end if;
        else
            if  xx.jm_gb = 'F'  then
                if  xx.sonik > 0    then
                        w_iik := xx.JS_SONIK_AEK;
                else    w_son := - xx.JS_SONIK_AEK;
                end if;
                w_aek := number_varray_50 (w_iik, w_iik, w_son, w_son, 0, 0);
                SR_SZSL999( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', xx.option_type, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.seq_no, 1, w_aek, 58, 'PROC0580', w_msg );
            else
                if  xx.tr_ymd = xx.sudo_ymd then
                        w_jasan_gb := xx.jm_gb || 'A';
                else    w_jasan_gb := xx.jm_gb || 'B';
                end if;
                SR_SZSL020( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', w_jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', xx.seq_no, 1, xx.aek, xx.aek, 58, 'PROC0580', w_msg );
            end if;
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'syt0mc.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd, '미지급 채권/채무 재처리' );

    -- 미지급 채권/채무 재처리
    DELETE FROM SYT0MC t1   /* 해외 채권/채무 발생 및 감소 MASTER */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr          = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd           = p_ymd
       AND NVL(bfil_aek,0)     = 0
       AND NVL(won_bfil_aek,0) = 0;

    UPDATE SYT0MC t1    /* 해외 채권/채무 발생 및 감소 MASTER */
       SET up_aek     = 0
         , dw_aek     = 0
         , won_up_aek = 0
         , won_dw_aek = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd;

    -- 외화예금 처리
    -- trigger 이동 yjs 20200406
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.*
          FROM SKT0BU t1  /* 분개장 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd        = p_ymd
           AND t1.gwamok        = '10151'
           AND t1.proc_step     != 9
           AND ia.corp_gr       = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fund_currency != 'KRW'
    ) loop
        -- 기준통화 외화예금 증가(D)/감소(C)
        if  xx.chadae_gb = 'D'  then
                SR_10151_FCUR_IN( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.aek, w_msg  );
        ELSE    SR_10151_FCUR_OUT( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.aek, w_msg );
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B030', p_ymd, '해외채권 이자수령 처리' );

    SR_SYCP010( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'PROC0580', 58, w_msg );
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR ('sycp010 - ' || w_msg,1,180);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B031', p_ymd, '해외채권 원금상환 처리' );

    SR_SYCP020( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'PROC0580', 58, w_msg );
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR ('sycp020 - ' || w_msg,1,180);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B032', p_ymd, '해외 배당/권리처리' );

    SR_SYCP030( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 58, w_msg );
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR ('sycp030 - ' || w_msg,1,180);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B033', p_ymd, '해외 매매처리' );

    SR_SYCP040( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'PROC0580', 58, w_msg );
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR ('sycp040 - ' || w_msg,1,180);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B050', p_ymd, '해외 비용출금 수도결제처리' );

    SR_SYCP050( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 58, w_msg );
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR ('sycp050 - ' || w_msg,1,180);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS( p_corp_gr, 'B050', p_ymd, '해외현금 유보처리(E80) 및 유보분상환처리(E81) 수도결제처리' );

    SR_SYCP060( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 58, w_msg );
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR ('sycp060 - ' || w_msg,1,180);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 해외채권 이자구간 생성
    -- 매일작업 하므로
    if  F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '+1') = p_ymd    then    SR_SYJ0IG (p_corp_gr, p_ymd);
    end if;

    -- 해외회계처리 마무리

    -- 외화예금 처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.*
          FROM SKT0BU t1  /* 분개장 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd        = p_ymd
           AND t1.gwamok        = '10151'
           AND t1.proc_step     = 9
           AND ia.corp_gr       = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fund_currency != 'KRW'
    ) loop
        -- 기준통화 외화예금 증가(D)/감소(C)
        if  xx.chadae_gb = 'D'  then
                SR_10151_FCUR_IN( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.aek, w_msg  );
        ELSE    SR_10151_FCUR_OUT( p_corp_gr, xx.tr_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.aek, w_msg );
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 해외파생 종목구분과 보유구분 점검 20210611 yjs
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.jm_cd
             , t1.sj_gb
          FROM SYM0YA t1  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd    IN (SELECT jm_cd
                                 FROM SYM0YZ ta  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                                WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                  AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd)
           AND t1.jasan_gb = 'A'
    ) loop
        -- 해외선물
        if  xx.sj_gb = '1'      then
            SELECT MAX (fund_cd)
              INTO w_fund_cd
              FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.sm_tr_gb NOT IN ('1','2');

            -- 해외콜옵션
        elsif xx.sj_gb = '2'    then
            SELECT MAX (fund_cd)
              INTO w_fund_cd
              FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.sm_tr_gb NOT IN ('3','4');

            -- 해외풋옵션
        elsif xx.sj_gb = '3'    then
            SELECT MAX (fund_cd)
              INTO w_fund_cd
              FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.sm_tr_gb NOT IN ('5','6');
        else
            p_msg := xx.jm_cd || ' - 해외 파생구분자 재설정';
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  w_fund_cd IS NOT NULL   then
            p_msg := xx.jm_cd || '(' || ') - 해외 파생구분 오류 종목정보 수정 또는 당일 매매확인';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';

    -- 외화채권 시가평가 초기자료 생성
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t2.jm_cd
             , t2.isin_cd
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SYM0YA t2  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t2.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
           AND t2.jasan_gb = '2'
           AND t2.isin_cd IS NOT NULL
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SYM1SM  /* 해외채권 시가평가 자료 */
                   ( corp_gr  , ymd  , jm_cd   , isin_cd    )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.jm_cd, xx.isin_cd );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            UPDATE SYM1SM   /* 해외채권 시가평가 자료 */
               SET isin_cd = xx.isin_cd
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND ymd     = p_ymd;
        END;
    end loop;

    -- 외화채권 시가평가 초기자료 생성(익일 매매분 처리용)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t2.jm_cd
             , t2.isin_cd
          FROM SYT0MG t1  /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
             , SYM0YA t2  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd   > (p_ymd - 14)
           AND t1.tr_cd    LIKE 'J%'
           AND t2.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
           AND t2.jasan_gb = '2'
           AND t2.isin_cd IS NOT NULL
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SYM1SM  /* 해외채권 시가평가 자료 */
                   ( corp_gr  , ymd  , jm_cd   , isin_cd    )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.jm_cd, xx.isin_cd );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            UPDATE SYM1SM   /* 해외채권 시가평가 자료 */
               SET isin_cd = xx.isin_cd
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND ymd     = p_ymd;
        END;
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0590 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 회계처리 단계 오류 점검 (KSD연계 등)
--

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);

    w_fymd                       DATE; -- 전영업일 + 1
    w_tymd                       DATE;
    w_jy_ymd                     DATE; -- 전영업일

    w_seq                        NUMBER;
    w_cnt                        NUMBER;
    w_item_cnt                   NUMBER;
    w_skt0bu_aek                 NUMBER;

    w_unit_gb                    VARCHAR(1);
    w_sosok_gb                   VARCHAR(1);
    w_check_yn                   VARCHAR(1);
    w_bigo                       szt0ck.bigo%type;
    w_acct_no                    VARCHAR(40);

    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '110.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 채권 및 대출채권 미수입금 존재하는 종목에 매도 발생 확인! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '120.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 차등배분펀드에 손익분담펀드 미지정! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '130.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 차등배분형 수탁회사 요청 결산시에만 차등배분 적용! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '140.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 정정분개처리 비고란 미입력 오류! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '150.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 해외 배당처리 점검! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '160.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 전부해지 자(클레스)펀드 전부해지 점검! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '161.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 설정환매 점검(예탁원 전문과 대사)! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '170.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 타사집합투자증권 매매 점검(예탁원 전문과 대사)! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '180.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 타사이익분배금 점검(예탁원 전문과 대사)! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '190.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 보수인출등점검(예탁원 전문과 대사)! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '200.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 채권매매 점검(예탁원전문매매만 대사)! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '210.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 증거금 채권매입점검! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '220.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 배당처리 신주인수권/워런트종목배당처리! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '230.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 공모청약 내역점검(예탁원 전문에서 수신된 내역 만 대사)! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '231.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 예탁원 공시내역 당사 미처리 점검! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '240.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: KSD주식매매 점검(예탁원 전문에서 수신내역 대사)!');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '250.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: KSD주식매매 점검(KSD주식 매매중 당사계좌미등록으로 거래 미생성된 거래)!');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '260.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 주식매도제한 주식매도종목 점검)!');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '270.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 주식매매처위탁계좌 점검)!');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '271.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 주식매매 중 당사미보유 종목을 매입하는 경우 벤처등록여부 체크 점검)!');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '280.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 선물매매대사점검)!');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '290.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 라이언2007A펀드 운용보수율(#) 재셋팅!');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '291.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 네오밸류2004100펀드결산익일분개점검(#)!');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '300.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 유상처리누락점검(#)!');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '301.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 유상청약일 청약처리 누락 점검(#)!');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '310.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: KIND공시자료로드 건수확인! 누락 점검(#)!');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '320.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: REPO상환거래점검 건수확인! 점검(#)!');


BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'PROC0590', 'start. ' || p_ymd || '- : 회계처리 단계 오류 점검');

    DELETE FROM SZT0CK t1  
     WHERE t1.corp_gr            = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd                = p_ymd
       AND t1.CHECK_PGMID        = 'PROC0590'
       AND NVL(t1.check_yn,'N')  = 'N';

    SELECT NVL(MAX(seq), 0)
      INTO w_seq
      FROM SZT0CK t1
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    w_cnt   := 0;

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 채권 및 대출채권 미수입금 존재하는 종목에 거래 발생
    --------------------------------------------------------
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '110.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 채권 및 대출채권 미수입금 존재하는 종목에 매도 발생 확인! ');

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT fund_cd
             , jm_cd
             , tr_cd
             , SUM(NVL(aekm,0))    AS aekm
             , SUM(NVL(tr_aek,0))  AS tr_aek
          FROM SCT0CG t1
         WHERE corp_gr          = p_corp_gr
           AND tr_ymd           = p_ymd
           AND tr_cd            IN ('E38','E42','K11','K12','K13')
           AND (fund_cd,jm_cd)  IN (SELECT DISTINCT fund_cd
                                         , jm_cd
                                      FROM SCT1CG h1
                                     WHERE corp_gr         = p_corp_gr
                                       AND NVL(JAN_AEK,0)  > 0)
         GROUP BY fund_cd, jm_cd, tr_cd
        UNION ALL
        SELECT fund_cd
             , jm_cd
             , tr_cd
             , SUM(NVL(aekm,0))    AS aekm
             , SUM(NVL(tr_aek,0))  AS tr_aek
          FROM SHT0HG t1
         WHERE corp_gr          = p_corp_gr
           AND tr_ymd           = p_ymd
           AND tr_cd            IN ('E37','E41','K30')
           AND (fund_cd,jm_cd)  IN (SELECT DISTINCT fund_cd
                                         , jm_cd
                                      FROM SHT1HG h1
                                     WHERE corp_gr         = p_corp_gr
                                       AND NVL(JAN_AEK,0)  > 0)
         GROUP BY fund_cd, jm_cd, tr_cd
    ) loop

        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(check_yn,'N')
              INTO w_check_yn
              FROM SZT0CK t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
               AND t1.tr_cd       = xx.tr_cd
               AND t1.check_item  = '미수금종목매도확인'
               AND t1.check_pgmid = 'PROC0590'
               AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            w_check_yn  := 'F';
        END;

        if  w_check_yn != 'Y'   then    -- 미점검
            if  w_check_yn = 'F'    then    -- 미생성
                w_seq   := w_seq + 1;

                INSERT INTO SZT0CK
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr             /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd                 /* _2- */
                       , xx.fund_cd            /* _3- */
                       , xx.jm_cd              /* _4- */
                       , xx.tr_cd              /* _5- */
                       , w_seq                 /* _6- */
                       , 'N'                   /* _7- */
                       , 'Z1'                  /* _8- */
                       , '미수금종목매도확인'  /* _9- */
                       , '미등록'              /* _10- */
                       , NULL                  /* _11- */
                       , NULL                  /* _12- */
                       , NULL                  /* _13- */
                       , NULL                  /* _14- */
                       , xx.aekm               /* _15- */
                       , xx.tr_aek             /* _16- */
                       , sysdate               /* _17- */
                       , 'PROC0590'            /* _18- */
                       , NULL                  /* _19- */
                       , 13762560              /* _20- */
                       , 'PROC0590'            /* _21- */
                       );
            end if;

        w_cnt   := w_cnt + 1;
--        INSERT INTO WFRMERR
--        VALUES ( p_corp_gr
--               , 'SZ46998 ' || TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '(' || p_corp_gr || '/' || xx.fund_cd || '/' || xx.jm_cd || '/' || xx.tr_cd || ') '
--                            || ' 거래액면: ' || F_NTRIM(xx.AEKM)
--                            || ' 거래금액: ' || F_NTRIM(xx.TR_AEK) || ' - 110.채권(#)/대출채권(#)미수입금보유종목감소거래 발생정산여부검토!'
--               );
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 정정분개처리 비고란 미입력 오류 처리
    --------------------------------------------------------
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '140.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 정정분개처리 비고란 미입력 오류! ');

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT fund_cd
             , tr_cd
             , MAX(bigo)  AS bigo
          FROM SKT0BU t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr         = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd          = p_ymd
           AND t1.bigo IS NULL
           AND SUBSTR(TR_CD,1,1)  = 'Z'
         GROUP BY fund_cd
                , tr_cd
    ) loop
        w_cnt   := w_cnt + 1;
--        INSERT INTO WFRMERR
--        VALUES ( p_corp_gr
--               , 'SZ46998 ' || TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '(' || p_corp_gr || '/' || xx.fund_cd || '/' || xx.tr_cd || ') '
--                            || ' 140.정정분개처리 시 사유입력이 누락되었습니다. # 비고를 입력하세요!'
--               );
    END LOOP;

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 해외 배당처리 점검
    -- 기 처리한 배당이 있는 종목은 기처리분과 합산하여 처리할 것이지 검토가 필요함
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '150.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 해외 배당처리 점검! ');

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.corp_gr               /* _1- */
             , t1.ymd                   /* _2- */
             , yg.fund_cd               /* _3- */
             , yg.trustee               /* _4- */
             , yg.jm_cd                 /* _5- */
             , ya.jm_nm                 /* _6- */
             , yg.currency              /* _7- */
             , yg.upd_user              /* _8- */
             , COUNT(*)     AS row_cnt  /* _9- */
          FROM SYT0YG_PYUNGA t1
             , SYT0YG        yg
             , SYM0YA        ya
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.churi_ymd,t1.ymd + 1)  > t1.ymd
           AND yg.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
           AND yg.upd_user    != 'Y'
           AND yg.pyunga_join = t1.pyunga_join
           AND ya.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd       = yg.jm_cd
         GROUP BY t1.corp_gr 
                , t1.ymd     
                , yg.fund_cd 
                , yg.trustee 
                , yg.jm_cd   
                , ya.jm_nm   
                , yg.currency
                , yg.upd_user
         HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    ) loop
        w_cnt   := w_cnt + 1;
--        INSERT INTO WFRMERR
--        VALUES ( p_corp_gr
--               , 'SZ46998 ' || TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '(' || p_corp_gr || '/' || xx.fund_cd || '/' || xx.jm_cd || '/' || xx.jm_nm
--                            || '/150. 종목기처리분이' || xx.row_cnt-1 || '건이 있습니다.) 전처리내역 감안 당일분 처리(확인시 # 확인란=Y입력)!'
--               );
    END LOOP;

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 신주인수권/워런트 종목배당처리된 종목 점검
    --------------------------------------------------------
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '220.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 신주인수권/워런트 종목 배당처리! ');

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT fund_cd
             , jm_cd
             , NVL(MISU_BAED_AEK,0)  AS MISU_BAED_AEK
          FROM SJM0JM t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr            = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                = p_ymd
           AND SUBSTR(t1.jm_cd,1,3)  NOT IN ('KR7','KR8')
           AND (NVL(BFIL_BOYU_JUSU,0) + NVL(UP_JUSU,0) - NVL(DW_JUSU,0) + NVL(GONGS_UP_JUSU,0) - NVL(GONGS_DW_JUSU,0))  > 0
           AND NVL(MISU_BAED_AEK,0)  > 0
    ) loop
        -- 점검 후 예외처리 (행후 사용자가 점검하게 반영)
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(check_yn,'N')
              INTO w_check_yn
              FROM SZT0CK t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
               AND t1.tr_cd       = '%'
               AND t1.check_item  = '특별주식종목배당처리점검'
               AND t1.check_pgmid = 'PROC0590'
               AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            w_check_yn  := 'F';
        END;

        if  w_check_yn != 'Y'   then    -- 미점검
            if  w_check_yn = 'F'    then    -- 미생성
                w_seq   := w_seq + 1;

                INSERT INTO SZT0CK
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                   /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd                       /* _2- */
                       , xx.fund_cd                  /* _3- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                    /* _4- */
                       , '%'                         /* _5- */
                       , w_seq                       /* _6- */
                       , 'N'                         /* _7- */
                       , 'Z1'                        /* _8- */
                       , '특별주식종목배당처리점검'  /* _9- */
                       , '미등록'                    /* _10- */
                       , NULL                        /* _11- */
                       , NULL                        /* _12- */
                       , NULL                        /* _13- */
                       , NULL                        /* _14- */
                       , xx.MISU_BAED_AEK            /* _15- */
                       , NULL                        /* _16- */
                       , sysdate                     /* _17- */
                       , 'PROC0590'                  /* _18- */
                       , NULL                        /* _19- */
                       , 13762560                    /* _20- */
                       , 'PROC0590'                  /* _21- */
                       );
            end if;

            w_cnt   := w_cnt + 1;
--            INSERT INTO WFRMERR
--            VALUES ( p_corp_gr
--                   , 'SZ46998 ' || TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '(' || p_corp_gr || '/' || xx.fund_cd || '/' || xx.jm_cd || ') '
--                                || ' sjm0jm의 MISU_BAED_AEK : ' || F_NTRIM(xx.MISU_BAED_AEK) || ' - 220.수익증권/워런트 종목 배당처리 확인!'
--                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --주식매매 중 매도제한 종목 점검
    --(20200325 new)공모주등 매도제한주식 매도 점검
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '260.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 매도제한주식매도 종목 점검)!');

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                       /* _1- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                         /* _2- */
             , F_JM_NM(t1.corp_gr,t1.jm_cd)                        AS jm_nm     /* _3- */
             , NVL(t1.BFIL_BOYU_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.UP_JUSU,0)
                                        - NVL(t1.DW_JUSU,0)
                                        + NVL(t1.GONGS_UP_JUSU,0)
                                        - NVL(t1.GONGS_DW_JUSU,0)  AS jan_jusu  /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.BFIL_JILG_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.JILG_UP_JUSU,0)
                                        - NVL(t1.JILG_DW_JUSU,0)   AS JILG_JUSU /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.LOCK_JUSU,0)                                 AS LOCK_JUSU /* _6- */
             , NVL(t2.TR_JUSU,0)                                   AS TR_JUSU   /* _7- */
          FROM SJM0JM t1
             , SJT0JG t2
         WHERE 1 = 1
         --and   ((nvl(t1.BFIL_JILG_JUSU,0) + nvl(t1.JILG_UP_JUSU,0) - nvl(t1.JILG_DW_JUSU,0)) > 0 or nvl(t1.LOCK_JUSU,0) > 0)
           AND t1.corp_gr            = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.BFIL_BOYU_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.UP_JUSU,0) 
                                        - NVL(t1.DW_JUSU,0)
                                        + NVL(t1.GONGS_UP_JUSU,0)
                                        - NVL(t1.GONGS_DW_JUSU,0)  < NVL(t1.BFIL_JILG_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.JILG_UP_JUSU,0)
                                        - NVL(t1.JILG_DW_JUSU,0)
                                        + NVL(t1.LOCK_JUSU,0)
           AND t2.corp_gr            = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd            = t1.fund_cd
           AND SUBSTR(t2.tr_cd,1,1)  = 'K'  /* 매도거래 */
           AND t2.tr_ymd             = t1.ymd
           AND t2.jm_cd              = t1.jm_cd
           AND t2.jm_cd              = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(check_yn,'N')
              INTO w_check_yn
              FROM SZT0CK t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
               AND t1.tr_cd       = 'K00'
               AND t1.check_item  = '매도제한주식매도점검'
               AND t1.check_pgmid = 'PROC0590'
               AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            w_check_yn  := 'F';
        END;
        if  w_check_yn != 'Y'   then    -- 미점검
            if  w_check_yn = 'F'    then    -- 미생성
                w_seq   := w_seq + 1;
                INSERT INTO SZT0CK
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr               /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd                   /* _2- */
                       , xx.fund_cd              /* _3- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                /* _4- */
                       , 'K00'                   /* _5- */
                       , w_seq                   /* _6- */
                       , 'N'                     /* _7- */
                       , 'Z1'                    /* _8- */
                       , '매도제한주식매도점검'  /* _9- */
                       , '미등록'                /* _10- */
                       , SUBSTR(xx.jm_nm,1,10)   /* _11- */
                       , xx.jan_jusu             /* _12- */
                       , xx.JILG_JUSU            /* _13- */
                       , NULL                    /* _14- */
                       , xx.LOCK_JUSU            /* _15- */
                       , xx.TR_JUSU              /* _16- */
                       , sysdate                 /* _17- */
                       , 'PROC0590'              /* _18- */
                       , NULL                    /* _19- */
                       , 13762560                /* _20- */
                       , 'PROC0590'              /* _21- */
                       );
            end if;
            w_cnt   := w_cnt + 1;
--            INSERT INTO WFRMERR
--            VALUES ( p_corp_gr
--                   , 'SZ46998 ' || w_check_yn || '/' || TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '(' || p_corp_gr || '/' || xx.fund_cd || ' /' || xx.jm_cd || '/' || xx.jm_nm || ') '
--                                || ' 잔고주수: ' || xx.jan_jusu || ' 질권주수: ' || xx.JILG_JUSU
--                                || ' 제한수량: ' || xx.LOCK_JUSU || ' 매도주수: ' || xx.TR_JUSU
--                                || ' 과다매매수량: ' || F_NTRIM(xx.jan_jusu - xx.LOCK_JUSU - xx.TR_JUSU) || ' 260.매도제한주식매도종목(#)확인!'
--                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    -- 20211207 유상 청약일에 처리 누락 점검(#)!
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '301.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 유상청약일 청약처리 누락 점검(#)!');

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT tt.balh_co                                                          /* _1- */
             , tt.fund_cd                                                          /* _2- */
             , tt.new_jm_cd                                                        /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(sjt0j1_jusu), 0)                             AS sjt0j1_jusu /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(sjt0cy_jusu), 0)                             AS sjt0cy_jusu /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(sjt0cy_jusu), 0) - NVL(SUM(sjt0j1_jusu), 0)  AS diff_jusu   /* _6- */
          FROM (SELECT t1.balh_co             AS balh_co
                     , t1.fund_cd
                     , t1.new_jm_cd           AS new_jm_cd
                     , NVL(t1.CHG_BF_JUSU,0)  AS sjt0j1_jusu
                     , 0                      AS sjt0cy_jusu
                  FROM SJT0J1 t1
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.balh_co IN (SELECT DISTINCT BALH_CO
                                        FROM SJT0JK g1
                                       WHERE tr_cd                        = 'G31'
                                         AND NVL(CHENG_YMD,to_date ('20211209','yyyymmdd'))  Between p_ymd - 7 AND p_ymd)
                UNION ALL
                SELECT SUBSTR(t1.KOSCOM_CD,1,5)  AS balh_co
                     , t1.fund_cd
                     , t1.jm_cd                  AS new_jm_cd
                     , 0                         AS sjt0j1_jusu
                     , NVL(t1.HWAKJ_JUSU,0)      AS sjt0cy_jusu
                  FROM SJT0CY t1
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr                = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.tr_ymd                 Between p_ymd - 7 AND p_ymd
                   AND SUBSTR(t1.KOSCOM_CD,1,5)  IN (SELECT DISTINCT BALH_CO
                                                       FROM SJT0JK g1
                                                      WHERE tr_cd                        = 'G31'
                                                        AND NVL(CHENG_YMD,to_date ('20211209','yyyymmdd'))  Between p_ymd - 7 AND p_ymd)
                ) tt 
         HAVING NVL(SUM(sjt0cy_jusu), 0)- NVL(SUM(sjt0j1_jusu), 0) != 0  /* 점검범위 */
         GROUP BY tt.balh_co, tt.fund_cd, tt.new_jm_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(NVL(BFIL_BOYU_JUSU,0) + NVL(UP_JUSU,0)
                                             - NVL(DW_JUSU,0)
                                             + NVL(GONGS_UP_JUSU,0)
                                             - NVL(GONGS_DW_JUSU,0), 0)
              INTO w_skt0bu_aek
              FROM SJM0JM t1
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND ymd     = p_ymd
               AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd   = xx.new_jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            w_skt0bu_aek    := 0;
        END;

        if  xx.sjt0j1_jusu > 0 AND xx.sjt0cy_jusu = 0 AND w_skt0bu_aek = 0  then    CONTINUE;
        end if;  --공시처리 이후 KRT종목 매도후 현재 잔고없음 시 미체크

        BEGIN
            SELECT COUNT(*)
              INTO w_item_cnt
              FROM SJT0JK t1
             WHERE tr_cd                        = 'G32'
               AND balh_co                      = xx.balh_co
               AND NVL(CHENG_YMD,to_date ('20211209','yyyymmdd'))  Between p_ymd - 7 AND p_ymd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            w_item_cnt  := 0;
        END;

        --제외
        if  xx.sjt0j1_jusu = 0 AND xx.sjt0cy_jusu > 0 AND w_item_cnt > 0    then    CONTINUE;
        end if;  --G32 발행가/유상비율 변경처리내역이 있는 경우 제외


        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(check_yn,'N')
              INTO w_check_yn
              FROM SZT0CK t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
               AND t1.tr_cd       = 'F18'
               AND t1.check_item  = '유상청약처리누락'
               AND t1.check_pgmid = 'PROC0590'
               AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.new_jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            w_check_yn  := 'F';
        END;
--
        if  w_check_yn != 'Y'   then    -- 미점검
            if  w_check_yn = 'F'    then    -- 미생성
                w_seq   := w_seq + 1;
                INSERT INTO SZT0CK
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                    /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd                        /* _2- */
                       , xx.fund_cd                   /* _3- */
                       , xx.new_jm_cd                 /* _4- */
                       , 'F18'                        /* _5- */
                       , w_seq                        /* _6- */
                       , 'N'                          /* _7- */
                       , 'Z1'                         /* _8- */
                       , '유상청약처리누락'           /* _9- */
                       , '미등록'                     /* _10- */
                       , NULL                         /* _11- */
                       , xx.sjt0j1_jusu               /* _12- */
                       , NULL                         /* _13- */
                       , NULL                         /* _14- */
                       , xx.sjt0cy_jusu               /* _15- */
                       , xx.diff_jusu                 /* _16- */
                       , sysdate                      /* _17- */
                       , 'PROC0590'                   /* _18- */
                       , xx.new_jm_cd || F_BALH_NM(p_corp_gr, xx.balh_co) 
                                      || '/메뉴:# #'  /* _19- */
                       , 13762560                     /* _20- */
                       , 'PROC0590'                   /* _21- */
                       );
            end if;

            w_cnt   := w_cnt + 1;
--            INSERT INTO WFRMERR
--            VALUES ( p_corp_gr
--                   , 'SZ46998 ' || w_check_yn || '/' || TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '(' || p_corp_gr || '/' || xx.fund_cd || '/' || xx.new_jm_cd || '/'
--                                || F_BALH_NM(p_corp_gr, xx.balh_co) || ') '
--                                || ' 공시(sjt0j1)수량 : ' || xx.sjt0j1_jusu
--                                || ' 청약(sjt0cy)수량 : ' || xx.sjt0cy_jusu
--                                || ' 차이수량  : ' || xx.diff_jusu
--                                || ' 중도매도수량 : ' || w_skt0bu_aek
--                                || ' 301.유상청약 처리 누락 점검(#/#)!'
--                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    ---------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 20220104 납입일 공모주 청약종목 납입처리 누락 점검(#)
    ---------------------------------------------------------------
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '302.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 공모주청약 납입처리 누락 점검(#)!');

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT corp_gr                                             /* _1- */
             , fund_cd                                             /* _2- */
             , jm_cd                                               /* _3- */
             , SUM(sjg1fc_jusu)                     AS sjg1fc_jusu /* _4- */
             , SUM(sjm0jm_jusu)                     AS sjm0jm_jusu /* _5- */
             , SUM(sjg1fc_jusu) - SUM(sjm0jm_jusu)  AS diff_jusu   /* _6- */
          FROM (         --납입일 공모주 청약종목 납입 미처리
                SELECT t1.corp_gr   AS corp_gr
                     , t1.fund_cd   AS fund_cd
                     , t2.cy_jm_cd  AS jm_cd
                     , CASE WHEN t2.cy_gb='1' THEN NVL(t1.cy_aek,0) + NVL(t1.cy_susu,0)
                                              ELSE (NVL(t1.cy_aek,0) + NVL(t1.cy_susu,0)) - NVL(t1.sc_aek,0)
                       END          AS sjg1fc_jusu
                     , 0            AS sjm0jm_jusu  /* 공모청약 '1', 실권주청약 '2' */
                  FROM SJG1FC t1
                     , SJG1JC t2
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr        = p_corp_gr
                   AND NVL(t1.CY_AEK,0)  > 0
                   AND t2.nabib_ymd      = p_ymd
                   AND t2.jc_join        = t1.jc_join
                UNION ALL
         --납입일 공모주 청약종목 납입 미처리
                SELECT corp_gr
                     , fund_cd
                     , jm_cd
                     , 0
                     , SUM(CASE WHEN CHADAE_GB='C' THEN NVL(aek,0)
                                                   ELSE NVL(aek,0) * -1
                           END)
                  FROM SKT0BU h1
                 WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd
                   AND gwamok  = '10101'
                   AND tr_cd   IN ('F47','F49')
                   AND jm_cd   IN (SELECT DISTINCT cy_jm_cd
                                     FROM SJG1JC g1
                                    WHERE nabib_ymd = p_ymd)
                 GROUP BY corp_gr, fund_cd, jm_cd
                ) t1 
         HAVING SUM(sjg1fc_jusu) = 0 OR SUM(sjm0jm_jusu) = 0 OR SUM(sjg1fc_jusu) != SUM(sjm0jm_jusu)
         GROUP BY corp_gr, fund_cd, jm_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(check_yn,'N')
              INTO w_check_yn
              FROM SZT0CK t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
               AND t1.tr_cd       = 'F49'
               AND t1.check_item  = '공모주납입처리누락'
               AND t1.check_pgmid = 'PROC0590'
               AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            w_check_yn  := 'F';
        END;
--
        if  w_check_yn != 'Y'   then    -- 미점검
            if  w_check_yn = 'F'    then    -- 미생성
                w_seq   := w_seq + 1;
                INSERT INTO SZT0CK
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                  /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd                                      /* _2- */
                       , xx.fund_cd                                 /* _3- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                                   /* _4- */
                       , 'F49'                                      /* _5- */
                       , w_seq                                      /* _6- */
                       , 'N'                                        /* _7- */
                       , 'Z1'                                       /* _8- */
                       , '공모주납입처리누락'                       /* _9- */
                       , '미등록'                                   /* _10- */
                       , NULL                                       /* _11- */
                       , xx.sjg1fc_jusu                             /* _12- */
                       , NULL                                       /* _13- */
                       , NULL                                       /* _14- */
                       , xx.sjm0jm_jusu                             /* _15- */
                       , xx.diff_jusu                               /* _16- */
                       , sysdate                                    /* _17- */
                       , 'PROC0590'                                 /* _18- */
                       , F_JM_NM(p_corp_gr, xx.jm_cd) || '/메뉴:#'  /* _19- */
                       , 13762560                                   /* _20- */
                       , 'PROC0590'                                 /* _21- */
                       );
            end if;

            w_cnt   := w_cnt + 1;
--            INSERT INTO WFRMERR
--            VALUES ( p_corp_gr
--                   , 'SZ46998 ' || w_check_yn || '/' || TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '(' || p_corp_gr || '/' || xx.fund_cd || '/' || xx.jm_cd || '/'
--                                || F_JM_NM(p_corp_gr, xx.jm_cd) || ') '
--                                || ' sjg1fc금액 : ' || xx.sjg1fc_jusu
--                                || ' sjm0jm금액 : ' || xx.sjm0jm_jusu
--                                || ' 금액수량  : ' || xx.diff_jusu
--                                || ' 302.공모주 납입처리 누락 점검(#)!'
--                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    ---------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 20220104 공모주종목 상장일에 상장처리 누락 점검(#)
    ---------------------------------------------------------------
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', '303.PROC0590 회계처리점검 :: 공모주청약 상장처리 누락 점검(#)!');

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT corp_gr                                   /* _1- */
             , fund_cd                                   /* _2- */
             , balh_co                      AS jm_cd     /* _3- */
             , SUM(dw_jusu)                 AS dw_jusu   /* _4- */
             , SUM(up_jusu)                 AS up_jusu   /* _5- */
             , SUM(up_jusu) - SUM(dw_jusu)  AS diff_jusu /* _6- */
          FROM (SELECT t1.corp_gr
                     , t1.fund_cd
                     , t1.balh_co
                     , CASE WHEN t2.cy_gb='1' THEN NVL(GONGS_DW_JUSU,0)
                                              ELSE NVL(DW_JUSU,0) + NVL(GONGS_DW_JUSU,0)
                       END  AS dw_jusu
                     , 0    AS up_jusu
                  FROM SJM0JM t1
                     , SJG1JC t2
                     , SJG1FC t3
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
                   AND t2.sj_ymd   = t1.ymd
                   AND t2.balh_co  = t1.balh_co
                   AND t2.cy_jm_cd = t1.jm_cd  /* 청약코드 */
                   AND t3.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
                   AND t3.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
                   AND t3.jc_join  = t2.jc_join
                UNION ALL
                SELECT t1.corp_gr
                     , t1.fund_cd
                     , t1.balh_co
                     , 0    AS dw_jusu
                     , CASE WHEN t2.cy_gb='1' THEN NVL(GONGS_UP_JUSU,0)
                                              ELSE NVL(UP_JUSU,0) + NVL(GONGS_UP_JUSU,0)
                       END  AS up_jusu
                  FROM SJM0JM t1
                     , SJG1JC t2
                     , SJG1FC t3
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
                   AND t2.sj_ymd   = t1.ymd
                   AND t2.balh_co  = t1.balh_co
                   AND t2.sj_jm_cd = t1.jm_cd  /* 상장코드 */
                   AND t3.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
                   AND t3.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
                   AND t3.jc_join  = t2.jc_join
                ) t1 
         HAVING SUM(dw_jusu) = 0 OR SUM(up_jusu) = 0 OR SUM(dw_jusu) != SUM(up_jusu)
         GROUP BY corp_gr, fund_cd, balh_co
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(tr_cd,1,1)='J' THEN NVL(tr_jusu,0)
                                                           ELSE NVL(tr_jusu,0) * -1
                           END), 0)
              INTO w_skt0bu_aek
              FROM SJT0JG t1
             WHERE corp_gr            = p_corp_gr
               AND tr_ymd             = p_ymd
               AND SUBSTR(tr_cd,1,1)  IN ('K','J')
               AND fund_cd            = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd              IN (SELECT DISTINCT sj_jm_cd
                                            FROM SJG1JC h1
                                           WHERE sj_ymd  = p_ymd
                                             AND balh_co = xx.jm_cd);
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            w_skt0bu_aek    := 0;
        END;

        if  w_skt0bu_aek = xx.diff_jusu then    CONTINUE;
        end if;  --시장매입이 있는는경우 미체크

        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(check_yn,'N')
              INTO w_check_yn
              FROM SZT0CK t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
               AND t1.tr_cd       = 'G51'
               AND t1.check_item  = '공모주상장처리누락'
               AND t1.check_pgmid = 'PROC0590'
               AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            w_check_yn  := 'F';
        END;
--
        if  w_check_yn != 'Y'   then    -- 미점검
            if  w_check_yn = 'F'    then    -- 미생성
                w_seq   := w_seq + 1;
                INSERT INTO SZT0CK
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                  /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd                                      /* _2- */
