                       , xx.fund_cd                                 /* _3- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                                   /* _4- */
                       , 'G51'                                      /* _5- */
                       , w_seq                                      /* _6- */
                       , 'N'                                        /* _7- */
                       , 'Z1'                                       /* _8- */
                       , '공모주상장처리누락'                       /* _9- */
                       , '미등록'                                   /* _10- */
                       , NULL                                       /* _11- */
                       , xx.up_jusu                                 /* _12- */
                       , w_skt0bu_aek                               /* _13- */
                       , NULL                                       /* _14- */
                       , xx.dw_jusu                                 /* _15- */
                       , xx.diff_jusu                               /* _16- */
                       , sysdate                                    /* _17- */
                       , 'PROC0590'                                 /* _18- */
                       , F_JM_NM(p_corp_gr, xx.jm_cd) || '/메뉴:#'  /* _19- */
                       , 13762560                                   /* _20- */
                       , 'PROC0590'                                 /* _21- */
                       );
            end if;

            w_cnt   := w_cnt + 1;
--            INSERT INTO WFRMERR
--            VALUES ( p_corp_gr
--                   , 'SZ46998 ' || w_check_yn || '/' || TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '(' || p_corp_gr || '/' || xx.fund_cd || '/' || xx.jm_cd || '/'
--                                || F_JM_NM(p_corp_gr, xx.jm_cd) || ') '
--                                || ' 신주증가수량 : ' || xx.up_jusu
--                                || ' 구주감소수량 : ' || xx.dw_jusu
--                                || ' 차이수량 : ' || xx.diff_jusu
--                                || ' 매입수량 : ' || w_skt0bu_aek
--                                || ' 303.공모주 상장처리 누락 점검(#)!'
--                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    ---------------------------------------------
    -- REPO 상환시 원금/이자/수수료 차이 검증(#2812)
    ---------------------------------------------

    if (TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24:MI:SS') > '13:00:00') then
        FOR xx IN (
            SELECT fund_cd                                           /* _1- */
                 , s_sanghw_ymd                                      /* _2- */
                 , SUM(s_aekm)                        AS s_aekm      /* _3- */
                 , SUM(s_ija)                         AS s_ija       /* _4- */
                 , SUM(s_susu_ga)                     AS s_susu_ga   /* _5- */
                 , SUM(ksd_aekm)                      AS ksd_aekm    /* _6- */
                 , SUM(ksd_ija)                       AS ksd_ija     /* _7- */
                 , SUM(ksd_susu_ga)                   AS ksd_susu_ga /* _8- */
                 , SUM(s_aekm) - SUM(ksd_aekm)        AS err_aekm    /* _9- */
                 , SUM(s_ija) - SUM(ksd_ija)          AS err_ija     /* _10- */
                 , SUM(s_susu_ga) - SUM(ksd_susu_ga)  AS err_susu_ga /* _11- */
              FROM (SELECT t1.corp_gr                                           /* _1- */
                         , t1.fund_cd                                           /* _2- */
                         , TO_DATE(t2.SANGHW_YMD,'yyyy/mm/dd')  AS s_sanghw_ymd /* _3- */
                         , t1.AEKM                              AS s_aekm       /* _4- */
                         , t1.SANGHW_AEK - t1.AEKM              AS s_ija        /* _5- */
                         , t1.SUSU_GA                           AS s_susu_ga    /* _6- */
                         , 0                                    AS ksd_aekm     /* _7- */
                         , 0                                    AS ksd_ija      /* _8- */
                         , 0                                    AS ksd_susu_ga  /* _9- */
                      FROM SHT0HG t1     , SHM0HJ t2
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                       AND t2.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
                       AND t2.SANGHW_YMD = p_ymd
                       AND t2.cash_cd    = '72'  /* REPO매수 */
                       AND t2.jm_cd      = t1.jm_cd
                    ) t1 
             HAVING abs(SUM(s_aekm) - SUM(ksd_aekm)) > 0 OR abs(SUM(s_ija) - SUM(ksd_ija)) > 0
                     OR abs(SUM(s_susu_ga) - SUM(ksd_susu_ga)) > 0
             GROUP BY fund_cd, s_sanghw_ymd
        ) loop

            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL(check_yn,'N')
                  INTO w_check_yn
                  FROM SZT0CK t1
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
                   AND t1.tr_cd       = '%'
                   AND t1.check_item  = 'REPO종료결제확인'
                   AND t1.check_pgmid = 'PROC0590'
                   AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.s_sanghw_ymd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                w_check_yn  := 'F';
            END;
--

        if  w_check_yn != 'Y'   then    -- 미점검
            if  w_check_yn = 'F'    then    -- 미생성
                w_seq   := w_seq + 1;
                INSERT INTO SZT0CK
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                       /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd                                           /* _2- */
                       , xx.fund_cd                                      /* _3- */
                       , xx.s_sanghw_ymd                                 /* _4- */
                       , '%'                                             /* _5- */
                       , w_seq                                           /* _6- */
                       , 'N'                                             /* _7- */
                       , 'Z1'                                            /* _8- */
                       , 'REPO종료결제확인'                              /* _9- */
                       , '미등록'                                        /* _10- */
                       , xx.s_aekm                                       /* _11- */
                       , xx.s_ija                                        /* _12- */
                       , xx.s_susu_ga                                    /* _13- */
                       , xx.ksd_aekm                                     /* _14- */
                       , xx.ksd_ija                                      /* _15- */
                       , xx.ksd_susu_ga                                  /* _16- */
                       , sysdate                                         /* _17- */
                       , 'PROC0590'                                      /* _18- */
                       , '메뉴:#2812' || '/액면차:' || xx.err_aekm
                                      || '/이자차:' || xx.err_ija
                                      || '/수수료차:' || xx.err_susu_ga  /* _19- */
                       , 13762560                                        /* _20- */
                       , 'PROC0590'                                      /* _21- */
                       );
            end if;

            w_cnt   := w_cnt + 1;
--            INSERT INTO WFRMERR
--            VALUES ( p_corp_gr
--                   , 'SZ46998 ' || w_check_yn || '/' || TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || '(' || p_corp_gr || '/' || xx.fund_cd || '/' || xx.s_sanghw_ymd || '/'
--                                || F_FUND_NM(p_corp_gr, xx.fund_cd) || ') '
--                                || ' 액면차이 : ' || xx.err_aekm
--                                || ' 이자차이 : ' || xx.err_ija
--                                || ' 수수료차이 : ' || xx.err_susu_ga
--                                || ' 320.REPO종료결제확인 점검(#)!'
--                   );
        end if;
        END LOOP;
    end if;
--    if  w_cnt > 0   then
--        p_msg   := F_NTRIM (w_cnt) || '건의 점검오류가 발생했습니다. #8888화면에서 확인하시기 바랍니다.';
--        RETURN;
--    end if;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0590 : ', 'end. 회계처리점검(szt0ck) 종료!!!! ');

    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    p_msg   := 'SZ46998:' || w_msg || SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0600 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 평가처리
--
    w_trade_ymd                    DATE;
    w_open_ymd                     DATE;
    w_siga_ymd                     DATE;

    w_z10_1                        NUMBER;  /* 취득액보정 손실해당액 */
    w_z10_2                        NUMBER;  /* 취득액보정 이익해당액 */

    w_jonga                        NUMBER;
    w_sangj_jusu                   NUMBER;

    w_siga_aek                     NUMBER;
    w_danga                        NUMBER;
    w_jungsan_aek                  NUMBER;
    w_pyunga_sonik                 NUMBER;

    w_gijun_ga                     NUMBER;
    w_ggijun_ga                    NUMBER;
    w_trans_unit                   NUMBER;

    w_tr_sonik_gb                  sst0ks.tr_sonik_gb%type;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    w_trade_ymd := F_TRADE_YMD (p_ymd, '-');  /* 주식평가처리 */
    w_open_ymd  := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '-');   /* 입력일이 비영업일인 경우 전영업일 */

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0600', p_ymd || ' : 주식평가처리 초기화');

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
       AND t1.tr_cd   = 'Z10'
       AND proc_step  = 9;

    -- 20240902 리코 선급비용 제외처리
    if  p_ymd = TO_DATE ('20240902','yyyymmdd') then
        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.fund_cd                                          /* _1- */
                 , t1.jm_cd                                            /* _2- */
                 , t1.sung_cost                                        /* _3- */
                 , CASE hj.cash_cd WHEN '10' THEN '10107'
                                   WHEN '20' THEN '10108'
                                   WHEN '50' THEN '10106'
                                   WHEN '60' THEN '10109'
                                   WHEN '70' THEN '10110'
                                   WHEN '71' THEN '20105'
                                   WHEN '72' THEN '10110'
                                   WHEN '80' THEN '10102'
                                   WHEN 'AA' THEN '10207'
                                   WHEN 'DC' THEN '10205'
                                   WHEN 'ZS' THEN '10507'
                                   WHEN 'ZF' THEN '10107'
                   END                                     AS gwamok   /* _4- */
                 , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                                              , t1.jm_cd)  AS row_no   /* _5- */
              FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
                 , SHM0HJ hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd       = p_ymd
               AND t1.sung_cost != 0
               AND hj.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr
               AND hj.jm_cd     = t1.jm_cd
        ) loop
            UPDATE SHM0HM   /* 현금 보유현황 */
               SET bfil_chui_aek  = bfil_chui_aek + x1.sung_cost
                 , bfil_sung_cost = 0
                 , sung_cost      = 0
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND ymd     = p_ymd
               AND fund_cd = x1.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd   = x1.jm_cd;

            SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z10', 'A', '1', x1.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                       x1.jm_cd, 1, 1, x1.row_no, 'D', x1.gwamok, x1.sung_cost, 'Z10', 9, '취득액 선급비용포함처리(PROC0600)', w_msg);

            SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z10', 'A', '1', x1.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                       x1.jm_cd, 1, 2, 1, 'C', '12204', x1.sung_cost, 'Z10', 9, '취득액보정 이익해당액(PROC0600)', w_msg);
        end loop;
        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.fund_cd                                          /* _1- */
                 , t1.jm_cd                                            /* _2- */
                 , t1.buy_date                                         /* _3- */
                 , t1.sung_cost                                        /* _4- */
                 , CASE cj.slip_attr || cj.sangj_gb WHEN '1A' THEN '10501'
                                                    WHEN '1B' THEN '10521'
                                                    WHEN '2A' THEN '10502'
                                                    WHEN '2B' THEN '10522'
                                                    WHEN '3A' THEN '10503'
                                                    WHEN '3B' THEN '10523'
                                                    WHEN '4A' THEN '10504'
                                                    WHEN '4B' THEN '10524'
                                                    WHEN '5A' THEN '10506'
                                                    WHEN '5B' THEN '10526'
                                                    WHEN '6A' THEN '10505'
                                                    WHEN '6B' THEN '10525'
                   END                                     AS gwamok   /* _5- */
                 , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                                              , t1.jm_cd)  AS row_no   /* _6- */
              FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
                 , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd       = p_ymd
               AND t1.sung_cost != 0
               AND cj.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr
               AND cj.jm_cd     = t1.jm_cd
        ) loop
            UPDATE SCM0CM t1    /* 채권 보유현황 */
               SET bfil_chui_aek  = bfil_chui_aek + x1.sung_cost
                 , bfil_sung_cost = 0
                 , sung_cost      = 0
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = x1.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = x1.jm_cd
               AND t1.buy_date = x1.buy_date;

            SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z10', 'A', '1', x1.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                       x1.jm_cd, 2, 1, x1.row_no, 'D', x1.gwamok, x1.sung_cost, 'Z10', 9, '취득액 선급비용포함처리(PROC0600)', w_msg);
            SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z10', 'A', '1', x1.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                       x1.jm_cd, 2, 2, 1, 'C', '12202', x1.sung_cost, 'Z10', 9, '취득액보정 이익해당액(PROC0600)', w_msg);
        end loop;
    end if;

    -- 취득액 수정작업(분개포함)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT fund_cd
          FROM (SELECT t1.fund_cd
                  FROM SJM0JM_CHUI t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr          = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd              = p_ymd
                   AND NVL(t1.alter_aek,0) != 0
                UNION ALL
                SELECT t1.fund_cd
                  FROM SCM0CM_CHUI t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr          = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd              = p_ymd
                   AND NVL(t1.alter_aek,0) != 0
                UNION ALL
                SELECT t1.fund_cd
                  FROM SHM0HM_CHUI t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr          = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd              = p_ymd
                   AND NVL(t1.alter_aek,0) != 0
                 ) tt
    ) loop
        w_z10_1 := 0;  /* 취득액보정 손실해당액 */
        w_z10_2 := 0;  /* 취득액보정 이익해당액 */
        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                                                       /* _1- */
                 , t1.jm_cd                                                                                         /* _2- */
                 , t1.type_trench                                                                                   /* _3- */
                 , t1.bs_type                                                                                       /* _4- */
                 , t1.alter_aek                                                                                     /* _5- */
                 , t1.alter_aek - (NVL(jm.BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(jm.GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK,0))             AS mod_aek    /* _6- */
                 , ROUND (t1.alter_aek * jm.GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK / (NVL(jm.BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                                                     + NVL(jm.GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK,0)))  AS gongs_aek  /* _7- */
                 , CASE jj.danc_gb WHEN 'A' THEN '10401'
                                   WHEN 'C' THEN '10402'
                                   WHEN 'D' THEN '10403'
                                   WHEN 'G' THEN '10404'
                                            ELSE '10408'
                   END                                                                                AS gwamok     /* _8- */
                 , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (ORDER BY t1.fund_cd, t1.jm_cd)                                 AS row_no     /* _9- */
              FROM SJM0JM_CHUI t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                 , SJM0JM      jm  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                 , SJM0JJ      jj  /* 주식종목 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr          = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd          = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd              = p_ymd
               AND NVL(t1.alter_aek,0) != 0
               AND jm.CORP_GR          = t1.CORP_GR
               AND jm.YMD              = t1.YMD
               AND jm.FUND_CD          = t1.FUND_CD
               AND jm.JM_CD            = t1.JM_CD
               AND jm.TYPE_TRENCH      = t1.TYPE_TRENCH
               AND jm.BS_TYPE          = t1.BS_TYPE
               AND jj.jm_cd            = t1.jm_cd
        ) loop
            if  x1.gongs_aek > 0    then
                UPDATE SJM0JM t1    /* 주식 보유현황 */
                   SET BFIL_CHUI_AEK     = (x1.alter_aek - x1.gongs_aek)
                     , GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK = x1.gongs_aek
                 WHERE t1.CORP_GR     = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.FUND_CD     = x1.fund_cd
                   AND t1.YMD         = p_ymd
                   AND t1.JM_CD       = x1.jm_cd
                   AND t1.TYPE_TRENCH = x1.type_trench
                   AND t1.BS_TYPE     = x1.bs_type;
            else
                UPDATE SJM0JM t1    /* 주식 보유현황 */
                   SET BFIL_CHUI_AEK = x1.alter_aek
                 WHERE t1.CORP_GR     = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.FUND_CD     = x1.fund_cd
                   AND t1.YMD         = p_ymd
                   AND t1.JM_CD       = x1.jm_cd
                   AND t1.TYPE_TRENCH = x1.type_trench
                   AND t1.BS_TYPE     = x1.bs_type;
            end if;

            SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z10', 'A', '1', x1.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                       x1.jm_cd, 1, 1, x1.row_no, 'D', x1.gwamok, x1.mod_aek, 'Z10', 9, '취득액변경(PROC0600)', w_msg);

            if  x1.mod_aek > 0  then    w_z10_2 := w_z10_2 + x1.mod_aek;
            ELSE                        w_z10_1 := w_z10_1 + ABS(x1.mod_aek);
            end if;
        end loop;

        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.fund_cd                                          /* _1- */
                 , t1.jm_cd                                            /* _2- */
                 , t1.buy_date                                         /* _3- */
                 , t1.alter_aek                                        /* _4- */
                 , t1.alter_aek - t1.bfil_chui_aek         AS mod_aek  /* _5- */
                 , CASE cj.slip_attr || cj.sangj_gb WHEN '1A' THEN '10501'
                                                    WHEN '1B' THEN '10521'
                                                    WHEN '2A' THEN '10502'
                                                    WHEN '2B' THEN '10522'
                                                    WHEN '3A' THEN '10503'
                                                    WHEN '3B' THEN '10523'
                                                    WHEN '4A' THEN '10504'
                                                    WHEN '4B' THEN '10524'
                                                    WHEN '5A' THEN '10506'
                                                    WHEN '5B' THEN '10526'
                                                    WHEN '6A' THEN '10505'
                                                    WHEN '6B' THEN '10525'
                   END                                     AS gwamok   /* _6- */
                 , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                                              , t1.jm_cd)  AS row_no   /* _7- */
              FROM SCM0CM_CHUI t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
                 , SCM0CJ      cj  /* 채권종목 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr          = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd          = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd              = p_ymd
               AND NVL(t1.alter_aek,0) != 0
               AND cj.corp_gr          = t1.corp_gr
               AND cj.jm_cd            = t1.jm_cd
        ) loop
            UPDATE SCM0CM t1    /* 채권 보유현황 */
               SET bfil_chui_aek = x1.alter_aek
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = x1.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = x1.jm_cd
               AND t1.buy_date = x1.buy_date;

            SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z10', 'A', '1', x1.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                       x1.jm_cd, 1, 2, x1.row_no, 'D', x1.gwamok, x1.mod_aek, 'Z10', 9, '취득액변경(PROC0600)', w_msg);
            if  x1.mod_aek > 0  then    w_z10_2 := w_z10_2 + x1.mod_aek;
            ELSE                        w_z10_1 := w_z10_1 + ABS(x1.mod_aek);
            end if;
        end loop;

        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.fund_cd                                          /* _1- */
                 , t1.jm_cd                                            /* _2- */
                 , t1.alter_aek                                        /* _3- */
                 , t1.alter_aek - t1.bfil_chui_aek         AS mod_aek  /* _4- */
                 , CASE hj.cash_cd WHEN '10' THEN '10107'
                                   WHEN '20' THEN '10108'
                                   WHEN '50' THEN '10106'
                                   WHEN '60' THEN '10109'
                                   WHEN '70' THEN '10110'
                                   WHEN '71' THEN '20105'
                                   WHEN '72' THEN '10110'
                                   WHEN '80' THEN '10102'
                                   WHEN 'AA' THEN '10207'
                                   WHEN 'DC' THEN '10205'
                                   WHEN 'ZS' THEN '10507'
                                   WHEN 'ZF' THEN '10107'
                   END                                     AS gwamok   /* _5- */
                 , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                                              , t1.jm_cd)  AS row_no   /* _6- */
              FROM SHM0HM_CHUI t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
                 , SHM0HJ      hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr          = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd          = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd              = p_ymd
               AND NVL(t1.alter_aek,0) != 0
               AND hj.corp_gr          = t1.corp_gr
               AND hj.jm_cd            = t1.jm_cd
        ) loop
            UPDATE SHM0HM t1    /* 현금 보유현황 */
               SET bfil_chui_aek = x1.alter_aek
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = x1.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd   = x1.jm_cd;

            if  x1.gwamok = '20105'     then
                SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z10', 'A', '1', x1.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                           x1.jm_cd, 1, 3, x1.row_no, 'C', x1.gwamok, x1.mod_aek, 'Z10', 9, '취득액변경(PROC0600)', w_msg);

                if  x1.mod_aek < 0  then    w_z10_2 := w_z10_2 + ABS (x1.mod_aek);
                else                        w_z10_1 := w_z10_1 + x1.mod_aek;
                end if;
            else
                SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z10', 'A', '1', x1.fund_cd, 'KRW',
                           x1.jm_cd, 1, 3, x1.row_no, 'D', x1.gwamok, x1.mod_aek, 'Z10', 9, '취득액변경(PROC0600)', w_msg);

                if  x1.mod_aek > 0  then    w_z10_2 := w_z10_2 + x1.mod_aek;
                ELSE                        w_z10_1 := w_z10_1 + ABS(x1.mod_aek);
                end if;
            end if;
        end loop;

        SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z10', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', '', 1, 4, 1, 'D', '54949', w_z10_1, 'Z10', 9, '취득액보정 손실해당액(PROC0600)', w_msg);
        SR_INSBU1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z10', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', '', 1, 4, 2, 'C', '64949', w_z10_2, 'Z10', 9, '취득액보정 이익해당액(PROC0600)', w_msg);
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B000', 'sz52000_1 skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0bu.proc_step=60', '평가처리');

    -- 수신종가로 입력된 종가제외 종목 수정처리
    -- 2202 이언투자자문은 입력종가 사용으로 20251113 yjs
    MERGE INTO SJT0TG m1  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
       USING ( SELECT DISTINCT t1.koscom_cd  /* _1- */
                    , tg.close               /* _2- */
                    , tg.volume              /* _3- */
                    , tg.value               /* _4- */
                    , tg.preclose            /* _5- */
                    , tg.change              /* _6- */
                    , tg.aekm                /* _7- */
                    , tg.sangj_jusu          /* _8- */
                    , tg.gyul_mm             /* _9- */
                 FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                    , SJT1TG tg  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
                WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
                  AND t1.ymd       = p_ymd
                  AND tg.ymd       = w_open_ymd
                  AND tg.koscom_cd = t1.koscom_cd ) tg 
          ON ( m1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND m1.ymd       = w_open_ymd
           AND m1.koscom_cd = tg.koscom_cd )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
         UPDATE
            SET CLOSE      = CASE WHEN p_corp_gr='2202' THEN CLOSE
                                  WHEN MOD_DT IS NULL   THEN tg.close
                                                        ELSE CLOSE END
              , VOLUME     = tg.volume
              , VALUE      = tg.value
              , PRECLOSE   = tg.preclose
              , CHANGE     = tg.change
              , AEKM       = tg.aekm
              , SANGJ_JUSU = tg.sangj_jusu
              , GYUL_MM    = tg.gyul_mm
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
         INSERT
         VALUES ( p_corp_gr      /* _1- */
                , w_open_ymd     /* _2- */
                , tg.koscom_cd   /* _3- */
                , NULL           /* _4- */
                , NULL           /* _5- */
                , NULL           /* _6- */
                , tg.close       /* _7- */
                , tg.volume      /* _8- */
                , tg.value       /* _9- */
                , tg.preclose    /* _10- */
                , tg.change      /* _11- */
                , NULL           /* _12- */
                , tg.aekm        /* _13- */
                , tg.sangj_jusu  /* _14- */
                , tg.gyul_mm     /* _15- */
                , NULL           /* _16- */
                );

    --  주식종가 수신자료 처리
    if  p_ymd = F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '-')     then
        MERGE INTO SJT0TG m1  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
           USING ( SELECT DISTINCT t1.koscom_cd            /* _1- */
                        , NVL(tg.close,0)        AS CLOSE  /* _2- */
                        , tg.volume                        /* _3- */
                        , tg.value                         /* _4- */
                        , tg.preclose                      /* _5- */
                        , tg.change                        /* _6- */
                        , tg.aekm                          /* _7- */
                        , tg.sangj_jusu                    /* _8- */
                        , tg.gyul_mm                       /* _9- */
                     FROM SJM0JM t1             /* 주식 보유현황 */
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN SJT0TG tg  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
                                  ON tg.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr
                                 AND tg.ymd       = p_ymd
                                 AND tg.koscom_cd = t1.koscom_cd
                    WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                      AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd ) tg 
              ON ( m1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
               AND m1.ymd       = p_ymd
               AND m1.koscom_cd = tg.koscom_cd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET CLOSE      = CASE WHEN p_corp_gr='2202' THEN CLOSE
                                      WHEN MOD_DT IS NULL   THEN tg.close
                                                            ELSE CLOSE END
                  , VOLUME     = tg.volume
                  , VALUE      = tg.value
                  , PRECLOSE   = tg.preclose
                  , CHANGE     = tg.change
                  , AEKM       = tg.aekm
                  , SANGJ_JUSU = tg.sangj_jusu
                  , GYUL_MM    = tg.gyul_mm
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr      /* _1- */
                    , w_open_ymd     /* _2- */
                    , tg.koscom_cd   /* _3- */
                    , NULL           /* _4- */
                    , NULL           /* _5- */
                    , NULL           /* _6- */
                    , tg.close       /* _7- */
                    , tg.volume      /* _8- */
                    , tg.value       /* _9- */
                    , tg.preclose    /* _10- */
                    , tg.change      /* _11- */
                    , NULL           /* _12- */
                    , tg.aekm        /* _13- */
                    , tg.sangj_jusu  /* _14- */
                    , tg.gyul_mm     /* _15- */
                    , NULL           /* _16- */
                    );
    end if;

    DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND t1.proc_step = 60;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', '주식시가평가', '주식 시가평가 처리');

    UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
       SET sonik  = 0
         , gsonik = 0
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    -- 주식마스타 보유내역
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                          /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                        /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                          /* _3- */
             , t1.koscom_cd                                                      /* _4- */
             , t1.danc_gb                                                        /* _5- */
             , t1.up_jusu                                                        /* _6- */
             , t1.dw_jusu                                                        /* _7- */
             , t2.jj_nm                                                          /* _8- */
             , NVL(bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(up_jusu,0) - NVL(dw_jusu,0) + NVL(gongs_up_jusu,0)
                                     - NVL(gongs_dw_jusu,0)        AS jusu       /* _9- */
             , NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(dw_chui_aek,0) + NVL(gongs_up_chui_aek,0)
                                    - NVL(gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)     AS chui_aek   /* _10- */
             , NVL(gbfil_aek,0) + NVL(gup_aek,0) - NVL(gdw_aek,0)  AS gchui_aek  /* _11- */
             , t4.sosok_gb                                                       /* _12- */
          FROM SJM0JM t1             /* 주식 보유현황 */
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SJM0JJ t2  /* 주식종목 */
                       ON t2.jm_cd = t1.jm_cd
             , SZM0IA t3             /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJX0JB t4             /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.dw_jusu,0)
                                        + NVL(t1.gongs_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_jusu,0) != 0
           AND t3.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t3.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND t4.balh_co                   = t2.balh_co
         ORDER BY t1.jm_cd
                , t1.koscom_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.danc_gb = 'B'    then
            UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
               SET sonik = 0
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        else
            BEGIN
                SELECT CLOSE
                     , sangj_jusu
                  INTO w_jonga
                     , w_sangj_jusu
                  FROM SJT0TG t1  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd       = w_trade_ymd
                   AND t1.koscom_cd = xx.koscom_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                w_jonga      := 0;
                w_sangj_jusu := 0;
            END;
            if  p_corp_gr = '2203' AND w_jonga = 0  then
                UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
                   SET sonik = 0
                 WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
            else
                UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
                   SET sonik = (xx.jusu * w_jonga) - xx.chui_aek
                 WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
            end if;
            if  w_sangj_jusu > 0    then
                UPDATE SJM0JJ tt    /* 주식종목 */
                   SET sangj_jusu = w_sangj_jusu
                 WHERE koscom_cd = xx.koscom_cd;
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 유상증자주식 미청약 주식 평가손실시 0처리 (청약포기로 봄)
    UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
       SET sonik = 0
     WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd         = p_ymd
       AND mijunab_aek > 0
       AND sonik       < 0;

    -- 상장폐지종목 손익 0처리
    UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
       SET sonik = 0
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND jm_cd   IN (SELECT tb.jm_cd
                         FROM SJX0JB ta  /* 발행기관 */
                            , SJM0JJ tb  /* 주식종목 */
                        WHERE ta.tr_stop_gb = '9'
                          AND tb.balh_co    = ta.balh_co)
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0600', p_ymd || ' : 타사수익증권평가처리');

    -- 펀드시가 LOAD액 처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , sc.tasa_jm_cd
             , t1.siga_aek
          FROM SJM5SM_SIGA t1  /* 채권 시가 LOAD 자료 */
             , SJM0SC      sc  /* 타사집합투자증권 정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd   IN (sc.tasa_jm_cd, sc.tasa_fund_cd)
           AND sc.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
    ) loop
        UPDATE SJT0SC   /* ETF/상장집합투자증권/타사집합투자증권 종가정보 */
           SET load_siga_aek = xx.siga_aek
         WHERE corp_gr            = p_corp_gr
           AND ymd                = p_ymd
           AND jm_cd              = xx.tasa_jm_cd
           AND NVL(bigo,'update') <> 'W_SJT0SC';
    end loop;

    if  p_corp_gr = '2402'  then
        for xx IN (
            SELECT t1.fund_cd                                               /* _1- */
                 , t1.tasa_jm_cd                                            /* _2- */
                 , NVL(bfil_jwa,0) + NVL(up_jwa,0) - NVL(dw_jwa,0)  AS jwa  /* _3- */
                 , NVL(bfil_aek,0) + NVL(up_aek,0) - NVL(dw_aek,0)  AS aek  /* _4- */
                 , t1.rowid                                                 /* _5- */
              FROM SJM5SM t1  /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
               AND NVL(t1.bfil_jwa,0) + NVL(t1.up_jwa,0) - NVL(t1.dw_jwa,0) > 0
               AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
               AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
        ) loop
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL(load_siga_aek,0)
                     , NVL(t1.dang_gijun_ga,0)
                     , NVL(t1.dang_ggijun_ga,0)
                     , NVL(t2.trans_unit,0)
                  INTO w_siga_aek
                     , w_gijun_ga
                     , w_ggijun_ga
                     , w_trans_unit
                  FROM SJT0SC t1  /* ETF/상장집합투자증권/타사집합투자증권 종가정보 */
                     , SJM0SC t2  /* 타사집합투자증권 정보 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.tasa_jm_cd
                   AND t2.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
                   AND t2.tasa_jm_cd = t1.jm_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(bfil_aek,0) + NVL(up_aek,0) - NVL(dw_aek,0) + NVL(sonik,0)), xx.jwa)
                  INTO w_siga_aek
                  FROM SJM5SM t1  /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd - 1
                   AND t1.tasa_jm_cd = xx.tasa_jm_cd;

                MERGE INTO SJT0SC tt  /* ETF/상장집합투자증권/타사집합투자증권 종가정보 */
                   USING DUAL ON ( corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                               AND ymd     = p_ymd
                               AND jm_cd   = xx.tasa_jm_cd )
                WHEN MATCHED THEN
                     UPDATE
                        SET LOAD_SIGA_AEK = w_siga_aek
                WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                     INSERT ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                            , ymd            /* _2- */
                            , jm_cd          /* _3- */
                            , LOAD_SIGA_AEK  /* _4- */
                            )
                     VALUES ( p_corp_gr      /* _1- */
                            , p_ymd          /* _2- */
                            , xx.tasa_jm_cd  /* _3- */
                            , w_siga_aek     /* _4- */
                            );
            END;
            if  w_siga_aek > 0  then
                UPDATE SJM5SM t1    /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
                   SET sonik = w_siga_aek - xx.aek
                 WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
            else
                UPDATE SJM5SM t1    /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
                   SET sonik = ROUND(xx.jwa * w_gijun_ga / w_trans_unit) - xx.aek
                 WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
            end if;
        end loop;
    else
        for xx IN (
            SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                                /* _1- */
                 , t1.tasa_jm_cd                                                             /* _2- */
                 , NVL(bfil_jwa,0) + NVL(up_jwa,0) - NVL(dw_jwa,0)              AS jwa       /* _3- */
                 , NVL(bfil_aek,0) + NVL(up_aek,0) - NVL(dw_aek,0)              AS aek       /* _4- */
                 , NVL(gbfil_jwa,0) + NVL(gup_jwa,0) - NVL(gdw_jwa,0)           AS gjwa      /* _5- */
                 , NVL(bi_gbfil_jwa,0) + NVL(bi_gup_jwa,0) - NVL(bi_gdw_jwa,0)  AS bi_gjwa   /* _6- */
                 , NVL(t1.pre_susu,0)                                           AS pre_susu  /* _7- */
                 , t1.rowid                                                                  /* _8- */
              FROM SJM5SM t1  /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
               AND NVL(t1.bfil_jwa,0) + NVL(t1.up_jwa,0) - NVL(t1.dw_jwa,0) > 0
               AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
               AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
        ) loop
            BEGIN
                SELECT t1.dang_gijun_ga
                     , t1.dang_ggijun_ga
                     , t2.trans_unit
                  INTO w_gijun_ga
                     , w_ggijun_ga
                     , w_trans_unit
                  FROM SJT0SC t1  /* ETF/상장집합투자증권/타사집합투자증권 종가정보 */
                     , SJM0SC t2  /* 타사집합투자증권 정보 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.tasa_jm_cd
                   AND t2.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
                   AND t2.tasa_jm_cd = t1.jm_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := xx.tasa_jm_cd || '-타사수익증권 종가를 입력하십시오';
                RETURN;
            END;

            UPDATE SJM5SM t1    /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
               SET sonik  = ROUND(xx.jwa * w_gijun_ga / w_trans_unit) - xx.aek
                 , gsonik = ROUND(xx.gjwa * w_ggijun_ga / w_trans_unit) - xx.aek - xx.pre_susu
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        end loop;
    end if;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A'   , 'SR_PROC0600'         , p_ymd || ' : 채권평가처리');
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'scm0cm.ymd=' || p_ymd, '평가액계산'              );

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 평가액 계산
    -- 평가액 = 취득가(당일증감반영) + 선급비용(할인,할증포함) + 누적미수이자(할인,할증포함) + 누적손익안분 + 선매출선급비용 + 선매출미수이자 + 휴일수입이자(20200309)
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    UPDATE SCM0CM t1    /* 채권 보유현황 */
       SET pyunga_aek = NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aek,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aek,0)
                                                + NVL(t1.sung_cost,0) + NVL(t1.pr_sung_cost,0) + NVL(t1.misu_ija,0)
                                                + NVL(t1.pr_misu_ija,0) + NVL(t1.anbun_aek,0) + NVL(t1.suib_ija,0)
                                                + NVL(t1.cbmg_misu_ija,0) + NVL(t1.CBMG_SUNG_COST,0)
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    -- 선매출채권 평가처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , t1.jm_cd
             , t1.buy_date
             , NVL(t1.sung_cost,0) + NVL(t1.misu_ija,0)  AS ija
          FROM SCM0SC t1  /* 채권 선매출이자현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
    ) loop
        UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
           SET pyunga_aek = NVL(pyunga_aek,0) + xx.ija
         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
           AND buy_date = xx.buy_date
           AND ymd      = p_ymd;
    end loop;

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 선매출기간의 경우 : 발행일 > 처리일
    -- 평가액 = 취득가 + 선급비용(선매출) + 누적미수이자(선매출) + 누적손익안분
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , t1.jm_cd
             , t1.buy_date
             , NVL(t1.sung_cost,0) + NVL(t1.misu_ija,0)  AS ija
          FROM SCM0SC t1  /* 채권 선매출이자현황 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND cj.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND cj.balh_ymd                  > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
    ) loop
        UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
           SET pyunga_aek = NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(meib_aek,0) - NVL(medo_aek,0) + NVL(anbun_aek,0) + xx.ija
         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
           AND buy_date = xx.buy_date
           AND ymd      = p_ymd;
    end loop;

    -- 채권마스타Table의 시가평가액 clear
    UPDATE SCM0CM t1    /* 채권 보유현황 */
       SET siga_aek = 0
         , ip_user  = NULL
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    -- 채권평가사 단가기준 시가평가
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                              /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                   AS cm_jm_cd  /* _3- */
             , t1.buy_date                                             /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0)
                                   - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)  AS aekm      /* _5- */
             , NVL(cj.as_cj_cd, t1.jm_cd)                 AS jm_cd     /* _6- */
             , -1                                         AS danga     /* _7- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND cj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
         ORDER BY t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT siga_aek / aekm
              INTO w_siga_aek
              FROM SCM0CM_SIGA t1  /* 채권 시가 LOAD 자료 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.buy_date = '%';

            UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
               SET siga_aek = ROUND(xx.aekm * w_siga_aek,0)
                 , ip_user  = 'SIGA'
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            SELECT MAX(ymd)
              INTO w_siga_ymd
              FROM SCM1SM ta  /* 채권 시가평가 자료 */
             WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND ta.ymd     BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS (p_ymd,-1) AND p_ymd
               AND ta.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;
            if  w_siga_ymd IS NOT NULL  then
                SELECT NVL(danga,0)
                  INTO xx.danga
                  FROM SCM1SM t1  /* 채권 시가평가 자료 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd     = w_siga_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;

                UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
                   SET siga_aek = ROUND(xx.aekm * xx.danga / 10000,0)
                     , ip_user  = 'DANGA'
                 WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
            else
                UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
                   SET siga_aek = pyunga_aek
                     , ip_user  = 'PYUNGA'
                 WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
            end if;
        END;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A'   , 'SR_PROC0600'                                            , p_ymd || ' : 현금평가처리 초기화'   );
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B000', 'skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0bu.proc_step=' || 60, '현금평가처리 분개장(skt0bu) delete');

    --------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 현금자산 평가금액 = 취득가 + 선급비용 + 미수이자 + 손익안분
    --------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 선취
    UPDATE SHM0HM   /* 현금 보유현황 */
       SET pyunga_aek = NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(meib_aek,0) - NVL(medo_aek,0) + NVL(anbun_aek,0)
                                             + (NVL(gugan_ija,0) - (NVL(bfil_sunsu_ija,0) + NVL(up_sunsu_ija,0) - NVL(dw_sunsu_ija,0)))
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND jm_cd   IN (SELECT jm_cd
                         FROM SHM0HJ ta  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                        WHERE ta.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                          AND ta.cash_cd  != '90'
                          AND ta.sunhu_gb = '1')
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;
    -- 후취
    UPDATE SHM0HM   /* 현금 보유현황 */
       SET pyunga_aek = NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(meib_aek,0) - NVL(medo_aek,0) + NVL(sung_cost,0) + NVL(misu_ija,0) + NVL(anbun_aek,0)
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND jm_cd   IN (SELECT jm_cd
                         FROM SHM0HJ ta  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                        WHERE ta.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                          AND ta.cash_cd  != '90'
                          AND ta.sunhu_gb != '1')
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    -- 현금마스타Table의 시가평가액 clear
    UPDATE SHM0HM t1    /* 현금 보유현황 */
       SET t1.siga_aek = pyunga_aek
         , ip_user     = 'PYUNGA'
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    -- 시가평가
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                   /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                 /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                   /* _3- */
             , hj.cash_cd                                                 /* _4- */
             , NVL(hj.ksd_jm_cd, hj.jm_cd)                AS danga_jm_cd  /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0)
                                   - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)  AS aekm         /* _6- */
          FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
             , SHM0HJ hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0) > 0
           AND hj.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND hj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND hj.cash_cd                   NOT IN ('70','90')
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
         ORDER BY t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            if  xx.cash_cd = '20'   then
                -- 발행어음은 구간이자로 계산
                UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
                   SET siga_aek = pyunga_aek
                     , ip_user  = 'PYUNGA'
                 WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

            elsif xx.cash_cd = '80' then
                BEGIN
                    SELECT siga_aek
                      INTO w_siga_aek
                      FROM SHM0HM_SIGA t1  /* 현금 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.ymd     = F_OPEN_YMD(p_ymd,'-')
                       AND t1.jm_cd   IN (xx.jm_cd, xx.danga_jm_cd);

                    UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
                       SET siga_aek = w_siga_aek
                         , ip_user  = 'DANGA'
                     WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

                    MERGE INTO SHM1SM sm  /* 현금 시가평가 자료 */
                       USING DUAL ON ( sm.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                   AND sm.ymd     = p_ymd
                                   AND sm.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd )
                    WHEN MATCHED THEN
                         UPDATE
                            SET danga = w_siga_aek / xx.aekm * 10000
                    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                         INSERT ( corp_gr  /* _1- */
                                , ymd      /* _2- */
                                , jm_cd    /* _3- */
                                , danga    /* _4- */
                                )
                         VALUES ( p_corp_gr                     /* _1- */
                                , p_ymd                         /* _2- */
                                , xx.jm_cd                      /* _3- */
                                , w_siga_aek / xx.aekm * 10000  /* _4- */
                                );
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    SELECT MAX(ymd)
                      INTO w_siga_ymd
                      FROM SHM1SM ta  /* 현금 시가평가 자료 */
                     WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND ta.ymd     BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(ymd,-1) AND ymd
                       AND ta.jm_cd   IN (xx.jm_cd, xx.danga_jm_cd);

                    if  w_siga_ymd IS NOT NULL  then
                        SELECT NVL(t1.danga,0)
                          INTO w_danga
                          FROM SHM1SM t1  /* 현금 시가평가 자료 */
                         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                           AND t1.ymd     = w_siga_ymd
                           AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;

                        UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
                           SET siga_aek = ROUND(xx.aekm * w_danga / 10000)
                             , ip_user  = 'DANGA'
                         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
                    else
                        UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
                           SET siga_aek = pyunga_aek
                             , ip_user  = 'PYUNGA'
                         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
                    end if;
                END;
            else
                BEGIN
                    SELECT siga_aek
                      INTO w_siga_aek
                      FROM SHM0HM_SIGA t1  /* 현금 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.ymd     = F_OPEN_YMD(p_ymd,'-')
                       AND t1.jm_cd   IN (xx.jm_cd, xx.danga_jm_cd);

                    UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
                       SET siga_aek = w_siga_aek
                         , ip_user  = 'SIGA'
                     WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

                    MERGE INTO SHM1SM sm  /* 현금 시가평가 자료 */
                       USING DUAL ON ( sm.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                   AND sm.ymd     = p_ymd
                                   AND sm.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd )
                    WHEN MATCHED THEN
                         UPDATE
                            SET danga = w_siga_aek / xx.aekm * 10000
                    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                         INSERT ( corp_gr  /* _1- */
                                , ymd      /* _2- */
                                , jm_cd    /* _3- */
                                , danga    /* _4- */
                                )
                         VALUES ( p_corp_gr                     /* _1- */
                                , p_ymd                         /* _2- */
                                , xx.jm_cd                      /* _3- */
                                , w_siga_aek / xx.aekm * 10000  /* _4- */
                                );
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    SELECT MAX(ymd)
                      INTO w_siga_ymd
                      FROM SHM1SM ta  /* 현금 시가평가 자료 */
                     WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND ta.ymd     BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(p_ymd,-1) AND p_ymd
                       AND ta.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;

                    if  w_siga_ymd IS NOT NULL  then
                        SELECT NVL(t1.danga,0)
                          INTO w_danga
                          FROM SHM1SM t1  /* 현금 시가평가 자료 */
                         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                           AND t1.ymd     = w_siga_ymd
                           AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;

                        UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
                           SET siga_aek = ROUND(xx.aekm * w_danga / 10000)
                             , ip_user  = 'DANGA'
                         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
                    else
                        UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
                           SET siga_aek = pyunga_aek
                             , ip_user  = 'PYUNGA'
                         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
                    end if;
                END;
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
               SET siga_aek = pyunga_aek
                 , ip_user  = 'PYUNGA'
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        END;
    end loop;

    -- RP예금 시가평가(2개 이상 존재시 장부가 비율로 안분처리, 20250619)
    UPDATE SHM0HM t1    /* 현금 보유현황 */
       SET IP_USER = 'WAIT'
     WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.YMD     = p_ymd
       AND t1.JM_CD   IN (SELECT JM_CD
                            FROM SHM0HJ ta  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                           WHERE ta.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                             AND ta.CASH_CD = '70')
       AND NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0) > 0;

    for xx IN (
        WITH siga AS (
             SELECT t1.FUND_CD
                  , t1.JM_CD
                  , t1.SIGA_AEK
               FROM SHM0HM_SIGA t1  /* 현금 시가 LOAD 자료 */
              WHERE t1.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
                AND t1.YMD      = F_OPEN_YMD(p_ymd,'-')
                AND t1.SIGA_AEK > 0
             ) , 
             hm AS (
             SELECT t1.FUND_CD
                  , ss.SIGA_AEK
                  , ROUND(t1.PYUNGA_AEK / SUM(t1.PYUNGA_AEK) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FUND_CD, ss.JM_CD) * ss.SIGA_AEK)  AS anbun_siga
                  , hj.JM_CD
               FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
                  , SHM0HJ hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                  , SIGA   ss
              WHERE t1.CORP_GR    = p_corp_gr
                AND t1.YMD        = p_ymd
                AND t1.PYUNGA_AEK > 0
                AND hj.CORP_GR    = t1.corp_gr
                AND hj.JM_CD      = t1.JM_CD
                AND hj.CASH_CD    = '70'
                AND ss.fund_cd    = t1.FUND_CD
                AND ss.JM_CD      = NVL(hj.KSD_JM_CD, hj.JM_CD)
             )
        -- Main SQL --
        --------------
        SELECT * FROM HM t1
    ) loop
        UPDATE SHM0HM t1    /* 현금 보유현황 */
           SET SIGA_AEK = xx.anbun_siga
             , ip_user  = 'PYUNGA'
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.FUND_CD = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.YMD     = p_ymd
           AND t1.JM_CD   = xx.jm_cd;
    end loop;

    -- 발행어음 시가평가(이자보정)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , NVL(SUM(t1.pyunga_aek),0)         AS pyunga_aek
             , t2.siga_aek
             , t2.siga_aek - SUM(t1.pyunga_aek)  AS cha_aek
          FROM SHM0HM      t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
             , SHM0HJ      hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
             , SZM0IA      ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SHM0HM_SIGA t2  /* 현금 시가 LOAD 자료 */
             , SHM0HJ      h2  /* 현금 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND hj.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND hj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND hj.cash_cd                   = '20'
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND t2.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND t2.ymd                       = F_OPEN_YMD(t1.ymd,'-')
           AND h2.corp_gr                   = t2.corp_gr
           AND h2.jm_cd                     = t2.jm_cd
           AND h2.cash_cd                   = '20'
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, t2.siga_aek
        HAVING NVL(SUM(t1.pyunga_aek),0) <> t2.siga_aek
    ) loop
        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.rowid                                                   /* _1- */
                 , t1.fund_cd                                                 /* _2- */
                 , t1.jm_cd                                                   /* _3- */
                 , hj.cash_cd                                                 /* _4- */
                 , NVL(hj.ksd_jm_cd, hj.jm_cd)                AS danga_jm_cd  /* _5- */
                 , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0)
                                       - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)  AS aekm         /* _6- */
              FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
                 , SHM0HJ hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
               AND hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
               AND hj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
               AND hj.cash_cd = '20'
             ORDER BY NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0)+ NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0)- NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0) DESC
        ) loop
            UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
               SET siga_aek = siga_aek + xx.cha_aek
                 , ip_user  = 'SIGA'
             WHERE ROWID = x1.rowid;
            EXIT;
        end loop;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B000', 'skt0bu.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * skt0bu.proc_step=60', '선물/SWAP/OTS 평가처리 분개장(skt0bu) delete');

    -- 수도결제 Table  delete
    DELETE FROM SST0KS t1   /* 파생상품 수도결제 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
       AND t1.tr_cd   = 'S65';

    -- 선물 평가처리
    -- 단위액(unit_aek) 소숫점으로 당일 증감액 round 처리
    UPDATE SSM0KM t1    /* 파생 보유현황 */
       SET pyunga_sonik = 0
         , jungsan_aek  = 0
         , siga_aek     = 0
         , up_chui_ga   = ROUND(up_chui_ga)
         , dw_chui_ga   = ROUND(dw_chui_ga)
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                       /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                     /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                               /* _3- */
             , t1.sj_cd                                                       /* _4- */
             , t1.chasu                                                       /* _5- */
             , t1.sm_tr_gb                                                    /* _6- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                                    /* _7- */
             , NVL(pass_gyey_su,0)                           AS pass_gyey_su  /* _8- */
             , NVL(up_gyey_su,0)                             AS up_gyey_su    /* _9- */
             , NVL(dw_gyey_su,0)                             AS dw_gyey_su    /* _10- */
             , NVL(pass_chui_ga,0)                           AS pass_chui_ga  /* _11- */
             , NVL(up_chui_ga,0)                             AS up_chui_ga    /* _12- */
             , NVL(dw_chui_ga,0)                             AS dw_chui_ga    /* _13- */
             , t1.dang_mm_sonik                                               /* _14- */
             , tg.close                                                       /* _15- */
             , tg.preclose                                                    /* _16- */
             , kj.unit_aek                                                    /* _17- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq           /* _18- */
          FROM SSM0KM t1             /* 파생 보유현황 */
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SJT1TG tg  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
                       ON tg.ymd       = w_open_ymd
                      AND tg.koscom_cd = t1.sj_cd
             , SZM0IA ia             /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SSX0KJ kj             /* 파생종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
           AND kj.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND kj.sj_cd                 = t1.sj_cd
    ) loop
        /* 선물평가액 생성 처리 */
        w_jungsan_aek  := 0;
        w_siga_aek     := 0;
        w_pyunga_sonik := 0;
        if (xx.pass_gyey_su + xx.up_gyey_su - xx.dw_gyey_su) != 0   then
            w_siga_aek := ROUND (xx.close * xx.unit_aek * (xx.pass_gyey_su + xx.up_gyey_su - xx.dw_gyey_su));
            if  xx.sm_tr_gb = '1'   then    -- 선물매입
                w_jungsan_aek  := ROUND (xx.preclose * xx.unit_aek * xx.pass_gyey_su) + xx.up_chui_ga - xx.dang_mm_sonik;
                w_pyunga_sonik := ROUND (w_siga_aek - w_jungsan_aek);

            elsif xx.sm_tr_gb = '2' then    -- 선물매도
                w_jungsan_aek  := ROUND (xx.preclose * xx.unit_aek * xx.pass_gyey_su) + xx.up_chui_ga - xx.dang_mm_sonik;
                w_pyunga_sonik := ROUND (w_jungsan_aek - w_siga_aek);

            elsif xx.sm_tr_gb IN ('3','5')  then
                w_pyunga_sonik := ROUND (w_siga_aek - (xx.pass_chui_ga + xx.up_chui_ga - xx.dw_chui_ga));

            elsif xx.sm_tr_gb IN ('4','6')  then
                w_pyunga_sonik := ROUND ((xx.pass_chui_ga + xx.up_chui_ga - xx.dw_chui_ga) - w_siga_aek);
            else
                p_msg := xx.sj_cd || '- 매입/매도 선물 구분이 없습니다.';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;

        /* 선물마스타 Table update */
        UPDATE SSM0KM tt    /* 파생 보유현황 */
           SET pyunga_sonik = w_pyunga_sonik
             , jungsan_aek  = w_jungsan_aek
             , siga_aek     = w_siga_aek
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        if  xx.sm_tr_gb IN ('1','2') AND (w_pyunga_sonik != 0)  then    -- 선물
            if  w_pyunga_sonik > 0  then
                    w_tr_sonik_gb := '1';
            else    w_tr_sonik_gb := '2';
            end if;

            /* 수도결제액  선물 수도결제  table insert */
            SR_INSKS (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'S65', xx.fund_cd, xx.sj_cd, 'KRW', 'KRW', xx.chasu, xx.seq, NULL, NULL,
                      w_tr_sonik_gb, abs (w_pyunga_sonik), F_TRADE_YMD(p_ymd + 1, '+'), xx.tr_co_cd, NULL, NULL, NULL, w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 분개
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                   /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                             /* _2- */
             , CASE WHEN gr.sebu_cd_efnm IS NULL
                    THEN kj.jasan || 'err'
                    WHEN gr.sebu_cd_efnm='채권'
                    THEN CASE WHEN t1.pyunga_sonik > 0 THEN '10'
                                                       ELSE '11' END
                    ELSE CASE WHEN t1.pyunga_sonik > 0 THEN '00'
                                                       ELSE '01' END
               END                                            AS jasan_gb   /* _3- */
             , SUM(F_ROUND (pyunga_sonik, ia.fund_currency))  AS aek        /* _4- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)   AS seq        /* _5- */
          FROM SSM0KM t1             /* 파생 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia             /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SSX0KJ kj             /* 파생종목 */
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SZX0GR gr  /* 그룹코드 */
                       ON gr.gr_cd   = 'A6'
                      AND gr.sebu_cd = kj.jasan
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd
           AND t1.sm_tr_gb              IN ('1','2')
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
           AND kj.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND kj.sj_cd                 = t1.sj_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, ia.fund_currency
                , CASE WHEN gr.sebu_cd_efnm IS NULL
                       THEN kj.jasan || 'err'
                       WHEN gr.sebu_cd_efnm='채권'
                       THEN CASE WHEN t1.pyunga_sonik > 0 THEN '10'
                                                          ELSE '11' END
                       ELSE CASE WHEN t1.pyunga_sonik > 0 THEN '00'
                                                          ELSE '01' END END
    ) loop
        if  xx.jasan_gb LIKE '%err' then
            p_msg := xx.jasan_gb || '-자산구분을 확인하십시오.';
            RETURN;
        end if;
        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'S65', 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', '', 1, xx.seq, abs (xx.aek), 60, 'PROC0600', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';

    commit;
END;
/

    -- 종가없는 자산을 위한 초기 Setting
    UPDATE SYM0YZ t1   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
       SET tr_pyunga_aek = TRUNC(NVL(tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0) + NVL(RIGHT_AEK,0),2)
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    -- 미지급비용 출금 및 원화 증감액은 환율 계산후 처리하므로 평가에서 재처리
    UPDATE SYT0MC t1   /* 해외 채권/채무 발생 및 감소 MASTER */
       SET won_up_aek  = 0
         , fcur_up_aek = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd;

    -- 보관비용은 평가액을 기준으로 계산하므로 평가에서 재처리
    UPDATE SYT0MC t1   /* 해외 채권/채무 발생 및 감소 MASTER */

    -- 해외자산 해외 수도결제 외화잔고(SAM0LD_yesu 자료로 해외예금 보정)

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'B020', 'PROC0610 : ' || p_ymd || ' : 잔고 LOAD 된 외화잔고 평가전에 조정');

    -- 해외통화 잔액조정(잔액,취득액)

       SET bigo = NULL
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    -- 보정을 위한 자료가 존재하는 펀드만 예금 보정
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                  /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                /* _2- */
             , t1.currency                                               /* _3- */
             , F_ROUND (t1.cur_aek, ia.fund_currency)  AS cur_aek        /* _4- */
             , t1.won_aek                                                /* _5- */
             , CASE WHEN ia.fund_currency='KRW'
                    THEN t1.won_aek
                    ELSE F_COVCUR (t1.corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.cur_aek, ia.fund_currency)
               END                                     AS fcur_aek       /* _6- */
             , ia.fund_currency                        AS fund_currency  /* _7- */
             , ia.mg_cd                                                  /* _8- */
          FROM SYT1LD_YESU t1  /* 해외 예수금 잔고 */
             , SZM0IA      ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd
           AND t1.currency              != 'KRW'
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd         <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        if  xx.cur_aek = 0  then
            xx.won_aek  := 0;
            xx.fcur_aek := 0;
            CONTINUE;
        end if;

        BEGIN
            SELECT t1.rowid                                                 /* _1- */
                 , t2.jm_cd                                                 /* _2- */
                 , NVL(t1.tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                              + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK,0)         /* _3- */
                 , NVL(t1.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                               + NVL(t1.RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)    /* _4- */
                 , NVL(t1.fcur_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.fcur_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.fcur_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                + NVL(t1.RIGHT_FCUR_AEK,0)  /* _5- */
              INTO yz_rowid     /* _1- */
                 , w_jm_cd      /* _2- */
                 , yz_chui_aek  /* _3- */
                 , yz_won_aek   /* _4- */
                 , yz_fcur_aek  /* _5- */
              FROM SYM0YZ t1    /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                 , SYM0YA t2    /* 해외 자산종목 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.currency = xx.currency
               AND t2.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND t2.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
               AND t2.jasan_gb = '5';
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            BEGIN
                SELECT jm_cd
                  INTO w_jm_cd
                  FROM SYM0YA t1  /* 해외 자산종목 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.currency   = xx.currency
                   AND t1.sanghw_ymd >= p_ymd
                   AND t1.gyulje_jm  = 'Y'
                   AND t1.jasan_gb   = '5';
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                CONTINUE;
            END;

            INSERT INTO SYM0YZ /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                 ( corp_gr           /* _1- */
                 , ymd               /* _2- */
                 , fund_cd           /* _3- */
                 , trustee           /* _4- */
                 , jm_cd             /* _5- */
                 , bs_type           /* _6- */
                 , currency          /* _7- */
                 , tr_up_jusu        /* _8- */
                 , tr_up_chui_aek    /* _9- */
                 , won_up_chui_aek   /* _10- */
                 , fcur_up_chui_aek  /* _11- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr            /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd           /* _3- */
                   , xx.currency || '01'  /* _4- */
                   , w_jm_cd              /* _5- */
                   , 0                    /* _6- */
                   , xx.currency          /* _7- */
                   , xx.cur_aek           /* _8- */
                   , xx.cur_aek           /* _9- */
                   , xx.won_aek           /* _10- */
                   , xx.fcur_aek          /* _11- */
                   );

            -- 예금차액 보정 분개처리
            if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                    SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B90', 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, w_jm_cd, 2, 1, xx.won_aek , 61, 'PROC0610', w_msg);
            ELSE    SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B90', 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, w_jm_cd, 2, 1, xx.fcur_aek, 61, 'PROC0610', w_msg);
            end if;
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
            CONTINUE;
        END;

        if  yz_chui_aek < xx.cur_aek    then
            UPDATE SYM0YZ /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
               SET tr_up_jusu       = NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) + (xx.cur_aek - yz_chui_aek)
                 , tr_up_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) + (xx.cur_aek - yz_chui_aek)
                 , won_up_chui_aek  = NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) + (xx.won_aek - yz_won_aek)
                 , fcur_up_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0) + (xx.fcur_aek - yz_fcur_aek)
             WHERE ROWID = yz_rowid;
        elsif yz_chui_aek > xx.cur_aek      then
            UPDATE SYM0YZ /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
               SET tr_dw_jusu       = NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0) + (yz_chui_aek - xx.cur_aek)
                 , tr_dw_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0) + (yz_chui_aek - xx.cur_aek)
                 , won_dw_chui_aek  = NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0) + (yz_won_aek - xx.won_aek)
                 , fcur_dw_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_dw_chui_aek,0) + (yz_fcur_aek - xx.fcur_aek)
             WHERE ROWID = yz_rowid;
        else
            CONTINUE;
        end if;

        -- 예금차액 보정 분개처리
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B90', 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, w_jm_cd, 2, 2, TRUNC(xx.won_aek - yz_won_aek), 61, 'PROC0610', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B90', 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, w_jm_cd, 2, 2, TRUNC(xx.fcur_aek - yz_fcur_aek), 61, 'PROC0610', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B030', 'PROC0611', '해외자산 미수이자 계산 및 평가액(환차손익) 산정 처리');

    SR_PROC0611 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 61, w_msg);
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := 'PROC0611-' || w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B040', '', '해외자산 기타비용 생성 및 외화환산 처리');
    -- 보관비용 생성
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                 /* _1- */
             , t1.trustee                                 /* _2- */
             , t1.currency                                /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_currency                           /* _4- */
             , mm.keep_currency                           /* _5- */
             , NVL(mm.keep_cost,0)      AS keep_cost      /* _6- */
             , NVL(mm.keep_cost_mon,0)  AS keep_cost_mon  /* _7- */
             , SUM(t1.tr_pyunga_aek)    AS tr_pyunga_aek  /* _8- */
             , SUM(t1.won_pyunga_aek)   AS aek            /* _9- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             , SYX2MM mm  /* 해외보관처 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.won_pyunga_aek,0)     != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND ya.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb                  = '1'
           AND ya.jasan_attr                IN ('300','310')
           AND mm.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND mm.trustee                   = t1.trustee
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.trustee
                , t1.currency
                , ia.fund_currency
                , mm.keep_cost
                , mm.keep_cost_mon
                , mm.keep_currency
    ) loop
        if  xx.keep_cost_mon != 0   then
                w_cost_aek := xx.keep_cost_mon / TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (LAST_DAY (p_ymd), 'dd'));
        else    w_cost_aek := xx.tr_pyunga_aek * xx.keep_cost / 3650000;
        end if;
        if  xx.currency != xx.keep_currency     then
            SELECT w_cost_aek / cross_rate
              INTO w_cost_aek
              FROM SYX0HY t1  /* (개별 환율이 없을경우)적용 환율 */
             WHERE t1.currency  = xx.currency
               AND t1.gijun_ymd = p_ymd;

            BEGIN
                SELECT trustee
                  INTO xx.trustee
                  FROM SYX2MM t1  /* 해외보관처 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.currency      = xx.keep_currency
                   AND t1.fund_currency = 'Y'
                   AND t1.used          = '1';
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := '기준통화(' || xx.keep_currency || ')별 해외보관처 확인(1개만 존재해야 함).(9024 화면)';
                RETURN;
            END;
        end if;

        w_cost_aek := F_TRUNC (w_cost_aek, xx.keep_currency);
        w_fcur_aek := F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, w_cost_aek, xx.fund_currency);

        UPDATE SYT0MC /* 해외 채권/채무 발생 및 감소 MASTER */
           SET up_aek      = NVL(up_aek,0) + w_cost_aek
             , fcur_up_aek = NVL(fcur_up_aek,0) + w_fcur_aek
             , cost_keep   = xx.keep_cost
         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND tr_ymd   = p_ymd
           AND tr_cd    = 'P40'
           AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND trustee  = xx.trustee
           AND currency = xx.keep_currency;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO SYT0MC /* 해외 채권/채무 발생 및 감소 MASTER */
                 ( corp_gr      /* _1- */
                 , tr_ymd       /* _2- */
                 , tr_cd        /* _3- */
                 , fund_cd      /* _4- */
                 , trustee      /* _5- */
                 , currency     /* _6- */
                 , up_aek       /* _7- */
                 , fcur_up_aek  /* _8- */
                 , cost_keep    /* _9- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                   , 'P40'             /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _4- */
