                   , xx.trustee        /* _5- */
                   , xx.keep_currency  /* _6- */
                   , w_cost_aek        /* _7- */
                   , w_fcur_aek        /* _8- */
                   , w_keep_per        /* _9- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 수도결제 환차손익
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                                                   /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                                                                   /* _2- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                                                /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                                           /* _4- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                                                                                                              /* _5- */
             , t1.won_gyulje_aek - NVL(t1.bunhal_won_gyulje_aek,0)                                               AS won_gyulje_aek        /* _6- */
             , t1.fcur_gyulje_aek - NVL(t1.bunhal_fcur_gyulje_aek,0)                                             AS fcur_gyulje_aek       /* _7- */
             , F_COVWON (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek - NVL(t1.bunhal_aek,0))                    AS today_won_gyulje_aek  /* _8- */
             , F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek - NVL(t1.bunhal_aek,0), ia.fund_currency)  AS today_fcur_aek        /* _9- */
          FROM SYT0YS t1  /* 해외 수도결제 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                        = p_ymd
           AND t1.gyulje_gb                  = 'N'
           AND NVL(t1.gyulje_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr                    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                    = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  > p_ymd
    ) loop
        if  xx.tr_cd IN ('J14','J20','J61','K51','H21','H22')   then    -- (익일)매입액/환전매도액/미지급비용 = 출금액
            UPDATE SYT0YS /* 해외 수도결제 */
               SET won_pyunga_aek  = xx.today_won_gyulje_aek
                 , won_hwan_cha    = xx.won_gyulje_aek - xx.today_won_gyulje_aek
                 , fcur_pyunga_aek = xx.today_fcur_aek
                 , fcur_hwan_cha   = xx.fcur_gyulje_aek - xx.today_fcur_aek
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        elsif xx.tr_cd = 'G33'  then    -- 유상불입액은 환차손익 계산하지 않음
            UPDATE SYT0YS /* 해외 수도결제 */
               SET won_pyunga_aek  = xx.today_won_gyulje_aek
                 , won_hwan_cha    = 0
                 , fcur_pyunga_aek = xx.today_fcur_aek
                 , fcur_hwan_cha   = 0
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        else
            UPDATE SYT0YS /* 해외 수도결제 */
               SET won_pyunga_aek  = xx.today_won_gyulje_aek
                 , won_hwan_cha    = xx.today_won_gyulje_aek - xx.won_gyulje_aek
                 , fcur_pyunga_aek = xx.today_fcur_aek
                 , fcur_hwan_cha   = xx.today_fcur_aek - xx.fcur_gyulje_aek
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 미지급비용 전표생성
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                              /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                                /* _3- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                              /* _4- */
             , t1.currency                                                                             /* _5- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                        /* _6- */
             , F_COVWON_TR (t1.corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.up_aek)                 AS won_up_aek   /* _7- */
             , F_COVCUR (t1.corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.up_aek, ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_up_aek  /* _8- */
          FROM SYT0MC t1  /* 해외 채권/채무 발생 및 감소 MASTER */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                    = p_ymd
           AND t1.up_aek                    != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
    ) loop
        UPDATE SYT0MC /* 해외 채권/채무 발생 및 감소 MASTER */
           SET won_up_aek  = NVL(won_up_aek,0) + xx.won_up_aek
             , fcur_up_aek = NVL(fcur_up_aek,0) + xx.fcur_up_aek
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW'           , xx.trustee, 1, 1, xx.won_up_aek , 61, 'PROC0610', w_msg);
        ELSE    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.trustee, 1, 1, xx.fcur_up_aek, 61, 'PROC0610', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := 'PROC0610(szsl010) - ' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 미지급비용 환차손익
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                          /* _1- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                       /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                  /* _3- */
             , NVL(bfil_aek,0) + NVL(up_aek,0) - NVL(dw_aek,0)                                   AS aek          /* _4- */
             , NVL(won_bfil_aek,0) + NVL(won_up_aek,0) - NVL(won_dw_aek,0)                       AS won_aek      /* _5- */
             , F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, NVL(fcur_bfil_aek,0), ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_aek     /* _6- */
             , F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, NVL(up_aek,0), ia.fund_currency)         AS fcur_up_aek  /* _7- */
             , F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, NVL(dw_aek,0), ia.fund_currency)         AS fcur_dw_aek  /* _8- */
          FROM SYT0MC t1  /* 해외 채권/채무 발생 및 감소 MASTER */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                    = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
    ) loop
        xx.fcur_aek := xx.fcur_aek + xx.fcur_up_aek - xx.fcur_dw_aek;
        UPDATE SYT0MC /* 해외 채권/채무 발생 및 감소 MASTER */
           SET won_hwan_cha  = xx.won_aek - F_COVWON(p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, xx.aek)
             , fcur_hwan_cha = xx.fcur_aek - F_COVCUR(p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, xx.aek, xx.fund_currency)
             , fcur_up_aek   = xx.fcur_up_aek
             , fcur_dw_aek   = xx.fcur_dw_aek
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B050', 'PROC0612', 'USPM 잔고내역 생성');

    SR_PROC0612 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_msg);
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := 'PROC0612-' || w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0611 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 해외자산 미수이자 계산 및 평가액(환차손익) 산정
--
    w_af_ija_ymd                   DATE;

    w_r                            NUMBER;
    w_imp_volatility               NUMBER;
    w_delta                        NUMBER;
    w_gamma                        NUMBER;
    w_vega                         NUMBER;

    w_gijun_rt                     NUMBER;

    w_gugan_ilsu                   NUMBER;
    w_gugan_ija                    NUMBER;
    w_pass_ilsu                    NUMBER;

    w_day_ija                      NUMBER;

    w_jonga                        NUMBER;
    w_jun_jonga                    NUMBER;

    w_err                          NUMBER;

    w_cur_aek                      NUMBER;
    w_cur_ija                      NUMBER;
    w_avg_cur                      NUMBER;

    w_pyunga_aek                   NUMBER;
    w_hwansan_sonik                NUMBER;
    w_pyunga_sonik                 NUMBER;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'PROC0611', 'start ' || p_ymd || p_proc_step || '-' || ' :  해외자산 미수이자 계산 및 평가액(환차손익) 산정');

    -- 외화예금 평가액 산정
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sym0yz.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sym0ya.jasan_gb=5', '외화예금 평가액 산정(취득액으로)');

    -- 해외예금은 취득액으로
    UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
       SET tr_pyunga_aek = NVL(tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0) + NVL(RIGHT_AEK,0)
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND jm_cd   IN (SELECT jm_cd
                         FROM SYM0YA ta  /* 해외 자산종목 */
                        WHERE ta.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                          AND ta.jasan_gb = '5')
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    -- 해외파생에 대한 종가
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'sym0yz.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sym0ya.jasan_gb=A', '해외 파생 종가 점검');
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT NVL(ya.RIGHT_JM_CD, t1.JM_CD)  AS jm_cd
             , t1.currency
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0) != 0
           AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.currency = t1.currency
           AND ya.jasan_gb = 'A'
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT jonga
              INTO w_jonga
              FROM SYT0LP t1  /* 해외수신 종목 시세 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd          = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd        = xx.jm_cd
               AND NVL(t1.jonga,0) != 0;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.jm_cd || ' - 해외파생 종가가 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B030', 'sym0yz.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sym0ya.jasan_gb=1,2', '해외 주식/채권 평가 시가평가');

    -- 해외 주식/채권 평가
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                   /* _1- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                   /* _2- */
             , t2.jasan_gb                                                /* _3- */
             , t2.sj_gb                                                   /* _4- */
             , t2.gbx                                                     /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0)
                                      + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU,0)
                                      + NVL(msd_meib_aekm,0)
                                      - NVL(msd_medo_aekm,0)     AS jusu  /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                          + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK,0)
                                          + NVL(msd_meib_aek,0)
                                          - NVL(msd_medo_aek,0)  AS aek   /* _7- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SYM0YA t2  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0) + NVL(msd_meib_aekm,0) != 0
           AND t2.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
           AND t2.jasan_gb IN ('1','2')
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            if  xx.jasan_gb = '1'   then    -- 해외주식
                BEGIN
                    SELECT CASE WHEN xx.gbx='Y' THEN NVL(jonga,0) / 100  /* 영국주식종가 파운드(Great British Pence) */
                                                ELSE NVL(jonga,0) END
                      INTO w_jonga
                      FROM SYT0LP t1  /* 해외수신 종목 시세 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
                       AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;
                    if  w_jonga = 0 then
                        p_msg := xx.jm_cd || ' - 해외주식 종가(' || TO_CHAR (p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || ')를 확인하십시요!!';
                        RETURN;
                    end if;

                    UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                       SET tr_pyunga_aek = TRUNC(xx.jusu * w_jonga,4)
                     WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    if  xx.sj_gb = 'B'  then
                        -- 비상장 해외주식 장부가 평가
                        UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                           SET tr_pyunga_aek = xx.aek
                         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
                    else
                        p_msg := xx.jm_cd || ' - 해외주식 종가를 찾지 못했습니다.';
                        RETURN;
                    end if;
                END;
            elsif xx.jasan_gb = '2' then    -- 해외채권
                -- 평가사 단가 (SYM1SM)
                -- 입력(#4006) 단가
                BEGIN
                    SELECT NVL(danga,0)
                      INTO w_jonga
                      FROM SYT0LP t1  /* 해외수신 종목 시세 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
                       AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;
                    if  w_jonga = 0 then
                        p_msg := xx.jm_cd || ' - 해외채권 단가(' || TO_CHAR (p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || ')를 확인하십시요!!';
                        RETURN;
                    end if;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    p_msg := xx.jm_cd || ' - 해외채권 단가를 찾지 못했습니다.';
                    RETURN;
                END;

                UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                   SET tr_pyunga_aek = TRUNC(xx.jusu * w_jonga / 100,4)
                 WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
            else
                p_msg := xx.jm_cd || ' - 시가평가 처리를 생성 하십시오.';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
            p_msg := xx.jm_cd || ' - 주식종가,채권단가(' || TO_CHAR (p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || ') NOT !!!';
            RETURN;
        END;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B040', 'sym0yz.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sym0ya.jasan_gb=1,2', '해외 파생 시가평가');

    -- 해외 파생 시가평가
    BEGIN
        SELECT IJA_PER / 100
          INTO w_r
          FROM SYM0YA t1  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
           AND JASAN_GB = '5'
           AND JM_NM    = '기준금리'
           AND CURRENCY = 'USD'
           AND BALH_YMD = (SELECT MAX(BALH_YMD)
                             FROM SYM0YA h1  /* 해외 자산종목 */
                            WHERE CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
                              AND JASAN_GB = '5'
                              AND JM_NM    = '기준금리'
                              AND CURRENCY = 'USD'
                              AND p_ymd    BETWEEN BALH_YMD AND SANGHW_YMD);
        for xx IN (
            SELECT t1.CORP_GR                                                            /* _1- */
                 , t1.YMD                                                                /* _2- */
                 , t1.FUND_CD                                                            /* _3- */
                 , t1.TRUSTEE                                                            /* _4- */
                 , t1.BS_TYPE                                                            /* _5- */
                 , t1.JM_CD                                                              /* _6- */
                 , ya.RIGHT_JM_CD                                                        /* _7- */
                 , CASE WHEN t1.SM_TR_GB IN ('6','3')
                        THEN -1
                        ELSE 1 END                                   AS risk_sign        /* _8- */
                 , NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_JUSU,0) - NVL(t1.TR_DW_JUSU,0)
                                          + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU,0)     AS su               /* _9- */
                 , NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.TR_DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                              + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK,0)  AS chui_aek         /* _10- */
                 , ya.UNIT_AEK                                                           /* _11- */
                 , NVL(lp.JONGA,0)                                   AS jonga            /* _12- */
                 , ya.GBX                                                                /* _13- */
                 , ya.CHANGE_JM_CD                                                       /* _14- */
                 , ya.HANGSA_GA                                                          /* _15- */
                 , ya.LSY_YMD - p_ymd + 1                            AS T                /* _16- */
                 , 0                                                 AS tr_pyunga_aek    /* _17- */
                 , 0                                                 AS opt_nominal_amt  /* _18- */
              FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                 , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
                 , SYT0LP lp  /* 해외수신 종목 시세 */
             WHERE t1.CORP_GR     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.YMD         = p_ymd
               AND NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0) != 0
               AND ya.CORP_GR     = t1.CORP_GR
               AND ya.JM_CD       = t1.JM_CD
               AND ya.JASAN_GB    = 'A'
               AND lp.CORP_GR(+)  = t1.CORP_GR
               AND lp.YMD(+)      = t1.YMD
               AND lp.JM_CD(+)    = NVL(ya.RIGHT_JM_CD, t1.JM_CD)
               AND lp.CURRENCY(+) = t1.CURRENCY
        ) loop
            if  xx.right_jm_cd IS NOT NULL AND xx.jonga = 0 then
                -- 액면분할 종목 종가없을경우 장부가로 처리
                xx.tr_pyunga_aek := xx.chui_aek;
                xx.jonga         := xx.chui_aek / (xx.su * xx.unit_aek);
            else
                xx.tr_pyunga_aek := TRUNC (NVL(xx.su,0) * NVL(xx.jonga,0) * NVL(xx.unit_aek,0), 4);
            end if;
            xx.opt_nominal_amt := TRUNC (NVL(xx.su,0) * NVL(xx.hangsa_ga,0) * NVL(xx.unit_aek,0), 4);

            BEGIN
                SELECT CASE WHEN xx.gbx='Y' THEN NVL(jonga,0) / 100  /* 영국주식종가 파운드(Great British Pence) */
                                            ELSE NVL(jonga,0)
                       END
                  INTO w_jonga
                  FROM SYT0LP t1  /* 해외수신 종목 시세 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.change_jm_cd;

                w_imp_volatility := F_IMP_VOLATILITY(w_jonga, xx.hangsa_ga, xx.t, w_r, xx.jonga);
                if  xx.t > 0 AND w_imp_volatility > 0   then
                    SELECT PUT_DELTA
                         , GAMMA
                         , VEGA
                      INTO w_delta
                         , w_gamma
                         , w_vega
                      FROM F_DGTVR_COM (w_jonga, xx.t, xx.hangsa_ga, w_r, w_imp_volatility) t1;
                else
                    w_delta := NULL;
                    w_gamma := NULL;
                    w_vega  := NULL;
                end if;

                -- 위험평가액 계산
                -- 델타산정공식 : 기초자산가격 * 델타 * 계약수 * 승수
                -- 감마산정공식 : 0.5 * 감마 * (기초자산가격 * 0.08) ^2 * 계약수 * 승수
                -- 베가산정공식 : 베가 * (내재변동성* 0 .25) * 계약수 * 승수 * 100(%로 환원한 값)
                UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                   SET TR_PYUNGA_AEK    = xx.tr_pyunga_aek
                     , OPT_NOMINAL_AMT  = xx.opt_nominal_amt
                     , IMP_JONGA        = xx.jonga
                     , IMP_VOLATILITY   = w_imp_volatility
                     , DELTA            = w_delta
                     , GAMMA            = w_gamma
                     , VEGA             = w_vega
                     , DELTA_RISK_VALUE = TRUNC(w_jonga * w_delta * NVL(xx.su,0) * NVL(xx.unit_aek,0),4)
                     , GAMMA_RISK_VALUE = TRUNC(0.5 * w_gamma * POWER(w_jonga * 0.08,2) * NVL(xx.su,0) * NVL(xx.unit_aek,0),4) * xx.risk_sign
                     , VEGA_RISK_VALUE  = TRUNC(w_vega * (w_imp_volatility * 0.25) * NVL(xx.su,0) * NVL(xx.unit_aek,0) * 100,4) * xx.risk_sign
                 WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                   AND YMD     = p_ymd
                   AND FUND_CD = xx.fund_cd
                   AND TRUSTEE = xx.trustee
                   AND JM_CD   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND BS_TYPE = xx.bs_type;

            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                   SET TR_PYUNGA_AEK    = xx.tr_pyunga_aek
                     , OPT_NOMINAL_AMT  = xx.opt_nominal_amt
                     , IMP_JONGA        = xx.jonga
                     , IMP_VOLATILITY   = NULL
                     , DELTA            = NULL
                     , GAMMA            = NULL
                     , VEGA             = NULL
                     , DELTA_RISK_VALUE = NULL
                     , GAMMA_RISK_VALUE = NULL
                     , VEGA_RISK_VALUE  = NULL
                 WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                   AND YMD     = p_ymd
                   AND FUND_CD = xx.fund_cd
                   AND TRUSTEE = xx.trustee
                   AND JM_CD   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND BS_TYPE = xx.bs_type;
            END;
        end loop;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        NULL;
    END;

    -- 해외 배당/주식권리 평가
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B050', 'syt0yg_pyunga.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sym0ya.jasan_gb=1', '해외 배당/주식권리 평가');

    UPDATE SYT0YG_PYUNGA    /* 해외 배당/주식권리 일별 평가 */
       SET pyunga_aek       = 0
         , won_pyunga_aek   = 0
         , won_pyunga_sonik = 0
         , won_hwan_cha     = 0
         , fcur_pyunga_aek  = 0
         , fcur_hwan_cha    = 0
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid
             , yg.jm_cd
             , ya.jasan_gb
             , t1.jusu
          FROM SYT0YG_PYUNGA t1  /* 해외 배당/주식권리 일별 평가 */
             , SYT0YG        yg  /* 해외 배당/주식권리 현황 */
             , SYM0YA        ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND t1.jusu                      != 0
           AND NVL(t1.napbu_ymd, p_ymd + 1) <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.churi_ymd, p_ymd - 1) < p_ymd
           AND yg.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND yg.pyunga_join               = t1.pyunga_join
           AND ya.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd                     = yg.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb                  = '1'
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(jonga,0)
              INTO w_jonga
              FROM SYT0LP t1  /* 해외수신 종목 시세 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;
            if  w_jonga = 0 then
                p_msg := xx.jm_cd || ' - 해외주식 종가(' || TO_CHAR (p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || ')를 확인하십시요!!';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.jm_cd || ' - 해외주식 종가를 찾지 못했습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        UPDATE SYT0YG_PYUNGA    /* 해외 배당/주식권리 일별 평가 */
           SET pyunga_aek = TRUNC(xx.jusu * w_jonga,2)
             , gijun_rt   = w_jonga
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;

    -- 해외채권 이자계산
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B060', 'sym0yz.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sym0ya.jasan_gb=2', '해외채권 이자계산');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                     /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                   /* _2- */
             , t1.trustee                                                   /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                     /* _4- */
             , t1.currency                                                  /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0)
                                      + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU,0)  AS aekm       /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.sung_cost,0)                            AS sung_cost  /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.misu_ija,0)                             AS misu_ija   /* _8- */
             , CASE WHEN ya.ija_dcf IN ('2','3') THEN '1'
                                                 ELSE ya.ija_dcf
               END                                            AS ija_dcf    /* _9- */
             , ya.days_calc_gb                                              /* _10- */
             , ya.sj_gb                                                     /* _11- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                             /* _12- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0) != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND ya.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb                  = '2'
    ) loop
        -- 구간이자
        BEGIN
            -- 대출채권/대여금은 대출일부터 수령이자를 계산하므로 합산처리
            if  xx.ija_dcf = '1' AND xx.sj_gb = 'Z' then
                if  xx.days_calc_gb = '1'   then
                    SELECT t1.af_ija_ymd
                         , SUM (t1.gugan_ija * (NVL(yz.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(yz.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(yz.tr_dw_jusu,0)
                                                                       + NVL(yz.RIGHT_JUSU,0)) / gugan_ilsu)
                      INTO w_af_ija_ymd
                         , w_gugan_ija
                      FROM SYJ0IG t1  /* 해외채권 종목별 이자구간 */
                         , SYM0YZ yz  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                       AND p_ymd      BETWEEN t1.bf_ija_ymd AND (t1.af_ija_ymd - 1)
                       AND yz.ymd     BETWEEN t1.bf_ija_ymd AND p_ymd
                       AND yz.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND yz.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                       AND yz.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                       AND yz.trustee = xx.trustee
                     GROUP BY t1.af_ija_ymd;
                else
                    SELECT t1.af_ija_ymd
                         , SUM (t1.gugan_ija * (NVL(yz.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(yz.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(yz.tr_dw_jusu,0) + NVL(yz.RIGHT_JUSU,0)) / gugan_ilsu)
                      INTO w_af_ija_ymd
                         , w_gugan_ija
                      FROM SYJ0IG t1  /* 해외채권 종목별 이자구간 */
                         , SYM0YZ yz  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                       AND p_ymd      BETWEEN t1.bf_ija_ymd AND t1.af_ija_ymd
                       AND yz.ymd     BETWEEN t1.bf_ija_ymd AND p_ymd
                       AND yz.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND yz.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                       AND yz.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                       AND yz.trustee = xx.trustee
                     GROUP BY t1.af_ija_ymd;
                end if;
            else
                if  xx.days_calc_gb = '1'   then
                    SELECT t1.gugan_ija * xx.aekm
                         , t1.gugan_ilsu
                         , F_DCF_ILSU (xx.ija_dcf, t1.bf_ija_ymd, p_ymd) + 1  AS dcf_ilsu
                      INTO w_gugan_ija
                         , w_gugan_ilsu
                         , w_pass_ilsu
                      FROM SYJ0IG t1  /* 해외채권 종목별 이자구간 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                       AND p_ymd      BETWEEN t1.bf_ija_ymd AND (t1.af_ija_ymd - 1);
                else
                    -- 앙편넣기
                    -- 이자수령일인 경우 sr_sycp010에서 수입이자 처리 했으므로 당일 이자계산 0처리
                    SELECT CASE WHEN t1.af_ija_ymd=p_ymd THEN 0
                                                         ELSE t1.gugan_ija * xx.aekm END
                         , t1.gugan_ilsu
                         , F_DCF_ILSU (xx.ija_dcf, t1.bf_ija_ymd, p_ymd) + 1  AS dcf_ilsu
                      INTO w_gugan_ija
                         , w_gugan_ilsu
                         , w_pass_ilsu
                      FROM SYJ0IG t1  /* 해외채권 종목별 이자구간 */
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                       AND p_ymd      BETWEEN t1.bf_ija_ymd AND t1.af_ija_ymd;
                end if;
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.jm_cd || '-구간이자 생성(' || TO_CHAR (p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || ')이 되지 않았습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;
--        SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'IJAY', xx.jm_cd, f_n#(w_day_ija) || ' = ' || f_n#(w_gugan_ija, 12, 6) || '/' || f_n#(w_gugan_ilsu) || '*'
--                                                             || f_n#(w_pass_ilsu) || '-' || f_n#(xx.sung_cost) || '-' || f_n#(xx.misu_ija));
        -- 대출채권/대여금은 발생일부터 이자계산하므로 하루이자만 계산 20211216 yjs
        if  xx.ija_dcf = '1' AND xx.sj_gb = 'Z' then
            if  xx.days_calc_gb = '2' AND w_af_ija_ymd = p_ymd  then
                    w_day_ija := 0;
            else    w_day_ija := ROUND (w_gugan_ija,2) - xx.misu_ija;
            end if;
        else
            w_day_ija := ROUND (w_gugan_ija / w_gugan_ilsu * w_pass_ilsu,2) - xx.sung_cost - xx.misu_ija;
        end if;
        w_gijun_rt := F_CURRENCY_RT (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency);
        if  w_gijun_rt = -1 then
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.currency || ' - 환율이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;
        UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
           SET misu_ija      = NVL(misu_ija,0) + w_day_ija
             , day_ija       = w_day_ija
             , won_misu_ija  = NVL(won_misu_ija,0) + TRUNC(w_gijun_rt * w_day_ija)
             , won_day_ija   = TRUNC(w_gijun_rt * w_day_ija)
             , fcur_misu_ija = NVL(fcur_misu_ija,0) + F_COVCUR(p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, w_day_ija, xx.fund_currency)
             , fcur_day_ija  = F_COVCUR(p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, w_day_ija, xx.fund_currency)
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;

    -- 일괄 분개처리
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B061', 'sym0yz.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sym0ya.jasan_gb=2', '해외채권 분개처리');
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                     /* _1- */
             , t1.currency                                                    /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                               /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.won_day_ija),0)                    AS won_day_ija   /* _4- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq           /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.fcur_day_ija),0)                   AS fcur_day_ija  /* _6- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND ya.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb                  = '2'
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.currency
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B22', 'A', '2', '2', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW'           , xx.currency, xx.seq, 1, xx.won_day_ija , p_proc_step, 'PROC0611', w_msg);
        ELSE    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B22', 'A', '2', '2', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.currency, xx.seq, 1, xx.fcur_day_ija, p_proc_step, 'PROC0611', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.currency || '-' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 해외주식 평가
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B070', 'sym0yz.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sym0ya.jasan_gb=1', '해외주식 평가');

    w_err := 0;
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                  /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                /* _2- */
             , t1.currency                                                               /* _3- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0)
                                      + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU,0)          AS jusu            /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0)
                                    + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU,0)            AS dong_updw_jusu  /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                          + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK,0)       AS tr_chui_aek     /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                           + NVL(t1.RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)  AS won_chui_aek    /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_pyunga_aek,0)                                AS tr_pyunga_aek   /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_sonik                                                               /* _9- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                  /* _10- */
             , ya.sj_gb                                                                  /* _11- */
             , ya.isin_cd                                                                /* _12- */
             , ya.siga_agent                                                             /* _13- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0) != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND ya.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb                  IN ('1','9')
    ) loop
        xx.tr_sonik     := xx.tr_pyunga_aek - xx.tr_chui_aek;
        w_pyunga_aek    := 0;
        w_hwansan_sonik := 0;
        w_pyunga_sonik  := 0;
        if  xx.jusu > 0 then
            w_cur_aek := xx.tr_chui_aek;  /* 평잔방식 환차손익은 평가손익 제외분만 처리 */
            -- 환산손익(원) = 평균환율과 당일환율 차이를 구해 통화금액을 곱하므로 환산손익액만 구함
            BEGIN
                w_avg_cur       := TRUNC (xx.won_chui_aek / xx.tr_chui_aek,4);                                /* 매입평균환율 */
                w_hwansan_sonik := TRUNC (F_HWANMOD (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, w_avg_cur) * w_cur_aek);
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := xx.fund_cd || xx.jm_cd;
                RETURN;
            END;
            -- 기준환율
            w_gijun_rt := F_CURRENCY_RT (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency);
            if  w_gijun_rt = -1 THEN
                w_err := w_err + 1;
                INSERT INTO WFRMERR /* 에러메세지(저장작업 정지됨) */
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                                /* _1- */
                       , xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.currency || ' - 환율이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.'  /* _2- */
                       );
                CONTINUE;
            ELSE
                w_pyunga_aek := TRUNC (w_gijun_rt * xx.tr_pyunga_aek);
            end if;
        end if;

        w_pyunga_sonik := (w_pyunga_aek - xx.won_chui_aek) - w_hwansan_sonik;  /* 평가손익(원) 전체 := 전체평가손익(원) - 환산손익(원) */

        -- isin_cd null 장부가평가 20201201 yjs
        if NVL (xx.siga_agent,'B') = 'B' OR (xx.sj_gb = 'B' AND xx.tr_chui_aek = xx.tr_pyunga_aek)  THEN
            -- 일부평가손익금액 무조건 0 처리를 환차손익액으로 조정 20201215 yjs
            w_hwansan_sonik := w_hwansan_sonik + w_pyunga_sonik;
            w_pyunga_sonik  := 0;
        end if;

        UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
           SET tr_sonik         = xx.tr_sonik
             , won_pyunga_aek   = w_pyunga_aek
             , won_pyunga_sonik = w_pyunga_sonik
             , won_hwan_cha     = w_hwansan_sonik
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;
    if  w_err > 0   THEN
        p_msg := F_NTRIM (w_err) || '건 주식 환차손익계산 환율이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 해외주식 평가(외화기준가)
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B071', 'sym0yz.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sym0ya.jasan_gb=1', '해외주식 평가(외화기준가)');

    w_err := 0;
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                                   /* _1- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                                /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                           /* _3- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0)
                                      + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU,0)                                         AS jusu              /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                          + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK,0)                                      AS tr_chui_aek       /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_pyunga_aek,0)                                                               AS tr_pyunga_aek     /* _6- */
             , F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_pyunga_aek, ia.fund_currency)          AS fcur_pyunga_aek   /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.fcur_bfil_chui_aek,0)                                                          AS fcur_chui_aek     /* _8- */
             , NVL(F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_up_chui_aek, ia.fund_currency),0)  AS fcur_up_chui_aek  /* _9- */
             , NVL(F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_dw_chui_aek, ia.fund_currency),0)  AS fcur_dw_chui_aek  /* _10- */
             , NVL(F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.RIGHT_AEK, ia.fund_currency),0)       AS fcur_right_aek    /* _11- */
             , t1.fcur_sonik                                                                                              /* _12- */
             , ya.isin_cd                                                                                                 /* _13- */
             , ya.siga_agent                                                                                              /* _14- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0) != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fund_currency             != 'KRW'
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND ya.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb                  IN ('1','9')
    ) loop
        xx.fcur_chui_aek := xx.fcur_chui_aek + xx.fcur_up_chui_aek - xx.fcur_dw_chui_aek + xx.fcur_right_aek;
        xx.fcur_sonik    := xx.fcur_pyunga_aek - xx.fcur_chui_aek;
        w_pyunga_aek     := 0;
        w_hwansan_sonik  := 0;
        w_pyunga_sonik   := 0;
        if  xx.jusu > 0 THEN
            -- 환산손익(기준통화)
            if  xx.currency != xx.fund_currency THEN
                    w_hwansan_sonik := F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, xx.tr_chui_aek, xx.fund_currency) - xx.fcur_chui_aek;
            else    w_hwansan_sonik := 0;
            end if;

            w_pyunga_aek   := F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, xx.tr_pyunga_aek, xx.fund_currency);
            w_pyunga_sonik := (w_pyunga_aek - xx.fcur_chui_aek) - w_hwansan_sonik;                           /* 평가손익(기준통화) = 전체평가손익(기준통화) - 환산손익(기준통화) */
            if NVL (xx.siga_agent,'B') = 'B'    THEN
                -- 일부평가손익금액 무조건 0 처리를 환차손익액으로 조정 20201215 yjs
                w_hwansan_sonik := w_hwansan_sonik + w_pyunga_sonik;
                w_pyunga_sonik  := 0;
            end if;
        end if;
        UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
           SET RIGHT_FCUR_AEK    = xx.fcur_right_aek
             , fcur_sonik        = xx.fcur_sonik
             , fcur_pyunga_aek   = w_pyunga_aek
             , fcur_pyunga_sonik = w_pyunga_sonik
             , fcur_hwan_cha     = w_hwansan_sonik
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;
    if  w_err > 0   THEN
        p_msg := F_NTRIM (w_err) || '건 주식 환차손익계산 환율(외화기준가)이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 해외 배당/주식권리 평가
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B080', 'syt0yg_pyunga.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sym0ya.jasan_gb=1', '해외 배당/주식권리 평가');

    w_err := 0;
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                 /* _1- */
             , yg.fund_cd                               /* _2- */
             , yg.currency                              /* _3- */
             , NVL(t1.jusu,0)            AS jusu        /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.gyulje_aek,0)      AS aek         /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.won_gyulje_aek,0)  AS won_aek     /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.pyunga_aek,0)      AS pyunga_aek  /* _7- */
          FROM SYT0YG_PYUNGA t1  /* 해외 배당/주식권리 일별 평가 */
             , SYT0YG        yg  /* 해외 배당/주식권리 현황 */
             , SZM0IA        ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SYM0YA        ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND t1.napbu_ymd                 <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.churi_ymd, p_ymd - 1) < p_ymd
           AND yg.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND yg.pyunga_join               = t1.pyunga_join
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = yg.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND ya.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd                     = yg.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb                  = '1'
    ) loop
        -- 기준환율
        w_gijun_rt := F_CURRENCY_RT (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency);
        if  xx.jusu > 0 THEN
            w_cur_aek := xx.aek;  /* 평잔방식 환차손익은 평가손익 제외분만 처리 */
            -- 환산손익(원) = 평균환율과 당일환율 차이를 구해 통화금액을 곱하므로 환산손익액만 구함
            if  xx.aek = 0  THEN
                    w_avg_cur := 0;
            else    w_avg_cur := TRUNC (xx.won_aek / xx.aek,4);  /* 매입평균환율 */
            end if;
            w_hwansan_sonik := TRUNC (F_HWANMOD (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, w_avg_cur) * w_cur_aek);
            if  w_gijun_rt = -1 THEN
                w_err := w_err + 1;
                INSERT INTO WFRMERR /* 에러메세지(저장작업 정지됨) */
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                                /* _1- */
                       , xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.currency || ' - 환율이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.'  /* _2- */
                       );
                CONTINUE;
            ELSE
                w_pyunga_aek := TRUNC (w_gijun_rt * xx.pyunga_aek);
            end if;
            -- 평가손익(원) := 전체평가손익(원) - 환산손익(원)
            w_pyunga_sonik := (w_pyunga_aek - xx.won_aek) - w_hwansan_sonik;
        ELSE
            w_pyunga_aek   := 0;
            w_pyunga_sonik := 0;
            if  xx.aek = 0  THEN
                w_hwansan_sonik := 0;
            ELSE
                w_avg_cur       := TRUNC (xx.won_aek / xx.aek,4);                                          /* 매입평균환율 */
                w_hwansan_sonik := TRUNC (F_HWANMOD (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, w_avg_cur) * xx.aek);
            end if;
        end if;
        UPDATE SYT0YG_PYUNGA    /* 해외 배당/주식권리 일별 평가 */
           SET won_pyunga_aek   = w_pyunga_aek
             , won_pyunga_sonik = w_pyunga_sonik
             , won_hwan_cha     = w_hwansan_sonik
             , gijun_rt         = w_gijun_rt
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;
    if  w_err > 0   THEN
        p_msg := F_NTRIM (w_err) || '건 주식 환차손익계산 환율이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 해외 배당/주식권리 평가(외화기준가)
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B081', 'syt0yg_pyunga.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sym0ya.jasan_gb=1', '해외 배당/주식권리 평가(외화기준가)');

    w_err := 0;
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                  /* _1- */
             , yg.currency                               /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                          /* _3- */
             , NVL(t1.jusu,0)             AS jusu        /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.gyulje_aek,0)       AS aek         /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.pyunga_aek,0)       AS pyunga_aek  /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.fcur_gyulje_aek,0)  AS fcur_aek    /* _7- */
          FROM SYT0YG_PYUNGA t1  /* 해외 배당/주식권리 일별 평가 */
             , SYT0YG        yg  /* 해외 배당/주식권리 현황 */
             , SZM0IA        ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SYM0YA        ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND t1.napbu_ymd                 <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.churi_ymd, p_ymd - 1) < p_ymd
           AND yg.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND yg.pyunga_join               = t1.pyunga_join
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = yg.fund_cd
           AND ia.fund_currency             != 'KRW'
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND ya.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd                     = yg.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb                  = '1'
    ) loop
        if  xx.jusu > 0 THEN
            -- 환산손익(기준통화)
            if  xx.currency != xx.fund_currency THEN
                    w_hwansan_sonik := F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, xx.pyunga_aek, xx.fund_currency) - xx.fcur_aek;
            else    w_hwansan_sonik := 0;
            end if;
            w_pyunga_aek := F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, xx.pyunga_aek, xx.fund_currency);
            -- 평가손익(기준통화)   := 전체평가손익(기준통화) - 환산손익(기준통화)
            w_pyunga_sonik := (w_pyunga_aek - xx.fcur_aek) - w_hwansan_sonik;
        ELSE
            w_pyunga_aek   := 0;
            w_pyunga_sonik := 0;
            if  xx.aek = 0  THEN
                    w_hwansan_sonik := 0;
            else    w_hwansan_sonik := F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, xx.aek, xx.fund_currency) - xx.fcur_aek;
            end if;
        end if;
        UPDATE SYT0YG_PYUNGA    /* 해외 배당/주식권리 일별 평가 */
           SET fcur_pyunga_aek   = w_pyunga_aek
             , fcur_pyunga_sonik = w_pyunga_sonik
             , fcur_hwan_cha     = w_hwansan_sonik
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;
    if  w_err > 0   THEN
        p_msg := F_NTRIM (w_err) || '건 주식 환차손익계산 환율이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 해외파생 평가
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B090', 'sym0yz.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sym0ya.jasan_gb=A', '해외파생 평가');

    w_err := 0;
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                 /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                               /* _2- */
             , t1.trustee                                                               /* _3- */
             , t1.currency                                                              /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0)
                                      + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU,0)          AS jusu           /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                          + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK,0)       AS tr_chui_aek    /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                           + NVL(t1.RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)  AS won_chui_aek   /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_pyunga_aek,0)                                AS tr_pyunga_aek  /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_sonik                                                              /* _9- */
             , t1.sm_tr_gb                                                              /* _10- */
             , ya.sj_gb                                                                 /* _11- */
             , ya.isin_cd                                                               /* _12- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0) != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND ya.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb                  = 'A'
    ) loop
        if  xx.sm_tr_gb IN ('2','4','6')    THEN
                xx.tr_sonik := xx.tr_chui_aek - xx.tr_pyunga_aek;  /* 매도분 */
        else    xx.tr_sonik := xx.tr_pyunga_aek - xx.tr_chui_aek;
        end if;
--        UPDATE SSM0WG
--           SET sm_pyunga_misu_c  = NVL (sm_pyunga_misu_c,0) + CASE WHEN xx.tr_sonik > 0 THEN xx.tr_sonik ELSE 0 END
--             , sm_pyunga_misu_s  = NVL (sm_pyunga_misu_s,0) + CASE WHEN xx.tr_sonik < 0 THEN - xx.tr_sonik ELSE 0 END
--         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
--           AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
--           AND ymd      = p_ymd
--           AND trustee  = xx.trustee
--           AND currency = xx.currency
--           AND gwamok   = '10156'
--           AND NVL(pass_cash_aek,0) + NVL(day_up_aek,0) - NVL(day_dw_aek,0)  > 0
--           AND ROWNUM = 1;
        w_pyunga_aek    := 0;
        w_hwansan_sonik := 0;
        w_pyunga_sonik  := 0;
        if  xx.jusu > 0 THEN
            if  xx.sj_gb = 'B' AND xx.tr_chui_aek = xx.tr_pyunga_aek    THEN
                xx.tr_sonik := 0;
            end if;
            -- 환산손익(원) = 평균환율과 당일환율 차이를 구해 통화금액을 곱하므로 환산손익액만 구함
            w_avg_cur       := TRUNC (xx.won_chui_aek / xx.tr_chui_aek,4);                                  /* 매입평균환율 */
            w_hwansan_sonik := TRUNC (F_HWANMOD (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, w_avg_cur) * xx.tr_sonik);
            -- 기준환율
            w_gijun_rt := F_CURRENCY_RT (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency);
            if  w_gijun_rt = -1 THEN
                w_err := w_err + 1;
                INSERT INTO WFRMERR /* 에러메세지(저장작업 정지됨) */
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                                /* _1- */
                       , xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.currency || ' - 환율이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.'  /* _2- */
                       );
                CONTINUE;
            ELSE
                w_pyunga_sonik := TRUNC (w_gijun_rt * xx.tr_sonik);
            end if;
            w_pyunga_sonik := w_pyunga_sonik - w_hwansan_sonik;
            if  xx.sj_gb = 'B' AND xx.tr_chui_aek = xx.tr_pyunga_aek    THEN
                -- 일부평가손익금액 무조건 0 처리를 환차손익액으로 조정 20201215 yjs
                w_hwansan_sonik := w_hwansan_sonik + w_pyunga_sonik;
                w_pyunga_sonik  := 0;
            end if;
        end if;
        UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
           SET tr_sonik         = xx.tr_sonik
             , won_pyunga_aek   = TRUNC(w_gijun_rt * xx.tr_pyunga_aek)
             , won_pyunga_sonik = w_pyunga_sonik
             , won_hwan_cha     = w_hwansan_sonik
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;
    if  w_err > 0   THEN
        p_msg := F_NTRIM (w_err) || '건 주식 환차손익계산 환율이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 해외파생 평가(외화기준가)
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B091', 'sym0yz.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sym0ya.jasan_gb=A', '해외주식 평가(외화기준가)');

    w_err := 0;
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                          /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                        /* _2- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                        /* _3- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                       /* _4- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                  /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0)
                                      + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU,0)                                 AS jusu             /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                          + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK,0)                              AS tr_chui_aek      /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_pyunga_aek,0)                                                       AS tr_pyunga_aek    /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.fcur_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.fcur_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.fcur_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                            + NVL(t1.RIGHT_FCUR_AEK,0)                       AS fcur_chui_aek    /* _9- */
             , F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_pyunga_aek, ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_pyunga_aek  /* _10- */
             , t1.fcur_sonik                                                                                     /* _11- */
             , t1.sm_tr_gb                                                                                       /* _12- */
             , ya.sj_gb                                                                                          /* _13- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0) != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fund_currency             != 'KRW'
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND ya.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb                  = 'A'
    ) loop
        if  xx.sm_tr_gb IN ('2','4','6')    THEN
                xx.fcur_sonik := xx.fcur_chui_aek - xx.fcur_pyunga_aek;
        else    xx.fcur_sonik := xx.fcur_pyunga_aek - xx.fcur_chui_aek;
        end if;
--        UPDATE SSM0WG
--           SET fcur_sm_pyunga_misu_c  = NVL (fcur_sm_pyunga_misu_c,0) + CASE WHEN xx.fcur_sonik > 0 THEN xx.fcur_sonik ELSE 0 END
--             , fcur_sm_pyunga_misu_s  = NVL (fcur_sm_pyunga_misu_s,0) + CASE WHEN xx.fcur_sonik < 0 THEN - xx.fcur_sonik ELSE 0 END
--         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
--           AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
--           AND ymd      = p_ymd
--           AND trustee  = xx.trustee
--           AND currency = xx.currency
--           AND gwamok   = '10156'
--           AND ROWNUM = 1;
        w_hwansan_sonik := 0;
        w_pyunga_sonik  := 0;
        if  xx.jusu > 0 THEN
            -- 환산손익(원) = 평균환율과 당일환율 차이를 구해 통화금액을 곱하므로 환산손익액만 구함
            if  xx.currency = xx.fund_currency  THEN
                w_hwansan_sonik := 0;
            ELSE
                if  xx.sj_gb = 'B' AND xx.tr_chui_aek = xx.tr_pyunga_aek    then    xx.fcur_sonik := 0;
                end if;
                w_avg_cur       := TRUNC (xx.fcur_chui_aek / xx.tr_chui_aek,4);                                   /* 매입평균환율 */
                w_hwansan_sonik := TRUNC (F_HWANMOD (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, w_avg_cur) * xx.fcur_sonik);
            end if;
            if  xx.sj_gb = 'B' AND xx.tr_chui_aek = xx.tr_pyunga_aek    THEN
                -- 장부가평가는 평가손익 0 처리
                w_pyunga_sonik := 0;
            ELSE
                -- 평가손익(원) := 전체 - 전체평가손익(원) - 환산손익(원)
                -- -2 : 매도분
                if  xx.sm_tr_gb IN ('2','4','6')    THEN
                        w_pyunga_sonik := (xx.fcur_chui_aek - xx.fcur_pyunga_aek) - w_hwansan_sonik;
                else    w_pyunga_sonik := (xx.fcur_pyunga_aek - xx.fcur_chui_aek) - w_hwansan_sonik;
                end if;
            end if;
        end if;
        UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
           SET fcur_sonik        = xx.fcur_sonik
             , fcur_pyunga_aek   = xx.fcur_pyunga_aek
             , fcur_pyunga_sonik = w_pyunga_sonik
             , fcur_hwan_cha     = w_hwansan_sonik
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;
    if  w_err > 0   THEN
        p_msg := F_NTRIM (w_err) || '건 주식 환차손익계산 환율이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 해외주식이외 평가
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B100', 'PROC0611_11 sym0yz.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sym0ya.jasan_gb not in (1A)', '해외주식이외 평가');

    w_err := 0;
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                    /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                  /* _2- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                  /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                    /* _4- */
             , t1.currency                                                                 /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0)
                                      + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU,0)          AS aekm              /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                          + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK,0)       AS tr_chui_aek       /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_pyunga_aek,0)                                AS tr_pyunga_aek     /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                           + NVL(t1.RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)  AS won_chui_aek      /* _9- */
             , NVL(t1.sung_cost,0)                                    AS sung_cost         /* _10- */
             , NVL(t1.misu_ija,0)                                     AS misu_ija          /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.won_sung_cost,0)                                AS won_sung_cost     /* _12- */
             , NVL(t1.won_misu_ija,0)                                 AS won_misu_ija      /* _13- */
             , NVL(t1.msd_meib_aek,0)                                 AS msd_meib_aek      /* _14- */
             , NVL(t1.msd_medo_aekm,0)                                AS msd_medo_aekm     /* _15- */
             , NVL(t1.won_msd_meib_aek,0)                             AS won_msd_meib_aek  /* _16- */
             , 0                                                      AS msd_meib_ija      /* _17- */
             , 0                                                      AS msd_meib_won_ija  /* _18- */
             , ya.jasan_gb                                                                 /* _19- */
             , ya.isin_cd                                                                  /* _20- */
             , ya.siga_agent                                                               /* _21- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.msd_meib_aekm,0) != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND ya.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb                  NOT IN ('1','A')
    ) loop
        -- 익일매도 취득액 반영
        SELECT xx.tr_chui_aek - NVL(SUM(chui_aek),0)
             , xx.won_chui_aek - NVL(SUM(won_chui_aek),0)
          INTO xx.tr_chui_aek
             , xx.won_chui_aek
          FROM SYT0MG t1  /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd     <= p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
           AND t1.currency   = xx.currency
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'K11'
           AND t1.trustee    = xx.trustee
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd > p_ymd;

        -- 평잔방식 환차손익은 평가손익 제외분만 처리
        w_cur_ija := 0;
        w_cur_aek := xx.tr_chui_aek;

        -- 환산손익(원) = 평균환율과 당일환율 차이를 구해 통화금액을 곱하므로 환산손익액만 구함
        -- 매입평균 환율을 구하므로 매도분 비율처리를 하지 않음
        w_avg_cur   := (xx.won_chui_aek + xx.won_msd_meib_aek + xx.won_sung_cost + xx.won_misu_ija + xx.msd_meib_won_ija)
                        / (xx.tr_chui_aek + xx.msd_meib_aek + xx.sung_cost + xx.misu_ija + xx.msd_meib_ija);
        w_hwansan_sonik := TRUNC (F_HWANMOD (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, w_avg_cur) * w_cur_aek);

        -- 기준환율
        w_gijun_rt := F_CURRENCY_RT (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency);
        if  w_gijun_rt = -1 THEN
            w_err := w_err + 1;
            INSERT INTO WFRMERR /* 에러메세지(저장작업 정지됨) */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                                /* _1- */
                   , xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.currency || ' - 환율이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.'  /* _2- */
                   );
            CONTINUE;
        ELSE
            w_pyunga_aek := TRUNC (w_gijun_rt * w_cur_aek);
        end if;

        -- 평가손익(원) := 전체평가손익(원) - 환산손익(원)
        if  xx.aekm = 0 THEN
            w_pyunga_sonik := (w_pyunga_aek - xx.won_msd_meib_aek) - w_hwansan_sonik;
        ELSE
            w_pyunga_sonik  := (NVL(w_pyunga_aek,0) - NVL(xx.won_msd_meib_aek,0)) - NVL (w_hwansan_sonik,0)
                                                                                  - (NVL(xx.won_chui_aek,0) + ((NVL(xx.won_sung_cost,0) + NVL(xx.won_misu_ija,0))
                                                                                                                / xx.aekm * (xx.aekm - NVL(xx.msd_medo_aekm,0))));
            if  xx.msd_medo_aekm = 0 AND NVL (xx.siga_agent,'B') = 'B'      THEN
                -- 일부평가손익금액 무조건 0 처리를 환차손익액으로 조정 20201215 yjs
                w_hwansan_sonik := w_hwansan_sonik + w_pyunga_sonik;
                w_pyunga_sonik  := 0;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 익일매도분 손익 평가손익처리
        SELECT w_pyunga_sonik + NVL(SUM(NVL(won_gyulje_aek,0) - NVL(won_chui_aek,0) - NVL(won_pass_ija,0)),0)
          INTO w_pyunga_sonik
          FROM SYT0MG t1  /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd     <= p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
           AND t1.currency   = xx.currency
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'K11'
           AND t1.trustee    = xx.trustee
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd > p_ymd;

--        SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, '030', xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.jm_cd || ' ' || xx.trustee || ' ' || xx.currency,
--                    f_ntrim(w_avg_cur) || ' * ' || f_ntrim(w_cur_aek) || ' = ' || f_ntrim(w_hwansan_sonik) || ' / ' || f_ntrim(w_pyunga_sonik));
        -- 외회예금은 환차손익으로
        if  xx.jasan_gb = '5'   THEN
            w_hwansan_sonik := w_hwansan_sonik + w_pyunga_sonik;
            w_pyunga_sonik  := 0;
        end if;
        UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
           SET tr_sonik         = w_cur_aek - xx.tr_chui_aek
             , won_pyunga_aek   = w_pyunga_aek
             , won_pyunga_sonik = w_pyunga_sonik
             , won_hwan_cha     = w_hwansan_sonik
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;
    if  w_err > 0   THEN
        p_msg := F_NTRIM (w_err) || '건 주식이외 환차손익계산 환율이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 해외주식이외 평가(외화기준가)
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B101', 'sym0yz.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * sym0ya.jasan_gb not in (1A)', '해외주식이외 평가(외화기준가)');

    w_err := 0;
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                                    /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                                  /* _2- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                                  /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                                    /* _4- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                                 /* _5- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                            /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0)
                                      + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU,0)                                         AS aekm               /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_pyunga_aek,0)                                                               AS tr_pyunga_aek      /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.fcur_bfil_chui_aek,0)                                                          AS fcur_chui_aek      /* _9- */
             , NVL(F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_up_chui_aek, ia.fund_currency),0)  AS fcur_up_chui_aek   /* _10- */
             , NVL(F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_dw_chui_aek, ia.fund_currency),0)  AS fcur_dw_chui_aek   /* _11- */
             , NVL(F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.RIGHT_AEK, ia.fund_currency),0)       AS fcur_right_aek     /* _12- */
             , NVL(t1.sung_cost,0)                                                                   AS sung_cost          /* _13- */
             , NVL(t1.misu_ija,0)                                                                    AS misu_ija           /* _14- */
             , NVL(t1.fcur_sung_cost,0)                                                              AS fcur_sung_cost     /* _15- */
             , NVL(t1.fcur_misu_ija,0)                                                               AS fcur_misu_ija      /* _16- */
             , NVL(t1.msd_medo_aekm,0)                                                               AS msd_medo_aekm      /* _17- */
             , NVL(t1.fcur_msd_meib_aek,0)                                                           AS fcur_msd_meib_aek  /* _18- */
             , 0                                                                                     AS msd_meib_ija       /* _19- */
             , 0                                                                                     AS msd_meib_fcur_ija  /* _20- */
             , ya.jasan_gb                                                                                                 /* _21- */
             , ya.isin_cd                                                                                                  /* _22- */
             , ya.siga_agent                                                                                               /* _23- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.msd_meib_aekm,0) != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fund_currency             != 'KRW'
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND ya.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb                  NOT IN ('1','A','9')
    ) loop
        -- 익일매도 취득액 반영
        SELECT xx.fcur_chui_aek - NVL(SUM(fcur_chui_aek),0)
          INTO xx.fcur_chui_aek
          FROM SYT0MG t1  /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd     <= p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
           AND t1.currency   = xx.currency
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'K11'
           AND t1.trustee    = xx.trustee
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd > p_ymd;

        xx.fcur_chui_aek := xx.fcur_chui_aek + xx.fcur_up_chui_aek - xx.fcur_dw_chui_aek;

        SELECT NVL(SUM(pass_ija),0)
             , NVL(SUM(F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, tr_ymd, t1.currency, NVL(pass_ija,0), xx.fund_currency)),0)
          INTO xx.msd_meib_ija
             , xx.msd_meib_fcur_ija
          FROM SYT0MG t1  /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd     <= p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
           AND t1.currency   = xx.currency
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'J14'
           AND t1.trustee    = xx.trustee
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd > p_ymd;
        if  xx.aekm = 0 THEN
                w_cur_ija := xx.msd_meib_ija;
        else    w_cur_ija := xx.msd_meib_ija + TRUNC ((xx.sung_cost + xx.misu_ija) / xx.aekm * (xx.aekm - xx.msd_medo_aekm),2);
        end if;

        w_cur_aek := xx.tr_pyunga_aek + w_cur_ija;

        -- 환산손익(기준통화)
        if  xx.aekm = 0 THEN
                w_avg_cur := xx.fcur_chui_aek + xx.fcur_msd_meib_aek + xx.msd_meib_fcur_ija;
        else    w_avg_cur := xx.fcur_chui_aek + xx.fcur_msd_meib_aek + TRUNC ((xx.fcur_sung_cost + xx.fcur_misu_ija) / xx.aekm * (xx.aekm - xx.msd_medo_aekm),2) + xx.msd_meib_fcur_ija;
        end if;

        if  xx.currency != xx.fund_currency THEN
                w_hwansan_sonik := F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, w_cur_aek, xx.fund_currency) - w_avg_cur;
        else    w_hwansan_sonik := 0;
        end if;

        -- 평가손익(기준통화)   := 전체평가손익(기준통화) - 환산손익(기준통화)
        if  xx.aekm = 0 THEN
            w_pyunga_sonik := (w_cur_aek - xx.fcur_msd_meib_aek) - w_hwansan_sonik;
        ELSE
            -- 미수도 매도분은 장부가평가종목도 평가손익계산
            w_pyunga_sonik  := (w_cur_aek - xx.fcur_msd_meib_aek) - w_hwansan_sonik
                                                                  - (xx.fcur_chui_aek + TRUNC ((xx.fcur_sung_cost + xx.fcur_misu_ija) / xx.aekm * (xx.aekm - xx.msd_medo_aekm),2));
            if  xx.msd_medo_aekm = 0 AND NVL (xx.siga_agent,'B') = 'B'      then
                -- 일부평가손익금액 무조건 0 처리를 환차손익액으로 조정 20201215 yjs
                w_hwansan_sonik := w_hwansan_sonik + w_pyunga_sonik;
                w_pyunga_sonik  := 0;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 익일매도분 손익 평가손익처리
        SELECT w_pyunga_sonik + NVL(SUM(fcur_gyulje_aek - fcur_chui_aek - NVL(fcur_pass_ija,0)),0)
          INTO w_pyunga_sonik
          FROM SYT0MG t1  /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd     <= p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
           AND t1.currency   = xx.currency
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'K11'
           AND t1.trustee    = xx.trustee
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd > p_ymd;
        UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
           SET RIGHT_FCUR_AEK    = xx.fcur_right_aek
             , fcur_sonik        = w_cur_aek - xx.fcur_chui_aek
             , fcur_up_chui_aek  = xx.fcur_up_chui_aek
             , fcur_dw_chui_aek  = xx.fcur_dw_chui_aek
             , fcur_pyunga_aek   = w_cur_aek
             , fcur_pyunga_sonik = w_pyunga_sonik
             , fcur_hwan_cha     = w_hwansan_sonik
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;
    if  w_err > 0   then
        p_msg := F_NTRIM (w_err) || '건 주식이외 환차손익계산 환율이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 해외 증거금 환차손익 계산
--    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B110', 'PROC0611_13 ssm0wg.ymd=' || p_ymd, '해외 증거금 환차손익 계산');
--
--    w_err   := 0;
--    FOR xx IN (
--        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                /* _1- */
--             , t1.currency                                                                             /* _2- */
--             , ia.fund_currency                                                                        /* _3- */
--             , NVL(t1.pass_cash_aek,0) + NVL(day_up_aek,0) - NVL(day_dw_aek,0)              AS aek     /* _4- */
--             , NVL(t1.won_pass_cash_aek,0) + NVL(won_day_up_aek,0) - NVL(won_day_dw_aek,0)  AS won_aek /* _5- */
--             , t1.in_cash_aek                                                                          /* _6- */
--          FROM SSM0WG t1
--             , SZM0IA ia
--         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
--           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
--           AND ia.corp_gr       = t1.corp_gr
--           AND ia.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd
--           AND ia.fund_currency != t1.currency
--    ) loop
--        if NVL (xx.aek,0) > 0   theny
--                w_hwansan_sonik := trunc (F_HWANMOD (p_corp_gr,p_ymd,xx.currency,trunc (xx.won_aek / xx.aek,4)) * xx.aek);
--        else    w_hwansan_sonik := 0;
--        end if;
--
--        UPDATE SSM0WG
--           SET hwan_cha = w_hwansan_sonik
--         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
--    END LOOP;
--    if  w_err > 0   then
--        p_msg   := F_NTRIM (w_err) || '건 증거금 환차손익계산 환율이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.';
--        RETURN;
--    end if;

    COMMIT;
    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := 'PROC0611:' || SUBSTR (sqlerrm, 1, 180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0612 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- USPM OPT 잔고 및 손익생성
--
    w_fund_cd                      VARCHAR (20) := '!@#$';
    p_port_num                     VARCHAR (2)  := '!@';

    w_price                        NUMBER;

    p_year_beta                    NUMBER;
    p_mon_beta                     NUMBER;
    p_port_rt                      NUMBER;
    w_year_beta                    NUMBER;
    w_mon_beta                     NUMBER;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM USPM_OPT /* US Portfolio Model 펀드/일별 해외주식,파생 잔고 */
     WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
       AND YMD     = p_ymd;

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.JM_CD
          FROM USPM_DD t1  /* US Portfolio Model 종목 일별 기준변동성 현황 */
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR                = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.YMD                    = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.OVRS_EXCG_CD,'US') <> 'KRX'
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(t1.JONGA,0)
              INTO w_price
              FROM SYT0LP t1  /* 해외수신 종목 시세 */
             WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.YMD     = F_OPEN_US(p_ymd,'-')
               AND t1.JM_CD   = xx.jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_price := 0;
        END;

        FOR uspm IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT FUND_CD
                 , '(' || t1.PORT_NUM || ')'  AS trustee
              FROM USPM t1  /* US Portfolio Model 일변 기준정보 */
             WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.YMD     = p_ymd
               AND t1.JM_CD   = xx.jm_cd
        ) loop
            INSERT INTO USPM_OPT /* US Portfolio Model 펀드/일별 해외주식,파생 잔고 */
                 ( CORP_GR  /* _1- */
                 , YMD      /* _2- */
                 , FUND_CD  /* _3- */
                 , JM_CD    /* _4- */
                 , PORT     /* _5- */
                 , JONGA    /* _6- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd         /* _2- */
                   , uspm.fund_cd  /* _3- */
                   , xx.jm_cd      /* _4- */
                   , uspm.trustee  /* _5- */
                   , w_price       /* _6- */
                   );
        END LOOP;

        FOR x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.FUND_CD                                          /* _1- */
                 , t1.TRUSTEE                                          /* _2- */
                 , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_JUSU,0)
                            - NVL(t1.TR_DW_JUSU,0)
                            + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU,0)),0)  AS stock_jusu  /* _3- */
                 , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_CHUI_AEK,0)
                            - NVL(t1.TR_DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                            + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK,0)),0)   AS stock_chui  /* _4- */
                 , NVL(SUM(t1.TR_PYUNGA_AEK),0)         AS stock_siga  /* _5- */
              FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.YMD     = p_ymd
               AND t1.JM_CD   = xx.jm_cd
             GROUP BY t1.FUND_CD, t1.TRUSTEE
        ) loop
            MERGE INTO USPM_OPT mm  /* US Portfolio Model 펀드/일별 해외주식,파생 잔고 */
               USING DUAL  ON ( mm.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                            AND mm.YMD     = p_ymd
                            AND mm.FUND_CD = x1.fund_cd
                            AND mm.JM_CD   = xx.jm_cd
                            AND mm.PORT    = x1.trustee )
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                 INSERT ( CORP_GR     /* _1- */
                        , YMD         /* _2- */
                        , FUND_CD     /* _3- */
                        , JM_CD       /* _4- */
                        , PORT        /* _5- */
                        , JONGA       /* _6- */
                        , STOCK_JUSU  /* _7- */
                        , STOCK_CHUI  /* _8- */
                        , STOCK_SIGA  /* _9- */
                        )
                 VALUES ( p_corp_gr      /* _1- */
                        , p_ymd          /* _2- */
                        , x1.fund_cd     /* _3- */
                        , xx.jm_cd       /* _4- */
                        , x1.trustee     /* _5- */
                        , w_price        /* _6- */
                        , x1.stock_jusu  /* _7- */
                        , x1.stock_chui  /* _8- */
                        , x1.stock_siga  /* _9- */
                        )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                 UPDATE
                    SET STOCK_JUSU = x1.stock_jusu
                      , STOCK_CHUI = x1.stock_chui
