                      , STOCK_SIGA = x1.stock_siga;
        END LOOP;

        FOR x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.FUND_CD                                               /* _1- */
                 , t1.TRUSTEE                                               /* _2- */
                 , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_JUSU,0)
                            - NVL(t1.TR_DW_JUSU,0)
                            + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU,0)),0)  AS opt_qty          /* _3- */
                 , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_CHUI_AEK,0)
                            - NVL(t1.TR_DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                            + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK,0)),0)   AS opt_premium      /* _4- */
                 , NVL(SUM(t1.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT),0)       AS opt_nominal_amt  /* _5- */
                 , NVL(SUM(t1.TR_PYUNGA_AEK),0)         AS opt_siga         /* _6- */
              FROM SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
                 , SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             WHERE ya.CHANGE_JM_CD = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.CORP_GR      = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.CORP_GR      = ya.CORP_GR
               AND t1.YMD          = p_ymd
               AND t1.JM_CD        = ya.JM_CD
             GROUP BY t1.FUND_CD, t1.TRUSTEE
        ) loop
            MERGE INTO USPM_OPT m1  /* US Portfolio Model 펀드/일별 해외주식,파생 잔고 */
               USING DUAL  ON ( m1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                            AND m1.YMD     = p_ymd
                            AND m1.FUND_CD = x1.fund_cd
                            AND m1.JM_CD   = xx.jm_cd
                            AND m1.PORT    = x1.trustee )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                 UPDATE
                    SET JONGA           = w_price
                      , OPT_QTY         = x1.opt_qty
                      , OPT_SIGA        = x1.opt_siga
                      , OPT_PREMIUM     = x1.opt_premium
                      , OPT_NOMINAL_AMT = x1.opt_nominal_amt
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                 INSERT ( CORP_GR          /* _1- */
                        , YMD              /* _2- */
                        , FUND_CD          /* _3- */
                        , JM_CD            /* _4- */
                        , PORT             /* _5- */
                        , JONGA            /* _6- */
                        , OPT_QTY          /* _7- */
                        , OPT_SIGA         /* _8- */
                        , OPT_PREMIUM      /* _9- */
                        , OPT_NOMINAL_AMT  /* _10- */
                        )
                 VALUES ( p_corp_gr           /* _1- */
                        , p_ymd               /* _2- */
                        , x1.fund_cd          /* _3- */
                        , xx.jm_cd            /* _4- */
                        , x1.trustee          /* _5- */
                        , w_price             /* _6- */
                        , x1.opt_qty          /* _7- */
                        , x1.opt_siga         /* _8- */
                        , x1.opt_premium      /* _9- */
                        , x1.opt_nominal_amt  /* _10- */
                        );
        END LOOP;
    END LOOP;

    UPDATE SZT0IA_V t1   /* 펀드별 모델산정 기준정보 */
       SET RISK_VALUE = (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(ta.DELTA_RISK_VALUE,0) + NVL(ta.GAMMA_RISK_VALUE,0) + NVL(ta.VEGA_RISK_VALUE,0)),0)
                           FROM SYM0YZ ta  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                          WHERE ta.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                            AND ta.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD
                            AND ta.YMD     = p_ymd)
     WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
       AND TR_YMD  = p_ymd;

    FOR xx IN (
        WITH port AS (
                 SELECT FUND_CD                                                            /* _1- */
                      , PORT_NUM                                                           /* _2- */
                      , FYMD                                                               /* _3- */
                      , TYMD                                                               /* _4- */
                      , USD_TUJA                                                           /* _5- */
                      , USD_TUJA / SUM ( USD_TUJA) OVER (PARTITION BY FUND_CD)  AS port_rt /* _6- */
                   FROM USPM_PORT t1  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
                  WHERE CORP_GR         = p_corp_gr
                    AND TYMD            = p_ymd
                    AND NVL(USD_TUJA,0) > 0
                 )
            -- Main SQL --
            --------------
            SELECT t1.FUND_CD                             /* _1- */
                 , t2.PORT_NUM                            /* _2- */
                 , t2.FYMD                                /* _3- */
                 , t2.TYMD                                /* _4- */
                 , t3.USD_TUJA / t2.USD_TUJA  AS tuja_rt  /* _5- */
                 , t2.port_rt                             /* _6- */
                 , t3.JM_CD                               /* _7- */
              FROM SZT0IA_V t1  /* 펀드별 모델산정 기준정보 */
                 , PORT     t2
                 , USPM     t3  /* US Portfolio Model 일변 기준정보 */
             WHERE t1.CORP_GR                = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.TR_YMD                 = p_ymd
               AND t2.FUND_CD                = t1.FUND_CD
               AND t2.TYMD                   = t1.TR_YMD
               AND t3.CORP_GR                = t1.CORP_GR
               AND t3.FUND_CD                = t1.FUND_CD
               AND t3.YMD                    = t1.TR_YMD
               AND NVL(t3.OVRS_EXCG_CD,'US') <> 'KRX'
               AND NVL(t3.USD_TUJA,0)        > 0
               AND t3.PORT_NUM               = t2.PORT_NUM
    ) loop
        if  w_fund_cd <> xx.fund_cd then
            if  w_fund_cd <> '!@#$' then
                UPDATE USPM_PORT t1   /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
                   SET t1.YEAR_BETA = p_year_beta
                     , t1.MON_BETA  = p_mon_beta
                 WHERE CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
                   AND FUND_CD  = w_fund_cd
                   AND TYMD     = p_ymd
                   AND PORT_NUM = p_port_num;

                w_year_beta := w_year_beta + (p_year_beta * p_port_rt);
                w_mon_beta  := w_mon_beta + (p_mon_beta * p_port_rt);

                UPDATE SZT0IA_V t1   /* 펀드별 모델산정 기준정보 */
                   SET t1.YEAR_BETA                         = w_year_beta
                     , t1.MON_BETA                          = w_mon_beta
                     , (t1.FX_SU, t1.FX_AMT)                
                          = (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.PASS_GYEY_SU,0) + NVL(t1.UP_GYEY_SU,0) - NVL(t1.DW_GYEY_SU,0)),0)
                                  , NVL(SUM(t1.SIGA_AEK),0)
                               FROM SSM0KM t1  /* 파생 보유현황 */
                                  , SSX0KJ kj  /* 파생종목 */
                              WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                                AND t1.YMD     = t1.TR_YMD
                                AND kj.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR
                                AND kj.SJ_CD   = t1.SJ_CD
                                AND kj.JASAN   BETWEEN '75' AND '84')
                     , (t1.OPT_PREMIUM, t1.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT) 
                          = (SELECT SUM(OPT_PREMIUM)
                                  , SUM(OPT_NOMINAL_AMT)
                               FROM USPM_OPT ta  /* US Portfolio Model 펀드/일별 해외주식,파생 잔고 */
                              WHERE ta.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                                AND ta.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD
                                AND ta.YMD     = p_ymd)
                 WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                   AND FUND_CD = w_fund_cd
                   AND TR_YMD  = p_ymd;
            end if;
            w_fund_cd   := xx.fund_cd;
            w_year_beta := 0;
            w_mon_beta  := 0;

            p_port_num  := xx.port_num;
            p_port_rt   := xx.port_rt;
            p_year_beta := 0;
            p_mon_beta  := 0;
        end if;
        if  p_port_num <> xx.port_num   then
            UPDATE USPM_PORT t1   /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
               SET t1.YEAR_BETA = p_year_beta
                 , t1.MON_BETA  = p_mon_beta
             WHERE CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
               AND FUND_CD  = w_fund_cd
               AND TYMD     = p_ymd
               AND PORT_NUM = p_port_num;

            w_year_beta := w_year_beta + (p_year_beta * p_port_rt);
            w_mon_beta  := w_mon_beta + (p_mon_beta * p_port_rt);

            p_port_num  := xx.port_num;
            p_port_rt   := xx.port_rt;
            p_year_beta := 0;
            p_mon_beta  := 0;
        end if;
        SELECT (t1.BETA * xx.tuja_rt) + p_year_beta
             , (t1.BETA20 * xx.tuja_rt) + p_mon_beta
          INTO p_year_beta
             , p_mon_beta
          FROM TABLE(F_BETA (p_corp_gr, 'S&P500', xx.jm_cd, xx.fymd, xx.tymd)) t1;
    END LOOP;
    UPDATE USPM_PORT t1   /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
       SET t1.YEAR_BETA = p_year_beta
         , t1.MON_BETA  = p_mon_beta
     WHERE CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
       AND FUND_CD  = w_fund_cd
       AND TYMD     = p_ymd
       AND PORT_NUM = p_port_num;

    w_year_beta := w_year_beta + (p_year_beta * p_port_rt);
    w_mon_beta  := w_mon_beta + (p_mon_beta * p_port_rt);

    UPDATE SZT0IA_V t1   /* 펀드별 모델산정 기준정보 */
       SET t1.YEAR_BETA                         = w_year_beta
         , t1.MON_BETA                          = w_mon_beta
         , (t1.FX_SU, t1.FX_AMT)                
              = (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.PASS_GYEY_SU,0) + NVL(t1.UP_GYEY_SU,0) - NVL(t1.DW_GYEY_SU,0)),0)
                      , NVL(SUM(t1.SIGA_AEK),0)
                   FROM SSM0KM t1  /* 파생 보유현황 */
                      , SSX0KJ kj  /* 파생종목 */
                  WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                    AND t1.YMD     = t1.TR_YMD
                    AND kj.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR
                    AND kj.SJ_CD   = t1.SJ_CD
                    AND kj.JASAN   BETWEEN '75' AND '84')
         , (t1.OPT_PREMIUM, t1.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT) 
              = (SELECT SUM(OPT_PREMIUM)
                      , SUM(OPT_NOMINAL_AMT)
                   FROM USPM_OPT ta  /* US Portfolio Model 펀드/일별 해외주식,파생 잔고 */
                  WHERE ta.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                    AND ta.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD
                    AND ta.YMD     = p_ymd)
     WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
       AND FUND_CD = w_fund_cd
       AND TR_YMD  = p_ymd;

    -- 국내시장 변동성은 계산만
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.JM_CD
          FROM USPM_DD t1  /* US Portfolio Model 종목 일별 기준변동성 현황 */
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR      = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.YMD          = p_ymd
           AND t1.OVRS_EXCG_CD = 'KRX'
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(t1.CLOSE,0)
              INTO w_price
              FROM SJT1TG t1  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
             WHERE t1.YMD       = F_TRADE_YMD(p_ymd,'-')
               AND t1.KOSCOM_CD = xx.jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_price := 0;
        END;

        FOR uspm IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT FUND_CD
                 , '(' || t1.PORT_NUM || ')'  AS trustee
              FROM USPM t1  /* US Portfolio Model 일변 기준정보 */
             WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.YMD     = p_ymd
               AND t1.JM_CD   = xx.jm_cd
        ) loop
            INSERT INTO USPM_OPT /* US Portfolio Model 펀드/일별 해외주식,파생 잔고 */
                 ( CORP_GR  /* _1- */
                 , YMD      /* _2- */
                 , FUND_CD  /* _3- */
                 , JM_CD    /* _4- */
                 , PORT     /* _5- */
                 , JONGA    /* _6- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd         /* _2- */
                   , uspm.fund_cd  /* _3- */
                   , xx.jm_cd      /* _4- */
                   , uspm.trustee  /* _5- */
                   , w_price       /* _6- */
                   );
        END LOOP;

        FOR x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.FUND_CD                                           /* _1- */
                 , 'KRX'                                 AS trustee     /* _2- */
                 , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.BFIL_BOYU_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.UP_JUSU,0)
                            - NVL(t1.DW_JUSU,0)),0)      AS stock_jusu  /* _3- */
                 , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.UP_CHUI_AEK,0)
                            - NVL(t1.DW_CHUI_AEK,0)),0)  AS stock_chui  /* _4- */
                 , NVL(SUM(t1.SONIK),0)                  AS stock_siga  /* _5- */
              FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.YMD     = p_ymd
               AND t1.JM_CD   = xx.jm_cd
             GROUP BY t1.FUND_CD
        ) loop
            MERGE INTO USPM_OPT mm  /* US Portfolio Model 펀드/일별 해외주식,파생 잔고 */
               USING DUAL  ON ( mm.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                            AND mm.YMD     = p_ymd
                            AND mm.FUND_CD = x1.fund_cd
                            AND mm.JM_CD   = xx.jm_cd
                            AND mm.PORT    = x1.trustee )
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                 INSERT ( CORP_GR     /* _1- */
                        , YMD         /* _2- */
                        , FUND_CD     /* _3- */
                        , JM_CD       /* _4- */
                        , PORT        /* _5- */
                        , JONGA       /* _6- */
                        , STOCK_JUSU  /* _7- */
                        , STOCK_CHUI  /* _8- */
                        , STOCK_SIGA  /* _9- */
                        )
                 VALUES ( p_corp_gr      /* _1- */
                        , p_ymd          /* _2- */
                        , x1.fund_cd     /* _3- */
                        , xx.jm_cd       /* _4- */
                        , x1.trustee     /* _5- */
                        , w_price        /* _6- */
                        , x1.stock_jusu  /* _7- */
                        , x1.stock_chui  /* _8- */
                        , x1.stock_siga  /* _9- */
                        )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                 UPDATE
                    SET STOCK_JUSU = x1.stock_jusu
                      , STOCK_CHUI = x1.stock_chui
                      , STOCK_SIGA = x1.stock_siga;
        END LOOP;
    END LOOP;

    -- 종목별 손익관리
    DELETE FROM USPM_SONIK /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 손익 */
     WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
       AND YMD     = p_ymd;

    -----------------------
    -- 당일 매매손익처리 --
    -----------------------
    -- 이월처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.FUND_CD                                                        /* _1- */
             , t1.JM_CD                                                          /* _2- */
             , t1.PORT                                                           /* _3- */
             , NVL(t1.JM_BF_SONIK,0) + NVL(t1.JM_UP_SONIK,0)     AS sonik        /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.PUT_BF_PREMIUM,0) + NVL(t1.SA3_PREMIUM,0)  AS put_premium  /* _5- */
          FROM USPM_SONIK t1  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 손익 */
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.YMD     = F_OPEN_US(p_ymd,'-1','US')
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO USPM_SONIK /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 손익 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
               , p_ymd           /* _2- */
               , xx.fund_cd      /* _3- */
               , xx.jm_cd        /* _4- */
               , xx.port         /* _5- */
               , xx.sonik        /* _6- */
               , 0               /* _7- */
               , 0               /* _8- */
               , xx.put_premium  /* _9- */
               , 0               /* _10- */
               , 0               /* _11- */
               , 0               /* _12- */
               , 0               /* _13- */
               );
    END LOOP;

    -- 이월 후 PORT번호 변경
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.TYMD
             , t1.FUND_CD
             , t1.PORT_NUM
             , 'AA'  AS target_num
          FROM USPM_PORT t1  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR          = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.TYMD             = F_OPEN_US(p_ymd,'-1')
           AND t1.MANGI            < p_ymd
           AND LENGTH(t1.PORT_NUM) = 1
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT t1.PORT_NUM
              INTO xx.target_num
              FROM USPM_PORT t1  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
             WHERE t1.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.FUND_CD  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.MANGI    = (SELECT MIN (MANGI)
                                    FROM USPM_PORT ta  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 정보 */
                                   WHERE ta.CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
                                     AND ta.FUND_CD  = xx.fund_cd
                                     AND ta.TYMD     = p_ymd
                                     AND ta.PORT_NUM = xx.port_num)
               AND t1.TYMD     = xx.tymd
               AND t1.PORT_NUM LIKE xx.port_num || '%';
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            CONTINUE;
        END;

        FOR x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.JM_CD
                 , t1.JM_BF_SONIK
                 , t1.PUT_BF_PREMIUM
              FROM USPM_SONIK t1  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 손익 */
             WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.FUND_CD = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.YMD     = p_ymd
               AND t1.PORT    = '(' || xx.target_num || ')'
        ) loop
            BEGIN
                UPDATE USPM_SONIK /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 손익 */
                   SET PORT = '(' || xx.port_num || ')'
                 WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                   AND YMD     = p_ymd
                   AND FUND_CD = xx.fund_cd
                   AND JM_CD   = x1.jm_cd
                   AND PORT    = '(' || xx.target_num || ')';
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                UPDATE USPM_SONIK /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 손익 */
                   SET JM_BF_SONIK    = NVL(JM_BF_SONIK,0) + NVL(x1.jm_bf_sonik, 0)
                     , PUT_BF_PREMIUM = NVL(PUT_BF_PREMIUM,0) + NVL(x1.put_bf_premium, 0)
                 WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                   AND YMD     = p_ymd
                   AND FUND_CD = xx.fund_cd
                   AND JM_CD   = x1.jm_cd
                   AND PORT    = '(' || xx.port_num || ')';

                DELETE FROM USPM_SONIK /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 손익 */
                 WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                   AND YMD     = p_ymd
                   AND FUND_CD = xx.fund_cd
                   AND JM_CD   = x1.jm_cd
                   AND PORT    = '(' || xx.target_num || ')';
            END;
        END LOOP;
    END LOOP;

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.FUND_CD                   /* _1- */
             , t1.JM_CD                     /* _2- */
             , t1.TRUSTEE  AS port          /* _3- */
             , CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_GB='A' AND t1.TR_CD='SA0'
                    THEN t1.GYULJE_AEK  /* 풋 매도 프리미엄 */
                    ELSE 0
               END         AS up_premium    /* _4- */
             , CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_GB='A' AND t1.TR_CD IN ('SA1','SA2')
                    THEN t1.GYULJE_AEK  /* 풋 환매수 프리미엄 */
                    ELSE 0
               END         AS dw_premium    /* _5- */
             , CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_GB='A' AND t1.TR_CD='SA3'
                    THEN t1.GYULJE_AEK  /* 풋 권리행사 프리미엄 이익액 */
                    ELSE 0
               END         AS sa3_premium   /* _6- */
             , CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_GB='1' AND t1.CHUI_AEK > 0
                    THEN t1.GYULJE_AEK - t1.CHUI_AEK  /* 주식 매매손익 */
                    ELSE 0
               END         AS mm_sonik      /* _7- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1  /* 해외 매매거래내역 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.TR_YMD  = p_ymd
           AND t1.TRUSTEE LIKE '(%)'
           AND ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR
           AND ya.JM_CD   = t1.JM_CD
    ) loop
        MERGE INTO USPM_SONIK m1  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 손익 */
           USING DUAL  ON ( m1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                        AND m1.YMD     = p_ymd
                        AND m1.FUND_CD = xx.fund_cd
                        AND m1.JM_CD   = xx.jm_cd
                        AND m1.PORT    = xx.port )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET JM_UP_SONIK    = NVL(JM_UP_SONIK,0) + xx.mm_sonik
                  , PUT_UP_PREMIUM = NVL(PUT_UP_PREMIUM,0) + xx.up_premium
                  , PUT_DW_PREMIUM = NVL(PUT_DW_PREMIUM,0) + xx.dw_premium + xx.sa3_premium
                  , SA3_PREMIUM    = NVL(SA3_PREMIUM,0) + xx.sa3_premium
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                       /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd                           /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                      /* _3- */
                    , xx.jm_cd                        /* _4- */
                    , xx.port                         /* _5- */
                    , 0                               /* _6- */
                    , xx.mm_sonik                     /* _7- */
                    , 0                               /* _8- */
                    , 0                               /* _9- */
                    , xx.sa3_premium                  /* _10- */
                    , 0                               /* _11- */
                    , xx.up_premium                   /* _12- */
                    , xx.dw_premium + xx.sa3_premium  /* _13- */
                    );
    END LOOP;

    -- 평가손익처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.FUND_CD                                                     /* _1- */
             , t1.JM_CD                                                       /* _2- */
             , ya.JASAN_GB                                                    /* _3- */
             , t1.TRUSTEE                                        AS port      /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                          - NVL(t1.TR_DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                          + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK,0)  AS chui_aek  /* _5- */
             , t1.TR_PYUNGA_AEK                                               /* _6- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.YMD     = p_ymd
           AND t1.TRUSTEE LIKE '(%)'
           AND ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR
           AND ya.JM_CD   = t1.JM_CD
    ) loop
        MERGE INTO USPM_SONIK m1  /* US Portfolio Model PORT별 손익 */
           USING DUAL  ON ( m1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                        AND m1.YMD     = p_ymd
                        AND m1.FUND_CD = xx.fund_cd
                        AND m1.JM_CD   = xx.jm_cd
                        AND m1.PORT    = xx.port )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET JM_PG_SONIK    = CASE WHEN xx.jasan_gb='1' THEN NVL(JM_PG_SONIK,0) + (xx.tr_pyunga_aek - xx.chui_aek)
                                                               ELSE JM_PG_SONIK END
                  , PUT_PG_PREMIUM = CASE WHEN xx.jasan_gb='A' THEN NVL(PUT_PG_PREMIUM,0) + xx.chui_aek
                                                               ELSE PUT_PG_PREMIUM END
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd            /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd       /* _3- */
                    , xx.jm_cd         /* _4- */
                    , xx.port          /* _5- */
                    , 0                /* _6- */
                    , 0                /* _7- */
                    , CASE WHEN xx.jasan_gb='1'
                           THEN xx.tr_pyunga_aek - xx.chui_aek
                           ELSE 0 END  /* _8- */
                    , 0                /* _9- */
                    , 0                /* _10- */
                    , CASE WHEN xx.jasan_gb='A'
                           THEN xx.chui_aek
                           ELSE 0 END  /* _11- */
                    , 0                /* _12- */
                    , 0                /* _13- */
                    );
    END LOOP;

    commit;
    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0690 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 평가단계 점검사항 체크
--
    w_fymd                       DATE; -- 전영업일 + 1PROC0690
    w_tymd                       DATE;
    w_jy_ymd                     DATE; -- 전영업일

    w_seq                        NUMBER;
    w_cnt                        NUMBER;
    w_skt0bu_aek                 NUMBER;
    w_currency_cnt               NUMBER;
    w_cha                        NUMBER;

    w_unit_gb                    VARCHAR(1);
    w_check_yn                   VARCHAR(1);

    hj                           shm0hj%rowtype;
    cj                           scm0cj%rowtype;
    ig                           scj0ig%rowtype;
    bh                           ucs0bh%rowtype;

    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0690 : ', '510. 평가처리점검 :: 특이주식종가 점검 확인! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0690 : ', '520. 평가처리점검 :: 당일환율등록 점검 확인! ');
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0690 : ', '530. 평가처리점검 :: 선물옵션최종결제점검 확인! '); 
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0690 : ', '540. 평가처리점검 :: 명세평가처리점검 확인! '); 


BEGIN
    p_msg   := 'Y';

    ------------------------------------
    -- 회계처리 완료 후 점검자료 생성 --
    ------------------------------------
    w_fymd      := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd - 1, '-') + 1;  --전영업익일
    w_tymd      := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '+1') - 1;

    w_jy_ymd    := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd - 1, '-');      --전영업일


    -- 주식평가점검
    -- 당일상환시 마스터 삭제로 전일자료 생성 20210318 yjs
    DELETE FROM SZT0CK t1  
     WHERE t1.corp_gr            = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd                = p_ymd
       AND t1.CHECK_PGMID        = 'PROC0690'
       AND NVL(t1.check_yn,'N')  = 'N';

    SELECT NVL(MAX(seq), 0)
      INTO w_seq
      FROM SZT0CK t1
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 특이주식종가점검
    --------------------------------------------------------
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0690 : ', '510. 평가처리점검 :: 특이주식종가 점검 확인! ');

    w_cnt       := 0;
    w_check_yn  := 'F';
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                                                /* _1- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                  /* _2- */
             , NVL(t1.BFIL_BOYU_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.UP_JUSU,0) - NVL(t1.DW_JUSU,0)
                                        + NVL(GONGS_UP_JUSU,0) - NVL(GONGS_DW_JUSU,0)   AS jusu          /* _3- */
             , (NVL(t1.BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                        + NVL(GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(GONGS_DW_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.SONIK,0))
                                        / (NVL(t1.BFIL_BOYU_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.UP_JUSU,0) - NVL(t1.DW_JUSU,0)
                                        + NVL(GONGS_UP_JUSU,0) - NVL(GONGS_DW_JUSU,0))  AS sjm0jm_danga  /* _4- */
             , NVL(t2.close,0)                                                          AS dangil_jonhga /* _5- */
             , NVL(t3.close,0)                                                          AS junil_jongga  /* _6- */
             , NVL(t2.close,0) - NVL(t3.close,0)                                        AS diff_jongga   /* _7- */
          FROM SJM0JM t1
             , SJT1TG t2
             , SJT1TG t3
         WHERE t1.corp_gr            = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                = p_ymd     /* 당일 */
           AND SUBSTR(t1.jm_cd,1,3)  IN ('KRG','KRA')
           AND (NVL(t1.BFIL_BOYU_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.UP_JUSU,0) - NVL(t1.DW_JUSU,0) + NVL(GONGS_UP_JUSU,0) - NVL(GONGS_DW_JUSU,0))  > 0
           AND (((NVL(t2.close,0) = NVL(t3.close,0)) OR (NVL(t2.close,0) = 0))
                 OR ((NVL(t1.BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.DW_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(GONGS_DW_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.SONIK,0)) / 
                     (NVL(t1.BFIL_BOYU_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.UP_JUSU,0) - NVL(t1.DW_JUSU,0) + NVL(GONGS_UP_JUSU,0) - NVL(GONGS_DW_JUSU,0)) != NVL(t2.close,0)))
           AND t2.ymd                = t1.ymd
           AND t2.koscom_cd          = t1.koscom_cd
           AND t3.ymd                = w_jy_ymd  /* 전영업일 */
           AND t3.koscom_cd          = t1.koscom_cd
    ) loop

        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(check_yn,'N')
              INTO w_check_yn
              FROM SZT0CK t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
               AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd       = '%'
               AND t1.check_item  = '특이주식종가점검'
               AND t1.check_pgmid = 'PROC0690';
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            w_check_yn  := 'F';
        END;

        if  w_check_yn != 'Y'   then    -- 미점검
            if  w_check_yn = 'F'    then    -- 미생성
                w_seq   := w_seq + 1;

                INSERT INTO SZT0CK
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                     /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd                         /* _2- */
                       , xx.fund_cd                    /* _3- */
                       , xx.jm_cd                      /* _4- */
                       , '%'                           /* _5- */
                       , w_seq                         /* _6- */
                       , 'N'                           /* _7- */
                       , 'Z1'                          /* _8- */
                       , '특이주식종가점검'            /* _9- */
                       , '미등록'                      /* _10- */
                       , NULL                          /* _11- */
                       , xx.diff_jongga                /* _12- */
                       , NULL                          /* _13- */
                       , NULL                          /* _14- */
                       , xx.dangil_jonhga              /* _15- */
                       , xx.junil_jongga               /* _16- */
                       , sysdate                       /* _17- */
                       , 'PROC0690'                    /* _18- */
                       , F_JM_NM(p_corp_gr, xx.jm_cd)  /* _19- */
                       , 13762560                      /* _20- */
                       , 'PROC0690'                    /* _21- */
                       );
            end if;

        w_cnt   := w_cnt + 1;
--        INSERT INTO WFRMERR
--        VALUES ( p_corp_gr
--               , 'PROC0690 ' || p_ymd || '/' || w_check_yn || '전영업일: ' || w_jy_ymd || '(' || p_corp_gr || '/' || xx.fund_cd || '/' || xx.jm_cd || '/' || F_JM_NM(p_corp_gr, xx.jm_cd) || ') '
--                             || ' 당일종가: ' || xx.dangil_jonhga
--                             || ' 전영업일종가: ' || xx.junil_jongga
--                             || ' 적용가격: ' || xx.sjm0jm_danga
--                             || ' 특이주식(신주인수권/워런트등)종가 차이/미입력 확인!'
--               );
        end if;

        commit;
    END LOOP;
--    if  w_cnt > 0   then
--        p_msg   := F_NTRIM (w_cnt) || '건 510. 평가처리시 특이주식종가 점검 확인!';
--        RETURN;
--    end if;

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 당일환율등록점검
    -- 전일종가와 모두 동일한 경우 당일 환율 로드 안하였으므로 체크 바람
    --------------------------------------------------------
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0690 : ', '520. 평가처리점검 :: 당일환율등록 점검 확인! ');

    w_cnt       := 0;
    w_check_yn  := 'F';

    if (TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24:MI:SS') > '17:00:00') AND w_check_yn != 'Y'   then
        FOR xx IN (
            SELECT currency                           AS currency
                 , SUM(t_gijun_rt)                    AS d_rt
                 , SUM(j_gijun_rt)                    AS j_rt
                 , SUM(t_gijun_rt) - SUM(j_gijun_rt)  AS diff_rt
              FROM (SELECT currency
                         , gijun_rt  AS t_gijun_rt
                         , 0         AS j_gijun_rt
                      FROM SYX0HY h1
                     WHERE gijun_ymd = p_ymd
                       AND currency  IN (SELECT DISTINCT CURRENCY
                                           FROM SYM0YZ g1
                                          WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                            AND ymd     = p_ymd)
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT currency
                         , 0
                         , gijun_rt
                      FROM SYX0HY h1
                     WHERE gijun_ymd = w_jy_ymd  /* 전영업일 */
                       AND currency  IN (SELECT DISTINCT CURRENCY
                                           FROM SYM0YZ g1
                                          WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                            AND ymd     = p_ymd)
                    ) t1 
             HAVING ((SUM(t_gijun_rt) - SUM(j_gijun_rt)) = 0 OR SUM(t_gijun_rt) <= 0)
             GROUP BY currency
        ) loop
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL(check_yn,'N')
                  INTO w_check_yn
                  FROM SZT0CK t1
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr     IN (SELECT corp_gr
                                            FROM SZX0AA h1
                                           WHERE COMPANY_NAME NOT LIKE '%*%')  /* 전체운용사에서 1군데라도 있으면 'N' */
                   AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
                   AND t1.fund_cd     = '%'
                   AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.currency
                   AND t1.tr_cd       = '%'
                   AND t1.check_item  = '당일환율등록점검'
                   AND t1.check_pgmid = 'PROC0690'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                w_check_yn  := 'F';
            END;

            if  w_check_yn != 'Y'   then    -- 미점검
                if  w_check_yn = 'F'    then    -- 미생성
                    w_seq   := w_seq + 1;

                    INSERT INTO SZT0CK
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr           /* _1- */
                           , p_ymd               /* _2- */
                           , '%'                 /* _3- */
                           , xx.currency         /* _4- */
                           , '%'                 /* _5- */
                           , w_seq               /* _6- */
                           , 'N'                 /* _7- */
                           , 'Z1'                /* _8- */
                           , '당일환율등록점검'  /* _9- */
                           , '미등록'            /* _10- */
                           , NULL                /* _11- */
                           , xx.diff_rt          /* _12- */
                           , NULL                /* _13- */
                           , NULL                /* _14- */
                           , xx.d_rt             /* _15- */
                           , xx.j_rt             /* _16- */
                           , sysdate             /* _17- */
                           , 'PROC0690'          /* _18- */
                           , '당일환율변동없음'  /* _19- */
                           , 13762560            /* _20- */
                           , 'PROC0690'          /* _21- */
                           );
                end if;

            w_cnt   := w_cnt + 1;
--            INSERT INTO WFRMERR
--            VALUES ( p_corp_gr
--                   , 'PROC0690 ' || p_ymd || '/' || w_check_yn || '전영업일: ' || w_jy_ymd || '회사 : ' || p_corp_gr || ' 환율 : ' || xx.currency
--                                 || ' 당일환율: ' || xx.d_rt
--                                 || ' 전영업일환율: ' || xx.j_rt
--                                 || ' 환율차이: ' || xx.diff_rt
--                                 || ' 당일환율 미입력 확인!'
--                   );
            end if;
            commit;
        END LOOP;
    end if;
--    if  w_cnt > 0   then
--        p_msg   := F_NTRIM (w_cnt) || '건 520. 평가처리시 당일환율 미입력 확인!';
--        RETURN;
--    end if;

    ---------------------------------------------
    -- 해외종가 로드 점검 20220316
    ---------------------------------------------
    --
    --SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'jmck', p_ymd || ' PROC0690 : ', '540. 해외종가로드처리점검 :: 해외종가로드처리점검 확인! ');   

--    w_cnt   := 0;
--    FOR xx IN (
--        SELECT t1.jm_cd                                                                         /* _1- */
--             , F_JM_NM(t1.corp_gr,t1.jm_cd)                                       AS jm_nm      /* _2- */
--             , NVL(t1.jonga,0)                                                    AS d_jonga    /* _3- */
--             , NVL(t2.jonga,0)                                                    AS j_jonga    /* _4- */
--             , CASE t3.SIGA_AGENT WHEN '1' THEN '평가사'
--                                  WHEN '2' THEN '발행사'
--                                  WHEN '3' THEN '증권사'
--                                  WHEN 'B' THEN '장부가'
--                                  WHEN 'S' THEN '시장종가' ELSE '기타미지정' END  AS siga_gb    /* _5- */
--             , CASE WHEN (t3.SIGA_AGENT = 'B' AND NVL(SUM(NVL(t4.tr_bfil_jusu,0)), 0) = 0 AND NVL(SUM(NVL(t4.tr_up_jusu,0)), 0) > 0)
--                    THEN '당일신규매입종목 장부가 인지 확인'
--                    WHEN (t3.SIGA_AGENT = 'B' AND (NVL(t1.jonga,0) != 0 OR  NVL(t2.jonga,0) != 0))
--                    THEN '장부가 평가종목에 종가 있음 확인'
--                    WHEN (t3.SIGA_AGENT != 'B' AND (NVL(t1.jonga,0) = 0 OR  NVL(t1.jonga,0) - NVL(t2.jonga,0) = 0))
--                    THEN '평가종목에 당일종가=0 또는 전일대비변동=0 확인'
--                    ELSE '정상(미처리)'
--               END                                                                AS err_gb     /* _6- */
--             , t3.SIGA_AGENT                                                                    /* _7- */

--          FROM SYT0LP t1

--           AND (t1.corp_gr,t1.jm_cd)  NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT corp_gr

--                 (t3.SIGA_AGENT = 'B'  AND (NVL(t1.jonga,0) != 0 OR  NVL(t2.jonga,0) != 0)) OR  /* 장부가 평가종목에 종가 있음 확인 */
--                 (t3.SIGA_AGENT != 'B' AND (NVL(t1.jonga,0) = 0 OR  NVL(t1.jonga,0) - NVL(t2.jonga,0) = 0))  /* 평가종목에 당일종가=0 또는 전일대비변동=0 확인 */)
--           AND t2.corp_gr             = t1.corp_gr

--         GROUP BY t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd, NVL(t1.jonga,0), NVL(t2.jonga,0), t3.SIGA_AGENT, t1.LOAD_TIME

--

--        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN

--                                 || ' 전일수량:' || xx.bfil_jusu
--                                 || ' 당일증가:' || xx.up_jusu
--                                 || ' 당일종가:' || xx.d_jonga
--                                 || ' 전일종가:' || xx.j_jonga || '/' || xx.err_gb
--                                 || ' 해외종가로드처리(#1018)를 확인하세요!'

    p_msg   := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0700 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_user_id                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 기준가처리
--
    w_last                         DATE;
    w_dt                           DATE;

    W_GYUL_GB                      VARCHAR (1); /* 결산처리flag */

    w_20301                        NUMBER;
    w_40201                        NUMBER;  /* 전기이월이익잉여금 과표 */
    w_40211                        NUMBER;  /* 전기이월이익잉여금 비과표 */
    w_90101                        NUMBER;

    w_dang_gwa                     NUMBER;  /* 당기이익분배금 과표 */
    w_dang_bgwa                    NUMBER;  /* 당기이익분배금 비과표(결산시 비거주자 동일처리) */

    w_aek                          number_varray_50;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'G---', TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd'), '기준가 계산 시작');

    -- 펀드별 예금액 수정분개 재처리
    DELETE FROM SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND proc_step = 70;

    -------------------------
    --  기준가 처리        --
    -------------------------
    W_GYUL_GB := 'A';  /* 비결산 기준가처리 */

    -- 기준가 Table 삭제
    DELETE FROM SKT0GI t1   /* 펀드별 기준가 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
       AND t1.work_gb = W_GYUL_GB;

    -- 분개장 Table 삭제
    DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1   /* 분개장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND t1.work_gb   = W_GYUL_GB
       AND t1.proc_step = 70;

    -- 총계정원장 보고서 난외계정 Clear...
    DELETE FROM SKM0AG t1   /* 총계정원장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
       AND t1.work_gb = W_GYUL_GB
       AND t1.gwamok  != '90120'
       AND t1.gwamok  BETWEEN '90000' AND '99999';

    -- 총계정원장 Table의 당일증감취득액 clear
    -- 손익차등분배관련 난외계정 제외 20201125 yjs
    UPDATE SKM0AG t1    /* 총계정원장 */
       SET t1.dr_aek = 0
         , t1.cr_aek = 0
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
       AND t1.work_gb = W_GYUL_GB
       AND t1.gwamok  NOT LIKE 'B03%'
       AND t1.gwamok  NOT IN ('A0459','B0103','B0401','D0212')
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 'x'
                     FROM SZX0GM ta  /* 계정과목 */
                    WHERE ta.gwamok_gb = '9'
                      AND ta.gwamok    = t1.gwamok);

    SR_PROC0701 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 70, w_msg);  /* 예금이자 계산 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR (':SR_PROC0701-' || w_msg,1,180);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_PROC0702 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 70);         /* 평가손익사전처리 */
    SR_PROC0703 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 70, w_msg);  /* 해외평가손익사전처리 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR (':SR_PROC0703-' || w_msg,1,180);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_PROC0710 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 70, w_msg);  /* 기준가격산출 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR (':SR_PROC0710-' || w_msg,1,180);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_PROC0711 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd);  /* 기준가관련보고난외계정 갱신 */

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'G040', TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd'), '결산처리');
    --------------------
    ----  결산처리  ----  해당프로그램에서 각 펀드의 결산일을 비교하여 처리
    --------------------
    W_GYUL_GB := 'B';

    SR_PROC0750 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 70, W_GYUL_GB);         /* 결산재처리 */
    SR_PROC0760 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 70, W_GYUL_GB, w_msg);  /* 평가손익반영 */

    -- 이익분배금 계산액
    -- 성과보수 인출 제외
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                   /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_currency             /* _2- */
             , ia.haeji_ymd                 /* _3- */
             , NVL(gi.in_aek,0)  AS in_aek  /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gm.tax_gb != '2'
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.chadae_gb='C'
                                      THEN NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek,0)
                                      ELSE - (NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)) END
                       END),0)   AS gwa     /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gm.tax_gb='2'
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.chadae_gb='C'
                                      THEN NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek,0)
                                      ELSE - (NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)) END
                       END),0)   AS bgwa    /* _6- */
          FROM SZX0GM gm  /* 계정과목 */
             , SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE gm.gwamok_gb                          IN ('4','5')
           AND gm.inp_gb                             = '1'
           AND gm.tax_gb                             IN ('1','2','5')
           AND t1.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                                = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb                            = w_gyul_gb
           AND t1.gwamok                             = gm.gwamok
           AND ia.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fund_currency                      = t1.fund_currency
           AND gi.corp_gr                            = ia.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                            = ia.fund_cd
           AND NVL(gi.haeji_ymd - 1, gi.af_gyul_ymd) = p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, t1.fund_currency
                , ia.haeji_ymd, NVL(gi.in_aek,0)
    ) loop
        SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0) - NVL(cr_aek,0)),0)
          INTO w_90101
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok        = '90101'
           AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;
        if  w_90101 = 0 then
            CONTINUE;   /* 순자산액이 0인 경우 이익분배금 계산 pass (자문용) */
        end if;

        -- 이월이익잉여금
        SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='40201'
                            THEN NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) END),0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='40211'
                            THEN NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) END),0)
          INTO w_40201
             , w_40211
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = w_gyul_gb
           AND t1.gwamok        IN ('40201','40211')
           AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;

        w_dang_gwa  := xx.gwa;
        w_dang_bgwa := xx.bgwa;

        -- 당기분배금처리 (자문처리 확인 필요 20230305)
        w_dang_gwa  := 0;
        w_dang_bgwa := 0;

        ---------------------------------
        -- 이익분배금 분배처리(이익)-> 분개처리
        -- 평잔계산(회사기준) 분개 별도처리
        ---------------------------------
        --  차) 이익분배금(1-4)      대) 이월이익잉여금(5-8)
        --  차) 이월이익잉여금(9-12) 대) 미지급이익분배금(13)
        --      이익잉여금중 외환적립금은 수작업 분개에 의한 처분으로 자동분개에서 제외함.
        ---------------------------------
        BEGIN
            -- 손익계정 마감결산분개처리
            INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
            SELECT p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                 , t1.ymd            /* _2- */
                 , t1.work_gb        /* _3- */
                 , t1.fund_cd        /* _4- */
                 , '1'               /* _5- */
                 , 'Q90'             /* _6- */
                 , NULL              /* _7- */
                 , 1                 /* _8- */
                 , 1                 /* _9- */
                 , ROWNUM            /* _10- */
                 , CASE t1.chadae_gb WHEN 'D' THEN 'C'
                                     WHEN 'C' THEN 'D'
                   END               /* _11- */
                 , t1.gwamok         /* _12- */
                 , CASE t1.chadae_gb WHEN 'D' THEN NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)
                                     WHEN 'C' THEN NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek,0)
                   END               /* _13- */
                 , 'Q90'             /* _14- */
                 , 70                /* _15- */
                 , 'skgp200'         /* _16- */
                 , xx.fund_currency  /* _17- */
              FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
               AND t1.work_gb       = w_gyul_gb
               AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM SZX0GM ta  /* 계정과목 */
                            WHERE ta.gwamok_gb IN ('4','5')
                              AND ta.gwamok    = t1.gwamok
                              AND ta.inp_gb    = '1');
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || ' - 결산분개(손익계정) insert error';
            RETURN;
        END;

        BEGIN
            -- 이익분배금 마감결산분개처리
            INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
            SELECT p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                 , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                 , w_gyul_gb         /* _3- */
                 , xx.fund_cd        /* _4- */
                 , '1'               /* _5- */
                 , 'Q90'             /* _6- */
                 , NULL              /* _7- */
                 , 1                 /* _8- */
                 , 1                 /* _9- */
                 , row_no            /* _10- */
                 , chadae_gb         /* _11- */
                 , gwamok            /* _12- */
                 , CASE row_no WHEN 96 THEN xx.gwa
                               WHEN 97 THEN xx.bgwa
                   END               /* _13- */
                 , jeokyo_cd         /* _14- */
                 , 70                /* _15- */
                 , 'skgp200'         /* _16- */
                 , xx.fund_currency  /* _17- */
              FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
             WHERE tr_cd    = 'Q90'
               AND upmu_gb  = '1'
               AND jasan_gb = '00';
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.fund_cd || ' - 결산분개(마감결산분개처리) insert error';
            RETURN;
        END;

        w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.gwa, xx.bgwa, xx.gwa, xx.bgwa,
                                     w_dang_gwa, w_dang_bgwa, w_dang_gwa + w_dang_bgwa);
        SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Q92', w_gyul_gb, '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, NULL, 1, 1, w_aek, 70, 'proc0700', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 결산기 테이블 이익분배금 관리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , t1.gyul_gi
          FROM SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE ia.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.corp_gr                            = ia.corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd                            = ia.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd - 1, t1.af_gyul_ymd) = p_ymd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(cr_aek,0)
              INTO w_20301
              FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
               AND t1.work_gb       = w_gyul_gb
               AND t1.gwamok        = '20301'
               AND t1.cr_aek        > 0
               AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            SELECT NVL(SUM(cr_aek),0)
              INTO w_20301
              FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
               AND t1.work_gb       = w_gyul_gb
               AND t1.gwamok        = '40200'
               AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;
        END;

        -- 결산구간 관리 테이블 수정  20180725 yjs
        -- 손실액도 관리
        UPDATE SZM0GI tt    /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
           SET gi_sonik_aek = w_20301
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND gyul_gi = xx.gyul_gi;
    end loop;

    --------------------
    -- 결산기준가산출 --
    --------------------
    SR_PROC0761 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 70, w_msg);  /* 결산기준가격산출 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR (':SR_PROC0761-' || w_msg,1,180);
        RETURN;
    end if;
    SR_PROC0762 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd);  /* 결산기준가관련보고난외계정 갱신 */

    SR_PROC0790 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd);  /* 결산실적 Update... */

    SR_PROC0791 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd);  /* 총계정원장 정리 */

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'G049', p_ymd, '결산 마무리 완료');

    ------------
    -- 마무리 --
    ------------
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , t1.work_gb
             , NVL(SUM(t1.dr_aek),0)  AS dr_aek
             , NVL(SUM(t1.cr_aek),0)  AS cr_aek
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             , SZX0GM gm  /* 계정과목 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND gm.gwamok_gb                 != '9'
           AND gm.gwamok                    = t1.gwamok
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND ia.fund_currency             = t1.fund_currency
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.work_gb
        HAVING NVL (SUM(T1.DR_AEK),0) != NVL (SUM(T1.CR_AEK),0)
    ) loop
        p_msg   := TO_CHAR (p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd') || ' ' || xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.work_gb
                                                 || '?' || xx.dr_aek || '/' || xx.cr_aek || ' - 총계정원장의 차대금액이 일치하지 않습니다.(분개장확인)';
        RETURN;
    end loop;

    SR_PROC0799 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd);  /* (결산연결)취득액 관리 */

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'G930', 'szx0dt.gijunga_ymd=' || TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd'), '기준가 계산일자 update');

    UPDATE SZX0AA tt    /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
       SET gijunga_ymd = p_ymd
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr;

    -- 기준가 재계산시 변경관리용
    w_dt := sysdate;

    INSERT INTO GIJUN_GA_COM    /* 기준가 재계산시 순자산 변동내역 관리 */
    WITH gwamok_temp AS (
         SELECT fund_cd
              , NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0) - NVL(cr_aek,0)  AS aek
           FROM SKM0AG ta  /* 총계정원장 */
          WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
            AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd
            AND ta.work_gb = 'A'
            AND ta.gwamok  = 'D0101'
         )
    -- Main SQL --
    --------------
    SELECT p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
         , p_ymd             /* _2- */
         , w_dt              /* _3- */
         , t1.fund_cd        /* _4- */
         , '00'              /* _5- */
         , t1.seolj_jwa      /* _6- */
         , t1.seolj_jwa      /* _7- */
         , t1.sun_jasan_aek  /* _8- */
         , NVL(t2.aek,0)     /* _9- */
         , p_user_id         /* _10- */
         , 'sayu'            /* _11- */
         , NULL              /* _12- */
         , t1.tuja_pj_aek    /* _13- */
         , NULL              /* _14- */
         , t1.fund_currency  /* _15- */
      FROM SKT0GI t1  /* 펀드별 기준가 */
      LEFT OUTER JOIN GWAMOK_TEMP t2
                   ON t2.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
       AND t1.work_gb = 'A';

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'G931', F_NTRIM(SQL%rowcount) || ' 건', '기준가 재계산 관리자료 생성(gijun_ga_com)...');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'G+++', TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy.mm.dd'), '기준가 계산 완료');

    DELETE FROM SZX3CK tt   /* 펀드별 Check 자료 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND proc    = 'PROC0700';

    -- 당일 결산펀드
    w_last := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '+1') - 1;
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                   /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_nm                                   /* _2- */
             , F_TR_CO_NM (t1.corp_gr, t1.mg_cd)  AS mg_nm  /* _3- */
             , t2.haeji_ymd                                 /* _4- */
             , t2.bf_gyul_ymd                               /* _5- */
             , t2.af_gyul_ymd                               /* _6- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI t2  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                             = p_corp_gr
           AND t2.corp_gr                             = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd                             = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd - 1, t2.af_gyul_ymd)  BETWEEN p_ymd AND w_last
           AND w_last                                 BETWEEN (t2.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND t2.af_gyul_ymd
    ) loop
        if  xx.haeji_ymd > w_last       then
            INSERT INTO SZX3CK tt   /* 펀드별 Check 자료 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                                                   /* _1- */
                   , xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.fund_nm || ' (' || xx.mg_nm || ') '
                                || TO_CHAR(xx.haeji_ymd, 'yyyy"년" mm"월" dd"일"') || ' 전부해지될 펀드입니다.'  /* _2- */
                   , 128                                                                                         /* _3- */
                   , 'PROC0700'                                                                                  /* _4- */
                   );
        elsif xx.haeji_ymd = w_last     then
            INSERT INTO SZX3CK tt   /* 펀드별 Check 자료 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                                             /* _1- */
                   , xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.fund_nm || ' (' || xx.mg_nm || ') '
                                || TO_CHAR(w_last, 'yyyy"년" mm"월" dd"일"') || ' 전부해지된 펀드입니다.'  /* _2- */
                   , 255                                                                                   /* _3- */
                   , 'PROC0700'                                                                            /* _4- */
                   );
        elsif xx.bf_gyul_ymd BETWEEN p_ymd AND F_OPEN_YMD (w_last, '+1')        then
            INSERT INTO SZX3CK tt   /* 펀드별 Check 자료 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                                                 /* _1- */
                   , xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.fund_nm || ' (' || xx.mg_nm || ') '
                                || TO_CHAR(xx.bf_gyul_ymd, 'yyyy"년" mm"월" dd"일"') || ' 결산한 펀드입니다.'  /* _2- */
                   , 16711680                                                                                  /* _3- */
                   , 'PROC0700'                                                                                /* _4- */
                   );
        else
            INSERT INTO SZX3CK tt   /* 펀드별 Check 자료 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                                                 /* _1- */
                   , xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.fund_nm || ' (' || xx.mg_nm || ') '
                                || TO_CHAR(xx.af_gyul_ymd, 'yyyy"년" mm"월" dd"일"') || ' 결산한 펀드입니다.'  /* _2- */
                   , 16711680                                                                                  /* _3- */
                   , 'PROC0700'                                                                                /* _4- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 결산 Check
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.mg_cd                                     /* _1- */
             , F_TR_CO_NM (t1.corp_gr, t1.mg_cd)  AS mg_nm  /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                   /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_nm                                   /* _4- */
             , t1.af_gyul_ymd                               /* _5- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.haeji_ymd IS NULL
           AND t1.af_gyul_ymd BETWEEN (p_ymd + 1) AND (p_ymd + 10)
         ORDER BY t1.mg_cd
                , t1.af_gyul_ymd
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO SZX3CK tt   /* 펀드별 Check 자료 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                                                 /* _1- */
               , xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.fund_nm || ' (' || xx.mg_nm || ') '
                            || TO_CHAR(xx.af_gyul_ymd, 'yyyy"년" mm"월" dd"일"') || ' 결산할 펀드입니다.'  /* _2- */
               , 1                                                                                         /* _3- */
               , 'PROC0700'                                                                                /* _4- */
               );
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';

    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0701 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 예금이자계산처리
--
    w_balh_ymd                     DATE;
    w_jm_cd                        VARCHAR (12); -- 종목코드
    w_mg_cd                        szm0ia.mg_cd%type    default '!@#$';

    w_aek                          NUMBER;
    w_pyom_iyul                    NUMBER; -- 표면이율
    w_bfil_aek                     NUMBER; -- 전일누적예금
    w_bfil_misu_ija                NUMBER; -- 전일누적이자
    w_misu_ija                     NUMBER; -- 누적미수이자
    w_dang_ija                     NUMBER; -- 당일계상 미수이자
    w_A0402                        NUMBER;
    w_A0412                        NUMBER;
    w_10101                        NUMBER;
    w_10901                        NUMBER;
    w_20202                        NUMBER;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    -- A0412 경과일수
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , t1.fund_currency
             , gi.bf_gyul_ymd
             , p_ymd - gi.bf_gyul_ymd  AS ilsu
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fst_seolj_ymd             <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND gi.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND p_ymd                        BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
    ) loop
        -- 결산펀드 누적일수 초기화처리
        if  xx.bf_gyul_ymd = p_ymd - 1  then
            DELETE FROM SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND ymd     = p_ymd
               AND work_gb = 'A'
               AND gwamok  = 'A0412';
        end if;
        SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'A0412', xx.ilsu);
    end loop;

    -- ma01osmr06 일임계좌원장 자료로 난외계정 생성 없을경우 SAT0GI 이용
    -- A0402 당일계약잔액
    -- A0403 (재)계약금평잔누적액
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , t1.fund_currency
             , gi.bf_gyul_ymd
             , p_ymd - gi.bf_gyul_ymd  AS ilsu
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fst_seolj_ymd             <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND gi.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND p_ymd                        BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT WONBON_AEK
              INTO w_A0402
              FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd  = (SELECT MAX(ta.tr_ymd)
                                   FROM SZT0IO ta  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
                                  WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                    AND ta.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                                    AND ta.tr_ymd  <= p_ymd);
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            if  p_corp_gr = '2402' AND p_ymd < TO_DATE ('20240515','yyyymmdd')  then
                -- 신규작업으로 pass
                CONTINUE;
            else
                p_msg := xx.fund_cd || ' - 입출금을 확인하십시오.';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        END;

        SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'A0402', w_A0402); -- 계약잔액

        -- 결산펀드 평잔누적액 초기화처리
        if  xx.bf_gyul_ymd = p_ymd - 1  then
            DELETE FROM SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND ymd     = p_ymd
               AND work_gb = 'A'
               AND gwamok  = 'A0403';
        end if;

        SELECT dr_aek
          INTO w_A0412
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok        = 'A0412'
           AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;

        -- 계약평잔누적액
        if  w_A0412 > 1     then
                SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'A0403', w_A0402 * w_A0412);
        ELSE    SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'A0403', w_A0402          );
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 일괄원본조정손익 계정상계
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , t1.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='50804' THEN F_JAN (chadae_gb, junj, dr_aek, cr_aek) END),0)  AS g50804
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='61004' THEN F_JAN (chadae_gb, junj, dr_aek, cr_aek) END),0)  AS g61004
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb                   = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok                    IN ('50804','61004')
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd             <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, t1.fund_currency
    ) loop
        if  xx.g50804 > xx.g61004   then w_aek := xx.g61004 * -1;
        elsif xx.g50804 < xx.g61004 then w_aek := xx.g50804 * -1;
        else                                w_aek := 0;
        end if;
        if  w_aek < 0   then
            SR_INSBU (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B90', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 1, 3, 1, 'D', '50804', w_aek, 'B90', p_proc_step, 'SR_PROC0701', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
            SR_INSBU (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B90', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 1, 3, 2, 'C', '61004', w_aek, 'B90', p_proc_step, 'SR_PROC0701', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 순자산 점검 초기자료 생성
    DELETE FROM SHT0YE tt   /* 증권사 예금잔액 Load자료 */
     WHERE corp_gr         = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd          = p_ymd
       AND NVL(bigo,'del') NOT IN ('w_sht0ye','w_ja010f','w_ja020n');

    -- 현금자산액 clear
    UPDATE SHT0YE /* 증권사 예금잔액 Load자료 */
       SET cash_aek = 0
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd;

    MERGE INTO SHT0YE t1  /* 증권사 예금잔액 Load자료 */
       USING ( SELECT fund_cd
                    , mg_cd
                    , enc_acct_no
                 FROM SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                WHERE ia.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
                  AND ia.fund_cd               IN (SELECT fund_cd
                                                     FROM SJM0JM_SIGA ta  /* 주식 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                                                    WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                                      AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd
                                                   UNION ALL
                                                   SELECT fund_cd
                                                     FROM SJM5SM_SIGA ta  /* 채권 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                                                    WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                                      AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd
                                                   UNION ALL
                                                   SELECT fund_cd
                                                     FROM SCM0CM_SIGA ta  /* 채권 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                                                    WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                                      AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd
                                                   UNION ALL
                                                   SELECT fund_cd
                                                     FROM SHM0HM_SIGA ta  /* 현금 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                                                    WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                                      AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd)
                  AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd ) mm  ON ( t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                                               AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
                                                               AND t1.fund_cd = mm.fund_cd )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
         UPDATE
            SET t0_aek = CASE WHEN bigo IN ('w_sht0ye','w_ja010f','w_ja020n') THEN t0_aek ELSE 0 END
              , t2_aek = CASE WHEN bigo IN ('w_sht0ye','w_ja010f','w_ja020n') THEN t2_aek ELSE 0 END
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
         INSERT
         VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
                , p_ymd           /* _2- */
                , mm.fund_cd      /* _3- */
                , mm.mg_cd        /* _4- */
                , mm.enc_acct_no  /* _5- */
                , 0               /* _6- */
                , NULL            /* _7- */
                , 0               /* _8- */
                , NULL            /* _9- */
                , NULL            /* _10- */
                , NULL            /* _11- */
                , NULL            /* _12- */
                , NULL            /* _13- */
                , NULL            /* _14- */
                , NULL            /* _15- */
                , sysdate         /* _16- */
                , NULL            /* _17- */
                );


    -- 공모참여 엑셀 LOAD 자료 이용 예금처리
    -- 20240705까지 리코자산운용
    UPDATE SHT0YE t1   /* 증권사 예금잔액 Load자료 */
       SET T0_AEK  = (SELECT ta.deposit_tday
                        FROM UZM0HY ta  /* 계좌별 수요예측 집계자료 */
                       WHERE ta.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
                         AND ta.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                         AND ta.ymd     = t1.tr_ymd
                         AND ta.ip_user = 'LOAD')
         , bigo    = 'UZM0HY'
         , LOAD_DT = sysdate
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd
       AND fund_cd IN (SELECT fund_cd
                         FROM UZM0HY ta  /* 계좌별 수요예측 집계자료 */
                        WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                          AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd
                          AND ta.ip_user = 'LOAD');


    -- 잔고 LOAD 자료를 이용한 예금잔고 처리
    UPDATE SHT0YE t1   /* 증권사 예금잔액 Load자료 */
       SET T0_AEK  = (SELECT NVL(SUM(ta.siga_aek),0)
                        FROM SHM0HM_SIGA ta  /* 현금 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                           , SHM0HJ      hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                       WHERE ta.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
                         AND ta.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                         AND ta.ymd     = t1.tr_ymd
                         AND hj.corp_gr = ta.corp_gr
                         AND hj.jm_cd   = ta.jm_cd
                         AND hj.cash_cd = '90')
         , bigo    = 'PROC0701'
         , LOAD_DT = sysdate
     WHERE corp_gr          = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd           = p_ymd
       AND NVL(bigo,'load') NOT IN ('w_sht0ye','w_ja010f','w_ja020n')  /* 예수금 LOAD자료 및 MAP 자료는 제외 */
       AND fund_cd          NOT IN (SELECT fund_cd
                                      FROM UZM0HY ta  /* 계좌별 수요예측 집계자료 */
                                     WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                       AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd
                                       AND ta.ip_user = 'LOAD')
       AND fund_cd          IN (SELECT ta.fund_cd
                                  FROM SHM0HM_SIGA ta  /* 현금 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                                     , SHM0HJ      hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                                 WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                   AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd
                                   AND hj.corp_gr = ta.corp_gr
                                   AND hj.jm_cd   = ta.jm_cd
                                   AND hj.cash_cd = '90');

    UPDATE SHT0YE t1   /* 증권사 예금잔액 Load자료 */
       SET stock_aek = (SELECT NVL(SUM(siga_aek),0)
                          FROM SJM0JM_SIGA ta  /* 주식 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                         WHERE ta.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
                           AND ta.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                           AND ta.ymd     = t1.tr_ymd)
         , bond_aek  = (SELECT SUM(tt.aek)
                          FROM (SELECT NVL(SUM(siga_aek),0)  AS aek
                                  FROM SCM0CM_SIGA ta  /* 채권 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                                 WHERE ta.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
                                   AND ta.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                                   AND ta.ymd     = t1.tr_ymd
                                UNION ALL
                                SELECT NVL(SUM(siga_aek),0)
                                  FROM SHM0HM_SIGA ta  /* 현금 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                                 WHERE ta.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
                                   AND ta.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                                   AND ta.ymd     = t1.tr_ymd
                                   AND (ta.jm_cd LIKE 'KRZF%' OR ta.jm_cd LIKE 'KRZS%')
                                 ) tt)
         , fund_aek  = (SELECT SUM(tt.aek)
                          FROM (SELECT NVL(SUM(siga_aek),0)  AS aek
                                  FROM SJM5SM_SIGA ta  /* 채권 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                                 WHERE ta.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
                                   AND ta.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                                   AND ta.ymd     = t1.tr_ymd
                                 ) tt)
         , cash_aek  = (SELECT NVL(SUM(siga_aek),0)
                          FROM SHM0HM_SIGA ta  /* 현금 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                             , SHM0HJ      hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                         WHERE ta.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
                           AND ta.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                           AND ta.ymd     = t1.tr_ymd
                           AND ta.jm_cd   IN (hj.jm_cd, hj.ksd_jm_cd)
                           AND hj.corp_gr = ta.corp_gr
                           AND hj.fund_cd = ta.fund_cd
                           AND hj.cash_cd NOT IN ('ZS','ZF','90','70'))
         , tot_aek   = (SELECT SUM(aek)
                          FROM (SELECT NVL(SUM(siga_aek),0)  AS aek
                                  FROM SJM0JM_SIGA ta  /* 주식 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                                 WHERE ta.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
                                   AND ta.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                                   AND ta.ymd     = t1.tr_ymd
                                UNION ALL
                                SELECT NVL(SUM(siga_aek),0)
                                  FROM SCM0CM_SIGA ta  /* 채권 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                                 WHERE ta.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
                                   AND ta.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                                   AND ta.ymd     = t1.tr_ymd
                                UNION ALL
                                SELECT NVL(SUM(siga_aek),0)
                                  FROM SHM0HM_SIGA ta  /* 현금 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                                     , SHM0HJ      hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                                 WHERE ta.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
                                   AND ta.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                                   AND ta.ymd     = t1.tr_ymd
                                   AND ta.jm_cd   IN (hj.jm_cd, hj.ksd_jm_cd)
                                   AND hj.corp_gr = ta.corp_gr
                                   AND hj.fund_cd = ta.fund_cd
                                   AND hj.cash_cd NOT IN ('90','70')
                                 ) f1)
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd IN (SELECT fund_cd
                            FROM SHM0HM_SIGA ta  /* 현금 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                           WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                             AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd
                          UNION ALL
                          SELECT fund_cd
                            FROM SJM5SM_SIGA ta  /* 채권 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                           WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                             AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd
                          UNION ALL
                          SELECT fund_cd
                            FROM SCM0CM_SIGA ta  /* 채권 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                           WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                             AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd
                          UNION ALL
                          SELECT fund_cd
                            FROM SJM0JM_SIGA ta  /* 주식 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                           WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                             AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd)
       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd;

    -- RP LOAD 금액은 최종 발행일 기준으로처리 20241118
    UPDATE SHT0YE t1   /* 증권사 예금잔액 Load자료 */
       SET cash_aek = NVL(cash_aek,0) + (SELECT NVL(SUM(siga_aek),0)
                                           FROM SHM0HM_SIGA ta  /* 현금 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                                              , SHM0HJ      hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                                          WHERE ta.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
                                            AND ta.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
                                            AND ta.ymd      = t1.tr_ymd
                                            AND ta.jm_cd    IN (hj.jm_cd, hj.ksd_jm_cd)
                                            AND hj.corp_gr  = ta.corp_gr
                                            AND hj.fund_cd  = ta.fund_cd
                                            AND hj.cash_cd  = '70'
                                            AND hj.balh_ymd = (SELECT MAX(balh_ymd)
                                                                 FROM SHM0HJ xx  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                                                                WHERE xx.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                                                                  AND xx.fund_cd  = ta.fund_cd
                                                                  AND xx.cash_cd  = hj.cash_cd
                                                                  AND xx.balh_ymd <= p_ymd
                                                                  AND ta.jm_cd    IN (xx.jm_cd, xx.ksd_jm_cd)))
         , tot_aek  = NVL(tot_aek,0) + (SELECT NVL(SUM(siga_aek),0)
                                          FROM SHM0HM_SIGA ta  /* 현금 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                                             , SHM0HJ      hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                                         WHERE ta.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
                                           AND ta.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
                                           AND ta.ymd      = t1.tr_ymd
                                           AND ta.jm_cd    IN (hj.jm_cd, hj.ksd_jm_cd)
                                           AND hj.corp_gr  = ta.corp_gr
                                           AND hj.fund_cd  = ta.fund_cd
                                           AND hj.cash_cd  = '70'
                                           AND hj.balh_ymd = (SELECT MAX(balh_ymd)
                                                                FROM SHM0HJ xx  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                                                               WHERE xx.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                                                                 AND xx.fund_cd  = ta.fund_cd
                                                                 AND xx.cash_cd  = hj.cash_cd
                                                                 AND xx.balh_ymd <= p_ymd
                                                                 AND ta.jm_cd    IN (xx.jm_cd, xx.ksd_jm_cd)))
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd IN (SELECT fund_cd
                            FROM SHM0HM_SIGA ta  /* 현금 시가 LOAD 자료 */
                           WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                             AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd)
       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd;

    -- 예금 입력액으로 수정분개 처리
