    -- 수요예측자료에서 예금 입=력시 해당 자료사용 (20240619)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , NVL(t0_aek,0)    AS t0
             , NVL(t2_aek,0)    AS t2
             , NVL(cash_aek,0)  AS cash_aek
          FROM SHT0YE t1  /* 증권사 예금잔액 Load자료 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                    = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.bigo,'del')           IN ('w_sht0ye','w_ja010f','w_ja020n','UZM0HY','PROC0701')
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd             <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
    ) loop

--        if  p_corp_gr = '2402' And xx.fund_cd = '2427' And xx.t0 = 0 And xx.t2 = 0  then
--            -- 리코 DB 저축은행 예수금 pass 20241016
--            CONTINUE;
--        end if;

        SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='10101' THEN NVL (junj,0) + NVL (dr_aek,0) - NVL (cr_aek,0) ELSE 0 END),0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='12001' THEN NVL (junj,0) + NVL (dr_aek,0) - NVL (cr_aek,0) ELSE 0 END),0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='20201' THEN NVL (junj,0) - NVL (dr_aek,0) + NVL (cr_aek,0) ELSE 0 END),0)
          INTO w_10101
             , w_10901
             , w_20202
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND ymd     = p_ymd
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND work_gb = 'A'
           AND gwamok  IN ('10101','12001','20201');
        if  xx.t0 != 0 OR xx.t2 != 0    then
            if  xx.t2 != 0  then
                w_10101 := (xx.t2 - w_10901 + w_20202) - w_10101;
                -- 입력예금으로 LOAD 현금액 반영
                -- 예금액 이중입력분 반영키위해 리코자산만 재계산
                if  p_corp_gr = '2402'  then
                    UPDATE SHT0YE t1   /* 증권사 예금잔액 Load자료 */
                       SET cash_aek = NVL(cash_aek,0) + (xx.t2 - w_10901 + w_20202)
                         , tot_aek  = tot_aek + (xx.t2 - w_10901 + w_20202)
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd;
                end if;
            else
                w_10101 := xx.t0 - w_10101;
                -- 입력예금으로 LOAD 현금액 반영
                -- 예금액 이중입력분 반영키위해 리코자산만 재계산
                if  p_corp_gr = '2402'  then
                    UPDATE SHT0YE t1   /* 증권사 예금잔액 Load자료 */
                       SET cash_aek = NVL(cash_aek,0) + xx.t0
                         , tot_aek  = tot_aek + xx.t0
                     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd;
                end if;
            end if;

            SR_INSBU (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z90', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', '', 2, 1, 1, 'D', '10101', w_10101, 'B90', p_proc_step, 'SR_PROC0701 sht0ye로 조정', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
            SR_INSBU (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z90', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', '', 2, 1, 2, 'C', '64902', w_10101, 'B90', p_proc_step, 'SR_PROC0701 sht0ye로 조정', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;

        elsif xx.t0 = 0 AND xx.t2 = 0   then
            if  xx.cash_aek != 0    then
                w_10101 := w_10101;
            else
                w_10101 := w_10101 - (w_10901 + w_20202);
            end if;
            SR_INSBU (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z90', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', '', 2, 1, 1, 'D', '10101', - w_10101, 'B90', p_proc_step, 'skkp010_111 sht0ye로 조정', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
            SR_INSBU (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Z90', 'A', '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', '', 2, 1, 2, 'C', '64902', - w_10101, 'B90', p_proc_step, 'skkp010_111 sht0ye로 조정', w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 예금이자 재처리
    UPDATE SHM0HM t1   /* 현금 보유현황 */
       SET misu_ija   = bfil_misu_ija
         , meib_aek   = 0
         , day_ija    = 0
         , pyunga_aek = bfil_misu_ija
         , siga_aek   = bfil_misu_ija
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
       AND t1.jm_cd   IN (SELECT jm_cd
                            FROM SHM0HJ ta  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                           WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                             AND ta.cash_cd = '90'
                             AND p_ymd      BETWEEN balh_ymd AND sanghw_ymd);
    commit;

    -- 총계정원장 예금계정 당일 잔액추출
    -- 자문 보수계산(szm0ia bosu_gb 삭제 PROC0790 결산시 일괄계산으로 변경)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                          /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_currency                                                    /* _2- */
             , NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)  AS dangj      /* _3- */
             , NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1)                          AS haeji_ymd  /* _4- */
             , ia.mg_cd                                                            /* _5- */
             , ia.pre_basic                                                        /* _6- */
             , ia.basic_per                                                        /* _7- */
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb                   = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok                    = '10101'
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd             <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
         ORDER BY ia.mg_cd
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        if NVL (xx.pre_basic,0) > 0 then    -- 투자일임 수수료계산(선취/후취기본만)
                SR_PROC0701_10 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.pre_basic / 100, w_msg);
        ELSE    SR_PROC0701_10 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.basic_per / 100, w_msg);
        end if;

        if  xx.mg_cd != w_mg_cd then
            w_mg_cd := xx.mg_cd;  -- 예금종목 및 이율(수탁사별)

            SELECT MAX(jm_cd)
              INTO w_jm_cd
              FROM SHM0HJ t1  /* 현금 종목정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.cash_cd   = '90'
               AND t1.balh_ymd  = (SELECT MAX(balh_ymd)
                                     FROM SHM0HJ ta  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                                    WHERE ta.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
                                      AND ta.cash_cd   = '90'
                                      AND ta.broker_cd = xx.mg_cd
                                      AND p_ymd        BETWEEN balh_ymd AND sanghw_ymd)
               AND t1.broker_cd = xx.mg_cd;
            if  w_jm_cd IS NULL then
                SELECT MAX(jm_cd)
                  INTO w_jm_cd
                  FROM SHM0HJ t1  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.cash_cd   = '90'
                   AND t1.broker_cd = '%'
                   AND t1.balh_ymd  = (SELECT MAX(balh_ymd)
                                         FROM SHM0HJ ta  /* 현금 종목정보 */
                                        WHERE ta.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
                                          AND ta.cash_cd   = '90'
                                          AND ta.broker_cd = '%'
                                          AND p_ymd        BETWEEN balh_ymd AND sanghw_ymd);
                if  w_jm_cd IS NULL then
                    p_msg := xx.mg_cd || ' - 증권(수탁)사 예금이자율이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.';
                    RETURN;
                end if;
            end if;

            SELECT NVL(pyom_iyul,0)
                 , balh_ymd
              INTO w_pyom_iyul
                 , w_balh_ymd
              FROM SHM0HJ t1  /* 현금 종목정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.jm_cd   = w_jm_cd;
        end if;

        if  xx.haeji_ymd = p_ymd    then
            w_bfil_aek := 0;
            w_misu_ija := 0;
            w_dang_ija := 0;
        else
            -------------------------------------
            -- 현금원장의 전일누적미수이자 find
            -------------------------------------
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(meib_aek,0) - NVL(medo_aek,0)
                     , NVL(misu_ija,0)
                  INTO w_bfil_aek
                     , w_bfil_misu_ija
                  FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd - 1
                   AND t1.jm_cd   = w_jm_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
                w_bfil_aek      := 0;
                w_bfil_misu_ija := 0;
            END;

            w_misu_ija := TRUNC((w_bfil_aek + xx.dangj) * w_pyom_iyul / 365);  -- 당일 누적 미수이자 계산
            w_dang_ija := w_misu_ija - w_bfil_misu_ija;                        -- 당일계상 예금 미수이자
        end if;

        ---------------------------------------
        --  현금마스타 갱신
        ---------------------------------------
        UPDATE SHM0HM tt   /* 현금 보유현황 */
           SET misu_ija      = w_misu_ija
             , bfil_chui_aek = w_bfil_aek
             , meib_aek      = xx.dangj
             , day_ija       = w_dang_ija
             , pyunga_aek    = xx.dangj + w_misu_ija
             , siga_aek      = xx.dangj + w_misu_ija
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = w_jm_cd
           AND ymd     = p_ymd;

        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
                 ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
                 , ymd            /* _2- */
                 , fund_cd        /* _3- */
                 , jm_cd          /* _4- */
                 , bfil_chui_aek  /* _5- */
                 , meib_aek       /* _6- */
                 , misu_ija       /* _7- */
                 , day_ija        /* _8- */
                 , pyunga_aek     /* _9- */
                 , siga_aek       /* _10- */
                 , bfil_jilg      /* _11- */
                 , up_jilg        /* _12- */
                 , dw_jilg        /* _13- */
                 )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr              /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                  /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd             /* _3- */
                   , w_jm_cd                /* _4- */
                   , w_bfil_aek             /* _5- */
                   , xx.dangj               /* _6- */
                   , w_misu_ija             /* _7- */
                   , w_dang_ija             /* _8- */
                   , xx.dangj + w_misu_ija  /* _9- */
                   , xx.dangj + w_misu_ija  /* _10- */
                   , 0                      /* _11- */
                   , 0                      /* _12- */
                   , 0                      /* _13- */
                   );
        end if;

        -- 예금이자 분개처리
        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B21', 'A', '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, w_jm_cd, 1, 1, w_dang_ija, p_proc_step, 'SR_PROC0701 ' || w_jm_cd, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0701_10 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_currency                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_basic_rt                     IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 투자일임수수료 산출
--
    w_wonbon                       NUMBER;
    w_tsusu                        NUMBER;
BEGIN
    BEGIN
        SELECT wonbon_aek
          INTO w_wonbon
          FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND tr_ymd  = (SELECT MAX(tr_ymd)
                            FROM SZT0IO ta  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
                           WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                             AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
                             AND tr_ymd  <= p_ymd);
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        w_wonbon := 0;
    END;

    if  p_corp_gr = '2202' AND p_fund_cd = '1913'   then
        -- 차등보수 계산
        if  w_wonbon > 7000000000 then -- 70억 초과
            w_tsusu := (3000000000 + (2000000000 * 0.8) + (2000000000 * 0.65) + ((w_wonbon - 7000000000) * 0.5)) * p_basic_rt / 365;

        elsif w_wonbon > 5000000000 then -- 50억 초과
            w_tsusu := (3000000000 + (2000000000 * 0.8) + ((w_wonbon - 5000000000) * 0.65)) * p_basic_rt / 365;

        elsif w_wonbon > 3000000000 then -- 30억 초과
            w_tsusu := (3000000000 + ((w_wonbon - 3000000000) * 0.8)) * p_basic_rt / 365;
        else -- 30억 이하
            w_tsusu := w_wonbon * p_basic_rt / 365;  -- 기본보수계산
        end if;
    else
        w_tsusu := w_wonbon * p_basic_rt / 365;  -- 기본보수계산
    end if;

    w_tsusu := TRUNC (w_tsusu,2);
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
               , p_ymd            /* _2- */
               , 'A'              /* _3- */
               , p_fund_cd        /* _4- */
               , '90120'          /* _5- */
               , 'D'              /* _6- */
               , 0                /* _7- */
               , w_tsusu          /* _8- */
               , NULL             /* _9- */
               , p_fund_currency  /* _10- */
               );
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        UPDATE SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
           SET dr_aek = w_tsusu
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND ymd     = p_ymd
           AND work_gb = 'A'
           AND gwamok  = '90120';
    END;
    commit;
    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0702 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER
 ) AS
-- 평가손익처리
--
    w_gwamok                       skm0ag.gwamok%type;
BEGIN
    -- 국내분
    UPDATE SKM0AG t1   /* 총계정원장 */
       SET dr_aek = NVL(junj,0) * -1
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
       AND t1.work_gb = 'A'
       AND t1.gwamok  LIKE 'A02%';

    -- 국내평가손익처리

    -- 차입주식 평가액은 감소로 처리
    -- 종목정보에 상장이라도 A0231이 선택되 있으면 과표처리 20210527
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , CASE WHEN jb.sosok_gb='8' THEN t1.danc_gb
                    WHEN jj.A0231='Y'    THEN 'B'
                                         ELSE jb.sosok_gb
               END                   AS sosok_gb
             , NVL(SUM(t1.sonik),0)  AS sonik
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             , SJM0JJ jj  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.dw_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.gongs_up_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.gongs_dw_jusu,0) != 0
           AND jj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND jb.balh_co                   = t1.balh_co
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, ia.fund_currency
                , CASE WHEN jb.sosok_gb='8' THEN t1.danc_gb
                       WHEN jj.A0231='Y'    THEN 'B'
                                            ELSE jb.sosok_gb END
    ) loop
        if  xx.sosok_gb NOT IN ('B','2','3','4','G')    then    -- 비상장,상장집합투자증권는 집합투자증권/ETF/ETN은 기타로 분류
            SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'A0201', xx.sonik);
        end if;

        if  xx.sosok_gb IN ('3','4','G')    then w_gwamok := 'A02C3';  -- ETF/ETN 평가총액
        elsif xx.sosok_gb = '2'             then w_gwamok := 'A0208';  -- 상장집합투자증권
        elsif xx.sosok_gb = 'C'             then w_gwamok := 'A02A2';  -- 등록주식
        elsif xx.sosok_gb = 'D'             then w_gwamok := 'A02A3';  -- 코넥스주식
        elsif xx.sosok_gb = 'B'             then w_gwamok := 'A0231';  -- 비상장주식
        else                                     w_gwamok := 'A02A1';  -- 상장주식
        end if;

        SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, w_gwamok, xx.sonik);
    end loop;

    -- 국내평가손익계상-수익증권
    for xx IN (
        SELECT tt.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , NVL(SUM(tt.sonik),0)  AS sonik
          FROM (SELECT ta.fund_cd
                     , ta.sonik
                  FROM SJM0SM ta  /* (모자 / Multi Class) 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
                     , SZM0GI tb  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
                 WHERE ta.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
                   AND ta.ymd                                = p_ymd
                   AND NVL(ta.bfil_jwa,0) + NVL(ta.up_jwa,0) - NVL(ta.dw_jwa,0) > 0
                   AND tb.corp_gr                            = ta.corp_gr
                   AND tb.fund_cd                            = ta.mo_fund_cd
                   AND NVL(tb.haeji_ymd - 1, tb.af_gyul_ymd) != p_ymd
                   AND p_ymd                                 BETWEEN (tb.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND tb.af_gyul_ymd
                UNION ALL
                SELECT fund_cd
                     , sonik
                  FROM SJM5SM ta  /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
                 WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd
                   AND NVL(ta.bfil_jwa,0) + NVL(ta.up_jwa,0) - NVL(ta.dw_jwa,0) > 0
                 ) tt
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE ia.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = tt.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
         GROUP BY tt.fund_cd, ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'A0208', xx.sonik);
    end loop;

    -- 채권시가평가손익계상
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                          /* _2- */
             , cj.bond_attr                                              /* _3- */
             , cj.sangj_gb                                               /* _4- */
             , SUM(NVL(t1.siga_aek,0) - NVL(t1.pyunga_aek,0))  AS sonik  /* _5- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.msd_meib_aekm,0) > 0
           AND cj.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd  , ia.fund_currency
                , cj.bond_attr, cj.sangj_gb
    ) loop
        SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'A0202', xx.sonik);

        if  xx.bond_attr = '1'      then w_gwamok := 'A02B1';
        elsif xx.bond_attr = '2'    then w_gwamok := 'A02B2';
        elsif xx.bond_attr = '3'    then w_gwamok := 'A02B3';
        else                             w_gwamok := 'A02B5';
        end if;
        SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, w_gwamok, xx.sonik);
    end loop;

    -- 현금시가평가손익계상
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , t3.fund_currency
             , CASE WHEN t2.cash_cd IN ('ZS','ZF') THEN '전단채'
                                                   ELSE '현금'
               END                                             AS cash_gb
             , SUM(NVL(t1.siga_aek,0) - NVL(t1.pyunga_aek,0))  AS sonik
          FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
             , SHM0HJ t2  /* 현금 종목정보 */
             , SZM0IA t3  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND t2.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND t3.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t3.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, t3.fund_currency
                , CASE WHEN t2.cash_cd IN ('ZS','ZF') THEN '전단채'
                                                      ELSE '현금' END
    ) loop
        if  xx.cash_gb = '전단채'   then
            SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'A0202', xx.sonik);
            SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'A02B7', xx.sonik);
        else
            SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'A0203', xx.sonik);
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A-', 'SR_PROC0702', p_ymd || ' : 선물/옵션 평가손익 계상');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'ssm0km.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * ssm0km.sm_tr_gb>=3', '총계정원장(skm0ag)의 난외계정 옵션평가손익(A0203,A0215) 생성');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , t3.fund_currency
             , t2.jasan
             , NVL(SUM(t1.pyunga_sonik),0)  AS pyunga_sonik
          FROM SSM0KM t1  /* 파생 보유현황 */
             , SSX0KJ t2  /* 파생종목 */
             , SZM0IA t3  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND t1.sm_tr_gb                  >= '3'
           AND NVL(t1.pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(t1.up_gyey_su,0) - NVL(t1.dw_gyey_su,0) > 0
           AND t2.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.sj_cd                     = t1.sj_cd
           AND t3.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t3.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, t3.fund_currency, t2.jasan
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT CASE WHEN sebu_cd_efnm='채권' THEN 'A0207'
                                                 ELSE 'A0206' END
              INTO w_gwamok
              FROM SZX0GR t1  /* 그룹코드 */
             WHERE t1.gr_cd   = 'A6'
               AND t1.sebu_cd = xx.jasan;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_gwamok := 'A0206';
        END;
        SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, w_gwamok, xx.pyunga_sonik);
    end loop;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0703 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 해외 평가/환산 손익처리 (난외계정)
--
    w_pgwamok                      skm0ag.gwamok%type;
    w_hgwamok                      skm0ag.gwamok%type;
BEGIN
    -- 해외분
    UPDATE SKM0AG t1   /* 총계정원장 */
       SET dr_aek = NVL(junj,0) * -1
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
       AND t1.work_gb = 'A'
       AND t1.gwamok  LIKE 'A03%';

    -- 해외자산
    for r1 IN (
        SELECT tt.fund_cd                                                                                   /* _1- */
             , tt.fund_currency                                                                             /* _2- */
             , tt.jasan_gb                                                                                  /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN tt.fund_currency='KRW' THEN tt.won_pyunga_sonik
                                                        ELSE tt.fcur_pyunga_sonik END),0)  AS pyunga_sonik  /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN tt.fund_currency='KRW' THEN tt.won_hwan_cha
                                                        ELSE tt.fcur_hwan_cha END),0)      AS hwan_cha      /* _5- */
          FROM (SELECT t1.fund_cd            /* _1- */
                     , ia.fund_currency      /* _2- */
                     , t2.jasan_gb           /* _3- */
                     , t1.won_pyunga_sonik   /* _4- */
                     , t1.won_hwan_cha       /* _5- */
                     , t1.fcur_pyunga_sonik  /* _6- */
                     , t1.fcur_hwan_cha      /* _7- */
                  FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                     , SYM0YA t2  /* 해외 자산종목 */
                     , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
                   AND NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.msd_meib_aekm,0) > 0
                   AND t2.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
                   AND t2.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
                   AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
                   AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
                UNION ALL
                SELECT yg.fund_cd            /* _1- */
                     , ia.fund_currency      /* _2- */
                     , t2.jasan_gb           /* _3- */
                     , t1.won_pyunga_sonik   /* _4- */
                     , t1.won_hwan_cha       /* _5- */
                     , t1.fcur_pyunga_sonik  /* _6- */
                     , t1.fcur_hwan_cha      /* _7- */
                  FROM SYT0YG_PYUNGA t1  /* 해외 배당/주식권리 일별 평가 */
                     , SYT0YG        yg  /* 해외 배당/주식권리 현황 */
                     , SYM0YA        t2  /* 해외 자산종목 */
                     , SZM0IA        ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
                   AND yg.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
                   AND yg.pyunga_join               = t1.pyunga_join
                   AND t2.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
                   AND t2.jm_cd                     = yg.jm_cd
                   AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd                   = yg.fund_cd
                   AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
                 ) tt
         GROUP BY tt.fund_cd, tt.fund_currency, tt.jasan_gb
    ) loop
        if  r1.jasan_gb = '1'   then
            w_pgwamok := 'A0331';  -- 해외주식평가손익-과표
            w_hgwamok := 'A0311';  -- 주식환차손익

        elsif r1.jasan_gb = '2' then
            w_pgwamok := 'A0332';  -- 채권평가손익
            w_hgwamok := 'A0312';  -- 채권환차손익

        elsif r1.jasan_gb = '3' then
            w_pgwamok := 'A0333';  -- 수익증권평가손익
            w_hgwamok := 'A0313';  -- 수익증권환차손익

        elsif r1.jasan_gb IN ('5','6')      then    -- 현금/mmf
            w_pgwamok := 'A0334';  -- 외화예금평가손익
            w_hgwamok := 'A0314';  -- 외화예금환차손익

        elsif r1.jasan_gb IN ('A','9')  then    -- 해외파생(선물/옵션)
            w_pgwamok := 'A0336';  -- 해외파생평가손익
            w_hgwamok := 'A0316';  -- 해외파생환차손익
        else
            w_pgwamok := '*****';
            w_hgwamok := '*****';
        end if;

        if  w_pgwamok != '*****'    then    -- 평가손익난외계정 update
            SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', r1.fund_cd, r1.fund_currency, w_pgwamok, r1.pyunga_sonik);

        elsif r1.pyunga_sonik <> 0   then
            p_msg := r1.fund_cd || '(' || r1.jasan_gb || ') - 평가손익난외계정이 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if  w_hgwamok != '*****'    then    -- 환차손익난외계정 update
            SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', r1.fund_cd, r1.fund_currency, w_hgwamok, r1.hwan_cha);

        elsif r1.hwan_cha <> 0   then
            p_msg := r1.fund_cd || '(' || r1.jasan_gb || ') - 환산손익 난외계정이 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 수도결제
    for r1 IN (
        SELECT tt.fund_cd
             , tt.fund_currency
             , tt.tr_cd
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN tt.fund_currency='KRW' THEN tt.won_hwan_cha
                                                        ELSE tt.fcur_hwan_cha END),0)  AS hwan_cha
          FROM (SELECT t1.fund_cd        /* _1- */
                     , ia.fund_currency  /* _2- */
                     , t1.tr_cd          /* _3- */
                     , t1.won_hwan_cha   /* _4- */
                     , t1.fcur_hwan_cha  /* _5- */
                  FROM SYT0YS t1  /* 해외 수도결제 */
                     , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
                   AND (t1.gyulje_gb = 'N' OR t1.gyulje_ymd > p_ymd)
                   AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
                   AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
                 ) tt
         GROUP BY tt.fund_cd, tt.fund_currency, tt.tr_cd
    ) loop
        if  r1.tr_cd IN ('J20','K20')               then w_hgwamok := 'A0311';  -- 주식환차손익
        elsif r1.tr_cd IN ('J14','K11')             then w_hgwamok := 'A0312';  -- 채권환차손익
        elsif r1.tr_cd IN ('H21','H22')             then w_hgwamok := 'A0315';  -- 기타부채
        elsif r1.tr_cd IN ('S10','S11','S20','S21') then w_hgwamok := 'A0316';  -- 해외파생환차손익 2019.06.10
        else                                             w_hgwamok := 'A0314';  -- 기타자산
        end if;
        SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', r1.fund_cd, r1.fund_currency, w_hgwamok, r1.hwan_cha);
    end loop;

    -- 미지급 비용 (해외 보관/거래비용)
    for r1 IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , t1.tr_cd
             , SUM(CASE WHEN ia.fund_currency='KRW' THEN t1.won_hwan_cha
                                                    ELSE t1.fcur_hwan_cha END)  AS hwan_cha
          FROM SYT0MC t1  /* 해외 채권/채무 발생 및 감소 MASTER */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                    = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, ia.fund_currency, t1.tr_cd
    ) loop
        SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', r1.fund_cd, r1.fund_currency, 'A0315', r1.hwan_cha);
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := 'SR_PROC0703-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0710 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 기준가산출
--
    g_D0204                        NUMBER;  /* 과표 */
    w_40201                        NUMBER;  /* 이월잉여금-과표 */
    w_40211                        NUMBER;  /* 이월잉여금-비과표 */
    w_D0204                        NUMBER;  /* 과표 */
    w_D0205                        NUMBER;  /* 비과표 */

    w_err                          NUMBER;
    w_bm_per                       NUMBER;
    w_suik                         NUMBER;

    w_gijunga                      NUMBER;
    w_gijunga_12                   NUMBER;

    w_gicho                        NUMBER;
    w_io_aek                       NUMBER;
    w_mod                          NUMBER;
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr , 'A', 'PROC0710', p_ymd || p_proc_step || ' : 기준가산출계산준비' );

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr , 'B010', '', p_ymd || ' 기준가 산출용 손익금액 계산' );

    -- D0101 신탁재산순자산총액
    -- D0204 과표손익
    -- D0205 비과표손익
    UPDATE SKM0AG t1    /* 총계정원장 */
       SET dr_aek = NVL(junj,0) * -1
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
       AND t1.work_gb = 'A'
       AND t1.gwamok  IN ('D0101','D0204','D0205');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT ag.fund_cd
             , ag.fund_currency
             , t1.gwamok
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ag.chadae_gb='D'
                            THEN NVL(ag.junj,0) + NVL(ag.dr_aek,0) - NVL(ag.cr_aek,0)
                            ELSE NVL(ag.junj,0) - NVL(ag.dr_aek,0) + NVL(ag.cr_aek,0)
                       END * t1.yonsan),0)  AS dangj
          FROM SZX0CC t1  /* 계정 계산식 */
             , SKM0AG ag  /* 총계정원장 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.gwamok                    IN ('D0101','D0204','D0205')
           AND ag.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND ag.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND ag.work_gb                   = 'A'
           AND ag.gwamok                    = t1.hab_gwamok
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = ag.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = ag.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd             <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND gi.corp_gr                   = ia.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                   = ia.fund_cd
           AND p_ymd                        BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
         GROUP BY ag.fund_cd, ag.fund_currency, t1.gwamok
         ORDER BY 1 ASC
    ) loop
        SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr , p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gwamok, xx.dangj );
    end loop;

    -- D0101 순자산이 없는 계좌 처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , t1.fund_currency
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd                   NOT IN (SELECT ta.fund_cd
                                                      FROM SKM0AG ta  /* 총계정원장 */
                                                     WHERE 1 = 1
                                                       AND ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                                       AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd
                                                       AND ta.work_gb = 'A'
                                                       AND ta.gwamok  = 'D0101')
           AND t1.fst_seolj_ymd             <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND gi.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND p_ymd                        BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
               , p_ymd             /* _2- */
               , 'A'               /* _3- */
               , xx.fund_cd        /* _4- */
               , 'D0101'           /* _5- */
               , 'D'               /* _6- */
               , 0                 /* _7- */
               , 0                 /* _8- */
               , 0                 /* _9- */
               , xx.fund_currency  /* _10- */
               );
    end loop;

    -- 90109 (평잔)순자산총액
    DELETE FROM SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
     WHERE 1 = 1 
       AND corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd
       AND work_gb = 'A'
       AND (gwamok='90109' OR gwamok LIKE 'B03%');

    -- 자문사 평잔원본액에 따른 기준가 계산 난외계산 작업(이월하지 않고 매일 재계산)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd        /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_currency  /* _2- */
             , gi.bf_gyul_ymd    /* _3- */
             , t1.fst_seolj_ymd  /* _4- */
             , t1.re_seolj_aek   /* _5- */
             , aa.customer_gr    /* _6- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
             , SZX0AA aa  /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fst_seolj_ymd             <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND gi.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND p_ymd                        BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
           AND aa.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT wonbon_aek
              INTO w_gicho
              FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd  = xx.bf_gyul_ymd + 1;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_gicho := xx.re_seolj_aek;
        END;

        -- B0301 기초잔고
        INSERT INTO SKM0AG hh   /* 총계정원장 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
               , p_ymd             /* _2- */
               , 'A'               /* _3- */
               , xx.fund_cd        /* _4- */
               , 'B0301'           /* _5- */
               , 'D'               /* _6- */
               , 0                 /* _7- */
               , w_gicho           /* _8- */
               , 0                 /* _9- */
               , xx.fund_currency  /* _10- */
               );

        SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(in_aek,0) - NVL(out_aek,0)),0)
             , NVL(SUM(gigan_amt),0)
          INTO w_io_aek
             , w_mod
          FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd  BETWEEN (xx.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND p_ymd;

        -- B0302 당기입(출)금액
        INSERT INTO SKM0AG hh   /* 총계정원장 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
               , p_ymd             /* _2- */
               , 'A'               /* _3- */
               , xx.fund_cd        /* _4- */
               , 'B0302'           /* _5- */
               , 'D'               /* _6- */
               , 0                 /* _7- */
               , w_io_aek          /* _8- */
               , 0                 /* _9- */
               , xx.fund_currency  /* _10- */
               );

        -- B0303 기간가중(수정)투자원금
        if  xx.customer_gr = '자산운용' then
            -- 당일 평가금액(순자산)에 의한 조정금 처리
            BEGIN
                SELECT wonbon_aek
                  INTO w_mod
                  FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.tr_ymd  = (SELECT MAX(tr_ymd)
                                       FROM SZT0IO tt  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
                                      WHERE 1 = 1
                                        AND tt.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                        AND tt.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                                        AND tt.tr_ymd  <= p_ymd);
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                p_msg := xx.fund_cd || ' - 입출금 점검';
                RETURN;
            END;

            INSERT INTO SKM0AG hh   /* 총계정원장 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                   , 'A'               /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _4- */
                   , 'B0303'           /* _5- */
                   , 'D'               /* _6- */
                   , 0                 /* _7- */
                   , w_mod             /* _8- */
                   , 0                 /* _9- */
                   , xx.fund_currency  /* _10- */
                   );
        else
            INSERT INTO SKM0AG hh   /* 총계정원장 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                   , 'A'               /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _4- */
                   , 'B0303'           /* _5- */
                   , 'D'               /* _6- */
                   , 0                 /* _7- */
                   , w_gicho + w_mod   /* _8- */
                   , 0                 /* _9- */
                   , xx.fund_currency  /* _10- */
                   );
        end if;

        -- B0309 투자원금
        INSERT INTO SKM0AG hh   /* 총계정원장 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr           /* _1- */
               , p_ymd               /* _2- */
               , 'A'                 /* _3- */
               , xx.fund_cd          /* _4- */
               , 'B0309'             /* _5- */
               , 'D'                 /* _6- */
               , 0                   /* _7- */
               , w_gicho + w_io_aek  /* _8- */
               , 0                   /* _9- */
               , xx.fund_currency    /* _10- */
               );

        BEGIN
            SELECT bm_per
              INTO w_bm_per
              FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_bm_per := 0;
        END;

        -- B0306 BM수익률(%)
        if  w_bm_per > 0    then
            INSERT INTO SKM0AG hh   /* 총계정원장 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                   , 'A'               /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _4- */
                   , 'B0306'           /* _5- */
                   , 'D'               /* _6- */
                   , 0                 /* _7- */
                   , w_bm_per          /* _8- */
                   , 0                 /* _9- */
                   , xx.fund_currency  /* _10- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr , 'A', 'PROC0710', p_ymd || ' : 기준가격산출' );

    for xx IN (
        WITH D0101 AS (
             SELECT FUND_CD
                  , NVL(JUNJ,0) + NVL(DR_AEK,0) - NVL(CR_AEK,0)  AS AEK
               FROM SKM0AG ta  /* 총계정원장 */
              WHERE 1 = 1
                AND TA.CORP_GR = P_CORP_GR
                AND TA.YMD     = P_YMD
                AND TA.WORK_GB = 'A'
                AND TA.GWAMOK  = 'D0101'
             ) , 
         G40101 AS (
             SELECT fund_cd
                  , NVL(junj,0) - NVL(dr_aek,0) + NVL(cr_aek,0)  AS aek
               FROM SKM0AG ta  /* 총계정원장 */
              WHERE 1 = 1
                AND ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd
                AND ta.work_gb = 'A'
                AND ta.gwamok  = '40101'
             )
        -- Main SQL --
        --------------
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                      /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_currency                                /* _2- */
             , t1.bf_gyul_ymd                                  /* _3- */
             , NVL(t2.aek,0)                 AS sun_jasan_aek  /* _4- */
             , NVL(t3.aek,0)                 AS wonbon         /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  AS haeji_ymd      /* _6- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
          LEFT OUTER JOIN D0101 t2
                       ON t2.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
          LEFT OUTER JOIN G40101 t3
                       ON t3.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fst_seolj_ymd             <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND gi.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND p_ymd                        BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
    ) loop
        SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='D0204'
                            THEN F_JAN (ag.chadae_gb, ag.junj, ag.dr_aek, ag.cr_aek) * t1.yonsan END),0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='D0205'
                            THEN F_JAN (ag.chadae_gb, ag.junj, ag.dr_aek, ag.cr_aek) * t1.yonsan END),0)
          INTO w_D0204
             , w_D0205
          FROM SZX0CC t1  /* 계정 계산식 */
             , SKM0AG ag  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.gwamok        IN ('D0204','D0205')
           AND t1.hab_gwamok    > '90000'
           AND ag.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND ag.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND ag.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND ag.work_gb       = 'A'
           AND ag.gwamok        = t1.hab_gwamok
           AND ag.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;

        SELECT w_D0204 + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.tax_gb='1'
                                      THEN F_JAN (ag.chadae_gb, ag.junj, ag.dr_aek, ag.cr_aek) * CASE WHEN t1.gwamok_gb='4' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END END),0)
             , w_D0205 + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.tax_gb='2'
                                      THEN F_JAN (ag.chadae_gb, ag.junj, ag.dr_aek, ag.cr_aek) * CASE WHEN t1.gwamok_gb='4' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END END),0)
          INTO w_D0204
             , w_D0205
          FROM SZX0GM t1  /* 계정과목 */
             , SKM0AG ag  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.gwamok_gb     IN ('4','5')
           AND t1.tax_gb        IN ('1','2')
           AND ag.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND ag.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND ag.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND ag.work_gb       = 'A'
           AND ag.gwamok        = t1.gwamok
           AND ag.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;

        -- 이월이익잉여금
        SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gm.tax_gb='1'
                            THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END),0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gm.tax_gb='2'
                            THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END),0)
          INTO w_40201
             , w_40211
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             , SZX0GM gm  /* 계정과목 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok        BETWEEN '40201' AND '40299'
           AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency
           AND gm.gwamok        = t1.gwamok;

        SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0)),0)
          INTO g_D0204
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok        = 'D0204'
           AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;
        if  w_D0204 != g_D0204  then
            w_err := w_err + 1;
            INSERT INTO WFRMERR hh      /* 에러메세지(저장작업 정지됨) */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                 /* _1- */
                   , xx.fund_cd || '(' || xx.fund_currency || ') - D0204 과표손익과 과표계정별 합이 틀립니다.('
                                || F_NTRIM(w_D0204 - g_D0204) || ')_PROC0710'  /* _2- */
                                          );
            CONTINUE;
        end if;

        xx.sun_jasan_aek := xx.sun_jasan_aek;

        SELECT xx.sun_jasan_aek - NVL(SUM(dr_aek),0)
          INTO w_suik
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok        IN ('B0301','B0302')
           AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;

        SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr , p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'B0304', w_suik );  /* B0304 운용수익액 */
        SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'B0305', CASE WHEN xx.wonbon=0 THEN 0 ELSE w_suik / xx.wonbon * 100 END);    /* B0305 성과수익률(%) */

        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(dr_aek,0)
              INTO w_bm_per
              FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
               AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
               AND t1.gwamok        = 'B0306'
               AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;

            SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr , p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'B0307', F_TRUNC(xx.wonbon * w_bm_per / 100, xx.fund_currency) );
            if  w_suik > F_TRUNC (xx.wonbon * w_bm_per / 100, xx.fund_currency) then
                SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr , p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'B0308', w_suik - F_TRUNC(xx.wonbon * w_bm_per / 100, xx.fund_currency) );
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;

        -- 90109 (평잔)순자산액
        SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr , p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '90109', xx.sun_jasan_aek );

        if  xx.wonbon > 0 AND xx.sun_jasan_aek != 0     then
            w_gijunga    := F_GROUND (xx.sun_jasan_aek * 1000 / xx.wonbon, xx.fund_currency);
            w_gijunga_12 := TRUNC  (xx.sun_jasan_aek * 1000 / xx.wonbon, 12 );
        else
            w_gijunga    := 0;
            w_gijunga_12 := 0;
        end if;

        SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr , p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'D0102', w_gijunga    );  /* 기준가격 */
        SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr , p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'D0103', w_gijunga_12 );  /* 기준가격2 */
        SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr , p_ymd, 'A', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'A0401', xx.wonbon    );  /* 잔존좌수 */

        -- 수익증권 기준가격 적용일 좌수계산
        UPDATE SJT0SG hh    /* 집합투자증권 매매내역 */
           SET tr_jwa = F_TRUNC(tr_aek / w_gijunga * 1000, xx.fund_currency)
             , danga  = w_gijunga
         WHERE 1 = 1 
           AND corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND mo_fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND gijunga_ymd = p_ymd + 1;
    end loop;
    if  w_err > 0   then
        p_msg := F_NTRIM (w_err) || '건 기준가격 산출에러발생';
        RETURN;
    end if;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0711 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
) AS
-- 기준가격 보고서 난외계정 갱신
--
    w_kungwa_ilsu                NUMBER;
    w_gyul_gijun_ga              NUMBER;
    w_gyul_ggijun_ga             NUMBER;
    w_gicho_gijun_ga             NUMBER;
    w_gicho_ggijun_ga            NUMBER;
    w_silhyn_suik_rt             NUMBER;
    w_bond_rt                    NUMBER;
    w_cash_rt                    NUMBER;
    w_stock_rt                   NUMBER;
    w_stock_rt1                  NUMBER;
    w_suik_stock_rt              NUMBER;
    w_kosp_jisu                  NUMBER;
    w_bond_suik_rt               NUMBER;
    w_bond_suik_aekm             NUMBER;
    w_cash_suik_rt               NUMBER;
    w_cash_suik_aekm             NUMBER;
    w_bc_suik_rt                 NUMBER;

    w_pj                         NUMBER;
    w_A0402                      NUMBER;
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0711', p_ymd || ' : 기준가격 보고서 난외계정 갱신');

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT ag.fund_cd
             , ag.fund_currency
             , t1.gwamok
             , SUM(ag.junj * t1.yonsan)  AS junj
             , SUM(CASE WHEN ag.chadae_gb='D'
                        THEN NVL(ag.dr_aek,0) - NVL(ag.cr_aek,0)
                        ELSE NVL(ag.cr_aek,0) - NVL(ag.dr_aek,0)
                   END * t1.yonsan)      AS dr_aek
          FROM SZX0CC t1
             , SKM0AG ag
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SZM0GI gi
         WHERE t1.gwamok        LIKE '90%'
           AND ag.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND ag.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND ag.work_gb       = 'A'
           AND ag.gwamok        = t1.hab_gwamok
           AND ia.corp_gr       = ag.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd       = ag.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  > p_ymd
           AND gi.corp_gr       = ia.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd       = ia.fund_cd
           AND p_ymd            Between  (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
         GROUP BY ag.fund_cd, ag.fund_currency, t1.gwamok
    ) loop
        -- 당일난외계정증감갱신
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SKM0AG hh  
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                   , 'A'               /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _4- */
                   , xx.gwamok         /* _5- */
                   , 'D'               /* _6- */
                   , xx.junj           /* _7- */
                   , xx.dr_aek         /* _8- */
                   , NULL              /* _9- */
                   , xx.fund_currency  /* _10- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            UPDATE SKM0AG hh  
               SET junj   = xx.junj
                 , dr_aek = xx.dr_aek
             WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND ymd           = p_ymd
               AND work_gb       = 'A'
               AND gwamok        = xx.gwamok
               AND fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;
        END;
    END LOOP;
    -- 총자산액 = 순자산액 + 총부채 20201110 yjs
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd
             , ia.fund_currency
             , '91112'       AS gwamok
             , SUM(t1.junj)  AS junj
             , SUM(CASE WHEN t1.chadae_gb='D'
                        THEN NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)
                        ELSE NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek,0)
                   END)      AS dr_aek
          FROM SKM0AG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SZM0GI gi
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok        IN ('90104','20000')
           AND ia.corp_gr       = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  > p_ymd
           AND gi.corp_gr       = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd
           AND p_ymd            Between  (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SELECT xx.dr_aek - NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.junj,0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) + NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)),0)
          INTO xx.dr_aek
          FROM SKM0AG t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok        = '20600'
           AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;

        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SKM0AG hh  
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                   , 'A'               /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _4- */
                   , xx.gwamok         /* _5- */
                   , 'D'               /* _6- */
                   , xx.junj           /* _7- */
                   , xx.dr_aek         /* _8- */
                   , NULL              /* _9- */
                   , xx.fund_currency  /* _10- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            UPDATE SKM0AG hh  
               SET junj   = xx.junj
                 , dr_aek = xx.dr_aek
             WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND ymd           = p_ymd
               AND work_gb       = 'A'
               AND gwamok        = xx.gwamok
               AND fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;
        END;
    END LOOP;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', '', '기준가(skt0gi) 테이블 생성처리 - 각종 편입비율 및 실현수익율 생성');

    BEGIN
        SELECT col_val
          INTO w_kosp_jisu
          FROM SKT0BM t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.col_id  = 'kospi_jisu';
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
        w_kosp_jisu := 0;   -- 종합주가지수
    END;

    FOR xx IN  (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                                                                                       /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_currency                                                                                                                 /* _2- */
             , ia.re_seolj_aek                                                                                                  AS seolj_aek    /* _3- */
             , ia.af_gyul_ymd                                                                                                                   /* _4- */
             , ia.bf_gyul_ymd                                                                                                                   /* _5- */
             , ia.fst_seolj_ymd                                                                                                                 /* _6- */
             , ia.haeji_ymd                                                                                                                     /* _7- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=1
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok
                                      THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END END),0)                      AS D0101        /* _8- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=2
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok
                                      THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END END),0)          AS CM           /* _9- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=3
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok
                                      THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END END),0)                      AS JM           /* _10- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=13
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok
                                      THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END END),0)                      AS SJM          /* _11- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=4
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok
                                      THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END END),0)                      AS HM           /* _12- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=5
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok
                                      THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END END),0)                      AS gijun_ga     /* _13- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=6
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok
                                      THEN CASE WHEN t1.chadae_gb='D' THEN NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)
                                                                      ELSE NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) END END END),0)  AS gijun_ga_dr  /* _14- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=7
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok
                                      THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END END),0)                      AS ggijun_ga    /* _15- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=8
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok
                                      THEN CASE WHEN t1.chadae_gb='D' THEN NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)
                                                                      ELSE NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) END END END),0)  AS ggijun_ga_dr /* _16- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=9
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok
                                      THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END END),0)                      AS gijun_ga2    /* _17- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=10
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok
                                      THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END END),0)                      AS ggijun_ga2   /* _18- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=12
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok
                                      THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END END),0)          AS b0201        /* _19- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=12
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok
                                      THEN t1.junj * we.yonsan END END),0)                                                      AS b0201_junj   /* _20- */
          FROM SKM0AG t1
             , SZX0WE we
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SZM0GI gi
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
           AND we.pgm_id        = 'SR_SKKP010_154'
           AND we.gwamok        = t1.gwamok
           AND ia.corp_gr       = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  > p_ymd
           AND gi.corp_gr       = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd
           AND p_ymd            Between  (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd    , t1.fund_currency, ia.re_seolj_aek, ia.af_gyul_ymd
                , ia.bf_gyul_ymd, ia.fst_seolj_ymd, ia.haeji_ymd
    ) loop
        if  xx.haeji_ymd = p_ymd OR xx.b0201 = 0    then
            w_gicho_gijun_ga    := NULL;
            w_gyul_gijun_ga     := NULL;
            w_gyul_ggijun_ga    := NULL;
            w_gicho_ggijun_ga   := NULL;
            w_silhyn_suik_rt    := NULL;
            w_bond_rt           := NULL;
            w_cash_rt           := NULL;
            w_stock_rt          := NULL;
            w_suik_stock_rt     := NULL;
            w_bc_suik_rt        := NULL;
            w_stock_rt1         := NULL;
            w_A0402             := NULL;
            w_pj                := NULL;
        else
            SELECT CASE WHEN aa.CUSTOMER_GR='자산운용'
                        THEN SUM(CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='B0303'
                                      THEN NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) END)
                        ELSE NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='A0403' THEN NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)
                                     END) / SUM(CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='A0412' THEN NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) END),0) END
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='A0402' THEN NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) END),0)
              INTO w_pj
                 , w_A0402
              FROM SKM0AG t1
                 , SZX0AA aa
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
               AND t1.work_gb = 'A'
               AND t1.gwamok  IN ('A0402','A0403','A0412','B0303')
               AND aa.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
             GROUP BY aa.customer_gr;

            -------------------------------------------
            -- 채권 편입비율...
            -------------------------------------------
            --  sum(주식관련계정)      / NAV (순자산 총액) * 100
            --  sum(수익증권계정)      / NAV (순자산 총액) * 100
            --  sum(채권관련계정)      / NAV (순자산 총액) * 100
            --  sum(현금/기타관련계정) / NAV (순자산 총액) * 100
            -------------------------------------------

            w_bond_rt   := xx.CM / xx.b0201;                -- 채권만
            if  w_bond_rt > 9.9 then    w_bond_rt   := 9.9; -- 대부분의 일부해지시 미지급해지금에 의한 비율이상보정
            end if;
            -------------------------------------------
            -- 현금 편입비율...
            -------------------------------------------
            w_cash_rt   := xx.HM / xx.b0201;
            -------------------------------------------
            -- 주식 편입비율...
            -------------------------------------------

            w_stock_rt  := xx.JM / xx.b0201;    -- 주식만
            if  w_stock_rt < 0  then    w_stock_rt  := 0;
            end if;
            w_suik_stock_rt := xx.SJM / xx.b0201;   -- 수익증권 편입비율
            -------------------------------------------
            -- 주식 편입비율 계산(일부해지 신청분 포함)
            -------------------------------------------
            w_stock_rt1 := NULL;

            w_stock_rt1 := xx.JM / xx.b0201;    -- 주식만
            if  w_stock_rt1 < 0 then    w_stock_rt1 := 0;
            end if;

            --  경과일수...
            SELECT p_ymd - re_seolj_ymd
              INTO w_kungwa_ilsu
              FROM SZM0IA t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd;

            -- 결산 기준가 가져오기...
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL(gyulaf_gijun_ga,0)
                     , NVL(gyulaf_ggijun_ga,0)
                     , NVL(gyulbf_gijun_ga,0)
                     , NVL(gyulbf_ggijun_ga,0)
                  INTO w_gicho_gijun_ga
                     , w_gicho_ggijun_ga
                     , w_gyul_gijun_ga
                     , w_gyul_ggijun_ga
                  FROM SKT0GS t1
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.gyul_ymd = xx.bf_gyul_ymd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                w_gicho_gijun_ga    := 1000;
                w_gicho_ggijun_ga   := 1000;
                w_gyul_gijun_ga     := NULL;
                w_gyul_ggijun_ga    := NULL;
            END;

            -- 실현수익율...
            if (w_gicho_gijun_ga * w_kungwa_ilsu = 0) OR w_pj = 0   then
                    w_silhyn_suik_rt    := 0;
            else    w_silhyn_suik_rt    := ROUND((xx.D0101 - w_A0402) / w_pj,6);
            end if;

            -- 채권/현금 가중평균 수익률 계산
            SELECT NVL(SUM((NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)
                            + msd_meib_aekm - msd_medo_aekm) * t1.bany_suik_rt),0)
                 , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)
                               + msd_meib_aekm - msd_medo_aekm),0)
              INTO w_bond_suik_rt
                 , w_bond_suik_aekm
              FROM SCM0CM t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

            SELECT NVL(SUM((NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)) * t3.meib_suik_rt),0)
                 , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)),0)
              INTO w_cash_suik_rt
                 , w_cash_suik_aekm
              FROM SHM0HM t1
                 , SHM0HJ t3
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
               AND t3.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
               AND t3.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd;

            if (w_bond_suik_aekm + w_cash_suik_aekm) = 0    then
                    w_bc_suik_rt    := 0;
            else    w_bc_suik_rt    := (w_bond_suik_rt + w_cash_suik_rt) / (w_bond_suik_aekm + w_cash_suik_aekm);
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 기준가 Table Insert...
        INSERT INTO SKT0GI
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr                  /* _1- */
               , p_ymd                      /* _2- */
               , xx.fund_cd                 /* _3- */
               , 'A'                        /* _4- */
               , xx.gijun_ga                /* _5- */
               , xx.gijun_ga_dr             /* _6- */
               , xx.gijun_ga2               /* _7- */
               , w_gicho_gijun_ga           /* _8- */
               , w_gyul_gijun_ga            /* _9- */
               , w_gyul_ggijun_ga           /* _10- */
               , xx.ggijun_ga               /* _11- */
               , xx.ggijun_ga_dr            /* _12- */
               , xx.ggijun_ga2              /* _13- */
               , w_gicho_ggijun_ga          /* _14- */
               , w_kosp_jisu                /* _15- */
               , TRUNC(w_silhyn_suik_rt,6)  /* _16- */
               , TRUNC(w_bond_rt,6)         /* _17- */
               , TRUNC(w_cash_rt,6)         /* _18- */
               , TRUNC(w_stock_rt,6)        /* _19- */
               , TRUNC(w_suik_stock_rt,6)   /* _20- */
               , w_A0402                    /* _21- */
               , xx.D0101                   /* _22- */
               , TRUNC(w_bc_suik_rt,6)      /* _23- */
               , TRUNC(w_stock_rt1,6)       /* _24- */
               , 0                          /* _25- */
               , 0                          /* _26- */
               , 0                          /* _27- */
               , xx.fund_currency           /* _28- */
               , TRUNC(w_pj)                /* _29- */
               );
    END LOOP;
    COMMIT;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0750 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_gyul_gb                      IN    VARCHAR
) AS
-- 결산처리
--
BEGIN
    -- 기준가 Table 삭제
    DELETE FROM SKT0GI t1  
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
       AND t1.work_gb = p_gyul_gb;

    -- 결산실적 Table 삭제
    DELETE FROM SKT0GS t1  
     WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.gyul_ymd = p_ymd;

    -- 분개장 Table 삭제
    DELETE FROM SKT0BU t1  
     WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_ymd    = p_ymd
       AND t1.proc_step = p_proc_step
       AND t1.work_gb   = p_gyul_gb;

    -- 총계정원장 삭제
    DELETE FROM SKM0AG t1  
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
       AND t1.work_gb = p_gyul_gb;

    -- 난외계정 clear
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                      /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_currency                                /* _2- */
             , t1.gwamok                                       /* _3- */
             , t1.chadae_gb                                    /* _4- */
             , CASE t1.chadae_gb WHEN 'D' THEN NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0) - NVL(cr_aek,0)
                                 WHEN 'C' THEN NVL(junj,0) - NVL(dr_aek,0) + NVL(cr_aek,0)
                                          ELSE 0 END  AS junj  /* _5- */
          FROM SKM0AG t1
             , SZM0GI t2
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok  NOT IN ('D0211','B0402','B0403')
           AND t1.gwamok  NOT BETWEEN '90000' AND '99999'
           AND t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND t2.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(t2.haeji_ymd - 1, t2.af_gyul_ymd)  = p_ymd
           AND p_ymd      Between  (t2.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND t2.af_gyul_ymd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SKM0AG hh  
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                   , p_gyul_gb         /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _4- */
                   , xx.gwamok         /* _5- */
                   , xx.chadae_gb      /* _6- */
                   , xx.junj           /* _7- */
                   , 0                 /* _8- */
                   , 0                 /* _9- */
                   , xx.fund_currency  /* _10- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN DUP_VAL_ON_INDEX THEN
            UPDATE SKM0AG hh  
               SET junj   = xx.junj
                 , dr_aek = 0
                 , cr_aek = 0
             WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND ymd           = p_ymd
               AND work_gb       = p_gyul_gb
               AND gwamok        = xx.gwamok
               AND fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;
        END;
    END LOOP;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0760 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_gyul_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 평가손익
--
    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -- 채권 평가손익 결산분개처리...(분개만)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                           /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                     /* _2- */
             , cj.slip_attr                                                         /* _3- */
             , cj.sangj_gb                                                          /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.siga_aek,0) - NVL(t1.pyunga_aek,0)),0)      AS sonik  /* _5- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd, cj.sangj_gb)  AS chasu  /* _6- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                                = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND cj.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd                              = t1.jm_cd
           AND gi.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(gi.haeji_ymd - 1, gi.af_gyul_ymd) = p_ymd
           AND p_ymd                                 BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, ia.fund_currency, cj.slip_attr, cj.sangj_gb
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010_GWA (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Q39', p_gyul_gb, '1', xx.slip_attr || xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        '', xx.slip_attr, xx.chasu, xx.sonik, 0, p_proc_step, 'skgp150', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;
    commit;

    -- 현금 평가손익 결산분개처리...(분개만)
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                          /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                    /* _2- */
             , hj.cash_cd                                                          /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.siga_aek,0) - NVL(t1.pyunga_aek,0)),0)     AS sonik  /* _4- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd, hj.cash_cd)  AS chasu  /* _5- */
          FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SHM0HJ hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                                = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND hj.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND hj.jm_cd                              = t1.jm_cd
           AND hj.cash_cd                            IN ('20','60','ZS','ZF')
           AND gi.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(gi.haeji_ymd - 1, gi.af_gyul_ymd) = p_ymd
           AND p_ymd                                 BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, ia.fund_currency, hj.cash_cd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010_GWA (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Q3B', p_gyul_gb, '1', xx.cash_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        '', xx.chasu, 1, xx.sonik, 0, p_proc_step, 'skgp160', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 국내분평가손익 처리(결산)
    -- 주식 Select...
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                  /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                            /* _2- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                  /* _3- */
             , CASE jb.sosok_gb WHEN 'D' THEN '05'
                                WHEN 'C' THEN '02'
                                WHEN 'G' THEN '03'
                                WHEN '3' THEN '03'
                                WHEN '4' THEN '03'
                                         ELSE '00' END       AS jasan_gb   /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(sonik),0)                             AS sonik      /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(gsonik),0)                            AS gsonik     /* _6- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq        /* _7- */
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                                = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.sonik,0)                       != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND jb.balh_co                            = t1.balh_co
           AND jb.sosok_gb                           != '2'
           AND gi.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(gi.haeji_ymd - 1, gi.af_gyul_ymd) = p_ymd
           AND p_ymd                                 BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, ia.fund_currency, t1.bs_type
                , CASE jb.sosok_gb WHEN 'D' THEN '05'
                                   WHEN 'C' THEN '02'
                                   WHEN 'G' THEN '03'
                                   WHEN '3' THEN '03'
                                   WHEN '4' THEN '03'
                                            ELSE '00' END
    ) loop
        if  xx.bs_type = -1 then
                SR_SZSL010_GWA (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Q32', p_gyul_gb, '1', '-', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                                '', xx.seq, 1, xx.sonik, xx.gsonik, p_proc_step, 'skgp170 1(-)', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL010_GWA (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Q32', p_gyul_gb, '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                                '', xx.seq, 1, xx.sonik, xx.gsonik, p_proc_step, 'skgp170 1 ' || xx.jasan_gb, w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    --  상장수익증권 Select...
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                               /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                         /* _2- */
             , NVL(SUM(sonik),0)                             AS sonik   /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.gsonik),0)                         AS gsonik  /* _4- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq     /* _5- */
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
