         WHERE t1.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                                = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.sonik,0)                       != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND jb.balh_co                            = t1.balh_co
           AND jb.sosok_gb                           = '2'
           AND gi.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(gi.haeji_ymd - 1, gi.af_gyul_ymd) = p_ymd
           AND p_ymd                                 BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010_GWA (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Q32', p_gyul_gb, '1', '04', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        '', xx.seq, 2, xx.sonik, xx.gsonik, p_proc_step, 'skgp170 2 04', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    --  수익증권 Select...
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                        /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                  /* _2- */
             , t1.mo_fund_cd                                                     /* _3- */
             , CASE WHEN ia.type_gb IN ('0','1','2') THEN '1'
                                                     ELSE '3' END  AS jasan_gb   /* _4- */
             , NVL(sonik,0)                                        AS sonik      /* _5- */
             , NVL(gsonik,0)                                       AS gsonik     /* _6- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)        AS seq        /* _7- */
          FROM SJM0SM t1  /* (모자 / Multi Class) 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                                = p_ymd
           AND t1.mo_fund_cd                         NOT IN (SELECT ta.fund_cd
                                                               FROM SZM0GI ta  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
                                                              WHERE ta.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
                                                                AND NVL(ta.haeji_ymd - 1, ta.af_gyul_ymd) = p_ymd
                                                                AND p_ymd                                 BETWEEN (ta.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND ta.af_gyul_ymd)
           AND ia.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                            = t1.mo_fund_cd
           AND ia.fund_cd                            = t1.mo_fund_cd
           AND gi.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(gi.haeji_ymd - 1, gi.af_gyul_ymd) = p_ymd
           AND p_ymd                                 BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010_GWA (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Q31', p_gyul_gb, '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        '', xx.seq, 3, xx.sonik, xx.gsonik, p_proc_step, 'skgp170 3 ' || xx.jasan_gb, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    --  타사수익증권 Select...
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                        /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                  /* _2- */
             , t1.tasa_jm_cd                                                     /* _3- */
             , CASE WHEN sc.type_gb IN ('0','1','2') THEN '1'
                    WHEN sc.type_gb='7'              THEN '7'
                    WHEN sc.type_gb='8'              THEN '8'
                                                     ELSE '3' END  AS jasan_gb   /* _4- */
             , NVL(sonik,0)                                        AS sonik      /* _5- */
             , NVL(gsonik,0)                                       AS gsonik     /* _6- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)        AS seq        /* _7- */
          FROM SJM5SM t1             /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SJM0SC sc  /* 타사집합투자증권 정보 */
                       ON sc.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                      AND sc.tasa_jm_cd = t1.tasa_jm_cd
             , SZM0IA ia             /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi             /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                                = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND gi.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(gi.haeji_ymd - 1, gi.af_gyul_ymd) = p_ymd
           AND p_ymd                                 BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010_GWA (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Q31', p_gyul_gb, '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        '', xx.seq, 4, xx.sonik, xx.gsonik, p_proc_step, 'skgp170 4 ' || xx.jasan_gb, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 선물 평가손익 처리...
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                     /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                               /* _2- */
             , t1.sj_cd                                                       /* _3- */
             , CASE t1.sm_tr_gb WHEN '3' THEN 'Q35'
                                WHEN '4' THEN 'Q36'
                                WHEN '5' THEN 'Q37'
                                WHEN '6' THEN 'Q38' END      AS tr_cd         /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.pyunga_sonik,0)                        AS pyunga_sonik  /* _5- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq           /* _6- */
          FROM SSM0KM t1  /* 파생 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SSX0KJ kj  /* 파생종목 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                                = p_ymd
           AND t1.sm_tr_gb                           >= '3'
           AND ia.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND kj.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND kj.sj_cd                              = t1.sj_cd
           AND gi.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(gi.haeji_ymd - 1, gi.af_gyul_ymd) = p_ymd
           AND p_ymd                                 BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, p_gyul_gb, '1', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                    xx.sj_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.pyunga_sonik, p_proc_step, 'skgp120', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 총계정원장 (평가손익 국내분 Update)
    -- 일부분배인 경우 평가손익 clear 제외
    UPDATE SKM0AG t1    /* 총계정원장 */
       SET dr_aek = NVL(t1.junj,0) * -1
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
       AND t1.work_gb = p_gyul_gb
       AND t1.gwamok  LIKE 'A02%'
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 'x'
                     FROM SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
                        , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                    WHERE gi.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
                      AND gi.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
                      AND NVL(gi.haeji_ymd - 1, gi.af_gyul_ymd) = p_ymd
                      AND p_ymd                                 BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
                      AND ia.corp_gr                            = gi.corp_gr
                      AND ia.fund_cd                            = gi.fund_cd);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0760_RE (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 평가손익 결산분개 익영업일 보정처리...
--
    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -- 채권 평가손익 결산분개 보정처리...
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                           /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                     /* _2- */
             , cj.slip_attr                                                         /* _3- */
             , cj.sangj_gb                                                          /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.siga_aek,0) - NVL(t1.pyunga_aek,0)),0)      AS sonik  /* _5- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd, cj.sangj_gb)  AS chasu  /* _6- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd - 1
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd             < p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND cj.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND gi.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND gi.af_gyul_ymd               = p_ymd - 1
           AND p_ymd - 1                    BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, ia.fund_currency, cj.slip_attr, cj.sangj_gb
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010_GWA (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Q3A', 'A', '1', xx.slip_attr || xx.sangj_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        '', xx.slip_attr, xx.chasu, xx.sonik * -1, 0, p_proc_step, 'skgp150_re', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 현금 평가손익 결산분개 보정처리...
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                          /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                    /* _2- */
             , hj.cash_cd                                                          /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.siga_aek,0) - NVL(t1.pyunga_aek,0)),0)     AS sonik  /* _4- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd, hj.cash_cd)  AS chasu  /* _5- */
          FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SHM0HJ hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd - 1
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd             < p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND hj.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND hj.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND hj.cash_cd                   IN ('20','60','ZS','ZF')
           AND gi.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND gi.af_gyul_ymd               = p_ymd - 1
           AND p_ymd - 1                    BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, ia.fund_currency, hj.cash_cd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010_GWA (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Q3C', 'A', '1', xx.cash_cd, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        '', xx.chasu, 1, xx.sonik * -1, 0, p_proc_step, 'skgp160_re', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 국내분 평가손익 결산보정

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B011', '', 'skgp170_re - 주식');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                  /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                            /* _2- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                  /* _3- */
             , CASE jb.sosok_gb WHEN 'B' THEN '01'
                                WHEN 'D' THEN '05'
                                WHEN 'C' THEN '02'
                                WHEN 'G' THEN '03'
                                WHEN '3' THEN '03'
                                WHEN '4' THEN '03'
                                         ELSE '00' END       AS jasan_gb   /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(sonik),0)                             AS re_sonik   /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(gsonik),0)                            AS re_gsonik  /* _6- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq        /* _7- */
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd - 1
           AND NVL(t1.sonik,0)              != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd             < p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) >= p_ymd
           AND (gi.af_gyul_ymd=p_ymd - 1 OR ia.haeji_ymd=p_ymd)
           AND jb.balh_co                   = t1.balh_co
           AND jb.sosok_gb                  != '2'
           AND gi.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND p_ymd - 1                    BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, ia.fund_currency, t1.bs_type
                , CASE jb.sosok_gb WHEN 'B' THEN '01'
                                   WHEN 'D' THEN '05'
                                   WHEN 'C' THEN '02'
                                   WHEN 'G' THEN '03'
                                   WHEN '3' THEN '03'
                                   WHEN '4' THEN '03'
                                            ELSE '00' END
    ) loop
        if  xx.bs_type = -1 then
                SR_SZSL010_GWA (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Q3F', 'A', '1', '-', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                                '', xx.seq, 1, xx.re_sonik * -1, xx.re_gsonik * -1, p_proc_step, 'skgp170_re 1(-)', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL010_GWA (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Q3F', 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                                '', xx.seq, 1, xx.re_sonik * -1, xx.re_gsonik * -1, p_proc_step, 'skgp170_re 1 ' || xx.jasan_gb, w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B012', '', 'skgp170_re - 상장수익증권');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                  /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                            /* _2- */
             , NVL(SUM(sonik),0)                             AS re_sonik   /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.gsonik),0)                         AS re_gsonik  /* _4- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq        /* _5- */
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJX0JB jb  /* 발행기관 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd - 1
           AND NVL(t1.sonik,0)              != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd             < p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) >= p_ymd
           AND (gi.af_gyul_ymd=p_ymd - 1 OR ia.haeji_ymd=p_ymd)
           AND jb.balh_co                   = t1.balh_co
           AND jb.sosok_gb                  = '2'
           AND gi.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND p_ymd - 1                    BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010_GWA (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Q3F', 'A', '1', '04', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        '', xx.seq, 2, xx.re_sonik * -1, xx.re_gsonik * -1, p_proc_step, 'skgp170_re 2 04', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B015', '', 'skgp170_re - 타사수익증권');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                         /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                   /* _2- */
             , t1.tasa_jm_cd                                                      /* _3- */
             , CASE WHEN sc.type_gb IN ('0','1','2') THEN '11'
                    WHEN sc.type_gb='7'              THEN '17'
                    WHEN sc.type_gb='8'              THEN '18'
                                                     ELSE '13' END  AS jasan_gb   /* _4- */
             , NVL(sonik,0)                                         AS re_sonik   /* _5- */
             , NVL(gsonik,0)                                        AS re_gsonik  /* _6- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)         AS seq        /* _7- */
          FROM SJM5SM t1             /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SJM0SC sc  /* 타사집합투자증권 정보 */
                       ON sc.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                      AND sc.tasa_jm_cd = t1.tasa_jm_cd
             , SZM0IA ia             /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi             /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd - 1
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd             < p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) >= p_ymd
           AND (gi.af_gyul_ymd=p_ymd - 1 OR ia.haeji_ymd=p_ymd)
           AND gi.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND p_ymd - 1                    BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL010_GWA (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'Q3J', 'A', '1', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.tasa_jm_cd, xx.seq, 6,
                        xx.re_sonik * -1, xx.re_gsonik * -1, p_proc_step, 'skgp170_re 9 ' || xx.jasan_gb, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 선물 평가손익 처리...
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                     /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                               /* _2- */
             , t1.sj_cd                                                       /* _3- */
             , CASE t1.sm_tr_gb WHEN '3' THEN 'Q35'
                                WHEN '4' THEN 'Q36'
                                WHEN '5' THEN 'Q37'
                                WHEN '6' THEN 'Q38' END      AS tr_cd         /* _4- */
             , NVL(t1.pyunga_sonik,0)                        AS pyunga_sonik  /* _5- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq           /* _6- */
          FROM SSM0KM t1  /* 파생 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SSX0KJ kj  /* 파생종목 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd - 1
           AND t1.sm_tr_gb                  >= '3'
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd             < p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
           AND kj.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND kj.sj_cd                     = t1.sj_cd
           AND gi.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND gi.af_gyul_ymd               = p_ymd - 1
           AND p_ymd - 1                    BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', 'RE', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                    xx.sj_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.pyunga_sonik, p_proc_step, 'skgp120', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0761 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 결산기준가산출
--
    g_D0204                        NUMBER;  /* 과표 */
    w_40201                        NUMBER;  /* 이월잉여금-과표 */
    w_40211                        NUMBER;  /* 이월잉여금-비과표 */
    w_D0204                        NUMBER;  /* 과표 */
    w_D0205                        NUMBER;  /* 비과표 */
    w_A0402                        NUMBER;

    w_err                          NUMBER;
    w_bm_per                       NUMBER;
    w_suik                         NUMBER;

    w_gijunga                      NUMBER;
    w_gijunga_12                   NUMBER;

    w_gicho                        NUMBER;
    w_io_aek                       NUMBER;
    w_mod                          NUMBER;
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0710', p_ymd || p_proc_step || ' : 결산기준가산출계산준비');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', '', p_ymd || ' 결산기준가 산출용 손익금액 계산');

    -- D0101 신탁재산순자산총액
    -- D0204 과표손익
    -- D0205 비과표손익
    UPDATE SKM0AG t1    /* 총계정원장 */
       SET dr_aek = NVL(junj,0) * -1
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
       AND t1.work_gb = 'B'
       AND t1.gwamok  IN ('D0101','D0204','D0205');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT ag.fund_cd
             , ag.fund_currency
             , t1.gwamok
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ag.chadae_gb='D'
                            THEN NVL(ag.junj,0) + NVL(ag.dr_aek,0) - NVL(ag.cr_aek,0)
                            ELSE NVL(ag.junj,0) - NVL(ag.dr_aek,0) + NVL(ag.cr_aek,0)
                       END * t1.yonsan),0)  AS dangj
          FROM SZX0CC t1  /* 계정 계산식 */
             , SKM0AG ag  /* 총계정원장 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.gwamok                             IN ('D0101','D0204','D0205')
           AND ag.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
           AND ag.ymd                                = p_ymd
           AND ag.work_gb                            = 'B'
           AND ag.gwamok                             = t1.hab_gwamok
           AND ia.corp_gr                            = ag.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                            = ag.fund_cd
           AND gi.corp_gr                            = ia.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                            = ia.fund_cd
           AND NVL(gi.haeji_ymd - 1, gi.af_gyul_ymd) = p_ymd
           AND p_ymd                                 BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
         GROUP BY ag.fund_cd, ag.fund_currency, t1.gwamok
         ORDER BY 1
    ) loop
        SR_INSAG1 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gwamok, xx.dangj);
    end loop;

    -- 90109 (평잔)순자산총액
    DELETE FROM SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd
       AND work_gb = 'B'
       AND (gwamok='90109' OR gwamok LIKE 'B03%');

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0710', p_ymd || ' : 기준가격산출');

    for xx IN (
        WITH D0101 AS (
             SELECT fund_cd
                  , NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0) - NVL(cr_aek,0)  AS aek
               FROM SKM0AG ta  /* 총계정원장 */
              WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd
                AND ta.work_gb = 'B'
                AND ta.gwamok  = 'D0101'
             ) , 
             G40101 AS (
             SELECT fund_cd
                  , NVL(junj,0) - NVL(dr_aek,0) + NVL(cr_aek,0)  AS aek
               FROM SKM0AG ta  /* 총계정원장 */
              WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd
                AND ta.work_gb = 'B'
                AND ta.gwamok  = '40101'
             )
        -- Main SQL --
        --------------
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                      /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_currency                                /* _2- */
             , t1.bf_gyul_ymd                                  /* _3- */
             , NVL(t2.aek,0)                 AS sun_jasan_aek  /* _4- */
             , NVL(t3.aek,0)                 AS wonbon         /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  AS haeji_ymd      /* _6- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
          LEFT OUTER JOIN D0101 t2
                       ON t2.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
          LEFT OUTER JOIN G40101 t3
                       ON t3.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
           AND gi.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(gi.haeji_ymd - 1, gi.af_gyul_ymd) = p_ymd
           AND p_ymd                                 BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
    ) loop
        SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='D0204' THEN F_JAN (ag.chadae_gb, ag.junj, ag.dr_aek, ag.cr_aek) * t1.yonsan END),0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.gwamok='D0205' THEN F_JAN (ag.chadae_gb, ag.junj, ag.dr_aek, ag.cr_aek) * t1.yonsan END),0)
          INTO w_D0204
             , w_D0205
          FROM SZX0CC t1  /* 계정 계산식 */
             , SKM0AG ag  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE t1.gwamok        IN ('D0204','D0205')
           AND t1.hab_gwamok    > '90000'
           AND ag.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND ag.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND ag.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND ag.work_gb       = 'B'
           AND ag.gwamok        = t1.hab_gwamok
           AND ag.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;

        SELECT w_D0204 + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.tax_gb='1'
                                      THEN F_JAN (ag.chadae_gb, ag.junj, ag.dr_aek, ag.cr_aek) * CASE WHEN t1.gwamok_gb='4' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END END),0)
             , w_D0205 + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.tax_gb='2'
                                      THEN F_JAN (ag.chadae_gb, ag.junj, ag.dr_aek, ag.cr_aek) * CASE WHEN t1.gwamok_gb='4' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END END),0)
          INTO w_D0204
             , w_D0205
          FROM SZX0GM t1  /* 계정과목 */
             , SKM0AG ag  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE t1.gwamok_gb     IN ('4','5')
           AND t1.tax_gb        IN ('1','2')
           AND ag.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND ag.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND ag.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND ag.work_gb       = 'B'
           AND ag.gwamok        = t1.gwamok
           AND ag.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;

        -- 이월이익잉여금
        SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gm.tax_gb='1'
                            THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END),0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gm.tax_gb='2'
                            THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END),0)
          INTO w_40201
             , w_40211
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             , SZX0GM gm  /* 계정과목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = 'B'
           AND t1.gwamok        BETWEEN '40201' AND '40299'
           AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency
           AND gm.gwamok        = t1.gwamok;

        SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0)),0)
          INTO g_D0204
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = 'B'
           AND t1.gwamok        = 'D0204'
           AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;
        if  w_D0204 != g_D0204  then
            w_err := w_err + 1;
            INSERT INTO WFRMERR hh      /* 에러메세지(저장작업 정지됨) */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                    /* _1- */
                   , xx.fund_cd || '(' || xx.fund_currency || ') - D0204 과표손익과 과표계정별 합이 틀립니다.('
                                || F_NTRIM(w_D0204 - g_D0204) || ')_skkp010_151'  /* _2- */
                   );
            CONTINUE;
        end if;

        xx.sun_jasan_aek := xx.sun_jasan_aek;

        SELECT xx.sun_jasan_aek - NVL(SUM(dr_aek),0)
          INTO w_suik
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = 'B'
           AND t1.gwamok        IN ('B0301','B0302')
           AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;

        SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'B0304', w_suik);  /* B0304 운용수익액 */
        SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'B0305', CASE WHEN xx.wonbon=0 THEN 0 ELSE w_suik / xx.wonbon * 100 END);    /* B0305 성과수익률(%) */

        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(dr_aek,0)
              INTO w_bm_per
              FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
               AND t1.work_gb       = 'B'
               AND t1.gwamok        = 'B0306'
               AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;

            SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'B0307', TRUNC(xx.wonbon * w_bm_per / 100, xx.fund_currency));
            if  w_suik > F_TRUNC (xx.wonbon * w_bm_per / 100, xx.fund_currency)     then
                SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'B0308', w_suik - TRUNC(xx.wonbon * w_bm_per / 100, xx.fund_currency));
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            NULL;
        END;

        -- 90109 (평잔)순자산액
        SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '90109', xx.sun_jasan_aek);

        if  xx.wonbon > 0 AND xx.sun_jasan_aek != 0     then
            w_gijunga    := F_GROUND (xx.sun_jasan_aek * 1000 / xx.wonbon, xx.fund_currency);
            w_gijunga_12 := TRUNC  (xx.sun_jasan_aek * 1000 / xx.wonbon, 12);
        else
            w_gijunga    := 0;
            w_gijunga_12 := 0;
        end if;

        SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'D0102', w_gijunga   );  /* 기준가격 */
        SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'D0103', w_gijunga_12);  /* 기준가격2 */
        SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'A0401', xx.wonbon   );  /* 잔존좌수 */

        -- 수익증권 기준가격 적용일 좌수계산
        UPDATE SJT0SG hh    /* 집합투자증권 매매내역 */
           SET tr_jwa = F_TRUNC(tr_aek / w_gijunga * 1000, xx.fund_currency)
             , danga  = w_gijunga
         WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND mo_fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND gijunga_ymd = p_ymd + 1;

        BEGIN
            SELECT wonbon_aek
              INTO w_A0402
              FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd  = (SELECT MAX(tr_ymd)
                                   FROM SZT0IO ta  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
                                  WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                    AND ta.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                                    AND ta.tr_ymd  <= p_ymd);
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            if  p_corp_gr = '2402' AND p_ymd < TO_DATE ('20240515','yyyymmdd')  then
                CONTINUE;
            end if;
        END;

        SR_INSAG (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'B', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, 'A0402', w_A0402);  /* 당일계약잔액 */
    end loop;
    if  w_err > 0   then
        p_msg := F_NTRIM (w_err) || '건 기준가격 산출에러발생';
        RETURN;
    end if;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0762 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
 ) AS
-- 결산기준가격 보고서 난외계정 갱신
--
    w_kungwa_ilsu                  NUMBER;
    w_gyul_gijun_ga                NUMBER;
    w_gyul_ggijun_ga               NUMBER;
    w_gicho_gijun_ga               NUMBER;
    w_gicho_ggijun_ga              NUMBER;
    w_silhyn_suik_rt               NUMBER;
    w_bond_rt                      NUMBER;
    w_cash_rt                      NUMBER;
    w_stock_rt                     NUMBER;
    w_stock_rt1                    NUMBER;
    w_suik_stock_rt                NUMBER;
    w_kosp_jisu                    NUMBER;
    w_bond_suik_rt                 NUMBER;
    w_bond_suik_aekm               NUMBER;
    w_cash_suik_rt                 NUMBER;
    w_cash_suik_aekm               NUMBER;
    w_bc_suik_rt                   NUMBER;

    w_pj                           NUMBER;
    w_A0402                        NUMBER;
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0711', p_ymd || ' : 기준가격 보고서 난외계정 갱신');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT ag.fund_cd                           /* _1- */
             , ag.fund_currency                     /* _2- */
             , t1.gwamok                            /* _3- */
             , SUM(ag.junj * t1.yonsan)  AS junj    /* _4- */
             , SUM(CASE WHEN ag.chadae_gb='D'
                        THEN NVL(ag.dr_aek,0) - NVL(ag.cr_aek,0)
                        ELSE NVL(ag.cr_aek,0) - NVL(ag.dr_aek,0)
                   END * t1.yonsan)      AS dr_aek  /* _5- */
          FROM SZX0CC t1  /* 계정 계산식 */
             , SKM0AG ag  /* 총계정원장 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.gwamok                             LIKE '90%'
           AND ag.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
           AND ag.ymd                                = p_ymd
           AND ag.work_gb                            = 'B'
           AND ag.gwamok                             = t1.hab_gwamok
           AND ia.corp_gr                            = ag.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                            = ag.fund_cd
           AND gi.corp_gr                            = ia.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                            = ia.fund_cd
           AND NVL(gi.haeji_ymd - 1, gi.af_gyul_ymd) = p_ymd
           AND p_ymd                                 BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
         GROUP BY ag.fund_cd, ag.fund_currency, t1.gwamok
    ) loop
        -- 당일난외계정증감갱신
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                   , 'B'               /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _4- */
                   , xx.gwamok         /* _5- */
                   , 'D'               /* _6- */
                   , xx.junj           /* _7- */
                   , xx.dr_aek         /* _8- */
                   , NULL              /* _9- */
                   , xx.fund_currency  /* _10- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            UPDATE SKM0AG tt    /* 총계정원장 */
               SET junj   = xx.junj
                 , dr_aek = xx.dr_aek
             WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND ymd           = p_ymd
               AND work_gb       = 'B'
               AND gwamok        = xx.gwamok
               AND fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;
        END;
    end loop;
    -- 총자산액 = 순자산액 + 총부채 20201110 yjs
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                   /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency             /* _2- */
             , '91112'           AS gwamok  /* _3- */
             , SUM(t1.junj)      AS junj    /* _4- */
             , SUM(CASE WHEN t1.chadae_gb='D'
                        THEN NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)
                        ELSE NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek,0)
                   END)          AS dr_aek  /* _5- */
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb                   = 'B'
           AND t1.gwamok                    IN ('90104','20000')
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd             <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SELECT xx.dr_aek - NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.junj,0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) + NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)),0)
          INTO xx.dr_aek
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = 'B'
           AND t1.gwamok        = '20600'
           AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;

        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                   , 'B'               /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _4- */
                   , xx.gwamok         /* _5- */
                   , 'D'               /* _6- */
                   , xx.junj           /* _7- */
                   , xx.dr_aek         /* _8- */
                   , NULL              /* _9- */
                   , xx.fund_currency  /* _10- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            UPDATE SKM0AG tt    /* 총계정원장 */
               SET junj   = xx.junj
                 , dr_aek = xx.dr_aek
             WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND ymd           = p_ymd
               AND work_gb       = 'B'
               AND gwamok        = xx.gwamok
               AND fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;
        END;
    end loop;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', '', '기준가(skt0gi) 테이블 생성처리 - 각종 편입비율 및 실현수익율 생성');

    BEGIN
        SELECT col_val
          INTO w_kosp_jisu
          FROM SKT0BM t1  /* 벤치마크수익률/성과보수 산출기준 각종비율 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.col_id  = 'kospi_jisu';
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        w_kosp_jisu := 0;  /* 종합주가지수 */
    END;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                                                                                                                 /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_currency                                                                                                                                           /* _2- */
             , ia.re_seolj_aek                                                                                                                           AS seolj_aek     /* _3- */
             , ia.af_gyul_ymd                                                                                                                                             /* _4- */
             , ia.bf_gyul_ymd                                                                                                                                             /* _5- */
             , ia.fst_seolj_ymd                                                                                                                                           /* _6- */
             , ia.haeji_ymd                                                                                                                                               /* _7- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=1
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END END),0)                      AS D0101         /* _8- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=2
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END END),0)          AS CM            /* _9- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=3
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END END),0)                      AS JM            /* _10- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=13
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END END),0)                      AS SJM           /* _11- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=4
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END END),0)                      AS HM            /* _12- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=5
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END END),0)                      AS gijun_ga      /* _13- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=6
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN CASE WHEN t1.chadae_gb='D' THEN NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)
                                                                                               ELSE NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) END END END),0)  AS gijun_ga_dr   /* _14- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=7
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END END),0)                      AS ggijun_ga     /* _15- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=8
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN CASE WHEN t1.chadae_gb='D' THEN NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)
                                                                                               ELSE NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) END END END),0)  AS ggijun_ga_dr  /* _16- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=9
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END END),0)                      AS gijun_ga2     /* _17- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=10
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) END END),0)                      AS ggijun_ga2    /* _18- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=12
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END END),0)          AS b0201         /* _19- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=12
                            THEN CASE WHEN t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN t1.junj * we.yonsan END END),0)                                                      AS b0201_junj    /* _20- */
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             , SZX0WE we  /* 보고서별 계정과목 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                       = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb                   = 'B'
           AND we.gwamok                    = t1.gwamok
           AND we.pgm_id                    = 'SR_SKKP010_154'
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
           AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd             <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd    , t1.fund_currency, ia.re_seolj_aek
                , ia.af_gyul_ymd, ia.bf_gyul_ymd  , ia.fst_seolj_ymd, ia.haeji_ymd
    ) loop
        if  xx.haeji_ymd = p_ymd OR xx.b0201 = 0    then
            w_gicho_gijun_ga  := NULL;
            w_gyul_gijun_ga   := NULL;
            w_gyul_ggijun_ga  := NULL;
            w_gicho_ggijun_ga := NULL;
            w_silhyn_suik_rt  := NULL;
            w_bond_rt         := NULL;
            w_cash_rt         := NULL;
            w_stock_rt        := NULL;
            w_suik_stock_rt   := NULL;
            w_bc_suik_rt      := NULL;
            w_stock_rt1       := NULL;
            w_A0402           := NULL;
            w_pj              := NULL;
        else
            SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='A0402' THEN NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0) END),0)
                 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='A0403' THEN NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0) END) / SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='A0412' THEN NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0) END),0)
              INTO w_A0402
                 , w_pj
              FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND ymd     = p_ymd
               AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND work_gb = 'A'
               AND gwamok  IN ('A0402','A0403','A0412');

            -------------------------------------------
            -- 채권 편입비율...
            -------------------------------------------
            --  sum(주식관련계정)      / NAV (순자산 총액) * 100
            --  sum(수익증권계정)      / NAV (순자산 총액) * 100
            --  sum(채권관련계정)      / NAV (순자산 총액) * 100
            --  sum(현금/기타관련계정) / NAV (순자산 총액) * 100
            -------------------------------------------

            w_bond_rt := xx.CM / xx.b0201;  /* 채권만 */
            if  w_bond_rt > 9.9 then    w_bond_rt := 9.9;  -- 대부분의 일부해지시 미지급해지금에 의한 비율이상보정
            end if;
            -------------------------------------------
            -- 현금 편입비율...
            -------------------------------------------
            w_cash_rt := xx.HM / xx.b0201;
            -------------------------------------------
            -- 주식 편입비율...
            -------------------------------------------

            w_stock_rt := xx.JM / xx.b0201;  /* 주식만 */
            if  w_stock_rt < 0  then    w_stock_rt := 0;
            end if;
            w_suik_stock_rt := xx.SJM / xx.b0201;  /* 수익증권 편입비율 */
            -------------------------------------------
            -- 주식 편입비율 계산(일부해지 신청분 포함)
            -------------------------------------------
            w_stock_rt1 := NULL;

            w_stock_rt1 := xx.JM / xx.b0201;  /* 주식만 */
            if  w_stock_rt1 < 0 then    w_stock_rt1 := 0;
            end if;

            --  경과일수...
            SELECT p_ymd - re_seolj_ymd
              INTO w_kungwa_ilsu
              FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd;

            -- 결산 기준가 가져오기...
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL(gyulaf_gijun_ga,0)
                     , NVL(gyulaf_ggijun_ga,0)
                     , NVL(gyulbf_gijun_ga,0)
                     , NVL(gyulbf_ggijun_ga,0)
                  INTO w_gicho_gijun_ga
                     , w_gicho_ggijun_ga
                     , w_gyul_gijun_ga
                     , w_gyul_ggijun_ga
                  FROM SKT0GS t1  /* 결산실적 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.gyul_ymd = xx.bf_gyul_ymd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                w_gicho_gijun_ga  := 1000;
                w_gicho_ggijun_ga := 1000;
                w_gyul_gijun_ga   := NULL;
                w_gyul_ggijun_ga  := NULL;
            END;

            -- 실현수익율...
            if  w_gicho_gijun_ga * w_kungwa_ilsu = 0    then
                    w_silhyn_suik_rt := 0;
            ELSE    w_silhyn_suik_rt := ROUND((xx.D0101 - w_A0402) / w_pj, 6);
            end if;

            -- 채권/현금 가중평균 수익률 계산
            SELECT NVL(SUM((NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0) + msd_meib_aekm - msd_medo_aekm) * t1.bany_suik_rt),0)
                 , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0) + msd_meib_aekm - msd_medo_aekm),0)
              INTO w_bond_suik_rt
                 , w_bond_suik_aekm
              FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

            SELECT NVL(SUM((NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)) * t3.meib_suik_rt),0)
                 , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)),0)
              INTO w_cash_suik_rt
                 , w_cash_suik_aekm
              FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
                 , SHM0HJ t3  /* 현금 종목정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
               AND t3.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
               AND t3.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd;

            if (w_bond_suik_aekm + w_cash_suik_aekm) = 0    then
                    w_bc_suik_rt := 0;
            ELSE    w_bc_suik_rt := (w_bond_suik_rt + w_cash_suik_rt) / (w_bond_suik_aekm + w_cash_suik_aekm);
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 기준가 Table Insert...
        INSERT INTO SKT0GI tt   /* 펀드별 기준가 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr          /* _1- */
               , p_ymd              /* _2- */
               , xx.fund_cd         /* _3- */
               , 'B'                /* _4- */
               , xx.gijun_ga        /* _5- */
               , xx.gijun_ga_dr     /* _6- */
               , xx.gijun_ga2       /* _7- */
               , w_gicho_gijun_ga   /* _8- */
               , w_gyul_gijun_ga    /* _9- */
               , w_gyul_ggijun_ga   /* _10- */
               , xx.ggijun_ga       /* _11- */
               , xx.ggijun_ga_dr    /* _12- */
               , xx.ggijun_ga2      /* _13- */
               , w_gicho_ggijun_ga  /* _14- */
               , w_kosp_jisu        /* _15- */
               , w_silhyn_suik_rt   /* _16- */
               , w_bond_rt          /* _17- */
               , w_cash_rt          /* _18- */
               , w_stock_rt         /* _19- */
               , w_suik_stock_rt    /* _20- */
               , w_A0402            /* _21- */
               , xx.D0101           /* _22- */
               , w_bc_suik_rt       /* _23- */
               , w_stock_rt1        /* _24- */
               , 0                  /* _25- */
               , 0                  /* _26- */
               , 0                  /* _27- */
               , xx.fund_currency   /* _28- */
               , TRUNC(w_pj)        /* _29- */
               );
    end loop;
    COMMIT;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0790 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
 ) AS
-- 결산실적 Update...
--
    w_inchul_ymd                   DATE;

    w_gyulbf_gijun_ga              NUMBER;  /* 결산전... */
    w_gyulaf_gijun_ga              NUMBER;  /* 결산후... */
    G325                           NUMBER;  /* 미지급이익분배금 */
    w_A0402                        NUMBER;  /* 계약잔액 */
    w_tsusu                        NUMBER;
    w_io_count                     NUMBER;

    w_tuja_aek                     NUMBER;
    w_basic_bosu                   NUMBER;
    w_success_bosu                 NUMBER;
    w_sonik                        NUMBER;
    w_bm_aek                       NUMBER;
    w_success_aek                  NUMBER;
    w_wm_seolj_aek                 NUMBER;
    w_wm_sonik                     NUMBER;
    w_wm_bosu                      NUMBER;

    w_product_nm                   SKT1GS_INDATA.PRODUCT_NM%type;
    w_send_cc_addr                 SKT1GS_INDATA.SEND_CC_ADDR%type;

    w_mrd_nm                       VARCHAR (40);
    w_bm_text                      VARCHAR (1200);
    w_contract_condition           VARCHAR (2000);
    w_success1                     VARCHAR (400);
    w_success2                     VARCHAR (400);
    w_wm_text                      VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0790', p_ymd || ' : 결산실적 Update');

    DELETE FROM SKT0GS tt   /* 결산실적 */
     WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND gyul_ymd = p_ymd;

    -- 결산내역 메일발송자료 삭제제외
    DELETE FROM SKT1GS_IO tt    /* 결산실정(입출금현황) */
     WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND gyul_ymd = p_ymd;

    DELETE FROM SKT1GS tt   /* 결산실적 */
     WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND gyul_ymd = p_ymd
       AND fund_cd  IN (SELECT fund_cd
                          FROM SKT1GS_INDATA ta  /* 결산실적(변경자료 입력관리) */
                         WHERE ta.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                           AND ta.gyul_ymd = p_ymd
                           AND ta.send_dt IS NULL);

    DELETE FROM SKT1GS_INDATA tt    /* 결산실적(변경자료 입력관리) */
     WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND gyul_ymd = p_ymd
       AND send_dt IS NULL;


    w_inchul_ymd := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd, '+1');
    for xx IN (
        SELECT ia.FUND_CD                                               /* _1-펀드코드 */
             , ia.FUND_CURRENCY                                         /* _2- */
             , NVL(ia.PRE_BASIC,0)                   AS pre_basic       /* _3- */
             , NVL(ia.BASIC_PER,0)                   AS basic_per       /* _4- */
             , NVL(ia.BM_PER,0)                      AS bm_per          /* _5- */
             , NVL(ia.SUCCESS_PER,0)                 AS success_per     /* _6- */
             , ia.SERIES_GB                                             /* _7- */
             , ia.EMAIL1                             AS send_mail_addr  /* _8- */
             , t1.SUN_JASAN_AEK                      AS NAV             /* _9-일임순자산액 */
             , t1.BOND_RT                                               /* _10-채권운용비율 */
             , t1.CASH_RT                                               /* _11-현금자산운용비율 */
             , t1.STOCK_RT                                              /* _12-주식운용비율 */
             , t1.STOCK_AVG_RT                                          /* _13-좌수가중평균(결산기)주식편입비율 */
             , t1.KOSPI_JISU                                            /* _14-종합주가지수 */
             , t1.SEOLJ_JWA                                             /* _15-원본좌수 */
             , t1.TUJA_PJ_AEK                                           /* _16-평잔 */
             , gi.BF_GYUL_YMD                                           /* _17-전결산일 */
             , gi.GYUL_GI                                               /* _18-결산기 */
             , gi.HAEJI_YMD                                             /* _19- */
             , NVL(gi.INCHUL_YMD, w_inchul_ymd)      AS inchul_ymd      /* _20- */
             , '+' || TRIM (TO_CHAR(aa.DEPOSIT_DD))  AS deposit_dd      /* _21- */
             , aa.DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT                                       /* _22- */
             , ia.SINTAK_GIGAN                                          /* _23- */
             , ia.BOSU_GIGAN                                            /* _24- */
             , ia.TARGET_JASAN                                          /* _25- */
          FROM SKT0GI t1  /* 펀드별 기준가 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
             , SZX0AA aa  /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                            = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                                = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb                            = 'A'
           AND ia.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND gi.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd                            = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(gi.haeji_ymd - 1, gi.af_gyul_ymd) = p_ymd
           AND p_ymd                                 BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
           AND aa.corp_gr                            = t1.corp_gr
    ) loop
        SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='D0103' AND work_gb='A' THEN F_JAN (chadae_gb, junj, dr_aek, cr_aek) END),0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='D0103' AND work_gb='B' THEN F_JAN (chadae_gb, junj, dr_aek, cr_aek) END),0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='90120' AND work_gb='A' THEN F_JAN (chadae_gb, junj, dr_aek, cr_aek) END),0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='A0402' AND work_gb='A' THEN F_JAN (chadae_gb, junj, dr_aek, cr_aek) END),0)
          INTO w_gyulbf_gijun_ga
             , w_gyulaf_gijun_ga
             , w_tsusu
             , w_A0402
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.gwamok        IN ('D0103','90120','A0402')
           AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;

        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(wm_seolj_aek,0)
                 , NVL(wm_sonik,0)
              INTO w_wm_seolj_aek
                 , w_wm_sonik
              FROM SKT1GS_INDATA t1  /* 결산실적 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.gyul_ymd = p_ymd;
            if  w_wm_seolj_aek = 0  then
                    w_wm_text := '';
            else    w_wm_text := ' (성과수수료 워터마크 : \' || F_NTRIM (w_wm_seolj_aek) || '-)';
            end if;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL(wm_seolj_aek,0)
                     , NVL(wm_sonik,0)
                  INTO w_wm_seolj_aek
                     , w_wm_sonik
                  FROM SKT1GS_INDATA t1  /* 결산실적 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.gyul_ymd = xx.bf_gyul_ymd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                w_wm_seolj_aek := 0;
                w_wm_sonik     := 0;
                w_wm_text      := '';
            END;
        END;

        -- 인출일 계산용 경과 영업일
        w_io_count := 0;
        w_tuja_aek := 0;
        w_bm_text  := '기준지표수익 : ';
        FOR io IN (
            SELECT TO_CHAR (t1.tr_ymd,'yyyy.mm.dd')                                   AS io_ymd      /* _1- */
                 , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.in_aek,0)=0 AND NVL(t1.out_aek,0)=0
                        THEN t1.wonbon_aek
                        ELSE NVL(t1.in_aek,0) - NVL(t1.out_aek,0)
                   END                                                                AS aek         /* _2- */
                 , F_NTRIM (CASE WHEN NVL(t1.in_aek,0)=0 AND NVL(t1.out_aek,0)=0
                                 THEN t1.wonbon_aek
                                 ELSE NVL(t1.in_aek,0) - NVL(t1.out_aek,0) END,14,0)  AS aek_str     /* _3- */
                 , p_ymd - t1.tr_ymd + 1                                              AS gigan_ilsu  /* _4-(미)운용일수 */
                 , t1.tr_ymd - xx.bf_gyul_ymd                                         AS pass_ilsu   /* _5-경과일수 */
              FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd  BETWEEN (xx.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND p_ymd
             ORDER BY tr_ymd ASC
        ) loop
            w_tuja_aek := w_tuja_aek + io.aek;
            w_io_count := w_io_count + 1;

            if  xx.bm_per > 0   THEN
                if  io.aek < 0  THEN
                    if  w_bm_text <> '기준지표수익 : '    then  w_bm_text := w_bm_text || ' - ';
                    end if;
                    w_bm_text := w_bm_text || '(' || F_NTRIM (io.aek * -1) || ' * ' || TO_CHAR (xx.bm_per) || '%)';
                ELSE
                    if  w_bm_text <> '기준지표수익 : '    then  w_bm_text := w_bm_text || ' + ';
                    end if;
                    w_bm_text := w_bm_text || '(' || F_NTRIM (io.aek) || ' * ' || TO_CHAR (xx.bm_per) || '%)';
                end if;
            end if;

            INSERT INTO SKT1GS_IO tt    /* 결산실정(입출금현황) */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr      /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd          /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd     /* _3- */
                   , w_io_count     /* _4- */
                   , '\' || io.aek_str || '- : '
                         || io.io_ymd || ' - ' || TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy"년" mm"월" dd"일"')
                         || CASE WHEN io.gigan_ilsu >= 365 THEN ''
                                                           ELSE ' (' || F_NTRIM(io.gigan_ilsu,3) || '일)'
                            END     /* _5- */
                   , io.aek         /* _6- */
                   , io.gigan_ilsu  /* _7- */
                   , io.pass_ilsu   /* _8- */
                   );
        end loop;
        if  w_io_count = 1  THEN
            UPDATE SKT1GS_IO tt     /* 결산실정(입출금현황) */
               SET gigan_str = TO_CHAR(xx.bf_gyul_ymd + 1, 'yyyy"년" mm"월" dd"일"') || ' - ' || TO_CHAR(p_ymd, 'yyyy"년" mm"월" dd"일"')
                                                                                     || ' (' || F_NTRIM(gigan_ilsu, 3) || '일)'
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND gyul_ymd = p_ymd
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND seq_no   = 1;
        end if;

        if (xx.NAV - w_A0402) < 0   THEN
            if  w_wm_seolj_aek = 0      THEN
                -- 신규 손실 발생시 워터마크 적용 투자액 산정
                w_wm_seolj_aek := w_tuja_aek;
                w_wm_sonik     := xx.NAV - w_A0402;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 기본보수만 있는 경우 워터마크 미적용 20250227
        if  xx.success_per = 0  then    w_wm_seolj_aek := 0;
        end if;

        -- 손실발생시 전기 성과보수조정용 워터마크 원본액 승계
        UPDATE SZM0GI tt    /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
           SET GI_SONIK_AEK = ROUND(xx.NAV - w_A0402)
             , WM_SEOLJ_AEK = w_wm_seolj_aek
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND gyul_gi = xx.gyul_gi;

        -- 미지급이익분배금
        G325 := xx.NAV - w_A0402;

        -- 결산실적 Update...
        INSERT INTO SKT0GS tt   /* 결산실적 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr            /* _1- */
               , p_ymd                /* _2- */
               , xx.inchul_ymd        /* _3- */
               , xx.fund_cd           /* _4- */
               , xx.bf_gyul_ymd       /* _5- */
               , xx.gyul_gi           /* _6- */
               , w_gyulbf_gijun_ga    /* _7- */
               , NULL                 /* _8- */
               , xx.seolj_jwa         /* _9- */
               , G325                 /* _10- */
               , G325 / xx.seolj_jwa  /* _11- */
               , G325 / xx.seolj_jwa  /* _12- */
               , w_gyulaf_gijun_ga    /* _13- */
               , NULL                 /* _14- */
               , xx.kospi_jisu        /* _15- */
               , xx.stock_rt          /* _16- */
               , xx.bond_rt           /* _17- */
               , xx.cash_rt           /* _18- */
               , xx.stock_avg_rt      /* _19-좌수가중평균(결산기)주식편입비 */
               , xx.NAV               /* _20-일임순자산액 */
               , xx.fund_currency     /* _21- */
               , xx.seolj_jwa         /* _22- */
               , xx.NAV               /* _23-재투자액 */
               , w_tsusu              /* _24-인출보수 */
               , NULL                 /* _25- */
               , w_wm_seolj_aek       /* _26-워터마크대상투자일임액 */
               , w_wm_sonik           /* _27-워터마크대상손익액 */
               , xx.sintak_gigan      /* _28- */
               , xx.bosu_gigan        /* _29- */
               , xx.basic_per         /* _30- */
               , xx.bm_per            /* _31- */
               , xx.success_per       /* _32- */
               , xx.target_jasan      /* _33- */
               , xx.pre_basic         /* _34- */
               );

        if  p_corp_gr = '2202' AND xx.fund_cd = '1913'  THEN
            -- 이언투자자문 차등보수 계산으로 계정으로 계산된 보수금액 사용
            SELECT NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0)
              INTO w_basic_bosu
              FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND ymd           = p_ymd
               AND work_gb       = 'A'
               AND fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND gwamok        = '90120'
               AND fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;
        ELSE
            if  p_corp_gr IN ('2202')   THEN
                    w_basic_bosu := TRUNC (xx.tuja_pj_aek * xx.basic_per / 100, -3);  /* 1,000원미만 절사 */
            else    w_basic_bosu := TRUNC (xx.tuja_pj_aek * xx.basic_per / 100, -4);  /* 10,000원미만 절사 */
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 워터마크 설정액 적용 성과보수 보정액
        w_wm_bosu := TRUNC ((w_wm_sonik * -1) * xx.success_per / 100);
        w_sonik   := xx.NAV - w_tuja_aek;

        if  xx.bm_per > 0   THEN
            w_bm_aek := TRUNC (xx.tuja_pj_aek * xx.bm_per / 100);
            if  w_io_count = 1  THEN
                w_bm_text := '기준지표수익 : ' || F_NTRIM (xx.tuja_pj_aek) || ' * ' || TO_CHAR (xx.bm_per) || '% = ' || F_NTRIM (w_bm_aek) || '원';
            ELSE
                w_bm_text := w_bm_text || ' = ' || F_NTRIM (w_bm_aek) || '원';
            end if;
            if (w_sonik - w_bm_aek) > 0     THEN
                    w_success1 := '기준지표수익초과분 : ' || F_NTRIM (w_sonik) || ' - ' || F_NTRIM (w_bm_aek) || ' = ' || F_NTRIM (w_sonik - w_bm_aek) || '원';
            else    w_success1 := '기준지표수익초과분 : \0-';
            end if;
        ELSE
            w_bm_aek   := 0;
            w_bm_text  := NULL;
            w_success1 := NULL;
        end if;
        if  xx.success_per = 0  THEN
            w_mrd_nm    := CASE w_io_count WHEN 1 THEN 'RD_JA010M31_' || p_corp_gr || '.mrd'
                                                  ELSE 'RD_JA010M32_' || p_corp_gr || '.mrd' END;
            w_wm_bosu      := 0;
            w_wm_seolj_aek := 0;
            w_wm_sonik     := 0;
            w_success_aek  := 0;
            w_success_bosu := 0;
            w_success2     := NULL;
            w_wm_text      := NULL;
        ELSE
            w_mrd_nm    := CASE w_io_count WHEN 1 THEN 'RD_JA010M3A_' || p_corp_gr || '.mrd'
                                                  ELSE 'RD_JA010M3B_' || p_corp_gr || '.mrd' END;
            w_success_aek := w_sonik - w_bm_aek;
            if  w_success_aek < 0   THEN
                w_wm_bosu      := 0;
                w_success_bosu := 0;
                w_success2     := NULL;
            ELSE
                if  w_wm_bosu != 0  THEN
                    if  p_corp_gr IN ('2202')   THEN
                            w_success_bosu := TRUNC (w_success_aek * xx.success_per / 100, -3);  /* 1,000원미만 절사 */
                    else    w_success_bosu := TRUNC (w_success_aek * xx.success_per / 100, -4);  /* 10,000원미만 절사 */
                    end if;
                    w_success2  := '성과수수료 : ' || F_NTRIM (w_success_aek) || ' * ' || xx.success_per || '% = ' || F_NTRIM (w_success_bosu) || '(당기) - ( '
                                                   || F_NTRIM (w_wm_sonik * -1) || '(전기손실액) * ' || xx.success_per || '% = ' || F_NTRIM (w_wm_bosu) || '원 )';
                    w_wm_seolj_aek := 0;
                    w_wm_sonik     := 0;
                else
                    if  p_corp_gr IN ('2202')   then
                            w_success_bosu := TRUNC (w_success_aek * xx.success_per / 100, -3);  /* 1,000원미만 절사 */
                    else    w_success_bosu := TRUNC (w_success_aek * xx.success_per / 100, -4);  /* 10,000원미만 절사 */
                    end if;
                    w_success2 := '성과수수료 : ' || F_NTRIM (w_success_aek) || ' * ' || xx.success_per || '% = ' || F_NTRIM(w_success_bosu) || '원';
                end if;
            end if;
        end if;

        if  p_corp_gr = '2402'  then
            -- 리코자산운용 양식
            if (xx.haeji_ymd - 1) = p_ymd   then
                    w_mrd_nm := 'RD_JA010M3_' || p_corp_gr || 'A.mrd';
            else    w_mrd_nm := 'RD_JA010M3_' || p_corp_gr || '.mrd';
            end if;

            w_wm_bosu  := 0;
            w_success1 := NULL;
            w_success2 := NULL;

            SELECT tb.COMMISSION
              INTO w_success_bosu
              FROM SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
                 , TABLE(F_COMMISSION (ia.CORP_GR,ia.FUND_CD,TO_CHAR (NVL(gi.haeji_ymd - 1,gi.af_gyul_ymd),'yyyymmdd'))) tb
             WHERE ia.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND gi.CORP_GR = ia.CORP_GR
               AND gi.FUND_CD = ia.FUND_CD
               AND p_ymd      BETWEEN gi.BF_GYUL_YMD + 1 AND gi.AF_GYUL_YMD
               AND tb.FUND_CD = ia.FUND_CD;
        end if;

        BEGIN
            SELECT series_nm
              INTO w_product_nm
              FROM SZX0SE t1  /* 시리즈구분 */
             WHERE t1.CORP_GR   = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.series_gb = xx.series_gb;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_product_nm := '';
        END;

        -- 출력용 결산내용 생성
        MERGE INTO SKT1GS t1  /* 결산실적 */
           USING DUAL ON ( t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                       AND t1.gyul_ymd = p_ymd
                       AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
             UPDATE
                SET mrd_nm          = w_mrd_nm
                  , TUJA_AEK        = w_tuja_aek
                  , TUJA_PJ         = xx.tuja_pj_aek
                  , NAV             = xx.NAV
                  , SONIK           = w_sonik
                  , IO_COUNT        = w_io_count
                  , DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT = xx.DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT
                  , CONTRACT_AEK    = xx.seolj_jwa
                  , RECONTRACT_AEK  = xx.NAV
                  , PJ_SUIK_PER     = TRUNC(w_sonik / xx.tuja_pj_aek * 100,6)
                  , WM_SEOLJ_AEK    = w_wm_seolj_aek
                  , WM_SONIK        = w_wm_sonik
                  , BM_TEXT         = w_bm_text
                  , SUCCESS1        = w_success1
                  , SUCCESS2        = w_success2
                  , WM_TEXT         = w_wm_text
                  , PRE_BASIC       = xx.pre_basic
                  , BASIC_PER       = xx.basic_per
                  , BM_PER          = xx.bm_per
                  , SUCCESS_PER     = xx.success_per
                  , BASIC_BOSU      = w_basic_bosu
                  , SUCCESS_BOSU    = w_success_bosu - w_wm_bosu
                  , TOTAL_BOSU      = w_basic_bosu + w_success_bosu - w_wm_bosu
                  , PRODUCT_NM      = w_product_nm
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
             INSERT
             VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                /* _1- */
                    , p_ymd                                    /* _2- */
                    , xx.fund_cd                               /* _3- */
                    , w_mrd_nm                                 /* _4- */
                    , xx.bf_gyul_ymd                           /* _5- */
                    , p_ymd                                    /* _6- */
                    , p_ymd - xx.bf_gyul_ymd                   /* _7- */
                    , TO_CHAR(F_TRADE_YMD (p_ymd,xx.DEPOSIT_DD),'yyyy"년" mm"월" dd"일"')
                             || '(계약만료일로부터 ' || SUBSTR(xx.DEPOSIT_DD,2)
                             || '영업일)'                      /* _8- */
                    , w_tuja_aek                               /* _9-평잔 */
                    , xx.tuja_pj_aek                           /* _10-평잔 */
                    , xx.NAV                                   /* _11-일임순자산액 */
                    , w_sonik                                  /* _12-손익액 */
                    , w_io_count                               /* _13- */
                    , NULL                                     /* _14- */
                    , w_product_nm                             /* _15- */
                    , xx.DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT                       /* _16- */
                    , NULL                                     /* _17- */
                    , NULL                                     /* _18- */
                    , NULL                                     /* _19- */
                    , NULL                                     /* _20- */
                    , xx.seolj_jwa                             /* _21- */
                    , xx.NAV                                   /* _22-재투자액 */
                    , TRUNC(w_sonik / xx.tuja_pj_aek * 100,6)  /* _23- */
                    , w_wm_seolj_aek                           /* _24-워터마크대상투자일임액 */
                    , w_wm_sonik                               /* _25-워터마크대상손익액 */
                    , xx.basic_per                             /* _26- */
                    , xx.bm_per                                /* _27- */
                    , xx.success_per                           /* _28- */
                    , w_basic_bosu                             /* _29- */
                    , w_success_bosu - w_wm_bosu               /* _30- */
                    , w_basic_bosu + w_success_bosu
                                   - w_wm_bosu                 /* _31- */
                    , w_bm_text                                /* _32- */
                    , w_success1                               /* _33- */
                    , w_success2                               /* _34- */
                    , w_wm_text                                /* _35- */
                    , NULL                                     /* _36- */
                    , xx.pre_basic                             /* _37- */
                    );

        BEGIN
            BEGIN
                SELECT PRODUCT_NM
                     , SEND_MAIL_ADDR
                     , SEND_CC_ADDR
                     , CONTRACT_CONDITION
                  INTO w_product_nm
                     , xx.send_mail_addr
                     , w_send_cc_addr
                     , w_contract_condition
                  FROM SKT1GS_INDATA t1  /* 결산실적(변경자료 입력관리) */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.gyul_ymd = (SELECT MAX(gyul_ymd)
                                        FROM SKT1GS_INDATA ta  /* 결산실적(변경자료 입력관리) */
                                       WHERE ta.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                                         AND ta.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
                                         AND ta.gyul_ymd < p_ymd);
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                w_send_cc_addr := NULL;
            END;

            INSERT INTO SKT1GS_INDATA   /* 결산실적(변경자료 입력관리) */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                                    /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                               /* _3- */
                   , xx.gyul_gi                               /* _4- */
                   , w_mrd_nm                                 /* _5- */
                   , w_tuja_aek                               /* _6-평잔 */
                   , xx.tuja_pj_aek                           /* _7-평잔 */
                   , xx.NAV                                   /* _8-일임순자산액 */
                   , w_sonik                                  /* _9-손익액 */
                   , NULL                                     /* _10- */
                   , w_product_nm                             /* _11- */
                   , xx.DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT                       /* _12- */
                   , xx.send_mail_addr                        /* _13- */
                   , w_send_cc_addr                           /* _14- */
                   , NULL                                     /* _15- */
                   , NULL                                     /* _16- */
                   , xx.NAV                                   /* _17- */
                   , TRUNC(w_sonik / xx.tuja_pj_aek * 100,6)  /* _18- */
                   , w_wm_seolj_aek                           /* _19-워터마크대상투자일임액 */
                   , w_wm_sonik                               /* _20-워터마크대상손익액 */
                   , w_basic_bosu                             /* _21- */
                   , w_success_bosu - w_wm_bosu               /* _22- */
                   , w_basic_bosu + w_success_bosu
                                  - w_wm_bosu                 /* _23- */
                   , w_contract_condition                     /* _24- */
                   , NULL                                     /* _25- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            -- SKT1GS_INDATA 자료는 메일 발송자료이므로 재생성시 유지 후 화면에서 정정처리 할 것.
            NULL;
        END;
    end loop;

    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0791 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
 ) AS
-- 총계정원장 정리
--
    w_cnt                          NUMBER;
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
     WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd           = p_ymd
       AND NVL(junj,0)   = 0
       AND NVL(dr_aek,0) = 0
       AND NVL(cr_aek,0) = 0
       AND gwamok        NOT IN ('10101','90102','90104','90106','90107','D0102','D0103','D0202','D0203','D0204','D0205');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.gwamok         /* _1- */
             , t1.gwamok_gb      /* _2- */
             , dt.ymd            /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_cd        /* _4- */
             , ia.fund_currency  /* _5- */
          FROM SZX0GM t1  /* 계정과목 */
             , SZX9DT dt  /* 작업일자 Between조건용 일자 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.gwamok_gb              != '9'
           AND t1.inp_gb                 IN ('2','3')
           AND dt.ymd                    = p_ymd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, dt.ymd) >= dt.ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr                = p_corp_gr
    ) loop
        SELECT COUNT (*)
          INTO w_cnt
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd           = xx.ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok        = xx.gwamok
           AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;
        if  w_cnt = 0   then
            SELECT COUNT (*)
              INTO w_cnt
              FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd           = xx.ymd
               AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
