               AND t1.gwamok        IN (SELECT ta.gwamok
                                          FROM SZX0CC ta  /* 계정 계산식 */
                                             , SZX0GM gm  /* 계정과목 */
                                         WHERE ta.hab_gwamok = xx.gwamok
                                           AND gm.gwamok_gb  != '9'
                                           AND gm.gwamok     = ta.gwamok)
               AND (NVL(t1.junj,0) != 0 OR NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) != 0 OR NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) != 0)
               AND t1.fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;

            if  w_cnt > 0   then
                INSERT INTO SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr          /* _1- */
                       , xx.ymd             /* _2- */
                       , 'A'                /* _3- */
                       , xx.fund_cd         /* _4- */
                       , xx.gwamok          /* _5- */
                       , CASE WHEN xx.gwamok_gb IN ('1','4')
                              THEN 'D'
                              ELSE 'C' END  /* _6- */
                       , 0                  /* _7- */
                       , 0                  /* _8- */
                       , 0                  /* _9- */
                       , xx.fund_currency   /* _10- */
                       );
            end if;
        end if;
    end loop;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0799 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
 ) AS
-- (결산연결) 취득액 처리
--
BEGIN
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                               /* _1- */
             , NVL(bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(up_jusu,0)                AS jusu          /* _2- */
             , NVL(cons_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(up_chui_aek,0)
                                         + NVL(gongs_up_chui_aek,0)  AS aek           /* _3- */
             , NVL(dw_jusu,0) + NVL(gongs_dw_jusu,0)                 AS dw_jusu       /* _4- */
             , CASE WHEN NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0)=NVL(cons_bfil_chui_aek,0)
                    THEN NVL(dw_chui_aek,0) + NVL(gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)
                    ELSE 0 END                                       AS dw_chui_aek   /* _5- */
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND NVL(dw_jusu,0) + NVL(gongs_dw_jusu,0) != 0
    ) loop
        if  xx.dw_chui_aek = 0  then
            UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
               SET cons_dw_chui_aek = CASE WHEN xx.jusu=0 THEN 0 ELSE TRUNC (xx.aek / xx.jusu * xx.dw_jusu) END
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        else
            UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
               SET cons_dw_chui_aek = xx.dw_chui_aek
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        end if;
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                    /* _1- */
             , NVL(bfil_jwa,0) + NVL(up_jwa,0)            AS jwa           /* _2- */
             , NVL(cons_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(up_aek,0)  AS aek           /* _3- */
             , dw_jwa                                                      /* _4- */
             , CASE WHEN NVL(bfil_aek,0)=NVL(cons_bfil_chui_aek,0)
                    THEN NVL(dw_aek,0)
                    ELSE 0 END                            AS dw_chui_aek   /* _5- */
          FROM SJM5SM t1  /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.dw_jwa  != 0
    ) loop
        if  xx.dw_chui_aek = 0  then
            UPDATE SJM5SM tt    /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
               SET cons_dw_chui_aek = TRUNC (xx.aek / xx.jwa * xx.dw_jwa)
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        else
            UPDATE SJM5SM tt    /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
               SET cons_dw_chui_aek = xx.dw_chui_aek
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        end if;
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                      /* _1- */
             , NVL(bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(meib_aekm,0)          AS aekm          /* _2- */
             , NVL(cons_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(meib_aek,0)  AS aek           /* _3- */
             , medo_aekm                                                     /* _4- */
             , CASE WHEN NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0)=NVL(cons_bfil_chui_aek,0)
                    THEN NVL(medo_aekm,0)
                    ELSE 0
               END                                          AS dw_chui_aek   /* _5- */
          FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd       = p_ymd
           AND t1.medo_aekm != 0
    ) loop
        if  xx.dw_chui_aek = 0  then
            UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
               SET cons_medo_aek = TRUNC (xx.aek / xx.aekm * xx.medo_aekm)
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        else
            UPDATE SHM0HM tt    /* 현금 보유현황 */
               SET cons_medo_aek = xx.dw_chui_aek
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        end if;
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                      /* _1- */
             , NVL(bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(meib_aekm,0)          AS aekm          /* _2- */
             , NVL(cons_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(meib_aek,0)  AS aek           /* _3- */
             , medo_aekm                                                     /* _4- */
             , CASE WHEN NVL(bfil_chui_aek,0)=NVL(cons_bfil_chui_aek,0)
                    THEN NVL(medo_aekm,0)
                    ELSE 0 END                              AS dw_chui_aek   /* _5- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd       = p_ymd
           AND t1.medo_aekm != 0
    ) loop
        if  xx.dw_chui_aek = 0  then
            UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
               SET cons_medo_aek = TRUNC (xx.aek / xx.aekm * xx.medo_aekm)
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        else
            UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
               SET cons_medo_aek = xx.dw_chui_aek
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        end if;
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                        /* _1- */
             , NVL(pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(up_gyey_su,0)        AS su            /* _2- */
             , NVL(cons_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(up_chui_ga,0)  AS aek           /* _3- */
             , dw_gyey_su                                                      /* _4- */
             , CASE WHEN NVL(pass_chui_ga,0)=NVL(cons_bfil_chui_aek,0)
                    THEN dw_chui_ga
                    ELSE 0
               END                                            AS dw_chui_aek   /* _5- */
          FROM SSM0KM t1  /* 파생 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND t1.dw_gyey_su != 0
    ) loop
        if  xx.dw_chui_aek = 0  then
            UPDATE SSM0KM tt    /* 파생 보유현황 */
               SET cons_dw_chui_aek = TRUNC (xx.aek / xx.su * xx.dw_gyey_su)
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        else
            UPDATE SSM0KM tt    /* 파생 보유현황 */
               SET cons_dw_chui_aek = xx.dw_chui_aek
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        end if;
    end loop;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0800 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 정보계 신탁재산운용현황 생성
--
    w_bond_s_b                     NUMBER;  /* 채권+전단채 합계 */
    w_bond_b                       NUMBER;  /* 채권합계 */
    w_bond_a                       NUMBER;  /* A등급 채권 */
    w_bond_s                       NUMBER;  /* 전단채합계 */
    w_bond_s_a2                    NUMBER;  /* 전단채합계(A2등급) */
    w_bond_under                   NUMBER;
    w_cash                         NUMBER;  /* 예금합계 */
    w_sj                           NUMBER;  /* 수익증권 */
    w_ex_sj                        NUMBER;  /* 비율산정제외 수익증권 */
    w_hm                           NUMBER;  /* 현금자산 */
    w_stock_tot                    NUMBER;
    w_stock_a                      NUMBER;
    w_stock_c                      NUMBER;
    w_stock_d                      NUMBER;
    w_stock_gongmo                 NUMBER;  /* 공모주식 */
    w_venture                      NUMBER;
BEGIN
    -- 수요예측 자료생성
    DELETE FROM UZM0HY tt   /* 계좌별 수요예측 집계자료 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd
       AND ip_user = 'PROC0800';

    -- 생성처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                /* _1- */
             , t1.seolj_jwa             AS invest_amt    /* _2- */
             , t1.sun_jasan_aek         AS nav           /* _3- */
             , t1.ymd - gi.bf_gyul_ymd  AS pass_day      /* _4-경과일수 */
             , gi.bf_gyul_ymd                            /* _5- */
             , CASE WHEN gi.haeji_ymd IS NOT NULL
                    THEN gi.haeji_ymd - 1
                    ELSE gi.af_gyul_ymd
               END                      AS af_gyul_ymd   /* _6- */
             , se.gugan                                  /* _7- */
          FROM SKT0GI t1  /* 펀드별 기준가 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZX0SE se  /* 시리즈구분 */
             , SZM0GI gi  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd   NOT IN (SELECT fund_cd
                                      FROM UZM0HY ta  /* 계좌별 수요예측 집계자료 */
                                     WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                       AND ta.ymd     = p_ymd)
           AND t1.ymd       = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb   = 'A'
           AND ia.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd   = t1.fund_cd
           AND se.corp_gr   = ia.corp_gr
           AND se.series_gb = ia.series_gb
           AND gi.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd   = ia.fund_cd
           AND p_ymd        BETWEEN (gi.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND gi.af_gyul_ymd
    ) loop
        SELECT NVL(SUM(t1.siga_aek),0)
          INTO w_bond_b
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

        SELECT NVL(SUM(t1.siga_aek),0)
          INTO w_bond_under
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SCM1J  j1  /* 채권 매수 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND j1.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND j1.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
           AND j1.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
           AND j1.pg_cd    BETWEEN '0210' AND '0330'
           AND j1.buy_date = t1.buy_date;

        w_bond_a := w_bond_b - w_bond_under;

        SELECT NVL(SUM(t1.siga_aek),0)
          INTO w_bond_s_a2
          FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
             , SHM0HJ hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND hj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND hj.cash_cd IN ('ZS','ZF')
           AND hj.pg_cd   BETWEEN '0110' AND '0123';

        SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t3.cash_cd IN ('ZS','ZF')          THEN t1.siga_aek END),0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t3.cash_cd='90'                    THEN t1.pyunga_aek END),0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t3.cash_cd NOT IN ('90','ZS','ZF') THEN t1.siga_aek END),0)
          INTO w_bond_s
             , w_cash
             , w_hm
          FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
             , SHM0HJ t3  /* 현금 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = F_OPEN_YMD(p_ymd,'-')
           AND t3.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd;

        -- 전단우량채 차감처리 20240904
        w_bond_s := NVL (w_bond_s,0) - NVL (w_bond_s_a2,0);

        -- 미수입금,미지급금,대여금 처리
        SELECT w_hm + NVL(SUM(siga_aek),0)
          INTO w_hm
          FROM UZM0UI t1  /* 정보계 신탁재산 명세부 */
             , SZX0GM gm  /* 계정과목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_gr   = '2'
           AND gm.gwamok  = t1.jm_cd;

        SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(BFIL_AEK,0) + NVL(UP_AEK,0) - NVL (DW_AEK,0) + NVL(SONIK,0)),0)
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(NAV_TARGET_YN,'Y')='N'
                            THEN NVL(BFIL_AEK,0) + NVL(UP_AEK,0) - NVL(DW_AEK,0) + NVL(SONIK,0) END),0)
          INTO w_sj
             , w_ex_sj
          FROM SJM5SM t1  /* 타사 집합투자증권 보유현황 */
             , SJM0SC sc  /* 타사집합투자증권 정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND sc.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND sc.TASA_JM_CD = t1.TASA_JM_CD;

        /* 채권합계 = 채권 + 전단채(비우량 + 우량) */
        w_bond_s_b := NVL (w_bond_b,0) + NVL (w_bond_s,0) + NVL (w_bond_s_a2,0);

        /* 주식 */
        SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                            + NVL(GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(GONGS_DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                            + NVL(SONIK,0)),0)  /* _1- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN DANC_GB IN ('A','G')
                            THEN NVL(BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                                      + NVL(GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(GONGS_DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                                      + NVL(SONIK,0)
                       END),0)                                  /* _2- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN DANC_GB='C'
                            THEN NVL(BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                                      + NVL(GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(GONGS_DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                                      + NVL(SONIK,0)
                       END),0)                                  /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN DANC_GB='D'
                            THEN NVL(BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                                      + NVL(GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(GONGS_DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                                      + NVL(SONIK,0)
                       END),0)                                  /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.venture_type IN ('A','B')
                            THEN NVL(BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                                      + NVL(GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(GONGS_DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                                      + NVL(SONIK,0)
                       END),0)                                  /* _5- */
          INTO w_stock_tot  /* _1- */
             , w_stock_a    /* _2- */
             , w_stock_c    /* _3- */
             , w_stock_d    /* _4- */
             , w_venture    /* _5- */
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

        -- 벤쳐 채권처리
        SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.venture_type IN ('A','B')
                            THEN t1.siga_aek
                            ELSE 0
                       END),0) + w_venture
          INTO w_venture
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND cj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND cj.bond_cd IN ('5','6','7');

        -- 수익증권 미포함 (리코 계산대상 제외자산으로 현재 합산하지 않고 있음)
        -- 리틴 확정 필요(NAV_TARGET_YN = 'N') 자사 처리필요

        INSERT INTO UZM0HY tt   /* 계좌별 수요예측 집계자료 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr                              /* _1- */
               , p_ymd                                  /* _2- */
               , xx.fund_cd                             /* _3- */
               , xx.invest_amt                          /* _4- */
               , xx.nav - NVL(w_ex_sj,0)                /* _5- */
               , xx.nav - NVL(w_ex_sj,0)                /* _6- */
               , NVL(w_ex_sj,0)                         /* _7- */
               , w_stock_tot                            /* _8- */
               , CASE WHEN xx.nav=0 THEN 0
                                    ELSE w_stock_tot / xx.nav
                 END * 100                              /* _9- */
               , w_stock_a                              /* _10- */
               , w_stock_c                              /* _11- */
               , w_stock_d                              /* _12- */
               , CASE WHEN xx.nav=0 THEN 0
                                    ELSE w_stock_d / xx.nav
                 END * 100                              /* _13- */
               , w_bond_b                               /* _14- */
               , w_bond_s                               /* _15- */
               , w_bond_under                           /* _16- */
               , CASE WHEN xx.nav=0 THEN 0
                                    ELSE w_bond_under / xx.nav
                 END * 100                              /* _17- */
               , NVL(w_bond_s,0) + NVL(w_bond_under,0)  /* _18- */
               , CASE WHEN xx.nav=0
                      THEN 0
                      ELSE (NVL(w_bond_s,0) + NVL(w_bond_under,0)) / xx.nav
                 END * 100                              /* _19- */
               , w_bond_s_b                             /* _20- */
               , CASE WHEN xx.nav=0
                      THEN 0
                      ELSE w_bond_s_b / xx.nav
                 END * 100                              /* _21- */
               , w_cash                                 /* _22- */
               , xx.pass_day                            /* _23- */
               , 0                                      /* _24- */
               , 0                                      /* _25- */
               , 0                                      /* _26- */
               , w_venture                              /* _27- */
               , NULL                                   /* _28- */
               , 'PROC0800'                             /* _29- */
               , w_bond_a                               /* _30-채권 A등급시가총액 */
               , w_bond_s_a2                            /* _31-전단채 A등급 시가총액 */
               , w_sj                                   /* _32-수익증권 시가퐁액 */
               , w_ex_sj                                /* _33-비율제외 수익증권 시가총액 */
               , w_hm                                   /* _34- */
               , 0                                      /* _35- */
               );
    end loop;

    -- 최초설정일용 기준가 생성
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                         /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_currency                   /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_nm                         /* _3- */
             , t1.type_gb                         /* _4- */
             , 1000              AS fst_gijun_ga  /* _5- */
             , t1.re_seolj_aek                    /* _6- */
             , t1.bf_gyul_ymd                     /* _7- */
             , t1.af_gyul_ymd                     /* _8- */
          FROM SZM0IA t1  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fst_seolj_ymd = p_ymd
    ) loop
        DELETE FROM UZM0UH tt   /* 정보계 신탁재산 운용현황 */
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND ymd     < p_ymd;

        INSERT INTO UZM0UH tt   /* 정보계 신탁재산 운용현황 */
             ( corp_gr         /* _1- */
             , ymd             /* _2- */
             , fund_cd         /* _3- */
             , type_gb         /* _4- */
             , wonbon_aek      /* _5- */
             , bf_gyul_ymd     /* _6- */
             , af_gyul_ymd     /* _7- */
             , yegm_aek        /* _8- */
             , sun_jasan_aek   /* _9- */
             , jasan_tot_aek   /* _10- */
             , gijun_ga        /* _11- */
             , gijun_ga_dr     /* _12- */
             , ggijun_ga       /* _13- */
             , real_jasan_aek  /* _14- */
             , d2_yegm_aek     /* _15- */
             , seolj_aek       /* _16- */
             , seolj_jwa       /* _17- */
             , fund_currency   /* _18- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
               , p_ymd - 1        /* _2- */
               , xx.fund_cd       /* _3- */
               , xx.type_gb       /* _4- */
               , xx.re_seolj_aek  /* _5- */
               , xx.bf_gyul_ymd   /* _6- */
               , xx.af_gyul_ymd   /* _7- */
               , xx.re_seolj_aek  /* _8- */
               , xx.re_seolj_aek  /* _9- */
               , xx.re_seolj_aek  /* _10- */
               , xx.fst_gijun_ga  /* _11- */
               , 0                /* _12- */
               , xx.fst_gijun_ga  /* _13- */
               , xx.re_seolj_aek  /* _14- */
               , xx.re_seolj_aek  /* _15- */
               , xx.re_seolj_aek  /* _16- */
               , xx.re_seolj_aek  /* _17- */
               , 'KRW'            /* _18- */
               );
    end loop;

    DELETE FROM UZM0UH tt   /* 정보계 신탁재산 운용현황 */
     WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd           = p_ymd
       AND fund_currency = 'KRW';

    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO UZM0UH tt   /* 정보계 신탁재산 운용현황 */
             ( corp_gr         /* _1- */
             , ymd             /* _2-처리일자 */
             , fund_cd         /* _3-펀드코드 */
             , type_gb         /* _4-펀드유형 */
             , wonbon_aek      /* _5-원본액 */
             , bf_gyul_ymd     /* _6-다음결산일 */
             , af_gyul_ymd     /* _7-다음결산일 */
             , silhyn_suik_rt  /* _8-실현수익율 */
             , gijun_ga        /* _9-기준가격 */
             , gijun_ga_dr     /* _10-기준가 일등락액 */
             , ggijun_ga       /* _11-과표기준가격 */
             , seolj_aek       /* _12-설정금액 */
             , seolj_jwa       /* _13- */
             , fund_currency   /* _14- */
             )
        SELECT p_corp_gr          /* _1- */
             , t1.ymd             /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd         /* _3- */
             , ia.type_gb         /* _4- */
             , t1.tuja_pj_aek     /* _5-원본액 */
             , ia.bf_gyul_ymd     /* _6- */
             , ia.af_gyul_ymd     /* _7- */
             , t1.silhyn_suik_rt  /* _8- */
             , t1.gijun_ga        /* _9- */
             , t1.gijun_ga_dr     /* _10- */
             , t1.ggijun_ga       /* _11- */
             , t1.tuja_pj_aek     /* _12- */
             , t1.seolj_jwa       /* _13- */
             , 'KRW'              /* _14- */
          FROM SKT0GI t1  /* 펀드별 기준가 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = 'A'
           AND t1.fund_currency = 'KRW'
           AND ia.corp_gr       = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd       = t1.fund_cd;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := '정보계 신탁재산운용현황 생성중 오류발생';
        RETURN;
    END;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.ymd                                                                                                                                                /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                                                                            /* _2- */
             , aa.customer_gr                                                                                                                                        /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=01 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS stock_aek     /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=02 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS sj_aek        /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=03 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS ss_aek        /* _6- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=04 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS bond_aek      /* _7- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=05 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS jungm_aek     /* _8- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=06 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS cd_aek        /* _9- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=07 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS call_aek      /* _10- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=08 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS balhum_aek    /* _11- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=09 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS bojngum_aek   /* _12- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=10 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS rp_meib_aek   /* _13- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=11 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS yegm_aek      /* _14- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=12 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS fm_yechi_aek  /* _15- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=13 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS misu_ija      /* _16- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=14 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS sunn_sung_aek /* _17- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=15 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS mibae_aek     /* _18- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=16 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS sun_jasan_aek /* _19- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=17 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS jasan_tot_aek /* _20- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=18 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS daecha_gwamok /* _21- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=19 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS ots_aek       /* _22- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=20 THEN CASE WHEN t1.chadae_gb='D' THEN t1.dr_aek
                                                                              ELSE t1.cr_aek END * we.yonsan END),0)                                AS bosu_aek      /* _23- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=21 THEN CASE WHEN t1.chadae_gb='D' THEN t1.dr_aek
                                                                              ELSE t1.cr_aek END * we.yonsan END),0)                                AS cost_aek      /* _24- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN we.seq_no=22 AND t1.gwamok=we.gwamok THEN F_JAN (t1.chadae_gb, t1.junj, t1.dr_aek, t1.cr_aek) * we.yonsan END),0)  AS d2_yegm_aek   /* _25- */
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             , SZX0WE we  /* 보고서별 계정과목 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZX0AA aa  /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                   = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb               = 'A'
           AND t1.fund_currency         = 'KRW'
           AND we.gwamok                = t1.gwamok
           AND we.pgm_id                = 'SR_SZZD090_40'
           AND ia.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd               = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
           AND aa.corp_gr               = t1.corp_gr
         GROUP BY t1.ymd
                , t1.fund_cd
                , aa.customer_gr
    ) loop
        SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                            + NVL(GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(GONGS_DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                            + NVL(SONIK,0)),0)
          INTO w_stock_gongmo
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd   IN (SELECT cy_jm_cd
                                FROM SJG1JC ta  /* 종목별 공모 기본정보 및 배정/청약내역(공통) */
                               WHERE ta.NABIB_YMD <= p_ymd);

        UPDATE UZM0UH tt    /* 정보계 신탁재산 운용현황 */
           SET stock_aek      = xx.stock_aek                         /* 주식 */
             , stock_gongmo   = w_stock_gongmo                       /* 공모미상장주식 */
             , sj_aek         = xx.sj_aek                            /* 수익증권 */
             , ss_aek         = xx.ss_aek                            /* 선물/옵션 */
             , bond_aek       = xx.bond_aek                          /* 채권 */
             , jungm_aek      = xx.jungm_aek                         /* 정기예금 */
             , cd_aek         = xx.cd_aek                            /* CD */
             , call_aek       = xx.call_aek                          /* Call */
             , balhum_aek     = xx.balhum_aek                        /* 발행어음 */
             , bojngum_aek    = xx.bojngum_aek                       /* 보증어음 */
             , rp_meib_aek    = xx.rp_meib_aek                       /* 환매채 */
             , yegm_aek       = xx.yegm_aek                          /* 예금 */
             , fm_yechi_aek   = xx.fm_yechi_aek                      /* 외화예치금 */
             , misu_ija       = xx.misu_ija                          /* 미수이자 */
             , cash_aek       = xx.jungm_aek + xx.cd_aek + xx.call_aek + xx.balhum_aek + xx.bojngum_aek
                                             + xx.rp_meib_aek + xx.yegm_aek + xx.fm_yechi_aek + xx.misu_ija
             , sunn_sung_aek  = xx.sunn_sung_aek                     /* 선납원천세,기타미수수익 */
             , mibae_aek      = xx.mibae_aek                         /* 미수입금,미수배당금,공모청약금,증거금,이연/기타자산,미지급금(차감) */
             , sun_jasan_aek  = xx.sun_jasan_aek                     /* 순자산 */
             , jasan_tot_aek  = xx.jasan_tot_aek                     /* 총자산 */
             , real_jasan_aek = xx.jasan_tot_aek - xx.daecha_gwamok  /* 미지급금,선물/옵션부채 제외 총자산 */
             , ots_aek        = xx.ots_aek                           /* OTS증권 */
             , bosu_aek       = xx.bosu_aek                          /* TER 발생보수 */
             , cost_aek       = xx.cost_aek                          /* TER 기타비용 */
             , d2_yegm_aek    = xx.d2_yegm_aek                       /* D+2 예금 */
         WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND fund_currency = 'KRW'
           AND ymd           = xx.ymd;
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.ymd
             , t1.fund_cd
             , SUM((NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aek,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aek,0)
                                            + NVL(t1.msd_meib_aek,0) - NVL(t1.msd_medo_aek,0)
                                            + (NVL(t1.sung_cost,0) + NVL(t1.pr_sung_cost,0) + NVL(t1.misu_ija,0) + NVL(t1.pr_misu_ija,0))
                                            + NVL(t1.anbun_aek,0)) + (NVL(sc.sung_cost,0) + NVL(sc.misu_ija,0)))  AS aek
          FROM SCM0CM t1             /* 채권 보유현황 */
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM0SC sc  /* 채권 선매출이자현황 */
                       ON sc.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                      AND sc.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
                      AND sc.ymd      = t1.ymd
                      AND sc.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
                      AND sc.buy_date = t1.buy_date
             , SCM0CJ cj             /* 채권종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND cj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
           AND cj.bond_cd IN ('027','031','101')
         GROUP BY t1.ymd
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        UPDATE UZM0UH tt    /* 정보계 신탁재산 운용현황 */
           SET tong_aek = xx.aek
             , bond_aek = bond_aek - xx.aek
         WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND fund_currency = 'KRW'
           AND ymd           = xx.ymd;
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT ymd
             , fund_cd
             , SUM(bany_suik_rt * pyunga_aek)  AS bany
             , SUM(pyunga_aek)                 AS pyunga_aek
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd          = p_ymd
           AND t1.pyunga_aek   > 0
           AND t1.bany_suik_rt < .5
         GROUP BY ymd
                , fund_cd
    ) loop
        UPDATE UZM0UH tt    /* 정보계 신탁재산 운용현황 */
           SET bond_bany_suik_rt = TRUNC(xx.bany / xx.pyunga_aek,6)
         WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND fund_currency = 'KRW'
           AND ymd           = xx.ymd;
    end loop;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.ymd
             , t1.fund_cd
             , SUM(hj.pyom_iyul * t1.pyunga_aek)  AS bany
             , SUM(t1.pyunga_aek)                 AS pyunga_aek
          FROM SHM0HM t1  /* 현금 보유현황 */
             , SHM0HJ hj  /* 현금 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND t1.pyunga_aek > 0
           AND hj.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
         GROUP BY t1.ymd
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        UPDATE UZM0UH tt    /* 정보계 신탁재산 운용현황 */
           SET cash_bany_suik_rt = TRUNC(xx.bany / xx.pyunga_aek,6)
         WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND fund_currency = 'KRW'
           AND ymd           = xx.ymd;
    end loop;

    -- 매매수수료 집계
    for xx IN (
        SELECT tr_ymd
             , fund_cd
             , SUM(NVL(susu,0) + NVL(tax,0))  AS susu_aek
          FROM SJT0JG t1  /* 주식거래 내역 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr        = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd         = p_ymd
           AND SUBSTR(tr_cd,1,1) IN ('J','K')
         GROUP BY tr_ymd, fund_cd
    ) loop
        UPDATE UZM0UH tt    /* 정보계 신탁재산 운용현황 */
           SET susu_aek = NVL(xx.susu_aek,0)
         WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd       = xx.fund_cd
           AND fund_currency = 'KRW'
           AND ymd           = xx.tr_ymd;
    end loop;

    UPDATE UZM0UH t1    /* 정보계 신탁재산 운용현황 */
       SET collateral = (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(coll_pass,0) + NVL(coll_up,0) - NVL(coll_dw,0)),0)
                           FROM SJM0JM ta  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                          WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                            AND ta.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
                            AND ta.ymd     = t1.ymd)
     WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd           = p_ymd
       AND fund_currency = 'KRW';

    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := 'PROC0800' || SUBSTR (sqlerrm,1,160);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0900 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 신탁재산명세부 생성
--
    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'SR_PROC0900', p_ymd || ' : 신탁재산명세부 생성');

    -- 차트용 일별자료 생성
    UPDATE FW_DAY_CHTDATA t1    /* 회사 일별 챠트자료 */
       SET (fund1, fund2)                   
              = (SELECT COUNT(1)
                      , COUNT(1)
                   FROM SZM0IA ta  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                  WHERE ta.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
                    AND NVL(ta.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd
                    AND ta.fund_currency         = t1.fund_currency)
         , (g90101, g90104, g91112)         
              = (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='90101' THEN NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0) - NVL(cr_aek,0) END), 0)
                      , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='90104' THEN NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0) - NVL(cr_aek,0) END), 0)
                      , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='91112' THEN NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0) - NVL(cr_aek,0) END), 0)
                   FROM SKM0AG ta  /* 총계정원장 */
                  WHERE ta.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
                    AND ta.fund_cd       IN (SELECT fund_cd
                                               FROM SZM0IA aa  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                                              WHERE aa.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
                                                AND NVL(aa.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd)
                    AND ta.ymd           = p_ymd
                    AND ta.gwamok        IN ('90101','90104','91112')
                    AND ta.fund_currency = t1.fund_currency)
         , g90105                           
              = (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(junj,0) + NVL(dr_aek,0) - NVL(cr_aek,0)), 0)
                   FROM SKM0AG ta  /* 총계정원장 */
                  WHERE ta.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
                    AND ta.fund_cd       IN (SELECT fund_cd
                                               FROM SZM0IA aa  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                                              WHERE aa.corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
                                                AND NVL(aa.haeji_ymd, p_ymd) >= p_ymd)
                    AND ta.ymd           = p_ymd
                    AND ta.gwamok        = '90105'
                    AND ta.fund_currency = t1.fund_currency)
         , (d20401, d20402, d20403, d20407) 
              = (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='20401' THEN cr_aek END), 0)
                      , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='20402' THEN cr_aek END), 0)
                      , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='20403' THEN cr_aek END), 0)
                      , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN gwamok='20407' THEN cr_aek END), 0)
                   FROM SKM0AG ta  /* 총계정원장 */
                  WHERE ta.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
                    AND ta.ymd           = p_ymd
                    AND ta.gwamok        IN ('20401','20402','20403','20407')
                    AND ta.fund_currency = t1.fund_currency)
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT fund_currency                   /* _1- */
             , NVL(SUM(fund1), 0)   AS fund1   /* _2- */
             , NVL(SUM(fund2), 0)   AS fund2   /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(g90101), 0)  AS g90101  /* _4- */
             , NVL(SUM(g90104), 0)  AS g90104  /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(g90105), 0)  AS g90105  /* _6- */
             , NVL(SUM(g91112), 0)  AS g91112  /* _7- */
             , NVL(SUM(d20401), 0)  AS d20401  /* _8- */
             , NVL(SUM(d20402), 0)  AS d20402  /* _9- */
             , NVL(SUM(d20403), 0)  AS d20403  /* _10- */
             , NVL(SUM(d20407), 0)  AS d20407  /* _11- */
          FROM FW_DAY_CHTDATA t1  /* 회사 일별 챠트자료 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr > '2200'
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
         GROUP BY fund_currency
    ) loop
        UPDATE FW_DAY_CHTDATA tt    /* 회사 일별 챠트자료 */
           SET fund1  = xx.fund1
             , fund2  = xx.fund2
             , g90101 = xx.g90101
             , g90104 = xx.g90104
             , g90105 = xx.g90105
             , g91112 = xx.g91112
             , d20401 = xx.d20401
             , d20402 = xx.d20402
             , d20403 = xx.d20403
             , d20407 = xx.d20407
         WHERE corp_gr       LIKE '2200'
           AND ymd           = p_ymd
           AND fund_currency = xx.fund_currency;
    end loop;

    DELETE FROM UZM0UI tt   /* 정보계 신탁재산 명세부 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;
    COMMIT;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', p_ymd, '신탁재산명세부 생성(채권)');

    SR_PROC0910 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_msg);  /* 채권 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR ('SR_PROC0910 - ' || w_msg,1,190);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B020', p_ymd, '신탁재산명세부 생성(주식)');

    SR_PROC0920 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_msg);  /* 주식 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR ('SR_PROC0920 - ' || w_msg,1,190);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B040', p_ymd, '신탁재산명세부 생성(현금)');

    SR_PROC0930 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_msg);  /* 현금(선납원천세 제외) */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR ('SKKP010_903 - ' || w_msg,1,190);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B070', p_ymd, '신탁재산명세부 생성(수익증권)');

    SR_PROC0940 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_msg);  /* 수익증권 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR ('SR_PROC0940 - ' || w_msg,1,190);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B070', p_ymd, '신탁재산명세부 생성(선물)');

    SR_PROC0950 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_msg);  /* 선물 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR ('SR_PROC0950 - ' || w_msg,1,190);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B080', p_ymd, '정보계 해외자산 마스타 생성');

    SR_PROC0960 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_msg);  /* 해외자산 */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR ('SR_PROC0960 - ' || w_msg,1,190);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 매입단가 일괄 생성
    -- 국내 채권/현금(현금대여)
    UPDATE UZM0UI tt    /* 정보계 신탁재산 명세부 */
       SET tr_danga = TRUNC(CASE WHEN aekm != 0
                                 THEN CASE WHEN jm_gr='1' THEN chui_aek + sung_cost
                                                          ELSE chui_aek END / aekm
                                 ELSE 0 END * 10000,2)
     WHERE corp_gr             = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd                 = p_ymd
       AND jm_gr               IN ('1','2','2D','2Z')
       AND NVL(currency,'KRW') = 'KRW';

    -- 수익증권
    UPDATE UZM0UI tt    /* 정보계 신탁재산 명세부 */
       SET tr_danga = TRUNC(CASE WHEN aekm != 0 THEN chui_aek / aekm END * 1000,2)
     WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd      = p_ymd
       AND tr_danga IS NULL
       AND jm_gr    = '6';

    UPDATE UZM0UI tt    /* 정보계 신탁재산 명세부 */
       SET tr_danga = CASE WHEN aekm != 0 THEN chui_aek / aekm END
     WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd      = p_ymd
       AND tr_danga IS NULL;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B130', p_ymd, '신탁재산명세부 생성 완료');

    SR_PROC0990 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_msg);          /* 기타자산(계정) */
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := SUBSTR ('SKKP010_919 - ' || w_msg,1,190);
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 빈자료 삭제처리 20201203 yjs
    DELETE FROM UZM0UI tt   /* 정보계 신탁재산 명세부 */
     WHERE corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd                       = p_ymd
       AND NVL(aekm,0)               = 0
       AND NVL(siga_aek,0)           = 0
       AND NVL(sung_cost,0)          = 0
       AND NVL(misu_aek,0)           = 0
       AND NVL(misu_ija,0)           = 0
       AND NVL(misu_baed_aek,0)      = 0
       AND NVL(chui_aek,0)           = 0
       AND NVL(pyunga_sonik,0)       = 0
       AND NVL(sun_jasan_siga_aek,0) = 0;

    -- 계좌별 주식 보유비율
    DELETE FROM SJM0JM_JM tt    /* 주식 종목별 보유비율 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd;
IF p_corp_gr = '2402' THEN

    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t1.jm_nm
             , t1.jm_cd
          FROM UZM0UI t1  /* 정보계 신탁재산 명세부 */
             , SKT0GI gi  /* 펀드별 기준가 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_gr    = '3'
           AND t1.type_gb  NOT IN ('5','X')
           AND (t1.siga_aek != 0 OR NVL(t1.misu_aek,0) + NVL(t1.misu_baed_aek,0) != 0)
           AND gi.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
           AND gi.work_gb  = 'A'
           AND gi.stock_rt != 0
    ) loop
        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.fund_cd
                 , ia.fund_nm
                 , F_JA010H (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, t1.fund_cd,'','5')  AS stock_sum
                 , 0                                                 AS jm_aek
              FROM SKT0GI t1  /* 펀드별 기준가 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.work_gb  = 'A'
               AND t1.stock_rt != 0
               AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
               AND ia.type_gb  NOT IN ('5','X')
        ) loop
            SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                   + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                   + NVL(t1.sonik,0)), 0)
              INTO x1.jm_aek
              FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd     = x1.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.bs_type     = 0
               AND t1.type_trench = '00:';

            INSERT INTO SJM0JM_JM tt    /* 주식 종목별 보유비율 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd         /* _2- */
                   , x1.fund_cd    /* _3- */
                   , xx.jm_cd      /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_nm      /* _5- */
                   , x1.stock_sum  /* _6- */
                   , x1.jm_aek     /* _7- */
                   , CASE WHEN x1.stock_sum=0 OR x1.jm_aek=0
                          THEN 0
                          ELSE x1.jm_aek / x1.stock_sum * 100
                     END           /* _8- */
                   , CASE p_corp_gr || x1.fund_cd WHEN '22021904'  THEN 1
                                                  WHEN '22022348'  THEN 1
                                                                   ELSE 0
                     END           /* _9- */
                   );
        end loop;
        if  p_corp_gr = '2202'  then
            for x1 IN (
                SELECT SUM(F_JA010H (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, t1.fund_cd,'','5'))  AS stock_sum
                     , 0                                                      AS jm_aek
                  FROM SKT0GI t1  /* 펀드별 기준가 */
                     , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd  IN ('1904','2348')
                   AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
                   AND t1.work_gb  = 'A'
                   AND t1.stock_rt != 0
                   AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
            ) loop
                SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                       + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                       + NVL(t1.sonik,0)), 0)
                  INTO x1.jm_aek
                  FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd     IN ('1904','2348')
                   AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.bs_type     = 0
                   AND t1.type_trench = '00:';

                INSERT INTO SJM0JM_JM tt    /* 주식 종목별 보유비율 */
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd         /* _2- */
                       , '0001'        /* _3- */
                       , xx.jm_cd      /* _4- */
                       , xx.jm_nm      /* _5- */
                       , x1.stock_sum  /* _6- */
                       , x1.jm_aek     /* _7- */
                       , CASE WHEN x1.stock_sum=0 OR x1.jm_aek=0
                              THEN 0
                              ELSE x1.jm_aek / x1.stock_sum * 100
                         END           /* _8- */
                       , '1'           /* _9- */
                       );
            end loop;
        end if;
    end loop;

ELSE
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t1.jm_nm
             , t1.jm_cd
          FROM UZM0UI t1  /* 정보계 신탁재산 명세부 */
             , SKT0GI gi  /* 펀드별 기준가 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_gr    = '3'
           AND t1.type_gb  NOT IN ('5','6','X')
           AND (t1.siga_aek != 0 OR NVL(t1.misu_aek,0) + NVL(t1.misu_baed_aek,0) != 0)
           AND gi.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND gi.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
           AND gi.work_gb  = 'A'
           AND gi.stock_rt != 0
    ) loop
        for x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.fund_cd
                 , ia.fund_nm
                 , F_JA010H (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, t1.fund_cd,'','5')  AS stock_sum
                 , 0                                                 AS jm_aek
              FROM SKT0GI t1  /* 펀드별 기준가 */
                 , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.work_gb  = 'A'
               AND t1.stock_rt != 0
               AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
               AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
               AND ia.type_gb  NOT IN ('5','6','X')
        ) loop
            SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                   + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                   + NVL(t1.sonik,0)), 0)
              INTO x1.jm_aek
              FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd     = x1.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.bs_type     = 0
               AND t1.type_trench = '00:';

            INSERT INTO SJM0JM_JM tt    /* 주식 종목별 보유비율 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd         /* _2- */
                   , x1.fund_cd    /* _3- */
                   , xx.jm_cd      /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_nm      /* _5- */
                   , x1.stock_sum  /* _6- */
                   , x1.jm_aek     /* _7- */
                   , CASE WHEN x1.stock_sum=0 OR x1.jm_aek=0
                          THEN 0
                          ELSE x1.jm_aek / x1.stock_sum * 100
                     END           /* _8- */
                   , CASE p_corp_gr || x1.fund_cd WHEN '22021904'  THEN 1
                                                  WHEN '22022348'  THEN 1
                                                                   ELSE 0
                     END           /* _9- */
                   );
        end loop;
        if  p_corp_gr = '2202'  then
            for x1 IN (
                SELECT SUM(F_JA010H (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, t1.fund_cd,'','5'))  AS stock_sum
                     , 0                                                      AS jm_aek
                  FROM SKT0GI t1  /* 펀드별 기준가 */
                     , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd  IN ('1904','2348')
                   AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
                   AND t1.work_gb  = 'A'
                   AND t1.stock_rt != 0
                   AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
            ) loop
                SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                       + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                                       + NVL(t1.sonik,0)), 0)
                  INTO x1.jm_aek
                  FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd     IN ('1904','2348')
                   AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.bs_type     = 0
                   AND t1.type_trench = '00:';

                INSERT INTO SJM0JM_JM tt    /* 주식 종목별 보유비율 */
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd         /* _2- */
                       , '0001'        /* _3- */
                       , xx.jm_cd      /* _4- */
                       , xx.jm_nm      /* _5- */
                       , x1.stock_sum  /* _6- */
                       , x1.jm_aek     /* _7- */
                       , CASE WHEN x1.stock_sum=0 OR x1.jm_aek=0
                              THEN 0
                              ELSE x1.jm_aek / x1.stock_sum * 100
                         END           /* _8- */
                       , '1'           /* _9- */
                       );
            end loop;
        end if;
    end loop;
END IF;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := 'PROC0900:' || SUBSTR (sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0910 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 정보계 신탁재산명세부 생성(채권)
--
    w_md                           NUMBER;
    w_jy_pg_nm                     VARCHAR(4);
    w_abs_gb                       VARCHAR(1);
    w_bogo_gr                      VARCHAR(20);

    w_jy_suik_rt                   NUMBER;
    w_danga                        NUMBER;
    w_cnt                          NUMBER;
    w_pass_ija                     NUMBER;

    w_jan_aekm                     NUMBER;
    w_jan_chui_aek                 NUMBER;
BEGIN
    -- 채권
    for xx IN (
        SELECT ia.type_gb                                                                               /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                               /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                 /* _3- */
             , t1.buy_date                                                                              /* _4- */
             , cj.cj_nm                                                                                 /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)
                                   + NVL(t1.msd_meib_aekm,0)
                                   - NVL(t1.msd_medo_aekm,0)                          AS aekm           /* _6-T+1 반영 (액면) */
             , NVL(t1.msd_meib_aekm,0)                                                AS msd_meib_aekm  /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.msd_medo_aekm,0)                                                AS msd_medo_aek   /* _8- */
             , t1.bany_suik_rt * 100                                                  AS bany_suik_per  /* _9- */
             , t1.siga_aek - NVL(msd_medo_aek,0)                                      AS siga_aek       /* _10- */
             , NVL(t1.sung_cost,0) + NVL(t1.pr_sung_cost,0)                           AS sung_cost      /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.misu_ija,0) + NVL(t1.pr_misu_ija,0)                             AS misu_ija       /* _12- */
             , NVL(t1.BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.MEIB_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.MEDO_AEK,0)
                                       + NVL(t1.msd_meib_aek,0)
                                       - NVL(t1.msd_medo_aek,0)                       AS aek            /* _13- */
             , NVL(t1.jilg_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.jilg_up_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.jilg_dw_aekm,0)  AS lock_aekm      /* _14- */
             , NVL(t1.day_anbun_aek,0)                                                AS day_anbun_aek  /* _15- */
             , NVL(t1.siga_aek,0) - (NVL(t1.BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.MEIB_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.MEDO_AEK,0)
                                  + NVL(t1.msd_meib_aek,0)
                                  - NVL(t1.msd_medo_aek,0))                           AS pyunga_sonik   /* _16- */
             , NVL(t1.day_ija,0)                                                      AS day_ija        /* _17- */
             , NVL(t1.yesu_tax,0) + NVL(t1.pr_yesu_tax,0)                             AS yesu_tax       /* _18- */
             , cj.sanghw_ymd                                                                            /* _19- */
             , NVL(cj.pyom_iyul,0)                                                    AS pyom_iyul      /* _20- */
             , NVL(cj.halin_iyul,0)                                                   AS halin_iyul     /* _21- */
             , cj.af_ija_ymd - cj.bf_ija_ymd                                          AS ilsu           /* _22- */
             , NVL(t1.cons_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.MEIB_AEK,0)
                                            - NVL(t1.cons_medo_aek,0)                 AS cons_chui_aek  /* _23- */
             , t1.lst_meib_ymd                                                                          /* _24- */
             , t1.venture_type                                                                          /* _25- */
             , cj.balh_ymd                                                                              /* _26- */
             , cj.balh_co                                                                               /* _27- */
             , cj.bojng_co                                                                              /* _28- */
             , cj.as_cj_cd                                                                              /* _29- */
             , cj.mojib_gb                                                                              /* _30- */
             , cj.bond_attr                                                                             /* _31- */
             , cj.bond_cd                                                                               /* _32- */
             , cj.bf_ija_ymd                                                                            /* _33- */
             , cj.af_ija_ymd                                                                            /* _34- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND cj.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT danga
                 , jy_suik_rt
                 , md
                 , jy_pg_nm
              INTO w_danga
                 , w_jy_suik_rt
                 , w_md
                 , w_jy_pg_nm
              FROM SCM1SM t1  /* 채권 시가평가 자료 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd     = (SELECT MAX(ymd)
                                   FROM SCM1SM ta  /* 채권 시가평가 자료 */
                                  WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                    AND ta.ymd     BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS (p_ymd, -1) AND p_ymd
                                    AND ta.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd)
               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_danga      := NULL;
            w_jy_suik_rt := NULL;
            w_md         := NULL;
            w_jy_pg_nm   := NULL;
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT sebu_cd_nm
              INTO w_jy_pg_nm
              FROM SCM1J  t1  /* 채권 매수 */
                 , SZX0GR y5  /* 그룹코드 */
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.buy_date = xx.buy_date
               AND y5.gr_cd    = 'Y5'
               AND y5.sebu_cd  = t1.pg_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            w_jy_pg_nm := NULL;
        END;

--        BEGIN
--            SELECT trunc (siga_aek / aekm * 10000,2)
--              INTO w_danga
--              FROM SCM0CM_SIGA t1
--             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
--               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
--               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
--               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
--               AND t1.aekm    != 0
--               AND ROWNUM = 1;
--        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
--            NULL;
--        END;

--        SELECT tj.aekm - NVL(SUM(tk.aekm),0)
--             , tj.aek - NVL(SUM(tk.chui_aek),0)
--          INTO w_jan_aekm
--             , w_jan_chui_aek
--          FROM SCM1J tj
--             , SCM1K tk
--         WHERE tj.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
--           AND tj.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
--           AND tj.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
--           AND tj.buy_date    = xx.buy_date
--           AND tk.corp_gr(+)  = tj.corp_gr
--           AND tk.fund_cd(+)  = tj.fund_cd
--           AND tk.jm_cd(+)    = tj.jm_cd
--           AND tk.buy_date(+) = tj.buy_date
--           AND tk.ymd(+)      <= p_ymd
--         GROUP BY tj.aekm
--                , tj.aek;
--        if  w_jan_chui_aek != 0 then
--            -- 리코자산운용 취득액은 매수취득액으로 관리 20240705
--            xx.aek  := w_jan_chui_aek;
--        end if;

        if  xx.bond_attr = '1'      then    w_bogo_gr := '09';  -- 국채
        elsif xx.bond_attr = '2'    then    w_bogo_gr := '10';  -- 지방채
        elsif xx.bond_attr = '3'    then    -- 특수채
            if  xx.bond_cd = '101'  then
                w_bogo_gr := '11';  /* 통안채 */
            else
                BEGIN
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                      INTO w_cnt
                      FROM SJX0JB t1  /* 발행기관 */
                     WHERE balh_co = xx.balh_co
                       AND comp_bu IN ('321','331','332','333','334');
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    w_cnt := 0;
                END;
                if  w_cnt > 0   then
                        w_bogo_gr := '13';  /* 금융채 */
                else    w_bogo_gr := '12';  /* 기타 특수채 */
                end if;
            end if;
        elsif xx.bond_attr = '6'    then    -- 회사채
            if  xx.mojib_gb = '1'   then    -- 공모
                BEGIN
                    SELECT CASE WHEN NVL(ydong_gb,'00') != '00' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'  END
                      INTO w_abs_gb
                      FROM SCM0CJ_KAP t1  /* 한국자산평가 (채권발행정보) */
                     WHERE as_cj_cd = NVL(xx.as_cj_cd, xx.jm_cd);
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    w_abs_gb := 'N';
                END;
                if  w_abs_gb = 'Y'  then
                    w_bogo_gr := '16';  /* 회사채 ABS(공모) */
                else
                    if  xx.bojng_co IS NOT NULL then
                            w_bogo_gr := '14';  /* 회사채 보증(공모) */
                    else    w_bogo_gr := '15';  /* 회사채 보증(공모) */
                    end if;
                end if;
            else    /* 사모 */
                w_bogo_gr := '17';  /* 회사채 사모회사채 */
            end if;
        else    /* 기타 */
            w_bogo_gr := '18';
        end if;

        if  xx.msd_meib_aekm > 0    then
            BEGIN
                SELECT SUM(NVL(pass_ija,0))
                  INTO w_pass_ija
                  FROM SCT0CG t1  /* 채권거래내역 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
                   AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
                   AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.tr_cd   = 'J14';
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                w_pass_ija := 0;
            END;
            xx.sung_cost := xx.sung_cost + w_pass_ija;
        end if;

        INSERT INTO UZM0UI tt   /* 정보계 신탁재산 명세부 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
               , p_ymd             /* _2- */
               , xx.type_gb        /* _3- */
               , xx.fund_cd        /* _4- */
               , xx.jm_cd          /* _5- */
               , xx.buy_date       /* _6- */
               , 1                 /* _7- */
               , xx.cj_nm          /* _8- */
               , xx.aekm           /* _9- */
               , w_danga           /* _10- */
               , xx.bany_suik_per  /* _11- */
               , xx.siga_aek       /* _12- */
               , 0                 /* _13- */
               , xx.sung_cost      /* _14- */
               , 0                 /* _15- */
               , xx.misu_ija       /* _16- */
               , 0                 /* _17- */
               , xx.aek            /* _18-취득가 */
               , xx.day_anbun_aek  /* _19- */
               , xx.pyunga_sonik   /* _20- */
               , xx.day_ija        /* _21- */
               , xx.yesu_tax       /* _22- */
               , 0                 /* _23- */
               , xx.sanghw_ymd     /* _24- */
               , 0                 /* _25- */
               , xx.pyom_iyul      /* _26- */
               , xx.halin_iyul     /* _27- */
               , xx.ilsu           /* _28- */
               , NULL              /* _29- */
               , 'KRW'             /* _30- */
               , w_jy_suik_rt      /* _31- */
               , xx.pyom_iyul      /* _32- */
               , 'Y'               /* _33- */
               , NULL              /* _34- */
               , '00:'             /* _35- */
               , 0                 /* _36- */
               , NULL              /* _37- */
               , '1'               /* _38- */
               , xx.cons_chui_aek  /* _39- */
               , '1'               /* _40- */
               , '1'               /* _41- */
               , xx.lock_aekm      /* _42- */
               , xx.lst_meib_ymd   /* _43- */
               , xx.balh_ymd       /* _44- */
               , w_md              /* _45- */
               , w_jy_pg_nm        /* _46- */
               , xx.siga_aek       /* _47- */
               , 'PROC0910'        /* _48- */
               , NULL              /* _49- */
               , w_bogo_gr         /* _50- */
               , NULL              /* _51- */
               , 0                 /* _52- */
               , xx.venture_type   /* _53- */
               , xx.balh_co        /* _54- */
               , NULL              /* _55- */
               , NULL              /* _56- */
               , NULL              /* _57- */
               , xx.bf_ija_ymd     /* _58- */
               , xx.af_ija_ymd     /* _59- */
               );
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := '신탁명세부(채권) 생성중 오류발생 ' || p_ymd || '[' || SQLERRM || ']';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0920 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 정보계 신탁재산명세부 생성(주식)
--
BEGIN
    BEGIN
        INSERT  INTO UZM0UI tt  
            ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
            , ymd            /* _2- */
            , type_gb        /* _3- */
            , fund_cd        /* _4- */
            , jm_cd          /* _5- */
            , jm_nm          /* _6- */
            , chasu          /* _7- */
            , aekm           /* _8- */
            , sise           /* _9- */
            , siga_aek       /* _10- */
            , pyunga_sonik   /* _11- */
            , chui_aek       /* _12- */
            , sung_cost      /* _13- */
            , misu_baed_aek  /* _14- */
            , nav_target_yn  /* _15- */
            , type_trench    /* _16- */
            , bs_type        /* _17- */
            , danc_gb        /* _18- */
            , jm_gr          /* _19- */
            , cons_chui_aek  /* _20- */
            , jasan_gr1      /* _21- */
            , jasan_gr2      /* _22- */
            , lock_jusu      /* _23- */
            , trustee        /* _24- */
            , cre_proc       /* _25- */
            , bogo_gr        /* _26- */
            , venture_type   /* _27- */
            , balh_co        /* _28- */
            , collateral     /* _29- */
            , coll_jusu      /* _30- */
            , coll_end       /* _31- */
            )
          select p_corp_gr                                                                                /* _1- */
               , t1.ymd                                                                                   /* _2- */
               , ia.type_gb                                                                               /* _3- */
               , t1.fund_cd                                                                               /* _4- */
               , t1.jm_cd                                                                                 /* _5- */
               , jj.jj_nm                                                                                 /* _6- */
               , ROWNUM                                                                                   /* _7- */
               , NVL(t1.bfil_boyu_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.dw_jusu,0) 
                                          + NVL(t1.gongs_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_jusu,0)             /* _8- */
               , F_JONGA (p_corp_gr, t1.koscom_cd, p_ymd)                                                 /* _9- */
               , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0) 
                                         + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                         + NVL(t1.sonik,0)                                                /* _10- */
               , t1.sonik                                                                                 /* _11- */
               , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_aek,0) 
                                         + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.gongs_dw_chui_aek,0)      /* _12- */
               , t1.mijunab_aek                                                                           /* _13- */
               , t1.misu_baed_aek                                                                         /* _14- */
               , 'Y'                                                                                      /* _15- */
               , t1.type_trench                                                                           /* _16- */
               , t1.bs_type                                                                               /* _17- */
               , t1.danc_gb                                                                               /* _18- */
               , CASE WHEN t1.bs_type= -1               THEN '3-'
                      WHEN jb.sosok_gb IN ('3','4','G') THEN '3E'
                                                        ELSE '3' END                                      /* _19- */
               , NVL(t1.cons_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_aek,0) 
                                              + NVL(t1.gongs_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cons_dw_chui_aek,0)  /* _20- */
               , '1'                                                                                      /* _21- */
               , '1'                                                                                      /* _22- */
               , NVL(t1.bfil_jilg_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.jilg_up_jusu,0) 
                                          - NVL(t1.jilg_dw_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.lock_jusu,0)                  /* _23- */
               , jb.balh_co                                                                               /* _24- */
               , 'PROC0920'                                                                               /* _25- */
               , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(t1.jm_cd,3,1) NOT IN ('A','G')
                      THEN CASE WHEN jb.sosok_gb IN ('2','3')                                                        THEN '26'  /* 집합투자증권(ETF포함) -> 수익증권 투자신탁 수익증권 */
                                WHEN jb.sosok_gb IN ('4','G')                                                        THEN '24'  /* 지분증권 기타 */
                                WHEN jb.sosok_gb='1' And (t1.danc_gb='A' OR t1.danc_gb Between 'S' And 'Z')          THEN '19'  /* 지분증권 주식/ETF 거래소 */
                                WHEN jb.sosok_gb IN ('C','8') And (t1.danc_gb='C' OR t1.danc_gb Between 'S' And 'Z') THEN '20'  /* 지분증권 주식 코스닥 */
                                WHEN jb.sosok_gb='B' And sk.new_danc_gb='A'                                          THEN '19'
                                WHEN jb.sosok_gb='B' And sk.new_danc_gb='C'                                          THEN '20'
                                WHEN jb.sosok_gb='B' And t1.danc_gb='B' And jj.CAPSIZE='R'                           THEN '24'
                                                                                                                     ELSE '21' END   /* 지분증권 주식 장외 */
                      ELSE '24' END                                                                       /* _26- */
               , t1.venture_type                                                                          /* _27- */
               , t1.balh_co                                                                               /* _28- */
               , NVL(t1.coll_pass,0) + NVL(t1.coll_up,0) - NVL(t1.coll_dw,0)                              /* _29- */
               , NVL(t1.coll_jusu,0)                                                                      /* _30- */
               , t1.coll_end                                                                              /* _31- */
            from SJM0JM t1
            LEFT OUTER JOIN sjt0sk sk  ON sk.tr_ymd    >= t1.ymd
                                      and sk.tr_cd     = 'G51'
                                      and sk.old_jm_cd = t1.jm_cd
               , SZM0IA ia
               , SJM0JJ jj
               , SJX0JB jb
           where t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
             and t1.ymd     = p_ymd
             and ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
             and ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
             and jj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
             and jb.balh_co = t1.balh_co;

        UPDATE UZM0UI t1  
           SET jy_suik_rt          = CASE WHEN NVL (chui_aek,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE pyunga_sonik / chui_aek * 100 END
             , sun_jasan_siga_aek  = NVL(siga_aek, 0) + NVL(misu_baed_aek, 0)
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND ymd     = p_ymd
           AND aekm    != 0
           AND jm_gr   LIKE '3%';

        -- 20210102 PDJ 매수배당금만 있는 종목 반영
        UPDATE UZM0UI tt  
           SET sun_jasan_siga_aek = NVL(siga_aek, 0) + NVL(misu_baed_aek, 0)
         WHERE corp_gr               = p_corp_gr
           AND ymd                   = p_ymd
           AND NVL(aekm,0)           = 0
           AND NVL(misu_baed_aek,0)  > 0
           AND jm_gr                 LIKE '3%';
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
        p_msg   := '신탁명세부(주식) 생성중 오류발생';
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- 최종매입일 관리
    for xx IN (
        select t1.rowid
             , t1.*
          from UZM0UI t1
         where t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           and t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           and t1.jm_gr   LIKE '3%'
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT lst_meib_ymd
              INTO xx.lst_meib_ymd
              FROM UZM0UI t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd          = p_ymd - 1
               AND t1.fund_cd      = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.type_gb      = xx.type_gb
               AND t1.jm_cd        = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.type_trench  = xx.type_trench
               AND t1.bs_type      = xx.bs_type
               AND t1.lst_meib_ymd IS NOT NULL;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            xx.lst_meib_ymd := p_ymd;
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT p_ymd
              INTO xx.lst_meib_ymd
              FROM SJT0JG t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.tr_ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.tr_cd       LIKE 'J%'
               AND t1.fund_cd     = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.jm_cd       = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.type_trench = xx.type_trench
               AND t1.bs_type     = xx.bs_type
               AND ROWNUM = 1;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            NULL;
        END;

        UPDATE UZM0UI tt  
           SET lst_meib_ymd = xx.lst_meib_ymd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0930 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 정보계 신탁재산명세부 생성(현금)
--
BEGIN
    -- 현금
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO UZM0UI tt  
          SELECT p_corp_gr                                                    /* _1- */
               , t1.ymd                                                       /* _2- */
               , ia.type_gb                                                   /* _3- */
               , t1.fund_cd                                                   /* _4- */
               , t1.jm_cd                                                     /* _5- */
               , TO_CHAR(hj.meib_ymd,'yyyymmdd')                              /* _6- */
               , ROWNUM                                                       /* _7- */
               , hj.hj_nm                                                     /* _8- */
               , CASE WHEN hj.cash_cd='90'
                      THEN t1.meib_aek
                      ELSE NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0)
                                               - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)
                 END                                                          /* _9- */
               , NULL                                                         /* _10- */
               , 0                                                            /* _11- */
               , CASE WHEN hj.cash_cd='DC' AND hj.sunhu_gb='1'
                      THEN NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0)
                                               - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)
                      ELSE t1.siga_aek
                 END + NVL(t1.susu_ga,0) + NVL(t1.susu_09900,0) - NVL(bfil_susu_ga,0) - NVL(day_susu_ga,0)
                            - NVL(bfil_susu_09900,0) - NVL(day_susu_09900,0)  /* _12- */
               , 0                                                            /* _13- */
               , NVL(t1.sung_cost,0)                                          /* _14- */
               , 0                                                            /* _15- */
               , NVL(t1.misu_ija,0)                                           /* _16- */
               , 0                                                            /* _17- */
               , CASE WHEN hj.cash_cd='90'
                      THEN t1.meib_aek
                      ELSE NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aek,0)
                                                   - NVL(t1.medo_aek,0)
                                                   + NVL(t1.anbun_aek,0)
                 END                                                          /* _18- */
               , NVL(t1.day_anbun_aek,0)                                      /* _19- */
               , t1.siga_aek - CASE WHEN hj.cash_cd='90'
                                    THEN t1.meib_aek
                                    ELSE NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aek,0)
                                                                 - NVL(t1.medo_aek,0)
                                                                 + NVL(t1.anbun_aek,0)
                               END                                            /* _20- */
               , NVL(t1.day_ija,0)                                            /* _21- */
