               , NVL(t1.yesu_tax,0)                                           /* _22- */
               , NVL(t1.sunn_tax,0)                                           /* _23- */
               , hj.sanghw_ymd                                                /* _24- */
               , 0                                                            /* _25- */
               , NVL(hj.pyom_iyul,0)                                          /* _26- */
               , 0                                                            /* _27- */
               , t1.ymd - hj.bf_ija_ymd                                       /* _28- */
               , NULL                                                         /* _29- */
               , NULL                                                         /* _30- */
               , sm.jy_suik_rt                                                /* _31- */
               , CASE WHEN hj.cash_cd='ZS' THEN hj.meib_suik_rt
                                           ELSE hj.pyom_iyul END              /* _32- */
               , 'Y'                                                          /* _33- */
               , NULL                                                         /* _34- */
               , '00:'                                                        /* _35- */
               , 0                                                            /* _36- */
               , NULL                                                         /* _37- */
               , CASE WHEN hj.cash_cd='AA'           THEN '2A'
                      WHEN hj.cash_cd IN ('ZS','ZF') THEN '2Z'
                                                     ELSE '2' END             /* _38- */
               , CASE WHEN hj.cash_cd='90'
                      THEN t1.meib_aek
                      ELSE NVL(t1.cons_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aek,0)
                                                        - NVL(t1.cons_medo_aek,0)
                                                        + NVL(t1.anbun_aek,0)
                 END                                                          /* _39- */
               , '1'                                                          /* _40- */
               , '1'                                                          /* _41- */
               , CASE WHEN hj.cash_cd='90' THEN 0
                                           ELSE NVL(t1.bfil_jilg,0) + NVL(t1.up_jilg,0)
                                                                    - NVL(t1.dw_jilg,0)
                 END                                                          /* _42- */
               , t1.lst_meib_ymd                                              /* _43- */
               , hj.balh_ymd                                                  /* _44- */
               , sm.md                                                        /* _45- */
               , sm.jy_last_pg_nm                                             /* _46- */
               , CASE WHEN hj.cash_cd='DC' AND hj.sunhu_gb='1'
                      THEN NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - 
                           NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0)
                      ELSE t1.siga_aek
                 END + NVL(t1.susu_ga,0) + NVL(t1.susu_09900,0) - NVL(bfil_susu_ga,0) - NVL(day_susu_ga,0)
                            - NVL(bfil_susu_09900,0) - NVL(day_susu_09900,0)  /* _47- */
               , 'PROC0930'                                                   /* _48- */
               , NULL                                                         /* _49- */
               , CASE WHEN hj.cash_cd='AA'            THEN '23'  /* 지분증권 출자지분 */
                      WHEN hj.cash_cd='90'            THEN '02'  /* 유동성자산 보통예금 */
                      WHEN hj.cash_cd='50'            THEN '03'  /* 유동성자산 정기예금 */
                      WHEN hj.cash_cd='60'            THEN '04'  /* 유동성자산 양도성예금증서(CD) */
                      WHEN hj.cash_cd='80'            THEN '05'  /* 유동성자산 환매조건부채권매수(RP) */
                      WHEN SUBSTR(hj.cash_cd,1,1)='7' THEN '06'  /* 유동성자산 기업어음증권(CP) */
                      WHEN hj.cash_cd='20'            THEN '07'
                                                      ELSE '08'
                 END                                                          /* _50- */
               , NULL                                                         /* _51- */
               , 0                                                            /* _52- */
               , NULL                                                         /* _53- */
               , hj.offer_co_cd                                               /* _54- */
               , NULL                                                         /* _55- */
               , NULL                                                         /* _56- */
               , NULL                                                         /* _57- */
               , hj.bf_ija_ymd                                                /* _58- */
               , hj.af_ija_ymd                                                /* _59- */
            FROM SHM0HM t1
            LEFT OUTER JOIN shm1sm sm  ON sm.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                      AND sm.ymd     = t1.ymd
                                      AND sm.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd     , SZM0IA ia
               , SHM0HJ hj
           WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
             AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
             AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
             AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
             AND hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
             AND hj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
        p_msg   := '신탁명세부(현금) 생성중 오류발생';
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- 현금 상환내역 삭제처리
    DELETE FROM UZM0UI
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd
       AND jm_cd   IN (SELECT jm_cd
                         FROM SHM0HJ ta
                        WHERE ta.corp_gr                     = p_corp_gr
                          AND F_OPEN_YMD(ta.sanghw_ymd,'+')  = p_ymd);

    -- 현금 전액매도 삭제처리
    DELETE FROM UZM0UI
     WHERE corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd          = p_ymd
       AND jm_cd        IN (SELECT jm_cd
                              FROM SHM0HJ ta
                             WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                               AND ta.cash_cd != '90')
       AND NVL(AEKM,0)  = 0;


    if  p_corp_gr = '2402'  then
        -- 리코자산 신용등급 매입일 기준
        FOR xx IN (
            SELECT t1.fund_cd
                 , t1.jm_cd
                 , TO_CHAR(hj.meib_ymd,'yyyymmdd')  AS buy_date
                 , hj.pg_cd
                 , gr.sebu_cd_nm                    AS pg_nm
              FROM SHM0HM t1
                 , SHM0HJ hj
                 , SZX0GR gr
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
               AND hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
               AND hj.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
               AND gr.gr_cd   = 'Y6'
               AND gr.sebu_cd = hj.pg_cd
        ) loop
            UPDATE UZM0UI tt  
               SET jy_pg_nm = xx.pg_nm
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND ymd      = p_ymd
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND buy_date = xx.buy_date;
        END LOOP;
    end if;

    UPDATE UZM0UI tt  
       SET sise = TRUNC(siga_aek / aekm * 10000,4)
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd     = p_ymd
       AND aekm    != 0
       AND jm_gr   LIKE '2%';

    p_msg   := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0940 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 정보계 신탁재산명세부 생성(집합투자증권)
--
BEGIN
    -- 모자펀드간 집합투자증권
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO UZM0UI tt  
          SELECT p_corp_gr                                                  /* _1- */
               , t1.ymd                                                     /* _2- */
               , ia.type_gb                                                 /* _3- */
               , t1.fund_cd                                                 /* _4- */
               , SUBSTR('KR5' || t1.mo_fund_cd || '00000',1,12)             /* _5- */
               , '%'                                                        /* _6- */
               , ROWNUM                                                     /* _7- */
               , mo.fund_nm                                                 /* _8- */
               , NVL(t1.bfil_jwa,0) + NVL(t1.up_jwa,0) - NVL(t1.dw_jwa,0)   /* _9- */
               , gi.gijun_ga                                                /* _10- */
               , 0                                                          /* _11- */
               , NVL(t1.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_aek,0)
                                    - NVL(t1.gyul_aek,0) + NVL(t1.sonik,0)  /* _12- */
               , 0                                                          /* _13- */
               , 0                                                          /* _14- */
               , 0                                                          /* _15- */
               , 0                                                          /* _16- */
               , 0                                                          /* _17- */
               , NVL(t1.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_aek,0)
                                    - NVL(t1.gyul_aek,0)                    /* _18- */
               , 0                                                          /* _19- */
               , NVL(t1.sonik,0)                                            /* _20- */
               , 0                                                          /* _21- */
               , 0                                                          /* _22- */
               , 0                                                          /* _23- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _24- */
               , 0                                                          /* _25- */
               , 0                                                          /* _26- */
               , 0                                                          /* _27- */
               , 0                                                          /* _28- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _29- */
               , 'KRW'                                                      /* _30- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _31- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _32- */
               , 'Y'                                                        /* _33- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _34- */
               , '00:'                                                      /* _35- */
               , 0                                                          /* _36- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _37- */
               , '6'                                                        /* _38- */
               , NVL(t1.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_aek,0)
                                    - NVL(t1.gyul_aek,0) + NVL(t1.sonik,0)  /* _39- */
               , '1'                                                        /* _40- */
               , '1'                                                        /* _41- */
               , 0                                                          /* _42- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _43- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _44- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _45- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _46- */
               , NVL(t1.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_aek,0) - NVL(t1.dw_aek,0)
                                    - NVL(t1.gyul_aek,0) + NVL(t1.sonik,0)  /* _47- */
               , 'PROC0940'                                                 /* _48- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _49- */
               , '26'                                                       /* _50- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _51- */
               , 0                                                          /* _52- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _53- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _54- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _55- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _56- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _57- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _58- */
               , NULL                                                       /* _59- */
            FROM SJM0SM t1
               , SZM0IA ia
               , SKT0GI gi
               , SZM0IA mo
           WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
             AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
             AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
             AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
             AND gi.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
             AND gi.ymd     = t1.ymd
             AND gi.fund_cd = t1.mo_fund_cd
             AND gi.work_gb = F_WORK_GB(p_corp_gr,t1.mo_fund_cd,t1.ymd)
             AND mo.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
             AND mo.fund_cd = t1.mo_fund_cd;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
        p_msg   := '신탁명세부(집합투자증권) 생성중 오류발생';
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- 타사
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT ia.type_gb                                                                               /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                               /* _2- */
             , t1.tasa_jm_cd                                                                            /* _3- */
             , jm.fund_nm                                                                               /* _4- */
             , sc.dang_gijun_ga                                                                         /* _5- */
             , jm.nav_target_yn                                                                         /* _6- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_jwa,0) + NVL(t1.up_jwa,0)
                                          - NVL(t1.dw_jwa,0)), 0)                      AS jwa           /* _7- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_aek,0)
                                          - NVL(t1.dw_aek,0)
                                          + NVL(t1.sonik,0)), 0)                       AS siga_aek      /* _8- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.bfil_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_aek,0)
                                          - NVL(t1.dw_aek,0)), 0)                      AS aek           /* _9- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.sonik), 0)                                                   AS sonik         /* _10- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.cons_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_aek,0)
                                                    - NVL(t1.cons_dw_chui_aek,0)), 0)  AS cons_chui_aek /* _11- */
          FROM SJM5SM t1
          LEFT OUTER JOIN sjt0sc sc  ON sc.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                                    AND sc.ymd     = t1.ymd
                                    AND sc.jm_cd   = t1.tasa_jm_cd
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SJM0SC jm
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
           AND jm.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND jm.tasa_jm_cd = t1.tasa_jm_cd
         GROUP BY ia.type_gb
                , t1.fund_cd
                , t1.tasa_jm_cd
                , jm.fund_nm
                , sc.dang_gijun_ga
                , jm.nav_target_yn
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO UZM0UI tt  
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd             /* _2- */
                   , xx.type_gb        /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd        /* _4- */
                   , xx.tasa_jm_cd     /* _5- */
                   , '%'               /* _6- */
                   , 1                 /* _7- */
                   , xx.fund_nm        /* _8- */
                   , xx.jwa            /* _9- */
                   , xx.dang_gijun_ga  /* _10- */
                   , 0                 /* _11- */
                   , xx.siga_aek       /* _12- */
                   , 0                 /* _13- */
                   , 0                 /* _14- */
                   , 0                 /* _15- */
                   , 0                 /* _16- */
                   , 0                 /* _17- */
                   , xx.aek            /* _18- */
                   , 0                 /* _19- */
                   , xx.sonik          /* _20- */
                   , 0                 /* _21- */
                   , 0                 /* _22- */
                   , 0                 /* _23- */
                   , NULL              /* _24- */
                   , 0                 /* _25- */
                   , 0                 /* _26- */
                   , 0                 /* _27- */
                   , 0                 /* _28- */
                   , NULL              /* _29- */
                   , 'KRW'             /* _30- */
                   , NULL              /* _31- */
                   , NULL              /* _32- */
                   , xx.nav_target_yn  /* _33- */
                   , NULL              /* _34- */
                   , '00:'             /* _35- */
                   , 0                 /* _36- */
                   , NULL              /* _37- */
                   , '6'               /* _38- */
                   , xx.cons_chui_aek  /* _39- */
                   , '1'               /* _40- */
                   , '1'               /* _41- */
                   , 0                 /* _42- */
                   , NULL              /* _43- */
                   , NULL              /* _44- */
                   , NULL              /* _45- */
                   , NULL              /* _46- */
                   , xx.siga_aek       /* _47- */
                   , 'PROC0940b'       /* _48- */
                   , NULL              /* _49- */
                   , '26'              /* _50- */
                   , NULL              /* _51- */
                   , 0                 /* _52- */
                   , NULL              /* _53- */
                   , NULL              /* _54- */
                   , NULL              /* _55- */
                   , NULL              /* _56- */
                   , NULL              /* _57- */
                   , NULL              /* _58- */
                   , NULL              /* _59- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            p_msg   := '신탁명세부(타사집합투자증권) 생성중 오류발생:' || xx.fund_cd || ' (' || xx.tasa_jm_cd || ')';
            RETURN;
        END;
    END LOOP;

    -- 매수진행중인 집합투자증권 증거금처리 (기준가적용일 GIJUNGA_YMD > 결제일 SUDO_YMD인 경우)
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT CASE WHEN SUBSTR (t1.tr_cd,1,1)='K' THEN -1
                                                   ELSE 1
               END                     AS tr_cd_s  /* _1- */
             , ia.type_gb                          /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                          /* _3- */
             , t1.tasa_jm_cd                       /* _4- */
             , sc.fund_nm || CASE WHEN SUBSTR(t1.tr_cd,1,1)='K' THEN '(매도)'
                                                                ELSE '(매수)'
                             END       AS fund_nm  /* _5- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.tr_jwa), 0)  AS jwa      /* _6- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.tr_aek), 0)  AS siga_aek /* _7- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.tr_aek), 0)  AS aek      /* _8- */
          FROM SJT5SG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SJM0SC sc
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.gijunga_ymd > p_ymd
           AND t1.sudo_ymd    <= p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd     = t1.fund_cd
           AND sc.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
           AND sc.tasa_jm_cd  = t1.tasa_jm_cd
         GROUP BY CASE WHEN SUBSTR (t1.tr_cd,1,1)='K' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END
                , ia.type_gb
                , t1.fund_cd
                , t1.tasa_jm_cd
                , sc.fund_nm || CASE WHEN SUBSTR(t1.tr_cd,1,1)='K' THEN '(매도)' ELSE '(매수)' END
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO UZM0UI tt  
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr                 /* _1- */
               , p_ymd                     /* _2- */
               , xx.type_gb                /* _3- */
               , xx.fund_cd                /* _4- */
               , xx.tasa_jm_cd             /* _5- */
               , '%'                       /* _6- */
               , 1                         /* _7- */
               , xx.fund_nm                /* _8- */
               , xx.jwa * xx.tr_cd_s       /* _9- */
               , 0                         /* _10- */
               , 0                         /* _11- */
               , xx.siga_aek * xx.tr_cd_s  /* _12- */
               , 0                         /* _13- */
               , 0                         /* _14- */
               , 0                         /* _15- */
               , 0                         /* _16- */
               , 0                         /* _17- */
               , xx.aek * xx.tr_cd_s       /* _18- */
               , 0                         /* _19- */
               , 0                         /* _20- */
               , 0                         /* _21- */
               , 0                         /* _22- */
               , 0                         /* _23- */
               , NULL                      /* _24- */
               , 0                         /* _25- */
               , 0                         /* _26- */
               , 0                         /* _27- */
               , 0                         /* _28- */
               , NULL                      /* _29- */
               , 'KRW'                     /* _30- */
               , NULL                      /* _31- */
               , NULL                      /* _32- */
               , 'Y'                       /* _33- */
               , NULL                      /* _34- */
               , '00:'                     /* _35- */
               , 0                         /* _36- */
               , NULL                      /* _37- */
               , '6'                       /* _38- */
               , NULL                      /* _39- */
               , '1'                       /* _40- */
               , '1'                       /* _41- */
               , 0                         /* _42- */
               , NULL                      /* _43- */
               , NULL                      /* _44- */
               , NULL                      /* _45- */
               , NULL                      /* _46- */
               , xx.aek                    /* _47- */
               , 'PROC0940c'               /* _48- */
               , NULL                      /* _49- */
               , '26'                      /* _50- */
               , NULL                      /* _51- */
               , 0                         /* _52- */
               , NULL                      /* _53- */
               , NULL                      /* _54- */
               , NULL                      /* _55- */
               , NULL                      /* _56- */
               , NULL                      /* _57- */
               , NULL                      /* _58- */
               , NULL                      /* _59- */
               );
    END LOOP;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0950 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 정보계 신탁재산명세부 생성(선물)
--
    w_bogo_gr                      VARCHAR(20);
BEGIN
    -- 선물 마스타 내역 insert
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.ymd                                                                                                          /* _1- */
             , ia.type_gb                                                                                                      /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                                      /* _3- */
             , kj.sj_cd                                                                                                        /* _4- */
             , kj.sj_nm                                                                                                        /* _5- */
             , kj.unit_aek                                                                                                     /* _6- */
             , kj.lsy_ymd                                                                                                      /* _7- */
             , tg.close                                                                                                        /* _8- */
             , t1.sm_tr_gb                                                                                                     /* _9- */
             , kj.jasan                                                                                                        /* _10- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(t1.up_gyey_su,0) - NVL(t1.dw_gyey_su,0)),0)              AS aekm           /* _11- */
             , ROUND (SUM((NVL(t1.pass_gyey_su,0) + NVL(t1.up_gyey_su,0) - NVL(t1.dw_gyey_su,0)) * tg.close
                                                  * kj.unit_aek))                                            AS siga_aek       /* _12- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.pass_chui_ga,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_ga,0) - NVL(t1.dw_chui_ga,0)),0)              AS chui_aek       /* _13- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.pyunga_sonik),0)                                                                   AS pyunga_sonik   /* _14- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.pyunga_tr_cha),0)                                                                  AS dang_misu_ija  /* _15- */
             , NVL(SUM(NVL(t1.cons_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.up_chui_ga,0) - NVL(t1.cons_dw_chui_aek,0)),0)  AS cons_chui_aek  /* _16- */
          FROM SSM0KM t1  /* 파생 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SJT1TG tg  /* 주식/선물/Option 종목별 종가(영업일만 존재) */
             , SSX0KJ kj  /* 파생종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd       = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd   = t1.fund_cd
           AND tg.ymd       = F_TRADE_YMD(t1.ymd,'-')
           AND tg.koscom_cd = t1.sj_cd
           AND kj.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr
           AND kj.sj_cd     = t1.sj_cd
         GROUP BY t1.ymd     , ia.type_gb, t1.fund_cd, kj.sj_cd   , kj.sj_nm
                , kj.unit_aek, kj.lsy_ymd, tg.close  , t1.sm_tr_gb, kj.jasan
    ) loop
        if  xx.sm_tr_gb IN ('1','3','5','2','4','6')    then
            if  xx.jasan BETWEEN '60' AND '74'                                          then    w_bogo_gr := '34-f';  -- 파생상품 장내파생상품 이자율관련거래
            elsif xx.jasan BETWEEN '75' AND '84'                                        then    w_bogo_gr := '35-f';  -- 파생상품 장내파생상품 통화관련거래
            elsif (xx.jasan BETWEEN '01' AND '59') OR (xx.jasan BETWEEN 'A0' AND 'ZZ')  then    w_bogo_gr := '36-f';  -- 파생상품 장내파생상품 주식관련거래
            elsif xx.jasan BETWEEN '85' AND '99'                                        then    w_bogo_gr := '37-f';  -- 파생상품 장내파생상품 기타
            else                                                                                w_bogo_gr := '37-f';  /* 파생상품 장내파생상품 기타 */
            end if;
        end if;

        INSERT INTO UZM0UI tt   /* 정보계 신탁재산 명세부 */
             ( corp_gr             /* _1- */
             , ymd                 /* _2- */
             , type_gb             /* _3- */
             , fund_cd             /* _4- */
             , jm_cd               /* _5- */
             , chasu               /* _6- */
             , jm_nm               /* _7- */
             , aekm                /* _8- */
             , sise                /* _9- */
             , siga_aek            /* _10- */
             , tr_danga            /* _11- */
             , chui_aek            /* _12- */
             , pyunga_sonik        /* _13- */
             , dang_misu_ija       /* _14- */
             , sanghw_ymd          /* _15- */
             , nav_target_yn       /* _16- */
             , jm_gr               /* _17- */
             , cons_chui_aek       /* _18- */
             , jasan_gr1           /* _19- */
             , jasan_gr2           /* _20- */
             , sun_jasan_siga_aek  /* _21- */
             , cre_proc            /* _22- */
             , bogo_gr             /* _23- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                           /* _1- */
               , xx.ymd                                                              /* _2- */
               , xx.type_gb                                                          /* _3- */
               , xx.fund_cd                                                          /* _4- */
               , xx.sj_cd                                                            /* _5- */
               , xx.sm_tr_gb                                                         /* _6- */
               , xx.sj_nm                                                            /* _7- */
               , xx.aekm                                                             /* _8- */
               , xx.close                                                            /* _9- */
               , xx.siga_aek                                                         /* _10- */
               , CASE WHEN xx.aekm=0 THEN 0
                                     ELSE xx.chui_aek / (xx.aekm * xx.unit_aek) END  /* _11- */
               , xx.chui_aek                                                         /* _12- */
               , xx.pyunga_sonik                                                     /* _13- */
               , xx.dang_misu_ija                                                    /* _14- */
               , xx.lsy_ymd                                                          /* _15- */
               , 'Y'                                                                 /* _16- */
               , '4' || xx.sm_tr_gb                                                  /* _17- */
               , xx.cons_chui_aek                                                    /* _18- */
               , '1'                                                                 /* _19- */
               , '1'                                                                 /* _20- */
               , CASE WHEN xx.sm_tr_gb IN ('1','2') THEN 0
                                                    ELSE xx.pyunga_sonik END         /* _21- */
               , 'SR_SKKP010_905a'                                                   /* _22- */
               , w_bogo_gr                                                           /* _23- */
               );

    end loop;

    -- 위탁 증거금
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.ymd                                                        /* _1- */
             , t1.gwamok                                                     /* _2- */
             , gm.gwamok_nm                                                  /* _3- */
             , ia.type_gb                                                    /* _4- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                    /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)  AS aek  /* _6- */
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZX0GM gm  /* 계정과목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok  = '10105'
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND gm.gwamok  = t1.gwamok
    ) loop
        INSERT INTO UZM0UI tt   /* 정보계 신탁재산 명세부 */
             ( corp_gr             /* _1- */
             , ymd                 /* _2- */
             , type_gb             /* _3- */
             , fund_cd             /* _4- */
             , jm_cd               /* _5- */
             , chasu               /* _6- */
             , jm_nm               /* _7- */
             , aekm                /* _8- */
             , chui_aek            /* _9- */
             , siga_aek            /* _10- */
             , won_hwans_sonik     /* _11- */
             , pyunga_sonik        /* _12- */
             , tr_danga            /* _13- */
             , nav_target_yn       /* _14- */
             , jm_gr               /* _15- */
             , jasan_gr1           /* _16- */
             , jasan_gr2           /* _17- */
             , sun_jasan_siga_aek  /* _18- */
             , cre_proc            /* _19- */
             , bogo_gr             /* _20- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
               , xx.ymd        /* _2- */
               , xx.type_gb    /* _3- */
               , xx.fund_cd    /* _4- */
               , 'KRW'         /* _5- */
               , xx.gwamok     /* _6- */
               , xx.gwamok_nm  /* _7- */
               , 0             /* _8- */
               , xx.aek        /* _9- */
               , xx.aek        /* _10- */
               , 0             /* _11- */
               , 0             /* _12- */
               , 0             /* _13- */
               , 'Y'           /* _14- */
               , '4'           /* _15- */
               , '1'           /* _16- */
               , '1'           /* _17- */
               , xx.aek        /* _18- */
               , 'PROC0950'    /* _19- */
               , '01'          /* _20- */
               );
    end loop;

    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := SUBSTR  (sqlerrm, 1, 180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0960 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 정보계 해외자산 마스타 생성
--
    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    -- 해외자산 마스타 Data 생성

    DELETE FROM UYM0YW t1   /* 정보계 해외자산 보유현황 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd;

    INSERT INTO UYM0YW  /* 정보계 해외자산 보유현황 */
    SELECT p_corp_gr                                                      /* _1- */
         , t1.ymd                                                         /* _2- */
         , t1.fund_cd                                                     /* _3- */
         , t1.trustee                                                     /* _4- */
         , t1.jm_cd                                                       /* _5- */
         , ya.jm_nm                                                       /* _6- */
         , t1.currency                                                    /* _7- */
         , NVL(tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(tr_up_jusu,0)
                               - NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0)
                               + NVL(RIGHT_JUSU,0)                        /* _8- */
         , NVL(tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0)
                                   - NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                   + NVL(RIGHT_AEK,0)                     /* _9- */
         , NVL(won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0)
                                    - NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                    + NVL(RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)                /* _10- */
         , NVL(sung_cost,0)                                               /* _11- */
         , NVL(won_sung_cost,0)                                           /* _12- */
         , F_CURRENCY_RT (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, t1.currency)                /* _13- */
         , tr_pyunga_aek                                                  /* _14- */
         , won_pyunga_aek                                                 /* _15- */
         , won_pyunga_sonik                                               /* _16- */
         , won_hwan_cha                                                   /* _17- */
         , NULL                                                           /* _18- */
         , NULL                                                           /* _19- */
         , NULL                                                           /* _20- */
         , NULL                                                           /* _21- */
         , NVL(misu_ija,0)                                                /* _22- */
         , NVL(won_misu_ija,0)                                            /* _23- */
         , NULL                                                           /* _24- */
         , NULL                                                           /* _25- */
         , 'Z' || CASE WHEN ya.jasan_gb='1'
                       THEN CASE ya.sj_gb WHEN '3' THEN '6'
                                          WHEN '2' THEN '7'
                                          WHEN '9' THEN '8'
                                                   ELSE '1' END
                       WHEN ya.jasan_gb='2'
                       THEN CASE ya.sj_gb WHEN 'Z' THEN '3'
                                                   ELSE '2' END
                       WHEN ya.jasan_gb='A'
                       THEN CASE WHEN ya.sj_gb='1' AND t1.sm_tr_gb='1' THEN 'A'
                                 WHEN ya.sj_gb='1' AND t1.sm_tr_gb='2' THEN 'B'
                                 WHEN ya.sj_gb='2' AND t1.sm_tr_gb='3' THEN 'C'
                                 WHEN ya.sj_gb='2' AND t1.sm_tr_gb='4' THEN 'D'
                                 WHEN ya.sj_gb='3' AND t1.sm_tr_gb='5' THEN 'E'
                                 WHEN ya.sj_gb='3' AND t1.sm_tr_gb='6' THEN 'F'
                                                                       ELSE ya.jasan_gb END
                       ELSE ya.jasan_gb END                               /* _26- */
         , t1.bs_type                                                     /* _27- */
         , NVL(fcur_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0)
                                     - NVL(fcur_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                     + NVL(RIGHT_FCUR_AEK,0)              /* _28- */
         , NVL(fcur_sung_cost,0)                                          /* _29- */
         , fcur_pyunga_aek                                                /* _30- */
         , fcur_pyunga_sonik                                              /* _31- */
         , fcur_hwan_cha                                                  /* _32- */
         , NULL                                                           /* _33- */
         , NULL                                                           /* _34- */
         , NVL(fcur_misu_ija,0)                                           /* _35- */
         , NULL                                                           /* _36- */
         , NVL(cons_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0)
                                     + NVL(RIGHT_AEK,0)
                                     - NVL(cons_dw_chui_aek,0)            /* _37- */
         , NVL(cons_won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0)
                                         + NVL(RIGHT_WON_AEK,0)
                                         - NVL(cons_won_dw_chui_aek,0)    /* _38- */
         , NVL(cons_fcur_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0)
                                          + NVL(RIGHT_FCUR_AEK,0)
                                          - NVL(cons_fcur_dw_chui_aek,0)  /* _39- */
      FROM SYM0YZ t1  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
         , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
       AND ya.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
       AND ya.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd;

    INSERT INTO UYM0YW  /* 정보계 해외자산 보유현황 */
    SELECT t1.corp_gr                                              /* _1- */
         , t1.ymd                                                  /* _2- */
         , yg.fund_cd                                              /* _3- */
         , yg.trustee                                              /* _4- */
         , yg.jm_cd                                                /* _5- */
         , ya.jm_nm                                                /* _6- */
         , yg.currency                                             /* _7- */
         , MAX(t1.jusu)                                            /* _8- */
         , SUM(t1.gyulje_aek)                                      /* _9- */
         , SUM(t1.won_gyulje_aek)                                  /* _10- */
         , 0                                                       /* _11- */
         , 0                                                       /* _12- */
         , AVG(t1.gijun_rt)                                        /* _13- */
         , SUM(t1.pyunga_aek)                                      /* _14- */
         , SUM(NVL(t1.won_gyulje_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_pyunga_sonik,0)
                                        + NVL(t1.won_hwan_cha,0))  /* _15- */
         , SUM(t1.won_pyunga_sonik)                                /* _16- */
         , SUM(t1.won_hwan_cha)                                    /* _17- */
         , NULL                                                    /* _18- */
         , NULL                                                    /* _19- */
         , NULL                                                    /* _20- */
         , NULL                                                    /* _21- */
         , NULL                                                    /* _22- */
         , NULL                                                    /* _23- */
         , NULL                                                    /* _24- */
         , NULL                                                    /* _25- */
         , CASE WHEN yg.tr_cd IN ('G12','G17') THEN 'ZH'
                WHEN yg.tr_cd IN ('G11','G16') THEN 'ZY'
                WHEN yg.tr_cd IN ('G31','G32') THEN 'ZT'
                WHEN yg.tr_cd IN ('G35','G36') THEN 'ZU'
           END                                                     /* _26- */
         , yg.bs_type                                              /* _27- */
         , SUM(t1.fcur_gyulje_aek)                                 /* _28- */
         , NULL                                                    /* _29- */
         , NULL                                                    /* _30- */
         , NULL                                                    /* _31- */
         , NULL                                                    /* _32- */
         , NULL                                                    /* _33- */
         , NULL                                                    /* _34- */
         , NULL                                                    /* _35- */
         , NULL                                                    /* _36- */
         , SUM(t1.gyulje_aek)                                      /* _37- */
         , SUM(t1.won_gyulje_aek)                                  /* _38- */
         , SUM(t1.fcur_gyulje_aek)                                 /* _39- */
      FROM SYT0YG_PYUNGA t1  /* 해외 배당/주식권리 일별 평가 */
         , SYT0YG        yg  /* 해외 배당/주식권리 현황 */
         , SYM0YA        ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr                    = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd                        = p_ymd
       AND NVL(t1.churi_ymd, t1.ymd + 1) > t1.ymd
       AND yg.corp_gr                    = t1.corp_gr
       AND yg.pyunga_join                = t1.pyunga_join
       AND ya.corp_gr                    = t1.corp_gr
       AND ya.jm_cd                      = yg.jm_cd
     GROUP BY t1.corp_gr
            , t1.ymd
            , yg.fund_cd
            , yg.trustee
            , yg.jm_cd
            , ya.jm_nm
            , yg.currency
            , CASE WHEN yg.tr_cd IN ('G12','G17') THEN 'ZH'
                   WHEN yg.tr_cd IN ('G11','G16') THEN 'ZY'
                   WHEN yg.tr_cd IN ('G31','G32') THEN 'ZT'
                   WHEN yg.tr_cd IN ('G35','G36') THEN 'ZU' END
            , yg.bs_type;

    -- 수도결제 미수입금 생성
    for r1 IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd           /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd          /* _2- */
             , t1.trustee          /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd            /* _4- */
             , t1.bs_type          /* _5- */
             , ya.jm_nm            /* _6- */
             , ya.currency         /* _7- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek       /* _8- */
             , t1.won_gyulje_aek   /* _9- */
             , t1.fcur_gyulje_aek  /* _10- */
          FROM SYT0YS t1  /* 해외 수도결제 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd       = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd     LIKE 'K%'
           AND t1.gyulje_gb = 'N'
           AND ya.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd     = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb  = '1'
    ) loop
        UPDATE UYM0YW   /* 정보계 해외자산 보유현황 */
           SET misu_aek      = NVL(misu_aek,0) + r1.gyulje_aek
             , won_misu_aek  = NVL(won_misu_aek,0) + r1.won_gyulje_aek
             , fcur_misu_aek = NVL(fcur_misu_aek,0) + r1.fcur_gyulje_aek
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = r1.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = r1.jm_cd
           AND bs_type = r1.bs_type
           AND ymd     = r1.tr_ymd
           AND trustee = r1.trustee;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO UYM0YW  /* 정보계 해외자산 보유현황 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr           /* _1- */
                   , r1.tr_ymd           /* _2- */
                   , r1.fund_cd          /* _3- */
                   , r1.trustee          /* _4- */
                   , r1.jm_cd            /* _5- */
                   , r1.jm_nm            /* _6- */
                   , r1.currency         /* _7- */
                   , 0                   /* _8- */
                   , 0                   /* _9- */
                   , 0                   /* _10- */
                   , 0                   /* _11- */
                   , 0                   /* _12- */
                   , NULL                /* _13- */
                   , NULL                /* _14- */
                   , NULL                /* _15- */
                   , NULL                /* _16- */
                   , NULL                /* _17- */
                   , r1.gyulje_aek       /* _18- */
                   , r1.won_gyulje_aek   /* _19- */
                   , NULL                /* _20- */
                   , NULL                /* _21- */
                   , NULL                /* _22- */
                   , NULL                /* _23- */
                   , NULL                /* _24- */
                   , NULL                /* _25- */
                   , '1'                 /* _26-?? */
                   , r1.bs_type          /* _27- */
                   , NULL                /* _28- */
                   , NULL                /* _29- */
                   , NULL                /* _30- */
                   , NULL                /* _31- */
                   , NULL                /* _32- */
                   , r1.fcur_gyulje_aek  /* _33- */
                   , NULL                /* _34- */
                   , NULL                /* _35- */
                   , NULL                /* _36- */
                   , r1.gyulje_aek       /* _37- */
                   , r1.won_gyulje_aek   /* _38- */
                   , r1.fcur_gyulje_aek  /* _39- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 수도결제 미지급금 생성
    for r1 IN (
        SELECT t1.ymd              /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd          /* _2- */
             , t1.trustee          /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd            /* _4- */
             , t1.bs_type          /* _5- */
             , ya.jm_nm            /* _6- */
             , ya.currency         /* _7- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek       /* _8- */
             , t1.won_gyulje_aek   /* _9- */
             , t1.fcur_gyulje_aek  /* _10- */
          FROM SYT0YS t1  /* 해외 수도결제 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd       = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd     LIKE 'J%'
           AND t1.gyulje_gb = 'N'
           AND ya.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd     = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb  = '1'
    ) loop
        UPDATE UYM0YW   /* 정보계 해외자산 보유현황 */
           SET mijk_aek      = NVL(mijk_aek,0) + r1.gyulje_aek
             , won_mijk_aek  = NVL(won_mijk_aek,0) + r1.won_gyulje_aek
             , fcur_mijk_aek = NVL(fcur_mijk_aek,0) + r1.fcur_gyulje_aek
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = r1.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = r1.jm_cd
           AND bs_type = r1.bs_type
           AND ymd     = r1.ymd
           AND trustee = r1.trustee;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO UYM0YW  /* 정보계 해외자산 보유현황 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr           /* _1- */
                   , r1.ymd              /* _2- */
                   , r1.fund_cd          /* _3- */
                   , r1.trustee          /* _4- */
                   , r1.jm_cd            /* _5- */
                   , r1.jm_nm            /* _6- */
                   , r1.currency         /* _7- */
                   , 0                   /* _8- */
                   , 0                   /* _9- */
                   , 0                   /* _10- */
                   , 0                   /* _11- */
                   , 0                   /* _12- */
                   , NULL                /* _13- */
                   , NULL                /* _14- */
                   , NULL                /* _15- */
                   , NULL                /* _16- */
                   , NULL                /* _17- */
                   , NULL                /* _18- */
                   , NULL                /* _19- */
                   , r1.gyulje_aek       /* _20- */
                   , r1.won_gyulje_aek   /* _21- */
                   , NULL                /* _22- */
                   , NULL                /* _23- */
                   , NULL                /* _24- */
                   , NULL                /* _25- */
                   , 'Z5'                /* _26- */
                   , r1.bs_type          /* _27- */
                   , NULL                /* _28- */
                   , NULL                /* _29- */
                   , NULL                /* _30- */
                   , NULL                /* _31- */
                   , NULL                /* _32- */
                   , NULL                /* _33- */
                   , r1.fcur_gyulje_aek  /* _34- */
                   , NULL                /* _35- */
                   , NULL                /* _36- */
                   , r1.gyulje_aek       /* _37- */
                   , r1.won_gyulje_aek   /* _38- */
                   , r1.fcur_gyulje_aek  /* _39- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 미수배당
    for r1 IN (
        SELECT ymd              /* _1- */
             , fund_cd          /* _2- */
             , trustee          /* _3- */
             , jm_cd            /* _4- */
             , bs_type          /* _5- */
             , currency         /* _6- */
             , gyulje_aek       /* _7- */
             , won_gyulje_aek   /* _8- */
             , fcur_gyulje_aek  /* _9- */
          FROM SYT0YS t1  /* 해외 수도결제 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'G25'
    ) loop
        UPDATE UYM0YW   /* 정보계 해외자산 보유현황 */
           SET misu_baed      = NVL(misu_baed,0) + r1.gyulje_aek
             , won_misu_baed  = NVL(won_misu_baed,0) + r1.won_gyulje_aek
             , fcur_misu_baed = NVL(fcur_misu_baed,0) + r1.fcur_gyulje_aek
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = r1.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = r1.jm_cd
           AND bs_type = r1.bs_type
           AND ymd     = r1.ymd
           AND trustee = r1.trustee;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO UYM0YW  /* 정보계 해외자산 보유현황 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                     /* _1- */
                   , r1.ymd                        /* _2- */
                   , r1.fund_cd                    /* _3- */
                   , r1.trustee                    /* _4- */
                   , r1.jm_cd                      /* _5- */
                   , F_JM_NM(p_corp_gr, r1.jm_cd)  /* _6- */
                   , r1.currency                   /* _7- */
                   , 0                             /* _8- */
                   , 0                             /* _9- */
                   , 0                             /* _10- */
                   , 0                             /* _11- */
                   , 0                             /* _12- */
                   , NULL                          /* _13- */
                   , NULL                          /* _14- */
                   , NULL                          /* _15- */
                   , NULL                          /* _16- */
                   , NULL                          /* _17- */
                   , NULL                          /* _18- */
                   , NULL                          /* _19- */
                   , NULL                          /* _20- */
                   , NULL                          /* _21- */
                   , NULL                          /* _22- */
                   , NULL                          /* _23- */
                   , r1.gyulje_aek                 /* _24- */
                   , r1.won_gyulje_aek             /* _25- */
                   , 'ZH'                          /* _26- */
                   , r1.bs_type                    /* _27- */
                   , NULL                          /* _28- */
                   , NULL                          /* _29- */
                   , NULL                          /* _30- */
                   , NULL                          /* _31- */
                   , NULL                          /* _32- */
                   , NULL                          /* _33- */
                   , NULL                          /* _34- */
                   , NULL                          /* _35- */
                   , r1.fcur_gyulje_aek            /* _36- */
                   , r1.gyulje_aek                 /* _37- */
                   , r1.won_gyulje_aek             /* _38- */
                   , r1.fcur_gyulje_aek            /* _39- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 미수이자
    for r1 IN (
        SELECT ymd              /* _1- */
             , fund_cd          /* _2- */
             , trustee          /* _3- */
             , jm_cd            /* _4- */
             , bs_type          /* _5- */
             , currency         /* _6- */
             , gyulje_aek       /* _7- */
             , won_gyulje_aek   /* _8- */
             , fcur_gyulje_aek  /* _9- */
          FROM SYT0YS t1  /* 해외 수도결제 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'E22'
    ) loop
        UPDATE UYM0YW   /* 정보계 해외자산 보유현황 */
           SET misu_ija      = NVL(misu_ija,0) + r1.gyulje_aek
             , won_misu_ija  = NVL(won_misu_ija,0) + r1.won_gyulje_aek
             , fcur_misu_ija = NVL(fcur_misu_ija,0) + r1.fcur_gyulje_aek
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = r1.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = r1.jm_cd
           AND bs_type = r1.bs_type
           AND ymd     = r1.ymd
           AND trustee = r1.trustee;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO UYM0YW  /* 정보계 해외자산 보유현황 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                     /* _1- */
                   , r1.ymd                        /* _2- */
                   , r1.fund_cd                    /* _3- */
                   , r1.trustee                    /* _4- */
                   , r1.jm_cd                      /* _5- */
                   , F_JM_NM(p_corp_gr, r1.jm_cd)  /* _6- */
                   , r1.currency                   /* _7- */
                   , 0                             /* _8- */
                   , 0                             /* _9- */
                   , 0                             /* _10- */
                   , 0                             /* _11- */
                   , 0                             /* _12- */
                   , NULL                          /* _13- */
                   , NULL                          /* _14- */
                   , NULL                          /* _15- */
                   , NULL                          /* _16- */
                   , NULL                          /* _17- */
                   , NULL                          /* _18- */
                   , NULL                          /* _19- */
                   , NULL                          /* _20- */
                   , NULL                          /* _21- */
                   , r1.gyulje_aek                 /* _22- */
                   , r1.won_gyulje_aek             /* _23- */
                   , NULL                          /* _24- */
                   , NULL                          /* _25- */
                   , 'Z5'                          /* _26- */
                   , r1.bs_type                    /* _27- */
                   , NULL                          /* _28- */
                   , NULL                          /* _29- */
                   , NULL                          /* _30- */
                   , NULL                          /* _31- */
                   , NULL                          /* _32- */
                   , NULL                          /* _33- */
                   , NULL                          /* _34- */
                   , r1.fcur_gyulje_aek            /* _35- */
                   , NULL                          /* _36- */
                   , r1.gyulje_aek                 /* _37- */
                   , r1.won_gyulje_aek             /* _38- */
                   , r1.fcur_gyulje_aek            /* _39- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 당일종가
    UPDATE UYM0YW t1    /* 정보계 해외자산 보유현황 */
       SET now_jonga = (SELECT jonga
                          FROM SYT0LP ta  /* 해외수신 종목 시세 */
                         WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                           AND ta.ymd     = F_OPEN_US(t1.ymd,'-')
                           AND ta.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd)
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
       AND t1.jm_cd   IN (SELECT jm_cd
                            FROM SYT0LP ta  /* 해외수신 종목 시세 */
                           WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                             AND ta.ymd     = F_OPEN_US(p_ymd,'-'));

    p_msg := 'Y';
    commit;
END;
