CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PROC0990 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 원장이외 자산 및 기타재산 생성
--
BEGIN
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO UZM0UI tt   /* 정보계 신탁재산 명세부 */
             ( corp_gr             /* _1- */
             , ymd                 /* _2- */
             , type_gb             /* _3- */
             , fund_cd             /* _4- */
             , jm_cd               /* _5- */
             , jm_nm               /* _6- */
             , chasu               /* _7- */
             , chui_aek            /* _8- */
             , siga_aek            /* _9- */
             , NAV_TARGET_YN       /* _10- */
             , TYPE_TRENCH         /* _11- */
             , BS_TYPE             /* _12- */
             , jm_gr               /* _13- */
             , cons_chui_aek       /* _14- */
             , jasan_gr1           /* _15- */
             , jasan_gr2           /* _16- */
             , sun_jasan_siga_aek  /* _17- */
             , cre_proc            /* _18- */
             , bogo_gr             /* _19- */
             )
        SELECT p_corp_gr                                                      /* _1- */
             , t1.ymd                                                         /* _2- */
             , ia.type_gb                                                     /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                     /* _4- */
             , t1.gwamok                                                      /* _5- */
             , gm.gwamok_nm                                                   /* _6- */
             , 0                                                              /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)           /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)           /* _9- */
             , 'Y'                                                            /* _10- */
             , '00:'                                                          /* _11- */
             , 0                                                              /* _12- */
             , '2'                                                            /* _13- */
             , NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)           /* _14- */
             , '1'                                                            /* _15- */
             , '2'                                                            /* _16- */
             , NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)           /* _17- */
             , 'PROC0990a'                                                    /* _18- */
             , CASE WHEN gm.gwamok='10103'                     THEN '01'
                    WHEN gm.gwamok BETWEEN '12051' AND '12099' THEN 'sy-53'  /* 해외 기타 */
                                                               ELSE '53' END  /* _19- */
          FROM SZX0GM gm  /* 계정과목 */
             , SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE gm.gwamok  NOT IN (SELECT jm_cd
                                    FROM UZM0UI ta  /* 정보계 신탁재산 명세부 */
                                   WHERE ta.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
                                     AND ta.ymd       = p_ymd
                                     AND ta.jasan_gr2 IN ('2','5','6'))
           AND (gm.gwamok='10103' OR gm.gwamok LIKE '120%')
           AND gm.inp_gb  = '1'
           AND t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok  = gm.gwamok
           AND NVL(t1.junj,0) + NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) - NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd;

        INSERT INTO UZM0UI tt   /* 정보계 신탁재산 명세부 */
             ( corp_gr             /* _1- */
             , ymd                 /* _2- */
             , type_gb             /* _3- */
             , fund_cd             /* _4- */
             , jm_cd               /* _5- */
             , jm_nm               /* _6- */
             , chasu               /* _7- */
             , chui_aek            /* _8- */
             , siga_aek            /* _9- */
             , NAV_TARGET_YN       /* _10- */
             , TYPE_TRENCH         /* _11- */
             , BS_TYPE             /* _12- */
             , jm_gr               /* _13- */
             , cons_chui_aek       /* _14- */
             , jasan_gr1           /* _15- */
             , jasan_gr2           /* _16- */
             , sun_jasan_siga_aek  /* _17- */
             , cre_proc            /* _18- */
             )
        SELECT p_corp_gr                                                       /* _1- */
             , t1.ymd                                                          /* _2- */
             , ia.type_gb                                                      /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                      /* _4- */
             , t1.gwamok                                                       /* _5- */
             , gm.gwamok_nm                                                    /* _6- */
             , 0                                                               /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.junj,0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) + NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)            /* _8- */
             , (NVL(t1.junj, 0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek, 0) + NVL(t1.cr_aek, 0)) * -1  /* _9- */
             , 'Y'                                                             /* _10- */
             , '00:'                                                           /* _11- */
             , 0                                                               /* _12- */
             , '2'                                                             /* _13- */
             , NVL(t1.junj,0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) + NVL(t1.cr_aek,0)            /* _14- */
             , '2'                                                             /* _15- */
             , '2'                                                             /* _16- */
             , (NVL(t1.junj, 0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek, 0) + NVL(t1.cr_aek, 0)) * -1  /* _17- */
             , 'PROC0990b'                                                     /* _18- */
          FROM SZX0GM gm  /* 계정과목 */
             , SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE gm.gwamok   NOT IN ('20204','20208')
           AND gm.inp_gb   = '1'
           AND REGEXP_LIKE (gm.gwamok,'^20[23]')
           AND t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb  = 'A'
           AND t1.gwamok   = gm.gwamok
           AND NVL(t1.junj,0) - NVL(t1.dr_aek,0) + NVL(t1.cr_aek,0) != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := '신탁명세부(자산/부채계정) 생성중 오류발생';
        RETURN;
    END;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_PYUNGJAN (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
 ) AS
-- 평잔 재계산
--
    w_fymd                         DATE;
    w_bf                           DATE;
    w_af                           DATE;

    w_gi                           NUMBER;
    w_jan                          NUMBER;
    w_junj                         NUMBER;
    w_A0403                        NUMBER;
    w_A0412                        NUMBER;
    w_wonbon_aek                   NUMBER;
    w_gigan_jan                    NUMBER;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    BEGIN
        SELECT gyul_gi
             , bf_gyul_ymd
             , af_gyul_ymd
          INTO w_gi
             , w_bf
             , w_af
          FROM SZM0GI t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 결산구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND p_ymd      BETWEEN (t1.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AND t1.af_gyul_ymd;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        -- 재계약 처리 오류(평잔게산 PASS)
        RETURN;
    END;

    UPDATE SZM0IA t1    /* 자문 계좌정보 */
       SET gyul_gi     = w_gi
         , bf_gyul_ymd = w_bf
         , af_gyul_ymd = w_af
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd;

    BEGIN
        SELECT wonbon_aek
             , wonbon_aek
          INTO w_wonbon_aek
             , w_gigan_jan
          FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = w_bf + 1;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        -- 재계약 처리 오류(평잔게산 PASS)
        RETURN;
    END;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                                        /* _1- */
             , NVL(t1.in_aek,0) - NVL(t1.out_aek,0)              AS aek         /* _2- */
             , NVL(t1.io_jo,0)                                   AS io_jo       /* _3- */
             , TRUNC((w_af - t1.tr_ymd + 1) / (w_af - w_bf),12)  AS gigan_rt    /* _4- */
             , w_af - t1.tr_ymd + 1                              AS gigan_ilsu  /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_ymd - w_bf - 1                              AS ilsu        /* _6- */
             , aa.customer_gr                                                   /* _7- */
          FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
             , SZX0AA aa  /* 작업관련 일자관리 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.tr_ymd  BETWEEN w_bf + 2 AND p_ymd
           AND (t1.in_aek > 0 OR t1.out_aek > 0)
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND aa.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
         ORDER BY t1.tr_ymd
    ) loop
        w_wonbon_aek := w_wonbon_aek + xx.aek;
        w_gigan_jan  := w_gigan_jan + TRUNC (xx.aek * xx.gigan_rt);

        if  xx.customer_gr = '자산운용' then
            -- 원본조정액 입력분 그대로 반영(차후를 위해 기간가중금액 산정)
            -- 입출금으로 입력한 경우 해당금액 가중평균없이 처리
            if  xx.aek != 0 then
                UPDATE SZT0IO t1    /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
                   SET WONBON_AEK = w_wonbon_aek
                     , gigan_per  = xx.gigan_rt * 100
                     , gigan_amt  = TRUNC(xx.aek * xx.gigan_rt)
                     , gigan_ilsu = xx.gigan_ilsu
                     , pass_ilsu  = xx.ilsu
                 WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
                   AND tr_ymd  = xx.tr_ymd;
            else
                UPDATE SZT0IO t1    /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
                   SET gigan_per  = xx.gigan_rt * 100
                     , gigan_amt  = TRUNC(xx.aek * xx.gigan_rt)
                     , gigan_ilsu = xx.gigan_ilsu
                     , pass_ilsu  = xx.ilsu
                 WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                   AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
                   AND tr_ymd  = xx.tr_ymd;
            end if;
        else
            UPDATE SZT0IO t1    /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
               SET wonbon_aek = w_wonbon_aek
                 , gigan_per  = xx.gigan_rt * 100
                 , gigan_amt  = TRUNC(xx.aek * xx.gigan_rt)
                 , gigan_ilsu = xx.gigan_ilsu
                 , pass_ilsu  = xx.ilsu
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
               AND tr_ymd  = xx.tr_ymd;
        end if;
    end loop;

    w_fymd := w_bf + 2;

    DELETE FROM SKM0AG t1   /* 총계정원장 */
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
       AND t1.ymd     >= w_fymd - 1
       AND t1.gwamok  IN ('A0403','A0412');

    SELECT wonbon_aek
      INTO w_jan
      FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
       AND tr_ymd  = (SELECT MAX(tr_ymd)
                        FROM SZT0IO ta  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
                       WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                         AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
                         AND tr_ymd  < w_fymd);

    INSERT INTO SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
    VALUES ( p_corp_gr   /* _1- */
           , w_fymd - 1  /* _2- */
           , 'A'         /* _3- */
           , p_fund_cd   /* _4- */
           , 'A0403'     /* _5- */
           , 'D'         /* _6- */
           , 0           /* _7- */
           , w_jan       /* _8- */
           , 0           /* _9- */
           , 'KRW'       /* _10- */
           );

    INSERT INTO SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
    VALUES ( p_corp_gr   /* _1- */
           , w_fymd - 1  /* _2- */
           , 'A'         /* _3- */
           , p_fund_cd   /* _4- */
           , 'A0412'     /* _5- */
           , 'D'         /* _6- */
           , 0           /* _7- */
           , 1           /* _8- */
           , 0           /* _9- */
           , 'KRW'       /* _10- */
           );

    -- 기준가테이블, 총계정원장 평잔수정
    w_A0403 := w_jan;
    w_A0412 := 1;
    w_junj  := 0;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid         /* _1- */
             , t1.corp_gr       /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd       /* _3- */
             , t1.ymd           /* _4- */
             , t1.seolj_jwa     /* _5- */
             , ia.re_seolj_ymd  /* _6- */
             , ia.bf_gyul_ymd   /* _7- */
             , ia.af_gyul_ymd   /* _8- */
          FROM SKT0GI t1  /* 펀드별 기준가 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd     BETWEEN w_fymd AND p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY t1.ymd
    ) loop
        SELECT wonbon_aek
          INTO w_jan
          FROM SZT0IO t1  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
           AND tr_ymd  = (SELECT MAX(tr_ymd)
                            FROM SZT0IO ta  /* 집합투자증권(펀드) 원본 History */
                           WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                             AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
                             AND tr_ymd  <= xx.ymd);

        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr  /* _1- */
                   , xx.ymd     /* _2- */
                   , 'A'        /* _3- */
                   , p_fund_cd  /* _4- */
                   , 'A0403'    /* _5- */
                   , 'D'        /* _6- */
                   , w_A0403    /* _7- */
                   , w_jan      /* _8- */
                   , 0          /* _9- */
                   , 'KRW'      /* _10- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            UPDATE SKM0AG tt    /* 총계정원장 */
               SET junj   = w_A0403
                 , dr_aek = w_jan
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
               AND ymd     = xx.ymd
               AND work_gb = 'A'
               AND gwamok  = 'A0403';
        END;

        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr  /* _1- */
                   , xx.ymd     /* _2- */
                   , 'A'        /* _3- */
                   , p_fund_cd  /* _4- */
                   , 'A0412'    /* _5- */
                   , 'D'        /* _6- */
                   , w_A0412    /* _7- */
                   , 1          /* _8- */
                   , 0          /* _9- */
                   , 'KRW'      /* _10- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            UPDATE SKM0AG tt    /* 총계정원장 */
               SET junj   = w_A0412
                 , dr_aek = 1
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd
               AND ymd     = xx.ymd
               AND work_gb = 'A'
               AND gwamok  = 'A0412';
        END;

        w_A0403 := w_A0403 + w_jan;
        w_A0412 := w_A0412 + 1;

        UPDATE SKT0GI   /* 펀드별 기준가 */
           SET seolj_jwa     = w_jan
             , sun_jasan_aek = sun_jasan_aek + (w_jan - xx.seolj_jwa)
             , tuja_pj_aek   = TRUNC(w_A0403 / w_A0412)
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        UPDATE UZM0UH   /* 정보계 신탁재산 운용현황 */
           SET seolj_jwa     = w_jan
             , sun_jasan_aek = sun_jasan_aek + (w_jan - xx.seolj_jwa)
         WHERE corp_gr = xx.corp_gr
           AND ymd     = xx.ymd
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd;
    end loop;

    UPDATE SZM0IA tt    /* 자문 계좌정보 */
       SET re_seolj_aek = w_jan
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND fund_cd = p_fund_cd;

    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_RESET_IJA_YMD (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE
 ) AS
-- 채권 전,후 이자일 재처리(수도결제시)
--
    w_ymd                          DATE;
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM SZX3CK tt   /* 펀드별 Check 자료 */
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND proc    = 'reset_15';

    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid
             , t1.slip_attr
             , t1.bond_attr
             , t1.bond_cd
          FROM SCM0CJ t1  /* 채권종목 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.slip_attr IS NULL
    ) loop
        xx.slip_attr := xx.bond_attr;
        if  xx.bond_attr = '3'  then
            if  xx.bond_cd IN ('101','102','105','807','808','811','562','810')     then    xx.slip_attr := '4';  -- 금융채--정금채(562), 농협은행(810) 추가 20200228 bjh
            end if;
        elsif xx.bond_attr = '6' AND xx.bond_cd IN ('5','6','7','N','P','S','T')    then    xx.slip_attr := '5';  -- 주식사채
        end if;

        UPDATE SCM0CJ tt    /* 채권종목 */
           SET slip_attr = xx.slip_attr
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;

    -- 이자구간 미생성 종목 생성처리
    SR_SCJ0IG (p_corp_gr, p_ymd);

    w_ymd := F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd,'-1');
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT t1.rowid                    /* _1- */
             , t1.jm_cd                             /* _2- */
             , t1.cj_nm                             /* _3- */
             , t1.holi_ija_su                       /* _4- */
             , t1.ija_jigub_gb                      /* _5- */
             , t1.bf_ija_ymd      AS cj_bf_ija_ymd  /* _6- */
             , ig.gugan_no                          /* _7- */
             , ig.bf_ija_ymd                        /* _8- */
             , ig.af_ija_ymd                        /* _9- */
          FROM SCM0CJ t1  /* 채권종목 */
             , SCJ0IG ig  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.sanghw_ymd > w_ymd
           AND ig.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND ig.jm_cd      = t1.jm_cd
           AND ig.ija_gb     = 'B'
           AND ig.gugan_no   != t1.now_gugan_no
           AND w_ymd         BETWEEN ig.bf_ija_ymd AND (ig.af_ija_ymd - 1)
    ) loop
        UPDATE SCM0CJ tt    /* 채권종목 */
           SET now_gugan_no = xx.gugan_no
             , bf_ija_ymd   = xx.bf_ija_ymd
             , af_ija_ymd   = xx.af_ija_ymd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;

    -- 이자수령일 미생성분 재생성
    for xx IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cj.rowid  /* _1- */
             , cj.jm_cd           /* _2- */
             , ig.gugan_no        /* _3- */
             , ig.bf_ija_ymd      /* _4- */
             , ig.af_ija_ymd      /* _5- */
          FROM SCM0CM t1  /* 채권 보유현황 */
             , SCM0CJ cj  /* 채권종목 */
             , SCJ0IG ig  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr             = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd                 = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0) + NVL(t1.msd_meib_aekm,0) != 0
           AND cj.corp_gr             = p_corp_gr
           AND cj.jm_cd               = t1.jm_cd
           AND NVL(cj.now_gugan_no,0) = 0
           AND ig.corp_gr             = p_corp_gr
           AND ig.jm_cd               = cj.jm_cd
           AND ig.ija_gb              = 'B'
           AND p_ymd                  BETWEEN ig.bf_ija_ymd AND (ig.af_ija_ymd - 1)
    ) loop
        UPDATE SCM0CJ tt    /* 채권종목 */
           SET now_gugan_no = xx.gugan_no
             , bf_ija_ymd   = xx.bf_ija_ymd
             , af_ija_ymd   = xx.af_ija_ymd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SCJ0IG (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR DEFAULT NULL
 ) AS
-- 채권 종목별 이자구간 생성
--
    w_ymd                          DATE;
    w_bf_ija_ymd                   DATE;
    w_af_ija_ymd                   DATE;

    w_cnt                          NUMBER;
    w_tot_ija_hoicha               NUMBER;
    w_gugan_ilsu                   NUMBER;
    w_all_gugan                    NUMBER;

    w_gugan_ija                    NUMBER;
    w_day_ija                      NUMBER;
    w_bok_ija                      NUMBER;

    w_pyom_iyul                    NUMBER;

    w_ija_jigub_gb                 scm0bj.geochi_ija_gb%type;
    bj_geochi_ija_gb               scm0bj.geochi_ija_gb%type;
    bj_geochi_gigan                scm0bj.geochi_gigan%type;
    bj_geochi_iyul                 scm0bj.geochi_iyul%type;
    bj_sanghw_gb                   scm0bj.sanghw_gb%type;
    bj_sanghw_biyul                scm0bj.sanghw_biyul%type;
    bj_sanghw_ija_gb               scm0bj.sanghw_ija_gb%type;
    bj_sanghw_gigan                scm0bj.sanghw_gigan%type;
    bj_sanghw_iyul                 scm0bj.sanghw_iyul%type;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    if  p_jm_cd IS NOT NULL then
        DELETE FROM SCJ0IG tt   /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND jm_cd   = p_jm_cd;
    end if;

    for xx IN (
        SELECT ROWID                                               /* _1- */
             , jm_cd                                               /* _2- */
             , balh_ymd                                            /* _3- */
             , medo_ymd                                            /* _4- */
             , sanghw_ymd                                          /* _5- */
             , ija_jigub_gb                                        /* _6- */
             , NVL(pyom_iyul,0)                      AS pyom_iyul  /* _7- */
             , NVL(halin_iyul,0) + NVL(halj_iyul,0)  AS hal_iyul   /* _8- */
             , halj_iyul                                           /* _9- */
             , bond_cd                                             /* _10- */
             , yy_ija_hoisu                                        /* _11- */
             , tot_ija_hoicha                                      /* _12- */
             , bunhal_gb                                           /* _13- */
             , now_gugan_no                                        /* _14- */
             , bf_ija_ymd                                          /* _15- */
             , af_ija_ymd                                          /* _16- */
          FROM SCM0CJ xx  /* 채권종목 */
         WHERE xx.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND xx.jm_cd   NOT IN (SELECT jm_cd
                                    FROM SCJ0IG ta  /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
                                   WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr)
    ) loop
        w_bok_ija := 0;

        -- 선매출 이자구간 생성
        if  xx.medo_ymd < xx.balh_ymd   then
            SR_CLCIJAS (xx.medo_ymd, xx.balh_ymd, xx.sanghw_ymd, xx.ija_jigub_gb, xx.bond_cd, 1, 0, xx.pyom_iyul, xx.yy_ija_hoisu, w_gugan_ija, w_day_ija, w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                INSERT INTO WFRMERR tt  /* 에러메세지(저장작업 정지됨) */
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                          /* _1- */
                       , 'SR_CLCIJAS error [' || xx.jm_cd || ']-' || w_msg  /* _2- */
                       );
                RETURN;
            end if;

            INSERT INTO SCJ0IG tt   /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                  /* _1- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                   /* _2- */
                   , 'B'                        /* _3- */
                   , 0                          /* _4- */
                   , xx.balh_ymd - xx.medo_ymd  /* _5- */
                   , w_gugan_ija                /* _6- */
                   , xx.pyom_iyul               /* _7- */
                   , xx.medo_ymd                /* _8- */
                   , xx.balh_ymd                /* _9- */
                   , NULL                       /* _10- */
                   , NULL                       /* _11- */
                   , '7'                        /* _12- */
                   , NULL                       /* _13- */
                   , NULL                       /* _14- */
                   , NULL                       /* _15- */
                   );

            xx.now_gugan_no := 0;
            xx.bf_ija_ymd   := xx.medo_ymd;
            xx.af_ija_ymd   := xx.balh_ymd;
        end if;

        if NVL (xx.yy_ija_hoisu,0) = 0  then    -- 년 이자회차가 없을경우 1회로 조정
            xx.yy_ija_hoisu := 1;
            if TRUNC (months_between(xx.sanghw_ymd, xx.balh_ymd) / 12) = months_between (xx.sanghw_ymd, xx.balh_ymd) / 12    then
                    xx.tot_ija_hoicha := months_between(xx.sanghw_ymd, xx.balh_ymd) / 12;
            else    xx.tot_ija_hoicha := TRUNC (months_between(xx.sanghw_ymd,xx.balh_ymd) / 12) + 1;
            end if;
            UPDATE SCM0CJ tt    /* 채권종목 */
               SET yy_ija_hoisu   = xx.yy_ija_hoisu
                 , tot_ija_hoicha = xx.tot_ija_hoicha
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        end if;

        -- 이자구간 생성
        if  xx.bunhal_gb = '2'  then    -- 분할채권이외 채권
            if  xx.ija_jigub_gb IN ('0','1','2','3','A','B','C')    then
                    w_tot_ija_hoicha := 1;                  /* 할인채,통화채 */
            else    w_tot_ija_hoicha := xx.tot_ija_hoicha;
            end if;

            w_ymd := xx.balh_ymd;
            for w_cnt IN 1..w_tot_ija_hoicha loop
                ----------------
                -- 이자일수 계산
                ----------------
                w_bf_ija_ymd := w_ymd;  /* 후이자일 계산 */
                SR_CLCAFD (w_bf_ija_ymd, xx.ija_jigub_gb, xx.yy_ija_hoisu, xx.balh_ymd, xx.sanghw_ymd, w_af_ija_ymd, w_msg);
                if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                    INSERT INTO WFRMERR tt  /* 에러메세지(저장작업 정지됨) */
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                         /* _1- */
                           , 'SR_CLCAFD error [' || xx.jm_cd || ']-' || w_msg  /* _2- */
                           );
                    RETURN;
                end if;
                -----------
                -- 이자계산
                -----------
                -- 이자율 변경시 적용
                BEGIN
                    SELECT NVL(xx.pyom_iyul,0)
                         , CASE WHEN NVL(xx.halin_iyul,0) > 0 THEN xx.halin_iyul
                                WHEN NVL(xx.halj_iyul,0) > 0  THEN xx.halj_iyul
                                                              ELSE 0 END
                      INTO xx.pyom_iyul
                         , xx.hal_iyul
                      FROM SCT0IJ xx  /* 채권 이율 정정 내역 */
                     WHERE xx.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
                       AND xx.chg_ymd BETWEEN w_bf_ija_ymd AND (w_af_ija_ymd - 1);
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    NULL;
                END;

                if  w_cnt = 1 AND NVL (xx.hal_iyul,0) != 0      then
                    SR_CLCIJAC (xx.ija_jigub_gb, '101', xx.hal_iyul, xx.yy_ija_hoisu, w_cnt, w_bok_ija, xx.balh_ymd, xx.sanghw_ymd, w_gugan_ija);
                    INSERT INTO SCJ0IG tt   /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                        /* _1- */
                           , xx.jm_cd                                         /* _2- */
                           , CASE WHEN NVL(xx.halj_iyul,0) != 0 THEN 'J'
                                                                ELSE 'I' END  /* _3- */
                           , w_cnt                                            /* _4- */
                           , xx.sanghw_ymd - xx.balh_ymd                      /* _5- */
                           , w_gugan_ija                                      /* _6- */
                           , xx.hal_iyul                                      /* _7- */
                           , xx.balh_ymd                                      /* _8- */
                           , xx.sanghw_ymd                                    /* _9- */
                           , NULL                                             /* _10- */
                           , NULL                                             /* _11- */
                           , '7'                                              /* _12- */
                           , NULL                                             /* _13- */
                           , NULL                                             /* _14- */
                           , NULL                                             /* _15- */
                           );
                end if;

                SR_CLCIJAC (xx.ija_jigub_gb, xx.bond_cd, xx.pyom_iyul, xx.yy_ija_hoisu, w_cnt, w_bok_ija, xx.balh_ymd, xx.sanghw_ymd, w_gugan_ija);
                w_gugan_ilsu := w_af_ija_ymd - w_bf_ija_ymd;
                if  w_af_ija_ymd > xx.sanghw_ymd    then    -- 이표채 구간이 균등하지 않을경우 처리
                    w_all_gugan  := w_gugan_ilsu;
                    w_af_ija_ymd := xx.sanghw_ymd;
                    w_gugan_ilsu := w_af_ija_ymd - w_bf_ija_ymd;
                    w_gugan_ija  := w_gugan_ija / w_all_gugan * w_gugan_ilsu;
                end if;

                INSERT INTO SCJ0IG tt   /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                       , xx.jm_cd      /* _2- */
                       , 'B'           /* _3- */
                       , w_cnt         /* _4- */
                       , w_gugan_ilsu  /* _5- */
                       , w_gugan_ija   /* _6- */
                       , xx.pyom_iyul  /* _7- */
                       , w_bf_ija_ymd  /* _8- */
                       , w_af_ija_ymd  /* _9- */
                       , NULL          /* _10- */
                       , NULL          /* _11- */
                       , '7'           /* _12- */
                       , NULL          /* _13- */
                       , NULL          /* _14- */
                       , NULL          /* _15- */
                       );
                if  p_ymd BETWEEN w_bf_ija_ymd AND (w_af_ija_ymd - 1)   then
                    xx.now_gugan_no := w_cnt;
                    xx.bf_ija_ymd   := w_bf_ija_ymd;
                    xx.af_ija_ymd   := w_af_ija_ymd;
                end if;

                -- 복리채,연단리만기의 경우
                if  xx.ija_jigub_gb IN ('4','5','6','D','E','F','9')    then
                        w_bok_ija := w_bok_ija + w_gugan_ija;
                else    w_bok_ija := 0;
                end if;
                if  w_af_ija_ymd = xx.sanghw_ymd    then
                    EXIT;
                end if;
                w_ymd := w_af_ija_ymd;  /* 후이자일을 전이자일로 Set */
            end loop;

        else    /* 분할채 */
            BEGIN
                SELECT geochi_ija_gb        /* _1- */
                     , NVL(geochi_gigan,0)  /* _2- */
                     , NVL(geochi_iyul,0)   /* _3- */
                     , sanghw_gb            /* _4- */
                     , NVL(sanghw_biyul,0)  /* _5- */
                     , sanghw_ija_gb        /* _6- */
                     , NVL(sanghw_gigan,0)  /* _7- */
                     , NVL(sanghw_iyul,0)   /* _8- */
                  INTO bj_geochi_ija_gb  /* _1- */
                     , bj_geochi_gigan   /* _2- */
                     , bj_geochi_iyul    /* _3- */
                     , bj_sanghw_gb      /* _4- */
                     , bj_sanghw_biyul   /* _5- */
                     , bj_sanghw_ija_gb  /* _6- */
                     , bj_sanghw_gigan   /* _7- */
                     , bj_sanghw_iyul    /* _8- */
                  FROM SCM0BJ xx  /* 분할채 */
                 WHERE xx.corp_gr = p_corp_gr;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                INSERT INTO WFRMERR tt  /* 에러메세지(저장작업 정지됨) */
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                       /* _1- */
                       , '분할채가 등록되지 않았습니다. : ' || xx.jm_cd  /* _2- */
                       );
                RETURN;
            END;

            -- 이자구간 생성
            w_tot_ija_hoicha := (bj_geochi_gigan + bj_sanghw_gigan);
            w_ymd            := xx.balh_ymd;
            for w_cnt IN 1..w_tot_ija_hoicha loop
                w_bf_ija_ymd := w_ymd;
                -- 후이자일계산
                SR_CLCAFD (w_bf_ija_ymd, xx.ija_jigub_gb, xx.yy_ija_hoisu, xx.balh_ymd, xx.sanghw_ymd, w_af_ija_ymd, w_msg);
                if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                    INSERT INTO WFRMERR tt  /* 에러메세지(저장작업 정지됨) */
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr                              /* _1- */
                           , '분할채 SR_CLCAFD error ' || xx.jm_cd  /* _2- */
                           );
                    RETURN;
                end if;
                w_gugan_ilsu := w_af_ija_ymd - w_bf_ija_ymd;

                -- 거치기간일경우 거치이자지급 및 이율 적용
                if  w_cnt <= bj_geochi_gigan    then
                    w_ija_jigub_gb := bj_geochi_ija_gb;
                    w_pyom_iyul    := bj_geochi_iyul;

                else    /* 상환기간일경우 상환이자지급 및 이율 적용 */
                    w_ija_jigub_gb := bj_sanghw_ija_gb;
                    w_pyom_iyul    := bj_sanghw_iyul;
                end if;

                -- 이자계산
                SR_CLCIJAC (w_ija_jigub_gb, xx.bond_cd, w_pyom_iyul, xx.yy_ija_hoisu, w_cnt, w_bok_ija, xx.balh_ymd, xx.sanghw_ymd, w_gugan_ija);

                INSERT INTO SCJ0IG tt   /* 채권 종목별 이자구간 */
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                       , xx.jm_cd      /* _2- */
                       , 'B'           /* _3- */
                       , w_cnt         /* _4- */
                       , w_gugan_ilsu  /* _5- */
                       , w_gugan_ija   /* _6- */
                       , xx.pyom_iyul  /* _7- */
                       , w_bf_ija_ymd  /* _8- */
                       , w_af_ija_ymd  /* _9- */
                       , NULL          /* _10- */
                       , NULL          /* _11- */
                       , '7'           /* _12- */
                       , NULL          /* _13- */
                       , NULL          /* _14- */
                       , NULL          /* _15- */
                       );
                if  p_ymd BETWEEN w_bf_ija_ymd AND (w_af_ija_ymd - 1)   then
                    xx.now_gugan_no := w_cnt;
                    xx.bf_ija_ymd   := w_bf_ija_ymd;
                    xx.af_ija_ymd   := w_af_ija_ymd;
                end if;

                w_ymd := w_af_ija_ymd;  /* 후이자일을 전이자일로 Set */

                if  xx.ija_jigub_gb IN ('4','5','6','D','E','F','9')    then
                        w_bok_ija := NVL  (w_bok_ija,0) + w_gugan_ija;  /* 복리채,연단리만기 */
                else    w_bok_ija := 0;
                end if;
            end loop;
        end if;

        UPDATE SCM0CJ tt    /* 채권종목 */
           SET now_gugan_no = xx.now_gugan_no
             , bf_ija_ymd   = xx.bf_ija_ymd
             , af_ija_ymd   = xx.af_ija_ymd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    end loop;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SHJ0IG (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_del                          IN    VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 현금자산, 전단채, 이자구간 생성
--
    w_gugan_no                     NUMBER;
    w_gugan_ija                    NUMBER;
    w_gugan_ilsu                   NUMBER;
    w_bf_ija_ymd                   DATE;
    w_af_ija_ymd                   DATE;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    if  p_del = 'ok'    then
        DELETE FROM SHJ0IG tt   /* 현금 종목별 이자구간 */
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND jm_cd   = p_jm_cd;
    end if;
    for xx IN (
        SELECT NVL(t1.pyom_iyul, t1.meib_suik_rt)  AS pyom_iyul      /* _1- */
             , t1.cash_cd                                            /* _2- */
             , t1.balh_ymd                                           /* _3- */
             , t1.sanghw_ymd                                         /* _4- */
             , t1.sunhu_gb                                           /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.yy_ija_hoicha,1)             AS yy_ija_hoicha  /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.tot_ija_gugan,1)             AS tot_ija_gugan  /* _7- */
          FROM SHM0HJ t1  /* 현금 종목정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd
           AND t1.cash_cd != '90'
    ) loop
        -- 구간을 가지는 자산
        if  xx.tot_ija_gugan > 1    then
            w_bf_ija_ymd := xx.balh_ymd;
            w_af_ija_ymd := ADD_MONTHS (w_bf_ija_ymd, TRUNC (12 / xx.yy_ija_hoicha));
            w_gugan_ija  := xx.pyom_iyul / xx.yy_ija_hoicha;
            w_gugan_no   := 1;
            for w_gugan_no IN 1..xx.tot_ija_gugan loop
                SR_CLCAFD (w_bf_ija_ymd, 'm', xx.yy_ija_hoicha, xx.balh_ymd, xx.sanghw_ymd, w_af_ija_ymd, w_msg);
                w_gugan_ilsu := w_af_ija_ymd - w_bf_ija_ymd;
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO SHJ0IG tt   /* 현금 종목별 이자구간 */
                    VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                           , p_jm_cd       /* _2- */
                           , w_gugan_no    /* _3- */
                           , w_gugan_ilsu  /* _4- */
                           , w_gugan_ija   /* _5- */
                           , w_bf_ija_ymd  /* _6- */
                           , w_af_ija_ymd  /* _7- */
                           , NULL          /* _8- */
                           , NULL          /* _9- */
                           , NULL          /* _10- */
                           , NULL          /* _11- */
                           , NULL          /* _12- */
                           , NULL          /* _13- */
                           , NULL          /* _14- */
                           );
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                    NULL;
                    -- 입력된 구간자료를 반영키 위해 20191216 yjs
                END;
                w_bf_ija_ymd := w_af_ija_ymd;
            end loop;

        else    /* 1구간만 가지는 자산 */
            w_bf_ija_ymd := xx.balh_ymd;
            w_af_ija_ymd := xx.sanghw_ymd;
            w_gugan_no   := 1;
            w_gugan_ilsu := w_af_ija_ymd - w_bf_ija_ymd;
            w_gugan_ija  := xx.pyom_iyul;
            if  xx.cash_cd IN ('80','71','72')  then
                    w_gugan_ija := xx.pyom_iyul * w_gugan_ilsu / 365;
            else    w_gugan_ija := xx.pyom_iyul * (w_af_ija_ymd - w_bf_ija_ymd) / 365;
            end if;
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO SHJ0IG tt   /* 현금 종목별 이자구간 */
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                       , p_jm_cd       /* _2- */
                       , w_gugan_no    /* _3- */
                       , w_gugan_ilsu  /* _4- */
                       , w_gugan_ija   /* _5- */
                       , w_bf_ija_ymd  /* _6- */
                       , w_af_ija_ymd  /* _7- */
                       , NULL          /* _8- */
                       , NULL          /* _9- */
                       , NULL          /* _10- */
                       , NULL          /* _11- */
                       , NULL          /* _12- */
                       , NULL          /* _13- */
                       , NULL          /* _14- */
                       );
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
                NULL;
                -- 입력된 구간자료를 반영키 위해 20191216 yjs
            END;
        end if;
    end loop;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SKT1GS_SONIK (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 결산손익 생성
--
    w_bf_ymd                     DATE;
BEGIN
    SELECT gi.BF_GYUL_YMD
      INTO w_bf_ymd
      FROM SZM0IA t1
         , SZM0GI gi
     WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.FUND_CD = p_fund_cd
       AND gi.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR
       AND gi.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD
       AND p_ymd      Between  (gi.BF_GYUL_YMD + 1) AND gi.AF_GYUL_YMD;

    DELETE FROM SKT1GS_SONIK
     WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
       AND FUND_CD = p_fund_cd
       AND YMD     Between  (w_bf_ymd + 1) AND p_ymd;

    -- 이월손익 생성
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.JM_CD
             , SUM(NVL(t1.BFIL_BOYU_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.UP_JUSU,0) - NVL(t1.DW_JUSU,0)
                                            + NVL(t1.GONGS_UP_JUSU,0)
                                            - NVL(t1.GONGS_DW_JUSU,0))     AS jusu
             , SUM(NVL(t1.BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.DW_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                           + NVL(t1.GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK,0)
                                           - NVL(t1.GONGS_DW_CHUI_AEK,0))  AS chui_aek
             , SUM(NVL(t1.SONIK,0))                                        AS sonik
             , SUM(NVL(t1.MISU_BAED_AEK,0))                                AS misu_baed_aek
          FROM SJM0JM t1
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.YMD     = w_bf_ymd
           AND t1.FUND_CD = p_fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.JM_CD
    ) loop
        if  xx.jusu <> 0    then
            INSERT INTO SKT1GS_SONIK
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                   , w_bf_ymd + 1      /* _2- */
                   , p_fund_cd         /* _3- */
                   , xx.jm_cd          /* _4- */
                   , NULL              /* _5- */
                   , xx.sonik          /* _6- */
                   , NULL              /* _7- */
                   , xx.misu_baed_aek  /* _8- */
                   , NULL              /* _9- */
                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.TASA_JM_CD                                             AS jm_cd
             , NVL(t1.BFIL_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.UP_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.DW_AEK,0)  AS aek
             , NVL(t1.SONIK,0)                                           AS sonik
          FROM SJM5SM t1
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.YMD     = w_bf_ymd
           AND t1.FUND_CD = p_fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.TASA_JM_CD
    ) loop
        if  xx.aek <> 0 then
            INSERT INTO SKT1GS_SONIK
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                   , w_bf_ymd + 1  /* _2- */
                   , p_fund_cd     /* _3- */
                   , xx.jm_cd      /* _4- */
                   , NULL          /* _5- */
                   , xx.sonik      /* _6- */
                   , NULL          /* _7- */
                   , NULL          /* _8- */
                   , NULL          /* _9- */
                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.JM_CD
             , NVL(t1.BFIL_AEKM,0) + NVL(t1.MEIB_AEKM,0)
                                   - NVL(t1.MEDO_AEKM,0)   AS aekm
             , NVL (t1.SIGA_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.PYUNGA_AEK,0)  AS sonik
          FROM SHM0HM t1
             , SHM0HJ hj
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.YMD     = w_bf_ymd
           AND t1.FUND_CD = p_fund_cd
           AND hj.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR
           AND hj.JM_CD   = t1.JM_CD
           AND hj.CASH_CD <> '90'
         GROUP BY t1.JM_CD
    ) loop
        if  xx.aekm <> 0    then
            INSERT INTO SKT1GS_SONIK
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                   , w_bf_ymd + 1  /* _2- */
                   , p_fund_cd     /* _3- */
                   , xx.jm_cd      /* _4- */
                   , NULL          /* _5- */
                   , xx.sonik      /* _6- */
                   , NULL          /* _7- */
                   , NULL          /* _8- */
                   , NULL          /* _9- */
                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.JM_CD
             , t1.BUY_DATE
             , NVL(t1.BFIL_AEKM,0) + NVL(t1.MEIB_AEKM,0)
                                   - NVL(t1.MEDO_AEKM,0)  AS aekm
             , NVL(t1.SIGA_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.PYUNGA_AEK,0)  AS sonik
          FROM SCM0CM t1
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.YMD     = w_bf_ymd
           AND t1.FUND_CD = p_fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.JM_CD
    ) loop
        if  xx.aekm <> 0    then
            INSERT INTO SKT1GS_SONIK
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                   , w_bf_ymd + 1  /* _2- */
                   , p_fund_cd     /* _3- */
                   , xx.jm_cd      /* _4- */
                   , xx.buy_date   /* _5- */
                   , xx.sonik      /* _6- */
                   , NULL          /* _7- */
                   , NULL          /* _8- */
                   , NULL          /* _9- */
                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.SJ_CD
             , NVL(t1.PASS_GYEY_SU,0) + NVL(t1.UP_GYEY_SU,0)
                                      - NVL(t1.DW_GYEY_SU,0)  AS su
             , CASE WHEN t1.SM_TR_GB IN ('3','5')
                    THEN NVL(t1.PYUNGA_SONIK,0) - NVL(t1.SIGA_AEK,0)
                    ELSE NVL(t1.SIGA_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.PYUNGA_SONIK,0)
               END                                            AS sonik
          FROM SSM0KM t1
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.YMD     = w_bf_ymd
           AND t1.FUND_CD = p_fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.SJ_CD
    ) loop
        if  xx.su <> 0  then
            INSERT INTO SKT1GS_SONIK
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                   , w_bf_ymd + 1  /* _2- */
                   , p_fund_cd     /* _3- */
                   , xx.sj_cd      /* _4- */
                   , NULL          /* _5- */
                   , xx.sonik      /* _6- */
                   , NULL          /* _7- */
                   , NULL          /* _8- */
                   , NULL          /* _9- */
                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.JM_CD
             , NVL(t1.BFIL_QTY,0) + NVL(t1.UP_QTY,0)
                                  - NVL(t1.DW_QTY,0)  AS qty
             , NVL(t1.SONIK,0)                        AS sonik
          FROM OTS0OM t1
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.YMD     = w_bf_ymd
           AND t1.FUND_CD = p_fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.JM_CD
    ) loop
        if  xx.qty <> 0 then
            INSERT INTO SKT1GS_SONIK
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                   , w_bf_ymd + 1  /* _2- */
                   , p_fund_cd     /* _3- */
                   , xx.jm_cd      /* _4- */
                   , NULL          /* _5- */
                   , xx.sonik      /* _6- */
                   , NULL          /* _7- */
                   , NULL          /* _8- */
                   , NULL          /* _9- */
                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    -- 당기 매매손익 생성
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.JM_CD
             , t1.TR_YMD
             , SUM(NVL(t1.GYUL_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.MEIB_CHUI_AEK,0))  AS sonik
          FROM SJT0JG t1
         WHERE t1.CORP_GR       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.TR_YMD        Between  (w_bf_ymd + 1) AND p_ymd
           AND t1.FUND_CD       = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.MEIB_CHUI_AEK > 0
         GROUP BY t1.JM_CD, t1.TR_YMD
    ) loop
        if  xx.sonik <> 0       then
            INSERT INTO SKT1GS_SONIK
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr  /* _1- */
                   , xx.tr_ymd  /* _2- */
                   , p_fund_cd  /* _3- */
                   , xx.jm_cd   /* _4- */
                   , NULL       /* _5- */
                   , NULL       /* _6- */
                   , xx.sonik   /* _7- */
                   , NULL       /* _8- */
                   , NULL       /* _9- */
                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;
--    FOR xx IN (
--        SELECT t1.TASA_JM_CD                                             AS jm_cd
--             , NVL(t1.BFIL_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.UP_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.DW_AEK,0)  AS aek
--             , NVL(t1.SONIK,0)                                           AS sonik
--          FROM SJM5SM t1
--         WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
--           AND t1.YMD     = w_bf_ymd

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SSSL040 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_work_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_upmu_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_currency                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_sj_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jasan                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_chasu                        IN    NUMBER,
    p_seq_no                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_aek                          IN    NUMBER,
    p_sudo_aek                     IN    NUMBER,  /* 미수(미지급) 수도결제액 */
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_bigo                         IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 선물 반대매매 분개처리
--
    w_aek                          NUMBER;
    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    for xx IN (
        SELECT row_no
             , CASE WHEN p_fund_currency != 'KRW' AND gwamok='10101' AND p_upmu_gb='1'
                    THEN '10151'
                    ELSE gwamok END  AS gwamok
             , chadae_gb
             , jeokyo_cd
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = p_jasan
         ORDER BY row_no
    ) loop
        if (xx.row_no = 1) AND (p_sudo_aek > 0)     then    w_aek := p_sudo_aek;
        elsif (xx.row_no = 2) AND (p_sudo_aek < 0)  then    w_aek := - p_sudo_aek;
        elsif (xx.row_no = 3) AND (p_aek < 0)       then    w_aek := - p_aek;
        elsif (xx.row_no = 4) AND (p_aek > 0)       then    w_aek := p_aek;
        elsif xx.row_no = 5                         then    w_aek := p_aek - p_sudo_aek;
        else                                                w_aek := 0;
        end if;

        SR_INSBU (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_tr_cd, p_work_gb, p_upmu_gb, p_fund_cd, p_fund_currency, p_sj_cd, p_seq_no, p_chasu, xx.row_no,
                  xx.chadae_gb, xx.gwamok, w_aek, xx.jeokyo_cd, p_proc_step, '(' || p_jasan || ')' || p_bigo, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;  /* 분개처리 error */
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end loop;
    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SYCP010 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_pgm_id                       IN    VARCHAR,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 해외자산 이자수령 처리
-- 수도결제 처리하므로 휴일에도 수령처리 함
--
    w_won_tax                      NUMBER;
    w_fcur_tax                     NUMBER;
    w_gross_up_rt                  NUMBER;
    w_gross_up_tax                 NUMBER;
    w_gross_up_aek                 NUMBER;
    w_won_misu_ija                 NUMBER;

    w_cur_suip_ija                 NUMBER;
    w_won_suip_ija                 NUMBER;
    w_fcur_suip_ija                NUMBER;

    w_aek                          number_varray_50;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', p_pgm_id, 'sycp010 : ' || p_ymd || p_proc_step || ' : 해외채권 이자수령 처리');

    for xx IN (
        SELECT yz.rowid                                                                             /* _1- */
             , yz.fund_cd                                                                           /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                     /* _3- */
             , yz.trustee                                                                           /* _4- */
             , yz.jm_cd                                                                             /* _5- */
             , yz.bs_type                                                                           /* _6- */
             , yz.currency                                                                          /* _7- */
             , NVL(yz.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(yz.tr_up_jusu,0)                     AS aekm            /* _8- */
             , NVL(yz.bfil_misu_ija,0)                                           AS misu_ija        /* _9- */
             , NVL(yz.bfil_sung_cost,0)                                          AS sung_cost       /* _10- */
             , NVL(yz.won_bfil_misu_ija,0)                                       AS won_misu_ija    /* _11- */
             , NVL(yz.won_bfil_sung_cost,0)                                      AS won_sung_cost   /* _12- */
             , ig.af_ija_ymd                                                                        /* _13- */
             , F_IJAY (yz.corp_gr, yz.ymd, yz.jm_cd, NVL(yz.tr_bfil_jusu,0))     AS ija             /* _14- */
             , ia.mg_cd                                                                             /* _15- */
             , NVL(t1.tax_per,0) / 100                                           AS tax_rt          /* _16- */
             , t1.ija_dcf                                                                           /* _17- */
             , t1.sj_gb                                                                             /* _18- */
             , t1.days_calc_gb                                                                      /* _19- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY yz.fund_cd ORDER BY yz.fund_cd)  AS seq             /* _20- */
             , 0                                                                 AS fcur_ija        /* _21- */
             , NVL(yz.fcur_bfil_misu_ija,0)                                      AS fcur_misu_ija   /* _22- */
             , NVL(yz.fcur_bfil_sung_cost,0)                                     AS fcur_sung_cost  /* _23- */
          FROM SYM0YA t1  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             , SYJ0IG ig  /* 해외채권 종목별 이자구간 */
             , SYM0YZ yz  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jasan_gb                  = '2'
           AND ig.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ig.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND ig.af_ija_ymd                = p_ymd
           AND yz.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND yz.ymd                       = ig.af_ija_ymd
           AND yz.jm_cd                     = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = yz.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd
    ) loop
        -- 해외채권마스타
        UPDATE SYM0YZ   /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
           SET misu_ija       = 0
             , sung_cost      = 0
             , won_misu_ija   = 0
             , won_sung_cost  = 0
             , fcur_misu_ija  = 0
             , fcur_sung_cost = 0
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        -- 대출채권/대여금은 대출일부터 수령이자를 계산하므로 합산처리
        if  xx.ija_dcf = '1' AND xx.sj_gb = 'Z' then
            if  xx.days_calc_gb = '1'   then
                xx.ija := xx.misu_ija;
            else
                SELECT F_ROUND (SUM (t1.gugan_ija * (NVL(yz.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(yz.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(yz.tr_dw_jusu,0)) / gugan_ilsu), xx.currency)
                  INTO xx.ija
                  FROM SYJ0IG t1  /* 해외채권 종목별 이자구간 */
                     , SYM0YZ yz  /* 해외 자산 보유현황 */
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
                   AND t1.af_ija_ymd = p_ymd
                   AND yz.ymd        BETWEEN t1.bf_ija_ymd AND p_ymd
                   AND yz.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
                   AND yz.fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
                   AND yz.jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
                   AND yz.trustee    = xx.trustee;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 영편넣기 당일이자는 수입이자처리
        if  xx.days_calc_gb = '2'   then
            w_cur_suip_ija  := xx.ija - xx.misu_ija;
            w_won_suip_ija  := F_COVWON (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, w_cur_suip_ija);
            w_fcur_suip_ija := F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, w_cur_suip_ija, xx.fund_currency);
            if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                w_aek := number_varray_50 (xx.won_misu_ija + xx.won_sung_cost + w_won_suip_ija, xx.won_misu_ija, xx.won_sung_cost, w_won_suip_ija);
            else
                xx.fcur_ija := F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, xx.ija, xx.fund_currency);
                w_aek       := number_varray_50 (xx.fcur_misu_ija + xx.fcur_sung_cost + w_fcur_suip_ija, xx.fcur_misu_ija, xx.fcur_sung_cost, w_fcur_suip_ija);
            end if;
        else
            w_cur_suip_ija  := 0;
            w_won_suip_ija  := 0;
            w_fcur_suip_ija := 0;
            if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                w_aek := number_varray_50 (xx.won_misu_ija + xx.won_sung_cost, xx.won_misu_ija, xx.won_sung_cost, w_won_suip_ija);
            else
                xx.fcur_ija := F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, xx.ija, xx.fund_currency);
                w_aek       := number_varray_50 (xx.fcur_misu_ija + xx.fcur_sung_cost, xx.fcur_misu_ija, xx.fcur_sung_cost, w_fcur_suip_ija);
            end if;
        end if;

        SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E22', 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                    xx.seq, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP010', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := SUBSTR ('sycp010 -> ' || w_msg,1,95);
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 이자수령
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO UCS0BH  /* 채권 상환내역 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                           /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                               /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                          /* _3- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                            /* _4- */
                   , '%'                                 /* _5- */
                   , NULL                                /* _6- */
                   , 0                                   /* _7- */
                   , 0                                   /* _8- */
                   , w_gross_up_aek                      /* _9- */
                   , 0                                   /* _10- */
                   , xx.won_misu_ija + w_won_suip_ija    /* _11- */
                   , xx.won_sung_cost                    /* _12- */
                   , xx.won_misu_ija + w_won_suip_ija
                                     + xx.won_sung_cost  /* _13- */
                   , NULL                                /* _14- */
                   , NULL                                /* _15- */
                   , NULL                                /* _16- */
                   , NULL                                /* _17- */
                   , xx.trustee                          /* _18- */
                   , xx.currency                         /* _19- */
                   , xx.ija - xx.sung_cost               /* _20- */
                   , xx.sung_cost                        /* _21- */
                   , NULL                                /* _22- */
                   , NULL                                /* _23- */
                   , NULL                                /* _24- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            p_msg := xx.jm_cd || '-채권이자 상환내역 생성오류입니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SYT0YS  /* 해외 수도결제 */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                     /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                                         /* _2- */
                   , p_ymd                                         /* _3- */
                   , 'E22'                                         /* _4- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                                    /* _5- */
                   , xx.mg_cd                                      /* _6- */
                   , xx.trustee                                    /* _7- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                                      /* _8- */
                   , xx.currency                                   /* _9- */
                   , xx.seq                                        /* _10- */
                   , NULL                                          /* _11- */
                   , 0                                             /* _12- */
                   , 0                                             /* _13- */
                   , xx.ija                                        /* _14- */
                   , xx.won_misu_ija + w_won_suip_ija
                                     + xx.won_sung_cost            /* _15- */
                   , 'N'                                           /* _16- */
                   , NULL                                          /* _17- */
                   , xx.won_misu_ija + w_won_suip_ija
                                     + xx.won_sung_cost            /* _18- */
                   , 0                                             /* _19- */
                   , 0                                             /* _20- */
                   , TRUNC((xx.ija - xx.sung_cost) * xx.tax_rt,2)  /* _21- */
                   , NULL                                          /* _22- */
                   , NULL                                          /* _23- */
                   , xx.bs_type                                    /* _24- */
                   , xx.fcur_ija + w_fcur_suip_ija                 /* _25- */
                   , xx.fcur_ija + w_fcur_suip_ija                 /* _26- */
                   , 0                                             /* _27- */
                   , NULL                                          /* _28- */
                   , NULL                                          /* _29- */
                   , NULL                                          /* _30- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
            UPDATE SYT0YS   /* 해외 수도결제 */
               SET gyulje_aek      = xx.ija
                 , won_gyulje_aek  = xx.won_misu_ija + w_won_suip_ija + xx.won_sung_cost
                 , won_pyunga_aek  = xx.won_misu_ija + w_won_suip_ija + xx.won_sung_cost
                 , tax_aek         = TRUNC((xx.ija - xx.sung_cost) * xx.tax_rt,2)
                 , fcur_gyulje_aek = xx.fcur_ija + w_fcur_suip_ija
                 , fcur_pyunga_aek = xx.fcur_ija + w_fcur_suip_ija
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND tr_ymd   = p_ymd
               AND tr_cd    = 'E22'
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND bs_type  = xx.bs_type
               AND ymd      = p_ymd
               AND tr_co_cd = xx.mg_cd
               AND trustee  = xx.trustee
               AND currency = xx.currency
               AND tr_seq   = xx.seq;
        END;
    end loop;

    -- 해외 이자미수입금 결제처리
    -- 전일환율을 당일환율로 20200723 yjs
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                               /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_ymd                                                                              /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                               /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                             /* _4- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                       /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                                                            /* _6- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                               /* _7- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                                             /* _8- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                             /* _9- */
             , t1.currency                                                                            /* _10- */
             , t1.tr_seq                                                                              /* _11- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                                                                        /* _12- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                                                                          /* _13- */
             , NVL(t1.tax_aek,0)                                                 AS tax_aek           /* _14- */
             , t1.won_gyulje_aek                                                                      /* _15- */
             , t1.sury_aek                                                                            /* _16- */
             , TRUNC(CASE WHEN t1.tr_ymd=p_ymd
                          THEN t1.won_gyulje_aek
                          ELSE F_CURRENCY_RT (t1.corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency) * t1.gyulje_aek
                     END)                                                        AS won_pyunga_aek    /* _17- */
             , F_CURRENCY_RT (t1.corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency)                    AS ex_rate           /* _18- */
             , F_CURRENCY_RT (t1.corp_gr, p_ymd, ia.fund_currency)               AS fcur_rate         /* _19- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq               /* _20- */
             , t1.fcur_gyulje_aek                                                                     /* _21- */
             , CASE WHEN t1.tr_ymd=p_ymd
                    THEN t1.fcur_gyulje_aek
                    ELSE t1.fcur_pyunga_aek
               END                                                               AS fcur_pyunga_aek   /* _22- */
          FROM SYT0YS t1  /* 해외 수도결제 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'E22'
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd = p_ymd
           AND t1.gyulje_gb  = 'Y'
           AND ya.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd      = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            w_cur_suip_ija := 0;
            if NVL (xx.sury_aek,0) > 0  then
                if NVL (xx.gyulje_aek,0) = 0    then
                        w_cur_suip_ija := F_TRUNC (xx.sury_aek * xx.ex_rate, xx.fund_currency);
                else    w_cur_suip_ija := TRUNC ((xx.sury_aek - (xx.gyulje_aek - xx.tax_aek)) * (xx.won_pyunga_aek / xx.gyulje_aek));
                end if;
            else    xx.gyulje_aek := xx.gyulje_aek - xx.tax_aek;
            end if;
        else
            w_cur_suip_ija := 0;
            if NVL (xx.sury_aek,0) > 0  then
                if NVL (xx.fcur_gyulje_aek,0) = 0   then
                        w_cur_suip_ija := F_TRUNC (xx.sury_aek * xx.fcur_rate, xx.fund_currency);
                else    w_cur_suip_ija := F_TRUNC (xx.sury_aek - xx.fcur_gyulje_aek, xx.fund_currency);
                end if;
            else    xx.fcur_gyulje_aek := xx.fcur_gyulje_aek - F_TRUNC (xx.tax_aek * xx.fcur_rate, xx.fund_currency);
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 이자수령일 환율로 처리
        w_won_tax  := TRUNC (xx.tax_aek * xx.ex_rate);
        w_fcur_tax := TRUNC (xx.tax_aek * xx.fcur_rate);

        -- 외국납부세액과 국내세액 중 작은 금액으로
        SELECT TRUNC(gross_up_ija_tax_rt * (xx.won_pyunga_aek + w_cur_suip_ija))
             , gross_up_ija_tax_rt
          INTO w_gross_up_tax
             , w_gross_up_rt
          FROM SZX0SB t1
         WHERE p_ymd BETWEEN t1.f_ymd AND t1.t_ymd;

        w_gross_up_aek := LEAST (w_gross_up_tax, w_won_tax);

        -- 외화예금 입금 처리(자기통화)
        if NVL (xx.sury_aek,0) > 0  then
            SR_10151_IN (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.trustee, 0,
                         xx.sury_aek, (xx.won_pyunga_aek - w_won_tax) + w_cur_suip_ija,
                         F_COVCUR(p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, xx.sury_aek, xx.fund_currency), w_msg);
        else
            SR_10151_IN (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.trustee, 0,
                         xx.gyulje_aek, (xx.won_pyunga_aek - w_won_tax) + w_cur_suip_ija, xx.fcur_gyulje_aek, w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := SUBSTR ('외화예금입금(sr_10151_in) 오류 : ' || w_msg,1,180);
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 ((xx.won_pyunga_aek - w_won_tax) + w_cur_suip_ija,
                                         xx.won_gyulje_aek,
                                         CASE WHEN xx.won_gyulje_aek > xx.won_pyunga_aek THEN xx.won_gyulje_aek - xx.won_pyunga_aek ELSE 0 END,
                                         CASE WHEN xx.won_gyulje_aek < xx.won_pyunga_aek THEN xx.won_pyunga_aek - xx.won_gyulje_aek ELSE 0 END,
                                         CASE WHEN (w_cur_suip_ija - w_gross_up_aek) < 0 THEN (w_cur_suip_ija - w_gross_up_aek) * -1 ELSE 0 END,
                                         CASE WHEN (w_cur_suip_ija - w_gross_up_aek) > 0 THEN (w_cur_suip_ija - w_gross_up_aek) ELSE 0 END,
                                         w_gross_up_aek,
                                         w_won_tax - w_gross_up_aek,
                                         w_gross_up_aek);
        else
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 ((xx.fcur_pyunga_aek - w_fcur_tax) + w_cur_suip_ija,
                                         xx.fcur_gyulje_aek,
                                         CASE WHEN xx.fcur_gyulje_aek > xx.fcur_pyunga_aek THEN xx.fcur_gyulje_aek - xx.fcur_pyunga_aek ELSE 0 END,
                                         CASE WHEN xx.fcur_gyulje_aek < xx.fcur_pyunga_aek THEN xx.fcur_pyunga_aek - xx.fcur_gyulje_aek ELSE 0 END,
                                         CASE WHEN w_cur_suip_ija < 0 THEN w_cur_suip_ija * -1 ELSE 0 END,
                                         CASE WHEN w_cur_suip_ija > 0 THEN w_cur_suip_ija - w_fcur_tax ELSE 0 END);
        end if;
        SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E22', 'A', '2', '10', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                    xx.seq, 2, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP010', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 해외 납부세금 관리
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW' AND w_won_tax != 0     then
            INSERT INTO SYT0TAX /* 해외 세금 납부확정 자료(GROSS-UP 환급관리) */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                           /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                               /* _2- */
                   , xx.tr_ymd                           /* _3- */
                   , xx.tr_cd                            /* _4- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                          /* _5- */
                   , xx.tr_seq                           /* _6- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd                         /* _7- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                            /* _8- */
                   , xx.trustee                          /* _9- */
                   , xx.currency                         /* _10- */
                   , NULL                                /* _11- */
                   , NULL                                /* _12- */
                   , NULL                                /* _13- */
                   , NULL                                /* _14- */
                   , xx.gyulje_aek                       /* _15- */
                   , xx.won_pyunga_aek + w_cur_suip_ija  /* _16- */
                   , xx.tax_aek                          /* _17- */
                   , w_won_tax                           /* _18- */
                   , w_gross_up_rt                       /* _19- */
                   , w_gross_up_tax                      /* _20- */
                   , w_gross_up_aek                      /* _21- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;

    -- 해외 NOTE 이자수령 처리
    for xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                  /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_ymd                                                                 /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                  /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                /* _4- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                          /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                                               /* _6- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                  /* _7- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                                /* _8- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                /* _9- */
             , t1.currency                                                               /* _10- */
             , t1.tr_seq                                                                 /* _11- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                                                           /* _12- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                                                             /* _13- */
             , NVL(t1.tax_aek,0)                                    AS tax_aek           /* _14- */
             , t1.won_gyulje_aek                                                         /* _15- */
             , t1.sury_aek                                                               /* _16- */
             , CASE WHEN t1.tr_ymd=p_ymd
                    THEN t1.won_gyulje_aek
                    ELSE t1.won_pyunga_aek
               END                                                  AS won_pyunga_aek    /* _17- */
             , F_CURRENCY_RT (t1.corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency)       AS ex_rate           /* _18- */
             , F_CURRENCY_RT (t1.corp_gr, p_ymd, ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_rate         /* _19- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)         AS seq               /* _20- */
             , t1.fcur_gyulje_aek                                                        /* _21- */
             , CASE WHEN t1.tr_ymd=p_ymd
                    THEN t1.fcur_gyulje_aek
                    ELSE t1.fcur_pyunga_aek
               END                                                  AS fcur_pyunga_aek   /* _22- */
          FROM SYT0YS t1  /* 해외 수도결제 */
             , SYM0YA ya  /* 해외 자산종목 */
             , SZM0IA ia  /* 자문 계좌정보 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'E2P'
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd = p_ymd
           AND t1.gyulje_gb  = 'Y'
           AND ya.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd      = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            w_cur_suip_ija := 0;
            if NVL (xx.sury_aek,0) > 0  then
                if NVL (xx.gyulje_aek,0) = 0    then
                        w_cur_suip_ija := F_TRUNC (xx.sury_aek * xx.ex_rate, xx.fund_currency);
                else    w_cur_suip_ija := TRUNC ((xx.sury_aek - (xx.gyulje_aek - xx.tax_aek)) * (xx.won_pyunga_aek / xx.gyulje_aek));
                end if;
            else    xx.gyulje_aek := xx.gyulje_aek - xx.tax_aek;
            end if;
        else
            w_cur_suip_ija := 0;
            if NVL (xx.sury_aek,0) > 0  then
                if NVL (xx.fcur_gyulje_aek,0) = 0   then
                        w_cur_suip_ija := F_TRUNC (xx.sury_aek * xx.fcur_rate, xx.fund_currency);
                else    w_cur_suip_ija := F_TRUNC (xx.sury_aek - xx.fcur_gyulje_aek, xx.fund_currency);
                end if;
            else    xx.fcur_gyulje_aek := xx.fcur_gyulje_aek - F_TRUNC (xx.tax_aek * xx.fcur_rate, xx.fund_currency);
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 이자수령일 환율로 처리
        w_won_tax  := TRUNC (xx.tax_aek * xx.ex_rate);
        w_fcur_tax := TRUNC (xx.tax_aek * xx.fcur_rate);

        -- 외국납부세액과 국내세액 중 작은 금액으로
        SELECT TRUNC(gross_up_ija_tax_rt * (xx.won_pyunga_aek + w_cur_suip_ija))
             , gross_up_ija_tax_rt
          INTO w_gross_up_tax
             , w_gross_up_rt
          FROM SZX0SB t1
         WHERE p_ymd BETWEEN t1.f_ymd AND t1.t_ymd;

        w_gross_up_aek := LEAST (w_gross_up_tax, w_won_tax);

        -- 외화예금 입금 처리(자기통화)
        SR_10151_IN (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.trustee, 0,
                     xx.gyulje_aek - xx.tax_aek, xx.won_pyunga_aek - w_won_tax, xx.fcur_gyulje_aek, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := SUBSTR ('외화예금입금(sr_10151_in) 오류 : ' || w_msg,1,180);
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.won_gyulje_aek - w_won_tax,
                                         xx.won_gyulje_aek - w_gross_up_aek,
                                         w_gross_up_aek,
                                         w_won_tax - w_gross_up_aek,
                                         w_gross_up_aek);
        else
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.fcur_gyulje_aek - w_fcur_tax,
                                         xx.fcur_gyulje_aek - w_fcur_tax,
                                         0, w_fcur_tax, 0);
        end if;
        SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E2P', 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                    xx.seq, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP010', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 해외 납부세금 관리
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW' AND w_won_tax != 0 then
            INSERT INTO SYT0TAX /* 해외 세금 납부확정 자료(GROSS-UP 환급관리) */
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd           /* _2- */
                   , xx.tr_ymd       /* _3- */
                   , xx.tr_cd        /* _4- */
                   , xx.fund_cd      /* _5- */
                   , xx.tr_seq       /* _6- */
                   , xx.tr_co_cd     /* _7- */
                   , xx.jm_cd        /* _8- */
                   , xx.trustee      /* _9- */
                   , xx.currency     /* _10- */
                   , NULL            /* _11- */
                   , NULL            /* _12- */
                   , NULL            /* _13- */
                   , NULL            /* _14- */
                   , xx.gyulje_aek   /* _15- */
                   , xx.gyulje_aek   /* _16- */
                   , xx.tax_aek      /* _17- */
                   , w_won_tax       /* _18- */
                   , w_gross_up_rt   /* _19- */
                   , w_gross_up_tax  /* _20- */
                   , w_gross_up_aek  /* _21- */
                   );
        end if;
    end loop;
    commit;

    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := 'sycp010:' || SUBSTR (sqlerrm, 1, 180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SYCP020 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_pgm_id                       IN    VARCHAR,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 해외채권 원금상환 처리, 해외파생 최종결제 처리
-- 수도결제 처리하므로 휴일에도 수령처리 함
--
    w_day_jonga                  NUMBER;
