    w_susu_tr_co_cd              VARCHAR(10);

    w_tr_cd                      CHAR(3);
    w_tr_seq                     NUMBER := 0;

    w_aek                        number_varray_50;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', p_pgm_id, 'sycp020 : ' || p_ymd || p_proc_step || ' : 해외채권 원리금 상환처리');

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                       /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                     /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                               /* _3- */
             , ia.mg_cd                                                                                       /* _4- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                       /* _5- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                     /* _6- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                    /* _7- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                                                     /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_bfil_jusu                                                              AS aekm           /* _9- */
             , t1.tr_bfil_chui_aek                                                          AS chui_aek       /* _10- */
             , F_COVWON_TR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_bfil_jusu)                 AS won_aekm       /* _11- */
             , t1.won_bfil_chui_aek                                                         AS won_chui_aek   /* _12- */
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ia.fund_cd ORDER BY ia.fund_cd)              AS seq            /* _13- */
             , F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_bfil_jusu, ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_aekm      /* _14- */
             , t1.fcur_bfil_chui_aek                                                        AS fcur_chui_aek  /* _15- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1
             , SYM0YA ya
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND ya.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.sanghw_ymd = p_ymd
           AND ya.jm_cd      = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  > p_ymd
    ) loop
        -- 해외채권마스타
        DELETE FROM SYM0YZ
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E32', 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd,
                            1, 1, xx.won_aekm, xx.won_chui_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP020', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E32', 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                            1, 1, xx.fcur_aekm, xx.fcur_chui_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP020', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := SUBSTR ('sycp020 -> ' || w_msg,1,180);
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 원금상환
        -- 이자수령에서 생성 하므로
        UPDATE UCS0BH
           SET aekm   = xx.aekm
             , won_gm = xx.won_aekm
         WHERE corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd    = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd      = xx.jm_cd
           AND sanghw_ymd = p_ymd;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            p_msg   := xx.jm_cd || '-채권원금 상환내역 수정오류입니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SYT0YS
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd         /* _2- */
                   , p_ymd         /* _3- */
                   , 'E32'         /* _4- */
                   , xx.fund_cd    /* _5- */
                   , xx.mg_cd      /* _6- */
                   , xx.trustee    /* _7- */
                   , xx.jm_cd      /* _8- */
                   , xx.currency   /* _9- */
                   , xx.seq        /* _10- */
                   , NULL          /* _11- */
                   , 0             /* _12- */
                   , 0             /* _13- */
                   , xx.aekm       /* _14- */
                   , xx.won_aekm   /* _15- */
                   , 'N'           /* _16- */
                   , NULL          /* _17- */
                   , xx.won_aekm   /* _18- */
                   , 0             /* _19- */
                   , 0             /* _20- */
                   , NULL          /* _21- */
                   , NULL          /* _22- */
                   , NULL          /* _23- */
                   , xx.bs_type    /* _24- */
                   , xx.fcur_aekm  /* _25- */
                   , xx.fcur_aekm  /* _26- */
                   , 0             /* _27- */
                   , NULL          /* _28- */
                   , NULL          /* _29- */
                   , NULL          /* _30- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            UPDATE SYT0YS
               SET gyulje_aek      = xx.aekm
                 , won_gyulje_aek  = xx.won_aekm
                 , won_pyunga_aek  = xx.won_aekm
                 , fcur_gyulje_aek = xx.fcur_aekm
                 , fcur_pyunga_aek = xx.fcur_aekm
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND tr_ymd   = p_ymd
               AND tr_cd    = 'E32'
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND bs_type  = xx.bs_type
               AND ymd      = p_ymd
               AND tr_co_cd = xx.mg_cd
               AND trustee  = xx.trustee
               AND currency = xx.currency
               AND tr_seq   = xx.seq;
        END;
    END LOOP;

    -- 해외 원금 미수입금 결제처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                         /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_ymd                                                        /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                         /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                       /* _4- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                 /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                                      /* _6- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                         /* _7- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                       /* _8- */
             , t1.trustee                                                       /* _9- */
             , t1.currency                                                      /* _10- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                                                  /* _11- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                                                    /* _12- */
             , t1.won_gyulje_aek                                                /* _13- */
             , t1.sury_aek                                                      /* _14- */
             , CASE WHEN t1.tr_ymd=p_ymd THEN t1.won_gyulje_aek
                                         ELSE t1.won_pyunga_aek
               END                                          AS won_pyunga_aek   /* _15- */
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                      ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq              /* _16- */
             , t1.fcur_gyulje_aek                                               /* _17- */
             , CASE WHEN t1.tr_ymd=p_ymd THEN t1.fcur_gyulje_aek
                                         ELSE t1.fcur_pyunga_aek
               END                                          AS fcur_pyunga_aek  /* _18- */
          FROM SYT0YS t1
             , SYM0YA t2
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'E32'
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd = p_ymd
           AND t1.gyulje_gb  = 'Y'
           AND t2.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd      = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        -- 외화예금 입금 처리(자기통화)
        SR_10151_IN (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.trustee, 0, xx.gyulje_aek,
                     xx.won_pyunga_aek, xx.fcur_gyulje_aek, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := SUBSTR ('외화예금입금(sr_10151_in) 오류 : ' || w_msg,1,180);
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.won_pyunga_aek, xx.won_gyulje_aek,
                                         CASE WHEN xx.won_gyulje_aek > xx.won_pyunga_aek THEN xx.won_gyulje_aek - xx.won_pyunga_aek ELSE 0 END,
                                         CASE WHEN xx.won_gyulje_aek < xx.won_pyunga_aek THEN xx.won_pyunga_aek - xx.won_gyulje_aek ELSE 0 END);
        else
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.fcur_pyunga_aek, xx.fcur_gyulje_aek,
                                         CASE WHEN xx.fcur_gyulje_aek > xx.fcur_pyunga_aek THEN xx.fcur_gyulje_aek - xx.fcur_pyunga_aek ELSE 0 END,
                                         CASE WHEN xx.fcur_gyulje_aek < xx.fcur_pyunga_aek THEN xx.fcur_pyunga_aek - xx.fcur_gyulje_aek ELSE 0 END);
        end if;
        SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E32', 'A', '2', '10', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                    2, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP020', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    -- 해외 파생은 현물결제 입출고로 수도결제에서 처리
    --
    -- 해외 최종결제/옵션 권리행사 처리
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'SYT0MG', p_ymd || ' : 해외 선물옵션 최종결제/옵션 권리행사 처리');

    -- 최종결제/옵션 권리행사 삭제
    DELETE FROM SYT0MG t1  
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('S13','S23','S73','S83','S93','SA3','S74','S84','S94','SA4')
       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd;

    SELECT NVL(MAX(tr_seq),0)
      INTO w_tr_seq
      FROM SYT0MG t1
     WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('S13','S23','S73','S83','S93','SA3','S74','S84','S94','SA4')
       AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd;

    -- 거래생성 처리
    DELETE FROM SYT0MG
     WHERE CORP_GR  = p_corp_gr
       AND TR_YMD   = p_ymd
       AND UPD_USER IN ('S13','S23','S73','S83','S93','SA3','S74','S84','S94','SA4');

    FOR xx IN  (
        SELECT t1.FUND_CD                                                /* _1- */
             , t1.TRUSTEE                                                /* _2- */
             , t1.JM_CD                                                  /* _3- */
             , t1.CURRENCY                                               /* _4- */
             , t1.SM_TR_GB                                               /* _5- */
             , t1.TR_BFIL_JUSU                            AS tr_jusu     /* _6- */
             , t1.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK                        AS tr_aek      /* _7- */
             , t1.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK                        AS gyulje_aek  /* _8- */
             , t1.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT                                        /* _9- */
             , yz.HANGSA_GA                                              /* _10- */
             , yz.CHANGE_JM_CD                                           /* _11- */
             , yz.UNIT_AEK                                               /* _12- */
             , ia.MG_CD                                                  /* _13- */
             , 'SYCP020'                                  AS upd_user    /* _14- */
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY yz.CHANGE_JM_CD
                                      ORDER BY yz.JM_CD)  AS tr_seq      /* _15- */
          FROM SYM0YA yz
             , SYM0YZ t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE yz.CORP_GR              = p_corp_gr
           AND yz.JASAN_GB             = 'A'
           AND yz.LSY_YMD              = p_ymd
           AND t1.CORP_GR              = yz.CORP_GR
           AND t1.YMD                  = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_JUSU,0)  <> 0
           AND t1.JM_CD                = yz.JM_CD
           AND ia.CORP_GR              = t1.CORP_GR
           AND ia.FUND_CD              = t1.FUND_CD
    ) loop
        -- 결제가격
        if  xx.CHANGE_JM_CD IS NOT NULL then
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL(t1.jonga,0)
                  INTO w_day_jonga
                  FROM SYT0LP t1
                 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd     = F_OPEN_US(p_ymd,'-')
                   AND t1.JM_CD   = xx.change_jm_cd;
            EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                w_day_jonga := 0;
            END;
            if  w_day_jonga = 0 then
                p_msg   := xx.jm_cd || '-' || xx.change_jm_cd || '- 결제 종가를 확인(#3590)하십시요.';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        else
            p_msg   := '펀드: ' || xx.fund_cd || ' 종목: ' || xx.jm_cd || '-' || xx.change_jm_cd || '- 결제 처리확인.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 수수료 적용코드
        w_susu_tr_co_cd := NULL;

        BEGIN
            SELECT sebu_cd_nm
              INTO w_susu_tr_co_cd
              FROM SZX1GR t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.gr_cd   = 'PP'
               AND t1.sebu_cd = xx.mg_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            NULL;
        END;
        if  w_susu_tr_co_cd IS NULL then
            p_msg   := xx.mg_cd || '- (#9022)최종결제 수수료율을 등록하십시오.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        /* 거래코드 생성 처리 */
        if  xx.sm_tr_gb = '1'   then    w_tr_cd     := 'S13';   -- 매입선물 최종결제
        elsif xx.sm_tr_gb = '2' then    w_tr_cd     := 'S23';   -- 매도선물 최종결제
        elsif xx.sm_tr_gb = '3' then    w_tr_cd     := 'S73';   -- 콜매입 권리행사
        elsif xx.sm_tr_gb = '4' then    w_tr_cd     := 'S83';   -- 콜매도 의무이행
        elsif xx.sm_tr_gb = '5' then
            w_tr_cd := 'S93';   -- 풋매입 권리행사

            -- 현물 출고거래 생성(F22)


        elsif xx.sm_tr_gb = '6' then
            w_tr_cd := 'SA3';   -- 풋매도 의무이행

            -- 현물 입고거래 생성(F21)
            -- 행사가보다 종가가 높을경우 권리포기
            if  xx.hangsa_ga > w_day_jonga  then
                xx.upd_user := 'F21';   -- 주식수령

                INSERT INTO SYT0MG
                    ( CORP_GR     /* _1- */
                    , TR_YMD      /* _2- */
                    , TR_CD       /* _3- */
                    , FUND_CD     /* _4- */
                    , TR_CO_CD    /* _5- */
                    , TRUSTEE     /* _6- */
                    , JM_CD       /* _7- */
                    , CURRENCY    /* _8- */
                    , TR_SEQ      /* _9- */
                    , TR_JUSU     /* _10- */
                    , TR_DANGA    /* _11- */
                    , TR_TAX      /* _12- */
                    , TR_COST     /* _13- */
                    , TR_AEK      /* _14- */
                    , GYULJE_YMD  /* _15- */
                    , GYULJE_AEK  /* _16- */
                    , upd_user    /* _17- */
                    )
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd                                    /* _2- */
                       , 'F21'                                    /* _3- */
                       , xx.fund_cd                               /* _4- */
                       , xx.mg_cd                                 /* _5- */
                       , xx.trustee                               /* _6- */
                       , xx.change_jm_cd                          /* _7- */
                       , xx.currency                              /* _8- */
                       , xx.tr_seq                                /* _9- */
                       , xx.tr_jusu * xx.unit_aek                 /* _10- */
                       , xx.hangsa_ga                             /* _11- */
                       , 0                                        /* _12- */
                       , 0                                        /* _13- */
                       , xx.tr_jusu * xx.hangsa_ga * xx.unit_aek  /* _14- */
                       , p_ymd                                    /* _15- */
                       , xx.tr_jusu * xx.hangsa_ga * xx.unit_aek  /* _16- */
                       , w_tr_cd                                  /* _17- */
                       );
            end if;
        else
            p_msg   := xx.jm_cd || '- 파생구분 구분이 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 계약수, 거래순번 및  처리 flag 생성
        w_tr_seq    := w_tr_seq + 1;

        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SYT0MG
                ( CORP_GR     /* _1- */
                , TR_YMD      /* _2- */
                , TR_CD       /* _3- */
                , FUND_CD     /* _4- */
                , TR_CO_CD    /* _5- */
                , TRUSTEE     /* _6- */
                , JM_CD       /* _7- */
                , CURRENCY    /* _8- */
                , TR_SEQ      /* _9- */
                , TR_JUSU     /* _10- */
                , TR_DANGA    /* _11- */
                , TR_COST     /* _12- */
                , TR_AEK      /* _13- */
                , GYULJE_YMD  /* _14- */
                , GYULJE_AEK  /* _15- */
                , TRANS_RT    /* _16- */
                , UPD_USER    /* _17- */
                )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr          /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd              /* _2- */
                   , w_tr_cd            /* _3- */
                   , xx.fund_cd         /* _4- */
                   , xx.mg_cd           /* _5- */
                   , xx.trustee         /* _6- */
                   , xx.jm_cd           /* _7- */
                   , xx.currency        /* _8- */
                   , w_tr_seq           /* _9- */
                   , xx.tr_jusu         /* _10- */
                   , 0                  /* _11- */
                   , 0                  /* _12- */
                   , xx.tr_aek          /* _13- */
                   , p_ymd              /* _14- */
                   , xx.gyulje_aek      /* _15- */
                   , NULL               /* _16- */
                   , TRIM(xx.upd_user)  /* _17-char 형식으로 잡혀 공란이 들어감 20250729 */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN DUP_VAL_ON_INDEX THEN
            p_msg   := '펀드: ' || xx.fund_cd || ' 종목: ' || xx.jm_cd || '-' || xx.change_jm_cd || '-최종결제거래 생성오류';
            RETURN;
        END;
    END LOOP;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    p_msg   := 'sycp020:' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SYCP030 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 해외주식 배당/권리 처리
--
    w_tr_cd                      VARCHAR (3);
    w_jm_cd                      VARCHAR (12);

    w_ys_rowid                   ROWID;
    w_tax_rowid                  ROWID;

    w_won_aek                    NUMBER;
    w_won_tax_aek                NUMBER;
    w_won_cha                    NUMBER;
    w_won_tax_cha                NUMBER;
    w_gross_up_cha               NUMBER;
    w_sum_aek                    NUMBER;
    w_sum_won_aek                NUMBER;

    w_gross_up_rt                NUMBER;
    w_gross_up_tax               NUMBER;
    w_gross_up_aek               NUMBER;

    w_days                       NUMBER;
    w_ma50                       NUMBER;
    w_ma200                      NUMBER;

    w_aek                        number_varray_50;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR (200);
BEGIN
    -- 유상비율변경시 기존 유상불입자료 삭제
    DELETE FROM SYT0YS
     WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
       AND ymd         = p_ymd
       AND pyunga_join IN ( SELECT pyunga_join
                              FROM SYT0YG ta
                             WHERE ta.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
                               AND ta.end_ymd   = p_ymd
                               AND ta.end_tr_cd = 'G31' );

    -- 해외 배당금 수령처리
    -- 전일환율을 당일환율로 20200723 yjs
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                        /* _1- */
             , t1.ymd                                                          /* _2- */
             , NVL(t1.aek,0)                                    AS aek         /* _3- */
             , NVL(t1.tax_aek,0)                                AS tax_aek     /* _4- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                                                 /* _5- */
             , yg.rowid                                         AS yg_rowid    /* _6- */
             , yg.tr_cd                                                        /* _7- */
             , yg.tr_ymd                                                       /* _8- */
             , yg.fund_cd                                                      /* _9- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                /* _10- */
             , yg.jm_cd                                                        /* _11- */
             , yg.bs_type                                                      /* _12- */
             , yg.trustee                                                      /* _13- */
             , yg.currency                                                     /* _14- */
             , NVL(yg.aek,0)                                    AS yg_aek      /* _15- */
             , NVL(yg.tax_aek,0)                                AS yg_tax_aek  /* _16- */
             , NVL(yg.won_aek,0)                                AS yg_won_aek  /* _17- */
             , ia.mg_cd                                                        /* _18- */
             , F_CURRENCY_RT (t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, yg.currency)  AS ex_rate     /* _19- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY yg.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY yg.fund_cd)     AS seq         /* _20- */
             , yg.hwakj_ymd                                                    /* _21- */
             , ia.bf_gyul_ymd                                                  /* _22- */
          FROM SYT0YG_PYUNGA t1
             , SYT0YG        yg
             , SYM0YA        t2
             , SZM0IA        ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
           AND t1.churi_ymd   = p_ymd
           AND yg.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
           AND yg.tr_cd       IN ('G12','G17')
           AND yg.pyunga_join = t1.pyunga_join
           AND t2.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd       = yg.jm_cd
           AND t2.jasan_gb    IN ('1','2')
           AND ia.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd     = yg.fund_cd
    ) loop
        UPDATE SYT0YG
           SET churi_ymd = p_ymd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.yg_rowid;

        -- 수령금액 전일 환율로 처리 20200428 yjs
        w_won_aek     := TRUNC (xx.aek * xx.ex_rate);
        w_won_tax_aek := TRUNC (xx.tax_aek * xx.ex_rate);

        -- 외국납부세액과 국내세액 중 작은 금액으로
        SELECT F_TRUNC (gross_up_ija_tax_rt * (w_won_aek + w_won_tax_aek), xx.fund_currency) 
             , gross_up_ija_tax_rt
          INTO w_gross_up_tax
             , w_gross_up_rt
          FROM SZX0SB t1
         WHERE p_ymd BETWEEN t1.f_ymd AND t1.t_ymd;

        w_gross_up_aek  := LEAST (w_gross_up_tax, w_won_tax_aek);

        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET tr_up_jusu      = NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) + xx.aek
             , tr_up_chui_aek  = NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.aek
             , won_up_chui_aek = NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) + w_won_aek
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = xx.gyulje_jm_cd
           AND bs_type = xx.bs_type
           AND ymd     = p_ymd
           AND trustee = xx.trustee;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO SYM0YZ
                ( corp_gr          /* _1- */
                , ymd              /* _2- */
                , fund_cd          /* _3- */
                , trustee          /* _4- */
                , jm_cd            /* _5- */
                , bs_type          /* _6- */
                , currency         /* _7- */
                , tr_up_jusu       /* _8- */
                , tr_up_chui_aek   /* _9- */
                , won_up_chui_aek  /* _10- */
                )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd            /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd       /* _3- */
                   , xx.trustee       /* _4- */
                   , xx.gyulje_jm_cd  /* _5- */
                   , xx.bs_type       /* _6- */
                   , xx.currency      /* _7- */
                   , xx.aek           /* _8- */
                   , xx.aek           /* _9- */
                   , w_won_aek        /* _10- */
                   );
        end if;

        w_aek   := number_varray_50 (w_won_aek,xx.yg_won_aek
                                     , CASE When xx.yg_won_aek > w_won_aek THEN xx.yg_won_aek - w_won_aek ELSE 0 END
                                     , CASE When xx.yg_won_aek < w_won_aek THEN w_won_aek - xx.yg_won_aek ELSE 0 END
                                     , w_gross_up_aek, w_gross_up_aek);
        if  xx.hwakj_ymd <= xx.bf_gyul_ymd      then
                SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'F11', 'A', '2', '-', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                            xx.seq, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP030 전기분', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'F11', 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                            xx.seq, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP030 당기분', w_msg);
        end if;

        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := 'SYCP030' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 해외 납부세금 관리
        if  w_gross_up_aek != 0 then
            -- 당일 전부수령하지 않은 배당금인 경우 분리 입력, 세금은 합산처리케 20211019 yjs
            SELECT NVL(SUM(aek),0) 
                 , NVL(SUM(won_gyulje_aek),0) 
              INTO w_sum_aek
                 , w_sum_won_aek
              FROM SYT0YG t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.tr_cd   = xx.tr_cd;

            if  xx.aek < w_sum_aek  then
                xx.aek    := w_sum_aek;
                w_won_aek := w_sum_won_aek;
            end if;

            INSERT INTO SYT0TAX
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                  /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                      /* _2- */
                   , xx.tr_ymd                  /* _3- */
                   , xx.tr_cd                   /* _4- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                 /* _5- */
                   , xx.seq                     /* _6- */
                   , xx.mg_cd                   /* _7- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                   /* _8- */
                   , xx.trustee                 /* _9- */
                   , xx.currency                /* _10- */
                   , NULL                       /* _11- */
                   , NULL                       /* _12- */
                   , NULL                       /* _13- */
                   , NULL                       /* _14- */
                   , xx.aek + xx.tax_aek        /* _15- */
                   , w_won_aek + w_won_tax_aek  /* _16- */
                   , xx.tax_aek                 /* _17- */
                   , w_won_tax_aek              /* _18- */
                   , w_gross_up_rt              /* _19- */
                   , w_gross_up_tax             /* _20- */
                   , w_gross_up_aek             /* _21- */
                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    -- 상장처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.churi_jusu                                              /* _1- */
             , NVL(t1.aek,0)                                 AS aek       /* _2- */
             , NVL(t1.won_aek,0)                             AS won_aek   /* _3- */
             , yg.rowid                                      AS yg_rowid  /* _4- */
             , yg.fund_cd                                                 /* _5- */
             , yg.jm_cd                                                   /* _6- */
             , yg.bs_type                                                 /* _7- */
             , yg.trustee                                                 /* _8- */
             , yg.currency                                                /* _9- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY yg.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY yg.fund_cd)  AS seq       /* _10- */
          FROM SYT0YG_PYUNGA t1
             , SYT0YG        yg
             , SYM0YA        t2
             , SZM0IA        ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
           AND t1.churi_ymd   = p_ymd
           AND yg.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
           AND yg.tr_cd       NOT IN ('G12','G17','G53')
           AND yg.pyunga_join = t1.pyunga_join
           AND t2.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd       = yg.jm_cd
           AND t2.jasan_gb    = '1'
           AND ia.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd     = yg.fund_cd
    ) loop
        UPDATE SYT0YG
           SET churi_ymd = p_ymd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.yg_rowid;

        -- 해외자산마스타 처리
        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET tr_up_jusu      = NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) + xx.churi_jusu
             , tr_up_chui_aek  = NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.aek
             , won_up_chui_aek = NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.won_aek
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND bs_type = xx.bs_type
           AND ymd     = p_ymd
           AND trustee = xx.trustee;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO SYM0YZ
                ( corp_gr            /* _1- */
                , ymd                /* _2- */
                , fund_cd            /* _3- */
                , trustee            /* _4- */
                , jm_cd              /* _5- */
                , bs_type            /* _6- */
                , currency           /* _7- */
                , tr_bfil_jusu       /* _8- */
                , tr_up_jusu         /* _9- */
                , tr_dw_jusu         /* _10- */
                , tr_bfil_chui_aek   /* _11- */
                , tr_up_chui_aek     /* _12- */
                , tr_dw_chui_aek     /* _13- */
                , won_bfil_chui_aek  /* _14- */
                , won_up_chui_aek    /* _15- */
                , won_dw_chui_aek    /* _16- */
                )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr      /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd          /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd     /* _3- */
                   , xx.trustee     /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_cd       /* _5- */
                   , xx.bs_type     /* _6- */
                   , xx.currency    /* _7- */
                   , 0              /* _8- */
                   , xx.churi_jusu  /* _9- */
                   , 0              /* _10- */
                   , 0              /* _11- */
                   , xx.aek         /* _12- */
                   , 0              /* _13- */
                   , 0              /* _14- */
                   , xx.won_aek     /* _15- */
                   , 0              /* _16- */
                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    -- 코드변경
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                      AS yg_rowid  /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                   /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                 /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                           /* _4- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                   /* _5- */
             , t1.g53_jm_cd                                               /* _6- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                 /* _7- */
             , t1.trustee                                                 /* _8- */
             , t1.currency                                                /* _9- */
             , t1.jusu                                                    /* _10- */
             , t1.aek                                                     /* _11- */
             , t1.won_aek                                                 /* _12- */
             , ya.sj_gb || y2.sj_gb                          AS jasan_gb  /* _13- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq       /* _14- */
          FROM SYT0YG t1
             , SYM0YA ya
             , SYM0YA y2
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd    = 'G53'
           AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
           AND ya.jasan_gb = '1'
           AND y2.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND y2.jm_cd    = t1.g53_jm_cd
           AND y2.jasan_gb = '1'
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        UPDATE SYT0YG
           SET churi_ymd = p_ymd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.yg_rowid;

        -- 해외자산마스타 처리
        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET tr_dw_jusu      = NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0) + xx.jusu
             , tr_dw_chui_aek  = NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0) + xx.aek
             , won_dw_chui_aek = NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0) + xx.won_aek
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND bs_type = xx.bs_type
           AND ymd     = p_ymd
           AND trustee = xx.trustee;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            p_msg   := xx.jm_cd || ' - 코드변경전 자료가 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        INSERT INTO SYM0YZ
            ( corp_gr            /* _1- */
            , ymd                /* _2- */
            , fund_cd            /* _3- */
            , trustee            /* _4- */
            , jm_cd              /* _5- */
            , bs_type            /* _6- */
            , currency           /* _7- */
            , tr_bfil_jusu       /* _8- */
            , tr_up_jusu         /* _9- */
            , tr_dw_jusu         /* _10- */
            , tr_bfil_chui_aek   /* _11- */
            , tr_up_chui_aek     /* _12- */
            , tr_dw_chui_aek     /* _13- */
            , won_bfil_chui_aek  /* _14- */
            , won_up_chui_aek    /* _15- */
            , won_dw_chui_aek    /* _16- */
            )
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
               , p_ymd         /* _2- */
               , xx.fund_cd    /* _3- */
               , xx.trustee    /* _4- */
               , xx.g53_jm_cd  /* _5- */
               , xx.bs_type    /* _6- */
               , xx.currency   /* _7- */
               , 0             /* _8- */
               , xx.jusu       /* _9- */
               , 0             /* _10- */
               , 0             /* _11- */
               , xx.aek        /* _12- */
               , 0             /* _13- */
               , 0             /* _14- */
               , xx.won_aek    /* _15- */
               , 0             /* _16- */
               );

        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                    xx.seq, 1, xx.won_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP030_G53', w_msg);
    END LOOP;

    -- (G11/G12),유상증자(G31/G32), 무상증자(G35/36)
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                /* _1- */
             , t1.churi_ymd                                                            /* _2- */
             , t1.pyunga_join                                                          /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                /* _4- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                              /* _5- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                        /* _6- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                /* _7- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                              /* _8- */
             , t1.trustee                                                              /* _9- */
             , t1.currency                                                             /* _10- */
             , t1.jusu                                                                 /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.aek,0)                                       AS aek              /* _12- */
             , NVL(t1.tax_aek,0)                                   AS tax_aek          /* _13- */
             , F_CURRENCY_RT (t1.corp_gr, p_ymd - 1, t1.currency)  AS ex_rate          /* _14- */
             , NVL(t1.org_won_aek,0)                               AS org_won_aek      /* _15- */
             , NVL(t1.org_won_tax_aek,0)                           AS org_won_tax_aek  /* _16- */
             , ia.mg_cd                                                                /* _17- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)        AS seq              /* _18- */
             , t1.hwakj_ymd                                                            /* _19- */
          FROM SYT0YG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd                    = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd                     NOT IN ('G53','G92')
           AND NVL(t1.churi_ymd, p_ymd + 1) >= p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr                   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                   = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_cd, t1.fund_cd, t1.trustee, t1.jm_cd, t1.bs_type
    ) loop
        w_won_aek     := TRUNC (xx.aek * xx.ex_rate);
        w_won_tax_aek := TRUNC (xx.tax_aek * xx.ex_rate);

        if  xx.tr_cd IN ('G11','G12','G31','G35')   then
            if  xx.hwakj_ymd < p_ymd    then
                    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '-', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                                xx.seq, 1, w_won_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP0030', w_msg);
            else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                                xx.seq, 1, w_won_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP0030', w_msg);
            end if;
        else
            w_won_cha     := w_won_aek - xx.org_won_aek;
            w_won_tax_cha := w_won_tax_aek - xx.org_won_tax_aek;
            SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                        xx.seq, 1, w_won_cha - w_won_tax_cha, p_proc_step, 'SYCP0030', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        UPDATE SYT0YG
           SET gyulje_aek     = xx.aek - xx.tax_aek
             , won_aek        = w_won_aek
             , won_tax_aek    = w_won_tax_aek
             , won_gyulje_aek = w_won_aek - w_won_tax_aek
             , gross_up_aek   = w_gross_up_aek
             , end_tr_cd      = CASE When xx.aek=0 AND xx.tr_cd NOT IN ('G35','G36') THEN xx.tr_cd ELSE end_tr_cd END
             , end_ymd        = CASE When xx.aek=0 AND xx.tr_cd NOT IN ('G35','G36') THEN p_ymd ELSE end_ymd END
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        if NVL (xx.churi_ymd,p_ymd + 1) > p_ymd then
            -- 일별 평가를 위한 자료 생성
            INSERT INTO SYT0YG_PYUNGA
                ( corp_gr           /* _1- */
                , ymd               /* _2- */
                , pyunga_join       /* _3- */
                , jusu              /* _4- */
                , gyulje_aek        /* _5- */
                , won_gyulje_aek    /* _6- */
                , pyunga_aek        /* _7- */
                , won_pyunga_aek    /* _8- */
                , won_pyunga_sonik  /* _9- */
                , won_hwan_cha      /* _10- */
                , napbu_ymd         /* _11- */
                )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr              /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                  /* _2- */
                   , xx.pyunga_join         /* _3- */
                   , CASE When xx.tr_cd IN ('G12','G17')
                          THEN 0
                          ELSE xx.jusu END  /* _4- */
                   , xx.aek                 /* _5- */
                   , w_won_aek              /* _6- */
                   , 0                      /* _7- */
                   , 0                      /* _8- */
                   , 0                      /* _9- */
                   , 0                      /* _10- */
                   , CASE When xx.tr_cd IN ('G31','G32')
                          THEN NULL
                          ELSE p_ymd END    /* _11- */
                   );

            -- 유상납입 생성
            if  xx.tr_cd IN ('G31','G32')   then
                DELETE FROM SYT0YS
                 WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
                   AND ymd         = p_ymd
                   AND pyunga_join = xx.pyunga_join;

                INSERT INTO SYT0YS
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd           /* _2- */
                       , p_ymd           /* _3- */
                       , 'G33'           /* _4- */
                       , xx.fund_cd      /* _5- */
                       , xx.mg_cd        /* _6- */
                       , xx.trustee      /* _7- */
                       , xx.jm_cd        /* _8- */
                       , xx.currency     /* _9- */
                       , xx.seq          /* _10- */
                       , NULL            /* _11- */
                       , 0               /* _12- */
                       , 0               /* _13- */
                       , xx.aek          /* _14- */
                       , w_won_aek       /* _15- */
                       , 'N'             /* _16- */
                       , NULL            /* _17- */
                       , 0               /* _18- */
                       , 0               /* _19- */
                       , 0               /* _20- */
                       , 0               /* _21- */
                       , NULL            /* _22- */
                       , xx.pyunga_join  /* _23- */
                       , xx.bs_type      /* _24- */
                       , NULL            /* _25- */
                       , NULL            /* _26- */
                       , NULL            /* _27- */
                       , NULL            /* _28- */
                       , NULL            /* _29- */
                       , NULL            /* _30- */
                       );
            end if;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    -- 권리 재처리
    UPDATE SYM0YZ
       SET RIGHT_JUSU     = 0
         , RIGHT_AEK      = 0
         , RIGHT_WON_AEK  = 0
         , RIGHT_FCUR_AEK = 0
     WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
       AND YMD     = p_ymd;

    -- 액면분할(G92) 20251118
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.JM_CD
             , t1.HWAKJ_PER / 100  AS rt
          FROM SYT0YG t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd     = 'G92'
           AND t1.HWAKJ_YMD = p_ymd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_cd, t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        -- 종목정보 다시 받게
        UPDATE SRS_CD
           SET EXCH_CD = NULL
         WHERE ISIN_CD = xx.jm_cd;

        -- 종목정보 행사가 조정(한번만 처리, 종목코드는 그대로 심벌에 1추가 행사가 조정)
        UPDATE SYM0YA
           SET HANGSA_GA       = HANGSA_GA / xx.rt
             , RIGHT_HANGSA_GA = HANGSA_GA
             , RIGHT_UPDATE    = sysdate
             , RIGHT_JM_CD     = REPLACE(JM_CD, F_N0(HANGSA_GA, 0, 1), F_N0(HANGSA_GA / xx.rt, 0, 1))
             , USPM_YMD        = sysdate
         WHERE CHANGE_JM_CD = xx.jm_cd
           AND RIGHT_UPDATE IS NULL;

        -- 이동평균 재생성
        FOR dt IN (
            SELECT ymd
              FROM SZX9DT t1
             WHERE t1.ymd BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS (p_ymd,-12) AND p_ymd
        ) loop
            w_days  := 0;
            FOR x1 IN (
                SELECT t1.YMD
                     , NVL(t1.JONGA,0)  AS jonga
                  FROM SYT0LP t1
                 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.YMD     BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS (dt.ymd,-12) AND dt.ymd
                   AND t1.YMD     NOT IN ( SELECT HOLI_YMD
                                             FROM SZX0HL ta
                                            WHERE ta.NATION_CD = 'US'
                                              AND ta.HOLI_YMD  >= ADD_MONTHS(dt.ymd,-12) )
                   AND t1.JM_CD   = xx.jm_cd
                 ORDER BY t1.YMD DESC
            ) loop
                w_days  := w_days + 1;
                if  w_days <= 50    then    w_ma50  := w_ma50 + x1.jonga;
                end if;
                w_ma200 := w_ma200 + x1.jonga;
                if  w_days = 200   then exit;
                end if;
            END LOOP;

            if  w_days > 1  then
                if  w_days >= 200 then
                    w_ma50  := w_ma50 / 50;
                    w_ma200 := w_ma200 / 200;
                else
                    if  w_days >= 50    then    w_ma50 := w_ma50 / 50;
                    else                        w_ma50 := w_ma50 / w_days;
                    end if;
                    w_ma200 := w_ma200 / w_days;
                end if;

                UPDATE USPM_DD
                   SET MA50  = w_ma50
                     , MA200 = w_ma200
                 WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                   AND YMD     = dt.ymd
                   AND JM_CD   = xx.jm_cd;
            end if;
        END LOOP;

        FOR x1 IN (
            SELECT t1.FUND_CD       /* _1- */
                 , t1.TRUSTEE       /* _2- */
                 , t1.JM_CD         /* _3- */
                 , t1.BS_TYPE       /* _4- */
                 , t1.TR_BFIL_JUSU  /* _5- */
              FROM SYM0YZ t1
             WHERE t1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.YMD     = p_ymd
               AND t1.JM_CD   IN ( SELECT h1.JM_CD
                                     FROM SYM0YA h1
                                    WHERE h1.CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
                                      AND (h1.JM_CD = xx.jm_cd OR h1.CHANGE_JM_CD = xx.jm_cd) )
        ) loop
            UPDATE SYM0YZ
               SET RIGHT_JUSU = TRUNC(x1.tr_bfil_jusu * xx.rt) - x1.tr_bfil_jusu
             WHERE CORP_GR = p_corp_gr
               AND YMD     = p_ymd
               AND FUND_CD = x1.fund_cd
               AND TRUSTEE = X1.trustee
               AND JM_CD   = x1.jm_cd
               AND BS_TYPE = x1.bs_type;
        END LOOP;
    END LOOP;

    -- 신규 또는 액면분할 종목 과거자료 재수신
    API_13_02_200 (p_corp_gr, TO_CHAR (p_ymd, 'yyyymmdd'), w_msg);

    -- 외화 세금환급신청 및 환급처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                     /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                               /* _2- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.request_aek),0)                    AS request_aek   /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.gross_up_aek),0)                   AS gross_up_aek  /* _4- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq           /* _5- */
          FROM SYT0TAX t1
             , SZM0IA  ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
           AND t1.request_ymd = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd     = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E65', 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '',
                    xx.seq, 1, xx.request_aek - xx.gross_up_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP0030', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    -- 환급처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                    /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                              /* _2- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.return_aek),0)                     AS return_aek   /* _3- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.request_aek),0)                    AS request_aek  /* _4- */
             , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq          /* _5- */
          FROM SYT0TAX t1
             , SZM0IA  ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.return_ymd = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.fund_cd, ia.fund_currency
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E65', 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '',
                    xx.seq, 1, xx.return_aek, xx.request_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP0030', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

    END LOOP;
    COMMIT;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg   := SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SYCP040 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_pgm_id                       IN    VARCHAR,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 매매분 수도결제 처리
-- 외국과 휴일이 다르므로 매일실행
--
    w_gyulje_jm_cd               VARCHAR(12);

    yz_won_aek                   NUMBER;
    yz_chui_aek                  NUMBER;
    yz_currency                  sym0yz.currency%type;

    w_tr_cost                    NUMBER;
    w_tr_trustee                 VARCHAR(5);
    w_cash_aek                   NUMBER;
    w_won_chui_aek               NUMBER;
    w_fcur_chui_aek              NUMBER;
    w_won_avg                    NUMBER;
    w_fcur_avg                   NUMBER;

    w_rowid                      ROWID;

    w_aek                        number_varray_50;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B000', 'syt0ys.ymd=' || p_ymd, '해외 결제종목 점검');

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT ROWID
             , currency
             , gyulje_jm_cd
          FROM SYT0YS t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd          = p_ymd
           AND (t1.gyulje_ymd = p_ymd OR t1.bunhal_aek != 0)
           AND t1.gyulje_jm_cd IS NULL
         ORDER BY currency
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT jm_cd
              INTO xx.gyulje_jm_cd
              FROM SYM0YA t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.sanghw_ymd >= p_ymd
               AND t1.gyulje_jm  = 'Y'
               AND t1.jasan_gb   = '5'
               AND t1.currency   = xx.currency;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            p_msg   := '통화(' || xx.currency || ')별 결제종목을 확인(1개만 존재해야 함).(2900 화면)';
            RETURN;
        END;

        UPDATE SYT0YS
           SET gyulje_jm_cd = xx.gyulje_jm_cd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    END LOOP;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B001', 'syt0mg.ymd=' || p_ymd, '해외 결제종목 점검');

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT ROWID
             , currency
             , gyulje_jm_cd
          FROM SYT0MG t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_ymd       = p_ymd
           AND t1.gyulje_jm_cd IS NULL
         ORDER BY currency
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT jm_cd
              INTO xx.gyulje_jm_cd
              FROM SYM0YA t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.sanghw_ymd >= p_ymd
               AND t1.gyulje_jm  = 'Y'
               AND t1.jasan_gb   = '5'
               AND t1.currency   = xx.currency;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            p_msg   := '통화(' || xx.currency || ')별 결제종목을 확인(1개만 존재해야 함).(2900 화면)';
            RETURN;
        END;

        UPDATE SYT0MG
           SET gyulje_jm_cd = xx.gyulje_jm_cd
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    END LOOP;

    -- 자문작업시 과거자료 처리시 잔고점검 예외처리를 위한 잔고 PASS 여부
    UPDATE SYT0MG
       SET pass_gb = 'N'
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'syt0ys.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=K10,K20', '매매분 수도결제 처리');

    -- 결제구분 2901 화면등록에서 자동으로 변경 20181210 yjs
    -- 사모펀드인 경우는 영업일인 경우만 자동 'Y' 처리 영업일이 휴일인 경우 화면에서 등록케 수정 20190502 yjs
    UPDATE SYT0YS
       SET gyulje_gb = CASE WHEN F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd,'-')=p_ymd
                            THEN 'Y'
                            ELSE gyulje_gb END
     WHERE corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_cd        IN ('E42','K10','K11','K20','K61')
       AND gyulje_jm_cd IS NOT NULL
       AND ymd          = p_ymd
       AND gyulje_ymd   = p_ymd;

    UPDATE SYT0YS
       SET gyulje_gb = CASE WHEN F_OPEN_YMD (p_ymd,'-')=p_ymd
                            THEN 'Y'
                            ELSE gyulje_gb END
     WHERE corp_gr      = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_cd        IN ('J10','J14','J20','J61')
       AND gyulje_jm_cd IS NOT NULL
       AND ymd          = p_ymd
       AND gyulje_ymd   = p_ymd;

    -- 환전 자동으로 변경 20181210 yjs
    UPDATE SYT0YS
       SET gyulje_gb = 'Y'
     WHERE corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_cd      IN ('J51','K51')
       AND ymd        = p_ymd
       AND gyulje_ymd = p_ymd;


    -- 외화기준가 관련 컬럼 처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid
             , t2.fund_currency
          FROM SYT0YS t1
             , SZM0IA t2
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        UPDATE SYT0YS

           AND t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr

             , won_tr_halin_aek  = F_TRUNC(xx.tr_halin_aek * xx.trans_rt, xx.fund_currency)

         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

    -- 거래비용 생성

                     , t1.trustee
                     , t1.currency
                     , t1.count_cost
                     , ia.fund_currency
                  FROM SYT0YS t1
                     , SZM0IA ia
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr              = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.ymd                  = p_ymd
                   AND t1.tr_cd                IN ('J14','J20','K11','K20')

                UNION ALL
                SELECT t1.fund_cd
                     , t1.trustee
                     , t1.currency
                     , t1.count_cost
                     , ia.fund_currency
                  FROM SYT0MG t1
                     , SZM0IA ia
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr              = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.tr_ymd               = p_ymd
                   AND t1.gyulje_ymd           = p_ymd
                   AND NVL(t1.count_cost,'0')  != '0'
                   AND ia.corp_gr              = t1.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd              = t1.fund_cd) tt 
         GROUP BY tt.fund_cd      
                , tt.trustee      
                , tt.currency     
                , tt.count_cost   
                , tt.fund_currency
         ORDER BY tt.fund_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT F_ROUND (xx.tr_cnt * cost, xx.fund_currency)
                 , cost_currency
                 , cost
                 , trustee
              INTO xx.tr_cnt
                 , xx.cost_currency
                 , w_tr_cost
                 , w_tr_trustee
              FROM SYX0SU t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.cost_gb  = '1'
               AND t1.cost_cd  = xx.count_cost
               AND t1.currency = xx.currency;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            p_msg   := xx.currency || '/' || xx.count_cost || '거래비용(#9210 해외보관처 기준통화보관처 체크)이 등록되어 있지 않습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;

        if  xx.tr_cnt > 0 OR w_tr_cost > 0  then
            UPDATE SYT0MC
               SET up_aek      = NVL(up_aek,0) + xx.tr_cnt
                 , cost_keep   = w_tr_cost
                 , fcur_up_aek = NVL(fcur_up_aek,0) + F_COVCUR(p_corp_gr,p_ymd,xx.cost_currency,xx.tr_cnt,xx.fund_currency)
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND tr_ymd   = p_ymd
               AND tr_cd    = 'P41'
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND trustee  = w_tr_trustee
               AND currency = xx.cost_currency;
            if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
                INSERT INTO SYT0MC
                    ( corp_gr      /* _1- */
                    , tr_ymd       /* _2- */
                    , tr_cd        /* _3- */
                    , fund_cd      /* _4- */
                    , trustee      /* _5- */
                    , currency     /* _6- */
                    , up_aek       /* _7- */
                    , cost_keep    /* _8- */
                    , fcur_up_aek  /* _9- */
                    )
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                                                  /* _1- */
                       , p_ymd                                                                      /* _2- */
                       , 'P41'                                                                      /* _3- */
                       , xx.fund_cd                                                                 /* _4- */
                       , w_tr_trustee                                                               /* _5- */
                       , xx.cost_currency                                                           /* _6- */
                       , xx.tr_cnt                                                                  /* _7- */
                       , w_tr_cost                                                                  /* _8- */
                       , F_COVCUR(p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.cost_currency, xx.tr_cnt, xx.fund_currency)  /* _9- */
                       );
            end if;
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
--EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
--    p_msg   := 'sycp040:' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SYCP041 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 해외현금 증가 처리
-- 외화예금 bs_type = 0인 잔고 관리
--
    w_gross_up_aek               NUMBER;

    w_aek                        number_varray_50;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sst0wc.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=S31,S35', '외화 증거금 회수처리');

    -- 외화 선물증거금 납입/회수처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                            /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                           /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                     /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                             /* _4- */
             , t1.tr_seq_no                                         /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                          /* _6- */
             , t1.trustee                                           /* _7- */
             , t1.currency                                          /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_aek                                            /* _9- */
             , t1.won_avg_aek                                       /* _10- */
             , t1.fcur_avg_aek                                      /* _11- */
             , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq /* _12- */
          FROM SST0WC t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd    IN ('S31','S35')
           AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
           AND t1.currency != 'KRW'
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        SR_10151_IN (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, NULL, xx.trustee, 0, xx.tr_aek, xx.won_avg_aek, xx.fcur_avg_aek, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := SUBSTR ('외화예금입금(sr_10151_in) 오류 : ' || w_msg,1,180);
            RETURN;
        end if;
        SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                    NULL, xx.seq, 1, xx.fcur_avg_aek, xx.fcur_avg_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP041 1', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'syt0ys.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=E42,K10,K11,K20', '수도결제 처리 : 주식/채권 매도분 결제처리');

    -- 수도결제 처리 : 주식/채권 매도분 결제처리(외화예금 증가)
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                                                                                /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                                          /* _2- */
             , 'E10'                                                                                                    AS tr_cd         /* _3- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                                                /* _4- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                                                                                                           /* _5- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                                               /* _6- */
             , CASE WHEN ya.jasan_gb='1'
                    THEN CASE ya.sj_gb WHEN '2'
                                       THEN '02'
                                       ELSE '00' END
                    ELSE '10' END                                                                                       AS jasan_gb      /* _7- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                                                                                                             /* _8- */
             , t1.won_gyulje_aek                                                                                                         /* _9- */
             , t1.won_pyunga_aek                                                                                                         /* _10- */
             , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)                                                             AS seq           /* _11- */
             , t1.fcur_gyulje_aek                                                                                                        /* _12- */
             , t1.fcur_pyunga_aek                                                                                                        /* _13- */
             , NVL(t1.sury_aek,0)                                                                                       AS sury_aek      /* _14- */
             , NVL(TRUNC (F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, p_ymd - 1, t1.currency, t1.sury_aek)),0)                                AS won_sury_aek  /* _15- */
             , F_TRUNC (F_COVCUR(t1.corp_gr, p_ymd - 1, t1.currency, t1.sury_aek, ia.fund_currency), ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_sury_aek /* _16- */
          FROM SYT0YS t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SYM0YA ya
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd      IN ('E42','K10','K11','K20')
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd = p_ymd
           AND t1.gyulje_gb  = 'Y'
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
           AND ya.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd      = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.sury_aek > 0 then
                SR_10151_IN (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.trustee, 0, xx.sury_aek, xx.won_sury_aek, xx.fcur_sury_aek, w_msg);
        else    SR_10151_IN (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.trustee, 0, xx.gyulje_aek, xx.won_pyunga_aek, xx.fcur_gyulje_aek, w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := SUBSTR ('외화예금입금(sr_10151_in) 오류 : ' || w_msg,1,180);
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            if  xx.sury_aek > 0 then
                SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.seq, 1,
                            xx.won_sury_aek, xx.won_gyulje_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP041 2', w_msg);
            else
                SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.seq, 1,
                            xx.won_pyunga_aek, xx.won_gyulje_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP041 2', w_msg);
            end if;
        else
            if  xx.sury_aek > 0 then
                SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.seq, 1,
                            xx.fcur_sury_aek, xx.fcur_gyulje_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP041 3', w_msg);
            else
                SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.seq, 1,
                            xx.fcur_pyunga_aek, xx.fcur_gyulje_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP041 3', w_msg);
            end if;
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    -- 수도결제 처리 : 분할수령 처리(외화예금 증가)
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                                                      /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                                                    /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                                              /* _3- */
             , 'E10'                                                                                                      AS tr_cd           /* _4- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                                                    /* _5- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                                                                                                               /* _6- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                                                   /* _7- */
             , CASE WHEN ya.jasan_gb='1'
                    THEN CASE ya.sj_gb WHEN '2'
                                       THEN '02'
                                       ELSE '00' END
                    ELSE '10'
               END                                                                                                        AS jasan_gb        /* _8- */
             , F_TRUNC (t1.won_gyulje_aek / t1.gyulje_aek * t1.bunhal_aek, ia.fund_currency)                              AS won_gyulje_aek  /* _9- */
             , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)                                                               AS seq             /* _10- */
             , F_TRUNC (t1.fcur_gyulje_aek / t1.gyulje_aek * t1.bunhal_aek, ia.fund_currency)                             AS fcur_gyulje_aek /* _11- */
             , t1.bunhal_aek                                                                                                                 /* _12- */
             , NVL(TRUNC (F_COVWON (t1.corp_gr, p_ymd - 1, t1.currency, t1.bunhal_aek)),0)                                AS won_bunhal_aek  /* _13- */
             , F_TRUNC (F_COVCUR(t1.corp_gr, p_ymd - 1, t1.currency, t1.bunhal_aek, ia.fund_currency), ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_bunhal_aek /* _14- */
          FROM SYT0YS t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SYM0YA ya
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd      IN ('E42','K10','K11','K20')
           AND t1.gyulje_gb  = 'N'
           AND t1.bunhal_aek != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
           AND ya.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd      = t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        UPDATE SYT0YS
           SET bunhal_won_gyulje_aek  = xx.won_gyulje_aek
             , bunhal_fcur_gyulje_aek = xx.fcur_gyulje_aek
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        SR_10151_IN (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.trustee, 0, xx.bunhal_aek, xx.won_bunhal_aek, xx.fcur_bunhal_aek, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := SUBSTR ('외화예금입금(sr_10151_in) 오류 : ' || w_msg,1,180);
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.seq, 2,
                        xx.won_bunhal_aek, xx.won_gyulje_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP041 4', w_msg);
        else
            SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.seq, 2,
                        xx.fcur_bunhal_aek, xx.fcur_gyulje_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP041 4', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'A', 'B030', 'SR_SYCP041 : ' || p_ymd || ' : 수익처리');

    -- 수익
    -- 당일환율 확인 20200723 yjs
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                  /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_ymd                                                                                 /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                                  /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                /* _4- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                /* _5- */
             , t1.currency                                                                               /* _6- */
             , t1.tr_aek                                                                                 /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.tax_aek,0)                                                          AS tax_aek     /* _8- */
             , F_COVWON_TR (p_corp_gr, tr_ymd, currency, tr_aek)                          AS won_tr_aek  /* _9- */
             , F_COVWON_TR (p_corp_gr, tr_ymd, currency, NVL(t1.tax_aek,0))               AS won_tax_aek /* _10- */
             , ia.mg_cd                                                                                  /* _11- */
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                      ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)                                AS seq         /* _12- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                          /* _13- */
             , F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_aek, ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_tr_aek /* _14- */
          FROM SYT0MA t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('E68','E69')
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  > p_ymd
    ) loop
        -- 해외 수익/비용 당일 발생/감소분 전표생성(외화 거래환율 때문에 평가에서 생성)
        UPDATE SYT0MA t1  
           SET won_tr_aek  = xx.won_tr_aek
             , won_tax_aek = xx.won_tax_aek
             , fcur_tr_aek = xx.fcur_tr_aek
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        SR_10151_IN (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, NULL, xx.trustee, 0, (xx.tr_aek - xx.tax_aek), (xx.won_tr_aek - xx.won_tax_aek), xx.fcur_tr_aek, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := '외화예금입금(sr_10151_in) 오류 : ' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
        SR_SYT0TAX (p_corp_gr, xx.fund_cd, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, xx.seq, xx.mg_cd, xx.trustee, xx.currency, xx.tr_aek, xx.won_tr_aek, xx.tax_aek, xx.won_tax_aek, w_gross_up_aek, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := 'GROSS-UP TAX(syt0tax) 오류 : ' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.won_tr_aek - xx.won_tax_aek, xx.won_tr_aek, w_gross_up_aek, xx.won_tax_aek - w_gross_up_aek);
        else    w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.fcur_tr_aek, xx.fcur_tr_aek);
        end if;
        SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '', 1, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP041 5', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B040', 'syt0yh.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=J51,Z91', '외화환전매수 외화예금자산 및 분개처리');

    -- 외화환전매수 외화예금자산 및 분개처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.*
             , ia.fund_currency
          FROM SYT0YH t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('J51','J52','Z91')
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = t1.gyulje_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_ymd 
                , t1.tr_cd  
                , t1.fund_cd
                , t1.jm_cd  
                , t1.tr_seq
    ) loop
        SR_10151_IN (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.trustee, 0, xx.gyulje_aek, xx.won_gyulje_aek, xx.fcur_gyulje_aek, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := SUBSTR ('외화예금입금(sr_10151_in) 오류 : ' || w_msg,1,180);
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            if  xx.tr_cd = 'J51'    then    -- 20191120 당일결제 10101예금 분개처리
                if  p_ymd = xx.gyulje_ymd   then
                        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd,
                                    xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.won_gyulje_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP041 6', w_msg);
                else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '02', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd,
                                    xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.won_gyulje_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP041 6', w_msg);
                end if;
            else
                SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd,
                            xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.won_gyulje_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP041', w_msg);
            end if;
        else
            if  xx.tr_cd = 'J51'    then
                    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '3', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                                xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.fcur_gyulje_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP041', w_msg);
            else    SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '3', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                                xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.fcur_gyulje_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP041', w_msg);
            end if;
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B050', 'syt0ys.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=J51', '수도결제 환전 매수처리');

    -- 수도결제 환전 매수처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                                                   /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                             /* _2- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                   /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                     /* _4- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                  /* _5- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                                                              AS aek            /* _6- */
             , t1.won_gyulje_aek                                                          AS won_aek        /* _7- */
             , t1.fcur_gyulje_aek                                                         AS fcur_aek       /* _8- */
             , F_COVWON (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek)                    AS today_won_aek  /* _9- */
             , F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek, ia.fund_currency)  AS today_fcur_aek /* _10- */
             , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)                               AS seq            /* _11- */
          FROM SYT0YS t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'J51'
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd = p_ymd
           AND t1.gyulje_gb  = 'Y'
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        SR_10151_IN (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.trustee, 0, xx.aek, xx.today_won_aek, xx.today_fcur_aek, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := SUBSTR ('외화예금입금(sr_10151_in) 오류 : ' || w_msg,1,180);
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            if  xx.today_won_aek < xx.won_aek   then
                    w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.won_aek, xx.won_aek, xx.today_won_aek, xx.won_aek, xx.won_aek - xx.today_won_aek);
            else    w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.won_aek, xx.won_aek, xx.today_won_aek, xx.won_aek, 0, xx.today_won_aek - xx.won_aek);
            end if;
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E70', 'A', '2', 'J5', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                        1, xx.seq, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP041 7', w_msg);
        else
            if  xx.today_fcur_aek < xx.fcur_aek     then
                    w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.fcur_aek, xx.fcur_aek, xx.today_fcur_aek, xx.fcur_aek, xx.fcur_aek - xx.today_fcur_aek);
            else    w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.fcur_aek, xx.fcur_aek, xx.today_fcur_aek, xx.fcur_aek, 0, xx.today_fcur_aek - xx.fcur_aek);
            end if;
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E70', 'A', '3', 'J5', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                        1, xx.seq, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP041 7', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    p_msg   := 'SYCP041:' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SYCP042 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 해외주식/집합투자증권 매매거래
--
    yz_jusu                      NUMBER;
    yz_won_aek                   NUMBER;
    yz_chui_aek                  NUMBER;
    yz_fcur_aek                  NUMBER;

    w_chui_aek                   NUMBER;
    w_won_avg                    NUMBER;
    w_fcur_avg                   NUMBER;

    w_rowid                      ROWID;

    w_err                        NUMBER := 0;

    w_gyulje_jm_cd               VARCHAR(12);
    w_won_rt                     NUMBER;
