    w_fcur_rt                    NUMBER;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -- 공모청약
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd                                                                                                /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                              /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                        /* _3- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                              /* _4- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                             /* _5- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                                /* _6- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                                                              /* _7- */
             , t1.tr_seq                                                                                               /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_jusu                                                                                              /* _9- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                                                                                           /* _10- */
             , F_COVWON_TR (t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek)                 AS today_won_gyulje_aek /* _11- */
             , TRUNC(NVL(t1.gyulje_aek,0) * t1.trans_rt,0)                                     AS mg_won_aek           /* _12- */
             , t1.rowid                                                                                                /* _13- */
             , F_COVCUR (t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek, ia.fund_currency)  AS today_fcur_aek       /* _14- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'F46'
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY tr_cd  
                , fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.mg_won_aek > 0   then    xx.today_won_gyulje_aek := xx.mg_won_aek;   -- 거래건별 거래환율이 있는경우
        end if;
        -- 해외자산마스타 처리
        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET tr_up_jusu       = NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) + xx.tr_jusu
             , tr_up_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.gyulje_aek
             , won_up_chui_aek  = NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.today_won_gyulje_aek
             , fcur_up_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.today_fcur_aek
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND bs_type = xx.bs_type
           AND ymd     = p_ymd
           AND trustee = xx.trustee;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO SYM0YZ
                ( corp_gr            /* _1- */
                , ymd                /* _2- */
                , fund_cd            /* _3- */
                , trustee            /* _4- */
                , jm_cd              /* _5- */
                , bs_type            /* _6- */
                , currency           /* _7- */
                , tr_bfil_jusu       /* _8- */
                , tr_up_jusu         /* _9- */
                , tr_dw_jusu         /* _10- */
                , tr_bfil_chui_aek   /* _11- */
                , tr_up_chui_aek     /* _12- */
                , tr_dw_chui_aek     /* _13- */
                , won_bfil_chui_aek  /* _14- */
                , won_up_chui_aek    /* _15- */
                , won_dw_chui_aek    /* _16- */
                , fcur_up_chui_aek   /* _17- */
                )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                    /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd               /* _3- */
                   , xx.trustee               /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                 /* _5- */
                   , xx.bs_type               /* _6- */
                   , xx.currency              /* _7- */
                   , 0                        /* _8- */
                   , xx.tr_jusu               /* _9- */
                   , 0                        /* _10- */
                   , 0                        /* _11- */
                   , xx.gyulje_aek            /* _12- */
                   , 0                        /* _13- */
                   , 0                        /* _14- */
                   , xx.today_won_gyulje_aek  /* _15- */
                   , 0                        /* _16- */
                   , xx.today_fcur_aek        /* _17- */
                   );
        end if;

        -- 회계분개처리
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd,
                            xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.today_won_gyulje_aek, xx.today_won_gyulje_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP042', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                            xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.today_fcur_aek, xx.today_fcur_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP042', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 해외매매거래 처리
        UPDATE SYT0MG
           SET won_gyulje_aek  = xx.today_won_gyulje_aek
             , fcur_gyulje_aek = xx.today_fcur_aek
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    END LOOP;

    -- 주식 매수(잔고관리, 외환 결제는 잔고처리 후)
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                       /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_ymd                                                                                      /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                                       /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                     /* _4- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                     /* _5- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                       /* _6- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                                                     /* _7- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                    /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_jusu                                                                                     /* _9- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                                                                                  /* _10- */
             , t1.tr_seq                                                                                      /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.gyulje_ymd, p_ymd - 1)                                                   AS gyulje_ymd  /* _12- */
             , F_COVWON_TR (t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek)                 AS tr_won_aek  /* _13- */
             , TRUNC(NVL(t1.gyulje_aek,0) * t1.trans_rt,0)                                     AS mg_won_aek  /* _14- */
             , F_COVCUR (t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek, ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_tr_aek /* _15- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                               /* _16- */
             , ya.sj_gb                                                                                       /* _17- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SYM0YA ya
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('F45','J20','J61')
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND ya.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_cd  
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        -- 결제일 체크
        if  xx.gyulje_ymd < xx.tr_ymd   then
            w_err   := w_err + 1;
            INSERT INTO WFRMERR
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr
                   , xx.jm_cd || '-해외주식종목 매수시 결제일을 확인하세요.[' || xx.gyulje_ymd || ' ' || xx.tr_cd || ' ' || xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.currency || ']'
                   );
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if  xx.mg_won_aek > 0   then    xx.tr_won_aek   := xx.mg_won_aek;   -- 거래건별 거래환율이 있는경우
        end if;

        if  xx.tr_ymd < xx.gyulje_ymd   then    -- 익일결제인 경우
            if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.sj_gb || '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd,
                                xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.tr_won_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP042', w_msg);
            else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.sj_gb || '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                                xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.fcur_tr_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP042', w_msg);
            end if;
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg   := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 해외자산마스타 처리
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'F45'    then
            -- 주식발행초과금출자는 취득액만 처리(주수 1은 상징적인 값임) (화면 #2911)
            UPDATE SYM0YZ
               SET tr_up_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.gyulje_aek
                 , won_up_chui_aek  = NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.tr_won_aek
                 , fcur_up_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.fcur_tr_aek
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND bs_type = xx.bs_type
               AND ymd     = p_ymd
               AND trustee = xx.trustee;
        else
            UPDATE SYM0YZ
               SET tr_up_jusu       = NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) + xx.tr_jusu
                 , tr_up_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.gyulje_aek
                 , won_up_chui_aek  = NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.tr_won_aek
                 , fcur_up_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.fcur_tr_aek
             WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
               AND bs_type = xx.bs_type
               AND ymd     = p_ymd
               AND trustee = xx.trustee;
        end if;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO SYM0YZ
                ( corp_gr            /* _1- */
                , ymd                /* _2- */
                , fund_cd            /* _3- */
                , trustee            /* _4- */
                , jm_cd              /* _5- */
                , bs_type            /* _6- */
                , currency           /* _7- */
                , tr_bfil_jusu       /* _8- */
                , tr_up_jusu         /* _9- */
                , tr_dw_jusu         /* _10- */
                , tr_bfil_chui_aek   /* _11- */
                , tr_up_chui_aek     /* _12- */
                , tr_dw_chui_aek     /* _13- */
                , won_bfil_chui_aek  /* _14- */
                , won_up_chui_aek    /* _15- */
                , won_dw_chui_aek    /* _16- */
                , fcur_up_chui_aek   /* _17- */
                )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd           /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd      /* _3- */
                   , xx.trustee      /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_cd        /* _5- */
                   , xx.bs_type      /* _6- */
                   , xx.currency     /* _7- */
                   , 0               /* _8- */
                   , xx.tr_jusu      /* _9- */
                   , 0               /* _10- */
                   , 0               /* _11- */
                   , xx.gyulje_aek   /* _12- */
                   , 0               /* _13- */
                   , 0               /* _14- */
                   , xx.tr_won_aek   /* _15- */
                   , 0               /* _16- */
                   , xx.fcur_tr_aek  /* _17- */
                   );
        end if;

        -- 해외매매거래 처리
        UPDATE SYT0MG
           SET won_gyulje_aek  = NVL(xx.tr_won_aek,0)
             , fcur_gyulje_aek = xx.fcur_tr_aek
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    END LOOP;

    -- 주식입고,차입처리
    SR_SYCP042_F21 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_proc_step, w_msg);
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        w_msg   := 'sycp042_f21 : ' || w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 주식 매도거래
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                          /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_ymd                                                                                         /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                                          /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                        /* _4- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                        /* _5- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                          /* _6- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                                                        /* _7- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                       /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_seq                                                                                         /* _9- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_jusu,0)                                                               AS jusu           /* _10- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                                                                                     /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.gyulje_ymd, p_ymd -1)                                                    AS gyulje_ymd     /* _12- */
             , TRUNC(CASE WHEN NVL(t1.won_gyulje_aek,0)=0
                          THEN F_COVWON_TR (p_corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek)
                          ELSE t1.won_gyulje_aek
                     END,0)                                                                    AS won_gyulje_aek /* _13- */
             , TRUNC(NVL(t1.gyulje_aek,0) * t1.trans_rt,0)                                     AS mg_won_aek     /* _14- */
             , F_COVCUR (t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek, ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_tr_aek    /* _15- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                  /* _16- */
             , ya.sj_gb                                                                                          /* _17- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SYM0YA ya
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('K20','K61')
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND ya.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_cd  
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        -- 결제일 체크
        if  xx.gyulje_ymd < xx.tr_ymd   then
            w_err   := w_err + 1;
            INSERT INTO WFRMERR
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr
                   , xx.jm_cd || '-해외주식종목 매도시 결제일을 확인하세요.[' || xx.gyulje_ymd || ' ' || xx.tr_cd || ' ' || xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.currency || ']'
                   );
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if  xx.mg_won_aek > 0   then    xx.won_gyulje_aek   := xx.mg_won_aek;   -- 거래건별 거래환율이 있는경우
        end if;

        BEGIN
            SELECT ROWID
                 , NVL(tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0)
                 , NVL(tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0)
                 , NVL(won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                 , NVL(fcur_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(fcur_dw_chui_aek,0)
              INTO w_rowid
                 , yz_jusu
                 , yz_chui_aek
                 , yz_won_aek
                 , yz_fcur_aek
              FROM SYM0YZ t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.bs_type  = xx.bs_type
               AND t1.trustee  = xx.trustee
               AND t1.currency = xx.currency;
        EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            w_err   := w_err + 1;
            INSERT INTO WFRMERR
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr
                   , xx.jm_cd || '-자산마스타가 없습니다.[' || xx.tr_cd || ' ' || xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.currency || ']'
                   );
            CONTINUE;
        END;

        if  yz_jusu < xx.jusu   then
            w_err   := w_err + 1;
            INSERT INTO WFRMERR
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr
                   , xx.jm_cd || '-잔고가 없습니다.[' || xx.tr_cd || ' ' || xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.currency || ']'
                   );
            CONTINUE;
        elsif yz_jusu = xx.jusu then
            w_chui_aek  := yz_chui_aek;
            w_won_avg   := yz_won_aek;
            w_fcur_avg  := yz_fcur_aek;
        else
            w_chui_aek  := F_TRUNC (yz_chui_aek / yz_jusu * xx.jusu, xx.fund_currency);
            w_won_avg   := TRUNC(yz_won_aek / yz_jusu * xx.jusu);
            w_fcur_avg  := F_TRUNC (yz_fcur_aek / yz_jusu * xx.jusu, xx.fund_currency);
        end if;

        if  xx.tr_ymd < xx.gyulje_ymd   then    -- 익일결제인 경우
            if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                    SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.sj_gb || '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd,
                                xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.won_gyulje_aek, w_won_avg, p_proc_step, 'SYCP042', w_msg);
            else    SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.sj_gb || '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                                xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.fcur_tr_aek, w_fcur_avg, p_proc_step, 'SYCP042', w_msg);
            end if;
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg   := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;

        -- 해외자산마스타 처리
        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET tr_dw_jusu       = NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0) + xx.jusu
             , tr_dw_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0) + w_chui_aek
             , won_dw_chui_aek  = NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0) + w_won_avg
             , fcur_dw_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_dw_chui_aek,0) + w_fcur_avg
         WHERE ROWID = w_rowid;

        -- 해외매매거래 처리
        UPDATE SYT0MG
           SET won_gyulje_aek = NVL(xx.won_gyulje_aek,0)
             , chui_aek       = w_chui_aek
             , won_chui_aek   = w_won_avg
             , fcur_chui_aek  = w_fcur_avg
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    END LOOP;
    if  w_err > 0   then
        p_msg   := F_NTRIM (w_err) || '건 매도거래생성 에러발생';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 주식 차입상환
    SR_SYCP042_F22 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, p_proc_step, w_msg);
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        w_msg   := 'sycp042_f22 : ' || w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    --
    -- 해외주식 잔고조정(잔고,취득액) --
    --
    UPDATE SYT0LD
       SET bigo = NULL
     WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
       AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd
       AND tr_cd   = 'Z1'
       AND bigo    LIKE '%주수보정%';

    -- 잔고 LOAD 된 계좌만 잔고조정
    INSERT INTO G_JOIN_FUND
      SELECT DISTINCT fund_cd
        FROM SYT0LD t1
       WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
         AND t1.tr_cd   = 'Z1'
         AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd;

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT tt.fund_cd                                                             /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_currency                                                       /* _2- */
             , tt.tr_co_cd                                                            /* _3- */
             , tt.jm_cd                                                               /* _4- */
             , tt.jm_nm                                                               /* _5- */
             , tt.currency                                                            /* _6- */
             , NVL(SUM(tt.tr_jusu),0)                             AS tr_jusu          /* _7- */
             , NVL(SUM(tt.yz_tr_jusu),0)                          AS yz_tr_jusu       /* _8- */
             , NVL(SUM(tt.tr_chui_aek),0)                         AS tr_chui_aek      /* _9- */
             , NVL(SUM(tt.yz_tr_chui_aek),0)                      AS yz_tr_chui_aek   /* _10- */
             , NVL(SUM(tt.won_chui_aek),0)                        AS won_chui_aek     /* _11- */
             , NVL(SUM(tt.yz_won_chui_aek),0)                     AS yz_won_chui_aek  /* _12- */
             , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.fund_currency='KRW'
                            THEN tt.won_chui_aek
                            ELSE F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, tt.currency, tt.tr_chui_aek, t1.fund_currency)
                       END),0)                                    AS fcur_chui_aek    /* _13- */
             , NVL(SUM(tt.yz_fcur_chui_aek),0)                    AS yz_fcur_chui_aek /* _14- */
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tt.fund_cd
                                      ORDER BY tt.fund_cd) + 500  AS seq              /* _15- */
          FROM (SELECT ta.fund_cd                         /* _1- */
                     , ta.tr_co_cd                        /* _2- */
                     , ta.jm_cd                           /* _3- */
                     , tb.jm_nm                           /* _4- */
                     , tb.currency                        /* _5- */
                     , ta.tr_jusu                         /* _6- */
                     , 0             AS yz_tr_jusu        /* _7- */
                     , CASE WHEN NVL(ta.tr_jan,0)=0
                            THEN ta.gyulje_aek
                            ELSE ta.tr_jan
                       END           AS tr_chui_aek       /* _8- */
                     , 0             AS yz_tr_chui_aek    /* _9- */
                     , TRUNC(CASE WHEN NVL(ta.won_jan,0)=0
                                  THEN ta.won_gyulje_aek
                                  ELSE ta.won_jan
                             END,0)  AS won_chui_aek      /* _10- */
                     , 0             AS yz_won_chui_aek   /* _11- */
                     , 0             AS yz_fcur_chui_aek  /* _12- */
                  FROM SYT0LD ta
                     , SYM0YA tb
                 WHERE ta.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND ta.tr_cd    = 'Z1'
                   AND ta.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
                   AND tb.corp_gr  = ta.corp_gr
                   AND tb.jasan_gb = '1'
                   AND tb.jm_cd    = ta.jm_cd
                UNION ALL
                SELECT ta.fund_cd                                                 /* _1- */
                     , ia.mg_cd                                                   /* _2- */
                     , ta.jm_cd                                                   /* _3- */
                     , tb.jm_nm                                                   /* _4- */
                     , tb.currency                                                /* _5- */
                     , 0                                                          /* _6- */
                     , NVL(ta.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(ta.tr_up_jusu,0)
                                              - NVL(ta.tr_dw_jusu,0)              /* _7- */
                     , 0                                                          /* _8- */
                     , NVL(ta.tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(ta.tr_up_chui_aek,0)
                                                  - NVL(ta.tr_dw_chui_aek,0)      /* _9- */
                     , 0                                                          /* _10- */
                     , NVL(ta.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(ta.won_up_chui_aek,0)
                                                   - NVL(ta.won_dw_chui_aek,0)    /* _11- */
                     , NVL(ta.fcur_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(ta.fcur_up_chui_aek,0)
                                                    - NVL(ta.fcur_dw_chui_aek,0)  /* _12- */
                  FROM SYM0YZ ta
                     , SYM0YA tb
                     , SZM0IA ia
                 WHERE ta.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
                   AND ta.fund_cd  IN (SELECT fund_cd FROM G_JOIN_FUND g1)
                   AND ta.ymd      = p_ymd
                   AND tb.corp_gr  = ta.corp_gr
                   AND tb.jasan_gb = '1'
                   AND tb.jm_cd    = ta.jm_cd
                   AND ia.corp_gr  = ta.corp_gr
                   AND ia.fund_cd  = ta.fund_cd) tt      , SZM0IA t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd                = tt.fund_cd
           AND t1.fst_seolj_ymd          <= p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
         GROUP BY tt.fund_cd      
                , t1.fund_currency
                , tt.tr_co_cd     
                , tt.jm_cd        
                , tt.jm_nm        
                , tt.currency
    ) loop
        if  xx.yz_tr_jusu < xx.tr_jusu      then
            if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'J20', 'A', '2', '1E', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '',
                                xx.seq, 1, xx.won_chui_aek - xx.yz_won_chui_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP042', w_msg);
            else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'J20', 'A', '2', '1E', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '',
                                xx.seq, 1, xx.fcur_chui_aek - xx.yz_fcur_chui_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP042', w_msg);
            end if;
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg   := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;

            UPDATE SYM0YZ
               SET tr_up_jusu       = NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) + (xx.tr_jusu - xx.yz_tr_jusu)
                 , tr_up_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) + (xx.tr_chui_aek - xx.yz_tr_chui_aek)
                 , won_up_chui_aek  = NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) + (xx.won_chui_aek - xx.yz_won_chui_aek)
                 , fcur_up_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0) + (xx.fcur_chui_aek - xx.yz_fcur_chui_aek)
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND ymd      = p_ymd
               AND currency = xx.currency;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO SYM0YZ
                ( corp_gr             /* _1- */
                , ymd                 /* _2- */
                , fund_cd             /* _3- */
                , trustee             /* _4- */
                , jm_cd               /* _5- */
                , currency            /* _6- */
                , tr_bfil_jusu        /* _7- */
                , tr_up_jusu          /* _8- */
                , tr_dw_jusu          /* _9- */
                , tr_bfil_chui_aek    /* _10- */
                , tr_up_chui_aek      /* _11- */
                , tr_dw_chui_aek      /* _12- */
                , won_bfil_chui_aek   /* _13- */
                , won_up_chui_aek     /* _14- */
                , won_dw_chui_aek     /* _15- */
                , fcur_bfil_chui_aek  /* _16- */
                , fcur_up_chui_aek    /* _17- */
                , fcur_dw_chui_aek    /* _18- */
                )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr            /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd           /* _3- */
                   , xx.currency || '01'  /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_cd             /* _5- */
                   , xx.currency          /* _6- */
                   , 0                    /* _7- */
                   , xx.tr_jusu           /* _8- */
                   , 0                    /* _9- */
                   , 0                    /* _10- */
                   , xx.tr_chui_aek       /* _11- */
                   , 0                    /* _12- */
                   , 0                    /* _13- */
                   , xx.won_chui_aek      /* _14- */
                   , 0                    /* _15- */
                   , 0                    /* _16- */
                   , xx.fcur_chui_aek     /* _17- */
                   , 0                    /* _18- */
                   );
        end if;

        elsif xx.yz_tr_jusu > xx.tr_jusu    then
            if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'K20', 'A', '2', '1E', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '',
                                xx.seq, 1, xx.yz_won_chui_aek - xx.won_chui_aek, p_proc_step, 'sycp042', w_msg);
            else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'K20', 'A', '2', '1E', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '',
                                xx.seq, 1, xx.yz_fcur_chui_aek - xx.fcur_chui_aek, p_proc_step, 'sycp042', w_msg);
            end if;
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg   := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;

            UPDATE SYM0YZ
               SET tr_dw_jusu       = NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0) + (xx.yz_tr_jusu - xx.tr_jusu)
                 , tr_dw_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0) + (xx.yz_tr_chui_aek - xx.tr_chui_aek)
                 , won_dw_chui_aek  = NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0) + (xx.yz_won_chui_aek - xx.won_chui_aek)
                 , fcur_dw_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_dw_chui_aek,0) + (xx.yz_fcur_chui_aek - xx.fcur_chui_aek)
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND ymd      = p_ymd
               AND currency = xx.currency;
        else
            CONTINUE;
        end if;

        UPDATE SYT0LD
           SET bigo = F_NTRIM(xx.tr_jusu - xx.yz_tr_jusu) || ' 주수보정(' || F_NTRIM(xx.tr_chui_aek - xx.yz_tr_chui_aek, 0, 2) || ')'
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND tr_cd   = 'Z1'
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd;
    END LOOP;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    p_msg   := 'sycp042:' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SYCP042_F21 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 해외주식 입고,차입처리
--
    w_err                        NUMBER := 0;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -- 주식입고
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                       /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_ymd                                                                                      /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                                       /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                     /* _4- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                     /* _5- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                       /* _6- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                                                     /* _7- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                    /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_jusu                                                                                     /* _9- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                                                                                  /* _10- */
             , t1.tr_seq                                                                                      /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.gyulje_ymd, p_ymd - 1)                                                   AS gyulje_ymd  /* _12- */
             , F_COVWON_TR (t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek)                 AS tr_won_aek  /* _13- */
             , TRUNC(NVL(t1.gyulje_aek,0) * t1.trans_rt,0)                                     AS mg_won_aek  /* _14- */
             , F_COVCUR (t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek, ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_tr_aek /* _15- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                               /* _16- */
             , ya.sj_gb                                                                                       /* _17- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SYM0YA ya
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd    = 'F21'
           AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
           AND t1.dx_jm_cd IS NULL
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
           AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_cd  
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        -- 결제일 체크
        if  xx.gyulje_ymd < xx.tr_ymd   then
            w_err   := w_err + 1;
            INSERT INTO WFRMERR
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr
                   , xx.jm_cd || '-해외주식종목 매수시 결제일을 확인하세요.[' || xx.gyulje_ymd || ' ' || xx.tr_cd || ' ' || xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.currency || ']'
                   );
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if  xx.mg_won_aek > 0   then
            xx.tr_won_aek   := xx.mg_won_aek;   -- 거래건별 거래환율이 있는경우
        end if;

        -- 해외자산마스타 처리
        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET tr_up_jusu       = NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) + xx.tr_jusu
             , tr_up_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.gyulje_aek
             , won_up_chui_aek  = NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.tr_won_aek
             , fcur_up_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.fcur_tr_aek
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND bs_type = xx.bs_type
           AND ymd     = p_ymd
           AND trustee = xx.trustee;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO SYM0YZ
                ( corp_gr            /* _1- */
                , ymd                /* _2- */
                , fund_cd            /* _3- */
                , trustee            /* _4- */
                , jm_cd              /* _5- */
                , bs_type            /* _6- */
                , currency           /* _7- */
                , tr_bfil_jusu       /* _8- */
                , tr_up_jusu         /* _9- */
                , tr_dw_jusu         /* _10- */
                , tr_bfil_chui_aek   /* _11- */
                , tr_up_chui_aek     /* _12- */
                , tr_dw_chui_aek     /* _13- */
                , won_bfil_chui_aek  /* _14- */
                , won_up_chui_aek    /* _15- */
                , won_dw_chui_aek    /* _16- */
                , fcur_up_chui_aek   /* _17- */
                )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd           /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd      /* _3- */
                   , xx.trustee      /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_cd        /* _5- */
                   , xx.bs_type      /* _6- */
                   , xx.currency     /* _7- */
                   , 0               /* _8- */
                   , xx.tr_jusu      /* _9- */
                   , 0               /* _10- */
                   , 0               /* _11- */
                   , xx.gyulje_aek   /* _12- */
                   , 0               /* _13- */
                   , 0               /* _14- */
                   , xx.tr_won_aek   /* _15- */
                   , 0               /* _16- */
                   , xx.fcur_tr_aek  /* _17- */
                   );
        end if;

        -- 해외매매거래 처리
        UPDATE SYT0MG
           SET won_gyulje_aek  = NVL(xx.tr_won_aek,0)
             , fcur_gyulje_aek = xx.fcur_tr_aek
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        if  p_corp_gr = '1803' AND xx.fund_currency = 'USD'     then
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'F21', 'A', '2', '2', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                        xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.fcur_tr_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP042_F21', w_msg);
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    -- 주식 차입입고
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                       /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_ymd                                                                                      /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                                       /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                     /* _4- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                     /* _5- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                       /* _6- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                                                     /* _7- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                    /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_jusu                                                                                     /* _9- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                                                                                  /* _10- */
             , t1.tr_seq                                                                                      /* _11- */
             , NVL(t1.gyulje_ymd, p_ymd - 1)                                                   AS gyulje_ymd  /* _12- */
             , F_COVWON_TR (t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek)                 AS tr_won_aek  /* _13- */
             , TRUNC(NVL(t1.gyulje_aek,0) * t1.trans_rt,0)                                     AS mg_won_aek  /* _14- */
             , F_COVCUR (t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek, ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_tr_aek /* _15- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                               /* _16- */
             , CASE WHEN t1.bs_type=-1 THEN '-1'
                                       ELSE '1' END                                            AS jasan_gb    /* _17- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SYM0YA ya
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd    = 'F21'
           AND t1.tr_ymd   = p_ymd
           AND t1.dx_jm_cd IS NOT NULL
           AND ia.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd  = t1.fund_cd
           AND ya.corp_gr  = t1.corp_gr
           AND ya.jm_cd    = t1.jm_cd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_cd  
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.mg_won_aek > 0   then    xx.tr_won_aek   := xx.mg_won_aek;   -- 거래건별 거래환율이 있는경우
        end if;

        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'F21', 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd,
                            xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.tr_won_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP042_F21', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'F21', 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                            xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.fcur_tr_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP042_F21', w_msg);
        end if;

        -- 해외자산마스타 처리
        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET tr_up_jusu       = NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) + xx.tr_jusu
             , tr_up_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.gyulje_aek
             , won_up_chui_aek  = NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.tr_won_aek
             , fcur_up_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.fcur_tr_aek
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND bs_type = xx.bs_type
           AND ymd     = p_ymd
           AND trustee = xx.trustee;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO SYM0YZ
                ( corp_gr            /* _1- */
                , ymd                /* _2- */
                , fund_cd            /* _3- */
                , trustee            /* _4- */
                , jm_cd              /* _5- */
                , bs_type            /* _6- */
                , currency           /* _7- */
                , tr_bfil_jusu       /* _8- */
                , tr_up_jusu         /* _9- */
                , tr_dw_jusu         /* _10- */
                , tr_bfil_chui_aek   /* _11- */
                , tr_up_chui_aek     /* _12- */
                , tr_dw_chui_aek     /* _13- */
                , won_bfil_chui_aek  /* _14- */
                , won_up_chui_aek    /* _15- */
                , won_dw_chui_aek    /* _16- */
                , fcur_up_chui_aek   /* _17- */
                )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd           /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd      /* _3- */
                   , xx.trustee      /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_cd        /* _5- */
                   , xx.bs_type      /* _6- */
                   , xx.currency     /* _7- */
                   , 0               /* _8- */
                   , xx.tr_jusu      /* _9- */
                   , 0               /* _10- */
                   , 0               /* _11- */
                   , xx.gyulje_aek   /* _12- */
                   , 0               /* _13- */
                   , 0               /* _14- */
                   , xx.tr_won_aek   /* _15- */
                   , 0               /* _16- */
                   , xx.fcur_tr_aek  /* _17- */
                   );
        end if;

        -- 해외매매거래 처리
        UPDATE SYT0MG
           SET won_gyulje_aek  = NVL(xx.tr_won_aek,0)
             , fcur_gyulje_aek = xx.fcur_tr_aek
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    END LOOP;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    p_msg   := 'SYCP042_F21:' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,160);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SYCP042_F22 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 차입상환 처리
--
    w_bm_ymd                     DATE;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'sym0yz.ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=F22', '외화주식(sym0yz) 차입상환 처리');

    -- 차입상환
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd     /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd   /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd     /* _3- */
             , t1.trustee   /* _4- */
             , t1.currency  /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_seq    /* _6- */
             , t1.tr_jusu   /* _7- */
             , t1.tr_aek    /* _8- */
             , t1.chui_aek  /* _9- */
             , t1.bs_type   /* _10- */
             , t1.dx_jm_cd  /* _11- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SYM0YA t2
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr                = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd                  = 'F22'
           AND t1.tr_ymd                 = p_ymd
           AND t1.dx_jm_cd IS NOT NULL
           AND t2.corp_gr                = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd                  = t1.jm_cd
           AND t2.currency               = t1.currency
           AND ia.corp_gr                = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd                = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd)  >= p_ymd
    ) loop
        SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '1', '-1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd,
                    xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.tr_aek, xx.chui_aek, p_proc_step, 'SJHP042_F22', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 차입주식 잔고 상환처리
        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET tr_dw_jusu     = NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0) + (xx.tr_jusu * -1)
             , tr_dw_chui_aek = NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0) + (xx.tr_aek * -1)
         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
           AND trustee  = xx.trustee
           AND currency = xx.currency
           AND ymd      = p_ymd
           AND bs_type  = -1;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            p_msg       := xx.fund_cd + ' ' + xx.jm_cd || ' 차입종목(sym0yz) 확인!';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        UPDATE SDM0DM
           SET dw_jusu     = NVL(dw_jusu,0) + xx.tr_jusu
             , dw_chui_aek = NVL(dw_chui_aek,0) + xx.tr_aek
         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd    = xx.dx_jm_cd
           AND buy_date = '%'
           AND ymd      = p_ymd;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            p_msg   := xx.fund_cd + ' ' + xx.dx_jm_cd || ' 차입종목(sdm0dm) 확인!';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SYCP043 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 해외채권 처리
--
    w_err                        NUMBER := 0;
    w_aekm                       NUMBER;
    w_chui_aek                   NUMBER;
    w_tr_chui_aek                NUMBER;

    w_won_avg                    NUMBER;
    w_fcur_avg                   NUMBER;
    w_won_chui_aek               NUMBER;
    w_fcur_chui_aek              NUMBER;
    w_tr_won_chui_aek            NUMBER;
    w_tr_fcur_chui_aek           NUMBER;
    w_sung_cost                  NUMBER;
    w_misu_ija                   NUMBER;
    w_won_sung_cost              NUMBER;
    w_won_misu_ija               NUMBER;
    w_fcur_sung_cost             NUMBER;
    w_fcur_misu_ija              NUMBER;

    yz_jusu                      NUMBER;
    yz_chui_aek                  NUMBER;
    yz_sung_cost                 NUMBER;
    yz_misu_ija                  NUMBER;
    yz_won_aek                   NUMBER;
    yz_won_sung_cost             NUMBER;
    yz_won_misu_ija              NUMBER;
    yz_fcur_aek                  NUMBER;
    yz_fcur_sung_cost            NUMBER;
    yz_fcur_misu_ija             NUMBER;

    w_rowid                      ROWID;

    w_aek                        number_varray_50;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'syt0mg.ymd<' || p_ymd || ' * gyulje_ymd=' || p_ymd, '해외채권 익일매매 마스타 결제처리');

    -- 채권 익일매수 처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                                  /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_ymd                                                                                                 /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                                                  /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_seq                                                                                                 /* _4- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                                /* _5- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                          /* _6- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                                /* _7- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                                  /* _8- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                                                                /* _9- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                               /* _10- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_jusu,0)                                                                    AS aekm              /* _11- */
             , t1.tr_aek                                                                                                 /* _12- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_tax,0)                                                                     AS tr_tax            /* _13- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_cost,0)                                                                    AS tr_cost           /* _14- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_halin_aek,0)                                                               AS tr_halin_aek      /* _15- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                                                                                             /* _16- */
             , NVL(t1.won_tr_halin_aek,0)                                                           AS won_tr_halin_aek  /* _17- */
             , t1.won_gyulje_aek                                                                                         /* _18- */
             , NVL(t1.pass_ija,0)                                                                   AS pass_ija          /* _19- */
             , NVL(t1.won_pass_ija,0)                                                               AS won_pass_ija      /* _20- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                                                                                           /* _21- */
             , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.trans_rt,0)=0
                    THEN F_CURRENCY_RT (t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency)
                    ELSE t1.trans_rt END                                                            AS trans_rt          /* _22- */
             , NVL(t1.fcur_tr_halin_aek,0)                                                          AS fcur_tr_halin_aek /* _23- */
             , t1.fcur_gyulje_aek                                                                                        /* _24- */
             , NVL(t1.fcur_pass_ija,0)                                                              AS fcur_pass_ija     /* _25- */
             , F_COVCUR (t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_aek, ia.fund_currency)           AS fcur_tr_aek       /* _26- */
             , F_COVCUR (t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, NVL(t1.tr_tax,0)
               + NVL(t1.tr_cost,0), ia.fund_currency)                                               AS fcur_cost         /* _27- */
             , F_COVCUR (t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, NVL(t1.pass_ija,0), ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_ija          /* _28- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'J14'
           AND t1.tr_ymd     Between ADD_MONTHS (p_ymd,-1) AND (p_ymd - 1)
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY tr_cd  
                , fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (TRUNC(xx.tr_aek * xx.trans_rt) + xx.won_tr_halin_aek,xx.won_gyulje_aek,
                                         xx.won_pass_ija,xx.won_gyulje_aek - TRUNC(xx.tr_aek * xx.trans_rt) - xx.won_pass_ija - xx.won_tr_halin_aek,
                                         xx.won_tr_halin_aek);
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '20', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_seq, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'sycp043', w_msg);
        else
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.fcur_tr_aek + xx.fcur_tr_halin_aek,xx.fcur_gyulje_aek,
                                         xx.fcur_pass_ija,xx.fcur_gyulje_aek - xx.fcur_tr_aek - xx.fcur_pass_ija - xx.fcur_tr_halin_aek,
                                         xx.fcur_tr_halin_aek,0,0);
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '20', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_seq, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'sycp043', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 해외자산마스타 처리
        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET tr_up_jusu       = NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) + xx.aekm
             , tr_up_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.tr_aek + xx.tr_halin_aek
             , won_up_chui_aek  = NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) + TRUNC(xx.tr_aek * xx.trans_rt) + xx.won_tr_halin_aek
             , sung_cost        = NVL(sung_cost,0) + xx.pass_ija
             , won_sung_cost    = NVL(won_sung_cost,0) + xx.won_pass_ija
             , fcur_up_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.fcur_tr_aek + xx.fcur_tr_halin_aek
             , fcur_sung_cost   = NVL(fcur_sung_cost,0) + xx.fcur_pass_ija
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND bs_type = xx.bs_type
           AND ymd     = p_ymd
           AND trustee = xx.trustee;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO SYM0YZ
                ( corp_gr           /* _1- */
                , ymd               /* _2- */
                , fund_cd           /* _3- */
                , trustee           /* _4- */
                , jm_cd             /* _5- */
                , bs_type           /* _6- */
                , currency          /* _7- */
                , tr_up_jusu        /* _8- */
                , tr_up_chui_aek    /* _9- */
                , won_up_chui_aek   /* _10- */
                , sung_cost         /* _11- */
                , won_sung_cost     /* _12- */
                , fcur_up_chui_aek  /* _13- */
                , fcur_sung_cost    /* _14- */
                )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                             /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                                                 /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                                            /* _3- */
                   , xx.trustee                                            /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                                              /* _5- */
                   , xx.bs_type                                            /* _6- */
                   , xx.currency                                           /* _7- */
                   , xx.aekm                                               /* _8- */
                   , xx.tr_aek + xx.tr_halin_aek                           /* _9- */
                   , TRUNC(xx.tr_aek * xx.trans_rt) + xx.won_tr_halin_aek  /* _10- */
                   , xx.pass_ija                                           /* _11- */
                   , xx.won_pass_ija                                       /* _12- */
                   , xx.fcur_tr_aek + xx.fcur_tr_halin_aek                 /* _13- */
                   , xx.fcur_pass_ija                                      /* _14- */
                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    -- 채권  익일매도 처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                    /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_ymd                   /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                    /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_seq                   /* _4- */
             , t1.fund_cd                  /* _5- */
             , ia.fund_currency            /* _6- */
             , t1.trustee                  /* _7- */
             , t1.currency                 /* _8- */
             , t1.jm_cd                    /* _9- */
             , t1.bs_type                  /* _10- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_jusu,0)   AS aekm /* _11- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek               /* _12- */
             , t1.won_gyulje_aek           /* _13- */
             , t1.chui_aek                 /* _14- */
             , t1.won_chui_aek             /* _15- */
             , t1.fcur_gyulje_aek          /* _16- */
             , t1.fcur_chui_aek            /* _17- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'K11'
           AND t1.tr_ymd     Between ADD_MONTHS (p_ymd,-1) AND (p_ymd - 1)
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_cd  
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        SELECT ROWID                 /* _1- */
             , NVL(tr_bfil_jusu,0)   /* _2- */
             , NVL(sung_cost,0)      /* _3- */
             , NVL(misu_ija,0)       /* _4- */
             , NVL(won_sung_cost,0)  /* _5- */
             , NVL(won_misu_ija,0)   /* _6- */
             , fcur_sung_cost        /* _7- */
             , fcur_misu_ija         /* _8- */
          INTO w_rowid            /* _1- */
             , yz_jusu            /* _2- */
             , yz_sung_cost       /* _3- */
             , yz_misu_ija        /* _4- */
             , yz_won_sung_cost   /* _5- */
             , yz_won_misu_ija    /* _6- */
             , yz_fcur_sung_cost  /* _7- */
             , yz_fcur_misu_ija   /* _8- */
          FROM SYM0YZ t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
           AND t1.bs_type  = xx.bs_type
           AND t1.trustee  = xx.trustee
           AND t1.currency = xx.currency;

        w_sung_cost         := TRUNC(yz_sung_cost / yz_jusu * xx.aekm,2);
        w_misu_ija          := TRUNC(yz_misu_ija / yz_jusu * xx.aekm,2);
        w_won_sung_cost     := TRUNC(yz_won_sung_cost / yz_jusu * xx.aekm);
        w_won_misu_ija      := TRUNC(yz_won_misu_ija / yz_jusu * xx.aekm);
        w_fcur_sung_cost    := TRUNC(yz_fcur_sung_cost / yz_jusu * xx.aekm,2);
        w_fcur_misu_ija     := TRUNC(yz_fcur_misu_ija / yz_jusu * xx.aekm,2);

        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.won_gyulje_aek,xx.won_chui_aek,w_won_sung_cost,w_won_misu_ija,0,0);
            if  xx.won_gyulje_aek > (xx.won_chui_aek + w_won_sung_cost + w_won_misu_ija)    then
                    w_aek (6)   := xx.won_gyulje_aek - (xx.won_chui_aek + w_won_sung_cost + w_won_misu_ija);
            else    w_aek (5)   := (xx.won_chui_aek + w_won_sung_cost + w_won_misu_ija) - xx.won_gyulje_aek;
            end if;
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '20', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_seq, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'sycp043', w_msg);
        else
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.fcur_gyulje_aek,xx.fcur_chui_aek,w_fcur_sung_cost,w_fcur_misu_ija,0,0);
            if  xx.fcur_gyulje_aek > (xx.fcur_chui_aek + w_fcur_sung_cost + w_fcur_misu_ija)    then
                    w_aek (6)   := xx.fcur_gyulje_aek - (xx.fcur_chui_aek + w_fcur_sung_cost + w_fcur_misu_ija);
            else    w_aek (5)   := (xx.fcur_chui_aek + w_fcur_sung_cost + w_fcur_misu_ija) - xx.fcur_gyulje_aek;
            end if;
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '20', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_seq, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'sycp043', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 해외자산마스타 처리
        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET tr_dw_jusu       = NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0) + xx.aekm
             , tr_dw_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0) + xx.chui_aek
             , won_dw_chui_aek  = NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0) + xx.won_chui_aek
             , sung_cost        = NVL(sung_cost,0) - w_sung_cost
             , misu_ija         = NVL(misu_ija,0) - w_misu_ija
             , won_sung_cost    = NVL(won_sung_cost,0) - w_won_sung_cost
             , won_misu_ija     = NVL(won_misu_ija,0) - w_won_misu_ija
             , fcur_dw_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_dw_chui_aek,0) + xx.fcur_chui_aek
             , fcur_sung_cost   = NVL(fcur_sung_cost,0) - w_fcur_sung_cost
             , fcur_misu_ija    = NVL(fcur_misu_ija,0) - w_fcur_misu_ija
         WHERE ROWID = w_rowid;
    END LOOP;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'syt0mg.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=F23,J10', '해외채권 입고/매수 처리');

    -- 채권 입고/매수
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                    /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_ymd                                                   /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                    /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                  /* _4- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                            /* _5- */
             , t1.trustee                                                  /* _6- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                    /* _7- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                  /* _8- */
             , t1.currency                                                 /* _9- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_jusu,0)                             AS tr_jusu    /* _10- */
             , t1.tr_halin_aek                                             /* _11- */
             , t1.tr_aek                                                   /* _12- */
             , t1.won_tr_halin_aek                                         /* _13- */
             , t1.won_gyulje_aek                                           /* _14- */
             , t1.pass_ija                                                 /* _15- */
             , t1.won_pass_ija                                             /* _16- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                                             /* _17- */
             , TRUNC(t1.tr_aek * CASE WHEN NVL(t1.trans_rt,0)=0
                                      THEN F_CURRENCY_RT (t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency)
                                      ELSE t1.trans_rt
                                 END)                        AS won_tr_aek /* _18- */
             , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq        /* _19- */
             , t1.fcur_tr_halin_aek                                        /* _20- */
             , t1.fcur_gyulje_aek                                          /* _21- */
             , t1.fcur_pass_ija                                            /* _22- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('F23','J10')
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY tr_cd  
                , fund_cd
    ) loop
        -- 해외자산마스타 처리
        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET tr_up_jusu       = NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) + xx.tr_jusu
             , tr_up_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.tr_aek + NVL(xx.tr_halin_aek,0)
             , won_up_chui_aek  = NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.won_tr_aek + NVL(xx.won_tr_halin_aek,0)
             , sung_cost        = NVL(sung_cost,0) + xx.pass_ija
             , won_sung_cost    = NVL(won_sung_cost,0) + xx.won_pass_ija
             , fcur_up_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.fcur_gyulje_aek + NVL(xx.fcur_tr_halin_aek,0)
             , fcur_sung_cost   = NVL(fcur_sung_cost,0) + xx.fcur_pass_ija
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND bs_type = xx.bs_type
           AND ymd     = p_ymd
           AND trustee = xx.trustee;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO SYM0YZ
                ( corp_gr             /* _1- */
                , ymd                 /* _2- */
                , fund_cd             /* _3- */
                , trustee             /* _4- */
                , jm_cd               /* _5- */
                , bs_type             /* _6- */
                , currency            /* _7- */
                , tr_bfil_jusu        /* _8- */
                , tr_up_jusu          /* _9- */
                , tr_dw_jusu          /* _10- */
                , tr_bfil_chui_aek    /* _11- */
                , tr_up_chui_aek      /* _12- */
                , tr_dw_chui_aek      /* _13- */
                , sung_cost           /* _14- */
                , won_bfil_chui_aek   /* _15- */
                , won_up_chui_aek     /* _16- */
                , won_dw_chui_aek     /* _17- */
                , won_sung_cost       /* _18- */
                , fcur_bfil_chui_aek  /* _19- */
                , fcur_up_chui_aek    /* _20- */
                , fcur_dw_chui_aek    /* _21- */
                , fcur_sung_cost      /* _22- */
                )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                                             /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                                        /* _3- */
                   , xx.trustee                                        /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                                          /* _5- */
                   , xx.bs_type                                        /* _6- */
                   , xx.currency                                       /* _7- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _8- */
                   , xx.tr_jusu                                        /* _9- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _10- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _11- */
                   , xx.tr_aek + NVL(xx.tr_halin_aek,0)                /* _12- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _13- */
                   , xx.pass_ija                                       /* _14- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _15- */
                   , xx.won_tr_aek + NVL(xx.won_tr_halin_aek,0)        /* _16- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _17- */
                   , xx.won_pass_ija                                   /* _18- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _19- */
                   , xx.fcur_gyulje_aek + NVL(xx.fcur_tr_halin_aek,0)  /* _20- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _21- */
                   , xx.fcur_pass_ija                                  /* _22- */
                   );
        end if;

        if  xx.tr_cd = 'F23'    then
            if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.won_tr_aek,xx.won_gyulje_aek,xx.won_pass_ija);
                SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'F23', 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'sycp043', w_msg);
            else
                w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.fcur_gyulje_aek,xx.fcur_gyulje_aek,xx.fcur_pass_ija);
                SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'F23', 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'sycp043', w_msg);
            end if;
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg   := w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B030', 'syt0mg.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=K10,E42', '해외채권 매도/조기상환 처리');

    -- 채권 매도거래
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                           /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_ymd                                                                                          /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                                           /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                         /* _4- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                   /* _5- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                         /* _6- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                           /* _7- */
             , t1.bs_type                                                                                         /* _8- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                        /* _9- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_jusu,0)                                                               AS aekm            /* _10- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                                                                                      /* _11- */
             , TRUNC(t1.won_gyulje_aek,0)                                                      AS won_gyulje_aek  /* _12- */
             , t1.gyulje_ymd                                                                                      /* _13- */
             , F_COVCUR (t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek, ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_gyulje_aek /* _14- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd   IN ('K10','E42')
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_cd  
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT ROWID                                                                            /* _1- */
                 , NVL(tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0)
                                       + NVL(msd_meib_aekm,0) - NVL(msd_medo_aekm,0)                /* _2- */
                 , NVL(tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                           + NVL(msd_meib_aek,0) - NVL(msd_medo_aek,0)              /* _3- */
                 , NVL(won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                            + NVL(won_msd_meib_aek,0) - NVL(won_msd_medo_aek,0)     /* _4- */
                 , NVL(sung_cost,0)                                                                 /* _5- */
                 , NVL(misu_ija,0)                                                                  /* _6- */
                 , NVL(won_sung_cost,0)                                                             /* _7- */
                 , NVL(won_misu_ija,0)                                                              /* _8- */
                 , NVL(fcur_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(fcur_dw_chui_aek,0)
                                             + NVL(fcur_msd_meib_aek,0) - NVL(fcur_msd_medo_aek,0)  /* _9- */
                 , NVL(fcur_sung_cost,0)                                                            /* _10- */
                 , NVL(fcur_misu_ija,0)                                                             /* _11- */
              INTO w_rowid            /* _1- */
                 , yz_jusu            /* _2- */
                 , yz_chui_aek        /* _3- */
                 , yz_won_aek         /* _4- */
                 , yz_sung_cost       /* _5- */
                 , yz_misu_ija        /* _6- */
                 , yz_won_sung_cost   /* _7- */
                 , yz_won_misu_ija    /* _8- */
                 , yz_fcur_aek        /* _9- */
                 , yz_fcur_sung_cost  /* _10- */
                 , yz_fcur_misu_ija   /* _11- */
              FROM SYM0YZ t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.bs_type  = xx.bs_type
               AND t1.trustee  = xx.trustee
               AND t1.currency = xx.currency;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            w_err   := w_err + 1;
            INSERT INTO WFRMERR
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr
                   , xx.jm_cd || '-자산마스타가 없습니다.[' || xx.tr_cd || ' ' || xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.currency || ' ' || xx.jm_cd || ']'
                   );
            CONTINUE;
        END;

        if  yz_jusu < xx.aekm   then
            w_err   := w_err + 1;
            INSERT INTO WFRMERR
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr
                   , xx.jm_cd || '-잔고가 없습니다.[' || xx.tr_cd || ' ' || xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.currency || ']'
                   );
            CONTINUE;
        elsif yz_jusu = xx.aekm then
            w_chui_aek          := yz_chui_aek;
            w_won_avg           := yz_won_aek;
            w_sung_cost         := yz_sung_cost;
            w_misu_ija          := yz_misu_ija;
            w_won_sung_cost     := yz_won_sung_cost;
            w_won_misu_ija      := yz_won_misu_ija;
            w_fcur_avg          := yz_fcur_aek;
            w_fcur_sung_cost    := yz_fcur_sung_cost;
            w_fcur_misu_ija     := yz_fcur_misu_ija;

        elsif xx.aekm = 0   then
            -- 취득액처리 (아랍권 이자없이 취득액처리 하는경우) 20211110 yjs
            w_chui_aek          := xx.gyulje_aek;
            w_won_avg           := F_TRUNC (yz_won_aek * (xx.gyulje_aek / yz_chui_aek), xx.fund_currency);
            w_sung_cost         := F_TRUNC (yz_sung_cost * (xx.gyulje_aek / yz_chui_aek), xx.currency);
            w_misu_ija          := F_TRUNC (yz_misu_ija * (xx.gyulje_aek / yz_chui_aek), xx.currency);
            w_won_sung_cost     := F_TRUNC (yz_won_sung_cost * (xx.gyulje_aek / yz_chui_aek), xx.fund_currency);
            w_won_misu_ija      := F_TRUNC (yz_won_misu_ija * (xx.gyulje_aek / yz_chui_aek), xx.fund_currency);
            w_fcur_avg          := F_TRUNC (yz_fcur_aek * (xx.gyulje_aek / yz_chui_aek), xx.fund_currency);
            w_fcur_sung_cost    := F_TRUNC (yz_fcur_sung_cost * (xx.gyulje_aek / yz_chui_aek), xx.fund_currency);
            w_fcur_misu_ija     := F_TRUNC (yz_fcur_misu_ija * (xx.gyulje_aek / yz_chui_aek), xx.fund_currency);
        else
            w_chui_aek          := F_TRUNC (yz_chui_aek / yz_jusu * xx.aekm, xx.currency);
            w_won_avg           := F_TRUNC (yz_won_aek / yz_jusu * xx.aekm, xx.fund_currency);
            w_sung_cost         := F_TRUNC (yz_sung_cost / yz_jusu * xx.aekm, xx.currency);
            w_misu_ija          := F_TRUNC (yz_misu_ija / yz_jusu * xx.aekm, xx.currency);
            w_won_sung_cost     := F_TRUNC (yz_won_sung_cost / yz_jusu * xx.aekm, xx.fund_currency);
            w_won_misu_ija      := F_TRUNC (yz_won_misu_ija / yz_jusu * xx.aekm, xx.fund_currency);
            w_fcur_avg          := F_TRUNC (yz_fcur_aek / yz_jusu * xx.aekm, xx.fund_currency);
            w_fcur_sung_cost    := F_TRUNC (yz_fcur_sung_cost / yz_jusu * xx.aekm, xx.fund_currency);
            w_fcur_misu_ija     := F_TRUNC (yz_fcur_misu_ija / yz_jusu * xx.aekm, xx.fund_currency);
        end if;

        -- 해외자산마스타 처리
        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET tr_dw_jusu       = NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0) + xx.aekm
             , tr_dw_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0) + w_chui_aek
             , won_dw_chui_aek  = NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0)+w_won_avg
             , sung_cost        = NVL(sung_cost,0) - w_sung_cost
             , misu_ija         = NVL(misu_ija,0) - w_misu_ija
             , won_sung_cost    = NVL(won_sung_cost,0) - w_won_sung_cost
             , won_misu_ija     = NVL(won_misu_ija,0) - w_won_misu_ija
             , fcur_dw_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_dw_chui_aek,0)+w_fcur_avg
             , fcur_sung_cost   = NVL(fcur_sung_cost,0) - w_fcur_sung_cost
             , fcur_misu_ija    = NVL(fcur_misu_ija,0) - w_fcur_misu_ija
         WHERE ROWID = w_rowid;

        -- 해외매매거래 처리
        UPDATE SYT0MG
           SET chui_aek      = w_chui_aek
             , won_chui_aek  = w_won_avg
             , pass_ija      = w_sung_cost
             , won_pass_ija  = w_won_sung_cost
             , misu_ija      = w_misu_ija
             , won_misu_ija  = w_won_misu_ija
             , fcur_chui_aek = w_fcur_avg
             , fcur_pass_ija = w_fcur_sung_cost
             , fcur_misu_ija = w_fcur_misu_ija
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    END LOOP;
    if  w_err > 0   then
        p_msg   := F_NTRIM (w_err) || '건 매도거래생성 에러발생';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B040', 'syt0mg.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=J14', '해외채권 익일매매 회계처리');

    -- 해외채권 익일매입 회계처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd                       /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                     /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency               /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                    /* _4- */
             , t1.trustee                     /* _5- */
             , t1.jm_cd                       /* _6- */
             , t1.bs_type                     /* _7- */
             , t1.tr_seq                      /* _8- */
             , t1.currency                    /* _9- */
             , t1.tr_jusu            AS aekm  /* _10- */
             , t1.tr_halin_aek                /* _11- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                  /* _12- */
             , t1.won_tr_halin_aek            /* _13- */
             , t1.won_gyulje_aek              /* _14- */
             , t1.gyulje_ymd                  /* _15- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                /* _16- */
             , t1.fcur_tr_halin_aek           /* _17- */
             , t1.fcur_gyulje_aek             /* _18- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'J14'
           AND t1.tr_ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY tr_cd  
                , fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            SR_SZSL021 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, TO_CHAR(xx.gyulje_ymd, 'dd'), xx.tr_seq,
                        xx.won_gyulje_aek + NVL(xx.won_tr_halin_aek, 0), xx.won_gyulje_aek, p_proc_step, 'sycp043', w_msg);
        else
            SR_SZSL021 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, TO_CHAR(xx.gyulje_ymd, 'dd'), xx.tr_seq,
                        xx.fcur_gyulje_aek + NVL(xx.fcur_tr_halin_aek, 0), xx.fcur_gyulje_aek, p_proc_step, 'sycp043', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 채권 익일매입 처리
        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET msd_meib_aekm     = NVL(msd_meib_aekm,0) + xx.aekm
             , msd_meib_aek      = NVL(msd_meib_aek,0) + xx.gyulje_aek + NVL(xx.tr_halin_aek,0)
             , won_msd_meib_aek  = NVL(won_msd_meib_aek,0) + xx.won_gyulje_aek
             , fcur_msd_meib_aek = NVL(fcur_msd_meib_aek,0) + xx.fcur_gyulje_aek + NVL(xx.fcur_tr_halin_aek,0)
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND bs_type = xx.bs_type
           AND ymd     = p_ymd
           AND trustee = xx.trustee;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO SYM0YZ
                ( corp_gr            /* _1- */
                , ymd                /* _2- */
                , fund_cd            /* _3- */
                , trustee            /* _4- */
                , jm_cd              /* _5- */
                , bs_type            /* _6- */
                , currency           /* _7- */
                , tr_bfil_jusu       /* _8- */
                , tr_up_jusu         /* _9- */
                , tr_dw_jusu         /* _10- */
                , tr_bfil_chui_aek   /* _11- */
                , tr_up_chui_aek     /* _12- */
                , tr_dw_chui_aek     /* _13- */
                , sung_cost          /* _14- */
                , won_bfil_chui_aek  /* _15- */
                , won_up_chui_aek    /* _16- */
                , won_dw_chui_aek    /* _17- */
                , won_sung_cost      /* _18- */
                , msd_meib_aekm      /* _19- */
