                , msd_meib_aek       /* _20- */
                , won_msd_meib_aek   /* _21- */
                , fcur_msd_meib_aek  /* _22- */
                )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr                                         /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd                                             /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd                                        /* _3- */
                   , xx.trustee                                        /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_cd                                          /* _5- */
                   , xx.bs_type                                        /* _6- */
                   , xx.currency                                       /* _7- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _8- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _9- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _10- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _11- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _12- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _13- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _14- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _15- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _16- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _17- */
                   , 0                                                 /* _18- */
                   , xx.aekm                                           /* _19- */
                   , xx.gyulje_aek                                     /* _20- */
                   , xx.won_gyulje_aek + NVL(xx.won_tr_halin_aek,0)    /* _21- */
                   , xx.fcur_gyulje_aek + NVL(xx.fcur_tr_halin_aek,0)  /* _22- */
                   );
        end if;
        -- 결제 외화예금 처리
        INSERT INTO SYT0YS
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr           /* _1- */
               , p_ymd               /* _2- */
               , p_ymd               /* _3- */
               , xx.tr_cd            /* _4- */
               , xx.fund_cd          /* _5- */
               , xx.tr_co_cd         /* _6- */
               , xx.trustee          /* _7- */
               , xx.jm_cd            /* _8- */
               , xx.currency         /* _9- */
               , xx.tr_seq           /* _10- */
               , xx.gyulje_ymd       /* _11- */
               , NULL                /* _12- */
               , NULL                /* _13- */
               , xx.gyulje_aek       /* _14- */
               , xx.won_gyulje_aek   /* _15- */
               , 'N'                 /* _16- */
               , xx.gyulje_jm_cd     /* _17- */
               , NULL                /* _18- */
               , NULL                /* _19- */
               , NULL                /* _20- */
               , 0                   /* _21- */
               , NULL                /* _22- */
               , NULL                /* _23- */
               , xx.bs_type          /* _24- */
               , xx.fcur_gyulje_aek  /* _25- */
               , 0                   /* _26- */
               , 0                   /* _27- */
               , NULL                /* _28- */
               , NULL                /* _29- */
               , NULL                /* _30- */
               );
    END LOOP;
    -- 채권 익일매도 회계처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                               /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                               /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                             /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                       /* _4- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                            /* _5- */
             , t1.trustee                                             /* _6- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                               /* _7- */
             , t1.bs_type                                             /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_seq                                              /* _9- */
             , t1.currency                                            /* _10- */
             , t1.tr_jusu                                    AS aekm  /* _11- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                                          /* _12- */
             , t1.won_gyulje_aek                                      /* _13- */
             , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq   /* _14- */
             , t1.gyulje_ymd                                          /* _15- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                                        /* _16- */
             , t1.fcur_gyulje_aek                                     /* _17- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'K11'
           AND t1.tr_ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd > p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY tr_cd  
                , fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.won_gyulje_aek, p_proc_step, 'sycp043', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 1, xx.fcur_gyulje_aek, p_proc_step, 'sycp043', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;


        -- 해외자산마스타  채권 익일매도처리
        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET msd_medo_aekm     = NVL(msd_medo_aekm,0) + xx.aekm
             , msd_medo_aek      = NVL(msd_medo_aek,0) + xx.gyulje_aek
             , won_msd_medo_aek  = NVL(won_msd_medo_aek,0) + xx.won_gyulje_aek
             , fcur_msd_medo_aek = NVL(fcur_msd_medo_aek,0) + xx.fcur_gyulje_aek
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd   = xx.jm_cd
           AND bs_type = xx.bs_type
           AND ymd     = p_ymd
           AND trustee = xx.trustee;

        -- 결제 외화예금 처리
        INSERT INTO SYT0YS
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr           /* _1- */
               , p_ymd               /* _2- */
               , p_ymd               /* _3- */
               , xx.tr_cd            /* _4- */
               , xx.fund_cd          /* _5- */
               , xx.tr_co_cd         /* _6- */
               , xx.trustee          /* _7- */
               , xx.jm_cd            /* _8- */
               , xx.currency         /* _9- */
               , xx.tr_seq           /* _10- */
               , xx.gyulje_ymd       /* _11- */
               , NULL                /* _12- */
               , NULL                /* _13- */
               , xx.gyulje_aek       /* _14- */
               , xx.won_gyulje_aek   /* _15- */
               , 'N'                 /* _16- */
               , xx.gyulje_jm_cd     /* _17- */
               , NULL                /* _18- */
               , NULL                /* _19- */
               , NULL                /* _20- */
               , 0                   /* _21- */
               , NULL                /* _22- */
               , NULL                /* _23- */
               , xx.bs_type          /* _24- */
               , xx.fcur_gyulje_aek  /* _25- */
               , NULL                /* _26- */
               , NULL                /* _27- */
               , NULL                /* _28- */
               , NULL                /* _29- */
               , NULL                /* _30- */
               );

        -- 수도일 현재 액면, 취득액
        SELECT NVL(t1.tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_jusu,0) + NVL(t1.msd_meib_aekm,0)
             , NVL(t1.tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.tr_dw_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.msd_meib_aek,0)
             , NVL(t1.won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.won_dw_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.won_msd_meib_aek,0)
             , NVL(t1.fcur_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.fcur_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(t1.fcur_dw_chui_aek,0) + NVL(t1.fcur_msd_meib_aek,0)
          INTO w_aekm
             , w_chui_aek
             , w_won_chui_aek
             , w_fcur_chui_aek
          FROM SYM0YZ t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
           AND t1.bs_type  = xx.bs_type
           AND t1.trustee  = xx.trustee
           AND t1.currency = xx.currency;

        -- 매도후 액면확인
        if  w_aekm < xx.aekm    then
            p_msg   := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.jm_cd || '-(' || F_NTRIM (w_aekm - xx.aekm, 0, 2) || ')-매도후 액면확인';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 매도분 비율계산
        w_tr_chui_aek       := F_TRUNC (w_chui_aek * (xx.aekm / w_aekm), xx.currency);
        w_tr_won_chui_aek   := F_TRUNC (w_won_chui_aek * (xx.aekm / w_aekm), xx.fund_currency);
        w_tr_fcur_chui_aek  := F_TRUNC (w_fcur_chui_aek * (xx.aekm / w_aekm), xx.fund_currency);

        UPDATE SYT0MG
           SET chui_aek      = w_tr_chui_aek
             , won_chui_aek  = w_tr_won_chui_aek
             , fcur_chui_aek = w_tr_fcur_chui_aek
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    END LOOP;

    -- 조기상환 익일결제처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                                                                                                         /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                                                                          /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                                                        /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                                                  /* _4- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                                                       /* _5- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                                                        /* _6- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                                                          /* _7- */
             , t1.upd_user                                                                                                                       /* _8- */
             , t3.sj_gb || '0'                                                                                                 AS jasan_gb       /* _9- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.gyulje_aek),0)                                                                                       AS aek            /* _10- */
             , NVL(SUM(TRUNC(t1.won_gyulje_aek)),0)                                                                            AS won_aek        /* _11- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.won_chui_aek),0)                                                                                     AS won_chui_aek   /* _12- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.won_pass_ija),0)                                                                                     AS won_sung_cost  /* _13- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.won_misu_ija),0)                                                                                     AS won_misu_ija   /* _14- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.won_today_ija),0)                                                                                    AS won_today_ija  /* _15- */
             , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)                                                AS seq            /* _16- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.fcur_chui_aek),0)                                                                                    AS fcur_chui_aek  /* _17- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.fcur_pass_ija),0)                                                                                    AS fcur_sung_cost /* _18- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.fcur_misu_ija),0)                                                                                    AS fcur_misu_ija  /* _19- */
             , F_TRUNC (SUM(F_COVCUR(t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek, ia.fund_currency)), ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_aek       /* _20- */
             , F_TRUNC (SUM(F_COVCUR(t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.today_ija, ia.fund_currency)), ia.fund_currency)   AS fcur_today_ija /* _21- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SYM0YA t3
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'E42'
           AND t1.tr_ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd > p_ymd
           AND t3.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.jm_cd      = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.tr_ymd       
                , t1.tr_cd        
                , t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
                , t1.currency     
                , t1.trustee      
                , t1.jm_cd        
                , t1.upd_user     
                , t3.sj_gb || '0'
    ) loop
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            if NVL (xx.won_today_ija,0) > 0     then
                SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '11', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 3,
                            (xx.won_sung_cost + xx.won_misu_ija) - (xx.won_today_ija), p_proc_step, 'sycp043', w_msg);
                if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                    p_msg   := w_msg;
                    RETURN;
                end if;
            end if;
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.won_aek,xx.won_chui_aek,xx.won_sung_cost,xx.won_misu_ija,0,0);
            if  xx.won_aek > (xx.won_chui_aek + xx.won_sung_cost + xx.won_misu_ija)     then
                    w_aek (6)   := xx.won_aek - (xx.won_chui_aek + xx.won_sung_cost + xx.won_misu_ija);
            else    w_aek (5)   := (xx.won_chui_aek + xx.won_sung_cost + xx.won_misu_ija) - xx.won_aek;
            end if;
        else
            if NVL (xx.fcur_today_ija,0) > 0        then
                SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '11', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 3,
                            (xx.fcur_sung_cost + xx.fcur_misu_ija) - (xx.fcur_today_ija), p_proc_step, 'sycp043', w_msg);
                if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                    p_msg   := w_msg;
                    RETURN;
                end if;
            end if;
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.fcur_aek,xx.fcur_chui_aek,xx.fcur_sung_cost,xx.fcur_misu_ija,0,0);
            if  xx.fcur_aek > (xx.fcur_chui_aek + xx.fcur_sung_cost + xx.fcur_misu_ija)     then
                    w_aek (6)   := xx.fcur_aek - (xx.fcur_chui_aek + xx.fcur_sung_cost + xx.fcur_misu_ija);
            else    w_aek (5)   := (xx.fcur_chui_aek + xx.fcur_sung_cost + xx.fcur_misu_ija) - xx.fcur_aek;
            end if;
        end if;
        SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '10', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.seq, 2, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'sycp043', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    p_msg   := 'sycp043:' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SYCP044 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 해외파생 매매거래
--
    w_rowid                      ROWID;

    w_err                        NUMBER := 0;
    w_chui_aek                   NUMBER;
    w_won_chui_aek               NUMBER;
    w_fcur_chui_aek              NUMBER;

    w_tr_cha                     NUMBER;
    w_won_tr_cha                 NUMBER;
    w_fcur_tr_cha                NUMBER;

    w_tr_cd                      VARCHAR(3) := 'S';
    w_currency                   szm0ia.fund_currency%type := 'KRW';
    w_fund_cd                    szm0ia.fund_cd%type := 'fund';
    w_fund_currency              szm0ia.fund_currency%type := 'KRW';
    w_tr_seq                     NUMBER := 0;
    w_won_susu_sum               NUMBER;
    w_fcur_susu_sum              NUMBER;

    yz_jusu                      NUMBER;
    yz_chui_aek                  NUMBER;
    yz_won_aek                   NUMBER;
    yz_fcur_aek                  NUMBER;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -- 해외선물 매수/매도(잔고관리, 외환 결제는 잔고처리 후)
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'SYT)MG', p_ymd || ' : 해외선물 매수/매도 처리');

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                     /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                                     /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                                                                  /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                   /* _4- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                             /* _5- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                   /* _6- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                     /* _7- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                  /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_seq                                                                                    /* _9- */
             , t1.tr_jusu                                                                                   /* _10- */
             , F_ROUND (t1.tr_aek, t1.currency)                                            AS tr_aek        /* _11- */
             , t1.tr_cost                                                                                   /* _12- */
             , F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_cost, ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_tr_cost  /* _13- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                                                                              /* _14- */
             , F_COVWON_TR (p_corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_aek)                  AS won_tr_aek    /* _15- */
             , F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_aek, ia.fund_currency)   AS fcur_tr_aek   /* _16- */
             , F_COVWON_TR (p_corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_cost)                 AS won_susu_aek  /* _17- */
             , F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_cost, ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_susu_aek /* _18- */
             , gr.sebu_cd_enm                                                              AS sm_tr_gb      /* _19- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SZX0GR gr
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd      IN ('S10','S20','S70','S80','S90','SA0')
           AND t1.tr_ymd     = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
           AND gr.gr_cd(+)   = 'B4'
           AND gr.sebu_cd(+) = t1.tr_cd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_cd, t1.currency, ia.fund_currency, t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.sm_tr_gb IS NULL then
            p_msg   := xx.tr_cd || '-그룹코드 등록(9202 szx0gr:B4)';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 해외자산마스타 처리
        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET tr_up_jusu       = NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) + xx.tr_jusu
             , tr_up_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.tr_aek
             , won_up_chui_aek  = NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.won_tr_aek
             , fcur_up_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0) + xx.fcur_tr_aek
         WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
           AND jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
           AND sm_tr_gb = xx.sm_tr_gb
           AND bs_type  = 0
           AND ymd      = p_ymd
           AND trustee  = xx.trustee;
        if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            INSERT INTO SYM0YZ
                ( corp_gr             /* _1- */
                , ymd                 /* _2- */
                , fund_cd             /* _3- */
                , trustee             /* _4- */
                , jm_cd               /* _5- */
                , sm_tr_gb            /* _6- */
                , bs_type             /* _7- */
                , currency            /* _8- */
                , tr_bfil_jusu        /* _9- */
                , tr_up_jusu          /* _10- */
                , tr_dw_jusu          /* _11- */
                , tr_bfil_chui_aek    /* _12- */
                , tr_up_chui_aek      /* _13- */
                , tr_dw_chui_aek      /* _14- */
                , won_bfil_chui_aek   /* _15- */
                , won_up_chui_aek     /* _16- */
                , won_dw_chui_aek     /* _17- */
                , fcur_bfil_chui_aek  /* _18- */
                , fcur_up_chui_aek    /* _19- */
                , fcur_dw_chui_aek    /* _20- */
                )
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd           /* _2- */
                   , xx.fund_cd      /* _3- */
                   , xx.trustee      /* _4- */
                   , xx.jm_cd        /* _5- */
                   , xx.sm_tr_gb     /* _6- */
                   , 0               /* _7- */
                   , xx.currency     /* _8- */
                   , 0               /* _9- */
                   , xx.tr_jusu      /* _10- */
                   , 0               /* _11- */
                   , 0               /* _12- */
                   , xx.tr_aek       /* _13- */
                   , 0               /* _14- */
                   , 0               /* _15- */
                   , xx.won_tr_aek   /* _16- */
                   , 0               /* _17- */
                   , 0               /* _18- */
                   , xx.fcur_tr_aek  /* _19- */
                   , 0               /* _20- */
                   );
        end if;

        -- 해외매매거래 처리
        UPDATE SYT0MG
           SET gyulje_aek      = xx.tr_aek
             , won_gyulje_aek  = xx.won_tr_aek
             , fcur_gyulje_aek = xx.fcur_tr_aek
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        -- 매매수수료 분개
        if  w_tr_cd || w_currency || w_fund_cd || w_fund_currency != xx.tr_cd || xx.currency || xx.fund_cd || xx.fund_currency  then
            if  w_won_susu_sum > 0  then
                if  w_fund_currency = 'KRW' then
                        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_tr_cd, 'A', '2', '10', w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency, w_currency,
                                    w_tr_seq, 1, w_won_susu_sum, p_proc_step, 'SYCP044', w_msg);
                else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_tr_cd, 'A', '2', '10', w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency, w_currency,
                                    w_tr_seq, 1, w_fcur_susu_sum, p_proc_step, 'SYCP044', w_msg);
                end if;
                if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                    p_msg   := w_msg;
                    RETURN;
                end if;
            end if;
            w_tr_cd         := xx.tr_cd;
            w_currency      := xx.currency;
            w_fund_cd       := xx.fund_cd;
            w_fund_currency := xx.fund_currency;
            w_tr_seq        := xx.tr_seq;
            w_won_susu_sum  := 0;
            w_fcur_susu_sum := 0;
        end if;
        w_won_susu_sum  := w_won_susu_sum + xx.won_susu_aek;
        w_fcur_susu_sum := w_fcur_susu_sum + xx.fcur_susu_aek;
    END LOOP;
    if  w_won_susu_sum > 0  then
        if  w_fund_currency = 'KRW' then
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_tr_cd, 'A', '2', '10', w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency, w_currency,
                            w_tr_seq, 1, w_won_susu_sum, p_proc_step, 'SYCP044', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_tr_cd, 'A', '2', '10', w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency, w_currency,
                            w_tr_seq, 1, w_fcur_susu_sum, p_proc_step, 'SYCP044', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end if;

    -- 해외선물 전매도/환매수
    w_won_susu_sum  := 0;
    w_fcur_susu_sum := 0;
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                     /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_seq                                                                                    /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                                     /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                   /* _4- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                             /* _5- */
             , t1.tr_co_cd                                                                                  /* _6- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                   /* _7- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                     /* _8- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                  /* _9- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_jusu,0)                                                           AS jusu          /* _10- */
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)             AS seq           /* _11- */
             , F_ROUND (t1.tr_aek, t1.currency)                                            AS tr_aek        /* _12- */
             , t1.tr_cost                                                                                   /* _13- */
             , F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_cost, ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_tr_cost  /* _14- */
             , F_COVWON_TR (p_corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_aek)                  AS won_tr_aek    /* _15- */
             , F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_aek, ia.fund_currency)   AS fcur_tr_aek   /* _16- */
             , F_COVWON_TR (p_corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_cost)                 AS won_susu_aek  /* _17- */
             , F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_cost, ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_susu_aek /* _18- */
             , t1.upd_user                                                                                  /* _19- */
             , t1.chui_aek                                                                                  /* _20- */
             , gr.sebu_cd_enm                                                              AS sm_tr_gb      /* _21- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SZX0GR gr
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd      IN ('S11','S12','S13','S21','S22','S23',
                                 'S71','S72','S73','S81','S82','S83',
                                 'S91','S92','S93','SA1','SA2','SA3')
           AND t1.tr_ymd     = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
           AND gr.gr_cd(+)   = 'B4'
           AND gr.sebu_cd(+) = t1.tr_cd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_cd, t1.currency, ia.fund_currency, t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.sm_tr_gb IS NULL then
            p_msg   := xx.tr_cd || '-그룹코드 등록(9202 szx0gr:B4)';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        BEGIN
            SELECT ROWID
                 , NVL(tr_bfil_jusu,0) + NVL(tr_up_jusu,0) - NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0)
                 , NVL(tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0)
                 , NVL(won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0)
                 , NVL(fcur_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(fcur_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(fcur_dw_chui_aek,0)
              INTO w_rowid
                 , yz_jusu
                 , yz_chui_aek
                 , yz_won_aek
                 , yz_fcur_aek
              FROM SYM0YZ t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd      = p_ymd
               AND t1.bs_type  = 0
               AND t1.jm_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND t1.sm_tr_gb = xx.sm_tr_gb
               AND t1.trustee  = xx.trustee
               AND t1.currency = xx.currency;
        EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            w_err   := w_err + 1;

            INSERT INTO WFRMERR
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr
                   , xx.jm_cd || '-파생마스타가 없습니다.[' || xx.tr_cd || ' ' || xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.currency || ']'
                   );
            CONTINUE;
        END;

        if  yz_jusu < xx.jusu   then
            w_err   := w_err + 1;
            INSERT INTO WFRMERR
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr
                   , xx.jm_cd || '-파생잔고가 없습니다.[' || xx.tr_cd || ' ' || xx.fund_cd || ' ' || xx.currency || ']'
                   );
            CONTINUE;
        elsif yz_jusu = xx.jusu then
            w_chui_aek      := yz_chui_aek;
            w_won_chui_aek  := yz_won_aek;
            w_fcur_chui_aek := yz_fcur_aek;
        else
            w_chui_aek      := TRUNC(yz_chui_aek / yz_jusu * xx.jusu,4);
            w_won_chui_aek  := F_TRUNC (yz_won_aek / yz_jusu * xx.jusu, xx.fund_currency);
            w_fcur_chui_aek := F_ROUND (yz_fcur_aek / yz_jusu * xx.jusu, xx.fund_currency);
        end if;

        -- 해외자산마스타 처리
        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET tr_dw_jusu       = NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0) + xx.jusu
             , tr_dw_chui_aek   = NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0) + w_chui_aek
             , won_dw_chui_aek  = NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0) + w_won_chui_aek
             , fcur_dw_chui_aek = NVL(fcur_dw_chui_aek,0) + w_fcur_chui_aek
         WHERE ROWID = w_rowid;

        -- 매매차액
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'SA3'    then
            w_tr_cha    := xx.tr_aek;   -- 해외파생은 현물결제이므로 프리미엄 금액 전체 분개 20250630
        else
            if  xx.sm_tr_gb IN ('2','4','6')    then
                    w_tr_cha    := w_chui_aek - xx.tr_aek;
            else    w_tr_cha    := xx.tr_aek - w_chui_aek;
            end if;
        end if;

        w_won_tr_cha    := F_COVWON_TR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, w_tr_cha);
        w_fcur_tr_cha   := F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.currency, w_tr_cha, xx.fund_currency);

        -- 해외매매거래 처리
        UPDATE SYT0MG
           SET gyulje_aek      = w_tr_cha
             , won_gyulje_aek  = xx.won_tr_aek
             , fcur_gyulje_aek = xx.fcur_tr_aek
             , chui_aek        = w_chui_aek
             , won_chui_aek    = w_won_chui_aek
             , fcur_chui_aek   = w_fcur_chui_aek
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                    xx.seq, 2, w_won_tr_cha, p_proc_step, 'SYCP044', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        -- 매매수수료 분개
        if  w_tr_cd || w_currency || w_fund_cd || w_fund_currency != xx.tr_cd || xx.currency || xx.fund_cd || xx.fund_currency  then
            if  w_won_susu_sum > 0  then
                if  w_fund_currency = 'KRW' then
                        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_tr_cd, 'A', '2', '10', w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency, w_currency,
                                    w_tr_seq, 1, w_won_susu_sum, p_proc_step, 'SYCP044', w_msg);
                else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_tr_cd, 'A', '2', '10', w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency, w_currency,
                                    w_tr_seq, 1, w_fcur_susu_sum, p_proc_step, 'SYCP044', w_msg);
                end if;
                if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                    p_msg   := w_msg;
                    RETURN;
                end if;
            end if;
            w_tr_cd         := xx.tr_cd;
            w_currency      := xx.currency;
            w_fund_cd       := xx.fund_cd;
            w_fund_currency := xx.fund_currency;
            w_tr_seq        := xx.tr_seq;
            w_won_susu_sum  := 0;
            w_fcur_susu_sum := 0;
        end if;
        w_won_susu_sum  := w_won_susu_sum + xx.won_susu_aek;
        w_fcur_susu_sum := w_fcur_susu_sum + xx.fcur_susu_aek;
    END LOOP;
    if  w_won_susu_sum > 0  then
        if  w_fund_currency = 'KRW' then
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_tr_cd, 'A', '2', '10', w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency, w_currency,
                            w_tr_seq, 1, w_won_susu_sum, p_proc_step, 'SYCP044', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, w_tr_cd, 'A', '2', '10', w_fund_cd, w_fund_currency, w_currency,
                            w_tr_seq, 1, w_fcur_susu_sum, p_proc_step, 'SYCP044', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end if;
    if  w_err > 0   then
        p_msg   := F_NTRIM (w_err) || '건 매도거래생성 에러발생';
        RETURN;
    end if;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    p_msg   := 'SYCP044:' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SYCP045 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 해외현금 감소 처리
-- 외화예금 bs_type = 0인 잔고 관리
--
    w_won_avg                    NUMBER;
    w_fcur_avg                   NUMBER;

    w_aek                        number_varray_50;

    w_err                        NUMBER := 0;

    w_trustee                    VARCHAR(5);
    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B010', 'syt0ma.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=', '해외 비용출금 외화예금 처리');

    -- 비용
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                          /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_ymd                                                                                         /* _2- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                                          /* _3- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                        /* _4- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                        /* _5- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                       /* _6- */
             , t1.gyulje_ymd                                                                                     /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.tr_aek,0)                                                                  AS tr_aek       /* _8- */
             , NVL(t1.bal_aek,0)                                                                 AS bal_aek      /* _9- */
             , NVL(t1.tax_aek,0)                                                                 AS tax_aek      /* _10- */
             , F_COVWON_TR (p_corp_gr, tr_ymd, currency, NVL(t1.tr_aek,0))                       AS won_tr_aek   /* _11- */
             , F_COVWON_TR (p_corp_gr, tr_ymd, currency, NVL(t1.tax_aek,0))                      AS won_tax_aek  /* _12- */
             , NVL(t1.won_bal_aek,0)                                                             AS won_bal_aek  /* _13- */
             , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.won_bal_aek,0)=0
                    THEN '00'
                    ELSE '01' END                                                                AS jasan_gb     /* _14- */
             , CASE t1.tr_cd WHEN 'H21' THEN 'P40'
                             WHEN 'H22' THEN 'P41'
                                        ELSE tr_cd END                                           AS jm_cd        /* _15- */
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                      ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)                                       AS seq          /* _16- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                  /* _17- */
             , ia.mg_cd                                                                                          /* _18- */
             , F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, NVL(t1.tr_aek,0), ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_tr_aek  /* _19- */
             , NVL(t1.fcur_bal_aek,0)                                                            AS fcur_bal_aek /* _20- */
          FROM SYT0MA t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd   NOT IN ('E68','E69')
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, p_ymd + 1)  > p_ymd
    ) loop
        -- 해외 수익/비용 당일 발생/감소분 전표생성(외화 거래환율 때문에 평가에서 생성)
        UPDATE SYT0MA t1  
           SET won_tr_aek   = xx.won_tr_aek
             , won_tax_aek  = xx.won_tax_aek
             , won_bal_aek  = xx.won_bal_aek
             , fcur_tr_aek  = xx.fcur_tr_aek
             , fcur_bal_aek = xx.fcur_bal_aek
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;

        if  xx.tr_cd NOT IN ('E72','H99')   then
            UPDATE SYT0MC
               SET dw_aek      = NVL(dw_aek,0) + xx.bal_aek
                 , won_dw_aek  = NVL(won_dw_aek,0) + xx.won_bal_aek
                 , fcur_dw_aek = NVL(fcur_dw_aek,0) + xx.fcur_bal_aek
             WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
               AND tr_ymd   = p_ymd
               AND tr_cd    = xx.jm_cd
               AND fund_cd  = xx.fund_cd
               AND trustee  = xx.trustee
               AND currency = xx.currency;

            if  xx.jasan_gb = '00'  then
                if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                        SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.trustee,
                                    xx.seq, 1, xx.won_tr_aek, p_proc_step, ' SYCP045 00 KRW', w_msg);
                else    SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.trustee,
                                    xx.seq, 1, xx.fcur_tr_aek, p_proc_step, ' SYCP045 00 ' || xx.fund_currency, w_msg);
                end if;
            else
                if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                        SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.trustee,
                                    xx.seq, 1, xx.won_bal_aek, xx.won_tr_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045 ' || xx.jasan_gb || 'KRW', w_msg);
                else    SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.trustee,
                                    xx.seq, 1, xx.fcur_bal_aek, xx.fcur_tr_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045' || xx.jasan_gb || xx.fund_currency, w_msg);
                end if;
            end if;
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if  xx.gyulje_ymd = xx.tr_ymd   then    -- 당일출금
            SR_10151_OUT (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, NULL, xx.trustee, 0, xx.tr_aek, w_won_avg, w_fcur_avg, w_msg);
            if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                p_msg   := '외화예금출금(sr_10151_out) 오류 : ' || w_msg;
                RETURN;
            end if;
            if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '10', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', '',
                            xx.seq, 2, xx.won_tr_aek, w_won_avg, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045 당일결제 KRW', w_msg);
            else
                if  xx.tr_cd = 'H22'    then    -- 20191107 비용인경우 예외처리 PDJ
                        SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '10', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '',
                                    xx.seq, 2, xx.fcur_tr_aek, xx.fcur_tr_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045 당일결제' || xx.fcur_tr_aek, w_msg);

                else    SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '10', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, '',
                                    xx.seq, 2, xx.fcur_tr_aek, w_fcur_avg, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045 외화당일' || xx.fcur_tr_aek || ' ' || w_fcur_avg, w_msg);
                end if;

            end if;
        else
            INSERT INTO SYT0YS
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd           /* _2- */
                   , p_ymd           /* _3- */
                   , xx.tr_cd        /* _4- */
                   , xx.fund_cd      /* _5- */
                   , xx.mg_cd        /* _6- */
                   , xx.trustee      /* _7- */
                   , xx.jm_cd        /* _8- */
                   , xx.currency     /* _9- */
                   , xx.seq          /* _10- */
                   , xx.gyulje_ymd   /* _11- */
                   , ''              /* _12- */
                   , ''              /* _13- */
                   , xx.tr_aek       /* _14- */
                   , xx.won_tr_aek   /* _15- */
                   , 'N'             /* _16- */
                   , ''              /* _17- */
                   , ''              /* _18- */
                   , ''              /* _19- */
                   , ''              /* _20- */
                   , 0               /* _21- */
                   , NULL            /* _22- */
                   , NULL            /* _23- */
                   , 0               /* _24- */
                   , xx.fcur_tr_aek  /* _25- */
                   , 0               /* _26- */
                   , 0               /* _27- */
                   , NULL            /* _28- */
                   , NULL            /* _29- */
                   , NULL            /* _30- */
                   );
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B020', 'syt0mg.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=E42,K10,K20', '해외 주식/채권 당일 매도거래 분개 및 외화예금 처리');

    -- 해외 주식/채권 당일 매도거래 분개 및 외화예금 처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                                                                                                         /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                                                                          /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                                                        /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                                                  /* _4- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                                                       /* _5- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                                                        /* _6- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                                                                                                                   /* _7- */
             , t1.upd_user                                                                                                                       /* _8- */
             , t3.sj_gb || '0'                                                                                                 AS jasan_gb       /* _9- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.gyulje_aek),0)                                                                                       AS aek            /* _10- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.pass_ija),0)                                                                                         AS pass_ija       /* _11- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.misu_ija),0)                                                                                         AS misu_ija       /* _12- */
             , NVL(SUM(TRUNC(t1.won_gyulje_aek)),0)                                                                            AS won_aek        /* _13- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.won_chui_aek),0)                                                                                     AS won_chui_aek   /* _14- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.won_pass_ija),0)                                                                                     AS won_sung_cost  /* _15- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.won_misu_ija),0)                                                                                     AS won_misu_ija   /* _16- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.today_ija),0)                                                                                        AS today_ija      /* _17- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.won_today_ija),0)                                                                                    AS won_today_ija  /* _18- */
             , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)                                                                    AS seq            /* _19- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.fcur_chui_aek),0)                                                                                    AS fcur_chui_aek  /* _20- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.fcur_pass_ija),0)                                                                                    AS fcur_sung_cost /* _21- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.fcur_misu_ija),0)                                                                                    AS fcur_misu_ija  /* _22- */
             , F_TRUNC (SUM(F_COVCUR(t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.gyulje_aek, ia.fund_currency)), ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_aek       /* _23- */
             , F_TRUNC (SUM(F_COVCUR(t1.corp_gr, t1.tr_ymd, t1.currency, t1.today_ija, ia.fund_currency)), ia.fund_currency)   AS fcur_today_ija /* _24- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SYM0YA t3
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr           = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd             IN ('E42','K10','K20','K61')
           AND t1.tr_ymd            = p_ymd
           AND NVL(t1.pass_gb,'N')  = 'N'
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd        = t1.tr_ymd
           AND t3.corp_gr           = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.jm_cd             = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr           = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd           = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.tr_ymd      , t1.tr_cd  , t1.fund_cd     , ia.fund_currency
                , t1.currency    , t1.trustee, t1.gyulje_jm_cd, t1.upd_user     
                , t3.sj_gb || '0'
    ) loop
        -- 당일 결제
        if  xx.today_ija > 0    then
            SR_10151_IN (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.trustee, 0,
                         xx.aek - ((xx.pass_ija + xx.misu_ija) - (xx.today_ija)), xx.won_aek - ((xx.won_sung_cost + xx.won_misu_ija) - (xx.won_today_ija)),
                         xx.fcur_aek - ((xx.fcur_sung_cost + xx.fcur_misu_ija) - (xx.fcur_today_ija)), w_msg);
        else
            SR_10151_IN (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.trustee, 0, xx.aek, xx.won_aek, xx.fcur_aek, w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := SUBSTR ('외화예금입금(sr_10151_in) 오류 : ' || w_msg,1,180);
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if  xx.tr_cd IN ('E42','K10')   then
            if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                if NVL (xx.won_today_ija,0) > 0 then
                    SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd,
                                xx.seq, 2, (xx.won_sung_cost + xx.won_misu_ija) - (xx.won_today_ija), p_proc_step, 'SYCP045/01', w_msg);
                    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                        p_msg   := w_msg;
                        RETURN;
                    end if;
                end if;
                w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.won_aek, xx.won_chui_aek, xx.won_sung_cost, xx.won_misu_ija, 0, 0);
                if  xx.won_aek > (xx.won_chui_aek + xx.won_sung_cost + xx.won_misu_ija) then
                        w_aek (6)   := xx.won_aek - (xx.won_chui_aek + xx.won_sung_cost + xx.won_misu_ija);
                else    w_aek (5)   := (xx.won_chui_aek + xx.won_sung_cost + xx.won_misu_ija) - xx.won_aek;
                end if;
            else
                if NVL (xx.fcur_today_ija,0) > 0    then
                    SR_SZSL011 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd,
                                xx.seq, 2, (xx.fcur_sung_cost + xx.fcur_misu_ija) - (xx.fcur_today_ija), p_proc_step, 'SYCP045/01', w_msg);
                    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
                        p_msg   := w_msg;
                        RETURN;
                    end if;
                end if;
                w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.fcur_aek, xx.fcur_chui_aek, xx.fcur_sung_cost, xx.fcur_misu_ija, 0, 0);
                if  xx.fcur_aek > (xx.fcur_chui_aek + xx.fcur_sung_cost + xx.fcur_misu_ija) then
                        w_aek (6)   := xx.fcur_aek - (xx.fcur_chui_aek + xx.fcur_sung_cost + xx.fcur_misu_ija);
                else    w_aek (5)   := (xx.fcur_chui_aek + xx.fcur_sung_cost + xx.fcur_misu_ija) - xx.fcur_aek;
                end if;
            end if;
            SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd,
                        xx.seq, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045/00', w_msg);
        else
            if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                    SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.gyulje_jm_cd,
                                xx.seq, 1, xx.won_aek, xx.won_chui_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045/' || xx.jasan_gb, w_msg);

            else    SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd,
                                xx.seq, 1, xx.fcur_aek, xx.fcur_chui_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045/' || xx.jasan_gb, w_msg);
            end if;
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B030', 'syt0ys.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=J10,J14,J20', '주식/채권 매입분 수도');

    -- 수도결제 처리 : 주식/채권 매입분 수도(외화예금 감소)
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                 /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                           /* _2- */
             , 'E90'                                         AS tr_cd     /* _3- */
             , t1.trustee                                                 /* _4- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                                            /* _5- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                   /* _6- */
             , t1.currency                                                /* _7- */
             , CASE WHEN t2.jasan_gb='1'
                    THEN CASE t2.sj_gb WHEN '2'
                                       THEN '02'
                                       ELSE '00' END
                    ELSE '10' END                            AS jasan_gb  /* _8- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                                              /* _9- */
             , t1.won_gyulje_aek                                          /* _10- */
             , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq       /* _11- */
             , t1.fcur_gyulje_aek                                         /* _12- */
          FROM SYT0YS t1
             , SYM0YA t2
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd      IN ('J10','J14','J20','J61')
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd = p_ymd
           AND t1.gyulje_gb  = 'Y'
           AND t2.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND t2.jm_cd      = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        SR_10151_OUT (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.trustee, 0, xx.gyulje_aek, w_won_avg, w_fcur_avg, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := SUBSTR ('외화예금출금(sr_10151_out) 오류 : ' || w_msg,1,180);
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                            xx.seq, 1, xx.won_gyulje_aek, w_won_avg, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045/2', w_msg);

        else    SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.jasan_gb, xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                            xx.seq, 1, xx.fcur_gyulje_aek, w_fcur_avg, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045/2', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := xx.gyulje_jm_cd || '-' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B040', 'syt0ys.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=K51', '수도결제 환전 매도처리(외화예수금)');

    -- 수도결제 환전 매도처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                 /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                           /* _2- */
             , t1.trustee                                                 /* _3- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                   /* _4- */
             , t1.currency                                                /* _5- */
             , t1.gyulje_aek                                 AS aek       /* _6- */
             , t1.won_gyulje_aek                             AS won_aek   /* _7- */
             , t1.fcur_gyulje_aek                            AS fcur_aek  /* _8- */
             , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq       /* _9- */
          FROM SYT0YS t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'K51'
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd = p_ymd
           AND t1.gyulje_gb  = 'Y'
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd
                , t1.jm_cd
    ) loop
        SR_10151_OUT (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.trustee, 0, xx.aek, w_won_avg, w_fcur_avg, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := SUBSTR ('외화예금출금(sr_10151_out) 오류 : ' || w_msg,1,180);
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            if  xx.won_aek < w_won_avg  then
                    w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.won_aek, xx.won_aek, xx.won_aek, w_won_avg, w_won_avg - xx.won_aek);
            else    w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.won_aek, xx.won_aek, xx.won_aek, w_won_avg, 0, xx.won_aek - w_won_avg);
            end if;
        else
            if  xx.fcur_aek < w_fcur_avg    then
                    w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.fcur_aek, xx.fcur_aek, xx.fcur_aek, w_fcur_avg, w_fcur_avg - xx.fcur_aek);
            else    w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.fcur_aek, xx.fcur_aek, xx.fcur_aek, w_fcur_avg, 0, xx.fcur_aek - w_fcur_avg);
            end if;
        end if;
        SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E70', 'A', '2', 'K5', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                    2, xx.seq, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045/3', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B050', 'syt0yh.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=K51', '환전 당일매도 처리');

    -- 환전 당일매도 처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid
             , t1.*
             , ia.fund_currency
          FROM SYT0YH t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd      = 'K51'
           AND t1.tr_ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY t1.fund_cd, t1.jm_cd, t1.tr_seq
    ) loop
        SR_10151_OUT (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, xx.jm_cd, xx.trustee, 0, xx.gyulje_aek, w_won_avg, w_fcur_avg, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := SUBSTR ('외화예금출금(sr_10151_out) 오류 : ' || w_msg,1,180);
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.jm_cd,
                            xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.won_gyulje_aek, w_won_avg, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045/4', w_msg);

        else    SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                            xx.tr_seq, 1, xx.fcur_gyulje_aek, w_fcur_avg, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045/4', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    if  w_err > 0   then
        p_msg   := F_NTRIM (w_err) || '건 환전매도 에러발생';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B060', 'syt0mg.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=J20,F21', '해외주식 당일 매입거래 분개 및 외화예금 처리');

    -- 해외주식 당일 매입거래 분개 및 외화예금 처리
    -- F45 주식발행초과금출자는 취득액만 처리(주수 1은 상징적인 값임) (화면 #2911)
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                                       /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                        /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                      /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                /* _4- */
             , t1.currency                                                     /* _5- */
             , t1.trustee                                                      /* _6- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                                                 /* _7- */
             , t1.upd_user                                                     /* _8- */
             , t3.sj_gb                                                        /* _9- */
             , SUM(t1.gyulje_aek)                            AS aek            /* _10- */
             , SUM(t1.won_gyulje_aek)                        AS won_aek        /* _11- */
             , SUM(t1.won_pass_ija)                          AS won_sung_cost  /* _12- */
             , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq            /* _13- */
             , SUM(t1.fcur_gyulje_aek)                       AS fcur_aek       /* _14- */
             , SUM(t1.fcur_pass_ija)                         AS fcur_sung_cost /* _15- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SYM0YA t3
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd      IN ('J20','F21','F45','J61')
           AND t1.tr_ymd     = p_ymd
           AND t1.gyulje_ymd = p_ymd
           AND t1.dx_jm_cd IS NULL
           AND t3.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.jm_cd      = t1.jm_cd
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.tr_ymd  , t1.tr_cd  , t1.fund_cd     , ia.fund_currency
                , t1.currency, t1.trustee, t1.gyulje_jm_cd, t1.upd_user     , t3.sj_gb
    ) loop
        if  xx.trustee LIKE '(%)'   then
            BEGIN
                SELECT trustee
                  INTO w_trustee
                  FROM SYX2MM t1
                 WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
                   AND t1.used          = '1'
                   AND t1.fund_currency = 'Y'
                   AND t1.currency      = xx.currency;
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS then
                p_msg   := 'PORT별 자산관리 예금 해외 보관처 등록확인 (#9024 해외보관처)';
                RETURN;
            END;
        else
            w_trustee   := xx.trustee;
        end if;

        SR_10151_OUT (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, w_trustee, 0, xx.aek, w_won_avg, w_fcur_avg, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := SUBSTR ('외화예금출금(sr_10151_out) 오류2(' || F_NTRIM (xx.aek,0,2) || ') : ' || w_msg,1,180);
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  xx.tr_cd = 'F21'    then
            if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'F21', 'A', '2', '1', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.gyulje_jm_cd,
                            xx.seq, 1, xx.won_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045/5/f21', w_msg);
            else
                SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'F21', 'A', '2', '1', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd,
                            xx.seq, 1, xx.fcur_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045/5/f21', w_msg);
            end if;
        else
            if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
                SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.sj_gb || '0', xx.fund_cd, 'KRW', xx.gyulje_jm_cd,
                            xx.seq, 1, xx.won_aek, w_won_avg, p_proc_step, 'sycp045/5', w_msg);

            else
                SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', xx.sj_gb || '0', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd,
                            xx.seq, 1, xx.fcur_aek, w_fcur_avg, p_proc_step, 'sycp045/5', w_msg);
            end if;
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    SR_BSS (p_corp_gr, 'B070', 'syt0mg.tr_ymd=' || p_ymd || ' * tr_cd=J10', '해외채권 당일 매입거래 분개 및 외화예금 처리');

    -- 해외채권 당일 매입거래 분개 및 외화예금 처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_ymd                                                                                                /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                                                 /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                               /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                                         /* _4- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                              /* _5- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                               /* _6- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                                                                 /* _7- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                                                                                          /* _8- */
             , t1.upd_user                                                                                              /* _9- */
             , t3.sj_gb                                                                                                 /* _10- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.gyulje_aek),0)                                                           AS aek               /* _11- */
             , NVL(SUM(t1.tr_aek),0)                                                               AS tr_aek            /* _12- */
             , NVL(SUM(TRUNC(t1.tr_aek * t1.trans_rt)),0)                                          AS won_tr_aek        /* _13- */
             , NVL(SUM(TRUNC(t1.won_tr_halin_aek)),0)                                              AS won_tr_halin_aek  /* _14- */
             , NVL(SUM(TRUNC(t1.won_pass_ija)),0)                                                  AS won_sung_cost     /* _15- */
             , NVL(SUM(TRUNC(NVL(t1.tr_cost,0) * t1.trans_rt)),0)                                  AS won_cost          /* _16- */
             , NVL(SUM(TRUNC(NVL(t1.tr_tax,0) * t1.trans_rt)),0)                                   AS won_tax           /* _17- */
             , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)                                        AS seq               /* _18- */
             , NVL(SUM(TRUNC(t1.fcur_tr_halin_aek,2)),0)                                           AS fcur_tr_halin_aek /* _19- */
             , NVL(SUM(TRUNC(t1.fcur_gyulje_aek,2)),0)                                             AS fcur_gyulje_aek   /* _20- */
             , NVL(SUM(TRUNC(t1.fcur_pass_ija,2)),0)                                               AS fcur_sung_cost    /* _21- */
             , NVL(SUM(F_COVCUR (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, t1.currency, t1.tr_cost, ia.fund_currency)),0)  AS fcur_cost         /* _22- */
          FROM SYT0MG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
             , SYM0YA t3
         WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd   = 'J10'
           AND t1.tr_ymd  = p_ymd
           AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd
           AND t3.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr
           AND t3.jm_cd   = t1.jm_cd
         GROUP BY t1.tr_ymd  , t1.tr_cd  , t1.fund_cd, ia.fund_currency
                , t1.currency, t1.trustee, t1.jm_cd  , t1.gyulje_jm_cd 
                , t1.upd_user, t3.sj_gb
    ) loop
        SR_10151_OUT (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.fund_cd, xx.currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd, xx.trustee, 0, xx.aek, w_won_avg, w_fcur_avg, w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := SUBSTR ('외화예금출금(sr_10151_out) 오류1 : ' || w_msg,1,180);
            RETURN;
        end if;
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.won_tr_aek + xx.won_tr_halin_aek, w_won_avg, xx.won_sung_cost, xx.won_cost, xx.won_tax, 0, 0, xx.won_tr_halin_aek);
            if (xx.won_tr_aek + xx.won_sung_cost + xx.won_cost + xx.won_tax) > w_won_avg    then
                    w_aek (7)   := (xx.won_tr_aek + xx.won_sung_cost + xx.won_cost + xx.won_tax) - w_won_avg;
            else    w_aek (6)   := w_won_avg - (xx.won_tr_aek + xx.won_sung_cost + xx.won_cost + xx.won_tax);
            end if;
        else
            w_aek   := number_varray_50 (xx.fcur_gyulje_aek + xx.fcur_tr_halin_aek, w_fcur_avg, xx.fcur_sung_cost, xx.fcur_cost, 0, 0, 0, xx.fcur_tr_halin_aek);
            if (xx.fcur_gyulje_aek + xx.fcur_sung_cost + xx.fcur_cost) > w_fcur_avg     then
                    w_aek (7)   := (xx.fcur_gyulje_aek + xx.fcur_sung_cost + xx.fcur_cost) - w_fcur_avg;
            else    w_aek (6)   := w_fcur_avg - (xx.fcur_gyulje_aek + xx.fcur_sung_cost + xx.fcur_cost);
            end if;
        end if;
        -- 대출채권(대여금) 분리
        if  xx.sj_gb = 'Z'  then
                SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'J10', 'A', '2', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                            xx.seq, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045/6 01', w_msg);
        else    SR_SZSL999 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'J10', 'A', '2', '00', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.jm_cd,
                            xx.seq, 1, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP045/6 00', w_msg);
        end if;
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
--EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
--    p_msg   := 'sycp045:' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SYCP050 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 비용출금 수도결제 처리
--
    yz_currency                  sym0yz.currency%type;
    yz_chui_aek                  NUMBER;
    yz_won_aek                   NUMBER;

    w_com                        NUMBER;
    w_rowid                      ROWID;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -- 수도결제 처리 : 비용 일부출금
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.rowid                                                                                    /* _1- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                                                    /* _2- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                                                                  /* _3- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                                            /* _4- */
             , t1.trustee                                                                                  /* _5- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                                                                             /* _6- */
             , t1.currency                                                                                 /* _7- */
             , t1.pyunga_join                                                                              /* _8- */
             , t1.bunhal_aek                                                                   AS aek      /* _9- */
             , F_TRUNC (t1.won_gyulje_aek / t1.gyulje_aek * t1.bunhal_aek, ia.fund_currency)   AS won_aek  /* _10- */
             , F_TRUNC (t1.fcur_gyulje_aek / t1.gyulje_aek * t1.bunhal_aek, ia.fund_currency)  AS fcur_aek /* _11- */
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                      ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)                                     AS seq      /* _12- */
          FROM SYT0YS t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr    = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd        = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd      IN ('H21','H22')
           AND t1.gyulje_gb  = 'N'
           AND t1.bunhal_aek != 0
           AND ia.corp_gr    = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd    = t1.fund_cd
         ORDER BY t1.tr_cd  
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT ROWID
                 , currency
                 , NVL(tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0)
                 , NVL(won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0)
              INTO w_rowid
                 , yz_currency
                 , yz_chui_aek
                 , yz_won_aek
              FROM SYM0YZ t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.gyulje_jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            p_msg   := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.gyulje_jm_cd || '-결제 자산마스타가 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;
        if  xx.currency != yz_currency  then
            p_msg   := xx.gyulje_jm_cd || '-처리할 수 없는 통화입니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if  yz_chui_aek <= xx.aek   then
                w_com   := yz_won_aek;
        else    w_com   := F_TRUNC (yz_won_aek / yz_chui_aek * xx.aek, xx.fund_currency);
        end if;

        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET tr_dw_jusu      = NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0) + xx.aek
             , tr_dw_chui_aek  = NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0) + xx.aek
             , won_dw_chui_aek = NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0) + w_com
         WHERE ROWID = w_rowid;

        SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '10', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd,
                    xx.seq, 1, xx.won_aek, w_com, p_proc_step, 'SYCP042', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        UPDATE SYT0YS
           SET bunhal_won_gyulje_aek  = xx.won_aek
             , bunhal_fcur_gyulje_aek = xx.fcur_aek
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    END LOOP;

    -- 수도결제 처리 : 유상불입 및 비용출금
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.tr_cd                                                /* _1- */
             , t1.fund_cd                                              /* _2- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                        /* _3- */
             , t1.trustee                                              /* _4- */
             , t1.gyulje_jm_cd                                         /* _5- */
             , t1.currency                                             /* _6- */
             , t1.pyunga_join                                          /* _7- */
             , SUM(t1.gyulje_aek)                           AS aek     /* _8- */
             , SUM(t1.won_gyulje_aek)                       AS won_aek /* _9- */
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                      ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq     /* _10- */
          FROM SYT0YS t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr   = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.ymd       = p_ymd
           AND t1.tr_cd     IN ('G33','H21','H22')
           AND t1.gyulje_gb = 'Y'
           AND ia.corp_gr   = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd   = t1.fund_cd
         GROUP BY t1.tr_cd        
                , t1.fund_cd      
                , ia.fund_currency
                , t1.trustee      
                , t1.gyulje_jm_cd 
                , t1.currency     
                , t1.pyunga_join  
         ORDER BY t1.tr_cd  
                , t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        BEGIN
            SELECT ROWID
                 , currency
                 , NVL(tr_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(tr_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0)
                 , NVL(won_bfil_chui_aek,0) + NVL(won_up_chui_aek,0) - NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0)
              INTO w_rowid
                 , yz_currency
                 , yz_chui_aek
                 , yz_won_aek
              FROM SYM0YZ t1
             WHERE t1.corp_gr = p_corp_gr
               AND t1.fund_cd = xx.fund_cd
               AND t1.ymd     = p_ymd
               AND t1.jm_cd   = xx.gyulje_jm_cd;
        EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            p_msg   := xx.fund_cd || '-' || xx.gyulje_jm_cd || '-결제 자산마스타가 없습니다.';
            RETURN;
        END;
        if  xx.currency != yz_currency  then
            p_msg   := xx.gyulje_jm_cd || '-처리할 수 없는 통화입니다.';
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if  yz_chui_aek <= xx.aek   then
                w_com   := yz_won_aek;
        else    w_com   := F_TRUNC (yz_won_aek / yz_chui_aek * xx.aek, xx.fund_currency);
        end if;

        UPDATE SYM0YZ
           SET tr_dw_jusu      = NVL(tr_dw_jusu,0) + xx.aek
             , tr_dw_chui_aek  = NVL(tr_dw_chui_aek,0) + xx.aek
             , won_dw_chui_aek = NVL(won_dw_chui_aek,0) + w_com
         WHERE ROWID = w_rowid;

        SR_SZSL020 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, xx.tr_cd, 'A', '2', '10', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency, xx.gyulje_jm_cd,
                    xx.seq, 1, xx.won_aek, w_com, p_proc_step, 'SYCP042', w_msg);
        if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
            p_msg   := w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

        if  xx.tr_cd = 'G33'    then
            UPDATE SYT0YG_PYUNGA
               SET napbu_ymd = p_ymd
             WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
               AND ymd         = p_ymd
               AND pyunga_join = xx.pyunga_join;
        end if;
    END LOOP;
    COMMIT;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    p_msg   := SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SYCP060 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- 해외 현금 유보 및 유보금 수령 처리
--
    w_tr_cd                      VARCHAR(3);
    w_jm_cd                      VARCHAR(12);

    w_aek                        NUMBER;

    w_msg                        VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --E83   외화 현금 유보 처리
    --E84   외화 현금 유보금액 수령처리
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- E83 분개처리
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                               /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                         /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                 /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                 /* _4- */
             , t1.gwamok                                                /* _5- */
             , t1.CURRENCY                                              /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.aek,0)                                 AS aek     /* _7- */
             , NVL(t1.won_aek,0)                             AS won_aek /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_seq                                                /* _9- */
             , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq     /* _10- */
          FROM SYT9MG t1
             , SZM0IA ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd       = 'E83'   /* 유보처리 */
           AND t1.tr_ymd      = p_ymd
           AND t1.aek_gb      IN ('1')  /* 해외배당 */
           AND NVL(t1.aek,0)  > 0
           AND ia.corp_gr     = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd     = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then    --원화기준가펀드
                w_aek   := xx.won_aek;
        else    w_aek   := xx.aek;            --외화기준가펀드
        end if;

        if  xx.gwamok = '12361' then    --당기 외화현금유보금
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E83', 'A', '1', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_seq, xx.seq, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP049 E83 01' || xx.fund_cd || '/' || xx.jm_cd, w_msg);

        elsif xx.gwamok = '12362'   then    --전기 외화현금유보금
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E83', 'A', '1', '11', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_seq, xx.seq, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP049 E83 11' || xx.fund_cd || '/' || xx.jm_cd, w_msg);
        else
            p_msg   := 'SYCP049 E83 계정:' || xx.gwamok || ' - ' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;

    END LOOP;

    -- E84 분개처리 (E83거래로 유보된 금액중 #???? 화면에 등록한 수령금액 처리)
    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT t1.fund_cd                                                      /* _1- */
             , ia.fund_currency                                                /* _2- */
             , t1.jm_cd                                                        /* _3- */
             , t1.tr_cd                                                        /* _4- */
             , t1.CURRENCY                                                     /* _5- */
             , NVL(t1.sanghw_aek,0)                          AS sanghw_aek     /* _6- */
             , NVL(t1.won_sanghw_aek,0)                      AS won_sanghw_aek /* _7- */
             , gg.gwamok                                                       /* _8- */
             , t1.tr_seq                                                       /* _9- */
             , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fund_cd
                                       ORDER BY t1.fund_cd)  AS seq            /* _10- */
          FROM SYT9MG_TR t1
             , SYT9MG    gg
             , SZM0IA    ia
         WHERE t1.corp_gr            = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.tr_cd              IN ('E84')  /* 유보분금액 중 수령금액 처리 */
           AND t1.sanghw_ymd         = p_ymd
           AND t1.aek_gb             IN ('1')
           AND NVL(t1.sanghw_aek,0)  > 0
           AND gg.corp_gr            = t1.corp_gr
           AND gg.fund_cd            = t1.fund_cd
           AND gg.tr_ymd             = t1.tr_ymd
           AND gg.jm_cd              = t1.jm_cd
           AND gg.tr_seq             = t1.tr_seq
           AND gg.aek_gb             = t1.aek_gb
           AND ia.corp_gr            = t1.corp_gr
           AND ia.fund_cd            = t1.fund_cd
    ) loop
        if  xx.fund_currency = 'KRW'    then    --원화기준가펀드
            w_aek   := xx.won_sanghw_aek;
