        else                                --외화기준가펀드
            w_aek   := xx.sanghw_aek;
        end if;

        if  xx.gwamok = '12361' then    --당기 외화현금유보금
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E83', 'A', '1', '01', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_seq, xx.seq, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP049 E84 01' || xx.fund_cd || '/' || xx.jm_cd, w_msg);

        elsif xx.gwamok = '12362'   then    --전기 외화현금유보금
            SR_SZSL010 (p_corp_gr, p_ymd, 'E83', 'A', '1', '11', xx.fund_cd, xx.fund_currency,
                        xx.jm_cd, xx.tr_seq, xx.seq, w_aek, p_proc_step, 'SYCP049 E84 11' || xx.fund_cd || '/' || xx.jm_cd, w_msg);
        else
            p_msg   := 'SYCP049 E84 계정:' || xx.gwamok || ' - ' || w_msg;
            RETURN;
        end if;
    END LOOP;

    commit;

    p_msg   := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    p_msg   := SUBSTR(sqlerrm,1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SYJ0IG (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR DEFAULT NULL
) AS
-- 해외채권 종목별 이자구간 생성
--
    w_ymd                        DATE;
    w_bf_ija_ymd                 DATE;
    w_af_ija_ymd                 DATE;

    w_cnt                        NUMBER;
    w_tot_ija_hoicha             NUMBER;
    w_gugan_ilsu                 NUMBER;
    w_all_gugan                  NUMBER;

    w_gugan_ija                  NUMBER;
    w_bok_ija                    NUMBER;
BEGIN
    if  p_jm_cd IS NOT NULL then
        DELETE FROM SYJ0IG
         WHERE corp_gr = p_corp_gr
           AND jm_cd   = p_jm_cd;
    end if;

    FOR xx IN (
        SELECT ROWID                              /* _1- */
             , jm_cd                              /* _2- */
             , balh_ymd                           /* _3- */
             , sanghw_ymd                         /* _4- */
             , NVL(ija_per / 100,0)  AS pyom_iyul /* _5- */
             , ija_dcf                            /* _6- */
             , yy_ija_hoisu                       /* _7- */
             , ija_jigub_gb                       /* _8- */
             , fst_ija_ymd                        /* _9- */
             , now_gugan_no                       /* _10- */
             , days_calc_gb                       /* _11- */
          FROM SYM0YA t1
         WHERE t1.corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.jm_cd    NOT IN (SELECT jm_cd
                                     FROM SYJ0IG ta
                                    WHERE ta.corp_gr = p_corp_gr)
           AND t1.jasan_gb = '2'
    ) loop
        w_bok_ija   := 0;
        if NVL (xx.yy_ija_hoisu,0) = 0  then    -- 년 이자회차가 없을경우 1회로 조정
            xx.yy_ija_hoisu := 1;
            UPDATE SYM0YA
               SET yy_ija_hoisu = xx.yy_ija_hoisu
             WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
        end if;

        w_tot_ija_hoicha    := trunc (months_between(xx.sanghw_ymd,xx.balh_ymd) / 12) + 1;
        if  xx.ija_jigub_gb IN ('1','Z')    then
                w_tot_ija_hoicha    := 1;   -- 할인채,PAPER
        else    w_tot_ija_hoicha    := w_tot_ija_hoicha * xx.yy_ija_hoisu;
        end if;

        -- 이자구간 생성
        w_ymd   := xx.balh_ymd;
        FOR w_cnt IN 1..w_tot_ija_hoicha LOOP
            -- 이자일수 계산
            w_bf_ija_ymd    := w_ymd;   -- 후이자일 계산
            -- 할인채
            if  w_cnt = 1 AND xx.fst_ija_ymd IS NOT NULL    then
                w_af_ija_ymd    := xx.fst_ija_ymd;
            else
                if  xx.ija_jigub_gb IN ('1','Z')    then
                        w_af_ija_ymd    := xx.sanghw_ymd;
                else    w_af_ija_ymd    := ADD_MONTHS(w_bf_ija_ymd, 12 / xx.yy_ija_hoisu);
                end if;
            end if;

            -- 이자계산
            SR_CLCIJAY (xx.ija_jigub_gb, xx.ija_dcf, xx.pyom_iyul, xx.yy_ija_hoisu, w_cnt, w_bok_ija, xx.balh_ymd, xx.sanghw_ymd, w_gugan_ija);

            w_gugan_ilsu    := F_DCF_ILSU (xx.ija_dcf, w_bf_ija_ymd, w_af_ija_ymd);
            if  w_af_ija_ymd >= xx.sanghw_ymd   then    -- 이표채 구간이 균등하지 않을경우 처리
                w_all_gugan     := w_gugan_ilsu;
                w_af_ija_ymd    := xx.sanghw_ymd;
                w_gugan_ilsu    := F_DCF_ILSU (xx.ija_dcf, w_bf_ija_ymd, w_af_ija_ymd);
                w_gugan_ija     := w_gugan_ija / w_all_gugan * w_gugan_ilsu;
            end if;

            if NVL (xx.days_calc_gb,'1') = '1'  then
                INSERT INTO SYJ0IG
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
                       , xx.jm_cd      /* _2- */
                       , w_cnt         /* _3- */
                       , w_gugan_ilsu  /* _4- */
                       , w_gugan_ija   /* _5- */
                       , xx.pyom_iyul  /* _6- */
                       , NULL          /* _7- */
                       , w_bf_ija_ymd  /* _8- */
                       , w_af_ija_ymd  /* _9- */
                       , NULL          /* _10- */
                       , NULL          /* _11- */
                       );
            else
                INSERT INTO SYJ0IG
                VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
                       , xx.jm_cd          /* _2- */
                       , w_cnt             /* _3- */
                       , w_gugan_ilsu      /* _4- */
                       , w_gugan_ija       /* _5- */
                       , xx.pyom_iyul      /* _6- */
                       , NULL              /* _7- */
                       , w_bf_ija_ymd      /* _8- */
                       , w_af_ija_ymd + 1  /* _9- */
                       , NULL              /* _10- */
                       , NULL              /* _11- */
                       );
            end if;

            if  p_ymd between w_bf_ija_ymd AND (w_af_ija_ymd - 1)   then    xx.now_gugan_no := w_cnt;
            end if;

            -- 복리채
            if  xx.ija_jigub_gb = '4'   then
                    w_bok_ija   := w_bok_ija + w_gugan_ija;
            else    w_bok_ija   := 0;
            end if;
            if  w_af_ija_ymd >= xx.sanghw_ymd   then    EXIT;
            end if;
            w_ymd   := w_af_ija_ymd;    -- 후이자일을 전이자일로 Set
        END LOOP;

        UPDATE SYM0YA
           SET now_gugan_no = xx.now_gugan_no
         WHERE ROWID = xx.rowid;
    END LOOP;
    commit;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SYT0TAX (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_seq                          IN    NUMBER,
    p_tr_co_cd                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_trustee                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_currency                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_tr_aek                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_won_tr_aek                   IN    NUMBER,
    p_tax_aek                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_won_tax_aek                  IN    NUMBER,
    p_gross_up_aek                 OUT   NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
) AS
-- GROSS-UP TAX 처리
--
    w_gross_up_rt                NUMBER;
    w_gross_up_tax               NUMBER;
    w_gross_up_aek               NUMBER;
BEGIN
    if NVL (p_tax_aek,0) != 0   then
        -- 외국납부세액과 국내세액 중 작은 금액으로
        SELECT trunc(gross_up_ija_tax_rt * p_won_tr_aek)
             , gross_up_ija_tax_rt
          INTO w_gross_up_tax
             , w_gross_up_rt
          FROM SZX0SB t1
         WHERE p_ymd Between t1.f_ymd AND t1.t_ymd;

        w_gross_up_aek  := LEAST (w_gross_up_tax, p_won_tax_aek);

        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO SYT0TAX
            VALUES ( p_corp_gr       /* _1- */
                   , p_ymd           /* _2- */
                   , p_ymd           /* _3- */
                   , p_tr_cd         /* _4- */
                   , p_fund_cd       /* _5- */
                   , p_seq           /* _6- */
                   , p_tr_co_cd      /* _7- */
                   , NULL            /* _8- */
                   , p_trustee       /* _9- */
                   , p_currency      /* _10- */
                   , NULL            /* _11- */
                   , NULL            /* _12- */
                   , NULL            /* _13- */
                   , NULL            /* _14- */
                   , p_tr_aek        /* _15- */
                   , p_won_tr_aek    /* _16- */
                   , p_tax_aek       /* _17- */
                   , p_won_tax_aek   /* _18- */
                   , w_gross_up_rt   /* _19- */
                   , w_gross_up_tax  /* _20- */
                   , w_gross_up_aek  /* _21- */
                   );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            p_msg   := p_ymd || ' ' || p_tr_cd || ' ' || p_fund_cd || ' ' || p_seq || ' ' || p_tr_co_cd;
            RETURN;
        END;
    else
        w_gross_up_aek  := 0;
    end if;
    p_gross_up_aek  := w_gross_up_aek;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SZSL010 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_work_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_upmu_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jasan_gb                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_currency                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_seq_no                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_chasu                        IN    NUMBER,
    p_aek                          IN    NUMBER,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_bigo                         IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 차대변 금액이 동일한 거래 1건 생성
--
    w_jasan_gb                     szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;
    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    p_msg := 'Y';
    if NVL (p_aek,0) = 0    then    RETURN;
    end if;

    BEGIN
        SELECT jasan_gb
          INTO w_jasan_gb
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = p_jasan_gb
           AND ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        w_jasan_gb := '[*]';
    END;

    INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
    SELECT p_corp_gr                           /* _1- */
         , p_ymd                               /* _2- */
         , p_work_gb                           /* _3- */
         , p_fund_cd                           /* _4- */
         , p_upmu_gb                           /* _5- */
         , p_tr_cd                             /* _6- */
         , p_jm_cd                             /* _7- */
         , p_seq_no                            /* _8- */
         , NVL(p_chasu,1)                      /* _9- */
         , row_no                              /* _10- */
         , chadae_gb                           /* _11- */
         , CASE WHEN p_fund_currency != 'KRW'
                     AND gwamok='10101' AND p_upmu_gb='1' THEN '10151'
                WHEN t1.GWAMOK LIKE '[%]'                 THEN F_GWAMOK_GG (t1.gwamok, p_jasan_gb)
                                                          ELSE gwamok
           END                                 /* _12- */
         , p_aek                               /* _13- */
         , jeokyo_cd                           /* _14- */
         , p_proc_step                         /* _15- */
         , '(' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || p_bigo  /* _16- */
         , p_fund_currency                     /* _17- */
      FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
       AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
       AND t1.jasan_gb = w_jasan_gb;
    if  sql%rowcount != 2   then
        p_msg := p_fund_cd || ',' || p_jm_cd || ',' || p_tr_cd || '(' || p_jasan_gb || ') szsl010 - 거래코드별 분개유형(9051) 확인(' || sql%rowcount || ')';
    end if;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg   := SUBSTR (p_tr_cd || '-' || p_work_gb || '-' || p_fund_cd || '-' || NVL(p_jm_cd,'') || '-' || p_seq_no || ',' || NVL(p_chasu,1) || ','
                               || F_NTRIM( p_aek, 0, 2 ) || '(' || p_upmu_gb || ',' || p_jasan_gb || ') - szsl010 분개 err(' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 9) || ')',1,180);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SZSL010_GWA (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_work_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_upmu_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jasan_gb                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_currency                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_seq_no                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_chasu                        IN    NUMBER,
    p_sonik                        IN    NUMBER,
    p_gwa_aek                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_bigo                         IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 손익 - 과표 분개
--
    w_bgwa_aek                     NUMBER;
    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    p_msg := 'Y';
    -- 손익과 과표손익 차이
    w_bgwa_aek := NVL (p_sonik, 0) - NVL (p_gwa_aek, 0);

    -- 손익 분개
    INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
    SELECT p_corp_gr                           /* _1- */
         , p_ymd                               /* _2- */
         , p_work_gb                           /* _3- */
         , p_fund_cd                           /* _4- */
         , p_upmu_gb                           /* _5- */
         , p_tr_cd                             /* _6- */
         , p_jm_cd                             /* _7- */
         , p_seq_no                            /* _8- */
         , NVL(p_chasu, 1)                     /* _9- */
         , row_no                              /* _10- */
         , chadae_gb                           /* _11- */
         , CASE WHEN p_fund_currency != 'KRW' AND gwamok='10101' AND p_upmu_gb='1'
                THEN '10151'
                ELSE gwamok END                /* _12- */
         , ABS(p_sonik)                        /* _13- */
         , jeokyo_cd                           /* _14- */
         , p_proc_step                         /* _15- */
         , '(' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || p_bigo  /* _16- */
         , p_fund_currency                     /* _17- */
      FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
     WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
       AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
       AND t1.jasan_gb = p_jasan_gb
       AND t1.row_no   = (CASE WHEN sign(p_sonik)= -1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END);
    if  sql%rowcount != 1   then
        p_msg := p_tr_cd || '(' || p_jasan_gb || ') 손익분개 szsl010_gwa - 9203 거래코드별 분개유형 확인(' || sql%rowcount || ')';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    -- 손익과 과표손익 차이  분개
    if NVL (w_bgwa_aek, 0) != 0     then
        INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
        SELECT p_corp_gr                           /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                               /* _2- */
             , p_work_gb                           /* _3- */
             , p_fund_cd                           /* _4- */
             , p_upmu_gb                           /* _5- */
             , p_tr_cd                             /* _6- */
             , p_jm_cd                             /* _7- */
             , p_seq_no                            /* _8- */
             , NVL(p_chasu, 1)                     /* _9- */
             , row_no                              /* _10- */
             , chadae_gb                           /* _11- */
             , gwamok                              /* _12- */
             , ABS(w_bgwa_aek)                     /* _13- */
             , jeokyo_cd                           /* _14- */
             , p_proc_step                         /* _15- */
             , '(' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || p_bigo  /* _16- */
             , p_fund_currency                     /* _17- */
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = p_jasan_gb
           AND t1.row_no   = (CASE WHEN sign(w_bgwa_aek)= -1 THEN 3
                                                            ELSE 4 END);
        if  sql%rowcount != 1   then
            p_msg := p_tr_cd || '(' || p_jasan_gb || ') 차액분개 szsl010_gwa - #9051 거래코드별 분개유형 확인(' || sql%rowcount || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end if;

    -- 과표손익 분개
    if NVL (p_gwa_aek, 0) != 0      then
        INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
        SELECT p_corp_gr                           /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                               /* _2- */
             , p_work_gb                           /* _3- */
             , p_fund_cd                           /* _4- */
             , p_upmu_gb                           /* _5- */
             , p_tr_cd                             /* _6- */
             , p_jm_cd                             /* _7- */
             , p_seq_no                            /* _8- */
             , NVL(p_chasu, 1)                     /* _9- */
             , row_no                              /* _10- */
             , chadae_gb                           /* _11- */
             , gwamok                              /* _12- */
             , ABS(p_gwa_aek)                      /* _13- */
             , jeokyo_cd                           /* _14- */
             , p_proc_step                         /* _15- */
             , '(' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || p_bigo  /* _16- */
             , p_fund_currency                     /* _17- */
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = p_jasan_gb
           AND t1.row_no   = (CASE WHEN sign(p_gwa_aek)= -1 THEN 5
                                                           ELSE 6 END);
        if  sql%rowcount != 1   then
            p_msg := p_tr_cd || '(' || p_jasan_gb || ') 과표분개 szsl010_gwa - #9051 거래코드별 분개유형 확인(' || sql%rowcount || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end if;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg   := p_tr_cd || '-' || p_work_gb || '-' || p_fund_cd || '-' || NVL (p_jm_cd, '') || '-' || p_seq_no || ',' || NVL (p_chasu,1) || ','
                       || '(' || p_upmu_gb || ',' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || NVL (w_bgwa_aek,0) || '/' || NVL (p_gwa_aek,0) || '- szsl010_gwa 분개 err(' || SUBSTR (sqlerrm, 1, 9) || ')';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SZSL011 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_work_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_upmu_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jasan_gb                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_currency                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_seq_no                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_chasu                        IN    NUMBER,
    p_aek                          IN    NUMBER,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_bigo                         IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 차대변 동일한 거래 1건 이면서 금액의 +/- 에 따라서 차.대변이 결정
--
    w_jasan_gb                     szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;
    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    p_msg := 'Y';
    if NVL (p_aek,0) = 0    then    RETURN;
    end if;

    BEGIN
        SELECT jasan_gb
          INTO w_jasan_gb
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = p_jasan_gb
           AND ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        w_jasan_gb := '[*]';
    END;

    if  p_aek > 0   then
        INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
        SELECT p_corp_gr                           /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                               /* _2- */
             , p_work_gb                           /* _3- */
             , p_fund_cd                           /* _4- */
             , p_upmu_gb                           /* _5- */
             , p_tr_cd                             /* _6- */
             , p_jm_cd                             /* _7- */
             , p_seq_no                            /* _8- */
             , NVL(p_chasu,1)                      /* _9- */
             , row_no                              /* _10- */
             , chadae_gb                           /* _11- */
             , CASE WHEN p_fund_currency != 'KRW'
                         AND gwamok='10101' AND p_upmu_gb='1' THEN '10151'
                    WHEN t1.GWAMOK LIKE '[%]'                 THEN F_GWAMOK_GG (t1.gwamok, p_jasan_gb)
                                                              ELSE gwamok
               END                                 /* _12- */
             , p_aek                               /* _13- */
             , jeokyo_cd                           /* _14- */
             , p_proc_step                         /* _15- */
             , '(' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || p_bigo  /* _16- */
             , p_fund_currency                     /* _17- */
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = w_jasan_gb
           AND t1.row_no   IN (1, 2);
    else
        INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
        SELECT p_corp_gr                           /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                               /* _2- */
             , p_work_gb                           /* _3- */
             , p_fund_cd                           /* _4- */
             , p_upmu_gb                           /* _5- */
             , p_tr_cd                             /* _6- */
             , p_jm_cd                             /* _7- */
             , p_seq_no                            /* _8- */
             , NVL(p_chasu,1)                      /* _9- */
             , row_no                              /* _10- */
             , chadae_gb                           /* _11- */
             , CASE WHEN p_fund_currency != 'KRW'
                         AND gwamok='10101' AND p_upmu_gb='1' THEN '10151'
                    WHEN t1.GWAMOK LIKE '[%]'                 THEN F_GWAMOK_GG (t1.gwamok, p_jasan_gb)
                                                              ELSE gwamok
               END                                 /* _12- */
             , - p_aek                             /* _13- */
             , jeokyo_cd                           /* _14- */
             , p_proc_step                         /* _15- */
             , '(' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || p_bigo  /* _16- */
             , p_fund_currency                     /* _17- */
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = w_jasan_gb
           AND t1.row_no   IN (3, 4);
    end if;
    if  sql%rowcount != 2   then
        p_msg   := p_fund_cd || ',' || p_jm_cd || ',' || p_tr_cd
                             || ',' || p_upmu_gb || '(' || p_jasan_gb
                             || ') szsl011 - 거래코드별 분개유형(9051) 확인(' || sql%rowcount || ') 금액' || p_aek;
    end if;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg   := p_tr_cd || '-' || p_work_gb || '-' || p_fund_cd || '-' || NVL (p_jm_cd,'')
                       || '-' || p_seq_no || ',' || NVL (p_chasu,1)
                       || '(' || p_jasan_gb || ',1-2 or 3-4) - szsl011 분개 err(' || SUBSTR (sqlerrm,1,9) || ')';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SZSL020 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_work_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_upmu_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jasan_gb                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_currency                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_seq_no                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_chasu                        IN    NUMBER,
    p_dr_aek                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_cr_aek                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_bigo                         IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 차대변 1건의 분개와 차이금액에 대한 분개
--
    w_jasan_gb                     szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;
    w_aek                          NUMBER;
    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    p_msg := 'Y';

    BEGIN
        SELECT jasan_gb
          INTO w_jasan_gb
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = p_jasan_gb
           AND ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        w_jasan_gb := '[*]';
    END;

    if NVL (p_dr_aek,0) != 0 OR NVL (p_cr_aek,0) != 0   then
        INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
        SELECT p_corp_gr                                  /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                                      /* _2- */
             , p_work_gb                                  /* _3- */
             , p_fund_cd                                  /* _4- */
             , p_upmu_gb                                  /* _5- */
             , p_tr_cd                                    /* _6- */
             , p_jm_cd                                    /* _7- */
             , p_seq_no                                   /* _8- */
             , NVL(p_chasu,1)                             /* _9- */
             , row_no                                     /* _10- */
             , chadae_gb                                  /* _11- */
             , CASE WHEN p_fund_currency != 'KRW'
                         AND gwamok='10101' AND p_upmu_gb='1' THEN '10151'
                    WHEN t1.GWAMOK LIKE '[%]'                 THEN F_GWAMOK_GG (t1.gwamok, p_jasan_gb)
                                                              ELSE gwamok
               END                                        /* _12- */
             , CASE WHEN chadae_gb='D' THEN p_dr_aek
                                       ELSE p_cr_aek END  /* _13- */
             , jeokyo_cd                                  /* _14- */
             , p_proc_step                                /* _15- */
             , '(' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || p_bigo         /* _16- */
             , p_fund_currency                            /* _17- */
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = w_jasan_gb
           AND t1.row_no   IN (1, 2)
           AND (CASE WHEN chadae_gb='D' THEN p_dr_aek
                                        ELSE p_cr_aek
                END) != 0;
        if (sql%rowcount != 2 AND NVL(p_dr_aek,0) != 0 AND NVL(p_cr_aek,0) != 0) OR sql%rowcount = 0    then
            p_msg   := p_fund_cd || ',' || p_jm_cd || ',' || p_tr_cd || '(' || p_jasan_gb
                                 || ') szsl020 - 거래코드별 분개유형(9051) 확인(' || sql%rowcount || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end if;

    w_aek := NVL (p_dr_aek,0) - NVL (p_cr_aek,0);
    if  sign (w_aek) != 0       then
        INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
        SELECT p_corp_gr                           /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                               /* _2- */
             , p_work_gb                           /* _3- */
             , p_fund_cd                           /* _4- */
             , p_upmu_gb                           /* _5- */
             , p_tr_cd                             /* _6- */
             , p_jm_cd                             /* _7- */
             , p_seq_no                            /* _8- */
             , NVL(p_chasu,1)                      /* _9- */
             , row_no                              /* _10- */
             , chadae_gb                           /* _11- */
             , CASE WHEN p_fund_currency != 'KRW'
                         AND gwamok='10101' AND p_upmu_gb='1' THEN '10151'
                    WHEN t1.GWAMOK LIKE '[%]'                 THEN F_GWAMOK_GG (t1.gwamok, p_jasan_gb)
                                                              ELSE gwamok
               END                                 /* _12- */
             , abs(w_aek)                          /* _13- */
             , jeokyo_cd                           /* _14- */
             , p_proc_step                         /* _15- */
             , '(' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || p_bigo  /* _16- */
             , p_fund_currency                     /* _17- */
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = w_jasan_gb
           AND t1.row_no   = (CASE sign(w_aek) WHEN 1  THEN 4
                                              WHEN -1 THEN 3 END);
        if  sql%rowcount != 1   then
            p_msg := p_tr_cd || '(' || p_jasan_gb || ') 차액분개 szsl020 - 9051 거래코드별 분개유형 확인(' || sql%rowcount || ')';
        end if;
    end if;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg   := p_tr_cd || '-' || p_work_gb || '-' || p_fund_cd || '-' || NVL (p_jm_cd,'')
                       || '-' || p_seq_no || ',' || NVL (p_chasu,1)
                       || '(' || p_jasan_gb || ') - szsl020 분개 err(' || SUBSTR (sqlerrm,1,9) || ')';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SZSL020_GWA (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_work_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_upmu_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jasan_gb                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_currency                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_seq_no                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_chasu                        IN    NUMBER,
    p_dr_aek                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_cr_aek                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_gwa_aek                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_bigo                         IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 차대변 1건분개, 차이금액에 대한 분개 및 과표손익
--
    w_aek                          NUMBER;
    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    p_msg := 'Y';

    if NVL (p_dr_aek, 0) != 0 OR NVL (p_cr_aek, 0) != 0     then
        INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
        SELECT p_corp_gr                                  /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                                      /* _2- */
             , p_work_gb                                  /* _3- */
             , p_fund_cd                                  /* _4- */
             , p_upmu_gb                                  /* _5- */
             , p_tr_cd                                    /* _6- */
             , p_jm_cd                                    /* _7- */
             , p_seq_no                                   /* _8- */
             , NVL(p_chasu, 1)                            /* _9- */
             , row_no                                     /* _10- */
             , chadae_gb                                  /* _11- */
             , CASE WHEN p_fund_currency != 'KRW' AND gwamok='10101' AND p_upmu_gb='1'
                    THEN '10151'
                    ELSE gwamok END                       /* _12- */
             , CASE WHEN chadae_gb='D' THEN p_dr_aek
                                       ELSE p_cr_aek END  /* _13- */
             , jeokyo_cd                                  /* _14- */
             , p_proc_step                                /* _15- */
             , '(' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || p_bigo         /* _16- */
             , p_fund_currency                            /* _17- */
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = p_jasan_gb
           AND t1.row_no   IN (1, 2)
           AND (CASE WHEN chadae_gb='D' THEN p_dr_aek
                                        ELSE p_cr_aek END) != 0;
        if (sql%rowcount != 2 AND NVL(p_dr_aek, 0) != 0 AND NVL(p_cr_aek, 0) != 0) OR sql%rowcount = 0  then
            p_msg   := p_fund_cd || ',' || p_jm_cd || ',' || p_tr_cd || '(' || p_jasan_gb
                                 || ') szsl020_gwa - 거래코드별 분개유형(9203) 확인(' || sql%rowcount || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end if;

    w_aek := (NVL(p_dr_aek, 0) - NVL(p_cr_aek, 0)) - NVL (p_gwa_aek, 0);
    if  sign (w_aek) != 0       then
        INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
        SELECT p_corp_gr                           /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                               /* _2- */
             , p_work_gb                           /* _3- */
             , p_fund_cd                           /* _4- */
             , p_upmu_gb                           /* _5- */
             , p_tr_cd                             /* _6- */
             , p_jm_cd                             /* _7- */
             , p_seq_no                            /* _8- */
             , NVL(p_chasu, 1)                     /* _9- */
             , row_no                              /* _10- */
             , chadae_gb                           /* _11- */
             , gwamok                              /* _12- */
             , abs(w_aek)                          /* _13- */
             , jeokyo_cd                           /* _14- */
             , p_proc_step                         /* _15- */
             , '(' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || p_bigo  /* _16- */
             , p_fund_currency                     /* _17- */
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = p_jasan_gb
           AND t1.row_no   = (CASE sign(w_aek) WHEN 1 THEN 4
                                              WHEN -1 THEN 3 END);
        if  sql%rowcount != 1   then
            p_msg := p_tr_cd || '(' || p_jasan_gb || ') 차액분개 szsl020_gwa - 9051 거래코드별 분개유형 확인(' || sql%rowcount || ')';
        end if;
    end if;

    if  sign (p_gwa_aek) != 0       then
        INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
        SELECT p_corp_gr                           /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                               /* _2- */
             , p_work_gb                           /* _3- */
             , p_fund_cd                           /* _4- */
             , p_upmu_gb                           /* _5- */
             , p_tr_cd                             /* _6- */
             , p_jm_cd                             /* _7- */
             , p_seq_no                            /* _8- */
             , NVL(p_chasu, 1)                     /* _9- */
             , row_no                              /* _10- */
             , chadae_gb                           /* _11- */
             , gwamok                              /* _12- */
             , abs(p_gwa_aek)                      /* _13- */
             , jeokyo_cd                           /* _14- */
             , p_proc_step                         /* _15- */
             , '(' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || p_bigo  /* _16- */
             , p_fund_currency                     /* _17- */
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = p_jasan_gb
           AND t1.row_no   = (CASE sign(p_gwa_aek) WHEN 1 THEN 6
                                                  WHEN -1 THEN 5 END);
        if  sql%rowcount != 1   then
            p_msg := p_tr_cd || '(' || p_jasan_gb || ') 차액분개 szsl020_gwa - 9051 거래코드별 분개유형 확인(' || sql%rowcount || ')';
        end if;
    end if;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg   := p_tr_cd || '-' || p_work_gb || '-' || p_fund_cd || '-' || NVL (p_jm_cd, '') || '-' || p_seq_no || ',' || NVL (p_chasu,1)
                       || '(' || p_jasan_gb || ') - szsl020_gwa 분개 err(' || SUBSTR (sqlerrm, 1, 9) || ')';
END;

        SELECT p_corp_gr                           /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                               /* _2- */
             , p_work_gb                           /* _3- */
             , p_fund_cd                           /* _4- */
             , p_upmu_gb                           /* _5- */

                                       ELSE p_cr_aek
               END                                 /* _13- */
             , jeokyo_cd                           /* _14- */
             , p_proc_step                         /* _15- */
             , '(' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || p_bigo  /* _16- */
             , p_fund_currency                     /* _17- */
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = w_jasan_gb
           AND t1.row_no   IN (1, 2)
           AND (CASE WHEN chadae_gb='D' THEN p_dr_aek
                                        ELSE p_cr_aek
                END) != 0;
        if (sql%rowcount != 2 AND NVL(p_dr_aek,0) != 0 AND NVL(p_cr_aek,0) != 0) OR sql%rowcount = 0    then
            p_msg   := p_fund_cd || ',' || p_jm_cd || ',' || p_tr_cd || '(' || p_jasan_gb
                                 || ') szsl021 - 거래코드별 분개유형(9051) 확인(' || sql%rowcount || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end if;

    w_aek := p_cr_aek - p_dr_aek;
    if  w_aek != 0  then
        INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
        SELECT p_corp_gr                           /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                               /* _2- */
             , p_work_gb                           /* _3- */
             , p_fund_cd                           /* _4- */
             , p_upmu_gb                           /* _5- */
             , p_tr_cd                             /* _6- */
             , p_jm_cd                             /* _7- */
             , p_seq_no                            /* _8- */
             , NVL(p_chasu,1)                      /* _9- */
             , row_no                              /* _10- */
             , chadae_gb                           /* _11- */
             , CASE WHEN p_fund_currency != 'KRW'
                         AND gwamok='10101' AND p_upmu_gb='1' THEN '10151'
                    WHEN t1.GWAMOK LIKE '[%]'                 THEN F_GWAMOK_GG (t1.gwamok, p_jasan_gb)
                                                              ELSE gwamok
               END                                 /* _12- */
             , CASE WHEN chadae_gb='D' THEN w_aek
                                       ELSE - w_aek
               END                                 /* _13- */
             , jeokyo_cd                           /* _14- */
             , p_proc_step                         /* _15- */
             , '(' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || p_bigo  /* _16- */
             , p_fund_currency                     /* _17- */
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = w_jasan_gb
           AND t1.row_no   IN (3, 4);
        if  sql%rowcount != 1   then
            p_msg := p_tr_cd || '(' || p_jasan_gb || ') 차액분개 szsl021 - 9051 거래코드별 분개유형 확인(' || sql%rowcount || ')';
        end if;
    end if;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg   := p_tr_cd || '-' || p_work_gb || '-' || p_fund_cd || '-' || NVL (p_jm_cd,'')
                       || '-' || p_seq_no || ',' || NVL (p_chasu,1)
                       || '(' || p_jasan_gb || ') - szsl021 분개 err(' || SUBSTR (sqlerrm,1,9) || ')';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SZSL022 (

    p_seq_no                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_chasu                        IN    NUMBER,

    p_aek2                         IN    NUMBER,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,

    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 2개 금액별 각각 분개처리
--
    w_jasan_gb                     szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;
    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    p_msg := 'Y';

    BEGIN
        SELECT jasan_gb
          INTO w_jasan_gb
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = p_jasan_gb
           AND ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        w_jasan_gb := '[*]';
    END;

    if NVL (p_aek1,0) != 0  then
        INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
        SELECT p_corp_gr                           /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                               /* _2- */
             , p_work_gb                           /* _3- */

             , row_no                              /* _10- */
             , chadae_gb                           /* _11- */
             , CASE WHEN p_fund_currency != 'KRW'
                         AND gwamok='10101' AND p_upmu_gb='1' THEN '10151'
                    WHEN t1.GWAMOK LIKE '[%]'                 THEN F_GWAMOK_GG (t1.gwamok, p_jasan_gb)
                                                              ELSE gwamok
               END                                 /* _12- */
             , p_aek1                              /* _13- */
             , jeokyo_cd                           /* _14- */
             , p_proc_step                         /* _15- */
             , '(' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || p_bigo  /* _16- */
             , p_fund_currency                     /* _17- */
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = w_jasan_gb
           AND t1.row_no   IN (1, 2);
        if  sql%rowcount != 2   then
            p_msg   := p_fund_cd || ',' || p_jm_cd || ',' || p_tr_cd || '(' || p_jasan_gb
                                 || ') szsl022 - 거래코드별 분개유형(9051) 확인(' || sql%rowcount || ')';
            RETURN;
        end if;
    end if;
    if NVL (p_aek2,0) != 0      then
        INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
        SELECT p_corp_gr                           /* _1- */
             , p_ymd                               /* _2- */
             , p_work_gb                           /* _3- */
             , p_fund_cd                           /* _4- */
             , p_upmu_gb                           /* _5- */
             , p_tr_cd                             /* _6- */
             , p_jm_cd                             /* _7- */
             , p_seq_no                            /* _8- */
             , NVL(p_chasu,1)                      /* _9- */
             , row_no                              /* _10- */
             , chadae_gb                           /* _11- */
             , CASE WHEN p_fund_currency != 'KRW'
                         AND gwamok='10101' AND p_upmu_gb='1' THEN '10151'
                    WHEN t1.GWAMOK LIKE '[%]'                 THEN F_GWAMOK_GG (t1.gwamok, p_jasan_gb)
                                                              ELSE gwamok
               END                                 /* _12- */
             , p_aek2                              /* _13- */
             , jeokyo_cd                           /* _14- */
             , p_proc_step                         /* _15- */
             , '(' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || p_bigo  /* _16- */
             , p_fund_currency                     /* _17- */
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = w_jasan_gb
           AND t1.row_no   IN (3, 4);
        if  sql%rowcount != 2   then
            p_msg   := p_fund_cd || ',' || p_jm_cd || ',' || p_tr_cd || '(' || p_jasan_gb
                                 || ') szsl022 - 거래코드별 분개유형(9051) 확인(' || sql%rowcount || ')';
        end if;
    end if;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg   := p_tr_cd || '-' || p_work_gb || '-' || p_fund_cd || '-' || NVL (p_jm_cd,'')
                       || '-' || p_seq_no || ',' || NVL (p_chasu,1)
                       || '(' || p_jasan_gb || ',12 or 34) - szsl022 분개 err(' || SUBSTR (sqlerrm,1,9) || ')';
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SZSL999 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_work_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_upmu_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jasan_gb                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_currency                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_seq_no                       IN    NUMBER,
    p_chasu                        IN    NUMBER,
    p_aek                          IN    number_varray_50,
    p_proc_step                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_bigo                         IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 복수개 분개
--
    w_jasan_gb                     szx0ga.jasan_gb%type;
    w_ii                           NUMBER   default 1;
    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    BEGIN
        SELECT jasan_gb
          INTO w_jasan_gb
          FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
           AND t1.jasan_gb = p_jasan_gb
           AND ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        w_jasan_gb := '[*]';
    END;

    LOOP
        if  NOT p_aek.EXISTS (w_ii) then
            EXIT;
        elsif NVL (p_aek(w_ii),0) != 0  then
            INSERT INTO SKT0BU tt   /* 분개장 */
            SELECT p_corp_gr                           /* _1- */
                 , p_ymd                               /* _2- */
                 , p_work_gb                           /* _3- */
                 , p_fund_cd                           /* _4- */
                 , p_upmu_gb                           /* _5- */
                 , p_tr_cd                             /* _6- */
                 , p_jm_cd                             /* _7- */
                 , p_seq_no                            /* _8- */
                 , NVL(p_chasu,1)                      /* _9- */
                 , row_no                              /* _10- */
                 , chadae_gb                           /* _11- */
                 , CASE WHEN p_fund_currency != 'KRW'
                             AND gwamok='10101' AND p_upmu_gb='1' THEN '10151'
                        WHEN t1.GWAMOK LIKE '[%]'                 THEN F_GWAMOK_GG (t1.gwamok, p_jasan_gb)
                                                                  ELSE gwamok
                   END                                 /* _12- */
                 , p_aek(w_ii)                         /* _13- */
                 , jeokyo_cd                           /* _14- */
                 , p_proc_step                         /* _15- */
                 , '(' || p_jasan_gb || ')' || p_bigo  /* _16- */
                 , p_fund_currency                     /* _17- */
              FROM SZX0GA t1  /* 거래코드별 분개유형 */
             WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
               AND t1.upmu_gb  = p_upmu_gb
               AND t1.jasan_gb = w_jasan_gb
               AND t1.row_no   = w_ii;
            if  sql%rowcount != 1   then
                p_msg   := p_fund_cd || ',' || p_jm_cd || ',' || p_tr_cd || '(' || p_jasan_gb || ',' || w_ii || ',' || p_aek(w_ii)
                                     || ') - 거래코드별 분개유형(9051) 확인';
                RETURN;
            end if;
        end if;
        w_ii := w_ii + 1;
    end loop;
    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg   := p_tr_cd || '-' || p_work_gb || '-' || p_upmu_gb || '-' || p_jasan_gb
                       || '-' || p_fund_cd || '-' || NVL (p_jm_cd,'') || '-' || p_seq_no || ',' || NVL (p_chasu,1)
                       || '(' || p_jasan_gb || ',' || TO_CHAR (w_ii) || ') - szsl999 분개 err(' || SUBSTR (sqlerrm,1,39) || ')';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_SZX1CK (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_chk_no                       IN    VARCHAR,
    p_chk_gb                       IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_currency                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_master_aek                   IN    NUMBER,
    p_ip_user                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ip_ymd                       IN    DATE
 ) AS
-- 마스타 검증 처리sub - update
--
    w_gwamok                       szx1ck.gwamok%type;
BEGIN
    BEGIN
        SELECT gwamok
          INTO w_gwamok
          FROM SZX0CK t1  /* 자가진단 점검 상대계정 */
         WHERE t1.gwamok IS NOT NULL
           AND t1.chk_no = p_chk_no
           AND t1.chk_gb = p_chk_gb;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        w_gwamok := p_chk_no || '-' || p_chk_gb;
    END;

    UPDATE SZX1CK tt    /* fund별 검증 자료 */
       SET master_aek = NVL(master_aek, 0) + NVL(p_master_aek, 0)
     WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
       AND fund_cd       = p_fund_cd
       AND fund_currency = p_fund_currency
       AND chk_no        = p_chk_no
       AND chk_gb        = p_chk_gb
       AND gwamok        = w_gwamok;
    if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
        INSERT INTO SZX1CK tt   /* fund별 검증 자료 */
             ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
             , chk_no         /* _2- */
             , chk_gb         /* _3- */
             , fund_cd        /* _4- */
             , fund_currency  /* _5- */
             , gwamok         /* _6- */
             , master_aek     /* _7- */
             , ip_user        /* _8- */
             , ip_ymd         /* _9- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
               , p_chk_no         /* _2- */
               , p_chk_gb         /* _3- */
               , p_fund_cd        /* _4- */
               , p_fund_currency  /* _5- */
               , w_gwamok         /* _6- */
               , p_master_aek     /* _7- */
               , p_ip_user        /* _8- */
               , p_ip_ymd         /* _9- */
               );
    end if;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_UPDAG (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,     /* 처리일자 */
    p_work_gb                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 작업구분('A'=결산외,'B'=결산) */
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 펀드코드 */
    p_fund_currency                IN    VARCHAR,
    p_gwamok                       IN    VARCHAR,  /* 계정과목 */
    p_chadae_gb                    IN    VARCHAR,  /* 차대구분('D'=차변,'C'=대변) */
    p_yonsan                       IN    NUMBER,   /* 연산구분('1'=합산,'-1'=감산) */
    p_aek                          IN    NUMBER,   /* 금액 */
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 분개장insert에 따른 총계정원장 갱신
--
    w_chadae_gb                    skm0ag.chadae_gb%type;   /* 총계정원장의 계정차대성격 */
    w_gwamok_gb                    szx0gm.gwamok_gb%type;
    w_dr_aek                       NUMBER;
    w_cr_aek                       NUMBER;
    w_find                         VARCHAR(01) := 'Y';
BEGIN
    BEGIN   /* 총계정원장의 해당계정 차대변금액 */
        SELECT chadae_gb
             , NVL(dr_aek,0)
             , NVL(cr_aek,0)
          INTO w_chadae_gb
             , w_dr_aek
             , w_cr_aek
          FROM SKM0AG t1  /* 총계정원장 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd       = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd           = p_ymd
           AND t1.work_gb       = p_work_gb
           AND t1.gwamok        = p_gwamok
           AND t1.fund_currency = p_fund_currency;
    EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
        w_find   := 'N';
        w_dr_aek := 0;
        w_cr_aek := 0;

        BEGIN
            SELECT gwamok_gb
              INTO w_gwamok_gb
              FROM SZX0GM t1  /* 계정과목 */
             WHERE t1.gwamok = p_gwamok;
        EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
            p_msg := '해당계정과목코드를 등록하십시요.';
            RETURN;
        END;
        if  w_gwamok_gb IN ('1','4')    then
                w_chadae_gb := 'D';
        else    w_chadae_gb := 'C';
        end if;
    END;

    -- 분개장의 차대구분에 따라 총계정의 차대금액 갱신
    if  p_chadae_gb = 'D'   then
            w_dr_aek := w_dr_aek + (NVL(p_aek,0) * p_yonsan);
    ELSE    w_cr_aek := w_cr_aek + (NVL(p_aek,0) * p_yonsan);
    end if;

    -- 총계정원장 갱신
    if  w_find = 'N'    then
        INSERT INTO SKM0AG tt   /* 총계정원장 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr        /* _1- */
               , p_ymd            /* _2- */
               , p_work_gb        /* _3- */
               , p_fund_cd        /* _4- */
               , p_gwamok         /* _5- */
               , w_chadae_gb      /* _6- */
               , 0                /* _7- */
               , w_dr_aek         /* _8- */
               , w_cr_aek         /* _9- */
               , p_fund_currency  /* _10- */
               );
    else
        UPDATE SKM0AG tt    /* 총계정원장 */
           SET dr_aek = w_dr_aek
             , cr_aek = w_cr_aek
         WHERE corp_gr       = p_corp_gr
           AND fund_cd       = p_fund_cd
           AND ymd           = p_ymd
           AND work_gb       = p_work_gb
           AND gwamok        = p_gwamok
           AND fund_currency = p_fund_currency;
    end if;
    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := 'updag... 오류 ';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_UPDJM (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_tr_jusu                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_lock_jusu                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_type_trench                  IN    VARCHAR,
    p_bs_type                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 주식종목 마스타 당일증감주수 update
--
    w_tr_dr_gb                     szx0gc.tr_dr_gb%type;

    jm_balh_co                     sjm0jm.balh_co%type;
    jm_woos_ilban_gb               sjm0jm.woos_ilban_gb%type;
    jm_chg_gb                      sjm0jm.chg_gb%type;
    jm_new_old_gb                  sjm0jm.new_old_gb%type;
    jm_danc_gb                     sjm0jm.danc_gb%type;
    jm_koscom_cd                   sjm0jm.koscom_cd%type;
    jb_sosok_gb                    sjx0jb.sosok_gb%type;
BEGIN
    /* 거래코드 거래증감구분 가져오기 */
    SR_GETGC (p_tr_cd, w_tr_dr_gb, p_msg);
    if  p_msg != 'Y' OR NVL (w_tr_dr_gb,'-') NOT IN ('1','2')   then
        p_msg := p_tr_cd || ' - 거래코드를 등록하십시요.';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    BEGIN
        SELECT t1.balh_co        /* _1- */
             , t1.woos_ilban_gb  /* _2- */
             , t1.chg_gb         /* _3- */
             , t1.new_old_gb     /* _4- */
             , t1.danc_gb        /* _5- */
             , t1.koscom_cd      /* _6- */
             , t2.sosok_gb       /* _7- */
          INTO jm_balh_co        /* _1- */
             , jm_woos_ilban_gb  /* _2- */
             , jm_chg_gb         /* _3- */
             , jm_new_old_gb     /* _4- */
             , jm_danc_gb        /* _5- */
             , jm_koscom_cd      /* _6- */
             , jb_sosok_gb       /* _7- */
          FROM SJM0JJ t1  /* 주식종목 */
             , SJX0JB t2  /* 발행기관 */
         WHERE t1.jm_cd   = p_jm_cd
           AND t2.balh_co = t1.balh_co;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := p_jm_cd || ' - 주식종목을 등록하십시요.(updjm)';
        RETURN;
    END;

    UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
       SET up_jusu   = CASE WHEN w_tr_dr_gb='1' THEN NVL(up_jusu,0) + NVL(p_tr_jusu,0) ELSE up_jusu END
         , dw_jusu   = CASE WHEN w_tr_dr_gb='2' THEN NVL(dw_jusu,0) + NVL(p_tr_jusu,0) ELSE dw_jusu END
         , lock_jusu = NVL(lock_jusu, 0) + NVL(p_lock_jusu, 0)
     WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
       AND fund_cd     = p_fund_cd
       AND jm_cd       = p_jm_cd
       AND ymd         = p_ymd
       AND bs_type     = p_bs_type
       AND type_trench = p_type_trench;
    if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
        INSERT INTO SJM0JM tt   /* 주식 보유현황 */
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr         /* _1- */
               , p_ymd             /* _2- */
               , p_fund_cd         /* _3- */
               , p_jm_cd           /* _4- */
               , 0                 /* _5- */
               , CASE WHEN w_tr_dr_gb='1' THEN p_tr_jusu
                 END               /* _6- */
               , CASE WHEN w_tr_dr_gb='2' THEN p_tr_jusu
                 END               /* _7- */
               , 0                 /* _8- */
               , 0                 /* _9- */
               , 0                 /* _10- */
               , 0                 /* _11- */
               , 0                 /* _12- */
               , 0                 /* _13- */
               , 0                 /* _14- */
               , 0                 /* _15- */
               , 0                 /* _16- */
               , 0                 /* _17- */
               , jm_koscom_cd      /* _18- */
               , jm_balh_co        /* _19- */
               , 0                 /* _20- */
               , 0                 /* _21- */
               , 0                 /* _22- */
               , 0                 /* _23- */
               , jm_woos_ilban_gb  /* _24- */
               , jm_chg_gb         /* _25- */
               , jm_new_old_gb     /* _26- */
               , jm_danc_gb        /* _27- */
               , NULL              /* _28- */
               , p_lock_jusu       /* _29- */
               , 0                 /* _30- */
               , 0                 /* _31- */
               , 0                 /* _32- */
               , 0                 /* _33- */
               , p_type_trench     /* _34- */
               , p_bs_type         /* _35- */
               , NULL              /* _36- */
               , NULL              /* _37- */
               , NULL              /* _38- */
               , NULL              /* _39- */
               , NULL              /* _40- */
               , NULL              /* _41- */
               , NULL              /* _42- */

               , NULL              /* _45- */

               , NULL              /* _47- */
               , NULL              /* _48- */
               );
    end if;
    p_msg := 'Y';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
    p_msg := 'updjm:' || SUBSTR (sqlerrm, 1, 80);
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_UPDJM2 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_bs_type                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_type_trench                  IN    VARCHAR,
    p_gyul_aek                     IN    NUMBER,
    p_ggyul_aek                    IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 주식종목 마스타 당일증감 취득가 update
--
    gc_tr_dr_gb                    szx0gc.tr_dr_gb%type;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    /* 거래코드 거래증감구분 가져오기 */
    SR_GETGC (p_tr_cd, gc_tr_dr_gb, w_msg);
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;

    UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
       SET up_chui_aek = CASE WHEN gc_tr_dr_gb='1'                             THEN NVL(up_chui_aek,0) + p_gyul_aek ELSE up_chui_aek END
         , dw_chui_aek = CASE WHEN gc_tr_dr_gb='2'                             THEN NVL(dw_chui_aek,0) + p_gyul_aek ELSE dw_chui_aek END
         , gup_aek     = CASE WHEN NVL(p_ggyul_aek,0) != 0 AND gc_tr_dr_gb='1' THEN NVL(gup_aek,0) + p_ggyul_aek    ELSE gup_aek     END
         , gdw_aek     = CASE WHEN NVL(p_ggyul_aek,0) != 0 AND gc_tr_dr_gb='2' THEN NVL(gdw_aek,0) + p_ggyul_aek    ELSE gdw_aek     END
     WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
       AND fund_cd     = p_fund_cd
       AND jm_cd       = p_jm_cd
       AND ymd         = p_ymd
       AND bs_type     = p_bs_type
       AND type_trench = p_type_trench;
    if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
            p_msg := p_fund_cd || '-' || p_jm_cd || '- 주식마스타 등록이 안됐습니다.';
    else    p_msg := 'Y';
    end if;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_UPDJM4 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_tr_jusu                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_type_trench                  IN    VARCHAR,
    p_bs_type                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 주식종목 마스타 공개매수할당수량 update
--
    jm_qty                         NUMBER;
BEGIN
    /* 현재 공개매수할당수량  가져오기 */
    BEGIN
        SELECT NVL(mesu_hald_jusu,0)
          INTO jm_qty
          FROM SJM0JM t1  /* 주식 보유현황 */
         WHERE t1.corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
           AND t1.fund_cd     = p_fund_cd
           AND t1.ymd         = p_ymd
           AND t1.jm_cd       = p_jm_cd
           AND t1.type_trench = p_type_trench
           AND t1.bs_type     = p_bs_type;
    EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
        p_msg := p_fund_cd || '-' || p_jm_cd || '- 주식종목마스타에 등록되지 않았습니다.(updjm4)';
        RETURN;
    END;

    if NVL (p_tr_jusu,0) + NVL (jm_qty,0) < 0   then
        p_msg := '공개매수수량이 현 운용가능 주식수량을 초과합니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    UPDATE SJM0JM tt    /* 주식 보유현황 */
       SET mesu_hald_jusu = NVL(mesu_hald_jusu, 0) + NVL(p_tr_jusu, 0)
     WHERE corp_gr     = p_corp_gr
       AND fund_cd     = p_fund_cd
       AND jm_cd       = p_jm_cd
       AND ymd         = p_ymd
       AND type_trench = p_type_trench
       AND bs_type     = p_bs_type;

    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_UPDKM2 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_sj_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_chasu                        IN    NUMBER,
    p_sm_tr_gb                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_tr_co_cd                     IN    VARCHAR,
    p_gyul_ga                      IN    NUMBER,
    p_dw_jungsan_ga                IN    NUMBER,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 선물 마스타 당일증감 취득가,계약액 update
--
    gc_tr_dr_gb                    szx0gc.tr_dr_gb%type;

    w_msg                          VARCHAR(200);
BEGIN
    -- 거래코드 거래증감구분 가져오기
    SR_GETGC (p_tr_cd, gc_tr_dr_gb, w_msg);
    if  w_msg != 'Y'    then
        p_msg := w_msg;
        RETURN;
    end if;
    if  gc_tr_dr_gb IS NULL then
        p_msg := p_tr_cd || ' - 거래증감을 입력하십시오.';
        RETURN;
    end if;

    UPDATE SSM0KM tt    /* 파생 보유현황 */
       SET up_chui_ga    = CASE WHEN gc_tr_dr_gb='1' THEN NVL(up_chui_ga,0) + p_gyul_ga ELSE up_chui_ga END
         , dw_chui_ga    = CASE WHEN gc_tr_dr_gb='2' THEN NVL(dw_chui_ga,0) + p_gyul_ga ELSE dw_chui_ga END
         , dang_mm_sonik = NVL(dang_mm_sonik,0) + p_dw_jungsan_ga
     WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
       AND ymd      = p_ymd
       AND sj_cd    = p_sj_cd
       AND chasu    = p_chasu
       AND sm_tr_gb = p_sm_tr_gb
       AND tr_co_cd = p_tr_co_cd;
    if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
        p_msg := p_fund_cd || '-' || p_sj_cd || '- 선물마스타 등록이 안됐습니다.';
        RETURN;
    end if;
    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_UPDKM9 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,     /* 처리일자 */
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,  /* 펀드 */
    p_tr_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,  /* 거래코드 */
    p_sj_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,  /* 선물종목 */
    p_chasu                        IN    NUMBER,   /* 차수 */
    p_gyey_su                      IN    NUMBER,   /* 계약수 */
    p_tr_co_cd                     IN    VARCHAR,  /* 매매처 */
    p_iud_gb                       IN    VARCHAR,
    p_msg                          OUT   VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- 선물마스타 당일 계약수  update (sst0kt trigger 에서 사용 : 선물거래 Table)
--
    w_sm_tr_gb                     ssm0km.sm_tr_gb%type;
    w_up_dw_gb                     VARCHAR(1);

    w_up_gyey_su                   NUMBER := 0;
    w_dw_gyey_su                   NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
    BEGIN
        SELECT sebu_cd_enm
          INTO w_sm_tr_gb
          FROM SZX0GR t1  /* 그룹코드 */
         WHERE t1.gr_cd   = 'B4'
           AND t1.sebu_cd = p_tr_cd;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := p_tr_cd || '-그룹코드 등록(9001 szx0gr:B4)';
        RETURN;
    END;
    BEGIN
        SELECT tr_dr_gb
          INTO w_up_dw_gb
          FROM SZX0GC t1  /* 거래코드 */
         WHERE t1.tr_cd    = p_tr_cd
           AND t1.tr_dr_gb IN ('1','2');
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN 
        p_msg := p_tr_cd || '-거래코드 등록(9051 szx0gc)';
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- 증가및 감소 구분
    if  w_up_dw_gb = '1'    then
            w_up_gyey_su := p_gyey_su;
    else    w_dw_gyey_su := p_gyey_su;
    end if;

    -- 선물마스타에 Update 처리
    UPDATE SSM0KM tt    /* 파생 보유현황 */
       SET up_gyey_su = NVL(up_gyey_su, 0) + w_up_gyey_su
         , dw_gyey_su = NVL(dw_gyey_su, 0) + w_dw_gyey_su
         , tr_co_cd   = p_tr_co_cd
     WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
       AND ymd      = p_ymd
       AND sj_cd    = p_sj_cd
       AND chasu    = p_chasu
       AND sm_tr_gb = w_sm_tr_gb
       AND tr_co_cd = p_tr_co_cd;
    if  sql%rowcount = 0    then
        INSERT INTO SSM0KM tt   /* 파생 보유현황 */
             ( corp_gr        /* _1- */
             , ymd            /* _2- */
             , fund_cd        /* _3- */
             , sj_cd          /* _4- */
             , chasu          /* _5- */
             , sm_tr_gb       /* _6- */
             , tr_co_cd       /* _7- */
             , org_tr_ymd     /* _8- */
             , pass_gyey_su   /* _9- */
             , up_gyey_su     /* _10- */
             , dw_gyey_su     /* _11- */
             , pass_chui_ga   /* _12- */
             , up_chui_ga     /* _13- */
             , dw_chui_ga     /* _14- */
             , pyunga_sonik   /* _15- */
             , pyunga_tr_cha  /* _16- */
             , audit_gb       /* _17- */
             )
        VALUES ( p_corp_gr     /* _1- */
               , p_ymd         /* _2- */
               , p_fund_cd     /* _3- */
               , p_sj_cd       /* _4- */
               , p_chasu       /* _5- */
               , w_sm_tr_gb    /* _6- */
               , p_tr_co_cd    /* _7- */
               , p_ymd         /* _8- */
               , 0             /* _9- */
               , w_up_gyey_su  /* _10- */
               , w_dw_gyey_su  /* _11- */
               , 0             /* _12- */
               , 0             /* _13- */
               , 0             /* _14- */
               , 0             /* _15- */
               , 0             /* _16- */
               , 'p'           /* _17- */
               );
    end if;

    -- 선물마스타 삭제 : 매입매도약정이면서 Delete,
    --                   원계약일과 같으며 약정한날에 반대매매없을경우 매입,매도삭제면 Mstr 도 삭제
    if (w_up_dw_gb='1') AND (p_iud_gb='d')  then
        DELETE FROM SSM0KM tt   /* 파생 보유현황 */
         WHERE corp_gr              = p_corp_gr
           AND org_tr_ymd           = p_ymd
           AND fund_cd              = p_fund_cd
           AND ymd                  = p_ymd
           AND sj_cd                = p_sj_cd
           AND chasu                = p_chasu
           AND sm_tr_gb             = w_sm_tr_gb
           AND tr_co_cd             = p_tr_co_cd
           AND NVL(pass_gyey_su, 0) = 0
           AND NVL(up_gyey_su, 0)   = 0
           AND NVL(dw_gyey_su, 0)   = 0;
    end if;
    p_msg := 'Y';
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE KFP.SR_UPDMST1 (
    p_corp_gr                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_ymd                          IN    DATE,
    p_fund_cd                      IN    VARCHAR,
    p_jm_cd                        IN    VARCHAR,
    p_buy_date                     IN    VARCHAR
 ) AS
-- sr_updmst1  : 채권전부매도/전부전환시 마스타 갱신
--              (채권마스타/선매출마스타/이자구간 정리)
--
BEGIN
    UPDATE SCM0CM tt    /* 채권 보유현황 */
       SET anbun_aek     = 0
         , misu_ija      = 0
         , pr_misu_ija   = 0
         , sung_cost     = 0
         , pr_sung_cost  = 0
         , sung_tax      = 0
         , pr_sung_tax   = 0
         , yesu_tax      = 0
         , pr_yesu_tax   = 0
         , pyunga_aek    = 0
         , bany_suik_rt  = 0
         , day_ija       = 0
         , pr_day_ija    = 0
         , sc_day_ija    = 0
         , day_anbun_aek = 0
     WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
       AND jm_cd    = p_jm_cd
       AND buy_date = p_buy_date
       AND ymd      = p_ymd;

    UPDATE SCM0SC tt    /* 채권 선매출이자현황 */
       SET misu_ija  = 0
         , sung_cost = 0
         , sung_tax  = 0
         , yesu_tax  = 0
         , day_ija   = 0
         , gugan_ija = 0
     WHERE corp_gr  = p_corp_gr
       AND fund_cd  = p_fund_cd
       AND jm_cd    = p_jm_cd
       AND buy_date = p_buy_date
       AND ymd      = p_ymd;
END;
/
